	internal class ParserStack<T>
	{
		public T[] array = new T[1];

		public int top;

		public void Push(T value)
		{
			if (top >= array.Length)
			{
				T[] destinationArray = new T[array.Length * 2];
				Array.Copy(array, destinationArray, top);
				array = destinationArray;
			}
			array[top++] = value;
		}

		public T Pop()
		{
			return array[--top];
		}

		public T Top()
		{
			return array[top - 1];
		}

		public bool IsEmpty()
		{
			return top == 0;
		}
	}
	internal class Rule

		{

			this.rhs = rhs;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class ShiftReduceParser<YYSTYPE, YYLTYPE> where YYSTYPE : struct where YYLTYPE : IMerge<YYLTYPE>
	{
		public bool Trace;

		public AScanner<YYSTYPE, YYLTYPE> scanner;

		protected YYSTYPE yyval;

		protected YYLTYPE yyloc;

		protected YYLTYPE lastL;

		private int next;

		private State current_state;

		private bool recovering;

		private int tokensSinceLastError;

		private ParserStack<State> state_stack = new ParserStack<State>();

		protected ParserStack<YYSTYPE> value_stack = new ParserStack<YYSTYPE>();

		protected ParserStack<YYLTYPE> location_stack = new ParserStack<YYLTYPE>();

		protected string[] nonTerminals;

		protected State[] states;

		protected Rule[] rules;

		protected int errToken;

		protected int eofToken;

		protected abstract void Initialize();

		public bool Parse()
		{
			Initialize();
			next = 0;
			current_state = states[0];
			state_stack.Push(current_state);
			value_stack.Push(yyval);
			location_stack.Push(yyloc);
			while (true)
			{
				if (Trace)
				{
					Console.Error.WriteLine("Entering state {0} ", current_state.num);
				}
				int num = current_state.defaultAction;
				if (current_state.parser_table != null)
				{
					if (next == 0)
					{
						if (Trace)
						{
							Console.Error.Write("Reading a token: ");
						}
						lastL = scanner.yylloc;
						next = scanner.yylex();
					}
					if (Trace)
					{
						Console.Error.WriteLine("Next token is {0}", TerminalToString(next));
					}
					if (current_state.parser_table.ContainsKey(next))
					{
						num = current_state.parser_table[next];
					}
				}
				if (num > 0)
				{
					Shift(num);
				}
				else if (num < 0)
				{
					Reduce(-num);
					if (num == -1)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				else if (num == 0 && !ErrorRecovery())
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected void Shift(int state_nr)
		{
			if (Trace)
			{
				Console.Error.Write("Shifting token {0}, ", TerminalToString(next));
			}
			current_state = states[state_nr];
			value_stack.Push(scanner.yylval);
			state_stack.Push(current_state);
			location_stack.Push(scanner.yylloc);
			if (recovering)
			{
				if (next != errToken)
				{
					tokensSinceLastError++;
				}
				if (tokensSinceLastError > 5)
				{
					recovering = false;
				}
			}
			if (next != eofToken)
			{
				next = 0;
			}
		}

		protected void Reduce(int rule_nr)
		{
			if (Trace)
			{
				DisplayRule(rule_nr);
			}
			Rule rule = rules[rule_nr];
			if (rule.rhs.Length == 1)
			{
				yyval = value_stack.Top();
			}
			else
			{
				yyval = new YYSTYPE();
			}
			if (rule.rhs.Length == 1)
			{
				yyloc = location_stack.Top();
			}
			else if (rule.rhs.Length == 0)
			{
				object obj;
				if (scanner.yylloc == null)
				{
					obj = default(YYLTYPE);
				}
				else
				{
					ref YYLTYPE yylloc = ref scanner.yylloc;
					YYLTYPE last = lastL;
					obj = yylloc.Merge(last);
				}
				yyloc = (YYLTYPE)obj;
			}
			else
			{
				YYLTYPE val = location_stack.array[location_stack.top - rule.rhs.Length];
				YYLTYPE val2 = location_stack.Top();
				if (val != null && val2 != null)
				{
					yyloc = val.Merge(val2);
				}
			}
			DoAction(rule_nr);
			for (int i = 0; i < rule.rhs.Length; i++)
			{
				state_stack.Pop();
				value_stack.Pop();
				location_stack.Pop();
			}
			if (Trace)
			{
				DisplayStack();
			}
			current_state = state_stack.Top();
			if (current_state.Goto.ContainsKey(rule.lhs))
			{
				current_state = states[current_state.Goto[rule.lhs]];
			}
			state_stack.Push(current_state);
			value_stack.Push(yyval);
			location_stack.Push(yyloc);
		}

		protected abstract void DoAction(int action_nr);

		public bool ErrorRecovery()
		{
			if (!recovering)
			{
				ReportError();
			}
			if (!FindErrorRecoveryState())
			{
				return false;
			}
			ShiftErrorToken();
			bool result = DiscardInvalidTokens();
			recovering = true;
			tokensSinceLastError = 0;
			return result;
		}

		public void ReportError()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.AppendFormat("syntax error, unexpected {0}", TerminalToString(next));
			if (current_state.parser_table.Count < 7)
			{
				bool flag = true;
				foreach (int key in current_state.parser_table.Keys)
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(", expecting ");
					}
					else
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(", or ");
					}
					stringBuilder.Append(TerminalToString(key));
					flag = false;
				}
			}
			scanner.yyerror(stringBuilder.ToString());
		}

		public void ShiftErrorToken()
		{
			int num = next;
			next = errToken;
			Shift(current_state.parser_table[next]);
			if (Trace)
			{
				Console.Error.WriteLine("Entering state {0} ", current_state.num);
			}
			next = num;
		}

		public bool FindErrorRecoveryState()
		{
			while (true)
			{
				if (current_state.parser_table != null && current_state.parser_table.ContainsKey(errToken) && current_state.parser_table[errToken] > 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (Trace)
				{
					Console.Error.WriteLine("Error: popping state {0}", state_stack.Top().num);
				}
				state_stack.Pop();
				value_stack.Pop();
				location_stack.Pop();
				if (Trace)
				{
					DisplayStack();
				}
				if (state_stack.IsEmpty())
				{
					break;
				}
				current_state = state_stack.Top();
			}
			if (Trace)
			{
				Console.Error.Write("Aborting: didn't find a state that accepts error token");
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool DiscardInvalidTokens()
		{
			int num = current_state.defaultAction;
			if (current_state.parser_table != null)
			{
				while (true)
				{
					if (next == 0)
					{
						if (Trace)
						{
							Console.Error.Write("Reading a token: ");
						}
						next = scanner.yylex();
					}
					if (Trace)
					{
						Console.Error.WriteLine("Next token is {0}", TerminalToString(next));
					}
					if (next == eofToken)
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (current_state.parser_table.ContainsKey(next))
					{
						num = current_state.parser_table[next];
					}
					if (num != 0)
					{
						break;
					}
					if (Trace)
					{
						Console.Error.WriteLine("Error: Discarding {0}", TerminalToString(next));
					}
					next = 0;
				}
				return true;
			}
			if (recovering && tokensSinceLastError == 0)
			{
				if (Trace)
				{
					Console.Error.WriteLine("Error: panic discard of {0}", TerminalToString(next));
				}
				next = 0;
				return true;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected void yyclearin()
		{
			next = 0;
		}

		protected void yyerrok()
		{
			recovering = false;
		}

		protected void AddState(int statenr, State state)
		{
			states[statenr] = state;
			state.num = statenr;
		}

		private void DisplayStack()
		{
			Console.Error.Write("State now");
			for (int i = 0; i < state_stack.top; i++)
			{
				Console.Error.Write(" {0}", state_stack.array[i].num);
			}
			Console.Error.WriteLine();
		}

		private void DisplayRule(int rule_nr)
		{
			Console.Error.Write("Reducing stack by rule {0}, ", rule_nr);
			DisplayProduction(rules[rule_nr]);
		}

		private void DisplayProduction(Rule rule)
		{
			if (rule.rhs.Length == 0)
			{
				Console.Error.Write("/* empty */ ");
			}
			else
			{
				int[] rhs = rule.rhs;
				foreach (int symbol in rhs)
				{
					Console.Error.Write("{0} ", SymbolToString(symbol));
				}
			}
			Console.Error.WriteLine("-> {0}", SymbolToString(rule.lhs));
		}

		protected abstract string TerminalToString(int terminal);

		private string SymbolToString(int symbol)
		{
			if (symbol < 0)
			{
				return nonTerminals[-symbol];
			}
			return TerminalToString(symbol);
		}

		protected string CharToString(char ch)
		{
			return ch switch
			{
				'\a' => "'\\a'", 
				'\b' => "'\\b'", 
				'\f' => "'\\f'", 
				'\n' => "'\\n'", 
				'\r' => "'\\r'", 
				'\t' => "'\\t'", 
				'\v' => "'\\v'", 
				'\0' => "'\\0'", 
				_ => string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "'{0}'", ch), 
			};
		}
	}
	internal class State
	{
		public int num;

		public Dictionary<int, int> parser_table;

		public Dictionary<int, int> Goto;

		public int defaultAction;

		public State(int[] actions, int[] gotos)
			: this(actions)
		{
			Goto = new Dictionary<int, int>();
			for (int i = 0; i < gotos.Length; i += 2)
			{
				Goto.Add(gotos[i], gotos[i + 1]);
			}
		}

		public State(int[] actions)
		{
			parser_table = new Dictionary<int, int>();
			for (int i = 0; i < actions.Length; i += 2)
			{
				parser_table.Add(actions[i], actions[i + 1]);
			}
		}

		public State(int defaultAction)
		{
			this.defaultAction = defaultAction;
		}

		public State(int defaultAction, int[] gotos)
			: this(defaultAction)
		{
			Goto = new Dictionary<int, int>();
			for (int i = 0; i < gotos.Length; i += 2)
			{
				Goto.Add(gotos[i], gotos[i + 1]);
			}
		}
	}

	{
		public static readonly Task<TResult> Default;

		static CompletedTask()
		{
			TaskCompletionSource<TResult> taskCompletionSource = new TaskCompletionSource<TResult>();

	[DebuggerTypeProxy(typeof(QueuedTaskSchedulerDebugView))]

	internal sealed class QueuedTaskScheduler : TaskScheduler, IDisposable
	{
		private class QueuedTaskSchedulerDebugView
		{
			private QueuedTaskScheduler _scheduler;

			public IEnumerable<Task> ScheduledTasks
			{
				get
				{
					IEnumerable<Task> enumerable;
					if (_scheduler._targetScheduler == null)
					{
						IEnumerable<Task> blockingTaskQueue = _scheduler._blockingTaskQueue;
						enumerable = blockingTaskQueue;
					}
					else
					{
						IEnumerable<Task> blockingTaskQueue = _scheduler._nonthreadsafeTaskQueue;
						enumerable = blockingTaskQueue;
					}
					IEnumerable<Task> source = enumerable;
					return source.Where((Task t) => t != null).ToList();
				}
			}

			public IEnumerable<TaskScheduler> Queues
			{
				get
				{
					List<TaskScheduler> list = new List<TaskScheduler>();
					foreach (KeyValuePair<int, QueueGroup> queueGroup in _scheduler._queueGroups)
					{
						list.AddRange(queueGroup.Value);
					}
					return list;
				}
			}

			public QueuedTaskSchedulerDebugView(QueuedTaskScheduler scheduler)
			{
				if (scheduler == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("scheduler");
				}
				_scheduler = scheduler;
			}
		}

		private class QueueGroup : List<QueuedTaskSchedulerQueue>
		{
			public int NextQueueIndex;

			public IEnumerable<int> CreateSearchOrder()
			{
				for (int i = NextQueueIndex; i < base.Count; i++)
				{
					yield return i;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < NextQueueIndex; i++)
				{
					yield return i;
				}
			}
		}

		[DebuggerDisplay("QueuePriority = {_priority}, WaitingTasks = {WaitingTasks}")]
		[DebuggerTypeProxy(typeof(QueuedTaskSchedulerQueueDebugView))]
		private sealed class QueuedTaskSchedulerQueue : TaskScheduler, IDisposable
		{
			private sealed class QueuedTaskSchedulerQueueDebugView
			{
				private readonly QueuedTaskSchedulerQueue _queue;

				public int Priority => _queue._priority;

				public int Id => _queue.Id;

				public IEnumerable<Task> ScheduledTasks => _queue.GetScheduledTasks();

				public QueuedTaskScheduler AssociatedScheduler => _queue._pool;

				public QueuedTaskSchedulerQueueDebugView(QueuedTaskSchedulerQueue queue)
				{
					if (queue == null)
					{
						throw new ArgumentNullException("queue");
					}
					_queue = queue;
				}
			}

			private readonly QueuedTaskScheduler _pool;

			internal readonly Queue<Task> _workItems;

			internal bool _disposed;

			internal int _priority;

			public override int MaximumConcurrencyLevel => _pool.MaximumConcurrencyLevel;

			internal QueuedTaskSchedulerQueue(int priority, QueuedTaskScheduler pool)
			{
				_priority = priority;
				_pool = pool;
				_workItems = new Queue<Task>();
			}

			protected override IEnumerable<Task> GetScheduledTasks()
			{
				return _workItems.ToList();
			}

			protected override void QueueTask(Task task)
			{
				if (_disposed)
				{
					throw new ObjectDisposedException(GetType().Name);
				}
				lock (_pool._queueGroups)
				{
					_workItems.Enqueue(task);
				}
				_pool.NotifyNewWorkItem();
			}

			protected override bool TryExecuteTaskInline(Task task, bool taskWasPreviouslyQueued)
			{
				if (_taskProcessingThread.Value)
				{
					return TryExecuteTask(task);
				}
				return false;
			}

			internal void ExecuteTask(Task task)
			{
				TryExecuteTask(task);
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
				if (_disposed)
				{
					return;
				}
				lock (_pool._queueGroups)
				{
					if (_workItems.Count == 0)
					{
						_pool.RemoveQueue_NeedsLock(this);
					}
				}
				_disposed = true;
			}
		}

		private readonly SortedList<int, QueueGroup> _queueGroups = new SortedList<int, QueueGroup>();

		private readonly CancellationTokenSource _disposeCancellation = new CancellationTokenSource();

		private readonly int _concurrencyLevel;

		private static ThreadLocal<bool> _taskProcessingThread = new ThreadLocal<bool>();

		private readonly TaskScheduler _targetScheduler;

		private readonly Queue<Task> _nonthreadsafeTaskQueue;

		private int _delegatesQueuedOrRunning;

		private readonly Thread[] _threads;

		private readonly BlockingCollection<Task> _blockingTaskQueue;

		public override int MaximumConcurrencyLevel => _concurrencyLevel;

		public QueuedTaskScheduler()
			: this(TaskScheduler.Default, 0)
		{
		}

		public QueuedTaskScheduler(TaskScheduler targetScheduler)
			: this(targetScheduler, 0)
		{
		}

		public QueuedTaskScheduler(TaskScheduler targetScheduler, int maxConcurrencyLevel)
		{
			if (targetScheduler == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("underlyingScheduler");
			}
			if (maxConcurrencyLevel < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("concurrencyLevel");
			}
			_targetScheduler = targetScheduler;
			_nonthreadsafeTaskQueue = new Queue<Task>();
			_concurrencyLevel = ((maxConcurrencyLevel != 0) ? maxConcurrencyLevel : Environment.ProcessorCount);
			if (targetScheduler.MaximumConcurrencyLevel > 0 && targetScheduler.MaximumConcurrencyLevel < _concurrencyLevel)
			{
				_concurrencyLevel = targetScheduler.MaximumConcurrencyLevel;
			}
		}

		public QueuedTaskScheduler(int threadCount)
			: this(threadCount, string.Empty)
		{
		}

		public QueuedTaskScheduler(int threadCount, string threadName = "", bool useForegroundThreads = false, ThreadPriority threadPriority = ThreadPriority.Normal, ApartmentState threadApartmentState = ApartmentState.MTA, int threadMaxStackSize = 0, Action threadInit = null, Action threadFinally = null)
		{
			QueuedTaskScheduler queuedTaskScheduler = this;
			if (threadCount < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("concurrencyLevel");
			}
			if (threadCount == 0)
			{
				_concurrencyLevel = Environment.ProcessorCount;
			}
			else
			{
				_concurrencyLevel = threadCount;
			}
			_blockingTaskQueue = new BlockingCollection<Task>();
			_threads = new Thread[threadCount];
			for (int i = 0; i < threadCount; i++)
			{
				_threads[i] = new Thread((ThreadStart)delegate
				{
					queuedTaskScheduler.ThreadBasedDispatchLoop(threadInit, threadFinally);
				}, threadMaxStackSize)
				{
					Priority = threadPriority,
					IsBackground = !useForegroundThreads
				};
				if (threadName != null)
				{
					_threads[i].Name = threadName + " (" + i + ")";
				}
				_threads[i].SetApartmentState(threadApartmentState);
			}
			Thread[] threads = _threads;
			foreach (Thread thread in threads)
			{
				thread.Start();
			}
		}

		private void ThreadBasedDispatchLoop(Action threadInit, Action threadFinally)
		{
			_taskProcessingThread.Value = true;
			threadInit?.Invoke();
			try
			{
				while (true)
				{
					try
					{
						foreach (Task item in _blockingTaskQueue.GetConsumingEnumerable(_disposeCancellation.Token))
						{
							if (item != null)
							{
								TryExecuteTask(item);
								continue;
							}
							Task targetTask;
							QueuedTaskSchedulerQueue queueForTargetTask;
							lock (_queueGroups)
							{
								FindNextTask_NeedsLock(out targetTask, out queueForTargetTask);
							}
							if (targetTask != null)
							{
								queueForTargetTask.ExecuteTask(targetTask);
							}
						}
					}
					catch (ThreadAbortException)
					{
						if (!Environment.HasShutdownStarted && !AppDomain.CurrentDomain.IsFinalizingForUnload())
						{
							Thread.ResetAbort();
						}
					}
				}
			}
			catch (OperationCanceledException)
			{
			}
			finally
			{
				threadFinally?.Invoke();
				_taskProcessingThread.Value = false;
			}
		}

		private void FindNextTask_NeedsLock(out Task targetTask, out QueuedTaskSchedulerQueue queueForTargetTask)
		{
			targetTask = null;
			queueForTargetTask = null;
			foreach (KeyValuePair<int, QueueGroup> queueGroup in _queueGroups)
			{
				QueueGroup value = queueGroup.Value;
				foreach (int item in value.CreateSearchOrder())
				{
					queueForTargetTask = value[item];
					Queue<Task> workItems = queueForTargetTask._workItems;
					if (workItems.Count > 0)
					{
						targetTask = workItems.Dequeue();
						if (queueForTargetTask._disposed && workItems.Count == 0)
						{
							RemoveQueue_NeedsLock(queueForTargetTask);
						}
						value.NextQueueIndex = (value.NextQueueIndex + 1) % queueGroup.Value.Count;
						return;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void QueueTask(Task task)
		{
			if (_disposeCancellation.IsCancellationRequested)
			{
				throw new ObjectDisposedException(GetType().Name);
			}
			if (_targetScheduler == null)
			{
				_blockingTaskQueue.Add(task);
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			lock (_nonthreadsafeTaskQueue)
			{
				_nonthreadsafeTaskQueue.Enqueue(task);
				if (_delegatesQueuedOrRunning < _concurrencyLevel)
				{
					_delegatesQueuedOrRunning++;
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				Task.Factory.StartNew(ProcessPrioritizedAndBatchedTasks, CancellationToken.None, TaskCreationOptions.None, _targetScheduler);
			}
		}

		private void ProcessPrioritizedAndBatchedTasks()
		{
			bool flag = true;
			while (!_disposeCancellation.IsCancellationRequested && flag)
			{
				try
				{
					_taskProcessingThread.Value = true;
					while (!_disposeCancellation.IsCancellationRequested)
					{
						Task targetTask;
						lock (_nonthreadsafeTaskQueue)
						{
							if (_nonthreadsafeTaskQueue.Count == 0)
							{
								break;
							}
							targetTask = _nonthreadsafeTaskQueue.Dequeue();
							goto IL_0055;
						}
						IL_0055:
						QueuedTaskSchedulerQueue queueForTargetTask = null;
						if (targetTask == null)
						{
							lock (_queueGroups)
							{
								FindNextTask_NeedsLock(out targetTask, out queueForTargetTask);
							}
						}
						if (targetTask != null)
						{
							if (queueForTargetTask != null)
							{
								queueForTargetTask.ExecuteTask(targetTask);
							}
							else
							{
								TryExecuteTask(targetTask);
							}
						}
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					lock (_nonthreadsafeTaskQueue)
					{
						if (_nonthreadsafeTaskQueue.Count == 0)
						{
							_delegatesQueuedOrRunning--;
							flag = false;
							_taskProcessingThread.Value = false;
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void NotifyNewWorkItem()
		{
			QueueTask(null);
		}

		protected override bool TryExecuteTaskInline(Task task, bool taskWasPreviouslyQueued)
		{
			if (_taskProcessingThread.Value)
			{
				return TryExecuteTask(task);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<Task> GetScheduledTasks()
		{
			if (_targetScheduler == null)
			{
				return _blockingTaskQueue.Where((Task t) => t != null).ToList();
			}
			return _nonthreadsafeTaskQueue.Where((Task t) => t != null).ToList();
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			_disposeCancellation.Cancel();
		}

		public TaskScheduler ActivateNewQueue()
		{
			return ActivateNewQueue(0);
		}

		public TaskScheduler ActivateNewQueue(int priority)
		{
			QueuedTaskSchedulerQueue queuedTaskSchedulerQueue = new QueuedTaskSchedulerQueue(priority, this);
			lock (_queueGroups)
			{
				if (!_queueGroups.TryGetValue(priority, out var value))
				{
					value = new QueueGroup();
					_queueGroups.Add(priority, value);
				}
				value.Add(queuedTaskSchedulerQueue);
				return queuedTaskSchedulerQueue;
			}
		}

		private void RemoveQueue_NeedsLock(QueuedTaskSchedulerQueue queue)
		{
			QueueGroup queueGroup = _queueGroups[queue._priority];
			int num = queueGroup.IndexOf(queue);
			if (queueGroup.NextQueueIndex >= num)
			{
				queueGroup.NextQueueIndex--;
			}
			queueGroup.RemoveAt(num);
		}
	}

namespace System.Threading.Async

	internal sealed class AsyncCache<TKey, TValue>
	{
		private readonly Func<TKey, Task<TValue>> valueFactory;

		private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<TKey, Lazy<Task<TValue>>> map;

		public Task<TValue> this[TKey key] => map.GetOrAdd(key, (TKey toAdd) => new Lazy<Task<TValue>>(() => valueFactory(toAdd))).Value;

		public AsyncCache(Func<TKey, Task<TValue>> valueFactory)
		{
			this.valueFactory = valueFactory;
			map = new ConcurrentDictionary<TKey, Lazy<Task<TValue>>>();
		}

		public bool TryRemoveKey(TKey key)
		{
			Lazy<Task<TValue>> value;
			return map.TryRemove(key, out value);
		}
	}
	[DebuggerDisplay("Count={CurrentCount}")]
	internal sealed class AsyncProducerConsumerCollection<T> : IDisposable
	{
		private AsyncSemaphore _semaphore = new AsyncSemaphore();

		private IProducerConsumerCollection<T> _collection;

		public int Count => _collection.Count;

		public AsyncProducerConsumerCollection()
			: this((IProducerConsumerCollection<T>)new ConcurrentQueue<T>())
		{
		}

		public AsyncProducerConsumerCollection(IProducerConsumerCollection<T> collection)
		{
			if (collection == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("collection");
			}
			_collection = collection;
		}

		public void Add(T item)
		{
			if (_collection.TryAdd(item))
			{
				_semaphore.Release();
				return;
			}
			throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid collection");
		}

		public Task<T> Take()
		{
			return _semaphore.WaitAsync().ContinueWith(delegate
			{
				if (!_collection.TryTake(out var item))
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid collection");
				}
				return item;
			}, TaskContinuationOptions.OnlyOnRanToCompletion | TaskContinuationOptions.ExecuteSynchronously);
		}

		public void CancelAllExisting()
		{
			_semaphore.CancelAllExisting();
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (_semaphore != null)
			{
				_semaphore.Dispose();
				_semaphore = null;
			}
		}
	}
	[DebuggerDisplay("CurrentCount={CurrentCount}, MaximumCount={MaximumCount}, WaitingCount={WaitingCount}")]
	internal sealed class AsyncSemaphore : IDisposable
	{
		private int _currentCount;

		private int _maxCount;

		private Queue<TaskCompletionSource<object>> _waitingTasks;

		public int CurrentCount => _currentCount;

		public int MaximumCount => _maxCount;

		public int WaitingCount
		{
			get
			{
				lock (_waitingTasks)
				{
					return _waitingTasks.Count;
				}
			}
		}

		public AsyncSemaphore()
			: this(0)
		{
		}

		public AsyncSemaphore(int initialCount)
			: this(initialCount, int.MaxValue)
		{
		}

		public AsyncSemaphore(int initialCount, int maxCount)
		{
			if (maxCount <= 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("maxCount");
			}
			if (initialCount > maxCount || initialCount < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("initialCount");
			}
			_currentCount = initialCount;
			_maxCount = maxCount;
			_waitingTasks = new Queue<TaskCompletionSource<object>>();
		}

		public Task WaitAsync()
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			lock (_waitingTasks)
			{
				if (_currentCount > 0)
				{
					_currentCount--;
					return CompletedTask.Default;
				}
				TaskCompletionSource<object> taskCompletionSource = new TaskCompletionSource<object>();
				_waitingTasks.Enqueue(taskCompletionSource);
				return taskCompletionSource.Task;
			}
		}

		public Task Queue(Action action)
		{
			return WaitAsync().ContinueWith(delegate
			{
				try
				{
					action();
				}
				finally
				{
					Release();
				}
			});
		}

		public Task<TResult> Queue<TResult>(Func<TResult> function)
		{
			return WaitAsync().ContinueWith(delegate
			{
				try
				{
					return function();
				}
				finally
				{
					Release();
				}
			});
		}

		public void Release()
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			TaskCompletionSource<object> taskCompletionSource = null;
			lock (_waitingTasks)
			{
				if (_currentCount == _maxCount)
				{
					throw new SemaphoreFullException();
				}
				if (_waitingTasks.Count > 0)
				{
					taskCompletionSource = _waitingTasks.Dequeue();
				}
				else
				{
					_currentCount++;
				}
			}
			taskCompletionSource?.SetResult(null);
		}

		public void CancelAllExisting()
		{
			List<TaskCompletionSource<object>> list = new List<TaskCompletionSource<object>>();
			lock (_waitingTasks)
			{
				while (_waitingTasks.Count > 0)
				{
					list.Add(_waitingTasks.Dequeue());
				}
			}
			list.ForEach(delegate(TaskCompletionSource<object> task)
			{
				task.TrySetCanceled();
			});
		}

		private void ThrowIfDisposed()
		{
			if (_maxCount <= 0)
			{
				throw new ObjectDisposedException(GetType().Name);
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (_maxCount <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			_maxCount = 0;
			lock (_waitingTasks)
			{
				while (_waitingTasks.Count > 0)
				{
					_waitingTasks.Dequeue().SetCanceled();
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

	internal sealed class AmqpRelay : IConnectionStatus, ITraceSource
	{
		private sealed class ConnectTask
		{
			private readonly AmqpRelay relay;

			private readonly bool isReconnect;

			private TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper;

			public ConnectTask(AmqpRelay relay, bool isReconnect, TimeSpan timeout)
			{
				this.relay = relay;
				this.isReconnect = isReconnect;
				timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateOnly(timeout);
			}

			public async Task Start()
			{
				_ = 10;
				try
				{
					TimeSpan timeSpan = ConnectDelayIntervals[relay.connectDelayIndex];
					if (timeSpan != TimeSpan.Zero)
					{
						await AsyncIOTask.Delay(timeSpan).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					}
					lock (relay.ThisLock)
					{
						if (relay.State != AmqpObjectState.OpenReceived && relay.State != AmqpObjectState.Opened)
						{
							return;
						}
					}
					if (isReconnect)
					{
						ServiceBusEventSource.Log.Info(relay, "Listener: Reconnecting, Uri: " + relay.TrackingContext.SystemTracker, "ConnectTask.Start", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\AmqpRelay\\AmqpRelay.cs", 340);
					}
					SecurityToken token = await relay.tokenRenewer.GetTokenAsync(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime()).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					string hostName = relay.serviceBusUri.Host;
					AmqpSettings amqpSettings = CreateAmqpSettings();
					ConnectivityMode mode = relay.connectivitySettings.Mode;
					TransportBase transport = null;
					if (mode == ConnectivityMode.Tcp)
					{
						string host = await relay.connectivitySettings.ResolveDnsAsync("amqps", hostName, 5671).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						TcpTransportSettings innerSettings = new TcpTransportSettings
						{
							Host = host,
							Port = 5671
						};
						TlsTransportSettings transportSettings = new TlsTransportSettings(innerSettings)
						{
							TargetHost = hostName
						};
						AmqpTransportInitiator amqpTransportInitiator = new AmqpTransportInitiator(amqpSettings, transportSettings);
						transport = await amqpTransportInitiator.ConnectTaskAsync(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime()).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					}
					else if (mode == ConnectivityMode.Http || mode == ConnectivityMode.Https || relay.httpConnectivitySettings != null)
					{
						Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Amqp.Transport.WebSocketTransportSettings webSocketTransportSettings = new Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Amqp.Transport.WebSocketTransportSettings(relay.serviceBusUri, "wsrelayedamqp");
						webSocketTransportSettings.ConnectivitySettings = relay.connectivitySettings;

			}

		private static readonly TimeSpan[] ConnectDelayIntervals = new TimeSpan[6]

			TimeSpan.Zero,
			TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1.0),

		public string DisplayName { get; set; }

		public AmqpRelay(Uri serviceBusUri, TokenProvider tokenProvider, ConnectivitySettings connectivitySettings, HttpConnectivitySettings httpConnectivitySettings, TransportClientEndpointBehavior transportBehavior, TrackingContext trackingContext)
		{
			this.serviceBusUri = serviceBusUri;
			this.transportBehavior = transportBehavior;
			TrackingContext = trackingContext ?? TrackingContext.Create(serviceBusUri);
			traceSource = GetType().Name;
			tokenRenewer = new TokenRenewer(tokenProvider, this.serviceBusUri.AbsoluteUri, "Listen", this);
			RelayClientAuthorizationRequired = true;
			IsDynamic = true;
			State = AmqpObjectState.Start;
			ListenerType = ListenerType.RelayedConnection;
			onAmqpLinkClosed = OnAmqpLinkClosed;
			this.connectivitySettings = connectivitySettings ?? ServiceBusEnvironment.SystemConnectivity;
			this.httpConnectivitySettings = httpConnectivitySettings;
			ClientAgent = "ServiceBus/" + FileVersion + ";";
		}

		public async Task OpenAsync(TimeSpan openTimeout)
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (State != AmqpObjectState.Start)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException();
				}
				State = AmqpObjectState.OpenReceived;
			}
			await new ConnectTask(this, isReconnect: false, openTimeout).Start().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			tokenRenewer.TokenRenewed += OnTokenRenewed;
			State = AmqpObjectState.Opened;
		}

		public Task CloseAsync(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				switch (State)
				{
				case AmqpObjectState.OpenReceived:
				case AmqpObjectState.Opened:
					State = AmqpObjectState.CloseReceived;
					break;
				case AmqpObjectState.CloseReceived:
				case AmqpObjectState.End:
					return CompletedTask.Default;
				default:
					throw new InvalidOperationException();
				}
			}
			return CloseOrAbortAsync(aborting: false, timeout);
		}

		public void Abort()
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				AmqpObjectState state = State;
				if ((uint)(state - 11) <= 1u)
				{
					return;
				}
				State = AmqpObjectState.CloseReceived;
			}
			CloseOrAbortAsync(aborting: true, TimeSpan.Zero).Fork();
		}

		public void RegisterMessageListener(Action<DuplexAmqpLink, AmqpMessage> newListener)
		{
			if (Interlocked.Exchange(ref messageListener, newListener) != null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.MessageListenerAlreadyRegistered);
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return traceSource;
		}

		private async Task CloseOrAbortAsync(bool aborting, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			if (tokenRenewer != null)
			{
				tokenRenewer.Close();
			}
			AmqpConnection amqpConnection = connection;
			if (amqpConnection != null)
			{
				if (!aborting)
				{
					await amqpConnection.CloseAsync(timeout).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				else
				{
					amqpConnection.SafeClose();
				}
			}
			State = AmqpObjectState.End;
		}

		private void OnAmqpLinkClosed(object sender, EventArgs args)
		{
			DuplexAmqpLink duplexAmqpLink = (DuplexAmqpLink)sender;
			duplexAmqpLink.Closed -= onAmqpLinkClosed;
			Exception exception = duplexAmqpLink.TerminalException ?? duplexAmqpLink.SendingLink.Session.TerminalException ?? duplexAmqpLink.SendingLink.Session.Connection.TerminalException ?? new ConnectionLostException("The connection to the connect service was lost.");
			exception = AmqpExceptionHelper.ToRelayContract(exception);
			OnDisconnected(exception);
		}

		private void OnOnline()
		{
			ServiceBusEventSource.Log.Info(this, $"Listener: Online. ListenerType: {ListenerType}, Uri: {TrackingContext.SystemTracker}", "OnOnline", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\AmqpRelay\\AmqpRelay.cs", 221);
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (IsOnline)
				{
					return;
				}
				LastError = null;
				IsOnline = true;
				connectDelayIndex = -1;
			}
			this.Online?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		private void OnDisconnected(Exception lastError)
		{
			AmqpConnection amqpConnection;
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (lastError != null && (State == AmqpObjectState.OpenReceived || State == AmqpObjectState.Opened))
				{
					LastError = lastError;
				}
				if (connectDelayIndex < ConnectDelayIntervals.Length - 1)
				{
					connectDelayIndex++;
				}
				amqpConnection = connection;
				connection = null;
				IsOnline = false;
			}
			amqpConnection?.SafeClose();
			if (lastError is RelayNotFoundException || lastError is AddressAlreadyInUseException || lastError is AuthorizationFailedException || State != AmqpObjectState.Opened)
			{
				ServiceBusEventSource.Log.Info(this, "Listener: Stopped connecting, Uri: " + TrackingContext.SystemTracker, "OnDisconnected", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\AmqpRelay\\AmqpRelay.cs", 269);
				if (tokenRenewer != null)
				{
					tokenRenewer.Close();
				}
				this.Offline?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
			else
			{
				this.Connecting?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
				new ConnectTask(this, isReconnect: true, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(120.0)).Start().Fork();
			}
		}

		private void OnTokenRenewed(object sender, TokenEventArgs args)
		{
			DuplexAmqpLink duplexAmqpLink = link;
			if (duplexAmqpLink != null)
			{
				string tokenString = TokenProviderUtility.GetTokenString(args.Token);
				Fields fields = new Fields { 
				{
					AmqpConstants.SimpleWebTokenPropertyName,
					tokenString
				} };
				duplexAmqpLink.SendProperties(fields);
			}
		}

		private static string LookupFileVersion()
		{
			Assembly executingAssembly = Assembly.GetExecutingAssembly();
			AssemblyFileVersionAttribute assemblyFileVersionAttribute = (AssemblyFileVersionAttribute)executingAssembly.GetCustomAttributes(typeof(AssemblyFileVersionAttribute), inherit: true)[0];
			return assemblyFileVersionAttribute.Version;
		}
	}

	public class AzureActiveDirectoryTokenProvider : TokenProvider
	{
		public delegate Task<string> AuthenticationCallback(string audience, string authority, object state);

		private const int DefaultCacheSize = 100;

		private readonly string authority;

		private readonly string audience;

		private readonly string clientId;

		private readonly object authCallbackState;

		private event AuthenticationCallback AuthCallback;

		internal AzureActiveDirectoryTokenProvider(AuthenticationCallback authenticationCallback, Uri audience, string authority, object state)
			: base(cacheTokens: true, supportHttpAuthToken: true, 100, TokenScope.Entity)
		{
			clientId = Guid.NewGuid().ToString();
			this.audience = audience.ToString();
			this.AuthCallback = authenticationCallback;
			this.authority = authority;
			authCallbackState = state;
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginGetToken(string appliesTo, string action, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return GetTokenAsync().ToAsyncResult(callback, state);
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginGetWebToken(string appliesTo, string action, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return GetTokenAsync().ToAsyncResult(callback, state);
		}

		protected override SecurityToken OnEndGetToken(IAsyncResult result, out DateTime cacheUntil)
		{
			JsonSecurityToken jsonSecurityToken = TaskHelpers.EndAsyncResult<JsonSecurityToken>(result);
			cacheUntil = jsonSecurityToken.ValidTo.ToUniversalTime();
			return jsonSecurityToken;
		}

		protected override string OnEndGetWebToken(IAsyncResult result, out DateTime cacheUntil)
		{
			JsonSecurityToken jsonSecurityToken = TaskHelpers.EndAsyncResult<JsonSecurityToken>(result);
			cacheUntil = jsonSecurityToken.ValidTo.ToUniversalTime();
			return "Bearer " + jsonSecurityToken.Token;
		}

		protected override Key BuildKey(string appliesTo, string action)
		{
			return new Key(clientId, string.Empty);
		}

		private async Task<JsonSecurityToken> GetTokenAsync()
		{
			return new JsonSecurityToken(await this.AuthCallback(audience, authority, authCallbackState).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false));
		}
	}
	public class IoTTokenProvider : SharedAccessSignatureTokenProvider
	{
		private readonly byte[] messagingEncodedSharedAccessKey;

		internal IoTTokenProvider(string keyName, string sharedAccessKey, TimeSpan tokenTimeToLive)
			: base(keyName, sharedAccessKey, Constants.IoTTokenProviderKeyEncoder, tokenTimeToLive, TokenScope.Entity)
		{
			messagingEncodedSharedAccessKey = Constants.MessagingTokenProviderKeyEncoder(sharedAccessKey);

		protected override string BuildSignature(string targetUri)
		{
			if (Uri.IsWellFormedUriString(targetUri, UriKind.Absolute))
			{
				Uri endpoint = new Uri(targetUri);
				if (!endpoint.IsIoTDeviceUri())
				{
					return SharedAccessSignatureBuilder.BuildSignature(keyName, messagingEncodedSharedAccessKey, targetUri, tokenTimeToLive);
				}
			}
			return SharedAccessSignatureBuilder.BuildSignature(keyName, encodedSharedAccessKey, targetUri, tokenTimeToLive);
		}

	internal class ContinuationToken
	{
		public bool IsValid { get; private set; }

		public string NextPartition { get; private set; }

		public int Skip { get; private set; }

		public string Token { get; private set; }

		public ContinuationToken(string nextPartition, int skip)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(nextPartition))
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("nextPartition");
			}
			NextPartition = nextPartition;
			Skip = skip;
			Token = ToBase64UriEscapeString(nextPartition + ";" + skip.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
			IsValid = true;
		}

		public ContinuationToken(string continuationTokenString)
		{
			IsValid = false;
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(continuationTokenString))
			{
				IsValid = true;
				return;
			}
			string text = FromBase64UriEscapeString(continuationTokenString);
			if (text == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			string[] array = text.Split(';');
			if (array.Length == 2)
			{
				NextPartition = array[0];
				int result = 0;
				if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(array[1]) && !int.TryParse(array[1], out result))
				{
					result = 0;
				}
				Skip = result;
				Token = continuationTokenString;
				IsValid = true;
			}
		}

		private static string ToBase64UriEscapeString(string value)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return Uri.EscapeDataString(Convert.ToBase64String(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(value)));
		}

		private static string FromBase64UriEscapeString(string base64Value)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(base64Value))
			{
				return null;
			}
			try
			{
				return Encoding.UTF8.GetString(Convert.FromBase64String(Uri.UnescapeDataString(base64Value)));
			}
			catch (ArgumentNullException)
			{
				return null;
			}
			catch (FormatException)
			{
				return null;
			}
		}
	}

		private int bytesRead;

		public byte[] AsyncReadBuffer { get; private set; }

		public int AsyncReadBufferSize { get; private set; }

		public Uri Uri { get; private set; }

		public EventTraceActivity Activity => TrackingContext.Activity;

		public ClientWebSocketConnection(ServiceBusClientWebSocket webSocket, int asyncReadBufferSize, Uri uri)
		{
			this.webSocket = webSocket;

			AsyncReadBufferSize = asyncReadBufferSize;

		public void Abort()
		{
			ServiceBusEventSource.Log.WebSocketConnectionAborted(Uri.AbsoluteUri);

				}
				catch (Exception exception) when (!Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					ServiceBusEventSource.Log.HandledException(exception, this, EventLevel.Warning, "Abort", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\SocketConnection\\ClientWebSocketConnection.cs", 71);
				}
			}
		}

		public int Read(byte[] buffer, int offset, int size, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			ThrowIfNotOpen();
			ConnectionUtilities.ValidateBufferBounds(buffer, offset, size);
			if (timeout <= TimeSpan.Zero)
			{
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new TimeoutException(TrackingContext.CreateTrackableErrorMessage(SR.GetString(Resources.TimeoutOnRequest, timeout))), this, EventLevel.Warning, "Read", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\SocketConnection\\ClientWebSocketConnection.cs", 194);
			}
			try
			{
				if (asyncReadBufferOffset > 0)
				{
					Fx.AssertAndThrow(remainingBytes > 0, "Must have data in buffer to transfer");
					return TransferData(remainingBytes, buffer, offset, size);
				}
				IAsyncResult result = webSocket.BeginReceive(AsyncReadBuffer, 0, size, timeout, null, null);
				bytesRead = webSocket.EndReceive(result);
				return TransferData(bytesRead, buffer, offset, size);
			}
			catch (IOException ioException)
			{
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(ConvertIOException(ioException), this, EventLevel.Warning, "Read", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\SocketConnection\\ClientWebSocketConnection.cs", 214);
			}
			catch (ObjectDisposedException ex)
			{
				if (webSocket.State == ServiceBusClientWebSocket.WebSocketState.Faulted)
				{
					throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new CommunicationObjectFaultedException(TrackingContext.CreateTrackableErrorMessage(ex.Message), ex), this, EventLevel.Warning, "Read", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\SocketConnection\\ClientWebSocketConnection.cs", 220);
				}
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new CommunicationObjectAbortedException(TrackingContext.CreateTrackableErrorMessage(ex.Message), ex), this, EventLevel.Warning, "Read", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\SocketConnection\\ClientWebSocketConnection.cs", 223);
			}
		}

		public AsyncReadResult BeginRead(int offset, int size, TimeSpan timeout, WaitCallback callback, object state)
		{
			ThrowIfNotOpen();
			ConnectionUtilities.ValidateBufferBounds(AsyncReadBufferSize, offset, size);
			if (timeout <= TimeSpan.Zero)
			{
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new TimeoutException(TrackingContext.CreateTrackableErrorMessage(SR.GetString(Resources.TimeoutOnRequest, timeout))), this, EventLevel.Warning, "BeginRead", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\SocketConnection\\ClientWebSocketConnection.cs", 233);
			}
			if (Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref asyncReadPending, 1, 0) != 0)
			{
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new InvalidOperationException(TrackingContext.CreateTrackableErrorMessage(Resources.ClientWebSocketConnectionReadPending)), this, EventLevel.Warning, "BeginRead", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\SocketConnection\\ClientWebSocketConnection.cs", 239);
			}
			readCallback = callback;
			readObject = state;
			AsyncReadResult asyncReadResult = AsyncReadResult.Completed;
			bool flag = false;
			try
			{
				IAsyncResult asyncResult = webSocket.BeginReceive(AsyncReadBuffer, offset, size, timeout, onRead, this);
				if (!asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
				{
					asyncReadResult = AsyncReadResult.Queued;
				}
				else
				{
					readCallback = null;
					readObject = null;
					bytesRead = webSocket.EndReceive(asyncResult);
				}
				flag = true;
			}
			catch (IOException ioException)
			{
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(ConvertIOException(ioException), this, EventLevel.Warning, "BeginRead", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\SocketConnection\\ClientWebSocketConnection.cs", 266);
			}
			catch (ObjectDisposedException ex)
			{
				if (webSocket.State == ServiceBusClientWebSocket.WebSocketState.Faulted)
				{
					throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new CommunicationObjectFaultedException(TrackingContext.CreateTrackableErrorMessage(ex.Message), ex), this, EventLevel.Warning, "BeginRead", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\SocketConnection\\ClientWebSocketConnection.cs", 272);
				}
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new CommunicationObjectAbortedException(TrackingContext.CreateTrackableErrorMessage(ex.Message), ex), this, EventLevel.Warning, "BeginRead", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\SocketConnection\\ClientWebSocketConnection.cs", 276);
			}
			finally
			{
				if (!flag || asyncReadResult == AsyncReadResult.Completed)
				{
					Interlocked.Exchange(ref asyncReadPending, 0);
				}
			}
			return asyncReadResult;
		}

		public int EndRead()
		{
			if (Thread.VolatileRead(ref asyncReadPending) != 0)
			{
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new InvalidOperationException(TrackingContext.CreateTrackableErrorMessage(Resources.ClientWebSocketConnectionPrematureEndRead)), this, EventLevel.Warning, "EndRead", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\SocketConnection\\ClientWebSocketConnection.cs", 294);
			}
			IAsyncResult asyncResult = readResult;
			if (asyncResult != null)
			{
				readResult = null;
				readCallback = null;
				readObject = null;
				try
				{
					bytesRead = webSocket.EndReceive(asyncResult);
				}
				catch (IOException ioException)
				{
					throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(ConvertIOException(ioException), this, EventLevel.Warning, "EndRead", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\SocketConnection\\ClientWebSocketConnection.cs", 310);
				}
				catch (ObjectDisposedException ex)
				{
					if (webSocket.State == ServiceBusClientWebSocket.WebSocketState.Faulted)
					{
						throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new CommunicationObjectFaultedException(TrackingContext.CreateTrackableErrorMessage(ex.Message), ex), this, EventLevel.Warning, "EndRead", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\SocketConnection\\ClientWebSocketConnection.cs", 316);
					}
					throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new CommunicationObjectAbortedException(TrackingContext.CreateTrackableErrorMessage(ex.Message), ex), this, EventLevel.Warning, "EndRead", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\SocketConnection\\ClientWebSocketConnection.cs", 320);
				}
			}
			return bytesRead;
		}

		private int TransferData(int numBytesRead, byte[] buffer, int offset, int size)
		{
			if (numBytesRead <= size)
			{
				Buffer.BlockCopy(AsyncReadBuffer, asyncReadBufferOffset, buffer, offset, numBytesRead);
				asyncReadBufferOffset = 0;
				remainingBytes = 0;
				return numBytesRead;
			}
			Buffer.BlockCopy(AsyncReadBuffer, asyncReadBufferOffset, buffer, offset, size);
			asyncReadBufferOffset += size;
			remainingBytes = numBytesRead - size;
			return size;
		}

		public bool Validate(Uri uri)
		{
			return true;
		}

		public virtual T GetProperty<T>()
		{
			if (typeof(T) == typeof(Uri))
			{
				return (T)(object)Uri;
			}
			if (typeof(T) == typeof(TrackingContext))
			{
				return (T)(object)TrackingContext;
			}
			return default(T);
		}

		protected Exception ConvertIOException(IOException ioException)
		{
			if (ioException.InnerException is TimeoutException)
			{
				return new TimeoutException(TrackingContext.CreateTrackableErrorMessage(ioException.InnerException.Message), ioException);
			}
			if (ioException.InnerException is CommunicationObjectAbortedException)
			{
				return new CommunicationObjectAbortedException(TrackingContext.CreateTrackableErrorMessage(ioException.InnerException.Message), ioException);
			}
			if (ioException.InnerException is CommunicationException)
			{
				return new CommunicationException(TrackingContext.CreateTrackableErrorMessage(ioException.InnerException.Message), ioException);
			}
			return new CommunicationException(TrackingContext.CreateTrackableErrorMessage(Resources.StreamError), ioException);
		}

		private void OnRead(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (!result.CompletedSynchronously)
			{
				Fx.AssertAndThrow(readResult == null, "ClientWebSocketConnection.OnRead called twice, readResult is null");
				readResult = result;
				if (Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref asyncReadPending, 0, 1) != 1)
				{
					throw Fx.AssertAndThrow("OnRead method should not get called when there is no read operation pending.");
				}
				readCallback(readObject);
			}
		}

		private void ThrowIfNotOpen()
		{
			if (webSocket.State == ServiceBusClientWebSocket.WebSocketState.Open)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (webSocket.State == ServiceBusClientWebSocket.WebSocketState.Aborted)
			{
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new CommunicationObjectAbortedException(TrackingContext.CreateTrackableErrorMessage(string.Empty)), this, EventLevel.Warning, "ThrowIfNotOpen", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\SocketConnection\\ClientWebSocketConnection.cs", 412);
			}
			if (webSocket.State == ServiceBusClientWebSocket.WebSocketState.Closed)
			{
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new ObjectDisposedException(TrackingContext.CreateTrackableErrorMessage(Resources.ClientWebSocketConnectionClosed)), this, EventLevel.Warning, "ThrowIfNotOpen", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\SocketConnection\\ClientWebSocketConnection.cs", 418);
			}
			string exceptionMessage = SR.GetString(Resources.CommunicationObjectCannotBeUsed, GetType(), webSocket.State);
			throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new CommunicationException(TrackingContext.CreateTrackableErrorMessage(exceptionMessage)), this, EventLevel.Warning, "ThrowIfNotOpen", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\SocketConnection\\ClientWebSocketConnection.cs", 423);
		}
	}
	internal class ServiceBusClientWebSocket : ITraceSource
	{
		public enum WebSocketMessageType
		{
			Binary,
			Close,
			Text
		}

		public enum WebSocketState
		{
			Initial,
			Connecting,
			Open,
			Closed,
			Aborted,
			Faulted
		}

		private sealed class ReceiveAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<ReceiveAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly ServiceBusClientWebSocket clientWebSocket;

			private readonly Stream webSocketStream;

			private readonly byte[] buffer;

			private readonly int startOffset;

			private readonly byte[] header = new byte[2];

			private readonly IOThreadTimer readTimer;

			private int bytesRead;

			private bool timedOut;

			internal int TotalBytesRead { get; private set; }

			internal bool ConnectionClosed { get; private set; }

			public ReceiveAsyncResult(ServiceBusClientWebSocket clientWebSocket, byte[] buffer, int startOffset, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.clientWebSocket = clientWebSocket;
				webSocketStream = clientWebSocket.WebSocketStream;
				this.buffer = buffer;
				this.startOffset = startOffset;
				base.OnCompleting = (Action<Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult, Exception>)Delegate.Combine(base.OnCompleting, (Action<Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult, Exception>)delegate(Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult a, Exception e)
				{
					Finally(a, e);
				});
				readTimer = ScheduleTimer();
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				byte payloadLength;
				bool pongFrame;
				do
				{
					TotalBytesRead = 0;
					do
					{
						yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((ReceiveAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.webSocketStream.BeginRead(thisPtr.header, thisPtr.TotalBytesRead, thisPtr.header.Length - thisPtr.TotalBytesRead, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(ReceiveAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
						{
							thisPtr.bytesRead = thisPtr.webSocketStream.EndRead(r);
						}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
						if (bytesRead == 0)
						{
							Complete(new IOException(SR.GetString(Resources.FramingPrematureEOF), new InvalidDataException("ServiceBusClientWebSocket was expecting more bytes")));
							yield break;
						}
						TotalBytesRead += bytesRead;
					}
					while (TotalBytesRead < header.Length);
					if (!ParseWebSocketFrameHeader(header, out payloadLength, out pongFrame))
					{
						ConnectionClosed = true;
						byte[] closeHeader = PrepareWebSocketHeader(0, WebSocketMessageType.Close);
						yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((ReceiveAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.webSocketStream.BeginWrite(closeHeader, 0, closeHeader.Length, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(ReceiveAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
						{
							thisPtr.webSocketStream.EndWrite(r);
						}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
						yield break;
					}
					if (!pongFrame || payloadLength <= 0)
					{
						continue;
					}
					TotalBytesRead = 0;
					byte[] tempBuffer = new byte[payloadLength];
					while (TotalBytesRead < payloadLength)
					{
						yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((ReceiveAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.webSocketStream.BeginRead(tempBuffer, thisPtr.TotalBytesRead, payloadLength - thisPtr.TotalBytesRead, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(ReceiveAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
						{
							thisPtr.bytesRead = thisPtr.webSocketStream.EndRead(r);
						}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
						if (bytesRead == 0)
						{
							Complete(new IOException(SR.GetString(Resources.FramingPrematureEOF), new InvalidDataException("ServiceBusClientWebSocket was expecting more bytes")));
							yield break;
						}
						TotalBytesRead += bytesRead;
					}
				}
				while (pongFrame);
				TotalBytesRead = 0;
				bytesRead = 0;
				if (buffer.Length < payloadLength)
				{
					throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new InvalidOperationException(Resources.SizeExceedsRemainingBufferSpace), clientWebSocket, EventLevel.Warning, "GetAsyncSteps", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\SocketConnection\\ServiceBusClientWebSocket.cs", 825);
				}
				if (payloadLength < 126)
				{
					while (TotalBytesRead < payloadLength)
					{
						yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((ReceiveAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.webSocketStream.BeginRead(thisPtr.buffer, thisPtr.startOffset + thisPtr.TotalBytesRead, payloadLength - thisPtr.TotalBytesRead, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(ReceiveAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
						{
							thisPtr.bytesRead = thisPtr.webSocketStream.EndRead(r);
						}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
						if (bytesRead == 0)
						{
							Complete(new IOException(SR.GetString(Resources.FramingPrematureEOF), new InvalidDataException("ServiceBusClientWebSocket was expecting more bytes")));
							break;
						}
						TotalBytesRead += bytesRead;
					}
					yield break;
				}
				switch (payloadLength)
				{
				case 126:
				{
					do
					{
						yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((ReceiveAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.webSocketStream.BeginRead(thisPtr.header, thisPtr.TotalBytesRead, thisPtr.header.Length - thisPtr.TotalBytesRead, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(ReceiveAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
						{
							thisPtr.bytesRead = thisPtr.webSocketStream.EndRead(r);
						}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
						if (bytesRead == 0)
						{
							Complete(new IOException(SR.GetString(Resources.FramingPrematureEOF), new InvalidDataException("ServiceBusClientWebSocket was expecting more bytes")));
							yield break;
						}
						TotalBytesRead += bytesRead;
					}
					while (TotalBytesRead < header.Length);
					TotalBytesRead = 0;
					ushort extendedPayloadLength = (ushort)((header[0] << 8) | header[1]);
					if (buffer.Length >= extendedPayloadLength)
					{
						while (TotalBytesRead < extendedPayloadLength)
						{
							yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((ReceiveAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.webSocketStream.BeginRead(thisPtr.buffer, thisPtr.startOffset + thisPtr.TotalBytesRead, extendedPayloadLength - thisPtr.TotalBytesRead, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(ReceiveAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
							{
								thisPtr.bytesRead = thisPtr.webSocketStream.EndRead(r);
							}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
							if (bytesRead == 0)
							{
								Complete(new IOException(SR.GetString(Resources.FramingPrematureEOF), new InvalidDataException("ServiceBusClientWebSocket was expecting more bytes")));
								break;
							}
							TotalBytesRead += bytesRead;
						}
						break;
					}
					throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new InvalidOperationException(Resources.SizeExceedsRemainingBufferSpace), clientWebSocket, EventLevel.Warning, "GetAsyncSteps", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\SocketConnection\\ServiceBusClientWebSocket.cs", 895);
				}
				case 127:
				{
					byte[] payloadLengthBuffer = new byte[8];
					do
					{
						yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((ReceiveAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.webSocketStream.BeginRead(payloadLengthBuffer, thisPtr.TotalBytesRead, payloadLengthBuffer.Length - thisPtr.TotalBytesRead, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(ReceiveAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
						{
							thisPtr.bytesRead = thisPtr.webSocketStream.EndRead(r);
						}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
						if (bytesRead == 0)
						{
							Complete(new IOException(SR.GetString(Resources.FramingPrematureEOF), new InvalidDataException("ServiceBusClientWebSocket was expecting more bytes")));
							yield break;
						}
						TotalBytesRead += bytesRead;
					}
					while (TotalBytesRead < payloadLengthBuffer.Length);
					TotalBytesRead = 0;
					uint superExtendedPayloadLength = (uint)((payloadLengthBuffer[4] << 24) | (payloadLengthBuffer[5] << 16) | (payloadLengthBuffer[6] << 8) | payloadLengthBuffer[7]);
					if (buffer.Length >= superExtendedPayloadLength)
					{
						while (TotalBytesRead < superExtendedPayloadLength)
						{
							yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((ReceiveAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.webSocketStream.BeginRead(thisPtr.buffer, thisPtr.startOffset + thisPtr.TotalBytesRead, (int)(superExtendedPayloadLength - thisPtr.TotalBytesRead), c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(ReceiveAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
							{
								thisPtr.bytesRead = thisPtr.webSocketStream.EndRead(r);
							}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
							if (bytesRead == 0)
							{
								Complete(new IOException(SR.GetString(Resources.FramingPrematureEOF), new InvalidDataException("ServiceBusClientWebSocket was expecting more bytes")));
								break;
							}
							TotalBytesRead += bytesRead;
						}
						break;
					}
					throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new InvalidOperationException(Resources.SizeExceedsRemainingBufferSpace), clientWebSocket, EventLevel.Warning, "GetAsyncSteps", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\SocketConnection\\ServiceBusClientWebSocket.cs", 946);
				}
				}
			}

			private IOThreadTimer ScheduleTimer()
			{
				int num = TimeoutHelper.ToMilliseconds(RemainingTime());
				if (num == -1 || num == int.MaxValue)
				{
					return null;
				}
				IOThreadTimer iOThreadTimer = new IOThreadTimer(delegate(object s)
				{
					OnReceiveTimeout(s);
				}, this, isTypicallyCanceledShortlyAfterBeingSet: true);
				iOThreadTimer.Set(num);
				return iOThreadTimer;
			}

			private static void OnReceiveTimeout(object state)
			{
				ReceiveAsyncResult receiveAsyncResult = (ReceiveAsyncResult)state;
				try
				{
					lock (receiveAsyncResult.ThisLock)
					{
						if (!receiveAsyncResult.IsCompleted)
						{
							ServiceBusEventSource.Log.Warning(receiveAsyncResult.clientWebSocket, "Receive Operation timed out.", "OnReceiveTimeout", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\SocketConnection\\ServiceBusClientWebSocket.cs", 976);
							receiveAsyncResult.timedOut = true;
						}
					}
					if (receiveAsyncResult.timedOut)
					{
						receiveAsyncResult.webSocketStream.Dispose();
					}
				}
				catch (Exception ex) when (!Fx.IsFatal(ex))
				{
					ServiceBusEventSource.Log.HandledException(ex, receiveAsyncResult.clientWebSocket, EventLevel.Warning, "OnReceiveTimeout", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\SocketConnection\\ServiceBusClientWebSocket.cs", 988);
				}
			}

			private static void Finally(IAsyncResult asyncResult, Exception exception)
			{
				ReceiveAsyncResult receiveAsyncResult = (ReceiveAsyncResult)asyncResult;
				receiveAsyncResult.readTimer?.Cancel();
				if (exception != null && !(exception is TimeoutException) && receiveAsyncResult.timedOut)
				{
					throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new TimeoutException(SR.GetString(Resources.TimeoutOnRequest, receiveAsyncResult.OriginalTimeout), exception), receiveAsyncResult.clientWebSocket, EventLevel.Warning, "Finally", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\SocketConnection\\ServiceBusClientWebSocket.cs", 1000);
				}
			}
		}

				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((SendAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan _, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.webSocketStream.BeginWrite(thisPtr.webSocketHeader, 0, thisPtr.webSocketHeader.Length, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(SendAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					thisPtr.webSocketStream.EndWrite(r);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
				MaskWebSocketData(buffer, offset, size);

				{
					thisPtr.webSocketStream.EndWrite(r);

		private sealed class CloseAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<CloseAsyncResult>

					{
						thisPtr.webSocketStream.EndWrite(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
				}
			}
		}

		}

		private async Task ConnectAsync(string host, int port, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			if (State != WebSocketState.Initial)
			{
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new InvalidOperationException(Resources.ClientWebSocketNotInInitialState), this, EventLevel.Warning, "ConnectAsync", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\SocketConnection\\ServiceBusClientWebSocket.cs", 160);
			}
			State = WebSocketState.Connecting;
			this.host = host;
			this.port = port;
			bool succeeded = false;
			CancellationTokenSource cancelTokenSource = new CancellationTokenSource(timeout);
			try
			{
				HttpWebRequest webSocketHttpRequest = await CreateWebRequestAsync("wss", host, port).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				webSocketHttpRequest.Proxy = WebRequest.DefaultWebProxy;
				cancelTokenSource.Token.Register(delegate
				{
					AbortRequest(webSocketHttpRequest);
				});
				webSocketHttpRequest.ServerCertificateValidationCallback = CustomizedCertificateValidator;
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(webSocketHttpRequest.Headers["Sec-WebSocket-Version"]))
				{
					webSocketHttpRequest.Headers["Sec-WebSocket-Version"] = "13";
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(webSocketRole))
				{
					webSocketHttpRequest.Headers["Sec-WebSocket-Protocol"] = webSocketRole;
				}
				WebResponse = (HttpWebResponse)(await webSocketHttpRequest.GetResponseAsyncWithoutTaskRun().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false));
				ValidateResponse(webSocketHttpRequest);
				WebSocketStream = WebResponse.GetResponseStream();
				State = WebSocketState.Open;
				succeeded = true;
			}
			catch (WebException ex)
			{
				if (ex.Status == WebExceptionStatus.RequestCanceled && cancelTokenSource.IsCancellationRequested)
				{
					throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new TimeoutException(SR.GetString(Resources.TimeoutOnRequest, timeout), ex), this, EventLevel.Warning, "ConnectAsync", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\SocketConnection\\ServiceBusClientWebSocket.cs", 204);
				}
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new IOException(ex.Message, ex), this, EventLevel.Warning, "ConnectAsync", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\SocketConnection\\ServiceBusClientWebSocket.cs", 207);
			}
			finally
			{
				cancelTokenSource.Dispose();
				if (!succeeded)
				{
					Fault();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool WriteAsync(TransportAsyncCallbackArgs args)
		{
			byte[] array;
			if (args.Buffer != null)
			{
				array = PrepareBigByteArray(args.Buffer, args.Offset, args.Count);
			}
			else if (args.ByteBufferList.Count == 1)
			{
				array = PrepareBigByteArray(args.ByteBufferList[0].Buffer, args.ByteBufferList[0].Offset, args.ByteBufferList[0].Length);
			}
			else
			{
				byte[][] array2 = new byte[args.ByteBufferList.Count][];
				int num = 0;
				for (int i = 0; i < args.ByteBufferList.Count; i++)
				{
					array2[i] = PrepareWebSocketHeader(args.ByteBufferList[i].Length, WebSocketMessageType.Binary);
					num += array2[i].Length;
				}
				array = Fx.AllocateByteArray(num + args.Count);
				int num2 = 0;
				for (int j = 0; j < args.ByteBufferList.Count; j++)
				{
					Buffer.BlockCopy(array2[j], 0, array, num2, array2[j].Length);
					num2 += array2[j].Length;
					Buffer.BlockCopy(args.ByteBufferList[j].Buffer, args.ByteBufferList[j].Offset, array, num2, args.ByteBufferList[j].Length);
					MaskWebSocketData(array, num2, args.ByteBufferList[j].Length);
					num2 += args.ByteBufferList[j].Length;
				}
			}
			IAsyncResult asyncResult = WebSocketStream.BeginWrite(array, 0, array.Length, onWriteComplete, args);
			bool completedSynchronously = asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously;
			if (completedSynchronously)
			{
				HandleOperationComplete(asyncResult, syncComplete: true);
			}
			return !completedSynchronously;
		}

		private async Task<HttpWebRequest> CreateWebRequestAsync(string scheme, string originalHost, int port)
		{
			string text = originalHost;
			if (ConnectivitySettings != null)
			{
				try
				{
					text = await ConnectivitySettings.ResolveDnsAsync(scheme, originalHost, port).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				catch (Exception ex) when (!Fx.IsFatal(ex))
				{
					throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new IOException(ex.Message, ex), this, EventLevel.Warning, "CreateWebRequestAsync", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\SocketConnection\\ServiceBusClientWebSocket.cs", 372);
				}
			}
			HttpWebRequest httpWebRequest = (HttpWebRequest)WebRequest.Create(new UriBuilder(scheme, text, port, requestPath).Uri);
			if (!text.Equals(originalHost, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				httpWebRequest.Host = originalHost;
			}
			return httpWebRequest;
		}

		private string ValidateResponse(HttpWebRequest request)
		{
			if (WebResponse.StatusCode != HttpStatusCode.SwitchingProtocols)
			{
				throw new WebException($"The server returned status code '{(int)WebResponse.StatusCode}' when status code '101' was expected.");
			}
			string text = WebResponse.Headers["Upgrade"];
			if (!string.Equals(text, "websocket", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				throw new WebException("The 'Upgrade' header value '" + text + "' is invalid.");
			}
			string text2 = WebResponse.Headers[HttpResponseHeader.Connection];
			if (!string.Equals(text2, "Upgrade", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				throw new WebException($"The '{HttpResponseHeader.Connection}' header value '{text2}' is invalid.");
			}
			string text3 = WebResponse.Headers["Sec-WebSocket-Accept"];
			string secWebSocketAcceptString = GetSecWebSocketAcceptString(request.Headers["Sec-WebSocket-Key"]);
			if (!string.Equals(text3, secWebSocketAcceptString, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				throw new WebException("The 'Sec-WebSocket-Accept' header value '" + text3 + "' is invalid.");
			}
			string text4 = WebResponse.Headers["Sec-WebSocket-Protocol"];
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text4) && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(webSocketRole) && !string.Equals(webSocketRole, text4, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				throw new WebException("The WebSocket client request requested '" + webSocketRole + "' protocol, but server is only accepting '" + text4 + "' protocol(s).");
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text4))
			{
				return text4;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static string GetSecWebSocketAcceptString(string secWebSocketKey)
		{
			using SHA1 sHA = SHA1.Create();
			string s = secWebSocketKey + "258EAFA5-E914-47DA-95CA-C5AB0DC85B11";
			byte[] bytes = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(s);
			return Convert.ToBase64String(sHA.ComputeHash(bytes));
		}

		private void CloseStream()
		{
			WebSocketStream?.Close();
			WebResponse?.Close();
			WebSocketStream = null;
			WebResponse = null;
		}

		private byte[] PrepareBigByteArray(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)
		{
			Fx.AssertAndThrow(count > 0, "count should be greater than zero");
			byte[] array = PrepareWebSocketHeader(count, WebSocketMessageType.Binary);
			byte[] array2 = Fx.AllocateByteArray(array.Length + count);
			Buffer.BlockCopy(array, 0, array2, 0, array.Length);
			Buffer.BlockCopy(buffer, offset, array2, array.Length, count);
			MaskWebSocketData(array2, array.Length, count);
			return array2;
		}

		private void HandleOperationComplete(IAsyncResult result, bool syncComplete)
		{
			TransportAsyncCallbackArgs transportAsyncCallbackArgs = null;
			try
			{
				transportAsyncCallbackArgs = (TransportAsyncCallbackArgs)result.AsyncState;
				WebSocketStream.EndWrite(result);
				transportAsyncCallbackArgs.BytesTransfered = transportAsyncCallbackArgs.Count;
			}
			catch (Exception exception) when (!Fx.IsFatal(exception))
			{
				transportAsyncCallbackArgs.Exception = exception;
			}
			transportAsyncCallbackArgs.CompletedSynchronously = syncComplete;
			if (!syncComplete)
			{
				Action<TransportAsyncCallbackArgs> completedCallback = transportAsyncCallbackArgs.CompletedCallback;
				if (completedCallback != null)
				{
					transportAsyncCallbackArgs.CompletedCallback(transportAsyncCallbackArgs);
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnWriteComplete(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (!result.CompletedSynchronously)
			{
				HandleOperationComplete(result, syncComplete: false);
			}
		}

		public static bool IsSupportingScheme(Uri factoryEndpointUri, out Exception exception)
		{
			exception = null;
			try
			{
				using WebSocketConnectAsyncResult webSocketConnectAsyncResult = new WebSocketConnectAsyncResult(factoryEndpointUri, TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1.0), "wsrelayedconnection", null, null, null).RunSynchronously();
				return webSocketConnectAsyncResult.ClientWebSocket != null;
			}
			catch (Exception ex) when (!Fx.IsFatal(ex))
			{
				exception = ex;
				return false;
			}
		}

		private static int GetSocketTimeoutInMilliSeconds(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			if (timeout == TimeSpan.MaxValue)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (timeout == TimeSpan.Zero)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			long num = Ticks.FromTimeSpan(timeout);
			if (num / 10000 > int.MaxValue)
			{
				return int.MaxValue;
			}
			return Ticks.ToMilliseconds(num);
		}

		private static byte[] PrepareWebSocketHeader(int bufferLength, WebSocketMessageType webSocketMessageType)
		{
			return (bufferLength < 126) ? new byte[6]
			{
				PrepareOctet0(webSocketMessageType),
				(byte)(bufferLength | 0x80),
				maskingKey[0],
				maskingKey[1],
				maskingKey[2],
				maskingKey[3]
			} : ((bufferLength <= 65535) ? new byte[8]
			{
				PrepareOctet0(webSocketMessageType),
				254,
				(byte)((bufferLength >> 8) & 0xFF),
				(byte)(bufferLength & 0xFF),
				maskingKey[0],
				maskingKey[1],
				maskingKey[2],
				maskingKey[3]
			} : new byte[14]
			{
				PrepareOctet0(webSocketMessageType),
				255,
				0,
				0,
				0,
				0,
				(byte)((bufferLength >> 24) & 0xFF),
				(byte)((bufferLength >> 16) & 0xFF),
				(byte)((bufferLength >> 8) & 0xFF),
				(byte)(bufferLength & 0xFF),
				maskingKey[0],
				maskingKey[1],
				maskingKey[2],
				maskingKey[3]
			});
		}

		private static byte PrepareOctet0(WebSocketMessageType webSocketMessageType)
		{
			byte b = 128;
			return webSocketMessageType switch
			{
				WebSocketMessageType.Binary => (byte)(b | 2), 
				WebSocketMessageType.Text => (byte)(b | 1), 
				_ => (byte)(b | 8), 
			};
		}

		private static void MaskWebSocketData(byte[] buffer, int offset, int size)
		{
			ConnectionUtilities.ValidateBufferBounds(buffer, offset, size);
			for (int i = 0; i < size; i++)
			{
				buffer[i + offset] ^= maskingKey[i % 4];
			}
		}

		private static bool CustomizedCertificateValidator(object sender, X509Certificate certificate, X509Chain chain, SslPolicyErrors sslPolicyErrors)
		{
			return SecureSocketUtil.CustomizedCertificateValidator(sender, certificate, chain, sslPolicyErrors, RelayEnvironment.RelayHostRootName);
		}

		private static bool ParseWebSocketFrameHeader(byte[] buffer, out byte payloadLength, out bool pongFrame)
		{
			payloadLength = 0;
			int num = buffer[0] & 0x80;
			if (num == 128)
			{
				bool flag = true;
				int num2 = buffer[0] & 0xF;
				pongFrame = false;
				switch (num2)
				{
				case 0:
					if (flag)
					{
						return false;
					}
					break;
				case 8:
					return false;
				case 9:
					throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new NotImplementedException("Client Websocket implementation lacks ping message support"), null, EventLevel.Warning, "ParseWebSocketFrameHeader", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\SocketConnection\\ServiceBusClientWebSocket.cs", 702);
				case 10:
					pongFrame = true;
					break;
				default:
					return false;
				case 1:
				case 2:
					break;
				}
				int num3 = buffer[1] & 0x80;
				if (num3 == 128)
				{
					return false;
				}
				payloadLength = (byte)(buffer[1] & 0x7F);
				return true;
			}
			throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new NotImplementedException("Client Websocket implementation lacks fragmentation support"), null, EventLevel.Warning, "ParseWebSocketFrameHeader", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\SocketConnection\\ServiceBusClientWebSocket.cs", 674);
		}

		private void Fault()
		{
			State = WebSocketState.Faulted;
			CloseStream();
		}
