		public UriPrefixTable<ITransportManagerRegistration> TransportManagerTable => transportManagerTable;

		internal Guid ActivityId { get; }

		public WebSocketRelayedConnectionElement(TokenProvider tokenProvider, SocketSecurityRole socketSecurityMode, BindingContext context, NameSettings nameSettings, ConnectivitySettings connectivitySettings, SslProtocols? sslProtocolOverride)
		{
			ActivityId = context.BindingParameters.Find<TransportClientEndpointBehavior>()?.ActivityId ?? Guid.NewGuid();
			ConnectivitySettings = connectivitySettings;
			TokenProvider = tokenProvider;
			SecurityMode = socketSecurityMode;
			BindingContext = context;
			NameSettings = nameSettings;
			SslProtocolOverride = sslProtocolOverride;
			connectionListener = new WebSocketRelayedConnectionListener(this);
		}

		public IConnectionInitiator CreateInitiator(int bufferSize)
		{
			return new WebSocketConnectionInitiator(ConnectivitySettings, TokenProvider, bufferSize, SslProtocolOverride, BindingContext);
		}

		public IConnectionListener CreateListener(int bufferSize, Uri uri)
		{
			System.ServiceModel.Channels.Binding innerBinding = CreateInnerBinding();
			connectionListener.Initialize(uri, bufferSize, innerBinding);
			return connectionListener;
		}

		public bool IsCompatible(IConnectionElement element)
		{
			return element is WebSocketRelayedConnectionElement;
		}

		public T GetProperty<T>() where T : class
		{
			if (typeof(T) == typeof(IConnectionStatus))
			{
				return (T)connectionListener.ConnectionStatus;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private System.ServiceModel.Channels.Binding CreateInnerBinding()
		{
			lock (bindingTable)
			{
				if (!bindingTable.TryGetValue(NameSettings, out var value))
				{
					RelayedOnewayTransportBindingElement relayedOnewayTransportBindingElement = RelayedOnewayTransportBindingElement.CreateOnewayTransportBindingElement(BindingContext, NameSettings.ServiceSettings.RelayClientAuthenticationType, RelayedOnewayConnectionMode.Unicast);
					value = new CustomBinding(ClientMessageUtility.CreateInnerEncodingBindingElement(BindingContext), relayedOnewayTransportBindingElement)
					{
						CloseTimeout = BindingContext.Binding.CloseTimeout,
						Name = BindingContext.Binding.Name,
						Namespace = BindingContext.Binding.Namespace,
						OpenTimeout = BindingContext.Binding.OpenTimeout,
						ReceiveTimeout = BindingContext.Binding.ReceiveTimeout,
						SendTimeout = BindingContext.Binding.SendTimeout
					};
					bindingTable.Add(NameSettings, value);
				}
				return value;
			}
		}
	}

	internal class WebSocketConnectionInitiator : IConnectionInitiator
	{
		private readonly TokenProvider tokenProvider;

		private readonly int bufferSize;

		private readonly SslProtocols? sslProtocolOverride;

		private readonly ConnectivitySettings connectivitySettings;

		private readonly BindingContext bindingContext;

		public WebSocketConnectionInitiator(ConnectivitySettings connectivitySettings, TokenProvider tokenProvider, int bufferSize, SslProtocols? sslProtocolOverride, BindingContext bindingContext)
		{
			this.tokenProvider = tokenProvider;
			this.bufferSize = bufferSize;
			this.sslProtocolOverride = sslProtocolOverride;
			this.connectivitySettings = connectivitySettings;
			this.bindingContext = bindingContext;
		}

		public IConnection Connect(Uri uri, TrackingContext trackingContext, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			return ConnectAsync(uri, trackingContext, timeout).CompleteSynchronously();
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginConnect(Uri uri, TrackingContext trackingContext, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return ConnectAsync(uri, trackingContext, timeout).ToAsyncResult(callback, state);
		}

		public IConnection EndConnect(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			return TaskHelpers.EndAsyncResult<IConnection>(result);
		}

		private async Task<IConnection> ConnectAsync(Uri uri, TrackingContext trackingContext, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			OperationContext operationContext = OperationContext.Current;
			TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
			ClientWebSocketConnection clientWebSocketConnection = new ClientWebSocketConnection(await TaskHelpers.FromAsync((AsyncCallback c, object s) => new WebSocketConnectAsyncResult(uri, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime(), "wsrelayedconnection", sslProtocolOverride, connectivitySettings, trackingContext, c, s).Start(), (IAsyncResult a) => AsyncResult<WebSocketConnectAsyncResult>.End(a).ClientWebSocket).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), bufferSize, uri);
			ServiceBusEventSource.Log.WebSocketConnectionEstablished(uri.AbsoluteUri);
			SendRelayedConnectAndReceiveResponse(clientWebSocketConnection, operationContext, timeoutHelper);
			return clientWebSocketConnection;
		}

		private void SendRelayedConnectAndReceiveResponse(ClientWebSocketConnection connection, OperationContext operationContext, TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper)
		{
			SocketMessageHelper socketMessageHelper = new SocketMessageHelper();
			ConnectMessage body = ClientMessageUtility.CreateConnectMessage(connection.Uri, operationContext);
			System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message = System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message.CreateMessage(socketMessageHelper.MessageVersion, "RelayedConnect", body);
			TrackingIdHeader.TryAddOrUpdate(message.Headers, connection.TrackingContext.TrackingId);
			if (tokenProvider != null)
			{
				string absoluteUri = RelayedHttpUtility.ConvertToHttpUri(connection.Uri).AbsoluteUri;
				SecurityToken token = tokenProvider.GetToken(absoluteUri, "Send", bypassCache: false, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
				message.Headers.Add(new RelayTokenHeader(token));
			}
			socketMessageHelper.SendMessage(connection, message, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
			System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message2 = socketMessageHelper.ReceiveMessage(connection, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
			if (message2.IsFault)
			{
				MessageFault fault = MessageFault.CreateFault(message2, 65536);
				throw ErrorUtility.ConvertToError(fault);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class WebSocketOnewayConnectionInitiator : IConnectionInitiator
	{
		private readonly int bufferSize;

		private readonly string webSocketRole;

		private readonly ConnectivitySettings connectivitySettings;

		public WebSocketOnewayConnectionInitiator(string webSocketRole, int bufferSize, ConnectivitySettings connectivitySettings)

		}

		public IConnection Connect(Uri uri, TrackingContext trackingContext, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			WebSocketConnectAsyncResult webSocketConnectAsyncResult = new WebSocketConnectAsyncResult(uri, timeout, webSocketRole, null, connectivitySettings, trackingContext, null, null).RunSynchronously();
			IConnection result = new ClientWebSocketConnection(webSocketConnectAsyncResult.ClientWebSocket, bufferSize, uri);
			ServiceBusEventSource.Log.WebSocketConnectionEstablished(webSocketConnectAsyncResult.Uri.AbsoluteUri);
			return result;
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginConnect(Uri uri, TrackingContext trackingContext, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new CompletedAsyncResult<IConnection>(Connect(uri, trackingContext, timeout), callback, state);
		}

		{
			return CompletedAsyncResult<IConnection>.End(result);
		}

	internal sealed class WebSocketConnectAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<WebSocketConnectAsyncResult>, IDisposable
	{
		private readonly TimeSpan timeout;

		private readonly string webSocketRole;

		private readonly SslProtocols? sslProtocolOverride;

		private readonly ConnectivitySettings connectivitySettings;

		public TrackingContext TrackingContext { get; }

		internal Uri Uri { get; private set; }

		internal ServiceBusClientWebSocket ClientWebSocket { get; private set; }

		public WebSocketConnectAsyncResult(Uri uri, TimeSpan timeout, string webSocketRole, ConnectivitySettings connectivitySettings, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			: this(uri, timeout, webSocketRole, null, connectivitySettings, null, callback, state)
		{
		}

		public WebSocketConnectAsyncResult(Uri uri, TimeSpan timeout, string webSocketRole, SslProtocols? sslProtocolOverride, ConnectivitySettings connectivitySettings, TrackingContext trackingContext, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			: base(timeout, callback, state)
		{
			Uri = uri;
			this.timeout = timeout;
			this.webSocketRole = webSocketRole;
			this.sslProtocolOverride = sslProtocolOverride;
			this.connectivitySettings = connectivitySettings;
			TrackingContext = trackingContext;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (ClientWebSocket != null)
			{
				ClientWebSocket.Abort();
			}
		}

		public TimeSpan TimeRemaining()
		{
			return RemainingTime();
		}

		protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
		{
			ClientWebSocket = new ServiceBusClientWebSocket(webSocketRole, sslProtocolOverride, TrackingContext);
			ClientWebSocket.ConnectivitySettings = connectivitySettings;
			yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((WebSocketConnectAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => ClientWebSocket.BeginConnect(thisPtr.Uri.Host, RelayEnvironment.RelayHttpsPort, thisPtr.timeout, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(WebSocketConnectAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
			{
				ClientWebSocket.EndConnect(r);
			}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
			if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
			{
				Complete(new CommunicationException(base.LastAsyncStepException.Message, base.LastAsyncStepException));
			}
		}
	}
	internal abstract class WebSocketConnectionListener : IConnectionListener
	{

		protected WebSocketConnectionListener()
		{

		}

		public abstract void Open(TimeSpan timeout);

		public abstract void Abort();

		public abstract void Close(TimeSpan timeout);

		public IAsyncResult BeginAccept(AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return connectionQueue.BeginDequeue(TimeSpan.MaxValue, callback, state);
		}

		public IConnection EndAccept(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			try
			{
				return connectionQueue.EndDequeue(result);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(ex) || ex is CommunicationException)
				{
					throw;
				}
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new CommunicationException(ex.Message, ex), null, EventLevel.Warning, "EndAccept", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\SocketConnection\\WebSocketConnectionListener.cs", 56);
			}
		}

		public void EnqueueConnection(IConnection connection, bool transportProtectionEnabled)
		{
			connectionQueue.EnqueueAndDispatch(connection);
		}
	}
	[ServiceBehavior(ConcurrencyMode = ConcurrencyMode.Multiple, InstanceContextMode = InstanceContextMode.Single, AddressFilterMode = AddressFilterMode.Prefix)]
	internal class WebSocketRelayedConnectionListener : WebSocketConnectionListener, IRelayedConnectionControl
	{
		private sealed class ConnectAsyncResult : TrackingContextIteratorAsyncResult<ConnectAsyncResult>, ITraceSource
		{
			private readonly WebSocketRelayedConnectionListener relayedConnectionListener;

			private IConnection connection;

			private System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message;

			public string Component => "Relay";

			public RelayedConnectMessage Request { get; private set; }

			public ConnectAsyncResult(RelayedConnectMessage request, WebSocketRelayedConnectionListener relayedConnectionListener, TrackingContext trackingContext, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(trackingContext, ConnectConstants.ConnectionInitiateTimeout, callback, state)
			{
				Request = request;
				this.relayedConnectionListener = relayedConnectionListener;
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				Uri baseUri = ServiceBusUriHelper.CreateServiceUri(Uri.UriSchemeHttps, Request.HttpsEndpoint.ToHostPortString(), "/");
				ServiceBusClientWebSocket clientWebSocket = new ServiceBusClientWebSocket("wsrelayedconnection", relayedConnectionListener.sslProtocolOverride, base.TrackingContext);
				clientWebSocket.ConnectivitySettings = relayedConnectionListener.connectivitySettings;
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((ConnectAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => clientWebSocket.BeginConnect(baseUri.Host, baseUri.Port, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(ConnectAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					clientWebSocket.EndConnect(r);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
				connection = new ClientWebSocketConnection(clientWebSocket, relayedConnectionListener.bufferSize, relayedConnectionListener.uri);
				message = System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message.CreateMessage(relayedConnectionListener.messageHelper.MessageVersion, "RelayedAccept", new AcceptMessage(Request.Id));
				message.Headers.To = EndpointAddress.AnonymousUri;
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((ConnectAsyncResult thisRef, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisRef.relayedConnectionListener.messageHelper.BeginSendMessage(thisRef.connection, thisRef.message, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(ConnectAsyncResult thisRef, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					thisRef.relayedConnectionListener.messageHelper.EndSendMessage(r);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
				IOThreadScheduler.ScheduleCallbackNoFlow(relayedConnectionListener.BeginConnectCallback, connection);
				ServiceBusEventSource.Log.Info(this, $"Listener: Accepted a client connection. Source: {relayedConnectionListener.uri}, ConnectionId: {Request.Id}.", "GetAsyncSteps", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\SocketConnection\\WebSocketConnectionListener.cs", 271);
			}
		}

		{

		}

		private void EndConnectCallback(IAsyncResult ar)
		{

			}
			catch (Exception exception) when (!Fx.IsFatal(exception))
			{
				ServiceBusEventSource.Log.HandledException(exception, connection.TrackingContext, "Relay", this, EventLevel.Warning, "EndConnectCallback", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\SocketConnection\\WebSocketConnectionListener.cs", 215);
			}
		}

	internal class TimeSpanOrInfiniteConverter : TimeSpanConverter
	{
		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext ctx, CultureInfo ci, object value, Type type)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("value");
			}
			if (!(value is TimeSpan))
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.Argument("value", SR.GetString(Resources.SFxWrongType2, typeof(TimeSpan), value.GetType()));
			}
			if ((TimeSpan)value == TimeSpan.MaxValue)
			{
				return "Infinite";
			}
			return base.ConvertTo(ctx, ci, value, type);
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext ctx, CultureInfo ci, object data)
		{
			if (string.Equals((string)data, "infinite", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				return TimeSpan.MaxValue;
			}
			return base.ConvertFrom(ctx, ci, data);
		}
	}

		public override BindingElementCollection CreateBindingElements()
		{
			BindingElementCollection bindingElementCollection = new BindingElementCollection();
			SecurityBindingElement securityBindingElement = CreateMessageSecurity();
			if (securityBindingElement != null)
			{
				bindingElementCollection.Add(securityBindingElement);
			}
			WSMessageEncodingHelper.SyncUpEncodingBindingElementProperties(textEncoding, mtomEncoding);
			if (MessageEncoding == WSMessageEncoding.Text)
			{
				bindingElementCollection.Add(textEncoding);
			}
			else if (MessageEncoding == WSMessageEncoding.Mtom)
			{
				bindingElementCollection.Add(mtomEncoding);
			}
			bindingElementCollection.Add(GetTransport());
			return bindingElementCollection.Clone();
		}

		internal static bool TryCreate(BindingElementCollection elements, out System.ServiceModel.Channels.Binding binding)
		{
			binding = null;
			if (elements.Count > 3)
			{
				return false;
			}
			SecurityBindingElement securityElement = null;
			MessageEncodingBindingElement messageEncodingBindingElement = null;
			HttpRelayTransportBindingElement httpRelayTransportBindingElement = null;
			foreach (BindingElement element in elements)
			{
				if (element is SecurityBindingElement)
				{
					securityElement = element as SecurityBindingElement;
					continue;
				}
				if (element is HttpsRelayTransportBindingElement)
				{
					httpRelayTransportBindingElement = element as HttpsRelayTransportBindingElement;
					continue;
				}
				if (element is HttpRelayTransportBindingElement)
				{
					httpRelayTransportBindingElement = element as HttpRelayTransportBindingElement;
					continue;
				}
				if (element is MessageEncodingBindingElement)
				{
					messageEncodingBindingElement = element as MessageEncodingBindingElement;
					continue;
				}
				return false;
			}
			HttpRelayTransportSecurity transportSecurity = new HttpRelayTransportSecurity();
			if (!GetSecurityModeFromTransport(httpRelayTransportBindingElement, transportSecurity, out var mode))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (messageEncodingBindingElement == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (messageEncodingBindingElement.MessageVersion.Envelope != EnvelopeVersion.Soap11)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!TryCreateSecurity(securityElement, httpRelayTransportBindingElement.RelayClientAuthenticationType, mode, transportSecurity, out var basicHttpRelaySecurity))
			{
				return false;
			}
			BasicHttpRelayBinding basicHttpRelayBinding = new BasicHttpRelayBinding(basicHttpRelaySecurity);
			basicHttpRelayBinding.InitializeFrom(httpRelayTransportBindingElement, messageEncodingBindingElement);
			if (!basicHttpRelayBinding.IsBindingElementsMatch(httpRelayTransportBindingElement, messageEncodingBindingElement))
			{
				return false;
			}
			binding = basicHttpRelayBinding;
			return true;
		}

		private static bool GetSecurityModeFromTransport(HttpRelayTransportBindingElement http, HttpRelayTransportSecurity transportSecurity, out UnifiedSecurityMode mode)
		{
			mode = UnifiedSecurityMode.None;
			if (http == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (http is HttpsRelayTransportBindingElement)
			{
				mode = UnifiedSecurityMode.Transport | UnifiedSecurityMode.TransportWithMessageCredential;
				BasicHttpRelaySecurity.EnableTransportSecurity((HttpsRelayTransportBindingElement)http, transportSecurity);
			}
			else
			{
				if (!HttpRelayTransportSecurity.IsDisabledTransportAuthentication(http))
				{
					return false;
				}
				mode = UnifiedSecurityMode.None | UnifiedSecurityMode.Message;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool TryCreateSecurity(SecurityBindingElement securityElement, RelayClientAuthenticationType relayClientAuthenticationType, UnifiedSecurityMode mode, HttpRelayTransportSecurity transportSecurity, out BasicHttpRelaySecurity security)
		{
			return BasicHttpRelaySecurity.TryCreate(securityElement, relayClientAuthenticationType, mode, transportSecurity, out security);
		}

		private void Initialize()
		{
			httpTransport = new HttpRelayTransportBindingElement();
			httpsTransport = new HttpsRelayTransportBindingElement();
			messageEncoding = WSMessageEncoding.Text;
			textEncoding = new TextMessageEncodingBindingElement();
			textEncoding.MessageVersion = MessageVersion.Soap11;
			mtomEncoding = new MtomMessageEncodingBindingElement();
			mtomEncoding.MessageVersion = MessageVersion.Soap11;
		}

		private bool IsBindingElementsMatch(HttpRelayTransportBindingElement transport, MessageEncodingBindingElement encoding)
		{
			if (MessageEncoding == WSMessageEncoding.Text)
			{
				if (!(bool)InvokeHelper.InvokeInstanceMethod(typeof(BindingElement), textEncoding, "IsMatch", encoding))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			else if (MessageEncoding == WSMessageEncoding.Mtom && !(bool)InvokeHelper.InvokeInstanceMethod(typeof(BindingElement), mtomEncoding, "IsMatch", encoding))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(bool)InvokeHelper.InvokeInstanceMethod(typeof(BindingElement), GetTransport(), "IsMatch", transport))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void InitializeFrom(HttpRelayTransportBindingElement transport, MessageEncodingBindingElement encoding)
		{
			MaxBufferPoolSize = transport.MaxBufferPoolSize;
			MaxBufferSize = transport.MaxBufferSize;
			MaxReceivedMessageSize = transport.MaxReceivedMessageSize;
			ProxyAddress = transport.ProxyAddress;
			TransferMode = transport.TransferMode;
			UseDefaultWebProxy = transport.UseDefaultWebProxy;
			if (encoding is TextMessageEncodingBindingElement)
			{
				MessageEncoding = WSMessageEncoding.Text;
				TextMessageEncodingBindingElement textMessageEncodingBindingElement = (TextMessageEncodingBindingElement)encoding;
				TextEncoding = textMessageEncodingBindingElement.WriteEncoding;
				ReaderQuotas = textMessageEncodingBindingElement.ReaderQuotas;
			}
			else if (encoding is MtomMessageEncodingBindingElement)
			{
				messageEncoding = WSMessageEncoding.Mtom;
				MtomMessageEncodingBindingElement mtomMessageEncodingBindingElement = (MtomMessageEncodingBindingElement)encoding;
				TextEncoding = mtomMessageEncodingBindingElement.WriteEncoding;
				ReaderQuotas = mtomMessageEncodingBindingElement.ReaderQuotas;
			}
		}

		private void ApplyConfiguration(string configurationName)
		{
			BasicHttpRelayBindingCollectionElement bindingCollectionElement = BasicHttpRelayBindingCollectionElement.GetBindingCollectionElement();
			BasicHttpRelayBindingElement basicHttpRelayBindingElement = bindingCollectionElement.Bindings[configurationName];
			if (basicHttpRelayBindingElement == null)
			{
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new ConfigurationErrorsException(SR.GetString(Resources.ConfigInvalidBindingConfigurationName, configurationName, "basicHttpRelayBinding")), null, EventLevel.Warning, "ApplyConfiguration", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\BasicHttpRelayBinding.cs", 495);
			}
			basicHttpRelayBindingElement.ApplyConfiguration(this);
		}

		private TransportBindingElement GetTransport()
		{
			if (security.Mode == EndToEndBasicHttpSecurityMode.Transport || security.Mode == EndToEndBasicHttpSecurityMode.TransportWithMessageCredential || (security.Mode == EndToEndBasicHttpSecurityMode.Message && security.RelayClientAuthenticationType == RelayClientAuthenticationType.RelayAccessToken))
			{
				security.EnableTransportSecurity(httpsTransport);
				httpsTransport.RelayClientAuthenticationType = Security.RelayClientAuthenticationType;
				return httpsTransport;
			}
			security.DisableTransportAuthentication(httpTransport);
			httpTransport.RelayClientAuthenticationType = Security.RelayClientAuthenticationType;
			return httpTransport;
		}

		private SecurityBindingElement CreateMessageSecurity()
		{
			return security.CreateMessageSecurity();
		}
	}

		internal const BasicHttpMessageCredentialType DefaultClientCredentialType = BasicHttpMessageCredentialType.UserName;

		private BasicHttpMessageCredentialType clientCredentialType;

		private SecurityAlgorithmSuite algorithmSuite;

		public BasicHttpMessageCredentialType ClientCredentialType
		{
			get
			{
				return clientCredentialType;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != BasicHttpMessageCredentialType.Certificate && value != BasicHttpMessageCredentialType.UserName)
				{
					throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("value"), null, EventLevel.Warning, "ClientCredentialType", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\BasicHttpRelayMessageSecurity.cs", 41);
				}
				clientCredentialType = value;
			}
		}

		public SecurityAlgorithmSuite AlgorithmSuite
		{
			get
			{
				return algorithmSuite;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("value");
				}
				algorithmSuite = value;

		internal BasicHttpRelayMessageSecurity()
		{
			clientCredentialType = BasicHttpMessageCredentialType.UserName;
			algorithmSuite = SecurityAlgorithmSuite.Default;
		}

		internal SecurityBindingElement CreateMessageSecurity(bool isSecureTransportMode)
		{
			SecurityBindingElement securityBindingElement;
			if (isSecureTransportMode)
			{
				MessageSecurityVersion wSSecurity10WSTrustFebruary2005WSSecureConversationFebruary2005WSSecurityPolicy11BasicSecurityProfile = MessageSecurityVersion.WSSecurity10WSTrustFebruary2005WSSecureConversationFebruary2005WSSecurityPolicy11BasicSecurityProfile10;
				switch (clientCredentialType)
				{
				case BasicHttpMessageCredentialType.Certificate:
					securityBindingElement = SecurityBindingElement.CreateCertificateOverTransportBindingElement(wSSecurity10WSTrustFebruary2005WSSecureConversationFebruary2005WSSecurityPolicy11BasicSecurityProfile);
					break;
				case BasicHttpMessageCredentialType.UserName:
					securityBindingElement = SecurityBindingElement.CreateUserNameOverTransportBindingElement();
					securityBindingElement.MessageSecurityVersion = wSSecurity10WSTrustFebruary2005WSSecureConversationFebruary2005WSSecurityPolicy11BasicSecurityProfile;
					break;
				default:
					DiagnosticUtility.DebugAssert("Unsupported basic http message credential type");
					throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new NotSupportedException(), null, EventLevel.Warning, "CreateMessageSecurity", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\BasicHttpRelayMessageSecurity.cs", 83);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (clientCredentialType != BasicHttpMessageCredentialType.Certificate)
				{
					throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString(Resources.BasicHttpMessageSecurityRequiresCertificate)), null, EventLevel.Warning, "CreateMessageSecurity", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\BasicHttpRelayMessageSecurity.cs", 90);
				}
				securityBindingElement = SecurityBindingElement.CreateMutualCertificateBindingElement(MessageSecurityVersion.WSSecurity10WSTrustFebruary2005WSSecureConversationFebruary2005WSSecurityPolicy11BasicSecurityProfile10, allowSerializedSigningTokenOnReply: true);
			}
			securityBindingElement.DefaultAlgorithmSuite = AlgorithmSuite;
			securityBindingElement.SecurityHeaderLayout = SecurityHeaderLayout.Lax;
			securityBindingElement.SetKeyDerivation(requireDerivedKeys: false);
			InvokeHelper.InvokeInstanceSet(securityBindingElement.GetType(), securityBindingElement, "DoNotEmitTrust", true);
			return securityBindingElement;
		}

		internal static bool TryCreate(SecurityBindingElement sbe, out BasicHttpRelayMessageSecurity security, out bool isSecureTransportMode)
		{
			DiagnosticUtility.DebugAssert(sbe != null, string.Empty);
			security = null;
			isSecureTransportMode = false;
			if (!(bool)InvokeHelper.InvokeInstanceGet(sbe.GetType(), sbe, "DoNotEmitTrust"))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(bool)InvokeHelper.InvokeInstanceMethod(sbe.GetType(), sbe, "IsSetKeyDerivation", false))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (sbe.SecurityHeaderLayout != SecurityHeaderLayout.Lax)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (sbe.MessageSecurityVersion != MessageSecurityVersion.WSSecurity10WSTrustFebruary2005WSSecureConversationFebruary2005WSSecurityPolicy11BasicSecurityProfile10)
			{
				return false;
			}
			BasicHttpMessageCredentialType basicHttpMessageCredentialType;
			if (!SecurityUtil.SecurityBindingElement.IsMutualCertificateBinding(sbe, p: true))
			{
				isSecureTransportMode = true;
				if (SecurityUtil.SecurityBindingElement.IsCertificateOverTransportBinding(sbe))
				{
					basicHttpMessageCredentialType = BasicHttpMessageCredentialType.Certificate;
				}
				else
				{
					if (!SecurityUtil.SecurityBindingElement.IsUserNameOverTransportBinding(sbe))
					{
						return false;
					}
					basicHttpMessageCredentialType = BasicHttpMessageCredentialType.UserName;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				basicHttpMessageCredentialType = BasicHttpMessageCredentialType.Certificate;
			}
			security = new BasicHttpRelayMessageSecurity();
			security.ClientCredentialType = basicHttpMessageCredentialType;
			security.AlgorithmSuite = sbe.DefaultAlgorithmSuite;
			return true;
		}
	}

		internal BasicHttpRelaySecurity()
			: this(EndToEndBasicHttpSecurityMode.Transport, RelayClientAuthenticationType.RelayAccessToken, new HttpRelayTransportSecurity(), new BasicHttpRelayMessageSecurity())
		{
		}

		private BasicHttpRelaySecurity(EndToEndBasicHttpSecurityMode mode, RelayClientAuthenticationType relayClientAuthenticationType, HttpRelayTransportSecurity transportSecurity, BasicHttpRelayMessageSecurity messageSecurity)
		{
			DiagnosticUtility.DebugAssert(EndToEndBasicHttpSecurityModeHelper.IsDefined(mode), string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "Invalid BasicHttpSecurityMode value: {0}.", mode.ToString()));
			Mode = mode;
			RelayClientAuthenticationType = relayClientAuthenticationType;
			this.transportSecurity = ((transportSecurity == null) ? new HttpRelayTransportSecurity() : transportSecurity);
			this.messageSecurity = ((messageSecurity == null) ? new BasicHttpRelayMessageSecurity() : messageSecurity);
		}

		internal static void EnableTransportSecurity(HttpsRelayTransportBindingElement https, HttpRelayTransportSecurity transportSecurity)
		{
			HttpRelayTransportSecurity.ConfigureTransportProtectionAndAuthentication(https, transportSecurity);
		}

		internal static bool IsEnabledTransportAuthentication(HttpRelayTransportBindingElement http, HttpRelayTransportSecurity transportSecurity)
		{
			return HttpRelayTransportSecurity.IsConfiguredTransportAuthentication(http, transportSecurity);
		}

		internal static bool TryCreate(SecurityBindingElement sbe, RelayClientAuthenticationType relayClientAuthenticationType, UnifiedSecurityMode mode, HttpRelayTransportSecurity transportSecurity, out BasicHttpRelaySecurity security)
		{
			security = null;
			BasicHttpRelayMessageSecurity security2 = null;
			if (sbe != null)
			{
				mode &= UnifiedSecurityMode.Message | UnifiedSecurityMode.TransportWithMessageCredential;
				if (!BasicHttpRelayMessageSecurity.TryCreate(sbe, out security2, out var _))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				mode &= ~(UnifiedSecurityMode.Message | UnifiedSecurityMode.TransportWithMessageCredential);
			}
			EndToEndBasicHttpSecurityMode endToEndBasicHttpSecurityMode = EndToEndBasicHttpSecurityModeHelper.ToEndToEndBasicHttpSecurityMode(mode);
			DiagnosticUtility.DebugAssert(EndToEndBasicHttpSecurityModeHelper.IsDefined(endToEndBasicHttpSecurityMode), string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "Invalid BasicHttpSecurityMode value: {0}.", endToEndBasicHttpSecurityMode.ToString()));
			security = new BasicHttpRelaySecurity(endToEndBasicHttpSecurityMode, relayClientAuthenticationType, transportSecurity, security2);
			if (sbe != null)
			{
				return (bool)InvokeHelper.InvokeStaticMethod(typeof(SecurityElementBase), "AreBindingsMatching", security.CreateMessageSecurity(), sbe);
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void EnableTransportSecurity(HttpsRelayTransportBindingElement https)
		{
			if (mode == EndToEndBasicHttpSecurityMode.TransportWithMessageCredential)
			{
				transportSecurity.ConfigureTransportProtectionOnly(https);
			}
			else
			{
				transportSecurity.ConfigureTransportProtectionAndAuthentication(https);
			}
		}

		internal void EnableTransportAuthentication(HttpRelayTransportBindingElement http)
		{
			transportSecurity.ConfigureTransportAuthentication(http);
		}

		internal void DisableTransportAuthentication(HttpRelayTransportBindingElement http)
		{
			transportSecurity.DisableTransportAuthentication(http);
		}

		internal SecurityBindingElement CreateMessageSecurity()
		{
			if (mode == EndToEndBasicHttpSecurityMode.Message || mode == EndToEndBasicHttpSecurityMode.TransportWithMessageCredential)
			{
				return messageSecurity.CreateMessageSecurity(Mode == EndToEndBasicHttpSecurityMode.TransportWithMessageCredential);
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static BinaryMessageEncodingBindingElement CreateInnerEncodingBindingElement(BindingContext context)
		{
			if (context == null)

				return defaultEncoderBindingElement;
			}
			BinaryMessageEncodingBindingElement binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement = context.BindingParameters.Find<BinaryMessageEncodingBindingElement>();
			BinaryMessageEncodingBindingElement binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement2;

			{
				binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement2 = binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement.Clone() as BinaryMessageEncodingBindingElement;
			}
			else
			{
				binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement2 = new BinaryMessageEncodingBindingElement();
				TextMessageEncodingBindingElement textMessageEncodingBindingElement = context.BindingParameters.Find<TextMessageEncodingBindingElement>();
				if (textMessageEncodingBindingElement != null)
				{
					textMessageEncodingBindingElement.ReaderQuotas.CopyTo(binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement2.ReaderQuotas);
					binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement2.MaxReadPoolSize = textMessageEncodingBindingElement.MaxReadPoolSize;
					binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement2.MaxWritePoolSize = textMessageEncodingBindingElement.MaxWritePoolSize;
				}
				else
				{
					MtomMessageEncodingBindingElement mtomMessageEncodingBindingElement = context.BindingParameters.Find<MtomMessageEncodingBindingElement>();
					if (mtomMessageEncodingBindingElement != null)
					{
						mtomMessageEncodingBindingElement.ReaderQuotas.CopyTo(binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement2.ReaderQuotas);
						binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement2.MaxReadPoolSize = mtomMessageEncodingBindingElement.MaxReadPoolSize;
						binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement2.MaxWritePoolSize = mtomMessageEncodingBindingElement.MaxWritePoolSize;
					}
					else
					{
						WebMessageEncodingBindingElement webMessageEncodingBindingElement = context.BindingParameters.Find<WebMessageEncodingBindingElement>();
						if (webMessageEncodingBindingElement != null)
						{
							webMessageEncodingBindingElement.ReaderQuotas.CopyTo(binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement2.ReaderQuotas);
							binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement2.MaxReadPoolSize = webMessageEncodingBindingElement.MaxReadPoolSize;
							binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement2.MaxWritePoolSize = webMessageEncodingBindingElement.MaxWritePoolSize;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement2;
		}

		internal static ConnectMessage CreateConnectMessage(Uri endpointAddress, OperationContext operationContext)
		{
			ConnectMessage connectMessage = new ConnectMessage(endpointAddress);
			if (operationContext != null)
			{
				connectMessage.AllowedListenerIDs = ExtractListenerIDs(operationContext.OutgoingMessageProperties, "Microsoft-Relay-AllowedListeners")?.ToArray();
				connectMessage.DisallowedListenerIDs = ExtractListenerIDs(operationContext.OutgoingMessageProperties, "Microsoft-Relay-DisallowedListeners")?.ToArray();
			}
			return connectMessage;
		}

		internal static IList<Guid> ParseListenersString(string listeners)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(listeners))
			{
				List<Guid> list = new List<Guid>();
				string[] array = listeners.Split(new char[1] { ',' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
				foreach (string input in array)
				{
					list.Add(Guid.Parse(input));
				}
				return list;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static IList<Guid> ExtractListenerIDs(MessageProperties messageProperties, string keyName)
		{
			if (messageProperties != null && messageProperties.TryGetValue(keyName, out var value))
			{
				return ParseListenersString(value.ToString());
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	internal class ConnectivityModeHelper
	{
		private static readonly InternalConnectivityMode? OverrideInternalConnectivityMode;

		internal static ConnectivityMode SystemConnectivityMode
		{
			get
			{
				if (ServiceBusEnvironment.SystemConnectivity.Mode == ConnectivityMode.AutoDetect && OverrideInternalConnectivityMode.HasValue)
				{
					if (OverrideInternalConnectivityMode != InternalConnectivityMode.Tcp)
					{
						return ConnectivityMode.Http;
					}
					return ConnectivityMode.Tcp;
				}
				return ServiceBusEnvironment.SystemConnectivity.Mode;
			}
		}

		internal ConnectivitySettings ConnectivitySettings { get; }

		internal HttpConnectivitySettings HttpConnectivitySettings { get; }

		static ConnectivityModeHelper()
		{
			OverrideInternalConnectivityMode = ConfigurationHelpers.GetOverrideConnectivityMode();
		}

		public ConnectivityModeHelper(ConnectivitySettings connectivitySettings, HttpConnectivitySettings httpConnectivitySettings)
		{
			ConnectivitySettings = connectivitySettings;
			HttpConnectivitySettings = httpConnectivitySettings;
		}

		internal InternalConnectivityMode GetInternalConnectivityMode(Uri uri)
		{
			return GetInternalConnectivityMode(ConnectivitySettings, HttpConnectivitySettings, uri);
		}

		internal static InternalConnectivityMode GetInternalConnectivityMode(ConnectivitySettings connectivitySettings, HttpConnectivitySettings httpConnectivitySettings, Uri uri)
		{
			if (connectivitySettings == ServiceBusEnvironment.SystemConnectivity && httpConnectivitySettings == null && connectivitySettings.Mode == ConnectivityMode.AutoDetect && OverrideInternalConnectivityMode.HasValue)
			{
				return OverrideInternalConnectivityMode.Value;
			}
			ConnectivityMode detectMode = connectivitySettings?.Mode ?? ServiceBusEnvironment.SystemConnectivity.Mode;
			HttpConnectivityMode defaultHttpDetectMode = httpConnectivitySettings?.Mode ?? HttpConnectivityMode.AutoDetect;
			return GetInternalConnectivityMode(detectMode, defaultHttpDetectMode, uri);
		}

		private static InternalConnectivityMode GetInternalConnectivityMode(ConnectivityMode detectMode, HttpConnectivityMode defaultHttpDetectMode, Uri uri)
		{
			switch (detectMode)
			{
			case ConnectivityMode.Tcp:
				return InternalConnectivityMode.Tcp;
			case ConnectivityMode.Https:
				switch (defaultHttpDetectMode)
				{
				case HttpConnectivityMode.Https:
					return InternalConnectivityMode.Https;
				default:
					return InternalConnectivityMode.HttpsWebSocket;
				case HttpConnectivityMode.AutoDetect:
					break;
				}
				break;
			}
			if (detectMode == ConnectivityMode.Http)
			{
				switch (defaultHttpDetectMode)
				{
				case HttpConnectivityMode.Http:
					return InternalConnectivityMode.Http;
				case HttpConnectivityMode.Https:
					return InternalConnectivityMode.Https;
				default:
					return InternalConnectivityMode.HttpsWebSocket;
				case HttpConnectivityMode.AutoDetect:
					break;
				}
			}
			if (detectMode != ConnectivityMode.AutoDetect)
			{
				return NetworkDetector.DetectInternalConnectivityModeForHttp(uri);
			}
			return NetworkDetector.DetectInternalConnectivityModeForAutoDetect(uri);
		}
	}
	internal class ConnectivityModeConnectionElement : IConnectionElement, ISecureableConnectionElement
	{
		private static readonly UriPrefixTable<ITransportManagerRegistration> transportManagerTable = new UriPrefixTable<ITransportManagerRegistration>(includePortInComparison: true);

		private readonly TokenProvider tokenProvider;

		private readonly ConnectivityModeHelper connectivityModeHelper;

		private readonly IConnectionElement connectionElement;

		private readonly SslProtocols? sslProtocolOverride;

		private readonly BindingContext context;

		public SocketSecurityRole SecurityMode { get; private set; }

		public UriPrefixTable<ITransportManagerRegistration> TransportManagerTable => transportManagerTable;

		public ConnectivityModeConnectionElement(TokenProvider tokenProvider, SocketSecurityRole socketSecurityMode, BindingContext context, NameSettings nameSettings, SslProtocols? sslProtocolOverride = null)
		{
			this.tokenProvider = tokenProvider;
			SecurityMode = socketSecurityMode;
			this.sslProtocolOverride = sslProtocolOverride;
			this.context = context;
			ConnectivitySettings connectivitySettings = context.BindingParameters.Find<ConnectivitySettings>() ?? ServiceBusEnvironment.SystemConnectivity;
			HttpConnectivitySettings httpConnectivitySettings = context.BindingParameters.Find<HttpConnectivitySettings>();
			connectivityModeHelper = new ConnectivityModeHelper(connectivitySettings, httpConnectivitySettings);
			if (context != null && context.ListenUriBaseAddress != null)
			{
				InternalConnectivityMode internalConnectivityMode = connectivityModeHelper.GetInternalConnectivityMode(context.ListenUriBaseAddress);
				switch (internalConnectivityMode)
				{
				case InternalConnectivityMode.Tcp:
					connectionElement = new RelayedSocketElement(context, nameSettings, this.tokenProvider, SecurityMode, this.sslProtocolOverride);
					break;
				case InternalConnectivityMode.Http:
					connectionElement = new WebStreamRelayedConnectionElement(this.tokenProvider, SecurityMode, context, nameSettings, useHttpsMode: false);
					break;
				case InternalConnectivityMode.Https:
					connectionElement = new WebStreamRelayedConnectionElement(this.tokenProvider, SecurityMode, context, nameSettings, useHttpsMode: true);
					break;
				case InternalConnectivityMode.HttpsWebSocket:
					connectionElement = new WebSocketRelayedConnectionElement(this.tokenProvider, SecurityMode, context, nameSettings, connectivityModeHelper.ConnectivitySettings, this.sslProtocolOverride);
					break;
				default:
					throw new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.UnsupportedConnectivityMode(internalConnectivityMode));
				}
			}
		}

		public IConnectionInitiator CreateInitiator(int bufferSize)
		{
			return new ConnectivityModeConnectionInitiator(tokenProvider, SecurityMode, bufferSize, connectivityModeHelper, sslProtocolOverride, context);
		}

		public IConnectionListener CreateListener(int bufferSize, Uri uri)
		{
			if (connectionElement == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("connectionElement");
			}
			return connectionElement.CreateListener(bufferSize, uri);
		}

		public bool IsCompatible(IConnectionElement element)
		{
			return element is ConnectivityModeConnectionElement;
		}

		public T GetProperty<T>() where T : class
		{
			if (connectionElement != null)
			{
				return connectionElement.GetProperty<T>();
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	internal class ConnectivityModeConnectionInitiator : IConnectionInitiator
	{
		private readonly TokenProvider tokenProvider;

		private readonly SocketSecurityRole securityMode;

		private readonly int bufferSize;

		private readonly ConnectivityModeHelper connectivityModeHelper;

		private readonly SslProtocols? sslProtocolOverride;

		private readonly BindingContext bindingContext;

		private readonly object mutex = new object();

		private volatile IConnectionInitiator httpWebStreamConnectionInitiator;

		private volatile IConnectionInitiator httpsWebSocketConnectionInitiator;

		private volatile IConnectionInitiator httpsWebStreamConnectionInitiator;

		private volatile IConnectionInitiator tcpConnectionInitiator;

		private InternalConnectivityMode mode;

		private IConnectionInitiator HttpWebStreamConnectionInitiator
		{
			get
			{
				if (httpWebStreamConnectionInitiator == null)
				{
					lock (mutex)
					{
						if (httpWebStreamConnectionInitiator == null)
						{
							httpWebStreamConnectionInitiator = new WebStreamConnectionInitiator(tokenProvider, securityMode, bufferSize, useHttpsMode: false);
						}
					}
				}
				return httpWebStreamConnectionInitiator;
			}
		}

		private IConnectionInitiator HttpsWebSocketConnectionInitiator
		{
			get
			{
				if (httpsWebSocketConnectionInitiator == null)
				{
					lock (mutex)
					{
						if (httpsWebSocketConnectionInitiator == null)
						{
							httpsWebSocketConnectionInitiator = new WebSocketConnectionInitiator(connectivityModeHelper.ConnectivitySettings, tokenProvider, bufferSize, sslProtocolOverride, bindingContext);
						}
					}
				}
				return httpsWebSocketConnectionInitiator;
			}
		}

		private IConnectionInitiator HttpsWebStreamConnectionInitiator
		{
			get
			{
				if (httpsWebStreamConnectionInitiator == null)
				{
					lock (mutex)
					{
						if (httpsWebStreamConnectionInitiator == null)
						{
							httpsWebStreamConnectionInitiator = new WebStreamConnectionInitiator(tokenProvider, securityMode, bufferSize, useHttpsMode: true);
						}
					}
				}
				return httpsWebStreamConnectionInitiator;
			}
		}

		private IConnectionInitiator TcpConnectionInitiator
		{
			get
			{
				if (tcpConnectionInitiator == null)
				{
					lock (mutex)
					{
						if (tcpConnectionInitiator == null)
						{
							tcpConnectionInitiator = new RelayedSocketInitiator(connectivityModeHelper.ConnectivitySettings, bufferSize, tokenProvider, securityMode, sslProtocolOverride);
						}
					}
				}
				return tcpConnectionInitiator;
			}
		}

		public ConnectivityModeConnectionInitiator(TokenProvider tokenProvider, SocketSecurityRole securityMode, int bufferSize, ConnectivityModeHelper connectivityModeHelper, SslProtocols? sslProtocolOverride, BindingContext bindingContext)
		{
			this.tokenProvider = tokenProvider;
			this.securityMode = securityMode;
			this.bufferSize = bufferSize;
			this.connectivityModeHelper = connectivityModeHelper;
			this.sslProtocolOverride = sslProtocolOverride;
			this.bindingContext = bindingContext;
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginConnect(Uri uri, TrackingContext trackingContext, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			mode = connectivityModeHelper.GetInternalConnectivityMode(uri);
			return mode switch
			{
				InternalConnectivityMode.Tcp => TcpConnectionInitiator.BeginConnect(uri, trackingContext, timeout, callback, state), 
				InternalConnectivityMode.Http => HttpWebStreamConnectionInitiator.BeginConnect(uri, trackingContext, timeout, callback, state), 
				InternalConnectivityMode.Https => HttpsWebStreamConnectionInitiator.BeginConnect(uri, trackingContext, timeout, callback, state), 
				InternalConnectivityMode.HttpsWebSocket => HttpsWebSocketConnectionInitiator.BeginConnect(uri, trackingContext, timeout, callback, state), 
				_ => throw new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.UnsupportedConnectivityMode(mode)), 
			};
		}

		public IConnection Connect(Uri uri, TrackingContext trackingContext, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			InternalConnectivityMode internalConnectivityMode = connectivityModeHelper.GetInternalConnectivityMode(uri);
			return internalConnectivityMode switch
			{
				InternalConnectivityMode.Tcp => TcpConnectionInitiator.Connect(uri, trackingContext, timeout), 
				InternalConnectivityMode.Http => HttpWebStreamConnectionInitiator.Connect(uri, trackingContext, timeout), 
				InternalConnectivityMode.Https => HttpsWebStreamConnectionInitiator.Connect(uri, trackingContext, timeout), 
				InternalConnectivityMode.HttpsWebSocket => HttpsWebSocketConnectionInitiator.Connect(uri, trackingContext, timeout), 
				_ => throw new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.UnsupportedConnectivityMode(internalConnectivityMode)), 
			};
		}

		public IConnection EndConnect(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			return mode switch
			{
				InternalConnectivityMode.Tcp => TcpConnectionInitiator.EndConnect(result), 
				InternalConnectivityMode.Http => HttpWebStreamConnectionInitiator.EndConnect(result), 
				InternalConnectivityMode.Https => HttpsWebStreamConnectionInitiator.EndConnect(result), 
				InternalConnectivityMode.HttpsWebSocket => HttpsWebSocketConnectionInitiator.EndConnect(result), 
				_ => throw new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.UnsupportedConnectivityMode(mode)), 
			};
		}
	}

	internal class RelayTokenHeader : MessageHeader, IXmlSerializable
	{
		private readonly SecurityToken token;

		public override string Name => "RelayAccessToken";

		public override string Namespace => "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2009/05/servicebus/connect";

		public SecurityToken Token => token;

		public RelayTokenHeader(SecurityToken token)
		{
			this.token = token;
		}

		protected override void OnWriteHeaderContents(XmlDictionaryWriter writer, MessageVersion messageVersion)
		{
			SecurityTokenSerializer defaultInstance = SimpleWebSecurityTokenSerializer.DefaultInstance;
			if (token != null && defaultInstance.CanWriteToken(token))
			{
				defaultInstance.WriteToken(writer, token);
			}
		}

		private static RelayViaHeader ReadHeader(MessageHeaders headers)
		{
			int num = headers.FindHeader("RelayVia", "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2009/05/servicebus/connect");
			if (num == -1)
			{
				return null;

			XmlDictionaryReader readerAtHeader = headers.GetReaderAtHeader(num);

		private enum ConnectivityStatus
		{
			Unknown,
			Testing,
			Available,
			Unavailable
		}

		private static int httpConnectivityStatus;

		private static int tcpConnectivityStatus;

		private static int httpWebStreamConnectivityStatus;

		private static int httpsWebStreamConnectivityStatus;

		private static int httpsWebSocketConnectivityStatus;

		static NetworkDetector()
		{
			NetworkChange.NetworkAvailabilityChanged += delegate
			{
				Reset();
			};
			NetworkChange.NetworkAddressChanged += delegate
			{
				Reset();
			};
		}

		public static bool IsHttpConnectivityAvailable(Uri baseAddress, out Exception exception)
		{
			exception = null;
			while (true)
			{
				ConnectivityStatus connectivityStatus = (ConnectivityStatus)Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref httpConnectivityStatus, 1, 0);
				switch (connectivityStatus)
				{
				case ConnectivityStatus.Available:
				case ConnectivityStatus.Unavailable:
					return connectivityStatus == ConnectivityStatus.Available;
				case ConnectivityStatus.Testing:
					Thread.Sleep(5);
					continue;
				}
				ConnectivityStatus connectivityStatus2 = CheckHttpConnectivity(baseAddress, out exception);
				ConnectivityStatus connectivityStatus3 = (ConnectivityStatus)Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref httpConnectivityStatus, (int)connectivityStatus2, 1);
				switch (connectivityStatus3)
				{
				case ConnectivityStatus.Unknown:
					continue;
				case ConnectivityStatus.Testing:
					return connectivityStatus2 == ConnectivityStatus.Available;
				}
				if (connectivityStatus2 == connectivityStatus3)
				{
					return connectivityStatus2 == ConnectivityStatus.Available;
				}
				httpConnectivityStatus = 0;
			}
		}

		private static ConnectivityStatus CheckHttpConnectivity(Uri baseAddress, out Exception exception)
		{
			ConnectivityStatus result = ConnectivityStatus.Unavailable;
			exception = null;
			try
			{
				Uri requestUri = ServiceBusUriHelper.CreateServiceUri("http", baseAddress.Authority, "/");
				WebRequest webRequest = WebRequest.Create(requestUri);
				webRequest.Method = "GET";
				WebResponse response = webRequest.GetResponse();
				StreamReader streamReader = new StreamReader(response.GetResponseStream());
				using (streamReader)
				{
					streamReader.ReadToEnd();
				}
				result = ConnectivityStatus.Available;
			}
			catch (WebException ex)
			{
				exception = ex;
			}
			LogResult(baseAddress, "Http", result);
			return result;
		}

		public static bool IsNetTcpConnectivityAvailable(Uri baseAddress, out Exception exception)
		{
			exception = null;
			while (true)
			{
				ConnectivityStatus connectivityStatus = (ConnectivityStatus)Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref tcpConnectivityStatus, 1, 0);
				switch (connectivityStatus)
				{
				case ConnectivityStatus.Available:
				case ConnectivityStatus.Unavailable:
					return connectivityStatus == ConnectivityStatus.Available;
				case ConnectivityStatus.Testing:
					Thread.Sleep(5);
					continue;
				}
				ConnectivityStatus connectivityStatus2 = CheckTcpConnectivity(baseAddress, out exception);
				ConnectivityStatus connectivityStatus3 = (ConnectivityStatus)Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref tcpConnectivityStatus, (int)connectivityStatus2, 1);
				switch (connectivityStatus3)
				{
				case ConnectivityStatus.Unknown:
					continue;
				case ConnectivityStatus.Testing:
					return connectivityStatus2 == ConnectivityStatus.Available;

				tcpConnectivityStatus = 0;
			}
		}

		private static ConnectivityStatus CheckTcpConnectivity(Uri baseAddress, out Exception exception)
		{
			ConnectivityStatus result = ConnectivityStatus.Unavailable;
			exception = null;
			if (!RelayEnvironment.GetEnvironmentVariable("RELAYFORCEHTTP", defaultValue: false) && !RelayEnvironment.GetEnvironmentVariable("RELAYFORCEHTTPS", defaultValue: false))
			{
				try
				{
					BinaryMessageEncodingBindingElement item = new BinaryMessageEncodingBindingElement();
					TcpTransportBindingElement tcpTransportBindingElement = new TcpTransportBindingElement();
					tcpTransportBindingElement.ConnectionPoolSettings.MaxOutboundConnectionsPerEndpoint = 100;
					tcpTransportBindingElement.MaxReceivedMessageSize = 65536L;
					CustomBinding customBinding = new CustomBinding();
					customBinding.Elements.Add(item);
					customBinding.Elements.Add(tcpTransportBindingElement);
					customBinding.OpenTimeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10.0);
					customBinding.SendTimeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10.0);
					customBinding.ReceiveTimeout = TimeSpan.MaxValue;
					Uri uri = ServiceBusUriHelper.CreateServiceUri("net.tcp", baseAddress.DnsSafeHost + ":" + 9350.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), "/");
					IChannelFactory<IDuplexSessionChannel> channelFactory = null;
					IDuplexSessionChannel duplexSessionChannel = null;
					try
					{
						channelFactory = customBinding.BuildChannelFactory<IDuplexSessionChannel>(Array.Empty<object>());
						channelFactory.Open();
						duplexSessionChannel = channelFactory.CreateChannel(new EndpointAddress(uri));
						duplexSessionChannel.Open();
						System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message = System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message.CreateMessage(MessageVersion.Default, "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2009/05/servicebus/connect/OnewayPing", new OnewayPingMessage());
						duplexSessionChannel.Send(message, customBinding.SendTimeout);
						duplexSessionChannel.Close();
						duplexSessionChannel = null;
						channelFactory.Close();
						channelFactory = null;
					}
					finally
					{
						duplexSessionChannel?.Abort();
						channelFactory?.Abort();
					}
					result = ConnectivityStatus.Available;
				}
				catch (CommunicationException ex)
				{
					exception = ex;
				}
				catch (TimeoutException ex2)
				{
					exception = ex2;
				}
			}
			LogResult(baseAddress, "Tcp (9350)", result);
			return result;
		}

		private static void LogResult(Uri checkUri, string checkMode, ConnectivityStatus result)
		{
			if (result == ConnectivityStatus.Available)
			{
				ServiceBusEventSource.Log.Info(TrackingContext.Current, "Relay", "NetworkDetector", $"Detecting connectivity mode succeeded: Endpoint: {checkUri}, TriedMode: {checkMode}", "LogResult", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\NetworkDetector.cs", 497);
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.DetectConnectivityModeSucceeded(checkUri.AbsoluteUri, checkMode);
			}
			else
			{
				ServiceBusEventSource.Log.Warning(TrackingContext.Current, "Relay", "NetworkDetector", $"Detecting connectivity mode failed: Endpoint: {checkUri}, TriedMode: {checkMode}", "LogResult", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\NetworkDetector.cs", 503);
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.DetectConnectivityModeFailed(checkUri.AbsoluteUri, checkMode);
			}
		}

			httpWebStreamConnectivityStatus = 0;

			httpsWebSocketConnectivityStatus = 0;
			httpConnectivityStatus = 0;
		}

		public static ConnectivityMode DetectConnectivityModeForAutoDetect(Uri uri)
		{
			if (tcpConnectivityStatus == 3 && httpConnectivityStatus == 3)
			{
				Reset();
			}
			Exception[] array = new Exception[2];
			if (IsNetTcpConnectivityAvailable(uri, out array[0]))
			{
				return ConnectivityMode.Tcp;
			}
			if (IsHttpConnectivityAvailable(uri, out array[1]))
			{
				return ConnectivityMode.Http;
			}
			Exception[] array2 = array.Where((Exception e) => e != null).ToArray();
			string message = SRClient.UnableToReach(uri.Host, 9351, 9352);
			if (array2.Length != 0)
			{
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new CommunicationException(message, new AggregateException(array2)), null, EventLevel.Warning, "DetectConnectivityModeForAutoDetect", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\NetworkDetector.cs", 546);
			}
			throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new CommunicationException(message), null, EventLevel.Warning, "DetectConnectivityModeForAutoDetect", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\NetworkDetector.cs", 550);
		}

		public static InternalConnectivityMode DetectInternalConnectivityModeForAutoDetect(Uri uri)
		{
			if (tcpConnectivityStatus == 3 && httpWebStreamConnectivityStatus == 3 && httpsWebStreamConnectivityStatus == 3)
			{
				Reset();
			}
			Exception[] array = new Exception[4];

				return InternalConnectivityMode.Https;

			Exception[] array2 = array.Where((Exception e) => e != null).ToArray();
			string message = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "Unable to reach {0} via TCP ({1}, {2}) or HTTP (80, 443)", uri.Host, 9351, 9352);
			if (array2.Length != 0)
			{
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new CommunicationException(message, new AggregateException(array2)), null, EventLevel.Warning, "DetectInternalConnectivityModeForAutoDetect", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\NetworkDetector.cs", 598);

		}

		public static InternalConnectivityMode DetectInternalConnectivityModeForHttp(Uri uri)
		{
			if (httpWebStreamConnectivityStatus == 3 && httpsWebSocketConnectivityStatus == 3 && httpsWebStreamConnectivityStatus == 3)
			{
				Reset();
			}
			Exception[] array = new Exception[3];
			if (IsHttpsWebSocketConnectivityAvailable(uri, out array[0]))
			{
				return InternalConnectivityMode.HttpsWebSocket;
			}
			if (IsHttpWebStreamConnectivityAvailable(uri, out array[1]))
			{
				return InternalConnectivityMode.Http;
			}
			if (IsHttpsWebStreamConnectivityAvailable(uri, out array[2]))
			{
				return InternalConnectivityMode.Https;
			}
			Exception[] array2 = array.Where((Exception e) => e != null).ToArray();
			string message = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "Unable to reach {0} HTTP (80, 443)", uri.Host);
			if (array2.Length != 0)
			{
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new CommunicationException(message, new AggregateException(array2)), null, EventLevel.Warning, "DetectInternalConnectivityModeForHttp", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\NetworkDetector.cs", 640);
			}
			throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new CommunicationException(message), null, EventLevel.Warning, "DetectInternalConnectivityModeForHttp", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\NetworkDetector.cs", 643);
		}

		public static void SetConnectivityMode(InternalConnectivityMode mode)
		{
			switch (mode)
			{
			case InternalConnectivityMode.Tcp:
				tcpConnectivityStatus = 2;
				httpsWebSocketConnectivityStatus = 3;
				httpWebStreamConnectivityStatus = 3;
				httpsWebStreamConnectivityStatus = 3;
				httpConnectivityStatus = 3;
				break;
			case InternalConnectivityMode.Http:
				tcpConnectivityStatus = 3;
				httpsWebSocketConnectivityStatus = 3;
				httpWebStreamConnectivityStatus = 2;
				httpsWebStreamConnectivityStatus = 3;
				httpConnectivityStatus = 2;
				break;
			case InternalConnectivityMode.Https:
				tcpConnectivityStatus = 3;
				httpsWebStreamConnectivityStatus = 2;
				httpsWebSocketConnectivityStatus = 3;
				httpWebStreamConnectivityStatus = 3;
				httpConnectivityStatus = 3;
				break;
			case InternalConnectivityMode.HttpsWebSocket:
				tcpConnectivityStatus = 3;
				httpsWebSocketConnectivityStatus = 2;
				httpsWebStreamConnectivityStatus = 3;
				httpWebStreamConnectivityStatus = 3;
				httpConnectivityStatus = 3;
				break;
			}
		}

	internal class RelayedHttpBodyFormatHeader : MessageHeader
	{
		public const string HeaderName = "BodyFormat";

		public const string HeaderNamespace = "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2009/05/servicebus/body";

		private readonly string format;

		public string Format => format;

		public override string Name => "BodyFormat";

		public override string Namespace => "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2009/05/servicebus/body";

		public RelayedHttpBodyFormatHeader(string format)
		{
			this.format = format;
		}

		public static string ReadHeader(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message)
		{
			MessageHeaders headers = message.Headers;
			int num = headers.FindHeader("BodyFormat", "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2009/05/servicebus/body");
			if (num == -1)
			{
				return RelayedHttpUtility.FormatStringDefault;
			}
			using XmlDictionaryReader xmlDictionaryReader = headers.GetReaderAtHeader(num);
			return xmlDictionaryReader.ReadString();
		}

		protected override void OnWriteHeaderContents(XmlDictionaryWriter writer, MessageVersion messageVersion)
		{
			writer.WriteString(format);
		}
	}
	internal class RelayedHttpStatusCodeHeader : MessageHeader
	{
		public const string HeaderName = "StatusCode";

		public const string HeaderNamespace = "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2009/05/servicebus/statuscode";

		private HttpStatusCode statusCode;

		public override string Name => "StatusCode";

		public override string Namespace => "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2009/05/servicebus/statuscode";

		public RelayedHttpStatusCodeHeader(HttpStatusCode statusCode)
		{
			this.statusCode = statusCode;
		}

		protected override void OnWriteHeaderContents(XmlDictionaryWriter writer, MessageVersion messageVersion)
		{
			int num = (int)statusCode;
			writer.WriteString(num.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
		}

		public static HttpStatusCode ReadHeader(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message)
		{
			return ReadHeader(message, HttpStatusCode.Accepted);
		}

		public static HttpStatusCode ReadHeader(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, HttpStatusCode defaultCode)
		{
			MessageHeaders headers = message.Headers;
			int num = headers.FindHeader("StatusCode", "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2009/05/servicebus/statuscode");
			if (num != -1)
			{
				XmlDictionaryReader readerAtHeader = headers.GetReaderAtHeader(num);
				string s = readerAtHeader.ReadString();
				return (HttpStatusCode)int.Parse(s, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			}
			if (message.Properties.TryGetValue(HttpResponseMessageProperty.Name, out var value))
			{
				HttpResponseMessageProperty httpResponseMessageProperty = (HttpResponseMessageProperty)value;
				return httpResponseMessageProperty.StatusCode;
			}
			return defaultCode;
		}
	}
	internal class LenientDnsIdentityVerifier : IdentityVerifier
	{
		private readonly DnsEndpointIdentity expectedIdentity;

		public LenientDnsIdentityVerifier()
		{
		}

		public LenientDnsIdentityVerifier(DnsEndpointIdentity expectedIdentity)
		{
			this.expectedIdentity = expectedIdentity;
		}

		public LenientDnsIdentityVerifier(string dnsName)
			: this(new DnsEndpointIdentity(dnsName))
		{
		}

		public override bool CheckAccess(EndpointIdentity identity, AuthorizationContext authContext)
		{
			X509Extension x509Extension = null;
			foreach (ClaimSet claimSet in authContext.ClaimSets)
			{
				if (x509Extension == null && claimSet is X509CertificateClaimSet { X509Certificate: not null } x509CertificateClaimSet)
				{
					x509Extension = x509CertificateClaimSet.X509Certificate.Extensions["2.5.29.17"];
				}
				foreach (Claim item in claimSet)
				{
					if (ClaimTypes.Dns == item.ClaimType && CheckTopLevelDomainCompatibleness(item.Resource.ToString(), identity.IdentityClaim.Resource.ToString()))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return SecureSocketUtil.CertificateCheckSubjectAlternativeNames(x509Extension, identity.IdentityClaim.Resource.ToString());
		}

		public override bool TryGetIdentity(EndpointAddress reference, out EndpointIdentity identity)
		{
			if (expectedIdentity != null)
			{
				identity = expectedIdentity;
				return true;
			}
			if (reference == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("reference");
			}
			identity = reference.Identity;
			if (identity == null)
			{
				identity = TryCreateDnsIdentity(reference);
			}
			if (identity == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool CheckTopLevelDomainCompatibleness(string actualIdentity, string expectedIdentity)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(actualIdentity) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(expectedIdentity))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (actualIdentity.StartsWith("*.", StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				actualIdentity = actualIdentity.Substring(2);
			}
			if (actualIdentity.Split('.').Length < 2 && expectedIdentity.IndexOf(".", StringComparison.Ordinal) != -1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (expectedIdentity.EndsWith(actualIdentity, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				string text = expectedIdentity.Substring(0, expectedIdentity.Length - actualIdentity.Length);
				if (text.IndexOf(".", StringComparison.Ordinal) != text.Length - 1)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			IdnMapping idnMapping = new IdnMapping();
			string ascii = idnMapping.GetAscii(expectedIdentity);
			if (ascii.EndsWith(actualIdentity, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				string text2 = ascii.Substring(0, ascii.Length - actualIdentity.Length);
				if (text2.IndexOf(".", StringComparison.Ordinal) != text2.Length - 1)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static EndpointIdentity TryCreateDnsIdentity(EndpointAddress reference)
		{
			Uri uri = reference.Uri;
			if (!uri.IsAbsoluteUri)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return EndpointIdentity.CreateDnsIdentity(uri.DnsSafeHost);
		}
	}
	internal class RelayedOnewayHttpSender : CommunicationObject, IRelayedOnewaySender, ICommunicationObject, IConnectionStatus
	{
		private IOutputChannel channel;

		private ChannelFactory<IOutputChannel> channelFactory;

		private TokenProvider tokenProvider;

		private Uri via;

		protected override TimeSpan DefaultCloseTimeout => ServiceDefaults.CloseTimeout;

		protected override TimeSpan DefaultOpenTimeout => ServiceDefaults.OpenTimeout;

		public bool IsOnline => true;

		public Exception LastError => null;

		public TokenProvider TokenProvider => tokenProvider;

		public event EventHandler Connecting;

		public event EventHandler Offline;

		public event EventHandler Online;

		public RelayedOnewayHttpSender(BindingContext context, Uri uri, bool transportProtectionEnabled)
		{
			tokenProvider = TokenProviderUtility.CreateTokenProvider(context);
			if (tokenProvider != null)
			{
				transportProtectionEnabled = true;
			}
			System.ServiceModel.Channels.Binding binding;
			if (transportProtectionEnabled)
			{
				binding = new WSHttpBinding(SecurityMode.Transport);
				via = RelayedHttpUtility.ConvertToHttpsUri(uri);
			}
			else
			{
				binding = new WSHttpBinding(SecurityMode.None);
				via = RelayedHttpUtility.ConvertToHttpUri(uri);
			}
			channelFactory = new ChannelFactory<IOutputChannel>(binding);
			channelFactory.Open();
			channel = channelFactory.CreateChannel(new EndpointAddress(uri), via);
			channel.Open();
			OnOnline(this, EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		private void OnOffline(object sender, EventArgs args)
		{
			this.Offline?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		private void OnOnline(object sender, EventArgs args)
		{
			this.Online?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		protected override void OnAbort()
		{
			channelFactory.Abort();
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return channelFactory.BeginClose(timeout, callback, state);
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginOpen(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new CompletedAsyncResult(callback, state);
		}

		protected override void OnClose(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			channelFactory.Close(timeout);
		}

		protected override void OnEndClose(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			channelFactory.EndClose(result);
		}

		protected override void OnEndOpen(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			CompletedAsyncResult.End(result);
		}

		protected override void OnOpen(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
		}

		protected override void OnClosed()
		{
			base.OnClosed();
			OnOffline(this, EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginSend(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
			AddToken(message, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
			return channel.BeginSend(message, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime(), callback, state);
		}

		public void EndSend(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			channel.EndSend(result);
		}

		public void Send(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
			AddToken(message, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
			channel.Send(message, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
		}

		private void AddToken(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			if (TokenProvider != null)
			{
				SecurityToken token = TokenProvider.GetToken(via.AbsoluteUri, "Send", bypassCache: false, timeout);
				message.Headers.Add(new RelayTokenHeader(token));
			}
		}
	}

		private NetOnewayRelaySecurity(EndToEndSecurityMode mode, RelayClientAuthenticationType relayClientAuthenticationType, RelayedOnewayTransportSecurity transportSecurity, MessageSecurityOverRelayOneway messageSecurity)
		{
			DiagnosticUtility.DebugAssert(EndToEndSecurityModeHelper.IsDefined(mode), string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "Invalid RelaySecurityMode value: {0}.", mode.ToString()));
			this.mode = mode;
			this.relayClientAuthenticationType = relayClientAuthenticationType;
			this.transportSecurity = ((transportSecurity == null) ? new RelayedOnewayTransportSecurity() : transportSecurity);
			this.messageSecurity = ((messageSecurity == null) ? new MessageSecurityOverRelayOneway() : messageSecurity);

		internal static bool IsConfiguredTransportSecurity(NetOnewayRelayBindingElement oneway, out UnifiedSecurityMode mode)
		{
			if (oneway == null)
			{
				mode = UnifiedSecurityMode.None;
				return false;
			}
			if (oneway.Security.Mode == EndToEndSecurityMode.Transport || oneway.Security.Mode == EndToEndSecurityMode.TransportWithMessageCredential)
			{
				mode = UnifiedSecurityMode.Transport | UnifiedSecurityMode.TransportWithMessageCredential;
			}
			else
			{
				mode = UnifiedSecurityMode.None | UnifiedSecurityMode.Message;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static bool TryCreate(SecurityBindingElement sbe, EndToEndSecurityMode mode, RelayClientAuthenticationType relayClientAuthenticationType, out NetOnewayRelaySecurity security)
		{
			security = null;
			if (!MessageSecurityOverRelayOneway.TryCreate(sbe, out var messageSecurityOverRelayOneway))
			{
				messageSecurityOverRelayOneway = null;
			}
			security = new NetOnewayRelaySecurity(mode, relayClientAuthenticationType, null, messageSecurityOverRelayOneway);
			if (sbe != null)
			{
				return (bool)InvokeHelper.InvokeStaticMethod(typeof(SecurityElementBase), "AreBindingsMatching", security.CreateMessageSecurity(), sbe, false);
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void ConfigureTransportSecurity(RelayedOnewayTransportBindingElement oneway)
		{
			if (mode == EndToEndSecurityMode.Transport || mode == EndToEndSecurityMode.TransportWithMessageCredential)
			{
				oneway.TransportProtectionEnabled = true;
			}
			else
			{
				oneway.TransportProtectionEnabled = false;
			}
		}

		internal SecurityBindingElement CreateMessageSecurity()
		{
			return Message.CreateSecurityBindingElement();
		}
