			if (netOnewayRelayBindingElement == null)
			{
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new ConfigurationErrorsException(SR.GetString(Resources.ConfigInvalidBindingConfigurationName, configurationName, "netTcpRelayBinding")), null, EventLevel.Warning, "ApplyConfiguration", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\NetOnewayRelayBinding.cs", 237);
			}
			netOnewayRelayBindingElement.ApplyConfiguration(this);
		}

		public override BindingElementCollection CreateBindingElements()
		{
			BindingElementCollection bindingElementCollection = new BindingElementCollection();
			SecurityBindingElement securityBindingElement = CreateMessageSecurity();
			if (securityBindingElement != null)
			{
				bindingElementCollection.Add(securityBindingElement);
			}
			bindingElementCollection.Add(encoding);
			transport.RelayClientAuthenticationType = security.RelayClientAuthenticationType;
			transport.TransportProtectionEnabled = security.Mode == EndToEndSecurityMode.Transport || security.Mode == EndToEndSecurityMode.TransportWithMessageCredential;
			bindingElementCollection.Add(transport);
			return bindingElementCollection.Clone();
		}

		internal static bool TryCreate(BindingElementCollection elements, out System.ServiceModel.Channels.Binding binding)
		{
			binding = null;
			if (elements.Count > 3)
			{
				return false;
			}
			SecurityBindingElement sbe = null;
			BinaryMessageEncodingBindingElement binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement = null;
			RelayedOnewayTransportBindingElement relayedOnewayTransportBindingElement = null;
			foreach (BindingElement element in elements)
			{
				if (element is SecurityBindingElement)
				{
					sbe = element as SecurityBindingElement;
					continue;
				}
				if (element is TransportBindingElement)
				{
					relayedOnewayTransportBindingElement = element as RelayedOnewayTransportBindingElement;
					continue;
				}
				if (element is MessageEncodingBindingElement)
				{
					binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement = element as BinaryMessageEncodingBindingElement;
					continue;
				}
				return false;
			}
			UnifiedSecurityMode mode = ((!relayedOnewayTransportBindingElement.TransportProtectionEnabled) ? (UnifiedSecurityMode.None | UnifiedSecurityMode.Message) : (UnifiedSecurityMode.Transport | UnifiedSecurityMode.TransportWithMessageCredential));
			if (binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!TryCreateSecurity(sbe, relayedOnewayTransportBindingElement.RelayClientAuthenticationType, mode, out var netOnewayRelaySecurity))
			{
				return false;
			}
			NetOnewayRelayBinding netOnewayRelayBinding = new NetOnewayRelayBinding(netOnewayRelaySecurity);
			InitializeFrom(relayedOnewayTransportBindingElement, binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement);
			if (!netOnewayRelayBinding.IsBindingElementsMatch(relayedOnewayTransportBindingElement, binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement))
			{
				return false;
			}
			binding = netOnewayRelayBinding;
			return true;
		}

		private static void InitializeFrom(RelayedOnewayTransportBindingElement transport, BinaryMessageEncodingBindingElement encoding)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		private SecurityBindingElement CreateMessageSecurity()
		{
			if (security.Mode == EndToEndSecurityMode.Message || security.Mode == EndToEndSecurityMode.TransportWithMessageCredential)
			{
				return security.CreateMessageSecurity();
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static bool TryCreateSecurity(SecurityBindingElement sbe, RelayClientAuthenticationType relayClientAuthenticationType, UnifiedSecurityMode mode, out NetOnewayRelaySecurity security)
		{
			mode = ((sbe == null) ? (mode & ~(UnifiedSecurityMode.Message | UnifiedSecurityMode.Both)) : (mode & (UnifiedSecurityMode.Message | UnifiedSecurityMode.Both)));
			EndToEndSecurityMode endToEndSecurityMode = EndToEndSecurityModeHelper.ToRelaySecurityMode(mode);
			DiagnosticUtility.DebugAssert(EndToEndSecurityModeHelper.IsDefined(endToEndSecurityMode), string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "Invalid RelaySecurityMode value: {0}.", endToEndSecurityMode.ToString()));
			if (NetOnewayRelaySecurity.TryCreate(sbe, endToEndSecurityMode, relayClientAuthenticationType, out security))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private RelayedOnewayTransportBindingElement GetTransport()
		{
			security.ConfigureTransportSecurity(transport);
			return transport;
		}
	}
	public class NetTcpRelayBinding : NetTcpRelayBindingBase, IBindingRuntimePreferences
	{
		private OptionalReliableSession reliableSession;

		private ReliableSessionBindingElement session;

		public OptionalReliableSession ReliableSession => reliableSession;

		public NetTcpRelayBinding()
		{
			Initialize();
		}

		public NetTcpRelayBinding(EndToEndSecurityMode securityMode, RelayClientAuthenticationType relayClientAuthenticationType)
			: base(securityMode, relayClientAuthenticationType)
		{
			Initialize();
		}

		public NetTcpRelayBinding(EndToEndSecurityMode securityMode, RelayClientAuthenticationType relayClientAuthenticationType, bool reliableSessionEnabled)
			: this(securityMode, relayClientAuthenticationType)
		{
			ReliableSession.Enabled = reliableSessionEnabled;
		}

		public NetTcpRelayBinding(string configurationName)
			: base(configurationName)
		{
		}

		protected NetTcpRelayBinding(TcpRelayTransportBindingElement transport, BinaryMessageEncodingBindingElement encoding, ReliableSessionBindingElement session, NetTcpRelaySecurity security)
			: base(transport, encoding, security)
		{
			Initialize();
			ReliableSession.Enabled = session != null;
			InitializeFrom(session);
		}

		private void Initialize()
		{
			session = new ReliableSessionBindingElement();
			reliableSession = new OptionalReliableSession(session);
		}

		private void InitializeFrom(ReliableSessionBindingElement session)
		{
			if (session != null)
			{
				this.session.InactivityTimeout = session.InactivityTimeout;
				this.session.Ordered = session.Ordered;
			}
		}

		protected bool IsBindingElementsMatch(TcpRelayTransportBindingElement transport, BinaryMessageEncodingBindingElement encoding, ReliableSessionBindingElement session)
		{
			if (!IsBindingElementsMatch(transport, encoding))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (reliableSession.Enabled)
			{
				if (!(bool)InvokeHelper.InvokeInstanceMethod(typeof(BindingElement), this.session, "IsMatch", session))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			else if (session != null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override void ApplyConfiguration(string configurationName)
		{
			Initialize();
			base.ApplyConfiguration(configurationName);
		}

		public override BindingElementCollection CreateBindingElements()
		{
			BindingElementCollection bindingElementCollection = base.CreateBindingElements();
			if (reliableSession.Enabled)
			{
				bindingElementCollection.Insert(0, session);
			}
			return bindingElementCollection.Clone();
		}

		protected internal override SecurityBindingElement CreateMessageSecurity()
		{
			if (security.Mode == EndToEndSecurityMode.Message || security.Mode == EndToEndSecurityMode.TransportWithMessageCredential)
			{
				return security.CreateMessageSecurity(ReliableSession.Enabled, base.MessageSecurityVersion);
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static bool TryCreate(BindingElementCollection elements, out System.ServiceModel.Channels.Binding binding)
		{
			binding = null;
			if (elements.Count > 5)
			{
				return false;
			}
			TcpRelayTransportBindingElement tcpRelayTransportBindingElement = null;
			BinaryMessageEncodingBindingElement binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement = null;
			ReliableSessionBindingElement reliableSessionBindingElement = null;
			SecurityBindingElement sbe = null;
			foreach (BindingElement element in elements)
			{
				if (element is SecurityBindingElement)
				{
					sbe = element as SecurityBindingElement;
				}
				else if (element is TransportBindingElement)
				{
					tcpRelayTransportBindingElement = element as TcpRelayTransportBindingElement;
				}
				else if (element is MessageEncodingBindingElement)
				{
					binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement = element as BinaryMessageEncodingBindingElement;
				}
				else if (element is ReliableSessionBindingElement)
				{
					reliableSessionBindingElement = element as ReliableSessionBindingElement;
				}
			}
			if (tcpRelayTransportBindingElement == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			TcpRelayTransportSecurity tcpTransportSecurity = new TcpRelayTransportSecurity();
			if (!NetTcpRelayBindingBase.TryCreateSecurity(mode: (!tcpRelayTransportBindingElement.TransportProtectionEnabled) ? (UnifiedSecurityMode.None | UnifiedSecurityMode.Message) : (UnifiedSecurityMode.Transport | UnifiedSecurityMode.TransportWithMessageCredential), sbe: sbe, relayClientAuthenticationType: tcpRelayTransportBindingElement.RelayClientAuthenticationType, isReliableSession: reliableSessionBindingElement != null, tcpTransportSecurity: tcpTransportSecurity, security: out var netTcpRelaySecurity))
			{
				return false;
			}
			NetTcpRelayBinding netTcpRelayBinding = new NetTcpRelayBinding(tcpRelayTransportBindingElement, binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement, reliableSessionBindingElement, netTcpRelaySecurity);
			if (!netTcpRelayBinding.IsBindingElementsMatch(tcpRelayTransportBindingElement, binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement, reliableSessionBindingElement))
			{
				return false;
			}
			binding = netTcpRelayBinding;
			return true;
		}
	}

	[DataContract(Name = "AddressCandidates", Namespace = "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2009/05/servicebus/connect")]
	internal class AddressCandidates : IExtensibleDataObject
	{
		[DataMember(Name = "Addresses", IsRequired = false, EmitDefaultValue = false, Order = 0)]
		private Collection<AddressCandidate> addresses;

		private ExtensionDataObject extension;

		ExtensionDataObject IExtensibleDataObject.ExtensionData
		{
			get
			{
				return extension;
			}
			set
			{
				extension = value;
			}
		}

		public Collection<AddressCandidate> Addresses
		{
			get
			{
				return addresses;
			}
			set
			{
				addresses = value;
			}
		}

		public AddressCandidates()
		{
			addresses = new Collection<AddressCandidate>();
		}

		public void AddEndpoints(AddressType type, params IPEndPoint[] endpoints)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < endpoints.Length; i++)
			{
				addresses.Add(new AddressCandidate(type, endpoints[i].Address.GetRawIPv4Address(), endpoints[i].Port));
			}
		}

		public AddressCandidate GetAddress(AddressType type)
		{
			List<AddressCandidate> list = GetAddresses(type);
			if (list.Count != 1)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.MoreThanOneAddressCandidate);
			}
			return list[0];
		}

		public List<AddressCandidate> GetAddresses(AddressType type)
		{
			List<AddressCandidate> list = new List<AddressCandidate>();
			for (int i = 0; i < addresses.Count; i++)
			{
				if (addresses[i].Type == type)
				{
					list.Add(addresses[i]);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public IPEndPoint GetEndpoint(AddressType type)
		{
			List<IPEndPoint> endpoints = GetEndpoints(type);
			if (endpoints.Count != 1)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.MoreThanOneIPEndPoint);
			}
			return endpoints[0];
		}

		public List<IPEndPoint> GetEndpoints(AddressType type)
		{
			List<AddressCandidate> list = GetAddresses(type);
			List<IPEndPoint> list2 = new List<IPEndPoint>();
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				list2.Add(new IPEndPoint(list[i].Address, list[i].Port));
			}
			return list2;
		}
	}

	internal class DirectConnectionCandidateManager : IDirectConnectionParent, IDisposable
	{
		private abstract class Candidate : IDisposable
		{
			private bool disposed;

			private bool complete;

			private object mutex;

			private IDirectConnectionParent parent;

			protected object ThisLock => mutex;

			public Candidate(string type, IDirectConnectionParent parent)
			{
				this.parent = parent;
				mutex = new object();
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
				lock (ThisLock)
				{
					if (disposed)
					{
						return;
					}
					disposed = true;
					complete = true;
				}
				try
				{
					OnDispose();
				}
				catch
				{
				}
				GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
			}

			protected void Failure(Exception exception)
			{
				lock (ThisLock)
				{
					if (complete)
					{
						return;
					}
					complete = true;
				}
				parent.Failure(this, exception);
			}

			protected void Success(Socket socket)
			{
				lock (ThisLock)
				{
					if (complete)
					{
						socket.Close();
						return;
					}
					complete = true;
				}
				parent.Success(this, socket);
			}

			protected abstract void OnDispose();
		}

		private class ConnectCandidate : Candidate
		{
			private Socket connectSocket;

			public ConnectCandidate(string type, IDirectConnectionParent parent)
				: base(type, parent)
			{
			}

			protected override void OnDispose()
			{
				lock (base.ThisLock)
				{
					if (connectSocket != null)
					{
						connectSocket.Close();
					}
				}
			}

			public bool Start(ref IPEndPoint localEndpoint, IPEndPoint serverAddress, out Exception exception)
			{
				exception = null;
				IAsyncResult asyncResult = null;
				try
				{
					connectSocket = new Socket(serverAddress.AddressFamily, SocketType.Stream, ProtocolType.Tcp);
					connectSocket.SetSocketOption(SocketOptionLevel.Socket, SocketOptionName.ReuseAddress, optionValue: true);
					connectSocket.SetSocketOption(SocketOptionLevel.Socket, SocketOptionName.KeepAlive, optionValue: true);
					connectSocket.Bind(localEndpoint);
					lock (base.ThisLock)
					{
						asyncResult = connectSocket.BeginConnect(serverAddress, ConnectCallback, null);
						localEndpoint = (IPEndPoint)connectSocket.LocalEndPoint;
					}
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					Failure(exception = ex);
					return false;
				}
				if (asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
				{
					ConnectComplete(asyncResult, completedSynchronously: true);
				}
				return true;
			}

			private void ConnectCallback(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				if (!result.CompletedSynchronously)
				{
					ConnectComplete(result, completedSynchronously: false);
				}
			}

			private void ConnectComplete(IAsyncResult result, bool completedSynchronously)
			{
				try
				{
					connectSocket.EndConnect(result);
					Socket socket;
					lock (base.ThisLock)
					{
						socket = connectSocket;
						connectSocket = null;
					}
					if (socket != null)
					{
						Success(socket);
					}
				}
				catch (Exception exception)
				{
					Failure(exception);
				}
			}
		}

		private class ListenCandidate : Candidate
		{
			private Socket listenSocket;

			public ListenCandidate(string type, IDirectConnectionParent parent)
				: base(type, parent)
			{
			}

			protected override void OnDispose()
			{
				listenSocket.Close();
				listenSocket = null;
			}

			public bool Start(ref IPEndPoint listenAddress)
			{
				try
				{
					listenSocket = new Socket(listenAddress.AddressFamily, SocketType.Stream, ProtocolType.Tcp);
					listenSocket.SetSocketOption(SocketOptionLevel.Socket, SocketOptionName.ReuseAddress, optionValue: true);
					listenSocket.SetSocketOption(SocketOptionLevel.Socket, SocketOptionName.KeepAlive, optionValue: true);
					listenSocket.Bind(listenAddress);
					listenSocket.Listen(10);
					listenAddress = (IPEndPoint)listenSocket.LocalEndPoint;
				}
				catch (Exception exception)
				{
					Failure(exception);
					return false;
				}
				BeginAccept();
				return true;
			}

			private void BeginAccept()
			{
				IAsyncResult asyncResult = null;
				try
				{
					asyncResult = listenSocket.BeginAccept(AcceptCallback, null);
				}
				catch (Exception exception)
				{
					Failure(exception);
					return;
				}
				if (asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
				{
					AcceptComplete(asyncResult, completedSynchronously: true);
				}
			}

			private void AcceptCallback(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				if (!result.CompletedSynchronously)
				{
					AcceptComplete(result, completedSynchronously: false);
				}
			}

			private void AcceptComplete(IAsyncResult result, bool completedSynchronously)
			{
				try
				{
					if (listenSocket != null)
					{
						Socket socket = listenSocket.EndAccept(result);
						if (socket != null)
						{
							Success(socket);
						}
					}
				}
				catch (Exception exception)
				{
					Failure(exception);
				}
			}
		}

		private readonly object mutex;

		private readonly List<Candidate> candidates;

		private readonly IDirectConnectionParent parent;

		private bool complete;

		private bool disposed;

		private int refCount;

		public Uri Uri => parent.Uri;

		private object ThisLock => mutex;

		public DirectConnectionCandidateManager(IDirectConnectionParent parent)
		{
			this.parent = parent;
			candidates = new List<Candidate>();
			mutex = new object();
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (disposed)
				{
					return;
				}
				disposed = true;
				complete = true;
				for (int i = 0; i < candidates.Count; i++)
				{
					try
					{
						candidates[i].Dispose();
					}
					catch
					{
					}
				}
				candidates.Clear();
			}
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		private void Failure(object sender, Exception exception)
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (complete)
				{
					return;
				}
				complete = true;
			}
			parent.Failure(this, exception);
		}

		public bool StartConnecting(ref IPEndPoint localEndpoint, IPEndPoint serverAddress, string type)
		{
			Exception exception;
			return StartConnecting(ref localEndpoint, serverAddress, type, out exception);
		}

		public bool StartConnecting(ref IPEndPoint localEndpoint, IPEndPoint serverAddress, string type, out Exception exception)
		{
			exception = null;
			ConnectCandidate connectCandidate = null;
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (complete)
				{
					return false;
				}
				connectCandidate = new ConnectCandidate(type, this);
				candidates.Add(connectCandidate);
			}
			return connectCandidate.Start(ref localEndpoint, serverAddress, out exception);
		}

		public bool StartListening(ref IPEndPoint listenAddress, string type)
		{
			IDisposable candidate;
			return StartListening(ref listenAddress, type, out candidate);
		}

		public bool StartListening(ref IPEndPoint listenAddress, string type, out IDisposable candidate)
		{
			candidate = null;
			ListenCandidate listenCandidate;
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (complete)
				{
					return false;
				}
				listenCandidate = new ListenCandidate(type, this);
				candidates.Add(listenCandidate);
				candidate = listenCandidate;
			}
			return listenCandidate.Start(ref listenAddress);
		}

		public void AddRef()
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				refCount++;
			}
		}

		public void Release()
		{
			bool flag = false;
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				refCount--;
				if (refCount == 0 && candidates.Count == 0 && !complete)
				{
					if (complete)
					{
						return;
					}
					complete = true;
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (complete)
				{
					return;
				}
				complete = true;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				parent.Failure(this, new Exception("Connect failed"));
			}
		}

		void IDirectConnectionParent.Failure(object sender, Exception exception)
		{
			Candidate candidate = (Candidate)sender;
			bool flag = false;
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				candidates.Remove(candidate);
				candidate.Dispose();
				if (refCount == 0 && candidates.Count == 0 && !complete)
				{
					if (complete)
					{
						return;
					}
					complete = true;
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				Failure(this, new Exception("Connect failed"));
			}
		}

		void IDirectConnectionParent.Success(object sender, Socket socket)
		{
			Candidate candidate = (Candidate)sender;
			bool flag = false;
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				candidates.Remove(candidate);
				candidate.Dispose();
				if (complete)
				{
					socket.Close();
					return;
				}
				complete = true;
				flag = true;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				parent.Success(this, socket);
			}
		}
	}
	[CallbackBehavior(ConcurrencyMode = ConcurrencyMode.Multiple)]
	internal class DirectConnectionSession : IDirectConnectionControl, IDirectConnectionParent
	{
		private abstract class Activity : IDirectConnectionControl, IDirectConnectionParent, IDisposable
		{
			private DirectConnectionCandidateManager candidates;

			private bool complete;

			private bool disposed;

			private IDirectConnectionParent parent;

			private DirectConnectionSession session;

			public Uri Uri => parent.Uri;

			protected DirectConnectionCandidateManager Candidates => candidates;

			protected DirectConnectionSession Session => session;

			protected object ThisLock => session.ThisLock;

			protected Activity(DirectConnectionSession session)
			{
				this.session = session;
				parent = session;
				candidates = new DirectConnectionCandidateManager(this);
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
				lock (ThisLock)
				{
					if (disposed)
					{
						return;
					}
					disposed = true;
					complete = true;
				}
				try
				{
					OnDispose();
				}
				catch (Exception exception)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
					{
						throw;
					}
				}
				GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
			}

			public void Failure(Exception exception)
			{
				lock (ThisLock)
				{
					if (complete)
					{
						return;
					}
					complete = true;
				}
				parent.Failure(this, exception);
			}

			public void Success(Socket socket)
			{
				lock (ThisLock)
				{
					if (complete)
					{
						socket.Close();
						return;
					}
					complete = true;
				}
				parent.Success(this, socket);
			}

			void IDirectConnectionParent.Failure(object sender, Exception exception)
			{
				lock (ThisLock)
				{
					if (complete)
					{
						return;
					}
				}
				OnFailure(exception);
			}

			void IDirectConnectionParent.Success(object sender, Socket socket)
			{
				lock (ThisLock)
				{
					if (complete)
					{
						socket.Close();
						return;
					}
				}
				if (!ValidateSocket(socket))
				{
					OnFailure(new CommunicationException("Socket validation failed"));
				}
				else
				{
					OnSuccess(socket);
				}
			}

			protected virtual void OnDispose()
			{
				candidates.Dispose();
			}

			protected virtual void OnFailure(Exception exception)
			{
				Failure(exception);
			}

			protected virtual void OnSuccess(Socket socket)
			{
				Success(socket);
			}

			public abstract void Start();

			protected abstract bool ValidateSocket(Socket socket);

			public virtual void Abort(AbortMessage request)
			{
				Failure(new CommunicationException("Connect attempt aborted"));
			}

			public virtual void Connect(DirectConnectMessage request)
			{
				throw new FaultException(SRClient.InvalidCallFaultException);
			}

			public virtual void ConnectRetry(ConnectRetryMessage request)
			{
				throw new FaultException(SRClient.InvalidCallFaultException);
			}

			public virtual void ConnectResponse(ConnectResponseMessage request)
			{
				throw new FaultException(SRClient.InvalidCallFaultException);
			}

			public virtual void SwitchRoles(SwitchRolesMessage request)
			{
				throw new FaultException(SRClient.InvalidCallFaultException);
			}
		}

		private class ConnectActivity : Activity
		{
			private const int ConnectTimeout = 15;

			private ManualResetEvent completeEvent;

			private DerivedEndpoint localDerivedEndpoint;

			private List<IPEndPoint> localEndpoints;

			private IDisposable localListener;

			private Socket socket;

			private const int WSAEADDRINUSE = 10048;

			public ConnectActivity(DirectConnectionSession session)
				: base(session)
			{
				completeEvent = new ManualResetEvent(initialState: false);
				localDerivedEndpoint = new DerivedEndpoint();
				localEndpoints = new List<IPEndPoint>();
			}

			protected override void OnFailure(Exception exception)
			{
				completeEvent.Set();
			}

			protected override void OnSuccess(Socket socket)
			{
				this.socket = socket;
				completeEvent.Set();
			}

			public override void Start()
			{
				if (base.Session.Attempts == 4)
				{
					try
					{
						base.Session.Channel.Abort(new AbortMessage(base.Session.Id.ToString()));
					}
					catch (Exception exception)
					{
						if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
						{
							throw;
						}
					}
					throw new CommunicationException(SRClient.MaximumAttemptsExceeded);
				}
				ClientStartListening(localDerivedEndpoint, localEndpoints);
				ClientSendConnectRequest(localDerivedEndpoint.ExternalEndpoint, localEndpoints);
			}

			public override void ConnectResponse(ConnectResponseMessage request)
			{
				IPEndPoint endpoint = request.Addresses.GetEndpoint(AddressType.External);
				if (!ClientStartConnecting(ref localDerivedEndpoint.LocalEndpoint, endpoint, out var exception) && exception is SocketException { ErrorCode: 10048 })
				{
					localListener.Dispose();
					ClientStartConnecting(ref localDerivedEndpoint.LocalEndpoint, endpoint, out exception);
				}
				IOThreadScheduler.ScheduleCallbackNoFlow(WaitForTimeout, null);
			}

			private void WaitForTimeout(object state)
			{
				if (completeEvent.WaitOne(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(15.0), exitContext: false) && socket != null)
				{
					Success(socket);
					return;
				}
				base.Session.StartActivity(new ListenActivity(base.Session));
				try
				{
					base.Session.Channel.SwitchRoles(new SwitchRolesMessage(base.Session.Id.ToString()));
				}
				catch (Exception exception)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
					{
						throw;
					}
				}
			}

			private void ClientSendConnectRequest(IPEndPoint externalEndpoint, List<IPEndPoint> localEndpoints)
			{
				AddressCandidates addressCandidates = new AddressCandidates();
				addressCandidates.AddEndpoints(AddressType.External, externalEndpoint);
				addressCandidates.AddEndpoints(AddressType.Local, localEndpoints.ToArray());
				try
				{
					if (base.Session.Attempts++ == 0)
					{
						base.Session.Channel.Connect(new DirectConnectMessage(base.Session.Id.ToString(), addressCandidates));
					}
					else
					{
						base.Session.Channel.ConnectRetry(new ConnectRetryMessage(base.Session.Id.ToString(), addressCandidates));
					}
				}
				catch (Exception exception)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
					{
						throw;
					}
				}
			}

			private void ClientStartListening(DerivedEndpoint localDerivedEndpoint, List<IPEndPoint> localEndpoints)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				if (base.Session.ProbingClient.PredictNextExternalPort(localDerivedEndpoint))
				{
					if (!base.Candidates.StartListening(ref localDerivedEndpoint.LocalEndpoint, "Listener.ClientLocalEndpoint", out localListener))
					{
						return;
					}
					if (localDerivedEndpoint.ExternalEndpoint.Port == 0)
					{
						localDerivedEndpoint.ExternalEndpoint.Port = localDerivedEndpoint.LocalEndpoint.Port;
					}
					localEndpoints.Add(localDerivedEndpoint.LocalEndpoint);
					flag = true;
				}
				List<IPAddress> localAddresses = GetLocalAddresses();
				for (int i = 0; i < localAddresses.Count; i++)
				{
					if (!flag || localAddresses[i].GetRawIPv4Address() != localDerivedEndpoint.LocalEndpoint.Address.GetRawIPv4Address())
					{
						IPEndPoint listenAddress = new IPEndPoint(localAddresses[i], 0);
						if (!base.Candidates.StartListening(ref listenAddress, "Listener.ClientRealAddress"))
						{
							return;
						}
						localEndpoints.Add(listenAddress);
					}
				}
				Thread.Sleep(200);
			}

			private bool ClientStartConnecting(ref IPEndPoint localEndpoint, IPEndPoint remoteExternalEndpoint, out Exception exception)
			{
				if (!base.Candidates.StartConnecting(ref localEndpoint, remoteExternalEndpoint, "Connector.ServerExternalEndpoint", out exception))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}

			public static List<IPAddress> GetLocalAddresses()
			{
				List<IPAddress> list = new List<IPAddress>();
				NetworkInterface[] allNetworkInterfaces = NetworkInterface.GetAllNetworkInterfaces();
				NetworkInterface[] array = allNetworkInterfaces;
				foreach (NetworkInterface networkInterface in array)
				{
					if (networkInterface.NetworkInterfaceType == NetworkInterfaceType.Loopback)
					{
						continue;
					}
					UnicastIPAddressInformationCollection unicastAddresses = networkInterface.GetIPProperties().UnicastAddresses;
					foreach (UnicastIPAddressInformation item in unicastAddresses)
					{
						if (item.Address.AddressFamily == AddressFamily.InterNetwork)
						{
							list.Add(item.Address);
						}
					}
				}
				return list;
			}

			protected override bool ValidateSocket(Socket socket)
			{
				try
				{
					byte[] buffer = base.Session.Id.ToByteArray();
					socket.Send(buffer);
					byte[] array = new byte[1];
					int num = socket.Receive(array, 0, 1, SocketFlags.None);
					if (num < 1 || array[0] != 1)
					{
						throw new CommunicationException(SRClient.InvalidReceivedContent);
					}
				}
				catch (Exception exception)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
					{
						throw;
					}
					socket.Close();
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private class ListenActivity : Activity
		{
			private bool connecting;

			private DerivedEndpoint localDerivedEndpoint;

			private List<IPEndPoint> localEndpoints;

			public ListenActivity(DirectConnectionSession session)
				: base(session)
			{
				localDerivedEndpoint = new DerivedEndpoint();
				localEndpoints = new List<IPEndPoint>();
			}

			public override void Start()
			{
			}

			public override void Connect(DirectConnectMessage request)
			{
				Connect(request.Addresses);
			}

			public override void ConnectRetry(ConnectRetryMessage request)
			{
				Connect(request.Addresses);
			}

			public override void SwitchRoles(SwitchRolesMessage request)
			{
				base.Session.StartActivity(new ConnectActivity(base.Session));
			}

			public void Connect(AddressCandidates addresses)
			{
				lock (base.ThisLock)
				{
					if (connecting)
					{
						throw new FaultException(SRClient.InvalidCallFaultException);
					}
					connecting = true;
				}
				try
				{
					localEndpoints = addresses.GetEndpoints(AddressType.Local);
					IPEndPoint endpoint = addresses.GetEndpoint(AddressType.External);
					ServerStartConnectingLocal(localEndpoints);
					ServerStartConnectingExternal(localDerivedEndpoint, endpoint);
					IOThreadScheduler.ScheduleCallbackNoFlow(SendResponse, null);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					Failure(ex);
					throw new FaultException(ex.ToString());
				}
			}

			private void SendResponse(object state)
			{
				try
				{
					AddressCandidates addressCandidates = new AddressCandidates();
					addressCandidates.AddEndpoints(AddressType.External, localDerivedEndpoint.ExternalEndpoint);
					base.Session.Channel.ConnectResponse(new ConnectResponseMessage(base.Session.Id.ToString(), addressCandidates));
				}
				catch (Exception exception)
				{
					Failure(exception);
				}
			}

			private void ServerStartConnectingLocal(List<IPEndPoint> localEndpoints)
			{
				NetworkInterface[] allNetworkInterfaces = NetworkInterface.GetAllNetworkInterfaces();
				NetworkInterface[] array = allNetworkInterfaces;
				foreach (NetworkInterface networkInterface in array)
				{
					if (networkInterface.NetworkInterfaceType == NetworkInterfaceType.Loopback)
					{
						continue;
					}
					UnicastIPAddressInformationCollection unicastAddresses = networkInterface.GetIPProperties().UnicastAddresses;
					foreach (UnicastIPAddressInformation item in unicastAddresses)
					{
						if (item.Address.AddressFamily != AddressFamily.InterNetwork || item.IPv4Mask == null)
						{
							continue;
						}
						IPEndPoint localEndpoint = new IPEndPoint(item.Address, 0);
						for (int j = 0; j < localEndpoints.Count; j++)
						{
							IPEndPoint iPEndPoint = localEndpoints[j];
							if ((item.IPv4Mask.GetRawIPv4Address() & localEndpoint.Address.GetRawIPv4Address()) == (item.IPv4Mask.GetRawIPv4Address() & iPEndPoint.Address.GetRawIPv4Address()))
							{
								base.Candidates.StartConnecting(ref localEndpoint, localEndpoints[j], "Connector.ClientLocalAddress");
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}

			private void ServerStartConnectingExternal(DerivedEndpoint localDerivedEndpoint, IPEndPoint remoteExternalEndpoint)
			{
				if (base.Session.ProbingClient.PredictNextExternalPort(localDerivedEndpoint) && base.Candidates.StartConnecting(ref localDerivedEndpoint.LocalEndpoint, remoteExternalEndpoint, "Connector.ClientExternalEndpoint"))
				{
					base.Candidates.StartListening(ref localDerivedEndpoint.LocalEndpoint, "Listener.ServerLocalEndpoint");
					if (localDerivedEndpoint.ExternalEndpoint.Port == 0)
					{
						localDerivedEndpoint.ExternalEndpoint.Port = localDerivedEndpoint.LocalEndpoint.Port;
					}
				}
			}

			protected override bool ValidateSocket(Socket socket)
			{
				try
				{
					byte[] array = new byte[16];
					int num = socket.Receive(array, 0, 16, SocketFlags.None);
					if (num != 16)
					{
						throw new CommunicationException(SRClient.InvalidLengthofReceivedContent);
					}
					Guid guid = new Guid(array);
					if (guid != base.Session.Id)
					{
						throw new CommunicationException(SRClient.InvalidReceivedSessionId);
					}
					byte[] buffer = new byte[1] { 1 };
					socket.Send(buffer);
				}
				catch (Exception exception)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
					{
						throw;
					}
					socket.Close();
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public const int MaxAttempts = 4;

		private Activity activity;

		private int attempt;

		private IDirectConnectionControl channel;

		private bool complete;

		private bool isClosed;

		private Guid id;

		private object mutex;

		private IDirectConnectionParent parent;

		private ProbingClient probingClient;

		public int Attempts
		{
			get
			{
				return attempt;
			}
			set
			{
				attempt = value;
			}
		}

		public IDirectConnectionControl Channel
		{
			get
			{
				return channel;
			}
			set
			{
				channel = value;
			}
		}

		public Guid Id => id;

		public Uri Uri => parent.Uri;

		public ProbingClient ProbingClient => probingClient;

		internal TrackingContext TrackingContext { get; }

		private object ThisLock => mutex;

		public DirectConnectionSession(Guid id, ProbingClient probingClient, IDirectConnectionParent parent)
		{
			this.id = id;
			TrackingContext = TrackingContext.Create(this.id.ToString(), parent.Uri, appendRole: false);
			this.probingClient = probingClient;
			this.parent = parent;
			mutex = new object();
		}

		public void Initiate()
		{
			StartActivity(new ConnectActivity(this));
		}

		public void Listen()
		{
			StartActivity(new ListenActivity(this));
		}

		private void StartActivity(Activity activity)
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (this.activity != null)
				{
					this.activity.Dispose();
				}
				this.activity = activity;
			}
			try
			{
				this.activity.Start();
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				Failure(this, exception);
			}
		}

		public void Close(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			Abort();
		}

		public void Abort()
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (!isClosed)
				{
					isClosed = true;
					complete = true;
					if (activity != null)
					{
						activity.Dispose();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public void Failure(object sender, Exception exception)
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (complete)
				{
					return;
				}
				complete = true;
			}
			parent.Failure(this, exception);
		}

		public void Success(object sender, Socket socket)
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (complete)
				{
					socket.Close();
					return;
				}
				complete = true;
			}
			parent.Success(this, socket);
		}

		void IDirectConnectionControl.Abort(AbortMessage request)
		{
			activity.Abort(request);
		}

		void IDirectConnectionControl.Connect(DirectConnectMessage request)
		{
			activity.Connect(request);
		}

		void IDirectConnectionControl.ConnectRetry(ConnectRetryMessage request)
		{
			activity.ConnectRetry(request);
		}

		void IDirectConnectionControl.ConnectResponse(ConnectResponseMessage request)
		{
			activity.ConnectResponse(request);
		}

		void IDirectConnectionControl.SwitchRoles(SwitchRolesMessage request)
		{
			activity.SwitchRoles(request);
		}
	}

	{

		public UriPrefixTable<ITransportManagerRegistration> TransportManagerTable => transportManagerTable;

		public DirectSocketElement(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Binding innerBinding)
		{
			this.innerBinding = innerBinding;
		}

		public IConnectionInitiator CreateInitiator(int bufferSize)
		{
			return new DirectSocketInitiator(bufferSize, innerBinding);
		}

		public IConnectionListener CreateListener(int bufferSize, Uri uri)
		{
			return new DirectSocketListener(bufferSize, uri, innerBinding);
		}

		{
			if (element is DirectSocketElement)
			{
				return innerBinding == ((DirectSocketElement)element).innerBinding;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public T GetProperty<T>() where T : class
		{
			return null;
		}
	}
	internal class DirectSocketInitiator : IConnectionInitiator
	{
		private class DirectConnectAsyncResult : AsyncResult<DirectConnectAsyncResult>, IDirectConnectionParent, ITraceSource
		{
			private readonly int bufferSize;

			private readonly DuplexChannelFactory<IDirectConnectionControl> channelFactory;

			private readonly DirectConnectionSession session;

			private Socket socket;

			private bool complete;

			public IConnection Connection { get; private set; }

			public string Component => "Relay";

			public TrackingContext TrackingContext => session.TrackingContext;

			public Uri Uri { get; }

			protected internal override EventTraceActivity Activity => session.TrackingContext.Activity;

			public DirectConnectAsyncResult(int bufferSize, Uri uri, TimeSpan timeout, System.ServiceModel.Channels.Binding innerBinding, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(callback, state)
			{
				this.bufferSize = bufferSize;
				Uri = uri;
				ProbingClient probingClient = new ProbingClient(uri.Host, ConnectConstants.DefaultProbePorts);
				session = new DirectConnectionSession(Guid.NewGuid(), probingClient, this);
				channelFactory = new DuplexChannelFactory<IDirectConnectionControl>(session, innerBinding, new EndpointAddress(uri));
			}

			public void StartConnecting()
			{
				try
				{
					IDirectConnectionControl directConnectionControl = channelFactory.CreateChannel();
					((IChannel)directConnectionControl).Open();
					session.Channel = directConnectionControl;
					session.Initiate();
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
					{
						throw;
					}
					ServiceBusEventSource.Log.HandledException(ex, this, EventLevel.Warning, "StartConnecting", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\DirectConnection\\DirectSocketInitiator.cs", 99);
					session.Abort();
					channelFactory.Abort();
				}
			}

			private void Cleanup()
			{
				try
				{
					session.Close(ServiceDefaults.CloseTimeout);
					try
					{
						channelFactory.Close(ServiceDefaults.CloseTimeout);
					}
					catch (Exception ex)
					{
						if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
						{
							throw;
						}
						ServiceBusEventSource.Log.HandledException(ex, this, EventLevel.Warning, "Cleanup", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\DirectConnection\\DirectSocketInitiator.cs", 121);
						channelFactory.Abort();
					}
				}
				catch (Exception ex2)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(ex2))
					{
						throw;
					}
					ServiceBusEventSource.Log.HandledException(ex2, this, EventLevel.Warning, "Cleanup", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\DirectConnection\\DirectSocketInitiator.cs", 132);
					session.Abort();
				}
			}

			public void Success(object sender, Socket socket)
			{
				lock (base.ThisLock)
				{
					if (complete)
					{
						socket.Close();
						return;
					}
					complete = true;
					Cleanup();
					this.socket = socket;
				}
				Connection = new SocketConnection(this.socket, bufferSize, TrackingContext);
				Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: false);
			}

			public void Failure(object sender, Exception exception)
			{
				lock (base.ThisLock)
				{
					if (complete)
					{
						return;
					}
					complete = true;
					Cleanup();
				}
				Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: false, exception);
			}
		}

		private class DirectConnectWaiter : IDirectConnectionParent, IDisposable
		{
			private readonly int bufferSize;

			private readonly DuplexChannelFactory<IDirectConnectionControl> channelFactory;

			private readonly object mutex;

			private readonly DirectConnectionSession session;

			private readonly ManualResetEvent socketEvent;

			private bool complete;

			private Exception exception;

			private Socket socket;

			private TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper;

			public Uri Uri { get; }

			private TrackingContext TrackingContext => session.TrackingContext;

			private object ThisLock => mutex;

			public DirectConnectWaiter(int bufferSize, Uri uri, TimeSpan timeout, System.ServiceModel.Channels.Binding innerBinding)
			{
				this.bufferSize = bufferSize;
				Uri = uri;
				ProbingClient probingClient = new ProbingClient(uri.Host, ConnectConstants.DefaultProbePorts);
				session = new DirectConnectionSession(Guid.NewGuid(), probingClient, this);
				channelFactory = new DuplexChannelFactory<IDirectConnectionControl>(session, innerBinding, new EndpointAddress(uri));
				timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
				socketEvent = new ManualResetEvent(initialState: false);
				mutex = new object();
			}

			public IConnection Connect()
			{
				try
				{
					IDirectConnectionControl directConnectionControl = channelFactory.CreateChannel();
					((IChannel)directConnectionControl).Open();
					session.Channel = directConnectionControl;
					session.Initiate();
					IConnection result = Wait();
					session.Close(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
					try
					{
						channelFactory.Close(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
					}
					catch (Exception ex)
					{
						if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
						{
							throw;
						}
						ServiceBusEventSource.Log.HandledException(ex, TrackingContext, "Relay", this, EventLevel.Warning, "Connect", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\DirectConnection\\DirectSocketInitiator.cs", 232);
					}
					return result;
				}
				finally
				{
					channelFactory.Abort();
				}
			}

			public IConnection Wait()
			{
				if (!socketEvent.WaitOne(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime(), exitContext: false))
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new TimeoutException());
				}
				if (exception != null)
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.AsError(exception);
				}
				if (socket == null)
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new CommunicationException(SRClient.ConnectFailedCommunicationException));
				}
				return new SocketConnection(socket, bufferSize, TrackingContext);
			}

			public void Success(object sender, Socket socket)
			{
				lock (ThisLock)
				{
					if (complete)
					{
						socket.Close();
						return;
					}
					complete = true;
					this.socket = socket;
					socketEvent.Set();
				}
			}

			public void Failure(object sender, Exception exception)
			{
				lock (ThisLock)
				{
					if (!complete)
					{
						complete = true;
						this.exception = exception;
						socketEvent.Set();
					}
				}
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
				channelFactory.Abort();
				channelFactory.Close();
				socketEvent.Dispose();
			}
		}

		private readonly int bufferSize;

		private readonly System.ServiceModel.Channels.Binding innerBinding;

		public DirectSocketInitiator(int bufferSize, System.ServiceModel.Channels.Binding innerBinding)
		{
			this.bufferSize = bufferSize;
			this.innerBinding = innerBinding;
		}

		public IConnection Connect(Uri uri, TrackingContext trackingContext, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			using DirectConnectWaiter directConnectWaiter = new DirectConnectWaiter(bufferSize, uri, timeout, innerBinding);
			return directConnectWaiter.Connect();
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginConnect(Uri uri, TrackingContext trackingContext, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			DirectConnectAsyncResult directConnectAsyncResult = new DirectConnectAsyncResult(bufferSize, uri, timeout, innerBinding, callback, state);
			directConnectAsyncResult.StartConnecting();
			return directConnectAsyncResult;
		}

		public IConnection EndConnect(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			return AsyncResult<DirectConnectAsyncResult>.End(result).Connection;
		}
	}
	[ServiceBehavior(ConcurrencyMode = ConcurrencyMode.Multiple, InstanceContextMode = InstanceContextMode.Single)]
	internal class DirectSocketListener : IConnectionListener, IDirectConnectionControl, IDirectConnectionParent
	{
		private readonly int bufferSize;

		private readonly Dictionary<string, DirectConnectionSession> connectionSessions;

		private readonly object mutex;

		private readonly ProbingClient probingClient;

		private readonly ServiceHost serviceHost;

		private readonly InputQueue<IConnection> socketQueue;

		private bool isClosed;

		public Uri Uri { get; }

		private TrackingContext TrackingContext { get; }

		private object ThisLock => mutex;

		public DirectSocketListener(int bufferSize, Uri uri, System.ServiceModel.Channels.Binding innerBinding)
		{
			this.bufferSize = bufferSize;
			Uri = uri;
			probingClient = new ProbingClient(uri.Host, ConnectConstants.DefaultProbePorts);
			TrackingContext = TrackingContext.Create(uri);
			mutex = new object();
			serviceHost = new ConfigurationlessServiceHost(this, uri);
			ServiceErrorHandlerBehavior serviceErrorHandlerBehavior = new ServiceErrorHandlerBehavior();
			serviceErrorHandlerBehavior.HandleError += delegate(object s, ServiceErrorEventArgs e)
			{
				ServiceBusEventSource.Log.HandledException(e.Exception, TrackingContext, "Relay", this, EventLevel.Warning, "IErrorHandler.HandleError", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\DirectConnection\\DirectSocketListener.cs", 41);
			};
			serviceHost.Description.Behaviors.Add(serviceErrorHandlerBehavior);
			serviceHost.AddServiceEndpoint(typeof(IDirectConnectionControl), innerBinding, "");
			connectionSessions = new Dictionary<string, DirectConnectionSession>();
			socketQueue = new InputQueue<IConnection>();
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginAccept(AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return socketQueue.BeginDequeue(ServiceDefaults.ReceiveTimeout, callback, state);
		}

		public IConnection EndAccept(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			return socketQueue.EndDequeue(result);
		}

		public void Close(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
			List<DirectConnectionSession> list;
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (isClosed)
				{
					return;
				}
				isClosed = true;
				list = new List<DirectConnectionSession>(connectionSessions.Values);
				connectionSessions.Clear();
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				try
				{
					list[i].Close(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
				}
				catch (Exception exception)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
					{
						throw;
					}
					ServiceBusEventSource.Log.HandledException(exception, TrackingContext, "Relay", this, EventLevel.Warning, "Close", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\DirectConnection\\DirectSocketListener.cs", 100);
					list[i].Abort();
				}
			}
			serviceHost.Close(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
		}

		public void Abort()
		{
			List<DirectConnectionSession> list;
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (isClosed)
				{
					return;
				}
				isClosed = true;
				list = new List<DirectConnectionSession>(connectionSessions.Values);
				connectionSessions.Clear();
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				try
				{
					list[i].Abort();
				}
				catch (Exception exception)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
					{
						throw;
					}
					ServiceBusEventSource.Log.HandledException(exception, TrackingContext, "Relay", this, EventLevel.Warning, "Abort", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\DirectConnection\\DirectSocketListener.cs", 138);
				}
			}
			serviceHost.Abort();
		}

		void IDirectConnectionParent.Success(object sender, Socket socket)
		{
			DirectConnectionSession directConnectionSession = (DirectConnectionSession)sender;
			Guid id = directConnectionSession.Id;
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				connectionSessions.Remove(id.ToString());
			}
			try
			{
				directConnectionSession.Close(ServiceDefaults.CloseTimeout);
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				ServiceBusEventSource.Log.HandledException(exception, directConnectionSession.TrackingContext, "Relay", this, EventLevel.Warning, "Success", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\DirectConnection\\DirectSocketListener.cs", 165);
				directConnectionSession.Abort();
			}
			socketQueue.EnqueueAndDispatch(new SocketConnection(socket, bufferSize, directConnectionSession.TrackingContext));
		}

		void IDirectConnectionParent.Failure(object sender, Exception exception)
		{
			DirectConnectionSession directConnectionSession = (DirectConnectionSession)sender;
			Guid id = directConnectionSession.Id;
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				connectionSessions.Remove(id.ToString());
			}
			try
			{
				directConnectionSession.Close(ServiceDefaults.CloseTimeout);
			}
			catch (Exception exception2)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception2))
				{
					throw;
				}
				TrackingContext trackingContext = TrackingContext.Create(id, TrackingContext.SystemTracker);
				ServiceBusEventSource.Log.HandledException(exception2, directConnectionSession.TrackingContext, "Relay", this, EventLevel.Warning, "Failure", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\DirectConnection\\DirectSocketListener.cs", 193);
				directConnectionSession.Abort();
			}
		}

		public void Open(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			serviceHost.Open(timeout);
		}

		void IDirectConnectionControl.Abort(AbortMessage request)
		{
			DirectConnectionSession value;
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (!connectionSessions.TryGetValue(request.Id, out value))
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new FaultException(SRClient.InvalidID));
				}
			}
			((IDirectConnectionControl)value).Abort(request);
		}

		void IDirectConnectionControl.Connect(DirectConnectMessage request)
		{
			DirectConnectionSession directConnectionSession;
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (isClosed)
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new FaultException(SRClient.EndpointNotFound));
				}
				if (connectionSessions.ContainsKey(request.Id))
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new FaultException(SRClient.DuplicateConnectionID));
				}
				directConnectionSession = new DirectConnectionSession(new Guid(request.Id), probingClient, this);
				directConnectionSession.Channel = OperationContext.Current.GetCallbackChannel<IDirectConnectionControl>();
				directConnectionSession.Listen();
				connectionSessions.Add(request.Id, directConnectionSession);
			}
			((IDirectConnectionControl)directConnectionSession).Connect(request);
		}

		void IDirectConnectionControl.ConnectRetry(ConnectRetryMessage request)
		{
			DirectConnectionSession value;
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (!connectionSessions.TryGetValue(request.Id, out value))
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new FaultException(SRClient.InvalidID));
				}
			}
			((IDirectConnectionControl)value).ConnectRetry(request);
		}

		void IDirectConnectionControl.ConnectResponse(ConnectResponseMessage request)
		{
			DirectConnectionSession value;
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (!connectionSessions.TryGetValue(request.Id, out value))
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new FaultException(SRClient.InvalidID));
				}
			}
			((IDirectConnectionControl)value).ConnectResponse(request);
		}

		void IDirectConnectionControl.SwitchRoles(SwitchRolesMessage request)
		{
			DirectConnectionSession value;
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (!connectionSessions.TryGetValue(request.Id, out value))
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new FaultException(SRClient.InvalidID));
				}
			}
			((IDirectConnectionControl)value).SwitchRoles(request);
		}

	internal static class HttpProxyCredentialTypeHelper
	{
		internal static bool IsDefined(HttpProxyCredentialType value)
		{
			if (value != HttpProxyCredentialType.None && value != HttpProxyCredentialType.Basic && value != HttpProxyCredentialType.Digest && value != HttpProxyCredentialType.Ntlm)
			{
				return value == HttpProxyCredentialType.Windows;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static AuthenticationSchemes MapToAuthenticationScheme(HttpProxyCredentialType proxyCredentialType)
		{
			switch (proxyCredentialType)
			{
			case HttpProxyCredentialType.None:
				return AuthenticationSchemes.Anonymous;
			case HttpProxyCredentialType.Basic:
				return AuthenticationSchemes.Basic;
			case HttpProxyCredentialType.Digest:
				return AuthenticationSchemes.Digest;
			case HttpProxyCredentialType.Ntlm:
				return AuthenticationSchemes.Ntlm;
			case HttpProxyCredentialType.Windows:
				return AuthenticationSchemes.Negotiate;
			default:
				DiagnosticUtility.DebugAssert("unsupported proxy credential type");
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new NotSupportedException(), null, EventLevel.Warning, "MapToAuthenticationScheme", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\HttpProxyCredentialTypeHelper.cs", 45);
			}
		}

		internal static HttpProxyCredentialType MapToProxyCredentialType(AuthenticationSchemes authenticationSchemes)
		{
			switch (authenticationSchemes)
			{
			case AuthenticationSchemes.Anonymous:
				return HttpProxyCredentialType.None;
			case AuthenticationSchemes.Basic:
				return HttpProxyCredentialType.Basic;
			case AuthenticationSchemes.Digest:
				return HttpProxyCredentialType.Digest;
			case AuthenticationSchemes.Ntlm:
				return HttpProxyCredentialType.Ntlm;
			case AuthenticationSchemes.Negotiate:
				return HttpProxyCredentialType.Windows;
			default:
				DiagnosticUtility.DebugAssert("unsupported authentication Scheme");
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new NotSupportedException(), null, EventLevel.Warning, "MapToProxyCredentialType", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\HttpProxyCredentialTypeHelper.cs", 73);
			}
		}
	}

		}

		private void InitializeFrom(TcpRelayTransportBindingElement transport, BinaryMessageEncodingBindingElement encoding)
		{
			DiagnosticUtility.DebugAssert(transport != null, "Invalid (null) transport value.");
			DiagnosticUtility.DebugAssert(encoding != null, "Invalid (null) encoding value.");
			MaxBufferPoolSize = transport.MaxBufferPoolSize;
			MaxBufferSize = transport.MaxBufferSize;
			MaxConnections = transport.MaxPendingConnections;
			ListenBacklog = transport.ListenBacklog;
			MaxReceivedMessageSize = transport.MaxReceivedMessageSize;
			TransferMode = transport.TransferMode;
			this.transport.TransportProtectionEnabled = transport.TransportProtectionEnabled;
			ConnectionMode = transport.ConnectionMode;
			ReaderQuotas = encoding.ReaderQuotas;
		}

		protected bool IsBindingElementsMatch(TcpRelayTransportBindingElement transport, BinaryMessageEncodingBindingElement encoding)
		{
			if (!this.transport.IsMatch(transport))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(bool)InvokeHelper.InvokeInstanceMethod(typeof(BindingElement), this.encoding, "IsMatch", encoding))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual void ApplyConfiguration(string configurationName)
		{
			NetTcpRelayBindingCollectionElement bindingCollectionElement = NetTcpRelayBindingCollectionElement.GetBindingCollectionElement();
			NetTcpRelayBindingElement netTcpRelayBindingElement = bindingCollectionElement.Bindings[configurationName];
			if (netTcpRelayBindingElement == null)
			{
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new ConfigurationErrorsException(SR.GetString(Resources.ConfigInvalidBindingConfigurationName, configurationName, "netTcpRelayBinding")), null, EventLevel.Warning, "ApplyConfiguration", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\NetTcpRelayBindingBase.cs", 268);
			}
			netTcpRelayBindingElement.ApplyConfiguration(this);
		}

		public override BindingElementCollection CreateBindingElements()
		{
			BindingElementCollection bindingElementCollection = new BindingElementCollection();
			SecurityBindingElement securityBindingElement = CreateMessageSecurity();
			if (securityBindingElement != null)
			{
				bindingElementCollection.Add(securityBindingElement);
			}
			bool flag = Security.Mode == EndToEndSecurityMode.TransportWithMessageCredential || Security.Mode == EndToEndSecurityMode.Transport;
			if (flag)
			{
				bindingElementCollection.Add(new TcpClientTransportTokenAssertionProviderBindingElement());
			}
			bindingElementCollection.Add(encoding);
			transport.RelayClientAuthenticationType = security.RelayClientAuthenticationType;
			transport.TransportProtectionEnabled = flag;
			bindingElementCollection.Add(transport);
			return bindingElementCollection.Clone();
		}

		protected internal abstract SecurityBindingElement CreateMessageSecurity();

		internal static bool TryCreateSecurity(SecurityBindingElement sbe, RelayClientAuthenticationType relayClientAuthenticationType, UnifiedSecurityMode mode, bool isReliableSession, TcpRelayTransportSecurity tcpTransportSecurity, out NetTcpRelaySecurity security)
		{
			mode = ((sbe == null) ? (mode & ~(UnifiedSecurityMode.Message | UnifiedSecurityMode.TransportWithMessageCredential)) : (mode & (UnifiedSecurityMode.Message | UnifiedSecurityMode.TransportWithMessageCredential)));
			EndToEndSecurityMode endToEndSecurityMode = EndToEndSecurityModeHelper.ToRelaySecurityMode(mode);
			DiagnosticUtility.DebugAssert(EndToEndSecurityModeHelper.IsDefined(endToEndSecurityMode), string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "Invalid RelaySecurityMode value: {0}.", endToEndSecurityMode.ToString()));
			if (NetTcpRelaySecurity.TryCreate(sbe, endToEndSecurityMode, relayClientAuthenticationType, isReliableSession, tcpTransportSecurity, out security))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public sealed class NetTcpRelaySecurity
	{
		internal const EndToEndSecurityMode DefaultMode = EndToEndSecurityMode.Transport;

		internal const RelayClientAuthenticationType DefaultRelayClientAuthenticationType = RelayClientAuthenticationType.RelayAccessToken;

		private RelayClientAuthenticationType relayClientAuthenticationType;

		private EndToEndSecurityMode mode;

		private TcpRelayTransportSecurity transportSecurity;

		private MessageSecurityOverRelayConnection messageSecurity;

		public EndToEndSecurityMode Mode
		{
			get
			{
				return mode;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!EndToEndSecurityModeHelper.IsDefined(value))
				{
					throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("value"), null, EventLevel.Warning, "Mode", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\NetTcpRelaySecurity.cs", 52);
				}
				mode = value;
			}
		}

		public RelayClientAuthenticationType RelayClientAuthenticationType
		{
			get
			{
				return relayClientAuthenticationType;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!RelayClientAuthenticationTypeHelper.IsDefined(value))
				{
					throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("value"), null, EventLevel.Warning, "RelayClientAuthenticationType", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\NetTcpRelaySecurity.cs", 69);
				}
				relayClientAuthenticationType = value;
			}
		}

		public TcpRelayTransportSecurity Transport => transportSecurity;

		public MessageSecurityOverRelayConnection Message => messageSecurity;

		internal NetTcpRelaySecurity()
			: this(EndToEndSecurityMode.Transport, RelayClientAuthenticationType.RelayAccessToken, new TcpRelayTransportSecurity(), new MessageSecurityOverRelayConnection())
		{
		}

		private NetTcpRelaySecurity(EndToEndSecurityMode mode, RelayClientAuthenticationType relayClientAuthenticationType, TcpRelayTransportSecurity transportSecurity, MessageSecurityOverRelayConnection messageSecurity)
		{
			DiagnosticUtility.DebugAssert(EndToEndSecurityModeHelper.IsDefined(mode), string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "Invalid RelaySecurityMode value: {0}.", mode.ToString()));
			this.mode = mode;
			this.relayClientAuthenticationType = relayClientAuthenticationType;
			this.transportSecurity = ((transportSecurity == null) ? new TcpRelayTransportSecurity() : transportSecurity);
			this.messageSecurity = ((messageSecurity == null) ? new MessageSecurityOverRelayConnection() : messageSecurity);
		}

		internal SecurityBindingElement CreateMessageSecurity(bool isReliableSessionEnabled, MessageSecurityVersion version)
		{
			if (mode == EndToEndSecurityMode.Message || mode == EndToEndSecurityMode.TransportWithMessageCredential)
			{
				return messageSecurity.CreateSecurityBindingElement(mode == EndToEndSecurityMode.TransportWithMessageCredential, isReliableSessionEnabled);
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static bool TryCreate(SecurityBindingElement wsSecurity, EndToEndSecurityMode mode, RelayClientAuthenticationType relayClientAuthenticationType, bool isReliableSessionEnabled, TcpRelayTransportSecurity tcpTransportSecurity, out NetTcpRelaySecurity security)
		{
			security = null;
			MessageSecurityOverRelayConnection messageSecurityOverRelayConnection = null;
			if ((mode == EndToEndSecurityMode.Message || mode == EndToEndSecurityMode.TransportWithMessageCredential) && !MessageSecurityOverRelayConnection.TryCreate(wsSecurity, isReliableSessionEnabled, out messageSecurityOverRelayConnection))
			{
				return false;
			}
			security = new NetTcpRelaySecurity(mode, relayClientAuthenticationType, tcpTransportSecurity, messageSecurityOverRelayConnection);
			if (wsSecurity != null)
			{
				return (bool)InvokeHelper.InvokeStaticMethod(typeof(SecurityElementBase), "AreBindingsMatching", security.CreateMessageSecurity(isReliableSessionEnabled, wsSecurity.MessageSecurityVersion), wsSecurity, false);
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

		private BindingElement BuildInnerBindingElement(BindingContext context)
		{
			SocketConnectionBindingElement socketConnectionBindingElement = null;
			NameSettings nameSettings;
			if ((nameSettings = context.BindingParameters.Find<NameSettings>()) == null)
			{
				nameSettings = new NameSettings();
				context.BindingParameters.Add(nameSettings);
			}
			nameSettings.ServiceSettings.TransportProtection = (transportProtectionEnabled ? RelayTransportProtectionMode.EndToEnd : RelayTransportProtectionMode.None);
			nameSettings.ServiceSettings.RelayClientAuthenticationType = RelayClientAuthenticationType;
			nameSettings.ServiceSettings.IsDynamic = IsDynamic;
			TokenProvider tokenProvider = TokenProviderUtility.CreateTokenProvider(context);
			TcpRelayConnectionMode connectionMode = ConnectionMode;
			if (connectionMode != TcpRelayConnectionMode.Relayed && connectionMode == TcpRelayConnectionMode.Hybrid)
			{
				if (base.ChannelInitializationTimeout < TimeSpan.FromSeconds(60.0))
				{
					base.ChannelInitializationTimeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(60.0);
				}
				nameSettings.ServiceSettings.ListenerType = ListenerType.DirectConnection;
				socketConnectionBindingElement = new SocketConnectionBindingElement(new HybridConnectionElement(context, this, nameSettings, tokenProvider));
			}
			else
			{
				if (nameSettings.ServiceSettings.ListenerType != ListenerType.RelayedHttp)
				{
					nameSettings.ServiceSettings.ListenerType = ListenerType.RelayedConnection;
				}
				socketConnectionBindingElement = new SocketConnectionBindingElement(new ConnectivityModeConnectionElement(tokenProvider, transportProtectionEnabled ? SocketSecurityRole.SslClient : SocketSecurityRole.None, context, nameSettings));
			}
			socketConnectionBindingElement.ChannelInitializationTimeout = base.ChannelInitializationTimeout;
			socketConnectionBindingElement.ConnectionBufferSize = base.ConnectionBufferSize;
			socketConnectionBindingElement.ConnectionPoolSettings.GroupName = ConnectionPoolSettings.GroupName;
			socketConnectionBindingElement.ConnectionPoolSettings.IdleTimeout = ConnectionPoolSettings.IdleTimeout;
			socketConnectionBindingElement.ConnectionPoolSettings.LeaseTimeout = ConnectionPoolSettings.LeaseTimeout;
			socketConnectionBindingElement.ConnectionPoolSettings.MaxOutboundConnectionsPerEndpoint = ConnectionPoolSettings.MaxOutboundConnectionsPerEndpoint;
			socketConnectionBindingElement.ExposeConnectionProperty = base.ExposeConnectionProperty;
			socketConnectionBindingElement.HostNameComparisonMode = base.HostNameComparisonMode;
			socketConnectionBindingElement.InheritBaseAddressSettings = base.InheritBaseAddressSettings;
			socketConnectionBindingElement.ListenBacklog = ListenBacklog;
			socketConnectionBindingElement.ManualAddressing = ManualAddressing;
			socketConnectionBindingElement.MaxBufferPoolSize = MaxBufferPoolSize;
			socketConnectionBindingElement.MaxBufferSize = base.MaxBufferSize;
			socketConnectionBindingElement.MaxOutputDelay = base.MaxOutputDelay;
			socketConnectionBindingElement.MaxPendingAccepts = base.MaxPendingAccepts;
			socketConnectionBindingElement.MaxPendingConnections = base.MaxPendingConnections;
			socketConnectionBindingElement.MaxReceivedMessageSize = MaxReceivedMessageSize;
			socketConnectionBindingElement.TransferMode = base.TransferMode;
			socketConnectionBindingElement.TeredoEnabled = false;
			return socketConnectionBindingElement;
		}

		private void EnsureValid()
		{
			if (TransportProtectionEnabled && ConnectionMode == TcpRelayConnectionMode.Hybrid)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.InvalidConfiguration);
			}
		}

		public override T GetProperty<T>(BindingContext context)
		{
			if (context == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("context");
			}
			BindingElement bindingElement = BuildInnerBindingElement(context);
			if (typeof(T) == typeof(IBindingDeliveryCapabilities))
			{
				return (T)(object)new BindingDeliveryCapabilitiesHelper();
			}
			return bindingElement.GetProperty<T>(context);
		}

		internal override bool IsMatch(BindingElement b)
		{
			if (!base.IsMatch(b))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(b is TcpRelayTransportBindingElement tcpRelayTransportBindingElement))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (listenBacklog != tcpRelayTransportBindingElement.listenBacklog)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (transportProtectionEnabled != tcpRelayTransportBindingElement.transportProtectionEnabled)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!connectionPoolSettings.IsMatch(tcpRelayTransportBindingElement.connectionPoolSettings))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		void IPolicyExportExtension.ExportPolicy(MetadataExporter exporter, PolicyConversionContext context)
		{
			if (exporter == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("exporter");
			}
			if (context == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("context");
			}
			XmlDocument xmlDocument = new XmlDocument();
			XmlElement xmlElement = null;
			if (TransportProtectionEnabled)
			{
				SslStreamSecurityBindingElement sslStreamSecurityBindingElement = new SslStreamSecurityBindingElement();
				if (!context.BindingElements.Contains(typeof(SecurityBindingElement)))
				{
					context.BindingElements.Add(sslStreamSecurityBindingElement);
				}
				((IPolicyExportExtension)sslStreamSecurityBindingElement).ExportPolicy(exporter, context);
			}
			TcpRelayConnectionMode connectionMode = ConnectionMode;
			xmlElement = ((connectionMode != TcpRelayConnectionMode.Relayed && connectionMode == TcpRelayConnectionMode.Hybrid) ? xmlDocument.CreateElement("rel", "HybridSocketConnection", "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2009/05/servicebus/connect") : xmlDocument.CreateElement("rel", "RelaySocketConnection", "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2009/05/servicebus/connect"));
			context.GetBindingAssertions().Add(xmlElement);
			XmlElement xmlElement2 = xmlDocument.CreateElement("rel", "ListenerRelayCredential", "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2009/05/servicebus/connect");
			xmlElement2.SetAttribute("Optional", exporter.PolicyVersion.Namespace, "true");
			context.GetBindingAssertions().Add(xmlElement2);
			if (RelayClientAuthenticationType == RelayClientAuthenticationType.RelayAccessToken)
			{
				XmlElement item = xmlDocument.CreateElement("rel", "SenderRelayCredential", "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2009/05/servicebus/connect");
				context.GetBindingAssertions().Add(item);
			}
		}
	}

		public override IChannelFactory<TChannel> BuildChannelFactory<TChannel>(BindingContext context)
		{
			if (typeof(TChannel) != typeof(IRequestChannel))
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.Argument("TChannel", SR.GetString(Resources.ChannelTypeNotSupported, typeof(TChannel)));
			}
			NameSettings nameSettings = context.BindingParameters.Find<NameSettings>();
			if (nameSettings == null)
			{
				nameSettings = new NameSettings();
				context.BindingParameters.Add(nameSettings);
			}
			nameSettings.ServiceSettings.ListenerType = ListenerType.RelayedHttp;
			nameSettings.ServiceSettings.TransportProtection = ((this is HttpsRelayTransportBindingElement) ? RelayTransportProtectionMode.EndToEnd : RelayTransportProtectionMode.None);
			nameSettings.ServiceSettings.RelayClientAuthenticationType = relayClientAuthenticationType;
			nameSettings.ServiceSettings.IsDynamic = IsDynamic;
			BindingContext bindingContext = CreateInnerChannelBindingContext(context);
			IChannelFactory<IRequestChannel> innerChannelFactory = bindingContext.BuildInnerChannelFactory<IRequestChannel>();
			return (IChannelFactory<TChannel>)new RelayHttpTransportChannelFactory(context, innerChannelFactory);
		}

		public override IChannelListener<TChannel> BuildChannelListener<TChannel>(BindingContext context)
		{
			if (typeof(TChannel) != typeof(IReplyChannel))
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.Argument("TChannel", SR.GetString(Resources.ChannelTypeNotSupported, typeof(TChannel)));
			}
			NameSettings nameSettings = context.BindingParameters.Find<NameSettings>();
			if (nameSettings == null)
			{
				nameSettings = new NameSettings();
				context.BindingParameters.Add(nameSettings);
			}
			nameSettings.ServiceSettings.ListenerType = ListenerType.RelayedHttp;
			nameSettings.ServiceSettings.TransportProtection = ((this is HttpsRelayTransportBindingElement) ? RelayTransportProtectionMode.EndToEnd : RelayTransportProtectionMode.None);
			nameSettings.ServiceSettings.RelayClientAuthenticationType = relayClientAuthenticationType;
			nameSettings.ServiceSettings.IsDynamic = IsDynamic;
			MessageEncodingBindingElement messageEncodingBindingElement = context.BindingParameters.Find<MessageEncodingBindingElement>();
			BindingContext bindingContext = CreateInnerListenerBindingContext(context);
			if (messageEncodingBindingElement != null)
			{
				context.BindingParameters.Remove<MessageEncodingBindingElement>();
			}
			IChannelListener<IReplyChannel> innerChannelListener = bindingContext.BuildInnerChannelListener<IReplyChannel>();
			return (IChannelListener<TChannel>)new RelayHttpTransportChannelListener(context, messageEncodingBindingElement, innerChannelListener);
		}

		private BindingContext CreateInnerListenerBindingContext(BindingContext context)
		{
			BinaryMessageEncodingBindingElement binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement = ClientMessageUtility.CreateInnerEncodingBindingElement(context);
			NameSettings nameSettings = context.BindingParameters.Find<NameSettings>();
			TcpRelayTransportBindingElement tcpRelayTransportBindingElement = new TcpRelayTransportBindingElement(RelayClientAuthenticationType);
			tcpRelayTransportBindingElement.ManualAddressing = ManualAddressing;
			tcpRelayTransportBindingElement.HostNameComparisonMode = HostNameComparisonMode;
			tcpRelayTransportBindingElement.MaxBufferPoolSize = MaxBufferPoolSize;
			tcpRelayTransportBindingElement.MaxBufferSize = MaxBufferSize;
			tcpRelayTransportBindingElement.MaxReceivedMessageSize = MaxReceivedMessageSize;
			tcpRelayTransportBindingElement.TransferMode = TransferMode.Streamed;
			tcpRelayTransportBindingElement.TransportProtectionEnabled = nameSettings.ServiceSettings.TransportProtection != RelayTransportProtectionMode.None;
			tcpRelayTransportBindingElement.ConnectionPoolSettings.MaxOutboundConnectionsPerEndpoint = 100;
			tcpRelayTransportBindingElement.IsDynamic = nameSettings.ServiceSettings.IsDynamic;
			CustomBinding customBinding = new CustomBinding(binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement, tcpRelayTransportBindingElement);
			customBinding.CloseTimeout = context.Binding.CloseTimeout;
			customBinding.Name = context.Binding.Name;
			customBinding.Namespace = context.Binding.Namespace;
			customBinding.OpenTimeout = context.Binding.OpenTimeout;
			customBinding.ReceiveTimeout = context.Binding.ReceiveTimeout;
			customBinding.SendTimeout = context.Binding.SendTimeout;
			BindingParameterCollection bindingParameterCollection = new BindingParameterCollection();
			foreach (object bindingParameter in context.BindingParameters)
			{
				if (!(bindingParameter is MessageEncodingBindingElement))
				{
					bindingParameterCollection.Add(bindingParameter);
				}
			}
			Uri listenUriBaseAddress = RelayedHttpUtility.ConvertToSbUri(context.ListenUriBaseAddress);
			return new BindingContext(customBinding, bindingParameterCollection, listenUriBaseAddress, context.ListenUriRelativeAddress, context.ListenUriMode);
		}
