		public override IChannelFactory<TChannel> BuildChannelFactory<TChannel>(BindingContext context)
		{
			if (context == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("context");
			}
			if (typeof(TChannel) != typeof(IOutputChannel))
			{
				throw new NotImplementedException(SRClient.UnsupportedChannelType(typeof(TChannel)));
			}
			NameSettings nameSettings = context.BindingParameters.Find<NameSettings>();
			if (nameSettings == null)
			{
				nameSettings = new NameSettings();
				context.BindingParameters.Add(nameSettings);
			}
			if (nameSettings.ServiceSettings.ListenerType == ListenerType.None)
			{
				nameSettings.ServiceSettings.ListenerType = ((ConnectionMode == RelayedOnewayConnectionMode.Unicast) ? ListenerType.Unicast : ListenerType.Multicast);
				nameSettings.ServiceSettings.TransportProtection = (transportProtectionEnabled ? RelayTransportProtectionMode.EndToEnd : RelayTransportProtectionMode.None);
				nameSettings.ServiceSettings.RelayClientAuthenticationType = relayClientAuthenticationType;
			}
			return (IChannelFactory<TChannel>)new RelayedOnewayChannelFactory(context, this);
		}

		public override IChannelListener<TChannel> BuildChannelListener<TChannel>(BindingContext context)
		{
			if (context == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("context");
			}
			if (typeof(TChannel) != typeof(IInputChannel))
			{
				throw new NotImplementedException(SRClient.UnsupportedChannelType(typeof(TChannel)));
			}
			NameSettings nameSettings = context.BindingParameters.Find<NameSettings>();
			if (nameSettings == null)
			{
				nameSettings = new NameSettings();
				context.BindingParameters.Add(nameSettings);
			}
			if (nameSettings.ServiceSettings.ListenerType == ListenerType.None)
			{
				nameSettings.ServiceSettings.ListenerType = ((ConnectionMode == RelayedOnewayConnectionMode.Unicast) ? ListenerType.Unicast : ListenerType.Multicast);
				nameSettings.ServiceSettings.TransportProtection = (transportProtectionEnabled ? RelayTransportProtectionMode.EndToEnd : RelayTransportProtectionMode.None);
				nameSettings.ServiceSettings.RelayClientAuthenticationType = relayClientAuthenticationType;
			}
			return (IChannelListener<TChannel>)(object)new RelayedOnewayChannelListener(context, this);
		}

		public override bool CanBuildChannelFactory<TChannel>(BindingContext context)
		{
			if (context == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("context");
			}
			return typeof(TChannel) == typeof(IOutputChannel);
		}

		public override bool CanBuildChannelListener<TChannel>(BindingContext context)
		{
			if (context == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("context");
			}
			return typeof(TChannel) == typeof(IInputChannel);
		}

		public override BindingElement Clone()
		{
			return new RelayedOnewayTransportBindingElement(this);
		}

		public override T GetProperty<T>(BindingContext context)
		{
			if (context == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("context");
			}
			if (typeof(T) == typeof(ChannelProtectionRequirements))
			{
				ChannelProtectionRequirements protectionRequirements = GetProtectionRequirements(context);
				protectionRequirements.Add(context.GetInnerProperty<ChannelProtectionRequirements>() ?? new ChannelProtectionRequirements());
				return (T)(object)protectionRequirements;
			}
			return base.GetProperty<T>(context);
		}

		internal static ChannelProtectionRequirements GetProtectionRequirements(BindingContext context)
		{
			AddressingVersion addressingVersion = AddressingVersion.WSAddressing10;
			MessageEncodingBindingElement messageEncodingBindingElement = ClientMessageUtility.CreateInnerEncodingBindingElement(context);
			if (messageEncodingBindingElement != null)
			{
				addressingVersion = messageEncodingBindingElement.MessageVersion.Addressing;
			}
			return GetProtectionRequirements(addressingVersion);
		}

		internal static RelayedOnewayTransportBindingElement CreateOnewayTransportBindingElement(BindingContext context, RelayClientAuthenticationType relayClientAuthenticationType, RelayedOnewayConnectionMode connectionMode)
		{
			RelayedOnewayTransportBindingElement relayedOnewayTransportBindingElement = new RelayedOnewayTransportBindingElement(relayClientAuthenticationType, connectionMode);
			Microsoft.ServiceBus.Channels.ConnectionOrientedTransportBindingElement connectionOrientedTransportBindingElement = context.Binding.Elements.Find<Microsoft.ServiceBus.Channels.ConnectionOrientedTransportBindingElement>();
			if (connectionOrientedTransportBindingElement != null)
			{
				relayedOnewayTransportBindingElement.HostNameComparisonMode = connectionOrientedTransportBindingElement.HostNameComparisonMode;
			}
			return relayedOnewayTransportBindingElement;
		}

		private static ChannelProtectionRequirements GetProtectionRequirements(AddressingVersion addressingVersion)
		{
			PropertyInfo property = addressingVersion.GetType().GetProperty("SignedMessageParts", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
			MessagePartSpecification parts = (MessagePartSpecification)property.GetValue(addressingVersion, new object[0]);
			ChannelProtectionRequirements channelProtectionRequirements = new ChannelProtectionRequirements();
			channelProtectionRequirements.IncomingSignatureParts.AddParts(parts);
			channelProtectionRequirements.OutgoingSignatureParts.AddParts(parts);
			return channelProtectionRequirements;
		}

		void IPolicyExportExtension.ExportPolicy(MetadataExporter exporter, PolicyConversionContext context)
		{
			if (exporter == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("exporter");
			}
			if (context == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("context");
			}
			XmlDocument xmlDocument = new XmlDocument();
			XmlElement xmlElement = xmlDocument.CreateElement("rel", "RelayedOneway", "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2009/05/servicebus/connect");
			if (connectionMode == RelayedOnewayConnectionMode.Multicast)
			{
				XmlElement newChild = xmlDocument.CreateElement("rel", "Multicast", "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2009/05/servicebus/connect");
				xmlElement.AppendChild(newChild);
			}
			context.GetBindingAssertions().Add(xmlElement);
		}
	}

	public enum EndToEndSecurityMode

		Transport,
		Message,
		TransportWithMessageCredential

	internal static class EndToEndSecurityModeHelper
	{
		internal static bool IsDefined(EndToEndSecurityMode value)
		{
			if (value != EndToEndSecurityMode.None && value != EndToEndSecurityMode.Transport && value != EndToEndSecurityMode.TransportWithMessageCredential)
			{
				return value == EndToEndSecurityMode.Message;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static EndToEndSecurityMode ToRelaySecurityMode(UnifiedSecurityMode value)
		{
			return value switch
			{
				UnifiedSecurityMode.Transport => EndToEndSecurityMode.Transport, 
				UnifiedSecurityMode.Message => EndToEndSecurityMode.Message, 
				UnifiedSecurityMode.TransportWithMessageCredential => EndToEndSecurityMode.TransportWithMessageCredential, 
				_ => EndToEndSecurityMode.None, 
			};
		}

		internal static SecurityMode ToSecurityMode(EndToEndSecurityMode value)
		{
			return value switch
			{
				EndToEndSecurityMode.Transport => SecurityMode.Transport, 
				EndToEndSecurityMode.Message => SecurityMode.Message, 
				EndToEndSecurityMode.TransportWithMessageCredential => SecurityMode.TransportWithMessageCredential, 
				_ => SecurityMode.None, 
			};
		}

	internal static class ProtectionLevelHelper
	{
		internal static bool IsDefined(ProtectionLevel value)
		{
			if (value != ProtectionLevel.None && value != ProtectionLevel.Sign)
			{
				return value == ProtectionLevel.EncryptAndSign;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static void Validate(ProtectionLevel value)
		{
			if (!IsDefined(value))
			{
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new InvalidEnumArgumentException("value", (int)value, typeof(ProtectionLevel)), null, EventLevel.Warning, "Validate", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\SecurityUtil.cs", 185);
			}
		}

		internal static bool IsStronger(ProtectionLevel v1, ProtectionLevel v2)
		{
			if (v1 != ProtectionLevel.EncryptAndSign || v2 == ProtectionLevel.EncryptAndSign)
			{
				if (v1 == ProtectionLevel.Sign)
				{
					return v2 == ProtectionLevel.None;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static bool IsStrongerOrEqual(ProtectionLevel v1, ProtectionLevel v2)
		{
			return v1 switch
			{
				ProtectionLevel.Sign => v2 != ProtectionLevel.EncryptAndSign, 
				ProtectionLevel.EncryptAndSign => true, 
				_ => false, 
			};
		}

		internal static ProtectionLevel Max(ProtectionLevel v1, ProtectionLevel v2)
		{
			if (!IsStronger(v1, v2))
			{
				return v2;
			}
			return v1;
		}

		internal static int GetOrdinal(ProtectionLevel? p)
		{
			if (p.HasValue)
			{
				return p.Value switch
				{
					ProtectionLevel.None => 2, 
					ProtectionLevel.Sign => 3, 
					ProtectionLevel.EncryptAndSign => 4,

	public sealed class RetryExponential : RetryPolicy
	{
		public TimeSpan MinimalBackoff { get; private set; }

		public TimeSpan MaximumBackoff { get; private set; }

		public TimeSpan DeltaBackoff { get; private set; }

		public TimeSpan TerminationTimeBuffer { get; private set; }

		public int MaxRetryCount { get; private set; }

		public RetryExponential(TimeSpan minBackoff, TimeSpan maxBackoff, int maxRetryCount)
			: this(minBackoff, maxBackoff, Constants.DefaultRetryDeltaBackoff, Constants.DefaultRetryTerminationBuffer, maxRetryCount, throwOnClientChecks: true)
		{
			if (DeltaBackoff >= maxBackoff - minBackoff)
			{
				DeltaBackoff = new TimeSpan((maxBackoff - minBackoff).Ticks / 2);
			}
		}

		[Obsolete("This constructor is obsolete. Please use the other constructor instead.")]
		public RetryExponential(TimeSpan minBackoff, TimeSpan maxBackoff, TimeSpan deltaBackoff, TimeSpan terminationTimeBuffer, int maxRetryCount)
			: this(minBackoff, maxBackoff, deltaBackoff, terminationTimeBuffer, maxRetryCount, throwOnClientChecks: true)
		{
		}

		internal RetryExponential(TimeSpan minBackoff, TimeSpan maxBackoff, TimeSpan deltaBackoff, TimeSpan terminationTimeBuffer, int maxRetryCount, bool throwOnClientChecks)
		{
			TimeoutHelper.ThrowIfNegativeArgument(minBackoff, "minBackoff");
			TimeoutHelper.ThrowIfNonPositiveArgument(maxBackoff, "maxBackoff");
			TimeoutHelper.ThrowIfNonPositiveArgument(deltaBackoff, "deltaBackoff");
			TimeoutHelper.ThrowIfNonPositiveArgument(terminationTimeBuffer, "terminationTimeBuffer");
			if (maxRetryCount <= 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("maxRetryCount", Resources.ValueMustBePositive);
			}
			if (minBackoff >= maxBackoff && throwOnClientChecks)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.RetryPolicyInvalidBackoffPeriod(minBackoff, maxBackoff));
			}
			MinimalBackoff = minBackoff;
			MaximumBackoff = maxBackoff;
			DeltaBackoff = deltaBackoff;
			TerminationTimeBuffer = terminationTimeBuffer;
			MaxRetryCount = maxRetryCount;
		}

		protected override bool OnShouldRetry(TimeSpan remainingTime, int currentRetryCount, out TimeSpan retryInterval)
		{
			if (currentRetryCount > MaxRetryCount)
			{
				retryInterval = TimeSpan.Zero;
				return false;
			}
			int num = ConcurrentRandom.Next((int)(DeltaBackoff.TotalMilliseconds * 0.8), (int)(DeltaBackoff.TotalMilliseconds * 1.2));
			double num2 = (Math.Pow(2.0, currentRetryCount) - 1.0) * (double)num;
			double value = Math.Min(MinimalBackoff.TotalMilliseconds + num2, MaximumBackoff.TotalMilliseconds);
			retryInterval = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(value);
			if (base.IsServerBusy)
			{
				retryInterval += RetryPolicy.ServerBusyBaseSleepTime;
			}
			if (retryInterval >= remainingTime - TerminationTimeBuffer)
			{
				retryInterval = TimeSpan.Zero;
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override RetryPolicy Clone()
		{
			RetryExponential retryExponential = new RetryExponential(MinimalBackoff, MaximumBackoff, DeltaBackoff, TerminationTimeBuffer, MaxRetryCount, throwOnClientChecks: false);
			if (base.IsServerBusy)
			{
				retryExponential.SetServerBusy(base.ServerBusyExceptionMessage);
			}
			return retryExponential;
		}

		private bool IsRetryableException(MessagingException lastException)
		{
			if (lastException == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNull("lastException");
			}
			return lastException.IsTransient;
		}

		protected override bool IsRetryableException(Exception lastException)
		{
			if (lastException == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNull("lastException");
			}
			if (lastException is MessagingException lastException2)
			{
				return IsRetryableException(lastException2);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

	public abstract class RetryPolicy
	{
		internal static readonly TimeSpan ServerBusyBaseSleepTime = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10.0);

		private object serverBusyLock = new object();

		private volatile bool serverBusy;

		private volatile bool encounteredServerBusy;

		private volatile string serverBusyExceptionMessage;

		private volatile IOThreadTimer serverBusyResetTimer;

		private volatile bool errorTrackingEnabled;

		private volatile int continousErrorCount;

		public static RetryPolicy NoRetry => new NoRetry();

		public static RetryPolicy Default => new RetryExponential(Constants.DefaultRetryMinBackoff, Constants.DefaultRetryMaxBackoff, Constants.DefaultMaxDeliveryCount);

		internal bool IsServerBusy => serverBusy;

		internal bool ServerBusyEncountered => encounteredServerBusy;

		internal string ServerBusyExceptionMessage => serverBusyExceptionMessage;

		internal RetryPolicy()
		{
			serverBusyResetTimer = new IOThreadTimer(OnTimerCallback, this, isTypicallyCanceledShortlyAfterBeingSet: true);
			continousErrorCount = 0;
		}

		internal bool ShouldRetry(TimeSpan remainingTime, int currentRetryCount, Exception lastException, out TimeSpan retryInterval)
		{
			if (lastException is ServerBusyException)
			{
				SetServerBusy(lastException.Message);
			}
			if (errorTrackingEnabled)
			{
				continousErrorCount++;
			}
			if (Transaction.Current == null)
			{
				if (lastException == null || remainingTime == TimeSpan.Zero)
				{
					retryInterval = TimeSpan.Zero;
					return false;
				}
				if (IsRetryableException(lastException))
				{
					return OnShouldRetry(remainingTime, currentRetryCount, out retryInterval);
				}
			}
			retryInterval = TimeSpan.Zero;
			return false;
		}

		public abstract RetryPolicy Clone();

		protected void SetServerBusy(string exceptionMessage)
		{
			if (encounteredServerBusy)
			{
				return;
			}
			lock (serverBusyLock)
			{
				if (!encounteredServerBusy)
				{
					encounteredServerBusy = true;
					serverBusyExceptionMessage = (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(exceptionMessage) ? SR.GetString(Resources.ServerBusy) : exceptionMessage);
					SetServerBusyInternal();
					serverBusyResetTimer.Set(ServerBusyBaseSleepTime);
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void SetServerBusyInternal()
		{
			serverBusy = true;
		}

		internal void ResetServerBusy()
		{
			if (!encounteredServerBusy)
			{
				return;
			}
			lock (serverBusyLock)
			{
				if (encounteredServerBusy)
				{
					encounteredServerBusy = false;
					serverBusyExceptionMessage = SR.GetString(Resources.ServerBusy);
					ResetServerBusyInternal();
					serverBusyResetTimer.Cancel();
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void ResetServerBusyInternal()
		{
			serverBusy = false;
		}

		private static void OnTimerCallback(object state)
		{
			RetryPolicy retryPolicy = (RetryPolicy)state;
			if (retryPolicy.ServerBusyEncountered)
			{
				retryPolicy.ResetServerBusy();
			}
		}

		protected abstract bool OnShouldRetry(TimeSpan remainingTime, int currentRetryCount, out TimeSpan retryInterval);

		protected abstract bool IsRetryableException(Exception lastException);
	}
	internal static class SecureStringHelper
	{
		public unsafe static SecureString ToSecureString(this string unsecureString)
		{
			if (unsecureString == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			fixed (char* value = unsecureString)
			{
				SecureString secureString = new SecureString(value, unsecureString.Length);
				secureString.MakeReadOnly();
				return secureString;
			}
		}

		public static string ToUnsecureString(this SecureString secureString)
		{
			if (secureString == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IntPtr intPtr = IntPtr.Zero;
			try
			{
				intPtr = Marshal.SecureStringToGlobalAllocUnicode(secureString);
				return Marshal.PtrToStringUni(intPtr);
			}
			finally
			{
				Marshal.ZeroFreeGlobalAllocUnicode(intPtr);
			}
		}
	}

			if (!dictionary.TryGetValue("sig", out var _))

			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("se");

		private static IDictionary<string, string> ExtractFieldValues(string sharedAccessSignature)
		{
			string[] array = sharedAccessSignature.Split();

			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("sharedAccessSignature");

			string[] array2 = array[1].Trim().Split(new string[1] { "&" }, StringSplitOptions.None);
			string[] array3 = array2;
			foreach (string text in array3)
			{

				{
					string[] array4 = text.Split(new string[1] { "=" }, StringSplitOptions.None);
					if (string.Equals(array4[0], "sr", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
					{
						dictionary.Add(array4[0], array4[1]);
					}
					else
					{
						dictionary.Add(array4[0], HttpUtility.UrlDecode(array4[1]));
					}
				}
			}
			return dictionary;

	public class SharedAccessSignatureTokenProvider : TokenProvider

		internal static class SharedAccessSignatureBuilder
		{
			public static string BuildSignature(string keyName, string sharedAccessKey, Func<string, byte[]> keyEncoder, string targetUri, TimeSpan timeToLive)
			{
				byte[] encodedSharedAccessKey = new byte[0];
				if (keyEncoder != null && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(sharedAccessKey))
				{
					encodedSharedAccessKey = keyEncoder(sharedAccessKey);
				}
				else if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(sharedAccessKey))
				{
					encodedSharedAccessKey = Constants.MessagingTokenProviderKeyEncoder(sharedAccessKey);
				}
				return BuildSignature(keyName, encodedSharedAccessKey, targetUri, timeToLive);
			}

			public static string BuildSignature(string keyName, byte[] encodedSharedAccessKey, string targetUri, TimeSpan timeToLive)
			{
				string text = BuildExpiresOn(timeToLive);
				string text2 = HttpUtility.UrlEncode(targetUri);
				List<string> values = new List<string> { text2, text };
				string str = Sign(string.Join("\n", values), encodedSharedAccessKey);
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0} {1}={2}&{3}={4}&{5}={6}&{7}={8}", "SharedAccessSignature", "sr", text2, "sig", HttpUtility.UrlEncode(str), "se", HttpUtility.UrlEncode(text), "skn", HttpUtility.UrlEncode(keyName));
			}

			private static string BuildExpiresOn(TimeSpan timeToLive)
			{
				long num = Convert.ToInt64(DateTime.UtcNow.Add(timeToLive).Subtract(EpochTime).TotalSeconds, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				return Convert.ToString(num, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			}

			private static string Sign(string requestString, byte[] encodedSharedAccessKey)
			{
				using HMACSHA256 hMACSHA = new HMACSHA256(encodedSharedAccessKey);
				return Convert.ToBase64String(hMACSHA.ComputeHash(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(requestString)));
			}
		}

			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(keyName))
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("keyName");
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(key))
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("key");
			}
			MessagingFactory.CheckValidEntityName(entityPath, 260, allowSeparator: false, "entityPath");
			MessagingFactory.CheckValidEntityName(publisher, 128, allowSeparator: false, "publisherId");
			return GetSharedAccessSignature(keyName, key, endpoint.AbsoluteUri + EntityNameHelper.FormatPublisherPath(entityPath, publisher), tokenTimeToLive);
		}
	}
	public class SimpleWebSecurityTokenSerializer : SecurityTokenSerializer
	{
		private const string LocalName = "BinarySecurityToken";

		private const string NamespaceUri = "http://docs.oasis-open.org/wss/2004/01/oasis-200401-wss-wssecurity-secext-1.0.xsd";

		private const string UtilityNamespaceUri = "http://docs.oasis-open.org/wss/2004/01/oasis-200401-wss-wssecurity-utility-1.0.xsd";

		private const string ValueTypeUri = "http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2009/11/swt-token-profile-1.0";

		private const string EncodingTypeBase64 = "http://docs.oasis-open.org/wss/2004/01/oasis-200401-wss-soap-message-security-1.0#Base64Binary";

		public static readonly SimpleWebSecurityTokenSerializer DefaultInstance = new SimpleWebSecurityTokenSerializer();

		private SecurityTokenSerializer innerSerializer;

		public SimpleWebSecurityTokenSerializer()
			: this(WSSecurityTokenSerializer.DefaultInstance)
		{
		}

		public SimpleWebSecurityTokenSerializer(SecurityTokenSerializer innerSerializer)
		{
			if (innerSerializer == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("innerSerializer");
			}
			this.innerSerializer = innerSerializer;
		}

		private static bool IsSecurityTokenXmlElement(XmlReader reader)
		{
			if (reader.IsStartElement("BinarySecurityToken", "http://docs.oasis-open.org/wss/2004/01/oasis-200401-wss-wssecurity-secext-1.0.xsd") && reader.GetAttribute("ValueType", null) == "http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2009/11/swt-token-profile-1.0")
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool CanReadKeyIdentifierClauseCore(XmlReader reader)
		{
			return innerSerializer.CanReadKeyIdentifierClause(reader);
		}

		protected override bool CanReadKeyIdentifierCore(XmlReader reader)
		{
			return innerSerializer.CanReadKeyIdentifier(reader);
		}

		protected override bool CanReadTokenCore(XmlReader reader)
		{
			if (IsSecurityTokenXmlElement(reader))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return innerSerializer.CanReadToken(reader);
		}

		protected override bool CanWriteKeyIdentifierClauseCore(SecurityKeyIdentifierClause keyIdentifierClause)
		{
			return innerSerializer.CanWriteKeyIdentifierClause(keyIdentifierClause);
		}

		protected override bool CanWriteKeyIdentifierCore(SecurityKeyIdentifier keyIdentifier)
		{
			return innerSerializer.CanWriteKeyIdentifier(keyIdentifier);
		}

		protected override bool CanWriteTokenCore(SecurityToken token)
		{
			if (token is SimpleWebSecurityToken || token is JsonSecurityToken)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return innerSerializer.CanWriteToken(token);
		}

		protected override SecurityKeyIdentifierClause ReadKeyIdentifierClauseCore(XmlReader reader)
		{
			return innerSerializer.ReadKeyIdentifierClause(reader);
		}

		protected override SecurityKeyIdentifier ReadKeyIdentifierCore(XmlReader reader)
		{
			return innerSerializer.ReadKeyIdentifier(reader);
		}

		protected override SecurityToken ReadTokenCore(XmlReader reader, SecurityTokenResolver tokenResolver)
		{
			if (IsSecurityTokenXmlElement(reader))
			{
				XmlDictionaryReader xmlDictionaryReader = XmlDictionaryReader.CreateDictionaryReader(reader);
				string attribute = xmlDictionaryReader.GetAttribute("Id", "http://docs.oasis-open.org/wss/2004/01/oasis-200401-wss-wssecurity-utility-1.0.xsd");
				string attribute2 = xmlDictionaryReader.GetAttribute("EncodingType", null);
				if (attribute2 == null || attribute2 == "http://docs.oasis-open.org/wss/2004/01/oasis-200401-wss-soap-message-security-1.0#Base64Binary")
				{
					byte[] rawData = xmlDictionaryReader.ReadElementContentAsBase64();
					return ReadBinaryCore(attribute, rawData);
				}
				throw new NotSupportedException(SRClient.UnsupportedEncodingType);
			}
			return innerSerializer.ReadToken(reader, tokenResolver);
		}

		protected override void WriteKeyIdentifierClauseCore(XmlWriter writer, SecurityKeyIdentifierClause keyIdentifierClause)
		{
			innerSerializer.WriteKeyIdentifierClause(writer, keyIdentifierClause);
		}

		protected override void WriteKeyIdentifierCore(XmlWriter writer, SecurityKeyIdentifier keyIdentifier)
		{
			innerSerializer.WriteKeyIdentifier(writer, keyIdentifier);
		}

		protected override void WriteTokenCore(XmlWriter writer, SecurityToken token)
		{
			if (token is SimpleWebSecurityToken || token is JsonSecurityToken)
			{
				WriteBinaryCore(token, out var id, out var rawData);
				if (rawData == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException(SRClient.NullRawDataInToken);
				}
				writer.WriteStartElement("wsse", "BinarySecurityToken", "http://docs.oasis-open.org/wss/2004/01/oasis-200401-wss-wssecurity-secext-1.0.xsd");
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(id))
				{
					writer.WriteAttributeString("wsu", "Id", "http://docs.oasis-open.org/wss/2004/01/oasis-200401-wss-wssecurity-utility-1.0.xsd", id);
				}
				writer.WriteAttributeString("ValueType", null, "http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2009/11/swt-token-profile-1.0");
				writer.WriteAttributeString("EncodingType", null, "http://docs.oasis-open.org/wss/2004/01/oasis-200401-wss-soap-message-security-1.0#Base64Binary");
				writer.WriteBase64(rawData, 0, rawData.Length);
				writer.WriteEndElement();
			}
			else
			{
				innerSerializer.WriteToken(writer, token);
			}
		}

		private static SecurityToken ReadBinaryCore(string id, byte[] rawData)
		{
			string text = Encoding.UTF8.GetString(rawData);
			id = id ?? string.Empty;
			if (text.StartsWith("SharedAccessSignature", StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				return new SharedAccessSignatureToken(id, text);
			}
			if (JsonSecurityToken.IsTokenType(text))
			{
				return new JsonSecurityToken(text);
			}
			return new SimpleWebSecurityToken(id, text);
		}

		private static void WriteBinaryCore(SecurityToken token, out string id, out byte[] rawData)
		{
			if (token is SimpleWebSecurityToken simpleWebSecurityToken)
			{
				id = simpleWebSecurityToken.Id;
				rawData = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(simpleWebSecurityToken.Token);
				return;
			}
			if (token is JsonSecurityToken jsonSecurityToken)
			{
				id = string.Empty;
				rawData = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(jsonSecurityToken.Token);
				return;
			}
			throw new ArgumentException($"The token type is unrecognized. Token type: {token.GetType()}");
		}
	}
	public class SimpleWebSecurityToken : SecurityToken
	{
		private const string InternalExpiresOnFieldName = "ExpiresOn";

		private const string InternalAudienceFieldName = "Audience";

		private const string InternalKeyValueSeparator = "=";

		private const string InternalPairSeparator = "&";

		private static readonly Func<string, string> Decoder = HttpUtility.UrlDecode;

		private static readonly DateTime EpochTime = new DateTime(1970, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

		private readonly string id;

		private readonly string token;

		private readonly DateTime validFrom;

		private readonly DateTime validTo;

		private readonly string audience;

		public string Audience => audience;

		public DateTime ExpiresOn => validTo;

		protected virtual string ExpiresOnFieldName => "ExpiresOn";

		protected virtual string AudienceFieldName => "Audience";

		protected virtual string KeyValueSeparator => "=";

		protected virtual string PairSeparator => "&";

		public override string Id => id;

		public override ReadOnlyCollection<SecurityKey> SecurityKeys => new ReadOnlyCollection<SecurityKey>(new List<SecurityKey>());

		public override DateTime ValidFrom => validFrom;

		public override DateTime ValidTo => validTo;

		public string Token => token;

		public SimpleWebSecurityToken(string tokenString, DateTime expiry, string audience)
		{
			if (tokenString == null)
			{
				throw new NullReferenceException("tokenString");
			}
			if (audience == null)
			{
				throw new NullReferenceException("audience");
			}
			id = "uuid:" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString();
			token = tokenString;
			validFrom = DateTime.MinValue;
			validTo = expiry;
			this.audience = audience;
		}

		public SimpleWebSecurityToken(string tokenString, DateTime expiry)
		{
			if (tokenString == null)
			{
				throw new NullReferenceException("tokenString");
			}
			id = "uuid:" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString();
			token = tokenString;
			validFrom = DateTime.MinValue;
			validTo = expiry;
			audience = GetAudienceFromToken(tokenString);
		}

		public SimpleWebSecurityToken(string tokenString)
			: this("uuid:" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString(), tokenString)
		{
		}

		public SimpleWebSecurityToken(string id, string tokenString)
		{
			if (id == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("id");
			}
			if (tokenString == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("tokenString");
			}
			this.id = id;
			token = tokenString;
			GetExpirationDateAndAudienceFromToken(tokenString, out validTo, out audience);
		}

		private string GetAudienceFromToken(string token)
		{
			IDictionary<string, string> dictionary = Decode(token, Decoder, Decoder, KeyValueSeparator, PairSeparator);
			if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(AudienceFieldName, out var value))
			{
				throw new FormatException(SRClient.TokenAudience);
			}
			return value;
		}

		private void GetExpirationDateAndAudienceFromToken(string token, out DateTime expiresOn, out string audience)
		{
			IDictionary<string, string> dictionary = Decode(token, Decoder, Decoder, KeyValueSeparator, PairSeparator);
			if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(ExpiresOnFieldName, out var value))
			{
				throw new FormatException(SRClient.TokenExpiresOn);
			}
			if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(AudienceFieldName, out audience))
			{
				throw new FormatException(SRClient.TokenAudience);
			}
			expiresOn = EpochTime + TimeSpan.FromSeconds(double.Parse(value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
		}

		private static IDictionary<string, string> Decode(string encodedString, Func<string, string> keyDecoder, Func<string, string> valueDecoder, string keyValueSeparator, string pairSeparator)
		{
			IDictionary<string, string> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, string>();
			IEnumerable<string> enumerable = encodedString.Split(new string[1] { pairSeparator }, StringSplitOptions.None);
			foreach (string item in enumerable)
			{
				string[] array = item.Split(new string[1] { keyValueSeparator }, StringSplitOptions.None);
				if (array.Length != 2)
				{
					throw new FormatException(SRClient.InvalidEncoding);
				}
				dictionary.Add(keyDecoder(array[0]), valueDecoder(array[1]));
			}
			return dictionary;
		}
	}

	public class SharedSecretTokenProvider : TokenProvider
	{
		private readonly string issuerName;

		private readonly byte[] issuerSecret;

		private readonly Uri stsUri;

		internal string IssuerName => issuerName;

		internal byte[] IssuerSecret => issuerSecret;

		internal SharedSecretTokenProvider(string issuerName, string issuerSecret)
			: this(issuerName, DecodeSecret(issuerSecret), TokenScope.Entity)
		{
		}

		internal SharedSecretTokenProvider(string issuerName, string issuerSecret, TokenScope tokenScope)
			: this(issuerName, DecodeSecret(issuerSecret), tokenScope)
		{
		}

		internal SharedSecretTokenProvider(string issuerName, byte[] issuerSecret)
			: this(issuerName, issuerSecret, TokenScope.Entity)
		{
		}

		internal SharedSecretTokenProvider(string issuerName, byte[] issuerSecret, TokenScope tokenScope)
			: base(cacheTokens: true, supportHttpAuthToken: true, tokenScope)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(issuerName))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.NullIssuerName, "issuerName");
			}
			if (issuerSecret == null || issuerSecret.Length == 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.NullIssuerSecret, "issuerSecret");
			}
			this.issuerName = issuerName;
			this.issuerSecret = issuerSecret;
			stsUri = null;
		}

		internal SharedSecretTokenProvider(string issuerName, string issuerSecret, Uri stsUri)
			: this(issuerName, issuerSecret, stsUri, TokenScope.Entity)
		{
		}

			: this(issuerName, DecodeSecret(issuerSecret), stsUri, tokenScope)
		{
		}

		internal SharedSecretTokenProvider(string issuerName, byte[] issuerSecret, Uri stsUri)
			: this(issuerName, issuerSecret, stsUri, TokenScope.Entity)
		{
		}

		internal SharedSecretTokenProvider(string issuerName, byte[] issuerSecret, Uri stsUri, TokenScope tokenScope)
			: base(cacheTokens: true, supportHttpAuthToken: true, tokenScope)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(issuerName))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.NullIssuerName, "issuerName");
			}
			if (issuerSecret == null || issuerSecret.Length == 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.NullIssuerSecret, "issuerSecret");
			}
			if (stsUri == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("stsUri");
			}
			if (!stsUri.AbsolutePath.EndsWith("/", StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.STSURIFormat, "stsUri");
			}
			this.issuerName = issuerName;
			this.issuerSecret = issuerSecret;
			this.stsUri = stsUri;
		}

		protected override Key BuildKey(string appliesTo, string action)
		{
			return new Key(appliesTo, string.Empty);
		}

		public static string ComputeSimpleWebTokenString(string issuerName, string issuerSecret)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(issuerName))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.NullIssuerName, "issuerName");
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(issuerSecret))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.NullIssuerSecret, "issuerSecret");
			}
			byte[] array = null;
			try
			{
				array = Convert.FromBase64String(issuerSecret);
			}
			catch (FormatException)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.InvalidIssuerSecret, "issuerSecret");
			}
			return ComputeSimpleWebTokenString(issuerName, array);
		}

		public static string ComputeSimpleWebTokenString(string issuerName, byte[] issuerSecret)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(issuerName))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.NullIssuerName, "issuerName");
			}
			if (issuerSecret == null || issuerSecret.Length < 1)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.NullIssuerSecret, "issuerSecret");
			}
			string text = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}={1}", "Issuer", HttpUtility.UrlEncode(issuerName));
			string str;
			using (HMACSHA256 hMACSHA = new HMACSHA256(issuerSecret))
			{
				str = Convert.ToBase64String(hMACSHA.ComputeHash(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(text)));
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.Append(text);
			stringBuilder.Append('&');
			stringBuilder.Append(string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}={1}", "HMACSHA256", HttpUtility.UrlEncode(str)));
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginGetToken(string appliesTo, string action, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			ValidateAction(action);
			Uri requestUri = TokenProviderHelper.GetStsUri(stsUri, appliesTo);
			return TokenProviderHelper.BeginGetAccessTokenByAssertion(requestUri, appliesTo, ComputeSimpleWebTokenString(issuerName, issuerSecret), "SWT", timeout, callback, state);
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginGetWebToken(string appliesTo, string action, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			ValidateAction(action);
			Uri requestUri = TokenProviderHelper.GetStsUri(stsUri, appliesTo);

			{
				return false;
			}
			MessageCredentialType messageCredentialType;
			IssuedSecurityTokenParameters infocardParameters;
			if (bootstrapSecurity is TransportSecurityBindingElement)
			{
				if (SecurityUtil.SecurityBindingElement.IsUserNameOverTransportBinding(bootstrapSecurity))
				{
					messageCredentialType = MessageCredentialType.UserName;
				}
				else if (SecurityUtil.SecurityBindingElement.IsCertificateOverTransportBinding(bootstrapSecurity))
				{
					messageCredentialType = MessageCredentialType.Certificate;
				}
				else if (SecurityUtil.SecurityBindingElement.IsSspiNegotiationOverTransportBinding(bootstrapSecurity, p: true))
				{
					messageCredentialType = MessageCredentialType.Windows;
				}
				else
				{
					if (!SecurityUtil.SecurityBindingElement.IsIssuedTokenOverTransportBinding(bootstrapSecurity, out infocardParameters))
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (!SecurityUtil.IssuedSecurityTokenParameters.IsInfoCardParameters(infocardParameters))
					{
						return false;
					}
					messageCredentialType = MessageCredentialType.IssuedToken;
				}
			}
			else if (SecurityUtil.SecurityBindingElement.IsUserNameForSslBinding(bootstrapSecurity, p: true))
			{
				messageCredentialType = MessageCredentialType.UserName;
			}
			else if (SecurityUtil.SecurityBindingElement.IsSslNegotiationBinding(bootstrapSecurity, p: true, p_3: true))
			{
				messageCredentialType = MessageCredentialType.Certificate;
			}
			else if (SecurityUtil.SecurityBindingElement.IsSspiNegotiationBinding(bootstrapSecurity, p: true))
			{
				messageCredentialType = MessageCredentialType.Windows;
			}
			else if (SecurityUtil.SecurityBindingElement.IsIssuedTokenForSslBinding(bootstrapSecurity, p: true, out infocardParameters))
			{
				if (!SecurityUtil.IssuedSecurityTokenParameters.IsInfoCardParameters(infocardParameters))
				{
					return false;
				}
				messageCredentialType = MessageCredentialType.IssuedToken;
			}
			else
			{
				if (!SecurityUtil.SecurityBindingElement.IsSslNegotiationBinding(bootstrapSecurity, p: false, p_3: true))
				{
					return false;
				}
				messageCredentialType = MessageCredentialType.None;
			}
			messageSecurity = new MessageSecurityOverRelayConnection();
			messageSecurity.ClientCredentialType = messageCredentialType;
			if (messageCredentialType != MessageCredentialType.IssuedToken)
			{
				messageSecurity.algorithmSuite = bootstrapSecurity.DefaultAlgorithmSuite;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

				establishSecurityContext = value;

		}

		internal NonDualMessageSecurityOverRelayHttp()
		{
			establishSecurityContext = true;
		}

		protected override bool IsSecureConversationEnabled()
		{
			return establishSecurityContext;
		}
	}

		private sealed class TokenRequestAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<TokenRequestAsyncResult>
		{
			private static readonly Action<object> onCancelTimer = OnCancelTimer;

			private readonly Uri requestUri;

			private readonly string appliesTo;

			private readonly string requestToken;

			private readonly string simpleAuthAssertionFormat;

			private Stream requestStream;

			private HttpWebRequest request;

			private HttpWebResponse response;

			private string expiresIn;

			private string audience;

			private string accessToken;

			private byte[] body;

			private Stream sourceStream;

			private MemoryStream tmpStream;

			private IOThreadTimer requestCancelTimer;

			private volatile bool requestTimedOut;

			public string ExpiresIn => expiresIn;

			public string Audience => audience;

			public string AccessToken => accessToken;

			public TokenRequestAsyncResult(Uri requestUri, string appliesTo, string requestToken, string simpleAuthAssertionFormat, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.requestUri = requestUri;
				this.appliesTo = appliesTo;
				this.requestToken = requestToken;
				this.simpleAuthAssertionFormat = simpleAuthAssertionFormat;
				Start();
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				try
				{
					StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
					stringBuilder.AppendFormat(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}={1}", "wrap_scope", HttpUtility.UrlEncode(appliesTo));
					stringBuilder.Append('&');
					stringBuilder.AppendFormat(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}={1}", "wrap_assertion_format", simpleAuthAssertionFormat);
					stringBuilder.Append('&');
					stringBuilder.AppendFormat(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}={1}", "wrap_assertion", HttpUtility.UrlEncode(requestToken));
					body = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(stringBuilder.ToString());
					request = (HttpWebRequest)WebRequest.Create(requestUri);
					request.ServicePoint.MaxIdleTime = Constants.ServicePointMaxIdleTimeMilliSeconds;
					request.AllowAutoRedirect = true;
					request.MaximumAutomaticRedirections = 1;
					request.Method = "POST";
					request.ContentType = "application/x-www-form-urlencoded";
					request.ContentLength = body.Length;
					try
					{
						request.Timeout = Convert.ToInt32(RemainingTime().TotalMilliseconds, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					}
					catch (OverflowException innerException)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.TimeoutExceeded, innerException);
					}
				}
				catch (ArgumentException ex)
				{
					Complete(ConvertException(ex));
					yield break;
				}
				try
				{
					requestCancelTimer = new IOThreadTimer(onCancelTimer, this, isTypicallyCanceledShortlyAfterBeingSet: true);
					try
					{
						TimeSpan timeToCancelRequest = RemainingTime();
						if (timeToCancelRequest <= TimeSpan.Zero)
						{
							Complete(new TimeoutException(SRClient.OperationRequestTimedOut(base.OriginalTimeout)));
							yield break;
						}
						yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)delegate(TokenRequestAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s)
						{
							IAsyncResult result = thisPtr.request.BeginGetRequestStream(c, s);
							thisPtr.requestCancelTimer.Set(timeToCancelRequest);
							return result;
						}, (EndCall)delegate(TokenRequestAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
						{
							thisPtr.requestStream = thisPtr.request.EndGetRequestStream(r);
						}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
						if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
						{
							Complete(ConvertException(base.LastAsyncStepException));
							yield break;
						}
						yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((TokenRequestAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.requestStream.BeginWrite(thisPtr.body, 0, thisPtr.body.Length, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(TokenRequestAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
						{
							thisPtr.requestStream.EndWrite(r);
						}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
						if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
						{
							Complete(ConvertException(base.LastAsyncStepException));
							yield break;
						}
					}
					finally
					{
						TokenRequestAsyncResult tokenRequestAsyncResult = this;
						if (tokenRequestAsyncResult.requestStream != null)
						{
							tokenRequestAsyncResult.requestStream.Dispose();
						}
						tokenRequestAsyncResult.requestCancelTimer.Cancel();
					}
					TimeSpan timeToCancelResponse = RemainingTime();
					if (timeToCancelResponse <= TimeSpan.Zero)
					{
						Complete(new TimeoutException(SRClient.OperationRequestTimedOut(base.OriginalTimeout)));
						yield break;
					}
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)delegate(TokenRequestAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s)
					{
						IAsyncResult result = thisPtr.request.BeginGetResponse(c, s);
						thisPtr.requestCancelTimer.Set(timeToCancelResponse);
						return result;
					}, (EndCall)delegate(TokenRequestAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.response = (HttpWebResponse)thisPtr.request.EndGetResponse(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
					if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
					{
						Complete(ConvertException(base.LastAsyncStepException));
						yield break;
					}
					using (sourceStream = response.GetResponseStream())
					{
						using (tmpStream = new MemoryStream())
						{
							yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((TokenRequestAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => new StreamReaderAsyncResult(thisPtr.sourceStream, thisPtr.tmpStream, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(TokenRequestAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
							{
								AsyncResult<StreamReaderAsyncResult>.End(r);
							}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
							if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
							{
								Complete(ConvertException(base.LastAsyncStepException));
								yield break;
							}
							try
							{
								tmpStream.Position = 0L;
								using StreamReader streamReader = new StreamReader(tmpStream, Encoding.UTF8);
								string urlParameters = streamReader.ReadToEnd();
								ExtractAccessToken(urlParameters, out accessToken, out expiresIn, out audience);
							}
							catch (Exception ex2)
							{
								if (Fx.IsFatal(ex2))
								{
									throw;
								}
								Complete(ConvertException(ex2));
								yield break;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					TokenRequestAsyncResult tokenRequestAsyncResult = this;
					if (tokenRequestAsyncResult.requestCancelTimer != null)
					{
						tokenRequestAsyncResult.requestCancelTimer.Cancel();
					}
				}
			}

			private static void OnCancelTimer(object state)
			{
				TokenRequestAsyncResult tokenRequestAsyncResult = (TokenRequestAsyncResult)state;
				tokenRequestAsyncResult.requestTimedOut = true;
				tokenRequestAsyncResult.request.Abort();
			}

			private Exception ConvertException(Exception exception)
			{
				if (exception is ArgumentException)
				{
					return TokenProviderHelper.ConvertException(requestUri, exception);
				}
				if (exception is WebException)
				{
					return ConvertWebException(requestUri, (WebException)exception);
				}
				if (exception is IOException && requestTimedOut)
				{
					return new TimeoutException(SRClient.OperationRequestTimedOut(base.OriginalTimeout), exception);
				}
				return exception;
			}
		}

		private sealed class StreamReaderAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<StreamReaderAsyncResult>
		{
			private const int ReadBufferSize = 1024;

			private readonly Stream inputStream;

			private readonly MemoryStream outputStream;

			private readonly byte[] buffer;

			private int bytesRead;

			public StreamReaderAsyncResult(Stream inputStream, MemoryStream outputStream, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.inputStream = inputStream;
				this.outputStream = outputStream;
				buffer = new byte[1024];
				bytesRead = -1;
				Start();
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				while (bytesRead != 0)
				{
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((StreamReaderAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.inputStream.BeginRead(thisPtr.buffer, 0, 1024, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(StreamReaderAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.bytesRead = thisPtr.inputStream.EndRead(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
					outputStream.Write(buffer, 0, bytesRead);
				}
			}
		}

		internal static string ExtractSolutionFromHostname(string hostname)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(hostname))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.NullHostname);
			}
			string text = hostname.ToLowerInvariant();
			string text2 = RelayEnvironment.RelayHostRootName.ToLowerInvariant();
			if (!text.EndsWith(text2, StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.MismatchServiceBusDomain(text, text2));
			}
			string text3 = text.Replace(text2, string.Empty);
			string[] array = text3.Split(new char[1] { '.' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
			if (array.Length > 1)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.UnsupportedServiceBusDomainPrefix(text, text2));
			}
			string result = string.Empty;
			if (array.Length == 1)
			{
				result = array[0];
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal static IAsyncResult BeginGetAccessTokenByAssertion(Uri requestUri, string appliesTo, string requestToken, string simpleAuthAssertionFormat, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)

		internal static TokenResult<SecurityToken> EndGetAccessTokenByAssertion(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			string expiresIn;
			string audience;
			string tokenString = EndGetAccessTokenCore(result, out expiresIn, out audience);
			DateTime dateTime = ConvertExpiry(expiresIn);
			SimpleWebSecurityToken token = new SimpleWebSecurityToken(tokenString, dateTime, audience);
			return new TokenResult<SecurityToken>
			{
				CacheUntil = dateTime,
				Token = token
			};
		}

		{

			string audience;
			string accessTokenCore = GetAccessTokenCore(requestUri, appliesTo, requestToken, simpleAuthAssertionFormat, timeout, out expiresIn, out audience);
			DateTime dateTime = ConvertExpiry(expiresIn);
			SimpleWebSecurityToken token = new SimpleWebSecurityToken(accessTokenCore, dateTime, audience);
			return new TokenResult<SecurityToken>
			{
				CacheUntil = dateTime,
				Token = token
			};
		}

		internal static TokenResult<string> GetHttpAuthAccessTokenByAssertion(Uri requestUri, string appliesTo, string requestToken, string simpleAuthAssertionFormat, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			string expiresIn;
			string audience;
			string accessTokenCore = GetAccessTokenCore(requestUri, appliesTo, requestToken, simpleAuthAssertionFormat, timeout, out expiresIn, out audience);
			DateTime cacheUntil = ConvertExpiry(expiresIn);
			string token = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0} {1}=\"{2}\"", "WRAP", "access_token", accessTokenCore);
			return new TokenResult<string>
			{
				CacheUntil = cacheUntil,
				Token = token
			};
		}

		internal static Uri GetStsUri(Uri stsUri, string appliesTo)
		{
			if (stsUri == null)
			{
				string serviceNamespace = ExtractSolutionFromHostname(new Uri(appliesTo).Host);
				return ServiceBusEnvironment.CreateAccessControlUri(serviceNamespace);
			}
			return new Uri(stsUri, "WRAPv0.9/");
		}

		private static DateTime ConvertExpiry(string expiresIn)
		{
			double value = Convert.ToDouble(expiresIn, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			return DateTime.UtcNow + TimeSpan.FromSeconds(value);
		}

		private static void ExtractExpiresInAndAudience(string simpleWebToken, out DateTime expiresIn, out string audience)
		{
			expiresIn = DateTime.MinValue;
			audience = null;
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(simpleWebToken))
			{
				IDictionary<string, string> dictionary = Decode(simpleWebToken);
				string text = dictionary["ExpiresOn"];
				if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
				{
					ThrowException(SR.GetString(Resources.TokenProviderEmptyExpiration));
				}
				expiresIn = TokenConstants.WrapBaseTime + TimeSpan.FromSeconds(double.Parse(HttpUtility.UrlDecode(text.Trim()), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
				audience = dictionary["Audience"];
				if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
				{
					ThrowException(SR.GetString(Resources.TokenProviderEmptyAudience));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ThrowException(SR.GetString(Resources.TokenProviderEmptyToken));
			}
		}

		private static IDictionary<string, string> Decode(string encodedString)
		{
			IDictionary<string, string> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, string>();
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(encodedString))
			{
				IEnumerable<string> enumerable = encodedString.Split(new char[1] { '&' }, StringSplitOptions.None);
				foreach (string item in enumerable)
				{
					string[] array = item.Split(new char[1] { '=' }, StringSplitOptions.None);
					if (array.Length != 2)
					{
						throw new FormatException(SRClient.InvalidEncoding);
					}
					dictionary.Add(HttpUtility.UrlDecode(array[0]), HttpUtility.UrlDecode(array[1]));
				}
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		private static void ExtractAccessToken(string urlParameters, out string token, out string expiresIn, out string audience)
		{
			token = null;
			expiresIn = null;
			audience = null;
			if (urlParameters != null)
			{
				string[] array = urlParameters.Split('&');
				foreach (string text in array)
				{
					string[] array2 = text.Split('=');
					if (array2.Length == 2)
					{
						string text2 = array2[0].Trim();
						if (text2 == "wrap_access_token")
						{
							token = HttpUtility.UrlDecode(array2[1].Trim());
							audience = ExtractAudience(token);
						}
						else if (text2 == "wrap_access_token_expires_in")
						{
							expiresIn = HttpUtility.UrlDecode(array2[1].Trim());
						}
					}
					else
					{
						ThrowException(SR.GetString(Resources.TokenProviderInvalidTokenParameter, text));
					}
				}
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(token))
			{
				ThrowException(SR.GetString(Resources.TokenProviderEmptyToken));
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(expiresIn))
			{
				ThrowException(SR.GetString(Resources.TokenProviderEmptyExpiration));
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(audience))
			{
				ThrowException(SR.GetString(Resources.TokenProviderEmptyAudience));
			}
		}

		private static string ExtractAudience(string token)
		{
			string text = null;
			if (token != null)
			{
				string[] array = token.Split('&');
				foreach (string text2 in array)
				{
					string[] array2 = text2.Split('=');
					if (array2.Length == 2)
					{
						string text3 = array2[0].Trim();
						if (text3 == "Audience")
						{
							text = HttpUtility.UrlDecode(array2[1].Trim());
						}
					}
					else
					{
						ThrowException(SR.GetString(Resources.TokenProviderInvalidTokenParameter, text2));
					}
				}
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				ThrowException(SR.GetString(Resources.TokenProviderEmptyAudience));
			}
			return text;
		}

		internal static IAsyncResult BeginGetAccessTokenCore(Uri requestUri, string appliesTo, string requestToken, string simpleAuthAssertionFormat, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new TokenRequestAsyncResult(requestUri, appliesTo, requestToken, simpleAuthAssertionFormat, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		internal static string EndGetAccessTokenCore(IAsyncResult result, out string expiresIn, out string audience)
		{
			TokenRequestAsyncResult tokenRequestAsyncResult = AsyncResult<TokenRequestAsyncResult>.End(result);
			expiresIn = tokenRequestAsyncResult.ExpiresIn;
			audience = tokenRequestAsyncResult.Audience;
			return tokenRequestAsyncResult.AccessToken;
		}

		private static string GetAccessTokenCore(Uri requestUri, string appliesTo, string requestToken, string simpleAuthAssertionFormat, TimeSpan timeout, out string expiresIn, out string audience)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.AppendFormat(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}={1}", "wrap_scope", HttpUtility.UrlEncode(appliesTo));
			stringBuilder.Append('&');
			stringBuilder.AppendFormat(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}={1}", "wrap_assertion_format", simpleAuthAssertionFormat);
			stringBuilder.Append('&');
			stringBuilder.AppendFormat(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}={1}", "wrap_assertion", HttpUtility.UrlEncode(requestToken));
			byte[] bytes = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(stringBuilder.ToString());
			string token = null;
			expiresIn = null;
			audience = null;
			try
			{
				HttpWebRequest httpWebRequest = WebRequest.Create(requestUri) as HttpWebRequest;
				httpWebRequest.ServicePoint.MaxIdleTime = Constants.ServicePointMaxIdleTimeMilliSeconds;
				httpWebRequest.AllowAutoRedirect = true;
				httpWebRequest.MaximumAutomaticRedirections = 1;
				httpWebRequest.Method = "POST";
				httpWebRequest.ContentType = "application/x-www-form-urlencoded";
				httpWebRequest.ContentLength = bytes.Length;
				try
				{
					httpWebRequest.Timeout = Convert.ToInt32(timeout.TotalMilliseconds, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				}
				catch (OverflowException innerException)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.TimeoutExceeded, innerException);
				}
				using (Stream stream = httpWebRequest.GetRequestStream())
				{
					stream.Write(bytes, 0, bytes.Length);
				}
				using HttpWebResponse httpWebResponse = (HttpWebResponse)httpWebRequest.GetResponse();
				using Stream stream2 = httpWebResponse.GetResponseStream();
				using StreamReader streamReader = new StreamReader(stream2, Encoding.UTF8);
				string urlParameters = streamReader.ReadToEnd();
				ExtractAccessToken(urlParameters, out token, out expiresIn, out audience);
			}
			catch (ArgumentException innerException2)
			{
				ThrowException(requestUri, innerException2);
			}
			catch (WebException exception)
			{
				ThrowException(requestUri, exception);
			}
			return token;
		}

		public static string GetWindowsAccessTokenCore(IEnumerator<Uri> stsUris, Func<Uri, Uri> uriBuilder, string requestToken, TimeSpan timeout, out DateTime expiresIn, out string audience)
		{
			byte[] bytes = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(requestToken);
			string text = null;
			expiresIn = DateTime.MinValue;
			audience = null;
			bool flag = stsUris.MoveNext();
			while (flag)
			{
				Uri uri = uriBuilder(stsUris.Current);
				try
				{
					HttpWebRequest httpWebRequest = WebRequest.Create(uri) as HttpWebRequest;
					httpWebRequest.ServicePoint.MaxIdleTime = Constants.ServicePointMaxIdleTimeMilliSeconds;
					httpWebRequest.AllowAutoRedirect = true;
					httpWebRequest.MaximumAutomaticRedirections = 1;
					httpWebRequest.Method = "POST";
					httpWebRequest.ContentType = "application/x-www-form-urlencoded";
					httpWebRequest.ContentLength = bytes.Length;
					httpWebRequest.Timeout = ConvertToInt32(timeout);
					httpWebRequest.UseDefaultCredentials = true;
					AuthenticationManager.CustomTargetNameDictionary[uri.AbsoluteUri] = "HTTP\\";
					using (Stream stream = httpWebRequest.GetRequestStream())
					{
						stream.Write(bytes, 0, bytes.Length);
					}
					using (HttpWebResponse httpWebResponse = httpWebRequest.GetResponse() as HttpWebResponse)
					{
						using Stream stream2 = httpWebResponse.GetResponseStream();
						using StreamReader streamReader = new StreamReader(stream2, Encoding.UTF8);
						text = streamReader.ReadToEnd();
						ExtractExpiresInAndAudience(text, out expiresIn, out audience);
					}
					flag = false;
				}
				catch (ArgumentException innerException)
				{
					ThrowException(uri, innerException);
				}
				catch (WebException exception)
				{
					flag = stsUris.MoveNext();
					if (!flag)
					{
						ThrowException(uri, exception);
					}
				}
			}
			return text;
		}

		public static string GetOAuthAccessTokenCore(IEnumerator<Uri> stsUris, Func<Uri, Uri> uriBuilder, string requestToken, TimeSpan timeout, out DateTime expiresIn, out string audience)
		{
			byte[] bytes = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(requestToken);
			string text = null;
			expiresIn = DateTime.MinValue;
			audience = null;
			bool flag = stsUris.MoveNext();
			while (flag)
			{
				Uri requestUri = uriBuilder(stsUris.Current);
				try
				{
					HttpWebRequest httpWebRequest = WebRequest.Create(requestUri) as HttpWebRequest;
					httpWebRequest.ServicePoint.MaxIdleTime = Constants.ServicePointMaxIdleTimeMilliSeconds;
					httpWebRequest.AllowAutoRedirect = true;
					httpWebRequest.MaximumAutomaticRedirections = 1;
					httpWebRequest.Method = "POST";
					httpWebRequest.ContentType = "application/x-www-form-urlencoded";
					httpWebRequest.ContentLength = bytes.Length;
					httpWebRequest.Timeout = ConvertToInt32(timeout);
					using (Stream stream = httpWebRequest.GetRequestStream())
					{
						stream.Write(bytes, 0, bytes.Length);
					}
					using (HttpWebResponse httpWebResponse = httpWebRequest.GetResponse() as HttpWebResponse)
					{
						using Stream stream2 = httpWebResponse.GetResponseStream();
						using StreamReader streamReader = new StreamReader(stream2, Encoding.UTF8);
						text = streamReader.ReadToEnd();
						ExtractExpiresInAndAudience(text, out expiresIn, out audience);
					}
					flag = false;
				}
				catch (ArgumentException innerException)
				{
					ThrowException(requestUri, innerException);
				}
				catch (WebException exception)
				{
					flag = stsUris.MoveNext();
					if (!flag)
					{
						ThrowException(requestUri, exception);
					}
				}
			}
			return text;
		}

		private static int ConvertToInt32(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			try
			{
				return Convert.ToInt32(timeout.TotalMilliseconds, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			}
			catch (OverflowException innerException)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.TimeoutExceeded, innerException);
			}
		}

		private static void ThrowException(string message)
		{
			SecurityTokenException ex = new SecurityTokenException(message);
			Fx.Exception.AsInformation(ex);
			throw ex;
		}

		private static void ThrowException(Uri requestUri, WebException exception)
		{
			throw ConvertWebException(requestUri, exception);
		}

		private static void ThrowException(Uri requestUri, Exception innerException)
		{
			throw ConvertException(requestUri, innerException);
		}

		private static Exception ConvertWebException(Uri requestUri, WebException exception)
		{
			string text = string.Empty;
			if (exception != null && exception.Response != null)
			{
				using (exception.Response)
				{
					using (StreamReader streamReader = new StreamReader(exception.Response.GetResponseStream()))
					{
						text = streamReader.ReadToEnd();
					}
					if (exception.Response is HttpWebResponse { StatusCode: not HttpStatusCode.OK, StatusCode: not HttpStatusCode.Continue } httpWebResponse)
					{
						Exception ex = new InternalSecurityTokenException(SR.GetString(Resources.TokenProviderFailedSecurityToken, requestUri.AbsoluteUri, text), httpWebResponse.StatusCode, exception);
						switch (httpWebResponse.StatusCode)
						{
						case HttpStatusCode.NotFound:
						case HttpStatusCode.BadGateway:
						case HttpStatusCode.ServiceUnavailable:
							ex = new TokenProviderException(SR.GetString(Resources.TokenProviderServiceUnavailable, requestUri.AbsoluteUri), exception);
							break;
						case HttpStatusCode.RequestTimeout:
						case HttpStatusCode.GatewayTimeout:
							ex = new TimeoutException(SR.GetString(Resources.TokenProviderTimeout, requestUri.AbsoluteUri), exception);
							break;
						}
						Fx.Exception.AsInformation(ex);
						return ex;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				text = ((exception == null) ? "Unknown" : exception.Message);
			}
			Exception ex2 = new SecurityTokenException(SR.GetString(Resources.TokenProviderFailedSecurityToken, requestUri.AbsoluteUri, text), exception);
			if (exception != null && (exception.Status == WebExceptionStatus.Timeout || exception.Status == WebExceptionStatus.RequestCanceled))
			{
				ex2 = new TimeoutException(SR.GetString(Resources.TokenProviderTimeout, requestUri.AbsoluteUri), ex2);
			}
			Fx.Exception.AsInformation(ex2);
			return ex2;
		}

		private static Exception ConvertException(Uri requestUri, Exception innerException)
		{
			SecurityTokenException ex = new SecurityTokenException(SR.GetString(Resources.TokenProviderFailedSecurityToken, requestUri.AbsoluteUri, (innerException == null) ? "Unknown" : innerException.Message), innerException);
			Fx.Exception.AsInformation(ex);
			return ex;
		}
	}
	public class WindowsTokenProvider : TokenProvider
	{
		private const int DefaultCacheSize = 100;

		private const string WindowsTokenServicePath = "$STS/Windows/";

		private const string ClientPasswordFormat = "grant_type=authorization_code&client_id={0}&client_secret={1}&scope={2}";

		private const string ScopeFormat = "scope={0}";

		private readonly Func<Uri, Uri> onBuildUri = BuildStsUri;

		internal readonly List<Uri> stsUris;

		internal readonly NetworkCredential credential;

		internal WindowsTokenProvider(IEnumerable<Uri> stsUris)
			: this(stsUris, null)
		{
		}

		internal WindowsTokenProvider(IEnumerable<Uri> stsUris, NetworkCredential credential)
			: base(cacheTokens: true, supportHttpAuthToken: true, 100, TokenScope.Namespace)
		{
			if (stsUris == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNull("stsUris");
			}
			this.stsUris = stsUris.ToList();
			if (this.stsUris.Count == 0)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNull("stsUris");
			}
			this.credential = credential;
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginGetToken(string appliesTo, string action, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			DateTime expiresIn;
			string audience;
			string windowsAccessTokenCore = TokenProviderHelper.GetWindowsAccessTokenCore(stsUris.GetEnumerator(), onBuildUri, BuildRequestToken(appliesTo), timeout, out expiresIn, out audience);
			SimpleWebSecurityToken token = new SimpleWebSecurityToken(windowsAccessTokenCore, expiresIn, audience);
			TokenProviderHelper.TokenResult<SecurityToken> data = new TokenProviderHelper.TokenResult<SecurityToken>
			{
				CacheUntil = expiresIn,
				Token = token
			};
			return new CompletedAsyncResult<TokenProviderHelper.TokenResult<SecurityToken>>(data, callback, state);
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginGetWebToken(string appliesTo, string action, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			DateTime expiresIn;
			string audience;
			string windowsAccessTokenCore = TokenProviderHelper.GetWindowsAccessTokenCore(stsUris.GetEnumerator(), onBuildUri, BuildRequestToken(appliesTo), timeout, out expiresIn, out audience);
			string token = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0} {1}=\"{2}\"", "WRAP", "access_token", windowsAccessTokenCore);
			TokenProviderHelper.TokenResult<string> data = new TokenProviderHelper.TokenResult<string>
			{
				CacheUntil = expiresIn,
				Token = token
			};
			return new CompletedAsyncResult<TokenProviderHelper.TokenResult<string>>(data, callback, state);
		}

		protected override SecurityToken OnEndGetToken(IAsyncResult result, out DateTime cacheUntil)
		{
			TokenProviderHelper.TokenResult<SecurityToken> tokenResult = CompletedAsyncResult<TokenProviderHelper.TokenResult<SecurityToken>>.End(result);
			cacheUntil = tokenResult.CacheUntil;
			return tokenResult.Token;
		}

		protected override string OnEndGetWebToken(IAsyncResult result, out DateTime cacheUntil)
		{
			TokenProviderHelper.TokenResult<string> tokenResult = CompletedAsyncResult<TokenProviderHelper.TokenResult<string>>.End(result);
			cacheUntil = tokenResult.CacheUntil;
			return tokenResult.Token;
		}

		protected override Key BuildKey(string appliesTo, string action)
		{
			string appliesTo2 = ((credential != null) ? string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}\\{1}", credential.Domain, credential.UserName) : WindowsIdentity.GetCurrent().Name);
			return new Key(appliesTo2, string.Empty);
		}

		protected override string NormalizeAppliesTo(string appliesTo)
		{
			return ServiceBusUriHelper.NormalizeUri(appliesTo, "http", StripQueryParameters).AbsoluteUri;
		}

		private string BuildRequestToken(string scope)
		{
			if (credential == null)
			{
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "scope={0}", HttpUtility.UrlEncode(scope));
			}
			string str = (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(credential.Domain) ? credential.UserName : string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}@{1}", credential.UserName, credential.Domain));
			return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "grant_type=authorization_code&client_id={0}&client_secret={1}&scope={2}", HttpUtility.UrlEncode(str), HttpUtility.UrlEncode(credential.Password), HttpUtility.UrlEncode(scope));
		}

		private static Uri BuildStsUri(Uri baseAddress)
		{
			UriBuilder uriBuilder = MessagingUtilities.CreateUriBuilderWithHttpsSchemeAndPort(baseAddress);
			uriBuilder.Path = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}{1}", uriBuilder.Path, "$STS/Windows/");
			return uriBuilder.Uri;
		}
	}

		{

				return ListenerType == ListenerType.HybridConnection;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool? ComputeIsDiscoverable(DiscoveryType? discovery)
		{
			if (!discovery.HasValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool value = false;
			switch (discovery.Value)
			{
			case DiscoveryType.Public:
				value = true;
				break;
			case DiscoveryType.Private:
				value = false;
				break;
			}
			return value;
		}

		internal bool IsCompatible(ServiceSettings serviceSettings)
		{
			if (Discovery == serviceSettings.Discovery && RelayClientAuthenticationType == serviceSettings.RelayClientAuthenticationType && ListenerType == serviceSettings.ListenerType && TransportProtection == serviceSettings.TransportProtection)
			{
				return IsDynamic == serviceSettings.IsDynamic;
			}
			return false;
		}
