	internal class BaseStreamConnection : IConnection, ITraceSource
	{
		protected enum State
		{
			Open,
			Closing,
			Closed
		}

		private int asyncReadBufferSize;

		private byte[] readBuffer;

		private TimeSpan sendTimeout;

		private TimeSpan receiveTimeout;

		private bool aborted;

		private int asyncReadSize;

		private AsyncCallback onRead;

		private WaitCallback asyncReadCallback;

		private volatile Exception asyncReadException;

		private object asyncReadState;

		private bool asyncReadPending;

		private bool asyncWritePending;

		private IOThreadTimer receiveTimer;

		private static Action<object> onReceiveTimeout;

		private IOThreadTimer sendTimer;

		private static Action<object> onSendTimeout;

		private string timeoutErrorString;

		private IPEndPoint remoteEndpoint;

		protected Stream Stream { get; private set; }

		protected State CloseState { get; set; }

		protected bool IsShutdown { get; set; }

		public string Component => "Relay";

		public TrackingContext TrackingContext { get; }

		public byte[] AsyncReadBuffer
		{
			get
			{
				if (readBuffer == null)
				{
					lock (ThisLock)
					{
						ThrowIfClosed();
						if (readBuffer == null)
						{
							readBuffer = Fx.AllocateByteArray(asyncReadBufferSize);
						}
					}
				}
				return readBuffer;
			}
		}

		protected object ThisLock => this;

		public int AsyncReadBufferSize
		{
			get
			{
				return asyncReadBufferSize;
			}
			protected set
			{
				asyncReadBufferSize = value;
			}
		}

		public EventLevel ExceptionEventType { get; set; }

		public IPEndPoint RemoteIPEndPoint
		{
			get
			{
				return remoteEndpoint;
			}
			set
			{
				remoteEndpoint = value;
			}
		}

		private TimeSpan SendTimeout
		{
			get
			{
				if (Stream.CanTimeout)
				{
					return TimeoutHelper.FromMilliseconds(Stream.WriteTimeout);
				}
				return sendTimeout;
			}
			set
			{
				if (Stream.CanTimeout)
				{
					Stream.WriteTimeout = TimeoutHelper.ToMilliseconds(value);
				}
				sendTimeout = value;
			}
		}

		private IOThreadTimer SendTimer
		{
			get
			{
				if (sendTimer == null)
				{
					if (onSendTimeout == null)
					{
						onSendTimeout = OnSendTimeout;
					}
					sendTimer = new IOThreadTimer(onSendTimeout, this, isTypicallyCanceledShortlyAfterBeingSet: false);
				}
				return sendTimer;
			}
		}

		private TimeSpan ReceiveTimeout
		{
			get
			{
				if (Stream.CanTimeout)
				{
					return TimeoutHelper.FromMilliseconds(Stream.ReadTimeout);
				}
				return receiveTimeout;
			}
			set
			{
				if (Stream.CanTimeout)
				{
					Stream.ReadTimeout = TimeoutHelper.ToMilliseconds(value);
				}
				receiveTimeout = value;
			}
		}

		private IOThreadTimer ReceiveTimer
		{
			get
			{
				if (receiveTimer == null)
				{
					if (onReceiveTimeout == null)
					{
						onReceiveTimeout = OnReceiveTimeout;
					}
					receiveTimer = new IOThreadTimer(onReceiveTimeout, this, isTypicallyCanceledShortlyAfterBeingSet: false);
				}
				return receiveTimer;
			}
		}

		public BaseStreamConnection(Stream stream, TrackingContext trackingContext)
			: this(stream, 65536, trackingContext)
		{
		}

		public BaseStreamConnection(Stream stream, int asyncReadBufferSize, TrackingContext trackingContext)
		{
			if (stream == null || trackingContext == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull((stream == null) ? "stream" : "trackingContext");
			}
			this.asyncReadBufferSize = asyncReadBufferSize;
			onRead = DiagnosticUtility.ThunkAsyncCallback(OnRead);
			TrackingContext = trackingContext;
			ExceptionEventType = EventLevel.Warning;
			Stream = stream;
			if (stream.CanTimeout)
			{
				SendTimeout = TimeoutHelper.FromMilliseconds(stream.WriteTimeout);
				ReceiveTimeout = TimeoutHelper.FromMilliseconds(stream.ReadTimeout);
			}
			else
			{
				SendTimeout = (ReceiveTimeout = TimeSpan.MaxValue);
			}
		}

		private void ThrowIfClosed()
		{
			if (CloseState == State.Closing || CloseState == State.Closed)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsInformation(ConvertObjectDisposedException(new ObjectDisposedException(GetType().ToString(), SR.GetString(Resources.SocketConnectionDisposed))));
			}
		}

		protected Exception ConvertObjectDisposedException(ObjectDisposedException originalException)
		{
			if (timeoutErrorString != null)
			{
				return new TimeoutException(timeoutErrorString, originalException);
			}
			if (aborted)
			{
				return new CommunicationObjectAbortedException(SR.GetString(Resources.SocketConnectionDisposed), originalException);
			}
			return new CommunicationException(SR.GetString(Resources.SocketConnectionDisposed), originalException);
		}

		protected static Exception ConvertIOException(IOException ioException)
		{
			if (ioException.InnerException is TimeoutException)
			{
				return new TimeoutException(ioException.InnerException.Message, ioException);
			}
			if (ioException.InnerException is CommunicationObjectAbortedException)
			{
				return new CommunicationObjectAbortedException(ioException.InnerException.Message, ioException);
			}
			if (ioException.InnerException is CommunicationException)
			{
				return new CommunicationException(ioException.InnerException.Message, ioException);
			}
			return new CommunicationException(SR.GetString(Resources.StreamError), ioException);
		}

		private static void OnReceiveTimeout(object state)
		{
			BaseStreamConnection baseStreamConnection = (BaseStreamConnection)state;
			baseStreamConnection.Abort(SR.GetString(Resources.SocketAbortedReceiveTimedOut, baseStreamConnection.ReceiveTimeout));
		}

		private static void OnSendTimeout(object state)
		{
			BaseStreamConnection baseStreamConnection = (BaseStreamConnection)state;
			baseStreamConnection.Abort(EventLevel.Warning, SR.GetString(Resources.SocketAbortedSendTimedOut, baseStreamConnection.SendTimeout));
		}

		public virtual void Abort()
		{
			try
			{
				Abort(null);
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				Fx.Exception.TraceHandled(exception, "BaseStreamConnection.Abort", TrackingContext.Activity);
			}
		}

		private void Abort(string timeoutErrorString)
		{
			EventLevel traceEventType = EventLevel.Warning;
			if (ExceptionEventType == EventLevel.Informational)
			{
				traceEventType = ExceptionEventType;
			}
			Abort(traceEventType, timeoutErrorString);
		}

		private void Abort(EventLevel traceEventType, string timeoutErrorString)
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (CloseState == State.Closed)
				{
					return;
				}
				this.timeoutErrorString = timeoutErrorString;
				aborted = true;
				CloseState = State.Closed;
				if (asyncReadPending)
				{
					CancelReceiveTimer();
				}
				if (asyncWritePending)
				{
					CancelSendTimer();
				}
			}
			ServiceBusEventSource.Log.WcfEventInformation(TraceCode.SocketConnectionAbort, this, string.Empty, "Abort", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\SocketConnection\\BaseStreamConnection.cs", 322);
			try
			{
				Stream.Close();
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				Fx.Exception.TraceHandled(exception, "BaseStreamConnection.Abort", TrackingContext.Activity);
			}
		}

		public virtual void Close(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (CloseState == State.Closing || CloseState == State.Closed)
				{
					return;
				}
				CloseState = State.Closing;
			}
			try
			{
				Stream.Close();
			}
			catch (ObjectDisposedException originalException)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsInformation(ConvertObjectDisposedException(originalException), TrackingContext.Activity);
			}
			catch (IOException ioException)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsInformation(ConvertIOException(ioException), TrackingContext.Activity);
			}
			catch (CommunicationException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (TimeoutException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception ex3) when (!Fx.IsFatal(ex3))
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new CommunicationException(ex3.Message, ex3), TrackingContext.Activity);
			}
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				CloseState = State.Closed;
			}
		}

		public virtual void Shutdown(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (!IsShutdown)
				{
					IsShutdown = true;
				}
			}
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginWrite(byte[] buffer, int offset, int size, bool immediate, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			try
			{
				lock (ThisLock)
				{
					SetWriteTimeOut(timeout, synchronous: false);
					asyncWritePending = true;
				}
				return Stream.BeginWrite(buffer, offset, size, callback, state);
			}
			catch (ObjectDisposedException originalException)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsInformation(ConvertObjectDisposedException(originalException));
			}
			catch (IOException ioException)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsInformation(ConvertIOException(ioException));
			}
			catch (CommunicationException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (TimeoutException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception ex3)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(ex3))
				{
					throw;
				}
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new CommunicationException(ex3.Message, ex3));
			}
		}

		private static bool UpdateTimeout(TimeSpan oldTimeout, TimeSpan newTimeout)
		{
			if (oldTimeout == newTimeout)
			{
				return false;
			}
			long num = oldTimeout.Ticks / 10;
			long num2 = Math.Max(oldTimeout.Ticks, newTimeout.Ticks) - Math.Min(oldTimeout.Ticks, newTimeout.Ticks);
			return num2 > num;
		}

		private void SetReadTimeout(TimeSpan timeout, bool synchronous, bool closing)
		{
			if (synchronous)
			{
				CancelReceiveTimer();
				if (timeout <= TimeSpan.Zero)
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.AsInformation(new TimeoutException(SR.GetString(Resources.TcpConnectionTimedOut, timeout)));
				}
				if (!UpdateTimeout(ReceiveTimeout, timeout))
				{
					return;
				}
				lock (ThisLock)
				{
					if (!closing || CloseState != State.Closing)
					{
						ThrowIfClosed();
					}
				}
				ReceiveTimeout = timeout;
			}
			else
			{
				ReceiveTimeout = timeout;
				if (timeout == TimeSpan.MaxValue)
				{
					CancelReceiveTimer();
				}
				else
				{
					ReceiveTimer.Set(timeout);
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetWriteTimeOut(TimeSpan timeout, bool synchronous)
		{
			if (synchronous)
			{
				CancelSendTimer();
				if (timeout <= TimeSpan.Zero)
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.AsInformation(new TimeoutException(SR.GetString(Resources.TcpConnectionTimedOut, timeout)));
				}
				if (UpdateTimeout(SendTimeout, timeout))
				{
					lock (ThisLock)
					{
						ThrowIfClosed();
					}
					SendTimeout = timeout;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				SendTimeout = timeout;
				if (timeout == TimeSpan.MaxValue)
				{
					CancelSendTimer();
				}
				else
				{
					SendTimer.Set(timeout);
				}
			}
		}

		public void Write(byte[] buffer, int offset, int size, bool immediate, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			try
			{
				SetWriteTimeOut(timeout, synchronous: true);
				Stream.Write(buffer, offset, size);
			}
			catch (ObjectDisposedException originalException)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsInformation(ConvertObjectDisposedException(originalException));
			}
			catch (IOException ioException)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsInformation(ConvertIOException(ioException));
			}
			catch (CommunicationException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (TimeoutException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception ex3)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(ex3))
				{
					throw;
				}
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new CommunicationException(ex3.Message, ex3));
			}
		}

		public void Write(byte[] buffer, int offset, int size, bool immediate, TimeSpan timeout, BufferManager bufferManager)
		{
			try
			{
				Write(buffer, offset, size, immediate, timeout);
			}
			finally
			{
				bufferManager.ReturnBuffer(buffer);
			}
		}

		public void EndWrite(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			try
			{
				CancelSendTimer();
				lock (ThisLock)
				{
					asyncWritePending = false;
				}
				Stream.EndWrite(result);
			}
			catch (ObjectDisposedException originalException)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsInformation(ConvertObjectDisposedException(originalException));
			}
			catch (IOException ioException)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsInformation(ConvertIOException(ioException));
			}
			catch (CommunicationException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (TimeoutException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception ex3)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(ex3))
				{
					throw;
				}
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new CommunicationException(ex3.Message, ex3));
			}
		}

		private void CancelSendTimer()
		{
			if (sendTimer != null)
			{
				sendTimer.Cancel();
				sendTimer = null;
			}
		}

		private void CancelReceiveTimer()
		{
			if (receiveTimer != null)
			{
				receiveTimer.Cancel();
				receiveTimer = null;
			}
		}

		public int Read(byte[] buffer, int offset, int size, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			ThrowIfClosed();
			return Read(buffer, offset, size, timeout, closing: false);
		}

		protected int Read(byte[] buffer, int offset, int size, TimeSpan timeout, bool closing)
		{
			int num = 0;
			TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateOnly(timeout);
			try
			{
				SetReadTimeout(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime(), synchronous: true, closing);
				return Stream.Read(buffer, offset, size);
			}
			catch (ObjectDisposedException originalException)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsInformation(ConvertObjectDisposedException(originalException));
			}
			catch (IOException ioException)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsInformation(ConvertIOException(ioException));
			}
			catch (CommunicationException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (TimeoutException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception ex3)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(ex3))
				{
					throw;
				}
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new CommunicationException(ex3.Message, ex3));
			}
		}

		public AsyncReadResult BeginRead(int offset, int size, TimeSpan timeout, WaitCallback callback, object state)
		{
			ConnectionUtilities.ValidateBufferBounds(AsyncReadBufferSize, offset, size);
			bool flag = true;
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				ThrowIfClosed();
				asyncReadState = state;
				asyncReadCallback = callback;
				asyncReadPending = true;
				SetReadTimeout(timeout, synchronous: false, closing: false);
			}
			try
			{
				IAsyncResult asyncResult = Stream.BeginRead(AsyncReadBuffer, offset, size, onRead, null);
				if (!asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
				{
					flag = false;
					return AsyncReadResult.Queued;
				}
				asyncReadSize = Stream.EndRead(asyncResult);
				flag = false;
				return AsyncReadResult.Completed;
			}
			catch (ObjectDisposedException originalException)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsInformation(ConvertObjectDisposedException(originalException));
			}
			catch (IOException ioException)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsInformation(ConvertIOException(ioException));
			}
			catch (CommunicationException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (TimeoutException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception ex3)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(ex3))
				{
					throw;
				}
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new CommunicationException(ex3.Message, ex3));
			}
			finally
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					AbortRead();
				}
			}
		}

		private void AbortRead()
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (asyncReadPending && CloseState != State.Closed)
				{
					asyncReadPending = false;
					CancelReceiveTimer();
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnRead(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			CancelReceiveTimer();
			if (result.CompletedSynchronously)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				asyncReadSize = Stream.EndRead(result);
			}
			catch (ObjectDisposedException originalException)
			{
				asyncReadException = ConvertObjectDisposedException(originalException);
			}
			catch (IOException ioException)
			{
				asyncReadException = ConvertIOException(ioException);
			}
			catch (CommunicationException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (TimeoutException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception ex3)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(ex3))
				{
					throw;
				}
				asyncReadException = Fx.Exception.AsError(new CommunicationException(ex3.Message, ex3));
			}
			FinishRead();
		}

		private void FinishRead()
		{
			try
			{
				WaitCallback waitCallback = asyncReadCallback;
				object state = asyncReadState;
				asyncReadState = null;
				asyncReadCallback = null;
				waitCallback(state);
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				Fx.Exception.TraceHandled(exception, "BaseStreamConnection.FinishRead", TrackingContext.Activity);
				AbortRead();
			}
		}

		public int EndRead()
		{
			if (asyncReadException != null)
			{
				Fx.Exception.AsInformation(asyncReadException);
				AbortRead();
				throw asyncReadException;
			}
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (!asyncReadPending)
				{
					throw Fx.AssertAndThrow("BaseStreamConnection.EndRead called with no read pending.");
				}
				asyncReadPending = false;
			}
			return asyncReadSize;
		}

		public bool Validate(Uri uri)
		{
			return true;
		}

		public virtual T GetProperty<T>()
		{
			if (typeof(T) == typeof(TrackingContext))
			{
				return (T)(object)TrackingContext;
			}
			return default(T);
		}
	}
	internal delegate int BufferRead(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count);
	internal delegate void BufferWrite(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count);
	internal class CompositeDuplexStream : Stream
	{
		protected Stream inputStream;

		protected Stream outputStream;

		private int lastReadTimeout = int.MaxValue;

		private bool disposed;

		public override bool CanRead => true;

		public override bool CanSeek => false;

		public override bool CanWrite => true;

		public override bool CanTimeout
		{
			get
			{
				Stream stream = inputStream;
				Stream stream2 = outputStream;
				if (stream == null || stream2 == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (stream.CanTimeout)
				{
					return stream2.CanTimeout;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected EventTraceActivity Activity { get; private set; }

		public override int ReadTimeout
		{
			get
			{
				Stream stream = inputStream;
				if (stream == null)
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.AsWarning(new ObjectDisposedException(GetType().Name), Activity);
				}
				return stream.ReadTimeout;
			}
			set
			{
				Stream stream = inputStream;
				if (stream == null)
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.AsWarning(new ObjectDisposedException(GetType().Name), Activity);
				}
				stream.ReadTimeout = value;
			}
		}

		public override int WriteTimeout
		{
			get
			{
				Stream stream = outputStream;
				if (stream == null)
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.AsWarning(new ObjectDisposedException(GetType().Name), Activity);
				}
				return stream.WriteTimeout;
			}
			set
			{
				Stream stream = outputStream;
				if (stream == null)
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.AsWarning(new ObjectDisposedException(GetType().Name), Activity);
				}
				stream.WriteTimeout = value;
			}
		}

		public override long Length
		{
			get
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new NotImplementedException(GetType().Name + ".get_Length"), Activity);
			}
		}

		public override long Position
		{
			get
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new NotImplementedException(GetType().Name + ".get_Position"), Activity);
			}
			set
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new NotImplementedException(GetType().Name + ".set_Position"), Activity);
			}
		}

		protected CompositeDuplexStream(EventTraceActivity activity)
			: this(null, null, activity)
		{
		}

		public CompositeDuplexStream(Stream inputStream, Stream outputStream, EventTraceActivity activity)
		{
			this.inputStream = inputStream;
			this.outputStream = outputStream;
			Activity = activity;
		}

		public virtual void Shutdown()
		{
			outputStream?.Close();
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposed)
			{
				return;
			}
			disposed = true;
			try
			{
				if (disposing)
				{
					DisposeStream(ref inputStream);
					DisposeStream(ref outputStream);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				base.Dispose(disposing);
			}
		}

		public override void Flush()
		{
			try
			{
				outputStream?.Flush();
			}
			catch (NotSupportedException)
			{
			}
		}

		public override IAsyncResult BeginRead(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			Stream stream = inputStream;
			if (stream == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsWarning(new ObjectDisposedException(GetType().Name), Activity);
			}
			if (stream.CanTimeout)
			{
				lastReadTimeout = stream.ReadTimeout;
				stream.ReadTimeout = int.MaxValue;
			}
			return stream.BeginRead(buffer, offset, count, callback, state);
		}

		public override int EndRead(IAsyncResult asyncResult)
		{
			Stream stream = inputStream;
			if (stream == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsWarning(new ObjectDisposedException(GetType().Name), Activity);
			}
			if (stream.CanTimeout)
			{
				stream.ReadTimeout = lastReadTimeout;
			}
			return stream.EndRead(asyncResult);
		}

		public override int Read(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)
		{
			Stream stream = inputStream;
			if (stream == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsWarning(new ObjectDisposedException(GetType().Name), Activity);
			}
			return stream.Read(buffer, offset, count);
		}

		public override long Seek(long offset, SeekOrigin origin)
		{
			throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new NotImplementedException(GetType().Name + ".Seek"), Activity);
		}

		public override void SetLength(long value)
		{
			throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new NotImplementedException(GetType().Name + ".SetLength"), Activity);
		}

		public override void Write(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)
		{
			Stream stream = outputStream;
			if (stream == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsWarning(new ObjectDisposedException(GetType().Name), Activity);
			}
			stream.Write(buffer, offset, count);
		}

		public override IAsyncResult BeginWrite(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			Stream stream = outputStream;
			if (stream == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsWarning(new ObjectDisposedException(GetType().Name), Activity);
			}
			return stream.BeginWrite(buffer, offset, count, callback, state);
		}

		public override void EndWrite(IAsyncResult asyncResult)
		{
			Stream stream = outputStream;
			if (stream == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsWarning(new ObjectDisposedException(GetType().Name), Activity);
			}
			stream.EndWrite(asyncResult);
		}

		private void DisposeStream(ref Stream stream)
		{
			Stream stream2 = stream;
			stream = null;
			if (stream2 == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				stream2.Close();
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				Fx.Exception.TraceHandled(exception, "CompositeDuplexStream.DisposeStream", Activity);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class FramingInputPump : Pump
	{
		private static readonly TimeSpan AllowedTimeBetweenReadingBytes = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30.0);

		private readonly BufferRead bufferRead;

		private readonly BufferWrite bufferWrite;

		private readonly Action bufferDone;

		private readonly byte[] inputBuffer;

		private readonly byte[] preambleBuffer;

		private readonly Uri uri;

		private Thread pumpThread;

		private EventTraceActivity Activity { get; set; }

		public FramingInputPump(BufferRead bufferRead, BufferWrite bufferWrite, Action bufferDone, EventTraceActivity activity, Uri uri)
		{
			this.bufferRead = bufferRead;
			this.bufferWrite = bufferWrite;
			this.bufferDone = bufferDone;
			inputBuffer = new byte[65536];
			preambleBuffer = new byte[2];
			Activity = activity;
			this.uri = uri;
		}

		public override IAsyncResult BeginRunPump(AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			if (base.IsRunning)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.AlreadyRunning), Activity);
			}
			base.IsRunning = true;
			base.Caller = new PumpAsyncResult(callback, state);
			pumpThread = new Thread(Run);
			pumpThread.IsBackground = true;
			pumpThread.Start();
			return base.Caller;
		}

		private void Run()
		{
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			Stopwatch stopwatch = Stopwatch.StartNew();
			try
			{
				do
				{
					int num = bufferRead(preambleBuffer, 0, preambleBuffer.Length);
					CheckDataTime(stopwatch, num);
					if (num == 1)
					{
						num += bufferRead(preambleBuffer, 1, 1);
						CheckDataTime(stopwatch, num);
					}
					if (num != preambleBuffer.Length)
					{
						break;
					}
					ushort num2 = BitConverter.ToUInt16(preambleBuffer, 0);
					if (num2 <= 0)
					{
						continue;
					}
					int num3 = 0;
					do
					{
						int num4 = bufferRead(inputBuffer, num3, num2 - num3);
						CheckDataTime(stopwatch, num4);
						if (num4 <= 0)
						{
							break;
						}
						num3 += num4;
					}
					while (num3 < num2);
					bufferWrite(inputBuffer, 0, num3);
				}
				while (!base.IsClosed);
				flag = true;
				bufferDone();
				flag2 = true;
				SetComplete();
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
				{
					throw;
				}
				Fx.Exception.TraceHandled(ex, "FramingInputPump.Run uri: " + uri.AbsoluteUri, Activity);
				CheckExceptionTime(stopwatch.Elapsed, ex);
				try
				{
					if (!flag)
					{
						bufferDone();
					}
				}
				catch (Exception exception)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
					{
						throw;
					}
					Fx.Exception.TraceHandled(exception, "FramingInputPump.Run(bufferDone) uri: " + uri.AbsoluteUri, Activity);
				}
				finally
				{
					if (!flag2)
					{
						SetComplete(ex);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void CheckExceptionTime(TimeSpan elapsed, Exception exception)
		{
			if (elapsed > AllowedTimeBetweenReadingBytes)
			{
				ServiceBusEventSource.Log.WebStreamFramingInputPumpSlowReadWithException(uri.AbsoluteUri, elapsed.ToString(), exception.ToString());
			}
		}

		private void CheckDataTime(Stopwatch watch, int preambleBytesRead)
		{
			TimeSpan elapsed = watch.Elapsed;
			if (elapsed > AllowedTimeBetweenReadingBytes)
			{
				ServiceBusEventSource.Log.WebStreamFramingInputPumpSlowRead(uri.AbsoluteUri, preambleBytesRead, elapsed.ToString());
			}
			if (preambleBytesRead > 0)
			{
				watch.Reset();
			}
		}
	}
	internal class FramingOutputPump : Pump
	{
		private static readonly TimeSpan MaxSendTimeAllowed = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30.0);

		private readonly BufferRead bufferRead;

		private readonly BufferWrite bufferWrite;

		private readonly byte[] inputBuffer;

		private readonly int pingFrequency;

		private readonly object threadLock = new object();

		private readonly object timerLock = new object();

		private readonly Uri uri;

		private readonly EventTraceActivity activity;

		private IOThreadTimer pingTimer;

		private bool abandonWrites;

		private Thread pumpThread;

		public FramingOutputPump(BufferRead bufferRead, BufferWrite bufferWrite, int pingFrequency, EventTraceActivity activity, Uri uri)
		{
			this.bufferRead = bufferRead;
			this.bufferWrite = bufferWrite;
			inputBuffer = new byte[65536];
			this.pingFrequency = pingFrequency;
			this.activity = activity;
			this.uri = uri;
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			try
			{
				CancelPingTimer();
			}
			finally
			{
				base.Dispose(disposing);
			}
		}

		public override IAsyncResult BeginRunPump(AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			if (base.IsRunning)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.AlreadyRunning));
			}
			base.IsRunning = true;
			base.Caller = new PumpAsyncResult(callback, state);
			if (pingFrequency > 0)
			{
				pingTimer = new IOThreadTimer(WriteIdleFrame, null, isTypicallyCanceledShortlyAfterBeingSet: false);
				pingTimer.Set(pingFrequency);
			}
			pumpThread = new Thread(Run);
			pumpThread.IsBackground = true;
			pumpThread.Start();
			return base.Caller;
		}

		private void Run()
		{
			bool flag = false;
			try
			{
				Stopwatch stopwatch = new Stopwatch();
				for (int num = bufferRead(inputBuffer, 2, inputBuffer.Length - 2); num > 0; num = bufferRead(inputBuffer, 2, inputBuffer.Length - 2))
				{
					lock (threadLock)
					{
						if (!abandonWrites)
						{
							try
							{
								byte[] bytes = BitConverter.GetBytes((ushort)num);
								stopwatch.Restart();
								Buffer.BlockCopy(bytes, 0, inputBuffer, 0, 2);
								CheckFramingPumpTime(stopwatch.Elapsed);
								bufferWrite(inputBuffer, 0, num + 2);
							}
							catch (Exception exception)
							{
								if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
								{
									throw;
								}
								abandonWrites = true;
								CheckFramingPumpTimeWithException(exception, stopwatch.Elapsed);
								throw;
							}
						}
					}
					if (base.IsClosed)
					{
						break;
					}
					pingTimer.Set(pingFrequency);
				}
				CancelPingTimer();
				flag = true;
				SetComplete();
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
				{
					throw;
				}
				ServiceBusEventSource.Log.FramingOuputPumpRunException(uri.AbsoluteUri, ex.ToStringSlim());
				CancelPingTimer();
				if (!flag)
				{
					SetComplete(ex);
				}
			}
		}

		private void CancelPingTimer()
		{
			lock (timerLock)
			{
				if (pingTimer != null)
				{
					pingTimer.Cancel();
					pingTimer = null;
				}
			}
		}

		private bool ChangePingTimer(int period)
		{
			lock (timerLock)
			{
				if (pingTimer != null)
				{
					if (period == -1)
					{
						pingTimer.Cancel();
					}
					else
					{
						pingTimer.Set(period);
					}
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void WriteIdleFrame(object timer)
		{
			if (!ChangePingTimer(-1))
			{
				return;
			}
			Stopwatch stopwatch = Stopwatch.StartNew();
			try
			{
				lock (threadLock)
				{
					if (!abandonWrites)
					{
						try
						{
							byte[] bytes = BitConverter.GetBytes((ushort)0);
							bufferWrite(bytes, 0, bytes.Length);
							CheckPingTime(stopwatch.Elapsed);
						}
						catch (Exception ex)
						{
							if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
							{
								throw;
							}
							abandonWrites = true;
							CheckPingTimeWithException(ex, stopwatch.Elapsed);
							CancelPingTimer();
							SetComplete(ex);
							throw;
						}
					}
				}
				ChangePingTimer(pingFrequency);
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				ServiceBusEventSource.Log.FramingOuputPumpPingException(uri.AbsoluteUri, exception.ToStringSlim());
				CancelPingTimer();
			}
		}

		private void CheckPingTimeWithException(Exception exception, TimeSpan elapsed)
		{
			if (elapsed > MaxSendTimeAllowed)
			{
				ServiceBusEventSource.Log.WebStreamFramingOuputPumpPingSlowException(uri.AbsoluteUri, elapsed.ToString(), exception.ToStringSlim());
			}
		}

		private void CheckPingTime(TimeSpan elapsed)
		{
			if (elapsed > MaxSendTimeAllowed)
			{
				ServiceBusEventSource.Log.WebStreamFramingOuputPumpPingSlow(uri.AbsoluteUri, elapsed.ToString());
			}
		}

		private void CheckFramingPumpTimeWithException(Exception exception, TimeSpan elapsed)
		{
			if (elapsed > MaxSendTimeAllowed)
			{
				ServiceBusEventSource.Log.WebStreamFramingOuputPumpSlowException(uri.AbsoluteUri, elapsed.ToString(), exception.ToStringSlim());
			}
		}

		private void CheckFramingPumpTime(TimeSpan elapsed)
		{
			if (elapsed > MaxSendTimeAllowed)
			{
				ServiceBusEventSource.Log.WebStreamFramingOuputPumpSlow(uri.AbsoluteUri, elapsed.ToString());
			}
		}
	}
	internal class NullableArray<T>
	{
		public static readonly NullableArray<T> NullArray = new NullableArray<T>(null);

		public T[] Value { get; private set; }

		public NullableArray(T[] array)
		{
			Value = array;
		}

	internal class PipeStream : Stream
	{
		private InputQueue<NullableArray<byte>> dataChunks;

		private byte[] currentChunk;

		private int currentChunkPosition;

		private volatile bool isShuttingDown;

		private ManualResetEvent done;

		private int naglingDelay;

		private int readTimeout;

		private int writeTimeout;

		private bool disposed;

		public override bool CanRead => true;

		public override bool CanSeek => false;

		public override bool CanWrite => !isShuttingDown;

		public override bool CanTimeout => true;

		protected WaitHandle ShutdownEvent => done;

		public override long Length
		{
			get
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
		}

		public override long Position
		{
			get
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
			set
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
		}

		public override int ReadTimeout
		{
			get
			{
				return readTimeout;
			}
			set
			{
				readTimeout = value;
			}
		}

		public override int WriteTimeout
		{
			get
			{
				return writeTimeout;
			}
			set
			{
				writeTimeout = value;
			}
		}

		protected InputQueue<NullableArray<byte>> DataChunksQueue => dataChunks;

		public PipeStream()
			: this(TimeSpan.Zero)
		{
		}

		public PipeStream(TimeSpan naglingDelay)
		{
			this.naglingDelay = TimeoutHelper.ToMilliseconds(naglingDelay);
			done = new ManualResetEvent(initialState: false);
			dataChunks = new InputQueue<NullableArray<byte>>();
			readTimeout = (writeTimeout = -1);
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposed)
			{
				return;
			}
			disposed = true;
			try
			{
				if (disposing)
				{
					isShuttingDown = true;
					done.Set();
					done.Close();
					dataChunks.Dispose();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				base.Dispose(disposing);
			}
		}

		public override void Flush()
		{
		}

		public override long Seek(long offset, SeekOrigin origin)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public override void SetLength(long value)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public override int Read(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)
		{
			if (isShuttingDown)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (buffer == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("buffer");
			}
			if (offset < 0 || offset >= buffer.Length)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("offset");
			}
			if (count < 0 || offset + count > buffer.Length)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("count");
			}
			if (count == 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			bool flag = true;
			int num = 0;
			int num3;
			while (true)
			{
				if (currentChunk == null)
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						IAsyncResult asyncResult = dataChunks.BeginDequeue(TimeoutHelper.FromMilliseconds(readTimeout), null, null);
						if (!asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously && WaitHandle.WaitAny(new WaitHandle[2] { asyncResult.AsyncWaitHandle, done }) == 1)
						{
							return 0;
						}
						NullableArray<byte> nullableArray = dataChunks.EndDequeue(asyncResult);
						if (nullableArray == NullableArray<byte>.NullArray || nullableArray == null)
						{
							isShuttingDown = true;
							return 0;
						}
						currentChunk = nullableArray.Value;
						flag = false;
					}
					else
					{
						NullableArray<byte> value;
						bool flag2 = dataChunks.Dequeue(TimeoutHelper.FromMilliseconds(naglingDelay), out value);
						if (!flag2 || (flag2 && (value == NullableArray<byte>.NullArray || value == null)))
						{
							if (flag2 && (value == NullableArray<byte>.NullArray || value == null))
							{
								isShuttingDown = true;
							}
							return num;
						}
						currentChunk = value.Value;
					}
					currentChunkPosition = 0;
				}
				else
				{
					flag = false;
				}
				int num2 = currentChunk.Length - currentChunkPosition;
				if (num2 > count)
				{
					break;
				}
				num3 = num2;
				Buffer.BlockCopy(currentChunk, currentChunkPosition, buffer, offset, num3);
				currentChunk = null;
				currentChunkPosition = 0;
				num += num3;
				offset += num3;
				count -= num3;
			}
			num3 = count;
			Buffer.BlockCopy(currentChunk, currentChunkPosition, buffer, offset, count);
			currentChunkPosition += count;
			return num + num3;
		}

		public override void Write(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)
		{
			if (isShuttingDown)
			{
				throw new EndOfStreamException();
			}
			if (buffer == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("buffer");
			}
			if (offset < 0 || offset >= buffer.Length)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("offset");
			}
			if (count < 0 || offset + count > buffer.Length)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("count");
			}
			if (count != 0)
			{
				byte[] array = new byte[count];
				Buffer.BlockCopy(buffer, offset, array, 0, count);
				EnqueueChunk(array);
			}
		}

		public void WriteEndOfStream()
		{
			if (!isShuttingDown)
			{
				dataChunks.EnqueueAndDispatch(NullableArray<byte>.NullArray);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void EnqueueChunk(byte[] chunk)
		{
			dataChunks.EnqueueAndDispatch(new NullableArray<byte>(chunk));
		}

		public void SetEndOfStream()
		{
			isShuttingDown = true;
			done.Set();
		}
	}
	internal abstract class Pump : IDisposable
	{
		internal class PumpAsyncResult : AsyncResult<PumpAsyncResult>
		{
			public PumpAsyncResult(AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(callback, state)
			{
			}

			internal void SetComplete()
			{
				Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: false);
			}

			internal void SetComplete(Exception ex)
			{
				Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: false, ex);
			}
		}

		private readonly object pumpCompletedLock = new object();

		private bool disposed;

		private ManualResetEvent pumpCompleted;

		internal PumpAsyncResult Caller { get; set; }

		internal bool IsRunning { get; set; }

		protected bool IsClosed => disposed;

		protected Pump()
		{
			pumpCompleted = new ManualResetEvent(initialState: false);
		}

		public void WaitForCompletion()
		{
			if (pumpCompleted != null)
			{
				try
				{
					pumpCompleted.WaitOne();
				}
				catch (ObjectDisposedException)
				{
				}
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (!disposed)
			{
				disposed = true;
				Dispose(disposing: true);
				GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			lock (pumpCompletedLock)
			{
				if (pumpCompleted != null)
				{
					pumpCompleted.Set();
					pumpCompleted.Close();
					pumpCompleted = null;
				}
			}
		}

		public abstract IAsyncResult BeginRunPump(AsyncCallback callback, object state);

		public static void EndRunPump(IAsyncResult asyncResult)
		{
			AsyncResult<PumpAsyncResult>.End(asyncResult);
		}

		public void RunPump()
		{
			EndRunPump(BeginRunPump(null, null));
		}

		protected void SetComplete()
		{
			SetComplete(delegate(PumpAsyncResult pumpAsyncResult)
			{
				pumpAsyncResult.SetComplete();
			});
		}

		protected void SetComplete(Exception ex)
		{
			SetComplete(delegate(PumpAsyncResult pumpAsyncResult)
			{
				pumpAsyncResult.SetComplete(ex);
			});
		}

		private void SetComplete(Action<PumpAsyncResult> callerAction)
		{
			lock (pumpCompletedLock)
			{
				if (pumpCompleted == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				pumpCompleted.Set();
			}
			PumpAsyncResult caller = Caller;
			if (caller != null)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				lock (pumpCompletedLock)
				{
					if (Caller != null)
					{
						Caller = null;
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				if (flag && !caller.IsCompleted)
				{
					callerAction(caller);
				}
			}
			IsRunning = false;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class PumpStream : Stream
	{
		protected Stream inputStream;

		protected Stream outputStream;

		protected Pump pump;

		private bool disposed;

		public Action PumpCompletedEvent;

		public override bool CanSeek => false;

		public override bool CanTimeout => true;

		public override long Length
		{
			get
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new NotSupportedException());
			}
		}

		public override long Position
		{
			get
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new NotSupportedException());
			}
			set
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new NotSupportedException());
			}
		}

		protected PumpStream(Stream input, Stream output, Pump pump)
		{
			inputStream = input;
			outputStream = output;
			this.pump = pump;
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginRunPump()
		{
			return BeginRunPump(OnPumpComplete, null);
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginRunPump(AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return pump.BeginRunPump(callback, state);
		}

		public abstract void Shutdown();

		protected void WaitForPumpToEnd()
		{
			if (pump != null)
			{
				pump.WaitForCompletion();
			}
		}

		public void EndRunPump(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			OnPumpComplete(result);
		}

		private void OnPumpComplete(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			try
			{
				Pump.EndRunPump(result);
				if (outputStream != null)
				{
					outputStream.Flush();
				}
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				Fx.Exception.TraceHandled(exception, "PumpStream.OnPumpComplete");
			}
			finally
			{
				PumpCompletedEvent?.Invoke();
			}
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposed)
			{
				return;
			}
			disposed = true;
			try
			{
				if (!disposing)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (pump != null)
				{
					pump.Dispose();
					pump = null;
				}
				if (outputStream != null)
				{
					outputStream.Close();
					outputStream = null;
				}
				if (inputStream == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				Stream state = inputStream;
				IOThreadScheduler.ScheduleCallbackNoFlow(delegate(object o)
				{
					try
					{
						((Stream)o).Close();
					}
					catch (Exception exception)
					{
						if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
						{
							throw;
						}
						Fx.Exception.TraceHandled(exception, "PumpStream.Dispose");
					}
				}, state);
				inputStream = null;
			}
			finally
			{
				base.Dispose(disposing);
			}
		}

		public override long Seek(long offset, SeekOrigin origin)
		{
			throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new NotSupportedException());
		}

		public override void SetLength(long value)
		{
			throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new NotSupportedException());
		}
	}

	internal sealed class ThrottledPipeStream : PipeStream
	{
		private Semaphore sempahore;

		public ThrottledPipeStream(int throttleCapacity)
		{
			Initialize(throttleCapacity);
		}

		public ThrottledPipeStream(int throttleCapacity, TimeSpan naglingDelay)
			: base(naglingDelay)
		{
			Initialize(throttleCapacity);
		}

		private void Initialize(int throttleCapacity)
		{
			sempahore = new Semaphore(throttleCapacity, throttleCapacity);
		}

		protected override void EnqueueChunk(byte[] chunk)
		{
			if (WaitHandle.WaitAny(new WaitHandle[2] { sempahore, base.ShutdownEvent }) == 0)
			{
				base.DataChunksQueue.EnqueueAndDispatch(new NullableArray<byte>(chunk), ChunkDequeued);
			}
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			base.Dispose(disposing);
			if (disposing)
			{
				sempahore.Close();
			}
		}

		private void ChunkDequeued()
		{
			sempahore.Release();
		}
	}

	internal class WebStreamConnection : BaseStreamConnection
	{
		private readonly Uri factoryEndpointUri;

		private readonly Uri sbUri;

		public WebStreamConnection(Uri factoryEndpointUri, int asyncReadBufferSize, TrackingContext trackingContext, WebStream webStream, Uri sbUri)
			: base(webStream, asyncReadBufferSize, trackingContext)
		{
			this.factoryEndpointUri = factoryEndpointUri;
			this.sbUri = sbUri;
		}

		public override void Abort()
		{
			ServiceBusEventSource.Log.WebStreamConnectionAbort(factoryEndpointUri.AbsoluteUri, sbUri.AbsoluteUri);
			base.Abort();
		}

		public override void Close(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			ServiceBusEventSource.Log.WebStreamConnectionClose(factoryEndpointUri.AbsoluteUri, sbUri.AbsoluteUri);
			base.Close(timeout);
		}

		public override void Shutdown(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			ServiceBusEventSource.Log.WebStreamConnectionShutdown(factoryEndpointUri.AbsoluteUri, sbUri.AbsoluteUri);
			lock (base.ThisLock)
			{
				if (base.IsShutdown)
				{
					return;
				}
				base.IsShutdown = true;
			}
			try
			{
				((WebStream)base.Stream).Shutdown();
			}
			catch (ObjectDisposedException originalException)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsWarning(ConvertObjectDisposedException(originalException));
			}
			catch (IOException ioException)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsWarning(BaseStreamConnection.ConvertIOException(ioException));
			}
		}
	}
	internal class WebStreamRelayedConnectionElement : IConnectionElement, ISecureableConnectionElement
	{
		private static Dictionary<NameSettings, System.ServiceModel.Channels.Binding> bindingTable = new Dictionary<NameSettings, System.ServiceModel.Channels.Binding>();

		private static UriPrefixTable<ITransportManagerRegistration> transportManagerTable = new UriPrefixTable<ITransportManagerRegistration>(includePortInComparison: true);

		private BindingContext context;

		private System.ServiceModel.Channels.Binding innerBinding;

		private NameSettings nameSettings;

		private TokenProvider tokenProvider;

		private WebStreamRelayedConnectionListener connectionListener;

		private bool useHttpsMode;

		public System.ServiceModel.Channels.Binding InnerBinding
		{
			get
			{
				return innerBinding;
			}
			set
			{
				innerBinding = value;
			}
		}

		public SocketSecurityRole SecurityMode { get; set; }

		public UriPrefixTable<ITransportManagerRegistration> TransportManagerTable => transportManagerTable;

		public WebStreamRelayedConnectionElement(TokenProvider tokenProvider, SocketSecurityRole socketSecurityMode, BindingContext context, NameSettings nameSettings, bool useHttpsMode)
		{
			this.tokenProvider = tokenProvider;
			SecurityMode = socketSecurityMode;
			this.context = context;
			this.nameSettings = nameSettings;
			this.useHttpsMode = useHttpsMode;
			connectionListener = new WebStreamRelayedConnectionListener(this.tokenProvider, SecurityMode, this.nameSettings, context, useHttpsMode);
		}

		public IConnectionInitiator CreateInitiator(int bufferSize)
		{
			return new WebStreamConnectionInitiator(tokenProvider, SecurityMode, bufferSize, useHttpsMode);
		}

		public IConnectionListener CreateListener(int bufferSize, Uri uri)
		{
			System.ServiceModel.Channels.Binding binding = innerBinding;
			if (binding == null)
			{
				binding = CreateInnerBinding();
			}
			connectionListener.Initialize(uri, bufferSize, binding);
			return connectionListener;
		}

		private System.ServiceModel.Channels.Binding CreateInnerBinding()
		{
			lock (bindingTable)
			{
				if (!bindingTable.TryGetValue(nameSettings, out var value))
				{
					RelayedOnewayTransportBindingElement relayedOnewayTransportBindingElement = RelayedOnewayTransportBindingElement.CreateOnewayTransportBindingElement(context, nameSettings.ServiceSettings.RelayClientAuthenticationType, RelayedOnewayConnectionMode.Unicast);
					value = new CustomBinding(ClientMessageUtility.CreateInnerEncodingBindingElement(context), relayedOnewayTransportBindingElement);
					value.CloseTimeout = context.Binding.CloseTimeout;
					value.Name = context.Binding.Name;
					value.Namespace = context.Binding.Namespace;
					value.OpenTimeout = context.Binding.OpenTimeout;
					value.ReceiveTimeout = context.Binding.ReceiveTimeout;
					value.SendTimeout = context.Binding.SendTimeout;
					bindingTable.Add(nameSettings, value);
				}
				return value;
			}
		}

		public bool IsCompatible(IConnectionElement element)
		{
			return element is WebStreamRelayedConnectionElement;
		}

		public T GetProperty<T>() where T : class
		{
			if (typeof(T) == typeof(IConnectionStatus))
			{
				return (T)connectionListener.ConnectionStatus;
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

	internal class WebStreamConnectionInitiator : IConnectionInitiator
	{
		private readonly int bufferSize;

		private readonly SocketSecurityRole socketSecurityRole;

		private readonly TokenProvider tokenProvider;

		private readonly bool useHttpsMode;

		public WebStreamConnectionInitiator(TokenProvider tokenProvider, SocketSecurityRole socketSecurityRole, int bufferSize, bool useHttpsMode)
		{
			this.tokenProvider = tokenProvider;
			this.socketSecurityRole = socketSecurityRole;
			this.bufferSize = bufferSize;
			this.useHttpsMode = useHttpsMode;
			if (tokenProvider != null)
			{
				this.socketSecurityRole = SocketSecurityRole.SslClient;
			}
		}

		public IConnection Connect(Uri uri, TrackingContext trackingContext, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
			WebStream webStream = new WebStream(uri, "connection", useHttpsMode, trackingContext.Activity, uri).Open();
			IConnection connection = new WebStreamConnection(uri, bufferSize, trackingContext, webStream, uri);
			connection = SecureSocketUtil.InitiateSecureClientUpgradeIfNeeded(connection, null, socketSecurityRole, uri.Host, sendControlByte: true, null, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
			SocketMessageHelper socketMessageHelper = new SocketMessageHelper();
			System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message = System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message.CreateMessage(socketMessageHelper.MessageVersion, "RelayedConnect", new ConnectMessage(uri));
			TrackingIdHeader.TryAddOrUpdate(message.Headers, trackingContext.TrackingId);
			if (tokenProvider != null)
			{
				string absoluteUri = RelayedHttpUtility.ConvertToHttpUri(uri).AbsoluteUri;
				SecurityToken token = tokenProvider.GetToken(absoluteUri, "Send", bypassCache: false, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
				message.Headers.Add(new RelayTokenHeader(token));
			}
			socketMessageHelper.SendMessage(connection, message, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
			System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message2 = socketMessageHelper.ReceiveMessage(connection, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
			if (message2.IsFault)
			{
				MessageFault fault = MessageFault.CreateFault(message2, 65536);
				throw ErrorUtility.ConvertToError(fault);
			}
			return connection;
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginConnect(Uri uri, TrackingContext trackingContext, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new CompletedAsyncResult<IConnection>(Connect(uri, trackingContext, timeout), callback, state);
		}

		public IConnection EndConnect(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			return CompletedAsyncResult<IConnection>.End(result);
		}

	internal class WebStreamOnewayConnectionInitiator : IConnectionInitiator
	{
		private sealed class ConnectAsyncResult : TrackingContextIteratorAsyncResult<ConnectAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly WebStreamOnewayConnectionInitiator initiator;

			private readonly Uri address;

			private readonly BeginEndAsyncWaitHandle asyncWaitHandle;

			private readonly WebStream webStream;

			public IConnection Connection { get; private set; }

			private Exception CompleteException { get; set; }

			public ConnectAsyncResult(WebStreamOnewayConnectionInitiator initiator, Uri address, TrackingContext trackingContext, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(trackingContext, timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.initiator = initiator;
				this.address = address;
				asyncWaitHandle = new BeginEndAsyncWaitHandle();
				webStream = new WebStream(this.address, this.initiator.webStreamRole, this.initiator.useHttpsMode, base.TrackingContext.Activity, this.address);
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				TimeSpan timeSpan = RemainingTime();
				if (timeSpan <= TimeSpan.Zero)
				{
					Complete(new TimeoutException(SRClient.OperationRequestTimedOut(base.OriginalTimeout)));
					yield break;
				}
				IOThreadScheduler.ScheduleCallbackNoFlow(delegate(object s)
				{
					ConnectAsyncResult connectAsyncResult = (ConnectAsyncResult)s;
					try
					{
						connectAsyncResult.webStream.Open();
						connectAsyncResult.Connection = new WebStreamConnection(connectAsyncResult.address, connectAsyncResult.initiator.bufferSize, connectAsyncResult.TrackingContext, connectAsyncResult.webStream, connectAsyncResult.address);
					}
					catch (Exception completeException)
					{
						connectAsyncResult.CompleteException = completeException;
					}
					finally
					{
						connectAsyncResult.asyncWaitHandle.Set();
					}
				}, this);
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((ConnectAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.asyncWaitHandle.BeginWait(thisPtr.TrackingContext.Activity, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(ConnectAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					thisPtr.asyncWaitHandle.EndWait(r);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
				if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null && Connection == null)
				{
					CompleteException = new TimeoutException(base.TrackingContext.CreateTrackableErrorMessage(SRClient.OperationRequestTimedOut(base.OriginalTimeout)), base.LastAsyncStepException);
				}
				Finally();
			}

			private void Finally()
			{
				if (CompleteException != null)
				{
					try
					{
						webStream.Dispose();
					}
					catch (Exception ex)
					{
						if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
						{
							throw;
						}
						ServiceBusEventSource.Log.HandledException(ex, null, "Relay", this, EventLevel.Warning, "Finally", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\SocketConnection\\WebStreamConnectionInitiator.cs", 205);
					}
				}
				Complete(CompleteException);
			}
		}

		private readonly int bufferSize;

		private readonly string webStreamRole;

		private readonly bool useHttpsMode;

		public WebStreamOnewayConnectionInitiator(string webStreamRole, int bufferSize, bool useHttpsMode)
		{
			this.webStreamRole = webStreamRole;
			this.bufferSize = bufferSize;
			this.useHttpsMode = useHttpsMode;
		}

		public IConnection Connect(Uri uri, TrackingContext trackingContext, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			ConnectAsyncResult connectAsyncResult = new ConnectAsyncResult(this, uri, trackingContext, timeout, null, null);
			return connectAsyncResult.RunSynchronously().Connection;
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginConnect(Uri uri, TrackingContext trackingContext, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new ConnectAsyncResult(this, uri, trackingContext, timeout, callback, state).Start();
		}

		public IConnection EndConnect(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			return AsyncResult<ConnectAsyncResult>.End(result).Connection;
		}

		public WebStreamConnectionListener()
		{
			connectionQueue = new InputQueue<IConnection>();
		}

		public abstract void Open(TimeSpan timeout);

		public void Abort()
		{
			connectionQueue.Close();
			OnAbort();
		}

		public void Close(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			connectionQueue.Shutdown();
			try
			{
				OnClose(timeout);
			}
			finally
			{
				connectionQueue.Close();
			}
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginAccept(AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return connectionQueue.BeginDequeue(TimeSpan.MaxValue, callback, state);
		}

		public IConnection EndAccept(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			try
			{
				return connectionQueue.EndDequeue(result);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(ex) || ex is CommunicationException)
				{
					throw;
				}
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new CommunicationException(ex.Message, ex), null, EventLevel.Warning, "EndAccept", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\SocketConnection\\WebStreamConnectionListener.cs", 68);
			}
		}

		public void EnqueueConnection(IConnection connection, bool transportProtectionEnabled)
		{
			connectionQueue.EnqueueAndDispatch(connection);
		}

		protected abstract void OnAbort();

		protected abstract void OnClose(TimeSpan timeout);
	}

			if (this.factoryEndpointUri.Scheme == "sb")
			{

		public WebStream Open()
		{
			Exception ex = null;
			int num = 5;
			do
			{
				int retries = num - 1;
				try
				{
					ServiceBusEventSource.Log.WebStreamConnectStart(factoryEndpointUri.AbsoluteUri, sbUri.AbsoluteUri, retries);
					if (Connect())
					{
						ServiceBusEventSource.Log.WebStreamConnectStop(factoryEndpointUri.AbsoluteUri, sbUri.AbsoluteUri, retries);
						return this;
					}
				}
				catch (WebException ex2)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(ex2))
					{
						throw;
					}
					string text = CloseResponseInWebException(ex2);
					ex = new CommunicationException(ex2.Message + text, ex2);
				}
				catch (Exception ex3)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(ex3))
					{
						throw;
					}
					ex = ex3;
				}
				string exception = ((ex != null) ? ex.ToString() : "Failed to connect. No exception thrown.");
				ServiceBusEventSource.Log.WebStreamConnectFailed(factoryEndpointUri.AbsoluteUri, sbUri.AbsoluteUri, retries, exception);
				Reset();
				disposed = false;
			}
			while (--num > 0);
			disposed = true;
			throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new CommunicationException(SRClient.HTTPConnectivityMode, ex));
		}

		}

			catch (Exception ex2)

				if (Fx.IsFatal(ex2))

					throw;

			}

		private void StartSession(Uri readEndpoint, Uri writeEndpoint)
		{
			lock (thisLock)
			{
				RemoteReadEndpoint = readEndpoint;
				RemoteWriteEndpoint = writeEndpoint;
			}
			outputStream = CreateUpStreamRequest(writeEndpoint);
			inputStream = CreateDownStreamRequest(readEndpoint);
		}

		private bool Connect()
		{
			CreateSession(out var endpointLocation, out var endpointLocation2);
			StartSession(endpointLocation, endpointLocation2);
			if (endpointLocation.Scheme == Uri.UriSchemeHttp)
			{
				return VerifySession();
			}
			return true;
		}

		private PumpStream CreateDownStreamRequest(Uri endpointLocation)
		{
			try
			{

		private void ConfigureProxy(HttpWebRequest request, ProxyAuthMode mode)
		{

				break;
			case ProxyAuthMode.Kerberos:
			{
				CredentialCache credentialCache3 = new CredentialCache();

				request.Proxy = new ForcedCredentialWebProxy(proxy, credentialCache3);
				request.PreAuthenticate = true;
				break;
			}
			case ProxyAuthMode.Ntlm:
			{
				CredentialCache credentialCache2 = new CredentialCache();

			case ProxyAuthMode.Other:
			{

				credentialCache.Add(proxy2, "digest", proxy.Credentials.GetCredential(proxy2, "digest"));

		}

		private void Reset()
		{
			ServiceBusEventSource.Log.WebStreamReset(factoryEndpointUri.AbsoluteUri, sbUri.AbsoluteUri);
			if (disposed)
			{
				return;
			}
			lock (thisLock)
			{
				if (!disposed)
				{
					disposed = true;
					Shutdown();
					shutdownRead = (shutdownWrite = false);
				}
			}
		}

		private static string CloseResponseInWebException(Exception e)
		{
			if (!(e is WebException { Response: not null } ex))
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			try
			{
				using WebResponse webResponse = ex.Response;
				using Stream stream = webResponse.GetResponseStream();
				using StreamReader streamReader = new StreamReader(stream);
				return " -- Response:" + streamReader.ReadToEnd();
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				ServiceBusEventSource.Log.HandledException(e, null, "Relay", "WebStream", EventLevel.Warning, "CloseResponseInWebException", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\SocketConnection\\WebStream.cs", 777);
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		}

		public override void Shutdown()
		{
			ServiceBusEventSource.Log.WebStreamShutdown(factoryEndpointUri.AbsoluteUri, sbUri.AbsoluteUri);
			lock (thisLock)
			{
				if (!shutdownWrite)
				{
					shutdownWrite = true;

					{
						upstreamRequest.Abort();
						upstreamRequest = null;
						if (outputStream != null)
						{
							((PumpStream)outputStream).Shutdown();
							outputStream = null;
						}
					}
				}
				if (!shutdownRead)
				{
					shutdownRead = true;
					if (downstreamRequest != null)
					{
						downstreamRequest.Abort();
						downstreamRequest = null;
						inputStream = null;
					}
				}
			}
		}

	public class WS2007HttpRelayBinding : WSHttpRelayBinding
	{
		private static readonly ReliableMessagingVersion WS2007ReliableMessagingVersion = ReliableMessagingVersion.WSReliableMessaging11;

		private static readonly MessageSecurityVersion WS2007MessageSecurityVersion = MessageSecurityVersion.WSSecurity11WSTrust13WSSecureConversation13WSSecurityPolicy12BasicSecurityProfile10;

		public WS2007HttpRelayBinding(string configName)
			: this()
		{
			ApplyConfiguration(configName);
		}

		public WS2007HttpRelayBinding()
		{
			base.ReliableSessionBindingElement.ReliableMessagingVersion = WS2007ReliableMessagingVersion;
			base.HttpsTransport.MessageSecurityVersion = WS2007MessageSecurityVersion;
		}

		public WS2007HttpRelayBinding(EndToEndSecurityMode securityMode, RelayClientAuthenticationType relayClientAuthenticationType)
			: this(securityMode, relayClientAuthenticationType, reliableSessionEnabled: false)
		{
		}

		public WS2007HttpRelayBinding(EndToEndSecurityMode securityMode, RelayClientAuthenticationType relayClientAuthenticationType, bool reliableSessionEnabled)
			: base(securityMode, relayClientAuthenticationType, reliableSessionEnabled)
		{
			base.ReliableSessionBindingElement.ReliableMessagingVersion = WS2007ReliableMessagingVersion;
			base.HttpsTransport.MessageSecurityVersion = WS2007MessageSecurityVersion;
		}

		internal WS2007HttpRelayBinding(WSHttpRelaySecurity security, bool reliableSessionEnabled)
			: base(security, reliableSessionEnabled)
		{
			base.ReliableSessionBindingElement.ReliableMessagingVersion = WS2007ReliableMessagingVersion;
			base.HttpsTransport.MessageSecurityVersion = WS2007MessageSecurityVersion;
		}

		private void ApplyConfiguration(string configurationName)
		{
			WS2007HttpRelayBindingCollectionElement bindingCollectionElement = WS2007HttpRelayBindingCollectionElement.GetBindingCollectionElement();
			WS2007HttpRelayBindingElement wS2007HttpRelayBindingElement = bindingCollectionElement.Bindings[configurationName];
			if (wS2007HttpRelayBindingElement == null)
			{
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new ConfigurationErrorsException(SR.GetString(Resources.ConfigInvalidBindingConfigurationName, configurationName, "ws2007HttpRelayBinding")), null, EventLevel.Warning, "ApplyConfiguration", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\WS2007HttpRelayBinding.cs", 74);
			}
			wS2007HttpRelayBindingElement.ApplyConfiguration(this);
		}

		protected override SecurityBindingElement CreateMessageSecurity()
		{
			return base.Security.CreateMessageSecurity(base.ReliableSession.Enabled, WS2007MessageSecurityVersion);
		}

		internal static bool TryCreate(SecurityBindingElement sbe, RelayClientAuthenticationType relayClientAuthenticationType, TransportBindingElement transport, ReliableSessionBindingElement rsbe, out System.ServiceModel.Channels.Binding binding)
		{
			bool flag = rsbe != null;
			binding = null;
			HttpRelayTransportSecurity defaultHttpTransportSecurity = WSHttpRelaySecurity.GetDefaultHttpTransportSecurity();
			if (!WSHttpRelayBinding.GetSecurityModeFromTransport(transport, defaultHttpTransportSecurity, out var mode))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (transport is HttpsRelayTransportBindingElement { MessageSecurityVersion: not null } httpsRelayTransportBindingElement && httpsRelayTransportBindingElement.MessageSecurityVersion.SecurityPolicyVersion != WS2007MessageSecurityVersion.SecurityPolicyVersion)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (TryCreateSecurity(sbe, mode, relayClientAuthenticationType, defaultHttpTransportSecurity, flag, out var wSHttpRelaySecurity))
			{
				WS2007HttpRelayBinding wS2007HttpRelayBinding = new WS2007HttpRelayBinding(wSHttpRelaySecurity, flag);
				if (!WSHttpRelayBinding.TryGetAllowCookiesFromTransport(transport, out var allowCookies))
				{
					return false;
				}
				wS2007HttpRelayBinding.AllowCookies = allowCookies;
				binding = wS2007HttpRelayBinding;
			}
			if (rsbe != null && rsbe.ReliableMessagingVersion != ReliableMessagingVersion.WSReliableMessaging11)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return binding != null;
		}

		private static bool TryCreateSecurity(SecurityBindingElement sbe, UnifiedSecurityMode mode, RelayClientAuthenticationType relayClientAuthenticationType, HttpRelayTransportSecurity transportSecurity, bool isReliableSession, out WSHttpRelaySecurity security)
		{
			if (!WSHttpRelaySecurity.TryCreate(sbe, mode, transportSecurity, relayClientAuthenticationType, isReliableSession, out security))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (sbe != null)
			{
				return AreBindingsMatching(security.CreateMessageSecurity(isReliableSession, WS2007MessageSecurityVersion), sbe);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool AreBindingsMatching(SecurityBindingElement sbe1, SecurityBindingElement sbe2)
		{
			return (bool)InvokeHelper.InvokeStaticMethod(typeof(SecurityElementBase), "AreBindingsMatching", sbe1, sbe2);
		}
	}
	public abstract class WSHttpRelayBinding : WSHttpRelayBindingBase
	{
		private static readonly MessageSecurityVersion WSMessageSecurityVersion = MessageSecurityVersion.WSSecurity11WSTrustFebruary2005WSSecureConversationFebruary2005WSSecurityPolicy11BasicSecurityProfile10;

		private WSHttpRelaySecurity security = new WSHttpRelaySecurity();

		public bool AllowCookies
		{
			get
			{
				return base.HttpTransport.AllowCookies;
			}
			set
			{
				base.HttpTransport.AllowCookies = value;
				base.HttpsTransport.AllowCookies = value;
			}
		}

		internal override RelayClientAuthenticationType RelayClientAuthenticationType => Security.RelayClientAuthenticationType;

		public WSHttpRelaySecurity Security => security;

		internal WSHttpRelayBinding()
		{
		}

		internal WSHttpRelayBinding(EndToEndSecurityMode securityMode, RelayClientAuthenticationType relayClientAuthenticationType, bool reliableSessionEnabled)
			: base(reliableSessionEnabled)
		{
			security.Mode = securityMode;
			security.RelayClientAuthenticationType = relayClientAuthenticationType;
		}

		internal WSHttpRelayBinding(WSHttpRelaySecurity security, bool reliableSessionEnabled)
			: base(reliableSessionEnabled)
		{
			this.security = security ?? new WSHttpRelaySecurity();
		}

		protected override TransportBindingElement GetTransport()
		{
			if (security.Mode == EndToEndSecurityMode.None || (security.Mode == EndToEndSecurityMode.Message && security.RelayClientAuthenticationType == RelayClientAuthenticationType.None))
			{
				base.HttpTransport.RelayClientAuthenticationType = RelayClientAuthenticationType;
				return base.HttpTransport;
			}
			security.ApplyTransportSecurity(base.HttpsTransport);
			base.HttpsTransport.RelayClientAuthenticationType = RelayClientAuthenticationType;
			return base.HttpsTransport;
		}

		internal static bool GetSecurityModeFromTransport(TransportBindingElement transport, HttpRelayTransportSecurity transportSecurity, out UnifiedSecurityMode mode)
		{
			mode = UnifiedSecurityMode.None;
			if (transport is HttpsRelayTransportBindingElement)
			{
				mode = UnifiedSecurityMode.Transport | UnifiedSecurityMode.TransportWithMessageCredential;
				WSHttpRelaySecurity.ApplyTransportSecurity((HttpsRelayTransportBindingElement)transport, transportSecurity);
			}
			else
			{
				if (!(transport is HttpRelayTransportBindingElement))
				{
					return false;
				}
				mode = UnifiedSecurityMode.None | UnifiedSecurityMode.Message;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static bool TryGetAllowCookiesFromTransport(TransportBindingElement transport, out bool allowCookies)
		{
			if (!(transport is HttpRelayTransportBindingElement httpRelayTransportBindingElement))
			{
				allowCookies = false;
				return false;
			}
			allowCookies = httpRelayTransportBindingElement.AllowCookies;
			return true;
		}

		protected override SecurityBindingElement CreateMessageSecurity()
		{
			return security.CreateMessageSecurity(base.ReliableSession.Enabled, WSMessageSecurityVersion);
		}
	}
