		private void Initialize()
		{
			WSHttpBinding wSHttpBinding = new WSHttpBinding();
			httpTransport = new HttpRelayTransportBindingElement();
			httpsTransport = new HttpsRelayTransportBindingElement();
			messageEncoding = wSHttpBinding.MessageEncoding;
			session = new ReliableSessionBindingElement(ordered: true);
			textEncoding = new TextMessageEncodingBindingElement();
			textEncoding.MessageVersion = MessageVersion.Soap12WSAddressing10;
			mtomEncoding = new MtomMessageEncodingBindingElement();
			mtomEncoding.MessageVersion = MessageVersion.Soap12WSAddressing10;
			reliableSession = new OptionalReliableSession(session);
		}

		private void InitializeFrom(HttpRelayTransportBindingElement transport, MessageEncodingBindingElement encoding, ReliableSessionBindingElement session)
		{
			MaxBufferPoolSize = transport.MaxBufferPoolSize;
			MaxReceivedMessageSize = transport.MaxReceivedMessageSize;
			ProxyAddress = transport.ProxyAddress;
			UseDefaultWebProxy = transport.UseDefaultWebProxy;
			if (encoding is TextMessageEncodingBindingElement)
			{
				MessageEncoding = WSMessageEncoding.Text;
				TextMessageEncodingBindingElement textMessageEncodingBindingElement = (TextMessageEncodingBindingElement)encoding;
				TextEncoding = textMessageEncodingBindingElement.WriteEncoding;
				ReaderQuotas = textMessageEncodingBindingElement.ReaderQuotas;
			}
			else if (encoding is MtomMessageEncodingBindingElement)
			{
				messageEncoding = WSMessageEncoding.Mtom;
				MtomMessageEncodingBindingElement mtomMessageEncodingBindingElement = (MtomMessageEncodingBindingElement)encoding;
				TextEncoding = mtomMessageEncodingBindingElement.WriteEncoding;
				ReaderQuotas = mtomMessageEncodingBindingElement.ReaderQuotas;
			}
			reliableSession.Enabled = session != null;
			if (session != null)
			{
				this.session.InactivityTimeout = session.InactivityTimeout;
				this.session.Ordered = session.Ordered;
			}
		}

		private bool IsBindingElementsMatch(HttpRelayTransportBindingElement transport, MessageEncodingBindingElement encoding, ReliableSessionBindingElement session)
		{
			if (!IsBindingElementMatch(GetTransport(), transport))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (MessageEncoding == WSMessageEncoding.Text)
			{
				if (!IsBindingElementMatch(textEncoding, encoding))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			else if (MessageEncoding == WSMessageEncoding.Mtom && !IsBindingElementMatch(mtomEncoding, encoding))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (reliableSession.Enabled)
			{
				if (!IsBindingElementMatch(this.session, session))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			else if (session != null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool IsBindingElementMatch(BindingElement elementThis, BindingElement elementThat)
		{
			return (bool)InvokeHelper.InvokeInstanceMethod(elementThis.GetType(), elementThis, "IsMatch", elementThat);
		}

		public override BindingElementCollection CreateBindingElements()
		{
			BindingElementCollection bindingElementCollection = new BindingElementCollection();
			if (reliableSession.Enabled)
			{
				bindingElementCollection.Add(session);
			}
			SecurityBindingElement securityBindingElement = CreateMessageSecurity();
			if (securityBindingElement != null)
			{
				bindingElementCollection.Add(securityBindingElement);
			}
			WSMessageEncodingHelper.SyncUpEncodingBindingElementProperties(textEncoding, mtomEncoding);
			if (MessageEncoding == WSMessageEncoding.Text)
			{
				bindingElementCollection.Add(textEncoding);
			}
			else if (MessageEncoding == WSMessageEncoding.Mtom)
			{
				bindingElementCollection.Add(mtomEncoding);
			}
			bindingElementCollection.Add(GetTransport());
			return bindingElementCollection.Clone();
		}

		internal static bool TryCreate(BindingElementCollection elements, out System.ServiceModel.Channels.Binding binding)
		{
			binding = null;
			if (elements.Count > 5)
			{
				return false;
			}
			PrivacyNoticeBindingElement privacyNoticeBindingElement = null;
			ReliableSessionBindingElement rsbe = null;
			SecurityBindingElement sbe = null;
			MessageEncodingBindingElement messageEncodingBindingElement = null;
			HttpRelayTransportBindingElement httpRelayTransportBindingElement = null;
			foreach (BindingElement element in elements)
			{
				if (element is SecurityBindingElement)
				{
					sbe = element as SecurityBindingElement;
					continue;
				}
				if (element is HttpsRelayTransportBindingElement)
				{
					httpRelayTransportBindingElement = element as HttpsRelayTransportBindingElement;
					continue;
				}
				if (element is HttpRelayTransportBindingElement)
				{
					httpRelayTransportBindingElement = element as HttpRelayTransportBindingElement;
					continue;
				}
				if (element is MessageEncodingBindingElement)
				{
					messageEncodingBindingElement = element as MessageEncodingBindingElement;
					continue;
				}
				if (element is ReliableSessionBindingElement)
				{
					rsbe = element as ReliableSessionBindingElement;
					continue;
				}
				if (element is PrivacyNoticeBindingElement)
				{
					privacyNoticeBindingElement = element as PrivacyNoticeBindingElement;
					continue;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (httpRelayTransportBindingElement == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (messageEncodingBindingElement == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (privacyNoticeBindingElement != null || !WS2007HttpRelayBinding.TryCreate(sbe, httpRelayTransportBindingElement.RelayClientAuthenticationType, httpRelayTransportBindingElement, rsbe, out binding))
			{
				return false;
			}
			WSHttpRelayBindingBase wSHttpRelayBindingBase = binding as WSHttpRelayBindingBase;
			wSHttpRelayBindingBase.InitializeFrom(httpRelayTransportBindingElement, messageEncodingBindingElement, rsbe);
			if (!wSHttpRelayBindingBase.IsBindingElementsMatch(httpRelayTransportBindingElement, messageEncodingBindingElement, rsbe))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected abstract TransportBindingElement GetTransport();

		protected abstract SecurityBindingElement CreateMessageSecurity();
	}
	public sealed class WSHttpRelaySecurity
	{
		internal const EndToEndSecurityMode DefaultMode = EndToEndSecurityMode.Transport;

		internal const RelayClientAuthenticationType DefaultRelayClientAuthenticationType = RelayClientAuthenticationType.RelayAccessToken;

		private RelayClientAuthenticationType relayClientAuthenticationType;

		private EndToEndSecurityMode mode;

		private HttpRelayTransportSecurity transportSecurity;

		private NonDualMessageSecurityOverRelayHttp messageSecurity;

		public EndToEndSecurityMode Mode
		{
			get
			{
				return mode;
			}
			set
			{
				mode = value;
			}
		}

		public RelayClientAuthenticationType RelayClientAuthenticationType
		{
			get
			{
				return relayClientAuthenticationType;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!RelayClientAuthenticationTypeHelper.IsDefined(value))
				{
					throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("value"), null, EventLevel.Warning, "RelayClientAuthenticationType", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\WSHttpRelaySecurity.cs", 64);
				}
				relayClientAuthenticationType = value;
			}
		}

		public HttpRelayTransportSecurity Transport => transportSecurity;

		public NonDualMessageSecurityOverRelayHttp Message => messageSecurity;

		internal WSHttpRelaySecurity()
			: this(EndToEndSecurityMode.Transport, RelayClientAuthenticationType.RelayAccessToken, GetDefaultHttpTransportSecurity(), new NonDualMessageSecurityOverRelayHttp())
		{
		}

		internal WSHttpRelaySecurity(EndToEndSecurityMode mode, RelayClientAuthenticationType relayClientAuthenticationType, HttpRelayTransportSecurity transportSecurity, NonDualMessageSecurityOverRelayHttp messageSecurity)
		{
			this.mode = mode;
			this.relayClientAuthenticationType = relayClientAuthenticationType;
			this.transportSecurity = ((transportSecurity == null) ? GetDefaultHttpTransportSecurity() : transportSecurity);
			this.messageSecurity = ((messageSecurity == null) ? new NonDualMessageSecurityOverRelayHttp() : messageSecurity);
		}

		internal static HttpRelayTransportSecurity GetDefaultHttpTransportSecurity()
		{
			return new HttpRelayTransportSecurity();
		}

		internal static void ApplyTransportSecurity(HttpsRelayTransportBindingElement transport, HttpRelayTransportSecurity transportSecurity)
		{
			HttpRelayTransportSecurity.ConfigureTransportProtectionAndAuthentication(transport, transportSecurity);
		}

		internal static bool TryCreate(SecurityBindingElement sbe, UnifiedSecurityMode mode, HttpRelayTransportSecurity transportSecurity, RelayClientAuthenticationType relayClientAuthenticationType, bool isReliableSessionEnabled, out WSHttpRelaySecurity security)
		{
			security = null;
			NonDualMessageSecurityOverRelayHttp nonDualMessageSecurityOverRelayHttp = null;
			EndToEndSecurityMode endToEndSecurityMode = EndToEndSecurityMode.None;
			if (sbe != null)
			{
				mode &= UnifiedSecurityMode.Message | UnifiedSecurityMode.TransportWithMessageCredential;
				endToEndSecurityMode = EndToEndSecurityModeHelper.ToRelaySecurityMode(mode);
				if (!MessageSecurityOverRelayHttp.TryCreate<NonDualMessageSecurityOverRelayHttp>(sbe, endToEndSecurityMode == EndToEndSecurityMode.TransportWithMessageCredential, isReliableSessionEnabled, out nonDualMessageSecurityOverRelayHttp))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				mode &= ~(UnifiedSecurityMode.Message | UnifiedSecurityMode.TransportWithMessageCredential);
				endToEndSecurityMode = EndToEndSecurityModeHelper.ToRelaySecurityMode(mode);
			}
			security = new WSHttpRelaySecurity(endToEndSecurityMode, relayClientAuthenticationType, transportSecurity, nonDualMessageSecurityOverRelayHttp);
			return true;
		}

		internal void ApplyTransportSecurity(HttpsRelayTransportBindingElement https)
		{
			if (mode == EndToEndSecurityMode.TransportWithMessageCredential || mode == EndToEndSecurityMode.Transport)
			{
				transportSecurity.ConfigureTransportProtectionOnly(https);
			}
		}

		internal SecurityBindingElement CreateMessageSecurity(bool isReliableSessionEnabled, MessageSecurityVersion version)
		{
			if (mode == EndToEndSecurityMode.Message || mode == EndToEndSecurityMode.TransportWithMessageCredential)
			{
				return messageSecurity.CreateSecurityBindingElement(Mode == EndToEndSecurityMode.TransportWithMessageCredential, isReliableSessionEnabled, version);
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	internal static class SecureSocketUtil
	{
		private sealed class InitiateSecureClientUpgradeClientSideAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<InitiateSecureClientUpgradeClientSideAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly IDefaultCommunicationTimeouts defaultTimeouts;

			private readonly SocketSecurityRole socketSecurityMode;

			private readonly string targetHost;

			private readonly IConnection connection;

			private readonly bool sendControlByte;

			private readonly SslProtocols? sslProtocolOverride;

			private SslStream sslStream;

			public IConnection ResultConnection { get; private set; }

			public InitiateSecureClientUpgradeClientSideAsyncResult(IConnection connection, IDefaultCommunicationTimeouts defaultTimeouts, SocketSecurityRole socketSecurityMode, string targetHost, bool sendControlByte, SslProtocols? sslProtocolOverride, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.connection = connection;
				this.defaultTimeouts = defaultTimeouts;
				this.socketSecurityMode = socketSecurityMode;
				this.targetHost = targetHost;
				this.sendControlByte = sendControlByte;
				this.sslProtocolOverride = sslProtocolOverride;
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				if (socketSecurityMode == SocketSecurityRole.SslClient)
				{
					ConnectionStream connectionStream = ((defaultTimeouts == null) ? new ConnectionStream(connection) : new ConnectionStream(connection, defaultTimeouts));
					if (sendControlByte)
					{
						yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((InitiateSecureClientUpgradeClientSideAsyncResult thisRef, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisRef.connection.BeginWrite(ConnectConstants.UseSsl, 0, 1, immediate: true, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(InitiateSecureClientUpgradeClientSideAsyncResult thisRef, IAsyncResult r)
						{
							thisRef.connection.EndWrite(r);
						}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
					}
					sslStream = new SslStream(connectionStream, leaveInnerStreamOpen: false, ValidateServerCertificate, null);
					if (sslProtocolOverride.HasValue)
					{
						yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((InitiateSecureClientUpgradeClientSideAsyncResult thisRef, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisRef.sslStream.BeginAuthenticateAsClient(thisRef.targetHost, null, thisRef.sslProtocolOverride.Value, checkCertificateRevocation: false, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(InitiateSecureClientUpgradeClientSideAsyncResult thisRef, IAsyncResult r)
						{
							thisRef.sslStream.EndAuthenticateAsClient(r);
						}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
					}
					else
					{
						yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((InitiateSecureClientUpgradeClientSideAsyncResult thisRef, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisRef.sslStream.BeginAuthenticateAsClient(thisRef.targetHost, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(InitiateSecureClientUpgradeClientSideAsyncResult thisRef, IAsyncResult r)
						{
							thisRef.sslStream.EndAuthenticateAsClient(r);
						}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
					}
					if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
					{
						try
						{
							sslStream.Close();
						}
						catch (Exception ex)
						{
							if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
							{
								throw;
							}
							ServiceBusEventSource.Log.HandledException(ex, connection.TrackingContext, connection.Component, this, EventLevel.Warning, "GetAsyncSteps", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\SocketConnection\\SecureSocketUtil.cs", 236);
						}
						Complete(base.LastAsyncStepException);
					}
					else
					{
						ResultConnection = new StreamConnection(sslStream, connectionStream);
					}
					yield break;
				}
				ResultConnection = connection;
				if (sendControlByte)
				{
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((InitiateSecureClientUpgradeClientSideAsyncResult thisRef, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisRef.ResultConnection.BeginWrite(ConnectConstants.NoSsl, 0, 1, immediate: true, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(InitiateSecureClientUpgradeClientSideAsyncResult thisRef, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisRef.ResultConnection.EndWrite(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
				}
			}
		}

		public static bool CustomizedCertificateValidator(object sender, X509Certificate certificate, X509Chain chain, SslPolicyErrors sslPolicyErrors, string hostName)
		{
			switch (sslPolicyErrors)
			{
			case SslPolicyErrors.None:
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			case SslPolicyErrors.RemoteCertificateNameMismatch:
			{
				X509Certificate2 x509Certificate = certificate as X509Certificate2;
				Fx.AssertAndThrow(x509Certificate != null, "CustomizedCertificateValidator received an invalid certificate");
				try
				{
					X509CertificateClaimSet x509CertificateClaimSet = new X509CertificateClaimSet(x509Certificate);
					foreach (Claim item in x509CertificateClaimSet)
					{
						if (item.ClaimType == ClaimTypes.Dns && LenientDnsIdentityVerifier.CheckTopLevelDomainCompatibleness(item.Resource.ToString(), hostName))
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
					return CertificateCheckSubjectAlternativeNames(x509Certificate.Extensions["2.5.29.17"], hostName);
				}
				catch (Exception exception)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
					{
						throw;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
			}
		}

		public static bool CertificateCheckSubjectAlternativeNames(X509Extension extensions, string hostName)
		{
			if (extensions != null)
			{
				string[] array = Regex.Split(extensions.Format(multiLine: true), Environment.NewLine);
				string[] array2 = array;
				foreach (string text in array2)
				{
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
					{
						string[] array3 = text.Trim().Split('=');
						if (array3[0].Trim().Equals("DNS Name") && LenientDnsIdentityVerifier.CheckTopLevelDomainCompatibleness(array3[1].Trim(), hostName))
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool ValidateServerCertificate(object sender, X509Certificate certificate, X509Chain chain, SslPolicyErrors sslPolicyErrors)
		{
			if (sslPolicyErrors == SslPolicyErrors.None)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

	internal class DemuxSocketListener : IConnectionListener
	{
		private InputQueue<IConnection> connectionQueue;

		private DemuxSocketManager demuxManager;

		private bool isClosed;

		private bool listening;

		private object mutex;

		private string type;

		private Uri uri;

		public string Type => type;

		public Uri Uri => uri;

		public DemuxSocketListener(Uri uri, string type, DemuxSocketManager demuxManager)
		{
			this.uri = uri;
			this.type = type;
			this.demuxManager = demuxManager;
			mutex = new object();
			connectionQueue = new InputQueue<IConnection>();
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginAccept(AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return connectionQueue.BeginDequeue(TimeSpan.MaxValue, callback, state);
		}

		public IConnection EndAccept(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			return connectionQueue.EndDequeue(result);
		}

		public void EnqueueConnection(IConnection socket, Action dequeuedCallback)
		{
			connectionQueue.EnqueueAndDispatch(socket, dequeuedCallback);
		}

		public void Close(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			lock (mutex)
			{
				if (!isClosed)
				{
					isClosed = true;
					if (listening)
					{
						demuxManager.UnregisterListener(timeout, this);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public void Abort()
		{
			lock (mutex)
			{
				if (!isClosed)
				{
					isClosed = true;
					if (listening)
					{
						demuxManager.UnregisterListener(TimeSpan.Zero, this);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public void Open(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			lock (mutex)
			{
				demuxManager.RegisterListener(timeout, this);
				listening = true;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class DemuxSocketManager
	{
		private const int MaxTypeLength = 100;

		private int bufferSize;

		private IConnectionElement innerElement;

		private IConnectionListener innerListener;

		private Dictionary<string, DemuxSocketListener> listenerTable;

		private Uri uri;

		public DemuxSocketManager(IConnectionElement innerElement, int bufferSize, Uri uri)
		{
			this.innerElement = innerElement;
			this.bufferSize = bufferSize;
			this.uri = uri;
			listenerTable = new Dictionary<string, DemuxSocketListener>();
		}

		public void RegisterListener(TimeSpan timeout, DemuxSocketListener listener)
		{
			if (listener.Type.Length > 100)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("listener", SRClient.ListenerLengthArgumentOutOfRange);
			}
			lock (listenerTable)
			{
				listenerTable.Add(listener.Type, listener);
				if (listenerTable.Count == 1)
				{
					innerListener = innerElement.CreateListener(bufferSize, uri);
					innerListener.Open(timeout);
					StartAccepting();
				}
			}
		}

		public void UnregisterListener(TimeSpan timeout, DemuxSocketListener listener)
		{
			lock (listenerTable)
			{
				if (!listenerTable.TryGetValue(listener.Type, out var value) || value != listener)
				{
					return;
				}
				listenerTable.Remove(listener.Type);
				if (listenerTable.Count == 0)
				{
					if (timeout == TimeSpan.Zero)
					{
						innerListener.Abort();
					}
					else
					{
						innerListener.Close(timeout);
					}
					innerListener = null;
				}
			}
		}

		private void StartAccepting()
		{
			try
			{
				IAsyncResult asyncResult = innerListener.BeginAccept(AcceptCallback, this);
				if (asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
				{
					AcceptComplete(asyncResult, completedSynchronously: true);
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		private static void StartAcceptingStatic(object state)
		{
			((DemuxSocketManager)state).StartAccepting();
		}

		private static void AcceptCallback(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (!result.CompletedSynchronously)
			{
				((DemuxSocketManager)result.AsyncState).AcceptComplete(result, completedSynchronously: false);
			}
		}

		private void AcceptComplete(IAsyncResult result, bool completedSynchronously)
		{
			try
			{
				IConnection connection;
				try
				{
					connection = innerListener.EndAccept(result);
					if (connection == null)
					{
						return;
					}
				}
				catch (Exception exception)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
					{
						throw;
					}
					IOThreadScheduler.ScheduleCallbackNoFlow(StartAcceptingStatic, this);
					return;
				}
				IOThreadScheduler.ScheduleCallbackNoFlow(StartAcceptingStatic, this);
				ProcessConnection(connection);
			}
			catch (Exception exception2)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception2))
				{
					throw;
				}
			}
		}

		private void ProcessConnection(IConnection connection)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			try
			{
				byte[] array = new byte[4];
				int num = connection.Read(array, 0, 4, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1.0));
				if (num != 4)
				{
					return;
				}
				int num2 = BitConverter.ToInt32(array, 0);
				if (num2 > 100)
				{
					return;
				}
				byte[] array2 = new byte[num2];
				num = connection.Read(array2, 0, num2, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1.0));
				if (num != num2)
				{
					return;
				}
				string key = Encoding.UTF8.GetString(array2);
				DemuxSocketListener value = null;
				lock (listenerTable)
				{
					if (!listenerTable.TryGetValue(key, out value))
					{
						return;
					}
				}
				value.EnqueueConnection(connection, OnConnectionDequeued);
				flag = true;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (!flag)
				{
					connection.Close(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1.0));
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnConnectionDequeued()
		{
		}
	}

	internal class HybridConnectionInitiator : IConnectionInitiator
	{
		private class DirectSocketClient : IDisposable
		{
			private bool disposed;

			private DirectSocketInitiator directSocketInitiator;

			private HybridConnectionInitiator hybridConnectionInitiator;

			private object mutex;

			private TimeoutHelper timeout;

			private Uri uri;

			public HybridConnection HybridConnection { get; internal set; }

			private object ThisLock => mutex;

			public DirectSocketClient(HybridConnectionInitiator hybridConnectionInitiator, DirectSocketInitiator directSocketInitiator, Uri uri, TimeSpan timeout)
			{
				this.hybridConnectionInitiator = hybridConnectionInitiator;
				this.directSocketInitiator = directSocketInitiator;
				this.uri = uri;
				this.timeout = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
				mutex = new object();
			}

			public void StartConnecting()
			{
				if (!disposed)
				{
					IAsyncResult asyncResult = directSocketInitiator.BeginConnect(uri, TrackingContext.Create(uri), timeout.RemainingTime(), DirectConnectCallback, this);
					if (asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
					{
						DirectConnectComplete(asyncResult, completedSynchronously: true);
					}
				}
			}

			private static void DirectConnectCallback(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				if (!result.CompletedSynchronously)
				{
					((DirectSocketClient)result.AsyncState).DirectConnectComplete(result, completedSynchronously: false);
				}
			}

			private void DirectConnectComplete(IAsyncResult result, bool completedSynchronously)
			{
				try
				{
					IConnection connection = directSocketInitiator.EndConnect(result);
					if (disposed)
					{
						connection.Abort();
						return;
					}
					hybridConnectionInitiator.SendInitiateMessage(connection, timeout.RemainingTime());
					HybridConnection.EnqueueConnection(connection);
				}
				catch (Exception exception)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
					{
						throw;
					}
				}
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
				lock (ThisLock)
				{
					if (disposed)
					{
						return;
					}
					disposed = true;
				}
				GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
			}
		}

		private int bufferSize;

		private Guid connectionId;

		private DirectSocketInitiator directSocketInitiator;

		private IConnectionInitiator relayedSocketInitiator;

		public HybridConnectionInitiator(BindingContext context, TcpRelayTransportBindingElement transportBindingElement, int bufferSize, TokenProvider tokenProvider, RelayTransportProtectionMode transportProtection)
		{
			this.bufferSize = bufferSize;
			IConnectionElement innerElement = new RelayedSocketElement(context, new NameSettings
			{
				ServiceSettings = 
				{
					TransportProtection = transportProtection,
					ListenerType = ListenerType.HybridConnection
				}
			}, tokenProvider, SocketSecurityRole.None);
			IConnectionElement connectionElement = new DemuxSocketElement(innerElement, "relayed");
			relayedSocketInitiator = connectionElement.CreateInitiator(bufferSize);
			IConnectionElement directDemuxSocketElement = new DemuxSocketElement(innerElement, "direct");
			System.ServiceModel.Channels.Binding innerBinding = HybridConnectionElement.CreateDirectControlBindingElement(context, transportBindingElement, directDemuxSocketElement);
			directSocketInitiator = new DirectSocketInitiator(bufferSize, innerBinding);
			connectionId = Guid.NewGuid();
		}

		public IConnection Connect(Uri uri, TrackingContext trackingContext, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
			IConnection connection = relayedSocketInitiator.Connect(uri, trackingContext, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
			SendInitiateMessage(connection, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
			DirectSocketClient directSocketClient = new DirectSocketClient(this, directSocketInitiator, uri, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
			HybridConnection result = (directSocketClient.HybridConnection = new HybridConnection(HybridConnectionRole.Initiator, connection, directSocketClient, bufferSize));
			IOThreadScheduler.ScheduleCallbackNoFlow(StartDirectConnect, directSocketClient);
			return result;
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginConnect(Uri uri, TrackingContext trackingContext, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new CompletedAsyncResult<IConnection>(Connect(uri, trackingContext, timeout), callback, state);
		}

		public IConnection EndConnect(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			return CompletedAsyncResult<IConnection>.End(result);

		private void StartDirectConnect(object state)
		{
			DirectSocketClient directSocketClient = (DirectSocketClient)state;
			directSocketClient.StartConnecting();
		}

		private void SendInitiateMessage(IConnection connection, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			try
			{
				TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
				byte[] array = connectionId.ToByteArray();
				connection.Write(array, 0, array.Length, immediate: true, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
				byte[] array2 = new byte[1];
				int num = connection.Read(array2, 0, 1, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
				if (num < 1 || array2[0] != 1)
				{
					throw new CommunicationException(SRClient.InvalidReceivedContent);
				}
			}
			catch
			{
				connection.Close(TimeSpan.Zero);
				throw;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class HybridConnectionListener : IConnectionListener
	{
		private class ConnectionAcceptor
		{
			private HybridConnectionListener connectionListener;

			private IConnectionListener socketListener;

			private HybridConnectionSocketType socketType;

			public ConnectionAcceptor(HybridConnectionListener connectionListener, IConnectionListener socketListener, HybridConnectionSocketType socketType)
			{
				this.connectionListener = connectionListener;
				this.socketListener = socketListener;
				this.socketType = socketType;
			}

			public void StartAccepting()
			{
				try
				{
					IAsyncResult asyncResult = socketListener.BeginAccept(AcceptCallback, this);
					if (asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
					{
						AcceptComplete(asyncResult, completedSynchronously: true);
					}
				}
				catch (Exception exception)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
					{
						throw;
					}
				}
			}

			private static void StartAcceptingStatic(object state)
			{
				((ConnectionAcceptor)state).StartAccepting();
			}

			private static void AcceptCallback(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				if (!result.CompletedSynchronously)
				{
					((ConnectionAcceptor)result.AsyncState).AcceptComplete(result, completedSynchronously: false);
				}
			}

			private void AcceptComplete(IAsyncResult result, bool completedSynchronously)
			{
				try
				{
					IConnection connection;
					try
					{
						connection = socketListener.EndAccept(result);
						if (connection == null)
						{
							return;
						}
					}
					catch (Exception exception)
					{
						if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
						{
							throw;
						}
						IOThreadScheduler.ScheduleCallbackNoFlow(StartAcceptingStatic, this);
						return;
					}
					try
					{
						ProcessConnection(connection);
					}
					catch (Exception exception2)
					{
						if (Fx.IsFatal(exception2))
						{
							throw;
						}
					}
					IOThreadScheduler.ScheduleCallbackNoFlow(StartAcceptingStatic, this);
				}
				catch (Exception exception3)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(exception3))
					{
						throw;
					}
				}
			}

			private void ProcessConnection(IConnection connection)
			{
				TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(ServiceDefaults.ReceiveTimeout);
				bool flag = false;
				try
				{
					byte[] array = new byte[16];
					int num = 0;
					int num2 = 0;
					do
					{
						num = connection.Read(array, num, array.Length - num, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
						num2 += num;
					}
					while (num != 0 && num2 != array.Length);
					if (num2 != array.Length)
					{
						throw new CommunicationException(SRClient.InvalidLengthofReceivedContent);
					}
					Guid connectionId = new Guid(array);
					connectionListener.EnqueueConnection(connectionId, connection, socketType, OnSocketDequeued);
					byte[] buffer = new byte[1] { 1 };
					connection.Write(buffer, 0, 1, immediate: true, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
					flag = true;
				}
				finally
				{
					if (!flag)
					{
						connection.Abort();
					}
				}
			}

			private void OnSocketDequeued()
			{
			}
		}

		private enum HybridConnectionSocketType
		{
			Relayed,
			Direct
		}

		private int bufferSize;

		private InputQueue<HybridConnection> connectionQueue;

		private Dictionary<Guid, HybridConnection> connectionTable;

		private ConnectionAcceptor directSocketAcceptor;

		private IConnectionListener directSocketListener;

		private ConnectionAcceptor relayedSocketAcceptor;

		private IConnectionListener relayedSocketListener;

		public HybridConnectionListener(BindingContext context, TcpRelayTransportBindingElement transportBindingElement, int bufferSize, Uri uri, NameSettings nameSettings, TokenProvider tokenProvider)
		{
			this.bufferSize = bufferSize;
			IConnectionElement innerElement = new RelayedSocketElement(context, nameSettings, tokenProvider, SocketSecurityRole.None);
			DemuxSocketManager demuxManager = new DemuxSocketManager(innerElement, bufferSize, uri);
			IConnectionElement connectionElement = new DemuxSocketElement(innerElement, "relayed", demuxManager);
			relayedSocketListener = connectionElement.CreateListener(bufferSize, uri);
			relayedSocketAcceptor = new ConnectionAcceptor(this, relayedSocketListener, HybridConnectionSocketType.Relayed);
			IConnectionElement directDemuxSocketElement = new DemuxSocketElement(innerElement, "direct", demuxManager);
			System.ServiceModel.Channels.Binding innerBinding = HybridConnectionElement.CreateDirectControlBindingElement(context, transportBindingElement, directDemuxSocketElement);
			IConnectionElement connectionElement2 = new DirectSocketElement(innerBinding);
			directSocketListener = connectionElement2.CreateListener(bufferSize, uri);
			directSocketAcceptor = new ConnectionAcceptor(this, directSocketListener, HybridConnectionSocketType.Direct);
			connectionQueue = new InputQueue<HybridConnection>();
			connectionTable = new Dictionary<Guid, HybridConnection>();
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginAccept(AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return connectionQueue.BeginDequeue(TimeSpan.MaxValue, callback, state);
		}

		public IConnection EndAccept(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			try
			{
				return connectionQueue.EndDequeue(result);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(ex) || ex is CommunicationException)
				{
					throw;
				}
				throw new CommunicationException(ex.Message, ex);
			}
		}

		public void Close(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
			relayedSocketListener.Close(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
			directSocketListener.Close(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
		}

		public void Abort()
		{
			relayedSocketListener.Abort();
			directSocketListener.Abort();
		}

		public void Open(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
			relayedSocketListener.Open(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
			relayedSocketAcceptor.StartAccepting();
			try
			{
				directSocketListener.Open(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
				directSocketAcceptor.StartAccepting();
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				relayedSocketListener.Abort();
				throw;
			}
		}

		private void EnqueueConnection(Guid connectionId, IConnection connection, HybridConnectionSocketType socketType, Action dequeuedCallback)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			try
			{
				HybridConnection value;
				lock (connectionTable)
				{
					if (connectionTable.TryGetValue(connectionId, out value))
					{
						value.EnqueueConnection(connection);
					}
					else
					{
						if (socketType == HybridConnectionSocketType.Direct)
						{
							connection.Abort();
							return;
						}
						value = new HybridConnection(HybridConnectionRole.Listener, connection, null, bufferSize);
						value.Closed += delegate
						{
							connectionTable.Remove(connectionId);
						};
						flag = true;
						connectionTable.Add(connectionId, value);
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					connectionQueue.EnqueueAndDispatch(value);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				dequeuedCallback();
			}
		}
	}

	internal enum ProbeMessageType
	{
		GetServerAddress = 1,
		GetClientAddress
	}
	internal class ProbingClient
	{
		private IPEndPoint probeAddress;

		private int[] probePorts;

		public ProbingClient(string hostName, int[] probePorts)
		{
			probeAddress = GetAddress(hostName, probePorts[0]);
			this.probePorts = probePorts;
		}

		private static IPEndPoint GetAddress(string hostName, int port)
		{
			IPAddress[] hostAddresses = Dns.GetHostAddresses(hostName);
			for (int i = 0; i < hostAddresses.Length; i++)
			{
				if (hostAddresses[i].AddressFamily == AddressFamily.InterNetwork)
				{
					return new IPEndPoint(hostAddresses[i], port);
				}
			}
			throw new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.NoValidHostAddress);
		}

		public bool PredictNextExternalPort(DerivedEndpoint derivedEndpoint)
		{
			return PredictNextExternalPort(probeAddress, probePorts, derivedEndpoint);
		}

		public static bool PredictNextExternalPort(IPEndPoint probeAddress, int[] probePorts, DerivedEndpoint derivedEndpoint)
		{
			try
			{
				IPEndPoint localEndpoint = new IPEndPoint(IPAddress.Any, 0);
				IPEndPoint returnedEndpoint = new IPEndPoint(IPAddress.Any, 0);
				SendProbeMessage(probeAddress, ProbeMessageType.GetServerAddress, ref localEndpoint, ref returnedEndpoint);
				IPEndPoint probeServer = new IPEndPoint(returnedEndpoint.Address, probePorts[0]);
				IPEndPoint probeServer2 = new IPEndPoint(returnedEndpoint.Address, probePorts[1]);
				IPEndPoint returnedEndpoint2 = new IPEndPoint(IPAddress.Any, 0);
				IPEndPoint returnedEndpoint3 = new IPEndPoint(IPAddress.Any, 0);
				localEndpoint = new IPEndPoint(IPAddress.Any, 0);
				SendProbeMessage(probeServer, ProbeMessageType.GetClientAddress, ref localEndpoint, ref returnedEndpoint2);
				if (localEndpoint.Address.GetRawIPv4Address() == returnedEndpoint2.Address.GetRawIPv4Address())
				{
					localEndpoint.Port = 0;
				}
				SendProbeMessage(probeServer2, ProbeMessageType.GetClientAddress, ref localEndpoint, ref returnedEndpoint3);
				if (returnedEndpoint2.Address.GetRawIPv4Address() != returnedEndpoint3.Address.GetRawIPv4Address())
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (localEndpoint.Address.GetRawIPv4Address() == returnedEndpoint2.Address.GetRawIPv4Address())
				{
					localEndpoint.Port = 0;
					derivedEndpoint.LocalEndpoint = localEndpoint;
					derivedEndpoint.ExternalEndpoint = localEndpoint;
					return true;
				}
				derivedEndpoint.LocalEndpoint = localEndpoint;
				derivedEndpoint.ExternalEndpoint = returnedEndpoint2;
				if (returnedEndpoint2.Port != returnedEndpoint3.Port)
				{
					int num = returnedEndpoint3.Port - returnedEndpoint2.Port;
					if (returnedEndpoint3.Port + num > 65535)
					{
						return false;
					}
					derivedEndpoint.ExternalEndpoint.Port = returnedEndpoint3.Port + num;
				}
				return true;
			}
			catch
			{
				return false;
			}
		}

		private static void SendProbeMessage(IPEndPoint probeServer, ProbeMessageType messageType, ref IPEndPoint localEndpoint, ref IPEndPoint returnedEndpoint)
		{
			Socket socket = new Socket(probeServer.AddressFamily, SocketType.Stream, ProtocolType.Tcp);
			try
			{
				socket.SetSocketOption(SocketOptionLevel.Socket, SocketOptionName.ReuseAddress, optionValue: true);
				socket.SetSocketOption(SocketOptionLevel.Socket, SocketOptionName.KeepAlive, optionValue: true);
				socket.Bind(localEndpoint);
				socket.Connect(probeServer);
				if (localEndpoint.Port == 0)
				{
					localEndpoint = (IPEndPoint)socket.LocalEndPoint;
				}
			}
			catch
			{
				socket.Close();
				throw;
			}
			byte[] bytes = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(ConnectConstants.ProbeType);
			byte[] bytes2 = BitConverter.GetBytes(bytes.Length);
			socket.Send(bytes2);
			socket.Send(bytes);
			byte[] bytes3 = BitConverter.GetBytes((int)messageType);
			socket.Send(bytes3);
			byte[] buffer = new byte[256];
			int num;
			try
			{
				num = socket.Receive(buffer);
			}
			finally
			{
				socket.Close();
			}
			if (num != 12)
			{
				throw new CommunicationException(SRClient.InvalidLengthofReceivedContent);
			}
			MemoryStream input = new MemoryStream(buffer, 0, num);
			BinaryReader binaryReader = new BinaryReader(input);
			returnedEndpoint.Address = new IPAddress(binaryReader.ReadInt64());
			returnedEndpoint.Port = binaryReader.ReadInt32();
		}
	}

	[Serializable]
	public class AuthorizationFailedException : Exception
	{
		public enum FailureCode
		{
			Generic,
			MissingToken,
			MalformedToken,
			InvalidSignature,
			InvalidAudience,
			ExpiredToken,
			InvalidClaim,
			MissingAudience,
			MissingExpiresOn,
			MissingIssuer,
			MissingSignature,
			NotValidYet,
			InvalidIssuer,
			InvalidLifetime,
			LocalAuthDisabled
		}

		public FailureCode ErrorCode { get; private set; }

		internal AuthorizationFailedException()
			: this(FailureCode.Generic)
		{
		}

		internal AuthorizationFailedException(string message)
			: this(FailureCode.Generic, message)
		{
		}

		internal AuthorizationFailedException(Exception innerException)
			: this(FailureCode.Generic, string.Empty, innerException)
		{
		}

		internal AuthorizationFailedException(string message, Exception innerException)
			: this(FailureCode.Generic, message, innerException)
		{
		}

		internal AuthorizationFailedException(FailureCode failureCode)
			: this(failureCode, string.Empty)
		{
			ErrorCode = failureCode;
		}

		internal AuthorizationFailedException(FailureCode failureCode, string message)
			: base(FormatExceptionMessage(failureCode, message))
		{
			ErrorCode = failureCode;
		}

		internal AuthorizationFailedException(FailureCode failureCode, string message, Exception innerException)
			: base(FormatExceptionMessage(failureCode, message), innerException)
		{
			ErrorCode = failureCode;
		}

		internal AuthorizationFailedException(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			: base(info, context)
		{
			try
			{
				ErrorCode = (FailureCode)info.GetValue("ErrorCode", typeof(FailureCode));
			}
			catch (SerializationException)
			{
				ErrorCode = FailureCode.Generic;
			}
		}

		public override void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			base.GetObjectData(info, context);
			info.AddValue("ErrorCode", ErrorCode);
		}

		private static string FormatExceptionMessage(FailureCode code, string message)
		{
			return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}: {1}", code, message);
		}
	}

	internal class ErrorUtility
	{
		public static bool CanRetry(Exception exception)
		{
			if (exception == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!(exception is AddressNotFoundException) && !(exception is ConnectionLostException) && !(exception is EndpointNotFoundException) && !(exception is System.ServiceModel.QuotaExceededException) && !(exception is ServerErrorException) && !(exception is TimeoutException) && !(exception is CommunicationException))
			{
				return exception is SecurityTokenException;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static Exception ConvertToError(MessageFault fault)
		{
			if (fault.Code.Namespace == "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2009/05/servicebus/relay")
			{
				if (fault.Code.Name == "AddressAlreadyInUseFault")
				{
					return new AddressAlreadyInUseException("The specified address already exists." + fault.Reason);
				}
				if (fault.Code.Name == "AddressNotFoundFault")
				{
					return new AddressNotFoundException("The address was not found. Please check whether the service at the specified name is currently running.");
				}
				if (fault.Code.Name == "AddressReplacedFault")
				{
					return new AddressReplacedException("The address was re-registered by a service at another location. Please check whether another instance of this service is now running.");
				}
				if (fault.Code.Name == "AuthorizationFailedFault")
				{
					return new AuthorizationFailedException(AuthorizationFailedException.FailureCode.Generic, "There was an authorization failure. Make sure you have specified the correct client credentials. " + fault.Reason);
				}
				if (fault.Code.Name == "EndpointNotFoundFault")
				{
					string arg = "The endpoint was not found. " + fault.Reason;
					return new EndpointNotFoundException(string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}. Please ensure that you can connect to the internet using HTTP port 80 and TCP port {1}.", arg, 9350));
				}
				if (fault.Code.Name == "RelayNotFoundFault")
				{
					return new RelayNotFoundException(fault.Reason.ToString());
				}
				if (fault.Code.Name == "NoTransportSecurityFault")
				{
					return new NoTransportSecurityException("Transport security is required for this connection. " + fault.Reason);
				}
				if (fault.Code.Name == "InvalidRequestFault")
				{
					return new InvalidRequestException("The request was rejected by the server as invalid. " + fault.Reason);
				}
				if (fault.Code.Name == "ConnectionFailedFault")
				{
					return new InvalidRequestException("The connection was failed. " + fault.Reason);
				}
				if (fault.Code.Name == "QuotaExceededFault")
				{
					return new System.ServiceModel.QuotaExceededException("User quota was exceeded. " + fault.Reason);
				}
				return new ServerErrorException("The server had an error while processing request. " + fault.Reason);
			}
			return FaultException.CreateFault(fault);
		}
	}

	internal class RelayedHttpHeader : MessageHeader
	{
		public const string HeaderNamespace = "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2009/05/servicebus/web";

		private string name;

		private string value;

		public override string Name => name;

		public override string Namespace => "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2009/05/servicebus/web";

		public RelayedHttpHeader(string name, string value)
		{
			this.name = name;
			this.value = value;
		}

		protected override void OnWriteHeaderContents(XmlDictionaryWriter writer, MessageVersion messageVersion)
		{
			writer.WriteString(value);
		}

		public static string ReadHeader(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, string headerName, string defaultValue)
		{
			MessageHeaders headers = message.Headers;
			int num = headers.FindHeader(headerName, "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2009/05/servicebus/web");
			if (num == -1)
			{
				return defaultValue;
			}
			using XmlDictionaryReader xmlDictionaryReader = headers.GetReaderAtHeader(num);
			return xmlDictionaryReader.ReadString();
		}
	}
	internal class RelayHttpTransportChannelListener : LayeredChannelListener<IReplyChannel>
	{
		private readonly IChannelListener<IReplyChannel> innerChannelListener;

		private readonly Uri listenUri;

		private readonly MessageEncoder encoder;

		public override Uri Uri => listenUri;

		public RelayHttpTransportChannelListener(BindingContext context, MessageEncodingBindingElement encodingBindingElement, IChannelListener<IReplyChannel> innerChannelListener)
			: base((IDefaultCommunicationTimeouts)context.Binding, (IChannelListener)innerChannelListener)
		{
			this.innerChannelListener = innerChannelListener;
			listenUri = this.innerChannelListener.Uri;
			encoder = encodingBindingElement.CreateMessageEncoderFactory().Encoder;
		}

		protected override IReplyChannel OnAcceptChannel(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			IReplyChannel innerChannel = innerChannelListener.AcceptChannel(timeout);
			return WrapInnerChannel(innerChannel);

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginAcceptChannel(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return innerChannelListener.BeginAcceptChannel(timeout, callback, state);
		}

		protected override IReplyChannel OnEndAcceptChannel(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			IReplyChannel innerChannel = innerChannelListener.EndAcceptChannel(result);
			return WrapInnerChannel(innerChannel);
		}

		protected override bool OnWaitForChannel(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			return innerChannelListener.WaitForChannel(timeout);
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginWaitForChannel(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return innerChannelListener.BeginWaitForChannel(timeout, callback, state);
		}

		protected override bool OnEndWaitForChannel(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			return innerChannelListener.EndWaitForChannel(result);
		}

		public override T GetProperty<T>()
		{
			return innerChannelListener.GetProperty<T>();
		}

		private IReplyChannel WrapInnerChannel(IReplyChannel innerChannel)
		{
			if (innerChannel == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new RelayHttpTransportReplyChannel(this, innerChannel, encoder);
		}
	}
	internal class RelayHttpTransportReplyChannel : LayeredChannel<IReplyChannel>, IReplyChannel, IChannel, ICommunicationObject
	{
		private class RelayHttpTransportRequestContext : RequestContext
		{
			private readonly RequestContext innerContext;

			private readonly IDefaultCommunicationTimeouts defaultTimeouts;

			private readonly string requestAction;

			private readonly System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message requestMessage;

			private readonly MessageEncoder encoder;

			private readonly MessageWrapper wrapper;

			private bool disposed;

			private bool isSoapRequest;

			public override System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message RequestMessage => requestMessage;

			private object ThisLock => wrapper;

			public RelayHttpTransportRequestContext(RequestContext innerContext, IDefaultCommunicationTimeouts defaultTimeouts, MessageEncoder encoder)
			{
				this.innerContext = innerContext;
				this.defaultTimeouts = defaultTimeouts;
				this.encoder = encoder;
				wrapper = new MessageWrapper(this.encoder);
				requestAction = this.innerContext.RequestMessage.Headers.Action;
				requestMessage = PrepareRequest(this.innerContext.RequestMessage);
			}

			public override void Abort()
			{
				Dispose(disposing: true);
			}

			public override void Close()
			{
				Close(defaultTimeouts.CloseTimeout);
			}

			public override void Close(TimeSpan timeout)
			{
				Dispose(disposing: true);
			}

			private System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message CreateAckMessage(HttpStatusCode statusCode, string statusDescription)
			{
				System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message = System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message.CreateMessage(MessageVersion.None, string.Empty);
				HttpResponseMessageProperty httpResponseMessageProperty = new HttpResponseMessageProperty();
				httpResponseMessageProperty.StatusCode = statusCode;
				httpResponseMessageProperty.SuppressEntityBody = true;
				if (statusDescription.Length > 0)
				{
					httpResponseMessageProperty.StatusDescription = statusDescription;
				}
				message.Properties.Add(HttpResponseMessageProperty.Name, httpResponseMessageProperty);
				return RelayedHttpUtility.ConvertWebResponseToSoapResponse(message, requestAction + "Response");
			}

			public override void Reply(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message)
			{
				Reply(message, defaultTimeouts.SendTimeout);
			}

			public override void Reply(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, TimeSpan timeout)
			{
				System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message2 = PrepareReply(message);
				innerContext.Reply(message2, timeout);
			}

			public override IAsyncResult BeginReply(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{
				return BeginReply(message, defaultTimeouts.SendTimeout, callback, state);
			}

			public override IAsyncResult BeginReply(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{
				System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message2 = PrepareReply(message);
				return innerContext.BeginReply(message2, timeout, callback, state);
			}

			public override void EndReply(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				innerContext.EndReply(result);
			}

			private System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message PrepareReply(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message)
			{
				if (message == null)
				{
					return CreateAckMessage(HttpStatusCode.Accepted, string.Empty);
				}
				if (isSoapRequest)
				{
					if (encoder.MessageVersion.Addressing == AddressingVersion.None)
					{
						message.Headers.Action = null;
						message.Headers.To = null;
						message.Headers.ReplyTo = null;
						message.Headers.From = null;
						message.Headers.FaultTo = null;
						message.Headers.MessageId = null;
						message.Headers.RelatesTo = null;
					}
					return message.ConvertSoapResponseToWrappedSoapResponse(message.Headers.Action, wrapper);
				}
				string responseAction = ((message.Headers.Action != null) ? (message.Headers.Action + "Response") : ((requestAction == null) ? string.Empty : (requestAction + "Response")));
				return RelayedHttpUtility.ConvertWebResponseToSoapResponse(message, responseAction);
			}

			private System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message PrepareRequest(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message)
			{
				if (message.Headers.FindHeader("BodyFormat", "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2009/05/servicebus/body") != -1)
				{
					return RelayedHttpUtility.ConvertSoapRequestToWebRequest(encoder, message, out isSoapRequest, wrapper);
				}
				isSoapRequest = true;
				return message;
			}

			protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				lock (ThisLock)
				{
					if (!disposed)
					{
						disposed = true;
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				if (flag && innerContext != null)
				{
					innerContext.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		private readonly EndpointAddress localAddress;

		private readonly MessageEncoder encoder;

		public EndpointAddress LocalAddress => localAddress;

		public RelayHttpTransportReplyChannel(ChannelManagerBase channelManager, IReplyChannel innerChannel, MessageEncoder encoder)
			: base(channelManager, innerChannel)
		{
			localAddress = innerChannel.LocalAddress;
			this.encoder = encoder;
		}

		public RequestContext ReceiveRequest()
		{
			return ReceiveRequest(base.DefaultReceiveTimeout);
		}

		public RequestContext ReceiveRequest(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			return ReplyChannel.HelpReceiveRequest(this, timeout);
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginReceiveRequest(AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return BeginReceiveRequest(base.DefaultReceiveTimeout, callback, state);
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginReceiveRequest(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return ReplyChannel.HelpBeginReceiveRequest(this, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		public RequestContext EndReceiveRequest(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			return ReplyChannel.HelpEndReceiveRequest(result);
		}

		public bool TryReceiveRequest(TimeSpan timeout, out RequestContext context)
		{
			if (!base.InnerChannel.TryReceiveRequest(timeout, out var context2))
			{
				context = null;
				return false;
			}
			context = WrapInnerRequestContext(context2);
			return true;
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginTryReceiveRequest(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return base.InnerChannel.BeginTryReceiveRequest(timeout, callback, state);
		}

		public bool EndTryReceiveRequest(IAsyncResult result, out RequestContext context)
		{
			if (!base.InnerChannel.EndTryReceiveRequest(result, out var context2))
			{
				context = null;
				return false;
			}
			context = WrapInnerRequestContext(context2);
			return true;
		}

		public bool WaitForRequest(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			return base.InnerChannel.WaitForRequest(timeout);
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginWaitForRequest(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return base.InnerChannel.BeginWaitForRequest(timeout, callback, state);
		}

		public bool EndWaitForRequest(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			return base.InnerChannel.EndWaitForRequest(result);
		}

		private RequestContext WrapInnerRequestContext(RequestContext request)
		{
			if (request == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new RelayHttpTransportRequestContext(request, base.Manager, encoder);
		}
	}

	internal class RelayedHttpRequestChannel : LayeredChannel<IRequestChannel>, IRequestChannel, IChannel, ICommunicationObject
	{
		private class RequestAsyncResult : AsyncResult<RequestAsyncResult>
		{
			private static readonly AsyncCallback requestCallback = RequestCallback;

			private readonly IRequestChannel innerChannel;

			public System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message Reply { get; private set; }

			protected override EventLevel TraceEventType => EventLevel.Warning;

			public RequestAsyncResult(RelayedHttpRequestChannel channel, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(callback, state)
			{
				innerChannel = channel.InnerChannel;
			}

			public void SendRequest(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message request, TimeSpan timeout)
			{
				IAsyncResult asyncResult = innerChannel.BeginRequest(request, timeout, requestCallback, this);
				if (asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
				{
					RequestComplete(asyncResult, completedSynchronously: true);
				}
			}

			private static void RequestCallback(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				if (!result.CompletedSynchronously)
				{
					((RequestAsyncResult)result.AsyncState).RequestComplete(result, completedSynchronously: false);
				}
			}

			private void RequestComplete(IAsyncResult result, bool completedSynchronously)
			{
				Exception e = null;
				try
				{
					Reply = innerChannel.EndRequest(result);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
					{
						throw;
					}
					e = ex;
				}
				Complete(completedSynchronously, e);
			}
		}

		private EndpointAddress remoteAddress;

		private Uri via;

		private TokenProvider tokenProvider;

		public EndpointAddress RemoteAddress => remoteAddress;

		public Uri Via => via;

		public RelayedHttpRequestChannel(ChannelManagerBase channelManager, TokenProvider tokenProvider, IRequestChannel innerChannel)
			: base(channelManager, innerChannel)
		{
			this.tokenProvider = tokenProvider;
			remoteAddress = innerChannel.RemoteAddress;
			via = innerChannel.Via;
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginRequest(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
			RequestAsyncResult requestAsyncResult = new RequestAsyncResult(this, callback, state);
			AddTokenToMessage(message, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
			requestAsyncResult.SendRequest(message, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
			return requestAsyncResult;
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginRequest(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return BeginRequest(message, base.DefaultSendTimeout, callback, state);
		}

		public System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message EndRequest(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			return AsyncResult<RequestAsyncResult>.End(result).Reply;
		}

		public System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message Request(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			return EndRequest(BeginRequest(message, timeout, null, null));
		}

		public System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message Request(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message)
		{
			return EndRequest(BeginRequest(message, null, null));
		}

		private void ValidateTransportProtectionForToken()
		{
			if (via.Scheme != Uri.UriSchemeHttps)
			{
				throw new CommunicationException(SRClient.TransportSecurity);
			}
		}

		private void AddTokenToMessage(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			if (tokenProvider != null)
			{
				ValidateTransportProtectionForToken();
				string action = "Send";
				HttpRequestMessageProperty httpRequestMessageProperty;
				if (!message.Properties.ContainsKey(HttpRequestMessageProperty.Name))
				{
					httpRequestMessageProperty = new HttpRequestMessageProperty();
					message.Properties.Add(HttpRequestMessageProperty.Name, httpRequestMessageProperty);
				}
				else
				{
					httpRequestMessageProperty = message.Properties[HttpRequestMessageProperty.Name] as HttpRequestMessageProperty;
				}
				if (!tokenProvider.IsWebTokenSupported)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(SRClient.HTTPAuthTokenNotSupportedException);
				}
				Uri uri = message.Headers.To ?? via;
				string absoluteUri = ServiceBusUriHelper.NormalizeUri(uri).AbsoluteUri;
				string webToken = tokenProvider.GetWebToken(absoluteUri, action, bypassCache: false, timeout);
				httpRequestMessageProperty.Headers["ServiceBusAuthorization"] = webToken;
			}
		}
	}

		private class MessageBodyWriter : BodyWriter
		{
			private readonly System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message;

			public MessageBodyWriter(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message)
				: base(isBuffered: false)

				message.WriteMessage(writer);
			}
		}

		public class HttpErrorMessageBodyWriter : BodyWriter
		{
			public const string Name = "RelayedHttpErrorMessageBodyWriter";

			public HttpStatusCode StatusCode { get; private set; }

			public string FaultReason { get; private set; }

			internal HttpErrorMessageBodyWriter(HttpStatusCode statusCode, string faultReason)
				: base(isBuffered: true)
			{
				StatusCode = statusCode;
				FaultReason = faultReason;
			}

			protected override void OnWriteBodyContents(XmlDictionaryWriter writer)
			{
				writer.WriteStartElement("Error");
				writer.WriteStartElement("Code");
				writer.WriteValue(Convert.ToInt32(StatusCode, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
				writer.WriteEndElement();
				writer.WriteElementString("Detail", FaultReason);
				writer.WriteEndElement();
			}
		}

		private sealed class FixupBase64XmlReader : LayeredXmlReader
		{
			private const int Base64Boundary = 4;

			private const int BinaryElementDepth = 2;

			private const int BinaryTextDepth = 3;

			private const string BinaryElementName = "Binary";

			private static readonly string BinaryElementNamespace = string.Empty;

			private string base64CompatibleValue;

			private string carriedOverChars;

			private bool processingBinaryNode;

			public override string Value
			{
				get
				{
					if (processingBinaryNode && base.InnerReader.NodeType == XmlNodeType.Text && base.InnerReader.Depth == 3)
					{
						return base64CompatibleValue;
					}
					return base.Value;
				}
			}

			public FixupBase64XmlReader(XmlDictionaryReader innerReader)
				: base(innerReader)
			{
			}

			public override bool Read()
			{
				bool result = base.Read();
				OnMoved();
				return result;
			}

			public override XmlNodeType MoveToContent()
			{
				XmlNodeType result = base.MoveToContent();
				OnMoved();
				return result;
			}

			public override bool MoveToElement()
			{
				bool result = base.MoveToElement();
				OnMoved();
				return result;
			}

			private void OnMoved()
			{
				if (!processingBinaryNode)
				{
					if (base.InnerReader.NodeType == XmlNodeType.Element && base.InnerReader.Depth == 2 && base.InnerReader.LocalName == "Binary" && base.InnerReader.NamespaceURI == BinaryElementNamespace && !base.InnerReader.IsEmptyElement)
					{
						processingBinaryNode = true;
					}
				}
				else if (base.InnerReader.NodeType == XmlNodeType.Text && base.InnerReader.Depth == 3)
				{
					string text = carriedOverChars + base.InnerReader.Value;
					int num = text.Length / 4 * 4;
					if (text.Length != num)
					{
						carriedOverChars = text.Substring(num, text.Length - num);
						base64CompatibleValue = text.Substring(0, num);
					}
					else
					{
						base64CompatibleValue = text;
						carriedOverChars = null;
					}
				}
				else if (base.InnerReader.NodeType == XmlNodeType.EndElement && base.InnerReader.Depth == 2 && base.InnerReader.LocalName == "Binary" && base.InnerReader.NamespaceURI == BinaryElementNamespace)
				{
					Fx.AssertAndThrow(carriedOverChars == null, "The inner XmlReader contained an invalid length for base64 content!");
					processingBinaryNode = false;
				}
			}
		}

		{

			public virtual int LineNumber
			{
				get
				{
					if (!(InnerReader is IXmlLineInfo xmlLineInfo))
					{
						return 1;
					}
					return xmlLineInfo.LineNumber;
				}
			}

			public virtual int LinePosition
			{
				get
				{
					if (!(InnerReader is IXmlLineInfo xmlLineInfo))
					{
						return 1;
					}
					return xmlLineInfo.LinePosition;
				}
			}

			public override XmlDictionaryReaderQuotas Quotas => InnerReader.Quotas;

			public override char QuoteChar => InnerReader.QuoteChar;

			public override XmlSpace XmlSpace => InnerReader.XmlSpace;

			public override string XmlLang => InnerReader.XmlLang;

			public override XmlReaderSettings Settings => InnerReader.Settings;

			protected XmlDictionaryReader InnerReader { get; private set; }

			public override string this[string name] => InnerReader[name];

			public override string this[string name, string namespaceURI] => InnerReader[name, namespaceURI];

			public override string this[int i] => InnerReader[i];

					throw new ArgumentNullException("innerReader");
				}
				InnerReader = innerReader;
			}

			public override void Close()
			{
				InnerReader.Close();
			}

			public override string GetAttribute(int i)
			{
				return InnerReader.GetAttribute(i);
			}

			public override string GetAttribute(string name)
			{
				return InnerReader.GetAttribute(name);
			}

			public override string GetAttribute(string name, string namespaceURI)
			{
				return InnerReader.GetAttribute(name, namespaceURI);
			}

			public virtual bool HasLineInfo()
			{
				if (!(InnerReader is IXmlLineInfo xmlLineInfo))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return xmlLineInfo.HasLineInfo();
			}

			public override bool IsStartElement(XmlDictionaryString localName, XmlDictionaryString namespaceUri)
			{
				return InnerReader.IsStartElement(localName, namespaceUri);
			}

		static RelayedHttpUtility()
		{
			FormatStringDefault = WebContentFormat.Default.ToString();
			FormatStringXml = WebContentFormat.Xml.ToString();
			FormatStringRaw = WebContentFormat.Raw.ToString();
			FormatStringJson = WebContentFormat.Json.ToString();
			MaxQuotas = new XmlDictionaryReaderQuotas();
			JsonErrorDataSerializer = new DataContractJsonSerializer(typeof(ServiceBusErrorData));
			HttpCrLfArray = new string[1] { "\r\n" };
			HttpHeaderValueSeparatorArray = new string[1] { ": " };
			encoderSoap11 = new TextMessageEncodingBindingElement(MessageVersion.Soap11, Encoding.UTF8)
			{
				ReaderQuotas = 
				{
					MaxBytesPerRead = 65536
				}
			}.CreateMessageEncoderFactory().Encoder;
			encoderSoap12 = new TextMessageEncodingBindingElement(MessageVersion.Soap12WSAddressing10, Encoding.UTF8)
			{
				ReaderQuotas = 
				{
					MaxBytesPerRead = 65536
				}
			}.CreateMessageEncoderFactory().Encoder;
			wrapperSoap11 = new MessageWrapper(encoderSoap11);
			wrapperSoap12 = new MessageWrapper(encoderSoap12);
			XmlDictionaryReaderQuotas.Max.CopyTo(MaxQuotas);
		}

		public static Uri ConvertToHttpUri(Uri uri)
		{
			return ConvertUriScheme(uri, Uri.UriSchemeHttp, RelayEnvironment.RelayHttpPort);
		}

		public static Uri ConvertToHttpsUri(Uri uri)
		{
			return ConvertUriScheme(uri, Uri.UriSchemeHttps, RelayEnvironment.RelayHttpsPort);
		}

		public static Uri ConvertToSbUri(Uri uri)
		{
			return ConvertUriScheme(uri, "sb", -1);
		}

		private static Uri ConvertUriScheme(Uri uri, string newScheme, int newPort)
		{
			if (uri == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (((newPort == -1 && uri.IsDefaultPort) || uri.Port == newPort) && uri.Scheme == newScheme)
			{
				return uri;
			}
			UriBuilder uriBuilder = new UriBuilder(uri)
			{
				Scheme = newScheme,
				Port = newPort
			};
			return uriBuilder.Uri;
		}

		public static System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message ConvertWebRequestToSoapRequest(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message webRequest, Uri to, string formatString, bool overrideHttpMethodToGet)
		{
			XmlDictionaryReader bodyReader = null;
			return ConvertWebRequestToSoapRequest(webRequest, to, formatString, overrideHttpMethodToGet, preserveMessage: false, ref bodyReader);
		}

		public static System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message ConvertWebRequestToSoapRequest(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message webRequest, Uri to, string formatString, bool overrideHttpMethodToGet, bool preserveMessage, ref XmlDictionaryReader bodyReader)
		{
			webRequest.Properties.TryGetValue(HttpRequestMessageProperty.Name, out var value);
			HttpRequestMessageProperty httpRequestMessageProperty = (HttpRequestMessageProperty)value;
			long result = 0L;
			string text = httpRequestMessageProperty.Headers[HttpRequestHeader.ContentLength];
			string text2 = httpRequestMessageProperty.Headers[HttpRequestHeader.TransferEncoding];
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && !long.TryParse(text, out result))
			{
				result = 0L;
			}
			System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message;
			if ((result == 0L && (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2) || !text2.Equals("Chunked", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))) || overrideHttpMethodToGet)
			{
				message = ((!overrideHttpMethodToGet) ? System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message.CreateMessage(MessageVersion.Soap12WSAddressing10, httpRequestMessageProperty.Method) : System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message.CreateMessage(MessageVersion.Soap12WSAddressing10, "GET"));
			}
			else if (formatString == FormatStringXml || formatString == FormatStringDefault)
			{
				if (bodyReader == null)
				{
					bodyReader = webRequest.GetReaderAtBodyContents();
				}
				message = System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message.CreateMessage(MessageVersion.Soap12WSAddressing10, httpRequestMessageProperty.Method, bodyReader);
			}
			else if (formatString == "WrappedSoap11" || formatString == "WrappedSoap12")
			{
				message = webRequest;
			}
			else
			{
				if (bodyReader == null)
				{
					bodyReader = webRequest.GetReaderAtBodyContents();
				}
				Stream stream = StreamMessageHelper.GetStream(bodyReader);
				message = StreamMessageHelper.CreateMessage(MessageVersion.Soap12WSAddressing10, httpRequestMessageProperty.Method, stream);
			}
			if (message != webRequest)
			{
				message.Headers.To = to;
				message.Headers.MessageId = new UniqueId();
				message.Headers.ReplyTo = new EndpointAddress(EndpointAddress.AnonymousUri);
			}
			ConvertWebPropertiesToSoapHeaders(message, httpRequestMessageProperty.Headers);
			ConvertWebAddressToSoapHeader(message, webRequest.Properties.Via);
			message.Properties.CopyProperties(webRequest.Properties);
			if (preserveMessage)
			{
				message = new NoCloseMessageWrapper(message);
			}
			return message;
		}

		public static System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message ConvertWebResponseToSoapResponse(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message webResponse, string responseAction)
		{
			System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message;
			object value;
			if (webResponse.IsEmpty)
			{
				message = System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message.CreateMessage(MessageVersion.Soap12WSAddressing10, responseAction);
			}
			else if (webResponse.Properties.TryGetValue("StreamMessageProperty", out value))
			{
				message = StreamMessageHelper.CreateMessage(MessageVersion.Soap12WSAddressing10, responseAction, ((StreamMessageProperty)value).Stream);
			}
			else
			{
				Type type = webResponse.GetType();
				if (type.FullName == "System.ServiceModel.Channels.ByteStreamMessage+InternalByteStreamMessage")
				{
					FieldInfo field = type.GetField("reader", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
					if (field != null)
					{
						object value2 = field.GetValue(webResponse);
						Type type2 = value2.GetType();
						FieldInfo field2 = type2.GetField("quotas", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic);

		public static void ParseHttpHeaderString(string headersString, Action<string, string> addHeaderAction)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(headersString))
			{
				return;
			}
			string[] array = headersString.Split(HttpCrLfArray, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
			string[] array2 = array;
			foreach (string text in array2)
			{
				string[] array3 = text.Split(HttpHeaderValueSeparatorArray, 2, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
				string arg;
				string arg2;
				if (array3.Length > 1)
				{
					arg = array3[0];
					arg2 = array3[1];
				}
				else
				{
					arg = string.Empty;
					arg2 = array3[0];
				}
				addHeaderAction(arg, arg2);
			}
		}

		public static string ToHttpHeaderString(this NameValueCollection headers)
		{
			if (headers == null || headers.Count == 0)
			{
				return "\r\n";
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(35 * headers.Count);
			string text = headers[string.Empty];
			if (text != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(text).Append("\r\n");
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < headers.Count; i++)
			{
				string key = headers.GetKey(i);
				string value = headers.Get(i);
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(key))
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(key).Append(": ").Append(value)
						.Append("\r\n");
				}
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

	internal static class TokenProviderUtility
	{
		private static readonly TimeSpan MaxGetTokenSyncTimeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(15.15);

		internal static IAsyncResult BeginGetMessagingToken(this TokenProvider tokenProvider, Uri namespaceAddress, string appliesTo, string action, bool bypassCache, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			try
			{
				return tokenProvider.BeginGetToken(namespaceAddress, appliesTo, action, bypassCache, timeout, callback, state);
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (!HandleTokenException(exception, out var outException))
				{
					throw;
				}
				throw outException;
			}
		}

		internal static SecurityToken EndGetMessagingToken(this TokenProvider tokenProvider, IAsyncResult result)
		{
			try
			{
				return tokenProvider.EndGetToken(result);
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (!HandleTokenException(exception, out var outException))
				{
					throw;
				}
				throw outException;
			}
		}

		private static bool HandleTokenException(Exception exception, out Exception outException)
		{
			outException = null;
			if (exception is TimeoutException)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (exception is TokenProviderException)
			{
				outException = new MessagingException(exception.Message, exception);
			}
			else
			{
				outException = new UnauthorizedAccessException(exception.Message, exception);
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static SecurityToken GetMessagingToken(this TokenProvider tokenProvider, Uri namespaceAddress, string appliesTo, string action, bool bypassCache, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			try
			{
				TimeSpan timeout2 = TimeoutHelper.Min(timeout, MaxGetTokenSyncTimeout);
				return tokenProvider.EndGetToken(tokenProvider.BeginGetToken(namespaceAddress, appliesTo, action, bypassCache, timeout2, null, null));
			}
			catch (TimeoutException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (TokenProviderException ex2)
			{
				throw new MessagingException(ex2.Message, ex2);
			}
			catch (Exception ex3)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(ex3))
				{
					throw;
				}
				throw new UnauthorizedAccessException(ex3.Message, ex3);
			}
		}

		internal static string GetTokenString(SecurityToken token)
		{
			if (token is SimpleWebSecurityToken simpleWebSecurityToken)
			{
				return simpleWebSecurityToken.Token;
			}
			if (token is JsonSecurityToken jsonSecurityToken)
			{
				return jsonSecurityToken.Token;
			}
			throw Fx.Exception.Argument("token", string.Format("The {0} type is unrecognized. Token type: {1}", "SecurityToken", token.GetType()));
		}

		internal static SecurityToken GetToken(this TokenProvider tokenProvider, string appliesTo, string action, bool bypassCache, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			TimeSpan timeout2 = TimeoutHelper.Min(timeout, MaxGetTokenSyncTimeout);
			return tokenProvider.EndGetToken(tokenProvider.BeginGetToken(appliesTo, action, bypassCache, timeout2, null, null));
		}

		internal static string GetWebToken(this TokenProvider tokenProvider, string appliesTo, string action, bool bypassCache, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			return tokenProvider.EndGetWebToken(tokenProvider.BeginGetWebToken(appliesTo, action, bypassCache, timeout, null, null));
		}

		internal static string GetMessagingWebToken(this TokenProvider tokenProvider, Uri namespaceAddress, string appliesTo, string action, bool bypassCache, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			try
			{
				return tokenProvider.EndGetWebToken(tokenProvider.BeginGetWebToken(namespaceAddress, appliesTo, action, bypassCache, timeout, null, null));
			}
			catch (TimeoutException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (TokenProviderException ex2)
			{
				throw new MessagingException(ex2.Message, ex2);
			}
			catch (Exception ex3)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(ex3))
				{
					throw;
				}
				throw new UnauthorizedAccessException(ex3.Message, ex3);
			}
		}

		internal static TokenProvider CreateTokenProvider(BindingContext context)
		{
			TransportClientEndpointBehavior behavior = context.BindingParameters.Find<TransportClientEndpointBehavior>();
			return CreateTokenProvider(behavior);
		}

		internal static TokenProvider CreateTokenProvider(TransportClientEndpointBehavior behavior)
		{
			return behavior?.TokenProvider;
		}
