	internal abstract class RelayedOnewayTcpClient : CommunicationObject, IConnectionStatus, ITraceSource
	{
		protected enum RelayedOnewayStatus
		{
			Connecting,
			Online,
			Offline
		}

		protected class ConnectRequestReplyContext : IRequestReplyContext, IDisposable
		{
			private readonly RelayedOnewayTcpClient client;

			private readonly object mutex;

			private readonly AutoResetEvent waitEvent;

			private bool disposed;

			private System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message reply;

			public ConnectRequestReplyContext(RelayedOnewayTcpClient client)
			{
				this.client = client;
				mutex = new object();
				waitEvent = new AutoResetEvent(initialState: false);
			}

			public void Complete(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message reply)
			{
				this.reply = reply;
				try
				{
					waitEvent.Set();
				}
				catch (ObjectDisposedException)
				{
				}
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
				lock (mutex)
				{
					if (disposed)
					{
						return;
					}
					disposed = true;
				}
				waitEvent.Close();
				GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
			}

			public void Send(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, TimeSpan timeout, out RelayedOnewayConnection channel)
			{
				TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
				if (message.Headers.MessageId == null)
				{
					message.Headers.MessageId = new UniqueId();
				}
				MessageBuffer messageBuffer = message.CreateBufferedCopy(65536);
				Uri uri = client.Via;
				for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
				{
					RelayedOnewayConnection relayedOnewayConnection = client.GetOrCreateConnection(uri, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
					try
					{
						message = messageBuffer.CreateMessage();
						client.Correlator.Add(message, (IRequestReplyContext)this);
						try
						{
							relayedOnewayConnection.Send(message, timeout);
							if (!waitEvent.WaitOne(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime(), exitContext: false))
							{
								throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new TimeoutException(), client, EventLevel.Warning, "Send", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\RelayedOneway\\RelayedOnewayTcpClient.cs", 869);
							}
						}
						catch (Exception ex)
						{
							if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
							{
								throw;
							}
							ServiceBusEventSource.Log.Error(client, $"Client failed to establish connection. Uri: {uri}, Reason: {ex}.", "Send", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\RelayedOneway\\RelayedOnewayTcpClient.cs", 879);
							client.Correlator.Remove<IRequestReplyContext>(message);
							throw;
						}
						System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message2 = reply;
						reply = null;
						using (message2)
						{
							if (message2.IsFault)
							{
								MessageFault fault = MessageFault.CreateFault(message2, 65536);
								throw ErrorUtility.ConvertToError(fault);
							}
							if (message2.Headers.Action != "Redirect")
							{
								channel = relayedOnewayConnection;
								relayedOnewayConnection = null;
								return;
							}
							RedirectMessage body = message2.GetBody<RedirectMessage>();
							ServiceBusEventSource.Log.Info(client, $"RelayClientConnect Redirected from {uri} to {body.Uri}.", "Send", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\RelayedOneway\\RelayedOnewayTcpClient.cs", 904);
							uri = body.Uri;
						}
					}
					finally
					{
						if (relayedOnewayConnection != null)
						{
							try
							{
								relayedOnewayConnection.Close(client.DefaultCloseTimeout);
							}
							catch (CommunicationException)
							{
								relayedOnewayConnection.Abort();
							}
							catch (TimeoutException)
							{
								relayedOnewayConnection.Abort();
							}
						}
					}
				}
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new CommunicationException(SRClient.MaxRedirectsExceeded(3)), client, EventLevel.Warning, "Send", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\RelayedOneway\\RelayedOnewayTcpClient.cs", 928);
			}
		}

		private class SyncRequestReplyContext : IRequestReplyContext, IDisposable
		{
			private readonly RelayedOnewayTcpClient client;

			private readonly object mutex;

			private readonly AutoResetEvent waitEvent;

			private bool disposed;

			private System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message reply;

			public SyncRequestReplyContext(RelayedOnewayTcpClient client)
			{
				this.client = client;
				mutex = new object();
				waitEvent = new AutoResetEvent(initialState: false);
			}

			public void Complete(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message reply)
			{
				this.reply = reply;
				try
				{
					waitEvent.Set();
				}
				catch (ObjectDisposedException)
				{
				}
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
				lock (mutex)
				{
					if (disposed)
					{
						return;
					}
					disposed = true;
				}
				waitEvent.Close();
				GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
			}

			public System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message Request(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, TimeSpan timeout)
			{
				TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
				if (message.Headers.MessageId == null)
				{
					message.Headers.MessageId = new UniqueId();
				}
				RelayedOnewayConnection relayedOnewayConnection = client.EnsureConnected(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
				client.Correlator.Add(message, (IRequestReplyContext)this);
				try
				{
					relayedOnewayConnection.Send(message, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
					if (!waitEvent.WaitOne(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime(), exitContext: false))
					{
						throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new TimeoutException(), client, EventLevel.Warning, "Request", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\RelayedOneway\\RelayedOnewayTcpClient.cs", 995);
					}
				}
				catch
				{
					client.Correlator.Remove<IRequestReplyContext>(message);
					throw;
				}
				return reply;
			}
		}

		private sealed class AsyncRequestReplyContext : AsyncResult<AsyncRequestReplyContext>, IRequestReplyContext
		{
			private static readonly AsyncCallback sendCallback = SendCallback;

			private static readonly Action<object> onExpiration = OnExpiration;

			private static readonly Action<Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult, Exception> onComplete = OnComplete;

			private readonly RelayedOnewayTcpClient client;

			private readonly System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message;

			private readonly IOThreadTimer expirationTimer;

			private TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper;

			private RelayedOnewayConnection connection;

			public System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message Reply { get; private set; }

			public AsyncRequestReplyContext(RelayedOnewayTcpClient client, System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(callback, state)
			{
				this.client = client;
				if (message.Headers.MessageId == null)
				{
					message.Headers.MessageId = new UniqueId();
				}
				this.message = message;
				timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
				base.OnCompleting = (Action<Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult, Exception>)Delegate.Combine(base.OnCompleting, onComplete);
				expirationTimer = new IOThreadTimer(onExpiration, this, isTypicallyCanceledShortlyAfterBeingSet: false);
				expirationTimer.Set(timeout);
				Start();
			}

			void IRequestReplyContext.Complete(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message reply)
			{
				Reply = reply;
				TryComplete(didCompleteSynchronously: false, null);
			}

			private void Start()
			{
				try
				{
					connection = client.EnsureConnected(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
					client.Correlator.Add(message, (IRequestReplyContext)this);
					IAsyncResult asyncResult = connection.BeginSend(message, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime(), sendCallback, this);
					if (asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
					{
						SendComplete(asyncResult, completedSynchronously: true);
					}
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
					{
						throw;
					}
					TryComplete(didCompleteSynchronously: true, ex);
				}
			}

			private static void SendCallback(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				if (!result.CompletedSynchronously)
				{
					AsyncRequestReplyContext asyncRequestReplyContext = (AsyncRequestReplyContext)result.AsyncState;
					asyncRequestReplyContext.SendComplete(result, completedSynchronously: false);
				}
			}

			private void SendComplete(IAsyncResult result, bool completedSynchronously)
			{
				try
				{
					connection.EndSend(result);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
					{
						throw;
					}
					TryComplete(completedSynchronously, ex);
				}
			}

			private static void OnComplete(Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult result, Exception exception)
			{
				AsyncRequestReplyContext asyncRequestReplyContext = (AsyncRequestReplyContext)result;
				asyncRequestReplyContext.client.Correlator.Remove<IRequestReplyContext>(asyncRequestReplyContext.message);
				asyncRequestReplyContext.expirationTimer.Cancel();
			}

			private static void OnExpiration(object state)
			{
				AsyncRequestReplyContext asyncRequestReplyContext = (AsyncRequestReplyContext)state;
				asyncRequestReplyContext.TryComplete(didCompleteSynchronously: false, new TimeoutException("Failed to receive reply within the specified timeout"));
			}
		}

		private interface IRequestReplyContext
		{
			void Complete(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message response);
		}

		protected abstract class RelayedOnewayConnection
		{
			public abstract Exception LastError { get; }

			public abstract CommunicationState State { get; }

			public Uri Via { get; private set; }

			public event EventHandler Closed;

			public event EventHandler Faulted;

			protected RelayedOnewayConnection(Uri via)
			{
				Via = via;
			}

			public abstract void Abort();

			public abstract void Close(TimeSpan timeout);

			public abstract IAsyncResult BeginReceive(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state);

			public abstract System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message EndReceive(IAsyncResult result);

			public virtual void Send(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, TimeSpan timeout)
			{
				EndSend(BeginSend(message, timeout, null, null));
			}

			public virtual Task SendAsync(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, TimeSpan timeout)
			{
				return TaskHelpers.FromAsync((System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message r, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => ((RelayedOnewayTcpConnection)s).BeginSend(r, t, c, s), delegate(IAsyncResult a)
				{
					((RelayedOnewayTcpConnection)a.AsyncState).EndSend(a);
				}, message, timeout, this);
			}

			public abstract IAsyncResult BeginSend(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state);

			public abstract void EndSend(IAsyncResult result);

			protected void RaiseClosed(object sender, EventArgs args)
			{
				this.Closed?.Invoke(sender, args);
			}

			protected void RaiseFaulted(object sender, EventArgs args)
			{
				this.Faulted?.Invoke(sender, args);
			}
		}

		private sealed class RelayedOnewayTcpConnection : RelayedOnewayConnection
		{
			private readonly RelayedOnewayTcpClient client;

			private readonly IDuplexSessionChannel innerChannel;

			private readonly MessageVersion messageVersion;

			private readonly IOThreadTimer pingTimer;

			private readonly EndpointAddress to;

			private readonly string requiredTokenAction;

			private Exception lastError;

			private int messagesInFlight;

			private SecurityToken activeToken;

			private int getTokenRetryCounter;

			public override Exception LastError => lastError;

			public override CommunicationState State => innerChannel.State;

			private object ThisLock { get; set; }

			private MessageVersion MessageVersion => messageVersion;

			public RelayedOnewayTcpConnection(RelayedOnewayTcpClient client, MessageVersion messageVersion, EndpointAddress to, Uri via)
				: base(via)
			{
				this.client = client;
				this.messageVersion = messageVersion;
				this.to = to;
				innerChannel = client.ChannelFactory.CreateChannel(to, via);
				innerChannel.Closed += OnInnerChannelClosed;
				innerChannel.Closing += OnInnerChannelClosing;
				innerChannel.Faulted += OnInnerChannelFaulted;
				pingTimer = new IOThreadTimer(delegate(object s)
				{
					PingCallbackStatic(s).Fork();
				}, this, isTypicallyCanceledShortlyAfterBeingSet: false);
				ThisLock = new object();
				requiredTokenAction = (this.client.IsListener ? "Listen" : "Send");
			}

			private void OnInnerChannelClosed(object sender, EventArgs args)
			{
				RaiseClosed(this, args);
			}

			private void OnInnerChannelClosing(object sender, EventArgs args)
			{
				pingTimer.Cancel();
			}

			private void OnInnerChannelFaulted(object sender, EventArgs args)
			{
				pingTimer.Cancel();
				if (lastError == null)
				{
					lastError = new CommunicationObjectFaultedException(SR.GetString(Resources.CommunicationObjectFaultedStack2, sender.GetType(), new StackTrace()));
				}
				RaiseFaulted(this, args);
			}

			public override void Abort()
			{
				pingTimer.Cancel();
				innerChannel.Abort();
			}

			public override void Close(TimeSpan timeout)
			{
				innerChannel.Close(timeout);
			}

			public void Open(TimeSpan timeout)
			{
				try
				{
					TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
					innerChannel.Open(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
					SetPing();
				}
				catch (Exception exception)
				{
					if (!Fx.IsFatal(exception))
					{
						lastError = exception;
					}
					throw;
				}
			}

			public override IAsyncResult BeginReceive(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{
				return innerChannel.BeginReceive(timeout, callback, state);
			}

			public override System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message EndReceive(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				return innerChannel.EndReceive(result);
			}

			public override IAsyncResult BeginSend(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{
				if (Interlocked.Increment(ref messagesInFlight) == 1)
				{
					pingTimer.Cancel();
				}
				try
				{
					return innerChannel.BeginSend(message, timeout, callback, state);
				}
				catch
				{
					Interlocked.Decrement(ref messagesInFlight);
					throw;
				}
			}

			public override void EndSend(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				try
				{
					innerChannel.EndSend(result);
				}
				finally
				{
					if (Interlocked.Decrement(ref messagesInFlight) == 0)
					{
						SetPing();
					}
				}
			}

			public override void Send(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, TimeSpan timeout)
			{
				TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
				if (message.Headers.Action != "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2009/05/servicebus/connect/OnewayPing" && message.Headers.FindHeader("RelayAccessToken", "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2009/05/servicebus/connect") == -1)
				{
					RenewTokenIfNeededAsync(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime()).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
				}
				if (Interlocked.Increment(ref messagesInFlight) == 1)
				{
					pingTimer.Cancel();
				}
				try
				{
					innerChannel.Send(message, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
				}
				finally
				{
					if (Interlocked.Decrement(ref messagesInFlight) == 0)
					{
						SetPing();
					}
				}
			}

			private void SetPing()
			{
				if (State == CommunicationState.Opened)
				{
					pingTimer.Set(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30.0));
				}
			}

			private async Task RenewTokenIfNeededAsync(TimeSpan timeout)
			{
				TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
				SecurityToken securityToken = await TryGetNewTokenAsync(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime()).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				bool flag;
				lock (ThisLock)
				{
					flag = securityToken != activeToken;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					await SendPingMessageAsync(securityToken, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime()).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
			}

			private static async Task PingCallbackStatic(object state)
			{
				RelayedOnewayTcpConnection thisPtr = (RelayedOnewayTcpConnection)state;
				if (thisPtr.State == CommunicationState.Opened)
				{
					await thisPtr.SendPingMessageAsync(await thisPtr.TryGetNewTokenAsync(thisPtr.client.timeouts.SendTimeout).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false), thisPtr.client.Timeouts.SendTimeout).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
			}

			private async Task<SecurityToken> TryGetNewTokenAsync(TimeSpan timeout)
			{
				try
				{
					if (client.TokenProvider != null)
					{
						SecurityToken result = await client.TokenProvider.GetTokenAsync(client.AppliesTo, requiredTokenAction, bypassCache: false, timeout).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						getTokenRetryCounter = 0;
						return result;
					}
				}
				catch (Exception ex) when (!Fx.IsFatal(ex))
				{
					if (getTokenRetryCounter > 3)
					{
						ServiceBusEventSource.Log.Warning(client, $"Relay Client failed to acquire token. Source: {base.Via}, IsListener: {client.IsListener}, Action: CloseAndReconnect, Exception: {ex}.", "TryGetNewTokenAsync", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\RelayedOneway\\RelayedOnewayTcpClient.cs", 1419);
						try
						{
							Close(client.timeouts.CloseTimeout);
						}
						catch
						{
							Abort();
						}
					}
					else
					{
						ServiceBusEventSource.Log.Warning(client, $"Relay Client failed to acquire token. Source: {base.Via}, IsListener: {client.IsListener}, Action: Retry, Exception: {ex}.", "TryGetNewTokenAsync", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\RelayedOneway\\RelayedOnewayTcpClient.cs", 1434);
					}
					getTokenRetryCounter++;
				}
				return null;
			}

			private async Task SendPingMessageAsync(SecurityToken token, TimeSpan timeout)
			{
				TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
				bool shouldRenew;
				lock (ThisLock)
				{
					shouldRenew = token != activeToken;
				}
				Exception ex = null;
				try
				{
					System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message = System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message.CreateMessage(MessageVersion, "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2009/05/servicebus/connect/OnewayPing", new OnewayPingMessage());
					to.ApplyTo(message);
					message.Properties.Via = base.Via;
					message.Headers.MessageId = new UniqueId();
					message.Headers.ReplyTo = EndpointAddress2.AnonymousAddress;
					if (shouldRenew && token != null)
					{
						message.Headers.Add(new RelayTokenHeader(token));
					}
					await SendAsync(message, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime()).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					lock (ThisLock)
					{
						if (shouldRenew)
						{
							activeToken = token;
						}
					}
				}
				catch (ObjectDisposedException ex2)
				{
					ex = ex2;
				}
				catch (CommunicationException ex3)
				{
					ex = ex3;
				}
				catch (TimeoutException ex4)
				{
					ex = ex4;
				}
				if (ex != null)
				{
					ServiceBusEventSource.Log.HandledException(ex, client.TrackingContext, "Relay", this, EventLevel.Warning, "SendPingMessageAsync", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\RelayedOneway\\RelayedOnewayTcpClient.cs", 1494);
					Abort();
				}
			}
		}

		protected class ReceivePump
		{
			private static readonly Action<object> startReceivingStatic = StartReceivingStatic;

			private static readonly AsyncCallback receiveCallback = ReceiveCallback;

			private readonly RelayedOnewayConnection connection;

			private readonly RelayedOnewayTcpClient client;

			public ReceivePump(RelayedOnewayConnection connection, RelayedOnewayTcpClient client)
			{
				this.connection = connection;
				this.client = client;
			}

			public void Open()
			{
				try
				{
					IAsyncResult asyncResult = connection.BeginReceive(TimeSpan.MaxValue, receiveCallback, this);
					if (asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
					{
						ReceiveComplete(asyncResult);
					}
				}
				catch
				{
					if (connection.State != CommunicationState.Opened)
					{
						connection.Abort();
						return;
					}
					throw;
				}
			}

			private void StartReceiving()
			{
				try
				{
					IAsyncResult asyncResult = connection.BeginReceive(TimeSpan.MaxValue, receiveCallback, this);
					if (asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
					{
						ReceiveComplete(asyncResult);
					}
				}
				catch
				{
					if (connection.State != CommunicationState.Opened)
					{
						connection.Abort();
					}
					else
					{
						IOThreadScheduler.ScheduleCallbackNoFlow(startReceivingStatic, this);
					}
				}
			}

			private static void StartReceivingStatic(object state)
			{
				((ReceivePump)state).StartReceiving();
			}

			private static void ReceiveCallback(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				if (!result.CompletedSynchronously)
				{
					ReceivePump receivePump = (ReceivePump)result.AsyncState;
					receivePump.ReceiveComplete(result);
				}
			}

			private void ReceiveComplete(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				try
				{
					System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message = connection.EndReceive(result);
					if (message == null)
					{
						connection.Close(client.DefaultCloseTimeout);
						return;
					}
					if (message.Headers.RelatesTo != null)
					{
						IRequestReplyContext requestReplyContext = client.Correlator.Find<IRequestReplyContext>(message, remove: true);
						if (requestReplyContext != null)
						{
							requestReplyContext.Complete(message);
							IOThreadScheduler.ScheduleCallbackNoFlow(startReceivingStatic, this);
							return;
						}
					}
					client.MessageReceived(message, OnMessageDequeued);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
					{
						throw;
					}
					if (connection.State != CommunicationState.Opened)
					{
						connection.Abort();
						return;
					}
					IOThreadScheduler.ScheduleCallbackNoFlow(startReceivingStatic, this);
					Trace.WriteLine(string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "Unknown exception on server: {0}, {1}", ex.GetType(), ex.Message));
				}
			}

			private void OnMessageDequeued()
			{
				IOThreadScheduler.ScheduleCallbackNoFlow(startReceivingStatic, this);
			}
		}

		protected RelayedOnewayTcpClient(BindingContext context, RelayedOnewayTransportBindingElement transportBindingElement, Uri uri, bool transportProtectionEnabled, EventTraceActivity activity)
		{
			this.context = context;
			this.uri = uri;
			bindingElement = transportBindingElement;
			this.transportProtectionEnabled = transportProtectionEnabled;
			messageVersion = context.Binding.MessageVersion;
			timeouts = context.Binding;
			TrackingContext = TrackingContext.Create(activity.ActivityId.ToString(), this.uri, appendRole: false);
			tokenProvider = TokenProviderUtility.CreateTokenProvider(context);
			if (tokenProvider != null)
			{
				this.transportProtectionEnabled = true;
			}
			appliesTo = RelayedHttpUtility.ConvertToHttpUri(uri).AbsoluteUri;
			retryTimer = new IOThreadTimer(retryCallback, this, isTypicallyCanceledShortlyAfterBeingSet: false);
			correlator = new RequestReplyCorrelator();
			connectionStatus = RelayedOnewayStatus.Connecting;
			SetConnectivityModeRelatedParameters(GetInternalConnectivityMode());
		}

		private void SetConnectivityModeRelatedParameters(InternalConnectivityMode mode)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			connectivityMode = mode;
			if (connectivityMode == InternalConnectivityMode.Http || connectivityMode == InternalConnectivityMode.Https)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			UriBuilder uriBuilder = new UriBuilder(uri)
			{
				Scheme = ((flag || mode == InternalConnectivityMode.HttpsWebSocket) ? "sb" : Uri.UriSchemeNetTcp)
			};
			if (!flag && mode != InternalConnectivityMode.HttpsWebSocket)
			{
				uriBuilder.Port = (transportProtectionEnabled ? 9351 : 9350);
			}
			else if (connectivityMode == InternalConnectivityMode.Http)
			{
				uriBuilder.Port = RelayEnvironment.RelayHttpPort;
			}
			else
			{
				uriBuilder.Port = RelayEnvironment.RelayHttpsPort;
				transportProtectionEnabled = false;
			}
			Via = uriBuilder.Uri;
			if (channelFactory != null)
			{
				channelFactory.Abort();
			}
			if (transportProtectionEnabled)
			{
				System.ServiceModel.Channels.Binding binding = CreateSecureNetTcpOnewayBinding(context, bindingElement, new LenientDnsIdentityVerifier(uri.Host));
				ClientCredentials clientCredentials = new ClientCredentials();
				clientCredentials.ServiceCertificate.Authentication.CertificateValidationMode = X509CertificateValidationMode.Custom;
				clientCredentials.ServiceCertificate.Authentication.CustomCertificateValidator = RetriableCertificateValidator.Instance;
				BindingParameterCollection parameters = new BindingParameterCollection { clientCredentials };
				channelFactory = binding.BuildChannelFactory<IDuplexSessionChannel>(parameters);
				channelFactory.Open();
			}
			else
			{
				System.ServiceModel.Channels.Binding binding2 = CreateNetTcpOnewayBinding(context, bindingElement);
				channelFactory = binding2.BuildChannelFactory<IDuplexSessionChannel>(Array.Empty<object>());
				channelFactory.Open();
			}
		}

		private InternalConnectivityMode GetInternalConnectivityMode()
		{
			ConnectivitySettings connectivitySettings = context.BindingParameters.Find<ConnectivitySettings>();
			HttpConnectivitySettings httpConnectivitySettings = context.BindingParameters.Find<HttpConnectivitySettings>();
			return ConnectivityModeHelper.GetInternalConnectivityMode(connectivitySettings, httpConnectivitySettings, uri);
		}

		private System.ServiceModel.Channels.Binding CreateNetTcpOnewayBinding(BindingContext context, RelayedOnewayTransportBindingElement transportBindingElement)
		{
			BinaryMessageEncodingBindingElement binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement = ClientMessageUtility.CreateInnerEncodingBindingElement(context);
			System.ServiceModel.Channels.Binding binding;
			if (connectivityMode == InternalConnectivityMode.HttpsWebSocket)
			{
				WebSocketOnewayClientConnectionElement connectionElement = new WebSocketOnewayClientConnectionElement(SocketSecurityRole.None, "wsrelayedoneway", context.BindingParameters);
				SocketConnectionBindingElement socketConnectionBindingElement = new SocketConnectionBindingElement(connectionElement, enableKeepAlive: false)

				binding = new CustomBinding(binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement, socketConnectionBindingElement);
			}
			else if (connectivityMode == InternalConnectivityMode.Http || connectivityMode == InternalConnectivityMode.Https)
			{
				bool flag = connectivityMode == InternalConnectivityMode.Https;
				SocketSecurityRole socketSecurityMode = ((!flag) ? SocketSecurityRole.SslClient : SocketSecurityRole.None);
				WebStreamOnewayClientConnectionElement connectionElement2 = new WebStreamOnewayClientConnectionElement(socketSecurityMode, "oneway", flag);
				SocketConnectionBindingElement socketConnectionBindingElement2 = new SocketConnectionBindingElement(connectionElement2, enableKeepAlive: false)

				};

				socketConnectionBindingElement2.ConnectionPoolSettings.IdleTimeout = transportBindingElement.ConnectionPoolSettings.IdleTimeout;
				socketConnectionBindingElement2.ConnectionPoolSettings.LeaseTimeout = transportBindingElement.ConnectionPoolSettings.LeaseTimeout;
				socketConnectionBindingElement2.ConnectionPoolSettings.MaxOutboundConnectionsPerEndpoint = transportBindingElement.ConnectionPoolSettings.MaxOutboundConnectionsPerEndpoint;
				binding = new CustomBinding(binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement, socketConnectionBindingElement2);
			}
			else
			{
				TcpTransportBindingElement tcpTransportBindingElement = new TcpTransportBindingElement
				{
					PortSharingEnabled = false,
					ListenBacklog = transportBindingElement.ListenBacklog,
					ChannelInitializationTimeout = transportBindingElement.ChannelInitializationTimeout,
					ConnectionBufferSize = transportBindingElement.ConnectionBufferSize,
					MaxBufferPoolSize = transportBindingElement.MaxBufferPoolSize,
					MaxBufferSize = transportBindingElement.MaxBufferSize,

					TransferMode = TransferMode.Buffered,

				};
				tcpTransportBindingElement.ConnectionPoolSettings.GroupName = transportBindingElement.ConnectionPoolSettings.GroupName;
				tcpTransportBindingElement.ConnectionPoolSettings.IdleTimeout = transportBindingElement.ConnectionPoolSettings.IdleTimeout;
				tcpTransportBindingElement.ConnectionPoolSettings.LeaseTimeout = transportBindingElement.ConnectionPoolSettings.LeaseTimeout;
				tcpTransportBindingElement.ConnectionPoolSettings.MaxOutboundConnectionsPerEndpoint = transportBindingElement.ConnectionPoolSettings.MaxOutboundConnectionsPerEndpoint;
				binding = new CustomBinding(binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement, tcpTransportBindingElement);

		protected override void OnAbort()
		{
			if (connection != null)
			{
				connection.Abort();
			}
			channelFactory.Abort();
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
			if (connection != null)
			{
				connection.Close(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
			}
			return channelFactory.BeginClose(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime(), callback, state);
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginOpen(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			EnsureConnected(timeout, isRetry: false);
			return new CompletedAsyncResult(callback, state);
		}

		protected override void OnClose(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
			if (connection != null)
			{
				connection.Close(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
			}
			channelFactory.Close(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
		}

		protected override void OnEndClose(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			channelFactory.EndClose(result);
		}

		protected override void OnEndOpen(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			CompletedAsyncResult.End(result);
		}

		protected override void OnOpen(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			EnsureConnected(timeout, isRetry: false);
		}

		private void EnsureConnected()
		{
			EnsureConnected(timeouts.OpenTimeout);
		}

		private RelayedOnewayConnection EnsureConnected(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			return EnsureConnected(timeout, isRetry: true);
		}

		private RelayedOnewayConnection EnsureConnected(TimeSpan timeout, bool isRetry)
		{
			lock (base.ThisLock)
			{
				if (connection != null)
				{
					if (connection.State == CommunicationState.Opened)
					{
						return connection;
					}
					connection.Abort();
					connection = null;
				}
				try
				{
					ServiceBusEventSource.Log.Info(this, string.Format("{0}: Connecting. Uri: {1}", IsListener ? "Listener" : "Sender", Uri), "EnsureConnected", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\RelayedOneway\\RelayedOnewayTcpClient.cs", 483);
					RelayedOnewayConnection result = Connect(timeout);
					Connected(result);
					return result;
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
					{
						throw;
					}
					if (connectSleep == TimeSpan.Zero)
					{
						connectSleep = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2.5);
					}
					else if (connectSleep < TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10.0))
					{
						connectSleep = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(connectSleep.TotalSeconds * 2.0);
					}
					Disconnected(ex, isRetry);
					throw;
				}
			}
		}

		protected abstract RelayedOnewayConnection Connect(TimeSpan timeout);

		protected virtual RelayedOnewayConnection GetOrCreateConnection(Uri via, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			lock (base.ThisLock)
			{
				if (connection != null)
				{
					if (connection.Via == via && connection.State == CommunicationState.Opened)
					{
						return connection;
					}
					connection.Abort();
				}
				ThrowIfDisposed();
				RelayedOnewayTcpConnection relayedOnewayTcpConnection = new RelayedOnewayTcpConnection(this, messageVersion, new EndpointAddress(uri), via);
				try
				{
					relayedOnewayTcpConnection.Open(timeout);
				}
				catch (Exception exception)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
					{
						throw;
					}
					relayedOnewayTcpConnection.Abort();
					throw;
				}
				receivePump = new ReceivePump(relayedOnewayTcpConnection, this);
				receivePump.Open();
				return relayedOnewayTcpConnection;
			}
		}

		private static void RetryCallback(object state)
		{
			RelayedOnewayTcpClient relayedOnewayTcpClient = (RelayedOnewayTcpClient)state;
			try
			{
				relayedOnewayTcpClient.EnsureConnected();
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				ServiceBusEventSource.Log.HandledException(exception, relayedOnewayTcpClient, EventLevel.Warning, "RetryCallback", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\RelayedOneway\\RelayedOnewayTcpClient.cs", 572);
			}
		}

		private void ChannelClosed(object sender, EventArgs args)
		{
			RelayedOnewayConnection relayedOnewayConnection = connection;
			if (relayedOnewayConnection != null)
			{
				Disconnected(relayedOnewayConnection.LastError, isRetry: false);
			}
		}

		private void ChannelFaulted(object sender, EventArgs args)
		{
			connection?.Abort();
		}

		private void Connected(RelayedOnewayConnection connection)
		{
			connectSleep = TimeSpan.Zero;
			this.connection = connection;
			if (this.connection == null)
			{
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new ArgumentException(SRClient.InvalidChannelType), this, EventLevel.Warning, "Connected", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\RelayedOneway\\RelayedOnewayTcpClient.cs", 602);
			}
			this.connection.Closed += ChannelClosed;
			this.connection.Faulted += ChannelFaulted;
			if (this.connection.State == CommunicationState.Closed)
			{
				ChannelClosed(this.connection, EventArgs.Empty);
				return;
			}
			if (this.connection.State == CommunicationState.Faulted)
			{
				ChannelFaulted(this.connection, EventArgs.Empty);
				return;
			}
			ServiceBusEventSource.Log.Info(this, (IsListener ? "Listener" : "Sender") + ": Connected", "Connected", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\RelayedOneway\\RelayedOnewayTcpClient.cs", 620);
			SetStatus(RelayedOnewayStatus.Online, null);
		}

		private void Disconnected(Exception error, bool isRetry)
		{
			RelayedOnewayStatus status;
			lock (base.ThisLock)
			{
				string arg = (IsListener ? "Listener" : "Sender");
				ServiceBusEventSource.Log.Info(this, $"{arg}: Disconnected. Uri: {Uri} {error?.ToStringSlim()}", "Disconnected", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\RelayedOneway\\RelayedOnewayTcpClient.cs", 631);
				if (base.State == CommunicationState.Opened && ErrorUtility.CanRetry(error))
				{
					status = RelayedOnewayStatus.Connecting;
					if (isRetry)
					{
						NetworkDetector.Reset();
						try
						{
							InternalConnectivityMode internalConnectivityMode = GetInternalConnectivityMode();
							ServiceBusEventSource.Log.Info(this, $"{arg}: detected ConnectivityMode: {internalConnectivityMode}", "Disconnected", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\RelayedOneway\\RelayedOnewayTcpClient.cs", 643);
							if (internalConnectivityMode != connectivityMode)
							{
								SetConnectivityModeRelatedParameters(internalConnectivityMode);
							}
						}
						catch (Exception ex)
						{
							if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
							{
								throw;
							}
							error = ex;
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					status = RelayedOnewayStatus.Offline;
				}
			}
			SetStatus(status, error);
			lock (base.ThisLock)
			{
				if (base.State != CommunicationState.Closing && base.State != CommunicationState.Closed && connectionStatus == RelayedOnewayStatus.Connecting)
				{
					retryTimer.Set(connectSleep);
				}
			}
		}

		private void RaiseEvent()
		{
			EventHandler eventHandler = null;
			switch (connectionStatus)
			{
			case RelayedOnewayStatus.Connecting:
				eventHandler = this.Connecting;
				break;
			case RelayedOnewayStatus.Online:
				eventHandler = this.Online;
				break;
			case RelayedOnewayStatus.Offline:
				eventHandler = this.Offline;
				break;
			}
			eventHandler?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		protected virtual void MessageReceived(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, Action dequeuedCallback)
		{
			message.Close();
			dequeuedCallback();
		}

		private bool SetConnectionStatus(RelayedOnewayStatus status, Exception error)
		{
			if (connectionStatus != status || error != null)
			{
				connectionStatus = status;
				connectionError = error;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected void SetStatus(RelayedOnewayStatus status, Exception error)
		{
			if (SetConnectionStatus(status, error))
			{
				RaiseEvent();
			}
		}

		private static Type GetErrorType(Exception error)
		{
			return error?.GetType();
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginRequest(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new AsyncRequestReplyContext(this, message, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginSend(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return BeginRequest(message, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		public static System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message EndRequest(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			return AsyncResult<AsyncRequestReplyContext>.End(result).Reply;
		}

		public void EndSend(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message = EndRequest(result);
			using (message)
			{
				if (message.IsFault)
				{
					MessageFault fault = MessageFault.CreateFault(message, 65536);
					throw ErrorUtility.ConvertToError(fault);
				}
			}
		}

		public System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message Request(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			using SyncRequestReplyContext syncRequestReplyContext = new SyncRequestReplyContext(this);
			return syncRequestReplyContext.Request(message, timeout);
		}

		public void Send(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message2 = Request(message, timeout);
			using (message2)
			{
				if (message2.IsFault)
				{
					MessageFault fault = MessageFault.CreateFault(message2, 65536);
					throw ErrorUtility.ConvertToError(fault);
				}
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (toString == null)
			{
				toString = GetType().Name + "(" + TrackingContext.SystemTracker + ")";
			}
			return toString;
		}

	internal class RelayedOnewayListener : RefcountedCommunicationObject, IRelayedOnewayListener, ICommunicationObject, IConnectionStatus
	{
		private class RelayedOnewayAmqpListenerClient : RelayedOnewayTcpClient
		{
			private class AmqpRelayedConnection : RelayedOnewayConnection
			{
				private readonly RelayedOnewayAmqpListenerClient client;

				private readonly AmqpRelay amqpRelay;

				private readonly InputQueue<System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message> receivedMessages;

				private CommunicationState communicationState;

				public override Exception LastError => amqpRelay.LastError;

				public override CommunicationState State => communicationState;

				public AmqpRelayedConnection(RelayedOnewayAmqpListenerClient client, Uri via, ConnectivitySettings connectivitySettings, HttpConnectivitySettings httpConnectivitySettings)
					: base(via)
				{
					communicationState = CommunicationState.Created;
					this.client = client;
					receivedMessages = new InputQueue<System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message>();
					amqpRelay = new AmqpRelay(client.Uri, client.TokenProvider, connectivitySettings, httpConnectivitySettings, client.TransportBehavior, client.TrackingContext);
					amqpRelay.Connecting += delegate(object s, EventArgs e)
					{
						RaiseClosed(this, e);
					};
					amqpRelay.Offline += delegate(object s, EventArgs e)
					{
						RaiseFaulted(this, e);
					};
					amqpRelay.Online += delegate(object s, EventArgs e)
					{
						OnOnline(this, e);
					};
					ServiceSettings serviceSettings = client.listener.nameSettings.ServiceSettings;
					if (serviceSettings.RelayClientAuthenticationType == RelayClientAuthenticationType.None)
					{
						amqpRelay.RelayClientAuthorizationRequired = false;
					}
					amqpRelay.DisplayName = client.listener.nameSettings.DisplayName;
					amqpRelay.ListenerType = serviceSettings.ListenerType;
					amqpRelay.IsDynamic = serviceSettings.IsDynamic;
					if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(serviceSettings.ClientAgent))
					{
						amqpRelay.ClientAgent = serviceSettings.ClientAgent;
					}
					amqpRelay.PublishToRegistry = serviceSettings.IsDiscoverable;
					amqpRelay.TransportSecurityRequired = serviceSettings.TransportProtection == RelayTransportProtectionMode.EndToEnd;
				}

				public override void Abort()
				{
					try
					{
						amqpRelay.Abort();
					}
					finally
					{
						receivedMessages.Close();
						OnClosed();
					}
				}

				public override void Close(TimeSpan timeout)
				{
					try
					{
						communicationState = CommunicationState.Closing;
						amqpRelay.CloseAsync(timeout).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false).GetAwaiter()
							.GetResult();
					}
					finally
					{
						receivedMessages.Close();
						OnClosed();
					}
				}

				public void Open(TimeSpan timeout)
				{
					communicationState = CommunicationState.Opening;
					amqpRelay.RegisterMessageListener(OnMessageReceived);
					bool flag = false;
					try
					{
						amqpRelay.OpenAsync(timeout).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false).GetAwaiter()
							.GetResult();
						flag = true;
						OnOpened();
					}
					finally
					{
						if (!flag)
						{
							OnFaulted();
						}
					}
				}

				public override IAsyncResult BeginReceive(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				{
					return receivedMessages.BeginDequeue(timeout, callback, state);
				}

				public override System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message EndReceive(IAsyncResult result)
				{
					return receivedMessages.EndDequeue(result);
				}

				public override IAsyncResult BeginSend(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				{
					throw new NotImplementedException();
				}

				public override void EndSend(IAsyncResult result)
				{
					throw new NotImplementedException();
				}

				private void OnMessageReceived(DuplexAmqpLink link, AmqpMessage amqpMessage)
				{
					try
					{
						Fx.AssertAndThrow(amqpMessage.BodyType == SectionFlag.Data, "Only 'Data' type is supported!");
						Data data = null;
						foreach (Data item2 in amqpMessage.DataBody)
						{
							Fx.AssertAndThrow(data == null, "Serialization of AMQP messages with multiple body frames is not implemented.");
							data = item2;
						}
						ArraySegment<byte> buffer = (ArraySegment<byte>)data.Value;
						System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message item = client.encoder.ReadMessage(buffer, client.bufferManager);
						receivedMessages.EnqueueAndDispatch(item);
						amqpMessage.Link.DisposeDelivery(amqpMessage, settled: true, AmqpConstants.AcceptedOutcome);
					}
					catch (Exception exception)
					{
						if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
						{
							throw;
						}
						ServiceBusEventSource.Log.HandledException(exception, client, EventLevel.Warning, "OnMessageReceived", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\RelayedOneway\\RelayedOnewayTcpListener.cs", 470);
					}
				}

				private void OnOnline(object sender, EventArgs args)
				{
					client.SetStatus(RelayedOnewayStatus.Online, null);
				}

				private void OnOpened()
				{
					communicationState = CommunicationState.Opened;
				}

				private void OnClosed()
				{
					communicationState = CommunicationState.Closed;
					RaiseClosed(this, EventArgs.Empty);
				}

				private void OnFaulted()
				{
					communicationState = CommunicationState.Faulted;
					RaiseFaulted(this, EventArgs.Empty);
				}
			}

			private readonly RelayedOnewayListener listener;

			private readonly MessageWrapper messageWrapper;

			private readonly MessageEncoder encoder;

			private readonly BufferManager bufferManager;

			private readonly ConnectivitySettings connectivitySettings;

			private readonly HttpConnectivitySettings httpConnectivitySettings;

			internal TransportClientEndpointBehavior TransportBehavior { get; }

			public RelayedOnewayAmqpListenerClient(BindingContext context, RelayedOnewayTransportBindingElement transportBindingElement, Uri uri, RelayedOnewayListener listener, EventTraceActivity activity)
				: base(context, transportBindingElement, uri, transportProtectionEnabled: true, activity)
			{
				this.listener = listener;
				BinaryMessageEncodingBindingElement binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement = ClientMessageUtility.CreateInnerEncodingBindingElement(context);
				encoder = binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement.CreateMessageEncoderFactory().Encoder;
				messageWrapper = new MessageWrapper(encoder);
				bufferManager = BufferManager.CreateBufferManager(transportBindingElement.MaxBufferPoolSize, transportBindingElement.MaxBufferSize);
				base.IsListener = true;
				connectivitySettings = context.BindingParameters.Find<ConnectivitySettings>();
				httpConnectivitySettings = context.BindingParameters.Find<HttpConnectivitySettings>();
				TransportBehavior = context.BindingParameters.Find<TransportClientEndpointBehavior>();
			}

			protected override RelayedOnewayConnection Connect(TimeSpan timeout)
			{
				return GetOrCreateConnection(base.Via, timeout);
			}

			protected override RelayedOnewayConnection GetOrCreateConnection(Uri via, TimeSpan timeout)
			{
				AmqpRelayedConnection amqpRelayedConnection = null;
				bool flag = false;
				try
				{
					amqpRelayedConnection = new AmqpRelayedConnection(this, via, connectivitySettings, httpConnectivitySettings);
					amqpRelayedConnection.Open(timeout);
					new ReceivePump(amqpRelayedConnection, this).Open();
					flag = true;
					return amqpRelayedConnection;
				}
				finally
				{
					if (!flag)
					{
						amqpRelayedConnection?.Abort();
					}
				}
			}

			protected override void MessageReceived(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, Action dequeuedCallback)
			{
				RelayViaHeader relayViaHeader = RelayViaHeader.ReadHeader(message);
				message = messageWrapper.UnwrapMessage(message);
				if (relayViaHeader != null)
				{
					message.Properties.Via = relayViaHeader.Via;
				}
				ServiceBusEventSource.Log.Info(base.TrackingContext, "Relay", this, "Listener: ControlMessage: " + message.Headers.Action, "MessageReceived", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\RelayedOneway\\RelayedOnewayTcpListener.cs", 293);
				RelayedOnewayChannelListener[] array = listener.Lookup(message.Properties.Via);
				if (array == null || array.Length == 0)
				{
					ServiceBusEventSource.Log.Warning(this, $"Listener: failed to dispatch message. Listener Uri: {base.Uri} Message Uri: {message.Properties.Via}.", "MessageReceived", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\RelayedOneway\\RelayedOnewayTcpListener.cs", 297);
					message.Close();
					dequeuedCallback();
					return;
				}
				if (array.Length == 1)
				{
					array[0].EnqueueAndDispatch(message, dequeuedCallback);
					return;
				}
				Action dequeuedCallback2 = dequeuedCallback;
				MessageBuffer messageBuffer = message.CreateBufferedCopy(65536);
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					array[i].EnqueueAndDispatch(messageBuffer.CreateMessage(), dequeuedCallback2);
					dequeuedCallback2 = null;
				}
			}
		}

		public void Register(RelayedOnewayChannelListener channelListener)
		{
			lock (base.ThisLock)
			{
				if (listenerTable.TryLookupUri(channelListener.Uri, hostNameComparisonMode, out var item) && item.Uri == channelListener.Uri)
				{
					if (!item.Multicast)
					{
						throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new AddressAlreadyInUseException(), null, "Relay", this, EventLevel.Warning, "Register", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\RelayedOneway\\RelayedOnewayTcpListener.cs", 110);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					item = new RelayedOnewayChannelListenerCollection(channelListener.Uri, channelListener.NameSettings.ServiceSettings.ListenerType == ListenerType.Multicast);
					listenerTable.RegisterUri(channelListener.Uri, hostNameComparisonMode, item);
				}
				item.AddListener(channelListener);
				AddRef();
			}
		}

		public void Unregister(RelayedOnewayChannelListener channelListener)
		{
			lock (base.ThisLock)
			{
				if (listenerTable.TryLookupUri(channelListener.Uri, hostNameComparisonMode, out var item) && item.Uri == channelListener.Uri)
				{
					item.RemoveListener(channelListener);
					if (item.Count == 0)
					{
						listenerTable.UnregisterUri(channelListener.Uri, hostNameComparisonMode);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public RelayedOnewayChannelListener[] Lookup(Uri uri)
		{
			lock (base.ThisLock)
			{
				if (listenerTable.TryLookupUri(uri, hostNameComparisonMode, out var item))
				{
					return item.GetListeners();
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public override IChannelFactory<TChannel> BuildChannelFactory<TChannel>(BindingContext context)
		{
			if (context == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("context");
			}
			if (!CanBuildChannelFactory<TChannel>(context))
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.Argument("TChannel", SR.GetString(Resources.ChannelTypeNotSupported, typeof(TChannel)));
			}
			return new SocketConnectionChannelFactory<TChannel>(this, context, enableKeepAlive);
		}

		public override IChannelListener<TChannel> BuildChannelListener<TChannel>(BindingContext context)
		{
			if (context == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("context");
			}
			if (!CanBuildChannelListener<TChannel>(context))
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.Argument("TChannel", SR.GetString(Resources.ChannelTypeNotSupported, typeof(TChannel)));
			}
			SocketConnectionChannelListener socketConnectionChannelListener;
			if (typeof(TChannel) == typeof(IReplyChannel))
			{
				socketConnectionChannelListener = new SocketConnectionReplyChannelListener(this, context);
			}
			else
			{
				if (!(typeof(TChannel) == typeof(IDuplexSessionChannel)))
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.Argument("TChannel", SR.GetString(Resources.ChannelTypeNotSupported, typeof(TChannel)));
				}
				socketConnectionChannelListener = new SocketConnectionDuplexChannelListener(this, context);
			}
			return (IChannelListener<TChannel>)socketConnectionChannelListener;
		}

		public override T GetProperty<T>(BindingContext context)
		{
			if (context == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("context");
			}
			if (typeof(T) == typeof(IBindingDeliveryCapabilities))
			{
				return (T)(object)new BindingDeliveryCapabilitiesHelper();
			}
			if (typeof(T) == typeof(ISecurityCapabilities))
			{
				return (T)(object)new SecurityCapabilitiesHelper(SocketSecurityRole);
			}
			return base.GetProperty<T>(context);
		}

		internal override bool IsMatch(BindingElement b)
		{
			if (!base.IsMatch(b))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(b is SocketConnectionBindingElement socketConnectionBindingElement))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (listenBacklog != socketConnectionBindingElement.listenBacklog)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (teredoEnabled != socketConnectionBindingElement.teredoEnabled)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (connectionElement != socketConnectionBindingElement.ConnectionElement)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (SocketSecurityRole != socketConnectionBindingElement.SocketSecurityRole)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!connectionPoolSettings.IsMatch(socketConnectionBindingElement.connectionPoolSettings))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

	internal class RelayedSocketElement : IConnectionElement, ISecureableConnectionElement
	{
		private static readonly Dictionary<NameSettings, System.ServiceModel.Channels.Binding> bindingTable = new Dictionary<NameSettings, System.ServiceModel.Channels.Binding>();

		private static readonly UriPrefixTable<ITransportManagerRegistration> transportManagerTable = new UriPrefixTable<ITransportManagerRegistration>(includePortInComparison: true);

		private readonly BindingContext context;

		private readonly RelayedSocketListener connectionListener;

		private readonly ConnectivitySettings connectivitySettings;

		public SocketSecurityRole SecurityMode { get; }

		public UriPrefixTable<ITransportManagerRegistration> TransportManagerTable => transportManagerTable;

		internal Guid ActivityId { get; }

		internal NameSettings NameSettings { get; }

		internal SslProtocols? SslProtocolOverride { get; }

		internal TokenProvider TokenProvider { get; }

		public RelayedSocketElement(BindingContext context, NameSettings nameSettings, TokenProvider tokenProvider, SocketSecurityRole socketSecurityMode, SslProtocols? sslProtocolOverride = null)
		{
			this.context = context;
			NameSettings = nameSettings;
			TokenProvider = tokenProvider;
			SecurityMode = socketSecurityMode;
			SslProtocolOverride = sslProtocolOverride;
			ActivityId = context.BindingParameters.Find<TransportClientEndpointBehavior>()?.ActivityId ?? Guid.NewGuid();
			connectivitySettings = this.context.BindingParameters.Find<ConnectivitySettings>() ?? ServiceBusEnvironment.SystemConnectivity;
			HttpConnectivitySettings httpConnectivitySettings = this.context.BindingParameters.Find<HttpConnectivitySettings>();
			ConnectivitySettingsEndpointBehavior connectivitySettingsEndpointBehavior = new ConnectivitySettingsEndpointBehavior(connectivitySettings, httpConnectivitySettings);
			connectionListener = new RelayedSocketListener(this, connectivitySettingsEndpointBehavior, context);
		}

		public IConnectionInitiator CreateInitiator(int bufferSize)
		{
			return new RelayedSocketInitiator(connectivitySettings, bufferSize, TokenProvider, SecurityMode, SslProtocolOverride);
		}

		public IConnectionListener CreateListener(int bufferSize, Uri uri)
		{
			System.ServiceModel.Channels.Binding binding = GetBinding();
			connectionListener.Initialize(bufferSize, uri, binding);
			return connectionListener;
		}

		public bool IsCompatible(IConnectionElement element)
		{
			if (!(element is RelayedSocketElement relayedSocketElement))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return NameSettings.IsCompatible(relayedSocketElement.NameSettings);
		}

		public T GetProperty<T>() where T : class
		{
			if (typeof(T) == typeof(IConnectionStatus))
			{
				return (T)connectionListener.ConnectionStatus;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private System.ServiceModel.Channels.Binding GetBinding()
		{
			lock (bindingTable)
			{
				if (!bindingTable.TryGetValue(NameSettings, out var value))
				{
					RelayedOnewayTransportBindingElement relayedOnewayTransportBindingElement = RelayedOnewayTransportBindingElement.CreateOnewayTransportBindingElement(context, NameSettings.ServiceSettings.RelayClientAuthenticationType, RelayedOnewayConnectionMode.Unicast);
					value = new CustomBinding(ClientMessageUtility.CreateInnerEncodingBindingElement(context), relayedOnewayTransportBindingElement);
					value.CloseTimeout = context.Binding.CloseTimeout;
					value.Name = context.Binding.Name;
					value.Namespace = context.Binding.Namespace;
					value.OpenTimeout = context.Binding.OpenTimeout;
					value.ReceiveTimeout = context.Binding.ReceiveTimeout;
					value.SendTimeout = context.Binding.SendTimeout;
					bindingTable.Add(NameSettings, value);
				}
				return value;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class RelayedSocketInitiator : IConnectionInitiator
	{
		private const int MaxRedirectDepth = 3;

		private readonly int bufferSize;

		private readonly SocketMessageHelper messageHelper;

		private readonly SocketSecurityRole socketSecurityMode;

		private readonly TokenProvider tokenProvider;

		private readonly ConnectivitySettings connectivitySettings;

		private readonly SslProtocols? sslProtocolOverride;

		public RelayedSocketInitiator(ConnectivitySettings connectivitySettings, int bufferSize, TokenProvider tokenProvider, SocketSecurityRole socketSecurityMode, SslProtocols? sslProtocolOverride)
		{
			this.connectivitySettings = connectivitySettings;
			this.bufferSize = bufferSize;
			this.tokenProvider = tokenProvider;
			this.socketSecurityMode = socketSecurityMode;
			this.sslProtocolOverride = sslProtocolOverride;
			if (this.tokenProvider != null)
			{
				this.socketSecurityMode = SocketSecurityRole.SslClient;
			}
			messageHelper = new SocketMessageHelper();
		}

		public IConnection Connect(Uri uri, TrackingContext trackingContext, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			return ConnectAsync(uri, trackingContext, timeout).CompleteSynchronously();
		}

		private async Task<IConnection> ConnectAsync(Uri uri, TrackingContext trackingContext, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateOnly(timeout);
			Uri via = uri;
			OperationContext operationContext = OperationContext.Current;
			for (int attempts = 0; attempts < 3; attempts++)
			{
				Socket socket = new Socket(AddressFamily.InterNetwork, SocketType.Stream, ProtocolType.Tcp);
				bool succeeded = false;
				try
				{
					string text = via.Host;
					if (via.HostNameType == UriHostNameType.Dns)
					{
						text = await connectivitySettings.ResolveDnsAsync(via.Scheme, via.Host, 9352).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						IPHostEntry iPHostEntry = DnsCache.Resolve(text);
						if (iPHostEntry != null && iPHostEntry.AddressList.Length != 0)
						{
							text = iPHostEntry.AddressList[0].ToString();
						}
					}
					await TaskHelpers.FromAsync((string h, AsyncCallback c, object s) => ((Socket)s).BeginConnect(h, 9352, c, s), delegate(IAsyncResult a)
					{
						((Socket)a.AsyncState).EndConnect(a);
					}, text, socket).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					IConnection connection = new SocketConnection(socket, bufferSize, trackingContext);
					byte[] bytes = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("connect");
					byte[] bytes2 = BitConverter.GetBytes(bytes.Length);
					byte[] bytes3 = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(via.ToString());
					byte[] bytes4 = BitConverter.GetBytes(bytes3.Length);
					byte[] array = ((socketSecurityMode == SocketSecurityRole.None) ? ConnectConstants.NoSsl : ConnectConstants.UseSsl);
					using (MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream(bytes2.Length + bytes.Length + bytes4.Length + bytes3.Length + array.Length))
					{
						memoryStream.Write(bytes2, 0, bytes2.Length);
						memoryStream.Write(bytes, 0, bytes.Length);
						memoryStream.Write(bytes4, 0, bytes4.Length);
						memoryStream.Write(bytes3, 0, bytes3.Length);
						memoryStream.Write(array, 0, array.Length);
						byte[] buffer = memoryStream.GetBuffer();
						await connection.WriteAsync(new ArraySegment<byte>(buffer), immediate: true, timeout).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					}
					connection = await SecureSocketUtil.InitiateSecureClientUpgradeIfNeededAsync(connection, null, socketSecurityMode, uri.Host, sendControlByte: false, sslProtocolOverride, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime()).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					ConnectMessage body = ClientMessageUtility.CreateConnectMessage(uri, operationContext);
					System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message = System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message.CreateMessage(messageHelper.MessageVersion, "RelayedConnect", body);
					TrackingIdHeader.TryAddOrUpdate(message.Headers, trackingContext.TrackingId);
					if (tokenProvider != null)
					{
						SecurityToken token = await tokenProvider.GetTokenAsync(RelayedHttpUtility.ConvertToHttpUri(uri).ToString(), "Send", bypassCache: false, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime()).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						message.Headers.Add(new RelayTokenHeader(token));
					}
					await messageHelper.SendMessageAsync(connection, message, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime()).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message2 = await messageHelper.ReceiveMessageAsync(connection, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime()).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					using (message2)
					{
						if (message2.Headers.Action == "Redirect")
						{
							RedirectMessage body2 = message2.GetBody<RedirectMessage>();
							via = body2.Uri;
							socket.Close();
							continue;
						}
						if (message2.IsFault)
						{
							MessageFault fault = MessageFault.CreateFault(message2, 65536);
							throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(ErrorUtility.ConvertToError(fault), trackingContext, "Relay", this, EventLevel.Warning, "ConnectAsync", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\RelayedConnection\\RelayedSocketInitiator.cs", 144);
						}
					}
					succeeded = true;
					return connection;
				}
				finally
				{
					if (!succeeded)
					{
						socket.Close();
					}
				}
			}
			throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new CommunicationException(SRClient.MaxRedirectsExceeded(3)), trackingContext, "Relay", this, EventLevel.Warning, "ConnectAsync", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\RelayedConnection\\RelayedSocketInitiator.cs", 161);
		}

		}

		public void Close(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
			List<RelayedConnectionSession> list;
			lock (ThisLock)

				if (isClosed)
				{
					return;
				}
				isClosed = true;
				list = new List<RelayedConnectionSession>(connectionSessions.Values);
				connectionSessions.Clear();
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				list[i].Close();
			}
			serviceHost.Close(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
			socketQueue.Close();
		}

			List<RelayedConnectionSession> list;

			socketQueue.Close();

			}
			relayedConnectionSession.Close();
		}

		IAsyncResult IRelayedConnectionControl.BeginConnect(RelayedConnectMessage request, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			Guid id = new Guid(request.Id);
			TrackingContext trackingContext = TrackingContext.Create(request.Id, uri, appendRole: false);
			ServiceBusEventSource.Log.Info(trackingContext, "Relay", this, $"Listener: Received a connection request. Source: {uri}, ConnectionId: {request.Id}, Rendezvous Address: {request.TcpEndpoint.ToHostPortString()}.", "BeginConnect", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\RelayedConnection\\RelayedSocketListener.cs", 205);
			RelayedConnectionSession relayedConnectionSession;
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (isClosed)
				{
					throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new FaultException(SRClient.EndpointNotFoundFault), trackingContext, "Relay", this, EventLevel.Warning, "BeginConnect", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\RelayedConnection\\RelayedSocketListener.cs", 211);
				}

					throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new FaultException(SRClient.DuplicateConnectionIDFault), trackingContext, "Relay", this, EventLevel.Warning, "BeginConnect", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\RelayedConnection\\RelayedSocketListener.cs", 215);
				}
				relayedConnectionSession = new RelayedConnectionSession(bufferSize, uri, tokenProvider, socketSecurityMode, id, this, trackingContext);
				connectionSessions.Add(request.Id, relayedConnectionSession);
			}
			return relayedConnectionSession.BeginConnect(request, callback, state);

	[CallbackBehavior(ConcurrencyMode = ConcurrencyMode.Multiple)]
	internal class RelayedConnectionSession : ITraceSource
	{
		private class ConnectAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<ConnectAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly RelayedConnectMessage request;

			private Socket socket;

			private IConnection connection;

			private System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message;

			private byte[] connectBuffer;

			public RelayedConnectionSession RelayedConnectionSession { get; }

			protected internal override EventTraceActivity Activity => RelayedConnectionSession.TrackingContext.Activity;

			protected override EventLevel TraceEventType => EventLevel.Warning;

			public ConnectAsyncResult(RelayedConnectMessage request, RelayedConnectionSession relayedConnectionSession, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(ConnectConstants.ConnectionInitiateTimeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.request = request;
				RelayedConnectionSession = relayedConnectionSession;
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				yield return CallAsyncSleep(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(2.0));
				socket = new Socket(AddressFamily.InterNetwork, SocketType.Stream, ProtocolType.Tcp);
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((ConnectAsyncResult thisRef, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisRef.socket.BeginConnect(thisRef.request.TcpEndpoint, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(ConnectAsyncResult thisRef, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					thisRef.socket.EndConnect(r);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
				connection = new SocketConnection(socket, RelayedConnectionSession.bufferSize, RelayedConnectionSession.TrackingContext);
				byte[] bytes = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("connect");
				byte[] bytes2 = BitConverter.GetBytes(bytes.Length);
				Uri uri = RelayedConnectionSession.Uri;
				byte[] bytes3 = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(uri.ToString());
				byte[] bytes4 = BitConverter.GetBytes(bytes3.Length);
				byte[] array = ((RelayedConnectionSession.socketSecurityMode == SocketSecurityRole.None) ? ConnectConstants.NoSsl : ConnectConstants.UseSsl);
				using (MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream(bytes2.Length + bytes.Length + bytes4.Length + bytes3.Length + array.Length))
				{
					memoryStream.Write(bytes2, 0, bytes2.Length);
					memoryStream.Write(bytes, 0, bytes.Length);
					memoryStream.Write(bytes4, 0, bytes4.Length);
					memoryStream.Write(bytes3, 0, bytes3.Length);
					memoryStream.Write(array, 0, array.Length);
					connectBuffer = memoryStream.GetBuffer();
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((ConnectAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.connection.BeginWrite(thisPtr.connectBuffer, 0, thisPtr.connectBuffer.Length, immediate: true, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(ConnectAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.connection.EndWrite(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
					connectBuffer = null;
				}
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((ConnectAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => SecureSocketUtil.BeginInitiateSecureClientUpgradeIfNeeded(thisPtr.connection, null, thisPtr.RelayedConnectionSession.socketSecurityMode, thisPtr.RelayedConnectionSession.uri.Host, sendControlByte: false, thisPtr.RelayedConnectionSession.sslProtocolOverride, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(ConnectAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					thisPtr.connection = SecureSocketUtil.EndInitiateSecureClientUpgradeIfNeeded(r);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
				message = System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message.CreateMessage(RelayedConnectionSession.messageHelper.MessageVersion, "RelayedAccept", new AcceptMessage(RelayedConnectionSession.id.ToString()));
				message.Headers.To = EndpointAddress.AnonymousUri;
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((ConnectAsyncResult thisRef, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisRef.RelayedConnectionSession.messageHelper.BeginSendMessage(thisRef.connection, thisRef.message, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(ConnectAsyncResult thisRef, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					thisRef.RelayedConnectionSession.messageHelper.EndSendMessage(r);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
				IOThreadScheduler.ScheduleCallbackNoFlow(RelayedConnectionSession.BeginConnectCallback, connection);
			}
		}

		private readonly int bufferSize;

		private readonly Guid id;

		private readonly SocketMessageHelper messageHelper;

		private readonly object mutex;

		private readonly RelayedSocketListener listener;

		private readonly SocketSecurityRole socketSecurityMode;

		private readonly TokenProvider tokenProvider;

		private readonly Uri uri;

		private readonly SslProtocols? sslProtocolOverride;

		private bool complete;

		private bool disposed;

		public Guid Id => id;

		public string Component => "Relay";

		public TrackingContext TrackingContext { get; }

		internal Uri Uri => uri;

		private object ThisLock => mutex;

		public RelayedConnectionSession(int bufferSize, Uri uri, TokenProvider tokenProvider, SocketSecurityRole socketSecurityMode, Guid id, RelayedSocketListener listener, TrackingContext trackingContext)
		{
			this.bufferSize = bufferSize;
			this.uri = uri;
			this.tokenProvider = tokenProvider;
			this.socketSecurityMode = socketSecurityMode;
			this.id = id;
			this.listener = listener;
			TrackingContext = trackingContext;
			sslProtocolOverride = listener.SslProtocolOverride;
			if (this.tokenProvider != null)
			{
				this.socketSecurityMode = SocketSecurityRole.SslClient;
			}
			messageHelper = new SocketMessageHelper();
			mutex = new object();
		}

		public void Close()
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (!disposed)
				{
					disposed = true;
					complete = true;
				}
			}
		}

		public void Failure(object sender, Exception exception)
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (complete)
				{
					return;
				}
				complete = true;
			}
			listener.Failure(this, exception);
		}

		public void Success(object sender, IConnection connection)
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (complete)
				{
					connection.Close(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1.0));
					return;
				}
				complete = true;
			}
			listener.Success(this, connection);
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginConnect(RelayedConnectMessage request, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			ConnectAsyncResult connectAsyncResult = new ConnectAsyncResult(request, this, callback, state);
			return connectAsyncResult.Start();
		}

		public void EndConnect(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			try
			{
				AsyncResult<ConnectAsyncResult>.End(result);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
				{
					throw;
				}
				listener.Failure(this, ex);
				throw new FaultException(ex.ToString());
			}
		}

		public static void End(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			RelayedConnectionSession relayedConnectionSession = ((ConnectAsyncResult)result).RelayedConnectionSession;
			relayedConnectionSession.EndConnect(result);
		}

		private void BeginConnectCallback(object state)
		{
			IConnection connection = (IConnection)state;
			messageHelper.BeginReceiveMessage(connection, ConnectConstants.ConnectionInitiateTimeout, EndConnectCallback, connection);
		}

		private void EndConnectCallback(IAsyncResult ar)
		{
			IConnection connection = (IConnection)ar.AsyncState;
			try
			{
				System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message = messageHelper.EndReceiveMessage(ar);
				if (message.IsFault)
				{
					MessageFault fault = MessageFault.CreateFault(message, 65536);
					throw ErrorUtility.ConvertToError(fault);
				}
				listener.Success(this, connection);
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				connection.Abort();
				listener.Failure(this, exception);
			}
		}
	}
