		internal class ConfigSettings : IEnvironment
		{
			private const string RelayHostNameElement = "relayHostName";

			private const string RelayHttpPortNameElement = "relayHttpPort";

			private const string RelayHttpsPortNameElement = "relayHttpsPort";

			private const string RelayNmfPortNameElement = "relayNmfPort";

			private const string RelayPathPrefixElement = "relayPathPrefix";

			private const string StsHostNameElement = "stsHostName";

			private const string StsEnabledElement = "stsEnabled";

			private const string StsHttpPortNameElement = "stsHttpPort";

			private const string StsHttpsPortNameElement = "stsHttpsPort";

			private const string V1ConfigFileName = "servicebus.config";

			private const string WebRootPath = "approot\\";

			private readonly string configFileName;

			private bool haveSettings;

			private string relayHostName;

			private int relayHttpPort;

			private int relayHttpsPort;

			private int relayNmfPort;

			private string relayPathPrefix = string.Empty;

			private string stsHostName;

			private bool stsEnabled;

			private int stsHttpPort;

			private int stsHttpsPort;

			public bool HaveSettings => haveSettings;

			public string RelayHostRootName => relayHostName;

			public int RelayHttpPort => relayHttpPort;

			public int RelayHttpsPort => relayHttpsPort;

			public int RelayNmfPort => relayNmfPort;

			public string RelayPathPrefix => relayPathPrefix;

			public string StsHostName => stsHostName;

			public bool StsEnabled => stsEnabled;

			public int StsHttpPort => stsHttpPort;

			public int StsHttpsPort => stsHttpsPort;

			public ConfigSettings()
			{
				configFileName = "servicebus.config";
				ReadConfigSettings();
			}

			private void ReadConfigSettings()
			{
				haveSettings = false;
				string location = Assembly.GetExecutingAssembly().Location;
				string text = null;
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(location))
				{
					string directoryName = Path.GetDirectoryName(location);
					text = Path.Combine(directoryName, configFileName);
				}
				string text2 = configFileName;
				string text3 = Path.Combine("approot\\", configFileName);
				string path;
				if (File.Exists(text2))
				{
					path = text2;
				}
				else if (File.Exists(text3))
				{
					path = text3;
				}
				else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && File.Exists(text))
				{
					path = text;
				}
				else
				{
					string filePath = ConfigurationManager.OpenMachineConfiguration().FilePath;
					string directoryName2 = Path.GetDirectoryName(filePath);
					path = Path.Combine(directoryName2, configFileName);
				}
				LiveEnvironment liveEnvironment = new LiveEnvironment();
				relayHostName = liveEnvironment.RelayHostRootName;
				relayHttpPort = liveEnvironment.RelayHttpPort;
				relayHttpsPort = liveEnvironment.RelayHttpsPort;
				relayNmfPort = liveEnvironment.RelayNmfPort;
				relayPathPrefix = liveEnvironment.RelayPathPrefix;
				stsHostName = liveEnvironment.StsHostName;
				stsEnabled = liveEnvironment.StsEnabled;
				stsHttpPort = liveEnvironment.StsHttpPort;
				stsHttpsPort = liveEnvironment.StsHttpsPort;
				if (!File.Exists(path))
				{
					return;
				}
				Stream stream = File.OpenRead(path);
				XmlReader xmlReader = XmlReader.Create(stream);
				xmlReader.ReadStartElement("configuration");
				xmlReader.ReadStartElement("Microsoft.ServiceBus");
				while (xmlReader.IsStartElement())
				{
					string name = xmlReader.Name;
					string s = xmlReader.ReadElementString();
					switch (name)
					{
					case "relayHostName":
						relayHostName = s;
						break;
					case "relayHttpPort":
						relayHttpPort = int.Parse(s, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
						break;
					case "relayHttpsPort":
						relayHttpsPort = int.Parse(s, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
						break;
					case "relayNmfPort":
						relayNmfPort = int.Parse(s, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
						break;
					case "relayPathPrefix":
						relayPathPrefix = s;
						if (!relayPathPrefix.StartsWith("/", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
						{
							relayPathPrefix = "/" + relayPathPrefix;
						}
						if (relayPathPrefix.EndsWith("/", StringComparison.Ordinal))
						{
							relayPathPrefix = relayPathPrefix.Substring(0, relayPathPrefix.Length - 1);
						}
						break;
					case "stsHostName":
						stsHostName = s;
						break;
					case "stsHttpPort":
						stsHttpPort = int.Parse(s, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
						break;
					case "stsHttpsPort":
						stsHttpsPort = int.Parse(s, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
						break;
					}
				}
				xmlReader.ReadEndElement();
				xmlReader.ReadEndElement();
				stream.Close();
				haveSettings = true;
			}
		}

		public const string RelayEnvEnvironmentVariable = "RELAYENV";

		public const string StsEnabledEnvironmentVariable = "RELAYSTSENABLED";

		public const string AcsVersionVariable = "ACSVERSION";

		private const int DefaultHttpPort = 80;

		private const int DefaultHttpsPort = 443;

		private const int DefaultNmfPort = 9354;

		public static string RelayHostRootName
		{
			get
			{
				return Environment.RelayHostRootName;
			}
			set
			{
				Environment.RelayHostRootName = value;
			}
		}

		public static int RelayHttpPort => Environment.RelayHttpPort;

		public static int RelayHttpsPort => Environment.RelayHttpsPort;

		public static string StsHostName => Environment.StsHostName;

		public static bool StsEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				return Environment.StsEnabled;
			}
			set
			{
				Environment.StsEnabled = value;
			}
		}

		public static int StsHttpPort => Environment.StsHttpPort;

		public static int StsHttpsPort => Environment.StsHttpsPort;

		public static int RelayNmfPort => Environment.RelayNmfPort;

		internal static string RelayPathPrefix => Environment.RelayPathPrefix;

		private static MutableEnvironment Environment { get; set; }

		static RelayEnvironment()
		{
			if (!TryInitializeBasedOnEnvironmentVariable())
			{
				ConfigSettings configSettings = new ConfigSettings();
				if (configSettings.HaveSettings)
				{
					Environment = new MutableEnvironment(configSettings);
				}
				else
				{
					Environment = new MutableEnvironment(new LiveEnvironment());
				}
			}
		}

		public static bool GetEnvironmentVariable(string variable, bool defaultValue)
		{
			string environmentVariable = System.Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable(variable);
			if (environmentVariable != null && bool.TryParse(environmentVariable, out var result))
			{
				return result;
			}
			return defaultValue;
		}

		public static int GetEnvironmentVariable(string variable, int defaultValue)
		{
			string environmentVariable = System.Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable(variable);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(environmentVariable) && int.TryParse(environmentVariable, out var result))
			{
				return result;
			}
			return defaultValue;
		}

		private static bool TryInitializeBasedOnEnvironmentVariable()
		{
			string environmentVariable = System.Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("RELAYENV");
			if (environmentVariable != null)
			{
				switch (environmentVariable.ToUpperInvariant())
				{
				case "LIVE":
					Environment = new MutableEnvironment(new LiveEnvironment());
					break;
				case "PPE":
					Environment = new MutableEnvironment(new PpeEnvironment());
					break;
				case "INT":
					Environment = new MutableEnvironment(new IntEnvironment());
					break;
				case "LOCAL":
					Environment = new MutableEnvironment(new LocalEnvironment());
					break;
				case "CUSTOM":
					Environment = new MutableEnvironment(new CustomEnvironment());
					break;
				default:
				{
					Environment = new MutableEnvironment(new LiveEnvironment());
					string message = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "Invalid RELAYENV value: {0}, valid values = LIVE, PPE, INT", environmentVariable);
					EventLog.WriteEntry("MSCSH", message, EventLogEntryType.Error, 0);
					break;
				}
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal class RelayedOnewayChannelFactory : ChannelFactoryBase<IOutputChannel>
	{
		private class RelayedOnewayOutputChannel : ChannelBase, IOutputChannel, IChannel, ICommunicationObject
		{
			private IRelayedOnewaySender connection;

			private EndpointAddress to;

			private Uri via;

			public EndpointAddress RemoteAddress => to;

			public Uri Via => via;

			public RelayedOnewayOutputChannel(RelayedOnewayChannelFactory channelFactory, BindingContext context, RelayedOnewayTransportBindingElement transportBindingElement, EndpointAddress to, Uri via)
				: base(channelFactory)
			{
				this.to = to;
				this.via = via;
				connection = RelayedOnewayManager.CreateConnection(context, transportBindingElement, via);
			}

			public override T GetProperty<T>()
			{
				if (typeof(T) == typeof(IConnectionStatus))
				{
					return (T)connection;
				}
				return base.GetProperty<T>();
			}

			protected override void OnAbort()
			{
				IRelayedOnewaySender relayedOnewaySender;
				lock (base.ThisLock)
				{
					relayedOnewaySender = connection;
					connection = null;
				}
				relayedOnewaySender?.Abort();
			}

			protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{
				IRelayedOnewaySender relayedOnewaySender;
				lock (base.ThisLock)
				{
					relayedOnewaySender = connection;
					connection = null;
				}
				if (relayedOnewaySender != null)
				{
					return new DelegatingAsyncResult(relayedOnewaySender.BeginClose, relayedOnewaySender.EndClose, timeout, callback, state);
				}
				return new CompletedAsyncResult(callback, state);
			}

			protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginOpen(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{
				IRelayedOnewaySender relayedOnewaySender = connection;
				if (relayedOnewaySender != null)
				{
					return new DelegatingAsyncResult(relayedOnewaySender.BeginOpen, relayedOnewaySender.EndOpen, timeout, callback, state);
				}
				return new CompletedAsyncResult(callback, state);
			}

			protected override void OnClose(TimeSpan timeout)
			{
				TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
				IRelayedOnewaySender relayedOnewaySender = null;
				lock (base.ThisLock)
				{
					relayedOnewaySender = connection;
					connection = null;
				}
				relayedOnewaySender?.Close(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
			}

			protected override void OnEndClose(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				if (result is DelegatingAsyncResult)
				{
					AsyncResult<DelegatingAsyncResult>.End(result);
				}
				else
				{
					CompletedAsyncResult.End(result);
				}
			}

			protected override void OnEndOpen(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				if (result is DelegatingAsyncResult)
				{
					AsyncResult<DelegatingAsyncResult>.End(result);
				}
				else
				{
					CompletedAsyncResult.End(result);
				}
			}

			protected override void OnOpen(TimeSpan timeout)
			{
				connection?.Open(timeout);
			}

			private System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message PrepareMessage(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message)
			{
				to.ApplyTo(message);
				return message;
			}

			public IAsyncResult BeginSend(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{
				TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
				message = PrepareMessage(message);
				return connection.BeginSend(message, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime(), callback, state);
			}

			public IAsyncResult BeginSend(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{
				return BeginSend(message, base.DefaultSendTimeout, callback, state);
			}

			public void EndSend(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				connection.EndSend(result);
			}

			public void Send(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, TimeSpan timeout)
			{
				TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
				message = PrepareMessage(message);
				connection.Send(message, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
			}

			public void Send(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message)
			{
				Send(message, base.DefaultSendTimeout);
			}
		}

		private BindingContext context;

		private RelayedOnewayTransportBindingElement transportBindingElement;

		public RelayedOnewayChannelFactory(BindingContext context, RelayedOnewayTransportBindingElement transportBindingElement)
			: base((IDefaultCommunicationTimeouts)context.Binding)

	internal sealed class RelayedOnewayChannelListener : DelegatingTransportChannelListener<IInputChannel>
	{
		private class RelayedOnewayInputChannel : InputChannel
		{
			public RelayedOnewayInputChannel(RelayedOnewayChannelListener channelListener, EndpointAddress localAddress)
				: base(channelListener, localAddress)
			{
			}
		}

		private readonly RelayedOnewayInputChannel channel;

		private readonly MessageVersion messageVersion;

		private readonly NameSettings nameSettings;

		private readonly string scheme;

		private Uri baseAddress;

		private IRelayedOnewayListener connection;

		private Uri listenUri;

		private string relativeAddress;

		public Uri BaseAddress => baseAddress;

		private InputChannelAcceptor ChannelAcceptor => (InputChannelAcceptor)base.Acceptor;

		public MessageVersion MessageVersion => messageVersion;

		public NameSettings NameSettings => nameSettings;

		public string RelativeAddress => relativeAddress;

		public override Uri Uri => listenUri;

		public RelayedOnewayChannelListener(BindingContext context, RelayedOnewayTransportBindingElement transportBindingElement)
			: base((IDefaultCommunicationTimeouts)context.Binding)
		{
			nameSettings = context.BindingParameters.Find<NameSettings>();
			if (nameSettings == null)
			{
				nameSettings = new NameSettings();
				nameSettings.ServiceSettings.ListenerType = ListenerType.Unicast;
			}
			scheme = context.Binding.Scheme;
			messageVersion = context.Binding.MessageVersion;
			switch (context.ListenUriMode)
			{
			case ListenUriMode.Explicit:
				SetUri(context.ListenUriBaseAddress, context.ListenUriRelativeAddress);
				break;
			case ListenUriMode.Unique:
				SetUniqueUri(context.ListenUriBaseAddress, context.ListenUriRelativeAddress);
				break;
			}
			channel = new RelayedOnewayInputChannel(this, new EndpointAddress(Uri));
			base.Acceptor = new InputChannelAcceptor(this, () => this.GetPendingException());
			ChannelAcceptor.EnqueueAndDispatch(channel, OnChannelDequeued);
			connection = RelayedOnewayManager.RegisterListener(context, transportBindingElement, this);
		}

		public override T GetProperty<T>()
		{
			if (typeof(T) == typeof(MessageVersion))
			{
				return (T)(object)messageVersion;
			}
			if (typeof(T) == typeof(IConnectionStatus))
			{
				return (T)connection;
			}
			return base.GetProperty<T>();
		}

		protected override void OnAbort()
		{
			CleanUpConnection();
			base.OnAbort();
		}

		protected override void OnFaulted()
		{
			CleanUpConnection();
			base.OnFaulted();
		}

		private void CleanUpConnection()
		{
			IRelayedOnewayListener relayedOnewayListener = null;
			lock (base.ThisLock)
			{
				relayedOnewayListener = connection;
				connection = null;
			}
			if (relayedOnewayListener != null)
			{
				relayedOnewayListener.Unregister(this);
				relayedOnewayListener.Abort();
			}
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			IRelayedOnewayListener relayedOnewayListener = null;
			lock (base.ThisLock)
			{
				relayedOnewayListener = connection;
				connection = null;
			}
			if (relayedOnewayListener != null)
			{
				relayedOnewayListener.Unregister(this);
				return new ChainedAsyncResult(timeout, callback, state, relayedOnewayListener.BeginClose, relayedOnewayListener.EndClose, base.OnBeginClose, base.OnEndClose);
			}
			return new DelegatingAsyncResult(base.OnBeginClose, base.OnEndClose, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginOpen(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			IRelayedOnewayListener relayedOnewayListener = connection;
			if (relayedOnewayListener != null)
			{
				return new ChainedAsyncResult(timeout, callback, state, base.OnBeginOpen, base.OnEndOpen, relayedOnewayListener.BeginOpen, relayedOnewayListener.EndOpen);
			}
			return new DelegatingAsyncResult(base.OnBeginOpen, base.OnEndOpen, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		protected override void OnClose(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
			IRelayedOnewayListener relayedOnewayListener = null;
			lock (base.ThisLock)
			{
				relayedOnewayListener = connection;
				connection = null;
			}
			if (relayedOnewayListener != null)
			{
				relayedOnewayListener.Unregister(this);
				relayedOnewayListener.Close(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
			}
			base.OnClose(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
		}

		protected override void OnEndClose(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (result is DelegatingAsyncResult)
			{
				AsyncResult<DelegatingAsyncResult>.End(result);
			}
			else
			{
				ChainedAsyncResult.End(result);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnEndOpen(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (result is DelegatingAsyncResult)
			{
				AsyncResult<DelegatingAsyncResult>.End(result);
			}
			else
			{
				ChainedAsyncResult.End(result);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnOpen(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
			base.OnOpen(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
			connection?.Open(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
		}

		public void SetUniqueUri(Uri baseAddress, string relativeAddress)
		{
			if (baseAddress.Scheme != scheme)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.BaseAddressScheme(scheme), "baseAddress");
			}
			if (relativeAddress.Length > 0 && !relativeAddress.EndsWith("/", StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				SetUri(baseAddress, relativeAddress + "/" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString() + "/");
			}
			else
			{
				SetUri(baseAddress, relativeAddress + Guid.NewGuid().ToString() + "/");
			}
		}

		public void SetUri(Uri baseAddress, string relativeAddress)
		{
			if (baseAddress.Scheme != scheme)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.BaseAddressScheme(scheme), "baseAddress");
			}
			if (baseAddress.AbsoluteUri.EndsWith("/", StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				this.baseAddress = baseAddress;
			}
			else
			{
				this.baseAddress = new Uri(baseAddress.AbsoluteUri + "/");
			}
			this.relativeAddress = relativeAddress;
			if (relativeAddress.Length > 0)
			{
				listenUri = new Uri(baseAddress, relativeAddress);
			}
			else
			{
				listenUri = baseAddress;
			}
		}

		public void EnqueueAndDispatch(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, Action dequeuedCallback)
		{
			channel.EnqueueAndDispatch(message, dequeuedCallback);
		}

		private void OnChannelDequeued()
		{
		}
	}

	internal static class RelayedOnewayManager
	{
		private static readonly UriPrefixTable<IRelayedOnewayListener> listenerTable;

		static RelayedOnewayManager()
		{
			listenerTable = new UriPrefixTable<IRelayedOnewayListener>();
		}

		private static Uri AppendSlash(Uri uri)
		{
			if (!uri.AbsoluteUri.EndsWith("/", StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				return new Uri(uri.AbsoluteUri + "/");
			}
			return uri;
		}

		public static IRelayedOnewaySender CreateConnection(BindingContext context, RelayedOnewayTransportBindingElement transportBindingElement, Uri uri)
		{
			ConnectivitySettings connectivitySettings = context.BindingParameters.Find<ConnectivitySettings>();
			NameSettings nameSettings = context.BindingParameters.Find<NameSettings>();
			ConnectivityMode connectivityMode = connectivitySettings?.Mode ?? ConnectivityModeHelper.SystemConnectivityMode;
			if (connectivityMode == ConnectivityMode.AutoDetect)
			{
				connectivityMode = NetworkDetector.DetectConnectivityModeForAutoDetect(uri);
			}
			if (connectivityMode == ConnectivityMode.Tcp)
			{
				return new RelayedOnewayTcpSender(context, transportBindingElement, uri, nameSettings.ServiceSettings.TransportProtection == RelayTransportProtectionMode.EndToEnd, new EventTraceActivity());
			}
			return new RelayedOnewayHttpSender(context, uri, nameSettings.ServiceSettings.TransportProtection == RelayTransportProtectionMode.EndToEnd);
		}

		public static IRelayedOnewayListener RegisterListener(BindingContext context, RelayedOnewayTransportBindingElement transportBindingElement, RelayedOnewayChannelListener channelListener)
		{
			lock (listenerTable)
			{
				if (listenerTable.TryLookupUri(channelListener.BaseAddress, HostNameComparisonMode.Exact, out var item) && AppendSlash(item.Uri).ToString() == AppendSlash(channelListener.BaseAddress).ToString())
				{
					if (!item.NameSettings.IsCompatible(channelListener.NameSettings))
					{
						throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new AddressAlreadyInUseException(SRClient.IncompatibleChannelListener), null, EventLevel.Warning, "RegisterListener", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\RelayedOneway\\RelayedOnewayManager.cs", 67);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					item = new RelayedOnewayListener(context, transportBindingElement, channelListener.BaseAddress);
					item.Closing += OnListenerClosing;
					listenerTable.RegisterUri(channelListener.BaseAddress, HostNameComparisonMode.Exact, item);
				}
				item.Register(channelListener);
				return item;
			}
		}

		private static void OnListenerClosing(object sender, EventArgs args)
		{
			IRelayedOnewayListener relayedOnewayListener = (IRelayedOnewayListener)sender;
			lock (listenerTable)
			{
				if (listenerTable.TryLookupUri(relayedOnewayListener.Uri, HostNameComparisonMode.Exact, out var item) && item == relayedOnewayListener)
				{
					listenerTable.UnregisterUri(relayedOnewayListener.Uri, HostNameComparisonMode.Exact);
				}
			}
		}
	}

		Uri Uri { get; }

		void Register(RelayedOnewayChannelListener channelListener);

		void Unregister(RelayedOnewayChannelListener channelListener);
	}

	public abstract class TokenProvider
	{
		private abstract class GetTokenAsyncResultBase<T> : IteratorAsyncResult<T> where T : GetTokenAsyncResultBase<T>
		{
			private readonly Key cacheKey;

			private readonly bool bypassCache;

			private readonly Uri appliesToUri;

			private TimeSpan retrySleepTime;

			protected TokenProvider TokenProvider { get; private set; }

			protected string AppliesTo { get; private set; }

			protected string Action { get; private set; }

			protected abstract BeginCall GetTokenBeginCall { get; }

			protected GetTokenAsyncResultBase(TokenProvider tokenProvider, string appliesTo, string action, bool bypassCache, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				TokenProvider = tokenProvider;
				cacheKey = TokenProvider.BuildKey(appliesTo, action);
				retrySleepTime = TokenProvider.retrySleepTime;
				this.bypassCache = bypassCache;
				AppliesTo = appliesTo;
				Action = action;
				if (!Uri.TryCreate(appliesTo, UriKind.RelativeOrAbsolute, out appliesToUri))
				{
					appliesToUri = new UriBuilder
					{
						Scheme = "sb",
						Host = appliesTo
					}.Uri;
				}
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				while (true)
				{
					bool retry = false;
					if (!bypassCache)
					{
						bool flag;
						lock (TokenProvider.mutex)
						{
							TokenInfo tokenInfoFromCache = TokenProvider.GetTokenInfoFromCache(cacheKey);
							flag = OnProcessCachedEntryFromTokenProvider(tokenInfoFromCache);
						}
						if (flag)
						{
							break;
						}
					}
					Stopwatch perfWatch = Stopwatch.StartNew();
					try
					{
						yield return CallAsync(GetTokenBeginCall, (EndCall)delegate(T thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
						{
							thisPtr.OnCompletion(r);
						}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
						if (base.LastAsyncStepException == null)
						{
							perfWatch.Stop();
							MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementTokenAcquisitionLatency(appliesToUri, perfWatch.ElapsedTicks);
							MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementTokensAcquiredPerSec(appliesToUri, 1);
							break;
						}
					}
					finally
					{
						perfWatch.Stop();
					}
					MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementTokenAcquisitionFailuresPerSec(appliesToUri, 1);
					SecurityTokenException ex = base.LastAsyncStepException as SecurityTokenException;
					TokenProviderException ex2 = base.LastAsyncStepException as TokenProviderException;
					if (base.LastAsyncStepException is TimeoutException { InnerException: not null } ex3 && ex3.InnerException is WebException)
					{
						retry = true;
					}
					else if (ex2 != null && ex2.InnerException != null && ex2.InnerException is WebException)
					{
						retry = true;
					}
					else if (ex != null)
					{
						TokenProviderHelper.InternalSecurityTokenException ex4 = ex as TokenProviderHelper.InternalSecurityTokenException;
						retry = true;
						if (ex4 != null)
						{
							base.LastAsyncStepException = new SecurityTokenException(ex4.Message, ex4.InnerException);
							HttpStatusCode statusCode = ex4.StatusCode;
							if ((uint)(statusCode - 400) <= 1u)
							{
								retry = false;
							}
						}
					}
					if (retry)
					{
						TimeSpan timeSpan = RemainingTime();
						if (timeSpan > TimeSpan.Zero)
						{
							yield return CallAsyncSleep(TimeoutHelper.Min(retrySleepTime, timeSpan));
							TimeSpan timeSpan2 = retrySleepTime.Add(retrySleepTime);
							retrySleepTime = ((timeSpan2 < MaxRetrySleepTime) ? timeSpan2 : MaxRetrySleepTime);
						}
						else
						{
							retry = false;
						}
					}
					if (!retry)
					{
						if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
						{
							Complete(base.LastAsyncStepException);
						}
						break;
					}
				}
			}

			private void OnCompletion(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				OnEndTokenProviderCallback(result, out var cacheUntil);
				if (cacheUntil >= DateTime.UtcNow)
				{
					lock (TokenProvider.mutex)
					{
						TokenInfo tokenInfo = TokenProvider.GetTokenInfoFromCache(cacheKey);
						OnUpdateTokenProviderCacheEntry(cacheUntil, ref tokenInfo);
					}
				}
			}

			protected abstract bool OnProcessCachedEntryFromTokenProvider(TokenInfo tokenInfo);

			protected abstract void OnEndTokenProviderCallback(IAsyncResult result, out DateTime cacheUntil);

			protected abstract void OnUpdateTokenProviderCacheEntry(DateTime cacheUntil, ref TokenInfo tokenInfo);
		}

		private sealed class GetTokenAsyncResult : GetTokenAsyncResultBase<GetTokenAsyncResult>
		{
			public SecurityToken SecurityToken { get; private set; }

			protected override BeginCall GetTokenBeginCall => (GetTokenAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.TokenProvider.OnBeginGetToken(thisPtr.AppliesTo, thisPtr.Action, t, c, s);

			internal GetTokenAsyncResult(TokenProvider tokenProvider, string appliesTo, string action, bool bypassCache, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(tokenProvider, appliesTo, action, bypassCache, timeout, callback, state)
			{
				Start();
			}

			protected override bool OnProcessCachedEntryFromTokenProvider(TokenInfo tokenInfo)
			{
				SecurityToken = tokenInfo.SecurityToken;
				return SecurityToken != null;
			}

			protected override void OnEndTokenProviderCallback(IAsyncResult result, out DateTime cacheUntil)
			{
				SecurityToken = base.TokenProvider.OnEndGetToken(result, out cacheUntil);
			}

			protected override void OnUpdateTokenProviderCacheEntry(DateTime cacheUntil, ref TokenInfo tokenInfo)
			{
				if (tokenInfo.SecurityToken == null || cacheUntil > tokenInfo.SecurityTokenCacheUntil)
				{
					tokenInfo.SecurityToken = SecurityToken;
					tokenInfo.SecurityTokenCacheUntil = cacheUntil;
				}
			}
		}

		private sealed class GetWebTokenAsyncResult : GetTokenAsyncResultBase<GetWebTokenAsyncResult>
		{
			public string WebToken { get; private set; }

			protected override BeginCall GetTokenBeginCall => (GetWebTokenAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.TokenProvider.OnBeginGetWebToken(thisPtr.AppliesTo, thisPtr.Action, t, c, s);

			internal GetWebTokenAsyncResult(TokenProvider tokenProvider, string appliesTo, string action, bool bypassCache, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(tokenProvider, appliesTo, action, bypassCache, timeout, callback, state)
			{
				Start();
			}

			protected override bool OnProcessCachedEntryFromTokenProvider(TokenInfo tokenInfo)
			{
				WebToken = tokenInfo.WebToken;
				return WebToken != null;
			}

			protected override void OnEndTokenProviderCallback(IAsyncResult result, out DateTime cacheUntil)
			{
				WebToken = base.TokenProvider.OnEndGetWebToken(result, out cacheUntil);
			}

			protected override void OnUpdateTokenProviderCacheEntry(DateTime cacheUntil, ref TokenInfo tokenInfo)
			{
				if (tokenInfo.WebToken == null || cacheUntil > tokenInfo.WebTokenCacheUntil)
				{
					tokenInfo.WebToken = WebToken;
					tokenInfo.WebTokenCacheUntil = cacheUntil;
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal class Key : IEquatable<Key>
		{
			private readonly string appliesTo;

			private readonly string claim;

			public Key(string appliesTo, string claim)
			{
				if (appliesTo == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("appliesTo");
				}
				if (claim == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("claim");
				}
				this.appliesTo = appliesTo;
				this.claim = claim;
			}

			public override bool Equals(object obj)
			{
				return Equals(obj as Key);
			}

			public override int GetHashCode()
			{
				return (appliesTo.GetHashCode() * 397) ^ claim.GetHashCode();
			}

			public bool Equals(Key other)
			{
				if (other == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (this == other)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (object.Equals(other.appliesTo, appliesTo))
				{
					return object.Equals(other.claim, claim);
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal class TokenInfo
		{
			internal SecurityToken SecurityToken { get; set; }

			internal DateTime SecurityTokenCacheUntil { get; set; }

			internal string WebToken { get; set; }

			internal DateTime WebTokenCacheUntil { get; set; }

			internal TokenInfo()
			{
				ResetSecurityToken();
				ResetWebToken();
			}

			internal void ResetSecurityToken()
			{
				SecurityToken = null;
				SecurityTokenCacheUntil = DateTime.MaxValue;
			}

			internal void ResetWebToken()
			{
				WebToken = null;
				WebTokenCacheUntil = DateTime.MaxValue;
			}
		}

		private const int DefaultCacheSize = 1000;

		private const TokenScope DefaultTokenScope = TokenScope.Entity;

		internal static readonly TimeSpan DefaultTokenTimeout = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(60.0);

		private static readonly TimeSpan MinimumCachedTokenTimeToLive = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5.0);

		private static readonly TimeSpan InitialRetrySleepTime = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(50.0);

		private static readonly TimeSpan MaxRetrySleepTime = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(3.0);

		private readonly bool isWebTokenSupported;

		private readonly object mutex = new object();

		private readonly TimeSpan retrySleepTime;

		private int cacheSize;

		private MruCache<Key, TokenInfo> tokenCache;

		public TokenScope TokenScope { get; private set; }

		public bool CacheTokens
		{
			get
			{
				lock (mutex)
				{
					return tokenCache != null;
				}
			}
			set
			{
				lock (mutex)
				{
					if (value)
					{
						tokenCache = new MruCache<Key, TokenInfo>(cacheSize);
					}
					else
					{
						tokenCache = null;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public int CacheSize
		{
			get
			{
				lock (mutex)
				{
					return cacheSize;
				}
			}
			set
			{
				lock (mutex)
				{
					if (value < 1)
					{
						throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("value", SRClient.ArgumentOutOfRangeLessThanOne);
					}
					cacheSize = value;
					Clear();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool IsWebTokenSupported => isWebTokenSupported;

			}
			TokenScope = tokenScope;

			retrySleepTime = InitialRetrySleepTime;
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			lock (mutex)
			{
				if (tokenCache != null)
				{
					tokenCache = new MruCache<Key, TokenInfo>(cacheSize);
				}
			}
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginGetToken(string appliesTo, string action, bool bypassCache, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return BeginGetToken(null, appliesTo, action, bypassCache, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		internal IAsyncResult BeginGetToken(Uri namespaceAddress, string appliesTo, string action, bool bypassCache, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(appliesTo))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.NullAppliesTo);
			}
			if (action == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("action");
			}
			if (timeout > TimeoutHelper.MaxWait)
			{
				timeout = TimeoutHelper.MaxWait;
			}
			ValidateTimeout(timeout);
			string appliesTo2 = NormalizeAppliesTo(namespaceAddress, appliesTo);
			return new GetTokenAsyncResult(this, appliesTo2, action, bypassCache, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginGetWebToken(string appliesTo, string action, bool bypassCache, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return BeginGetWebToken(null, appliesTo, action, bypassCache, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		internal IAsyncResult BeginGetWebToken(Uri namespaceAddress, string appliesTo, string action, bool bypassCache, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(appliesTo))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.NullAppliesTo);
			}
			if (action == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("action");
			}
			if (timeout > TimeoutHelper.MaxWait)
			{
				timeout = TimeoutHelper.MaxWait;
			}
			ValidateTimeout(timeout);
			if (!IsWebTokenSupported)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.BeginGetWebTokenNotSupported);
			}
			string appliesTo2 = NormalizeAppliesTo(namespaceAddress, appliesTo);
			return new GetWebTokenAsyncResult(this, appliesTo2, action, bypassCache, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		public SecurityToken EndGetToken(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			return AsyncResult<GetTokenAsyncResult>.End(result).SecurityToken;
		}

		public Task<SecurityToken> GetTokenAsync(string appliesTo, string action, bool bypassCache, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			return TaskHelpers.FromAsync((AsyncCallback c, object s) => BeginGetToken(appliesTo, action, bypassCache, timeout, c, s), (IAsyncResult a) => ((TokenProvider)a.AsyncState).EndGetToken(a), this);
		}

		public Task<string> GetWebTokenAsync(string appliesTo, string action, bool bypassCache, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			return TaskHelpers.FromAsync((AsyncCallback c, object s) => BeginGetWebToken(appliesTo, action, bypassCache, timeout, c, s), (IAsyncResult a) => ((TokenProvider)a.AsyncState).EndGetWebToken(a), this);
		}

		public string EndGetWebToken(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			return AsyncResult<GetWebTokenAsyncResult>.End(result).WebToken;
		}

		internal void ValidateAction(string action)
		{
			switch (action)
			{
			case "Send":
				return;
			case "Listen":
				return;
			case "Manage":
				return;
			}
			throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.UnsupportedAction(action), "action");
		}

		protected abstract IAsyncResult OnBeginGetToken(string appliesTo, string action, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state);

		protected abstract IAsyncResult OnBeginGetWebToken(string appliesTo, string action, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state);

		protected abstract SecurityToken OnEndGetToken(IAsyncResult result, out DateTime cacheUntil);

		protected abstract string OnEndGetWebToken(IAsyncResult result, out DateTime cacheUntil);

		protected virtual Key BuildKey(string appliesTo, string action)
		{
			return new Key(appliesTo, action);
		}

		protected virtual string NormalizeAppliesTo(string appliesTo)
		{
			return ServiceBusUriHelper.NormalizeUri(appliesTo, "http", StripQueryParameters, TokenScope == TokenScope.Namespace, ensureTrailingSlash: true).AbsoluteUri;
		}

		private string NormalizeAppliesTo(Uri namespaceAddress, string appliesTo)
		{
			if (namespaceAddress != null)
			{
				string uri = ((TokenScope == TokenScope.Namespace && namespaceAddress != null) ? namespaceAddress.AbsoluteUri : appliesTo);
				return ServiceBusUriHelper.NormalizeUri(uri, "http", StripQueryParameters, stripPath: false, ensureTrailingSlash: true).AbsoluteUri;
			}
			return NormalizeAppliesTo(appliesTo);
		}

		private static void ValidateTimeout(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			if (timeout < TimeSpan.Zero)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("timeout");
			}
		}

		private TokenInfo GetTokenInfoFromCache(Key key)
		{
			lock (mutex)
			{
				if (!CacheTokens)
				{
					return new TokenInfo();
				}
				if (!tokenCache.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
				{
					value = new TokenInfo();
					tokenCache.Add(key, value);
					return value;
				}
				DateTime dateTime = DateTime.UtcNow + MinimumCachedTokenTimeToLive;
				if (value.WebTokenCacheUntil < dateTime)
				{
					value.ResetWebToken();
				}
				if (value.SecurityTokenCacheUntil < dateTime)
				{
					value.ResetSecurityToken();
				}
				return value;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class SocketConnectionChannelFactory<TChannel> : ConnectionOrientedTransportChannelFactory<TChannel>, ISocketConnectionChannelFactorySettings, IConnectionOrientedTransportChannelFactorySettings, IConnectionOrientedTransportFactorySettings, ITransportFactorySettings, IDefaultCommunicationTimeouts, IConnectionOrientedConnectionSettings
	{
		private class DuplexSessionChannel : LayeredDuplexSessionChannel, IDuplexSessionChannel, IDuplexChannel, IInputChannel, IChannel, ICommunicationObject, IOutputChannel, ISessionChannel<IDuplexSession>
		{
			private static readonly Action<object> pingCallbackStatic = PingCallbackStatic;

			private readonly MessageVersion messageVersion;

			private readonly IOThreadTimer pingTimer;

			private readonly bool enableKeepAlive;

			private bool suppressPing;

			private int messagesInFlight;

			public DuplexSessionChannel(ChannelManagerBase channelManager, IDuplexSessionChannel innerChannel, MessageVersion messageVersion, bool enableKeepAlive)
				: base(channelManager, innerChannel)
			{
				this.messageVersion = messageVersion;
				this.enableKeepAlive = enableKeepAlive;
				pingTimer = new IOThreadTimer(pingCallbackStatic, this, isTypicallyCanceledShortlyAfterBeingSet: false);
				suppressPing = false;
			}

			public override IAsyncResult BeginSend(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{
				if (enableKeepAlive && Interlocked.Increment(ref messagesInFlight) == 1)
				{
					suppressPing = true;
					pingTimer.Cancel();
				}
				try
				{
					return base.InnerChannel.BeginSend(message, timeout, callback, state);
				}
				catch
				{
					if (enableKeepAlive && Interlocked.Decrement(ref messagesInFlight) == 0)
					{
						pingTimer.Set(ConnectConstants.ConnectionPingTimeout);
						suppressPing = false;
					}
					throw;
				}
			}

			public override void EndSend(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				try
				{
					base.InnerChannel.EndSend(result);
				}
				finally
				{
					if (enableKeepAlive && Interlocked.Decrement(ref messagesInFlight) == 0)
					{
						pingTimer.Set(ConnectConstants.ConnectionPingTimeout);
						suppressPing = false;
					}
				}
			}

			public override void Send(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, TimeSpan timeout)
			{
				if (enableKeepAlive && Interlocked.Increment(ref messagesInFlight) == 1)
				{
					suppressPing = true;
					pingTimer.Cancel();
				}
				try
				{
					base.InnerChannel.Send(message, timeout);
				}
				finally
				{
					if (enableKeepAlive && Interlocked.Decrement(ref messagesInFlight) == 0)
					{
						pingTimer.Set(ConnectConstants.ConnectionPingTimeout);
						suppressPing = false;
					}
				}
			}

			protected override void OnOpened()
			{
				base.OnOpened();
				if (enableKeepAlive)
				{
					pingTimer.Set(ConnectConstants.ConnectionPingTimeout);
					suppressPing = false;
				}
			}

			protected override void OnClosing()
			{
				if (enableKeepAlive)
				{
					suppressPing = true;
					pingTimer.Cancel();
				}
				base.OnClosing();
			}

			private static void PingCallbackStatic(object state)
			{
				DuplexSessionChannel duplexSessionChannel = (DuplexSessionChannel)state;
				duplexSessionChannel.PingCallbackAsync().Fork();
			}

			private async Task PingCallbackAsync()
			{
				if (suppressPing || base.State == CommunicationState.Closing || base.State == CommunicationState.Closed || base.State == CommunicationState.Faulted)
				{
					return;
				}
				try
				{
					System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message = System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message.CreateMessage(messageVersion, "Ping", new PingMessage());
					Interlocked.Increment(ref messagesInFlight);
					await this.SendAsync(message, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10.0)).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					Interlocked.Decrement(ref messagesInFlight);
					lock (base.ThisLock)
					{
						if (!suppressPing && base.State != CommunicationState.Closing && base.State != CommunicationState.Closed && base.State != CommunicationState.Faulted)
						{
							pingTimer.Set(ConnectConstants.ConnectionPingTimeout);
						}
					}
				}
				catch (Exception exception) when (!Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					ServiceBusEventSource.Log.HandledException(exception, null, EventLevel.Warning, "PingCallbackAsync", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\SocketConnection\\SocketConnectionChannelFactory.cs", 247);
					Abort();
				}
			}
		}

		private static SocketConnectionPoolRegistry connectionPoolRegistry = new SocketConnectionPoolRegistry();

		private TimeSpan leaseTimeout;

		private IConnectionElement connectionElement;

		private MessageVersion messageVersion;

		private ISecurityCapabilities securityCapabilities;

		private bool enableKeepAlive;

		public TimeSpan LeaseTimeout => leaseTimeout;

		public override string Scheme => "sb";

		internal BindingContext Context { get; }

		public SocketConnectionChannelFactory(SocketConnectionBindingElement bindingElement, BindingContext context, bool enableKeepAlive)
			: base((Microsoft.ServiceBus.Channels.ConnectionOrientedTransportBindingElement)bindingElement, context, bindingElement.ConnectionPoolSettings.GroupName, bindingElement.ConnectionPoolSettings.IdleTimeout, bindingElement.ConnectionPoolSettings.MaxOutboundConnectionsPerEndpoint)
		{
			this.enableKeepAlive = enableKeepAlive;
			connectionElement = bindingElement.ConnectionElement;
			leaseTimeout = bindingElement.ConnectionPoolSettings.LeaseTimeout;
			messageVersion = context.Binding.MessageVersion;
			securityCapabilities = bindingElement.GetProperty<ISecurityCapabilities>(context);
			Context = context;
		}

		internal override IConnectionInitiator GetConnectionInitiator()
		{
			IConnectionInitiator connectionInitiator = connectionElement.CreateInitiator(base.ConnectionBufferSize);
			return new BufferedConnectionInitiator(connectionInitiator, base.MaxOutputDelay, base.ConnectionBufferSize);
		}

		internal override ConnectionPool GetConnectionPool()
		{
			return connectionPoolRegistry.Lookup(this);
		}

		internal override void ReleaseConnectionPool(ConnectionPool pool, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			connectionPoolRegistry.Release(pool, timeout);
		}

		protected override TChannel OnCreateChannel(EndpointAddress address, Uri via)
		{
			TChannel innerChannel = base.OnCreateChannel(address, via);
			return WrapChannel(innerChannel);
		}

		public override T GetProperty<T>()
		{
			if (typeof(T) == typeof(ISecurityCapabilities))
			{
				return (T)securityCapabilities;
			}
			return base.GetProperty<T>();
		}

		private TChannel WrapChannel(TChannel innerChannel)
		{
			if (typeof(TChannel) == typeof(IDuplexSessionChannel))
			{
				return (TChannel)(object)new DuplexSessionChannel(this, (IDuplexSessionChannel)(object)innerChannel, messageVersion, enableKeepAlive);
			}
			if (typeof(TChannel) == typeof(IRequestChannel))
			{
				return innerChannel;
			}
			throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new NotSupportedException(SRClient.NotSupportedTypeofChannel), null, "Relay", this, EventLevel.Warning, "WrapChannel", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\SocketConnection\\SocketConnectionChannelFactory.cs", 109);
		}

	internal abstract class SocketConnectionChannelListener<TChannel, TChannelAcceptor> : SocketConnectionChannelListener, IChannelListener<TChannel>, IChannelListener, ICommunicationObject where TChannel : class, IChannel where TChannelAcceptor : ChannelAcceptor<TChannel>
	{
		private class DuplexSessionChannel : LayeredChannel<IDuplexSessionChannel>, IDuplexSessionChannel, IDuplexChannel, IInputChannel, IChannel, ICommunicationObject, IOutputChannel, ISessionChannel<IDuplexSession>
		{
			private sealed class ReceiveAsyncResult : AsyncResult<ReceiveAsyncResult>
			{
				private static readonly AsyncCallback receiveCallback = ReceiveCallback;

				private readonly DuplexSessionChannel channel;

				private TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper;

				public System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message Message { get; private set; }

				protected internal override EventTraceActivity Activity => channel.Activity;

				public ReceiveAsyncResult(DuplexSessionChannel channel, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
					: base(callback, state)
				{
					this.channel = channel;
					timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
					Receive(calledSync: true);
				}

				private void Receive(bool calledSync)
				{
					IAsyncResult asyncResult = channel.innerChannel.BeginReceive(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime(), receiveCallback, this);
					if (asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
					{
						ReceiveComplete(asyncResult, calledSync);
					}
				}

				private static void ReceiveStatic(object state)
				{
					ReceiveAsyncResult receiveAsyncResult = (ReceiveAsyncResult)state;
					try
					{
						receiveAsyncResult.Receive(calledSync: false);
					}
					catch (Exception e)
					{
						if (Fx.IsFatal(e))
						{
							throw;
						}
						receiveAsyncResult.Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: false, e);
					}
				}

				private static void ReceiveCallback(IAsyncResult result)
				{
					if (!result.CompletedSynchronously)
					{
						((ReceiveAsyncResult)result.AsyncState).ReceiveComplete(result, completedSynchronously: false);
					}
				}

				private void ReceiveComplete(IAsyncResult result, bool completedSynchronously)
				{
					Exception e = null;
					try
					{
						System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message = channel.innerChannel.EndReceive(result);
						if (message != null && message.Headers.Action == "Ping")
						{
							IOThreadScheduler.ScheduleCallbackNoFlow(delegate(object s)
							{
								ReceiveStatic(s);
							}, this);
							return;
						}
						Message = message;
					}
					catch (Exception ex)
					{
						if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
						{
							throw;
						}
						e = ex;
					}
					Complete(completedSynchronously, e);
				}
			}

			private sealed class TryReceiveAsyncResult : AsyncResult<TryReceiveAsyncResult>
			{
				private static readonly AsyncCallback receiveCallback = ReceiveCallback;

				private IDuplexSessionChannel innerChannel;

				private bool success;

				private TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper;

				public System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message Message { get; private set; }

				public TryReceiveAsyncResult(IDuplexSessionChannel innerChannel, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
					: base(callback, state)
				{
					this.innerChannel = innerChannel;
					timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
					Receive(calledSync: true);
				}

				private void Receive(bool calledSync)
				{
					IAsyncResult asyncResult = innerChannel.BeginTryReceive(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime(), receiveCallback, this);
					if (asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
					{
						ReceiveComplete(asyncResult, calledSync);
					}
				}

				private static void ReceiveStatic(object state)
				{
					TryReceiveAsyncResult tryReceiveAsyncResult = (TryReceiveAsyncResult)state;
					try
					{
						tryReceiveAsyncResult.Receive(calledSync: false);
					}
					catch (Exception e)
					{
						if (Fx.IsFatal(e))
						{
							throw;
						}
						tryReceiveAsyncResult.Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: false, e);
					}
				}

				private static void ReceiveCallback(IAsyncResult result)
				{
					if (!result.CompletedSynchronously)
					{
						((TryReceiveAsyncResult)result.AsyncState).ReceiveComplete(result, completedSynchronously: false);
					}
				}

				private void ReceiveComplete(IAsyncResult result, bool completedSynchronously)
				{
					Exception e = null;
					try
					{
						System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message;
						bool flag = innerChannel.EndTryReceive(result, out message);
						if (flag && message != null && message.Headers.Action == "Ping")
						{
							IOThreadScheduler.ScheduleCallbackNoFlow(delegate(object s)
							{
								ReceiveStatic(s);
							}, this);
							return;
						}
						success = flag;
						Message = message;
					}
					catch (Exception ex)
					{
						if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
						{
							throw;
						}
						e = ex;
					}
					Complete(completedSynchronously, e);
				}

				public static bool End(IAsyncResult result, out System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message)
				{
					TryReceiveAsyncResult tryReceiveAsyncResult = Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult.End<TryReceiveAsyncResult>(result);
					message = tryReceiveAsyncResult.Message;
					return tryReceiveAsyncResult.success;
				}
			}

			private IDuplexSessionChannel innerChannel;

			public EndpointAddress LocalAddress => innerChannel.LocalAddress;

			public EndpointAddress RemoteAddress => innerChannel.RemoteAddress;

			public IDuplexSession Session => innerChannel.Session;

			public Uri Via => innerChannel.Via;

			private EventTraceActivity Activity { get; set; }

			public DuplexSessionChannel(ChannelManagerBase channelManager, IDuplexSessionChannel innerChannel)
				: base(channelManager, innerChannel)
			{
				this.innerChannel = innerChannel;
				Activity = innerChannel.GetProperty<EventTraceActivity>() ?? new EventTraceActivity();
			}

			public IAsyncResult BeginReceive(AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{
				return BeginReceive(base.DefaultReceiveTimeout, callback, state);
			}

			public IAsyncResult BeginReceive(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{
				return new ReceiveAsyncResult(this, timeout, callback, state);
			}

			public IAsyncResult BeginTryReceive(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{
				return new TryReceiveAsyncResult(innerChannel, timeout, callback, state);
			}

			public IAsyncResult BeginWaitForMessage(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{
				return innerChannel.BeginWaitForMessage(timeout, callback, state);
			}

			public System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message EndReceive(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				return AsyncResult<ReceiveAsyncResult>.End(result).Message;

	internal class SocketConnectionTransportManager : ConnectionOrientedTransportManager<SocketConnectionChannelListener>
	{
		private ConnectionDemuxer connectionDemuxer;

		private IConnectionElement connectionElement;

		private IConnectionListener connectionListener;

		private int listenBacklog;

		private Uri listenUri;

		private SocketConnectionTransportManagerRegistration registration;

		public int ListenBacklog => listenBacklog;

		internal override string Scheme => "sb";

		public SocketConnectionTransportManager(SocketConnectionTransportManagerRegistration registration, SocketConnectionChannelListener channelListener)
		{
			ApplyListenerSettings(channelListener);
			listenUri = channelListener.BaseUri;
			listenBacklog = channelListener.ListenBacklog;
			this.registration = registration;
			connectionElement = channelListener.ConnectionElement;
		}

		internal override void OnOpen(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
			IConnectionListener connectionListener = connectionElement.CreateListener(base.ConnectionBufferSize, listenUri);
			this.connectionListener = new BufferedConnectionListener(connectionListener, base.MaxOutputDelay, base.ConnectionBufferSize);
			connectionDemuxer = new ConnectionDemuxer(this.connectionListener, base.MaxPendingAccepts, base.MaxPendingConnections, base.ChannelInitializationTimeout, base.IdleTimeout, base.MaxPooledConnections, base.OnGetTransportFactorySettings, base.OnGetSingletonMessageHandler, base.OnHandleServerSessionPreamble, base.OnDemuxerError);
			bool flag = false;
			try
			{
				connectionDemuxer.Open(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
				flag = true;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (!flag)
				{
					if (registration != null)
					{
						registration.Dispose();
						registration = null;
					}
					connectionDemuxer.Abort();
				}
			}
		}

		internal override void OnClose(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
			try
			{
				connectionDemuxer.Close(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				connectionDemuxer.Abort();
			}
			try
			{
				connectionListener.Close(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
			}
			catch (Exception exception2)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception2))
				{
					throw;
				}
				connectionListener.Abort();
			}
			registration.Dispose();
			registration = null;
		}

	internal class SocketConnectionTransportManagerRegistration : TransportManagerRegistration, IDisposable
	{
		private int connectionBufferSize;

		private TimeSpan channelInitializationTimeout;

		private TimeSpan idleTimeout;

		private int maxPooledConnections;

		private bool teredoEnabled;

		private int listenBacklog;

		private TimeSpan maxOutputDelay;

		private int maxPendingConnections;

		private int maxPendingAccepts;

		private TransferMode transferMode;

		private SocketConnectionTransportManager transportManager;

		private UriPrefixTable<ITransportManagerRegistration> transportManagerTable;

		public bool TeredoEnabled => teredoEnabled;

		public SocketConnectionTransportManagerRegistration(Uri listenUri, SocketConnectionChannelListener channelListener)
			: base(listenUri, channelListener.HostNameComparisonMode)
		{
			connectionBufferSize = channelListener.ConnectionBufferSize;
			channelInitializationTimeout = channelListener.ChannelInitializationTimeout;
			teredoEnabled = channelListener.TeredoEnabled;
			listenBacklog = channelListener.ListenBacklog;
			maxOutputDelay = channelListener.MaxOutputDelay;
			maxPendingConnections = channelListener.MaxPendingConnections;
			maxPendingAccepts = channelListener.MaxPendingAccepts;
			idleTimeout = channelListener.IdleTimeout;
			maxPooledConnections = channelListener.MaxPooledConnections;
			transferMode = channelListener.TransferMode;
			connectionElement = channelListener.ConnectionElement;
			transportManagerTable = channelListener.TransportManagerTable;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return GetType().Name + "(" + base.ListenUri?.ToString() + ")";
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			transportManager = null;
			transportManagerTable.UnregisterUri(base.ListenUri, base.HostNameComparisonMode);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		private bool IsCompatible(SocketConnectionChannelListener channelListener)
		{
			if (channelListener.InheritBaseAddressSettings)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (connectionElement.IsCompatible(channelListener.ConnectionElement) && channelInitializationTimeout == channelListener.ChannelInitializationTimeout && idleTimeout == channelListener.IdleTimeout && maxPooledConnections == channelListener.MaxPooledConnections && connectionBufferSize == channelListener.ConnectionBufferSize && teredoEnabled == channelListener.TeredoEnabled && listenBacklog == channelListener.ListenBacklog && maxPendingConnections == channelListener.MaxPendingConnections && maxOutputDelay == channelListener.MaxOutputDelay && maxPendingAccepts == channelListener.MaxPendingAccepts)
			{
				return transferMode == TransferMode.Buffered == (channelListener.TransferMode == TransferMode.Buffered);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ProcessSelection(SocketConnectionChannelListener channelListener, ref SocketConnectionTransportManager transportManager, IList<TransportManager> result)
		{
			if (transportManager == null)
			{
				transportManager = new SocketConnectionTransportManager(this, channelListener);
			}
			result.Add(transportManager);
		}

		public override IList<TransportManager> Select(TransportChannelListener channelListener)
		{
			SocketConnectionChannelListener channelListener2 = (SocketConnectionChannelListener)channelListener;
			if (!IsCompatible(channelListener2))
			{
				return null;
			}
			IList<TransportManager> result = new List<TransportManager>();
			ProcessSelection(channelListener2, ref transportManager, result);
			return result;
		}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()

		private class ReceiveMessageAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<ReceiveMessageAsyncResult>

		private sealed class ReadBytesAsyncResult : AsyncResult<ReadBytesAsyncResult>
		{
			private static readonly WaitCallback readCallback = ReadCallback;

			private readonly IConnection connection;

			private readonly int requestedCount;

			private readonly bool throwIfNotAllRead;

			private int totalBytesRead;

			private TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper;

			public ArraySegment<byte> Bytes { get; private set; }

			protected internal override EventTraceActivity Activity => connection.TrackingContext?.Activity;

			public ReadBytesAsyncResult(IConnection connection, int requestedCount, bool throwIfNotAllRead, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(callback, state)
			{
				this.connection = connection;
				this.requestedCount = requestedCount;
				this.throwIfNotAllRead = throwIfNotAllRead;
				timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
				if (BeginRead() == AsyncReadResult.Completed)
				{
					ReadComplete(calledSynchronously: true);
				}
			}

			private AsyncReadResult BeginRead()
			{
				return connection.BeginRead(totalBytesRead, requestedCount - totalBytesRead, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime(), readCallback, this);
			}

			private static void ReadCallback(object state)
			{
				ReadBytesAsyncResult readBytesAsyncResult = (ReadBytesAsyncResult)state;
				readBytesAsyncResult.ReadComplete(calledSynchronously: false);
			}

			private void ReadComplete(bool calledSynchronously)
			{
				try
				{
					int num = connection.EndRead();
					if (num == 0)
					{
						if (throwIfNotAllRead)
						{
							TimeSpan timeSpan = timeoutHelper.OriginalTimeout - timeoutHelper.RemainingTime();
							throw new InvalidDataException(Resources.PrematureEOF + " " + timeSpan.ToString());
						}
						Bytes = new ArraySegment<byte>(connection.AsyncReadBuffer, 0, totalBytesRead);
						Complete(calledSynchronously);
						return;
					}
					totalBytesRead += num;
					if (totalBytesRead != requestedCount)
					{
						AsyncReadResult asyncReadResult = AsyncReadResult.Completed;
						while (totalBytesRead != requestedCount && asyncReadResult == AsyncReadResult.Completed)
						{
							asyncReadResult = BeginRead();
							if (asyncReadResult != AsyncReadResult.Completed)
							{
								continue;
							}
							num = connection.EndRead();
							if (num == 0)
							{
								if (throwIfNotAllRead)
								{
									TimeSpan timeSpan2 = timeoutHelper.OriginalTimeout - timeoutHelper.RemainingTime();
									throw new InvalidDataException(Resources.PrematureEOF + " " + timeSpan2.ToString());
								}
								Bytes = new ArraySegment<byte>(connection.AsyncReadBuffer, 0, totalBytesRead);
								Complete(calledSynchronously);
								break;
							}
							totalBytesRead += num;
							if (totalBytesRead == requestedCount)
							{
								Bytes = new ArraySegment<byte>(connection.AsyncReadBuffer, 0, totalBytesRead);
								Complete(calledSynchronously);
								break;
							}
						}
					}
					else
					{
						Bytes = new ArraySegment<byte>(connection.AsyncReadBuffer, 0, totalBytesRead);
						Complete(calledSynchronously);
					}
				}
				catch (Exception e)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(e))
					{
						throw;
					}
					Complete(calledSynchronously, e);
				}
			}
		}

		private sealed class ReadBytesAsyncTask
		{
			private readonly IConnection connection;

			private readonly int requestedCount;

			private readonly bool throwIfNotAllRead;

			private readonly TaskCompletionSource<ArraySegment<byte>> tcs;

			private int totalBytesRead;

			private TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper;

			public Task<ArraySegment<byte>> Task => tcs.Task;

			public ReadBytesAsyncTask(IConnection connection, int requestedCount, bool throwIfNotAllRead, TimeSpan timeout)
			{
				this.connection = connection;
				this.requestedCount = requestedCount;
				this.throwIfNotAllRead = throwIfNotAllRead;
				tcs = new TaskCompletionSource<ArraySegment<byte>>();
				timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
				try
				{
					if (BeginRead() == AsyncReadResult.Completed)
					{
						ReadComplete();
					}
				}
				catch (Exception exception)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
					{
						throw;
					}
					tcs.TrySetException(exception);
				}
			}

			private AsyncReadResult BeginRead()
			{
				return connection.BeginRead(totalBytesRead, requestedCount - totalBytesRead, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime(), delegate(object s)
				{
					ReadCallback(s);
				}, this);
			}

			private static void ReadCallback(object state)
			{
				ReadBytesAsyncTask readBytesAsyncTask = (ReadBytesAsyncTask)state;
				try
				{
					readBytesAsyncTask.ReadComplete();
				}
				catch (Exception exception)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
					{
						throw;
					}
					readBytesAsyncTask.tcs.TrySetException(exception);
				}
			}

			private void ReadComplete()
			{
				AsyncReadResult asyncReadResult;
				do
				{
					int num = connection.EndRead();
					totalBytesRead += num;
					if (num == 0)
					{
						if (throwIfNotAllRead)
						{
							TimeSpan timeSpan = timeoutHelper.OriginalTimeout - timeoutHelper.RemainingTime();
							throw new InvalidDataException(Resources.PrematureEOF + " " + timeSpan.ToString());
						}
						tcs.TrySetResult(new ArraySegment<byte>(connection.AsyncReadBuffer, 0, totalBytesRead));
						break;
					}
					if (totalBytesRead == requestedCount)
					{
						tcs.TrySetResult(new ArraySegment<byte>(connection.AsyncReadBuffer, 0, requestedCount));
						break;
					}
					asyncReadResult = BeginRead();
				}
				while (asyncReadResult != AsyncReadResult.Queued);
			}
		}

		private const int SendMessageOffset = 4;

		private BufferManager SendBufferManager { get; set; }

		private BufferManager ReceiveBufferManager { get; set; }

		private MessageEncoder MessageEncoder { get; set; }

		public MessageVersion MessageVersion => MessageEncoder.MessageVersion;

		public SocketMessageHelper(MessageEncoder messageEncoder)
		{
			SendBufferManager = BufferManager.CreateBufferManager(67108864L, 65536);
			ReceiveBufferManager = BufferManager.CreateBufferManager(0L, 65536);
			MessageEncoder = messageEncoder;
		}

		public SocketMessageHelper()
			: this(ClientMessageUtility.DefaultBinaryMessageEncoderFactory.Encoder)
		{
		}

		public void SendMessage(IConnection connection, System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message)
		{
			SendMessage(connection, message, TimeSpan.MaxValue);
		}

		public void SendMessage(IConnection connection, System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			SendMessageAsyncResult sendMessageAsyncResult = new SendMessageAsyncResult(this, connection, message, timeout, null, null);
			sendMessageAsyncResult.RunSynchronously();
		}

		public async Task SendMessageAsync(IConnection connection, System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
			ArraySegment<byte> messageBytes = MessageEncoder.WriteMessage(message, 65536, SendBufferManager, 4);
			try
			{
				byte[] bytes = BitConverter.GetBytes(messageBytes.Count);
				Array.Copy(bytes, 0, messageBytes.Array, 0, bytes.Length);
				await connection.WriteAsync(new ArraySegment<byte>(messageBytes.Array, 0, 4), immediate: true, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime()).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				await connection.WriteAsync(new ArraySegment<byte>(messageBytes.Array, messageBytes.Offset, messageBytes.Count), immediate: true, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime()).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			finally
			{
				SendBufferManager.ReturnBuffer(messageBytes.Array);
			}
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginSendMessage(IConnection connection, System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			SendMessageAsyncResult sendMessageAsyncResult = new SendMessageAsyncResult(this, connection, message, timeout, callback, state);
			return sendMessageAsyncResult.Start();
		}

		public void EndSendMessage(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			AsyncResult<SendMessageAsyncResult>.End(result);
		}

		public System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message ReceiveMessage(IConnection connection, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			ReceiveMessageAsyncResult receiveMessageAsyncResult = new ReceiveMessageAsyncResult(this, connection, timeout, null, null);
			receiveMessageAsyncResult.RunSynchronously();
			return receiveMessageAsyncResult.Message;
		}

		public async Task<System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message> ReceiveMessageAsync(IConnection connection, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
			int size = BitConverter.ToInt32((await ReceiveBytesAsync(connection, 4, throwIfNotAllRead: true, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime()).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false)).Array, 0);
			ArraySegment<byte> buffer = await ReceiveBytesAsync(connection, size, throwIfNotAllRead: true, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime()).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			return MessageEncoder.ReadMessage(buffer, ReceiveBufferManager);
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginReceiveMessage(IConnection connection, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			ReceiveMessageAsyncResult receiveMessageAsyncResult = new ReceiveMessageAsyncResult(this, connection, timeout, callback, state);
			receiveMessageAsyncResult.Start();
			return receiveMessageAsyncResult;
		}

		public System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message EndReceiveMessage(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			ReceiveMessageAsyncResult receiveMessageAsyncResult = AsyncResult<ReceiveMessageAsyncResult>.End(result);
			return receiveMessageAsyncResult.Message;
		}

		public Task<ArraySegment<byte>> ReceiveBytesAsync(IConnection connection, int size, bool throwIfNotAllRead, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			return new ReadBytesAsyncTask(connection, size, throwIfNotAllRead, timeout).Task;
		}
	}

		private void Validate()
		{
			if (Endpoints.Count == 0)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNullOrEmpty("Endpoints");
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Publisher) && string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(EntityPath))
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.Argument(string.Format("{0}, {1}", "Publisher", "EntityPath"), SRClient.SpecifyPublisherIdOnlyWithEntityPath);
			}
			bool flag = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(SharedSecretIssuerName);
			bool flag2 = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(SharedSecretIssuerSecret);
			if (!(flag && flag2) && (flag || flag2))
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.Argument("SharedSecretIssuerName, SharedSecretIssuerSecret", SRClient.ArgumentInvalidCombination("SharedSecretIssuerName, SharedSecretIssuerSecret"));
			}
			bool flag3 = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(SharedAccessKeyName);
			bool flag4 = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(SharedAccessKey);
			bool flag5 = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(SharedAccessSignature);
			if (flag5)
			{
				if (flag3)
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.Argument(string.Format(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, "{0},{1}", "SharedAccessSignature", "SharedAccessKeyName"), SRClient.SasTokenShouldBeAlone("SharedAccessSignature", "SharedAccessKeyName"));
				}
				if (flag4)
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.Argument(string.Format(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, "{0},{1}", "SharedAccessSignature", "SharedAccessKey"), SRClient.SasTokenShouldBeAlone("SharedAccessSignature", "SharedAccessKey"));
				}
			}
			if (!(flag3 && flag4) && (flag3 || flag4))
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.Argument("SharedAccessKeyName, SharedAccessSecret", SRClient.ArgumentInvalidCombination("SharedAccessKeyName, SharedAccessSecret"));
			}
			bool flag6 = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(WindowsCredentialUsername);
			bool flag7 = WindowsCredentialPassword != null && WindowsCredentialPassword.Length > 0;
			if (!(flag6 && flag7) && (flag6 || flag7))
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.Argument("WindowsCredentialUsername, WindowsCredentialPassword", SRClient.ArgumentInvalidCombination("WindowsCredentialUsername, WindowsCredentialPassword"));
			}
			bool flag8 = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(OAuthUsername);
			bool flag9 = OAuthPassword != null && OAuthPassword.Length > 0;
			if (!(flag8 && flag9) && (flag8 || flag9))
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.Argument("OAuthUsername, OAuthPassword", SRClient.ArgumentInvalidCombination("OAuthUsername, OAuthPassword"));
			}
			bool flag10 = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Authentication);
			if (flag10 && flag)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.Argument("Authentication, SharedSecretIssuer", SRClient.ArgumentInvalidCombination("Authentication, SharedSecretIssuer"));
			}
			if (flag10 && flag3)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.Argument("Authentication, SharedAccessKeyName", SRClient.ArgumentInvalidCombination("Authentication, SharedAccessKeyName"));
			}
			if (flag10 && flag5)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.Argument("Authentication, SharedAccessSignature", SRClient.ArgumentInvalidCombination("Authentication, SharedAccessSignature"));
			}
		}

		private IList<Uri> GetAbsoluteEndpoints(int port, string uriScheme = null)
		{
			IList<Uri> list = new List<Uri>();
			foreach (Uri endpoint in Endpoints)
			{
				UriBuilder uriBuilder = new UriBuilder(endpoint);
				if (port >= 0)
				{
					uriBuilder.Port = port;
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(uriScheme))
				{
					uriBuilder.Scheme = uriScheme;
				}
				list.Add(uriBuilder.Uri);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private void InitializeFromString(string connection)
		{
			InitializeFromKeyValueManager(new KeyValueConfigurationManager(connection));
		}

		private void InitializeFromKeyValueManager(KeyValueConfigurationManager manager)
		{
			try
			{
				manager.Validate();
				string uriEndpoints = manager["Endpoint"];
				string hostNames = manager["HostName"];
				bool flag = true;
				foreach (Uri endpointAddress in KeyValueConfigurationManager.GetEndpointAddresses(uriEndpoints, hostNames, string.Empty))
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						flag = false;
						IsIoTDeviceUri = endpointAddress.IsIoTDeviceUri();
					}
					Endpoints.Add(endpointAddress);
				}
				string uriEndpoints2 = manager["StsEndpoint"];
				foreach (Uri endpointAddress2 in KeyValueConfigurationManager.GetEndpointAddresses(uriEndpoints2, string.Empty))
				{
					StsEndpoints.Add(endpointAddress2);
				}
				string s = manager["RuntimePort"];
				if (int.TryParse(s, out var result))
				{
					RuntimePort = result;
				}
				s = manager["ManagementPort"];
				if (int.TryParse(s, out var result2))
				{
					ManagementPort = result2;
				}
				string text = manager["OperationTimeout"];
				if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text) && TimeSpan.TryParse(text, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, out var result3) && !result3.Equals(OperationTimeout))
				{
					OperationTimeout = result3;
				}
				string text2 = manager["SharedSecretIssuer"];
				if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text2))
				{
					SharedSecretIssuerName = text2;
				}
				string text3 = manager["SharedSecretValue"];
				if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text3))
				{
					SharedSecretIssuerSecret = text3;
				}
				string text4 = manager["SharedAccessKeyName"];
				if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text4))
				{
