	public static class ServiceBusEnvironment
	{
		private static readonly ConnectivitySettings HttpListenerSettings = new ConnectivitySettings();

		public static string DefaultIdentityHostName => RelayEnvironment.StsHostName;

		public static ConnectivitySettings SystemConnectivity => HttpListenerSettings;

		public static Uri CreateAccessControlUri(string serviceNamespace)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(serviceNamespace))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.NullServiceNameSpace, "serviceNamespace");
			}
			return new Uri(string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "https://{0}-sb.{1}:{2}/WRAPv0.9/", serviceNamespace, RelayEnvironment.StsHostName, RelayEnvironment.StsHttpsPort));
		}

		public static Uri CreateServiceUri(string scheme, string serviceNamespace, string servicePath)
		{
			return CreateServiceUri(scheme, serviceNamespace, servicePath, suppressRelayPathPrefix: false, RelayEnvironment.RelayHostRootName);
		}

		public static Uri CreateServiceUri(string scheme, string serviceNamespace, string servicePath, bool suppressRelayPathPrefix)
		{
			return CreateServiceUri(scheme, serviceNamespace, servicePath, suppressRelayPathPrefix, RelayEnvironment.RelayHostRootName);
		}

		internal static string CreateAccessControlIssuer(string serviceNamespace)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(serviceNamespace))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.NullServiceNameSpace, "serviceNamespace");
			}
			if (RelayEnvironment.StsHttpsPort != 443)
			{
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "https://{0}-sb.{1}:{2}/", serviceNamespace, RelayEnvironment.StsHostName, RelayEnvironment.StsHttpsPort);
			}
			return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "https://{0}-sb.{1}/", serviceNamespace, RelayEnvironment.StsHostName);
		}

		private static Uri CreateServiceUri(string scheme, string serviceNamespace, string servicePath, bool suppressRelayPathPrefix, string hostName)
		{
			string serviceNamespace2 = serviceNamespace.Trim();
			ValidateSchemeAndNamespace(scheme, serviceNamespace2);
			if (!servicePath.EndsWith("/", StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				servicePath += "/";
			}
			Uri uri = ServiceBusUriHelper.CreateServiceUri(scheme, serviceNamespace2, hostName, servicePath, suppressRelayPathPrefix);
			if (!ServiceBusUriHelper.IsSafeBasicLatinUriPath(uri))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.PathSegmentASCIICharacters, servicePath);
			}
			return uri;
		}

		private static void ValidateSchemeAndNamespace(string scheme, string serviceNamespace)
		{
			if (!ValidateScheme(scheme))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.InvalidSchemeValue("sb"), "scheme");
			}
			if (!ValidateServiceNamespace(serviceNamespace))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.InvalidServiceNameSpace(serviceNamespace), "serviceNamespace");
			}
		}

		private static bool ValidateScheme(string scheme)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(scheme))
			{
				if (!scheme.Equals("http") && !scheme.Equals("https"))
				{
					return scheme.Equals("sb");
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool ValidateServiceNamespace(string serviceNamespace)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(serviceNamespace))
			{
				return ServiceBusUriHelper.IsBasicLatinNonControlString(serviceNamespace);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	[DataContract(Name = "Error", Namespace = "")]
	public class ServiceBusErrorData : IExtensibleDataObject
	{
		public const string RootTag = "Error";

		public const string HttpStatusCodeTag = "Code";

		public const string DetailTag = "Detail";

		private ExtensionDataObject extensionDataObject;

		[DataMember(Name = "Code", Order = 101, IsRequired = false, EmitDefaultValue = false)]
		public int Code { get; set; }

		[DataMember(Name = "Detail", Order = 102, IsRequired = false, EmitDefaultValue = false)]
		public string Detail { get; set; }

		public ExtensionDataObject ExtensionData
		{
			get
			{
				return extensionDataObject;
			}
			set
			{
				extensionDataObject = value;
			}
		}

		public static ServiceBusErrorData GetServiceBusErrorData(HttpWebResponse webResponse)
		{
			Stream stream = null;
			ServiceBusErrorData serviceBusErrorData = null;
			try
			{
				stream = webResponse.GetResponseStream();
			}
			catch (ProtocolViolationException)
			{
			}
			if (stream != null)
			{
				serviceBusErrorData = GetServiceBusErrorData(stream);
			}
			if (serviceBusErrorData == null)
			{
				serviceBusErrorData = new ServiceBusErrorData();
				serviceBusErrorData.Code = Convert.ToInt16(webResponse.StatusCode, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				serviceBusErrorData.Detail = webResponse.StatusDescription;
			}
			return serviceBusErrorData;
		}

		public static ServiceBusErrorData GetServiceBusErrorData(Stream responseStream)
		{
			if (responseStream.CanSeek)
			{
				responseStream.Position = 0L;
			}
			ServiceBusErrorData serviceBusErrorData = new ServiceBusErrorData();
			using StreamReader streamReader = new StreamReader(responseStream);
			string text = streamReader.ReadToEnd();
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
			{
				return null;
			}
			using XmlReader xmlReader = XmlReader.Create(new StringReader(text));
			try
			{
				xmlReader.Read();
				xmlReader.ReadStartElement("Error");
				xmlReader.ReadStartElement("Code");
				serviceBusErrorData.Code = Convert.ToInt32(xmlReader.ReadString(), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				xmlReader.ReadEndElement();
				xmlReader.ReadStartElement("Detail");
				serviceBusErrorData.Detail = xmlReader.ReadString();
				return serviceBusErrorData;
			}
			catch (XmlException)
			{
				serviceBusErrorData.Detail = text;
				return serviceBusErrorData;
			}
		}
	}
	internal static class ServiceBusUriHelper
	{
		private static class ServiceBusStringExtension
		{
			private const int MinServiceNamespaceLength = 6;

			private const int MaxServiceNamespaceLength = 50;

			private static readonly string ServiceNamespacePattern = "^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9-]{" + 4 + "," + 48 + "}[a-zA-Z0-9]$";

			private static readonly Regex ServiceNamespaceRegex = new Regex(ServiceNamespacePattern, RegexOptions.Compiled);

			private static IEnumerable<string> reservedHostnameSuffixes = new string[3] { "-sb", "-mgmt", "-sb-mgmt" };

			public static bool IsValidServiceNamespace(string serviceNamespaceCandidate, bool isReservedSuffixAllowed)
			{
				if (serviceNamespaceCandidate == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				string suffix;
				bool flag = HasReservedSuffix(serviceNamespaceCandidate, out suffix);
				if (!isReservedSuffixAllowed && flag)
				{
					return false;
				}
				serviceNamespaceCandidate = (flag ? StripReservedSuffix(serviceNamespaceCandidate, suffix) : serviceNamespaceCandidate);
				if (!ServiceNamespaceRegex.IsMatch(serviceNamespaceCandidate))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (serviceNamespaceCandidate.StartsWith("xn--", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}

			private static string StripReservedSuffix(string serviceNamespaceCandidate, string suffix)
			{
				return serviceNamespaceCandidate.Substring(0, serviceNamespaceCandidate.Length - suffix.Length);
			}

			private static bool HasReservedSuffix(string serviceNamespaceCandidate, out string suffix)
			{
				suffix = reservedHostnameSuffixes.FirstOrDefault((string s) => serviceNamespaceCandidate.EndsWith(s, StringComparison.Ordinal));
				return suffix != null;
			}
		}

		private const int MaxCacheItem = 10000;

		public static readonly Regex SafeBasicLatinUriSegmentExpression = new Regex("^[\\u0020\\u0021\\u0024-\\u002E\\u0030-\\u003B\\u003D\\u0040-\\u005B\\u005D-\\u007D\\u007E]*/?$", RegexOptions.Compiled);

		public static readonly Regex SafeMessagingEntityNameExpression = new Regex("^[\\w-\\.\\$]*/?$", RegexOptions.Compiled | RegexOptions.ECMAScript);

		private static readonly Regex BasicLatinNonControlStringExpression = new Regex("^[\\u0020-\\u007E]*$", RegexOptions.Compiled);

		private static readonly ConcurrentDictionary<Uri, string> uriCache = new ConcurrentDictionary<Uri, string>();

		private static bool IsOneboxEnvironment => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(RelayEnvironment.RelayPathPrefix);

		internal static Uri CreateServiceUri(string scheme, string authority, string servicePath)
		{
			return CreateServiceUri(scheme, authority, servicePath, suppressRelayPathPrefix: false);
		}

		internal static Uri CreateServiceUri(string scheme, string authority, string servicePath, bool suppressRelayPathPrefix)
		{
			string uri = "tempscheme://" + authority;
			UriBuilder uriBuilder = new UriBuilder(uri);
			if (uriBuilder.Port == -1)
			{
				uriBuilder.Port = GetSchemePort(scheme);
			}
			uriBuilder.Scheme = scheme;
			uriBuilder.Path = RefinePath(servicePath, suppressRelayPathPrefix);
			return uriBuilder.Uri;
		}

		internal static Uri CreateServiceUri(string scheme, string serviceNamespace, string hostName, string servicePath)
		{
			return CreateServiceUri(scheme, serviceNamespace, hostName, servicePath, suppressRelayPathPrefix: false);
		}

		internal static Uri CreateServiceUri(string scheme, string serviceNamespace, string hostName, string servicePath, bool suppressRelayPathPrefix)
		{
			string authority = (string.IsNullOrEmpty(serviceNamespace) ? hostName : string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}.{1}", serviceNamespace, hostName));
			return CreateServiceUri(scheme, authority, servicePath, suppressRelayPathPrefix);
		}

		private static int GetSchemePort(string scheme)
		{
			return scheme switch
			{
				"http" => RelayEnvironment.RelayHttpPort, 
				"https" => RelayEnvironment.RelayHttpsPort, 
				_ => -1, 
			};
		}

		internal static bool IsRequestAuthorityIpAddress(Uri requestUri)
		{
			if (requestUri == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (requestUri.HostNameType != UriHostNameType.IPv4)
			{
				return requestUri.HostNameType == UriHostNameType.IPv6;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static string RemoveServicePathPrefix(string path)
		{
			TryRemoveServicePathPrefix(path, out var refinedPath, throwOnFailure: true);
			return refinedPath;
		}

		internal static bool TryRemoveServicePathPrefix(string path, out string refinedPath)
		{
			return TryRemoveServicePathPrefix(path, out refinedPath, throwOnFailure: false);
		}

		private static bool TryRemoveServicePathPrefix(string path, out string refinedPath, bool throwOnFailure)
		{
			refinedPath = path;
			if (!IsOneboxEnvironment)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!path.StartsWith(RelayEnvironment.RelayPathPrefix, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				if (throwOnFailure)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.InputURIPath(path));
				}
				return false;
			}
			refinedPath = path.Substring(RelayEnvironment.RelayPathPrefix.Length);
			return true;
		}

		public static Uri EnsurePathEndsWith(this Uri uri, string value, StringComparison comparisonType = StringComparison.Ordinal)
		{
			if (uri.AbsolutePath.EndsWith(value, comparisonType))
			{
				return uri;
			}
			UriBuilder uriBuilder = new UriBuilder(uri);
			uriBuilder.Path += value;
			return uriBuilder.Uri;
		}

		internal static Uri NormalizeUri(Uri uri, bool ensureTrailingSlash = false)
		{
			return NormalizeUri(uri.AbsoluteUri, uri.Scheme, stripQueryParameters: true, stripPath: false, ensureTrailingSlash);
		}

		internal static Uri NormalizeUri(string uri, string scheme, bool stripQueryParameters = true, bool stripPath = false, bool ensureTrailingSlash = false)
		{
			UriBuilder uriBuilder = new UriBuilder(uri)
			{
				Scheme = scheme,
				Port = -1,
				Fragment = string.Empty,
				Password = string.Empty,
				UserName = string.Empty
			};
			if (stripPath)
			{
				uriBuilder.Path = string.Empty;
			}
			if (stripQueryParameters)
			{
				uriBuilder.Query = string.Empty;
			}
			if (ensureTrailingSlash && !uriBuilder.Path.EndsWith("/", StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				uriBuilder.Path += "/";
			}
			return uriBuilder.Uri;
		}

		internal static bool IsSafeUri(Uri uri)
		{
			if (uri == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("uri");
			}
			string text = HttpUtility.UrlDecode(uri.AbsoluteUri);
			int length = text.Length;
			bool flag = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < length; i++)
			{
				char c = text[i];
				if (!flag && ((c >= ' ' && c <= '~') || (c >= '\u00a0' && c <= '\ud7ff') || (c >= '\ue000' && c <= '\ufffd')))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (!flag && '\ud800' <= c && c <= '\udbff')
				{
					flag = true;
					continue;
				}
				if (flag && '\udc00' <= c && c <= '\udfff')
				{
					flag = false;
					continue;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return !flag;
		}

		internal static string FilterQueryString(string queryString, int removeStartIndex, int removeLength)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(queryString.Length);
			if (removeStartIndex > 0)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(queryString.Substring(0, removeStartIndex - 1));
			}
			if (removeStartIndex + removeLength < queryString.Length)
			{
				int num = removeStartIndex + removeLength;
				if (stringBuilder.Length == 0)
				{
					num++;
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(queryString.Substring(num));
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		internal static Uri ReplaceQueryString(Uri uri, string queryString)
		{
			UriBuilder uriBuilder = new UriBuilder(uri);
			uriBuilder.Query = queryString;
			return uriBuilder.Uri;
		}

		internal static bool IsSafeBasicLatinUriPath(Uri uri)
		{
			if (uri == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("uri");
			}
			string[] segments = uri.Segments;
			for (int i = 1; i < segments.Length; i++)
			{
				string str = segments[i];
				string input = HttpUtility.UrlDecode(str);
				if (!SafeBasicLatinUriSegmentExpression.IsMatch(input))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static bool IsSafeMessagingEntityUriPath(Uri uri)
		{
			if (uri == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("uri");
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(uri.Fragment))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(uri.UserInfo))
			{
				return false;
			}
			string[] segments = uri.Segments;
			for (int i = 1; i < segments.Length; i++)
			{
				string str = segments[i];
				string input = HttpUtility.UrlDecode(str);
				if (!SafeMessagingEntityNameExpression.IsMatch(input))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static bool IsBasicLatinNonControlString(string str)
		{
			return BasicLatinNonControlStringExpression.IsMatch(str);
		}

		internal static string ParseServiceNamespace(this Uri uri, string expectedHostnameSuffix, bool isReservedSuffixAllowed)
		{
			if (uri == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("uri");
			}
			if (expectedHostnameSuffix == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("expectedHostnameSuffix");
			}
			string host = uri.Host;
			string text = null;
			if (host.EndsWith(expectedHostnameSuffix, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				text = host.Replace(expectedHostnameSuffix, string.Empty);
			}
			if (text == null)
			{
				throw new FormatException(SRClient.UnexpedtedURIHostName(uri));
			}
			if (!ServiceBusStringExtension.IsValidServiceNamespace(text, isReservedSuffixAllowed))
			{
				throw new FormatException(SRClient.URIServiceNameSpace(uri));
			}
			return text;
		}

		internal static string GetEntityPerfCounterName(this Uri endpoint)
		{
			if (uriCache.TryGetValue(endpoint, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			if (uriCache.Count > 10000)
			{
				uriCache.Clear();
			}
			UriBuilder uriBuilder = new UriBuilder(endpoint)
			{
				Port = -1
			};
			Uri uri = uriBuilder.Uri;
			int num = uri.AbsoluteUri.IndexOf("://", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
			value = ((num < 0 || uri.AbsoluteUri.Length <= num + 3) ? uri.AbsoluteUri.Replace("/", "|") : uri.AbsoluteUri.Substring(num + 3).Replace("/", "|"));
			uriCache.TryAdd(endpoint, value);
			return value;
		}

		private static string RefinePath(string path, bool suppressRelayPathPrefix)
		{
			string result = path;
			if (!IsOneboxEnvironment || suppressRelayPathPrefix)
			{
				return result;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(path))
			{
				return RelayEnvironment.RelayPathPrefix;
			}
			return path.StartsWith("/", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ? (RelayEnvironment.RelayPathPrefix + path) : (RelayEnvironment.RelayPathPrefix + "/" + path);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class SR : Resources
	{
		internal static string GetString(string value, params object[] args)
		{
			if (args != null && args.Length != 0)
			{
				return string.Format(Resources.Culture, value, args);
			}
			return value;
		}
	}

	internal static class StringExtensions
	{
		public static string EnsureEndsWith(this string str, string value, StringComparison comparisonType = StringComparison.Ordinal)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(str) && str.EndsWith(value, comparisonType))
			{
				return str;
			}
			return str + value;
		}

		public static string EnsureStartsWith(this string s, string value, StringComparison comparisonType = StringComparison.Ordinal)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(s) && s.StartsWith(value, comparisonType))
			{
				return s;
			}
			return value + s;
		}

		public static string FormatInvariant(this string format, params object[] args)
		{
			return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, format, args);
		}

		public static string Truncate(this string s, int maxLength)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(s) || s.Length <= maxLength)
			{
				return s;
			}
			return s.Substring(0, maxLength);
		}
	}
	internal interface ITraceSource
	{
		string Component { get; }

		TrackingContext TrackingContext { get; }
	}
	internal static class TraceSourceExtensions
	{
		public static void Try(this ITraceSource traceSource, Action action, EventLevel level = EventLevel.Warning, [CallerMemberName] string operation = "", [CallerFilePath] string file = "", [CallerLineNumber] int line = 0)
		{
			try
			{
				action();
			}
			catch (Exception exception) when (!Fx.IsFatal(exception))
			{
				ServiceBusEventSource.Log.HandledException(exception, traceSource, level, operation, file, line);
			}
		}

		public static async Task TryAsync(this ITraceSource traceSource, Func<Task> func, EventLevel level = EventLevel.Warning, [CallerMemberName] string operation = "", [CallerFilePath] string file = "", [CallerLineNumber] int line = 0)
		{
			try
			{
				await func().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			catch (Exception exception) when (!Fx.IsFatal(exception))
			{
				ServiceBusEventSource.Log.HandledException(exception, traceSource, level, operation, file, line);
			}
		}
	}

		[System.Diagnostics.Tracing.NonEvent]

		{
			WriteToLevel(trackingContext, component, caller, $"Handled Exception. {trackingContext}, Exception: {ExceptionToString(exception)}", level, operation, file, line);

		[System.Diagnostics.Tracing.NonEvent]
		public TException ThrowingException<TException>(Func<string, TException> createExceptionFunc, string message, ITraceSource traceSource, EventLevel level = EventLevel.Warning, [CallerMemberName] string operation = "", [CallerFilePath] string file = "", [CallerLineNumber] int line = 0) where TException : Exception
		{
			return ThrowingException(createExceptionFunc, message, traceSource?.TrackingContext, traceSource?.Component, traceSource, level, operation, file, line);
		}

		[System.Diagnostics.Tracing.NonEvent]
		public TException ThrowingException<TException>(Func<string, TException> createExceptionFunc, string message, TrackingContext trackingContext, string component, object caller, EventLevel level = EventLevel.Warning, [CallerMemberName] string operation = "", [CallerFilePath] string file = "", [CallerLineNumber] int line = 0) where TException : Exception
		{
			if (trackingContext != null)
			{
				message = trackingContext.CreateTrackableErrorMessage(message);
			}
			TException exception = createExceptionFunc(message);
			return ThrowingException(exception, trackingContext, component, caller, level, operation, file, line);
		}

		[System.Diagnostics.Tracing.NonEvent]
		public TException ThrowingException<TException>(Func<string, Exception, TException> createExceptionFunc, string message, Exception innerException, TrackingContext trackingContext, string component, object caller, EventLevel level = EventLevel.Warning, [CallerMemberName] string operation = "", [CallerFilePath] string file = "", [CallerLineNumber] int line = 0) where TException : Exception
		{
			TException exception = TrackingContext.CreateTrackableException(createExceptionFunc, message, innerException, trackingContext);
			return ThrowingException(exception, trackingContext, component, caller, level, operation, file, line);
		}

		[System.Diagnostics.Tracing.NonEvent]
		public TException ThrowingException<TException>(TException exception, ITraceSource traceSource = null, EventLevel level = EventLevel.Warning, [CallerMemberName] string operation = "", [CallerFilePath] string file = "", [CallerLineNumber] int line = 0) where TException : Exception
		{
			return ThrowingException(exception, traceSource?.TrackingContext, traceSource?.Component, traceSource, level, operation, file, line);
		}

		[System.Diagnostics.Tracing.NonEvent]
		public TException ThrowingException<TException>(TException exception, TrackingContext trackingContext, string component, object caller, EventLevel level = EventLevel.Warning, [CallerMemberName] string operation = "", [CallerFilePath] string file = "", [CallerLineNumber] int line = 0) where TException : Exception
		{
			WriteToLevel(trackingContext, component, caller, "Throwing Exception: " + ExceptionToString(exception), level, operation, file, line);
			return exception;
		}

		[System.Diagnostics.Tracing.NonEvent]
		private void WriteToLevel(TrackingContext trackingContext, string component, object caller, string message, EventLevel level, string operation, string file, int line)
		{
			switch (level)
			{
			case EventLevel.Critical:
				Critical(trackingContext, component, caller, message, operation, file, line);
				break;
			case EventLevel.Warning:
				Warning(trackingContext, component, caller, message, operation, file, line);
				break;
			case EventLevel.Informational:
				Info(trackingContext, component, caller, message, operation, file, line);
				break;
			case EventLevel.Verbose:
				Verbose(trackingContext, component, caller, message, operation, file, line);
				break;
			default:
				Error(trackingContext, component, caller, message, operation, file, line);
				break;
			}
		}

		[System.Diagnostics.Tracing.NonEvent]
		private static string EnsureTrackingId(string message, TrackingContext trackingContext)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(message))
			{
				message = trackingContext?.ToString() ?? string.Empty;
			}
			else if (trackingContext != null && !message.Contains("TrackingId"))
			{
				message = message.EnsureEndsWith(".");
				message = $"{message} {trackingContext}";
			}
			return message;
		}

		[System.Diagnostics.Tracing.NonEvent]
		private static string ExceptionToString(Exception exception)
		{
			return exception.ToStringSlim() ?? string.Empty;
		}

		[System.Diagnostics.Tracing.NonEvent]
		private static void SetCurrentActivity(EventTraceActivity activity)
		{
			if (activity != null)
			{
				System.Diagnostics.Tracing.EventSource.SetCurrentThreadActivityId(activity.ActivityId);
			}
		}

		[System.Diagnostics.Tracing.NonEvent]
		private static string GetFileName(string filePath)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(filePath))
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return Path.GetFileName(filePath);
		}

		[System.Diagnostics.Tracing.Event(205, Level = EventLevel.Verbose)]
		private void WriteVerbose(string component, string msg, string caller, string operation, string file, int line)
		{
			WriteMessage(205, component, msg, caller, operation, file, line);
		}

		[System.Diagnostics.Tracing.Event(204, Level = EventLevel.Informational)]
		private void WriteInfo(string component, string msg, string caller, string operation, string file, int line)
		{
			WriteMessage(204, component, msg, caller, operation, file, line);
		}

		[System.Diagnostics.Tracing.Event(203, Level = EventLevel.Warning)]
		private void WriteWarning(string component, string msg, string caller, string operation, string file, int line)
		{
			WriteMessage(203, component, msg, caller, operation, file, line);
		}

		[System.Diagnostics.Tracing.Event(202, Level = EventLevel.Error)]
		private void WriteError(string component, string msg, string caller, string operation, string file, int line)
		{
			WriteMessage(202, component, msg, caller, operation, file, line);
		}

		[System.Diagnostics.Tracing.Event(201, Level = EventLevel.Critical)]
		private void WriteCritical(string component, string msg, string caller, string operation, string file, int line)
		{
			WriteMessage(201, component, msg, caller, operation, file, line);
		}

		[System.Diagnostics.Tracing.NonEvent]
		private unsafe void WriteMessage(int eventId, string component, string message, string caller, string operation, string file, int line)
		{
			component = component ?? string.Empty;
			caller = caller ?? string.Empty;
			operation = operation ?? string.Empty;
			file = GetFileName(file);
			message = message.Truncate(30000);
			fixed (char* ptr = component)
			{
				fixed (char* ptr2 = message)
				{
					fixed (char* ptr3 = caller)
					{
						fixed (char* ptr4 = operation)
						{
							fixed (char* ptr5 = file)
							{
								EventData* ptr6 = stackalloc EventData[6];
								ptr6->Size = (component.Length + 1) * 2;
								ptr6->DataPointer = (IntPtr)ptr;
								ptr6[1].Size = (message.Length + 1) * 2;
								ptr6[1].DataPointer = (IntPtr)ptr2;
								ptr6[2].Size = (caller.Length + 1) * 2;
								ptr6[2].DataPointer = (IntPtr)ptr3;
								ptr6[3].Size = (operation.Length + 1) * 2;
								ptr6[3].DataPointer = (IntPtr)ptr4;
								ptr6[4].Size = (file.Length + 1) * 2;
								ptr6[4].DataPointer = (IntPtr)ptr5;
								ptr6[5].Size = 4;
								ptr6[5].DataPointer = (IntPtr)(&line);
								WriteEventCore(eventId, 6, ptr6);
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

		Committed = 1,
		Aborted,
		InDoubt

	internal enum TransportClientCredentialType
	{
		Unauthenticated = 100,
		TokenProvider = 200
	}
	public sealed class TransportClientEndpointBehavior : IEndpointBehavior
	{
		private TokenProvider tokenProvider;

		public TokenProvider TokenProvider
		{
			get
			{
				TransportClientCredentialType credentialType = CredentialType;
				if (credentialType == TransportClientCredentialType.TokenProvider)
				{
					return tokenProvider;
				}
				return null;
			}
			set
			{
				UpdateCredentials(value);
			}
		}

		public Guid? ActivityId { get; set; }

		internal TransportClientCredentialType CredentialType { get; set; }

		public TransportClientEndpointBehavior()
		{
			CredentialType = TransportClientCredentialType.Unauthenticated;
		}

		public TransportClientEndpointBehavior(TokenProvider tokenProvider)
			: this()
		{
			TokenProvider = tokenProvider;
		}

		void IEndpointBehavior.AddBindingParameters(ServiceEndpoint endpoint, BindingParameterCollection bindingParameters)
		{
			bindingParameters.Add(this);
		}

		void IEndpointBehavior.ApplyClientBehavior(ServiceEndpoint endpoint, ClientRuntime clientRuntime)
		{
		}

		void IEndpointBehavior.ApplyDispatchBehavior(ServiceEndpoint endpoint, EndpointDispatcher endpointDispatcher)
		{
		}

		void IEndpointBehavior.Validate(ServiceEndpoint endpoint)
		{
		}

		private void UpdateCredentials(TokenProvider newTokenProvider)
		{
			if (newTokenProvider != null)
			{
				CredentialType = TransportClientCredentialType.TokenProvider;
				tokenProvider = newTokenProvider;
			}
			else
			{
				CredentialType = TransportClientCredentialType.Unauthenticated;
				tokenProvider = null;
			}
		}
	}

	internal static class WSMessageEncodingHelper
	{
		internal static bool IsDefined(WSMessageEncoding value)
		{
			if (value != WSMessageEncoding.Text)
			{
				return value == WSMessageEncoding.Mtom;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static void SyncUpEncodingBindingElementProperties(TextMessageEncodingBindingElement textEncoding, MtomMessageEncodingBindingElement mtomEncoding)
		{
			textEncoding.ReaderQuotas.CopyTo(mtomEncoding.ReaderQuotas);
			mtomEncoding.WriteEncoding = textEncoding.WriteEncoding;
		}

	internal class ServiceBusAuthorizationHeader : MessageHeader
	{
		public const string HeaderName = "Authorization";

		public const string HeaderNamespace = "http://schemas.microsoft.com/servicebus/2010/08/protocol/";

		private SecurityToken securityToken;

		public override string Name => "Authorization";

		public override string Namespace => "http://schemas.microsoft.com/servicebus/2010/08/protocol/";

		internal string TokenString
		{
			get
			{
				if (securityToken is JsonSecurityToken)
				{
					return (securityToken as JsonSecurityToken).Token;
				}
				if (securityToken is SimpleWebSecurityToken)
				{
					return (securityToken as SimpleWebSecurityToken).Token;
				}
				throw new NotSupportedException(SRClient.UnsupportedTokenProviderType);
			}
		}

		public ServiceBusAuthorizationHeader(SecurityToken token)
		{
			securityToken = token;
		}

		protected override void OnWriteHeaderContents(XmlDictionaryWriter writer, MessageVersion messageVersion)
		{
			if (securityToken != null)
			{
				writer.WriteString(TokenString);
			}
		}
	}

				: base(manager.settings.InternalOperationTimeout, callback, state)
			{
				if (description == null)
				{
					throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNull("description");
				}
				CheckValidEntityName(description.Path, 260, "description.Path");
				trackingContext = TrackingContext.Create(Guid.NewGuid(), manager.Address.DnsSafeHost + ":" + description.Path);
				this.manager = manager;
				EventHub = description;
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				while (RemainingTime() > TimeSpan.Zero)
				{
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((CreateEventHubIfNotExistsAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.manager.GetEventHubAsync(thisPtr.trackingContext, thisPtr.EventHub.Path).ToAsyncResult(c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(CreateEventHubIfNotExistsAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult a)
					{
						thisPtr.EventHub = TaskHelpers.EndAsyncResult<EventHubDescription>(a);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
					if (base.LastAsyncStepException == null)
					{
						yield break;
					}
					if (base.LastAsyncStepException is MessagingEntityNotFoundException)
					{
						base.LastAsyncStepException = null;
						yield return CallTask((Func<CreateEventHubIfNotExistsAsyncResult, TimeSpan, Task>)async delegate(CreateEventHubIfNotExistsAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t)
						{
							string path = thisPtr.EventHub.Path;
							thisPtr.EventHub = await thisPtr.manager.CreateOrUpdateEventHubAsync(thisPtr.trackingContext, thisPtr.EventHub, isUpdate: false).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
							thisPtr.EventHub.Path = path;
							thisPtr.EventHub.IsReadOnly = false;
						}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
						if (base.LastAsyncStepException == null)
						{
							yield break;
						}
						bool shouldRetry = false;
						if (base.LastAsyncStepException is MessagingEntityAlreadyExistsException)
						{
							yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((CreateEventHubIfNotExistsAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.manager.GetEventHubAsync(thisPtr.trackingContext, thisPtr.EventHub.Path).ToAsyncResult(c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(CreateEventHubIfNotExistsAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult a)
							{
								thisPtr.EventHub = TaskHelpers.EndAsyncResult<EventHubDescription>(a);
							}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
							if (base.LastAsyncStepException is MessagingEntityNotFoundException)
							{
								base.LastAsyncStepException = null;
								shouldRetry = true;
							}
						}
						if (!shouldRetry)
						{
							Complete(base.LastAsyncStepException);
							yield break;
						}
						continue;
					}
					Complete(base.LastAsyncStepException);
					yield break;

		private sealed class CreateOrUpdateTopicTask
		{
			private readonly TrackingContext trackingContext;

			private readonly NamespaceManager manager;

			private readonly bool isUpdate;

			private TopicDescription Topic { get; set; }

			public CreateOrUpdateTopicTask(NamespaceManager manager, TopicDescription description, bool isUpdate)
			{
				if (description == null)
				{
					throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNull("description");
				}
				CheckValidEntityName(description.Path, 260, "description.Path");
				if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(description.NewPath))
				{
					CheckValidEntityName(description.NewPath, 260, "description.NewPath");
				}
				trackingContext = TrackingContext.Create(Guid.NewGuid(), manager.Address.DnsSafeHost + ":" + description.Path);
				this.manager = manager;
				Topic = description;
				this.isUpdate = isUpdate;
			}

			public async Task<TopicDescription> RunAsync(CancellationToken cancelToken)
			{
				TopicDescription topicDescription = await ServiceBusResourceOperations.CreateOrUpdateAsync(trackingContext, Topic, null, new string[1] { Topic.Path }, manager, Topic.IsAnonymousAccessible, isUpdate, cancelToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				string path = (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Topic.NewPath) ? Topic.Path : Topic.NewPath);
				topicDescription.Path = path;
				topicDescription.IsReadOnly = false;
				return topicDescription;
			}
		}

		private sealed class CreateOrUpdateSubscriptionTask
		{
			private readonly TrackingContext trackingContext;

			private readonly NamespaceManager manager;

			private readonly bool isUpdate;

			private SubscriptionDescription subscription;

			public CreateOrUpdateSubscriptionTask(NamespaceManager manager, SubscriptionDescription description, RuleDescription ruleDescription, bool isUpdate)
			{
				this.isUpdate = isUpdate;
				if (!isUpdate && ruleDescription != null && string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ruleDescription.Name))
				{
					ruleDescription.Name = "$Default";
				}
				CheckValidEntityName(description.TopicPath, 260, "description.TopicPath");
				CheckValidEntityName(description.Name, 104, allowSeparator: false, "description.Name");
				if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(description.ClientAffineProperties?.ClientId))
				{
					CheckValidEntityName(description.ClientAffineProperties.ClientId, 50, allowSeparator: false, "clientId");
				}
				if (ruleDescription != null)
				{
					CheckValidEntityName(ruleDescription.Name, 50, allowSeparator: false, "ruleDescription.Name");
				}
				trackingContext = TrackingContext.Create(Guid.NewGuid(), manager.Address.DnsSafeHost + ":" + EntityNameHelper.FormatSubscriptionPath(description.TopicPath, description.Name));
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(description.ForwardTo))
				{
					description.ForwardTo = manager.ValidateAndNormalizeForwardToAddress(description.Name, description.ForwardTo);
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(description.ForwardDeadLetteredMessagesTo))
				{
					description.ForwardDeadLetteredMessagesTo = manager.ValidateAndNormalizeForwardToAddress(description.Name, description.ForwardDeadLetteredMessagesTo);
				}
				this.manager = manager;
				subscription = description;
				subscription.DefaultRuleDescription = ruleDescription;
			}

			public async Task<SubscriptionDescription> RunAsync()
			{
				string topicPath = subscription.TopicPath;
				string name = subscription.Name;
				subscription = await ServiceBusResourceOperations.CreateOrUpdateAsync(trackingContext, subscription, new IResourceDescription[1] { subscription }, new string[2] { subscription.TopicPath, subscription.Name }, manager, isAnonymousAccessible: false, isUpdate, CancellationToken.None).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				subscription.TopicPath = topicPath;
				subscription.Name = name;
				subscription.IsReadOnly = false;
				return subscription;
			}
		}

		public NamespaceManager(Uri address, TokenProvider tokenProvider)
		{
			MessagingUtilities.ThrowIfNullAddressOrPathExists(address, "address");
			Addresses = new List<Uri> { address };
			settings = new NamespaceManagerSettings
			{
				TokenProvider = tokenProvider
			};
		}

		public NamespaceManager(IEnumerable<Uri> addresses, TokenProvider tokenProvider)
		{
			MessagingUtilities.ThrowIfNullAddressesOrPathExists(addresses, "addresses");
			Addresses = addresses.ToList();
			settings = new NamespaceManagerSettings
			{
				TokenProvider = tokenProvider
			};
		}

		public NamespaceManager(string address, NamespaceManagerSettings settings)
			: this(new Uri(address), settings)
		{
		}

		public NamespaceManager(IEnumerable<string> addresses, NamespaceManagerSettings settings)
			: this(MessagingUtilities.GetUriList(addresses), settings)
		{
		}

		public NamespaceManager(Uri address, NamespaceManagerSettings settings)
			: this(new List<Uri> { address }, settings)
		{
		}

		public NamespaceManager(IEnumerable<Uri> addresses, NamespaceManagerSettings settings)
		{
			MessagingUtilities.ThrowIfNullAddressesOrPathExists(addresses, "addresses");
			if (settings == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNull("settings");
			}
			TimeoutHelper.ThrowIfNonPositiveArgument(settings.OperationTimeout);
			Addresses = addresses.ToList();
			this.settings = settings;
		}

		public static NamespaceManager Create()
		{
			KeyValueConfigurationManager keyValueConfigurationManager = new KeyValueConfigurationManager();
			return keyValueConfigurationManager.CreateNamespaceManager();
		}

		public static NamespaceManager CreateFromConnectionString(string connectionString)
		{
			KeyValueConfigurationManager keyValueConfigurationManager = new KeyValueConfigurationManager(connectionString);
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(keyValueConfigurationManager["EntityPath"]))
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.Argument("connectionString", SRClient.UnsupportedConnStr4MsgFactory(typeof(NamespaceManager).Name));
			}
			return keyValueConfigurationManager.CreateNamespaceManager();
		}

			return GetVersionInfoAsync().CompleteSynchronously();
		}

		public async Task<string> GetVersionInfoAsync()
		{
			TrackingContext trackingContext = TrackingContext.Create(Guid.NewGuid());
			IDictionary<string, string> dictionary = await ServiceBusResourceOperations.GetInformationAsync(trackingContext, Addresses, settings, CancellationToken.None).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			return dictionary.ContainsKey("MaxProtocolVersion") ? dictionary["MaxProtocolVersion"] : string.Empty;
		}

		public RevokedPublisherDescription RevokePublisher(string entityPath, string publisher)
		{
			return EndAddToPublisherRevocationList(BeginAddToPublisherRevocationList(entityPath, publisher, null, null));
		}

		public Task<RevokedPublisherDescription> RevokePublisherAsync(string entityPath, string publisher)
		{
			return TaskHelpers.FromAsync((Func<AsyncCallback, object, IAsyncResult>)((AsyncCallback c, object s) => BeginAddToPublisherRevocationList(entityPath, publisher, c, s)), (Func<IAsyncResult, RevokedPublisherDescription>)EndAddToPublisherRevocationList, (object)null);
		}

		public void RestorePublisher(string entityPath, string publisher)
		{
			RestorePublisherAsync(entityPath, publisher).CompleteSynchronously();
		}

		public Task RestorePublisherAsync(string entityPath, string publisher)
		{
			CheckValidEntityName(entityPath, 260, "entityPath");
			CheckValidEntityName(publisher, 128, "publisher");
			return ServiceBusResourceOperations.DeleteAsync(TrackingContext.Create(Guid.NewGuid(), EntityNameHelper.FormatRevokedPublisherPath(entityPath, publisher)), new IResourceDescription[1]
			{
				new RevokedPublisherDescription(publisher)
			}, new string[2] { entityPath, publisher }, this, CancellationToken.None);
		}

		private IAsyncResult BeginAddToPublisherRevocationList(string eventHubPath, string publisherName, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			RevokePublisherIfNotAlreadyRevokedAsyncResult revokePublisherIfNotAlreadyRevokedAsyncResult = new RevokePublisherIfNotAlreadyRevokedAsyncResult(this, eventHubPath, new RevokedPublisherDescription(publisherName), callback, state);
			revokePublisherIfNotAlreadyRevokedAsyncResult.Start();
			return revokePublisherIfNotAlreadyRevokedAsyncResult;
		}

		private RevokedPublisherDescription EndAddToPublisherRevocationList(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			return AsyncResult<RevokePublisherIfNotAlreadyRevokedAsyncResult>.End(result).RevokedPublisher;
		}

		private static void CheckValidEntityName(string entityName, int maxEntityNameLength, string paramName)
		{
			CheckValidEntityName(entityName, maxEntityNameLength, allowSeparator: true, paramName);
		}

		private static void CheckValidEntityName(string entityName, int maxEntityNameLength, bool allowSeparator, string paramName)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(entityName))
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNullOrEmpty(paramName);
			}
			string text = entityName.Replace("\\", "/");
			if (text.Length > maxEntityNameLength)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentOutOfRange(paramName, text, SRClient.EntityNameLengthExceedsLimit(text, maxEntityNameLength));
			}
			if (text.StartsWith("/", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || text.EndsWith("/", StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.Argument(paramName, SRClient.InvalidEntityNameFormatWithSlash(text));
			}
			if (!allowSeparator && text.Contains("/"))
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.Argument(paramName, SRClient.InvalidCharacterInEntityName("/", text));
			}
			MessagingUtilities.CheckUriSchemeKey(entityName, paramName);
		}

		private async Task<bool> EntityExistsAsync<TEntityDescription>(TrackingContext trackingContext, IResourceDescription[] resourceDescriptions, string[] resourceNames)
		{
			try
			{
				return await ServiceBusResourceOperations.GetAsync<TEntityDescription>(trackingContext, resourceDescriptions, resourceNames, Addresses, settings, CancellationToken.None).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false) != null;
			}
			catch (MessagingEntityNotFoundException)
			{
				return false;
			}
		}

		private string ValidateAndNormalizeForwardToAddress(string entityName, string forwardTo)
		{
			CheckValidEntityName(forwardTo, ForwardToEntityNameMaxLength, "description.ForwardTo");
			if (!Uri.TryCreate(forwardTo, UriKind.Absolute, out var result))
			{
				string text = Address.AbsoluteUri;
				if (!text.EndsWith("/", StringComparison.Ordinal))
				{
					text += "/";
				}
				result = new Uri(new Uri(text), forwardTo);
			}
			return result.AbsoluteUri;
		}

		public static async Task<QueueDescription> CreateOrUpdateQueueCoreAsync(NamespaceManager manager, QueueDescription description, bool isUpdate, CancellationToken cancelToken)
		{
			if (description == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNull("description");
			}
			CheckValidEntityName(description.Path, 260, "description.Path");
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(description.NewPath))
			{
				CheckValidEntityName(description.NewPath, 260, "description.NewPath");
			}
			TrackingContext trackingContext = TrackingContext.Create(Guid.NewGuid(), manager.Address.DnsSafeHost + ":" + description.Path);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(description.ForwardTo))
			{
				description.ForwardTo = manager.ValidateAndNormalizeForwardToAddress(description.Path, description.ForwardTo);
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(description.ForwardDeadLetteredMessagesTo))
			{
				description.InternalForwardDeadLetteredMessagesTo = manager.ValidateAndNormalizeForwardToAddress(description.Path, description.ForwardDeadLetteredMessagesTo);
			}
			QueueDescription queueDescription = await ServiceBusResourceOperations.CreateOrUpdateAsync(trackingContext, description, null, new string[1] { description.Path }, manager, description.IsAnonymousAccessible, isUpdate, CancellationToken.None).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			string path = (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(description.NewPath) ? description.Path : description.NewPath);
			queueDescription.Path = path;
			queueDescription.IsReadOnly = false;
			return queueDescription;
		}

		private async Task<EventHubDescription> CreateOrUpdateEventHubAsync(TrackingContext trackingContext, EventHubDescription description, bool isUpdate)
		{
			if (description == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNull("description");
			}
			CheckValidEntityName(description.Path, 260, allowSeparator: false, "description.Path");
			trackingContext = trackingContext ?? TrackingContext.Create(Guid.NewGuid(), Address.DnsSafeHost + ":" + description.Path);
			TimeSpan timeout = TimeoutHelper.Max(settings.InternalOperationTimeout, MinCreateTime);
			string path = description.Path;
			description = await ServiceBusResourceOperations.CreateOrUpdateAsync(trackingContext, description, null, new string[1] { path }, Addresses, Settings, isAnonymousAccessible: false, isUpdate, timeout, CancellationToken.None).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			description.Path = path;
			description.IsReadOnly = false;
			return description;
		}

		private static IEnumerable<TEntityDescription> EnumerateEntitySyndicationFeed<TEntityDescription>(SyndicationFeed feed, Action<TEntityDescription, string> onFeedEntry) where TEntityDescription : EntityDescription
		{
			if (feed == null)
			{
				yield break;
			}
			foreach (SyndicationItem item in feed.Items)
			{
				string text = item.Title.Text;
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new MessagingException("TEntityDescription: Atom Xml Title property is empty."));
				}
				if (!(item.Content is XmlSyndicationContent xmlSyndicationContent))
				{
					throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new MessagingException("TEntityDescription: Unable to read Atom XML content"));
				}
				TEntityDescription val = xmlSyndicationContent.ReadContent<TEntityDescription>();
				val.IsReadOnly = false;
				onFeedEntry?.Invoke(val, text);
				yield return val;
			}
		}
	}
	public sealed class NamespaceManagerSettings
	{
		private int getEntitiesPageSize;

		private TimeSpan operationTimeout;

		private RetryPolicy retryPolicy;

		private bool useInternalCommunication;

		public TimeSpan OperationTimeout
		{
			get
			{
				return operationTimeout;
			}
			set
			{
				TimeoutHelper.ThrowIfNonPositiveArgument(value, "OperationTimeout");
				operationTimeout = value;
			}
		}

		public RetryPolicy RetryPolicy
		{
			get
			{
				return retryPolicy;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNull("RetryPolicy");
				}
				retryPolicy = value;
			}
		}

		public TokenProvider TokenProvider { get; set; }

		internal TimeSpan InternalOperationTimeout
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(operationTimeout > Constants.MaxOperationTimeout))
				{
					return operationTimeout;
				}
				return Constants.MaxOperationTimeout;
			}
		}

		internal bool UseInternalCommunication
		{
			get
			{
				return useInternalCommunication;
			}
			set
			{
				useInternalCommunication = value;
			}
		}

		internal int GetEntitiesPageSize
		{
			get
			{
				return getEntitiesPageSize;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value <= 0)
				{
					throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentOutOfRange("GetEntitiesPageSize", value, "GetEntitiesPageSize has to be positive value");
				}
				getEntitiesPageSize = value;
			}
		}

		internal FaultInjectionInfo FaultInjectionInfo { get; set; }

		public NamespaceManagerSettings()
		{
			operationTimeout = Constants.DefaultOperationTimeout;
			retryPolicy = RetryPolicy.Default;
			getEntitiesPageSize = int.MaxValue;
			TokenProvider = null;
			useInternalCommunication = false;
		}
	}

	public static class StreamMessageHelper
	{
		public static System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message CreateMessage(MessageVersion version, string action, Stream stream)
		{
			StreamBodyWriter body = new StreamBodyWriter(stream);
			System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message = System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message.CreateMessage(version, action, body);
			message.Properties.Add("BodyFormat", new RelayedHttpBodyFormatHeader(RelayedHttpUtility.FormatStringRaw));
			message.Properties.Add("StreamMessageProperty", new StreamMessageProperty(stream));
			return message;
		}

		public static System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message CreateJsonMessage(MessageVersion version, string action, Stream jsonStream)
		{
			JsonStreamBodyWriter body = new JsonStreamBodyWriter(jsonStream);
			System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message = System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message.CreateMessage(version, action, body);
			message.Properties.Add("WebBodyFormatMessageProperty", new WebBodyFormatMessageProperty(WebContentFormat.Json));
			return message;
		}

		public static Stream GetStream(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message)
		{
			return GetStream(message.GetReaderAtBodyContents());
		}

		public static Stream GetStream(XmlDictionaryReader reader)
		{
			return new BinaryXmlReaderStream(reader);
		}
	}
	public delegate void StreamWriterDelegate(Stream output);
	internal class JsonStreamBodyWriter : BodyWriter
	{
		private Stream jsonStream;

		public JsonStreamBodyWriter(Stream jsonStream)
			: base(isBuffered: false)
		{
			this.jsonStream = jsonStream;
		}

		protected override void OnWriteBodyContents(XmlDictionaryWriter writer)
		{
			writer.WriteNode(JsonReaderWriterFactory.CreateJsonReader(jsonStream, XmlDictionaryReaderQuotas.Max), defattr: false);
			writer.Flush();
		}
	}
	internal class StreamBodyWriter : BodyWriter
	{
		private class StreamProvider : IStreamProvider
		{
			private readonly Stream stream;

			public StreamProvider(Stream stream)
			{
				this.stream = stream;
			}

			public Stream GetStream()
			{
				return stream;
			}

			public void ReleaseStream(Stream stream)
			{
			}
		}

		private readonly Stream stream;

		public StreamBodyWriter(Stream stream)
			: base(isBuffered: false)
		{
			this.stream = stream;
		}

		protected override void OnWriteBodyContents(XmlDictionaryWriter writer)
		{
			writer.WriteStartElement("Binary");
			writer.WriteValue(new StreamProvider(stream));
			writer.WriteEndElement();
		}
	}

		public override bool CanSeek => false;

		public override bool CanWrite => false;

			innerReader = xmlReader;
		}

		{
			throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new NotImplementedException());
		}

		public override int Read(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)
		{
			if (!readCalled)
			{
				innerReader.MoveToContent();
				innerReader.Read();
				readCalled = true;
			}
			if (innerReader.NodeType != XmlNodeType.Text)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return innerReader.ReadContentAsBase64(buffer, offset, count);
		}

		public override void Flush()
		{
		}

		{

	internal static class ExtensionMethods
	{
		private const string ExceptionIdentifierName = "ExceptionId";

		public static int ToStringLength(this object param)
		{
			return param?.ToString().Length ?? 0;
		}

		public static string ToSafeString(this object param)
		{
			if (param == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return param.ToString();
		}

		public static string ToStringSlim(this Exception exception)
		{
			if (exception == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (exception.Data != null && exception.Data.Contains("ExceptionId"))
			{
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "ExceptionId: {0}-{1}: {2}", exception.Data["ExceptionId"], exception.GetType(), exception.Message);
			}
			if (exception.Data != null)
			{
				string text = Guid.NewGuid().ToString();
				exception.Data["ExceptionId"] = text;
				string arg = (SkipCallStack(exception) ? (exception.GetType().Name + ": " + exception.Message) : exception.ToString());
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "ExceptionId: {0}-{1}", text, arg);
			}
			if (!SkipCallStack(exception))
			{
				return exception.ToString();
			}
			return exception.Message;
		}

		public static string GetReferenceCode(this Exception exception)
		{
			if (exception.Data != null && exception.Data.Contains("ExceptionId"))
			{
				return (string)exception.Data["ExceptionId"];
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static bool AnySlim<T>(this IEnumerable<T> enumerable)
		{
			if (enumerable is ICollection collection)
			{
				return collection.Count != 0;
			}
			return enumerable.Any();
		}

		public static int CountSlim<T>(this IEnumerable<T> enumerable)
		{
			if (enumerable is ICollection collection)
			{
				return collection.Count;
			}
			return enumerable.Count();
		}

		public static T LastSlim<T>(this IEnumerable<T> enumerable)
		{
			if (enumerable is IList<T> list)
			{
				return list[list.Count - 1];
			}
			return enumerable.Last();
		}

		public static IList<T> ToListSlim<T>(this IEnumerable<T> enumerable, bool requireMutable = false)
		{
			if (enumerable is IList<T> list && (!requireMutable || !list.IsReadOnly))
			{
				return list;
			}
			return enumerable.ToList();
		}

		public static Dictionary<TKey, List<TSource>> GroupBySlim<TKey, TSource>(this IEnumerable<TSource> items, Func<TSource, TKey> keySelector)
		{
			Dictionary<TKey, List<TSource>> dictionary = new Dictionary<TKey, List<TSource>>();
			foreach (TSource item in items)
			{
				TKey key = keySelector(item);
				if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
				{
					value = new List<TSource>();
					dictionary.Add(key, value);
				}
				value.Add(item);
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		public static ConcurrentDictionary<TKey, List<TSource>> GroupByToConcurrentDictionary<TKey, TSource>(this IEnumerable<TSource> items, Func<TSource, TKey> keySelector)
		{
			ConcurrentDictionary<TKey, List<TSource>> concurrentDictionary = new ConcurrentDictionary<TKey, List<TSource>>();
			foreach (TSource item in items)
			{
				TKey key = keySelector(item);
				if (!concurrentDictionary.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
				{
					value = new List<TSource>();
					concurrentDictionary.TryAdd(key, value);
				}
				value.Add(item);
			}
			return concurrentDictionary;
		}

		public static bool Remove<TKey, TValue>(this ConcurrentDictionary<TKey, TValue> thisPtr, TKey key)
		{
			TValue value;
			return thisPtr.TryRemove(key, out value);
		}

		public static string ToHostPortString(this EndPoint endpoint)
		{
			if (endpoint is DnsEndPoint dnsEndPoint)
			{
				return dnsEndPoint.Host + ":" + dnsEndPoint.Port;
			}
			return endpoint.ToString();
		}

		private static bool SkipCallStack(Exception exception)
		{
			return false;
		}
	}

	internal abstract class TrackingContextIteratorAsyncResult<TResult> : IteratorAsyncResult<TResult> where TResult : TrackingContextIteratorAsyncResult<TResult>
	{
		public TrackingContext TrackingContext { get; }

		[SecurityCritical]
		private unsafe static string EncodeObject(ref object data, EventData* dataDescriptor, byte* dataBuffer)
		{
			while (true)
			{
				dataDescriptor->Reserved = 0u;
				if (data is string text)
				{
					dataDescriptor->Size = (uint)((text.Length + 1) * 2);
					return text;
				}
				if (data is IntPtr)
				{
					dataDescriptor->Size = (uint)sizeof(IntPtr);
					*(IntPtr*)dataBuffer = (IntPtr)data;
					dataDescriptor->Ptr = (ulong)dataBuffer;
					break;
				}
				if (data is int)
				{
					dataDescriptor->Size = 4u;
					*(int*)dataBuffer = (int)data;
					dataDescriptor->Ptr = (ulong)dataBuffer;
					break;
				}
				if (data is long)
				{
					dataDescriptor->Size = 8u;
					*(long*)dataBuffer = (long)data;
					dataDescriptor->Ptr = (ulong)dataBuffer;
					break;
				}
				if (data is uint)
				{
					dataDescriptor->Size = 4u;
					*(uint*)dataBuffer = (uint)data;
					dataDescriptor->Ptr = (ulong)dataBuffer;
					break;
				}
				if (data is ulong)
				{
					dataDescriptor->Size = 8u;
					*(ulong*)dataBuffer = (ulong)data;
					dataDescriptor->Ptr = (ulong)dataBuffer;
					break;
				}
				if (data is char)
				{
					dataDescriptor->Size = 2u;
					*(char*)dataBuffer = (char)data;
					dataDescriptor->Ptr = (ulong)dataBuffer;
					break;
				}
				if (data is byte)
				{
					dataDescriptor->Size = 1u;
					*dataBuffer = (byte)data;
					dataDescriptor->Ptr = (ulong)dataBuffer;
					break;
				}
				if (data is short)
				{
					dataDescriptor->Size = 2u;
					*(short*)dataBuffer = (short)data;
					dataDescriptor->Ptr = (ulong)dataBuffer;
					break;
				}
				if (data is sbyte)
				{
					dataDescriptor->Size = 1u;
					*dataBuffer = (byte)(sbyte)data;
					dataDescriptor->Ptr = (ulong)dataBuffer;
					break;
				}
				if (data is ushort)
				{
					dataDescriptor->Size = 2u;
					*(ushort*)dataBuffer = (ushort)data;
					dataDescriptor->Ptr = (ulong)dataBuffer;
					break;
				}
				if (data is float)
				{
					dataDescriptor->Size = 4u;
					*(float*)dataBuffer = (float)data;
					dataDescriptor->Ptr = (ulong)dataBuffer;
					break;
				}
				if (data is double)
				{
					dataDescriptor->Size = 8u;
					*(double*)dataBuffer = (double)data;
					dataDescriptor->Ptr = (ulong)dataBuffer;
					break;
				}
				if (data is bool)
				{
					dataDescriptor->Size = 4u;
					if ((bool)data)
					{
						*(int*)dataBuffer = 1;
					}
					else
					{
						*(int*)dataBuffer = 0;
					}
					dataDescriptor->Ptr = (ulong)dataBuffer;
					break;
				}
				if (data is Guid)
				{
					dataDescriptor->Size = (uint)sizeof(Guid);
					*(Guid*)dataBuffer = (Guid)data;
					dataDescriptor->Ptr = (ulong)dataBuffer;
					break;
				}
				if (data is decimal)
				{
					dataDescriptor->Size = 16u;
					*(decimal*)dataBuffer = (decimal)data;
					dataDescriptor->Ptr = (ulong)dataBuffer;
					break;
				}
				if (data is bool)
				{
					dataDescriptor->Size = 1u;
					*dataBuffer = (((bool)data) ? ((byte)1) : ((byte)0));
					dataDescriptor->Ptr = (ulong)dataBuffer;
					break;
				}
				if (data is Enum)
				{
					Type underlyingType = Enum.GetUnderlyingType(data.GetType());
					if (underlyingType == typeof(int))
					{
						data = ((IConvertible)data).ToInt32(null);
						continue;
					}
					if (underlyingType == typeof(long))
					{
						data = ((IConvertible)data).ToInt64(null);
						continue;
					}
				}
				string text2 = ((data != null) ? data.ToString() : string.Empty);
				dataDescriptor->Size = (uint)((text2.Length + 1) * 2);
				return text2;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public bool IsEnabled()
		{
			return m_eventSourceEnabled;
		}

		public bool IsEnabled(int eventId)
		{
			if (!m_eventSourceEnabled)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (m_eventData != null)
			{
				if (!m_eventData[eventId].EnabledForETW)
				{
					return m_eventData[eventId].EnabledForAnyListener;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool IsEnabled(EventLevel level, EventKeywords keywords, EventChannel channel)
		{
			if (!m_eventSourceEnabled)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (m_level != EventLevel.LogAlways && m_level < level)
			{
				return false;
			}
			EventKeywords eventKeywords = (EventKeywords)((long)m_channelData[(uint)channel] | (long)keywords);
			if (m_matchAnyKeyword != EventKeywords.None)
			{
				return (eventKeywords & m_matchAnyKeyword) != 0;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static Guid GetGuid(Type eventSourceType)
		{
			EventSourceAttribute eventSourceAttribute = (EventSourceAttribute)Attribute.GetCustomAttribute(eventSourceType, typeof(EventSourceAttribute), inherit: false);
			string name = eventSourceType.Name;
			if (eventSourceAttribute != null)
			{
				if (eventSourceAttribute.Guid != null)
				{
					Guid empty = Guid.Empty;
					try
					{
						return new Guid(eventSourceAttribute.Guid);
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
					}
				}
				if (eventSourceAttribute.Name != null)
				{
					name = eventSourceAttribute.Name;
				}
			}
			throw new ArgumentException(EventSourceSR.ProviderGuidNotSpecified(name));
		}

		public static string GetName(Type eventSourceType)
		{
			EventSourceAttribute eventSourceAttribute = (EventSourceAttribute)Attribute.GetCustomAttribute(eventSourceType, typeof(EventSourceAttribute), inherit: false);
			if (eventSourceAttribute != null && eventSourceAttribute.Name != null)
			{
				return eventSourceAttribute.Name;
			}
			return eventSourceType.Name;
		}

		public static string GenerateManifest(Type eventSourceType, string assemblyPathToIncludeInManifest, string resourceFileName)
		{
			byte[] bytes = CreateManifestAndDescriptors(eventSourceType, assemblyPathToIncludeInManifest, resourceFileName, null);
			return Encoding.UTF8.GetString(bytes);
		}

		public static void SendCommand(EventSource eventSource, EventCommand command, IDictionary<string, string> commandArguments)
		{
			if (eventSource == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("eventSource");
			}
			SendCommand(eventSource, null, command, enable: true, EventLevel.LogAlways, EventKeywords.None, commandArguments);
		}

		public static IEnumerable<EventSource> GetSources()
		{
			List<EventSource> list = new List<EventSource>();
			lock (EventListener.EventListenersLock)
			{
				foreach (WeakReference s_EventSource in EventListener.s_EventSources)
				{
					if (s_EventSource.Target is EventSource item)
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
				}
				return list;
			}
		}

		protected EventSource(bool disableTracing = false)
		{
			Guid guid = GetGuid(GetType());
			string name = GetName(GetType());
			if (guid == Guid.Empty)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("EventSource.eventSourceGuid");
			}
			if (name == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("EventSource.eventSourceName");
			}
			if (!disableTracing)
			{
				m_name = name;
				m_guid = guid;
				m_provider = new OverideEventProvider(this);
				m_provider.Register(guid);
				if (m_eventSourceEnabled && !m_ETWManifestSent)
				{
					SendManifest(m_rawManifest, null);
					m_ETWManifestSent = true;
				}
				EventListener.AddEventSource(this);
				m_completelyInited = true;
			}
		}
