				fixed (char* ptr = arg1)
				{
					EventProviderClone.EventData* ptr2 = stackalloc EventProviderClone.EventData[3];
					ptr2->Ptr = (ulong)ptr;
					ptr2->Size = (uint)((arg1.Length + 1) * 2);
					ptr2->Reserved = 0u;
					ptr2[1].Ptr = (ulong)(&arg2);
					ptr2[1].Size = 4u;
					ptr2[1].Reserved = 0u;
					ptr2[2].Ptr = (ulong)(&arg3);
					ptr2[2].Size = 8u;
					ptr2[2].Reserved = 0u;
					m_provider.WriteEvent(ref m_eventData[eventId].Descriptor, 3, (IntPtr)ptr2);
				}
			}
			if (m_Dispatchers != null && m_eventData[eventId].EnabledForAnyListener)
			{
				WriteToAllListeners(eventId, arg1, arg2, arg3);
			}
		}

		protected unsafe void WriteEvent(int eventId, string arg1, long arg2)
		{
			if (m_eventData != null && m_eventData[eventId].EnabledForETW && m_provider != null)
			{
				if (arg1 == null)
				{
					arg1 = "";
				}
				fixed (char* ptr = arg1)
				{
					EventProviderClone.EventData* ptr2 = stackalloc EventProviderClone.EventData[2];
					ptr2->Ptr = (ulong)ptr;
					ptr2->Size = (uint)((arg1.Length + 1) * 2);
					ptr2->Reserved = 0u;
					ptr2[1].Ptr = (ulong)(&arg2);
					ptr2[1].Size = 8u;
					ptr2[1].Reserved = 0u;
					m_provider.WriteEvent(ref m_eventData[eventId].Descriptor, 2, (IntPtr)ptr2);
				}
			}
			if (m_Dispatchers != null && m_eventData[eventId].EnabledForAnyListener)
			{
				WriteToAllListeners(eventId, arg1, arg2);
			}
		}

		[SecurityCritical]
		protected unsafe void WriteEventCore(int eventId, int eventDataCount, EventData* data)
		{
			EventProviderClone.EventData* ptr = stackalloc EventProviderClone.EventData[eventDataCount];
			for (int i = 0; i < eventDataCount; i++)
			{
				ptr[i].Size = (uint)data[i].Size;
				ptr[i].Ptr = (ulong)data[i].DataPointer.ToInt64();
				ptr[i].Reserved = 0u;
			}
			if (m_provider != null)
			{
				m_provider.WriteEvent(ref m_eventData[eventId].Descriptor, eventDataCount, (IntPtr)ptr);
			}
			if (m_Dispatchers != null && m_eventData[eventId].EnabledForAnyListener)
			{
				object[] array = new object[eventDataCount];
				for (int j = 0; j < eventDataCount; j++)
				{
					array[j] = DecodeObject(eventId, j, data[j].Size, data[j].DataPointer);
				}
				WriteToAllListeners(eventId, array);
			}
		}

		protected void WriteEvent(int eventId, params object[] args)
		{
			WriteEvent(eventId, null, args);
		}

		protected void WriteEvent(int eventId, EventTraceActivity traceActivityId, params object[] args)
		{
			if (m_eventData != null && m_eventData[eventId].EnabledForETW && m_provider != null)
			{
				if (traceActivityId != null)
				{
					m_provider.SetActivityId(ref traceActivityId.ActivityId);
				}
				m_provider.WriteEvent(ref m_eventData[eventId].Descriptor, args);
			}
			if (m_Dispatchers != null && m_eventData[eventId].EnabledForAnyListener)
			{
				WriteToAllListeners(eventId, args);
			}
		}

		protected void WriteTransferEvent(int eventId, EventTraceActivity traceActivityId, EventTraceActivity relatedActivityId, params object[] args)
		{
			if (m_provider != null)
			{
				m_provider.WriteTransfer(ref m_eventData[eventId].Descriptor, ref traceActivityId.ActivityId, ref relatedActivityId.ActivityId, args);
			}
		}

		protected void SetActivityId(ref Guid activityId)
		{
			if (m_provider != null)
			{
				m_provider.SetActivityId(ref activityId);
			}
		}

		private bool DoDebugChecks()
		{
			return true;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing && m_provider != null)
			{
				m_provider.Dispose();
				m_provider = null;
			}
		}

		~EventSource()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: false);
		}

		[SecurityCritical]
		private unsafe object DecodeObject(int eventId, int parameterId, int dataBytes, IntPtr dataPointer)
		{
			Type type = m_eventData[eventId].Parameters[parameterId].ParameterType;
			while (true)
			{
				if (type == typeof(IntPtr))
				{
					return *(IntPtr*)(void*)dataPointer;
				}
				if (type == typeof(int))
				{
					return *(int*)(void*)dataPointer;
				}
				if (type == typeof(uint))
				{
					return *(uint*)(void*)dataPointer;
				}
				if (type == typeof(long))
				{
					return *(long*)(void*)dataPointer;
				}
				if (type == typeof(ulong))
				{
					return *(ulong*)(void*)dataPointer;
				}
				if (type == typeof(byte))
				{
					return *(byte*)(void*)dataPointer;
				}
				if (type == typeof(sbyte))
				{
					return *(sbyte*)(void*)dataPointer;
				}
				if (type == typeof(short))
				{
					return *(short*)(void*)dataPointer;
				}
				if (type == typeof(ushort))
				{
					return *(ushort*)(void*)dataPointer;
				}
				if (type == typeof(float))
				{
					return *(float*)(void*)dataPointer;
				}
				if (type == typeof(double))
				{
					return *(double*)(void*)dataPointer;
				}
				if (type == typeof(decimal))
				{
					return *(decimal*)(void*)dataPointer;
				}
				if (type == typeof(bool))
				{
					return *(bool*)(void*)dataPointer;
				}
				if (type == typeof(Guid))
				{
					return *(Guid*)(void*)dataPointer;
				}
				if (type == typeof(char))
				{
					return *(char*)(void*)dataPointer;
				}
				if (!type.IsEnum)
				{
					break;
				}
				type = Enum.GetUnderlyingType(type);
			}
			return Marshal.PtrToStringUni(dataPointer, dataBytes / 2);
		}

		private EventDispatcher GetDispatcher(EventListener listener)
		{
			EventDispatcher eventDispatcher;
			for (eventDispatcher = m_Dispatchers; eventDispatcher != null; eventDispatcher = eventDispatcher.m_Next)
			{
				if (eventDispatcher.m_Listener == listener)
				{
					return eventDispatcher;
				}
			}
			return eventDispatcher;
		}

		private void WriteToAllListeners(int eventId, params object[] args)
		{
			EventWrittenEventArgs e = new EventWrittenEventArgs(this);
			e.EventId = eventId;
			e.Payload = args;
			for (EventDispatcher eventDispatcher = m_Dispatchers; eventDispatcher != null; eventDispatcher = eventDispatcher.m_Next)
			{
				if (eventDispatcher.m_EventEnabled[eventId])
				{
					eventDispatcher.m_Listener.OnEventWritten(e);
				}
			}
		}

		private bool IsEnabledByDefault(int eventNum, bool enable, EventLevel currentLevel, EventKeywords currentMatchAnyKeyword)
		{
			if (!enable)
			{
				return false;
			}
			EventLevel level = (EventLevel)m_eventData[eventNum].Descriptor.Level;
			EventKeywords keywords = (EventKeywords)m_eventData[eventNum].Descriptor.Keywords;
			if ((level <= currentLevel || currentLevel == EventLevel.LogAlways) && (keywords == EventKeywords.None || (keywords & currentMatchAnyKeyword) != EventKeywords.None))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static void SendCommand(EventSource eventSource, EventListener eventListener, EventCommand command, bool enable, EventLevel level, EventKeywords matchAnyKeyword, IDictionary<string, string> commandArguments)
		{
			eventSource.SendCommand(eventListener, command, enable, level, matchAnyKeyword, commandArguments);
		}

		protected void WriteSBTraceEventWithLargeMessage(int eventId, EventTraceActivity traceActivityId, params object[] argsWithLastBeingLongMessage)
		{
			if (argsWithLastBeingLongMessage == null || argsWithLastBeingLongMessage.Length == 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("argsWithLastBeingLongMessage is null or empty");
			}
			int num = argsWithLastBeingLongMessage.Length - 1;
			int num2 = argsWithLastBeingLongMessage[num].ToStringLength();
			int num3 = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				if ((num3 += argsWithLastBeingLongMessage[i].ToStringLength()) > 7168)
				{
					WriteEvent(eventId, traceActivityId, argsWithLastBeingLongMessage);
					return;
				}
			}
			if (num2 + num3 < 7168 || num2 == 0)
			{
				WriteEvent(eventId, traceActivityId, argsWithLastBeingLongMessage);
				return;
			}
			int j = 0;
			int num4 = 7168;
			string text = ((argsWithLastBeingLongMessage[num] != null) ? argsWithLastBeingLongMessage[num].ToString() : string.Empty);
			string text2 = Guid.NewGuid().ToString().Substring(0, 6);
			for (; j < num2; j += num4)
			{
				string text3 = text.Substring(j, Math.Min(num4, num2 - j));
				string text4 = text2 + "-" + text3;
				argsWithLastBeingLongMessage[num] = ((j == 0) ? text4 : ("Event Trace Continued..." + text4));
				WriteEvent(eventId, traceActivityId, argsWithLastBeingLongMessage);
				if (j != 0)
				{
					continue;
				}
				for (int k = 0; k < num; k++)
				{
					if (argsWithLastBeingLongMessage[k].ToStringLength() > "[...]".Length)
					{
						argsWithLastBeingLongMessage[k] = "[...]";
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected void WriteSBEventWithLargeMessage(int eventId, params object[] argsWithLastBeingLongMessage)
		{
			WriteSBTraceEventWithLargeMessage(eventId, null, argsWithLastBeingLongMessage);
		}

		internal void SendCommand(EventListener listener, EventCommand command, bool enable, EventLevel level, EventKeywords matchAnyKeyword, IDictionary<string, string> commandArguments)
		{
			InsureInitialized();
			EventDispatcher dispatcher = GetDispatcher(listener);
			if (dispatcher == null && listener != null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(EventSourceSR.Event_ListenerNotFound);
			}
			if (commandArguments == null)
			{
				commandArguments = new Dictionary<string, string>();
			}
			switch (command)
			{
			case EventCommand.Update:
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < m_eventData.Length; i++)
				{
					EnableEventForDispatcher(dispatcher, i, IsEnabledByDefault(i, enable, level, matchAnyKeyword));
				}
				command = EventCommand.Disable;
				if (enable)
				{
					command = EventCommand.Enable;
					if (!m_eventSourceEnabled)
					{
						m_level = level;
						m_matchAnyKeyword = matchAnyKeyword;
					}
					else
					{
						if (level > m_level)
						{
							m_level = level;
						}
						if (matchAnyKeyword == EventKeywords.None)
						{
							m_matchAnyKeyword = EventKeywords.None;
						}
						else if (m_matchAnyKeyword != EventKeywords.None)
						{
							m_matchAnyKeyword |= matchAnyKeyword;
						}
					}
					if (dispatcher != null)
					{
						if (!dispatcher.m_ManifestSent)
						{
							dispatcher.m_ManifestSent = true;
							SendManifest(m_rawManifest, dispatcher.m_Listener);
						}
					}
					else if (!m_ETWManifestSent && m_completelyInited)
					{
						m_ETWManifestSent = true;
						SendManifest(m_rawManifest, null);
					}
				}
				OnEventCommand(new EventCommandEventArgs(command, commandArguments, this, dispatcher));
				if (enable)
				{
					m_eventSourceEnabled = true;
					return;
				}
				if (dispatcher != null)
				{
					dispatcher.m_ManifestSent = false;
				}
				else
				{
					m_ETWManifestSent = false;
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < m_eventData.Length; j++)
				{
					m_eventData[j].EnabledForAnyListener = false;
					for (EventDispatcher eventDispatcher = m_Dispatchers; eventDispatcher != null; eventDispatcher = eventDispatcher.m_Next)
					{
						if (eventDispatcher.m_EventEnabled[j])
						{
							m_eventData[j].EnabledForAnyListener = true;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				if (!AnyEventEnabled())
				{
					m_level = EventLevel.LogAlways;
					m_matchAnyKeyword = EventKeywords.None;
					m_eventSourceEnabled = false;
				}
				return;
			}
			case EventCommand.SendManifest:
				SendManifest(m_rawManifest, null);
				break;
			}
			OnEventCommand(new EventCommandEventArgs(command, commandArguments, null, null));
		}

		[Conditional("DEBUG")]
		private void TraceControllerCommand(EventCommand command, EventLevel level, EventKeywords matchAnyKeyword)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.Append("Enabled channels  = ");
			for (int i = 0; i < m_channelData.Length; i++)
			{
				if (((ulong)matchAnyKeyword & m_channelData[i]) != 0L)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append("0x").Append(i.ToString("x")).Append("{0x")
						.Append(m_channelData[i].ToString("x"))
						.Append("} ");
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool EnableEventForDispatcher(EventDispatcher dispatcher, int eventId, bool value)
		{
			if (dispatcher == null)
			{
				if (eventId >= m_eventData.Length)
				{
					return false;
				}
				m_eventData[eventId].EnabledForETW = value;
			}
			else
			{
				if (eventId >= dispatcher.m_EventEnabled.Length)
				{
					return false;
				}
				dispatcher.m_EventEnabled[eventId] = value;
				if (value)
				{
					m_eventData[eventId].EnabledForAnyListener = true;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool AnyEventEnabled()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < m_eventData.Length; i++)
			{
				if (m_eventData[i].EnabledForETW || m_eventData[i].EnabledForAnyListener)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void InsureInitialized()
		{
			lock (EventListener.EventListenersLock)
			{
				if (m_rawManifest == null)
				{
					m_rawManifest = CreateManifestAndDescriptors(GetType(), "", this);
				}
				if (DoDebugChecks())
				{
					foreach (WeakReference s_EventSource in EventListener.s_EventSources)
					{
						if (s_EventSource.Target is EventSource eventSource && eventSource.Guid == m_guid && eventSource != this)
						{
							throw new ArgumentException(EventSourceSR.Event_SourceWithUsedGuid(m_guid));
						}
					}
				}
				for (EventDispatcher eventDispatcher = m_Dispatchers; eventDispatcher != null; eventDispatcher = eventDispatcher.m_Next)
				{
					if (eventDispatcher.m_EventEnabled == null)
					{
						eventDispatcher.m_EventEnabled = new bool[m_eventData.Length];
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private unsafe bool SendManifest(byte[] rawManifest, EventListener Listener)
		{
			fixed (byte* ptr = rawManifest)
			{
				System.Diagnostics.Eventing.EventDescriptor eventDescriptor = new System.Diagnostics.Eventing.EventDescriptor(65534, 1, 0, 0, 254, 65534, -1L);
				ManifestEnvelope manifestEnvelope = new ManifestEnvelope
				{
					Format = ManifestEnvelope.ManifestFormats.SimpleXmlFormat,
					MajorVersion = 1,
					MinorVersion = 0,
					Magic = 91
				};
				int num = rawManifest.Length;
				manifestEnvelope.TotalChunks = (ushort)((num + 65279) / 65280);
				manifestEnvelope.ChunkNumber = 0;
				EventProviderClone.EventData* ptr2 = stackalloc EventProviderClone.EventData[2];
				ptr2->Ptr = (ulong)(&manifestEnvelope);
				ptr2->Size = (uint)sizeof(ManifestEnvelope);
				ptr2->Reserved = 0u;
				ptr2[1].Ptr = (ulong)ptr;
				ptr2[1].Reserved = 0u;
				bool result = true;
				while (num > 0)
				{
					ptr2[1].Size = (uint)Math.Min(num, 65280);
					if (Listener == null)
					{
						result = m_provider == null || !m_provider.WriteEvent(ref eventDescriptor, 2, (IntPtr)ptr2);
					}
					if (Listener != null)
					{
						byte[] array = null;
						byte[] array2 = null;
						if (array == null)
						{
							array = new byte[ptr2->Size];
							array2 = new byte[ptr2[1].Size];
						}
						Marshal.Copy((IntPtr)(long)ptr2->Ptr, array, 0, (int)ptr2->Size);
						Marshal.Copy((IntPtr)(long)ptr2[1].Ptr, array2, 0, (int)ptr2[1].Size);
						EventWrittenEventArgs e = new EventWrittenEventArgs(this);
						e.EventId = eventDescriptor.EventId;
						e.Payload = new ReadOnlyCollection<object>(new List<object> { array, array2 });
						Listener.OnEventWritten(e);
					}
					num -= 65280;
					ptr2[1].Ptr += 65280uL;
					manifestEnvelope.ChunkNumber++;
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		internal static byte[] CreateManifestAndDescriptors(Type eventSourceType, string eventSourceDllName, EventSource source)
		{
			return CreateManifestAndDescriptors(eventSourceType, eventSourceDllName, eventSourceDllName, source);
		}

		internal static byte[] CreateManifestAndDescriptors(Type eventSourceType, string eventSourceDllName, string resourceFileName, EventSource source)
		{
			MethodInfo[] methods = eventSourceType.GetMethods(BindingFlags.DeclaredOnly | BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
			int num = 1;
			EventMetadata[] eventData = null;
			Dictionary<string, string> eventsByName = null;
			if (source != null)
			{
				eventData = new EventMetadata[methods.Length];
			}
			ResourceManager resources = null;
			EventSourceAttribute eventSourceAttribute = (EventSourceAttribute)Attribute.GetCustomAttribute(eventSourceType, typeof(EventSourceAttribute), inherit: false);
			if (eventSourceAttribute != null && eventSourceAttribute.LocalizationResources != null)
			{
				resources = new ResourceManager(eventSourceAttribute.LocalizationResources, eventSourceType.Assembly);
			}
			ManifestBuilder manifestBuilder = new ManifestBuilder(GetName(eventSourceType), GetGuid(eventSourceType), eventSourceDllName, resourceFileName, resources);
			string[] array = new string[4] { "Keywords", "Tasks", "Opcodes", "Channels" };
			foreach (string text in array)
			{
				Type nestedType = eventSourceType.GetNestedType(text);
				if (nestedType != null)
				{
					FieldInfo[] fields = nestedType.GetFields(BindingFlags.DeclaredOnly | BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
					foreach (FieldInfo staticField in fields)
					{
						AddProviderEnumKind(manifestBuilder, staticField, text);
					}
				}
			}
			SortedList<int, Tuple<MethodInfo, EventAttribute>> sortedList = new SortedList<int, Tuple<MethodInfo, EventAttribute>>();
			foreach (MethodInfo methodInfo in methods)
			{
				ParameterInfo[] parameters = methodInfo.GetParameters();
				EventAttribute eventAttribute = (EventAttribute)Attribute.GetCustomAttribute(methodInfo, typeof(EventAttribute), inherit: false);
				string param = methodInfo.Name.Replace("EventWrite", string.Empty);
				if (methodInfo.ReturnType != typeof(void))
				{
					if (eventAttribute != null)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(EventSourceSR.Event_EventNotReturnVoid(param));
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (methodInfo.IsVirtual || methodInfo.IsStatic)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (eventAttribute == null)
					{
						if (Attribute.GetCustomAttribute(methodInfo, typeof(NonEventAttribute), inherit: false) != null)
						{
							continue;
						}
						EventAttribute eventAttribute2 = new EventAttribute(num);
						eventAttribute = eventAttribute2;
					}
					else if (eventAttribute.EventId <= 0)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(EventSourceSR.Event_IllegalID);
					}
					num++;
					if (eventAttribute.Opcode == EventOpcode.Info && eventAttribute.Task == EventTask.None)
					{
						eventAttribute.Task = (EventTask)(65534 - eventAttribute.EventId);
					}
					if (sortedList.ContainsKey(eventAttribute.EventId))
					{
						throw new ArgumentException($"An entry with the same key already exists.Key {eventAttribute.EventId}");
					}
					sortedList.Add(eventAttribute.EventId, new Tuple<MethodInfo, EventAttribute>(methodInfo, eventAttribute));
					if (source != null)
					{
						eventAttribute.Keywords |= (EventKeywords)manifestBuilder.GetChannelKeyword(eventAttribute.Channel);
						if (source.DoDebugChecks())
						{
							DebugCheckEvent(ref eventsByName, eventData, methodInfo, eventAttribute);
						}
						AddEventDescriptor(ref eventData, eventAttribute, parameters);
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<int, Tuple<MethodInfo, EventAttribute>> item3 in sortedList)
			{
				MethodInfo item = item3.Value.Item1;
				EventAttribute item2 = item3.Value.Item2;
				string eventName = item.Name.Replace("EventWrite", string.Empty);
				manifestBuilder.StartEvent(eventName, item2);
				ParameterInfo[] parameters2 = item.GetParameters();
				for (int l = 0; l < parameters2.Length; l++)
				{
					if (!(parameters2[l].ParameterType.Name == "EventTraceActivity"))
					{
						manifestBuilder.AddEventParameter(parameters2[l].ParameterType, parameters2[l].Name);
					}
				}
				manifestBuilder.EndEvent();
			}
			if (source != null)
			{
				TrimEventDescriptors(ref eventData);
				source.m_eventData = eventData;
				source.m_channelData = manifestBuilder.GetChannelData();
			}
			return manifestBuilder.CreateManifest();
		}

		private static void AddProviderEnumKind(ManifestBuilder manifest, FieldInfo staticField, string providerEnumKind)
		{
			Type fieldType = staticField.FieldType;
			if (fieldType == typeof(EventOpcode))
			{
				if (!(providerEnumKind != "Opcodes"))
				{
					int num = (int)staticField.GetRawConstantValue();
					if (num <= 10)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(EventSourceSR.Event_IllegalOpcode);
					}
					manifest.AddOpcode(staticField.Name, num);
					return;
				}
			}
			else if (fieldType == typeof(EventTask))
			{
				if (!(providerEnumKind != "Tasks"))
				{
					manifest.AddTask(staticField.Name, (int)staticField.GetRawConstantValue());
					return;
				}
			}
			else if (fieldType == typeof(EventKeywords))
			{
				if (!(providerEnumKind != "Keywords"))
				{
					manifest.AddKeyword(staticField.Name, (ulong)(long)staticField.GetRawConstantValue());
					return;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (!(fieldType == typeof(EventChannel)))
				{
					return;
				}
				if (!(providerEnumKind != "Channels"))
				{
					ChannelAttribute channelAttribute = (ChannelAttribute)Attribute.GetCustomAttribute(staticField, typeof(ChannelAttribute), inherit: false);
					byte channelId = (byte)staticField.GetRawConstantValue();
					manifest.AddChannel(staticField.Name, channelId, channelAttribute);
					return;
				}
			}
			throw new ArgumentException(EventSourceSR.Event_IllegalField(staticField.FieldType.Name, providerEnumKind));
		}

		private static void AddEventDescriptor(ref EventMetadata[] eventData, EventAttribute eventAttribute, ParameterInfo[] eventParameters)
		{
			if (eventData == null || eventData.Length <= eventAttribute.EventId)
			{
				EventMetadata[] array = new EventMetadata[Math.Max(eventData.Length + 16, eventAttribute.EventId + 1)];
				Array.Copy(eventData, array, eventData.Length);
				eventData = array;
			}
			eventData[eventAttribute.EventId].Descriptor = new System.Diagnostics.Eventing.EventDescriptor(eventAttribute.EventId, eventAttribute.Version, (byte)eventAttribute.Channel, (byte)eventAttribute.Level, (byte)eventAttribute.Opcode, (int)eventAttribute.Task, (long)eventAttribute.Keywords);
			eventData[eventAttribute.EventId].Parameters = eventParameters;
			eventData[eventAttribute.EventId].Message = eventAttribute.Message;
		}

		private static void TrimEventDescriptors(ref EventMetadata[] eventData)
		{
			int num = eventData.Length;
			while (0 < num)
			{
				num--;
				if (eventData[num].Descriptor.EventId != 0)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			if (eventData.Length - num > 2)
			{
				EventMetadata[] array = new EventMetadata[num + 1];
				Array.Copy(eventData, array, array.Length);
				eventData = array;
			}
		}

		internal void AddListener(EventListener listener)
		{
			lock (EventListener.EventListenersLock)
			{
				bool[] eventEnabled = null;
				if (m_eventData != null)
				{
					eventEnabled = new bool[m_eventData.Length];
				}
				m_Dispatchers = new EventDispatcher(m_Dispatchers, eventEnabled, listener);
				listener.OnEventSourceCreated(this);
			}
		}

		private static void DebugCheckEvent(ref Dictionary<string, string> eventsByName, EventMetadata[] eventData, MethodInfo method, EventAttribute eventAttribute)
		{
			int helperCallFirstArg = GetHelperCallFirstArg(method);
			string text = method.Name.Replace("EventWrite", string.Empty);
			if (helperCallFirstArg >= 0 && eventAttribute.EventId != helperCallFirstArg)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(EventSourceSR.Event_IllegalEventArg(text, eventAttribute.EventId, helperCallFirstArg));
			}
			if (eventAttribute.EventId < eventData.Length && eventData[eventAttribute.EventId].Descriptor.EventId != 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(EventSourceSR.Event_UsedEventID(text, eventAttribute.EventId));
			}
			if (eventsByName == null)
			{
				eventsByName = new Dictionary<string, string>();
			}
			if (eventsByName.ContainsKey(text))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(EventSourceSR.Event_UsedEventName(text));
			}
			eventsByName[text] = text;
		}

		private static int GetHelperCallFirstArg(MethodInfo method)
		{
			byte[] iLAsByteArray = method.GetMethodBody().GetILAsByteArray();
			int num = -1;
			for (int i = 0; i < iLAsByteArray.Length; i++)
			{
				switch (iLAsByteArray[i])
				{
				case 14:
				case 16:
					i++;
					continue;
				case 21:
				case 22:
				case 23:
				case 24:
				case 25:
				case 26:
				case 27:
				case 28:
				case 29:
				case 30:
					if (i > 0 && iLAsByteArray[i - 1] == 2)
					{
						num = iLAsByteArray[i] - 22;
					}
					continue;
				case 31:
					if (i > 0 && iLAsByteArray[i - 1] == 2)
					{
						num = iLAsByteArray[i + 1];
					}
					i++;
					continue;
				case 32:
					i += 4;
					continue;
				case 40:
					i += 4;
					if (num >= 0)
					{
						for (int j = i + 1; j < iLAsByteArray.Length; j++)
						{
							if (iLAsByteArray[j] == 42)
							{
								return num;
							}
							if (iLAsByteArray[j] != 0)
							{
								break;
							}
						}
					}
					num = -1;
					continue;
				case 44:
				case 45:
					num = -1;
					i++;
					continue;
				case 57:
				case 58:
					num = -1;
					i += 4;
					continue;
				case 140:
				case 141:
					i += 4;
					continue;
				case 254:
					i++;
					if (i < iLAsByteArray.Length && iLAsByteArray[i] < 6)
					{
						continue;
					}
					break;
				case 0:
				case 1:
				case 2:
				case 3:
				case 4:
				case 5:
				case 6:
				case 7:
				case 8:
				case 9:
				case 10:
				case 11:
				case 12:
				case 13:
				case 20:
				case 37:
				case 103:
				case 104:
				case 105:
				case 106:
				case 109:
				case 110:
				case 162:
					continue;
				}
				return -1;
			}
			return -1;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class EventListener : IDisposable
	{
		internal volatile EventListener m_Next;

		internal static EventListener s_Listeners;

		internal static List<WeakReference> s_EventSources;

		internal static object EventListenersLock
		{
			get
			{
				if (s_EventSources == null)
				{
					Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref s_EventSources, new List<WeakReference>(2), null);
				}
				return s_EventSources;
			}
		}

		protected EventListener()
		{
			lock (EventListenersLock)
			{
				foreach (WeakReference s_EventSource in s_EventSources)
				{
					if (s_EventSource.Target is EventSource eventSource)
					{
						eventSource.AddListener(this);
					}
				}
				m_Next = s_Listeners;
				s_Listeners = this;
			}
		}

		public virtual void Dispose()
		{
			lock (EventListenersLock)
			{
				if (s_Listeners == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (this == s_Listeners)
				{
					s_Listeners = m_Next;
					RemoveReferencesToListenerInEventSources(this);
					return;
				}
				EventListener eventListener = s_Listeners;
				EventListener next;
				while (true)
				{
					next = eventListener.m_Next;
					if (next == null)
					{
						return;
					}
					if (next == this)
					{
						break;
					}
					eventListener = next;
				}
				eventListener.m_Next = next.m_Next;
				RemoveReferencesToListenerInEventSources(this);
			}
		}

		public void EnableEvents(EventSource eventSource, EventLevel level)
		{
			EnableEvents(eventSource, level, EventKeywords.None);
		}

		public void EnableEvents(EventSource eventSource, EventLevel level, EventKeywords matchAnyKeyword)
		{
			EnableEvents(eventSource, level, matchAnyKeyword, null);
		}

		public void EnableEvents(EventSource eventSource, EventLevel level, EventKeywords matchAnyKeyword, IDictionary<string, string> arguments)
		{
			if (eventSource == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("eventSource");
			}
			EventSource.SendCommand(eventSource, this, EventCommand.Update, enable: true, level, matchAnyKeyword, arguments);
		}

		public void DisableEvents(EventSource eventSource)
		{
			if (eventSource == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("eventSource");
			}
			EventSource.SendCommand(eventSource, this, EventCommand.Update, enable: false, EventLevel.LogAlways, EventKeywords.None, null);
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnEventSourceCreated(EventSource eventSource)
		{
		}

		protected internal abstract void OnEventWritten(EventWrittenEventArgs eventData);

		protected static int EventSourceIndex(EventSource eventSource)
		{
			return eventSource.m_id;
		}

		internal static void AddEventSource(EventSource newEventSource)
		{
			lock (EventListenersLock)
			{
				if (s_EventSources == null)
				{
					s_EventSources = new List<WeakReference>(2);
				}
				int num = -1;
				if (s_EventSources.Count % 64 == 63)
				{
					int num2 = s_EventSources.Count;
					while (0 < num2)
					{
						num2--;
						WeakReference weakReference = s_EventSources[num2];
						if (!weakReference.IsAlive)
						{
							num = num2;
							weakReference.Target = newEventSource;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				if (num < 0)
				{
					num = s_EventSources.Count;
					s_EventSources.Add(new WeakReference(newEventSource));
				}
				newEventSource.m_id = num;
				for (EventListener next = s_Listeners; next != null; next = next.m_Next)
				{
					newEventSource.AddListener(next);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void RemoveReferencesToListenerInEventSources(EventListener listenerToRemove)
		{
			foreach (WeakReference s_EventSource in s_EventSources)
			{
				if (!(s_EventSource.Target is EventSource eventSource))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (eventSource.m_Dispatchers.m_Listener == listenerToRemove)
				{
					eventSource.m_Dispatchers = eventSource.m_Dispatchers.m_Next;
					continue;
				}
				EventDispatcher eventDispatcher = eventSource.m_Dispatchers;
				while (true)
				{
					EventDispatcher next = eventDispatcher.m_Next;
					if (next == null)
					{
						break;
					}
					if (next.m_Listener == listenerToRemove)
					{
						eventDispatcher.m_Next = next.m_Next;
						break;
					}
					eventDispatcher = next;
				}
			}
		}

		[Conditional("DEBUG")]
		internal static void Validate()
		{
			lock (EventListenersLock)
			{
				Dictionary<EventListener, bool> dictionary = new Dictionary<EventListener, bool>();
				for (EventListener next = s_Listeners; next != null; next = next.m_Next)
				{
					dictionary.Add(next, value: true);
				}
				int num = -1;
				foreach (WeakReference s_EventSource in s_EventSources)
				{
					num++;
					if (!(s_EventSource.Target is EventSource eventSource))
					{
						continue;
					}
					for (EventDispatcher eventDispatcher = eventSource.m_Dispatchers; eventDispatcher != null; eventDispatcher = eventDispatcher.m_Next)
					{
					}
					foreach (EventListener key in dictionary.Keys)
					{
						EventDispatcher eventDispatcher = eventSource.m_Dispatchers;
						while (eventDispatcher.m_Listener != key)
						{
							eventDispatcher = eventDispatcher.m_Next;
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal class EventCommandEventArgs : EventArgs
	{
		internal EventSource eventSource;

		internal EventDispatcher dispatcher;

		public EventCommand Command { get; private set; }

		public IDictionary<string, string> Arguments { get; private set; }

		public bool EnableEvent(int eventId)
		{
			if (Command != EventCommand.Enable && Command != EventCommand.Disable)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			return eventSource.EnableEventForDispatcher(dispatcher, eventId, value: true);
		}

		public bool DisableEvent(int eventId)
		{
			if (Command != EventCommand.Enable && Command != EventCommand.Disable)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			return eventSource.EnableEventForDispatcher(dispatcher, eventId, value: false);
		}

		internal EventCommandEventArgs(EventCommand command, IDictionary<string, string> arguments, EventSource eventSource, EventDispatcher dispatcher)
		{
			Command = command;
			Arguments = arguments;
			this.eventSource = eventSource;
			this.dispatcher = dispatcher;
		}
	}
	internal class EventWrittenEventArgs : EventArgs
	{
		private EventSource m_eventSource;

		public int EventId { get; internal set; }

		public IEnumerable<object> Payload { get; internal set; }

		public EventSource EventSource => m_eventSource;

		public EventKeywords Keywords => (EventKeywords)m_eventSource.m_eventData[EventId].Descriptor.Keywords;

		public EventOpcode Opcode => (EventOpcode)m_eventSource.m_eventData[EventId].Descriptor.Opcode;

		public EventTask Task => (EventTask)m_eventSource.m_eventData[EventId].Descriptor.Task;

		public string Message => m_eventSource.m_eventData[EventId].Message;

		public EventChannel Channel => (EventChannel)m_eventSource.m_eventData[EventId].Descriptor.Channel;

		public byte Version => m_eventSource.m_eventData[EventId].Descriptor.Version;

		public EventLevel Level
		{
			get
			{
				if ((uint)EventId >= (uint)m_eventSource.m_eventData.Length)
				{
					return EventLevel.LogAlways;
				}
				return (EventLevel)m_eventSource.m_eventData[EventId].Descriptor.Level;
			}
		}

		internal EventWrittenEventArgs(EventSource eventSource)
		{
			m_eventSource = eventSource;
		}
	}

	internal class ManifestBuilder
	{
		private class ChannelInfo
		{
			public string Name;

			public ChannelAttribute Attribs;
		}

		private Dictionary<int, ulong> channelKeywords;

		private ulong channelReservedKeywordMask = 9223372036854775808uL;

		private Dictionary<int, string> opcodeTab;

		private Dictionary<int, string> taskTab;

		private Dictionary<int, ChannelInfo> channelTab;

		private Dictionary<ulong, string> keywordTab;

		private Dictionary<string, Type> mapsTab;

		private Dictionary<string, string> stringTab;

		private StringBuilder sb;

		private StringBuilder events;

		private StringBuilder templates;

		private string providerName;

		private ResourceManager resources;

		private string templateName;

		private int numParams;

		public ManifestBuilder(string providerName, Guid providerGuid, string dllName, string resourceDll, ResourceManager resources)
		{
			this.providerName = providerName;
			this.resources = resources;
			sb = new StringBuilder();
			events = new StringBuilder();
			templates = new StringBuilder();
			opcodeTab = new Dictionary<int, string>();
			stringTab = new Dictionary<string, string>();
			sb.AppendLine("<instrumentationManifest xmlns=\"http://schemas.microsoft.com/win/2004/08/events\">");
			sb.AppendLine(" <instrumentation xmlns:xs=\"http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema\" xmlns:xsi=\"http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance\" xmlns:win=\"http://manifests.microsoft.com/win/2004/08/windows/events\">");
			sb.AppendLine("  <events xmlns=\"http://schemas.microsoft.com/win/2004/08/events\">");
			sb.Append("<provider name=\"").Append(providerName).Append("\" guid=\"{")
				.Append(providerGuid.ToString())
				.Append("}");
			if (resourceDll != null)
			{
				string value = Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + Path.GetFileName(resourceDll);
				sb.Append("\" resourceFileName=\"").Append(value).Append("\" messageFileName=\"")
					.Append(value);
			}
			string value2 = providerName.Replace("-", "");
			sb.Append("\" symbol=\"").Append(value2);
			sb.Append("\" >").AppendLine();
		}

		public void AddOpcode(string name, int value)
		{
			opcodeTab[value] = name;
		}

		public void AddTask(string name, int value)
		{
			if (taskTab == null)
			{
				taskTab = new Dictionary<int, string>();
			}
			taskTab[value] = name;
		}

		public void AddKeyword(string name, ulong value)
		{
			if ((value & (value - 1)) != 0L)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(EventSourceSR.Event_KeywordValue(value, name));
			}
			if (keywordTab == null)
			{
				keywordTab = new Dictionary<ulong, string>();
			}
			keywordTab[value] = name;
		}

		public void AddChannel(string name, int channelId, ChannelAttribute channelAttribute)
		{
			AddChannelKeyword((EventChannel)channelId);
			if (channelTab == null)
			{
				channelTab = new Dictionary<int, ChannelInfo>();
			}
			channelTab[channelId] = new ChannelInfo
			{
				Name = name,
				Attribs = channelAttribute
			};
		}

		private ulong AddChannelKeyword(EventChannel channel)
		{
			if (channelKeywords == null)
			{
				channelKeywords = new Dictionary<int, ulong>();
			}
			if (!channelKeywords.TryGetValue((int)channel, out var value))
			{
				value = channelReservedKeywordMask;
				channelReservedKeywordMask >>= 1;
				channelKeywords[(int)channel] = value;
			}
			return value;
		}

		public ulong GetChannelKeyword(EventChannel channel)
		{
			if (channelKeywords.TryGetValue((int)channel, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return 0uL;
		}

		public ulong[] GetChannelData()
		{
			int num = -1;
			foreach (int key in channelKeywords.Keys)
			{
				if (key > num)
				{
					num = key;
				}
			}
			ulong[] array = new ulong[num + 1];
			foreach (KeyValuePair<int, ulong> channelKeyword in channelKeywords)
			{
				array[channelKeyword.Key] = channelKeyword.Value;
			}
			return array;
		}

		public void StartEvent(string eventName, EventAttribute eventAttribute)
		{
			templateName = eventName + "Args";
			numParams = 0;
			events.Append("  <event").Append(" symbol=\"").Append(eventName)
				.Append("\"")
				.Append(" value=\"")
				.Append(eventAttribute.EventId)
				.Append("\"")
				.Append(" version=\"")
				.Append(eventAttribute.Version)
				.Append("\"")
				.Append(" level=\"")
				.Append(GetLevelName(eventAttribute.Level))
				.Append("\"");
			WriteMessageAttrib(events, "event", eventName, eventAttribute.Message);
			if (eventAttribute.Keywords != EventKeywords.None)
			{
				ulong keywords = ~GetChannelKeyword(eventAttribute.Channel) & (ulong)eventAttribute.Keywords;
				events.Append(" keywords=\"").Append(GetKeywords(keywords, eventName)).Append("\"");
			}
			if (eventAttribute.Opcode != EventOpcode.Info)
			{
				events.Append(" opcode=\"").Append(GetOpcodeName(eventAttribute.Opcode, eventName)).Append("\"");
			}
			if (eventAttribute.Task != EventTask.None)
			{
				events.Append(" task=\"").Append(GetTaskName(eventAttribute.Task, eventName)).Append("\"");
			}
			if (eventAttribute.Channel != EventChannel.Default)
			{
				events.Append(" channel=\"").Append(GetChannelName(eventAttribute.Channel, eventName)).Append("\"");
			}
		}

		public void AddEventParameter(Type type, string name)
		{
			if (numParams == 0)
			{
				templates.Append("  <template tid=\"").Append(templateName).Append("\">")
					.AppendLine();
			}
			numParams++;
			templates.Append("   <data name=\"").Append(name).Append("\" inType=\"")
				.Append(GetTypeName(type))
				.Append("\"");
			if (type.IsEnum)
			{
				templates.Append(" map=\"").Append(type.Name).Append("\"");
				if (mapsTab == null)
				{
					mapsTab = new Dictionary<string, Type>();
				}
				if (!mapsTab.ContainsKey(type.Name))
				{
					mapsTab.Add(type.Name, type);
				}
			}
			templates.Append("/>").AppendLine();
		}

		public void EndEvent()
		{
			if (numParams > 0)
			{
				templates.Append("  </template>").AppendLine();
				events.Append(" template=\"").Append(templateName).Append("\"");
			}
			events.Append("/>").AppendLine();
			templateName = null;
			numParams = 0;
		}

		public byte[] CreateManifest()
		{
			string s = CreateManifestString();
			return Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(s);
		}

		private string CreateManifestString()
		{
			if (channelTab != null)
			{
				sb.Append(" <channels>").AppendLine();
				List<int> list = new List<int>(channelTab.Keys);
				list.Sort();
				foreach (int item in list)
				{
					ChannelInfo channelInfo = channelTab[item];
					string text = null;
					string text2 = "channel";
					bool flag = false;
					string text3 = null;
					string text4 = null;
					if (channelInfo.Attribs != null)
					{
						ChannelAttribute attribs = channelInfo.Attribs;
						text = attribs.Type;
						if (attribs.ImportChannel != null)
						{
							text4 = attribs.ImportChannel;
							text2 = "importChannel";
						}
						flag = attribs.Enabled;
						text3 = attribs.Isolation;
					}
					if (text4 == null)
					{
						text4 = providerName + "/" + text;
					}
					string text5 = channelInfo.Name.Replace('-', '_');
					sb.Append("  <").Append(text2);
					sb.Append(" name=\"").Append(text4).Append("\"");
					sb.Append(" chid=\"").Append(channelInfo.Name).Append("\"");
					sb.Append(" symbol=\"").Append(text5).Append("\"");
					WriteMessageAttrib(sb, text2, text5, text);
					sb.Append(" value=\"").Append(item).Append("\"");
					if (text2 == "channel")
					{
						if (text != null)
						{
							sb.Append(" type=\"").Append(text).Append("\"");
						}
						sb.Append(" enabled=\"").Append(flag.ToString().ToLowerInvariant()).Append("\"");
						if (text3 != null)
						{
							sb.Append(" isolation=\"").Append(text3).Append("\"");
						}
					}
					if (channelInfo.Attribs != null && channelInfo.Attribs.BufferSize > 0)
					{
						sb.AppendLine(">").Append("    <publishing>").AppendFormat(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "      <bufferSize>{0}</bufferSize>", channelInfo.Attribs.BufferSize)
							.Append("    </publishing>")
							.AppendLine()
							.AppendFormat(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "  </{0}>", text2)
							.AppendLine();
					}
					else
					{
						sb.Append("/>").AppendLine();
					}
				}
				sb.Append(" </channels>").AppendLine();
			}
			if (taskTab != null)
			{
				sb.Append(" <tasks>").AppendLine();
				List<int> list2 = new List<int>(taskTab.Keys);
				list2.Sort();
				foreach (int item2 in list2)
				{
					sb.Append("  <task name=\"").Append(taskTab[item2]).Append("\" value=\"")
						.Append(item2)
						.Append("\"/>")
						.AppendLine();
				}
				sb.Append(" </tasks>").AppendLine();
			}
			if (mapsTab != null)
			{
				sb.Append(" <maps>").AppendLine();
				foreach (Type value3 in mapsTab.Values)
				{
					string value = ((Attribute.GetCustomAttribute(value3, typeof(FlagsAttribute), inherit: false) != null) ? "bitMap" : "valueMap");
					sb.Append("  <").Append(value).Append(" name=\"")
						.Append(value3.Name)
						.Append("\">")
						.AppendLine();
					FieldInfo[] fields = value3.GetFields(BindingFlags.DeclaredOnly | BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public);
					FieldInfo[] array = fields;
					foreach (FieldInfo fieldInfo in array)
					{
						object rawConstantValue = fieldInfo.GetRawConstantValue();
						if (rawConstantValue != null)
						{
							string value2 = null;
							if (rawConstantValue is int num)
							{
								value2 = num.ToString("x", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
							}
							else if (rawConstantValue is long num2)
							{
								value2 = num2.ToString("x", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
							}
							sb.Append("   <map value=\"0x").Append(value2).Append("\"");
							WriteMessageAttrib(sb, "map", value3.Name + "." + fieldInfo.Name, fieldInfo.Name);
							sb.Append("/>").AppendLine();
						}
					}
					sb.Append("  </").Append(value).Append(">")
						.AppendLine();
				}
				sb.Append(" </maps>").AppendLine();
			}
			sb.Append(" <opcodes>").AppendLine();
			List<int> list3 = new List<int>(opcodeTab.Keys);
			list3.Sort();
			foreach (int item3 in list3)
			{
				sb.Append("  <opcode");
				WriteNameAndMessageAttribs(sb, "opcode", opcodeTab[item3]);
				sb.Append(" value=\"").Append(item3).Append("\"/>")
					.AppendLine();
			}
			sb.Append(" </opcodes>").AppendLine();
			if (keywordTab != null)
			{
				sb.Append(" <keywords>").AppendLine();
				List<ulong> list4 = new List<ulong>(keywordTab.Keys);
				list4.Sort();
				foreach (ulong item4 in list4)
				{
					sb.Append("  <keyword");
					WriteNameAndMessageAttribs(sb, "keyword", keywordTab[item4]);
					sb.Append(" mask=\"0x").Append(item4.ToString("x", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)).Append("\"/>")
						.AppendLine();
				}
				sb.Append(" </keywords>").AppendLine();
			}
			sb.Append(" <events>").AppendLine();
			sb.Append(events);
			sb.Append(" </events>").AppendLine();
			if (templates.Length > 0)
			{
				sb.Append(" <templates>").AppendLine();
				sb.Append(templates);
				sb.Append(" </templates>").AppendLine();
			}
			sb.Append("</provider>").AppendLine();
			sb.Append("</events>").AppendLine();
			sb.Append("</instrumentation>").AppendLine();
			sb.Append("<localization>").AppendLine();
			sb.Append(" <resources culture=\"").Append("en-US").Append("\">")
				.AppendLine();
			sb.Append("  <stringTable>").AppendLine();
			List<string> list5 = new List<string>(stringTab.Keys);
			list5.Sort();
			foreach (string item5 in list5)
			{
				sb.Append("   <string id=\"").Append(item5).Append("\" value=\"")
					.Append(stringTab[item5])
					.Append("\"/>")
					.AppendLine();
			}
			sb.Append("  </stringTable>").AppendLine();
			sb.Append(" </resources>").AppendLine();
			sb.Append("</localization>").AppendLine();
			sb.AppendLine("</instrumentationManifest>");
			return sb.ToString();
		}

		private void WriteNameAndMessageAttribs(StringBuilder stringBuilder, string elementName, string name)
		{
			stringBuilder.Append(" name=\"").Append(name).Append("\" ");
			WriteMessageAttrib(sb, elementName, name, name);
		}

		private void WriteMessageAttrib(StringBuilder stringBuilder, string elementName, string name, string value)
		{
			string text = elementName + "_" + name;
			if (resources != null)
			{
				string text2 = resources.GetString(text);
				if (text2 != null)
				{
					value = text2;
				}
			}
			if (value != null)
			{
				if (elementName == "event")
				{
					value = TranslateToManifestConvention(value);
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(" message=\"$(string.").Append(text).Append(")\"");
				stringTab.Add(text, value);
			}
		}

		private static string GetLevelName(EventLevel level)
		{
			return ((level >= (EventLevel)16) ? "" : "win:") + level;
		}

		private string GetChannelName(EventChannel channel, string eventName)
		{
			ChannelInfo value = null;
			if (channelTab == null || !channelTab.TryGetValue((int)channel, out value))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(EventSourceSR.EventSource_UndefinedChannel(channel, eventName));
			}
			return value.Name;
		}

		private string GetTaskName(EventTask task, string eventName)
		{
			if (task == EventTask.None)
			{
				return "";
			}
			if (taskTab == null)
			{
				taskTab = new Dictionary<int, string>();
			}
			if (!taskTab.TryGetValue((int)task, out var value))
			{
				return taskTab[(int)task] = eventName;
			}
			return value;
		}

		private string GetOpcodeName(EventOpcode opcode, string eventName)
		{
			switch (opcode)
			{
			case EventOpcode.Info:
				return "win:Info";
			case EventOpcode.Start:
				return "win:Start";
			case EventOpcode.Stop:
				return "win:Stop";
			case EventOpcode.DataCollectionStart:
				return "win:DC_Start";
			case EventOpcode.DataCollectionStop:
				return "win:DC_Stop";
			case EventOpcode.Extension:
				return "win:Extension";
			case EventOpcode.Reply:
				return "win:Reply";
			case EventOpcode.Resume:
				return "win:Resume";
			case EventOpcode.Suspend:
				return "win:Suspend";
			case EventOpcode.Send:
				return "win:Send";
			case EventOpcode.Receive:
				return "win:Receive";
			default:
			{
				if (opcodeTab == null || !opcodeTab.TryGetValue((int)opcode, out var value))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException("Use of undefined opcode value " + opcode.ToString() + " for event " + eventName);
				}
				return value;
			}
			}
		}

		private string GetKeywords(ulong keywords, string eventName)
		{
			string text = "";
			for (ulong num = 1uL; num != 0L; num <<= 1)
			{
				if ((keywords & num) != 0L)
				{
					if (keywordTab == null || !keywordTab.TryGetValue(num, out var value))
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(EventSourceSR.Event_UndefinedKeyword(num, eventName));
					}
					if (text.Length != 0)
					{
						text += " ";
					}
					text += value;
				}
			}
			return text;
		}

		private static string GetTypeName(Type type)
		{
			if (type.IsEnum)
			{
				FieldInfo[] fields = type.GetFields(BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
				string typeName = GetTypeName(fields[0].FieldType);
				return typeName.Replace("win:Int", "win:UInt");
			}
			switch (Type.GetTypeCode(type))
			{
			case TypeCode.Boolean:
				return "win:Boolean";
			case TypeCode.Byte:
				return "win:Uint8";
			case TypeCode.UInt16:
				return "win:UInt16";
			case TypeCode.UInt32:
				return "win:UInt32";
			case TypeCode.UInt64:
				return "win:UInt64";
			case TypeCode.SByte:
				return "win:Int8";
			case TypeCode.Int16:
				return "win:Int16";
			case TypeCode.Int32:
				return "win:Int32";
			case TypeCode.Int64:
				return "win:Int64";
			case TypeCode.String:
				return "win:UnicodeString";
			case TypeCode.Single:
				return "win:Float";
			case TypeCode.Double:
				return "win:Double";
			case TypeCode.Object:
				return "win:UnicodeString";
			default:
				if (type == typeof(Guid))
				{
					return "win:GUID";
				}
				throw new ArgumentException(EventSourceSR.Event_UnsupportType(type.Name));
			}
		}

		private static string TranslateToManifestConvention(string eventMessage)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = null;
			int num = 0;
			int i = 0;
			while (i < eventMessage.Length)
			{
				if (eventMessage[i] == '{')
				{
					int num2 = i;
					i++;
					int num3 = 0;
					for (; i < eventMessage.Length && char.IsDigit(eventMessage[i]); i++)
					{
						num3 += num3 * 10 + eventMessage[i] - 48;
					}
					if (i < eventMessage.Length && eventMessage[i] == '}')
					{
						i++;
						if (stringBuilder == null)
						{
							stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
						}
						stringBuilder.Append(eventMessage, num, num2 - num);
						stringBuilder.Append('%').Append(num3 + 1);
						num = i;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					i++;
				}
			}
			if (stringBuilder == null)
			{
				return eventMessage;
			}
			stringBuilder.Append(eventMessage, num, i - num);
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
	}

	internal class EventTraceActivity
	{
		private static EventTraceActivity empty;

		public Guid ActivityId;

		public static EventTraceActivity Empty
		{
			get
			{
				if (empty == null)
				{
					empty = new EventTraceActivity(Guid.Empty);
				}
				return empty;
			}
		}

		public static string Name => "E2EActivity";

		internal EventTraceActivity()
			: this(Guid.NewGuid())
		{
		}

		internal EventTraceActivity(Guid activityId)
		{
			ActivityId = activityId;
		}

		public static EventTraceActivity CreateFromThread()
		{
			Guid activityId = Trace.CorrelationManager.ActivityId;
			if (activityId == Guid.Empty)
			{
				return Empty;
			}
			return new EventTraceActivity(activityId);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return ActivityId.ToString();
		}
	}
	internal class ServiceBusEventListener : EventListener
	{
		private enum TraceEventChannel
		{
			Admin = 1,
			Operational,
			Analytic,
			Debug
		}

		private static System.Diagnostics.Eventing.EventDescriptor manifestRequestDescriptor = new System.Diagnostics.Eventing.EventDescriptor(65534, 1, 0, 0, 254, 65534, -1L);

		private const string UtcDateTimeFormat = "yyyy'-'MM'-'dd'T'HH':'mm':'ss.fff'Z'";

		private const string TraceSourceName = "Microsoft.ServiceBus";

		private const string TruncatedString = "#TRUNCATED#\" />";

		private const int MaxTraceSize = 31744;

		private const char HighChar = '\udfff';

		private const char LowChar = '\ud800';

		private static readonly XmlWriterSettings xmlWriterSettings = new XmlWriterSettings
		{
			OmitXmlDeclaration = true
		};

		private static readonly TraceSource traceSource = new TraceSource("Microsoft.ServiceBus");

		private EventSource eventSource;

		private IDictionary<int, string> messageDictionary;

		internal Guid ProviderId { get; private set; }

		public ServiceBusEventListener(Guid providerId)
		{
			ProviderId = providerId;
		}

		protected internal override void OnEventSourceCreated(EventSource eventSource)
		{
			if (eventSource != null && ProviderId == eventSource.Guid)
			{
				this.eventSource = eventSource;
				messageDictionary = GetEventMessageDictionary(this.eventSource.GetType());
				if (traceSource.Switch.Level != SourceLevels.Off)
				{
					EnableEvents(eventSource, TranslateSourceSwitchLevelToEventLevel(traceSource.Switch.Level), EventKeywords.All);
				}
			}
			base.OnEventSourceCreated(eventSource);
		}

		protected internal override void OnEventWritten(EventWrittenEventArgs eventData)
		{
			if (eventData.EventId != manifestRequestDescriptor.EventId)
			{
				WriteToDiagnosticsTrace(eventData);
			}
		}

		private static IDictionary<int, string> GetEventMessageDictionary(Type eventSourceType)
		{
			Dictionary<int, string> dictionary = new Dictionary<int, string>();
			MethodInfo[] methods = eventSourceType.GetMethods(BindingFlags.DeclaredOnly | BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
			EventSourceAttribute eventSourceAttribute = (EventSourceAttribute)Attribute.GetCustomAttribute(eventSourceType, typeof(EventSourceAttribute), inherit: false);
			ResourceManager resourceManager = new ResourceManager(eventSourceAttribute.LocalizationResources, eventSourceType.Assembly);
			foreach (MethodInfo methodInfo in methods)
			{
				ParameterInfo[] parameters = methodInfo.GetParameters();
				EventAttribute eventAttribute = (EventAttribute)Attribute.GetCustomAttribute(methodInfo, typeof(EventAttribute), inherit: false);
				if (eventAttribute != null)
				{
					string text = methodInfo.Name.Replace("EventWrite", string.Empty);
					dictionary[eventAttribute.EventId] = resourceManager.GetString("event_" + text);
				}
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		private string ConvertMessageToXmlFormattedString(EventWrittenEventArgs eventDescriptor)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			using (XmlWriter xmlWriter = XmlWriter.Create(stringBuilder, xmlWriterSettings))
			{
				xmlWriter.WriteStartElement("Trc");
				xmlWriter.WriteAttributeString("Id", eventDescriptor.EventId.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
				xmlWriter.WriteAttributeString("Ch", GetEventChannel(eventDescriptor).ToString());
				xmlWriter.WriteAttributeString("Lvl", GetEventLevel(eventDescriptor).ToString());
				xmlWriter.WriteAttributeString("Kw", eventDescriptor.Keywords.ToString("x"));
				xmlWriter.WriteAttributeString("UTC", DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("yyyy'-'MM'-'dd'T'HH':'mm':'ss.fff'Z'", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
				string text = messageDictionary[eventDescriptor.EventId];
				if (text != null)
				{
					string str = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, text, GetObjectAgsWithoutActivity(eventDescriptor.Payload));
					xmlWriter.WriteAttributeString("Msg", System.Security.SecurityElement.Escape(str));
					xmlWriter.WriteEndElement();
				}
			}
			string text2 = stringBuilder.ToString();
			if (text2.Length > 31744)
			{
				string arg = text2.Substring(0, 31744 - "#TRUNCATED#\" />".Length);
				text2 = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}{1}", arg, "#TRUNCATED#\" />");
			}
			return text2;
		}

		private static object[] GetObjectAgsWithoutActivity(IEnumerable<object> readOnlyCollection)
		{
			return readOnlyCollection.Where((object e) => !(e is EventTraceActivity)).ToArray();
		}

		private void WriteToDiagnosticsTrace(EventWrittenEventArgs eventDescriptor)
		{
			TraceEventType eventLevel = GetEventLevel(eventDescriptor);
			TraceEventChannel eventChannel = GetEventChannel(eventDescriptor);
			if (eventChannel == TraceEventChannel.Operational || eventChannel == TraceEventChannel.Admin)
			{
				string message = ConvertMessageToXmlFormattedString(eventDescriptor);
				traceSource.TraceEvent(eventLevel, eventDescriptor.EventId, message);
			}
		}

		private static TraceEventChannel GetEventChannel(EventWrittenEventArgs eventDescriptor)
		{
			TraceEventChannel result = TraceEventChannel.Debug;
			switch ((int)eventDescriptor.Channel)
			{
			case 16:
				result = TraceEventChannel.Admin;
				break;
			case 17:
				result = TraceEventChannel.Operational;
				break;
			case 18:
				result = TraceEventChannel.Analytic;
				break;
			case 19:
				result = TraceEventChannel.Debug;
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private static TraceEventType GetEventLevel(EventWrittenEventArgs eventDescriptor)
		{
			TraceEventType result = TraceEventType.Verbose;
			switch ((int)eventDescriptor.Level)
			{
			case 0:
				result = TraceEventType.Verbose;
				break;
			case 1:
				result = TraceEventType.Critical;
				break;
			case 2:
				result = TraceEventType.Error;
				break;
			case 3:
				result = TraceEventType.Warning;
				break;
			case 4:
				result = TraceEventType.Information;
				break;
			case 5:
				result = TraceEventType.Verbose;
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private static EventLevel TranslateSourceSwitchLevelToEventLevel(SourceLevels sourceLevel)
		{
			return sourceLevel switch
			{
				SourceLevels.Critical => EventLevel.Critical, 
				SourceLevels.Error => EventLevel.Error, 
				SourceLevels.Warning => EventLevel.Warning, 
				SourceLevels.Information => EventLevel.Informational, 
				_ => EventLevel.Verbose, 
			};
		}
	}

		private static string GetDetailsForThrownException(Exception e)
		{
			string text = e.GetType().ToString();
			StackTrace stackTrace = new StackTrace();
			string text2 = stackTrace.ToString();
			if (stackTrace.FrameCount > 10)
			{
				string[] value = text2.Split(new string[1] { Environment.NewLine }, 11, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
				text2 = string.Join(Environment.NewLine, value, 0, 10) + "...";
			}
			text = text + Environment.NewLine + text2;
			text = text + Environment.NewLine + "Exception ToString:" + Environment.NewLine;
			return text + e.ToStringSlim();
		}
	}
	internal class TrackingIdHeader : MessageHeader
	{
		private string id;

		public string Id => id;

		public override string Name => "TrackingId";

		public override string Namespace => "http://schemas.microsoft.com/servicebus/2010/08/protocol/";

		public TrackingIdHeader()
			: this(Guid.NewGuid().ToString())
		{
		}

		public TrackingIdHeader(string id)
		{
			this.id = id;
		}

		public static TrackingIdHeader Read(MessageHeaders messageHeaders)
		{
			if (!TryRead(messageHeaders, out var trackingIdHeader))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.TrackingIDHeaderMissing, "messageHeaders");
			}
			return trackingIdHeader;
		}

		public static bool Remove(MessageHeaders messageHeaders)
		{
			if (messageHeaders != null)
			{
				int num = messageHeaders.FindHeader("TrackingId", "http://schemas.microsoft.com/servicebus/2010/08/protocol/");
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					messageHeaders.RemoveAt(num);
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool TryRead(MessageHeaders messageHeaders, out TrackingIdHeader trackingIdHeader)
		{
			trackingIdHeader = null;
			if (messageHeaders == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = messageHeaders.FindHeader("TrackingId", "http://schemas.microsoft.com/servicebus/2010/08/protocol/");
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				using XmlDictionaryReader xmlDictionaryReader = messageHeaders.GetReaderAtHeader(num);
				xmlDictionaryReader.ReadStartElement();
				string text = xmlDictionaryReader.ReadString();
				trackingIdHeader = new TrackingIdHeader(text);
			}
			return trackingIdHeader != null;
		}

		public static bool TryAddOrUpdate(MessageHeaders messageHeaders, string trackingId)
		{
			if (messageHeaders == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			TrackingIdHeader header = new TrackingIdHeader(trackingId);
			int num = messageHeaders.FindHeader("TrackingId", "http://schemas.microsoft.com/servicebus/2010/08/protocol/");
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				messageHeaders.RemoveAt(num);
				messageHeaders.Add(header);
			}
			else
			{
				messageHeaders.Add(header);
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override void OnWriteHeaderContents(XmlDictionaryWriter writer, MessageVersion messageVersion)
		{
			writer.WriteString(id);
		}
	}
	internal class TrackingContextMessageProperty
	{
		public static string Name => "TrackingId";

		public TrackingContext TrackingContext { get; internal set; }

		public TrackingContextMessageProperty(TrackingContext trackingContext)
		{
			TrackingContext = trackingContext;
		}

		public static void Set(IDictionary<string, object> messageProperties, TrackingContext trackingContext)
		{
			messageProperties[Name] = new TrackingContextMessageProperty(trackingContext);
		}

		public static bool TryGet(IDictionary<string, object> messageProperties, out TrackingContextMessageProperty property)
		{
			property = null;
			if (messageProperties != null)
			{
				if (!messageProperties.TryGetValue(Name, out var value))
				{
					return false;
				}
				property = value as TrackingContextMessageProperty;
			}
			return property != null;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return TrackingContext.ToString();
		}
	}

		internal struct Scope : IDisposable
		{
			private readonly Holder previous;

			public Scope(TrackingContext trackingContext)
			{
				previous = CurrentHolder;
				CurrentHolder = new Holder(trackingContext);
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
				CurrentHolder = previous;
			}
		}

		private sealed class Holder : MarshalByRefObject
		{
			internal TrackingContext TrackingContext { get; }

			public Holder(TrackingContext trackingContext)
			{
				TrackingContext = trackingContext;
			}
		}

		internal const string MessagingSubsystemString = "MessagingGatewaySubsystem";

		internal const string MessagingBrokerSubsystemString = "MessagingBrokerSubsystem";

		internal const string NoTrackingId = "NoTrackingId";

		internal const string NoClientRequestId = "NoClientRequestId";

		internal const string NoCorrelationRequestId = "NoCorrelationRequestId";

		public const string TrackingIdName = "TrackingId";

		public const string SystemTrackerName = "SystemTracker";

		public const string HeaderNamespace = "http://schemas.microsoft.com/servicebus/2010/08/protocol/";

		private const string AppendRoleSeparator = "_";

		private const string MessageIdHeaderName = "MessageId";

		private readonly string trackingId;

		{

			}

				return (Holder)CallContext.LogicalGetData(CurrentTrackingContextKey);

			set

				CallContext.LogicalSetData(CurrentTrackingContextKey, value);
			}
		}

		internal static string RoleInstanceId { get; private set; } = string.Empty;

		internal static string RoleSuffix { get; private set; } = string.Empty;

		public string TrackingId

		private TrackingContext(string trackingId, string systemTracker, OperationTracker operationTracker = null)
		{
			this.trackingId = trackingId;

			: this(trackingId, systemTracker)

			this.clientRequestId = clientRequestId;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(systemTracker))
			{
				return "TrackingId:" + TrackingId;
			}
			return "TrackingId:" + TrackingId + ", SystemTracker:" + SystemTracker;
		}

		internal static TrackingContext CreateFromKey(string key, string overrideSystemTracker)
		{
			if (!ComponentTrackingGuids.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
			{
				value = Guid.NewGuid();
			}
			return Create(subsystemId: (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(overrideSystemTracker)) ? overrideSystemTracker : string.Empty, guidTrackingId: value);
		}

		internal static TrackingContext CreateFromKey(string key)
		{
			if (!ComponentTrackingGuids.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
			{
				value = Guid.NewGuid();
			}
			return Create(value, null);
		}

		internal static TrackingContext Create(Guid guidTrackingId, string subsystemId)
		{
			string text = AppendRoleInstanceInformationToTrackingId(guidTrackingId.ToString());
			return new TrackingContext(text, subsystemId ?? string.Empty);
		}

		internal static bool TryParse(string trackingContextString, out TrackingContext trackingContext)
		{
			return TryParse(trackingContextString, appendRole: false, out trackingContext);
		}

		internal static bool TryParse(string trackingContextString, bool appendRole, out TrackingContext trackingContext)
		{
			trackingContext = null;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(trackingContextString))
			{
				return false;
			}
			string value = null;
			string subsystemId = null;
			int num = trackingContextString.IndexOf("TrackingId:");
			if (num != -1)
			{
				num += "TrackingId".Length + 1;
				int num2 = trackingContextString.IndexOf(",", num);
				if (num2 == -1)
				{
					num2 = trackingContextString.Length;
				}
				value = trackingContextString.Substring(num, num2 - num);
				int num3 = trackingContextString.IndexOf("SystemTracker:");
				if (num3 != -1)
				{
					num3 += "SystemTracker".Length + 1;
					int num4 = trackingContextString.IndexOf(",", num3);
					if (num4 == -1)
					{
						num4 = trackingContextString.Length;
					}
					subsystemId = trackingContextString.Substring(num3, num4 - num3);
				}
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				trackingContext = Create(value, subsystemId, appendRole);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static TrackingContext Create()
		{
			return Create(Guid.NewGuid(), string.Empty);
		}

		internal static TrackingContext Create(Uri subsystemId)

			return Create(Guid.NewGuid().ToString(), GetSystemTracker(subsystemId), appendRole: true);
		}
