			return Create(trackingId, GetSystemTracker(subsystemId), appendRole);
		}

		internal static TrackingContext Create(Guid guidTrackingId)
		{
			return Create(guidTrackingId, null);
		}

		internal static TrackingContext Create(string trackingId, string overrideSystemTracker, string correlationRequestId, string clientRequestId, bool appendRole)
		{
			string text = ((!string.IsNullOrEmpty(overrideSystemTracker)) ? overrideSystemTracker : string.Empty);
			if (appendRole)
			{
				trackingId = AppendRoleInstanceInformationToTrackingId(trackingId);
			}
			return new TrackingContext(trackingId, text, correlationRequestId, clientRequestId);
		}

		internal static TrackingContext Create(string trackingId, string subsystemId, bool appendRole, OperationTracker operationTracker = null)
		{
			if (appendRole)
			{
				trackingId = AppendRoleInstanceInformationToTrackingId(trackingId);
			}
			return new TrackingContext(trackingId, subsystemId ?? string.Empty, operationTracker);
		}

		internal static TrackingContext Create(string trackingId, bool appendRole)
		{
			return Create(trackingId, null, appendRole, null);
		}

		internal static TrackingContext GetInstance(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, string subsytemId, bool appendRole, WebOperationContext webOperationContext = null)
		{
			return GetInstance(message.Properties, message.Headers, subsytemId, appendRole, webOperationContext);
		}

		internal static TrackingContext GetInstance(Uri requestUri, IDictionary<string, object> messageProperties, IDictionary<string, string> messageHeaders)
		{
			string text = GetTrackingId(messageProperties, messageHeaders);
			string value = GetSystemTracker(messageProperties, messageHeaders);
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
			{
				value = GetSystemTracker(requestUri);
			}
			return new TrackingContext(text, value);
		}

		internal static TrackingContext GetInstance(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, WebOperationContext webOperationContext, bool appendRole)
		{
			return GetInstance(message, string.Empty, appendRole, webOperationContext);
		}

		internal static TrackingContext GetInstance(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, bool appendRole = false)
		{
			return GetInstance(message, string.Empty, appendRole);
		}

		internal static string GetSystemTracker(Uri requestUri)
		{
			if (requestUri != null)
			{
				string text = requestUri.AbsolutePath.Trim('/');
				return requestUri.DnsSafeHost + ":" + text;
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		internal static string GetSystemTracker(MessageHeaders messageHeaders, WebOperationContext webOperationContext)
		{
			if (webOperationContext != null)
			{
				Uri uri = null;
				if (webOperationContext.IncomingRequest != null && webOperationContext.IncomingRequest.UriTemplateMatch != null)
				{
					uri = webOperationContext.IncomingRequest.UriTemplateMatch.RequestUri;
				}
				else if (webOperationContext.IncomingRequest.Headers[HttpRequestHeader.Via] != null)
				{
					string uriString = webOperationContext.IncomingRequest.Headers[HttpRequestHeader.Via];
					if (Uri.IsWellFormedUriString(uriString, UriKind.Absolute))
					{
						uri = new Uri(uriString);
					}
				}
				if (uri != null)
				{
					return GetSystemTracker(uri);
				}
			}
			Uri to = messageHeaders.To;
			return GetSystemTracker(to);
		}

		internal static TrackingContext GetInstance(IDictionary<string, object> messageProperties, MessageHeaders messageHeaders, string subsystemId, bool appendRole, WebOperationContext webOperationContext)
		{
			if (TrackingContextMessageProperty.TryGet(messageProperties, out var property))
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(subsystemId) && !string.Equals(subsystemId, property.TrackingContext.systemTracker, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
				{
					property.TrackingContext = Create(property.TrackingContext.TrackingId, subsystemId, appendRole: false);
				}
				return property.TrackingContext;
			}
			string text = GetTrackingId(messageProperties, messageHeaders, webOperationContext);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(subsystemId))
			{
				subsystemId = GetSystemTracker(messageHeaders, webOperationContext);
			}
			TrackingContext trackingContext = Create(text, subsystemId, appendRole);
			TrackingContextMessageProperty.Set(messageProperties, trackingContext);
			return trackingContext;
		}

		internal static string GetTrackingId(IDictionary<string, object> messageProperties, MessageHeaders messageHeaders, WebOperationContext webOperationContext)
		{
			string text = null;
			if (webOperationContext != null)
			{
				text = webOperationContext.IncomingRequest.Headers.Get("TrackingId");
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return text;
			}
			if (TrackingIdHeader.TryRead(messageHeaders, out var trackingIdHeader))
			{
				return trackingIdHeader.Id;
			}
			if (messageHeaders.RelatesTo != null)
			{
				return GetTrackingId(messageHeaders.RelatesTo);
			}
			if (messageHeaders.MessageId != null)
			{
				return GetTrackingId(messageHeaders.MessageId);
			}
			return Guid.NewGuid().ToString();
		}

		internal static void SetCurrentRoleIdentifier(string roleInstanceId, RoleType roleType)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(RoleSuffix))
			{
				RoleInstanceId = roleInstanceId;
				RoleSuffix = "_" + (char)roleType + roleInstanceId;
			}
		}

		internal string CreateClientTrackingExceptionInfo()
		{
			return CreateClientTrackingExceptionInfo(DateTime.UtcNow);
		}

		internal string CreateClientTrackingExceptionInfo(DateTime timestamp)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(SystemTracker))
			{
				return SRClient.TrackingIdSystemTrackerAndTimestampFormat(TrackingId, SystemTracker, FormatDateTime(timestamp));
			}
			return SRClient.TrackingIdAndTimestampFormat(TrackingId, FormatDateTime(timestamp));
		}

		internal static string CreateMessage(string message)
		{
			TrackingContext current = Current;
			if (current != null)
			{
				return current.CreateTrackableErrorMessage(message);
			}
			return message;
		}

		internal string CreateTrackableErrorMessage(string exceptionMessage)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(exceptionMessage) || exceptionMessage.IndexOf("TrackingId", StringComparison.Ordinal) == -1)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(exceptionMessage) && !exceptionMessage.EndsWith(".", StringComparison.Ordinal))
				{
					exceptionMessage += ".";
				}
				return SRClient.TrackableExceptionMessageFormat(exceptionMessage, CreateClientTrackingExceptionInfo());
			}
			return exceptionMessage;
		}

		internal static TException CreateTrackableException<TException>(Func<string, Exception, TException> createExceptionFunc, string message, Exception innerException, TrackingContext trackingContext) where TException : Exception
		{
			if (!TryParse(innerException?.Message, out var trackingContext2))
			{
				trackingContext2 = trackingContext;
			}
			if (trackingContext2 != null)
			{
				message = trackingContext2.CreateTrackableErrorMessage(message);
			}
			return createExceptionFunc(message, innerException);
		}

		private static string GetTrackingId(UniqueId uniqueId)
		{
			if (uniqueId.TryGetGuid(out var guid))
			{
				return guid.ToString();
			}
			return uniqueId.ToString();
		}

		private static string GetTrackingId(IDictionary<string, object> requestProperties, IDictionary<string, string> requestHeaders)
		{
			if (TrackingContextMessageProperty.TryGet(requestProperties, out var property))
			{
				return property.TrackingContext.TrackingId;
			}
			if (!TryGetHeader(requestHeaders, "TrackingId", out var value))
			{
				if (requestHeaders.ContainsKey("MessageId"))
				{
					UniqueId uniqueId = new UniqueId(requestHeaders["MessageId"]);
					return AppendRoleInstanceInformationToTrackingId(GetTrackingId(uniqueId));
				}
				return AppendRoleInstanceInformationToTrackingId(Guid.NewGuid().ToString());
			}
			return value;
		}

		private static string GetSystemTracker(IDictionary<string, object> messageProperties, IDictionary<string, string> messageHeaders)
		{
			if (TrackingContextMessageProperty.TryGet(messageProperties, out var property))
			{
				return property.TrackingContext.SystemTracker;
			}
			if (TryGetHeader(messageHeaders, "SystemTracker", out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		internal static EventTraceActivity GetActivity(string id)
		{
			EventTraceActivity eventTraceActivity = null;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(id))
			{
				int num = id.IndexOf('_');
				if ((num > 0 && Guid.TryParse(id.Substring(0, num), out var result)) || Guid.TryParse(id, out result))
				{
					eventTraceActivity = new EventTraceActivity(result);
				}
			}
			return eventTraceActivity ?? new EventTraceActivity();
		}

		internal static string AppendRoleInstanceInformationToTrackingId(string trackingId)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(RoleSuffix))
			{
				return trackingId;
			}
			return trackingId + RoleSuffix;
		}

		internal static string GetRoleInstanceInformation()
		{
			return RoleSuffix;
		}

		private static bool TryGetHeader(IDictionary<string, string> headersDictionary, string header, out string value)
		{
			value = null;
			if (headersDictionary != null && headersDictionary.ContainsKey(header))
			{
				value = headersDictionary[header];
			}
			return value != null;
		}

		private static string FormatDateTime(DateTime timestamp)
		{
			timestamp = timestamp.ToUniversalTime();
			return timestamp.ToString("s", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class OperationTracker
	{
		private const int MaxLogLength = 4096;

		private readonly string operation;

		private readonly string target;

		private readonly DateTime startTime;

		private readonly Timestamp timestamp;

		private readonly StringBuilder info;

		private bool truncated;

		public string Operation => operation;

		public string Target => target;

		public string StartTime => startTime.ToString("O");

		public TimeSpan Duration => timestamp.Elapsed;

		public string Info
		{
			get
			{
				lock (info)
				{
					return info.ToString();
				}
			}
		}

		public OperationTracker(string operation, string target)
		{
			this.operation = operation;
			this.target = target;
			startTime = DateTime.UtcNow;
			timestamp = Timestamp.Now;
			info = new StringBuilder(operation.Length + (target?.Length ?? 0) + 128);
			info.Append(this.operation).Append("|").Append(this.target)
				.Append("|")
				.Append(StartTime)
				.Append("|");
		}

		public OperationTracker TraceStep(string step)
		{
			return TraceStep(step, 0);
		}

		public OperationTracker TraceStep<T>(string step, T arg)
		{
			lock (info)
			{
				if (info.Length > 4096)
				{
					if (!truncated)
					{
						info.Append("...");
						truncated = true;
					}
					return this;
				}
				info.Append("->").Append((int)Duration.TotalMilliseconds).Append(':')
					.Append(step);
				if (!EqualityComparer<T>.Default.Equals(arg, default(T)))
				{
					info.Append("-").Append(arg);
				}
			}
			return this;
		}

		public OperationTracker CompleteStep(string step, bool success)
		{
			lock (info)
			{
				TraceStep(step);
				info.Append(success ? ":1" : ":0");
				return this;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class SystemTrackerHeader : MessageHeader
	{
		public string Tracker { get; private set; }

		public override string Name => "SystemTracker";

		public override string Namespace => "http://schemas.microsoft.com/servicebus/2010/08/protocol/";

		public SystemTrackerHeader()
			: this(string.Empty)
		{
		}

		public SystemTrackerHeader(string tracker)
		{
			Tracker = tracker;
		}

		public static SystemTrackerHeader Read(MessageHeaders messageHeaders)
		{
			if (!TryRead(messageHeaders, out var systemTrackerHeader))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.SystemTrackerHeaderMissing, "messageHeaders");
			}
			return systemTrackerHeader;
		}

		public static bool Remove(MessageHeaders messageHeaders)
		{
			if (messageHeaders != null)
			{
				int num = messageHeaders.FindHeader("SystemTracker", "http://schemas.microsoft.com/servicebus/2010/08/protocol/");
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					messageHeaders.RemoveAt(num);
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool TryRead(MessageHeaders messageHeaders, out SystemTrackerHeader systemTrackerHeader)
		{
			systemTrackerHeader = null;
			if (messageHeaders == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = messageHeaders.FindHeader("SystemTracker", "http://schemas.microsoft.com/servicebus/2010/08/protocol/");
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				using XmlDictionaryReader xmlDictionaryReader = messageHeaders.GetReaderAtHeader(num);
				xmlDictionaryReader.ReadStartElement();
				string tracker = xmlDictionaryReader.ReadString();
				systemTrackerHeader = new SystemTrackerHeader(tracker);
			}
			return systemTrackerHeader != null;
		}

		protected override void OnWriteHeaderContents(XmlDictionaryWriter writer, MessageVersion messageVersion)
		{
			writer.WriteString(Tracker.ToString());
		}
	}

namespace Microsoft.ServiceBus.Description
{
	public class TcpRelayTransportBindingElementImporter : IWsdlImportExtension, IPolicyImportExtension
	{
		void IWsdlImportExtension.BeforeImport(ServiceDescriptionCollection wsdlDocuments, XmlSchemaSet xmlSchemas, ICollection<XmlElement> policy)
		{
		}

		void IWsdlImportExtension.ImportContract(WsdlImporter importer, WsdlContractConversionContext context)
		{
		}

		void IWsdlImportExtension.ImportEndpoint(WsdlImporter importer, WsdlEndpointConversionContext context)
		{
			if (context.WsdlPort != null)
			{
				EndpointAddress endpointAddress = (context.Endpoint.Address = WSAddressingHelper.ImportAddress(context.WsdlPort));
				EndpointAddress endpointAddress3 = endpointAddress;
				if (endpointAddress3 != null)
				{
					context.Endpoint.Address = endpointAddress3;
				}
			}
			SoapBinding soapBinding = (SoapBinding)context.WsdlBinding.Extensions.Find(typeof(SoapBinding));
			soapBinding.Handled = true;
		}

		void IPolicyImportExtension.ImportPolicy(MetadataImporter importer, PolicyConversionContext context)
		{
			if (importer == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("importer");
			}
			if (context == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("context");
			}
			ICollection<XmlElement> bindingAssertions = context.GetBindingAssertions();
			List<XmlElement> list = new List<XmlElement>();
			TcpRelayTransportBindingElement tcpRelayTransportBindingElement = null;
			RelayClientAuthenticationType relayClientAuthenticationType = RelayClientAuthenticationType.None;
			bool transportProtectionEnabled = false;
			foreach (XmlElement item in bindingAssertions)
			{
				if (item.NamespaceURI == "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2009/05/servicebus/connect")
				{
					if (item.LocalName == "RelaySocketConnection")
					{
						tcpRelayTransportBindingElement = new TcpRelayTransportBindingElement();
						tcpRelayTransportBindingElement.ConnectionMode = TcpRelayConnectionMode.Relayed;
						list.Add(item);
					}
					else if (item.LocalName == "HybridSocketConnection")
					{
						tcpRelayTransportBindingElement = new TcpRelayTransportBindingElement();
						tcpRelayTransportBindingElement.ConnectionMode = TcpRelayConnectionMode.Hybrid;
						list.Add(item);
					}
					else if (item.LocalName == "SenderRelayCredential")
					{
						relayClientAuthenticationType = RelayClientAuthenticationType.RelayAccessToken;
						list.Add(item);
					}
					else if (item.LocalName == "ListenerRelayCredential")
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
				}
				if (item.NamespaceURI == "http://schemas.microsoft.com/ws/2006/05/framing/policy" && item.LocalName == "SslTransportSecurity")
				{
					transportProtectionEnabled = true;
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			if (tcpRelayTransportBindingElement != null)
			{
				tcpRelayTransportBindingElement.RelayClientAuthenticationType = relayClientAuthenticationType;
				tcpRelayTransportBindingElement.TransportProtectionEnabled = transportProtectionEnabled;
				context.BindingElements.Add(tcpRelayTransportBindingElement);
				for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
				{
					bindingAssertions.Remove(list[i]);
				}
			}
		}
	}

		{
			if (context.WsdlPort != null)
			{
				EndpointAddress endpointAddress = (context.Endpoint.Address = WSAddressingHelper.ImportAddress(context.WsdlPort));
				EndpointAddress endpointAddress3 = endpointAddress;
				if (endpointAddress3 != null)
				{
					context.Endpoint.Address = endpointAddress3;
				}
			}
			SoapBinding soapBinding = (SoapBinding)context.WsdlBinding.Extensions.Find(typeof(SoapBinding));
			soapBinding.Handled = true;
		}

		void IPolicyImportExtension.ImportPolicy(MetadataImporter importer, PolicyConversionContext context)
		{
			if (importer == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("importer");
			}
			if (context == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("context");
			}
			ICollection<XmlElement> bindingAssertions = context.GetBindingAssertions();
			List<XmlElement> list = new List<XmlElement>();
			HttpRelayTransportBindingElement httpRelayTransportBindingElement = null;
			foreach (XmlElement item in bindingAssertions)
			{
				if (item.NamespaceURI == "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2009/05/servicebus/connect" && item.LocalName == "SenderRelayCredential")
				{
					httpRelayTransportBindingElement = new HttpsRelayTransportBindingElement();
					httpRelayTransportBindingElement.RelayClientAuthenticationType = RelayClientAuthenticationType.RelayAccessToken;
					list.Add(item);
				}
				else if (item.NamespaceURI == "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2009/05/servicebus/connect")
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			if (httpRelayTransportBindingElement != null)
			{
				context.BindingElements.Remove<TransportBindingElement>();
				context.BindingElements.Add(httpRelayTransportBindingElement);
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				bindingAssertions.Remove(list[i]);
			}
		}
	}

				EndpointAddress endpointAddress = (context.Endpoint.Address = WSAddressingHelper.ImportAddress(context.WsdlPort));
				EndpointAddress endpointAddress3 = endpointAddress;
				if (endpointAddress3 != null)

					context.Endpoint.Address = endpointAddress3;

			SoapBinding soapBinding = (SoapBinding)context.WsdlBinding.Extensions.Find(typeof(SoapBinding));
			soapBinding.Handled = true;

		void IPolicyImportExtension.ImportPolicy(MetadataImporter importer, PolicyConversionContext context)
		{
			if (importer == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("importer");
			}
			if (context == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("context");
			}
			ICollection<XmlElement> bindingAssertions = context.GetBindingAssertions();
			List<XmlElement> list = new List<XmlElement>();
			RelayedOnewayTransportBindingElement relayedOnewayTransportBindingElement = null;
			foreach (XmlElement item in bindingAssertions)
			{
				if (!(item.NamespaceURI == "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2009/05/servicebus/connect") || !(item.LocalName == "RelayedOneway"))
				{
					continue;
				}
				bool flag = false;
				bool flag2 = false;
				foreach (XmlElement childNode in item.ChildNodes)
				{
					if (childNode.NamespaceURI == "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2009/05/servicebus/connect" && childNode.LocalName == "Multicast")
					{
						flag = true;
						if (flag2)
						{
							throw new NotSupportedException(SRClient.MultipleConnectionModeAssertions);
						}
						flag2 = true;
					}
				}
				relayedOnewayTransportBindingElement = new RelayedOnewayTransportBindingElement(RelayClientAuthenticationType.RelayAccessToken, flag ? RelayedOnewayConnectionMode.Multicast : RelayedOnewayConnectionMode.Unicast);
				list.Add(item);
			}
			if (relayedOnewayTransportBindingElement != null)
			{
				context.BindingElements.Add(relayedOnewayTransportBindingElement);
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				bindingAssertions.Remove(list[i]);
			}
		}
	}
	public class StandardRelayBindingImporter : IWsdlImportExtension
	{
		public void BeforeImport(ServiceDescriptionCollection wsdlDocuments, XmlSchemaSet xmlSchemas, ICollection<XmlElement> policy)
		{
		}

		public void ImportContract(WsdlImporter importer, WsdlContractConversionContext context)
		{
		}

		public void ImportEndpoint(WsdlImporter importer, WsdlEndpointConversionContext endpointContext)
		{
			if (endpointContext == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("endpointContext");
			}
			if (endpointContext.Endpoint.Binding == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("endpointContext.Binding");
			}
			if (!(endpointContext.Endpoint.Binding is CustomBinding))
			{
				return;
			}
			BindingElementCollection elements = ((CustomBinding)endpointContext.Endpoint.Binding).Elements;
			System.ServiceModel.Channels.Binding binding;
			TransportBindingElement transportBindingElement;
			if ((transportBindingElement = elements.Find<HttpRelayTransportBindingElement>()) != null)
			{
				elements.Remove<HttpsTransportBindingElement>();
				if (WSHttpRelayBindingBase.TryCreate(elements, out binding))
				{
					SetBinding(endpointContext.Endpoint, binding);
				}
				else if (BasicHttpRelayBinding.TryCreate(elements, out binding))
				{
					SetBinding(endpointContext.Endpoint, binding);
				}
			}
			else if ((transportBindingElement = elements.Find<TcpRelayTransportBindingElement>()) != null && NetTcpRelayBinding.TryCreate(elements, out binding))
			{
				SetBinding(endpointContext.Endpoint, binding);
			}
		}

		private static void SetBinding(ServiceEndpoint endpoint, System.ServiceModel.Channels.Binding binding)
		{
			binding.Name = endpoint.Binding.Name;
			binding.Namespace = endpoint.Binding.Namespace;
			endpoint.Binding = binding;
		}
	}
	internal static class WSAddressingHelper
	{
		internal static EndpointAddress ImportAddress(Port wsdlPort)
		{
			if (wsdlPort != null)
			{
				XmlElement xmlElement = wsdlPort.Extensions.Find("EndpointReference", "http://www.w3.org/2005/08/addressing");
				XmlElement xmlElement2 = wsdlPort.Extensions.Find("EndpointReference", "http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2004/08/addressing");
				SoapAddressBinding soapAddressBinding = (SoapAddressBinding)wsdlPort.Extensions.Find(typeof(SoapAddressBinding));
				if (xmlElement != null)
				{
					return EndpointAddress.ReadFrom(AddressingVersion.WSAddressing10, new XmlNodeReader(xmlElement));
				}
				if (xmlElement2 != null)
				{
					return EndpointAddress.ReadFrom(AddressingVersion.WSAddressingAugust2004, new XmlNodeReader(xmlElement2));
				}
				if (soapAddressBinding != null)
				{
					return new EndpointAddress(soapAddressBinding.Location);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

	[ConfigurationCollection(typeof(AddressConfigurationElement), AddItemName = "address", CollectionType = ConfigurationElementCollectionType.BasicMap)]
	public sealed class AddressConfigurationElementCollection : ConfigurationElementCollection
	{
		private readonly object syncLock;

		private volatile List<Uri> addresses;

		public IEnumerable<Uri> Addresses
		{
			get
			{
				if (addresses == null)
				{
					lock (syncLock)
					{
						if (addresses == null)
						{
							addresses = (from AddressConfigurationElement address in this
								select address.Value).ToList();
						}
					}
				}
				return addresses;
			}
		}

		protected override string ElementName => string.Empty;

		public AddressConfigurationElementCollection()
		{
			syncLock = new object();
		}

		protected override bool IsElementName(string elementName)
		{
			return elementName == "address";
		}

		protected override ConfigurationElement CreateNewElement()
		{
			return new AddressConfigurationElement();
		}

		protected override object GetElementKey(ConfigurationElement element)
		{
			return ((AddressConfigurationElement)element).Value;
		}
	}

	internal static class ConfigurationHelpers
	{
		internal static BindingCollectionElement GetAssociatedBindingCollectionElement(ContextInformation evaluationContext, string bindingCollectionName)
		{
			BindingCollectionElement result = null;
			BindingsSection bindingsSection = (BindingsSection)GetAssociatedSection(evaluationContext, ConfigurationStrings.BindingsSectionGroupPath);
			if (bindingsSection != null)
			{
				try
				{
					result = bindingsSection[bindingCollectionName];
				}
				catch (KeyNotFoundException)
				{
					throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new ConfigurationErrorsException(SR.GetString(Resources.ConfigBindingExtensionNotFound, GetBindingsSectionPath(bindingCollectionName))), null, EventLevel.Warning, "GetAssociatedBindingCollectionElement", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Configuration\\ConfigurationHelpers.cs", 35);
				}

		public override void ApplyConfiguration(BindingElement bindingElement)
		{
			base.ApplyConfiguration(bindingElement);
			Microsoft.ServiceBus.Channels.ConnectionOrientedTransportBindingElement connectionOrientedTransportBindingElement = bindingElement as Microsoft.ServiceBus.Channels.ConnectionOrientedTransportBindingElement;
			int? num = null;
			PropertyInformationCollection propertyInformationCollection = base.ElementInformation.Properties;
			if (propertyInformationCollection["maxBufferSize"].ValueOrigin != PropertyValueOrigin.Default)
			{
				num = MaxBufferSize;
			}
			if (connectionOrientedTransportBindingElement != null)
			{
				connectionOrientedTransportBindingElement.ChannelInitializationTimeout = ChannelInitializationTimeout;
				connectionOrientedTransportBindingElement.ConnectionBufferSize = ConnectionBufferSize;
				connectionOrientedTransportBindingElement.HostNameComparisonMode = HostNameComparisonMode;
				connectionOrientedTransportBindingElement.MaxPendingConnections = MaxPendingConnections;
				connectionOrientedTransportBindingElement.MaxOutputDelay = MaxOutputDelay;
				connectionOrientedTransportBindingElement.MaxPendingAccepts = MaxPendingAccepts;
				connectionOrientedTransportBindingElement.TransferMode = TransferMode;
				if (num.HasValue)
				{
					connectionOrientedTransportBindingElement.MaxBufferSize = num.Value;
				}
				return;
			}
			if (bindingElement is RelayedOnewayTransportBindingElement relayedOnewayTransportBindingElement)
			{
				relayedOnewayTransportBindingElement.ChannelInitializationTimeout = ChannelInitializationTimeout;
				relayedOnewayTransportBindingElement.ConnectionBufferSize = ConnectionBufferSize;
				relayedOnewayTransportBindingElement.MaxPendingAccepts = MaxPendingAccepts;
				relayedOnewayTransportBindingElement.MaxPendingConnections = MaxPendingConnections;
				relayedOnewayTransportBindingElement.HostNameComparisonMode = HostNameComparisonMode;
				if (num.HasValue)
				{
					relayedOnewayTransportBindingElement.MaxBufferSize = num.Value;
				}
				return;
			}
			throw new InvalidCastException(SRClient.ExpectedTypeInvalidCastException(typeof(Microsoft.ServiceBus.Channels.ConnectionOrientedTransportBindingElement).ToString(), typeof(RelayedOnewayTransportBindingElement).ToString(), bindingElement.GetType().ToString()));
		}

			ConnectionBufferSize = connectionOrientedTransportElement.ConnectionBufferSize;
			MaxBufferSize = connectionOrientedTransportElement.MaxBufferSize;
			TransferMode = connectionOrientedTransportElement.TransferMode;
		}

	[ConfigurationCollection(typeof(StsUriElement), AddItemName = "stsUri", CollectionType = ConfigurationElementCollectionType.BasicMap)]
	public sealed class StsUriElementCollection : ConfigurationElementCollection
	{
		private volatile List<Uri> stsUris;

		private readonly object syncLock;

		protected override string ElementName => string.Empty;

		public IEnumerable<Uri> Addresses
		{
			get
			{
				if (stsUris == null)
				{
					lock (syncLock)
					{
						if (stsUris == null)
						{
							stsUris = (from StsUriElement stsUri in this
								select stsUri.Value).ToList();
						}
					}
				}
				return stsUris;
			}
		}

		public StsUriElementCollection()
		{
			syncLock = new object();
		}

		protected override bool IsElementName(string elementName)
		{
			return elementName == "stsUri";
		}

		protected override ConfigurationElement CreateNewElement()
		{
			return new StsUriElement();
		}

		protected override object GetElementKey(ConfigurationElement element)
		{
			return ((StsUriElement)element).Value;
		}
	}
	[ConfigurationCollection(typeof(TokenProviderElement), CollectionType = ConfigurationElementCollectionType.AddRemoveClearMap)]
	public sealed class TokenProviderElementCollection : ConfigurationElementCollection
	{
		public new TokenProviderElement this[string name] => (TokenProviderElement)BaseGet(name);

		protected override ConfigurationElement CreateNewElement()
		{
			return new TokenProviderElement();
		}

		protected override object GetElementKey(ConfigurationElement element)
		{
			TokenProviderElement tokenProviderElement = (TokenProviderElement)element;
			if (tokenProviderElement == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(tokenProviderElement.Name))
			{
				throw new ConfigurationErrorsException(SRCore.NullOrEmptyConfigurationAttribute("name", "tokenProvider"));
			}
			return tokenProviderElement.Name;
		}

	public class WindowsElement : ConfigurationElement
	{

		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)base["useDefaultCredentials"];
			}
			set
			{
				base["useDefaultCredentials"] = value;
			}
		}

		[ConfigurationProperty("userName", IsRequired = false)]
		public string UserName
		{
			get
			{
				return (string)base["userName"];
			}
			set
			{
				base["userName"] = value;
			}
		}

		[ConfigurationProperty("password", IsRequired = false)]
		public string Password
		{
			get
			{
				return (string)base["password"];
			}
			set
			{
				base["password"] = value;
			}
		}

		[ConfigurationProperty("domain", IsRequired = false)]
		public string Domain
		{
			get
			{
				return (string)base["domain"];
			}
			set
			{
				base["domain"] = value;
			}
		}

		[ConfigurationProperty("stsUris", IsRequired = true, IsDefaultCollection = false)]
		public virtual StsUriElementCollection StsUris => (StsUriElementCollection)base["stsUris"];

		internal bool IsValid
		{
			get
			{
				bool flag = (UseDefaultCredentials && string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(UserName) && string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Password) && string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Domain)) || (!UseDefaultCredentials && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(UserName));
				return StsUris != null && StsUris.Count > 0 && flag;
			}
		}

		protected override ConfigurationPropertyCollection Properties
		{
			get
			{
				if (properties == null)
				{
					ConfigurationPropertyCollection configurationPropertyCollection = base.Properties;
					configurationPropertyCollection.Add(new ConfigurationProperty("useDefaultCredentials", typeof(bool), true));
					configurationPropertyCollection.Add(new ConfigurationProperty("userName", typeof(string)));
					configurationPropertyCollection.Add(new ConfigurationProperty("password", typeof(string)));
					configurationPropertyCollection.Add(new ConfigurationProperty("domain", typeof(string)));
					configurationPropertyCollection.Add(new ConfigurationProperty("stsUris", typeof(StsUriElementCollection)));
					properties = configurationPropertyCollection;
				}
				return properties;
			}
		}

		internal WindowsElement()
		{
		}

		{
			UseDefaultCredentials = source.UseDefaultCredentials;
			UserName = source.UserName;
			Password = source.Password;
			Domain = source.Domain;
		}

				AlgorithmSuite = security.AlgorithmSuite;
			}

	internal class EncodingConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			if (typeof(string) == sourceType)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
		}

		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (typeof(InstanceDescriptor) == destinationType)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			if (value is string)
			{
				string text = (string)value;
				Encoding encoding = Encoding.GetEncoding(text);
				if (encoding == null)
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.Argument("value", SR.GetString(Resources.ConfigInvalidEncodingValue, text));
				}
				return encoding;
			}
			return base.ConvertFrom(context, culture, value);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (typeof(string) == destinationType && value is Encoding)
			{
				Encoding encoding = (Encoding)value;
				return encoding.HeaderName;
			}
			return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
		}
	}

	internal class SecurityAlgorithmSuiteConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			if (typeof(string) == sourceType)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
		}

		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (typeof(InstanceDescriptor) == destinationType)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			if (value is string)
			{
				string text = (string)value;
				SecurityAlgorithmSuite securityAlgorithmSuite = null;
				return text switch
				{
					"Default" => SecurityAlgorithmSuite.Default, 
					"Basic256" => SecurityAlgorithmSuite.Basic256, 
					"Basic192" => SecurityAlgorithmSuite.Basic192, 
					"Basic128" => SecurityAlgorithmSuite.Basic128, 
					"TripleDes" => SecurityAlgorithmSuite.TripleDes, 
					"Basic256Rsa15" => SecurityAlgorithmSuite.Basic256Rsa15, 
					"Basic192Rsa15" => SecurityAlgorithmSuite.Basic192Rsa15, 
					"Basic128Rsa15" => SecurityAlgorithmSuite.Basic128Rsa15, 
					"TripleDesRsa15" => SecurityAlgorithmSuite.TripleDesRsa15, 
					"Basic256Sha256" => SecurityAlgorithmSuite.Basic256Sha256, 
					"Basic192Sha256" => SecurityAlgorithmSuite.Basic192Sha256, 
					"Basic128Sha256" => SecurityAlgorithmSuite.Basic128Sha256, 
					"TripleDesSha256" => SecurityAlgorithmSuite.TripleDesSha256, 
					"Basic256Sha256Rsa15" => SecurityAlgorithmSuite.Basic256Sha256Rsa15, 
					"Basic192Sha256Rsa15" => SecurityAlgorithmSuite.Basic192Sha256Rsa15, 
					"Basic128Sha256Rsa15" => SecurityAlgorithmSuite.Basic128Sha256Rsa15, 
					"TripleDesSha256Rsa15" => SecurityAlgorithmSuite.TripleDesSha256Rsa15, 
					_ => throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("value", SR.GetString(Resources.ConfigInvalidClassFactoryValue, text, typeof(SecurityAlgorithmSuite).FullName)), null, EventLevel.Warning, "ConvertFrom", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Configuration\\SecurityAlgorithmSuiteConverter.cs", 92), 
				};
			}
			return base.ConvertFrom(context, culture, value);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (typeof(string) == destinationType && value is SecurityAlgorithmSuite)
			{
				string text = null;
				SecurityAlgorithmSuite securityAlgorithmSuite = (SecurityAlgorithmSuite)value;
				if (securityAlgorithmSuite == SecurityAlgorithmSuite.Default)
				{
					return "Default";
				}
				if (securityAlgorithmSuite == SecurityAlgorithmSuite.Basic256)
				{
					return "Basic256";
				}
				if (securityAlgorithmSuite == SecurityAlgorithmSuite.Basic192)
				{
					return "Basic192";
				}
				if (securityAlgorithmSuite == SecurityAlgorithmSuite.Basic128)
				{
					return "Basic128";
				}
				if (securityAlgorithmSuite == SecurityAlgorithmSuite.TripleDes)
				{
					return "TripleDes";
				}
				if (securityAlgorithmSuite == SecurityAlgorithmSuite.Basic256Rsa15)
				{
					return "Basic256Rsa15";
				}
				if (securityAlgorithmSuite == SecurityAlgorithmSuite.Basic192Rsa15)
				{
					return "Basic192Rsa15";
				}
				if (securityAlgorithmSuite == SecurityAlgorithmSuite.Basic128Rsa15)
				{
					return "Basic128Rsa15";
				}
				if (securityAlgorithmSuite == SecurityAlgorithmSuite.TripleDesRsa15)
				{
					return "TripleDesRsa15";
				}
				if (securityAlgorithmSuite == SecurityAlgorithmSuite.Basic256Sha256)
				{
					return "Basic256Sha256";
				}
				if (securityAlgorithmSuite == SecurityAlgorithmSuite.Basic192Sha256)
				{
					return "Basic192Sha256";
				}
				if (securityAlgorithmSuite == SecurityAlgorithmSuite.Basic128Sha256)
				{
					return "Basic128Sha256";
				}
				if (securityAlgorithmSuite == SecurityAlgorithmSuite.TripleDesSha256)
				{
					return "TripleDesSha256";
				}
				if (securityAlgorithmSuite == SecurityAlgorithmSuite.Basic256Sha256Rsa15)
				{
					return "Basic256Sha256Rsa15";
				}
				if (securityAlgorithmSuite == SecurityAlgorithmSuite.Basic192Sha256Rsa15)
				{
					return "Basic192Sha256Rsa15";
				}
				if (securityAlgorithmSuite == SecurityAlgorithmSuite.Basic128Sha256Rsa15)
				{
					return "Basic128Sha256Rsa15";
				}
				if (securityAlgorithmSuite == SecurityAlgorithmSuite.TripleDesSha256Rsa15)
				{
					return "TripleDesSha256Rsa15";
				}
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("value", SR.GetString(Resources.ConfigInvalidClassInstanceValue, typeof(SecurityAlgorithmSuite).FullName)), null, EventLevel.Warning, "ConvertTo", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Configuration\\SecurityAlgorithmSuiteConverter.cs", 142);
			}
			return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
		}

	public class TokenProviderElement : ClientCredentialsElement
	{
		private ConfigurationPropertyCollection properties;

		[ConfigurationProperty("name", IsRequired = false, IsKey = true)]
		[StringValidator(MinLength = 0, InvalidCharacters = " ")]
		public string Name
		{
			get
			{
				return (string)base["name"];
			}
			set
			{
				base["name"] = value;
			}
		}

		[ConfigurationProperty("sharedSecret")]
		public SharedSecretElement SharedSecret => (SharedSecretElement)base["sharedSecret"];

		[ConfigurationProperty("windowsAuthentication")]
		public WindowsElement WindowsAuthentication => (WindowsElement)base["windowsAuthentication"];

		[ConfigurationProperty("sharedAccessSignature")]
		public SharedAccessSignatureElement SharedAccessSignature => (SharedAccessSignatureElement)base["sharedAccessSignature"];

		internal bool IsValid
		{
			get
			{
				if (!SharedSecret.IsValid && !WindowsAuthentication.IsValid)
				{
					return SharedAccessSignature.IsValid;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected override ConfigurationPropertyCollection Properties
		{
			get
			{
				if (properties == null)
				{
					ConfigurationPropertyCollection configurationPropertyCollection = base.Properties;
					configurationPropertyCollection.Add(new ConfigurationProperty("name", typeof(string), null, null, new StringValidator(1, int.MaxValue, " "), ConfigurationPropertyOptions.IsKey));
					configurationPropertyCollection.Add(new ConfigurationProperty("sharedSecret", typeof(SharedSecretElement), null, null, null, ConfigurationPropertyOptions.None));
					configurationPropertyCollection.Add(new ConfigurationProperty("windowsAuthentication", typeof(WindowsElement), null, null, null, ConfigurationPropertyOptions.None));
					configurationPropertyCollection.Add(new ConfigurationProperty("sharedAccessSignature", typeof(SharedAccessSignatureElement), null, null, null, ConfigurationPropertyOptions.None));
					properties = configurationPropertyCollection;
				}
				return properties;
			}
		}

		internal TokenProviderElement()
		{
		}

		public override void CopyFrom(ServiceModelExtensionElement from)
		{
			TokenProviderElement tokenProviderElement = (TokenProviderElement)from;
			base.CopyFrom(from);
			SharedSecret.CopyFrom(tokenProviderElement.SharedSecret);
			WindowsAuthentication.CopyFrom(tokenProviderElement.WindowsAuthentication);
			SharedAccessSignature.CopyFrom(tokenProviderElement.SharedAccessSignature);
			Name = tokenProviderElement.Name;
		}

		internal TokenProvider CreateTokenProvider()
		{
			if (WindowsAuthentication != null && WindowsAuthentication.IsValid)
			{
				if (WindowsAuthentication.UseDefaultCredentials)
				{
					return TokenProvider.CreateWindowsTokenProvider(WindowsAuthentication.StsUris.Addresses);
				}
				return TokenProvider.CreateWindowsTokenProvider(WindowsAuthentication.StsUris.Addresses, new NetworkCredential(WindowsAuthentication.UserName, WindowsAuthentication.Password, WindowsAuthentication.Domain));
			}
			if (SharedAccessSignature != null && SharedAccessSignature.IsValid)
			{
				return TokenProvider.CreateSharedAccessSignatureTokenProvider(SharedAccessSignature.KeyName, SharedAccessSignature.Key, SharedAccessSignature.TokenScope);
			}
			return TokenProvider.CreateSharedSecretTokenProvider(SharedSecret.IssuerName, SharedSecret.IssuerSecret, SharedSecret.TokenScope);
		}
	}

	internal class ServiceModelEnumValidator : ConfigurationValidatorBase
	{
		private Type enumHelperType;

		private MethodInfo isDefined;

		public ServiceModelEnumValidator(Type enumHelperType)
		{
			this.enumHelperType = enumHelperType;
			isDefined = this.enumHelperType.GetMethod("IsDefined", BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
		}

		public override bool CanValidate(Type type)
		{
			return isDefined != null;
		}

		public override void Validate(object value)
		{
			if (!(bool)isDefined.Invoke(null, new object[1] { value }))
			{
				ParameterInfo[] parameters = isDefined.GetParameters();
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new InvalidEnumArgumentException("value", (int)value, parameters[0].ParameterType), null, EventLevel.Warning, "Validate", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Configuration\\ServiceModelEnumValidator.cs", 35);
			}
		}
	}

	{

		public WebHttpRelayBindingElement(string name)
			: base(name)
		{
		}

		public WebHttpRelayBindingElement()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		protected override void InitializeFrom(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Binding binding)
		{
			base.InitializeFrom(binding);
			WebHttpRelayBinding webHttpRelayBinding = (WebHttpRelayBinding)binding;
			MaxBufferSize = webHttpRelayBinding.MaxBufferSize;
			MaxBufferPoolSize = webHttpRelayBinding.MaxBufferPoolSize;
			MaxReceivedMessageSize = webHttpRelayBinding.MaxReceivedMessageSize;
			if (webHttpRelayBinding.ProxyAddress != null)
			{
				ProxyAddress = webHttpRelayBinding.ProxyAddress;
			}
			WriteEncoding = webHttpRelayBinding.WriteEncoding;
			TransferMode = webHttpRelayBinding.TransferMode;
			UseDefaultWebProxy = webHttpRelayBinding.UseDefaultWebProxy;
			AllowCookies = webHttpRelayBinding.AllowCookies;
			Security.InitializeFrom(webHttpRelayBinding.Security);
			InitializeReaderQuotas(webHttpRelayBinding.ReaderQuotas);
			IsDynamic = webHttpRelayBinding.IsDynamic;
		}

		internal void InitializeReaderQuotas(XmlDictionaryReaderQuotas readerQuotas)
		{
			if (readerQuotas == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("readerQuotas");
			}
			ReaderQuotas.MaxDepth = readerQuotas.MaxDepth;
			ReaderQuotas.MaxStringContentLength = readerQuotas.MaxStringContentLength;
			ReaderQuotas.MaxArrayLength = readerQuotas.MaxArrayLength;
			ReaderQuotas.MaxBytesPerRead = readerQuotas.MaxBytesPerRead;
			ReaderQuotas.MaxNameTableCharCount = readerQuotas.MaxNameTableCharCount;
		}

		protected override void OnApplyConfiguration(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Binding binding)
		{
			WebHttpRelayBinding webHttpRelayBinding = (WebHttpRelayBinding)binding;
			webHttpRelayBinding.MaxBufferPoolSize = MaxBufferPoolSize;
			webHttpRelayBinding.MaxReceivedMessageSize = MaxReceivedMessageSize;
			webHttpRelayBinding.WriteEncoding = WriteEncoding;
			webHttpRelayBinding.TransferMode = TransferMode;
			webHttpRelayBinding.UseDefaultWebProxy = UseDefaultWebProxy;
			webHttpRelayBinding.IsDynamic = IsDynamic;
			webHttpRelayBinding.AllowCookies = AllowCookies;
			if (ProxyAddress != null)
			{
				webHttpRelayBinding.ProxyAddress = ProxyAddress;
			}
			PropertyInformationCollection propertyInformationCollection = base.ElementInformation.Properties;
			if (propertyInformationCollection["maxBufferSize"].ValueOrigin != PropertyValueOrigin.Default)
			{
				webHttpRelayBinding.MaxBufferSize = MaxBufferSize;
			}
			Security.ApplyConfiguration(webHttpRelayBinding.Security);
			ApplyReaderQuotasConfiguration(webHttpRelayBinding.ReaderQuotas);
		}

		private void ApplyReaderQuotasConfiguration(XmlDictionaryReaderQuotas readerQuotas)
		{
			if (readerQuotas == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("readerQuotas");
			}
			if (ReaderQuotas.MaxDepth != 0)
			{
				readerQuotas.MaxDepth = ReaderQuotas.MaxDepth;
			}
			if (ReaderQuotas.MaxStringContentLength != 0)
			{
				readerQuotas.MaxStringContentLength = ReaderQuotas.MaxStringContentLength;
			}
			if (ReaderQuotas.MaxArrayLength != 0)
			{
				readerQuotas.MaxArrayLength = ReaderQuotas.MaxArrayLength;
			}
			if (ReaderQuotas.MaxBytesPerRead != 0)
			{
				readerQuotas.MaxBytesPerRead = ReaderQuotas.MaxBytesPerRead;
			}
			if (ReaderQuotas.MaxNameTableCharCount != 0)
			{
				readerQuotas.MaxNameTableCharCount = ReaderQuotas.MaxNameTableCharCount;
			}
		}
	}

					configurationPropertyCollection.Add(new ConfigurationProperty("maxStringContentLength", typeof(int), 0, null, new IntegerValidator(0, int.MaxValue, rangeIsExclusive: false), ConfigurationPropertyOptions.None));
					configurationPropertyCollection.Add(new ConfigurationProperty("maxArrayLength", typeof(int), 0, null, new IntegerValidator(0, int.MaxValue, rangeIsExclusive: false), ConfigurationPropertyOptions.None));
					configurationPropertyCollection.Add(new ConfigurationProperty("maxBytesPerRead", typeof(int), 0, null, new IntegerValidator(0, int.MaxValue, rangeIsExclusive: false), ConfigurationPropertyOptions.None));
					configurationPropertyCollection.Add(new ConfigurationProperty("maxNameTableCharCount", typeof(int), 0, null, new IntegerValidator(0, int.MaxValue, rangeIsExclusive: false), ConfigurationPropertyOptions.None));
					properties = configurationPropertyCollection;
				}
				return properties;
			}
		}

		internal void ApplyConfiguration(XmlDictionaryReaderQuotas readerQuotas)
		{
			if (readerQuotas == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("readerQuotas");
			}
			if (MaxDepth != 0)
			{
				readerQuotas.MaxDepth = MaxDepth;
			}
			if (MaxStringContentLength != 0)
			{
				readerQuotas.MaxStringContentLength = MaxStringContentLength;
			}
			if (MaxArrayLength != 0)
			{
				readerQuotas.MaxArrayLength = MaxArrayLength;
			}
			if (MaxBytesPerRead != 0)
			{
				readerQuotas.MaxBytesPerRead = MaxBytesPerRead;
			}
			if (MaxNameTableCharCount != 0)
			{
				readerQuotas.MaxNameTableCharCount = MaxNameTableCharCount;
			}
		}

		internal void InitializeFrom(XmlDictionaryReaderQuotas readerQuotas)
		{
			if (readerQuotas == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("readerQuotas");
			}
			MaxDepth = readerQuotas.MaxDepth;
			MaxStringContentLength = readerQuotas.MaxStringContentLength;
			MaxArrayLength = readerQuotas.MaxArrayLength;
			MaxBytesPerRead = readerQuotas.MaxBytesPerRead;
			MaxNameTableCharCount = readerQuotas.MaxNameTableCharCount;
		}
	}
	public class MessageSecurityOverRelayHttpElement : ConfigurationElement
	{
		[ConfigurationProperty("clientCredentialType", DefaultValue = MessageCredentialType.Windows)]
		[ServiceModelEnumValidator(typeof(MessageCredentialTypeHelper))]
		public MessageCredentialType ClientCredentialType
		{
			get
			{
				return (MessageCredentialType)base["clientCredentialType"];
			}
			set
			{
				base["clientCredentialType"] = value;
			}
		}

		[ConfigurationProperty("negotiateServiceCredential", DefaultValue = true)]
		public bool NegotiateServiceCredential
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)base["negotiateServiceCredential"];
			}
			set
			{
				base["negotiateServiceCredential"] = value;
			}
		}

		[ConfigurationProperty("algorithmSuite", DefaultValue = "Default")]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(SecurityAlgorithmSuiteConverter))]
		public SecurityAlgorithmSuite AlgorithmSuite
		{
			get
			{
				return (SecurityAlgorithmSuite)base["algorithmSuite"];
			}
			set
			{
				base["algorithmSuite"] = value;
			}
		}

		internal void ApplyConfiguration(MessageSecurityOverRelayHttp security)
		{
			if (security == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("security");
			}
			security.ClientCredentialType = ClientCredentialType;
			security.NegotiateServiceCredential = NegotiateServiceCredential;
			if (base.ElementInformation.Properties["algorithmSuite"].ValueOrigin != PropertyValueOrigin.Default)
			{
				security.AlgorithmSuite = AlgorithmSuite;
			}
		}

		internal void InitializeFrom(MessageSecurityOverRelayHttp security)
		{
			if (security == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("security");
			}
			ClientCredentialType = security.ClientCredentialType;
			NegotiateServiceCredential = security.NegotiateServiceCredential;
			if (security.WasAlgorithmSuiteSet)
			{
				AlgorithmSuite = security.AlgorithmSuite;
			}
		}

		internal MessageSecurityOverRelayHttpElement()
		{
		}
	}
	public sealed class NonDualMessageSecurityOverRelayHttpElement : MessageSecurityOverRelayHttpElement
	{
		private ConfigurationPropertyCollection properties;

		[ConfigurationProperty("establishSecurityContext", DefaultValue = true)]
		public bool EstablishSecurityContext
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)base["establishSecurityContext"];
			}
			set
			{
				base["establishSecurityContext"] = value;
			}
		}

		protected override ConfigurationPropertyCollection Properties
		{
			get
			{
				if (properties == null)
				{
					ConfigurationPropertyCollection configurationPropertyCollection = base.Properties;
					configurationPropertyCollection.Add(new ConfigurationProperty("establishSecurityContext", typeof(bool), true, null, null, ConfigurationPropertyOptions.None));
					properties = configurationPropertyCollection;
				}
				return properties;
			}
		}

		internal void ApplyConfiguration(NonDualMessageSecurityOverRelayHttp security)
		{
			ApplyConfiguration((MessageSecurityOverRelayHttp)security);
			security.EstablishSecurityContext = EstablishSecurityContext;
		}

		internal void InitializeFrom(NonDualMessageSecurityOverRelayHttp security)
		{
			InitializeFrom((MessageSecurityOverRelayHttp)security);
			EstablishSecurityContext = security.EstablishSecurityContext;
		}
	}

		private static readonly object staticSyncRoot = new object();

		private static readonly Dictionary<string, MessagingPerformanceCounters> performanceCounters = new Dictionary<string, MessagingPerformanceCounters>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

		private static CounterSet counterSet;

		private readonly string instanceName;

		private CounterSetInstance counterSetInstance;

		private CounterData[] counters;

		internal static bool DisableEntityLevelCounters { get; private set; }

		public override List<string> CounterNames
		{
			get
			{
				List<string> list = new List<string>();
				foreach (CounterMetadata value in PerfCounterDictionary.Values)
				{
					list.Add(value.Name);
				}
				return list;
			}
		}

		public override int CounterStart => 0;

		public override int CounterEnd => 69;

		public override string InstanceName => instanceName;

		protected override CounterSetInstance CounterSetInstance => counterSetInstance;

		protected internal override CounterData[] Counters => counters;

		private MessagingPerformanceCounters(string name)
		{
			if (name == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("name");
			}
			instanceName = name;
			base.Scope = new ClientPerformanceCounterScope(ClientPerformanceCounterLevel.All);
			Initialize(ClientPerformanceCounterLevel.All);
		}

		public static bool TryGetCounter(string name, out MessagingPerformanceCounters counter)
		{
			return performanceCounters.TryGetValue(name, out counter);
		}

		public static MessagingPerformanceCounters GetCounter(string name, bool isEntityLevelCounter = false)
		{
			if (isEntityLevelCounter && DisableEntityLevelCounters)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!performanceCounters.TryGetValue(name, out var value))
			{
				lock (staticSyncRoot)
				{
					if (!performanceCounters.TryGetValue(name, out value))
					{
						value = new MessagingPerformanceCounters(name);
						performanceCounters.Add(name, value);
					}
				}
			}
			return value;
		}

		protected override void OnInitialize()
		{
			if (MessagingPerformanceCounters.counterSet == null)
			{
				lock (staticSyncRoot)
				{
					if (MessagingPerformanceCounters.counterSet == null)
					{
						CounterSet counterSet = CreateCounterSet();
						foreach (KeyValuePair<MessagingPerfCounterKeys, CounterMetadata> item in PerfCounterDictionary)
						{
							counterSet.AddCounter(item.Value.Id, item.Value.Type, item.Value.Name);
						}
						MessagingPerformanceCounters.counterSet = counterSet;
					}
				}
			}
			counterSetInstance = CreateCounterSetInstance(InstanceName);
			counters = new CounterData[69];
			for (int i = 0; i < counters.Length; i++)
			{
				counters[i] = counterSetInstance.Counters[i];
				counters[i].Value = 0L;
			}
		}

		private static CounterSet CreateCounterSet()
		{
			return new CounterSet(ClientPerformanceCounterConstants.MessagingProviderId, ClientPerformanceCounterConstants.ClientProviderId, CounterSetInstanceType.Multiple);
		}

		private static CounterSetInstance CreateCounterSetInstance(string name)
		{
			return counterSet.CreateCounterSetInstance(name);
		}

		public static void SetCollectEntityLevelCounters(bool disable)
		{
			DisableEntityLevelCounters = disable;
		}

		public static void IncrementSendMessageSuccessPerSec(Uri namespaceEndpoint, Uri entityEndpoint, int count)
		{
			MessagingPerformanceCounters counter = GetCounter(namespaceEndpoint.Host);
			if (counter.Initialized)
			{
				counter.counters[0].IncrementBy(count);
				counter.counters[1].IncrementBy(count);
			}
			if (!DisableEntityLevelCounters && !(entityEndpoint == null))
			{
				string entityPerfCounterName = entityEndpoint.GetEntityPerfCounterName();
				MessagingPerformanceCounters counter2 = GetCounter(entityPerfCounterName, isEntityLevelCounter: true);
				if (counter2 != null && counter2.Initialized)
				{
					counter2.counters[46].IncrementBy(count);
					counter2.counters[47].IncrementBy(count);
				}
			}
		}

		public static void IncrementConnectionResetCount(Uri endpoint, int count)
		{
			MessagingPerformanceCounters counter = GetCounter(endpoint.Host);
			if (counter.Initialized)
			{
				counter.counters[60].IncrementBy(count);
			}
			if (!DisableEntityLevelCounters)
			{
				string entityPerfCounterName = endpoint.GetEntityPerfCounterName();
				MessagingPerformanceCounters counter2 = GetCounter(entityPerfCounterName, isEntityLevelCounter: true);
				if (counter2 != null && counter2.Initialized)
				{
					counter2.counters[59].IncrementBy(count);
				}
			}
		}

		public static void IncrementSendMessageFailurePerSec(Uri namespaceEndpoint, Uri entityEndpoint, int count)
		{
			MessagingPerformanceCounters counter = GetCounter(namespaceEndpoint.Host);
			if (counter.Initialized)
			{
				counter.counters[2].IncrementBy(count);
				counter.counters[3].IncrementBy(count);
			}
			if (!DisableEntityLevelCounters && !(entityEndpoint == null))
			{
				string entityPerfCounterName = entityEndpoint.GetEntityPerfCounterName();
				MessagingPerformanceCounters counter2 = GetCounter(entityPerfCounterName, isEntityLevelCounter: true);
				if (counter2 != null && counter2.Initialized)
				{
					counter2.counters[48].IncrementBy(count);
					counter2.counters[49].IncrementBy(count);
				}
			}
		}

		public static void IncrementSendMessageLatency(Uri namespaceEndpoint, Uri entityEndpoint, long ticks)
		{
			MessagingPerformanceCounters counter = GetCounter(namespaceEndpoint.Host);
			if (counter.Initialized)
			{
				counter.counters[5].IncrementBy(ticks);
				counter.counters[4].Increment();
			}
			if (!DisableEntityLevelCounters && !(entityEndpoint == null))
			{

	internal enum ClientPerformanceCounterDetail
	{
		Minimal = 0,
		Verbose = 1,
		Default = 1
	}
	internal enum ClientPerformanceCounterLevel
	{
		Off = 0,
		Endpoint = 1,
		All = 3,
		Default = 1
	}
	internal sealed class ClientPerformanceCounterScope
	{
		public ClientPerformanceCounterLevel Level { get; internal set; }

		public ClientPerformanceCounterDetail Detail { get; internal set; }

		public ClientPerformanceCounterScope()
			: this(ClientPerformanceCounterLevel.Endpoint)
		{
		}

		public ClientPerformanceCounterScope(ClientPerformanceCounterLevel level)
			: this(level, ClientPerformanceCounterDetail.Verbose)
		{
		}

		public ClientPerformanceCounterScope(ClientPerformanceCounterLevel level, ClientPerformanceCounterDetail detail)
		{
			Level = level;
			Detail = detail;
		}

		public static bool IsValid(ClientPerformanceCounterLevel level, ClientPerformanceCounterDetail detail)
		{
			bool flag = Enum.IsDefined(typeof(ClientPerformanceCounterLevel), level);
			bool flag2 = Enum.IsDefined(typeof(ClientPerformanceCounterDetail), detail);
			return flag && flag2;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class PerformanceCounter
	{
		public ClientPerformanceCounterScope Scope { get; protected set; }

		public abstract List<string> CounterNames { get; }

		public abstract int CounterStart { get; }

		public abstract int CounterEnd { get; }

		public abstract string InstanceName { get; }

		public bool Initialized { get; private set; }

		protected abstract CounterSetInstance CounterSetInstance { get; }

		protected internal abstract CounterData[] Counters { get; }

		internal static void ThrowInvalidOperationException()
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException("Performance counter is already initialized.");
		}

		protected void Initialize(ClientPerformanceCounterLevel compareLevel)
		{
			try
			{
				if (Scope.Level == compareLevel || Scope.Level == ClientPerformanceCounterLevel.All)
				{
					OnInitialize();
					Initialized = CounterSetInstance != null && Counters != null;
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWritePerformanceCounterInstanceCreated(InstanceName);
					});
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				Exception ex2 = ex;
				Exception e = ex2;
				if (!IsCounterSetException(e))
				{
					throw;
				}
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWritePerformanceCounterCreationFailed(e.ToString());
				});
			}
		}

		protected abstract void OnInitialize();

		protected virtual bool IsMinimalCountersEnabled()
		{
			return Initialized;
		}

		protected virtual bool IsVerboseCountersEnabled()
		{
			if (Scope.Detail == ClientPerformanceCounterDetail.Verbose)
			{
				return Initialized;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool IsCounterSetException(Exception e)
		{
			Type type = e.GetType();
			if (type == typeof(ArgumentException) || type == typeof(InsufficientMemoryException) || type == typeof(Win32Exception) || type == typeof(PlatformNotSupportedException))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public Hashtable CollectCurrentValueSet()
		{
			if (!Initialized)
			{
				throw new ObjectDisposedException(GetType().Name);
			}
			CounterSetInstanceCounterDataSet counters = CounterSetInstance.Counters;
			Hashtable hashtable = new Hashtable();
			foreach (string counterName in CounterNames)
			{
				hashtable.Add(counterName, counters[counterName].RawValue);
			}
			return hashtable;
		}
	}

	[DataContract(Name = "HybridConnectionDescription", Namespace = "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2010/10/servicebus/connect")]
	internal class HybridConnectionDescription : EntityDescription, IResourceDescription
	{
		internal static readonly DataContractSerializer Serializer = new DataContractSerializer(typeof(HybridConnectionDescription));

		public string Path
		{
			get
			{
				return InternalPath;
			}
			set
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("Path");
				}
				InternalPath = value;
			}
		}

		public DateTime CreatedAt
		{
			get
			{
				return InternalCreatedAt ?? DateTime.MinValue;
			}
			internal set
			{
				InternalCreatedAt = value;
			}
		}

		public DateTime UpdatedAt
		{
			get
			{
				return InternalUpdatedAt ?? DateTime.MinValue;
			}
			internal set
			{
				InternalUpdatedAt = value;
			}
		}

		public int ListenerCount
		{
			get
			{
				return InternalListenerCount.GetValueOrDefault();
			}
			internal set
			{
				InternalListenerCount = value;
			}
		}

		public bool RequiresClientAuthorization
		{
			get
			{
				return InternalRequiresClientAuthorization ?? true;
			}
			set
			{
				InternalRequiresClientAuthorization = value;
			}
		}

		public AuthorizationRules Authorization
		{
			get
			{
				if (InternalAuthorization == null)
				{
					InternalAuthorization = new AuthorizationRules();
				}
				return InternalAuthorization;
			}
		}

		public string UserMetadata
		{
			get
			{
				return InternalUserMetadata;
			}
			set
			{
				ThrowIfReadOnly();
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
				{
					InternalUserMetadata = null;
					return;
				}
				if (value.Length > 1024)
				{

			MemberInfo[] members = dataContract.GetType().GetMembers(BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.FlattenHierarchy);

			foreach (MemberInfo memberInfo in array)

				if (customAttributes == null || customAttributes.Length == 0)
				{
					continue;
				}
				object[] customAttributes2 = memberInfo.GetCustomAttributes(typeof(ManageClaimNotRequiredAttribute), inherit: true);
				if (customAttributes2 == null || customAttributes2.Length == 0)
				{
					PropertyInfo propertyInfo;
					if ((propertyInfo = memberInfo as PropertyInfo) != null)
					{
						propertyInfo.GetSetMethod(nonPublic: true).Invoke(dataContract, new object[1]);
						continue;
					}
					FieldInfo fieldInfo = (FieldInfo)memberInfo;
					fieldInfo.SetValue(dataContract, null);
				}
			}
		}

	internal class TokenRenewer
	{
		private static readonly TimeSpan GetTokenTimeout = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1.0);

		private readonly Timer renewTimer;

		private readonly TokenProvider tokenProvider;

		private readonly string action;

		private readonly string appliesTo;

		private readonly ITraceSource traceSource;

		private object ThisLock => renewTimer;

		public event EventHandler<TokenEventArgs> TokenRenewed;

		public event EventHandler<TokenEventArgs> TokenRenewException;

		public TokenRenewer(TokenProvider tokenProvider, string appliesTo, string action, ITraceSource traceSource)
		{
			this.tokenProvider = tokenProvider;
			this.appliesTo = appliesTo;
			this.action = action;
			this.traceSource = traceSource;
			renewTimer = new Timer(delegate(object s)
			{
				OnRenewTimer(s);
			}, this, -1, -1);
		}

		public async Task<SecurityToken> GetTokenAsync(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			try
			{
				ServiceBusEventSource.Log.Info(traceSource, "Listener: GetToken starting", "GetTokenAsync", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Relay\\TokenRenewer.cs", 54);
				SecurityToken securityToken = await tokenProvider.GetTokenAsync(appliesTo, action, bypassCache: false, timeout).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				ServiceBusEventSource.Log.Info(traceSource, $"Listener: GetToken complete. New token expires at {securityToken.ValidTo}.", "GetTokenAsync", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Relay\\TokenRenewer.cs", 56);
				OnTokenRenewed(securityToken);
				return securityToken;
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (!Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					OnTokenRenewException(exception);
				}
				throw;
			}
		}

		public void Close()
		{
			renewTimer.Change(-1, -1);
		}

		private static async void OnRenewTimer(object state)
		{
			TokenRenewer thisPtr = (TokenRenewer)state;
			try
			{
				await thisPtr.GetTokenAsync(GetTokenTimeout).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				ServiceBusEventSource.Log.HandledException(exception, thisPtr.traceSource, EventLevel.Warning, "OnRenewTimer", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Relay\\TokenRenewer.cs", 90);
			}
		}

		private void ScheduleRenewTimer(SecurityToken token)
		{
			TimeSpan timeSpan = token.ValidTo.Subtract(DateTime.UtcNow);
			if (timeSpan < TimeSpan.Zero)
			{
				ServiceBusEventSource log = ServiceBusEventSource.Log;
				ITraceSource obj = traceSource;
				TimeSpan timeSpan2 = timeSpan;
				log.Warning(obj, "Listener: Not renewing Token since " + timeSpan2.ToString() + " < TimeSpan.Zero!", "ScheduleRenewTimer", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Relay\\TokenRenewer.cs", 99);
			}
			else
			{
				timeSpan = TimeoutHelper.Max(timeSpan, AmqpClientConstants.ClientMinimumTokenRefreshInterval);
				timeSpan = TimeoutHelper.Min(timeSpan, TimeoutHelper.MaxWait);
				ServiceBusEventSource.Log.Info(traceSource, "Listener: Scheduling Token renewal after " + timeSpan.ToString() + ".", "ScheduleRenewTimer", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Relay\\TokenRenewer.cs", 107);
				renewTimer.Change(timeSpan, Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan);
			}
		}

		private void OnTokenRenewed(SecurityToken token)
		{
			this.TokenRenewed?.Invoke(this, new TokenEventArgs
			{
				Token = token
			});
			ScheduleRenewTimer(token);
		}

		private void OnTokenRenewException(Exception exception)
		{
			this.TokenRenewException?.Invoke(this, new TokenEventArgs
			{
				Exception = exception
			});
		}
	}

	internal sealed class LargeMessageStream : Stream
	{
		private const int InitialIndividualBufferSize = 262144;

		private const int MaxIndividualBufferSize = 1048576;

		private readonly List<ByteBuffer> buffers;

		private readonly TrackingContext instanceTrackingContext;

		private readonly object syncRoot;

		private int readBufferId;

		private int writeBufferId;

		private bool writeCompleted;

		private bool disposed;

		private StreamReadTask waitingReadTask;

		private Stopwatch writeLatency;

		private Stopwatch readLatency;

		public override bool CanRead => true;

		public override bool CanSeek => false;

		public override bool CanWrite => true;

		public int TotalWrittenLengthInBytes { get; private set; }

		public string TrackingId => instanceTrackingContext.TrackingId;

		public override long Length
		{
			get
			{
				lock (syncRoot)
				{
					int num = 0;
					foreach (ByteBuffer buffer in buffers)
					{
						num += buffer.Length;
					}
					return num;
				}
			}
		}

		public override long Position
		{
			get
			{
				throw new NotImplementedException();
			}
			set
			{
				throw new NotImplementedException();
			}
		}

		public LargeMessageStream()
		{
			instanceTrackingContext = TrackingContext.Create();
			buffers = new List<ByteBuffer>();
			syncRoot = new object();
			writeBufferId = -1;
			AllocateNewBuffer();
			readBufferId = 0;
		}

		public void Commit()
		{
			lock (syncRoot)
			{
				if (!writeCompleted)
				{
					writeCompleted = true;
					writeLatency.Stop();
					IOThreadScheduler.ScheduleCallbackNoFlow(NotifyReader, this);
				}
			}
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteLargeMessageStreamInfo(TrackingId, $"Write Completed, TotalWrittenLengthInBytes: {TotalWrittenLengthInBytes}, LatencyInMilliSeconds: {writeLatency.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds}");
		}

		public override void Write(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)
		{
			if (buffer == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("buffer");
			}
			if (offset < 0 || count < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException($"Offset: {offset}, Count: {count}");
			}
			if (offset + count > buffer.Length)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException($"Offset: {offset}, Count: {count}, BufferLength: {buffer.Length}");
			}
			if (disposed)
			{
				throw new ObjectDisposedException("LargeMessageStream");
			}
			if (writeLatency == null)
			{
				writeLatency = Stopwatch.StartNew();
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteLargeMessageStreamInfo(TrackingId, "Write Started");
			}
			lock (syncRoot)
			{
				ByteBuffer bufferToWrite = GetBufferToWrite();
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteBytes(bufferToWrite, buffer, offset, count);
				TotalWrittenLengthInBytes += count;
			}
			if (count > 0)
			{
				IOThreadScheduler.ScheduleCallbackNoFlow(NotifyReader, this);
			}
		}

		public override int Read(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)
		{
			return ReadAsync(buffer, offset, count, CancellationToken.None).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		public override Task<int> ReadAsync(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			lock (syncRoot)
			{
				int num = ReadStreamInternal(buffer, offset, count);
				if (num > 0 || writeCompleted)
				{
					return Task.FromResult(num);
				}
				waitingReadTask = new StreamReadTask(buffer, offset, count, cancellationToken);
				return waitingReadTask.Task;
			}
		}

		public override void Flush()
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		public override void SetLength(long value)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		public override long Seek(long offset, SeekOrigin origin)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			lock (syncRoot)
			{
				if (!disposed)
				{
					disposed = true;
					waitingReadTask?.SetException(new ObjectDisposedException("LargeMessageStream"));
					base.Dispose(disposing);
				}
			}
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteLargeMessageStreamInfo(TrackingId, "Stream Disposed");
		}

		private static void NotifyReader(object state)
		{
			LargeMessageStream largeMessageStream = (LargeMessageStream)state;
			lock (largeMessageStream.syncRoot)
			{
				try
				{
					if (largeMessageStream.disposed)
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteLargeMessageStreamInfo(largeMessageStream.TrackingId, "Returning From Notify Reader: Stream was already disposed");
					}
					else
					{
						if (largeMessageStream.waitingReadTask == null)
						{
							return;
						}
						if (largeMessageStream.waitingReadTask.Task.IsCompleted)
						{
							MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteLargeMessageStreamInfo(largeMessageStream.TrackingId, $"Returning From Notify Reader: ReadTask IsCompleted Status: {largeMessageStream.waitingReadTask.Task.IsCompleted}");
							return;
						}
						int num = largeMessageStream.ReadStreamInternal(largeMessageStream.waitingReadTask.Buffer, largeMessageStream.waitingReadTask.Offset, largeMessageStream.waitingReadTask.Count);
						if (num > 0 || largeMessageStream.writeCompleted)
						{
							largeMessageStream.waitingReadTask.SetResult(num);
							largeMessageStream.waitingReadTask = null;
						}
					}
				}
				catch (Exception exception)
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteLargeMessageStreamError(largeMessageStream.TrackingId, "Exception while reading stream: " + exception.ToStringSlim());
					if (!largeMessageStream.waitingReadTask.Task.IsCompleted)
					{
						largeMessageStream.waitingReadTask.SetException(exception);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private int ReadStreamInternal(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)
		{
			if (buffer == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("buffer");
			}
			if (offset < 0 || count < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException($"Offset or Count is less than 0, unexpected: Offset: {offset}, Count: {count}");
			}
			if (offset + count > buffer.Length)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException($"Offset + Count is greater than buffer length, unexpected: Offset: {offset}, Count: {count}, BufferLength: {buffer.Length}");
			}
			if (disposed)
			{
				throw new ObjectDisposedException("LargeMessageStream");
			}
			if (readLatency == null)
			{
				readLatency = Stopwatch.StartNew();
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteLargeMessageStreamInfo(TrackingId, "Read Started");
			}
			int num = 0;
			do
			{
				if (buffers[readBufferId].Length == 0 && readBufferId == writeBufferId)
				{
					if (num == 0 && writeCompleted)
					{
						buffers[readBufferId].Dispose();
						readLatency.Stop();
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteLargeMessageStreamInfo(TrackingId, $"Read Completed, LatencyInMilliSeconds: {readLatency.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds}");
					}
					return num;
				}
				int num2 = Math.Min(buffers[readBufferId].Length, count - num);
				AmqpBitConverter.ReadBytes(buffers[readBufferId], buffer, offset + num, num2);
				num += num2;
				if (buffers[readBufferId].Length == 0 && readBufferId < writeBufferId)
				{
					buffers[readBufferId].Dispose();
					readBufferId++;
				}
			}
			while (num < count);
			return num;
		}

		private ByteBuffer GetBufferToWrite()
		{
			ByteBuffer result = buffers[writeBufferId];
			if (buffers[writeBufferId].WritePos >= 1048576)
			{
				result = AllocateNewBuffer();
			}
			return result;
		}

		private ByteBuffer AllocateNewBuffer()
		{
			buffers.Add(new ByteBuffer(262144, autoGrow: true));
			writeBufferId++;
			return buffers[writeBufferId];
		}
	}

		{
			base.IsTransient = false;
		}

			: base(detail, trackingContext, innerException)
		{
			base.IsTransient = false;
		}

		private SenderDisconnectedException(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			: base(info, context)
		{
			base.IsTransient = false;
		}

	[DataContract(Name = "Destination", Namespace = "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2010/10/servicebus/connect")]
	internal class ArchiveDestination
	{
		internal const string EventHubArchivePrefix = "EventHubArchive.";

		internal const string ArchiveProviderAzureBlockBlob = "EventHubArchive.AzureBlockBlob";

		internal const string ArchiveProviderAzureDataLakeStore = "EventHubArchive.AzureDataLake";

		internal const string ConnectionStringName = "ConnectionString";

		internal const string StorageAccountResourceId = "StorageAccountResourceId";

		internal const string BlobContainerName = "BlobContainer";

		internal const string ArchiveNameFormat = "ArchiveNameFormat";

		internal const string Namespace = "{Namespace}";

		internal const string EventHub = "{EventHub}";

		internal const string PartitionId = "{PartitionId}";

		internal const string Year = "{Year}";

		internal const string Month = "{Month}";

		internal const string Day = "{Day}";

		internal const string Hour = "{Hour}";

		internal const string Minute = "{Minute}";

		internal const string Second = "{Second}";

		internal const string DefaultArchiveNameFormat = "{Namespace}/{EventHub}/{PartitionId}/{Year}/{Month}/{Day}/{Hour}/{Minute}/{Second}";

		internal const int ArchiveNameCustomPartMaxLengthForBlob = 512;

		internal const string DataLakeSubscriptionId = "DataLakeSubscriptionId";

		internal const string DataLakeResourceId = "DataLakeResourceId";

		internal const string DataLakeAccountName = "DataLakeAccountName";

		internal const string DataLakeFolderPath = "DataLakeFolderPath";

		internal const int DataLakeMaxFolderPathDepth = 10;

		internal const int DataLakeMaxFolderPathSize = 512;

		[DataMember(Name = "Name", IsRequired = true, Order = 1000, EmitDefaultValue = true)]
		internal string Name { get; set; }

		[DataMember(Name = "Properties", IsRequired = false, Order = 1001, EmitDefaultValue = false)]
		internal PropertyDictionary Properties { get; set; }

		internal virtual bool ContainsSecrets => Properties.ContainsKey("ConnectionString");

		internal string ShortName
		{
			get
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(Name))
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				int num = Name.IndexOf("EventHubArchive.", StringComparison.InvariantCulture);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					return Name.Substring(num + "EventHubArchive.".Length);
				}
				return Name;
			}
		}

		internal ArchiveDestination()
		{
		}

		[OnDeserialized]
		private void OnDeserialized(StreamingContext c)
		{
			if (Properties != null && !Properties.ContainsKey("ArchiveNameFormat"))
			{
				Properties.Add("ArchiveNameFormat", "{Namespace}/{EventHub}/{PartitionId}/{Year}/{Month}/{Day}/{Hour}/{Minute}/{Second}");
			}
		}

		public static ArchiveDestination CreateBlockBlobDestination(string storageAccountResourceId, string blobContainer, string nameFormat = "{Namespace}/{EventHub}/{PartitionId}/{Year}/{Month}/{Day}/{Hour}/{Minute}/{Second}")

		public static ArchiveDestination CreateDataLakeDestination(string dataLakeSubscriptionId, string dataLakeAccountName, string dataLakeFolderPath, string nameFormat = "{Namespace}/{EventHub}/{PartitionId}/{Year}/{Month}/{Day}/{Hour}/{Minute}/{Second}")
