		internal bool TryGetProperty<T>(string name, out T value)
		{
			if (Properties.TryGetValue(name, out var value2) && typeof(T).IsAssignableFrom(value2.GetType()))
			{
				value = (T)value2;
				return true;
			}
			value = default(T);
			return false;
		}

		internal void Validate()
		{
			if (Properties == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("Destination.Properties");
			}
			if (Properties.ContainsKey("ArchiveNameFormat"))
			{
				string pattern = "(?=.*{Namespace})(?=.*{EventHub})(?=.*{PartitionId})(?=.*{Year})(?=.*{Month})(?=.*{Day})(?=.*{Hour})(?=.*{Minute})(?=.*{Second}).+";
				string input = (string)Properties["ArchiveNameFormat"];
				if (!Regex.Match(input, pattern, RegexOptions.IgnoreCase).Success)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.InvalidArchiveNameFormat("ArchiveNameFormat"));
				}
				string text = Regex.Replace(input, "({Namespace}|{EventHub}|{PartitionId}|{Year}|{Month}|{Day}|{Hour}|{Minute}|{Second})", string.Empty, RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);
				if (text.Length > 512)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.ArchiveNameCustomPartLength(512));
				}
			}
			switch (Name)
			{
			case "EventHubArchive.AzureBlockBlob":
				ValidateBlockBlobDestination();
				break;
			case "EventHubArchive.AzureDataLake":
				ValidateDataLakeDestination();
				break;
			default:
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.InvalidArchiveDestinationChoice(Name, "Destination.Name", "EventHubArchive.AzureBlockBlob or EventHubArchive.AzureDataLake"));
			}
		}

		internal void ValidateBlockBlobDestination()
		{
			if (!Properties.ContainsKey("ConnectionString") && !Properties.ContainsKey("StorageAccountResourceId"))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.InvalidArchiveDestination("StorageAccountResourceId or ConnectionString"));
			}
			if (!Properties.ContainsKey("BlobContainer"))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.ArchiveNullOrEmptyInput("BlobContainer"));
			}
			string text = Properties["BlobContainer"] as string;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.ArchiveNullOrEmptyInput("BlobContainer"));
			}
			if (text.StartsWith("\"") || text.EndsWith("\"") || text.StartsWith("'") || text.EndsWith("'"))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.ArchiveInputHasQuotes("BlobContainer"));
			}
			if (Properties.ContainsKey("StorageAccountResourceId"))
			{
				string text2 = Properties["StorageAccountResourceId"] as string;
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.ArchiveNullOrEmptyInput("StorageAccountResourceId"));
				}
				if (text2.StartsWith("\"") || text2.EndsWith("\"") || text2.StartsWith("'") || text2.EndsWith("'"))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.ArchiveInputHasQuotes("StorageAccountResourceId"));
				}
				string[] array = text2.Split('/');
				if (array.Length != 9 || !array[1].Equals("subscriptions", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase) || !Guid.TryParse(array[2], out var _) || !array[3].Equals("resourceGroups", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase) || !array[5].Equals("providers", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase) || (!array[6].Equals("Microsoft.Storage", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase) && !array[6].Equals("Microsoft.ClassicStorage", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase)) || !array[7].Equals("storageAccounts", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException("StorageAccountResourceId");
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ValidateDataLakeDestination()
		{
			if (!Properties.ContainsKey("DataLakeResourceId"))
			{
				if (!Properties.ContainsKey("DataLakeSubscriptionId"))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.ArchiveNullOrEmptyInput("DataLakeSubscriptionId"));
				}
				if (!Properties.ContainsKey("DataLakeAccountName"))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.ArchiveNullOrEmptyInput("DataLakeAccountName"));
				}
			}
			if (!Properties.ContainsKey("DataLakeFolderPath"))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.ArchiveNullOrEmptyInput("DataLakeFolderPath"));
			}
			string text = Properties["DataLakeFolderPath"] as string;
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.ArchiveNullOrEmptyInput("DataLakeFolderPath"));
			}
			int num = text.IndexOfAny(Path.GetInvalidPathChars());
			if (num != -1)
			{
				char c = text[num];
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.ArchivePathIsInvalid($"Invalid character: '{c}' at position {num}"));
			}
			text = text.Replace("\\", "/");
			if (text.Count((char ch) => ch == '/') > 10)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.ArchivePathIsInvalid($"Folder depth is more than {10}"));
			}
			if (text.Length > 512)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.ArchivePathIsInvalid($"Path size is more than {512}"));
			}
		}

		internal static string GetArchiveName(string ns, string entity, string shardId, DateTime time, string ext, string archiveNameFormat)
		{
			IDictionary<string, string> nameReplacements = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
			{
				{ "{Namespace}", ns },
				{ "{EventHub}", entity },
				{ "{PartitionId}", shardId },
				{
					"{Year}",
					time.Year.ToString("d4")
				},
				{
					"{Month}",
					time.Month.ToString("d2")
				},
				{
					"{Day}",
					time.Day.ToString("d2")
				},
				{
					"{Hour}",
					time.Hour.ToString("d2")
				},
				{
					"{Minute}",
					time.Minute.ToString("d2")
				},
				{
					"{Second}",
					time.Second.ToString("d2")
				}
			};
			return Regex.Replace(archiveNameFormat, "(" + string.Join("|", nameReplacements.Keys.ToArray()) + ")", (Match m) => nameReplacements[m.Value], RegexOptions.IgnoreCase) + "." + ext;
		}
	}

	internal abstract class RealProxy
	{
		private class PackedArgs
		{
			internal const int RealProxyPosition = 0;

			internal const int DeclaringTypePosition = 1;

			internal const int MethodTokenPosition = 2;

			internal const int ArgsPosition = 3;

			internal const int GenericTypesPosition = 4;

			internal const int ReturnValuePosition = 5;

			internal static readonly Type[] PackedTypes = new Type[6]
			{
				typeof(object),
				typeof(Type),
				typeof(int),
				typeof(object[]),
				typeof(Type[]),
				typeof(object)
			};

			private object[] args;

			internal RealProxy RealProxy => (RealProxy)args[0];

			internal Type DeclaringType => (Type)args[1];

			internal int MethodToken => (int)args[2];

			internal object[] Args => (object[])args[3];

			internal Type[] GenericTypes => (Type[])args[4];

			internal object ReturnValue
			{
				set
				{
					args[5] = value;
				}
			}

			internal PackedArgs()
				: this(new object[PackedTypes.Length])
			{
			}

			internal PackedArgs(object[] args)
			{
				this.args = args;
			}
		}

		private class ProxyAssembly
		{
			private AssemblyBuilder ab;

			private ModuleBuilder mb;

			private int typeId;

			private Dictionary<Type, Dictionary<int, MethodBase>> methodLookup;

			public ProxyAssembly(string name)
			{
				AssemblyName assemblyName = new AssemblyName(name);
				assemblyName.SetPublicKey(GetType().Assembly.GetName().GetPublicKey());
				ab = AppDomain.CurrentDomain.DefineDynamicAssembly(assemblyName, AssemblyBuilderAccess.Run);
				mb = ab.DefineDynamicModule("testmod", emitSymbolInfo: false);
			}

			public ProxyBuilder CreateProxy(string name, Type proxyBaseType)
			{
				int num = Interlocked.Increment(ref typeId);
				TypeBuilder tb = mb.DefineType(name + "_" + num, TypeAttributes.Public, proxyBaseType);
				return new ProxyBuilder(this, tb, proxyBaseType);
			}

			internal void GetTokenForMethod(MethodBase method, out Type type, out int token)
			{
				type = method.DeclaringType;
				token = method.MetadataToken;
				if (methodLookup == null)
				{
					methodLookup = new Dictionary<Type, Dictionary<int, MethodBase>>();
				}
				if (!methodLookup.TryGetValue(type, out var value))
				{
					value = new Dictionary<int, MethodBase>();
					methodLookup[type] = value;
				}
				value[token] = method;
			}

			internal MethodBase ResolveMethodToken(Type type, int token)
			{
				return methodLookup[type][token];
			}
		}

		private class ProxyBuilder
		{
			private class ParametersArray
			{
				private ILGenerator il;

				private Type[] paramTypes;

				internal ParametersArray(ILGenerator il, Type[] paramTypes)
				{
					this.il = il;
					this.paramTypes = paramTypes;
				}

				internal void Get(int i)
				{
					il.Emit(OpCodes.Ldarg, i + 1);
				}

				internal void BeginSet(int i)
				{
					il.Emit(OpCodes.Ldarg, i + 1);
				}

				internal void EndSet(int i, Type stackType)
				{
					Type elementType = paramTypes[i].GetElementType();
					Convert(il, stackType, elementType, isAddress: false);
					Stind(il, elementType);
				}
			}

			private class GenericArray<T>
			{
				private ILGenerator il;

				private LocalBuilder lb;

				internal GenericArray(ILGenerator il, int len)
				{
					this.il = il;
					lb = il.DeclareLocal(typeof(T[]));
					il.Emit(OpCodes.Ldc_I4, len);
					il.Emit(OpCodes.Newarr, typeof(T));
					il.Emit(OpCodes.Stloc, lb);
				}

				internal void Load()
				{
					il.Emit(OpCodes.Ldloc, lb);
				}

				internal void Get(int i)
				{
					il.Emit(OpCodes.Ldloc, lb);
					il.Emit(OpCodes.Ldc_I4, i);
					il.Emit(OpCodes.Ldelem_Ref);
				}

				internal void BeginSet(int i)
				{
					il.Emit(OpCodes.Ldloc, lb);
					il.Emit(OpCodes.Ldc_I4, i);
				}

				internal void EndSet(Type stackType)
				{
					Convert(il, stackType, typeof(T), isAddress: false);
					il.Emit(OpCodes.Stelem_Ref);
				}
			}

			private static readonly MethodInfo delegateInvoke = typeof(Action<object[]>).GetMethod("Invoke");

			private ProxyAssembly assembly;

			private TypeBuilder tb;

			private Type proxyBaseType;

			private List<FieldBuilder> fields;

			private static OpCode[] ConvOpCodes = new OpCode[19]
			{
				OpCodes.Nop,
				OpCodes.Nop,
				OpCodes.Nop,
				OpCodes.Conv_I1,
				OpCodes.Conv_I2,
				OpCodes.Conv_I1,
				OpCodes.Conv_U1,
				OpCodes.Conv_I2,
				OpCodes.Conv_U2,
				OpCodes.Conv_I4,
				OpCodes.Conv_U4,
				OpCodes.Conv_I8,
				OpCodes.Conv_U8,
				OpCodes.Conv_R4,
				OpCodes.Conv_R8,
				OpCodes.Nop,
				OpCodes.Nop,
				OpCodes.Nop,
				OpCodes.Nop
			};

			private static OpCode[] LdindOpCodes = new OpCode[19]
			{
				OpCodes.Nop,
				OpCodes.Nop,
				OpCodes.Nop,
				OpCodes.Ldind_I1,
				OpCodes.Ldind_I2,
				OpCodes.Ldind_I1,
				OpCodes.Ldind_U1,
				OpCodes.Ldind_I2,
				OpCodes.Ldind_U2,
				OpCodes.Ldind_I4,
				OpCodes.Ldind_U4,
				OpCodes.Ldind_I8,
				OpCodes.Ldind_I8,
				OpCodes.Ldind_R4,
				OpCodes.Ldind_R8,
				OpCodes.Nop,
				OpCodes.Nop,
				OpCodes.Nop,
				OpCodes.Ldind_Ref
			};

			private static OpCode[] StindOpCodes = new OpCode[19]
			{
				OpCodes.Nop,
				OpCodes.Nop,
				OpCodes.Nop,
				OpCodes.Stind_I1,
				OpCodes.Stind_I2,
				OpCodes.Stind_I1,
				OpCodes.Stind_I1,
				OpCodes.Stind_I2,
				OpCodes.Stind_I2,
				OpCodes.Stind_I4,
				OpCodes.Stind_I4,
				OpCodes.Stind_I8,
				OpCodes.Stind_I8,
				OpCodes.Stind_R4,
				OpCodes.Stind_R8,
				OpCodes.Nop,
				OpCodes.Nop,
				OpCodes.Nop,
				OpCodes.Stind_Ref
			};

			internal ProxyBuilder(ProxyAssembly assembly, TypeBuilder tb, Type proxyBaseType)
			{
				this.assembly = assembly;
				this.tb = tb;
				this.proxyBaseType = proxyBaseType;
				fields = new List<FieldBuilder>();
				fields.Add(tb.DefineField("proxy", typeof(object), FieldAttributes.Private));
				fields.Add(tb.DefineField("invoke", typeof(Action<object[]>), FieldAttributes.Private));
			}

			private void Complete()
			{
				Type[] array = new Type[fields.Count];
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					array[i] = fields[i].FieldType;
				}
				ConstructorBuilder constructorBuilder = tb.DefineConstructor(MethodAttributes.Public, CallingConventions.HasThis, array);
				ILGenerator iLGenerator = constructorBuilder.GetILGenerator();
				iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldarg_0);
				if (proxyBaseType == typeof(object))
				{
					iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Call, typeof(object).GetConstructor(new Type[0]));
				}
				else
				{
					for (int j = 0; j < array.Length; j++)
					{
						iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldarg, j + 1);
					}
					iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Call, proxyBaseType.GetConstructor(array));
				}
				for (int k = 0; k < array.Length; k++)
				{
					iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldarg_0);
					iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldarg, k + 1);
					iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Stfld, fields[k]);
				}
				iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ret);
				if (proxyBaseType == typeof(object))
				{
					MethodBuilder methodBuilder = tb.DefineMethod("GetRealProxy", MethodAttributes.Public, typeof(object), new Type[0]);
					iLGenerator = methodBuilder.GetILGenerator();
					iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldarg_0);
					iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldfld, fields[0]);
					iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ret);
				}
			}

			internal Type CreateType()
			{
				Complete();
				return tb.CreateType();
			}

			internal void AddInterfaceImpl(Type iface)
			{
				tb.AddInterfaceImplementation(iface);
				MethodInfo[] methods = iface.GetMethods();
				foreach (MethodInfo mi in methods)
				{
					AddMethodImpl(mi);
				}
			}

			private void AddMethodImpl(MethodInfo mi)
			{
				ParameterInfo[] parameters = mi.GetParameters();
				Type[] array = ParamTypes(parameters, noByRef: false);
				MethodBuilder methodBuilder = tb.DefineMethod(mi.Name, MethodAttributes.Public | MethodAttributes.Virtual, mi.ReturnType, array);
				if (mi.ContainsGenericParameters)
				{
					Type[] genericArguments = mi.GetGenericArguments();
					string[] array2 = new string[genericArguments.Length];
					for (int i = 0; i < genericArguments.Length; i++)
					{
						array2[i] = genericArguments[i].Name;
					}
					GenericTypeParameterBuilder[] array3 = methodBuilder.DefineGenericParameters(array2);
					for (int j = 0; j < array3.Length; j++)
					{
						array3[j].SetGenericParameterAttributes(genericArguments[j].GenericParameterAttributes);
					}
				}
				ILGenerator iLGenerator = methodBuilder.GetILGenerator();
				ParametersArray parametersArray = new ParametersArray(iLGenerator, array);
				iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Nop);
				GenericArray<object> genericArray = new GenericArray<object>(iLGenerator, ParamTypes(parameters, noByRef: true).Length);
				for (int k = 0; k < parameters.Length; k++)
				{
					if (!parameters[k].IsOut)
					{
						genericArray.BeginSet(k);
						parametersArray.Get(k);
						genericArray.EndSet(parameters[k].ParameterType);
					}
				}
				GenericArray<object> genericArray2 = new GenericArray<object>(iLGenerator, PackedArgs.PackedTypes.Length);
				genericArray2.BeginSet(0);
				iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldarg_0);
				iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldfld, fields[0]);
				genericArray2.EndSet(fields[0].FieldType);
				MethodInfo method = typeof(Type).GetMethod("GetTypeFromHandle", BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public, null, new Type[1] { typeof(RuntimeTypeHandle) }, null);
				assembly.GetTokenForMethod(mi, out var type, out var token);
				genericArray2.BeginSet(1);
				iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldtoken, type);
				iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Call, method);
				genericArray2.EndSet(typeof(object));
				genericArray2.BeginSet(2);
				iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldc_I4, token);
				genericArray2.EndSet(typeof(int));
				genericArray2.BeginSet(3);
				genericArray.Load();
				genericArray2.EndSet(typeof(object[]));
				if (mi.ContainsGenericParameters)
				{
					genericArray2.BeginSet(4);
					Type[] genericArguments2 = mi.GetGenericArguments();
					GenericArray<Type> genericArray3 = new GenericArray<Type>(iLGenerator, genericArguments2.Length);
					for (int l = 0; l < genericArguments2.Length; l++)
					{
						genericArray3.BeginSet(l);
						iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldtoken, genericArguments2[l]);
						iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Call, method);
						genericArray3.EndSet(typeof(Type));
					}
					genericArray3.Load();
					genericArray2.EndSet(typeof(Type[]));
				}
				iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldarg_0);
				iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldfld, fields[1]);
				genericArray2.Load();
				iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Call, delegateInvoke);
				for (int m = 0; m < parameters.Length; m++)
				{
					if (parameters[m].ParameterType.IsByRef)
					{
						parametersArray.BeginSet(m);
						genericArray.Get(m);
						parametersArray.EndSet(m, typeof(object));
					}
				}
				if (mi.ReturnType != typeof(void))
				{
					genericArray2.Get(5);
					Convert(iLGenerator, typeof(object), mi.ReturnType, isAddress: false);
				}
				iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ret);
				tb.DefineMethodOverride(methodBuilder, mi);
			}

			private static Type[] ParamTypes(ParameterInfo[] parms, bool noByRef)
			{
				Type[] array = new Type[parms.Length];
				for (int i = 0; i < parms.Length; i++)
				{
					array[i] = parms[i].ParameterType;
					if (noByRef && array[i].IsByRef)
					{
						array[i] = array[i].GetElementType();
					}
				}
				return array;
			}

			private static void Convert(ILGenerator il, Type source, Type target, bool isAddress)
			{
				if (target == source)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (source.IsByRef)
				{
					Type elementType = source.GetElementType();
					Ldind(il, elementType);
					Convert(il, elementType, target, isAddress);
				}
				else if (target.IsValueType)
				{
					if (source.IsValueType)
					{
						OpCode opcode = ConvOpCodes[(int)Type.GetTypeCode(target)];
						il.Emit(opcode);
						return;
					}
					il.Emit(OpCodes.Unbox, target);
					if (!isAddress)
					{
						Ldind(il, target);
					}
				}
				else if (target.IsAssignableFrom(source))
				{
					if (source.IsValueType)
					{
						if (isAddress)
						{
							Ldind(il, source);
						}
						il.Emit(OpCodes.Box, source);
					}
				}
				else if (target.IsGenericParameter)
				{
					il.Emit(OpCodes.Unbox_Any, target);
				}
				else
				{
					il.Emit(OpCodes.Castclass, target);
				}
			}

			private static void Ldind(ILGenerator il, Type type)
			{
				OpCode opcode = LdindOpCodes[(int)Type.GetTypeCode(type)];
				if (!opcode.Equals(OpCodes.Nop))
				{
					il.Emit(opcode);
				}
				else
				{
					il.Emit(OpCodes.Ldobj, type);
				}
			}

			private static void Stind(ILGenerator il, Type type)
			{
				OpCode opcode = StindOpCodes[(int)Type.GetTypeCode(type)];
				if (!opcode.Equals(OpCodes.Nop))
				{
					il.Emit(opcode);
				}
				else
				{
					il.Emit(OpCodes.Stobj, type);
				}
			}
		}

		internal const string DynamicAssemblyName = "DynamicProxyAssembly.F4A75B89";

		private static Dictionary<Type, Type> proxyTypes = new Dictionary<Type, Type>();

		private static ProxyAssembly proxyAssembly;

		private Type proxyType;

		private Type baseType;

		internal Type proxiedType;

		protected RealProxy(Type proxiedType, Type baseType)
		{
			this.proxiedType = proxiedType;
			this.baseType = baseType;
		}

		private Type GetProxyType()
		{
			if (proxyType == null)
			{
				lock (proxyTypes)
				{
					if (!proxyTypes.TryGetValue(proxiedType, out proxyType))
					{
						if (proxyAssembly == null)
						{
							proxyAssembly = new ProxyAssembly("DynamicProxyAssembly.F4A75B89");
						}
						if (!proxyTypes.TryGetValue(baseType, out var value))
						{
							ProxyBuilder proxyBuilder = proxyAssembly.CreateProxy("proxyBase", typeof(object));
							Type[] interfaces = baseType.GetInterfaces();
							foreach (Type iface in interfaces)
							{
								proxyBuilder.AddInterfaceImpl(iface);
							}
							value = (proxyTypes[baseType] = proxyBuilder.CreateType());
						}
						ProxyBuilder proxyBuilder2 = proxyAssembly.CreateProxy("proxy", value);
						Type[] interfaces2 = proxiedType.GetInterfaces();
						foreach (Type iface2 in interfaces2)
						{
							proxyBuilder2.AddInterfaceImpl(iface2);
						}
						proxyBuilder2.AddInterfaceImpl(proxiedType);
						proxyTypes[proxiedType] = (proxyType = proxyBuilder2.CreateType());
					}
				}
			}
			return proxyType;
		}

		public object GetTransparentProxy()
		{
			return Activator.CreateInstance(GetProxyType(), this, new Action<object[]>(Invoke));
		}

		private static void Invoke(object[] args)
		{
			PackedArgs packedArgs = new PackedArgs(args);
			MethodBase methodBase = proxyAssembly.ResolveMethodToken(packedArgs.DeclaringType, packedArgs.MethodToken);
			if (methodBase.IsGenericMethodDefinition)
			{
				methodBase = ((MethodInfo)methodBase).MakeGenericMethod(packedArgs.GenericTypes);
			}
			MethodCallMessage mcm = new MethodCallMessage(methodBase, packedArgs.Args, packedArgs.GenericTypes);
			ReturnMessage returnMessage = packedArgs.RealProxy.Invoke(mcm);
			if (returnMessage.Exception != null)
			{
				throw returnMessage.Exception;
			}
			packedArgs.ReturnValue = returnMessage.ReturnValue;
		}

		protected abstract ReturnMessage Invoke(MethodCallMessage mcm);
	}
	internal abstract class MethodMessageBase
	{
		private readonly MethodBase method;

		public MethodBase MethodBase => method;

		protected MethodMessageBase(MethodBase method)
		{
			this.method = method;
		}
	}
	internal class MethodCallMessage : MethodMessageBase
	{
		public object[] InArgs { get; private set; }

		public Type[] GenericTypes { get; private set; }

		public MethodCallMessage(MethodBase method, object[] inArgs, Type[] genericTypes)
			: base(method)
		{
			InArgs = inArgs;
			GenericTypes = genericTypes;
		}
	}
	internal class ReturnMessage : MethodMessageBase
	{
		private readonly object ret;

		private readonly Exception exception;

		public object ReturnValue => ret;

		public Exception Exception => exception;

		public ReturnMessage(object ret, object[] outArgs, int outArgsCount, MethodCallMessage mcm)
			: base(mcm.MethodBase)
		{
			this.ret = ret;
		}

		public ReturnMessage(Exception e, MethodCallMessage mcm)
			: base(mcm.MethodBase)
		{
			exception = e;
		}
	}
	public abstract class ClientEntity : IMessageClientEntity, ICloseable
	{
		private class AlreadyClosedAsyncResult : Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult
		{
			public AlreadyClosedAsyncResult(AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(callback, state)
			{
				Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: true);
			}

			public static void End(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult.End<AlreadyClosedAsyncResult>(result);
			}
		}

		private readonly object thisLock;

		private readonly Lazy<Queue<Exception>> exceptionQueue;

		private readonly string traceId;

		private bool isClosing;

		private bool raisedClosed;

		private bool raisedOpened;

		private bool raisedFaulted;

		private RetryPolicy retryPolicy;

		private RuntimeEntityDescription runtimeEntityDescription;

		public RetryPolicy RetryPolicy
		{
			get
			{
				return retryPolicy;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNull("RetryPolicy");
				}
				retryPolicy = value;
				if (ClientEntityManager != null)
				{
					ClientEntityManager.UpdateRetryPolicy(retryPolicy);
				}
			}
		}

		public bool IsClosed
		{
			get
			{
				lock (ThisLock)
				{
					return raisedClosed;
				}
			}
		}

		bool ICloseable.IsClosedOrClosing => IsClosedOrClosing;

		internal MessageClientEntityManager ClientEntityManager { get; set; }

		internal bool ShouldLinkRetryPolicy { get; set; }

		internal bool IsClosedOrClosing
		{
			get
			{
				lock (ThisLock)
				{
					return raisedClosed || isClosing;
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool IsOpened
		{
			get
			{
				lock (ThisLock)
				{
					return raisedOpened && !raisedClosed && !raisedFaulted;
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool IsFaulted
		{
			get
			{
				lock (ThisLock)
				{
					return raisedFaulted;
				}
			}
		}

		internal abstract TimeSpan OperationTimeout { get; }

		internal virtual RuntimeEntityDescription RuntimeEntityDescription
		{
			get
			{
				return runtimeEntityDescription;
			}
			set
			{
				runtimeEntityDescription = value;
				OnRuntimeDescriptionChanged(runtimeEntityDescription);
			}
		}

		protected object ThisLock => thisLock;

		internal event EventHandler Opened;

		internal event EventHandler Closed;

		internal event EventHandler Faulted;

		internal ClientEntity()
		{
			thisLock = new object();
			exceptionQueue = new Lazy<Queue<Exception>>();
			traceId = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}/{1}", GetType().Name, GetHashCode());
			retryPolicy = RetryPolicy.Default;
		}

		~ClientEntity()
		{
			lock (thisLock)
			{
				if (isClosing || raisedClosed)
				{
					return;
				}
				isClosing = true;
			}
			OnClosed();
		}

		public virtual void Abort()
		{
			Abort(fromClose: false);
		}

		public void Close()
		{
			Close(OperationTimeout);
		}

		public Task CloseAsync()
		{
			return TaskHelpers.FromAsync(BeginClose, EndClose);
		}

		internal virtual void Close(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			EndClose(BeginClose(timeout, null, null));
		}

		private IAsyncResult BeginClose(AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return BeginClose(OperationTimeout, callback, state);
		}

		internal virtual IAsyncResult BeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (isClosing)
				{
					return new AlreadyClosedAsyncResult(callback, state);
				}
				isClosing = true;
			}
			try
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteLogOperation("Entity Closing", traceId);
				});
				return OnBeginClose(timeout, callback, state);
			}
			catch
			{
				Abort(fromClose: true);
				throw;
			}
		}

		internal virtual void EndClose(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			try
			{
				if (result is AlreadyClosedAsyncResult)
				{
					AlreadyClosedAsyncResult.End(result);
					return;
				}
				OnEndClose(result);
				OnClosed();
				GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
			}
			catch
			{
				Abort(fromClose: true);
				throw;
			}
		}

		internal void ThrowPending()
		{
			if (exceptionQueue.IsValueCreated && exceptionQueue.Value.Count > 0)
			{
				Exception ex = exceptionQueue.Value.Dequeue();
				if (ex != null)
				{
					throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(ex);
				}
			}
		}

		internal Exception GetPendingException()
		{
			if (exceptionQueue.IsValueCreated && exceptionQueue.Value.Count > 0)
			{
				return exceptionQueue.Value.Dequeue();
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void Fault(Exception exception)
		{
			if (!IsFaulted)
			{
				if (exception != null)
				{
					exceptionQueue.Value.Enqueue(exception);
				}
				Fault();
			}
		}

		internal void Open()
		{
			Open(OperationTimeout);
		}

		internal virtual void Open(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			OnOpen(timeout);
			OnOpened();
		}

		internal Task OpenAsync()
		{
			return TaskHelpers.FromAsync(BeginOpen, EndOpen);
		}

		internal IAsyncResult BeginOpen(AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return BeginOpen(OperationTimeout, callback, state);
		}

		internal IAsyncResult BeginOpen(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			return OnBeginOpen(timeout, callback, state);
		}

		internal virtual void EndOpen(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			OnEndOpen(result);
			OnOpened();
		}

		internal virtual void OnRuntimeDescriptionChanged(RuntimeEntityDescription newValue)
		{
		}

		protected void Fault()
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (raisedClosed || raisedFaulted)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			OnFaulted();
		}

		protected virtual void OnOpen(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			OnEndOpen(OnBeginOpen(timeout, null, null));
		}

		protected virtual void OnClose(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			OnEndClose(OnBeginClose(timeout, null, null));
		}

		protected void ThrowIfClosed()
		{
			ThrowPending();
			if (IsClosed)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new OperationCanceledException(SRClient.MessageEntityDisposed));
			}
		}

		protected void ThrowIfDisposed()
		{
			ThrowIfClosed();
			ThrowIfFaulted();
		}

		protected void ThrowIfDisposedOrNotOpen()
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			if (!IsOpened)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new OperationCanceledException(SRClient.MessageEntityDisposed));
			}
		}

		protected void ThrowIfFaulted()
		{
			ThrowPending();
			if (IsFaulted)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new OperationCanceledException(SRClient.MessageEntityDisposed));
			}
		}

		protected void ThrowIfDisposedOrImmutable()
		{
			ThrowIfClosed();
			ThrowIfFaulted();
		}

		protected virtual void OnOpened()
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (raisedOpened)
				{
					return;
				}
				raisedOpened = true;
			}
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteLogOperation("Entity Opened", traceId);
			});
			this.Opened?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		protected virtual void OnClosed()
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (raisedClosed)
				{
					return;
				}
				raisedClosed = true;
				isClosing = false;
			}
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteLogOperation("Entity Closed", traceId);
			});
			this.Closed?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		protected virtual void OnFaulted()
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (raisedFaulted)
				{
					return;
				}
				raisedFaulted = true;
			}
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteLogOperationWarning("Entity Faulted", traceId);
			});
			this.Faulted?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		protected abstract void OnAbort();

		protected abstract IAsyncResult OnBeginOpen(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state);

		protected abstract void OnEndOpen(IAsyncResult result);

		protected abstract IAsyncResult OnBeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state);

		protected abstract void OnEndClose(IAsyncResult result);

		private void Abort(bool fromClose)
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (!fromClose)
				{
					if (raisedClosed || isClosing)
					{
						return;
					}
				}
				else if (raisedClosed)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (!isClosing)
				{
					isClosing = true;
				}
			}
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteLogOperation("Entity Aborted", traceId);
			});
			OnAbort();
			OnClosed();
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}
	}

	public sealed class EntityMetadataUpdatedException : MessagingException
	{
		public EntityMetadataUpdatedException(string message)
			: base(message)

			base.IsTransient = true;

	public sealed class EventDataBatch : IDisposable
	{
		private const int MaxSizeLimit = 4194304;

		private const int MaxSizeLimitBasic = 262144;

		private readonly List<EventData> eventDataList;

		private long maxSize;

		private long currentSize;

		private bool disposed;

		public int Count
		{
			get
			{
				ThrowIfDisposed();
				return eventDataList.Count;
			}
		}

		public EventDataBatch(long maxSizeInBytes)
		{
			maxSize = Math.Min(maxSizeInBytes, 4194304L);
			if (maxSize == -1)
			{
				currentSize = 65536L;
			}
			else
			{
				currentSize = maxSize / 65536 * 1024;
			}
			eventDataList = new List<EventData>();
		}

		public bool TryAdd(EventData eventData)
		{
			if (eventData == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("eventData");
			}
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			long size = GetSize(eventData, eventDataList.Count == 0);
			if (maxSize == -1)
			{
				if (eventDataList.Count > 0 || size >= 4194304)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (currentSize + size < 262144)
				{
					maxSize = 262144L;
				}
			}
			else if (currentSize + size > maxSize)
			{
				return false;
			}
			eventDataList.Add(eventData);
			currentSize += size;
			return true;
		}

		public IEnumerable<EventData> ToEnumerable()
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			return eventDataList;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			disposed = true;
			foreach (EventData eventData in eventDataList)
			{
				eventData.Dispose();
			}
		}

		private static long GetSize(EventData eventData, bool first)
		{
			long serializedSizeInBytes = eventData.SerializedSizeInBytes;
			serializedSizeInBytes += 16;
			if (first)
			{
				int num = 0;
				if (eventData.PartitionKey != null)
				{
					num += SymbolEncoding.GetEncodeSize("x-opt-partition-key");
					num += StringEncoding.GetEncodeSize(eventData.PartitionKey);
				}
				if (eventData.Publisher != null)
				{
					num += SymbolEncoding.GetEncodeSize("x-opt-publisher");
					num += StringEncoding.GetEncodeSize(eventData.Publisher);
				}
				if (num > 0)
				{
					serializedSizeInBytes += num;
					serializedSizeInBytes += 16;
				}
			}
			return serializedSizeInBytes;
		}

		private void ThrowIfDisposed()
		{
			if (disposed)
			{
				throw new ObjectDisposedException(GetType().Name);
			}
		}
	}
	[AmqpContract(Name = "com.microsoft:eventhub-runtime-info:map", Encoding = EncodingType.Map)]
	public class EventHubRuntimeInformation
	{

	public class EventPosition
	{
		internal string Offset { get; set; }

		internal bool IsInclusive { get; set; }

		internal DateTime? EnqueuedTimeUtc { get; set; }

		internal long? SequenceNumber { get; set; }

		private EventPosition()
		{
		}

		public static EventPosition FromStart()
		{
			return FromOffset("-1");
		}

		public static EventPosition FromEnd()
		{
			return FromOffset("@latest");
		}

		public static EventPosition FromOffset(string offset, bool inclusive = false)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(offset))
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("offset");
			}
			return new EventPosition
			{
				Offset = offset,
				IsInclusive = inclusive
			};
		}

		public static EventPosition FromSequenceNumber(long sequenceNumber, bool inclusive = false)
		{
			return new EventPosition
			{
				SequenceNumber = sequenceNumber,
				IsInclusive = inclusive
			};
		}

		public static EventPosition FromEnqueuedTime(DateTime enqueuedTimeUtc)
		{
			return new EventPosition
			{
				EnqueuedTimeUtc = enqueuedTimeUtc
			};
		}

		internal string GetExpression()
		{
			if (Offset != null)
			{
				if (!IsInclusive)
				{
					return "amqp.annotation.x-opt-offset > " + Offset;
				}
				return "amqp.annotation.x-opt-offset >= " + Offset;
			}
			if (SequenceNumber.HasValue)
			{
				if (!IsInclusive)
				{
					return string.Format("{0} > {1}", "amqp.annotation.x-opt-sequence-number", SequenceNumber.Value);
				}
				return string.Format("{0} >= {1}", "amqp.annotation.x-opt-sequence-number", SequenceNumber.Value);
			}
			if (EnqueuedTimeUtc.HasValue)
			{
				long milliseconds = TimeStampEncoding.GetMilliseconds(EnqueuedTimeUtc.Value);
				return string.Format("{0} > {1}", "amqp.annotation.x-opt-enqueued-time", milliseconds);
			}
			throw new ArgumentException("No starting position was set");
		}
	}

	public enum IpFilterActionType
	{
		[EnumMember]
		Reject,
		[EnumMember]
		Accept
	}
	[DataContract(Name = "IpFilterAuthorizationRule", Namespace = "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2010/10/servicebus/connect")]
	public class IpFilterAuthorizationRule : AuthorizationRule
	{
		private const string FixedClaimType = "IpFilter";

		private const string FixedClaimValue = "None";

		private static readonly Regex IpFilterRuleNameRegex = new Regex("^[A-Za-z0-9-:.+%_#*?!(),=@;']{1,128}$", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Compiled);

		private byte cidr;

		private int cidrMask;

		private int ipRangeMask;

		[DataMember(Name = "KeyName", IsRequired = true, Order = 1001, EmitDefaultValue = false)]
		internal string InternalKeyName { get; set; }

		[DataMember(Name = "Action", IsRequired = true, Order = 1002)]
		public IpFilterActionType Action { get; set; }

		[DataMember(Name = "IpMask", IsRequired = true, Order = 1003, EmitDefaultValue = false)]
		internal string InternalIpMaskString { get; set; }

		public override string KeyName
		{
			get
			{
				return InternalKeyName;
			}
			set
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("value");
				}
				if (!string.Equals(InternalKeyName, HttpUtility.UrlEncode(InternalKeyName)))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(SRCore.AuthorizationRuleKeyContainsInvalidCharacters(GetType().Name));
				}
				if (value.Length > 256)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("KeyName", SRCore.ArgumentStringTooBig("KeyName", 256, value.Length));
				}
				InternalKeyName = value;
			}
		}

		public string IpMaskString
		{
			get
			{
				return InternalIpMaskString;
			}
			set
			{
				ValidateIpMaskFormat(value);
				string internalIpMaskString = InternalIpMaskString;
				try
				{
					InternalIpMaskString = value;
					PopulateCidrParameters();
				}
				catch
				{
					InternalIpMaskString = internalIpMaskString;
					throw;
				}
			}
		}

		internal IpFilterAuthorizationRule()
		{
			base.ClaimType = "IpFilter";
			base.ClaimValue = "None";
			Action = IpFilterActionType.Accept;
			InternalIpMaskString = "0.0.0.0/0";
		}

		public IpFilterAuthorizationRule(string filterName, IpFilterActionType action, string ipMask)
		{
			Action = action;
			KeyName = filterName;
			IpMaskString = ipMask;
			base.ClaimType = "IpFilter";
			base.ClaimValue = "None";
		}

		internal static void ValidateIpMaskFormat(string ipMaskString)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ipMaskString))
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("ipMaskString");
			}
			string[] array = ipMaskString.Split('/');
			if (array.Length > 2)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.InvalidIpAddressMask, "ipMaskString");
			}
			string[] array2 = array[0].Split('.');
			if (array2.Length != 4)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.InvalidIpAddressMask, "ipMaskString");
			}
			if (!IPAddress.TryParse(array[0], out var address))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.InvalidIpAddressMask, "ipMaskString");
			}
			if (address.AddressFamily != AddressFamily.InterNetwork)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.InvalidIpAddressMask, "ipMaskString");
			}
		}

		internal static void ValidateCIDRValue(string[] ipAddrArray, IPAddress ipAddr)
		{
			if (!byte.TryParse(ipAddrArray[1], out var result))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.InvalidIpAddressCIDRValue);
			}
			if (result > 32)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.InvalidIpAddressCIDRValue);
			}
			if (result == 0 && !ipAddr.Equals(IPAddress.Any))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.InvalidIpAddressCIDRValue);
			}
		}

		public bool IsInRange(IPAddress ipAddr)
		{
			if (cidr == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			byte[] addressBytes = ipAddr.GetAddressBytes();
			int num = BitConverter.ToInt32(addressBytes, ipAddr.IsIPv4MappedToIPv6 ? 12 : 0);
			return ipRangeMask == (num & cidrMask);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!base.Equals(obj))
			{
				return false;
			}
			IpFilterAuthorizationRule ipFilterAuthorizationRule = (IpFilterAuthorizationRule)obj;
			if (string.Equals(KeyName, ipFilterAuthorizationRule.KeyName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) && string.Equals(IpMaskString, ipFilterAuthorizationRule.IpMaskString, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				return Action == ipFilterAuthorizationRule.Action;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return KeyName?.GetHashCode() ?? 0;
		}

		protected override void ValidateRights(IEnumerable<AccessRights> value)
		{
			if (base.Rights != null && base.Rights.Any())
			{
				base.ValidateRights(value);
			}
		}

		[OnDeserialized]
		private void OnDeserialized(StreamingContext ctx)
		{
			PopulateCidrParameters();
		}

		private void PopulateCidrParameters()
		{
			string[] array = InternalIpMaskString.Split('/');
			IPAddress iPAddress = IPAddress.Parse(array[0]);
			if (array.Length == 1)
			{
				cidr = 32;
			}
			else
			{
				ValidateCIDRValue(array, iPAddress);
				cidr = byte.Parse(array[1]);
			}
			int num = BitConverter.ToInt32(iPAddress.GetAddressBytes(), 0);
			cidrMask = IPAddress.HostToNetworkOrder(-1 << 32 - cidr);
			ipRangeMask = num & cidrMask;
		}
	}

	public sealed class EventHubSender : ClientEntity
	{
		public string Path { get; private set; }

		public string PartitionId { get; private set; }

		internal override TimeSpan OperationTimeout => MessagingFactory.OperationTimeout;

		internal MessageSender InternalSender { get; set; }

		internal MessagingFactory MessagingFactory { get; private set; }

		internal EventHubSender(MessagingFactory factory, string path, string partitionId = null)
		{
			if (factory == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("factory");
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path))
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNullOrWhiteSpace("path");
			}
			if (path.IndexOf("/" + "Publishers" + "/", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) != -1 && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(partitionId))
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new NotSupportedException(SRClient.PublisherPolicyNotSupportedOnPartitionedSenders));
			}
			Path = path;
			PartitionId = partitionId;
			MessagingFactory = factory;
			base.RetryPolicy = factory.RetryPolicy.Clone();
		}

		public static EventHubSender CreateFromConnectionString(string connectionString)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(connectionString))
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNullOrWhiteSpace("connectionString");
			}
			ServiceBusConnectionStringBuilder serviceBusConnectionStringBuilder = new ServiceBusConnectionStringBuilder(connectionString);
			MessagingFactory.CheckValidEntityName(serviceBusConnectionStringBuilder.EntityPath, 260, allowSeparator: false, "EventHub");
			MessagingFactory.CheckValidEntityName(serviceBusConnectionStringBuilder.Publisher, 128, allowSeparator: false, "Publisher");
			KeyValueConfigurationManager keyValueConfigurationManager = new KeyValueConfigurationManager(connectionString, TransportType.Amqp);
			MessagingFactory factory = keyValueConfigurationManager.CreateMessagingFactory();
			string path = EntityNameHelper.FormatPublisherPath(serviceBusConnectionStringBuilder.EntityPath, serviceBusConnectionStringBuilder.Publisher);
			return new EventHubSender(factory, path);
		}

		public EventDataBatch CreateBatch()
		{
			ThrowIfSenderNull("CreateBatch");
			return new EventDataBatch(InternalSender.MaxMessageSize);
		}

		public void Send(EventData data)
		{
			ThrowIfSenderNull("Send");
			InternalSender.EndSendEventData(InternalSender.BeginSendEventData(null, new EventData[1] { data }, OperationTimeout, null, null));
		}

		public Task SendAsync(EventData data)
		{
			ThrowIfSenderNull("Send");
			return TaskHelpers.FromAsync((AsyncCallback c, object s) => InternalSender.BeginSendEventData(null, new EventData[1] { data }, OperationTimeout, c, s), InternalSender.EndSendEventData);
		}

		public void SendBatch(IEnumerable<EventData> eventDataList)
		{
			ThrowIfSenderNull("SendBatch");
			InternalSender.EndSendEventData(InternalSender.BeginSendEventData(null, eventDataList, OperationTimeout, null, null));
		}

		public Task SendBatchAsync(IEnumerable<EventData> eventDataList)
		{
			ThrowIfSenderNull("SendBatchAsync");
			return TaskHelpers.FromAsync((AsyncCallback c, object s) => InternalSender.BeginSendEventData(null, eventDataList, OperationTimeout, c, s), InternalSender.EndSendEventData);
		}

		protected override void OnAbort()
		{
			if (InternalSender != null)
			{
				InternalSender.Abort();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnOpen(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			ThrowIfSenderNull("Open");
			InternalSender.Open(timeout);
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginOpen(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			ThrowIfSenderNull("BeginOpen");
			return InternalSender.BeginOpen(timeout, callback, state);
		}

		protected override void OnEndOpen(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			InternalSender.EndOpen(result);
		}

		protected override void OnClose(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			if (InternalSender != null)
			{
				InternalSender.Close(timeout);
			}
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			if (InternalSender != null)
			{
				return InternalSender.BeginClose(timeout, callback, state);
			}
			return new CompletedAsyncResult(callback, state);
		}

		protected override void OnEndClose(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (InternalSender != null)
			{
				InternalSender.EndClose(result);
			}
			else
			{
				CompletedAsyncResult.End(result);
			}
		}

		private void ThrowIfSenderNull(string operationName)
		{
			EnsureCreateInternalSender();
			if (InternalSender == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException(SRCore.UnsupportedOperation(operationName)));
			}
		}

		private void EnsureCreateInternalSender()
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			if (InternalSender != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			lock (base.ThisLock)
			{
				if (InternalSender == null)
				{
					try
					{
						InternalSender = ((!string.IsNullOrEmpty(PartitionId)) ? MessagingFactory.CreateSenderAsync(Path, PartitionId).Result : MessagingFactory.CreateMessageSender(Path));
						InternalSender.RetryPolicy = base.RetryPolicy;
						InternalSender.EntityType = MessagingEntityType.EventHub;
						return;
					}
					catch (AggregateException ex)
					{
						throw ex.Flatten().InnerException;
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public class Lease
	{

		public string Token { get; set; }

		public long Epoch { get; set; }

		public string Offset { get; set; }

		public long SequenceNumber { get; set; }

		public Lease()
		{
		}

		public Lease(Lease source)
		{
			PartitionId = source.PartitionId;
			Owner = source.Owner;
			Token = source.Token;
			Epoch = source.Epoch;
			Offset = source.Offset;
			SequenceNumber = source.SequenceNumber;
		}

		public virtual bool IsExpired()
		{
			return false;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (this == obj)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!(obj is Lease lease))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return string.Equals(PartitionId, lease.PartitionId);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return PartitionId.GetHashCode();
		}
	}

			: base(info, context)
		{
			Lease = (Lease)info.GetValue("Lease", typeof(Lease));
		}

		public override void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			base.GetObjectData(info, context);
			if (Lease != null)
			{
				info.AddValue("Lease", Lease);
			}
		}
	}
	internal static class NetworkDetector
	{
		private enum ConnectCheckState
		{
			Checking,
			Checked
		}

		private sealed class ConnectCheckContext
		{
			public InternalConnectivityMode Value { get; set; }

			public ConnectCheckState State { get; set; }

			public ConnectCheckContext(ConnectCheckState initialState)
			{
				State = initialState;
			}
		}

		private sealed class CheckConnectAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<CheckConnectAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly int key;

			private readonly TimeSpan waitTimePerCheck;

			private readonly string host;

			private readonly int port;

			private TcpClient tcpClient;

			private ServiceBusClientWebSocket clientWebSocket;

			private Dictionary<int, ConnectCheckContext> cache;

			private ConnectCheckContext connectCheckContext;

			private volatile bool shouldReleaseLock;

			private bool ownsLoading;

			private InternalConnectivityMode Value { get; set; }

			private string TcpAddress { get; set; }

			private string WebSocketAddress { get; set; }

			public CheckConnectAsyncResult(string host, int port, int key, Dictionary<int, ConnectCheckContext> cache, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.host = host;
				this.port = port;
				this.key = key;
				this.cache = cache;
				base.OnCompleting = (Action<Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult, Exception>)Delegate.Combine(base.OnCompleting, new Action<Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult, Exception>(OnFinally));
				waitTimePerCheck = TimeoutHelper.Divide(timeout, 2);
				if (waitTimePerCheck <= TimeSpan.Zero)
				{
					waitTimePerCheck = timeout;
				}
				Start();
			}

			public new static InternalConnectivityMode End(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				return AsyncResult<CheckConnectAsyncResult>.End(result).Value;
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				while (true)
				{
					Monitor.Enter(NetworkDetector.ThisLock);
					shouldReleaseLock = true;
					try
					{
						if (!cache.TryGetValue(key, out connectCheckContext))
						{
							connectCheckContext = new ConnectCheckContext(ConnectCheckState.Checking);
							cache.Add(key, connectCheckContext);
							ownsLoading = true;
							break;
						}
						if (connectCheckContext.State == ConnectCheckState.Checked)
						{
							Value = connectCheckContext.Value;
							break;
						}
						if (RemainingTime() <= TimeSpan.Zero)
						{
							Value = connectCheckContext?.Value ?? InternalConnectivityMode.HttpsWebSocket;
							yield break;
						}
						yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)delegate(CheckConnectAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s)
						{
							try
							{
								thisPtr.shouldReleaseLock = false;
								return BeginWaitPendingOperation(thisPtr.key, t, c, s);
							}
							finally
							{
								Monitor.Exit(NetworkDetector.ThisLock);
							}
						}, (EndCall)delegate(CheckConnectAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
						{
							EndWaitPendingOperation(r);
						}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
					}
					finally
					{
						CheckConnectAsyncResult checkConnectAsyncResult = this;
						if (checkConnectAsyncResult.shouldReleaseLock)
						{
							checkConnectAsyncResult.shouldReleaseLock = false;
							Monitor.Exit(NetworkDetector.ThisLock);
						}
					}
				}
				if (!ownsLoading)
				{
					yield break;
				}
				TcpAddress = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}://{1}:{2}", Uri.UriSchemeNetTcp, host, port);
				WebSocketAddress = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}://{1}:{2}", Uri.UriSchemeHttps, host, RelayEnvironment.RelayHttpsPort);
				tcpClient = new TcpClient();
				connectCheckContext.Value = InternalConnectivityMode.HttpsWebSocket;
				yield return CallTask((Func<CheckConnectAsyncResult, TimeSpan, Task>)delegate(CheckConnectAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t)
				{
					Task task = thisPtr.tcpClient.ConnectAsync(host, port);
					double value = Math.Min(t.TotalMilliseconds, thisPtr.waitTimePerCheck.TotalMilliseconds);
					task.Wait(Convert.ToInt32(value));
					return task;
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
				if (base.LastAsyncStepException == null && tcpClient.Connected)
				{
					connectCheckContext.Value = InternalConnectivityMode.Tcp;
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.DetectConnectivityModeSucceeded(TcpAddress, "Tcp");
					yield break;
				}
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.DetectConnectivityModeFailed(TcpAddress, "Tcp");
				connectCheckContext.Value = InternalConnectivityMode.Http;
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((CheckConnectAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => new WebSocketConnectAsyncResult(new Uri(thisPtr.WebSocketAddress), TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(Math.Min(t.TotalMilliseconds, thisPtr.waitTimePerCheck.TotalMilliseconds)), "AMQPWSB10", null, c, s).Start()), (EndCall)delegate(CheckConnectAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					thisPtr.clientWebSocket = AsyncResult<WebSocketConnectAsyncResult>.End(r).ClientWebSocket;
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
				if (base.LastAsyncStepException == null && clientWebSocket != null && clientWebSocket.State != ServiceBusClientWebSocket.WebSocketState.Closed && clientWebSocket.State != ServiceBusClientWebSocket.WebSocketState.Aborted && clientWebSocket.State != ServiceBusClientWebSocket.WebSocketState.Faulted)
				{
					connectCheckContext.Value = InternalConnectivityMode.HttpsWebSocket;
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.DetectConnectivityModeSucceeded(WebSocketAddress, "HttpsWebSocket");
				}
				else
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.DetectConnectivityModeFailed(WebSocketAddress, "HttpsWebSocket");
				}
			}

			private static void OnFinally(Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult result, Exception exception)
			{
				CheckConnectAsyncResult checkConnectAsyncResult = (CheckConnectAsyncResult)result;
				checkConnectAsyncResult.Value = checkConnectAsyncResult.connectCheckContext.Value;
				if (checkConnectAsyncResult.ownsLoading)
				{
					checkConnectAsyncResult.tcpClient?.Close();
					checkConnectAsyncResult.clientWebSocket?.Abort();
					checkConnectAsyncResult.connectCheckContext.State = ConnectCheckState.Checked;
					SignalPendingOperations(checkConnectAsyncResult.key);
				}
			}
		}

		private static readonly Dictionary<int, List<AsyncWaiter>> pendingOperations;

		private static readonly object ThisLock;

		private static Dictionary<int, ConnectCheckContext> cache;

		static NetworkDetector()
		{
			cache = new Dictionary<int, ConnectCheckContext>();
			pendingOperations = new Dictionary<int, List<AsyncWaiter>>();
			NetworkChange.NetworkAvailabilityChanged += delegate
			{
				Reset();
			};
			NetworkChange.NetworkAddressChanged += delegate
			{
				Reset();
			};
			ThisLock = new object();
		}

		internal static IAsyncResult BeginCheckConnectivity(IEnumerable<Uri> addresses, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return BeginCheckConnectivity(addresses, RelayEnvironment.RelayNmfPort, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		internal static IAsyncResult BeginCheckConnectivity(IEnumerable<Uri> addresses, int tcpPort, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			if (addresses != null)
			{
				Uri uri = addresses.FirstOrDefault();
				if (uri != null)
				{
					return BeginInternalCheckConnectivity(uri.DnsSafeHost, (uri.Port != -1) ? uri.Port : tcpPort, timeout, callback, state);
				}
			}
			return new CompletedAsyncResult<InternalConnectivityMode>(InternalConnectivityMode.Tcp, callback, state);
		}

		internal static InternalConnectivityMode EndCheckConnectivity(IAsyncResult asyncResult)
		{
			return EndInternalCheckConnectivity(asyncResult);
		}

		private static IAsyncResult BeginInternalCheckConnectivity(string host, int port, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new CheckConnectAsyncResult(host, port, GetHashCode(host, port), cache, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		private static InternalConnectivityMode EndInternalCheckConnectivity(IAsyncResult asyncResult)
		{
			if (asyncResult is CheckConnectAsyncResult)
			{
				return CheckConnectAsyncResult.End(asyncResult);
			}
			return CompletedAsyncResult<InternalConnectivityMode>.End(asyncResult);
		}

		private static IAsyncResult BeginWaitPendingOperation(int key, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			if (!pendingOperations.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
			{
				value = new List<AsyncWaiter>();
				pendingOperations.Add(key, value);
			}
			AsyncWaiter asyncWaiter = new AsyncWaiter(timeout, callback, state);
			value.Add(asyncWaiter);
			return asyncWaiter;
		}

		private static void EndWaitPendingOperation(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			AsyncWaiter.End(result);
		}

		private static void SignalPendingOperations(int key)
		{
			List<AsyncWaiter> value;
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (pendingOperations.TryGetValue(key, out value))
				{
					pendingOperations.Remove(key);
				}
			}
			if (value == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (AsyncWaiter item in value)
			{
				IOThreadScheduler.ScheduleCallbackNoFlow(delegate(object state)
				{
					((AsyncWaiter)state).Signal();
				}, item);
			}
		}

		private static int GetHashCode(string host, int port)
		{
			return HashCode.CombineHashCodes(host.GetHashCode(), port);
		}

		private static void Reset()
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				cache = new Dictionary<int, ConnectCheckContext>();
			}
		}
	}
	[DataContract(Name = "CursorType", Namespace = "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2010/10/servicebus/connect")]

	{
		[EnumMember]

		Client
	}

	public abstract class EventHubClient : ClientEntity
	{
		private sealed class CloseOrAbortAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<CloseOrAbortAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly EventHubClient owner;

			private readonly bool shouldAbort;

			public CloseOrAbortAsyncResult(EventHubClient owner, bool shouldAbort, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.owner = owner;
				this.shouldAbort = shouldAbort;
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				if (shouldAbort)
				{
					owner.ClientEntityManager.Abort();
					yield break;
				}
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((CloseOrAbortAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.owner.ClientEntityManager.BeginClose(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(CloseOrAbortAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					thisPtr.owner.ClientEntityManager.EndClose(r);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
			}
		}

		private readonly Lazy<MessagingFactorySettings> cachedSettings;

		private int prefetchCount;

		private long? prefetchSizeInBytes;

		private volatile MessageSender sender;

		public int PrefetchCount
		{
			get
			{
				return prefetchCount;
			}
			set
			{
				ValidateEventHubPrefetchCount(value);
				prefetchCount = value;
				if (prefetchCount > 0)
				{
					prefetchSizeInBytes = null;
				}
			}
		}

		public long? PrefetchSizeInBytes
		{
			get
			{
				return prefetchSizeInBytes;
			}
			set
			{
				ValidateEventHubPrefetchBySizeInBytes(value);
				prefetchSizeInBytes = value;
				if (prefetchSizeInBytes.HasValue)
				{
					prefetchCount = 0;
				}
			}
		}

		public string Path { get; private set; }

		public bool DisableEntityLevelPerformanceCounters
		{
			get
			{
				return MessagingPerformanceCounters.DisableEntityLevelCounters;
			}
			set
			{
				MessagingPerformanceCounters.SetCollectEntityLevelCounters(value);
			}
		}

		internal MessageSender InternalSender
		{
			get
			{
				return sender;
			}
			set
			{
				sender = value;
			}
		}

		internal MessagingFactory MessagingFactory { get; private set; }

		internal static bool TestSmallPrefetchSize { get; set; }

		internal override TimeSpan OperationTimeout => MessagingFactory.OperationTimeout;

		internal EventHubClient(MessagingFactory messagingFactory, string path)
		{
			MessagingFactory = messagingFactory;
			cachedSettings = new Lazy<MessagingFactorySettings>(MessagingFactory.GetSettings);
			base.ClientEntityManager = new MessageClientEntityManager();

		public static EventHubClient CreateFromConnectionString(string connectionString, string path)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(connectionString))
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNullOrWhiteSpace("connectionString");
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path))
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNullOrWhiteSpace("path");
			}
			ServiceBusConnectionStringBuilder serviceBusConnectionStringBuilder = new ServiceBusConnectionStringBuilder(connectionString);
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(serviceBusConnectionStringBuilder.EntityPath))
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("entityPath", SRClient.SpecifyEntityNameInPathArg("EventHub"));
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(serviceBusConnectionStringBuilder.Publisher))
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.Argument("publisher", SRClient.PublisherPolicyNotSupportedOnEventHubClient);
			}
			serviceBusConnectionStringBuilder.TransportType = TransportType.Amqp;
			return MessagingFactory.CreateFromConnectionString(serviceBusConnectionStringBuilder.ToString(), useCache: true).CreateEventHubClient(path);
		}

		public static EventHubClient CreateFromConnectionString(string connectionString)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(connectionString))
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNullOrWhiteSpace("connectionString");
			}
			ServiceBusConnectionStringBuilder serviceBusConnectionStringBuilder = new ServiceBusConnectionStringBuilder(connectionString);
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(serviceBusConnectionStringBuilder.EntityPath))
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("entityPath", SRClient.SpecifyConnStrEntityPath("EventHub"));
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(serviceBusConnectionStringBuilder.Publisher))
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.Argument("publisher", SRClient.PublisherPolicyNotSupportedOnEventHubClient);
			}
			serviceBusConnectionStringBuilder.TransportType = TransportType.Amqp;
			return MessagingFactory.CreateFromConnectionString(serviceBusConnectionStringBuilder.ToString(), useCache: true).CreateEventHubClient(serviceBusConnectionStringBuilder.EntityPath);
		}

		public void Send(EventData data)

		}

		}

		public EventHubConsumerGroup GetConsumerGroup(string groupName)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(groupName))
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNullOrWhiteSpace("groupName");
			}
			EventHubConsumerGroup eventHubConsumerGroup = new EventHubConsumerGroup(MessagingFactory, Path, groupName, PrefetchCount, PrefetchSizeInBytes);
			RegisterMessageClientEntity(eventHubConsumerGroup);
			return eventHubConsumerGroup;
		}

		internal void RegisterMessageClientEntity(ClientEntity child)
		{
			base.ClientEntityManager.Add(child);
		}

		protected override void OnAbort()
		{
			CloseOrAbortAsyncResult closeOrAbortAsyncResult = new CloseOrAbortAsyncResult(this, shouldAbort: true, TimeSpan.MaxValue, null, null);
			closeOrAbortAsyncResult.RunSynchronously();
		}

		protected override void OnClose(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			CloseOrAbortAsyncResult closeOrAbortAsyncResult = new CloseOrAbortAsyncResult(this, shouldAbort: false, timeout, null, null);
			closeOrAbortAsyncResult.RunSynchronously();
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			CloseOrAbortAsyncResult closeOrAbortAsyncResult = new CloseOrAbortAsyncResult(this, shouldAbort: false, timeout, callback, state);
			return closeOrAbortAsyncResult.Start();
		}

		protected override void OnEndClose(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			AsyncResult<CloseOrAbortAsyncResult>.End(result);
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginOpen(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new CompletedAsyncResult(callback, state);
		}

		protected override void OnEndOpen(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			CompletedAsyncResult.End(result);
		}

		protected abstract Task<MessageSender> CreateSenderAsync();

		private void ThrowIfSbmpClient(string operationName)
		{
			if (cachedSettings.Value.TransportType == TransportType.NetMessaging)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(SRCore.UnsupportedTransport(operationName, TransportType.NetMessaging.ToString()));
			}
		}

		private void ThrowIfSenderNull(string operationName)
		{
			EnsureCreateInternalSender();
			if (InternalSender == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException(SRCore.UnsupportedOperation(operationName)));
			}
		}

		private void EnsureCreateInternalSender()
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			if (sender != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			lock (base.ThisLock)
			{
				if (sender == null)
				{
					sender = CreateSenderAsync().Result;
					sender.RetryPolicy = base.RetryPolicy.Clone();
					sender.EntityType = MessagingEntityType.EventHub;
					RegisterMessageClientEntity(sender);
				}
			}
		}

		internal static void ValidateEventHubPrefetchCount(int value)
		{
			if (value < Constants.EventHubMinimumPrefetchCount)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentOutOfRange("PrefetchCount", value, SRClient.ArgumentOutOfRange(Constants.EventHubMinimumPrefetchCount, int.MaxValue));
			}
		}

		internal static void ValidateEventHubPrefetchBySizeInBytes(long? sizeInBytes)
		{
			if (!TestSmallPrefetchSize && sizeInBytes.HasValue && (sizeInBytes.Value < Constants.EventHubMinimumPrefetchSizeInBytes || sizeInBytes.Value > Constants.EventHubMaximumPrefetchSizeInBytes))
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentOutOfRange("PrefetchSizeInBytes", sizeInBytes, SRClient.ArgumentOutOfRange(Constants.EventHubMinimumPrefetchSizeInBytes, Constants.EventHubMaximumPrefetchSizeInBytes));
			}
		}
	}
