	public sealed class EventHubReceiver : ClientEntity
	{
		private readonly EventPosition position;

		private volatile MessageReceiver receiver;

		public string StartingOffset => position.Offset;

		public DateTime? StartingDateTimeUtc => position.EnqueuedTimeUtc;

		public long? StartingSequenceNumber => position.SequenceNumber;

		public string EventHubPath { get; private set; }

		public string Name { get; private set; }

		public long? Epoch { get; private set; }

		public string PartitionId { get; private set; }

		public bool OffsetInclusive => position.IsInclusive;

		public int PrefetchCount
		{
			get
			{
				EnsureCreateInternalReceiver();
				return InternalReceiver.PrefetchCount;
			}
			set
			{
				EventHubClient.ValidateEventHubPrefetchCount(value);
				EnsureCreateInternalReceiver();
				InternalReceiver.PrefetchCount = value;
			}
		}

		public long? PrefetchSizeInBytes
		{
			get
			{
				EnsureCreateInternalReceiver();
				return InternalReceiver.PrefetchEventSizeInBytes;
			}
			set
			{
				EventHubClient.ValidateEventHubPrefetchBySizeInBytes(value);
				EnsureCreateInternalReceiver();
				InternalReceiver.PrefetchEventSizeInBytes = value;
			}
		}

		public ReceiverRuntimeInfo RuntimeInfo
		{
			get
			{
				EnsureCreateInternalReceiver();
				return InternalReceiver.RuntimeInfo;
			}
		}

		public bool ReceiverRuntimeMetricEnabled { get; private set; }

		public string Identifier { get; private set; }

		internal bool EnableCheckpoint
		{
			get
			{
				EnsureCreateInternalReceiver();
				return InternalReceiver.Mode == ReceiveMode.PeekLock;
			}
		}

		internal override TimeSpan OperationTimeout => MessagingFactory.OperationTimeout;

		internal MessageReceiver InternalReceiver
		{
			get
			{
				return receiver;
			}
			set
			{
				receiver = value;
			}
		}

		internal MessagingFactory MessagingFactory { get; private set; }

		internal EventHubReceiver(MessagingFactory factory, string path, string consumerName, string partitionId, EventPosition position, long? epoch, int prefetchCount, long? prefetchSizeInBytes, bool enableRuntimeMetric, string receiverName)
		{
			if (factory == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("factory");
			}
			if (partitionId == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("partitionId");
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path))
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNullOrWhiteSpace("path");
			}
			Name = consumerName;
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(consumerName))
			{
				Name = "$Default";
			}
			EventHubPath = path;
			MessagingFactory = factory;
			PartitionId = partitionId;
			base.RetryPolicy = factory.RetryPolicy.Clone();
			Epoch = epoch;
			this.position = position;
			ReceiverRuntimeMetricEnabled = enableRuntimeMetric;
			Identifier = receiverName;
			if (prefetchSizeInBytes.HasValue)
			{
				PrefetchSizeInBytes = prefetchSizeInBytes;
			}
			else
			{
				PrefetchCount = prefetchCount;
			}
		}

		public EventData Receive()
		{
			return Receive(OperationTimeout);
		}

		public EventData Receive(TimeSpan waitTime)
		{
			ThrowIfReceiverNull("Receive");
			if (InternalReceiver.EndTryReceiveEventData(InternalReceiver.BeginTryReceiveEventData(null, 1, waitTime, null, null), out var messages))
			{
				return messages.FirstOrDefault();
			}
			return null;
		}

		public Task<EventData> ReceiveAsync()
		{
			return ReceiveAsync(OperationTimeout);
		}

		public Task<EventData> ReceiveAsync(TimeSpan waitTime)
		{
			ThrowIfReceiverNull("Receive");
			IEnumerable<EventData> messages;
			return TaskHelpers.FromAsync((AsyncCallback callback, object o) => InternalReceiver.BeginTryReceiveEventData(null, 1, waitTime, callback, o), (IAsyncResult result) => InternalReceiver.EndTryReceiveEventData(result, out messages) ? messages.FirstOrDefault() : null);
		}

		public IEnumerable<EventData> Receive(int maxCount)
		{
			return Receive(maxCount, OperationTimeout);
		}

		public IEnumerable<EventData> Receive(int maxCount, TimeSpan waitTime)
		{
			ThrowIfReceiverNull("Receive");
			if (!InternalReceiver.EndTryReceiveEventData(InternalReceiver.BeginTryReceiveEventData(null, maxCount, waitTime, null, null), out var messages))
			{
				return Enumerable.Empty<EventData>();
			}
			return messages;
		}

		public Task<IEnumerable<EventData>> ReceiveAsync(int maxCount)
		{
			return ReceiveAsync(maxCount, OperationTimeout);
		}

		public Task<IEnumerable<EventData>> ReceiveAsync(int maxCount, TimeSpan waitTime)
		{
			ThrowIfReceiverNull("Receive");
			IEnumerable<EventData> messages;
			return TaskHelpers.FromAsync((AsyncCallback callback, object o) => InternalReceiver.BeginTryReceiveEventData(null, maxCount, waitTime, callback, o), (IAsyncResult result) => (!InternalReceiver.EndTryReceiveEventData(result, out messages)) ? Enumerable.Empty<EventData>() : messages);
		}

		internal void Checkpoint(EventData data)
		{
			ThrowIfReceiverNull("Receive");
			if (data == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("data");
			}
			if (InternalReceiver.Mode == ReceiveMode.ReceiveAndDelete)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.CannotCheckpointWithCurrentConsumerGroup));
			}
			InternalReceiver.EndCheckpoint(InternalReceiver.BeginCheckpoint(null, data.DeliveryTag, null, null));
		}

		internal Task CheckpointAsync(EventData data)
		{
			ThrowIfReceiverNull("Receive");
			if (data == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("data");
			}
			if (InternalReceiver.Mode == ReceiveMode.ReceiveAndDelete)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.CannotCheckpointWithCurrentConsumerGroup));
			}
			return TaskHelpers.FromAsync((AsyncCallback callback, object o) => InternalReceiver.BeginCheckpoint(null, data.DeliveryTag, callback, o), delegate(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				InternalReceiver.EndCheckpoint(result);
			});
		}

		protected override void OnAbort()
		{
			if (InternalReceiver != null)
			{
				InternalReceiver.Abort();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnOpen(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			ThrowIfReceiverNull("Open");
			InternalReceiver.Open(timeout);
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginOpen(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			ThrowIfReceiverNull("BeginOpen");
			return InternalReceiver.BeginOpen(timeout, callback, state);
		}

		protected override void OnEndOpen(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			ThrowIfReceiverNull("EndOpen");
			InternalReceiver.EndOpen(result);
		}

		protected override void OnClose(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			if (InternalReceiver != null)
			{
				InternalReceiver.Close(timeout);
			}
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			if (InternalReceiver != null)
			{
				return InternalReceiver.BeginClose(timeout, callback, state);
			}
			return new CompletedAsyncResult(callback, state);
		}

		protected override void OnEndClose(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (InternalReceiver != null)
			{
				InternalReceiver.EndClose(result);
			}
			else
			{
				CompletedAsyncResult.End(result);
			}
		}

		internal void IncrementContinuousErrorCount()
		{
			EnsureCreateInternalReceiver();
			InternalReceiver.IncrementContinuousErrorCount();
		}

		internal void ResetContinuousErrorCount()
		{
			EnsureCreateInternalReceiver();
			InternalReceiver.ResetContinuousErrorCount();
		}

		private void ThrowIfReceiverNull(string operationName)
		{
			EnsureCreateInternalReceiver();
			if (InternalReceiver == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException(SRCore.UnsupportedOperation(operationName)));
			}
		}

		private void EnsureCreateInternalReceiver()
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			if (receiver != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			lock (base.ThisLock)
			{
				if (receiver == null)
				{
					try
					{
						ReceiveMode userRequestedMode = ReceiveMode.ReceiveAndDelete;
						receiver = MessagingFactory.CreateReceiverAsync(EventHubPath, Name, userRequestedMode, PartitionId, position, Epoch).Result;
						receiver.PrefetchCount = PrefetchCount;
						receiver.RetryPolicy = base.RetryPolicy;
						receiver.EntityType = MessagingEntityType.ConsumerGroup;
						receiver.RuntimeInfo.PartitionId = PartitionId;
						receiver.EnableReceiverRuntimeMetric = ReceiverRuntimeMetricEnabled;
						receiver.Identifier = Identifier;
						return;
					}
					catch (AggregateException ex)
					{
						throw ex.Flatten().InnerException;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private static string GetValueOrDefaultOffset(string startingOffset)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(startingOffset))
			{
				return "-1";
			}
			return startingOffset;
		}
	}
	public sealed class EventHubConsumerGroup : ClientEntity
	{
		private sealed class CreateReceiverAsyncResult : RetryAsyncResult<CreateReceiverAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly EventHubConsumerGroup owner;

			private readonly string partitionId;

			private readonly EventPosition position;

			private readonly long? epoch;

			private readonly TrackingContext trackingContext;

			private readonly bool enableReceiverRuntimeMetric;

			private readonly string receiverName;

			public EventHubReceiver Receiver { get; private set; }

			public CreateReceiverAsyncResult(EventHubConsumerGroup owner, string partitionId, EventPosition position, long? epoch, ReceiverOptions receiverOptions, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.owner = owner;
				this.partitionId = partitionId;
				this.position = position;
				this.epoch = epoch;
				trackingContext = TrackingContext.Create(Guid.NewGuid(), Path.Combine(owner.EventHubPath, owner.GroupName, partitionId));
				enableReceiverRuntimeMetric = receiverOptions?.EnableReceiverRuntimeMetric ?? this.owner.EnableReceiverRuntimeMetric;
				receiverName = receiverOptions?.Identifier;
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				int iteration = 0;
				TimeSpan iterationSleep = (owner.RetryPolicy.IsServerBusy ? RetryPolicy.ServerBusyBaseSleepTime : TimeSpan.Zero);
				if (owner.RetryPolicy.IsServerBusy && RetryPolicy.ServerBusyBaseSleepTime >= owner.OperationTimeout)
				{
					string serverBusyExceptionMessage = owner.RetryPolicy.ServerBusyExceptionMessage;
					yield return CallAsyncSleep(RemainingTime());
					Complete(new ServerBusyException(serverBusyExceptionMessage, trackingContext));
					yield break;
				}
				bool shouldRetry;
				do
				{
					shouldRetry = false;
					if (iterationSleep != TimeSpan.Zero)
					{
						yield return CallAsyncSleep(iterationSleep);
					}
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)delegate(CreateReceiverAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s)
					{
						thisPtr.Receiver = thisPtr.CreateEventHubReceiver();
						return thisPtr.Receiver.BeginOpen(t, c, s);
					}, (EndCall)delegate(CreateReceiverAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.Receiver.EndOpen(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
					if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
					{
						if (Receiver != null)
						{
							Receiver.IncrementContinuousErrorCount();
							try
							{
								Receiver.Abort();
							}
							catch (Exception ex)
							{
								if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
								{
									throw;
								}
								MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteEntityAbortFailed(trackingContext.Activity, trackingContext.TrackingId, Path.Combine(owner.GroupName, partitionId), ex.GetType().FullName, ex.Message);
							}
						}
						shouldRetry = !base.TransactionExists && owner.RetryPolicy.ShouldRetry(RemainingTime(), iteration, base.LastAsyncStepException, out iterationSleep);
						if (shouldRetry)
						{
							MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteRetryPolicyIteration(trackingContext.Activity, trackingContext.TrackingId, owner.RetryPolicy.GetType().Name, "EventHubReceiver.Open", iteration, iterationSleep.ToString(), base.LastAsyncStepException.GetType().FullName, base.LastAsyncStepException.Message);
							iteration++;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						Fx.AssertIsNotNull(Receiver, "this.Receiver is null in CallAsync before RegisterMessageClientEntity");
						owner.RegisterMessageClientEntity(Receiver);
						Receiver.ResetContinuousErrorCount();
					}
				}
				while (shouldRetry);
				Complete(base.LastAsyncStepException);
			}

			private EventHubReceiver CreateEventHubReceiver()
			{
				return new EventHubReceiver(owner.MessagingFactory, owner.EventHubPath, owner.GroupName, partitionId, position, epoch, owner.PrefetchCount, owner.PrefetchSizeInBytes, enableReceiverRuntimeMetric, receiverName);
			}
		}

		private sealed class CloseOrAbortAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<CloseOrAbortAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly EventHubConsumerGroup owner;

			private readonly bool shouldAbort;

			public CloseOrAbortAsyncResult(EventHubConsumerGroup owner, bool shouldAbort, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.owner = owner;
				this.shouldAbort = shouldAbort;
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				foreach (EventProcessorLifecycleManager dispatcher in owner.handlers.Values)
				{
					dispatcher.Faulted -= owner.OnEventProcessorLifeCycleManagerFaulted;
					yield return CallTask((Func<CloseOrAbortAsyncResult, TimeSpan, Task>)((CloseOrAbortAsyncResult AsyncResult, TimeSpan timespan) => dispatcher.UnregisterProcessorAsync(CloseReason.Shutdown)), ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
				}
				owner.handlers.Clear();
				if (shouldAbort)
				{
					owner.ClientEntityManager.Abort();
					yield break;
				}
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((CloseOrAbortAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.owner.ClientEntityManager.BeginClose(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(CloseOrAbortAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					thisPtr.owner.ClientEntityManager.EndClose(r);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
			}
		}

		public const string DefaultGroupName = "$Default";

		public const string StartOfStream = "-1";

		public const string EndOfStream = "@latest";

		private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<Lease, EventProcessorLifecycleManager> handlers = new ConcurrentDictionary<Lease, EventProcessorLifecycleManager>();

		private int prefetchCount;

		private long? prefetchSizeInBytes;

		public int PrefetchCount
		{
			get
			{
				return prefetchCount;
			}
			set
			{
				EventHubClient.ValidateEventHubPrefetchCount(value);
				prefetchCount = value;
				if (prefetchCount > 0)
				{
					prefetchSizeInBytes = null;
				}
			}
		}

		public long? PrefetchSizeInBytes
		{
			get
			{
				return prefetchSizeInBytes;
			}
			set
			{
				EventHubClient.ValidateEventHubPrefetchBySizeInBytes(value);
				prefetchSizeInBytes = value;
				if (prefetchSizeInBytes.HasValue)
				{
					prefetchCount = 0;
				}
			}
		}

		public string EventHubPath { get; private set; }

		public string GroupName { get; private set; }

		public bool EnableReceiverRuntimeMetric { get; set; }

		internal MessageSender InternalSender { get; set; }

		internal MessagingFactory MessagingFactory { get; private set; }

		internal override TimeSpan OperationTimeout => MessagingFactory.OperationTimeout;

		public event EventHandler<EventProcessorFaultedEventArgs> EventProcessorLifeCycleManagerFaulted;

		internal EventHubConsumerGroup(MessagingFactory messagingFactory, string eventHubPath, string groupName, int prefetchCount, long? prefetchSizeInBytes)
		{
			MessagingFactory = messagingFactory;
			base.ClientEntityManager = new MessageClientEntityManager();
			handlers = new ConcurrentDictionary<Lease, EventProcessorLifecycleManager>();
			EventHubPath = eventHubPath;
			GroupName = groupName;
			base.RetryPolicy = messagingFactory.RetryPolicy.Clone();
			if (prefetchSizeInBytes.HasValue)
			{
				PrefetchSizeInBytes = prefetchSizeInBytes;
			}
			else
			{
				PrefetchCount = prefetchCount;
			}
			EnableReceiverRuntimeMetric = messagingFactory.GetSettings().AmqpTransportSettings.EnableReceiverRuntimeMetric;
		}

		public void RegisterProcessor<T>(Lease lease, ICheckpointManager checkpointManager) where T : IEventProcessor

			RegisterProcessor<T>(lease, checkpointManager, EventProcessorOptions.DefaultOptions);
		}

		{
			RegisterProcessorAsync<T>(lease, checkpointManager, processorOptions).Wait();
		}

		public Task RegisterProcessorAsync<T>(Lease lease, ICheckpointManager checkpointManager) where T : IEventProcessor
		{
			return RegisterProcessorAsync<T>(lease, checkpointManager, EventProcessorOptions.DefaultOptions);
		}

		public Task RegisterProcessorAsync<T>(Lease lease, ICheckpointManager checkpointManager, EventProcessorOptions processorOptions) where T : IEventProcessor
		{
			IEventProcessorFactory eventProcessorFactory = new DefaultEventProcessorFactory<T>();
			return RegisterProcessorFactoryAsync(lease, checkpointManager, eventProcessorFactory, processorOptions);
		}

		public void RegisterProcessorFactory(Lease lease, ICheckpointManager checkpointManager, IEventProcessorFactory eventProcessorFactory)
		{
			RegisterProcessorFactory(lease, checkpointManager, eventProcessorFactory, EventProcessorOptions.DefaultOptions);
		}

		public void RegisterProcessorFactory(Lease lease, ICheckpointManager checkpointManager, IEventProcessorFactory eventProcessorFactory, EventProcessorOptions processorOptions)
		{
			RegisterProcessorFactoryAsync(lease, checkpointManager, eventProcessorFactory, processorOptions).Wait();
		}

		public Task RegisterProcessorFactoryAsync(Lease lease, ICheckpointManager checkpointManager, IEventProcessorFactory eventProcessorFactory)
		{
			return RegisterProcessorFactoryAsync(lease, checkpointManager, eventProcessorFactory, EventProcessorOptions.DefaultOptions);
		}

		public Task RegisterProcessorFactoryAsync(Lease lease, ICheckpointManager checkpointManager, IEventProcessorFactory eventProcessorFactory, EventProcessorOptions processorOptions)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			if (lease == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("lease");
			}
			if (checkpointManager == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("checkpointManager");
			}
			if (eventProcessorFactory == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("eventProcessorFactory");
			}
			if (processorOptions == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("processorOptions");
			}
			EventProcessorLifecycleManager value = null;
			if (handlers.TryGetValue(lease, out value))
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString(Resources.EventProcessorAlreadyRegistered, lease.PartitionId)));
			}
			value = new EventProcessorLifecycleManager(this, lease, checkpointManager, processorOptions);
			if (handlers.TryAdd(lease, value))
			{
				value.SafeAddFaulted(OnEventProcessorLifeCycleManagerFaulted);
				return value.RegisterProcessorFactoryAsync(eventProcessorFactory);
			}
			return TaskHelpers.FromResult<object>();
		}

		public void UnregisterProcessor(Lease lease, CloseReason reason)
		{
			EventProcessorLifecycleManager value = null;
			if (handlers.TryRemove(lease, out value))
			{
				value.Faulted -= OnEventProcessorLifeCycleManagerFaulted;
				value.UnregisterProcessorAsync(reason).Wait();
			}
		}

		public Task UnregisterProcessorAsync(Lease lease, CloseReason reason)
		{
			EventProcessorLifecycleManager value = null;
			if (handlers.TryRemove(lease, out value))
			{
				value.Faulted -= OnEventProcessorLifeCycleManagerFaulted;
				return value.UnregisterProcessorAsync(reason);
			}
			return TaskHelpers.FromResult<object>();
		}

		protected override void OnAbort()
		{
			CloseOrAbortAsyncResult closeOrAbortAsyncResult = new CloseOrAbortAsyncResult(this, shouldAbort: true, TimeSpan.MaxValue, null, null);
			closeOrAbortAsyncResult.RunSynchronously();
		}

		protected override void OnClose(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			CloseOrAbortAsyncResult closeOrAbortAsyncResult = new CloseOrAbortAsyncResult(this, shouldAbort: false, timeout, null, null);
			closeOrAbortAsyncResult.RunSynchronously();
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			CloseOrAbortAsyncResult closeOrAbortAsyncResult = new CloseOrAbortAsyncResult(this, shouldAbort: false, timeout, callback, state);
			return closeOrAbortAsyncResult.Start();
		}

		protected override void OnEndClose(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			AsyncResult<CloseOrAbortAsyncResult>.End(result);
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginOpen(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new CompletedAsyncResult(callback, state);
		}

		protected override void OnEndOpen(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			CompletedAsyncResult.End(result);
		}

		private void RegisterMessageClientEntity(ClientEntity child)
		{
			base.ClientEntityManager.Add(child);
		}

		private void OnEventProcessorLifeCycleManagerFaulted(object sender, EventArgs args)
		{
			EventProcessorLifecycleManager eventProcessorLifecycleManager = (EventProcessorLifecycleManager)sender;
			string partitionId = eventProcessorLifecycleManager.PartitionId;
			string leaseToken = eventProcessorLifecycleManager.LeaseToken;
			IOThreadScheduler.ScheduleCallbackNoFlow(delegate
			{
				try
				{
					EventHandler<EventProcessorFaultedEventArgs> eventHandler = this.EventProcessorLifeCycleManagerFaulted;
					if (eventHandler != null)
					{
						EventProcessorFaultedEventArgs e = new EventProcessorFaultedEventArgs(partitionId, leaseToken);
						eventHandler(this, e);
					}
				}
				catch (Exception exception)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
					{
						throw;
					}
				}
			}, null);
		}
	}

			RemoveHeader(headers);
			MessageHeader header = MessageHeader.CreateHeader("FaultInjectionInfo", "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2011/06/servicebus", this, serializer);
			headers.Add(header);
		}

		{
			Stream stream = null;

				stream = new MemoryStream();
				serializer.WriteObject(stream, this);
				stream.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
				using StreamReader streamReader = new StreamReader(stream);
				stream = null;
				string value = streamReader.ReadToEnd();
				request.Headers.Add("FaultInjectionInfo", value);
			}
			finally

				stream?.Dispose();
			}
		}

			brokeredMessage.Properties.Add("FaultInjectionInfo", memoryStream);
		}

		{
			using MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();

			memoryStream.Flush();
			memoryStream.Position = 0L;
			data.Properties.Add("FaultInjectionInfo", SerializationUtilities.ConvertByteArrayToNativeValue(1, PropertyValueType.Stream, memoryStream.ToArray()));
		}

		public bool IsFaultDue(DateTime utcNow)
		{
			if (ValidAfter <= utcNow)
			{
				return utcNow <= ValidBefore;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool TryGetHeader(WebHeaderCollection headers, out FaultInjectionInfo value)
		{
			if (headers == null)
			{
				value = null;
				return false;
			}
			string text = headers["FaultInjectionInfo"];
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
			{
				using (XmlReader reader = new XmlTextReader(new StringReader(text)))
				{
					value = (FaultInjectionInfo)serializer.ReadObject(reader);
				}
				return true;
			}
			value = null;
			return false;
		}

		public static void RemoveHeader(WebHeaderCollection headers)
		{
			string value = headers["FaultInjectionInfo"];
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
			{
				headers.Remove("FaultInjectionInfo");
			}
		}

		public static bool TryGetHeader(MessageHeaders headers, out FaultInjectionInfo value)
		{
			int num = headers.FindHeader("FaultInjectionInfo", "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2011/06/servicebus");
			if (num != -1)
			{
				value = headers.GetHeader<FaultInjectionInfo>(num, serializer);
				return true;
			}
			value = null;
			return false;
		}

		public static void RemoveHeader(MessageHeaders headers)
		{
			int num = headers.FindHeader("FaultInjectionInfo", "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2011/06/servicebus");
			if (num != -1)
			{
				headers.RemoveAt(num);
			}
		}

		public static bool TryGetProperty(IDictionary<string, object> properties, out FaultInjectionInfo value)
		{
			if (properties != null && properties.TryGetValue("FaultInjectionInfo", out var value2))
			{
				byte[] array = value2 as byte[];
				MemoryStream memoryStream = value2 as MemoryStream;
				if (array != null)

					using (MemoryStream stream = new MemoryStream(array))

					}
					return true;
				}
				if (memoryStream != null)
				{
					value = dataContractBinarySerializer.ReadObject(memoryStream) as FaultInjectionInfo;
					return true;
				}

	public sealed class EventData : IDisposable, IReadOnlyIndicator
	{
		private readonly AmqpMessage receivedAmqpMessage;

		private readonly object messageLock = new object();

		private volatile Stream bodyStream;

		private volatile IDictionary<string, object> properties;

		private volatile bool isDeserializedUserProperties;

		private AmqpMessage serializedAmqpMessage;

		private bool disposed;

		private bool ownsBodyStream;

		private int getBodyCalled;

		private long sizeInBytesCalled;

		public long SerializedSizeInBytes
		{
			get
			{
				if (serializedAmqpMessage == null)
				{
					lock (messageLock)
					{
						if (serializedAmqpMessage == null)
						{
							serializedAmqpMessage = ToAmqpMessage(setBodyCalled: false);
						}
					}
				}
				return serializedAmqpMessage.SerializedMessageSize;
			}
		}

		public string Offset
		{
			get
			{
				return GetSystemProperty<string>("Offset");
			}
			internal set
			{
				SystemProperties["Offset"] = value;
			}
		}

		public string PartitionKey
		{
			get
			{
				return GetSystemProperty<string>("PartitionKey");
			}
			set
			{
				SystemProperties["PartitionKey"] = value;
			}
		}

		public long SequenceNumber
		{
			get
			{
				return GetSystemProperty<long>("SequenceNumber");
			}
			internal set
			{
				SystemProperties["SequenceNumber"] = value;
			}
		}

		public DateTime EnqueuedTimeUtc
		{
			get
			{
				return GetSystemProperty<DateTime>("EnqueuedTimeUtc");
			}
			internal set
			{
				SystemProperties["EnqueuedTimeUtc"] = value;
			}
		}

		public IDictionary<string, object> Properties
		{
			get
			{
				UpdateUserPropertiesForReceive();
				return properties;
			}
		}

		public IDictionary<string, object> SystemProperties { get; private set; }

		bool IReadOnlyIndicator.IsReadOnly => Interlocked.Read(ref sizeInBytesCalled) == 1;

		internal Stream BodyStream => bodyStream;

		internal AmqpMessage SerializedAmqpMessage
		{
			get
			{
				lock (messageLock)
				{
					return serializedAmqpMessage;
				}
			}
		}

		internal string Publisher
		{
			get
			{
				return GetSystemProperty<string>("Publisher");
			}
			set
			{
				SystemProperties["Publisher"] = value;
			}
		}

		internal ArraySegment<byte> DeliveryTag { get; set; }

		internal long LastSequenceNumber { get; set; }

		internal string LastEnqueuedOffset { get; set; }

		internal DateTime LastEnqueuedTime { get; set; }

		internal DateTime RetrievalTime { get; set; }

		public EventData()
		{
			isDeserializedUserProperties = true;
			properties = new ReadOnlyDictionary45<string, object>(new Dictionary<string, object>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase), this);
			SystemProperties = new ReadOnlyDictionary45<string, object>(new Dictionary<string, object>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase), this);
			InitializeWithStream(Stream.Null, ownsStream: true);
			serializedAmqpMessage = null;
		}

		public EventData(Stream stream)
			: this()
		{
			if (stream != null)
			{
				InitializeWithStream(stream, ownsStream: false);
			}
		}

		public EventData(byte[] byteArray)
			: this()
		{
			if (byteArray == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("byteArray");
			}
			InitializeWithStream(new BufferListStream(new ArraySegment<byte>[1]
			{
				new ArraySegment<byte>(byteArray, 0, byteArray.Length)
			}), ownsStream: true);
		}

		public EventData(IList<ArraySegment<byte>> arraySegments)
			: this(new BufferListStream(arraySegments))
		{
			ownsBodyStream = true;
		}

		public EventData(object content, XmlObjectSerializer serializer)
			: this()
		{
			if (content == null)
			{
				InitializeWithStream(Stream.Null, ownsStream: true);
				return;
			}
			if (content.GetType().IsSubclassOf(typeof(Stream)) && serializer == null)
			{
				InitializeWithStream((Stream)content, ownsStream: false);
				return;
			}
			if (serializer == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("serializer");
			}
			MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			serializer.WriteObject(memoryStream, content);
			memoryStream.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
			InitializeWithStream(memoryStream, ownsStream: true);
		}

		internal EventData(AmqpMessage amqpMessage, bool ownMessage)
			: this()
		{
			if (amqpMessage == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("amqpMessage");
			}
			isDeserializedUserProperties = false;
			receivedAmqpMessage = amqpMessage;
			AmqpMessageConverter.UpdateEventDataHeaderAndProperties(receivedAmqpMessage, this, updateAllProperties: false);
			Stream stream = amqpMessage.BodyStream;
			InitializeWithStream(stream, ownMessage);
		}

		internal EventData(Stream stream, bool ownStream)
			: this(stream)
		{
			ownsBodyStream = ownStream;
		}

		public EventData Clone()
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			if (serializedAmqpMessage != null)
			{
				return new EventData(serializedAmqpMessage, ownMessage: false);
			}
			EventData eventData = new EventData();
			if (bodyStream != null)
			{
				eventData = new EventData(CloneStream(bodyStream))
				{
					ownsBodyStream = true
				};
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, object> systemProperty in SystemProperties)
			{
				eventData.SystemProperties.Add(systemProperty);
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, object> property in Properties)
			{
				eventData.Properties.Add(property);
			}
			return eventData;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
		}

		public Stream GetBodyStream()
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			SetGetBodyCalled();
			if (bodyStream != null)
			{
				return bodyStream;
			}
			return Stream.Null;
		}

		public byte[] GetBytes()
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			if (bodyStream == null)
			{
				return new byte[0];
			}
			if (bodyStream is BufferListStream amqpStream)
			{
				return ReadFromBufferListStream(amqpStream);
			}
			if (!bodyStream.CanSeek)
			{
				SetGetBodyCalled();
			}
			return ReadFullStream(bodyStream);
		}

		internal void UpdateUserPropertiesForReceive()
		{
			if (isDeserializedUserProperties || receivedAmqpMessage == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			lock (messageLock)
			{
				if (isDeserializedUserProperties || receivedAmqpMessage == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				SectionFlag sections = receivedAmqpMessage.Sections;
				if ((sections & SectionFlag.ApplicationProperties) != 0)
				{
					foreach (KeyValuePair<string, object> item in receivedAmqpMessage.ApplicationProperties.Map)
					{
						if (AmqpMessageConverter.TryGetNetObjectFromAmqpObject(item.Value, MappingType.ApplicationProperty, out var netObject))
						{
							properties[item.Key.ToString()] = netObject;
						}
					}
				}
				isDeserializedUserProperties = true;
			}
		}

		internal AmqpMessage ToAmqpMessage(bool setBodyCalled = true)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			if (serializedAmqpMessage == null)
			{
				lock (messageLock)
				{
					if (serializedAmqpMessage == null)
					{
						if (setBodyCalled)
						{
							SetGetBodyCalled();
						}
						SetSizeInBytesCalled();
						AmqpMessage message = ((bodyStream == null) ? AmqpMessage.Create() : AmqpMessage.Create(bodyStream, ownStream: false));
						PopulateAmqpMessageForSend(message);
						serializedAmqpMessage = message;
					}
				}
			}
			return serializedAmqpMessage;
		}

		internal void ResetGetBodyCalled()
		{
			Interlocked.Exchange(ref getBodyCalled, 0);
			if (bodyStream != null && bodyStream.CanSeek)
			{
				bodyStream.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
			}
		}

		private void SetGetBodyCalled()
		{
			if (Interlocked.Exchange(ref getBodyCalled, 1) == 1)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.MessageBodyConsumed));
			}
		}

		private void SetSizeInBytesCalled()
		{
			Interlocked.Exchange(ref sizeInBytesCalled, 1L);
		}

		private void InitializeWithStream(Stream stream, bool ownsStream)
		{
			bodyStream = stream;
			ownsBodyStream = ownsStream;
		}

		internal static byte[] ReadFullStream(Stream inputStream)
		{
			using MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			try
			{
				if (inputStream.CanSeek)
				{
					inputStream.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
				}
				inputStream.CopyTo(memoryStream);
				return memoryStream.ToArray();
			}
			finally
			{
				if (inputStream.CanSeek)
				{
					inputStream.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
				}
			}
		}

		internal static byte[] ReadFromBufferListStream(BufferListStream amqpStream)
		{
			amqpStream.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
			try
			{
				byte[] array = new byte[amqpStream.Length];
				amqpStream.Read(array, 0, array.Length);
				return array;
			}
			finally
			{
				amqpStream.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
			}
		}

		private static Stream CloneStream(Stream originalStream)
		{
			if (originalStream != null)
			{
				if (originalStream is BufferListStream bufferListStream)
				{
					return (Stream)bufferListStream.Clone();
				}
				if (originalStream is MemoryStream memoryStream)
				{
					return new MemoryStream(memoryStream.ToArray(), 0, (int)memoryStream.Length, writable: false, publiclyVisible: true);
				}
				if (originalStream is ICloneable cloneable)
				{
					return (Stream)cloneable.Clone();
				}
				if (originalStream.Length == 0L)
				{
					return Stream.Null;
				}
				throw Fx.AssertAndThrow("Does not support cloning of Stream Type: " + originalStream.GetType());
			}
			return Stream.Null;
		}

		private BrokeredMessage PopulateSbmpMessageForSend(BrokeredMessage message)
		{
			message.PartitionKey = PartitionKey;
			message.Publisher = Publisher;
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, object> property in Properties)
			{
				message.Properties.Add(property);
			}
			return message;
		}

		private void PopulateAmqpMessageForSend(AmqpMessage message)
		{
			AmqpMessageConverter.UpdateAmqpMessageHeadersAndProperties(message, this);
		}

		private T GetSystemProperty<T>(string key)
		{
			if (SystemProperties.ContainsKey(key))
			{
				return (T)SystemProperties[key];
			}
			return default(T);
		}

		private void ThrowIfDisposed()
		{
			if (disposed)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ObjectDisposed(SRClient.EventDataDisposed);
			}
		}

		private void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposed)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (disposing)
			{
				if (serializedAmqpMessage != null)
				{
					serializedAmqpMessage.Dispose();
				}
				if (receivedAmqpMessage != null)
				{
					receivedAmqpMessage.Dispose();
				}
				if (bodyStream != null && ownsBodyStream)
				{
					bodyStream.Dispose();
				}
			}
			disposed = true;
		}
	}
	public abstract class MessageSessionAsyncHandler : IMessageSessionAsyncHandler

			return OnCloseSessionAsync(session);
		}

		Task IMessageSessionAsyncHandler.OnSessionLostAsync(Exception exception)

			return OnSessionLostAsync(exception);
		}

		protected abstract Task OnMessageAsync(MessageSession session, BrokeredMessage message);

		protected virtual Task OnCloseSessionAsync(MessageSession session)
		{
			return CompletedTask.Default;
		}

		protected virtual Task OnSessionLostAsync(Exception exception)

			return CompletedTask.Default;
		}
	}

		}

		}
