	internal static class MessageSessionHandlerFactory
	{
		private sealed class DefaultMessageSessionHandlerFactory : IMessageSessionAsyncHandlerFactory
		{
			private readonly Func<object> factoryFunction;

			private readonly bool wrapSyncHandler;

			public DefaultMessageSessionHandlerFactory(Func<object> factoryFunction, bool wrapSyncHandler)
			{
				this.factoryFunction = factoryFunction;
				this.wrapSyncHandler = wrapSyncHandler;
			}

			public IMessageSessionAsyncHandler CreateInstance(MessageSession session, BrokeredMessage message)
			{
				if (wrapSyncHandler)
				{
					IMessageSessionHandler syncHandler = (IMessageSessionHandler)factoryFunction();
					return new SyncHandlerAdapter(syncHandler, isDefaultFactory: true);
				}
				return (IMessageSessionAsyncHandler)factoryFunction();
			}

			public void DisposeInstance(IMessageSessionAsyncHandler handler)
			{
				if (handler is IDisposable disposable)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		private sealed class SyncFactoryAdapter : IMessageSessionAsyncHandlerFactory
		{
			private readonly IMessageSessionHandlerFactory syncFactory;

			public SyncFactoryAdapter(IMessageSessionHandlerFactory syncFactory)
			{
				this.syncFactory = syncFactory;
			}

			IMessageSessionAsyncHandler IMessageSessionAsyncHandlerFactory.CreateInstance(MessageSession session, BrokeredMessage message)
			{
				IMessageSessionHandler syncHandler = syncFactory.CreateInstance(session, message);
				return new SyncHandlerAdapter(syncHandler, isDefaultFactory: false);
			}

			void IMessageSessionAsyncHandlerFactory.DisposeInstance(IMessageSessionAsyncHandler handler)
			{
				SyncHandlerAdapter syncHandlerAdapter = (SyncHandlerAdapter)handler;
				syncFactory.DisposeInstance(syncHandlerAdapter.SyncHandler);
			}
		}

		private sealed class SyncHandlerAdapter : IMessageSessionAsyncHandler, IDisposable
		{
			private readonly IMessageSessionHandler syncHandler;

			private readonly bool isDefaultFactory;

			public IMessageSessionHandler SyncHandler => syncHandler;

			public SyncHandlerAdapter(IMessageSessionHandler syncHandler, bool isDefaultFactory)
			{
				this.syncHandler = syncHandler;
				this.isDefaultFactory = isDefaultFactory;
			}

			Task IMessageSessionAsyncHandler.OnMessageAsync(MessageSession session, BrokeredMessage message)
			{
				return Task.Factory.StartNew(delegate
				{
					syncHandler.OnMessage(session, message);
				});
			}

			Task IMessageSessionAsyncHandler.OnCloseSessionAsync(MessageSession session)
			{
				return Task.Factory.StartNew(delegate
				{
					syncHandler.OnCloseSession(session);
				});
			}

			Task IMessageSessionAsyncHandler.OnSessionLostAsync(Exception e)
			{
				return Task.Factory.StartNew(delegate
				{
					syncHandler.OnSessionLost(e);
				});
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
				if (isDefaultFactory && syncHandler is IDisposable disposable)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		public static IMessageSessionAsyncHandlerFactory Create(IMessageSessionHandlerFactory factory)
		{
			return new SyncFactoryAdapter(factory);
		}

		public static IMessageSessionAsyncHandlerFactory Create(Type handlerType)
		{
			if (handlerType == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("handlerType");
			}
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			Type[] interfaces = handlerType.GetInterfaces();
			foreach (Type type in interfaces)
			{
				if (type == typeof(IMessageSessionAsyncHandler))
				{
					flag2 = true;
				}
				else if (type == typeof(IMessageSessionHandler))
				{
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			if (!flag2 && !flag)
			{
				string message = SRClient.SessionHandlerMissingInterfaces(handlerType.Name, typeof(IMessageSessionAsyncHandler).Name, typeof(IMessageSessionHandler).Name);
				throw new ArgumentException(message, "handlerType");
			}
			ConstructorInfo constructor = handlerType.GetConstructor(Type.EmptyTypes);
			if (constructor == null)
			{
				string message2 = SRClient.SessionHandlerDoesNotHaveDefaultConstructor(handlerType.Name);
				throw new ArgumentException(message2, "handlerType");
			}
			Func<object> factoryFunction = Expression.Lambda<Func<object>>(Expression.New(constructor), Array.Empty<ParameterExpression>()).Compile();
			return new DefaultMessageSessionHandlerFactory(factoryFunction, !flag2);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class MessageSessionPump : CommunicationObject
	{
		private sealed class OpenAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<OpenAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly MessageSessionPump owner;

			private MessageSession initialSession;

			public OpenAsyncResult(MessageSessionPump owner, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.owner = owner;
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				while (true)
				{
					if (RemainingTime() <= TimeSpan.Zero)
					{
						Complete(new TimeoutException(SRCore.TimeoutOnOperation(base.OriginalTimeout)));
						yield break;
					}
					yield return CallTask((Func<OpenAsyncResult, TimeSpan, Task>)async delegate(OpenAsyncResult result, TimeSpan span)
					{
						result.initialSession = await result.owner.entity.AcceptMessageSessionAsync(ServerWaitTimeForFirstAcceptMessageSessionCall);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
					if (base.LastAsyncStepException == null || base.LastAsyncStepException is TimeoutException)
					{
						break;
					}
					if (IsNonTransientException(base.LastAsyncStepException))
					{
						Complete(base.LastAsyncStepException);
						yield break;
					}
					TimeSpan timeSpan = TimeSpan.FromTicks(Math.Min(RemainingTime().Ticks, SleepAmount.Ticks));
					if (timeSpan > TimeSpan.Zero)
					{
						yield return CallAsyncSleep(timeSpan);
					}
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < owner.options.MaxPendingAcceptSessionCalls; i++)
				{
					if (initialSession != null && i == 0)
					{
						if (!owner.instanceSemaphore.TryEnter())
						{
							Fx.AssertAndFailFastService("Bug: MessageSessionSemaphore failed to enter the instanceSemaphore for the first call.");
							yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((OpenAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.owner.instanceSemaphore.BeginEnter(c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(OpenAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
							{
								thisPtr.owner.instanceSemaphore.EndEnter(r);
							}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
						}
						owner.ScheduleSesssionPump(initialSession);
					}
					else
					{
						owner.ScheduleSesssionPump(null);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private sealed class CloseOrAbortAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<CloseOrAbortAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly MessageSessionPump owner;

			private readonly bool shouldAbort;

			public CloseOrAbortAsyncResult(MessageSessionPump owner, bool shouldAbort, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.owner = owner;
				this.shouldAbort = shouldAbort;
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				owner.pumpCancellationTokenSource.Cancel();
				if (!shouldAbort && owner.options.WaitForPendingOperationsOnClose)
				{
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((CloseOrAbortAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.owner.operationTracker.BeginWaitPendingOperations(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(CloseOrAbortAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.owner.operationTracker.EndWaitPendingOperations(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
				}
			}
		}

		private sealed class PumpSessionAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<PumpSessionAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly MessageSessionPump owner;

			private readonly TrackingContext trackingContext;

			private MessageSession session;

			private CancellationToken cancellationToken;

			public PumpSessionAsyncResult(TrackingContext trackingContext, MessageSessionPump owner, MessageSession initialSession, CancellationToken cancellationToken, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(TimeSpan.MaxValue, callback, state)
			{
				this.trackingContext = trackingContext;
				this.owner = owner;
				session = initialSession;
				this.cancellationToken = cancellationToken;
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				do
				{
					bool shouldReleaseInstanceSemaphore = false;
					try
					{
						if (session == null)
						{
							if (!owner.instanceSemaphore.TryEnter())
							{
								yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((PumpSessionAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.owner.instanceSemaphore.BeginEnter(c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(PumpSessionAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
								{
									thisPtr.owner.instanceSemaphore.EndEnter(r);
								}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
							}
							shouldReleaseInstanceSemaphore = true;
							try
							{
								if (!owner.acceptSemaphore.TryEnter())
								{
									yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((PumpSessionAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.owner.acceptSemaphore.BeginEnter(c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(PumpSessionAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
									{
										thisPtr.owner.acceptSemaphore.EndEnter(r);
									}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
								}
								session = null;
								yield return CallTask((Func<PumpSessionAsyncResult, TimeSpan, Task>)async delegate(PumpSessionAsyncResult result, TimeSpan span)
								{
									result.session = await result.owner.Entity.AcceptMessageSessionAsync();
								}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
								if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
								{
									Exception acceptSessionException = base.LastAsyncStepException;
									MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
									{
										MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.MessageSessionPumpAcceptSessionFailed(trackingContext.Activity, trackingContext.TrackingId, trackingContext.SystemTracker, acceptSessionException.ToStringSlim());
									});
									if (!IndicatesEntityClosed(acceptSessionException))
									{
										if (IsNonTransientException(acceptSessionException))
										{
											yield return CallAsyncSleep(NonTransientExceptionSleepAmount, cancellationToken);
										}
										if (!(acceptSessionException is TimeoutException))
										{
											owner.RaiseExceptionRecieved(acceptSessionException, "AcceptMessageSession");
										}
										continue;
									}
									break;
								}
							}
							finally
							{
								owner.acceptSemaphore.Exit();
							}
						}
						owner.ScheduleMessagePump(session);
						shouldReleaseInstanceSemaphore = false;
					}
					finally
					{
						PumpSessionAsyncResult pumpSessionAsyncResult = this;
						pumpSessionAsyncResult.session = null;
						if (shouldReleaseInstanceSemaphore)
						{
							pumpSessionAsyncResult.owner.instanceSemaphore.Exit();
						}
					}
				}
				while (owner.IsOpenningOrOpened() && !owner.entity.IsClosed && !cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested);
			}

			private static bool IndicatesEntityClosed(Exception e)
			{
				return e is OperationCanceledException;
			}
		}

		private sealed class PumpMessageAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<PumpMessageAsyncResult>
		{
			private sealed class BatchCompleteAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<BatchCompleteAsyncResult>
			{
				private static readonly TimeSpan completionBufferWaitTime = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(500.0);

				private readonly PumpMessageAsyncResult owner;

				private readonly List<Guid> lockTokens;

				private bool exceptionHandled;

				public PumpMessageAsyncResult Owner => owner;

				public BatchCompleteAsyncResult(PumpMessageAsyncResult owner, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
					: base(timeout, callback, state)
				{
					this.owner = owner;
					lockTokens = new List<Guid>();
				}

				protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
				{
					yield return CallAsyncSleep(completionBufferWaitTime);
					if (owner.cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested || owner.session.IsClosedOrClosing || owner.owner.IsDisposed || !owner.owner.IsOpenningOrOpened())
					{
						yield break;
					}
					Owner.owner.operationTracker.IncrementOperationCount();
					lock (owner.completionList)
					{
						lockTokens.AddRange(owner.completionList);
						owner.completionList.Clear();
					}
					if (lockTokens.Count == 0)
					{
						Owner.owner.operationTracker.DecrementOperationCount();
						yield break;
					}
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((BatchCompleteAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.owner.session.BeginComplete(thisPtr.lockTokens, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(BatchCompleteAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.owner.session.EndComplete(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
					try
					{
						if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
						{
							Exception e = base.LastAsyncStepException;
							yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((BatchCompleteAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => new HandleExceptionAsyncResult(thisPtr.owner, "Complete", e, closeSession: true, t, c, s).Start()), (EndCall)delegate(BatchCompleteAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
							{
								thisPtr.exceptionHandled = AsyncResult<HandleExceptionAsyncResult>.End(r).Handled;
							}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
							if (!exceptionHandled)
							{
								Complete(e);
							}
						}
					}
					finally
					{
						Owner.owner.operationTracker.DecrementOperationCount();
					}
				}
			}

			private sealed class HandleExceptionAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<HandleExceptionAsyncResult>
			{
				private static readonly Action<Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult, Exception> StaticFinally = Finally;

				private readonly PumpMessageAsyncResult owner;

				private readonly TrackingContext trackingContext;

				private readonly MessageSession session;

				private readonly string action;

				private readonly Exception exception;

				private readonly MessageSessionPump pump;

				private readonly CancellationTokenSource renewCancellationTokenSource;

				private readonly IMessageSessionAsyncHandler sessionHandler;

				private readonly bool closeSession;

				public bool Handled { get; private set; }

				public HandleExceptionAsyncResult(PumpMessageAsyncResult owner, string action, Exception exception, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
					: this(owner, action, exception, closeSession: false, timeout, callback, state)
				{
				}

				public HandleExceptionAsyncResult(PumpMessageAsyncResult owner, string action, Exception exception, bool closeSession, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
					: base(timeout, callback, state)
				{
					this.action = action;
					this.exception = exception;
					this.owner = owner;
					trackingContext = owner.trackingContext;
					session = owner.session;
					pump = owner.owner;
					renewCancellationTokenSource = owner.renewCancellationTokenSource;
					sessionHandler = owner.sessionHandler;
					this.closeSession = closeSession;
					base.OnCompleting = (Action<Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult, Exception>)Delegate.Combine(base.OnCompleting, StaticFinally);
				}

				protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.MessageSessionPumpActionFailed(trackingContext.Activity, trackingContext.TrackingId, trackingContext.SystemTracker, session.SessionId, action, exception.ToString());
					});
					if (closeSession || !pump.IsOpenningOrOpened())
					{
						if (!session.IsClosed)
						{
							yield return CallTask((Func<HandleExceptionAsyncResult, TimeSpan, Task>)((HandleExceptionAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t) => thisPtr.session.CloseAsync()), ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
							if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
							{
								Exception closeException = base.LastAsyncStepException;
								MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
								{
									MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.MessageSessionPumpSessionCloseFailed(trackingContext.Activity, trackingContext.TrackingId, trackingContext.SystemTracker, session.SessionId, closeException.ToString());
								});
								pump.RaiseExceptionRecieved(closeException, "CloseSession");
							}
						}
						if (!pump.IsOpenningOrOpened())
						{
							Handled = false;
							yield break;
						}
					}
					pump.RaiseExceptionRecieved(exception, action);
					if (closeSession || IndicatesSessionLost(exception) || IsNonTransientException(exception))
					{
						try
						{
							if (!renewCancellationTokenSource.IsCancellationRequested)
							{
								renewCancellationTokenSource.Cancel();
							}
						}
						catch (ObjectDisposedException)
						{
						}
						yield return CallTask((Func<HandleExceptionAsyncResult, TimeSpan, Task>)((HandleExceptionAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t) => thisPtr.sessionHandler.OnSessionLostAsync(exception)), ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
						if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
						{
							owner.ReportUserException(base.LastAsyncStepException, "OnSessionLostAsync");
						}
						Handled = false;
					}
					else
					{
						Handled = true;
					}
				}

				private static void Finally(Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult ar, Exception e)
				{
					if (e != null)
					{
						Fx.AssertAndFailFastService(e.ToString());
					}
				}
			}

			private static readonly AsyncCallback StaticOnRenewSessionLockCompleted = OnRenewSessionLockCompleted;

			private static readonly Action<object> StaticOnUserCallTimedOut = OnUserCallTimedOut;

			private static readonly Action<object> StaticOnPumpCancelled = OnPumpCancelled;

			private static readonly TimeSpan MessageCompletionOperationTimeout = Constants.DefaultOperationTimeout;

			private readonly MessageSessionPump owner;

			private readonly TrackingContext trackingContext;

			private readonly MessageSession session;

			private readonly CancellationTokenSource renewCancellationTokenSource;

			private readonly IOThreadTimer userCallTimer;

			private readonly List<Guid> completionList;

			private BrokeredMessage message;

			private IMessageSessionAsyncHandler sessionHandler;

			private CancellationToken cancellationToken;

			private CancellationTokenRegistration cancellationTokenRegistration;

			private bool exceptionHandled;

			private volatile bool completionInProgress;

			public PumpMessageAsyncResult(MessageSessionPump owner, TrackingContext trackingContext, MessageSession session, CancellationToken cancellationToken, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(TimeSpan.MaxValue, callback, state)
			{
				this.owner = owner;
				this.trackingContext = trackingContext;
				this.session = session;
				renewCancellationTokenSource = new CancellationTokenSource();
				this.cancellationToken = cancellationToken;
				userCallTimer = new IOThreadTimer(StaticOnUserCallTimedOut, this, isTypicallyCanceledShortlyAfterBeingSet: true);
				completionList = new List<Guid>();
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				try
				{
					try
					{
						cancellationTokenRegistration = cancellationToken.Register(StaticOnPumpCancelled, this);
					}
					catch (ObjectDisposedException)
					{
						renewCancellationTokenSource.Cancel();
						yield break;
					}
					if (owner.renewSupported)
					{
						ScheduleRenew();
					}
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((PumpMessageAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.session.BeginReceive(TimeSpan.Zero, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(PumpMessageAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.message = thisPtr.session.EndReceive(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
					if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
					{
						Exception receiveException = base.LastAsyncStepException;
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
						{
							MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.MessageSessionPumpFirstReceiveFailed(trackingContext.Activity, trackingContext.TrackingId, trackingContext.SystemTracker, session.SessionId, receiveException.ToString());
						});
						if (!owner.IsOpenningOrOpened())
						{
							goto IL_0608;
						}
						owner.RaiseExceptionRecieved(receiveException, "Receive");
					}
					if (message == null)
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
						{
							MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.MessageSessionPumpFirstReceiveReturnedNoMessage(trackingContext.Activity, trackingContext.TrackingId, trackingContext.SystemTracker, session.SessionId);
						});
					}
					else
					{
						RunUserCode(delegate(PumpMessageAsyncResult thisPtr)
						{
							thisPtr.sessionHandler = thisPtr.owner.handlerFactory.CreateInstance(thisPtr.session, thisPtr.message);
						}, "FactoryCreateInstance");
						if (sessionHandler == null)
						{
							yield return CallAsyncSleep(SleepAmount);
						}
						else
						{
							do
							{
								userCallTimer.Set(owner.options.AutoRenewTimeout);
								try
								{
									yield return CallTask((Func<PumpMessageAsyncResult, TimeSpan, Task>)((PumpMessageAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t) => thisPtr.sessionHandler.OnMessageAsync(thisPtr.session, thisPtr.message)), ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
								}
								finally
								{
									userCallTimer.Cancel();
								}
								if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
								{
									ReportUserException(base.LastAsyncStepException, "OnMessageAsync");
									if (!session.IsClosedOrClosing)
									{
										yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((PumpMessageAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.message.BeginAbandon(c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(PumpMessageAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
										{
											thisPtr.message.EndAbandon(r);
										}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
										if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
										{
											Exception e = base.LastAsyncStepException;
											yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((PumpMessageAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => new HandleExceptionAsyncResult(thisPtr, "Abandon", e, closeSession: true, t, c, s).Start()), (EndCall)delegate(PumpMessageAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
											{
												thisPtr.exceptionHandled = AsyncResult<HandleExceptionAsyncResult>.End(r).Handled;
											}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
											if (!exceptionHandled)
											{
												yield break;
											}
										}
									}
								}
								else if (owner.options.AutoComplete && !session.IsClosedOrClosing)
								{
									ScheduleMessageCompletion(this, message);
								}
								if (!owner.IsOpenningOrOpened() || owner.entity.IsClosed || session.IsClosedOrClosing)
								{
									break;
								}
								Timestamp timestamp = Timestamp.Now;
								if (message != null)
								{
									message.Dispose();
									message = null;
								}
								do
								{
									yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((PumpMessageAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.session.BeginReceive(thisPtr.owner.options.MessageWaitTimeout, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(PumpMessageAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
									{
										thisPtr.message = thisPtr.session.EndReceive(r);
									}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
									if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
									{
										Exception e2 = base.LastAsyncStepException;
										yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((PumpMessageAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => new HandleExceptionAsyncResult(thisPtr, "Receive", e2, t, c, s).Start()), (EndCall)delegate(PumpMessageAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
										{
											thisPtr.exceptionHandled = AsyncResult<HandleExceptionAsyncResult>.End(r).Handled;
										}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
										if (!exceptionHandled)
										{
											yield break;
										}
										TimeSpan timeSpan = TimeSpan.FromTicks(Math.Min((owner.options.MessageWaitTimeout - timestamp.Elapsed).Ticks, SleepAmount.Ticks));
										if (timeSpan > TimeSpan.Zero)
										{
											yield return CallAsyncSleep(timeSpan, cancellationToken);
										}
									}
									else if (message != null)
									{
										break;
									}
								}
								while (timestamp.Elapsed < owner.options.MessageWaitTimeout);
								if (message != null)
								{
									continue;
								}
								userCallTimer.Set(owner.options.AutoRenewTimeout);
								try
								{
									yield return CallTask((Func<PumpMessageAsyncResult, TimeSpan, Task>)((PumpMessageAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t) => thisPtr.sessionHandler.OnCloseSessionAsync(thisPtr.session)), ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
								}
								finally
								{
									userCallTimer.Cancel();
								}
								if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
								{
									ReportUserException(base.LastAsyncStepException, "OnCloseSessionAsync");
								}
								break;
							}
							while (owner.IsOpenningOrOpened() && !session.IsClosed && !cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested);
						}
					}
					goto IL_0608;
					IL_0608:
					if (session.IsClosed)
					{
						yield break;
					}
					yield return CallTask((Func<PumpMessageAsyncResult, TimeSpan, Task>)((PumpMessageAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t) => thisPtr.session.CloseAsync()), ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
					if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
					{
						Exception closeException = base.LastAsyncStepException;
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
						{
							MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.MessageSessionPumpSessionCloseFailed(trackingContext.Activity, trackingContext.TrackingId, trackingContext.SystemTracker, session.SessionId, closeException.ToString());
						});
						owner.RaiseExceptionRecieved(closeException, "SessionClose");
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					PumpMessageAsyncResult pumpMessageAsyncResult = this;
					try
					{
						if (pumpMessageAsyncResult.message != null)
						{
							pumpMessageAsyncResult.message.Dispose();
							pumpMessageAsyncResult.message = null;
						}
						if (!pumpMessageAsyncResult.session.IsClosed)
						{
							pumpMessageAsyncResult.session.Abort();
						}
						pumpMessageAsyncResult.RunUserCode(delegate(PumpMessageAsyncResult thisPtr)
						{
							thisPtr.owner.handlerFactory.DisposeInstance(thisPtr.sessionHandler);
						}, "FactoryDisposeInstance");
					}
					finally
					{
						pumpMessageAsyncResult.owner.instanceSemaphore.Exit();
						pumpMessageAsyncResult.cancellationTokenRegistration.Dispose();
						pumpMessageAsyncResult.renewCancellationTokenSource.Cancel();
						pumpMessageAsyncResult.renewCancellationTokenSource.Dispose();
					}
				}
			}

			private static void OnPumpCancelled(object state)
			{
				PumpMessageAsyncResult pumpMessageAsyncResult = (PumpMessageAsyncResult)state;
				try
				{
					pumpMessageAsyncResult.renewCancellationTokenSource.Cancel();
				}
				catch (ObjectDisposedException)
				{
				}
			}

			private static void OnUserCallTimedOut(object state)
			{
				PumpMessageAsyncResult thisPtr = (PumpMessageAsyncResult)state;
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.MessageSessionPumpUserCallTimedOut(thisPtr.trackingContext.Activity, thisPtr.trackingContext.TrackingId, thisPtr.trackingContext.SystemTracker, thisPtr.session.SessionId, thisPtr.owner.options.AutoRenewTimeout.ToString());
				});
				thisPtr.renewCancellationTokenSource.Cancel();
			}

			private static void OnRenewSessionLockCompleted(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				PumpMessageAsyncResult thisPtr = (PumpMessageAsyncResult)result.AsyncState;
				try
				{
					AsyncResult<RenewSessionLockAsyncResult>.End(result);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					Exception e = ex;
					if (Fx.IsFatal(e))
					{
						throw;
					}
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.MessageSessionPumpRenewEndFailed(thisPtr.trackingContext.Activity, thisPtr.trackingContext.TrackingId, thisPtr.trackingContext.SystemTracker, thisPtr.session.SessionId, e.ToString());
					});
				}
			}

			private static void ScheduleMessageCompletion(PumpMessageAsyncResult result, BrokeredMessage messageToComplete)
			{
				if (result.owner.IsDisposed || result.session.IsClosedOrClosing || result.cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested || !result.owner.IsOpenningOrOpened())
				{
					return;
				}
				BatchCompleteAsyncResult batchCompleteAsyncResult = null;
				lock (result.completionList)
				{
					if (messageToComplete != null)
					{
						result.completionList.Add(messageToComplete.LockToken);
					}
					if (!result.completionInProgress && result.completionList.Count > 0)
					{
						result.completionInProgress = true;
						batchCompleteAsyncResult = new BatchCompleteAsyncResult(result, MessageCompletionOperationTimeout, OnCompleteMessageCompletion, null);
					}
				}
				if (batchCompleteAsyncResult != null)
				{
					IOThreadScheduler.ScheduleCallbackNoFlow(delegate(object o)
					{
						((BatchCompleteAsyncResult)o).Start();
					}, batchCompleteAsyncResult);
				}
			}

			private static void OnCompleteMessageCompletion(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				BatchCompleteAsyncResult batchCompleteAsyncResult = (BatchCompleteAsyncResult)result;
				PumpMessageAsyncResult pumpMessageAsyncResult = batchCompleteAsyncResult.Owner;
				lock (pumpMessageAsyncResult.completionList)
				{
					try
					{
						AsyncResult<BatchCompleteAsyncResult>.End(batchCompleteAsyncResult);
					}
					catch (Exception ex)
					{
						if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
						{
							throw;
						}
					}
					finally
					{
						pumpMessageAsyncResult.completionInProgress = false;
					}
				}
				ScheduleMessageCompletion(pumpMessageAsyncResult, null);
			}

			private void RunUserCode(Action<PumpMessageAsyncResult> action, string actionName)
			{
				try
				{
					userCallTimer.Set(owner.options.AutoRenewTimeout);
					action(this);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
					{
						throw;
					}
					ReportUserException(ex, actionName);
				}
				finally
				{
					userCallTimer.Cancel();
				}
			}

			private void ReportUserException(Exception exception, string action)
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.MessageSessionPumpUserException(trackingContext.Activity, trackingContext.TrackingId, trackingContext.SystemTracker, session.SessionId, exception.ToString());
				});
				owner.RaiseExceptionRecieved(exception, action);
			}

			private void ScheduleRenew()
			{
				try
				{
					RenewSessionLockAsyncResult renewSessionLockAsyncResult = new RenewSessionLockAsyncResult(trackingContext, owner, session, renewCancellationTokenSource.Token, StaticOnRenewSessionLockCompleted, this);
					renewSessionLockAsyncResult.Start();
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					Exception e = ex;
					if (Fx.IsFatal(e))
					{
						throw;
					}
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.MessageSessionPumpRenewBeginFailed(trackingContext.Activity, trackingContext.TrackingId, trackingContext.SystemTracker, session.SessionId, e.ToString());
					});
				}
			}
		}

		private sealed class RenewSessionLockAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<RenewSessionLockAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly TrackingContext trackingContext;

			private readonly MessageSessionPump pump;

			private readonly MessageSession session;

			private CancellationToken cancellationToken;

			public RenewSessionLockAsyncResult(TrackingContext trackingContext, MessageSessionPump pump, MessageSession session, CancellationToken cancellationToken, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(TimeSpan.MaxValue, callback, state)
			{
				this.trackingContext = trackingContext;
				this.pump = pump;
				this.session = session;
				this.cancellationToken = cancellationToken;
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				while (pump.IsOpenningOrOpened() && !cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
				{
					TimeSpan amountToSleep = MessagingUtilities.CalculateRenewAfterDuration(session.LockedUntilUtc);
					yield return CallAsyncSleep(amountToSleep, cancellationToken);
					if (cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
					{
						break;
					}
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((RenewSessionLockAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.session.BeginRenewLock(c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(RenewSessionLockAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.session.EndRenewLock(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
					if (base.LastAsyncStepException == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					Exception e = base.LastAsyncStepException;
					if (e is NotSupportedException)
					{
						pump.renewSupported = false;
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
						{
							MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.MessageSessionPumpRenewNotSupported(trackingContext.Activity, trackingContext.TrackingId, trackingContext.SystemTracker, session.SessionId, e.ToString());
						});
						break;
					}
					if (IndicatesSessionLost(e))
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
						{
							MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.MessageSessionPumpRenewDetectedSessionLost(trackingContext.Activity, trackingContext.TrackingId, trackingContext.SystemTracker, session.SessionId, e.ToString());
						});
						break;
					}
					if (!session.IsClosedOrClosing)
					{
						pump.RaiseExceptionRecieved(e, "RenewLock");
					}
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.MessageSessionPumpRenewFailed(trackingContext.Activity, trackingContext.TrackingId, trackingContext.SystemTracker, session.SessionId, e.ToString());
					});
				}
			}
		}

		private static readonly TimeSpan SleepAmount = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1.0);

		private static readonly TimeSpan NonTransientExceptionSleepAmount = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(60.0);

		private static readonly TimeSpan ServerWaitTimeForFirstAcceptMessageSessionCall = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5.0);

		private static readonly AsyncCallback StaticOnPumpSessionCompleted = OnPumpSessionCompleted;

		private static readonly AsyncCallback StaticOnPumpMessageCompleted = OnPumpMessageCompleted;

		private readonly IMessageSessionEntity entity;

		private readonly PendingOperationTracker operationTracker;

		private readonly IMessageSessionAsyncHandlerFactory handlerFactory;

		private readonly SessionHandlerOptions options;

		private readonly AsyncSemaphore acceptSemaphore;

		private readonly AsyncSemaphore instanceSemaphore;

		private readonly CancellationTokenSource pumpCancellationTokenSource;

		private readonly TrackingContext trackingContext;

		private bool renewSupported;

		public IMessageSessionEntity Entity => entity;

		protected override TimeSpan DefaultCloseTimeout => TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1.0);

		protected override TimeSpan DefaultOpenTimeout => TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1.0);

		public MessageSessionPump(string entityPath, IMessageSessionEntity entity, IMessageSessionAsyncHandlerFactory handlerFactory, SessionHandlerOptions options)
		{
			trackingContext = TrackingContext.Create(Guid.NewGuid(), entityPath);
			this.entity = entity;
			this.handlerFactory = handlerFactory;
			this.options = options ?? new SessionHandlerOptions();
			operationTracker = new PendingOperationTracker();
			acceptSemaphore = new AsyncSemaphore(this.options.MaxPendingAcceptSessionCalls);
			instanceSemaphore = new AsyncSemaphore(this.options.MaxConcurrentSessions);
			pumpCancellationTokenSource = new CancellationTokenSource();
			renewSupported = true;
			if (this.entity.PrefetchCount == 0)
			{
				this.entity.PrefetchCount = Constants.DefaultClientPumpPrefetchCount;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnOpen(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			OpenAsyncResult openAsyncResult = new OpenAsyncResult(this, timeout, null, null);
			openAsyncResult.RunSynchronously();
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginOpen(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			OpenAsyncResult openAsyncResult = new OpenAsyncResult(this, timeout, callback, state);
			return openAsyncResult.Start();
		}

		protected override void OnEndOpen(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			AsyncResult<OpenAsyncResult>.End(result);
		}

		protected override void OnAbort()
		{
			CloseOrAbortAsyncResult closeOrAbortAsyncResult = new CloseOrAbortAsyncResult(this, shouldAbort: true, TimeSpan.MaxValue, null, null);
			closeOrAbortAsyncResult.RunSynchronously();
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			CloseOrAbortAsyncResult closeOrAbortAsyncResult = new CloseOrAbortAsyncResult(this, shouldAbort: false, timeout, callback, state);
			return closeOrAbortAsyncResult.Start();
		}

		protected override void OnEndClose(IAsyncResult ar)
		{
			AsyncResult<CloseOrAbortAsyncResult>.End(ar);
		}

		protected override void OnClose(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			CloseOrAbortAsyncResult closeOrAbortAsyncResult = new CloseOrAbortAsyncResult(this, shouldAbort: false, timeout, null, null);
			closeOrAbortAsyncResult.RunSynchronously();
		}

		protected override void OnClosed()
		{
			pumpCancellationTokenSource.Dispose();
			base.OnClosed();
		}

		private static bool IndicatesSessionLost(Exception exception)
		{
			if (!(exception is OperationCanceledException))
			{
				return exception is SessionLockLostException;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool IsNonTransientException(Exception e)
		{
			if (e is MessagingException ex)
			{
				return !ex.IsTransient;
			}
			return !(e is TimeoutException);
		}

		private bool IsOpenningOrOpened()
		{
			CommunicationState communicationState = base.State;
			if (communicationState != CommunicationState.Opening)
			{
				return communicationState == CommunicationState.Opened;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void ScheduleSesssionPump(MessageSession prefetchedSession)
		{
			try
			{
				BeginPumpSession(prefetchedSession, pumpCancellationTokenSource.Token, StaticOnPumpSessionCompleted, this);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				Exception e = ex;
				if (Fx.IsFatal(e))
				{
					throw;
				}
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.MessageSessionPumpUnexpectedException(trackingContext.Activity, trackingContext.TrackingId, trackingContext.SystemTracker, string.Empty, e.ToString());
				});
				throw;
			}
		}

		private IAsyncResult BeginPumpSession(MessageSession initialSession, CancellationToken cancellationToken, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			operationTracker.IncrementOperationCount();
			try
			{
				PumpSessionAsyncResult pumpSessionAsyncResult = new PumpSessionAsyncResult(trackingContext, this, initialSession, cancellationToken, callback, state);
				return pumpSessionAsyncResult.Start();
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				operationTracker.DecrementOperationCount();
				throw;
			}
		}

		private void EndPumpSession(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			try
			{
				AsyncResult<PumpSessionAsyncResult>.End(result);
			}
			finally
			{
				operationTracker.DecrementOperationCount();
			}
		}

		private void ScheduleMessagePump(MessageSession session)
		{
			try
			{
				BeginPumpMessage(session, pumpCancellationTokenSource.Token, StaticOnPumpMessageCompleted, this);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				Exception e = ex;
				if (Fx.IsFatal(e))
				{
					throw;
				}
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.MessageSessionPumpUnexpectedException(trackingContext.Activity, trackingContext.TrackingId, trackingContext.SystemTracker, session.SessionId, e.ToString());
				});
				throw;
			}
		}

		private IAsyncResult BeginPumpMessage(MessageSession session, CancellationToken token, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			operationTracker.IncrementOperationCount();
			try
			{
				PumpMessageAsyncResult pumpMessageAsyncResult = new PumpMessageAsyncResult(this, trackingContext, session, token, callback, state);
				return pumpMessageAsyncResult.Start();
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				operationTracker.DecrementOperationCount();
				throw;
			}
		}

		private void EndPumpMessage(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			try
			{
				AsyncResult<PumpMessageAsyncResult>.End(result);
			}
			finally
			{
				operationTracker.DecrementOperationCount();
			}
		}

		private static void OnPumpMessageCompleted(IAsyncResult ar)
		{
			MessageSessionPump thisPtr = (MessageSessionPump)ar.AsyncState;
			try
			{
				thisPtr.EndPumpMessage(ar);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				Exception e = ex;
				if (Fx.IsFatal(e))
				{
					throw;
				}
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.MessageSessionPumpUnexpectedException(thisPtr.trackingContext.Activity, thisPtr.trackingContext.TrackingId, thisPtr.trackingContext.SystemTracker, string.Empty, e.ToString());
				});
				throw;
			}
		}

		private static void OnPumpSessionCompleted(IAsyncResult ar)
		{
			MessageSessionPump thisPtr = (MessageSessionPump)ar.AsyncState;
			try
			{
				thisPtr.EndPumpSession(ar);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				Exception e = ex;
				if (Fx.IsFatal(e))
				{
					throw;
				}
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.MessageSessionPumpUnexpectedException(thisPtr.trackingContext.Activity, thisPtr.trackingContext.TrackingId, thisPtr.trackingContext.SystemTracker, string.Empty, e.ToString());
				});
				throw;
			}
		}

		}

	internal sealed class MessageSessionPumpHost
	{
		private sealed class RegisterSessionHandlerFactoryAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<RegisterSessionHandlerFactoryAsyncResult>
		{
			private static readonly Action<Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult, Exception> OnFinally = Finally;

			private readonly MessageSessionPumpHost owner;

			private readonly IMessageSessionAsyncHandlerFactory factory;

			private readonly SessionHandlerOptions options;

			private bool ownsRegistration;

			public RegisterSessionHandlerFactoryAsyncResult(MessageSessionPumpHost owner, IMessageSessionAsyncHandlerFactory factory, SessionHandlerOptions options, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(TimeSpan.MaxValue, callback, state)
			{
				this.owner = owner;
				this.factory = factory;
				this.options = options;
				base.OnCompleting = (Action<Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult, Exception>)Delegate.Combine(base.OnCompleting, OnFinally);
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				lock (owner.ThisLock)
				{
					if (owner.markedForClosed)
					{
						throw new OperationCanceledException(SRClient.MessageEntityDisposed);
					}
					if (owner.pump != null)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.SessionHandlerAlreadyRegistered);
					}
					ownsRegistration = true;
					owner.pump = new MessageSessionPump(owner.entityName, owner.entity, factory, options);
				}
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((RegisterSessionHandlerFactoryAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.owner.pump.BeginOpen(c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(RegisterSessionHandlerFactoryAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					thisPtr.owner.pump.EndOpen(r);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
			}

			private static void Finally(Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult asyncResult, Exception exception)
			{
				RegisterSessionHandlerFactoryAsyncResult registerSessionHandlerFactoryAsyncResult = (RegisterSessionHandlerFactoryAsyncResult)asyncResult;
				if (exception != null && registerSessionHandlerFactoryAsyncResult.ownsRegistration && registerSessionHandlerFactoryAsyncResult.owner.pump != null)
				{
					registerSessionHandlerFactoryAsyncResult.owner.pump.Abort();
					lock (registerSessionHandlerFactoryAsyncResult.owner.ThisLock)
					{
						registerSessionHandlerFactoryAsyncResult.owner.pump = null;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private sealed class CloseOrAbortAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<CloseOrAbortAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly MessageSessionPumpHost owner;

			private readonly bool shouldAbort;

			private MessageSessionPump pumpToClose;

			public CloseOrAbortAsyncResult(MessageSessionPumpHost owner, bool shouldAbort, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.owner = owner;
				this.shouldAbort = shouldAbort;
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				lock (base.ThisLock)
				{
					owner.markedForClosed = true;
					pumpToClose = owner.pump;
				}
				if (pumpToClose == null)
				{
					yield break;
				}
				if (shouldAbort)
				{
					pumpToClose.Abort();
					yield break;
				}
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((CloseOrAbortAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.pumpToClose.BeginClose(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(CloseOrAbortAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					thisPtr.pumpToClose.EndClose(r);
				}, (Call)delegate(CloseOrAbortAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t)
				{
					thisPtr.pumpToClose.Close(t);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
			}
		}

		private readonly object syncRoot;

		private readonly string entityName;

		private readonly IMessageSessionEntity entity;

		private bool markedForClosed;

		private MessageSessionPump pump;

		private object ThisLock => syncRoot;

		public MessageSessionPumpHost(object syncRoot, string entityName, IMessageSessionEntity entity)
		{
			this.syncRoot = syncRoot;
			this.entityName = entityName;
			this.entity = entity;
		}

		public void Abort()
		{
			CloseOrAbortAsyncResult closeOrAbortAsyncResult = new CloseOrAbortAsyncResult(this, shouldAbort: true, TimeSpan.MaxValue, null, null);
			closeOrAbortAsyncResult.RunSynchronously();
		}

		public void Close(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			CloseOrAbortAsyncResult closeOrAbortAsyncResult = new CloseOrAbortAsyncResult(this, shouldAbort: false, timeout, null, null);
			closeOrAbortAsyncResult.RunSynchronously();
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{

			return closeOrAbortAsyncResult.Start();
		}

		public void EndClose(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			AsyncResult<CloseOrAbortAsyncResult>.End(result);
		}

	public sealed class OnShardMessageOptions
	{

			set

			}
		}

		internal ClientEntity MessageClientEntity { get; set; }

		internal TimeSpan ReceiveTimeOut { get; set; }

		public event EventHandler<ExceptionReceivedEventArgs> ExceptionReceived;

		public OnShardMessageOptions()

		}

		}

	public class PartitionContext : ICheckpointer
	{
		private readonly AutoResetEvent checkpointing;

		private readonly ICheckpointManager checkpointManager;

		private long lastCheckpointedSequenceNumber;

		public string EventHubPath { get; set; }

		public string ConsumerGroupName { get; set; }

		public Lease Lease { get; set; }

		public ReceiverRuntimeInfo RuntimeInfo { get; private set; }

		internal string Offset { get; set; }

		internal long SequenceNumber { get; set; }

		public PartitionContext()
		{
			checkpointing = new AutoResetEvent(initialState: true);
			RuntimeInfo = new ReceiverRuntimeInfo();
		}

		internal PartitionContext(ICheckpointManager checkpointManager)
			: this()
		{
			this.checkpointManager = checkpointManager;
		}

		public Task CheckpointAsync()
		{
			return PerformCheckpointAsync(SequenceNumber, Offset);
		}

		public Task CheckpointAsync(EventData data)
		{
			if (data == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("data");
			}
			if (data.SequenceNumber > SequenceNumber)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("sequenceNumber");
			}
			return PerformCheckpointAsync(data.SequenceNumber, data.Offset);
		}

		private Task PerformCheckpointAsync(long sequenceNumber, string offset)
		{
			if (InterlockedExchangeIfGreaterThanOrEqual(ref lastCheckpointedSequenceNumber, sequenceNumber))
			{
				try
				{
					checkpointing.WaitOne();
					if (InterlockedExchangeIfGreaterThanOrEqual(ref lastCheckpointedSequenceNumber, sequenceNumber))
					{
						return checkpointManager.CheckpointAsync(Lease, offset, sequenceNumber).Then(delegate
						{
							Lease.SequenceNumber = sequenceNumber;
							Lease.Offset = offset;
							return CompletedTask.Default;
						});
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					checkpointing.Set();
				}
			}
			throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("offset");
		}

		private static bool InterlockedExchangeIfGreaterThanOrEqual(ref long location, long newValue)
		{
			long num;
			do
			{
				num = location;
				if (num > newValue)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			while (Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref location, newValue, num) != num);
			return true;
		}
	}
	internal sealed class EventProcessorLifecycleManager : ClientEntity
	{
		private sealed class EventProcessorInitializeAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<EventProcessorInitializeAsyncResult>
		{
			private static readonly Action<Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult, Exception> OnFinallyDelegate = OnFinally;

			private readonly TrackingContext trackingContext;

			private readonly EventProcessorLifecycleManager lifeCycleManager;

			private readonly Lease lease;

			private readonly string partitionId;

			private readonly string startingOffset;

			private readonly long epoch;

			private EventHubReceiver receiver;

			private PartitionContext partitionContext;

			public EventProcessorInitializeAsyncResult(EventProcessorLifecycleManager lifeCycleManager, Lease lease, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(TimeSpan.MaxValue, callback, state)
			{
				this.lifeCycleManager = lifeCycleManager;
				this.lease = lease;
				trackingContext = TrackingContext.Create(Guid.NewGuid(), lease.PartitionId);
				partitionId = lease.PartitionId;
				startingOffset = lease.Offset;
				epoch = lease.Epoch;
				base.OnCompleting = (Action<Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult, Exception>)Delegate.Combine(base.OnCompleting, OnFinallyDelegate);
				Start();
			}

			public static IAsyncResult Begin(EventProcessorLifecycleManager lifeCycleManager, Lease lease, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{
				return new EventProcessorInitializeAsyncResult(lifeCycleManager, lease, callback, state);
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				Func<Task<EventHubReceiver>> createReceiverFunc = null;
				if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(startingOffset))
				{
					object obj = lifeCycleManager.processorOptions.InitialOffsetProvider?.Invoke(lease.PartitionId);
					if (obj == null)
					{
						createReceiverFunc = () => lifeCycleManager.eventHubConsumer.CreateReceiverAsync(partitionId, "-1", epoch);
					}
					else
					{
						string stringOffset = obj as string;
						if (stringOffset != null)
						{
							createReceiverFunc = () => lifeCycleManager.eventHubConsumer.CreateReceiverAsync(partitionId, stringOffset, epoch);
						}
						else
						{
							DateTime? dateOffset = obj as DateTime?;
							if (!dateOffset.HasValue)
							{
								throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.InitialOffsetProviderReturnTypeNotSupported(obj.GetType().ToString())));
							}
							createReceiverFunc = () => lifeCycleManager.eventHubConsumer.CreateReceiverAsync(partitionId, dateOffset.Value, epoch);
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					createReceiverFunc = () => lifeCycleManager.eventHubConsumer.CreateReceiverAsync(partitionId, startingOffset, epoch);
				}
				yield return CallTask((Func<EventProcessorInitializeAsyncResult, TimeSpan, Task>)((EventProcessorInitializeAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t) => createReceiverFunc().Then(delegate(EventHubReceiver receiver)
				{
					thisPtr.partitionContext = thisPtr.lifeCycleManager.InitializeManager(receiver);
					thisPtr.receiver = receiver;
					return thisPtr.lifeCycleManager.processor.OpenAsync(thisPtr.partitionContext);
				})), ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
				TaskCompletionSource<object> pumpTcs = new TaskCompletionSource<object>();
				try
				{
					EventDataPumpAsyncResult.Begin(lifeCycleManager, receiver, partitionContext, delegate
					{
						pumpTcs.TrySetResult(null);
					}, null);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					Environment.FailFast(ex.ToString());
				}
				lifeCycleManager.dispatchTask = pumpTcs.Task;
			}

			private static void OnFinally(Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult asyncResult, Exception exception)
			{
				EventProcessorInitializeAsyncResult eventProcessorInitializeAsyncResult = (EventProcessorInitializeAsyncResult)asyncResult;
				if (exception != null)
				{
					eventProcessorInitializeAsyncResult.lifeCycleManager.RaiseExceptionReceivedEvent(exception, "Open");
				}
			}
		}

		private sealed class EventDataPumpAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<EventDataPumpAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly TrackingContext trackingContext;

			private readonly EventProcessorLifecycleManager lifeCycleManager;

			private readonly EventHubReceiver receiver;

			private readonly PartitionContext context;

			private IEnumerable<EventData> messages;

			public EventDataPumpAsyncResult(EventProcessorLifecycleManager lifeCycleManager, EventHubReceiver receiver, PartitionContext context, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(TimeSpan.MaxValue, callback, state)
			{
				this.context = context;
				this.lifeCycleManager = lifeCycleManager;
				this.receiver = receiver;
				trackingContext = TrackingContext.Create(Guid.NewGuid(), this.receiver.Name);
				Start();
			}

			public static IAsyncResult Begin(EventProcessorLifecycleManager lifeCycleManager, EventHubReceiver receiver, PartitionContext context, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{
				return new EventDataPumpAsyncResult(lifeCycleManager, receiver, context, callback, state);
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				while (lifeCycleManager.isStarted == 1 && receiver.IsOpened)
				{
					messages = Enumerable.Empty<EventData>();
					yield return CallTask((Func<EventDataPumpAsyncResult, TimeSpan, Task>)((EventDataPumpAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t) => thisPtr.receiver.ReceiveAsync(lifeCycleManager.processorOptions.MaxBatchSize, thisPtr.lifeCycleManager.processorOptions.ReceiveTimeOut).Then(delegate(IEnumerable<EventData> m)
					{
						if (m != null && m.Any())
						{
							thisPtr.messages = m;
						}
						return TaskHelpers.FromResult<object>();
					})), ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
					if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
						{
							MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.MessageReceivePumpReceiveException(trackingContext.Activity, trackingContext.TrackingId, trackingContext.SystemTracker, base.LastAsyncStepException.ToString());
						});
						lifeCycleManager.RaiseExceptionReceivedEvent(base.LastAsyncStepException, "Receive");
						if (base.LastAsyncStepException is ReceiverDisconnectedException)
						{
							lifeCycleManager.Fault(base.LastAsyncStepException);
							if (Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref lifeCycleManager.isStarted, 0, 1) == 1)
							{
								yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((EventDataPumpAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => EventProcessorShutdownAsyncResult.Begin(thisPtr.lifeCycleManager, thisPtr.receiver, thisPtr.lifeCycleManager.processor, thisPtr.context, CloseReason.LeaseLost, null, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(EventDataPumpAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
								{
									AsyncResult<EventProcessorShutdownAsyncResult>.End(r);
								}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
							}
							continue;
						}
						if (ShouldBackoff(base.LastAsyncStepException, out var amount))
						{
							MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
							{
								MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.MessageReceivePumpBackoff(trackingContext.Activity, trackingContext.TrackingId, trackingContext.SystemTracker, (int)ServerBusyExceptionBackoffAmount.TotalMilliseconds, base.LastAsyncStepException.ToString());
							});
							yield return CallAsyncSleep(amount);
						}
					}
					if (!lifeCycleManager.processorOptions.InvokeProcessorAfterReceiveTimeout && (messages == null || !messages.Any()))
					{
						continue;
					}
					Stopwatch perfWatch = Stopwatch.StartNew();
					int batchSize = 0;
					try
					{
						yield return CallTask((Func<EventDataPumpAsyncResult, TimeSpan, Task>)delegate
						{
							if (messages != null && messages.Any())
							{
								batchSize = messages.Count();
								EventData eventData = messages.Last();
								if (eventData != null)
								{
									context.Offset = eventData.Offset;
									context.SequenceNumber = eventData.SequenceNumber;
									if (lifeCycleManager.processorOptions.EnableReceiverRuntimeMetric)
									{
										context.RuntimeInfo.LastSequenceNumber = eventData.LastSequenceNumber;
										context.RuntimeInfo.LastEnqueuedOffset = eventData.LastEnqueuedOffset;
										context.RuntimeInfo.LastEnqueuedTimeUtc = eventData.LastEnqueuedTime;
										context.RuntimeInfo.RetrievalTime = eventData.RetrievalTime;
										context.RuntimeInfo.PartitionId = lifeCycleManager.PartitionId;
									}
								}
							}
							return lifeCycleManager.processor.ProcessEventsAsync(context, messages);
						}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
						if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
						{
							MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
							{
								MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.MessageReceivePumpUserCallbackException(trackingContext.Activity, trackingContext.TrackingId, trackingContext.SystemTracker, base.LastAsyncStepException.ToString());
							});
							lifeCycleManager.RaiseExceptionReceivedEvent(base.LastAsyncStepException, "ProcessMessages");
						}
					}
					finally
					{
						EventDataPumpAsyncResult eventDataPumpAsyncResult = this;
						perfWatch.Stop();
						MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementProcessEventsLatency(eventDataPumpAsyncResult.receiver.MessagingFactory.Address, perfWatch.ElapsedTicks);
						MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementProcessEventsBatchSize(eventDataPumpAsyncResult.receiver.MessagingFactory.Address, batchSize);
					}
				}
			}

			private static bool ShouldBackoff(Exception exception, out TimeSpan amount)
			{
				if (exception is ServerBusyException || exception is MessagingEntityNotFoundException)
				{
					amount = ServerBusyExceptionBackoffAmount;
					return true;
				}
				if (exception is MessagingException { IsTransient: not false })
				{
					amount = TimeSpan.Zero;
					return false;
				}
				amount = OtherExceptionBackoffAmount;
				return true;
			}
		}

		private sealed class EventProcessorShutdownAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<EventProcessorShutdownAsyncResult>
		{
			private static readonly Action<Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult, Exception> OnFinallyDelegate = OnFinally;

			private readonly EventProcessorLifecycleManager lifeCycleManager;

			private readonly EventHubReceiver receiver;

			private readonly IEventProcessor processor;

			private readonly PartitionContext context;

			private readonly CloseReason reason;

			private readonly Task dispatchTask;

			public EventProcessorShutdownAsyncResult(EventProcessorLifecycleManager lifeCycleManager, EventHubReceiver receiver, IEventProcessor processor, PartitionContext context, CloseReason reason, Task dispatchTask, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(TimeSpan.MaxValue, callback, state)
			{
				this.lifeCycleManager = lifeCycleManager;
				this.receiver = receiver;
				this.processor = processor;
				this.context = context;
				this.reason = reason;
				this.dispatchTask = dispatchTask;
				base.OnCompleting = (Action<Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult, Exception>)Delegate.Combine(base.OnCompleting, OnFinallyDelegate);
				Start();
			}

			public static IAsyncResult Begin(EventProcessorLifecycleManager lifeCycleManager, EventHubReceiver receiver, IEventProcessor processor, PartitionContext context, CloseReason reason, Task dispatchTask, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{
				return new EventProcessorShutdownAsyncResult(lifeCycleManager, receiver, processor, context, reason, dispatchTask, callback, state);
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				if (receiver == null)
				{
					yield break;
				}
				yield return CallTask((Func<EventProcessorShutdownAsyncResult, TimeSpan, Task>)((EventProcessorShutdownAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t) => thisPtr.receiver.CloseAsync().Then(() => (dispatchTask != null && reason != CloseReason.LeaseLost) ? dispatchTask : TaskHelpers.FromResult<object>())), ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
				if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
				{
					lifeCycleManager.RaiseExceptionReceivedEvent(base.LastAsyncStepException, "Close");
				}
				if (processor != null)
				{
					yield return CallTask((Func<EventProcessorShutdownAsyncResult, TimeSpan, Task>)((EventProcessorShutdownAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t) => thisPtr.processor.CloseAsync(thisPtr.context, thisPtr.reason)), ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
				}
			}

			private static void OnFinally(Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult asyncResult, Exception exception)
			{
				EventProcessorShutdownAsyncResult eventProcessorShutdownAsyncResult = (EventProcessorShutdownAsyncResult)asyncResult;
				if (exception != null)
				{
					eventProcessorShutdownAsyncResult.lifeCycleManager.RaiseExceptionReceivedEvent(exception, "Close");
				}
			}
		}

		private static readonly TimeSpan DefaultOperationTimeout = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1.0);

		private static readonly TimeSpan ServerBusyExceptionBackoffAmount = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10.0);

		private static readonly TimeSpan OtherExceptionBackoffAmount = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1.0);

		private readonly EventHubConsumerGroup eventHubConsumer;

		private readonly Lease lease;

		private readonly ICheckpointManager checkpointManager;

		private readonly EventProcessorOptions processorOptions;

		private readonly string partitionId;

		private readonly string leaseToken;

		private EventHubReceiver eventHubReceiver;

		private IEventProcessor processor;

		private IEventProcessorFactory processorFactory;

		private int isStarted;

		private PartitionContext context;

		private Task dispatchTask;

		public string PartitionId => partitionId;

		public string LeaseToken => leaseToken;

		internal override TimeSpan OperationTimeout => DefaultOperationTimeout;

		public EventProcessorLifecycleManager(EventHubConsumerGroup eventHubConsumer, Lease lease, ICheckpointManager checkpointManager, EventProcessorOptions processorOptions)
		{
			this.eventHubConsumer = eventHubConsumer;
			this.lease = lease;
			this.checkpointManager = checkpointManager;
			this.processorOptions = processorOptions;
			partitionId = lease.PartitionId;
			leaseToken = lease.Token;
		}

		protected override void OnAbort()
		{
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginOpen(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new CompletedAsyncResult(callback, state);
		}

		protected override void OnEndOpen(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			CompletedAsyncResult.End(result);
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new CompletedAsyncResult(callback, state);
		}

		protected override void OnEndClose(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			CompletedAsyncResult.End(result);
		}

		public Task RegisterProcessorAsync<T>() where T : IEventProcessor
		{
			IEventProcessorFactory factory = new DefaultEventProcessorFactory<T>();
			return RegisterProcessorFactoryAsync(factory);
		}

		public Task RegisterProcessorFactoryAsync(IEventProcessorFactory factory)
		{
			processorFactory = factory;
			return StartAsync();
		}

		public Task UnregisterProcessorAsync(CloseReason reason)
		{
			if (Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref isStarted, 0, 1) != 1)
			{
				return TaskHelpers.FromResult<object>();
			}
			return TaskHelpers.FromAsync((AsyncCallback c, object s) => EventProcessorShutdownAsyncResult.Begin(this, eventHubReceiver, processor, context, reason, dispatchTask, c, s), (IAsyncResult r) => AsyncResult<EventProcessorShutdownAsyncResult>.End(r));
		}

		private Task StartAsync()
		{
			if (Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref isStarted, 1, 0) != 0)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("EventHubDispatcher has already started");
			}
			return TaskHelpers.FromAsync((AsyncCallback c, object s) => EventProcessorInitializeAsyncResult.Begin(this, lease, c, s), (IAsyncResult r) => AsyncResult<EventProcessorInitializeAsyncResult>.End(r));
		}

		private PartitionContext InitializeManager(EventHubReceiver receiver)
		{
			eventHubReceiver = receiver;
			context = CreateContext();
			processor = processorFactory.CreateEventProcessor(context);
			return context;
		}

		private PartitionContext CreateContext()
		{
			return new PartitionContext(checkpointManager)
			{
				EventHubPath = eventHubConsumer.EventHubPath,
				ConsumerGroupName = eventHubConsumer.GroupName,
				Offset = lease.Offset,
				SequenceNumber = lease.SequenceNumber,
				Lease = lease
			};
		}

		private void RaiseExceptionReceivedEvent(Exception exception, string action)
		{
			try
			{
				processorOptions.RaiseExceptionReceived(processor, new ExceptionReceivedEventArgs(exception, action));
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				Environment.FailFast(ex.ToString());
			}
		}
	}

	[DataContract(Name = "ArchiveDescription", Namespace = "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2010/10/servicebus/connect")]
	internal class ArchiveDescription
	{
		private const int defaultInterval = 300;

		private const int minInterval = 60;

		private const int maxInterval = 900;

		private const int defaultSizeLimit = 104857600;

		private const int minSizeLimit = 10485760;

		private const int maxSizeLimit = 524288000;

		[DataMember(Name = "IntervalInSeconds", IsRequired = false, Order = 1003, EmitDefaultValue = false)]
		internal int? intervalInSeconds;

		[DataMember(Name = "SizeLimitInBytes", IsRequired = false, Order = 1004, EmitDefaultValue = false)]
		internal int? sizeLimitInBytes;

		[DataMember(Name = "SkipEmptyArchives", IsRequired = false, Order = 1005, EmitDefaultValue = false)]
		internal bool skipEmptyArchives;

		[DataMember(Name = "Enabled", IsRequired = true, Order = 1000, EmitDefaultValue = true)]
		public bool Enabled { get; set; }

		[DataMember(Name = "Encoding", IsRequired = true, Order = 1001, EmitDefaultValue = true)]
		public ArchiveEncoding Encoding { get; set; }

		[DataMember(Name = "Destination", IsRequired = true, Order = 1002, EmitDefaultValue = true)]
		public ArchiveDestination Destination { get; set; }

		public int IntervalInSeconds
		{
			get
			{
				return intervalInSeconds ?? 300;
			}
			set
			{
				Validate("IntervalInSeconds", 60, 900, value);
				intervalInSeconds = value;
			}
		}

		public int SizeLimitInBytes
		{
			get
			{
				return sizeLimitInBytes ?? 104857600;
			}
			set
			{
				Validate("SizeLimitInBytes", 10485760, 524288000, value);
				sizeLimitInBytes = value;
			}
		}

		public bool SkipEmptyArchives
		{
			get
			{
				return skipEmptyArchives;
			}
			set
			{
				skipEmptyArchives = value;
			}
		}

		internal bool RequiresEncryption => Destination.ContainsSecrets;

		public ArchiveDescription()
		{
			Encoding = ArchiveEncoding.Avro;
		}

		internal void Validate()
		{
			Validate("IntervalInSeconds", 60, 900, IntervalInSeconds);
			Validate("SizeLimitInBytes", 10485760, 524288000, SizeLimitInBytes);
			if (Destination == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Destination");
			}
			Destination.Validate();
		}

		internal static bool HasEqualRuntimeBehavior(ArchiveDescription a, ArchiveDescription b)
		{
			if (a == null && b == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (a == null || b == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (a.Enabled == b.Enabled && a.Encoding == b.Encoding && a.IntervalInSeconds == b.IntervalInSeconds && a.SizeLimitInBytes == b.SizeLimitInBytes && a.SkipEmptyArchives == b.SkipEmptyArchives)
			{
				return HasEqualRuntimeBehavior(a.Destination, b.Destination);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static bool HasEqualRuntimeBehavior(ArchiveDestination a, ArchiveDestination b)
		{
			if (!string.Equals(a.Name, b.Name, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, object> property in a.Properties)
			{
				if (!b.Properties.TryGetValue(property.Key, out var value) || !property.Value.Equals(value))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static void Validate(string name, int min, int max, int value)
		{
			if (value < min || value > max)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(name, value, $"Value must be between {min} and {max}");
			}
		}

		[OnDeserialized]
		private void OnDeserialized(StreamingContext context)
		{
			if (!intervalInSeconds.HasValue)
			{
				intervalInSeconds = 300;
			}
			if (!sizeLimitInBytes.HasValue)
			{
				sizeLimitInBytes = 104857600;
			}
		}
	}

	internal class EventHubContinuationToken
	{
		public bool IsValid { get; private set; }

		public string NextEventHubPartition { get; private set; }

		public string NextRowKey { get; private set; }

		public string Token { get; private set; }

		public EventHubContinuationToken(string nextPartition, string nextRowKey)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(nextPartition))
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("nextPartition");
			}
			NextEventHubPartition = nextPartition;
			NextRowKey = nextRowKey;
			Token = ToBase64UriEscapeString(nextPartition + ";" + nextRowKey);
			IsValid = true;
		}

		public EventHubContinuationToken(string continuationTokenString)
		{
			IsValid = false;
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(continuationTokenString))
			{
				IsValid = true;
				return;
			}
			string text = FromBase64UriEscapeString(continuationTokenString);
			if (text == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			string[] array = text.Split(';');
			if (array.Length == 2)
			{
				NextEventHubPartition = array[0];
				if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(array[1]))
				{
					NextRowKey = array[1];
				}
				Token = continuationTokenString;
				IsValid = true;
			}
		}

		private static string ToBase64UriEscapeString(string value)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return Uri.EscapeDataString(Convert.ToBase64String(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(value)));
		}

		private static string FromBase64UriEscapeString(string base64Value)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(base64Value))
			{
				return null;
			}
			try
			{
				return Encoding.UTF8.GetString(Convert.FromBase64String(Uri.UnescapeDataString(base64Value)));
			}
			catch (ArgumentNullException)
			{
				return null;
			}
			catch (FormatException)
			{
				return null;
			}
		}
	}
	internal static class RuntimeEntityDescriptionCache
	{
		private static readonly MemoryCache entityDescriptionCache;

		private static readonly TimeSpan cacheEntryTtl;

		private static readonly TimeSpan cacheEntryAllowToRemoveTtl;

		static RuntimeEntityDescriptionCache()
		{
			cacheEntryTtl = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(10.0);
			cacheEntryAllowToRemoveTtl = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(2.0);
			entityDescriptionCache = new MemoryCache(typeof(RuntimeEntityDescriptionCache).Name + "entityDescriptionCache", new NameValueCollection { { "CacheMemoryLimitMegabytes", "1" } });
		}

		public static bool TryGet(string entityAddress, out RuntimeEntityDescription entityDescription)
		{
			entityDescription = null;
			object obj = entityDescriptionCache.Get(entityAddress.ToUpperInvariant());
			if (obj != null)
			{
				entityDescription = ((RuntimeEntityDescriptionRecord)obj).RuntimeEntityDescription;
			}
			return entityDescription != null;
		}

		public static void CheckLastRefreshAndTryRemove(string entityAddress)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(entityAddress))
			{
				object obj = entityDescriptionCache.Get(entityAddress.ToUpperInvariant());
				if (obj != null && DateTime.UtcNow - ((RuntimeEntityDescriptionRecord)obj).RecordCreatedTimeUtc > cacheEntryAllowToRemoveTtl)
				{
					entityDescriptionCache.Remove(entityAddress.ToUpperInvariant());
				}
			}
		}

		public static void AddOrUpdate(string entityAddress, RuntimeEntityDescriptionRecord newEntityDescriptionRecord)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(entityAddress))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SRCore.ArgumentNullOrEmpty("entityAddress"));
			}
			if (newEntityDescriptionRecord == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("newEntityDescriptionRecord");
			}
			RuntimeEntityDescriptionRecord runtimeEntityDescriptionRecord = (RuntimeEntityDescriptionRecord)entityDescriptionCache.AddOrGetExisting(entityAddress.ToUpperInvariant(), newEntityDescriptionRecord, DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.Add(cacheEntryTtl));
			if (runtimeEntityDescriptionRecord != null)
			{
				runtimeEntityDescriptionRecord.RuntimeEntityDescription.EnableMessagePartitioning = newEntityDescriptionRecord.RuntimeEntityDescription.EnableMessagePartitioning;
			}
		}
	}

	public class SessionHandlerOptions
	{
		private int maxConcurrentSessions;

		private int maxPendingAcceptSessionCalls;

		private TimeSpan messageWaitTimeout;

		private TimeSpan autoRenewTimeout;

		public TimeSpan MessageWaitTimeout
		{
			get
			{
				return messageWaitTimeout;
			}
			set
			{
				TimeoutHelper.ThrowIfNegativeArgument(value, "value");
				messageWaitTimeout = value;
			}
		}

		public int MaxConcurrentSessions
		{
			get
			{
				return maxConcurrentSessions;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value <= 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("value", value, SRClient.ValueMustBePositive(value));
				}
				maxConcurrentSessions = value;
				MaxPendingAcceptSessionCalls = Math.Min(value, Environment.ProcessorCount);
			}
		}

		public bool AutoComplete { get; set; }

		public TimeSpan AutoRenewTimeout
		{
			get
			{
				return autoRenewTimeout;
			}
			set
			{
				TimeoutHelper.ThrowIfNonPositiveArgument(value, "value");
				autoRenewTimeout = value;
			}
		}

		internal int MaxPendingAcceptSessionCalls
		{
			get
			{
				return maxPendingAcceptSessionCalls;
			}
			set
			{
				if (MaxConcurrentSessions < value)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("value", value, SRClient.PropertyMustBeEqualOrLessThanOtherProperty("MaxPendingAcceptSessionCalls", "MaxConcurrentSessions"));
				}
				maxPendingAcceptSessionCalls = value;
			}
		}

		internal bool WaitForPendingOperationsOnClose { get; set; }

		public event EventHandler<ExceptionReceivedEventArgs> ExceptionReceived;

		public SessionHandlerOptions()
		{
			AutoComplete = true;
			MaxConcurrentSessions = Environment.ProcessorCount * 1000;
			MessageWaitTimeout = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1.0);
			AutoRenewTimeout = Constants.ClientPumpRenewLockTimeout;
			WaitForPendingOperationsOnClose = false;
		}

		internal void RaiseExceptionReceived(object source, ExceptionReceivedEventArgs args)
		{
			EventHandler<ExceptionReceivedEventArgs> eventHandler = this.ExceptionReceived;
			if (eventHandler != null)
			{
				try
				{
					eventHandler(source, args);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					throw Fx.AssertAndFailFastService(ex.ToString());
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public sealed class OnMessageOptions
	{
		private int maxConcurrentCalls;

		private TimeSpan autoRenewTimeout;

		public int MaxConcurrentCalls
		{
			get
			{
				return maxConcurrentCalls;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value <= 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(SRClient.MaxConcurrentCallsMustBeGreaterThanZero(value));
				}
				maxConcurrentCalls = value;
			}
		}

		public bool AutoComplete { get; set; }

		internal bool AutoRenewLock => AutoRenewTimeout > TimeSpan.Zero;

		public TimeSpan AutoRenewTimeout
		{
			get
			{
				return autoRenewTimeout;
			}
			set
			{
				TimeoutHelper.ThrowIfNegativeArgument(value, "value");
				autoRenewTimeout = value;
			}
		}

		internal ClientEntity MessageClientEntity { get; set; }

		internal TimeSpan ReceiveTimeOut { get; set; }

		public event EventHandler<ExceptionReceivedEventArgs> ExceptionReceived;

		public OnMessageOptions()
		{
			MaxConcurrentCalls = 1;
			AutoComplete = true;
			ReceiveTimeOut = Constants.DefaultOperationTimeout;
			AutoRenewTimeout = Constants.ClientPumpRenewLockTimeout;
		}

		internal void RaiseExceptionReceived(ExceptionReceivedEventArgs e)
		{
			this.ExceptionReceived?.Invoke(MessageClientEntity, e);
		}
