	internal class SendAvailabilityMessagePump
	{
		private class ProcessQueueAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<ProcessQueueAsyncResult>
		{
			private static readonly TimeSpan MinTimeToProcessLoop = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(4.0);

			private static readonly TimeSpan DefaultReadTimeout = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(2.0);

			private readonly SendAvailabilityMessagePump pump;

			private readonly MessageReceiver messageReceiver;

			private List<BrokeredMessage> messagesToDispose = new List<BrokeredMessage>();

			public ProcessQueueAsyncResult(SendAvailabilityMessagePump pump, int index, TimeSpan timespan, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timespan, callback, state)
			{
				this.pump = pump;
				base.OnCompleting = (Action<Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult, Exception>)Delegate.Combine(base.OnCompleting, new Action<Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult, Exception>(OnFinally));
				if (this.pump.CanPump())
				{
					string entityPath = this.pump.options.FetchBacklogQueueName(index);
					messageReceiver = this.pump.options.SecondaryMessagingFactory.CreateMessageReceiver(entityPath);
					messageReceiver.PrefetchCount = 100;
					messageReceiver.RetryPolicy = this.pump.options.SecondaryMessagingFactory.RetryPolicy;
					messageReceiver.ShouldLinkRetryPolicy = true;
					Start();
				}
				else
				{
					Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: true);
				}
			}

			private void OnFinally(Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult asyncResult, Exception exception)
			{
				if (exception != null)
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWritePairedNamespaceMessagePumpProcessQueueFailed(exception);
					});
				}
				try
				{
					if (messageReceiver != null && messageReceiver.IsOpened)
					{
						messageReceiver.BeginClose(RemainingTime(), EndCloseMessageReceiver, messageReceiver);
					}
					foreach (BrokeredMessage item in messagesToDispose)
					{
						item.Dispose();
					}
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					Exception ex2 = ex;
					Exception closeException = ex2;
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWritePairedNamespaceMessagePumpProcessQueueFailed(closeException);
					});
					if (messageReceiver != null)
					{
						messageReceiver.Abort();
					}
				}
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				bool doneWithQueue = false;
				HashSet<string> failedDestinations = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
				while (!(RemainingTime() < MinTimeToProcessLoop))
				{
					base.LastAsyncStepException = null;
					IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> receivedMessages = null;
					bool hasMessages = false;
					if (!pump.CanPump())
					{
						break;
					}
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((ProcessQueueAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.messageReceiver.BeginTryReceive(100, DefaultReadTimeout, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(ProcessQueueAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						hasMessages = messageReceiver.EndTryReceive(r, out receivedMessages);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
					if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
						{
							MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWritePairedNamespaceMessagePumpReceiveFailed(messageReceiver.MessagingFactory.Address.ToString(), messageReceiver.Path, base.LastAsyncStepException);
						});
						if (Fx.IsFatal(base.LastAsyncStepException) || base.LastAsyncStepException is UnauthorizedAccessException || base.LastAsyncStepException is MessagingEntityNotFoundException)
						{
							Complete(base.LastAsyncStepException);
						}
						break;
					}
					if (!hasMessages || receivedMessages == null)
					{
						doneWithQueue = true;
					}
					else
					{
						messagesToDispose.AddRange(receivedMessages);
						Dictionary<string, List<BrokeredMessage>> splitMessages = new Dictionary<string, List<BrokeredMessage>>();
						foreach (BrokeredMessage message in receivedMessages)
						{
							MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
							{
								MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWritePairedNamespaceReceiveMessageFromSecondary(message.SequenceNumber, messageReceiver.Path);
							});
							base.LastAsyncStepException = null;
							if (message.Properties.TryGetValue("x-ms-path", out var value) && value is string)
							{
								string text = (string)value;
								if (!failedDestinations.Contains(text))
								{
									if (!splitMessages.TryGetValue(text, out var value2))
									{
										value2 = new List<BrokeredMessage>();
										splitMessages.Add(text, value2);
									}
									value2.Add(message);
								}
							}
							else
							{
								BrokeredMessage tempMessage = message;
								string messageId = message.MessageId;
								MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
								{
									MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWritePairedNamespaceMessageNoPathInBacklog(messageReceiver.MessagingFactory.Address.ToString(), messageReceiver.Path, messageId);
								});
								yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((ProcessQueueAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => tempMessage.BeginDeadLetter(SRClient.BacklogDeadletterReasonNoQueuePath, SRClient.BacklogDeadletterDescriptionNoQueuePath, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(ProcessQueueAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
								{
									tempMessage.EndDeadLetter(r);
								}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
							}
						}
						foreach (string path in splitMessages.Keys)
						{
							base.LastAsyncStepException = null;
							string tempPath = path;
							List<BrokeredMessage> messageList = splitMessages[path];
							MessageSender messageSender = null;
							yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((ProcessQueueAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.pump.options.PrimaryMessagingFactory.BeginCreateMessageSender(null, tempPath, tryPairSender: false, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(ProcessQueueAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
							{
								messageSender = thisPtr.pump.options.PrimaryMessagingFactory.EndCreateMessageSender(r);
							}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
							if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
							{
								MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
								{
									MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWritePairedNamespaceCouldNotCreateMessageSender(messageReceiver.MessagingFactory.Address.ToString(), messageReceiver.Path, base.LastAsyncStepException);
								});
								continue;
							}
							messageSender.ShouldLinkRetryPolicy = true;
							messageSender.RetryPolicy = pump.options.PrimaryMessagingFactory.RetryPolicy;
							if (!pump.CanPump())
							{
								messageSender.Abort();
								yield break;
							}
							yield return CallParallelAsync<BrokeredMessage>((ICollection<BrokeredMessage>)messageList, (BeginCall<BrokeredMessage>)((ProcessQueueAsyncResult thisPtr, BrokeredMessage i, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => new SendAsyncResult(messageSender, i, pump, pump.options.PrimaryMessagingFactory.OperationTimeout, c, s)), (EndCall<BrokeredMessage>)delegate(ProcessQueueAsyncResult thisPtr, BrokeredMessage i, IAsyncResult r)
							{
								AsyncResult<SendAsyncResult>.End(r);
							}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
							if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null && !failedDestinations.Contains(path))
							{
								failedDestinations.Add(path);
							}
							if (!messageSender.IsOpened)
							{
								continue;
							}
							yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((ProcessQueueAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => messageSender.BeginClose(thisPtr.RemainingTime(), c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(ProcessQueueAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
							{
								messageSender.EndClose(r);
							}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
							if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
							{
								MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
								{
									MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWritePairedNamespaceMessagePumpProcessCloseSenderFailed(base.LastAsyncStepException);
								});
							}
						}
					}
					if (doneWithQueue)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}

			private static void EndCloseMessageReceiver(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				MessageReceiver messageReceiver = (MessageReceiver)result.AsyncState;
				try
				{
					messageReceiver.EndClose(result);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					Exception ex2 = ex;
					Exception exception = ex2;
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWritePairedNamespaceMessagePumpProcessQueueFailed(exception);
					});
				}
			}
		}

		private class SendAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<SendAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly MessageSender messageSender;

			private readonly BrokeredMessage message;

			private readonly SendAvailabilityMessagePump pump;

			private readonly long sequenceNumber;

			public SendAsyncResult(MessageSender sender, BrokeredMessage message, SendAvailabilityMessagePump pump, TimeSpan timespan, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timespan, callback, state)
			{
				messageSender = sender;
				this.message = message;
				this.pump = pump;
				sequenceNumber = message.SequenceNumber;
				base.OnCompleting = (Action<Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult, Exception>)Delegate.Combine(base.OnCompleting, new Action<Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult, Exception>(OnFinally));
				Start();
			}

			private void OnFinally(Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult result, Exception exception)
			{
				if (exception == null)
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWritePairedNamespaceSendMessageSuccess(sequenceNumber, messageSender.Path);
					});
				}
				else
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWritePairedNamespaceSendMessageFailure(sequenceNumber, messageSender.Path, exception);
					});
				}
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				BrokeredMessage brokeredMessage = SendAvailabilityPairedNamespaceMessageSender.ConvertMessageForPrimary(message, messageSender.Path);
				try
				{
					if (brokeredMessage == null || !pump.CanPump())
					{
						yield break;
					}
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWritePairedNamespaceSendingMessage(sequenceNumber, messageSender.Path);
					});
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((SendAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.messageSender.BeginSend(brokeredMessage, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(SendAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.messageSender.EndSend(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
					if (base.LastAsyncStepException == null)
					{
						yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((SendAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.message.BeginComplete(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(SendAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
						{
							thisPtr.message.EndComplete(r);
						}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
						if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
						{
							MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
							{
								MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWritePairedNamespaceDestinationSendException(pump.options.PrimaryMessagingFactory.Address.ToString(), messageSender.Path, base.LastAsyncStepException);
							});
							Complete(base.LastAsyncStepException);
							yield break;
						}
						yield break;
					}
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWritePairedNamespaceDestinationSendException(pump.options.PrimaryMessagingFactory.Address.ToString(), messageSender.Path, base.LastAsyncStepException);
					});
					MessagingException ex = base.LastAsyncStepException as MessagingException;
					if (ex == null)
					{
						Complete(base.LastAsyncStepException);
						yield break;
					}
					if (!ex.IsTransient && !(ex is QuotaExceededException))
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
						{
							MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWritePairedNamespaceDeadletterException(messageSender.MessagingFactory.Address.ToString(), messageSender.Path, ex);
						});
						message.DeadLetter(SRClient.BacklogDeadletterReasonNotRetryable, SRClient.BacklogDeadletterDescriptionNotRetryable(messageSender.Path, ex.GetType().Name, ex.Message));
					}
					Complete(base.LastAsyncStepException);
				}
				finally
				{
					if (brokeredMessage != null)
					{
						((IDisposable)brokeredMessage).Dispose();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private class CloseAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<CloseAsyncResult>
		{
			private SendAvailabilityMessagePump pump;

			public CloseAsyncResult(SendAvailabilityMessagePump pump, TimeSpan timespan, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timespan, callback, state)
			{
				this.pump = pump;
				this.pump.Closed = true;
				base.OnCompleting = (Action<Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult, Exception>)Delegate.Combine(base.OnCompleting, new Action<Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult, Exception>(OnFinally));
				Start();
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				IOThreadTimer[] timers = pump.timers;
				foreach (IOThreadTimer iOThreadTimer in timers)
				{
					iOThreadTimer.Cancel();
				}
				WaitHandle[] array = (from result in pump.queuesInProcess
					where result != null
					select result.AsyncWaitHandle).ToArray();
				if (array.Length != 0)
				{
					WaitHandle.WaitAll(array, RemainingTime());
				}
				yield break;
			}

			private static void OnFinally(Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult asyncResult, Exception exception)
			{
				CloseAsyncResult thisPtr = (CloseAsyncResult)asyncResult;
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWritePairedNamespaceStopSyphon(thisPtr.pump.InstanceTrackingContext.Activity, thisPtr.pump.syphonId, thisPtr.pump.options.PrimaryMessagingFactory.Address.ToString(), thisPtr.pump.options.SecondaryMessagingFactory.Address.ToString());
				});
			}
		}

		private static readonly TimeSpan DefaultCloseTimeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5.0);

		internal static readonly TimeSpan SyphonReadTimeout = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(15.0);

		private static int latestSyphonId = 0;

		private readonly SendAvailabilityPairedNamespaceOptions options;

		private readonly IOThreadTimer[] timers;

		private readonly IAsyncResult[] queuesInProcess;

		private readonly int syphonId;

		private long closed;

		private IOThreadTimer closeTimer;

		private bool Closed
		{
			get
			{
				return Interlocked.Read(ref closed) != 0;
			}
			set
			{
				long value2 = (value ? 1 : 0);
				Interlocked.Exchange(ref closed, value2);
			}
		}

		private TrackingContext InstanceTrackingContext { get; set; }

		public SendAvailabilityMessagePump(SendAvailabilityPairedNamespaceOptions options)
		{
			if (options == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new ArgumentNullException("options"));
			}
			if (options.PrimaryMessagingFactory == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new ArgumentNullException("options.PrimaryMessagingFactory"));
			}
			if (options.SecondaryMessagingFactory == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new ArgumentNullException("options.MessagingFactory"));
			}
			this.options = options;
			InstanceTrackingContext = TrackingContext.Create(Guid.NewGuid(), this.options.SbNamespace);
			syphonId = NextSyphonId();
			timers = new IOThreadTimer[this.options.BacklogQueueCount];
			queuesInProcess = new IAsyncResult[this.options.BacklogQueueCount];
		}

		public void Start()
		{
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWritePairedNamespaceStartSyphon(InstanceTrackingContext.Activity, syphonId, options.PrimaryMessagingFactory.Address.ToString(), options.SecondaryMessagingFactory.Address.ToString(), options.BacklogQueueCount);
			});
			for (int num = 0; num < options.BacklogQueueCount; num++)
			{
				IOThreadTimer iOThreadTimer = new IOThreadTimer(BeginProcessQueue, num, isTypicallyCanceledShortlyAfterBeingSet: false);
				iOThreadTimer.Set(options.SyphonRetryInterval);
				timers[num] = iOThreadTimer;
			}
		}

		private void BeginProcessQueue(object state)
		{
			int num = (int)state;
			queuesInProcess[num] = new ProcessQueueAsyncResult(this, num, SyphonReadTimeout, EndProcessQueue, num);
		}

		private void EndProcessQueue(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			TimeSpan zero = TimeSpan.Zero;
			try
			{
				AsyncResult<ProcessQueueAsyncResult>.End(result);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				Exception ex2 = ex;
				Exception exception = ex2;
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWritePairedNamespaceMessagePumpProcessQueueFailed(exception);
				});
			}
			finally
			{
				if (CanPump())
				{
					int num = (int)result.AsyncState;
					if (timers.Length > num && !Closed)
					{
						IOThreadTimer iOThreadTimer = timers[num];
						TimeSpan timeFromNow = ((options.SyphonRetryInterval > zero) ? options.SyphonRetryInterval : zero);
						iOThreadTimer.Set(timeFromNow);
						queuesInProcess[num] = null;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					HandleUnplannedShutdown();
				}
			}
		}

		private void HandleUnplannedShutdown()
		{
			MessagingFactory primaryMessagingFactory = options.PrimaryMessagingFactory;
			MessagingFactory secondaryMessagingFactory = options.SecondaryMessagingFactory;
			HandleUnplannedShutdown(primaryMessagingFactory, secondaryMessagingFactory);
			HandleUnplannedShutdown(secondaryMessagingFactory, primaryMessagingFactory);
		}

		private void HandleUnplannedShutdown(MessagingFactory factory1, MessagingFactory factory2)
		{
			if (!Closed && (factory1.IsFaulted || factory1.IsClosedOrClosing) && (factory2.IsClosedOrClosing || factory2.IsFaulted))
			{
				Close();
			}
			else if (factory1.IsFaulted && factory2.IsOpened)
			{
				Exception exception = new PairedMessagingFactoryException(SRClient.FaultingPairedMessagingFactory(factory2.Address.ToString(), factory1.Address.ToString()));
				factory2.Fault(exception);
			}
			else if (factory1.IsClosedOrClosing && factory2.IsOpened)
			{
				IOThreadTimer iOThreadTimer = new IOThreadTimer(FaultingClose, new Tuple<MessagingFactory, MessagingFactory, SendAvailabilityMessagePump>(factory2, factory1, this), isTypicallyCanceledShortlyAfterBeingSet: false);
				if (Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref closeTimer, iOThreadTimer, null) == null)
				{
					iOThreadTimer.Set(DefaultCloseTimeout);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void FaultingClose(object state)
		{
			Tuple<MessagingFactory, MessagingFactory, SendAvailabilityMessagePump> tuple = (Tuple<MessagingFactory, MessagingFactory, SendAvailabilityMessagePump>)state;
			MessagingFactory item = tuple.Item1;
			MessagingFactory item2 = tuple.Item2;
			SendAvailabilityMessagePump item3 = tuple.Item3;
			if (item.IsOpened)
			{
				Exception exception = new PairedMessagingFactoryException(SRClient.FaultingPairedMessagingFactory(item.Address.ToString(), item2.Address.ToString()));
				item.Fault(exception);
			}
			if (!item3.Closed)
			{
				item3.Close();
			}
		}

		private bool CanPump()
		{
			MessagingFactory primaryMessagingFactory = options.PrimaryMessagingFactory;
			MessagingFactory secondaryMessagingFactory = options.SecondaryMessagingFactory;
			bool flag = !primaryMessagingFactory.IsClosedOrClosing && !primaryMessagingFactory.IsFaulted;
			bool flag2 = !secondaryMessagingFactory.IsClosedOrClosing && !secondaryMessagingFactory.IsFaulted;
			return flag && flag2;
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new CloseAsyncResult(this, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		public void EndClose(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			AsyncResult<CloseAsyncResult>.End(result);
		}

		public void Close()
		{
			EndClose(BeginClose(DefaultCloseTimeout, null, null));
		}

		private static int NextSyphonId()
		{
			return Interlocked.Increment(ref latestSyphonId);
		}
	}
	internal class SendAvailabilityPairedNamespaceMessageSender : MessageSender
	{
		private class SendAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<SendAsyncResult>
		{
			private static readonly TimeSpan SafeBacklogAttempt = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2.0);

			private readonly SendAvailabilityPairedNamespaceMessageSender sender;

			private readonly TrackingContext trackingContext;

			private readonly IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages;

			private List<BrokeredMessage> messageBuffer;

			public SendAsyncResult(SendAvailabilityPairedNamespaceMessageSender sender, TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				SendAsyncResult sendAsyncResult = this;
				this.sender = sender;
				this.trackingContext = trackingContext;
				this.messages = messages;
				messageBuffer = new List<BrokeredMessage>();
				try
				{
					foreach (BrokeredMessage message in this.messages)
					{
						message.IsConsumed = false;
						messageBuffer.Add(message.Clone());
					}
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					Exception e = ex;
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteRetryPolicyStreamNotClonable(sendAsyncResult.trackingContext.Activity, sendAsyncResult.trackingContext.TrackingId, "PairnedNamespaceSender", "Send", e.GetType().FullName, e.Message);
					});
					foreach (BrokeredMessage item in messageBuffer)
					{
						item.Dispose();
					}
					messageBuffer.Clear();
				}
				Start();
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				Exception ex = sender.Options.RetrieveNontransientException(sender.Primary.Path);
				if (ex != null)
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new SendAvailabilityMessagingException(ex));
				}
				if (sender.CanUsePrimary())
				{
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((SendAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.sender.Primary.BeginSend(thisPtr.trackingContext, thisPtr.messages, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(SendAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.sender.Primary.EndSend(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
					if (base.LastAsyncStepException == null)
					{
						sender.Options.MarkPathHealthy(sender.Path);
						yield break;
					}
					if (!sender.Options.ExceptionInspector.CausesFailover(base.LastAsyncStepException))
					{
						Complete(base.LastAsyncStepException);
						yield break;
					}
					sender.Options.NotifyPrimarySendResult(sender.Primary.Path, success: false);
				}
				if (sender.CanUsePrimary())
				{
					Complete(base.LastAsyncStepException);
					yield break;
				}
				if (messageBuffer.Count > 0)
				{
					ConvertMessagesForBacklog(messageBuffer, sender.Primary.Path);
					while (RemainingTime() > SafeBacklogAttempt || RemainingTime() > TimeSpan.FromTicks(base.OriginalTimeout.Ticks / 2))
					{
						List<BrokeredMessage> clonedMessages = null;
						clonedMessages = messageBuffer.Select((BrokeredMessage msg) => msg.Clone()).ToList();
						try
						{
							yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((SendAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.sender.Backlog.BeginSend(clonedMessages, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(SendAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
							{
								thisPtr.sender.Backlog.EndSend(r);
							}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
						}
						finally
						{
							if (clonedMessages != null)
							{
								clonedMessages.ForEach(delegate(BrokeredMessage msg)
								{
									msg.Dispose();
								});
								clonedMessages.Clear();
							}
						}
						if (base.LastAsyncStepException == null)
						{
							break;
						}
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
						{
							MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWritePairedNamespaceSendToBacklogFailed(sender.MessagingFactory.Address.ToString(), sender.Backlog.Path, base.LastAsyncStepException);
						});
						if (!(RemainingTime() > TimeSpan.Zero) || sender.Options.BacklogQueueCount <= 1)
						{
							break;
						}
						sender.FindNewMessageSender(sender.Backlog.Path);
					}
				}
				messageBuffer.ForEach(delegate(BrokeredMessage msg)
				{
					msg.Dispose();
				});
				messageBuffer.Clear();
				Complete(base.LastAsyncStepException);
			}
		}

		private class OpenAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<OpenAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly MessageSender sender;

			public OpenAsyncResult(MessageSender sender, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.sender = sender;
				Start();
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((OpenAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.sender.BeginOpen(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(OpenAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					thisPtr.sender.EndOpen(r);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
			}
		}

		private class CloseAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<CloseAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly ICollection<MessageSender> senders;

			public CloseAsyncResult(ICollection<MessageSender> senders, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				List<MessageSender> list = new List<MessageSender>();
				foreach (MessageSender sender in senders)
				{
					if (sender != null && sender.IsOpened)
					{
						list.Add(sender);
					}
				}
				this.senders = list;
				Start();
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				yield return CallParallelAsync<MessageSender>(senders, (BeginCall<MessageSender>)((CloseAsyncResult thisPtr, MessageSender i, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => i.BeginClose(t, c, s)), (EndCall<MessageSender>)delegate(CloseAsyncResult thisPtr, MessageSender i, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					i.EndClose(r);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
			}
		}

		private MessageSender backlog;

		private object backlogLock = new object();

		private MessageSender Primary { get; set; }

		private MessageSender Backlog
		{
			get
			{
				if (backlog == null)
				{
					lock (backlogLock)
					{
						if (backlog == null)
						{
							string entityPath = Options.FetchBacklogQueueName(ConcurrentRandom.Next(0, Options.BacklogQueueCount));
							backlog = Options.SecondaryMessagingFactory.CreateMessageSender(entityPath);
							backlog.ShouldLinkRetryPolicy = true;
							backlog.RetryPolicy = Options.SecondaryMessagingFactory.RetryPolicy;
						}
					}
				}
				return backlog;
			}
			set
			{
				backlog = value;
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool SupportsGetRuntimeEntityDescription => false;

		internal override bool ViaSender => false;

		private SendAvailabilityPairedNamespaceOptions Options => (SendAvailabilityPairedNamespaceOptions)base.MessagingFactory.Options;

		public SendAvailabilityPairedNamespaceMessageSender(MessageSender primary)
			: base(primary.MessagingFactory, primary.Path, null, RetryPolicy.NoRetry)
		{
			if (primary == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new ArgumentNullException("primary"));
			}
			Primary = primary;
			base.ShouldLinkRetryPolicy = false;
		}

		private void FindNewMessageSender(string path)
		{
			if (!string.Equals(Backlog.Path, path, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || Options.BacklogQueueCount <= 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			lock (backlogLock)
			{
				if (!string.Equals(Backlog.Path, path, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
				{
					return;
				}
				int num = ConcurrentRandom.Next(0, Options.BacklogQueueCount);
				string text = Options.FetchBacklogQueueName(num);
				if (string.Equals(path, text, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
				{
					num++;
					if (num >= Options.BacklogQueueCount)
					{
						num = 0;
					}
					text = Options.FetchBacklogQueueName(num);
				}
				Backlog = Options.SecondaryMessagingFactory.CreateMessageSender(text);
				Backlog.ShouldLinkRetryPolicy = true;
				Backlog.RetryPolicy = Options.SecondaryMessagingFactory.RetryPolicy;
			}
		}

		private bool CanUsePrimary()
		{
			return Options.IsPathAvailable(Primary.Path);
		}

		protected override void OnAbort()
		{
			Primary.Abort();
			if (backlog != null)
			{
				Backlog.Abort();
			}
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginOpen(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new OpenAsyncResult(Primary, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		protected override void OnEndOpen(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			AsyncResult<OpenAsyncResult>.End(result);
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new CloseAsyncResult(new MessageSender[2] { Primary, backlog }, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		protected override void OnEndClose(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			AsyncResult<CloseAsyncResult>.End(result);
		}

		private static void ConvertMessagesForBacklog(IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages, string path)
		{
			foreach (BrokeredMessage message in messages)
			{
				TimeSpan timeToLive = message.TimeToLive;
				if (message.SessionId != null)
				{
					message.Properties.Add("x-ms-sessionid", message.SessionId);
					message.SessionId = null;
				}
				if (!TimeSpan.Equals(timeToLive, TimeSpan.MaxValue))
				{
					message.Properties.Add("x-ms-timetolive", timeToLive);
					message.TimeToLive = TimeSpan.MaxValue;
				}
				if (!DateTime.Equals(DateTime.MinValue, message.ScheduledEnqueueTimeUtc))
				{
					message.Properties.Add("x-ms-scheduledenqueuetimeutc", message.ScheduledEnqueueTimeUtc);
					message.ScheduledEnqueueTimeUtc = DateTime.MinValue;
				}
				message.Properties.Add("x-ms-path", path);
			}
		}

		internal static BrokeredMessage ConvertMessageForPrimary(BrokeredMessage message, string path)
		{
			BrokeredMessage brokeredMessage = message.Clone();
			if (message.Properties.TryGetValue("x-ms-scheduledenqueuetimeutc", out var value))
			{
				if (!(value is DateTime))
				{
					DeadLetterMessageWithInvalidProperty("x-ms-scheduledenqueuetimeutc", value, typeof(TimeSpan), message);
					return null;
				}
				brokeredMessage.ScheduledEnqueueTimeUtc = (DateTime)value;
				brokeredMessage.Properties.Remove("x-ms-scheduledenqueuetimeutc");
			}
			if (message.Properties.TryGetValue("x-ms-sessionid", out value))
			{
				if (!(value is string sessionId))
				{
					DeadLetterMessageWithInvalidProperty("x-ms-sessionid", value, typeof(string), message);
					return null;
				}
				brokeredMessage.SessionId = sessionId;
				brokeredMessage.Properties.Remove("x-ms-sessionid");
			}
			if (message.Properties.TryGetValue("x-ms-timetolive", out value))
			{
				if (!(value is TimeSpan))
				{
					DeadLetterMessageWithInvalidProperty("x-ms-timetolive", value, typeof(TimeSpan), message);
					return null;
				}
				brokeredMessage.TimeToLive = (TimeSpan)value;
				brokeredMessage.Properties.Remove("x-ms-timetolive");
			}
			if (message.Properties.TryGetValue("x-ms-path", out value))
			{
				brokeredMessage.Properties.Remove("x-ms-path");
			}
			return brokeredMessage;
		}

		private static void DeadLetterMessageWithInvalidProperty(string propertyName, object temp, Type type, BrokeredMessage message)
		{
			string deadLetterErrorDescription = SRClient.PairedNamespacePropertyExtractionDlqDescription(propertyName, message.MessageId, type, (temp == null) ? SRClient.NullAsString : temp.GetType().FullName, (temp == null) ? SRClient.NullAsString : temp.ToString());
			message.BeginDeadLetter(SRClient.PairedNamespacePropertyExtractionDlqReason, deadLetterErrorDescription, EndDeadLetterMessageWithInvalidProperty, message);
		}

		private static void EndDeadLetterMessageWithInvalidProperty(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			BrokeredMessage message = (BrokeredMessage)result.AsyncState;
			try
			{
				message.EndDeadLetter(result);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				Exception exception = ex;
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWritePairedNamespaceDeadletterException(message.ReceiveContext.MessageReceiver.MessagingFactory.Address.ToString(), message.ReceiveContext.MessageReceiver.Path, exception);
				});
			}
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginSend(TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages, bool fromSync, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new SendAsyncResult(this, trackingContext, messages, timeout, callback, state);

		}

		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginScheduleMessage(TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> message, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<long> OnEndScheduleMessage(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginCancelScheduledMessage(TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<long> sequenceNumbers, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();

		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();

		internal override IAsyncResult OnBeginGetRuntimeEntityDescriptionAsyncResult(TrackingContext trackingContext, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)

	}
	public abstract class PairedNamespaceOptions
	{
		private readonly NamespaceManager secondaryNamespaceManager;

		private readonly MessagingFactory secondaryMessagingFactory;

		private readonly TimeSpan failoverInterval;

		private readonly object syncLock = new object();

		private MessagingFactory primaryMessagingFactory;

		public NamespaceManager SecondaryNamespaceManager => secondaryNamespaceManager;

		public MessagingFactory SecondaryMessagingFactory => secondaryMessagingFactory;

		public TimeSpan FailoverInterval => failoverInterval;

		internal MessagingFactory PrimaryMessagingFactory
		{
			get
			{
				return primaryMessagingFactory;
			}
			set
			{
				if (primaryMessagingFactory == null)
				{
					lock (syncLock)
					{
						if (primaryMessagingFactory == null)
						{
							primaryMessagingFactory = value;
							return;
						}
					}
				}
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.PairedNamespaceMessagingFactoyCannotBeChanged));
			}
		}

		protected PairedNamespaceOptions(NamespaceManager secondaryNamespaceManager, MessagingFactory secondaryMessagingFactory)
			: this(secondaryNamespaceManager, secondaryMessagingFactory, Constants.DefaultPrimaryFailoverInterval)
		{
		}

		protected PairedNamespaceOptions(NamespaceManager secondaryNamespaceManager, MessagingFactory secondaryMessagingFactory, TimeSpan failoverInterval)
		{
			if (secondaryNamespaceManager == null)
			{
				Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("secondaryNamespaceManager");
			}
			if (secondaryMessagingFactory == null)
			{
				Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("secondaryMessagingFactory");
			}
			if (failoverInterval < Constants.MinPrimaryFailoverInterval || failoverInterval > Constants.MaxPrimaryFailoverInterval)
			{
				Fx.Exception.ArgumentOutOfRange("failoverInterval", failoverInterval, SRClient.ArgumentOutOfRange(Constants.MinPrimaryFailoverInterval, Constants.MaxPrimaryFailoverInterval));
			}
			this.secondaryNamespaceManager = secondaryNamespaceManager;
			this.secondaryMessagingFactory = secondaryMessagingFactory;
			this.failoverInterval = failoverInterval;
		}

		protected internal virtual void ClearPairing()
		{
			primaryMessagingFactory = null;
		}

		protected abstract void OnNotifyPrimarySendResult(string path, bool success);

		internal void NotifyPrimarySendResult(string path, bool success)
		{
			OnNotifyPrimarySendResult(path, success);
		}

		internal abstract IPairedNamespaceFactory CreatePairedNamespaceFactory();
	}
	public sealed class SendAvailabilityPairedNamespaceOptions : PairedNamespaceOptions
	{
		private class SendAvailabilityPairedNamespaceFactory : IPairedNamespaceFactory
		{
			private SendAvailabilityPairedNamespaceOptions options;

			public SendAvailabilityPairedNamespaceFactory(SendAvailabilityPairedNamespaceOptions options)
			{
				this.options = options;
			}

			MessageSender IPairedNamespaceFactory.CreateMessageSender(MessageSender primary)
			{
				return new SendAvailabilityPairedNamespaceMessageSender(primary);
			}

			IAsyncResult IPairedNamespaceFactory.BeginStart(MessagingFactory primary, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{
				return new StartAsyncResult(options, timeout, callback, state);
			}

			void IPairedNamespaceFactory.EndStart(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				AsyncResult<StartAsyncResult>.End(result);
			}

			IAsyncResult IPairedNamespaceFactory.BeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{
				options.Closed = true;
				return new CloseAsyncResult(options, timeout, callback, state);
			}

			void IPairedNamespaceFactory.EndClose(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				AsyncResult<CloseAsyncResult>.End(result);
			}
		}

		private class StartAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<StartAsyncResult>
		{
			private static readonly TimeSpan CreateQueuePauseTime = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30.0);

			private static readonly TimeSpan GetQueuesTime = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(2.0);

			private static readonly TimeSpan LocalMaxLockDuration = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1.0);

			private readonly SendAvailabilityPairedNamespaceOptions options;

			public StartAsyncResult(SendAvailabilityPairedNamespaceOptions options, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.options = options;
				Start();
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				IEnumerable<QueueDescription> queues = null;
				Stopwatch stopWatch = Stopwatch.StartNew();
				while (stopWatch.Elapsed < GetQueuesTime)
				{
					string filter = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "startswith(path, '{0}/x-servicebus-transfer/') eq true", options.SbNamespace);
					yield return CallTask((Func<StartAsyncResult, TimeSpan, Task>)async delegate(StartAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t)
					{
						IEnumerable<QueueDescription> enumerable = await thisPtr.options.SecondaryNamespaceManager.GetQueuesAsync(filter);
						queues = enumerable;
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
					if ((base.LastAsyncStepException == null && queues != null) || base.LastAsyncStepException is MessagingException { IsTransient: false })
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				if (queues == null && base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
				{
					Complete(base.LastAsyncStepException);
					yield break;
				}
				HashSet<string> hashSet = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
				foreach (QueueDescription item2 in queues)
				{
					hashSet.Add(item2.Path);
				}
				for (int num = 0; num < options.BacklogQueueCount; num++)
				{
					string item = options.CreateBacklogQueueName(num);
					if (hashSet.Contains(item))
					{
						options.availableBacklogQueues.Add(item);
					}
					else
					{
						options.availableBacklogQueues.Add(string.Empty);
					}
				}
				int i = 0;
				while (i < options.BacklogQueueCount)
				{
					string queueName = options.CreateBacklogQueueName(i);
					int num2;
					if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(options.availableBacklogQueues[i]))
					{
						for (int j = 0; j < 3; j = num2)
						{
							if (base.LastAsyncStepException == null)
							{
								QueueDescription queueDescription = new QueueDescription(queueName);
								queueDescription.MaxSizeInMegabytes = 5120L;
								queueDescription.MaxDeliveryCount = int.MaxValue;
								queueDescription.DefaultMessageTimeToLive = TimeSpan.MaxValue;
								queueDescription.AutoDeleteOnIdle = TimeSpan.MaxValue;
								queueDescription.LockDuration = ((Constants.MaximumLockDuration < LocalMaxLockDuration) ? Constants.MaximumLockDuration : LocalMaxLockDuration);
								queueDescription.EnableDeadLetteringOnMessageExpiration = true;
								queueDescription.EnableBatchedOperations = true;
								yield return CallTask((Func<StartAsyncResult, TimeSpan, Task>)((StartAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t) => thisPtr.options.SecondaryNamespaceManager.CreateQueueAsync(queueDescription)), ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
							}
							if (base.LastAsyncStepException == null)
							{
								options.availableBacklogQueues[i] = queueName;
								break;
							}
							if (base.LastAsyncStepException is MessagingEntityAlreadyExistsException)
							{
								QueueDescription tempQueue = null;
								yield return CallTask((Func<StartAsyncResult, TimeSpan, Task>)async delegate(StartAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t)
								{
									tempQueue = await thisPtr.options.SecondaryNamespaceManager.GetQueueAsync(queueName);
								}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
								if (base.LastAsyncStepException == null && tempQueue != null && tempQueue.Path == queueName)
								{
									options.availableBacklogQueues[i] = queueName;
									break;
								}
							}
							if (base.LastAsyncStepException is UnauthorizedAccessException)
							{
								Complete(base.LastAsyncStepException);
								yield break;
							}
							MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
							{
								MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWritePairedNamespaceTransferQueueCreateError(queueName, options.SecondaryNamespaceManager.Address.ToString(), base.LastAsyncStepException.ToString());
							});
							yield return CallAsyncSleep(CreateQueuePauseTime);
							num2 = j + 1;
						}
					}
					num2 = i + 1;
					i = num2;
				}
				for (int num3 = options.availableBacklogQueues.Count - 1; num3 >= 0; num3--)
				{
					if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(options.availableBacklogQueues[num3]))
					{
						options.availableBacklogQueues.RemoveAt(num3);
					}
				}
				options.UpdateBacklogQueueCount(options.availableBacklogQueues.Count);
				if (options.BacklogQueueCount == 0)
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new SendAvailabilityBacklogException(SRClient.SendAvailabilityNoTransferQueuesCreated));
				}
				if (options.EnableSyphon)
				{
					options.pump = new SendAvailabilityMessagePump(options);
					options.pump.Start();
				}
			}
		}

		private class CloseAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<CloseAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly SendAvailabilityPairedNamespaceOptions options;

			public CloseAsyncResult(SendAvailabilityPairedNamespaceOptions options, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.options = options;
				Start();
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				if (options.availabilityTimers.Count > 0)
				{
					foreach (IOThreadTimer value in options.availabilityTimers.Values)
					{
						value.Cancel();
					}
				}
				if (options.EnableSyphon)
				{
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((CloseAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.options.pump.BeginClose(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(CloseAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.options.pump.EndClose(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((CloseAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.options.SecondaryMessagingFactory.BeginClose(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(CloseAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.options.SecondaryMessagingFactory.EndClose(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
					if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
					{
						options.SecondaryMessagingFactory.Abort();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private class PingAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<PingAsyncResult>
		{
			private static readonly TimeSpan PingMessageTimeToLive = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1.0);

			private readonly SendAvailabilityPairedNamespaceOptions options;

			private readonly string path;

			public PingAsyncResult(SendAvailabilityPairedNamespaceOptions options, string path, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.options = options;
				this.path = path;
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				MessageSender messageSender = null;
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((PingAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.options.PrimaryMessagingFactory.BeginCreateMessageSender(null, thisPtr.path, tryPairSender: false, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(PingAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					messageSender = thisPtr.options.PrimaryMessagingFactory.EndCreateMessageSender(r);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
				if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWritePairedNamespaceCouldNotCreateMessageSender(options.PrimaryMessagingFactory.Address.ToString(), path, base.LastAsyncStepException);
					});
					yield break;
				}
				List<BrokeredMessage> messages = new List<BrokeredMessage>
				{
					new BrokeredMessage(GetType().Name)
					{
						ContentType = "application/vnd.ms-servicebus-ping",
						TimeToLive = PingMessageTimeToLive,
						SessionId = Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N")
					}
				};
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((PingAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => messageSender.BeginSend(messages, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(PingAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					messageSender.EndSend(r);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
				if (base.LastAsyncStepException == null)
				{
					options.unavailableEntities.TryRemove(path, out var _);
					options.MarkPathHealthy(path);
					yield break;
				}
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWritePairedNamespacePingException(base.LastAsyncStepException);
				});
				if (base.LastAsyncStepException is MessagingException { IsTransient: false })
				{
					Complete(base.LastAsyncStepException);
					options.unavailableEntities.TryAdd(messageSender.Path, base.LastAsyncStepException);
				}
			}
		}

		private const int DefaultBacklogQueueCount = 10;

		private static readonly TimeSpan MaxPingPrimaryInterval = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(30.0);

		private static readonly TimeSpan MinPingPrimaryInterval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1.0);

		private static readonly TimeSpan DefaultPingPrimaryInterval = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1.0);

				Interlocked.Exchange(ref closed, value2);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnNotifyPrimarySendResult(string path, bool success)
		{
			if (success)
			{
				if (primaryFailureTimers.TryRemove(path, out var value))
				{
					value.Cancel();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (primaryFailureTimers.ContainsKey(path))
				{
					return;
				}
				Tuple<SendAvailabilityPairedNamespaceOptions, string> tuple = new Tuple<SendAvailabilityPairedNamespaceOptions, string>(this, path);
				if (base.FailoverInterval == TimeSpan.Zero)
				{
					OnPrimaryFailedIntervalExpired(tuple);
					return;
				}
				IOThreadTimer iOThreadTimer = new IOThreadTimer(OnPrimaryFailedIntervalExpired, tuple, isTypicallyCanceledShortlyAfterBeingSet: false);
				if (primaryFailureTimers.TryAdd(path, iOThreadTimer))
				{
					iOThreadTimer.Set(base.FailoverInterval);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void OnPrimaryFailedIntervalExpired(object state)
		{
			Tuple<SendAvailabilityPairedNamespaceOptions, string> tuple = (Tuple<SendAvailabilityPairedNamespaceOptions, string>)state;
			SendAvailabilityPairedNamespaceOptions item = tuple.Item1;
			item.StartCheckForAvailability(tuple.Item2);
		}

		internal bool IsPathAvailable(string path)
		{
			return !availabilityTimers.ContainsKey(path);
		}

		internal Exception RetrieveNontransientException(string path)
		{
			if (!unavailableEntities.TryGetValue(path, out var value))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return value;
		}

		internal string CreateBacklogQueueName(int index)

		}

		internal void StartCheckForAvailability(string path)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (availableEntities.ContainsKey(path))
			{
				if (availableEntities.TryUpdate(path, newValue: false, comparisonValue: true))
				{
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			else if (availableEntities.TryAdd(path, value: false))
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			if (flag && availabilityTimers.TryAdd(path, null))
			{
				IOThreadTimer iOThreadTimer = new IOThreadTimer(AvailabilityCallback, path, isTypicallyCanceledShortlyAfterBeingSet: false);
				if (availabilityTimers.TryUpdate(path, iOThreadTimer, null) && !Closed)
				{
					iOThreadTimer.Set(PingPrimaryInterval);
				}
				else
				{
					iOThreadTimer.Cancel();
				}
			}
		}

		private void AvailabilityCallback(object state)
		{
			string path = (string)state;
			PingAsyncResult pingAsyncResult = new PingAsyncResult(this, path, PingTimeout, PingCompleted, state);
			pingAsyncResult.Start();
		}

		private void PingCompleted(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			string key = (string)result.AsyncState;
			try
			{
				AsyncResult<PingAsyncResult>.End(result);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				Exception ex2 = ex;
				Exception ex3 = ex2;
				if (Fx.IsFatal(ex3))
				{
					throw;
				}
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWritePairedNamespacePingException(ex3);
				});
			}
			if (availabilityTimers.TryGetValue(key, out var value) && !Closed)
			{
				value.Set(PingPrimaryInterval);
			}
		}

		internal override IPairedNamespaceFactory CreatePairedNamespaceFactory()
		{
			return new SendAvailabilityPairedNamespaceFactory(this);
		}

		protected internal override void ClearPairing()
		{
			availableBacklogQueues.Clear();
			availableEntities.Clear();
			foreach (IOThreadTimer value in availabilityTimers.Values)
			{
				value.Cancel();
			}
			availabilityTimers.Clear();
			unavailableEntities.Clear();
			Closed = false;
			base.ClearPairing();
		}

		public void MarkPathHealthy(string path)
		{
			if (availabilityTimers.TryRemove(path, out var value))
			{
				value.Cancel();
			}
			availableEntities.TryUpdate(path, newValue: true, comparisonValue: false);
			OnNotifyPrimarySendResult(path, success: true);
		}

			new NullMessageEncoder(),
			new NullMessageEncoder()

		public sealed override string KeyName
		{
			get
			{
				return InternalKeyName;
			}
			set
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("KeyName");
				}
				if (IsSystemRule && !string.Equals(value, "$system"))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(SRCore.AuthorizationRuleKeyContainsInvalidCharacters(GetType().Name));
				}
				if (!IsSystemRule && !string.Equals(InternalKeyName, HttpUtility.UrlEncode(InternalKeyName)))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(SRCore.AuthorizationRuleKeyContainsInvalidCharacters(GetType().Name));
				}
				if (value.Length > 256)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("KeyName", SRCore.ArgumentStringTooBig("KeyName", 256, value.Length));
				}
				InternalKeyName = value;
			}
		}

		public string PrimaryKey
		{
			get

				return InternalPrimaryKey;
			}
			set

		protected override void OnValidate()
		{
			base.OnValidate();
			if (IsSystemRule && !string.Equals(InternalKeyName, "$system"))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SRCore.AuthorizationRuleKeyContainsInvalidCharacters(GetType().Name));
			}
			if (!IsSystemRule && (string.IsNullOrEmpty(InternalKeyName) || !string.Equals(InternalKeyName, HttpUtility.UrlEncode(InternalKeyName))))
			{
				throw new InvalidDataContractException(SRCore.AuthorizationRuleKeyContainsInvalidCharacters(GetType().Name));
			}
			if (InternalKeyName.Length > 256)
			{
				throw new InvalidDataContractException(SRCore.AuthorizationRuleKeyNameTooBig(GetType().Name, 256));
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(InternalPrimaryKey))
			{
				throw new InvalidDataContractException(SRCore.SharedAccessAuthorizationRuleRequiresPrimaryKey);
			}
			if (Encoding.ASCII.GetByteCount(InternalPrimaryKey) != 44)
			{
				throw new InvalidDataContractException(SRCore.SharedAccessRuleAllowsFixedLengthKeys(44));
			}
			if (!CheckBase64(InternalPrimaryKey))
			{
				throw new InvalidDataContractException(SRCore.SharedAccessKeyShouldbeBase64);
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(InternalSecondaryKey))
			{
				if (Encoding.ASCII.GetByteCount(InternalSecondaryKey) != 44)
				{
					throw new InvalidDataContractException(SRCore.SharedAccessRuleAllowsFixedLengthKeys(44));
				}
				if (!CheckBase64(InternalSecondaryKey))
				{
					throw new InvalidDataContractException(SRCore.SharedAccessKeyShouldbeBase64);
				}
			}
			if (!IsValidCombinationOfRights(base.Rights))
			{
				throw new InvalidDataContractException(SRClient.InvalidCombinationOfManageRight);
			}
		}

		private static bool CheckBase64(string base64EncodedString)
		{
			try
			{
				Convert.FromBase64String(base64EncodedString);
				return true;
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected override void ValidateRights(IEnumerable<AccessRights> value)
		{

			if (!IsValidCombinationOfRights(value))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.InvalidCombinationOfManageRight);
			}
		}

		private static bool IsValidCombinationOfRights(IEnumerable<AccessRights> rights)
		{
			if (rights.Contains(AccessRights.Manage))
			{
				return rights.Count() == 3;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			int num = base.GetHashCode();
			string[] array = new string[3] { KeyName, PrimaryKey, SecondaryKey };
			foreach (string text in array)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					num += text.GetHashCode();
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!base.Equals(obj))
			{
				return false;
			}
			SharedAccessAuthorizationRule sharedAccessAuthorizationRule = (SharedAccessAuthorizationRule)obj;
			if (string.Equals(KeyName, sharedAccessAuthorizationRule.KeyName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) && string.Equals(PrimaryKey, sharedAccessAuthorizationRule.PrimaryKey, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				return string.Equals(SecondaryKey, sharedAccessAuthorizationRule.SecondaryKey, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static string GenerateRandomKey()
		{
			byte[] array = new byte[32];
			using (RNGCryptoServiceProvider rNGCryptoServiceProvider = new RNGCryptoServiceProvider())
			{
				rNGCryptoServiceProvider.GetBytes(array);
			}
			return Convert.ToBase64String(array);
		}

		internal static SharedAccessAuthorizationRule GenerateSystemRule()
		{
			SharedAccessAuthorizationRule sharedAccessAuthorizationRule = new SharedAccessAuthorizationRule();
			sharedAccessAuthorizationRule.IsSystemRule = true;
			sharedAccessAuthorizationRule.ClaimType = "SharedAccessKey";
			sharedAccessAuthorizationRule.ClaimValue = "None";
			sharedAccessAuthorizationRule.PrimaryKey = GenerateRandomKey();
			sharedAccessAuthorizationRule.SecondaryKey = GenerateRandomKey();
			sharedAccessAuthorizationRule.Rights = new AccessRights[3]
			{
				AccessRights.Manage,
				AccessRights.Send,
				AccessRights.Listen
			};
			sharedAccessAuthorizationRule.KeyName = "$system";
			return sharedAccessAuthorizationRule;
		}

	internal static class ExpressionEvaluator
	{
		private enum TokenType
		{
			None,
			Dollar,
			Hash,
			Dot,
			Percentage,
			SingleLiteral,
			DoubleLiteral,
			Body
		}

		public enum ExpressionType
		{
			Literal,
			Numeric,
			String,
			Composite,
			None
		}

		private class Token
		{
			public bool EmptyString { get; set; }

			public int Length { get; set; }

			public string Property { get; set; }

			public TokenType Type { get; set; }

			public string DefaultValue { get; set; }
		}

		public const string InternalBodyProperty = "READ_ONCE_BODY_PUSHNOTIFICATION";

		public const string InternalJsonNavigationProperty = "FIRST_LEVEL_JSON_NAVIGATION_PUSHNOTIFICATION";

		private const string BodyExpression = "$body";

		public const int MaxLengthOfPropertyName = 120;

		public static readonly Regex PropertyNameRegEx = new Regex("^[A-Za-z0-9_]+$");

		public static string Evaluate(string expression, BrokeredMessage message)
		{
			ExpressionType expressionType;
			return Evaluate(expression, message, out expressionType);
		}

		public static string Evaluate(string expression, BrokeredMessage message, out ExpressionType expressionType)
		{
			expressionType = ExpressionType.None;
			if (expression == null)
			{
				return expression;
			}
			List<Token> tokens = ValidateAndTokenize(expression, out expressionType);
			if (expressionType == ExpressionType.Literal)
			{
				return expression;
			}
			List<string> values = ExtractValuesFromMessage(tokens, message);
			return Evaluate(values);
		}

		public static ExpressionType Validate(string expression, ApiVersion version)
		{
			ExpressionType expressionType;
			List<Token> list = ValidateAndTokenize(expression, out expressionType);
			if (version > ApiVersion.Three)
			{
				Token token = list.Find((Token t) => t.Type == TokenType.Body);
				if (token != null)
				{
					throw new InvalidDataContractException(SRClient.BodyIsNotSupportedExpression);
				}
			}
			return expressionType;
		}

		private static List<Token> ValidateAndTokenize(string expression, out ExpressionType expressionType)
		{
			expressionType = PeekExpressionType(expression);
			if (expressionType == ExpressionType.Literal)
			{
				return new List<Token>();
			}
			List<Token> list = new List<Token>();
			string text = expression;
			if (expressionType == ExpressionType.Composite)
			{
				if (expression[expression.Length - 1] != '}')
				{
					throw new InvalidDataContractException(SRClient.ExpressionMissingClosingParenthesesNoToken(expression));
				}
				text = expression.Substring(1, expression.Length - 2).TrimEnd();
			}
			while (true)
			{
				Token token = new Token();
				text = text.TrimStart();
				if (text.Length < 3)
				{
					throw new InvalidDataContractException(SRClient.ExpressionInvalidToken(expression, text));
				}
				int num;
				switch (text[0])
				{
				case '.':
					token.Type = TokenType.Dot;
					num = ExtractToken(expression, text, token);
					break;
				case '%':
					token.Type = TokenType.Percentage;
					num = ExtractToken(expression, text, token);
					break;
				case '\'':
					token.Type = TokenType.SingleLiteral;
					num = ExtractLiteral(expression, text, token);
					break;
				case '"':
					token.Type = TokenType.DoubleLiteral;
					num = ExtractLiteral(expression, text, token);
					break;
				case '#':
					token.Type = TokenType.Hash;
					num = ExtractToken(expression, text, token);
					break;
				case '$':
					if (text.ToLowerInvariant().StartsWith("$body", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
					{
						num = "$body".Length - 1;
						token.Type = TokenType.Body;
					}
					else
					{
						token.Type = TokenType.Dollar;
						num = ExtractToken(expression, text, token);
					}
					break;
				default:
					throw new InvalidDataContractException(SRClient.ExpressionInvalidTokenType(expression, text));
				}
				if (token.Type != TokenType.SingleLiteral && token.Type != TokenType.DoubleLiteral && token.Type != TokenType.Body && !string.Equals(token.Property, "$body", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
				{
					if (!PropertyNameRegEx.IsMatch(token.Property))
					{
						throw new InvalidDataContractException(SRClient.PropertyNameIsBad(token.Property));
					}
					if (token.Property.Length > 120)
					{
						throw new InvalidDataContractException(SRClient.PropertyTooLong(token.Property.Length, 120));
					}
				}
				list.Add(token);
				if (text.Length == num + 1)
				{
					break;
				}
				text = text.Substring(num + 1).TrimStart();
				if (text[0] != '+')
				{
					throw new InvalidDataContractException(SRClient.ExpressionInvalidCompositionOperator(expression, text));
				}
				text = text.Substring(1);
			}
			if (list.Count > 1 && list.Find((Token token2) => token2.Type == TokenType.Hash) != null)
			{
				throw new InvalidDataContractException(SRClient.ExpressionHashInComposite);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static List<string> ExtractValuesFromMessage(List<Token> tokens, BrokeredMessage message)
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			IDictionary<string, string> dictionary = ReadFirstLevelJsonProperties(message);
			foreach (Token token in tokens)
			{
				if (token.Type == TokenType.Body)
				{
					list.Add(ReadBody(message));
					continue;
				}
				if (token.Type == TokenType.SingleLiteral || token.Type == TokenType.DoubleLiteral)
				{
					list.Add(token.Property);
					continue;
				}
				if (token.EmptyString || token.Length != 0)
				{
					string value = string.Empty;
					object value2;
					if (token.Property == "$body")
					{
						value = ReadBody(message);
					}
					else if (message.Properties.TryGetValue(token.Property, out value2))
					{
						value = value2.ToString();
					}
					else
					{
						dictionary.TryGetValue(token.Property, out value);
					}
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
					{
						if (token.Length >= value.Length || (token.Type != TokenType.Dollar && value.Length <= token.Length + 3))
						{
							list.Add(value);
						}
						else if (token.Type == TokenType.Dollar)
						{
							list.Add(value.Substring(0, token.Length));
						}
						else
						{
							list.Add(value.Substring(0, token.Length) + "...");
						}
					}
					continue;
				}
				string value3 = string.Empty;
				object value4;
				if (string.Equals(token.Property, "$body", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
				{
					value3 = ReadBody(message);
				}
				else if (message.Properties.TryGetValue(token.Property, out value4))
				{
					value3 = value4.ToString();
				}
				else
				{
					dictionary.TryGetValue(token.Property, out value3);
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value3))
				{
					if (token.Type == TokenType.Percentage)
					{
						list.Add(Uri.EscapeDataString(value3));
					}
					else
					{
						list.Add(value3);
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static string Evaluate(List<string> values)
		{
			if (values.Count == 1)
			{
				return values[0];
			}
			int expectedStringSize = 0;
			values.ForEach(delegate(string s)
			{
				expectedStringSize += s.Length;
			});
			StringBuilder finalString = new StringBuilder(expectedStringSize);
			values.ForEach(delegate(string s)
			{
				finalString.Append(s);
			});
			return finalString.ToString();
		}

		private static ExpressionType PeekExpressionType(string expression)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(expression))
			{
				return ExpressionType.Literal;
			}
			switch (expression[0])
			{
			case '$':
			case '%':
			case '.':
				return ExpressionType.String;
			case '#':
				return ExpressionType.Numeric;
			case '{':
				return ExpressionType.Composite;
			default:
				return ExpressionType.Literal;
			}
		}

		private static int ExtractLiteral(string fullExpression, string tokenBegin, Token token)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int startIndex = 1;
			char c = ((token.Type == TokenType.SingleLiteral) ? '\'' : '"');
			bool flag = false;
			while (true)
			{
				num = tokenBegin.IndexOf(c, startIndex);
				if (num == -1)
				{
					throw new InvalidDataContractException(SRClient.ExpressionLiteralMissingClosingNotation(fullExpression, tokenBegin));
				}
				if (num + 1 >= tokenBegin.Length || tokenBegin[num + 1] != c)
				{
					break;
				}
				flag = true;
				startIndex = num + 2;
			}
			string text = tokenBegin.Substring(1, num - 1);
			if (flag)
			{
				token.Property = ((token.Type == TokenType.DoubleLiteral) ? text.Replace("\"\"", "\"") : text.Replace("''", "'"));
			}
			else
			{
				token.Property = text;
			}
			return num;
		}

		public static string ReadBody(BrokeredMessage message)
		{
			return message.Properties["READ_ONCE_BODY_PUSHNOTIFICATION"] as string;
		}

		internal static IDictionary<string, string> ReadFirstLevelJsonProperties(BrokeredMessage message)
		{
			if (message.Properties.TryGetValue("FIRST_LEVEL_JSON_NAVIGATION_PUSHNOTIFICATION", out var value))
			{
				return (IDictionary<string, string>)value;
			}
			return new Dictionary<string, string>();
		}

		private static int ExtractToken(string fullExpression, string tokenBegin, Token token)
		{
			if (tokenBegin[1] != '(')
			{
				throw new InvalidDataContractException(SRClient.ExpressionMissingOpenParentheses(fullExpression, tokenBegin));
			}
			int num = tokenBegin.IndexOf(')');
			int num2 = tokenBegin.IndexOf(',');
			int num3 = tokenBegin.IndexOf(":{", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
			int num4 = num3 + 2;
			int num5 = 0;
			if (num3 > 1 && num3 < num)
			{
				if (num3 < 3)
				{
					throw new InvalidDataContractException(SRClient.ExpressionMissingProperty(fullExpression, tokenBegin));
				}
				bool flag = false;
				while (true)
				{
					if (num4 >= tokenBegin.Length)
					{
						throw new InvalidDataContractException(SRClient.ExpressionMissingDefaultEnd(fullExpression, tokenBegin));
					}
					if (tokenBegin[num4] == '}' && !flag)
					{
						break;
					}
					flag = tokenBegin[num4] == '\\' && !flag;
					num4++;
				}
				num5 = num4 - num3 + 1;
				token.DefaultValue = tokenBegin.Substring(num3 + 2, num5 - 3);
				num2 = tokenBegin.IndexOf(',', num4);
				num = tokenBegin.IndexOf(')', num4);
			}
			if (num == -1)
			{
				throw new InvalidDataContractException(SRClient.ExpressionMissingClosingParentheses(fullExpression, tokenBegin));
			}
			if ((token.Type == TokenType.Percentage || token.Type == TokenType.Hash) && num2 != -1 && num2 < num)
			{
				throw new InvalidDataContractException(SRClient.ExpressionErrorParsePercentFormat(fullExpression, tokenBegin));
			}
			if (token.Type == TokenType.Dot && num2 == -1)
			{
				throw new InvalidDataContractException(SRClient.ExpressionErrorParseDotFormat(fullExpression, tokenBegin));
			}
			int result = 0;
			if (num2 != -1 && num2 < num)
			{
				string text = tokenBegin.Substring(num2 + 1, num - num2 - 1);
				if (!int.TryParse(text, out result) || result < 0)
				{
					throw new InvalidDataContractException(SRClient.ExpressionIsNotPositiveInteger(fullExpression, tokenBegin, text));
				}
				if (result == 0)
				{
					token.EmptyString = true;
				}
				token.Length = result;
				token.Property = tokenBegin.Substring(2, num2 - 2 - num5);
			}
			else
			{
				token.Property = tokenBegin.Substring(2, num - 2 - num5);
			}
			token.Property = token.Property.Trim();
			return num;
		}
	}
	internal interface IMessageBrowser
	{
		BrokeredMessage Peek();

		BrokeredMessage Peek(long fromSequenceNumber);

		IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> PeekBatch(int messageCount);

		IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> PeekBatch(long fromSequenceNumber, int messageCount);

		Task<BrokeredMessage> PeekAsync();

		Task<BrokeredMessage> PeekAsync(long fromSequenceNumber);

		Task<IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage>> PeekBatchAsync(int messageCount);

		Task<IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage>> PeekBatchAsync(long fromSequenceNumber, int messageCount);
	}
	internal abstract class MessageBrowser : MessagingEntityClient, IMessageBrowser
	{
		private sealed class RetryBrowserAsyncResult : RetryAsyncResult<RetryBrowserAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly MessageBrowser browser;

			private readonly PeekOptions peekOptions;

			public IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> Messages { get; private set; }

			public RetryBrowserAsyncResult(MessageBrowser browser, PeekOptions peekOptions, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.browser = browser;
				this.peekOptions = peekOptions;
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				int iteration = 0;
				TimeSpan iterationSleep = (browser.RetryPolicy.IsServerBusy ? RetryPolicy.ServerBusyBaseSleepTime : TimeSpan.Zero);
				if (browser.RetryPolicy.IsServerBusy && RetryPolicy.ServerBusyBaseSleepTime >= base.OriginalTimeout)
				{
					string serverBusyExceptionMessage = browser.RetryPolicy.ServerBusyExceptionMessage;
					yield return CallAsyncSleep(RemainingTime());
					Complete(new ServerBusyException(serverBusyExceptionMessage, peekOptions.TrackingContext));
					yield break;
				}
				bool shouldRetry;
				do
				{
					shouldRetry = false;
					if (iterationSleep != TimeSpan.Zero)
					{
						yield return CallAsyncSleep(iterationSleep);
					}
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((RetryBrowserAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.browser.OnBeginPeek(thisPtr.peekOptions, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(RetryBrowserAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.Messages = thisPtr.browser.OnEndPeek(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
					if (Messages != null && Messages.AnySlim())
					{
						browser.LastPeekedSequenceNumber = Messages.LastSlim().SequenceNumber;
					}
					if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
					{
						MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementExceptionPerSec(browser.MessagingFactory.Address, 1, base.LastAsyncStepException);
						shouldRetry = !base.TransactionExists && browser.RetryPolicy.ShouldRetry(RemainingTime(), iteration, base.LastAsyncStepException, out iterationSleep);
						if (shouldRetry)
						{
							MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
							{
								MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteRetryPolicyIteration(peekOptions.TrackingContext.Activity, peekOptions.TrackingContext.TrackingId, browser.RetryPolicy.GetType().Name, "Peek", iteration, iterationSleep.ToString(), base.LastAsyncStepException.GetType().FullName, base.LastAsyncStepException.Message);
							});
							iteration++;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						browser.RetryPolicy.ResetServerBusy();
					}
				}
				while (shouldRetry);
				Complete(base.LastAsyncStepException);
			}
		}

		private readonly OpenOnceManager openOnceManager;

		private readonly TimeSpan operationTimeout;

		private long lastPeekedSequenceNumber;

		internal TrackingContext InstanceTrackingContext { get; set; }

		internal MessagingFactory MessagingFactory { get; private set; }

		public virtual long LastPeekedSequenceNumber
		{
			get
			{
				return lastPeekedSequenceNumber;
			}
			internal set
			{
				if (value < 0)
				{
					throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentOutOfRange("LastPeekedSequenceNumber", value, SRClient.ArgumentOutOfRange(0, long.MaxValue));
				}
				lastPeekedSequenceNumber = value;
			}
		}

		internal override TimeSpan OperationTimeout => operationTimeout;

		internal MessageBrowser(MessagingFactory messagingFactory, string path, MessagingEntityType? entityType, RetryPolicy retryPolicy)
			: base(path, entityType)
		{
			MessagingFactory = messagingFactory;
			operationTimeout = messagingFactory.OperationTimeout;
			lastPeekedSequenceNumber = Constants.DefaultLastPeekedSequenceNumber;
			base.RetryPolicy = retryPolicy ?? messagingFactory.RetryPolicy.Clone();
			openOnceManager = new OpenOnceManager(this);
		}

		public BrokeredMessage Peek()
		{
			return Peek(LastPeekedSequenceNumber + 1);
		}

		public BrokeredMessage Peek(long fromSequenceNumber)
		{
			return Peek(null, fromSequenceNumber, OperationTimeout);
		}

		public IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> PeekBatch(int messageCount)
		{
			return PeekBatch(LastPeekedSequenceNumber + 1, messageCount);
		}

		public IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> PeekBatch(long fromSequenceNumber, int messageCount)
		{
			return PeekBatch(null, fromSequenceNumber, messageCount, OperationTimeout);
		}

		internal BrokeredMessage Peek(TrackingContext trackingContext, long fromSequenceNumber, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages = PeekBatch(trackingContext, fromSequenceNumber, 1, timeout);
			return GetTopMessage(messages);
		}

		internal IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> PeekBatch(TrackingContext trackingContext, long fromSequenceNumber, int messageCount, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			TimeoutHelper.ThrowIfNegativeArgument(timeout);
			if (trackingContext == null)
			{
				trackingContext = TrackingContext.Create(Guid.NewGuid(), base.Path);
			}
			TracePeek(EventTraceActivity.CreateFromThread(), trackingContext);
			if (openOnceManager.ShouldOpen)
			{
				openOnceManager.Open();
			}
			return OnPeek(trackingContext, fromSequenceNumber, messageCount, timeout);
		}

		public Task<BrokeredMessage> PeekAsync()
		{
			return TaskHelpers.FromAsync((Func<AsyncCallback, object, IAsyncResult>)((AsyncCallback c, object s) => BeginPeekBatch(new PeekOptions(null, LastPeekedSequenceNumber + 1, 1), OperationTimeout, c, s)), (Func<IAsyncResult, BrokeredMessage>)EndPeek, (object)null);
		}

		public Task<BrokeredMessage> PeekAsync(long fromSequenceNumber)
		{
			return TaskHelpers.FromAsync((Func<AsyncCallback, object, IAsyncResult>)((AsyncCallback c, object s) => BeginPeekBatch(new PeekOptions(null, fromSequenceNumber, 1), OperationTimeout, c, s)), (Func<IAsyncResult, BrokeredMessage>)EndPeek, (object)null);
		}

		public Task<IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage>> PeekBatchAsync(int messageCount)
		{
			return TaskHelpers.FromAsync((Func<AsyncCallback, object, IAsyncResult>)((AsyncCallback c, object s) => BeginPeekBatch(new PeekOptions(null, LastPeekedSequenceNumber + 1, messageCount), OperationTimeout, c, s)), (Func<IAsyncResult, IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage>>)EndPeekBatch, (object)null);
		}

		public Task<IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage>> PeekBatchAsync(long fromSequenceNumber, int messageCount)
		{
			return TaskHelpers.FromAsync((Func<AsyncCallback, object, IAsyncResult>)((AsyncCallback c, object s) => BeginPeekBatch(new PeekOptions(null, fromSequenceNumber, messageCount), OperationTimeout, c, s)), (Func<IAsyncResult, IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage>>)EndPeekBatch, (object)null);
		}

		internal IAsyncResult BeginPeekBatch(PeekOptions peekOptions, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			TimeoutHelper.ThrowIfNegativeArgument(timeout);
			if (peekOptions.TrackingContext == null)
			{
				peekOptions.TrackingContext = TrackingContext.Create(Guid.NewGuid(), base.Path);
			}
			TracePeek(EventTraceActivity.CreateFromThread(), peekOptions.TrackingContext);
			if (openOnceManager.ShouldOpen)
			{
				return openOnceManager.Begin(callback, state, delegate(AsyncCallback c, object s)
				{
					RetryBrowserAsyncResult retryBrowserAsyncResult2 = new RetryBrowserAsyncResult(this, peekOptions, timeout, c, s);
					retryBrowserAsyncResult2.Start();
					return retryBrowserAsyncResult2;
				}, (IAsyncResult a) => AsyncResult<RetryBrowserAsyncResult>.End(a).Messages);
			}
			RetryBrowserAsyncResult retryBrowserAsyncResult = new RetryBrowserAsyncResult(this, peekOptions, timeout, callback, state);
			retryBrowserAsyncResult.Start();
			return retryBrowserAsyncResult;
		}

		internal BrokeredMessage EndPeek(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages = EndPeekBatch(result);
			return GetTopMessage(messages);
		}

		internal IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> EndPeekBatch(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (OpenOnceManager.ShouldEnd<IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage>>(result))
			{
				return OpenOnceManager.End<IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage>>(result);
			}
			return AsyncResult<RetryBrowserAsyncResult>.End(result).Messages;
		}

		protected abstract IAsyncResult OnBeginPeek(PeekOptions peekOptions, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state);

		protected abstract IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> OnEndPeek(IAsyncResult result);

		protected virtual IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> OnPeek(TrackingContext trackingContext, long fromSequenceNumber, int messageCount, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			RetryBrowserAsyncResult retryBrowserAsyncResult = new RetryBrowserAsyncResult(this, new PeekOptions(trackingContext, fromSequenceNumber, messageCount), timeout, null, null);
			retryBrowserAsyncResult.RunSynchronously();
			return retryBrowserAsyncResult.Messages;
		}

		private static BrokeredMessage GetTopMessage(IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages)
		{
			return messages?.FirstOrDefault();
		}

		private static void TracePeek(EventTraceActivity activity, TrackingContext trackingContext)
		{
			if (activity != null && activity != EventTraceActivity.Empty && trackingContext != null)
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.MessageReceiveTransfer(activity, trackingContext.Activity);
				});
			}
		}
	}

			}

					throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.NotSupportedPropertyType(type), "value");
				}
			}
			inner.Add(key, value);
		}

		{
			return inner.ContainsKey(key);
		}

		{

		}

		{

		}

		{
			inner.Add(item);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			inner.Clear();
		}

		public bool Contains(KeyValuePair<string, object> item)
		{
			return inner.Contains(item);
		}

		public void CopyTo(KeyValuePair<string, object>[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			inner.CopyTo(array, arrayIndex);
		}

		public bool Remove(KeyValuePair<string, object> item)
		{
			return inner.Remove(item);
		}

		public IEnumerator<KeyValuePair<string, object>> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return inner.GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return inner.GetEnumerator();
		}
	}
