		private bool IpFilterValidation(IPAddress ipAddress, IEnumerable<IpFilterAuthorizationRule> ipFilters, out AccessCheckResult reason)
		{
			if (ipAddress == null || ipAddress.AddressFamily == AddressFamily.InterNetworkV6)
			{
				reason = AccessCheckResult.NotValidIPV4Address;
				return false;
			}
			reason = AccessCheckResult.NoIPFilter;
			foreach (IpFilterAuthorizationRule ipFilter in ipFilters)
			{
				if (ipFilter.IsInRange(ipAddress) && ipFilter.Action == IpFilterActionType.Accept)
				{
					reason = AccessCheckResult.MatchesIPAddrFilter;
					return true;
				}
			}
			reason = AccessCheckResult.NoMatchIPAddrFilter;
			return false;
		}

		internal bool IsClientAccessFromAllowedNetwork(VirtualNetworkInformation clientNetworkInfo, bool systemSasRuleBypass, out AccessCheckResult reason)
		{
			IEnumerable<VirtualNetworkAuthorizationRule> enumerable = this.OfType<VirtualNetworkAuthorizationRule>();
			IEnumerable<IpFilterAuthorizationRule> enumerable2 = this.OfType<IpFilterAuthorizationRule>();
			if (clientNetworkInfo.IsPrivateLink)
			{
				IEnumerable<PrivateEndpointAuthorizationRule> privateEndpointRules = this.OfType<PrivateEndpointAuthorizationRule>();
				return TryValidatePrivateEndpointRules(clientNetworkInfo, privateEndpointRules, out reason);
			}
			bool flag;
			if (systemSasRuleBypass && TryGetSystemSasRule(out var _))
			{
				reason = AccessCheckResult.InternalConnection;
				flag = true;
			}
			else if (enumerable.Any() && enumerable2.Any())
			{
				flag = ValidateVirtualNetworkAuthorizationRules(clientNetworkInfo, enumerable, out reason);
				if (!flag)
				{
					flag = IpFilterValidation(clientNetworkInfo.PublicAddress, enumerable2, out reason);
					if (!flag)
					{
						reason = AccessCheckResult.NoMatchAnyRules;
					}
				}
			}
			else if (enumerable.Any())
			{
				flag = ValidateVirtualNetworkAuthorizationRules(clientNetworkInfo, enumerable, out reason);
			}
			else if (enumerable2.Any())
			{
				flag = IpFilterValidation(clientNetworkInfo.PublicAddress, enumerable2, out reason);
			}
			else
			{
				reason = AccessCheckResult.NoConnectionRulesDefined;
				flag = false;
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private bool ValidateVirtualNetworkAuthorizationRules(VirtualNetworkInformation networkInfo, IEnumerable<VirtualNetworkAuthorizationRule> vnetRules, out AccessCheckResult reason)
		{
			if (networkInfo.PrivateAddress == null)
			{
				reason = AccessCheckResult.IPAddrNotInVNet;
				return false;
			}
			foreach (VirtualNetworkAuthorizationRule vnetRule in vnetRules)
			{
				if (vnetRule.VnetTrafficTag == (int)networkInfo.VnetTrafficTag && vnetRule.SubnetTrafficTag == networkInfo.SubnetTrafficTag)
				{
					reason = AccessCheckResult.MatchesVNetRule;
					return true;
				}
			}
			reason = AccessCheckResult.NoMatchVNetRule;
			return false;
		}

		private static bool TryValidatePrivateEndpointRules(VirtualNetworkInformation networkInfo, IEnumerable<PrivateEndpointAuthorizationRule> privateEndpointRules, out AccessCheckResult reason)
		{
			foreach (PrivateEndpointAuthorizationRule privateEndpointRule in privateEndpointRules)
			{
				if (privateEndpointRule.LinkIds.Contains(networkInfo.PrivateLinkId))
				{
					reason = AccessCheckResult.MatchesPrivateLinkRule;
					return true;
				}
			}
			reason = AccessCheckResult.NoMatchPrivateLinkRule;
			return false;
		}

	internal sealed class AsyncWaiter : Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult, IWaiter
	{
		private static readonly Action<object> timerCallback = OnTimerCallback;

		private volatile int waitResult;

		private volatile int waiterSignaled;

		private IOThreadTimer ioThreadTimer;

		private bool signalCalled;

		private bool timerCallbackCalled;

		private string dueTime = "DateTime.MaxValue";

		public AsyncWaiter(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			: this(timeout, callback, state, startTimer: true)
		{
		}

		public AsyncWaiter(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state, bool startTimer)
			: base(callback, state)
		{
			if (timeout != TimeSpan.MaxValue && startTimer)
			{
				StartTimer(timeout);
			}
		}

		public static bool End(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			AsyncWaiter asyncWaiter = Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult.End<AsyncWaiter>(result);
			return asyncWaiter.waiterSignaled == 1;
		}

		public void StartTimer(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			if (timeout != TimeSpan.MaxValue)
			{
				ioThreadTimer = new IOThreadTimer(timerCallback, this, isTypicallyCanceledShortlyAfterBeingSet: true);
				ioThreadTimer.Set(timeout);
				dueTime = TimeoutHelper.Add(DateTime.UtcNow, timeout).ToString("R");
			}
		}

		public bool Cancel()
		{
			return Cancel(synchronous: false);
		}

		public bool Cancel(bool synchronous)
		{
			return Signal(synchronous, new OperationCanceledException());
		}

		public bool Signal()
		{
			return Signal(synchronous: false, null);
		}

		public bool Signal(bool synchronous)
		{
			return Signal(synchronous, null);
		}

		public bool Signal(bool synchronous, Exception exception)
		{
			signalCalled = true;
			if (((ioThreadTimer != null && ioThreadTimer.Cancel()) || ioThreadTimer == null) && Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref waitResult, 1, 0) == 0)
			{
				waiterSignaled = 1;
				Complete(synchronous, exception);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static void OnTimerCallback(object state)
		{
			AsyncWaiter asyncWaiter = (AsyncWaiter)state;
			asyncWaiter.timerCallbackCalled = true;
			if (Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref asyncWaiter.waitResult, 1, 0) == 0)
			{
				asyncWaiter.Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: false);
			}
		}
	}

	{
		[DataMember(Name = "Actions", EmitDefaultValue = false, IsRequired = true, Order = 65537)]
		private readonly List<RuleAction> actions;

		public CompositeAction()

			actions = new List<RuleAction>();
		}

		public CompositeAction(IEnumerable<RuleAction> actions)
		{
			this.actions = new List<RuleAction>(actions);
		}

		{
			actions.Add(action);
		}

		public override RuleAction Preprocess()
		{
			List<RuleAction> list = new List<RuleAction>();
			foreach (RuleAction action in actions)
			{
				RuleAction ruleAction = action;
				while (ruleAction.RequiresPreprocessing)
				{
					ruleAction = action.Preprocess();
				}
				list.Add(ruleAction);
			}
			return new CompositeAction(list);
		}

		public override BrokeredMessage Execute(BrokeredMessage message)
		{
			foreach (RuleAction action in actions)
			{
				action.Execute(message);
			}
			return message;
		}

		{
			foreach (RuleAction action in actions)
			{
				action.Execute(message, context);
			}
			return message;
		}

		public override void Validate()
		{
			foreach (RuleAction action in actions)
			{
				action.Validate();
			}
		}

		public IEnumerator<RuleAction> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return actions.GetEnumerator();
		}

		{
			return actions.GetEnumerator();
		}
	}

	{

		public QualifiedPropertyName PropertyName { get; private set; }

		[DataMember(Name = "Value", Order = 65538, IsRequired = false, EmitDefaultValue = false)]
		public object Value { get; set; }

		public PropertyReference(string propertyName)
		{
			PropertyName = new QualifiedPropertyName(PropertyScope.User, propertyName);
		}

		public PropertyReference(PropertyScope scope, string propertyName)
		{
			PropertyName = new QualifiedPropertyName(scope, propertyName);
		}

		public PropertyReference(QualifiedPropertyName propertyName)
		{
			PropertyName = propertyName;
		}

		public static T GetValue<T>(object propertyReferenceOrValue)
		{
			if (propertyReferenceOrValue is PropertyReference propertyReference)
			{
				return (T)propertyReference.Value;
			}
			return (T)propertyReferenceOrValue;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return PropertyName.ToString();
		}
	}
	internal sealed class RuleExecutionContext
	{
		private readonly IRuleManager ruleManager;

		public string SubscriptionName { get; private set; }

		public string RuleName { get; private set; }

		public RuleExecutionContext(string subscriptionName, string ruleName, IRuleManager ruleManager)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(subscriptionName))
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("subscriptionName");
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(ruleName))
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("subscriptionName");
			}
			if (ruleManager == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("ruleManager");
			}
			SubscriptionName = subscriptionName;
			RuleName = ruleName;
			this.ruleManager = ruleManager;
		}

		public void AddRule(RuleDescription description)
		{
			ruleManager.AddRule(SubscriptionName, description);
		}
	}
	[DataContract(Namespace = "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2010/10/servicebus/connect")]
	[KnownType(typeof(SqlRuleActionTemplate))]
	internal abstract class RuleActionTemplate
	{
		internal RuleActionTemplate()
		{
		}

		public abstract RuleAction Create();

		internal abstract void Validate(ICollection<PropertyReference> initializationList);
	}
	[DataContract(Name = "RuleCreationAction", Namespace = "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2010/10/servicebus/connect")]
	[KnownType(typeof(PropertyReference))]
	internal class RuleCreationAction : RuleAction
	{
		[DataMember(Name = "Initializes", Order = 65537, EmitDefaultValue = false, IsRequired = false)]
		public ICollection<PropertyReference> Initializes { get; private set; }

		[DataMember(Name = "FilterTemplate", Order = 65537, EmitDefaultValue = false, IsRequired = true)]
		public FilterTemplate FilterTemplate { get; set; }

		[DataMember(Name = "ActionTemplate", Order = 65537, EmitDefaultValue = false, IsRequired = false)]
		public RuleActionTemplate ActionTemplate { get; set; }

		[DataMember(Name = "Tag", Order = 65537, EmitDefaultValue = false, IsRequired = false)]
		public object Tag { get; set; }

		public override bool RequiresPreprocessing => false;

		public RuleCreationAction()
		{
			Initializes = new List<PropertyReference>();
		}

		public override RuleAction Preprocess()
		{
			return this;
		}

		public override BrokeredMessage Execute(BrokeredMessage message)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		internal override BrokeredMessage Execute(BrokeredMessage message, RuleExecutionContext context)
		{
			Validate();
			foreach (PropertyReference initialize in Initializes)
			{
				if (initialize.PropertyName.Scope == PropertyScope.System)
				{
					initialize.Value = message.GetSystemProperty(initialize.PropertyName.Name);
				}
				else
				{
					initialize.Value = message.Properties[initialize.PropertyName.Name];
				}
			}
			Filter filter = FilterTemplate.Create();
			RuleAction action = ((ActionTemplate != null) ? ActionTemplate.Create() : null);
			RuleDescription ruleDescription = new RuleDescription(Guid.NewGuid().ToString(), filter);
			ruleDescription.Action = action;
			ruleDescription.Tag = PropertyReference.GetValue<string>(Tag);
			context.AddRule(ruleDescription);
			return message;
		}

		public override void Validate()
		{
			if (FilterTemplate == null)
			{
				throw new RuleActionException(SRClient.RuleCreationActionRequiresFilterTemplate);
			}
			FilterTemplate.Validate(Initializes);
			if (ActionTemplate != null)
			{
				ActionTemplate.Validate(Initializes);
			}
			if (Tag is PropertyReference propertyReference && !Initializes.Contains(propertyReference))
			{
				throw new RuleActionException(SRClient.PropertyReferenceUsedWithoutInitializes(propertyReference));
			}
		}

		[OnDeserialized]
		private void OnDeserialized(StreamingContext context)
		{
			if (Initializes == null)
			{
				Initializes = new Collection<PropertyReference>();
			}
		}
	}
	[DataContract(Name = "SqlFilterTemplate", Namespace = "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2010/10/servicebus/connect")]
	[KnownType(typeof(DateTimeOffset))]
	internal class SqlFilterTemplate : FilterTemplate
	{
		[DataMember(Name = "Parameters", Order = 65538, EmitDefaultValue = false, IsRequired = false)]
		private PropertyReferenceDictionary parameters;

		[DataMember(Name = "SqlExpression", Order = 65537, EmitDefaultValue = false, IsRequired = true)]
		public string SqlExpression { get; set; }

		public IDictionary<string, object> Parameters => parameters ?? (parameters = new PropertyReferenceDictionary());

		public SqlFilterTemplate(string sqlExpression)
		{
			SqlExpression = sqlExpression;
		}

		public override Filter Create()
		{
			SqlFilter sqlFilter = new SqlFilter(SqlExpression);
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, object> parameter in Parameters)
			{
				sqlFilter.Parameters[parameter.Key] = PropertyReference.GetValue<object>(parameter.Value);
			}
			return sqlFilter;
		}

		internal override void Validate(ICollection<PropertyReference> initializationList)
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, object> parameter in Parameters)
			{
				if (parameter.Value is PropertyReference propertyReference && !initializationList.Contains(propertyReference))
				{
					throw new RuleActionException(SRClient.PropertyReferenceUsedWithoutInitializes(propertyReference));
				}
			}
		}
	}
	[DataContract(Name = "SqlRuleActionTemplate", Namespace = "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2010/10/servicebus/connect")]
	[KnownType(typeof(DateTimeOffset))]
	internal class SqlRuleActionTemplate : RuleActionTemplate
	{
		[DataMember(Name = "SqlExpression", Order = 65537, EmitDefaultValue = false, IsRequired = true)]
		public string SqlExpression { get; set; }

		[DataMember(Name = "Parameters", Order = 65538, EmitDefaultValue = false, IsRequired = false)]
		public IDictionary<string, object> Parameters { get; private set; }

		public SqlRuleActionTemplate(string expression)
		{
			SqlExpression = expression;
			Parameters = new Dictionary<string, object>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
		}

		public override RuleAction Create()
		{
			SqlRuleAction sqlRuleAction = new SqlRuleAction(SqlExpression);
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, object> parameter in Parameters)
			{
				sqlRuleAction.Parameters[parameter.Key] = PropertyReference.GetValue<object>(parameter.Value);
			}
			return sqlRuleAction;
		}

		internal override void Validate(ICollection<PropertyReference> initializationList)
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, object> parameter in Parameters)
			{
				if (parameter.Value is PropertyReference propertyReference && !initializationList.Contains(propertyReference))
				{
					throw new RuleActionException(SRClient.PropertyReferenceUsedWithoutInitializes(propertyReference));
				}
			}
		}

		[OnDeserialized]
		private void OnDeserialized(StreamingContext context)
		{
			if (Parameters != null)
			{
				Parameters = new Dictionary<string, object>(Parameters, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
			}
			else
			{
				Parameters = new Dictionary<string, object>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
			}
		}
	}

	internal enum PropertyScope

	internal sealed class MessageReceivePump
	{
		private sealed class SyncCallbackAsyncResult : AsyncResult<SyncCallbackAsyncResult>
		{
			private static readonly Action<object> executeSyncCallback = ExecuteSyncCallback;

			private readonly MessageReceivePump owner;

			private readonly BrokeredMessage message;

			public SyncCallbackAsyncResult(MessageReceivePump owner, BrokeredMessage message, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(callback, state)
			{
				this.owner = owner;
				this.message = message;
				IOThreadScheduler.ScheduleCallbackNoFlow(executeSyncCallback, this);
			}

			private static void ExecuteSyncCallback(object state)
			{
				SyncCallbackAsyncResult syncCallbackAsyncResult = (SyncCallbackAsyncResult)state;
				Exception e = null;
				try
				{
					syncCallbackAsyncResult.owner.syncCallback(syncCallbackAsyncResult.message);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
					{
						throw;
					}
					e = ex;
				}
				syncCallbackAsyncResult.Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: false, e);
			}
		}

		private sealed class StartAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<StartAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly AsyncCallback onPumpCompleted = OnPumpCompleted;

			private readonly MessageReceivePump owner;

			private int currentRetryCount;

			public BrokeredMessage InitialMessage { get; private set; }

			public StartAsyncResult(MessageReceivePump owner, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(TimeSpan.MaxValue, callback, state)
			{
				this.owner = owner;
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				while (currentRetryCount <= 3)
				{
					currentRetryCount++;
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((StartAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.owner.receiver.BeginReceive(TimeSpan.Zero, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(StartAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.InitialMessage = thisPtr.owner.receiver.EndReceive(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
					if (base.LastAsyncStepException == null)
					{
						break;
					}
					if (!ShouldRetry(base.LastAsyncStepException))
					{
						Complete(base.LastAsyncStepException);
						yield break;
					}
					if (ShouldBackoff(base.LastAsyncStepException, out var amount))
					{
						yield return CallAsyncSleep(amount);
					}
				}
				try
				{
					new PumpAsyncResult(owner, InitialMessage, onPumpCompleted, this).Start();
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					Environment.FailFast(ex.ToString());
				}
			}

			private static void OnPumpCompleted(IAsyncResult ar)
			{
				try
				{
					AsyncResult<PumpAsyncResult>.End(ar);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					Environment.FailFast(ex.ToString());
				}
			}

			private bool ShouldRetry(Exception exception)
			{
				if (currentRetryCount == 3)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (exception is MessagingException ex)
				{
					return ex.IsTransient;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private sealed class PumpAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<PumpAsyncResult>
		{
			private static readonly Action<Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult, Exception> CompletingAction = Finally;

			private static readonly AsyncCallback onDispatchCompleted = OnDispatchCompleted;

			private readonly TrackingContext trackingContext;

			private readonly MessageReceivePump owner;

			private BrokeredMessage firstMessage;

			private BrokeredMessage message;

			public PumpAsyncResult(MessageReceivePump owner, BrokeredMessage firstMessage, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(TimeSpan.MaxValue, callback, state)
			{
				this.owner = owner;
				this.firstMessage = firstMessage;
				trackingContext = TrackingContext.Create(Guid.NewGuid(), owner.receiver.Path);
				base.OnCompleting = (Action<Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult, Exception>)Delegate.Combine(base.OnCompleting, CompletingAction);
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				while (owner.receiver.IsOpened)
				{
					if (!owner.semaphore.TryEnter())
					{
						yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((PumpAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.owner.semaphore.BeginEnter(c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(PumpAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
						{
							thisPtr.owner.semaphore.EndEnter(r);
						}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
					}
					message = null;
					if (firstMessage == null)
					{
						yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((PumpAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.owner.receiver.BeginReceive(thisPtr.owner.OnMessageOptions.ReceiveTimeOut, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(PumpAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
						{
							thisPtr.message = thisPtr.owner.receiver.EndReceive(r);
						}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
					}
					else
					{
						message = firstMessage;
						firstMessage = null;
					}
					if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
						{
							MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.MessageReceivePumpReceiveException(trackingContext.Activity, trackingContext.TrackingId, trackingContext.SystemTracker, base.LastAsyncStepException.ToString());
						});
						owner.RaiseExceptionReceivedEvent(base.LastAsyncStepException, "Receive");
						if (ShouldBackoff(base.LastAsyncStepException, out var amount))
						{
							MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
							{
								MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.MessageReceivePumpBackoff(trackingContext.Activity, trackingContext.TrackingId, trackingContext.SystemTracker, (int)ServerBusyExceptionBackoffAmount.TotalMilliseconds, base.LastAsyncStepException.ToString());
							});
							yield return CallAsyncSleep(amount);
						}
					}
					if (message == null)
					{
						owner.semaphore.Exit();
						continue;
					}
					try
					{
						new DispatchAsyncResult(owner, trackingContext, message, onDispatchCompleted, owner).Start();
					}
					catch (Exception ex)
					{
						if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
						{
							throw;
						}
						owner.semaphore.Exit();
					}
				}
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.MessageReceivePumpStopped(trackingContext.Activity, trackingContext.TrackingId, trackingContext.SystemTracker);
				});
			}

			private static void OnDispatchCompleted(IAsyncResult asyncResult)
			{
				MessageReceivePump messageReceivePump = (MessageReceivePump)asyncResult.AsyncState;
				try
				{
					AsyncResult<DispatchAsyncResult>.End(asyncResult);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
					{
						throw;
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					messageReceivePump.semaphore.Exit();
				}
			}

			private static void Finally(Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult asyncResult, Exception exception)
			{
				if (exception != null)
				{
					PumpAsyncResult thisPtr = (PumpAsyncResult)asyncResult;
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.MessageReceivePumpUnexpectedException(thisPtr.trackingContext.Activity, thisPtr.trackingContext.TrackingId, thisPtr.trackingContext.SystemTracker, exception.ToString());
					});
				}
			}
		}

		private sealed class RenewLockLoopAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<RenewLockLoopAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly MessageReceivePump pump;

			private readonly TrackingContext trackingContext;

			private readonly BrokeredMessage message;

			private readonly CancellationToken cancellationToken;

			public RenewLockLoopAsyncResult(MessageReceivePump pump, TrackingContext trackingContext, BrokeredMessage message, CancellationToken cancellationToken, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(TimeSpan.MaxValue, callback, state)
			{
				this.pump = pump;
				this.trackingContext = trackingContext;
				this.message = message;
				this.cancellationToken = cancellationToken;
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				while (!pump.receiver.IsClosed && !cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
				{
					TimeSpan amountToSleep = MessagingUtilities.CalculateRenewAfterDuration(message.LockedUntilUtc);
					yield return CallAsyncSleep(amountToSleep, cancellationToken);
					if (cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
					{
						break;
					}
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((RenewLockLoopAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.message.BeginRenewLock(c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(RenewLockLoopAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.message.EndRenewLock(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
					if (base.LastAsyncStepException == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					Exception renewLockException = base.LastAsyncStepException;
					if (renewLockException is NotSupportedException)
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
						{
							MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.MessageReceivePumpRenewLockNotSupported(trackingContext.Activity, trackingContext.SystemTracker, trackingContext.TrackingId, message.MessageId, renewLockException.ToStringSlim());
						});
						pump.renewSupported = false;
						break;
					}
					if (renewLockException is MessageLockLostException || renewLockException is ObjectDisposedException)
					{
						break;
					}
					if (renewLockException is InvalidOperationException)
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
						{
							MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.MessageReceivePumpRenewLockInvalidOperation(trackingContext.Activity, trackingContext.SystemTracker, trackingContext.TrackingId, message.MessageId, renewLockException.ToStringSlim());
						});
						break;
					}
					if (!(renewLockException is OperationCanceledException))
					{
						pump.RaiseExceptionReceivedEvent(renewLockException, "RenewLock");
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
						{
							MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.MessageReceivePumpRenewLockFailed(trackingContext.Activity, trackingContext.SystemTracker, trackingContext.TrackingId, message.MessageId, renewLockException.ToStringSlim());
						});
						continue;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private sealed class BatchCompleteAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<BatchCompleteAsyncResult>
		{
			private static readonly TimeSpan completionBufferWaitTime = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(500.0);

			private readonly MessageReceivePump owner;

			private readonly List<Guid> lockTokens;

			private readonly TrackingContext trackingContext;

			public MessageReceivePump Pump => owner;

			public TrackingContext TrackingContext => trackingContext;

			public BatchCompleteAsyncResult(MessageReceivePump owner, TrackingContext trackingContext, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.owner = owner;
				lockTokens = new List<Guid>();
				this.trackingContext = trackingContext;
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				yield return CallAsyncSleep(completionBufferWaitTime);
				lock (owner.completionList)
				{
					lockTokens.AddRange(owner.completionList);
					owner.completionList.Clear();
				}
				if (lockTokens.Count == 0)
				{
					yield break;
				}
				yield return CallParallelAsync<Guid>((ICollection<Guid>)lockTokens, (BeginCall<Guid>)((BatchCompleteAsyncResult thisPtr, Guid i, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.owner.receiver.BeginComplete(i, c, s)), (EndCall<Guid>)delegate(BatchCompleteAsyncResult thisPtr, Guid i, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					thisPtr.owner.receiver.EndComplete(r);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
				if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.MessageReceivePumpFailedToComplete(trackingContext.Activity, trackingContext.TrackingId, trackingContext.SystemTracker, base.LastAsyncStepException.ToString());
					});
					owner.RaiseExceptionReceivedEvent(base.LastAsyncStepException, "Complete");
				}
			}
		}

		private sealed class DispatchAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<DispatchAsyncResult>
		{
			private static readonly Action<object> StaticOnProcessingTimeout = OnProcessingTimeout;

			private static readonly Action<Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult, Exception> CompletingAction = Finally;

			private readonly MessageReceivePump owner;

			private readonly BrokeredMessage message;

			private readonly TrackingContext trackingContext;

			private readonly CancellationTokenSource renewCancellationTokenSource;

			private readonly IOThreadTimer processingTimer;

			public DispatchAsyncResult(MessageReceivePump owner, TrackingContext trackingContext, BrokeredMessage message, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(TimeSpan.MaxValue, callback, state)
			{
				this.owner = owner;
				this.message = message;
				this.trackingContext = trackingContext;
				processingTimer = new IOThreadTimer(StaticOnProcessingTimeout, this, isTypicallyCanceledShortlyAfterBeingSet: true);
				renewCancellationTokenSource = new CancellationTokenSource();
				base.OnCompleting = (Action<Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult, Exception>)Delegate.Combine(base.OnCompleting, CompletingAction);
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				if (ShouldRenewLock())
				{
					owner.ScheduleRenewLockLoop(trackingContext, message, renewCancellationTokenSource.Token);
					processingTimer.Set(owner.OnMessageOptions.AutoRenewTimeout);
				}
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((DispatchAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.owner.beginCallback(thisPtr.message, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(DispatchAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					thisPtr.owner.endCallback(r);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
				if (ShouldRenewLock())
				{
					processingTimer.Cancel();
					renewCancellationTokenSource.Cancel();
					renewCancellationTokenSource.Dispose();
				}
				if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.MessageReceivePumpUserCallbackException(trackingContext.Activity, trackingContext.TrackingId, trackingContext.SystemTracker, base.LastAsyncStepException.ToString());
					});
					owner.RaiseExceptionReceivedEvent(base.LastAsyncStepException, "UserCallback");
				}
				if (owner.receiver.Mode != ReceiveMode.PeekLock)
				{
					yield break;
				}
				if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
				{
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((DispatchAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.owner.receiver.BeginAbandon(thisPtr.message.LockToken, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(DispatchAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.owner.receiver.EndAbandon(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
					if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
						{
							MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.MessageReceivePumpFailedToAbandon(trackingContext.Activity, trackingContext.TrackingId, trackingContext.SystemTracker, base.LastAsyncStepException.ToString());
						});
						owner.RaiseExceptionReceivedEvent(base.LastAsyncStepException, "Abandon");
					}
				}
				else if (owner.OnMessageOptions.AutoComplete)
				{
					owner.ScheduleMessageCompletion(message, trackingContext);
				}
				if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null && ShouldBackoff(base.LastAsyncStepException, out var amount))
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.MessageReceivePumpBackoff(trackingContext.Activity, trackingContext.TrackingId, trackingContext.SystemTracker, (int)ServerBusyExceptionBackoffAmount.TotalMilliseconds, base.LastAsyncStepException.ToString());
					});
					yield return CallAsyncSleep(amount);
				}
			}

			private static void OnProcessingTimeout(object state)
			{
				DispatchAsyncResult thisPtr = (DispatchAsyncResult)state;
				try
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.MessageReceivePumpUserCallTimedOut(thisPtr.trackingContext.Activity, thisPtr.trackingContext.TrackingId, thisPtr.trackingContext.SystemTracker, thisPtr.message.MessageId);
					});
				}
				catch (ObjectDisposedException)
				{
				}
				try
				{
					thisPtr.renewCancellationTokenSource.Cancel();
				}
				catch (ObjectDisposedException)
				{
				}
			}

			private bool ShouldRenewLock()
			{
				if (owner.receiver.Mode == ReceiveMode.PeekLock && owner.renewSupported)
				{
					return owner.OnMessageOptions.AutoRenewLock;
				}
				return false;
			}

			private static void Finally(Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult asyncResult, Exception exception)
			{
				DispatchAsyncResult dispatchAsyncResult = (DispatchAsyncResult)asyncResult;
				dispatchAsyncResult.message.Dispose();
			}
		}

		private const int MaxInitialReceiveRetryCount = 3;

		private static readonly AsyncCallback StaticOnRenewLoopLoopCompleted = OnRenewLockLoopCompleted;

		private static readonly TimeSpan ServerBusyExceptionBackoffAmount = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10.0);

		private static readonly TimeSpan OtherExceptionBackoffAmount = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1.0);

		private static readonly TimeSpan MessageCompletionOperationTimeout = Constants.DefaultOperationTimeout;

		private readonly MessageReceiver receiver;

		private readonly Action<BrokeredMessage> syncCallback;

		private readonly Func<BrokeredMessage, Task> taskCallback;

		private readonly Func<BrokeredMessage, AsyncCallback, object, IAsyncResult> beginCallback;

		private readonly Action<IAsyncResult> endCallback;

		private readonly AsyncSemaphore semaphore;

		private readonly List<Guid> completionList;

		private bool renewSupported;

		private volatile bool completionInProgress;

		public OnMessageOptions OnMessageOptions { get; private set; }

		public MessageReceivePump(MessageReceiver receiver, OnMessageOptions onMessageOptions, Action<BrokeredMessage> syncCallback)
			: this(receiver, onMessageOptions)
		{
			this.syncCallback = syncCallback;
			beginCallback = BeginSyncCallback;
			endCallback = EndSyncCallback;
		}

		public MessageReceivePump(MessageReceiver receiver, OnMessageOptions onMessageOptions, Func<BrokeredMessage, Task> taskCallback)
			: this(receiver, onMessageOptions)
		{
			this.taskCallback = taskCallback;
			beginCallback = BeginTaskCallback;
			endCallback = EndTaskCallback;
		}

		private MessageReceivePump(MessageReceiver receiver, OnMessageOptions onMessageOptions)
		{
			if (receiver == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("receiver");
			}
			this.receiver = receiver;
			OnMessageOptions = onMessageOptions;
			semaphore = new AsyncSemaphore(onMessageOptions.MaxConcurrentCalls);
			renewSupported = true;
			completionList = new List<Guid>();
		}

		public void Start()
		{
			StartAsyncResult startAsyncResult = new StartAsyncResult(this, null, null);
			startAsyncResult.RunSynchronously();
		}

		private IAsyncResult BeginSyncCallback(BrokeredMessage message, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new SyncCallbackAsyncResult(this, message, callback, state);
		}

		private void EndSyncCallback(IAsyncResult asyncResult)
		{
			AsyncResult<SyncCallbackAsyncResult>.End(asyncResult);
		}

		private IAsyncResult BeginTaskCallback(BrokeredMessage message, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return taskCallback(message).ToAsyncResult(callback, state);
		}

		private void EndTaskCallback(IAsyncResult asyncResult)
		{
			TaskHelpers.EndAsyncResult(asyncResult);
		}

		private void ScheduleMessageCompletion(BrokeredMessage message, TrackingContext trackingContext)
		{
			BatchCompleteAsyncResult batchCompleteAsyncResult = null;
			lock (completionList)
			{
				if (message != null)
				{
					completionList.Add(message.LockToken);
				}
				if (!completionInProgress && completionList.Count > 0)
				{
					completionInProgress = true;
					batchCompleteAsyncResult = new BatchCompleteAsyncResult(this, trackingContext, MessageCompletionOperationTimeout, OnCompleteMessageCompletion, null);
				}
			}
			if (batchCompleteAsyncResult != null)
			{
				IOThreadScheduler.ScheduleCallbackNoFlow(delegate(object o)
				{
					((BatchCompleteAsyncResult)o).Start();
				}, batchCompleteAsyncResult);
			}
		}

		private static void OnCompleteMessageCompletion(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			BatchCompleteAsyncResult batchCompleteAsyncResult = (BatchCompleteAsyncResult)result;
			MessageReceivePump pump = batchCompleteAsyncResult.Pump;
			TrackingContext context = batchCompleteAsyncResult.TrackingContext;
			lock (pump.completionList)
			{
				try
				{
					AsyncResult<BatchCompleteAsyncResult>.End(batchCompleteAsyncResult);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					Exception exception = ex;
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.MessageReceivePumpFailedToComplete(context.Activity, context.TrackingId, context.SystemTracker, exception.ToStringSlim());
					});
					pump.RaiseExceptionReceivedEvent(exception, "Complete");
				}
				finally
				{
					pump.completionInProgress = false;
				}
			}
			pump.ScheduleMessageCompletion(null, context);
		}

		private static bool ShouldBackoff(Exception exception, out TimeSpan amount)
		{
			if (exception is ServerBusyException || exception is MessagingEntityNotFoundException)
			{
				amount = ServerBusyExceptionBackoffAmount;
				return true;
			}
			if (exception is MessagingException { IsTransient: not false })
			{
				amount = TimeSpan.Zero;
				return false;
			}
			amount = OtherExceptionBackoffAmount;
			return true;
		}

		private void RaiseExceptionReceivedEvent(Exception exception, string action)
		{
			try
			{
				OnMessageOptions.RaiseExceptionReceived(new ExceptionReceivedEventArgs(exception, action));
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				Environment.FailFast(ex.ToString());
			}
		}

		private void ScheduleRenewLockLoop(TrackingContext trackingContext, BrokeredMessage message, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			try
			{
				BeginRenewLockLoop(trackingContext, message, cancellationToken, StaticOnRenewLoopLoopCompleted, this);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				Exception e = ex;
				if (Fx.IsFatal(e))
				{
					throw;
				}
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.MessageReceivePumpUnexpectedException(trackingContext.Activity, trackingContext.TrackingId, trackingContext.SystemTracker, e.ToString());
				});
				throw;
			}
		}

		private static void OnRenewLockLoopCompleted(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			MessageReceivePump messageReceivePump = (MessageReceivePump)result.AsyncState;
			try
			{
				messageReceivePump.EndRenewLockLoop(result);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				Exception ex2 = ex;
				Exception e = ex2;
				if (Fx.IsFatal(e))
				{
					throw;
				}
				TrackingContext trackingContext = TrackingContext.Create(Guid.NewGuid(), messageReceivePump.receiver.Path);
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.MessageReceivePumpUnexpectedException(trackingContext.Activity, trackingContext.TrackingId, trackingContext.SystemTracker, e.ToString());
				});
				throw;
			}
		}

		private IAsyncResult BeginRenewLockLoop(TrackingContext trackingContext, BrokeredMessage message, CancellationToken cancellationToken, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			RenewLockLoopAsyncResult renewLockLoopAsyncResult = new RenewLockLoopAsyncResult(this, trackingContext, message, cancellationToken, callback, state);
			return renewLockLoopAsyncResult.Start();
		}

		private void EndRenewLockLoop(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			AsyncResult<RenewLockLoopAsyncResult>.End(result);
		}
	}

		{
			ManageClaimNotRequiredAttribute.ClearManageOnlyMembers(this);
		}

		internal override void UpdateForVersion(ApiVersion version, EntityDescription existingDescription = null)
		{
			base.UpdateForVersion(version, existingDescription);
			if (!InternalListenerType.HasValue && InternalRelayType.HasValue)
			{
				InternalListenerType = MapRelayTypeToListenerType(InternalRelayType);
			}
			if (version < ApiVersion.Eight)
			{
				InternalUserMetadata = null;
			}
			if (version < ApiVersion.Five)
			{
				InternalRelayType = null;
				InternalRequiresClientAuthorization = null;
				InternalRequiresTransportSecurity = null;
				InternalPublishToRegistry = null;
				InternalAuthorization = null;
				InternalIsDynamic = null;
			}
			else if (!InternalRelayType.HasValue && InternalListenerType.HasValue)
			{
				InternalRelayType = MapListenerTypeToRelayType(InternalListenerType);
			}
		}

		internal override bool IsValidForVersion(ApiVersion version)
		{
			if (version < ApiVersion.Eight && InternalUserMetadata != null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (version < ApiVersion.Five && (InternalRelayType.HasValue || InternalRequiresClientAuthorization.HasValue || InternalRequiresTransportSecurity.HasValue || InternalPublishToRegistry.HasValue || InternalAuthorization != null || InternalIsDynamic.HasValue))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return base.IsValidForVersion(version);
		}

		internal static ListenerType MapRelayTypeToListenerType(RelayType? relayType)
		{
			if (!relayType.HasValue)
			{
				return ListenerType.None;
			}
			return relayType switch
			{
				RelayType.Http => ListenerType.RelayedHttp, 
				RelayType.NetEvent => ListenerType.Multicast, 
				RelayType.NetOneway => ListenerType.Unicast, 
				RelayType.NetTcp => ListenerType.RelayedConnection, 
				_ => ListenerType.None, 
			};
		}

		internal static RelayType MapListenerTypeToRelayType(ListenerType? listenerType)
		{
			if (!listenerType.HasValue)
			{
				return RelayType.None;
			}
			return listenerType switch
			{
				ListenerType.RelayedConnection => RelayType.NetTcp, 
				ListenerType.RelayedHttp => RelayType.Http, 
				ListenerType.Multicast => RelayType.NetEvent, 
				ListenerType.Unicast => RelayType.NetOneway, 
				_ => RelayType.None, 
			};
		}
	}

	[DataContract(Name = "QualifiedPropertyName", Namespace = "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2010/10/servicebus/connect")]
	internal struct QualifiedPropertyName : IEquatable<QualifiedPropertyName>, IComparable<QualifiedPropertyName>
	{
		[DataMember(Name = "Scope", EmitDefaultValue = true, IsRequired = true, Order = 65537)]
		private readonly PropertyScope scope;

		[DataMember(Name = "Name", EmitDefaultValue = true, IsRequired = true, Order = 65538)]
		private readonly string name;

		public PropertyScope Scope => scope;

		public string Name => name;

		public QualifiedPropertyName(PropertyScope scope, string name)
		{
			this.scope = scope;
			this.name = name;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}.{1}", scope, name);
		}

		public bool Equals(QualifiedPropertyName other)
		{
			if (scope == other.scope)
			{
				return StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase.Equals(name, other.name);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public int CompareTo(QualifiedPropertyName other)
		{
			int num = ((int)scope).CompareTo((int)other.scope);
			if (num == 0)
			{
				num = StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase.Compare(name, other.name);
			}
			return num;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is QualifiedPropertyName)
			{
				return Equals((QualifiedPropertyName)obj);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			int hashCode = ((int)scope).GetHashCode();
			int hashCode2 = StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase.GetHashCode(name);
			return HashCode.CombineHashCodes(hashCode, hashCode2);
		}
	}

	internal class MessagingDescriptionSerializer<TMessagingDescription>
	{
		public static readonly MessagingDescriptionSerializer<TMessagingDescription> Serializer = new MessagingDescriptionSerializer<TMessagingDescription>();

		private const int MaxItemsInObjectGraph = 65536;

		private readonly DataContractSerializer serializer;

		public MessagingDescriptionSerializer()
		{
			serializer = CreateSerializer<TMessagingDescription>();
		}

		private DataContractSerializer CreateSerializer<T>()
		{
			return new DataContractSerializer(typeof(T), null, 65536, ignoreExtensionDataObject: false, preserveObjectReferences: false, null);
		}

		public TMessagingDescription DeserializeFromAtomFeed(Stream stream)
		{
			if (stream == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("stream");
			}
			XmlReaderSettings settings = new XmlReaderSettings
			{
				ValidationType = ValidationType.None
			};
			using XmlReader xmlReader = XmlReader.Create(stream, settings);
			xmlReader.ReadToDescendant(typeof(TMessagingDescription).Name);
			return (TMessagingDescription)serializer.ReadObject(xmlReader);
		}

		public TMessagingDescription Deserialize(string description)
		{
			if (description == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("description");
			}
			XmlReaderSettings settings = new XmlReaderSettings
			{
				ValidationType = ValidationType.None
			};
			using XmlReader reader = XmlReader.Create(new StringReader(description), settings);
			return (TMessagingDescription)serializer.ReadObject(reader);
		}

		public string Serialize(TMessagingDescription description)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			XmlWriterSettings settings = new XmlWriterSettings
			{
				ConformanceLevel = ConformanceLevel.Fragment,
				NamespaceHandling = NamespaceHandling.OmitDuplicates
			};
			using (XmlWriter writer = XmlWriter.Create(stringBuilder, settings))
			{
				serializer.WriteObject(writer, description);
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public string SerializeTooLargeDescription(TMessagingDescription description)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			XmlWriterSettings settings = new XmlWriterSettings
			{
				ConformanceLevel = ConformanceLevel.Fragment,
				NamespaceHandling = NamespaceHandling.OmitDuplicates
			};
			using (XmlWriter writer = XmlWriter.Create(stringBuilder, settings))
			{
				DataContractSerializer dataContractSerializer = new DataContractSerializer(typeof(TMessagingDescription), null, 66560, ignoreExtensionDataObject: false, preserveObjectReferences: false, null);
				dataContractSerializer.WriteObject(writer, description);
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
	}

	public sealed class MessagingEntityDisabledException : MessagingException
	{

			: this(SRClient.MessagingEntityIsDisabledException(entityName), null)
		{
			base.IsTransient = false;
		}

		public MessagingEntityDisabledException(string message, Exception innerException)
			: base(message, innerException)
		{
			base.IsTransient = false;
		}

		internal MessagingEntityDisabledException(MessagingExceptionDetail detail, TrackingContext trackingContext)
			: base(detail, trackingContext)
		{
			base.IsTransient = false;
		}

		internal MessagingEntityDisabledException(MessagingExceptionDetail detail, TrackingContext trackingContext, Exception innerException)
			: base(detail, trackingContext, innerException)
		{
			base.IsTransient = false;
		}

		private MessagingEntityDisabledException(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			: base(info, context)
		{
			base.IsTransient = false;
		}
	}

	internal sealed class CloseEntityCollectionAsyncResult : Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult
	{
		private sealed class CallbackState
		{
			public CloseEntityCollectionAsyncResult AsyncResult { get; private set; }

			public ClientEntity AsyncData { get; private set; }

			public CallbackState(CloseEntityCollectionAsyncResult asyncResult, ClientEntity data)
			{
				AsyncResult = asyncResult;
				AsyncData = data;
			}
		}

		private static readonly AsyncCallback onObjectClosed = OnObjectClosed;

		private TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper;

		private int interlockedCount;

		private Exception DelayedException { get; set; }

		public CloseEntityCollectionAsyncResult(IList<ClientEntity> clientEntities, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			: base(callback, state)
		{
			timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
			interlockedCount = clientEntities.Count;
			if (interlockedCount > 0)
			{
				foreach (ClientEntity clientEntity in clientEntities)
				{
					try
					{
						IAsyncResult asyncResult = clientEntity.BeginClose(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime(), onObjectClosed, new CallbackState(this, clientEntity));
						if (asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
						{
							CompleteClose(clientEntity, asyncResult);
						}
					}
					catch (Exception e)
					{
						if (Fx.IsFatal(e))
						{
							throw;
						}
						Decrement(completeSyncronously: true, e);
						clientEntity.Abort();
					}
				}
				return;
			}
			Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: true);
		}

		public static void End(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult.End<CloseEntityCollectionAsyncResult>(result);
		}

		private static void OnObjectClosed(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (!result.CompletedSynchronously)
			{
				CallbackState callbackState = (CallbackState)result.AsyncState;
				callbackState.AsyncResult.CompleteClose(callbackState.AsyncData, result);
			}
		}

		private void CompleteClose(ClientEntity entity, IAsyncResult result)
		{
			Exception e = null;
			try
			{
				entity.EndClose(result);
			}
			catch (MessagingEntityNotFoundException)
			{
			}
			catch (Exception ex2)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(ex2))
				{
					throw;
				}
				e = ex2;
			}
			Decrement(result.CompletedSynchronously, e);
		}

		private void Decrement(bool completeSyncronously, Exception e)
		{
			if (e != null && DelayedException == null)
			{
				DelayedException = e;
			}
			if (Interlocked.Decrement(ref interlockedCount) == 0)
			{
				Complete(completeSyncronously, DelayedException);
			}
		}
	}
	internal sealed class CloseEntityCollectionIteratedAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<CloseEntityCollectionIteratedAsyncResult>
	{
		private ClientEntity currentEntity;

		private IEnumerable<ClientEntity> ClientEntities { get; set; }

		public CloseEntityCollectionIteratedAsyncResult(IEnumerable<ClientEntity> entities, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			: base(timeout, callback, state)
		{
			ClientEntities = entities;
			Start();
		}

		protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
		{
			foreach (ClientEntity clientEntity in ClientEntities)
			{
				currentEntity = clientEntity;
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((CloseEntityCollectionIteratedAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.currentEntity.BeginClose(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(CloseEntityCollectionIteratedAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					thisPtr.currentEntity.EndClose(r);
				}, (Call)delegate(CloseEntityCollectionIteratedAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t)
				{
					thisPtr.currentEntity.Close(t);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
				if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
				{
					currentEntity.Abort();
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal sealed class CommunicationObjectManager
	{
		private readonly EventHandler onInnerObjectClosed;

		private readonly EventHandler onInnerObjectFaulted;

		private readonly HashSet<ICommunicationObject> communicationObjects;

		private bool closed;

		private bool faulted;

		private object ThisLock => communicationObjects;

		public event EventHandler Faulted;

		public CommunicationObjectManager()
		{
			communicationObjects = new HashSet<ICommunicationObject>();
			onInnerObjectClosed = OnInnerObjectClosed;
			onInnerObjectFaulted = OnInnerObjectFaulted;
		}

		public void Abort()
		{
			IEnumerable<ICommunicationObject> enumerable = null;
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (!closed)
				{
					closed = true;
					enumerable = new HashSet<ICommunicationObject>(communicationObjects);
					communicationObjects.Clear();
				}
			}
			if (enumerable == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (ICommunicationObject item in enumerable)
			{
				item.Abort();
			}
		}

		public void Add(ICommunicationObject communicationObject, bool faultAll = true)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (closed)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				else
				{
					communicationObjects.Add(communicationObject);
					if (faultAll)
					{
						communicationObject.SafeAddFaulted(onInnerObjectFaulted);
					}
					communicationObject.SafeAddClosed(onInnerObjectClosed);
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				communicationObject.Abort();
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsWarning(new ObjectDisposedException(GetType().Name));
			}
		}

		public bool Remove(ICommunicationObject communicationObject)
		{
			bool flag = communicationObjects.Remove(communicationObject);
			if (flag)
			{
				communicationObject.Faulted -= onInnerObjectFaulted;
				communicationObject.Closed -= onInnerObjectClosed;
			}
			return flag;
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			HashSet<ICommunicationObject> hashSet;
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (!closed)
				{
					closed = true;
					hashSet = new HashSet<ICommunicationObject>(communicationObjects);
					communicationObjects.Clear();
				}
				else
				{
					hashSet = new HashSet<ICommunicationObject>();
				}
			}
			return new CloseCollectionAsyncResult(hashSet, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		public void EndClose(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			CloseCollectionAsyncResult.End(result);
		}

		private void Fault()
		{
			EventHandler eventHandler;
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (faulted || closed)
				{
					eventHandler = null;
				}
				else
				{
					faulted = true;
					eventHandler = this.Faulted;
				}
			}
			eventHandler?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		private void OnInnerObjectClosed(object sender, EventArgs args)
		{
			if (closed)
			{
				return;
			}
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (!closed)
				{
					ICommunicationObject communicationObject = (ICommunicationObject)sender;
					communicationObjects.Remove(communicationObject);
					communicationObject.Closed -= onInnerObjectClosed;
					communicationObject.Faulted -= onInnerObjectFaulted;
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnInnerObjectFaulted(object sender, EventArgs args)
		{
			Fault();
		}
	}
	internal sealed class MessageClientEntityManager
	{
		private readonly object syncLock;

		private readonly EventHandler onInnerObjectClosed;

		internal List<WeakReference> clientObjects;

		private bool closed;

		public bool IsEmpty
		{
			get
			{
				if (clientObjects == null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				lock (syncLock)
				{
					return clientObjects.Count == 0;
				}
			}
		}

		internal event EventHandler ManagerEmptied;

		public MessageClientEntityManager()
		{
			clientObjects = new List<WeakReference>();
			onInnerObjectClosed = OnInnerObjectClosed;
			syncLock = new object();
		}

		public void Abort()
		{
			List<WeakReference> list = null;
			lock (syncLock)
			{
				if (!closed)
				{
					closed = true;
					list = clientObjects;
					clientObjects = new List<WeakReference>();
				}
			}
			if (list == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (WeakReference item in list)
			{
				if (item.Target is ClientEntity clientEntity)
				{
					clientEntity.Abort();
				}
			}
			this.ManagerEmptied?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		public void Add(ClientEntity clientEntity)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			lock (syncLock)
			{
				if (closed)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				else
				{
					clientObjects.Add(new WeakReference(clientEntity));
					clientEntity.SafeAddClosed(onInnerObjectClosed);
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				clientEntity.Abort();
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new OperationCanceledException(SRClient.MessageEntityDisposed));
			}
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			List<ClientEntity> list = new List<ClientEntity>();
			lock (syncLock)
			{
				if (!closed)
				{
					closed = true;
					foreach (WeakReference clientObject in clientObjects)
					{
						if (clientObject.Target is ClientEntity item)
						{
							list.Add(item);
						}
					}
					clientObjects = new List<WeakReference>();
				}
			}
			return new CloseEntityCollectionAsyncResult(list, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		public void EndClose(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			CloseEntityCollectionAsyncResult.End(result);
			this.ManagerEmptied?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		public void UpdateRetryPolicy(RetryPolicy policy)
		{
			lock (syncLock)
			{
				foreach (WeakReference clientObject in clientObjects)
				{
					if (clientObject.Target is ClientEntity { ShouldLinkRetryPolicy: not false } clientEntity)
					{
						clientEntity.RetryPolicy = policy;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnInnerObjectClosed(object sender, EventArgs args)
		{
			if (closed)
			{
				return;
			}
			lock (syncLock)
			{
				if (closed)
				{
					return;
				}
				ClientEntity clientEntity = (ClientEntity)sender;
				List<WeakReference> list = new List<WeakReference>(clientObjects);
				foreach (WeakReference item in list)
				{
					if (item.Target is ClientEntity clientEntity2)
					{
						if (clientEntity2.Equals(clientEntity))
						{
							clientObjects.Remove(item);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						clientObjects.Remove(item);
					}
				}
				clientEntity.Closed -= onInnerObjectClosed;
				if (clientObjects.Count == 0)
				{
					this.ManagerEmptied?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
				}
			}
		}
	}

		}
	}
	public sealed class NetMessagingBinding : System.ServiceModel.Channels.Binding
	{
		private BinaryMessageEncodingBindingElement encoder;

		private NetMessagingTransportBindingElement transport;

		public NetMessagingTransportSettings TransportSettings
		{
			get
			{
				return transport.TransportSettings;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNull("value");
				}
				transport.TransportSettings = value;
			}
		}

		[DefaultValue(524288L)]
		public long MaxBufferPoolSize
		{
			get
			{
				return transport.MaxBufferPoolSize;
			}
			set
			{
				transport.MaxBufferPoolSize = value;
			}
		}

		public override string Scheme => "sb";

		[DefaultValue(typeof(TimeSpan), "00:01:00")]
		public TimeSpan SessionIdleTimeout
		{
			get
			{
				return transport.SessionIdleTimeout;
			}
			set
			{
				transport.SessionIdleTimeout = value;
			}
		}

		[DefaultValue(-1)]
		public int PrefetchCount
		{
			get
			{
				return transport.PrefetchCount;
			}
			set
			{
				transport.PrefetchCount = value;
			}
		}

		public NetMessagingBinding()
		{
			encoder = Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Channels.TransportDefaults.CreateDefaultEncoder();
			transport = new NetMessagingTransportBindingElement();
		}

		public NetMessagingBinding(string configurationName)
			: this()
		{
			ApplyConfiguration(configurationName);
		}

		public override BindingElementCollection CreateBindingElements()
		{
			BindingElementCollection bindingElementCollection = new BindingElementCollection();
			bindingElementCollection.Add(encoder);
			bindingElementCollection.Add(transport);
			return bindingElementCollection.Clone();
		}

		internal static bool TryCreate(BindingElementCollection elements, out NetMessagingBinding binding)
		{
			binding = null;
			if (elements.Count > 2)
			{
				return false;
			}
			BinaryMessageEncodingBindingElement binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement = null;
			NetMessagingTransportBindingElement netMessagingTransportBindingElement = null;
			foreach (BindingElement element in elements)
			{
				if (element is TransportBindingElement)
				{
					netMessagingTransportBindingElement = element as NetMessagingTransportBindingElement;
					continue;
				}
				if (element is BinaryMessageEncodingBindingElement)
				{
					binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement = element as BinaryMessageEncodingBindingElement;
					continue;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (netMessagingTransportBindingElement == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			NetMessagingBinding netMessagingBinding = new NetMessagingBinding();
			netMessagingBinding.InitializeFrom(binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement, netMessagingTransportBindingElement);
			if (!netMessagingBinding.IsBindingElementsMatch(binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement, netMessagingTransportBindingElement))
			{
				return false;
			}
			binding = netMessagingBinding;
			return true;
		}

		private void InitializeFrom(BinaryMessageEncodingBindingElement binaryEncoding, NetMessagingTransportBindingElement netMessagingTransport)
		{
			transport.MaxBufferPoolSize = netMessagingTransport.MaxBufferPoolSize;
			transport.MaxReceivedMessageSize = netMessagingTransport.MaxReceivedMessageSize;
			binaryEncoding.ReaderQuotas.CopyTo(encoder.ReaderQuotas);
		}

		private bool IsBindingElementsMatch(BinaryMessageEncodingBindingElement binaryEncoding, NetMessagingTransportBindingElement netMessagingTransport)
		{
			if (!IsTransportMatch(transport, netMessagingTransport))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!IsEncodingMatch(encoder, binaryEncoding))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool IsTransportMatch(BindingElement a, BindingElement b)
		{
			if (b == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			NetMessagingTransportBindingElement netMessagingTransportBindingElement = a as NetMessagingTransportBindingElement;
			if (!(b is NetMessagingTransportBindingElement netMessagingTransportBindingElement2))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (netMessagingTransportBindingElement.MaxBufferPoolSize != netMessagingTransportBindingElement2.MaxBufferPoolSize)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (netMessagingTransportBindingElement.MaxReceivedMessageSize != netMessagingTransportBindingElement2.MaxReceivedMessageSize)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool IsEncodingMatch(BindingElement a, BindingElement b)
		{
			if (b == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(b is MessageEncodingBindingElement))
			{
				return false;
			}
			BinaryMessageEncodingBindingElement binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement = a as BinaryMessageEncodingBindingElement;
			if (!(b is BinaryMessageEncodingBindingElement binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement2))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement.MaxReadPoolSize != binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement2.MaxReadPoolSize)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement.MaxWritePoolSize != binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement2.MaxWritePoolSize)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement.ReaderQuotas.MaxStringContentLength != binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement2.ReaderQuotas.MaxStringContentLength)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement.ReaderQuotas.MaxArrayLength != binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement2.ReaderQuotas.MaxArrayLength)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement.ReaderQuotas.MaxBytesPerRead != binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement2.ReaderQuotas.MaxBytesPerRead)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement.ReaderQuotas.MaxDepth != binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement2.ReaderQuotas.MaxDepth)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement.ReaderQuotas.MaxNameTableCharCount != binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement2.ReaderQuotas.MaxNameTableCharCount)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!IsMessageVersionMatch(binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement.MessageVersion, binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement2.MessageVersion))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool IsMessageVersionMatch(MessageVersion a, MessageVersion b)
		{
			if (b == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNull("b");
			}
			if (a.Addressing == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException("MessageVersion.Addressing cannot be null"));
			}
			if (a.Envelope != b.Envelope)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void ApplyConfiguration(string configurationName)
		{
			NetMessagingBindingExtensionElement netMessagingBindingExtensionElement = NetMessagingBindingCollectionElement.GetBindingCollectionElement().Bindings[configurationName];
			if (netMessagingBindingExtensionElement == null)
			{
				string message = SRClient.ConfigInvalidBindingConfigurationName(configurationName, "netMessagingBinding");
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new ConfigurationErrorsException(message));
			}
			netMessagingBindingExtensionElement.ApplyConfiguration(this);
		}
	}
	public sealed class NetMessagingTransportBindingElement : TransportBindingElement, IPolicyExportExtension, IWsdlExportExtension
	{
		private sealed class ReceiveContextSettings : IReceiveContextSettings
		{
			public bool Enabled { get; set; }

			public TimeSpan ValidityDuration
			{
				get
				{
					throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new NotSupportedException());
				}
			}

			public ReceiveContextSettings()
			{
				Enabled = false;
			}
		}

		private NetMessagingTransportSettings transportSettings;

		private ReceiveContextSettings receiveContextSettings;

		private int prefetchCount;

		private TimeSpan sessionIdleTimeout;

		[DefaultValue(-1)]
		public int PrefetchCount
		{
			get
			{
				return prefetchCount;
			}
			set
			{
				prefetchCount = value;
			}
		}

		public override string Scheme => "sb";

		[DefaultValue(typeof(TimeSpan), "00:01:00")]
		public TimeSpan SessionIdleTimeout
		{
			get
			{
				return sessionIdleTimeout;
			}
			set
			{
				TimeoutHelper.ThrowIfNonPositiveArgument(value, "SessionIdleTimeout");
				sessionIdleTimeout = value;
			}
		}

		public NetMessagingTransportSettings TransportSettings
		{
			get
			{
				return transportSettings;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNull("value");
				}
				transportSettings = value;
			}
		}

		internal bool ReceiveContextEnabled => receiveContextSettings.Enabled;

		public NetMessagingTransportBindingElement()
		{
			receiveContextSettings = new ReceiveContextSettings();
			prefetchCount = -1;
			SessionIdleTimeout = Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Channels.TransportDefaults.SessionIdleTimeout;
			MaxReceivedMessageSize = 262144L;
			transportSettings = new NetMessagingTransportSettings();
		}

		private NetMessagingTransportBindingElement(NetMessagingTransportBindingElement other)
			: base(other)
		{
			prefetchCount = other.prefetchCount;
			SessionIdleTimeout = other.SessionIdleTimeout;
			transportSettings = (NetMessagingTransportSettings)other.transportSettings.Clone();
			receiveContextSettings = other.receiveContextSettings;
		}

		public override IChannelFactory<TChannel> BuildChannelFactory<TChannel>(BindingContext context)
		{
			if (!CanBuildChannelFactory<TChannel>(context))
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.Argument("TChannel", SRClient.ChannelTypeNotSupported(typeof(TChannel)));
			}
			return (IChannelFactory<TChannel>)(object)new ServiceBusChannelFactory(context, this);
		}

		public override IChannelListener<TChannel> BuildChannelListener<TChannel>(BindingContext context)
		{
			if (!CanBuildChannelListener<TChannel>(context))
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.Argument("TChannel", SRClient.ChannelTypeNotSupported(typeof(TChannel)));
			}
			if (typeof(TChannel) == typeof(IInputChannel))
			{
				return (IChannelListener<TChannel>)(object)new ServiceBusInputChannelListener(context, this);
			}
			return (IChannelListener<TChannel>)(object)new ServiceBusInputSessionChannelListener(context, this);
		}

		public override bool CanBuildChannelFactory<T>(BindingContext context)
		{
			if (context == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNull("context");
			}
			return typeof(T) == typeof(IOutputChannel);
		}

		public override bool CanBuildChannelListener<T>(BindingContext context)
		{
			if (context == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNull("context");
			}
			if (!(typeof(T) == typeof(IInputChannel)))
			{
				return typeof(T) == typeof(IInputSessionChannel);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override BindingElement Clone()
		{
			return new NetMessagingTransportBindingElement(this);
		}

		public override T GetProperty<T>(BindingContext context)
		{
			if (context == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNull("context");
			}
			if (typeof(T) == typeof(IReceiveContextSettings))
			{
				return (T)(object)receiveContextSettings;
			}
			return base.GetProperty<T>(context);
		}

		void IPolicyExportExtension.ExportPolicy(MetadataExporter exporter, PolicyConversionContext context)
		{
			if (exporter == null || context == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNull((exporter == null) ? "exporter" : "context");
			}
			ICollection<XmlElement> bindingAssertions = context.GetBindingAssertions();
			XmlDocument xmlDocument = new XmlDocument();
			XmlElement item = xmlDocument.CreateElement("sb", "netMessaging", "http://sample.schemas.microsoft.com/policy/netMessaging");
			bindingAssertions.Add(item);
			MessageEncodingBindingElement messageEncodingBindingElement = context.BindingElements.Find<MessageEncodingBindingElement>();
			if (messageEncodingBindingElement == null)
			{
				messageEncodingBindingElement = Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Channels.TransportDefaults.CreateDefaultEncoder();
				if (messageEncodingBindingElement is IPolicyExportExtension policyExportExtension)
				{
					policyExportExtension.ExportPolicy(exporter, context);
				}
			}
			WSAddressingHelper.AddWSAddressingAssertion(exporter, context, messageEncodingBindingElement.MessageVersion.Addressing);
		}

		void IWsdlExportExtension.ExportContract(WsdlExporter exporter, WsdlContractConversionContext context)
		{
		}

		void IWsdlExportExtension.ExportEndpoint(WsdlExporter exporter, WsdlEndpointConversionContext context)
		{
			BindingElementCollection bindingElementCollection = context.Endpoint.Binding.CreateBindingElements();
			MessageEncodingBindingElement messageEncodingBindingElement = bindingElementCollection.Find<MessageEncodingBindingElement>();
			if (messageEncodingBindingElement == null)
			{
				messageEncodingBindingElement = Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Channels.TransportDefaults.CreateDefaultEncoder();
			}
			SoapBinding soapBinding = GetSoapBinding(context, exporter);
			if (soapBinding != null)
			{
				soapBinding.Transport = "http://sample.schemas.microsoft.com/policy/netMessaging";
			}
			if (context.WsdlPort != null)
			{
				WSAddressingHelper.AddAddressToWsdlPort(context.WsdlPort, context.Endpoint.Address, messageEncodingBindingElement.MessageVersion.Addressing);
			}
		}

		internal MessagingFactorySettings CreateMessagingFactorySettings(BindingContext context)
		{
			MessagingFactorySettings messagingFactorySettings = new MessagingFactorySettings();
			messagingFactorySettings.NetMessagingTransportSettings = (NetMessagingTransportSettings)TransportSettings.Clone();
			TransportClientEndpointBehavior transportClientEndpointBehavior = context.BindingParameters.Find<TransportClientEndpointBehavior>();
			if (transportClientEndpointBehavior != null)
			{
				messagingFactorySettings.TokenProvider = transportClientEndpointBehavior.TokenProvider;
			}
			return messagingFactorySettings;
		}

		private static SoapBinding GetSoapBinding(WsdlEndpointConversionContext endpointContext, WsdlExporter exporter)
		{
			EnvelopeVersion envelopeVersion = null;
			SoapBinding result = null;
			object value = null;
			object key = new object();
			if (exporter.State.TryGetValue(key, out value) && value is Dictionary<System.Web.Services.Description.Binding, EnvelopeVersion> dictionary && dictionary.ContainsKey(endpointContext.WsdlBinding))
			{
				envelopeVersion = dictionary[endpointContext.WsdlBinding];
			}
			if (envelopeVersion == EnvelopeVersion.None)
			{
				return null;
			}
			foreach (object extension in endpointContext.WsdlBinding.Extensions)
			{
				if (extension is SoapBinding soapBinding)
				{
					result = soapBinding;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	public sealed class NetMessagingTransportSettings : ITransportSettings, IServiceBusSecuritySettings
	{
		private TimeSpan batchFlushInterval;

		private TimeSpan leaseTimeout;

		private string clientAuthThumbprint;

		public TimeSpan BatchFlushInterval
		{

			set
			{

				{
					throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentOutOfRange("BatchFlushInterval", value, SRClient.InvalidBatchFlushInterval);
				}
				batchFlushInterval = value;
			}
		}

		public TimeSpan LeaseTimeout
		{
			get
			{
				return leaseTimeout;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value < TimeSpan.Zero)
				{
					throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentOutOfRange("LeaseTimeout", value, SR.GetString(Resources.SFxTimeoutOutOfRange0));
				}
				if (TimeoutHelper.IsTooLarge(value))
				{
					throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentOutOfRange("LeaseTimeout", value, SR.GetString(Resources.SFxTimeoutOutOfRangeTooBig));
				}
				leaseTimeout = value;
			}
		}

		TokenProvider IServiceBusSecuritySettings.TokenProvider { get; set; }

		internal bool UseSslStreamSecurity { get; set; }

		internal bool GatewayMode { get; set; }

		internal bool EnablePing { get; set; }

		internal string ClientAuthThumbprint
		{
			get
			{
				return clientAuthThumbprint;
			}
			set
			{
				clientAuthThumbprint = value;
			}
		}

		internal DnsEndpointIdentity EndpointIdentity { get; set; }

		internal Uri Via { get; set; }

		public NetMessagingTransportSettings()
		{
			batchFlushInterval = Constants.DefaultBatchFlushInterval;
			leaseTimeout = TcpTransportDefaults.ConnectionLeaseTimeout;
			SoapProtocolDefaults.IsAvailableClientCertificateThumbprint(out clientAuthThumbprint);
			UseSslStreamSecurity = true;
			EnablePing = true;
		}

		public object Clone()
		{
			NetMessagingTransportSettings netMessagingTransportSettings = new NetMessagingTransportSettings();
			netMessagingTransportSettings.BatchFlushInterval = BatchFlushInterval;
			((IServiceBusSecuritySettings)netMessagingTransportSettings).TokenProvider = ((IServiceBusSecuritySettings)this).TokenProvider;
			netMessagingTransportSettings.UseSslStreamSecurity = UseSslStreamSecurity;
			netMessagingTransportSettings.EnableRedirect = EnableRedirect;
			netMessagingTransportSettings.GatewayMode = GatewayMode;
			netMessagingTransportSettings.EnablePing = EnablePing;
			netMessagingTransportSettings.EndpointIdentity = EndpointIdentity;
			netMessagingTransportSettings.Via = Via;
			netMessagingTransportSettings.LeaseTimeout = LeaseTimeout;
			return netMessagingTransportSettings;
		}

		IAsyncResult ITransportSettings.BeginCreateFactory(IEnumerable<Uri> physicalUriAddresses, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			MessagingFactory data = new SbmpMessagingFactory(physicalUriAddresses, this);
			return new CompletedAsyncResult<MessagingFactory>(data, callback, state);
		}

		MessagingFactory ITransportSettings.EndCreateFactory(IAsyncResult result)
		{
