		}
	}
	internal abstract class SingletonDictionaryManager<TKey, TInstance> : CommunicationObject
	{
		internal enum SingletonState
		{
			Loading,
			Loaded,
			Unloading
		}

		public sealed class SingletonContext : IExtensibleObject<SingletonContext>
		{
			private IExtensionCollection<SingletonContext> extensions;

			private SingletonState innerState;

			private string stateChangeTime;

			public IExtensionCollection<SingletonContext> Extensions
			{
				get
				{
					if (extensions == null)
					{
						Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref extensions, new ExtensionCollection<SingletonContext>(this), null);
					}
					return extensions;
				}
			}

			internal TInstance Instance { get; private set; }

			internal SingletonState State
			{
				get
				{
					return innerState;
				}
				set
				{
					innerState = value;
					stateChangeTime = DateTime.UtcNow.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				}
			}

			public SingletonContext(SingletonState initialState)
			{
				State = initialState;
			}

			internal void UnsafeSetInstance(TInstance value)
			{
				Instance = value;
			}

			public override string ToString()
			{
				string arg = ((Instance != null) ? Instance.ToString() : string.Empty);
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "instance: {0}, state = {1}, stateChangeTime = {2}", arg, innerState, stateChangeTime);
			}
		}

		private sealed class GetInstanceAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<GetInstanceAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly SingletonDictionaryManager<TKey, TInstance> owner;

			private readonly TKey key;

			private SingletonContext singletonContext;

			public TInstance Instance { get; private set; }

			public GetInstanceAsyncResult(SingletonDictionaryManager<TKey, TInstance> owner, TKey key, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.owner = owner;
				this.key = key;
				Instance = default(TInstance);
			}

			public new static TInstance End(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				return AsyncResult<GetInstanceAsyncResult>.End(result).Instance;
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				while (true)
				{
					Monitor.Enter(owner.ThisLock);
					bool shouldReleaseLock = true;
					try
					{
						owner.ThrowIfDisposedOrNotOpen();
						if (!owner.instances.TryGetValue(key, out singletonContext))
						{
							break;
						}
						if (singletonContext.State == SingletonState.Loaded)
						{
							Instance = singletonContext.Instance;
							break;
						}
						if (singletonContext.State == SingletonState.Unloading)
						{
							break;
						}
						if (RemainingTime() <= TimeSpan.Zero)
						{
							Complete(new TimeoutException(SRCore.TimeoutOnOperation(base.OriginalTimeout)));
							break;
						}
						if (singletonContext.State == SingletonState.Loading)
						{
							yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)delegate(GetInstanceAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s)
							{
								try
								{
									shouldReleaseLock = false;
									return thisPtr.owner.BeginWaitPendingOperation(thisPtr.key, t, c, s);
								}
								finally
								{
									Monitor.Exit(thisPtr.owner.ThisLock);
								}
							}, (EndCall)delegate(GetInstanceAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
							{
								thisPtr.owner.EndWaitPendingOperation(r);
							}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
							continue;
						}
						string description = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0} was not recognized. This is likely a bug in {1}.", singletonContext.State, typeof(SingletonDictionaryManager<TKey, TInstance>).Name);
						Fx.AssertAndFailFastService(description);
						break;
					}
					finally
					{
						GetInstanceAsyncResult getInstanceAsyncResult = this;
						if (shouldReleaseLock)
						{
							shouldReleaseLock = false;
							Monitor.Exit(getInstanceAsyncResult.owner.ThisLock);
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private sealed class LoadInstanceAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<LoadInstanceAsyncResult>
		{
			private static readonly Action<Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult, Exception> CompletingDelegate = OnFinally;

			private readonly SingletonDictionaryManager<TKey, TInstance> owner;

			private readonly object loadingContext;

			private readonly TKey key;

			private SingletonContext singletonContext;

			private bool ownsLoading;

			private bool created;

			public TInstance Instance { get; private set; }

			public LoadInstanceAsyncResult(SingletonDictionaryManager<TKey, TInstance> owner, TKey key, object loadingContext, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.owner = owner;
				this.key = key;
				this.loadingContext = loadingContext;
				base.OnCompleting = (Action<Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult, Exception>)Delegate.Combine(base.OnCompleting, CompletingDelegate);
			}

			public new static TInstance End(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				return AsyncResult<LoadInstanceAsyncResult>.End(result).Instance;
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				while (true)
				{
					Monitor.Enter(owner.ThisLock);
					bool shouldReleaseLock = true;
					try
					{
						owner.ThrowIfDisposedOrNotOpen();
						if (RemainingTime() <= TimeSpan.Zero)
						{
							Complete(new TimeoutException(SRCore.TimeoutOnOperation(base.OriginalTimeout)));
							yield break;
						}
						if (!owner.instances.TryGetValue(key, out singletonContext))
						{
							singletonContext = new SingletonContext(SingletonState.Loading);
							owner.instances.Add(key, singletonContext);
							ownsLoading = true;
							break;
						}
						if (singletonContext.State == SingletonState.Loaded)
						{
							Instance = singletonContext.Instance;
							break;
						}
						if (singletonContext.State == SingletonState.Loading || singletonContext.State == SingletonState.Unloading)
						{
							yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)delegate(LoadInstanceAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s)
							{
								try
								{
									shouldReleaseLock = false;
									return thisPtr.owner.BeginWaitPendingOperation(thisPtr.key, t, c, s);
								}
								finally
								{
									Monitor.Exit(thisPtr.owner.ThisLock);
								}
							}, (EndCall)delegate(LoadInstanceAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
							{
								thisPtr.owner.EndWaitPendingOperation(r);
							}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
							continue;
						}
						string description = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0} was not recognized. This is likely a bug in {1}.", singletonContext.State, typeof(SingletonDictionaryManager<TKey, TInstance>).Name);
						Fx.AssertAndFailFastService(description);
					}
					finally
					{
						LoadInstanceAsyncResult loadInstanceAsyncResult = this;
						if (shouldReleaseLock)
						{
							shouldReleaseLock = false;
							Monitor.Exit(loadInstanceAsyncResult.owner.ThisLock);
						}
					}
					break;
				}
				if (ownsLoading)
				{
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((LoadInstanceAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.owner.OnBeginCreateInstance(thisPtr.singletonContext, thisPtr.key, thisPtr.loadingContext, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(LoadInstanceAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.singletonContext.UnsafeSetInstance(thisPtr.owner.OnEndCreateInstance(r));
					}, (Call)delegate(LoadInstanceAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t)
					{
						thisPtr.singletonContext.UnsafeSetInstance(thisPtr.owner.OnCreateInstance(thisPtr.singletonContext, thisPtr.key, thisPtr.loadingContext, t));
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
					created = true;
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((LoadInstanceAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.owner.OnBeginOpenInstance(thisPtr.singletonContext, thisPtr.key, thisPtr.singletonContext.Instance, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(LoadInstanceAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.owner.OnEndOpenInstance(r);
					}, (Call)delegate(LoadInstanceAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t)
					{
						thisPtr.owner.OnOpenInstance(thisPtr.singletonContext, thisPtr.key, thisPtr.singletonContext.Instance, t);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
					if (owner.State != CommunicationState.Opened)
					{
						Complete(new ObjectDisposedException(owner.GetType().Name));
					}
				}
				else
				{
					owner.OnGetInstance(singletonContext, key, singletonContext.Instance, loadingContext);
				}
			}

			private static void OnFinally(Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult result, Exception exception)
			{
				LoadInstanceAsyncResult loadInstanceAsyncResult = (LoadInstanceAsyncResult)result;
				if (!loadInstanceAsyncResult.ownsLoading)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (exception != null)
				{
					try
					{
						if (loadInstanceAsyncResult.created)
						{
							loadInstanceAsyncResult.owner.OnAbortInstance(loadInstanceAsyncResult.singletonContext, loadInstanceAsyncResult.key, loadInstanceAsyncResult.singletonContext.Instance, null);
						}
					}
					finally
					{
						lock (loadInstanceAsyncResult.owner.ThisLock)
						{
							loadInstanceAsyncResult.owner.instances.Remove(loadInstanceAsyncResult.key);
						}
						loadInstanceAsyncResult.owner.SignalPendingOperations(loadInstanceAsyncResult.key);
					}
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteSingletonManagerLoadFailed(loadInstanceAsyncResult.owner, loadInstanceAsyncResult.owner.GetKeyString(loadInstanceAsyncResult.key), string.Empty, exception.ToStringSlim());
				}
				else
				{
					lock (loadInstanceAsyncResult.owner.ThisLock)
					{
						loadInstanceAsyncResult.Instance = loadInstanceAsyncResult.singletonContext.Instance;
						loadInstanceAsyncResult.singletonContext.State = SingletonState.Loaded;
					}
					loadInstanceAsyncResult.owner.SignalPendingOperations(loadInstanceAsyncResult.key);
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteSingletonManagerLoadSucceeded(loadInstanceAsyncResult.owner, loadInstanceAsyncResult.owner.GetKeyString(loadInstanceAsyncResult.key), loadInstanceAsyncResult.owner.GetValueString(loadInstanceAsyncResult.Instance));
				}
			}
		}

		private sealed class UnloadInstanceAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<UnloadInstanceAsyncResult>
		{
			private static readonly Action<Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult, Exception> CompletingDelegate = OnFinally;

			private readonly SingletonDictionaryManager<TKey, TInstance> owner;

			private readonly TKey key;

			private readonly object unloadingContext;

			private readonly bool shouldAbort;

			private readonly TimeSpan closeTimeout;

			private bool ownsUnloading;

			private int shouldReleaseLock;

			private SingletonContext singletonContext;

			private TInstance instance;

			private bool waitPendingOperationsCalled;

			public UnloadInstanceAsyncResult(SingletonDictionaryManager<TKey, TInstance> owner, TKey key, object unloadingContext, bool shouldAbort, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(TimeSpan.MaxValue, callback, state)
			{
				this.owner = owner;
				this.key = key;
				this.unloadingContext = unloadingContext;
				this.shouldAbort = shouldAbort;
				closeTimeout = timeout;
				base.OnCompleting = (Action<Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult, Exception>)Delegate.Combine(base.OnCompleting, CompletingDelegate);
			}

			public new static void End(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				AsyncResult<UnloadInstanceAsyncResult>.End(result);
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				while (true)
				{
					Monitor.Enter(owner.ThisLock);
					Interlocked.Exchange(ref shouldReleaseLock, 1);
					try
					{
						if (!owner.instances.TryGetValue(key, out singletonContext))
						{
							break;
						}
						if (singletonContext.State == SingletonState.Loaded)
						{
							singletonContext.State = SingletonState.Unloading;
							instance = singletonContext.Instance;
							ownsUnloading = true;
							break;
						}
						if (singletonContext.State == SingletonState.Loading || singletonContext.State == SingletonState.Unloading)
						{
							yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)delegate(UnloadInstanceAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s)
							{
								try
								{
									Interlocked.Exchange(ref shouldReleaseLock, 0);
									return thisPtr.owner.BeginWaitPendingOperation(thisPtr.key, t, c, s);
								}
								finally
								{
									Monitor.Exit(thisPtr.owner.ThisLock);
								}
							}, (EndCall)delegate(UnloadInstanceAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
							{
								thisPtr.owner.EndWaitPendingOperation(r);
							}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
							continue;
						}
						string description = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0} was not recognized. This is likely a bug in {1}.", singletonContext.State, typeof(SingletonDictionaryManager<TKey, TInstance>).Name);
						Fx.AssertAndFailFastService(description);
					}
					finally
					{
						UnloadInstanceAsyncResult unloadInstanceAsyncResult = this;
						if (Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref unloadInstanceAsyncResult.shouldReleaseLock, 0, 1) == 1)
						{
							Monitor.Exit(unloadInstanceAsyncResult.owner.ThisLock);
						}
					}
					break;
				}
				if (!ownsUnloading)
				{
					yield break;
				}
				if (!waitPendingOperationsCalled)
				{
					waitPendingOperationsCalled = true;
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((UnloadInstanceAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.owner.OnBeginWaitPendingOperations(thisPtr.instance, thisPtr.closeTimeout, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(UnloadInstanceAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.owner.OnEndWaitPendingOperations(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
				}
				if (!shouldAbort)
				{
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((UnloadInstanceAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.owner.OnBeginCloseInstance(thisPtr.singletonContext, thisPtr.key, thisPtr.instance, thisPtr.unloadingContext, thisPtr.closeTimeout, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(UnloadInstanceAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.owner.OnEndCloseInstance(r);
					}, (Call)delegate(UnloadInstanceAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t)
					{
						thisPtr.owner.OnCloseInstance(thisPtr.singletonContext, thisPtr.key, thisPtr.instance, thisPtr.unloadingContext, thisPtr.closeTimeout);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
				}
				string valueName = ((instance == null) ? string.Empty : owner.GetValueString(instance));
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteSingletonManagerUnloadSucceeded(owner, owner.GetKeyString(key), valueName);
			}

			private static void OnFinally(Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult result, Exception exception)
			{
				UnloadInstanceAsyncResult unloadInstanceAsyncResult = (UnloadInstanceAsyncResult)result;
				if (!unloadInstanceAsyncResult.ownsUnloading)
				{
					return;
				}
				try
				{
					if (exception != null || unloadInstanceAsyncResult.shouldAbort)
					{
						if (exception != null)
						{
							MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteSingletonManagerClosingInstanceFailed(unloadInstanceAsyncResult.owner, unloadInstanceAsyncResult.owner.GetKeyString(unloadInstanceAsyncResult.key), unloadInstanceAsyncResult.owner.GetValueString(unloadInstanceAsyncResult.instance), exception.ToStringSlim());
						}
						try
						{
							unloadInstanceAsyncResult.owner.OnAbortInstance(unloadInstanceAsyncResult.singletonContext, unloadInstanceAsyncResult.key, unloadInstanceAsyncResult.instance, unloadInstanceAsyncResult.unloadingContext);
							MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteSingletonManagerAbortInstance(unloadInstanceAsyncResult.owner, unloadInstanceAsyncResult.owner.GetKeyString(unloadInstanceAsyncResult.key), unloadInstanceAsyncResult.owner.GetValueString(unloadInstanceAsyncResult.instance), string.Empty);
							return;
						}
						catch (Exception ex)
						{
							MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteSingletonManagerAbortInstance(unloadInstanceAsyncResult.owner, unloadInstanceAsyncResult.owner.GetKeyString(unloadInstanceAsyncResult.key), unloadInstanceAsyncResult.owner.GetValueString(unloadInstanceAsyncResult.instance), ex.ToStringSlim());
							throw;
						}
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					lock (unloadInstanceAsyncResult.owner.ThisLock)
					{
						unloadInstanceAsyncResult.owner.instances.Remove(unloadInstanceAsyncResult.key);
					}
					unloadInstanceAsyncResult.owner.SignalPendingOperations(unloadInstanceAsyncResult.key);
				}
			}
		}

		private sealed class CloseAsyncResult : Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult
		{
			private static readonly AsyncCallback OnUnloadCompletedCallback = OnUnloadCompleted;

			private readonly SingletonDictionaryManager<TKey, TInstance> owner;

			private readonly object syncRoot;

			private TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper;

			private volatile Exception firstException;

			private int waitCount;

			public CloseAsyncResult(SingletonDictionaryManager<TKey, TInstance> owner, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(callback, state)
			{
				this.owner = owner;
				syncRoot = new object();
				timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
				List<TKey> list;
				lock (this.owner.ThisLock)
				{
					list = new List<TKey>(this.owner.instances.Keys);
				}
				IncreaseWaitCount();
				foreach (TKey item in list)
				{
					try
					{
						IncreaseWaitCount();
						new UnloadInstanceAsyncResult(this.owner, item, null, shouldAbort: false, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime(), OnUnloadCompletedCallback, this).Start();
					}
					catch (Exception ex)
					{
						if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
						{
							throw;
						}
						DecreaseWaitCount(ex, isCompletedSynchronously: true);
					}
				}
				DecreaseWaitCount(null, isCompletedSynchronously: true);
			}

			public static void End(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult.End<CloseAsyncResult>(result);
			}

			private static void OnUnloadCompleted(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				CloseAsyncResult closeAsyncResult = (CloseAsyncResult)result.AsyncState;
				try
				{
					UnloadInstanceAsyncResult.End(result);
					closeAsyncResult.DecreaseWaitCount(null, result.CompletedSynchronously);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
					{
						throw;
					}
					closeAsyncResult.DecreaseWaitCount(ex, result.CompletedSynchronously);
				}
			}

			private void IncreaseWaitCount()
			{
				lock (syncRoot)
				{
					waitCount++;
				}
			}

			private void DecreaseWaitCount(Exception exception, bool isCompletedSynchronously)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				lock (syncRoot)
				{
					if (firstException == null)
					{
						firstException = exception;
					}
					if (--waitCount == 0)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					Complete(isCompletedSynchronously, firstException);
				}
			}
		}

		private readonly Dictionary<TKey, SingletonContext> instances;

		private readonly Dictionary<TKey, List<AsyncWaiter>> pendingOperations;

		protected override TimeSpan DefaultCloseTimeout => Constants.DefaultOperationTimeout;

		protected override TimeSpan DefaultOpenTimeout => Constants.DefaultOperationTimeout;

		protected SingletonDictionaryManager()
			: this((IEqualityComparer<TKey>)EqualityComparer<TKey>.Default)
		{
		}

		protected SingletonDictionaryManager(IEqualityComparer<TKey> comparer)
		{
			instances = new Dictionary<TKey, SingletonContext>(comparer);
			pendingOperations = new Dictionary<TKey, List<AsyncWaiter>>(comparer);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return GetType().Name;
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginOpen(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new CompletedAsyncResult(callback, state);
		}

		protected override void OnEndOpen(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			CompletedAsyncResult.End(result);
		}

		protected override void OnOpen(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new CloseAsyncResult(this, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		protected override void OnEndClose(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			CloseAsyncResult.End(result);
		}

		protected override void OnClose(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			OnEndClose(OnBeginClose(timeout, null, null));
		}

		protected override void OnAbort()
		{
			KeyValuePair<TKey, SingletonContext>[] array;
			lock (base.ThisLock)
			{
				array = new KeyValuePair<TKey, SingletonContext>[instances.Count];
				((ICollection<KeyValuePair<TKey, SingletonContext>>)instances).CopyTo(array, 0);
				KeyValuePair<TKey, SingletonContext>[] array2 = array;
				for (int i = 0; i < array2.Length; i++)
				{
					KeyValuePair<TKey, SingletonContext> keyValuePair = array2[i];
					SingletonContext value = keyValuePair.Value;
					if (value.State == SingletonState.Loaded)
					{
						instances.Remove(keyValuePair.Key);
					}
				}
			}
			KeyValuePair<TKey, SingletonContext>[] array3 = array;
			for (int j = 0; j < array3.Length; j++)
			{
				KeyValuePair<TKey, SingletonContext> keyValuePair2 = array3[j];
				SingletonContext value2 = keyValuePair2.Value;
				if (value2.State == SingletonState.Loaded)
				{
					OnAbortInstance(value2, keyValuePair2.Key, value2.Instance, null);
				}
			}
		}

		protected IAsyncResult BeginGetInstance(TKey key, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposedOrNotOpen();
			return new GetInstanceAsyncResult(this, key, timeout, callback, state).Start();
		}

		protected TInstance EndGetInstance(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			return GetInstanceAsyncResult.End(result);
		}

		protected TInstance GetInstance(TKey key, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			GetInstanceAsyncResult getInstanceAsyncResult = new GetInstanceAsyncResult(this, key, timeout, null, null);
			getInstanceAsyncResult.RunSynchronously();
			return getInstanceAsyncResult.Instance;
		}

		protected bool TryGetLoadedInstance(TKey key, out TInstance instance)
		{
			instance = default(TInstance);
			if (base.State != CommunicationState.Opened)
			{
				return false;
			}
			lock (base.ThisLock)
			{
				if (instances.TryGetValue(key, out var value) && value.State == SingletonState.Loaded)
				{
					instance = value.Instance;
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected IAsyncResult BeginLoadInstance(TKey key, object loadingContext, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposedOrNotOpen();
			return new LoadInstanceAsyncResult(this, key, loadingContext, timeout, callback, state).Start();
		}

		protected TInstance EndLoadInstance(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			return LoadInstanceAsyncResult.End(result);
		}

		protected TInstance LoadInstance(TKey key, object loadingContext, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			LoadInstanceAsyncResult loadInstanceAsyncResult = new LoadInstanceAsyncResult(this, key, loadingContext, timeout, null, null);
			loadInstanceAsyncResult.RunSynchronously();
			return loadInstanceAsyncResult.Instance;
		}

		protected IAsyncResult BeginUnloadInstance(TKey key, object unloadingContext, bool shouldAbort, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposedOrNotOpen();
			return new UnloadInstanceAsyncResult(this, key, unloadingContext, shouldAbort, timeout, callback, state).Start();
		}

		protected void EndUnloadInstance(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			UnloadInstanceAsyncResult.End(result);
		}

		protected void UnloadInstance(TKey key, object unloadingContext, bool shouldAbort, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			UnloadInstanceAsyncResult unloadInstanceAsyncResult = new UnloadInstanceAsyncResult(this, key, unloadingContext, shouldAbort, timeout, null, null);
			unloadInstanceAsyncResult.RunSynchronously();
		}

		protected void SafeUnloadInstance(TKey key, object unloadingContext, bool shouldAbort, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			if (!TryGetLoadedInstance(key, out var _))
			{
				return;
			}
			BeginUnloadInstance(key, unloadingContext, shouldAbort, timeout, delegate(IAsyncResult r)
			{
				try
				{
					((SingletonDictionaryManager<TKey, TInstance>)r.AsyncState).EndUnloadInstance(r);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
					{
						throw;
					}
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.HandledExceptionWithFunctionName(EventTraceActivity.Empty, "SafeUnloadInstance", ex.GetType().Name, ex.Message);
				}
			}, this);
		}

		protected async Task<TInstance> ReloadInstanceAsync(TKey key, object loadingContext, object unloadingContext, bool mustCloseFirst, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			SingletonContext existingContext = null;
			SingletonContext newContext = null;
			TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
			Exception exception = null;
			bool ownsLoading = false;
			bool created = false;
			bool opened = false;
			bool oldInstanceClosing = false;
			bool oldInstanceClosed = false;
			try
			{
				while (true)
				{
					bool shouldReleaseLock = true;
					Monitor.Enter(base.ThisLock);
					try
					{
						ThrowIfDisposedOrNotOpen();
						if (timeoutHelper.RemainingTime() <= TimeSpan.Zero)
						{
							throw new TimeoutException(SRCore.TimeoutOnOperation(timeoutHelper.OriginalTimeout));
						}
						if (!instances.TryGetValue(key, out existingContext))
						{
							newContext = new SingletonContext(SingletonState.Loading);
							instances.Add(key, newContext);
							ownsLoading = true;
							break;
						}
						if (existingContext.State == SingletonState.Loaded)
						{
							newContext = new SingletonContext(SingletonState.Loading);
							instances[key] = newContext;
							ownsLoading = true;
							break;
						}
						if (existingContext.State == SingletonState.Loading || existingContext.State == SingletonState.Unloading)
						{
							Task task;
							try
							{
								shouldReleaseLock = false;
								task = TaskHelpers.FromAsync((AsyncCallback c, object s) => BeginWaitPendingOperation(key, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime(), c, s), delegate(IAsyncResult r)
								{
									EndWaitPendingOperation(r);
								});
							}
							finally
							{
								Monitor.Exit(base.ThisLock);
							}
							await task;
						}
						else
						{
							string description = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0} was not recognized. This is likely a bug in {1}.", existingContext.State, this);
							Fx.AssertAndFailFastService(description);
						}
					}
					finally
					{
						if (shouldReleaseLock)
						{
							Monitor.Exit(base.ThisLock);
						}
					}
				}
				if (mustCloseFirst && existingContext != null)
				{
					oldInstanceClosing = true;
					await TaskHelpers.FromAsync((AsyncCallback c, object s) => OnBeginCloseInstance(existingContext, key, existingContext.Instance, unloadingContext, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime(), c, s), delegate(IAsyncResult r)
					{
						OnEndCloseInstance(r);
					});
					oldInstanceClosed = true;
				}
				await TaskHelpers.FromAsync((AsyncCallback c, object s) => OnBeginCreateInstance(newContext, key, loadingContext, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime(), c, s), delegate(IAsyncResult r)
				{
					newContext.UnsafeSetInstance(OnEndCreateInstance(r));
				});
				created = true;
				await TaskHelpers.FromAsync((AsyncCallback c, object s) => OnBeginOpenInstance(newContext, key, newContext.Instance, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime(), c, s), delegate(IAsyncResult r)
				{
					OnEndOpenInstance(r);
				});
				opened = true;
				if (!mustCloseFirst && existingContext != null)
				{
					oldInstanceClosing = true;
					await TaskHelpers.FromAsync((AsyncCallback c, object s) => OnBeginCloseInstance(existingContext, key, existingContext.Instance, unloadingContext, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime(), c, s), delegate(IAsyncResult r)
					{
						OnEndCloseInstance(r);
					});
					oldInstanceClosed = true;
				}
				if (base.State != CommunicationState.Opened)
				{
					throw new ObjectDisposedException(GetType().Name);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				exception = ex;
				if (oldInstanceClosing && !oldInstanceClosed)
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteSingletonManagerClosingInstanceFailed(this, GetKeyString(key), GetValueString(existingContext.Instance), exception.ToStringSlim());
				}
				if (!oldInstanceClosing || oldInstanceClosed || mustCloseFirst)
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteSingletonManagerReloadFailed(this, GetKeyString(key), (newContext != null) ? GetValueString(newContext.Instance) : string.Empty, mustCloseFirst, exception.ToStringSlim());
					throw;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (ownsLoading)
				{
					if (exception != null)
					{
						TInstance instance = default(TInstance);
						try
						{
							if (created && !opened)
							{
								instance = newContext.Instance;
								OnAbortInstance(newContext, key, newContext.Instance, null);
								MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteSingletonManagerAbortInstance(this, GetKeyString(key), GetValueString(newContext.Instance), string.Empty);
							}
							if (oldInstanceClosing && !oldInstanceClosed)
							{
								instance = existingContext.Instance;
								OnAbortInstance(existingContext, key, existingContext.Instance, null);
								MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteSingletonManagerAbortInstance(this, GetKeyString(key), GetValueString(existingContext.Instance), string.Empty);
							}
						}
						catch (Exception exception2)
						{
							MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteSingletonManagerAbortInstance(this, GetKeyString(key), GetValueString(instance), exception2.ToStringSlim());
						}
						finally
						{
							lock (base.ThisLock)
							{
								if (!opened)
								{
									if (existingContext == null || (mustCloseFirst && oldInstanceClosing))
									{
										instances.Remove(key);
									}
									else
									{
										instances[key] = existingContext;
									}
								}
							}
							SignalPendingOperations(key);
						}
					}
					if (exception == null || (oldInstanceClosing && !oldInstanceClosed))
					{
						TInstance instance2 = default(TInstance);
						lock (base.ThisLock)
						{
							instance2 = newContext.Instance;
							newContext.State = SingletonState.Loaded;
						}
						SignalPendingOperations(key);
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteSingletonManagerReloadSucceeded(this, GetKeyString(key), GetValueString(instance2));
					}
				}
			}
			return newContext.Instance;
		}

		protected List<TKey> GetInstanceKeys()
		{
			lock (base.ThisLock)
			{
				return new List<TKey>(instances.Keys);
			}
		}

		protected SingletonContext[] GetInstances()
		{
			lock (base.ThisLock)
			{
				return instances.Values.ToArray();
			}
		}

		protected bool TryGetSingletonContext(TKey key, out SingletonContext singletonContext)
		{
			lock (base.ThisLock)
			{
				return instances.TryGetValue(key, out singletonContext);
			}
		}

		protected bool OnTryRemoveSingletonContext(TKey key, SingletonContext expected = null)
		{
			lock (base.ThisLock)
			{
				if (expected != null && (!instances.TryGetValue(key, out var value) || value != expected))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return instances.Remove(key);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnGetInstance(SingletonContext singletonContext, TKey key, TInstance instance, object loadingContext)
		{
		}

		protected abstract IAsyncResult OnBeginCreateInstance(SingletonContext singletonContext, TKey key, object loadingContext, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state);

		protected abstract TInstance OnEndCreateInstance(IAsyncResult result);

		protected abstract TInstance OnCreateInstance(SingletonContext singletonContext, TKey key, object loadingContext, TimeSpan timeout);

		protected abstract IAsyncResult OnBeginOpenInstance(SingletonContext singletonContext, TKey key, TInstance instance, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state);

		protected abstract void OnEndOpenInstance(IAsyncResult result);

		protected abstract void OnOpenInstance(SingletonContext singletonContext, TKey key, TInstance instance, TimeSpan timeout);

		protected abstract IAsyncResult OnBeginCloseInstance(SingletonContext singletonContext, TKey key, TInstance instance, object unloadingContext, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state);

		protected abstract void OnEndCloseInstance(IAsyncResult result);

		protected abstract void OnCloseInstance(SingletonContext singletonContext, TKey key, TInstance instance, object unloadingContext, TimeSpan timeout);

		protected abstract void OnAbortInstance(SingletonContext singletonContext, TKey key, TInstance instance, object unloadingContext);

		protected virtual IAsyncResult OnBeginWaitPendingOperations(TInstance instance, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new CompletedAsyncResult(callback, state);
		}

		protected virtual void OnEndWaitPendingOperations(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			CompletedAsyncResult.End(result);
		}

		protected virtual string GetKeyString(TKey key)
		{
			return key.ToString();
		}

		protected virtual string GetValueString(TInstance instance)
		{
			return typeof(TInstance).Name;
		}

		protected IEnumerable<SingletonContext> GetInstanceContexts()
		{
			lock (base.ThisLock)
			{
				return instances.Values.ToList();
			}
		}

		private IAsyncResult BeginWaitPendingOperation(TKey key, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			if (!pendingOperations.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
			{
				value = new List<AsyncWaiter>();
				pendingOperations.Add(key, value);
			}
			AsyncWaiter asyncWaiter = new AsyncWaiter(timeout, callback, state);
			value.Add(asyncWaiter);
			return asyncWaiter;
		}

		private void EndWaitPendingOperation(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			AsyncWaiter.End(result);
		}

		private void SignalPendingOperations(TKey key)
		{
			List<AsyncWaiter> value;
			lock (base.ThisLock)
			{
				if (pendingOperations.TryGetValue(key, out value))
				{
					pendingOperations.Remove(key);
				}
			}
			if (value == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (AsyncWaiter item in value)
			{
				IOThreadScheduler.ScheduleCallbackNoFlow(delegate(object state)
				{
					((AsyncWaiter)state).Signal();
				}, item);
			}
		}

		internal bool IsInstanceLoadingOrLoaded(TKey key)
		{
			bool result = false;
			lock (base.ThisLock)
			{
				if (instances.TryGetValue(key, out var value) && value.State != SingletonState.Unloading)
				{
					result = true;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	[DataContract(Name = "WorkUnitInfo", Namespace = "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2011/06/servicebus")]
	internal class WorkUnitInfo : IExtensibleDataObject
	{
		[DataMember(Name = "Identifier", EmitDefaultValue = false)]
		private string identifier;

		[DataMember(Name = "SequenceNumber", IsRequired = true)]
		private int sequenceNumber;

		public string Identifier
		{
			get
			{
				return identifier;
			}
			set
			{
				identifier = value;
			}
		}

		public int SequenceNumber
		{
			get
			{
				return sequenceNumber;
			}
			set
			{
				sequenceNumber = value;
			}
		}

		public bool More { get; set; }

		public ExtensionDataObject ExtensionData { get; set; }

		public static WorkUnitInfo GetFrom(MessageHeaders messageHeaders, string workUnitName)
		{
			int num = messageHeaders.FindHeader(workUnitName, "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2011/06/servicebus");
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return messageHeaders.GetHeader<WorkUnitInfo>(num);
		}

		public static void AddTo(MessageHeaders messageHeaders, string workUnitName, string workUnitId, int sequenceNumber)
		{
			WorkUnitInfo value = new WorkUnitInfo
			{
				Identifier = workUnitId,
				SequenceNumber = sequenceNumber
			};
			messageHeaders.Add(MessageHeader.CreateHeader(workUnitName, "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2011/06/servicebus", value));
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}:{1}", identifier, sequenceNumber);
		}
	}

	internal sealed class PropertyReferenceDictionary : IDictionary<string, object>, ICollection<KeyValuePair<string, object>>, IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<string, object>>, IEnumerable
	{
		private readonly IDictionary<string, object> inner;

		public ICollection<string> Keys => inner.Keys;

		public ICollection<object> Values => inner.Values;

		public object this[string key]
		{
			get
			{
				return inner[key];
			}
			set
			{
				inner[key] = value;
			}
		}

		public int Count => inner.Count;

		public bool IsReadOnly => inner.IsReadOnly;

		public PropertyReferenceDictionary()
		{
			inner = new Dictionary<string, object>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
		}

		public PropertyReferenceDictionary(IDictionary<string, object> container)
		{
			inner = container;
		}

		public void Add(string key, object value)
		{
			if (value != null)
			{
				Type type = value.GetType();
				if (typeof(PropertyReference) != type && !SerializationUtilities.IsSupportedPropertyType(value.GetType()))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.NotSupportedPropertyType(type), "value");
				}
			}
			inner.Add(key, value);
		}

		public bool ContainsKey(string key)
		{
			return inner.ContainsKey(key);
		}

		public bool Remove(string key)
		{
			return inner.Remove(key);
		}

		public bool TryGetValue(string key, out object value)
		{
			return inner.TryGetValue(key, out value);
		}

		public void Add(KeyValuePair<string, object> item)
		{
			inner.Add(item);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			inner.Clear();
		}

		public bool Contains(KeyValuePair<string, object> item)
		{
			return inner.Contains(item);
		}

		public void CopyTo(KeyValuePair<string, object>[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			inner.CopyTo(array, arrayIndex);
		}

		public bool Remove(KeyValuePair<string, object> item)
		{
			return inner.Remove(item);
		}

		public IEnumerator<KeyValuePair<string, object>> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return inner.GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return inner.GetEnumerator();
		}
	}
	[DataContract(Name = "PrivateEndpoint", Namespace = "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2010/10/servicebus/connect")]
	public sealed class PrivateEndpointAuthorizationRule : AuthorizationRule
	{
		private const string PrivateEndpointClaimType = "privatelink";

		[IgnoreDataMember]
		private ISet<uint> linkIds;

		[DataMember(Name = "KeyName", IsRequired = true, Order = 2001, EmitDefaultValue = false)]
		private string InternalKeyName { get; set; }

		[CLSCompliant(false)]
		[IgnoreDataMember]
		public ISet<uint> LinkIds => linkIds ?? (linkIds = new HashSet<uint>());

		public override string KeyName
		{
			get
			{
				return InternalKeyName;
			}
			set
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("value");
				}
				if (!string.Equals(InternalKeyName, HttpUtility.UrlEncode(InternalKeyName)))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(SRCore.AuthorizationRuleKeyContainsInvalidCharacters(GetType().Name));
				}
				if (value.Length > 256)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("KeyName", SRCore.ArgumentStringTooBig("KeyName", 256, value.Length));
				}
				InternalKeyName = value;
			}
		}

		public PrivateEndpointAuthorizationRule(string ruleName)
			: this(ruleName, null)
		{
		}

		public PrivateEndpointAuthorizationRule(string ruleName, params uint[] linkIds)
		{
			KeyName = ruleName;
			base.ClaimType = "privatelink";
			if (linkIds != null)
			{
				foreach (uint item in linkIds)
				{
					LinkIds.Add(item);
				}
			}
		}

		public override AuthorizationRule Clone()
		{
			PrivateEndpointAuthorizationRule privateEndpointAuthorizationRule = (PrivateEndpointAuthorizationRule)base.Clone();
			if (linkIds != null)
			{
				privateEndpointAuthorizationRule.linkIds = new HashSet<uint>(linkIds);
			}
			return privateEndpointAuthorizationRule;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!base.Equals(obj) || !(obj is PrivateEndpointAuthorizationRule privateEndpointAuthorizationRule))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!string.Equals(KeyName, privateEndpointAuthorizationRule.KeyName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return LinkIds.SetEquals(privateEndpointAuthorizationRule.LinkIds);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return KeyName?.GetHashCode() ?? 0;
		}

		protected override void ValidateRights(IEnumerable<AccessRights> value)
		{
			if (base.Rights != null && base.Rights.Any())
			{
				base.ValidateRights(value);
			}
		}

		[OnDeserialized]
		private void OnDeserialized(StreamingContext streamingContext)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(base.ClaimValue))
			{
				string[] array = base.ClaimValue.Split(new char[1] { ',' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
				string[] array2 = array;
				foreach (string s in array2)
				{
					LinkIds.Add(uint.Parse(s, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
				}
				base.ClaimValue = null;
			}
		}

		[OnSerializing]
		private void OnSerializing(StreamingContext streamingContext)
		{
			base.ClaimValue = string.Join(",", LinkIds);
		}

		[OnSerialized]
		private void OnSerialized(StreamingContext streamingContext)
		{
			base.ClaimValue = null;
		}
	}
	internal sealed class ServiceBusUriManager
	{
		private readonly List<Uri> uriAddresses;

		private readonly bool roundRobin;

		private int currentUriIndex;

		private int firstUriIndex;

		public Uri Current => uriAddresses[currentUriIndex];

		public ServiceBusUriManager(List<Uri> uriAddresses, bool roundRobin = false)
		{
			this.uriAddresses = uriAddresses;
			firstUriIndex = -1;
			this.roundRobin = roundRobin;
		}

		public bool MoveNextUri()
		{
			if (firstUriIndex == -1)
			{
				firstUriIndex = (currentUriIndex = ConcurrentRandom.Next(0, uriAddresses.Count));
			}
			else
			{
				if (!roundRobin && IsLastUri())
				{
					return false;
				}
				currentUriIndex = GetNextUriValue();
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool CanRetry()
		{
			if (!roundRobin)
			{
				return !IsLastUri();
			}
			return true;
		}

		private int GetNextUriValue()
		{
			return (currentUriIndex + 1) % uriAddresses.Count;
		}

		private bool IsLastUri()
		{
			return GetNextUriValue() == firstUriIndex;
		}
	}

			}
		}

			: this(exception, includeInnerException: false)

			Type = exception.GetType().ToString();
			StackTrace = string.Empty;
			InnerException = null;
			if (includeInnerException && exception.InnerException != null)
			{
				InnerException = new ExceptionDetailNoStackTrace(exception.InnerException, includeInnerException);
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.Append(GetType().Name);
			stringBuilder.Append(": ");
			stringBuilder.Append(Type);
			stringBuilder.Append(": ");
			stringBuilder.Append(Message);
			if (InnerException != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append("--->");
				stringBuilder.AppendLine(InnerException.ToString());
				stringBuilder.Append(SRCore.EndOfInnerExceptionStackTrace);
			}
			stringBuilder.AppendLine();
			stringBuilder.Append(StackTrace);
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		}

		public static string[] SplitSubQueuePath(string path)
		{
			if (path.Contains("$"))
			{
				if (!path.Contains("/") && !path.Contains("|"))
				{
					return new string[2]
					{
						string.Empty,
						path
					};
				}
				string[] array = path.Split(new string[2] { "/", "|" }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
				string text = array[array.Length - 1];
				if (!text.StartsWith("$"))
				{
					return new string[2]
					{
						path,
						string.Empty
					};
				}
				return new string[2]
				{
					path.Substring(0, path.Length - text.Length - 1),
					text
				};
			}
			return new string[2]
			{
				path,
				string.Empty
			};
		}

	internal static class SoapProtocolDefaults
	{
		public const bool DefaultPortSharingEnabled = false;

		public const ushort DefaultPort = 9093;

		public const string UriScheme = "sb";

		public const string TransportUriScheme = "net.tcp";

		private const string ClientAuthEnabledSetting = "clientCertificateAuthInWindowsfabricSslEnabled";

		private static readonly TimeSpan ClientToBrokerTimeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10.0);

		public static CustomBinding CreateBinding(bool portSharingEnabled, int maxReceivedMessageSize, long maxBufferPoolSize, bool useSslStreamSecurity, bool clientCertificateAuthEnabled, DnsEndpointIdentity endpointIdentity, IssuedSecurityTokenParameters issuedTokenParameters)
		{
			TransactionFlowBindingElement item = new TransactionFlowBindingElement();
			BinaryMessageEncodingBindingElement binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement = new BinaryMessageEncodingBindingElement();
			binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement.ReaderQuotas.MaxStringContentLength = maxReceivedMessageSize;
			TcpTransportBindingElement tcpTransportBindingElement = new TcpTransportBindingElement();
			tcpTransportBindingElement.PortSharingEnabled = portSharingEnabled;
			tcpTransportBindingElement.MaxReceivedMessageSize = maxReceivedMessageSize;
			tcpTransportBindingElement.MaxBufferPoolSize = maxBufferPoolSize;
			CustomBinding customBinding = new CustomBinding();
			customBinding.Elements.Add(item);
			if (useSslStreamSecurity)
			{
				SslStreamSecurityBindingElement sslStreamSecurityBindingElement = new SslStreamSecurityBindingElement();
				if (endpointIdentity != null)
				{
					sslStreamSecurityBindingElement.IdentityVerifier = new LenientDnsIdentityVerifier(endpointIdentity);
				}
				sslStreamSecurityBindingElement.RequireClientCertificate = clientCertificateAuthEnabled;
				customBinding.Elements.Add(sslStreamSecurityBindingElement);
			}
			customBinding.Elements.Add(binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement);
			customBinding.Elements.Add(tcpTransportBindingElement);
			return customBinding;
		}

		public static CustomBinding CreateBinding(bool portSharingEnabled, int maxReceivedMessageSize, long maxBufferPoolSize, IssuedSecurityTokenParameters issuedTokenParameters)
		{
			return CreateBinding(portSharingEnabled, maxReceivedMessageSize, maxBufferPoolSize, useSslStreamSecurity: false, clientCertificateAuthEnabled: false, null, issuedTokenParameters);
		}

		public static CustomBinding CreateSslBinding(bool portSharingEnabled, int maxReceivedMessageSize, long maxBufferPoolSize, bool clientCertificateAuthEnabled, DnsEndpointIdentity endpointIdentity, IssuedSecurityTokenParameters issuedTokenParameters)
		{
			return CreateBinding(portSharingEnabled, maxReceivedMessageSize, maxBufferPoolSize, useSslStreamSecurity: true, clientCertificateAuthEnabled, endpointIdentity, issuedTokenParameters);
		}

		public static CustomBinding CreateSslBinding(bool portSharingEnabled, int maxReceivedMessageSize, long maxBufferPoolSize, bool clientCertificateAuthEnabled, IssuedSecurityTokenParameters issuedTokenParameters)
		{
			return CreateBinding(portSharingEnabled, maxReceivedMessageSize, maxBufferPoolSize, useSslStreamSecurity: true, clientCertificateAuthEnabled, null, issuedTokenParameters);
		}

		public static ChannelProtectionRequirements GetChannelProtectionRequirements(ProtectionLevel protectionLevel)
		{
			MessagePartSpecification parts = new MessagePartSpecification(isBodyIncluded: true);
			MessagePartSpecification parts2 = new MessagePartSpecification();
			ChannelProtectionRequirements channelProtectionRequirements = new ChannelProtectionRequirements();
			switch (protectionLevel)
			{
			case ProtectionLevel.None:
				channelProtectionRequirements.IncomingSignatureParts.AddParts(parts2, "*");
				channelProtectionRequirements.OutgoingSignatureParts.AddParts(parts2, "*");
				channelProtectionRequirements.IncomingEncryptionParts.AddParts(parts2, "*");
				channelProtectionRequirements.OutgoingEncryptionParts.AddParts(parts2, "*");
				break;
			case ProtectionLevel.Sign:
				channelProtectionRequirements.IncomingSignatureParts.AddParts(parts, "*");
				channelProtectionRequirements.OutgoingSignatureParts.AddParts(parts, "*");
				channelProtectionRequirements.IncomingEncryptionParts.AddParts(parts2, "*");
				channelProtectionRequirements.OutgoingEncryptionParts.AddParts(parts2, "*");
				break;
			case ProtectionLevel.EncryptAndSign:
				channelProtectionRequirements.IncomingSignatureParts.AddParts(parts, "*");
				channelProtectionRequirements.OutgoingSignatureParts.AddParts(parts, "*");
				channelProtectionRequirements.IncomingEncryptionParts.AddParts(parts, "*");
				channelProtectionRequirements.OutgoingEncryptionParts.AddParts(parts, "*");
				break;
			}
			return channelProtectionRequirements;
		}
