	internal delegate int CalculateBatchSizeDelegate<TItem>(IEnumerable<TItem> batchItems);
	internal delegate IAsyncResult BeginBatchedDelegate<TItem>(TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<TItem> batchItems, string transactionId, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state);
	internal delegate void EndBatchedDelegate(IAsyncResult result, bool forceCleanUp);
	internal delegate IComparable GroupByKeySelectorDelegate<TItem>(IEnumerable<TItem> batchedObjects);
	internal delegate bool OnRetryDelegate<TItem>(IEnumerable<TItem> batchItem, Exception exception, bool isMultiBatchCommand);
	internal delegate void TransactionStateChangedDelegate(TrackingContext trackingContext, string transactionId, TransactionCommitStatus transactionCommitStatus);
	internal sealed class BatchManager<TItem> : CommunicationObject
	{
		private delegate void StartBatchOperationDelegate(PerformFlushAsyncResult thisPtr, IList<BatchedObjectsAsyncResult> batchedObjectsAsyncResults);

		private sealed class BatchedObjectsAsyncResult : Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult
		{
			private TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper;

			public TrackingContext TrackingContext { get; private set; }

			public int BatchSize { get; private set; }

			public IEnumerable<TItem> BatchedObjects { get; private set; }

			public TimeSpan RemainingTime => timeoutHelper.RemainingTime();

			public BatchedObjectsAsyncResult(TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<TItem> batchedObjects, int batchSize, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(callback, state)
			{
				TrackingContext = trackingContext;
				BatchedObjects = batchedObjects;
				BatchSize = batchSize;
				timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateOnly(timeout);
			}

			public static void End(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult.End<BatchedObjectsAsyncResult>(result);
			}

			public void CompleteBatch(Exception delayedException)
			{
				Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: false, delayedException);
			}
		}

		private sealed class PerformFlushAsyncResult : Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult
		{
			private static AsyncCallback onFlushCompletionCallback = OnFlushCompletedCallback;

			private static AsyncCallback singleOperationCompleteCallback = OnSingleOperationCompletedCallback;

			private readonly StartBatchOperationDelegate startBatchOperation;

			private readonly TrackingContext trackingContext;

			private readonly IList<BatchedObjectsAsyncResult> batchedResults;

			private readonly TimeSpan timeout;

			private readonly bool isInTransaction;

			private readonly string transactionId;

			private int batchedResultsCount;

			private Exception completionException;

			public BatchManager<TItem> BatchManager { get; private set; }

			public TrackingContext TrackingContext => trackingContext;

			public PerformFlushAsyncResult(TrackingContext trackingContext, BatchManager<TItem> batchManager, List<BatchedObjectsAsyncResult> batchedResults, string transactionId, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(callback, state)
			{
				this.trackingContext = trackingContext;
				BatchManager = batchManager;
				startBatchOperation = BatchManager.StartBatchOperation;
				this.batchedResults = batchedResults;
				this.timeout = timeout;
				batchedResultsCount = 0;
				this.transactionId = transactionId;
				isInTransaction = transactionId != null;
			}

			public static void End(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult.End<PerformFlushAsyncResult>(result);
			}

			public void StartOperation()
			{
				Interlocked.Increment(ref batchedResultsCount);
				startBatchOperation(this, batchedResults);
			}

			public static void StartGroupByBatchOperation(PerformFlushAsyncResult thisPtr, IList<BatchedObjectsAsyncResult> batchedObjectsAsyncResults)
			{
				ICollection<IList<BatchedObjectsAsyncResult>> collection = GroupBy(batchedObjectsAsyncResults, thisPtr.BatchManager.GroupByKeySelector);
				Interlocked.Add(ref thisPtr.batchedResultsCount, collection.Count);
				foreach (IList<BatchedObjectsAsyncResult> item in collection)
				{
					StartBatchOperation(thisPtr, item);
				}
			}

			public static void StartBatchOperation(PerformFlushAsyncResult thisPtr, IList<BatchedObjectsAsyncResult> batchedObjectsAsyncResults)
			{
				List<TItem> list = new List<TItem>();
				foreach (BatchedObjectsAsyncResult batchedObjectsAsyncResult in batchedObjectsAsyncResults)
				{
					TrackingContext itemTrackingContext = batchedObjectsAsyncResult.TrackingContext;
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteBatchManagerExecutingBatchedObject(itemTrackingContext.Activity, thisPtr.trackingContext.Activity, itemTrackingContext.TrackingId, itemTrackingContext.SystemTracker, thisPtr.TrackingContext.TrackingId);
					});
					list.AddRange(batchedObjectsAsyncResult.BatchedObjects);
				}
				try
				{
					IAsyncResult asyncResult = thisPtr.BatchManager.BatchedBegin(thisPtr.TrackingContext, list, thisPtr.transactionId, thisPtr.timeout, onFlushCompletionCallback, new Tuple<PerformFlushAsyncResult, IList<BatchedObjectsAsyncResult>>(thisPtr, batchedObjectsAsyncResults));
					if (asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
					{
						thisPtr.OnFlushCompleted(asyncResult, batchedObjectsAsyncResults);
					}
				}
				catch (Exception delayedException)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(delayedException))
					{
						throw;
					}
					thisPtr.TryContinueOperation(completedSynchronously: true, delayedException, batchedObjectsAsyncResults);
				}
			}

			private static void OnFlushCompletedCallback(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				if (!result.CompletedSynchronously)
				{
					Tuple<PerformFlushAsyncResult, IList<BatchedObjectsAsyncResult>> tuple = (Tuple<PerformFlushAsyncResult, IList<BatchedObjectsAsyncResult>>)result.AsyncState;
					PerformFlushAsyncResult item = tuple.Item1;
					IList<BatchedObjectsAsyncResult> item2 = tuple.Item2;
					item.OnFlushCompleted(result, item2);
				}
			}

			private static void OnSingleOperationCompletedCallback(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				if (!result.CompletedSynchronously)
				{
					Tuple<PerformFlushAsyncResult, BatchedObjectsAsyncResult> tuple = (Tuple<PerformFlushAsyncResult, BatchedObjectsAsyncResult>)result.AsyncState;
					PerformFlushAsyncResult item = tuple.Item1;
					item.OnSingleOperationCompleted(result);
				}
			}

			private void OnFlushCompleted(IAsyncResult result, IList<BatchedObjectsAsyncResult> batchedObjectsAsyncResults)
			{
				Exception delayedException = null;
				try
				{
					BatchManager.BatchedEnd(result, isInTransaction);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
					{
						throw;
					}
					delayedException = ex;
				}
				TryContinueOperation(result.CompletedSynchronously, delayedException, batchedObjectsAsyncResults);
			}

			private void TryContinueOperation(bool completedSynchronously, Exception delayedException, IList<BatchedObjectsAsyncResult> batchedObjectsAsyncResults)
			{
				ContinueOperation(delayedException, batchedObjectsAsyncResults);
				if (Interlocked.Decrement(ref batchedResultsCount) == 0)
				{
					Complete(completedSynchronously, delayedException);
				}
			}

			private void OnSingleOperationCompleted(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				Exception delayedException = null;
				Tuple<PerformFlushAsyncResult, BatchedObjectsAsyncResult> tuple = (Tuple<PerformFlushAsyncResult, BatchedObjectsAsyncResult>)result.AsyncState;
				BatchedObjectsAsyncResult item = tuple.Item2;
				try
				{
					BatchManager.BatchedEnd(result, forceCleanUp: true);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
					{
						throw;
					}
					delayedException = ex;
				}
				CompleteSingleOperation(item, delayedException);
			}

			private void CompleteSingleOperation(BatchedObjectsAsyncResult singleOperation, Exception delayedException)
			{
				if (delayedException != null)
				{
					completionException = delayedException;
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteBatchManagerException(TrackingContext.Activity, TrackingContext.TrackingId, TrackingContext.SystemTracker, "BatchManager.PerformFlushAsyncResult.CompleteSingleOperation", delayedException.ToStringSlim());
					});
				}
				IOThreadScheduler.ScheduleCallbackNoFlow(delegate
				{
					singleOperation.CompleteBatch(delayedException);
				}, null);
				if (Interlocked.Decrement(ref batchedResultsCount) == 0)
				{
					Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: false, completionException);
				}
			}

			private bool ContinueOperation(Exception delayedException, IList<BatchedObjectsAsyncResult> batchedObjectsAsyncResults)
			{
				if (delayedException != null)
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteBatchManagerException(TrackingContext.Activity, TrackingContext.TrackingId, TrackingContext.SystemTracker, "BatchManager.PerformFlushAsyncResult.ContinueOperation", delayedException.ToStringSlim());
					});
				}
				if (!isInTransaction && delayedException != null && !(delayedException is CommunicationObjectFaultedException))
				{
					int count = batchedObjectsAsyncResults.Count;
					bool isMultiCommandBatch = count > 1;
					Interlocked.Add(ref batchedResultsCount, count);
					foreach (BatchedObjectsAsyncResult batchedObjectsAsyncResult in batchedObjectsAsyncResults)
					{
						if (ShouldRetry(delayedException, batchedObjectsAsyncResult, isMultiCommandBatch))
						{
							try
							{
								IAsyncResult asyncResult = BatchManager.BatchedBegin(TrackingContext, batchedObjectsAsyncResult.BatchedObjects, transactionId, timeout, singleOperationCompleteCallback, new Tuple<PerformFlushAsyncResult, BatchedObjectsAsyncResult>(this, batchedObjectsAsyncResult));
								if (asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
								{
									OnSingleOperationCompleted(asyncResult);
								}
							}
							catch (Exception delayedException2)
							{
								if (Fx.IsFatal(delayedException2))
								{
									throw;
								}
								CompleteSingleOperation(batchedObjectsAsyncResult, delayedException2);
							}
						}
						else
						{
							CompleteSingleOperation(batchedObjectsAsyncResult, delayedException);
						}
					}
					return true;
				}
				ExceptionInfo completionExceptionInfo = new ExceptionInfo(delayedException);
				foreach (BatchedObjectsAsyncResult batchedObjectsAsyncResult2 in batchedObjectsAsyncResults)
				{
					IOThreadScheduler.ScheduleCallbackNoFlow(delegate(object s)
					{
						((BatchedObjectsAsyncResult)s).CompleteBatch(completionExceptionInfo.CreateException());
					}, batchedObjectsAsyncResult2);
				}
				return false;
			}

			private bool ShouldRetry(Exception delayedException, BatchedObjectsAsyncResult singleOperation, bool isMultiCommandBatch)
			{
				bool flag = BatchManager.OnRetry == null;
				if (!flag)
				{
					try
					{
						flag = BatchManager.OnRetry(singleOperation.BatchedObjects, delayedException, isMultiCommandBatch);
					}
					catch (Exception ex) when (!Fx.IsFatal(ex))
					{
						Fx.Exception.HandledAsWarning(ex, this, TrackingContext, "ShouldRetry");
						flag = false;
					}
				}
				return flag;
			}

			private static ICollection<IList<BatchedObjectsAsyncResult>> GroupBy(IList<BatchedObjectsAsyncResult> batchedObjectsAsyncResults, GroupByKeySelectorDelegate<TItem> selector)
			{
				Dictionary<IComparable, IList<BatchedObjectsAsyncResult>> dictionary = new Dictionary<IComparable, IList<BatchedObjectsAsyncResult>>();
				foreach (BatchedObjectsAsyncResult batchedObjectsAsyncResult in batchedObjectsAsyncResults)
				{
					IComparable key = selector(batchedObjectsAsyncResult.BatchedObjects) ?? BatchManager<TItem>.nullKey;
					if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
					{
						value = new List<BatchedObjectsAsyncResult>();
						dictionary.Add(key, value);
					}
					value.Add(batchedObjectsAsyncResult);
				}
				return dictionary.Values;
			}
		}

		private sealed class BatchNotification : IEnlistmentNotification
		{
			private static readonly AsyncCallback onFlushCompleted = OnFlushCompleted;

			private readonly TrackingContext trackingContext;

			private readonly BatchManager<TItem> batchManager;

			private readonly string transactionIdentifier;

			private PreparingEnlistment preparingEnlistment;

			private bool prepareCalled;

			public BatchNotification(TrackingContext trackingContext, BatchManager<TItem> batchManager, string transactionIdentifier)
			{
				this.trackingContext = trackingContext;
				this.batchManager = batchManager;
				this.transactionIdentifier = transactionIdentifier;
			}

			void IEnlistmentNotification.Commit(Enlistment enlistment)
			{
				enlistment.Done();
			}

			void IEnlistmentNotification.InDoubt(Enlistment enlistment)
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteBatchManagerTransactionInDoubt(trackingContext.Activity, trackingContext.TrackingId, trackingContext.SystemTracker, transactionIdentifier, rollbackCalled: false);
				});
				if (batchManager.OnTransactionStateChanged != null)
				{
					batchManager.OnTransactionStateChanged(trackingContext, transactionIdentifier, TransactionCommitStatus.InDoubt);
				}
				enlistment.Done();
			}

			void IEnlistmentNotification.Prepare(PreparingEnlistment enlistment)
			{
				List<BatchedObjectsAsyncResult> list;
				lock (batchManager.syncTransactionLock)
				{
					list = batchManager.transactionalBatchResults[transactionIdentifier].ToList();
				}
				TimeSpan timeSpan = TimeSpan.MaxValue;
				foreach (BatchedObjectsAsyncResult item in list)
				{
					if (item.RemainingTime < timeSpan)
					{
						timeSpan = item.RemainingTime;
					}
				}
				preparingEnlistment = enlistment;
				prepareCalled = true;
				try
				{
					PerformFlushAsyncResult performFlushAsyncResult = new PerformFlushAsyncResult(trackingContext, batchManager, list, transactionIdentifier, timeSpan, onFlushCompleted, this);
					performFlushAsyncResult.StartOperation();
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					Exception e = ex;
					if (Fx.IsFatal(e))
					{
						throw;
					}
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteBatchManagerException(trackingContext.Activity, trackingContext.TrackingId, trackingContext.SystemTracker, string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "BatchManager<T>.BatchNotification.Prepare Rollback. Transaction ID: {0}", transactionIdentifier), e.ToStringSlim());
					});
					TransactionResultManager.Instance.SetTransactionResult(transactionIdentifier, e, trackingContext);
					try
					{
						preparingEnlistment.ForceRollback(e);
					}
					catch (InvalidOperationException ex2)
					{
						InvalidOperationException ex3 = ex2;
						InvalidOperationException ioe = ex3;
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
						{
							MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteBatchManagerException(trackingContext.Activity, trackingContext.TrackingId, trackingContext.SystemTracker, "BatchManager<T>.BatchNotification.Prepare.ForceRollback", ioe.ToStringSlim());
						});
					}
				}
			}

			private static void OnFlushCompleted(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				BatchNotification thisPtr = (BatchNotification)result.AsyncState;
				bool flag = false;
				TransactionStateChangedDelegate onTransactionStateChanged = thisPtr.batchManager.OnTransactionStateChanged;
				try
				{
					PerformFlushAsyncResult.End(result);
					flag = true;
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					Exception e = ex;
					if (Fx.IsFatal(e))
					{
						throw;
					}
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteBatchManagerException(thisPtr.trackingContext.Activity, thisPtr.trackingContext.TrackingId, thisPtr.trackingContext.SystemTracker, "BatchManager<T>.BatchNotification.OnFlushCompleted", e.ToStringSlim());
					});
					TransactionResultManager.Instance.SetTransactionResult(thisPtr.transactionIdentifier, e, thisPtr.trackingContext);
					if (onTransactionStateChanged != null)
					{
						if (e is QuotaExceededException || e is MessagingEntityAlreadyExistsException || e is MessagingEntityNotFoundException)
						{
							onTransactionStateChanged(thisPtr.trackingContext, thisPtr.transactionIdentifier, TransactionCommitStatus.Aborted);
						}
						else
						{
							onTransactionStateChanged(thisPtr.trackingContext, thisPtr.transactionIdentifier, TransactionCommitStatus.InDoubt);
						}
					}
					try
					{
						thisPtr.preparingEnlistment.ForceRollback(e);
					}
					catch (InvalidOperationException ex2)
					{
						InvalidOperationException ex3 = ex2;
						InvalidOperationException ioe = ex3;
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
						{
							MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteBatchManagerException(thisPtr.trackingContext.Activity, thisPtr.trackingContext.TrackingId, thisPtr.trackingContext.SystemTracker, "BatchManager<T>.BatchNotification.OnFlushCompleted.ForceRollback", ioe.ToStringSlim());
						});
					}
				}
				lock (thisPtr.batchManager.syncTransactionLock)
				{
					thisPtr.batchManager.transactionalBatchResults.Remove(thisPtr.transactionIdentifier);
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					onTransactionStateChanged?.Invoke(thisPtr.trackingContext, thisPtr.transactionIdentifier, TransactionCommitStatus.Committed);
					thisPtr.preparingEnlistment.Prepared();
				}
			}

			void IEnlistmentNotification.Rollback(Enlistment enlistment)
			{
				lock (batchManager.syncTransactionLock)
				{
					batchManager.transactionalBatchResults.Remove(transactionIdentifier);
				}
				if (batchManager.OnTransactionStateChanged != null && prepareCalled)
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteBatchManagerTransactionInDoubt(trackingContext.Activity, trackingContext.TrackingId, trackingContext.SystemTracker, transactionIdentifier, rollbackCalled: true);
					});
					batchManager.OnTransactionStateChanged(trackingContext, transactionIdentifier, TransactionCommitStatus.InDoubt);
				}
				enlistment.Done();
			}
		}

		private static string nullKey = Guid.NewGuid().ToString();

		private static Action<object> flushTimerCallback = OnFlushTimerFired;

		private static AsyncCallback flushCompleteCallback = OnFlushComplete;

		private static AsyncCallback transactionObjectCompleteCallback = OnTransactionObjectCompleteCallback;

		private readonly TransactionCompletedEventHandler transactionCompletedEventHandler;

		private GroupByKeySelectorDelegate<TItem> groupByKeySelector;

		private Queue<BatchedObjectsAsyncResult> batchedResults;

		private Dictionary<string, Queue<BatchedObjectsAsyncResult>> transactionalBatchResults;

		private TimeSpan flushInterval;

		private long flushThreshold;

		private IOThreadTimer flushTimer;

		private bool isTimerSet;

		private long maximumBatchSize;

		private int pendingBatchSize;

		private object syncLock;

		private object syncTransactionLock;

		private int batchOverheadSize;

		public TimeSpan FlushInterval
		{
			get
			{
				return flushInterval;
			}
			set
			{
				ThrowIfDisposedOrImmutable();
				flushInterval = value;
			}
		}

		protected override TimeSpan DefaultOpenTimeout => Constants.DefaultOperationTimeout;

		protected override TimeSpan DefaultCloseTimeout => Constants.DefaultOperationTimeout;

		private BeginBatchedDelegate<TItem> BatchedBegin { get; set; }

		private EndBatchedDelegate BatchedEnd { get; set; }

		private StartBatchOperationDelegate StartBatchOperation { get; set; }

		public GroupByKeySelectorDelegate<TItem> GroupByKeySelector
		{
			get
			{
				return groupByKeySelector;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != groupByKeySelector)
				{
					if (value != null)
					{
						StartBatchOperation = PerformFlushAsyncResult.StartGroupByBatchOperation;
					}
					else
					{
						StartBatchOperation = PerformFlushAsyncResult.StartBatchOperation;
					}
				}
				groupByKeySelector = value;
			}
		}

		public CalculateBatchSizeDelegate<TItem> CalculateBatchSize { get; set; }

		private OnRetryDelegate<TItem> OnRetry { get; set; }

		private TransactionStateChangedDelegate OnTransactionStateChanged { get; set; }

		public BatchManager(BeginBatchedDelegate<TItem> batchedBeginOperation, EndBatchedDelegate batchedEndOperation, CalculateBatchSizeDelegate<TItem> calculateBatchSize, OnRetryDelegate<TItem> onRetryOperation, TransactionStateChangedDelegate transactionStateChanged, TransactionCompletedEventHandler transactionCompletedEventHandler, long flushThreshold, long maximumBatchSize, int batchOverheadSize)
		{
			StartBatchOperation = PerformFlushAsyncResult.StartBatchOperation;
			BatchedBegin = batchedBeginOperation;
			BatchedEnd = batchedEndOperation;
			CalculateBatchSize = calculateBatchSize;
			OnRetry = onRetryOperation;
			OnTransactionStateChanged = transactionStateChanged;
			this.transactionCompletedEventHandler = transactionCompletedEventHandler;
			batchedResults = new Queue<BatchedObjectsAsyncResult>();
			transactionalBatchResults = new Dictionary<string, Queue<BatchedObjectsAsyncResult>>();
			flushTimer = new IOThreadTimer(flushTimerCallback, this, isTypicallyCanceledShortlyAfterBeingSet: false);
			this.flushThreshold = flushThreshold;
			this.maximumBatchSize = maximumBatchSize;
			pendingBatchSize = batchOverheadSize;
			this.batchOverheadSize = batchOverheadSize;
			syncLock = new object();
			syncTransactionLock = new object();
		}

		public BatchManager(BeginBatchedDelegate<TItem> batchedBeginOperation, EndBatchedDelegate batchedEndOperation, CalculateBatchSizeDelegate<TItem> calculateBatchSize, OnRetryDelegate<TItem> onRetryOperation, TransactionStateChangedDelegate transactionStateChanged, TransactionCompletedEventHandler transactionCompletedEventHandler, long flushThreshold, long maximumBatchSize)
			: this(batchedBeginOperation, batchedEndOperation, calculateBatchSize, onRetryOperation, transactionStateChanged, transactionCompletedEventHandler, flushThreshold, maximumBatchSize, 0)
		{
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginBatchedOperation(TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<TItem> batchItems, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposedOrNotOpen();
			if (!batchItems.Any())
			{
				return new CompletedAsyncResult(callback, state);
			}
			Transaction current = Transaction.Current;
			int num = CalculateBatchSize(batchItems);
			if (current != null)
			{
				string localIdentifier = current.TransactionInformation.LocalIdentifier;
				BatchedObjectsAsyncResult item = new BatchedObjectsAsyncResult(trackingContext, batchItems, num, timeout, transactionObjectCompleteCallback, state);
				lock (syncTransactionLock)
				{
					if (!transactionalBatchResults.ContainsKey(localIdentifier))
					{
						if (transactionCompletedEventHandler != null)
						{
							current.TransactionCompleted += transactionCompletedEventHandler;
						}
						current.EnlistVolatile(new BatchNotification(trackingContext, this, localIdentifier), EnlistmentOptions.EnlistDuringPrepareRequired);
						Queue<BatchedObjectsAsyncResult> queue = new Queue<BatchedObjectsAsyncResult>();
						queue.Enqueue(item);
						transactionalBatchResults.Add(localIdentifier, queue);
					}
					else
					{
						transactionalBatchResults[localIdentifier].Enqueue(item);
					}
				}
				return new CompletedAsyncResult(callback, state);
			}
			if (batchOverheadSize + num >= maximumBatchSize)
			{
				return BatchedBegin(trackingContext, batchItems, null, timeout, callback, state);
			}
			BatchedObjectsAsyncResult batchedObjectsAsyncResult = new BatchedObjectsAsyncResult(trackingContext, batchItems, num, timeout, callback, state);
			PerformFlushAsyncResult performFlushAsyncResult = null;
			lock (syncLock)
			{
				batchedResults.Enqueue(batchedObjectsAsyncResult);
				pendingBatchSize += num;
				if (pendingBatchSize >= flushThreshold)
				{
					if (!isTimerSet || flushTimer.Cancel())
					{
						performFlushAsyncResult = BeginFlush(trackingContext, TimeSpan.MaxValue, flushCompleteCallback, this);
					}
				}
				else if (!isTimerSet)
				{
					SetFlushTimer(fireImmediately: false);
				}
			}
			if (performFlushAsyncResult != null)
			{
				performFlushAsyncResult.StartOperation();
				if (performFlushAsyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
				{
					EndFlush(performFlushAsyncResult);
				}
			}
			return batchedObjectsAsyncResult;
		}

		public void EndBatchedOperation(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (result is BatchedObjectsAsyncResult)
			{
				BatchedObjectsAsyncResult.End(result);
			}
			else if (result is CompletedAsyncResult)
			{
				CompletedAsyncResult.End(result);
			}
			else
			{
				BatchedEnd(result, Transaction.Current == null);
			}
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginOpen(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new CompletedAsyncResult(callback, state);
		}

		protected override void OnEndOpen(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			CompletedAsyncResult.End(result);
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			TrackingContext trackingContext = TrackingContext.Create(Guid.NewGuid());
			PerformFlushAsyncResult performFlushAsyncResult = null;
			lock (syncLock)
			{
				if (flushTimer.Cancel())
				{
					performFlushAsyncResult = BeginFlush(trackingContext, timeout, callback, state);
				}
			}
			if (performFlushAsyncResult != null)
			{
				performFlushAsyncResult.StartOperation();
				return performFlushAsyncResult;
			}
			return new CompletedAsyncResult(callback, state);
		}

		protected override void OnEndClose(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (result is CompletedAsyncResult)
			{
				CompletedAsyncResult.End(result);
			}
			else if (!result.CompletedSynchronously)
			{
				EndFlush(result);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnAbort()
		{
			if (flushTimer != null)
			{
				flushTimer.Cancel();
			}
			lock (syncLock)
			{
				foreach (BatchedObjectsAsyncResult batchedResult in batchedResults)
				{
					BatchedObjectsAsyncResult currentAsyncResult = batchedResult;
					ActionItem.Schedule(delegate
					{
						currentAsyncResult.CompleteBatch(new CommunicationObjectAbortedException(SRClient.BatchManagerAborted));
					}, null);
				}
				batchedResults.Clear();
				pendingBatchSize = 0;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnOpen(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			OnEndOpen(OnBeginOpen(timeout, null, null));
		}

		protected override void OnClose(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			OnEndClose(OnBeginClose(timeout, null, null));
		}

		private static void OnTransactionObjectCompleteCallback(object state)
		{
			try
			{
				BatchedObjectsAsyncResult.End((IAsyncResult)state);
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
			}
		}

		private static void OnFlushComplete(object state)
		{
			IAsyncResult asyncResult = (IAsyncResult)state;
			if (!asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
			{
				BatchManager<TItem> batchManager = (BatchManager<TItem>)asyncResult.AsyncState;
				batchManager.EndFlush(asyncResult);
			}
		}

		private static void OnFlushTimerFired(object state)
		{
			TrackingContext trackingContext = TrackingContext.Create(Guid.NewGuid());
			BatchManager<TItem> batchManager = (BatchManager<TItem>)state;
			if (batchManager.State != CommunicationState.Opened)
			{
				return;
			}
			PerformFlushAsyncResult performFlushAsyncResult;
			lock (batchManager.syncLock)
			{
				performFlushAsyncResult = batchManager.BeginFlush(trackingContext, TimeSpan.MaxValue, flushCompleteCallback, batchManager);
			}
			if (performFlushAsyncResult != null)
			{
				performFlushAsyncResult.StartOperation();
				if (performFlushAsyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
				{
					batchManager.EndFlush(performFlushAsyncResult);
				}
			}
		}

		private PerformFlushAsyncResult BeginFlush(TrackingContext trackingContext, TimeSpan closeTimeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			isTimerSet = false;
			if (pendingBatchSize == batchOverheadSize)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<BatchedObjectsAsyncResult> list = new List<BatchedObjectsAsyncResult>();
			TimeSpan timeSpan = closeTimeout;
			int num = 0;
			while (batchedResults.Count > 0)
			{
				BatchedObjectsAsyncResult asyncResult = batchedResults.Peek();
				int batchSize = asyncResult.BatchSize;
				if (asyncResult.RemainingTime <= TimeSpan.Zero)
				{
					ActionItem.Schedule(delegate
					{
						asyncResult.CompleteBatch(new TimeoutException());
					}, null);
					pendingBatchSize -= batchSize;
					batchedResults.Dequeue();
					continue;
				}
				if (num + batchSize > maximumBatchSize)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (asyncResult.RemainingTime < timeSpan)
				{
					timeSpan = asyncResult.RemainingTime;
				}
				list.Add(asyncResult);
				num += batchSize;
				batchedResults.Dequeue();
			}
			pendingBatchSize -= num;
			if (pendingBatchSize > batchOverheadSize)
			{
				SetFlushTimer(pendingBatchSize >= flushThreshold);
			}
			if (list.Count > 0)
			{
				return new PerformFlushAsyncResult(trackingContext, this, list, null, timeSpan, callback, state);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void EndFlush(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			try
			{
				PerformFlushAsyncResult.End(result);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				Exception ex2 = ex;
				Exception e = ex2;
				if (Fx.IsFatal(e))
				{
					throw;
				}
				PerformFlushAsyncResult thisPtr = (PerformFlushAsyncResult)result;
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteBatchManagerException(thisPtr.TrackingContext.Activity, thisPtr.TrackingContext.TrackingId, thisPtr.TrackingContext.SystemTracker, "BatchManager.EndFlush", e.ToStringSlim());
				});
			}
		}

		private void SetFlushTimer(bool fireImmediately)
		{
			if (FlushInterval != TimeSpan.MaxValue)
			{
				isTimerSet = true;
				flushTimer.Set(fireImmediately ? TimeSpan.Zero : FlushInterval);
			}
		}
	}
	internal sealed class BatchManagerAsyncResult<T> : Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult
	{
		private static readonly AsyncCompletion onBatchedCompletion = OnBatchedCallback;

		private BatchManager<T> BatchManager { get; set; }

		public BatchManagerAsyncResult(TrackingContext trackingContext, BatchManager<T> batchManager, IEnumerable<T> msgs, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			: base(callback, state)
		{
			if (trackingContext == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("trackingContext");
			}
			BatchManager = batchManager;
			IAsyncResult result = BatchManager.BeginBatchedOperation(trackingContext, msgs, timeout, PrepareAsyncCompletion(onBatchedCompletion), this);
			if (SyncContinue(result))
			{
				Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: true);
			}
		}

		public static void End(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult.End<BatchManagerAsyncResult<T>>(result);
		}

		private static bool OnBatchedCallback(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			BatchManagerAsyncResult<T> batchManagerAsyncResult = (BatchManagerAsyncResult<T>)result.AsyncState;
			batchManagerAsyncResult.BatchManager.EndBatchedOperation(result);
			return true;
		}
	}

	internal sealed class DataContractBinarySerializer : XmlObjectSerializer
	{
		private readonly DataContractSerializer dataContractSerializer;

		public DataContractBinarySerializer(Type type)
		{
			dataContractSerializer = new DataContractSerializer(type);
		}

		public override object ReadObject(Stream stream)
		{
			if (stream == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNull("stream");
			}
			return ReadObject(XmlDictionaryReader.CreateBinaryReader(stream, XmlDictionaryReaderQuotas.Max));
		}

		public override void WriteObject(Stream stream, object graph)
		{
			if (stream == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNull("stream");
			}
			XmlDictionaryWriter xmlDictionaryWriter = XmlDictionaryWriter.CreateBinaryWriter(stream, null, null, ownsStream: false);
			WriteObject(xmlDictionaryWriter, graph);
			xmlDictionaryWriter.Flush();
		}

		public override void WriteObject(XmlDictionaryWriter writer, object graph)
		{
			if (writer == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNull("writer");
			}
			dataContractSerializer.WriteObject(writer, graph);
		}

		public override bool IsStartObject(XmlDictionaryReader reader)
		{
			return dataContractSerializer.IsStartObject(reader);
		}

		public override object ReadObject(XmlDictionaryReader reader, bool verifyObjectName)
		{
			return dataContractSerializer.ReadObject(reader, verifyObjectName);
		}

		public override void WriteEndObject(XmlDictionaryWriter writer)
		{
			dataContractSerializer.WriteEndObject(writer);
		}

		public override void WriteObjectContent(XmlDictionaryWriter writer, object graph)
		{
			dataContractSerializer.WriteObjectContent(writer, graph);
		}

		public override void WriteStartObject(XmlDictionaryWriter writer, object graph)
		{
			dataContractSerializer.WriteStartObject(writer, graph);
		}
	}

	internal sealed class CloseCollectionIteratedAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<CloseCollectionIteratedAsyncResult>
	{
		private ICommunicationObject currentCommunicationObject;

		private IEnumerable<ICommunicationObject> CommunicationObjects { get; set; }

		public CloseCollectionIteratedAsyncResult(IEnumerable<ICommunicationObject> communicationObjects, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			: base(timeout, callback, state)
		{
			CommunicationObjects = communicationObjects;
			Start();
		}

		protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
		{
			foreach (ICommunicationObject communicationObject in CommunicationObjects)
			{
				if (communicationObject != null && communicationObject.State != CommunicationState.Closed)
				{
					currentCommunicationObject = communicationObject;
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((CloseCollectionIteratedAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.currentCommunicationObject.BeginClose(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(CloseCollectionIteratedAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.currentCommunicationObject.EndClose(r);
					}, (Call)delegate(CloseCollectionIteratedAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t)
					{
						thisPtr.currentCommunicationObject.Close(t);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
					if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
					{
						currentCommunicationObject.Abort();
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	[DataContract(Name = "CorrelationFilter", Namespace = "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2010/10/servicebus/connect")]
	[KnownType(typeof(DateTimeOffset))]
	public sealed class CorrelationFilter : Filter
	{
		[DataMember(Name = "Properties", Order = 131080, EmitDefaultValue = false, IsRequired = false)]
		private PropertyDictionary properties;

		[DataMember(Name = "CorrelationId", Order = 65537, EmitDefaultValue = false, IsRequired = false)]
		public string CorrelationId { get; set; }

		[DataMember(Name = "MessageId", Order = 131073, EmitDefaultValue = false, IsRequired = false)]
		public string MessageId { get; set; }

		[DataMember(Name = "To", Order = 131074, EmitDefaultValue = false, IsRequired = false)]
		public string To { get; set; }

		[DataMember(Name = "ReplyTo", Order = 131075, EmitDefaultValue = false, IsRequired = false)]
		public string ReplyTo { get; set; }

		[DataMember(Name = "Label", Order = 131076, EmitDefaultValue = false, IsRequired = false)]
		public string Label { get; set; }

		[DataMember(Name = "SessionId", Order = 131077, EmitDefaultValue = false, IsRequired = false)]
		public string SessionId { get; set; }

		[DataMember(Name = "ReplyToSessionId", Order = 131078, EmitDefaultValue = false, IsRequired = false)]
		public string ReplyToSessionId { get; set; }

		[DataMember(Name = "ContentType", Order = 131079, EmitDefaultValue = false, IsRequired = false)]
		public string ContentType { get; set; }

		public IDictionary<string, object> Properties
		{
			get
			{
				if (properties == null)
				{
					properties = new PropertyDictionary();
				}
				return properties;
			}
		}

		public override bool RequiresPreprocessing => false;

		internal override FilterType FilterType => FilterType.CorrelationFilter;

		public CorrelationFilter()
		{
		}

		public CorrelationFilter(string correlationId)
			: this()
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(correlationId))
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNullOrWhiteSpace("correlationId");
			}
			CorrelationId = correlationId;
		}

		public override void Validate()
		{
			if (!EnumerateQualifiedProperties().Any())
			{
				throw new FilterException(SRClient.EmptyPropertyInCorrelationFilter);
			}
		}

		public override Filter Preprocess()
		{
			return this;
		}

		public override bool Match(BrokeredMessage message)
		{
			if (message == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("message");
			}
			if (CorrelationId != null && !CorrelationId.Equals(message.CorrelationId))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (MessageId != null && !MessageId.Equals(message.MessageId))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (To != null && !To.Equals(message.To))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (ReplyTo != null && !ReplyTo.Equals(message.ReplyTo))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Label != null && !Label.Equals(message.Label))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (SessionId != null && !SessionId.Equals(message.SessionId))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (ReplyToSessionId != null && !ReplyToSessionId.Equals(message.ReplyToSessionId))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (ContentType != null && !ContentType.Equals(message.ContentType))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Properties.Count > 0)
			{
				foreach (KeyValuePair<string, object> property in Properties)
				{
					if (!message.Properties.TryGetValue(property.Key, out var value))
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (!property.Value.Equals(value))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.Append("CorrelationFilter: ");
			bool firstExpression = true;
			AppendPropertyExpression(ref firstExpression, stringBuilder, "sys.CorrelationId", CorrelationId);
			AppendPropertyExpression(ref firstExpression, stringBuilder, "sys.MessageId", MessageId);
			AppendPropertyExpression(ref firstExpression, stringBuilder, "sys.To", To);
			AppendPropertyExpression(ref firstExpression, stringBuilder, "sys.ReplyTo", ReplyTo);
			AppendPropertyExpression(ref firstExpression, stringBuilder, "sys.Label", Label);
			AppendPropertyExpression(ref firstExpression, stringBuilder, "sys.SessionId", SessionId);
			AppendPropertyExpression(ref firstExpression, stringBuilder, "sys.ReplyToSessionId", ReplyToSessionId);
			AppendPropertyExpression(ref firstExpression, stringBuilder, "sys.ContentType", ContentType);
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, object> property in Properties)
			{
				string key = property.Key;
				object value = property.Value;
				AppendPropertyExpression(ref firstExpression, stringBuilder, key, value);
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		private void AppendPropertyExpression(ref bool firstExpression, StringBuilder builder, string propertyName, object value)
		{
			if (value != null)
			{
				if (firstExpression)
				{
					firstExpression = false;
				}
				else
				{
					builder.Append(" And ");
				}
				builder.AppendFormat("{0} = '{1}'", propertyName, value);
			}
		}

		internal IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<QualifiedPropertyName, object>> EnumerateQualifiedProperties()
		{
			if (CorrelationId != null)
			{
				yield return new KeyValuePair<QualifiedPropertyName, object>(new QualifiedPropertyName(PropertyScope.System, "CorrelationId"), CorrelationId);
			}
			if (MessageId != null)
			{
				yield return new KeyValuePair<QualifiedPropertyName, object>(new QualifiedPropertyName(PropertyScope.System, "MessageId"), MessageId);
			}
			if (To != null)
			{
				yield return new KeyValuePair<QualifiedPropertyName, object>(new QualifiedPropertyName(PropertyScope.System, "To"), To);
			}
			if (ReplyTo != null)
			{
				yield return new KeyValuePair<QualifiedPropertyName, object>(new QualifiedPropertyName(PropertyScope.System, "ReplyTo"), ReplyTo);
			}
			if (Label != null)
			{
				yield return new KeyValuePair<QualifiedPropertyName, object>(new QualifiedPropertyName(PropertyScope.System, "Label"), Label);
			}
			if (SessionId != null)
			{
				yield return new KeyValuePair<QualifiedPropertyName, object>(new QualifiedPropertyName(PropertyScope.System, "SessionId"), SessionId);
			}
			if (ReplyToSessionId != null)
			{
				yield return new KeyValuePair<QualifiedPropertyName, object>(new QualifiedPropertyName(PropertyScope.System, "ReplyToSessionId"), ReplyToSessionId);
			}
			if (ContentType != null)
			{
				yield return new KeyValuePair<QualifiedPropertyName, object>(new QualifiedPropertyName(PropertyScope.System, "ContentType"), ContentType);
			}
			if (properties == null || properties.Count <= 0)
			{
				yield break;
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, object> property in properties)
			{
				yield return new KeyValuePair<QualifiedPropertyName, object>(new QualifiedPropertyName(PropertyScope.User, property.Key), property.Value);
			}
		}

		internal override void UpdateForVersion(ApiVersion version, Filter existingFilter = null)
		{
			CorrelationFilter correlationFilter = existingFilter as CorrelationFilter;
			base.UpdateForVersion(version, existingFilter);
			if (version < ApiVersion.Two)
			{
				MessageId = correlationFilter?.MessageId;
				To = correlationFilter?.To;
				ReplyTo = correlationFilter?.ReplyTo;
				Label = correlationFilter?.Label;
				SessionId = correlationFilter?.SessionId;
				ReplyToSessionId = correlationFilter?.ReplyToSessionId;
				ContentType = correlationFilter?.ContentType;
				properties = correlationFilter?.properties;
			}
		}

		internal override bool IsValidForVersion(ApiVersion version)
		{
			if (!base.IsValidForVersion(version))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (version < ApiVersion.Two && (CorrelationId == null || MessageId != null || To != null || ReplyTo != null || Label != null || SessionId != null || ReplyToSessionId != null || ContentType != null || properties != null))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

	[DataContract(Name = "SqlRuleAction", Namespace = "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2010/10/servicebus/connect")]
	public sealed class SqlRuleAction : RuleAction
	{
		private sealed class CompiledItem
		{
			public Action<BrokeredMessage, IDictionary<string, object>> Delegate { get; private set; }

			public IEnumerable<string> RequiredParameters { get; private set; }

			public CompiledItem(Action<BrokeredMessage, IDictionary<string, object>> compiledDelegate, IEnumerable<string> requiredParameters)
			{
				Delegate = compiledDelegate;
				RequiredParameters = requiredParameters;
			}
		}

		private static readonly MemoryCache compiledCache = new MemoryCache(typeof(SqlRuleAction).Name, new NameValueCollection { { "CacheMemoryLimitMegabytes", "48" } });

		private static readonly CacheItemPolicy defaultCachePolicy = new CacheItemPolicy
		{
			SlidingExpiration = TimeSpan.FromHours(1.0)
		};

		[DataMember(Name = "Parameters", Order = 131073, EmitDefaultValue = false, IsRequired = false)]
		private PropertyDictionary parameters;

		[DataMember(Name = "SqlExpression", Order = 65537, EmitDefaultValue = false, IsRequired = true)]
		public string SqlExpression { get; private set; }

		[DataMember(Name = "CompatibilityLevel", Order = 65538, EmitDefaultValue = false, IsRequired = false)]
		public int CompatibilityLevel { get; private set; }

		public IDictionary<string, object> Parameters => parameters ?? (parameters = new PropertyDictionary());

		public override bool RequiresPreprocessing => true;

		public SqlRuleAction(string sqlExpression)
			: this(sqlExpression, 20)
		{
		}

		public SqlRuleAction(string sqlExpression, int compatibilityLevel)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(sqlExpression))
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNullOrEmpty("sqlExpression");
			}
			if (sqlExpression.Length > 1024)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.Argument("sqlExpression", SRClient.SqlFilterActionStatmentTooLong(sqlExpression.Length, 1024));
			}
			SqlExpression = sqlExpression;
			CompatibilityLevel = compatibilityLevel;
		}

		public override RuleAction Preprocess()
		{
			EnsureCompatibilityLevel();
			try
			{
				CompiledItem compiledItem = (CompiledItem)compiledCache.Get(SqlExpression);
				if (compiledItem == null)
				{
					SqlActionParserOutput sqlActionParserOutput = SqlActionParser.Parse(SqlExpression);
					Action<BrokeredMessage, IDictionary<string, object>> compiledDelegate = sqlActionParserOutput.ExpressionTree.Compile();
					compiledItem = new CompiledItem(compiledDelegate, sqlActionParserOutput.RequiredParameters);
					CompiledItem compiledItem2 = (CompiledItem)compiledCache.AddOrGetExisting(SqlExpression, compiledItem, defaultCachePolicy);

		private sealed class ExpressionValidator : ExpressionVisitor
		{
			private int nodeCount;

			private int currentDepth;

			public void Validate(Expression expression)
			{
				nodeCount = 0;
				currentDepth = 0;
				try
				{
					Visit(expression);
				}
				catch (FilterException ex)
				{
					throw ex;
				}
			}

			public override Expression Visit(Expression node)
			{
				nodeCount++;
				currentDepth++;
				if (currentDepth > 32)
				{
					throw new FilterException(SRClient.FilterExpressionTooComplex);
				}
				if (nodeCount > 1024)
				{
					throw new FilterException(SRClient.FilterExpressionTooComplex);
				}
				try
				{
					return base.Visit(node);
				}
				finally
				{
					currentDepth--;
				}
			}
		}

					CompiledItem compiledItem2 = (CompiledItem)compiledDelegateCache.AddOrGetExisting(SqlExpression, compiledItem, defaultCachePolicy);
					if (compiledItem2 != null)

				return new DelegateFilter(compiledItem.Delegate, Parameters);

			{

			}
			catch (Exception ex2)
			{

	internal class BufferedOutputStream : Stream
	{
		private InternalBufferManager bufferManager;

		private byte[][] chunks;

		private int chunkCount;

		private byte[] currentChunk;

		private int currentChunkSize;

		private int maxSize;

		private int maxSizeQuota;

		private int totalSize;

		private bool callerReturnsBuffer;

		private bool bufferReturned;

		private bool initialized;

		public override bool CanRead => false;

		public override bool CanSeek => false;

		public override bool CanWrite => true;

		public override long Length => totalSize;

		public override long Position
		{
			get
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new NotSupportedException(SRClient.SeekNotSupported));
			}
			set
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new NotSupportedException(SRClient.SeekNotSupported));
			}
		}

		public BufferedOutputStream(int initialSize, int maxSize, InternalBufferManager bufferManager)
			: this()
		{
			Reinitialize(initialSize, maxSize, bufferManager);
		}

		private BufferedOutputStream()
		{
			chunks = new byte[4][];
		}

		public void Reinitialize(int initialSize, int maxSizeQuota, InternalBufferManager bufferManager)
		{
			Reinitialize(initialSize, maxSizeQuota, maxSizeQuota, bufferManager);
		}

		public void Reinitialize(int initialSize, int maxSizeQuota, int effectiveMaxSize, InternalBufferManager bufferManager)
		{
			this.maxSizeQuota = maxSizeQuota;
			maxSize = effectiveMaxSize;
			this.bufferManager = bufferManager;
			currentChunk = bufferManager.TakeBuffer(initialSize);
			currentChunkSize = 0;
			totalSize = 0;
			chunkCount = 1;
			chunks[0] = currentChunk;
			initialized = true;
		}

		public override IAsyncResult BeginRead(byte[] buffer, int offset, int size, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new NotSupportedException(SRClient.ReadNotSupported));
		}

		public override int EndRead(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new NotSupportedException(SRClient.ReadNotSupported));
		}

		public override IAsyncResult BeginWrite(byte[] buffer, int offset, int size, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			Write(buffer, offset, size);
			return new CompletedAsyncResult(callback, state);
		}

		public override void EndWrite(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			CompletedAsyncResult.End(result);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			if (!callerReturnsBuffer)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < chunkCount; i++)
				{
					bufferManager.ReturnBuffer(chunks[i]);
					chunks[i] = null;
				}
			}
			callerReturnsBuffer = false;
			initialized = false;
			bufferReturned = false;
			chunkCount = 0;
			currentChunk = null;
		}

		public override void Flush()
		{
		}

		public override int Read(byte[] buffer, int offset, int size)
		{
			throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new NotSupportedException(SRClient.ReadNotSupported));
		}

		public override int ReadByte()
		{
			throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new NotSupportedException(SRClient.ReadNotSupported));
		}

		public override long Seek(long offset, SeekOrigin origin)
		{
			throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new NotSupportedException(SRClient.SeekNotSupported));
		}

		public override void SetLength(long value)
		{
			throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new NotSupportedException(SRClient.SeekNotSupported));
		}

		public MemoryStream ToMemoryStream()
		{
			int bufferSize;
			byte[] buffer = ToArray(out bufferSize);
			return new MemoryStream(buffer, 0, bufferSize);
		}

		public byte[] ToArray(out int bufferSize)
		{
			byte[] array;
			if (chunkCount == 1)
			{
				array = currentChunk;
				bufferSize = currentChunkSize;
				callerReturnsBuffer = true;
			}
			else
			{
				array = bufferManager.TakeBuffer(totalSize);
				int num = 0;
				int num2 = chunkCount - 1;
				for (int i = 0; i < num2; i++)
				{
					byte[] array2 = chunks[i];
					Buffer.BlockCopy(array2, 0, array, num, array2.Length);
					num += array2.Length;
				}
				Buffer.BlockCopy(currentChunk, 0, array, num, currentChunkSize);
				bufferSize = totalSize;
			}
			bufferReturned = true;
			return array;
		}

		public void Skip(int size)
		{
			WriteCore(null, 0, size);
		}

		public override void Write(byte[] buffer, int offset, int size)
		{
			WriteCore(buffer, offset, size);
		}

		public override void WriteByte(byte value)
		{
			if (totalSize == maxSize)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(CreateQuotaExceededException(maxSize));
			}
			if (currentChunkSize == currentChunk.Length)
			{
				AllocNextChunk(1);
			}
			currentChunk[currentChunkSize++] = value;
		}

		protected virtual Exception CreateQuotaExceededException(int maxSizeQuota)
		{
			return new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.BufferedOutputStreamQuotaExceeded(maxSizeQuota));
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			Clear();
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		private void AllocNextChunk(int minimumChunkSize)
		{
			int num = ((currentChunk.Length <= 1073741823) ? (currentChunk.Length * 2) : int.MaxValue);
			if (minimumChunkSize > num)
			{
				num = minimumChunkSize;
			}
			byte[] array = bufferManager.TakeBuffer(num);
			if (chunkCount == chunks.Length)
			{
				byte[][] destinationArray = new byte[chunks.Length * 2][];
				Array.Copy(chunks, destinationArray, chunks.Length);
				chunks = destinationArray;
			}
			chunks[chunkCount++] = array;
			currentChunk = array;
			currentChunkSize = 0;
		}

		private void WriteCore(byte[] buffer, int offset, int size)
		{
			if (size < 0)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentOutOfRange("size", size, SRClient.ValueMustBeNonNegative);
			}
			if (int.MaxValue - size < totalSize)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(CreateQuotaExceededException(maxSizeQuota));
			}
			int num = totalSize + size;
			if (num > maxSize)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(CreateQuotaExceededException(maxSizeQuota));
			}
			int num2 = currentChunk.Length - currentChunkSize;
			if (size > num2)
			{
				if (num2 > 0)
				{
					if (buffer != null)
					{
						Buffer.BlockCopy(buffer, offset, currentChunk, currentChunkSize, num2);
					}
					currentChunkSize = currentChunk.Length;
					offset += num2;
					size -= num2;
				}
				AllocNextChunk(size);
			}
			if (buffer != null)
			{
				Buffer.BlockCopy(buffer, offset, currentChunk, currentChunkSize, size);
			}
			totalSize = num;
			currentChunkSize += size;
		}
	}
	internal class BufferedInputStream : Stream, ICloneable
	{
		private sealed class BufferManagerByteArray
		{
			private volatile int references;

			public byte[] Bytes { get; private set; }

			private InternalBufferManager BufferManager { get; set; }

			public BufferManagerByteArray(byte[] bytes, InternalBufferManager bufferManager)
			{
				Bytes = bytes;
				BufferManager = bufferManager;
				references = 1;
			}

			public void AddReference()
			{
				if (Interlocked.Increment(ref references) == 1)
				{
					throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.BufferAlreadyReclaimed));
				}
			}

			public void RemoveReference()
			{
				if (references > 0 && Interlocked.Decrement(ref references) == 0)
				{
					BufferManager.ReturnBuffer(Bytes);
					Bytes = null;
				}
			}
		}

		private BufferManagerByteArray data;

		private MemoryStream innerStream;

		private bool disposed;

		public byte[] Buffer
		{
			get
			{
				ThrowIfDisposed();
				return data.Bytes;
			}
		}

		public override bool CanRead => true;

		public override bool CanSeek => true;

		public override bool CanWrite => false;

		public override long Length
		{
			get
			{
				ThrowIfDisposed();
				return innerStream.Length;
			}
		}

		public override long Position
		{
			get
			{
				ThrowIfDisposed();
				return innerStream.Position;
			}
			set
			{
				ThrowIfDisposed();
				innerStream.Position = value;
			}
		}

		public BufferedInputStream(byte[] bytes, int bufferSize, InternalBufferManager bufferManager)
		{
			data = new BufferManagerByteArray(bytes, bufferManager);
			innerStream = new MemoryStream(bytes, 0, bufferSize);
		}

		private BufferedInputStream(BufferManagerByteArray data, int bufferSize)
		{
			this.data = data;
			this.data.AddReference();
			innerStream = new MemoryStream(data.Bytes, 0, bufferSize);
		}

		public object Clone()
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			return new BufferedInputStream(data, (int)innerStream.Length);
		}

		public override void Flush()
		{
			throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new NotSupportedException());
		}

		public override int Read(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			return innerStream.Read(buffer, offset, count);
		}

		public override IAsyncResult BeginRead(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			return new CompletedAsyncResult<int>(innerStream.Read(buffer, offset, count), callback, state);
		}

		public override int EndRead(IAsyncResult asyncResult)
		{
			return CompletedAsyncResult<int>.End(asyncResult);
		}

		public override long Seek(long offset, SeekOrigin origin)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			return innerStream.Seek(offset, origin);
		}

		public override void SetLength(long value)
		{
			throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new NotSupportedException());
		}

		public override void Write(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)
		{
			throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new NotSupportedException());
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			try
			{
				if (!disposed && disposing)
				{
					if (disposing)
					{
						innerStream.Dispose();
					}
					data.RemoveReference();
					disposed = true;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				base.Dispose(disposing);
			}
		}

		private void ThrowIfDisposed()
		{
			if (disposed)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new ObjectDisposedException("BufferedInputStream"));
			}
		}
	}
	internal sealed class CloseCollectionAsyncResult : Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult
	{
		private sealed class CallbackState
		{
			public CloseCollectionAsyncResult AsyncResult { get; private set; }

			public ICommunicationObject AsyncData { get; private set; }

			public CallbackState(CloseCollectionAsyncResult asyncResult, ICommunicationObject data)
			{
				AsyncResult = asyncResult;
				AsyncData = data;
			}
		}

		private static readonly AsyncCallback onObjectClosed = OnObjectClosed;

		private readonly IList<ICommunicationObject> communicationObjects;

		private TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper;

		private int count;

		private Exception DelayedException { get; set; }

		public CloseCollectionAsyncResult(IEnumerable<ICommunicationObject> communicationObjects, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			: base(callback, state)
		{
			timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
			this.communicationObjects = new List<ICommunicationObject>(communicationObjects);
			count = this.communicationObjects.Count;
			if (count > 0)
			{
				foreach (ICommunicationObject communicationObject in this.communicationObjects)
				{
					try
					{
						IAsyncResult asyncResult = communicationObject.BeginClose(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime(), onObjectClosed, new CallbackState(this, communicationObject));
						if (asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
						{
							CompleteClose(communicationObject, asyncResult);
						}
					}
					catch (Exception ex)
					{
						if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
						{
							throw;
						}
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteExceptionAsInformation(ex.ToString());
						Decrement(completeSyncronously: true, ex);
						communicationObject.Abort();
					}
				}
				return;
			}
			Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: true);
		}

		public static void End(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult.End<CloseCollectionAsyncResult>(result);
		}

		private static void OnObjectClosed(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (!result.CompletedSynchronously)
			{
				CallbackState callbackState = (CallbackState)result.AsyncState;
				callbackState.AsyncResult.CompleteClose(callbackState.AsyncData, result);
			}
		}

		private void CompleteClose(ICommunicationObject communicationObject, IAsyncResult result)
		{
			Exception e = null;
			try
			{
				communicationObject.EndClose(result);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
				{
					throw;
				}
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteExceptionAsInformation(ex.ToStringSlim());
				communicationObject.Abort();
				e = ex;
			}
			Decrement(result.CompletedSynchronously, e);
		}

		private void Decrement(bool completeSyncronously, Exception e)
		{
			if (e != null && DelayedException == null)
			{
				DelayedException = e;
			}
			if (Interlocked.Decrement(ref count) == 0)
			{
				Complete(completeSyncronously, DelayedException);
			}
		}
	}

	internal static class HttpWebRequestExtensions
	{
		private const string UserAgentTemplate = "SERVICEBUS/2021-05(api-origin=DotNetSdk;os={0};os-version={1})";

		public static void SetUserAgentHeader(this HttpWebRequest request)
		{
			string userAgent = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "SERVICEBUS/2021-05(api-origin=DotNetSdk;os={0};os-version={1})", Environment.OSVersion.Platform, Environment.OSVersion.Version);
			request.UserAgent = userAgent;
		}

		public static void AddAuthorizationHeader(this HttpWebRequest request, TokenProvider tokenProvider, Uri namespaceAddress, string action)
		{
			if (tokenProvider != null)
			{
				string messagingWebToken = tokenProvider.GetMessagingWebToken(namespaceAddress, request.RequestUri.AbsoluteUri, action, bypassCache: false, Constants.TokenRequestOperationTimeout);
				request.Headers[HttpRequestHeader.Authorization] = messagingWebToken;
			}
		}

		public static void AddServiceBusSupplementaryAuthorizationHeader(this HttpWebRequest request, TokenProvider tokenProvider, Uri namespaceAddress, Uri appliesToUri, string action)
		{
			request.InternalAddServiceBusSupplementaryAuthorizationHeader("ServiceBusSupplementaryAuthorization", tokenProvider, namespaceAddress, appliesToUri, action);
		}

		public static void AddServiceBusDlqSupplementaryAuthorizationHeader(this HttpWebRequest request, TokenProvider tokenProvider, Uri namespaceAddress, Uri appliesToUri, string action)
		{
			request.InternalAddServiceBusSupplementaryAuthorizationHeader("ServiceBusDlqSupplementaryAuthorization", tokenProvider, namespaceAddress, appliesToUri, action);
		}

		private static void InternalAddServiceBusSupplementaryAuthorizationHeader(this HttpWebRequest request, string authorizationHeaderName, TokenProvider tokenProvider, Uri namespaceAddress, Uri appliesToUri, string action)
		{
			if (tokenProvider != null)
			{
				string messagingWebToken = tokenProvider.GetMessagingWebToken(namespaceAddress, appliesToUri.AbsoluteUri, action, bypassCache: false, Constants.TokenRequestOperationTimeout);
				request.Headers[authorizationHeaderName] = messagingWebToken;
			}
		}

		public static void AddTrackingIdHeader(this HttpWebRequest request, TrackingContext trackingContext)
		{
			if (trackingContext != null)
			{
				request.Headers["TrackingId"] = trackingContext.TrackingId;
			}
		}

		public static void AddCorrelationHeader(this HttpWebRequest request, EventTraceActivity activity)
		{
			if (activity != null && activity != EventTraceActivity.Empty)
			{
				request.Headers[EventTraceActivity.Name] = Convert.ToBase64String(activity.ActivityId.ToByteArray());
			}
		}

		public static void AddXProcessAtHeader(this HttpWebRequest request)
		{
			request.Headers.Add("X-PROCESS-AT", "ServiceBus");
		}

		public static void AddFaultInjectionHeader(this HttpWebRequest request, FaultInjectionInfo faultInjectionInfo)
		{
			faultInjectionInfo?.AddToHeader(request);
		}

		public static Task<WebResponse> GetResponseAsyncWithoutTaskRun(this WebRequest request)
		{
			return TaskHelpers.FromAsync((AsyncCallback c, object s) => ((WebRequest)s).BeginGetResponse(c, s), (IAsyncResult a) => ((WebRequest)a.AsyncState).EndGetResponse(a), request);
		}
	}

	[DebuggerStepThrough]
	internal abstract class IteratorAsyncResult<TIteratorAsyncResult> : AsyncResult<TIteratorAsyncResult> where TIteratorAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<TIteratorAsyncResult>
	{
		protected delegate IAsyncResult BeginCall(TIteratorAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state);

		protected delegate void EndCall(TIteratorAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult ar);

		protected delegate void Call(TIteratorAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan timeout);

		private enum CurrentThreadType
		{
			Synchronous,
			StartingThread,
			Callback
		}

		[DebuggerStepThrough]
		protected struct AsyncStep
		{
			private readonly ExceptionPolicy policy;

			private readonly BeginCall beginCall;

			private readonly EndCall endCall;

			private readonly Call call;

			private readonly Transaction transaction;

			public static readonly AsyncStep Empty;

			public BeginCall BeginCall => beginCall;

			public EndCall EndCall => endCall;

			public Call Call => call;

			public Transaction Transaction => transaction;

			public bool HasSynchronous => call != null;

			public ExceptionPolicy Policy => policy;

			public AsyncStep(Transaction transaction, BeginCall beginCall, EndCall endCall, Call call, ExceptionPolicy policy)
			{
				this.transaction = transaction;
				this.policy = policy;
				this.beginCall = beginCall;
				this.endCall = endCall;
				this.call = call;
			}
		}

		protected enum ExceptionPolicy
		{
			Transfer,
			Continue
		}

		private sealed class SleepAsyncResult : AsyncResult<SleepAsyncResult>
		{
			private static readonly Action<object> onTimer = OnTimer;

			private static readonly Action<object> StaticOnCancellation = OnCancellation;

			private readonly IOThreadTimer timer;

			private CancellationTokenRegistration cancellationTokenRegistration;

			public SleepAsyncResult(TimeSpan amount, CancellationToken cancellationToken, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(callback, state)
			{
				timer = new IOThreadTimer(onTimer, this, isTypicallyCanceledShortlyAfterBeingSet: false);
				timer.Set(amount);
				try
				{
					cancellationTokenRegistration = cancellationToken.Register(StaticOnCancellation, this);
				}
				catch (ObjectDisposedException)
				{
					HandleCancellation(scheduleComplete: false);
				}
			}

			public new static void End(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				SleepAsyncResult sleepAsyncResult = AsyncResult<SleepAsyncResult>.End(result);
				try
				{
					sleepAsyncResult.cancellationTokenRegistration.Dispose();
				}
				catch (ObjectDisposedException)
				{
				}
			}

			private static void OnTimer(object state)
			{
				SleepAsyncResult sleepAsyncResult = (SleepAsyncResult)state;
				sleepAsyncResult.Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: false);
			}

			private static void OnCancellation(object state)
			{
				SleepAsyncResult sleepAsyncResult = (SleepAsyncResult)state;
				sleepAsyncResult.HandleCancellation(scheduleComplete: true);
			}

			private void HandleCancellation(bool scheduleComplete)
			{
				if (!timer.Cancel())
				{
					return;
				}
				if (scheduleComplete)
				{
					IOThreadScheduler.ScheduleCallbackNoFlow(delegate(object s)
					{
						((SleepAsyncResult)s).Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: false);
					}, this);
				}
				else
				{
					Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: true);
				}
			}
		}

		protected delegate IAsyncResult BeginCall<TWorkItem>(TIteratorAsyncResult thisPtr, TWorkItem workItem, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state);

		protected delegate void EndCall<TWorkItem>(TIteratorAsyncResult thisPtr, TWorkItem workItem, IAsyncResult ar);

		private sealed class ParallelAsyncResult<TWorkItem> : AsyncResult<ParallelAsyncResult<TWorkItem>>
		{
			private sealed class CallbackState
			{
				public ParallelAsyncResult<TWorkItem> AsyncResult { get; private set; }

				public TWorkItem AsyncData { get; private set; }

				public CallbackState(ParallelAsyncResult<TWorkItem> asyncResult, TWorkItem data)
				{
					AsyncResult = asyncResult;
					AsyncData = data;
				}
			}

			private static AsyncCallback completed = OnCompleted;

			private readonly TIteratorAsyncResult iteratorAsyncResult;

			private readonly ICollection<TWorkItem> workItems;

			private readonly EndCall<TWorkItem> endCall;

			private long actions;

			private Exception firstException;

			public ParallelAsyncResult(TIteratorAsyncResult iteratorAsyncResult, ICollection<TWorkItem> workItems, BeginCall<TWorkItem> beginCall, EndCall<TWorkItem> endCall, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(callback, state)
			{
				this.iteratorAsyncResult = iteratorAsyncResult;
				this.workItems = workItems;
				this.endCall = endCall;
				actions = this.workItems.Count + 1;
				foreach (TWorkItem workItem in workItems)
				{
					try
					{
						beginCall(iteratorAsyncResult, workItem, timeout, completed, new CallbackState(this, workItem));
					}
					catch (Exception ex)
					{
						if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
						{
							throw;
						}
						TryComplete(ex, completedSynchronously: true);
					}
				}
				TryComplete(null, completedSynchronously: true);
			}

			private void TryComplete(Exception exception, bool completedSynchronously)
			{
				if (firstException == null && exception != null)
				{
					firstException = exception;
				}
				if (Interlocked.Decrement(ref actions) == 0L)
				{
					Complete(completedSynchronously, firstException);
				}
			}

			private static void OnCompleted(IAsyncResult ar)
			{
				CallbackState callbackState = (CallbackState)ar.AsyncState;
				ParallelAsyncResult<TWorkItem> asyncResult = callbackState.AsyncResult;
				try
				{
					asyncResult.endCall(asyncResult.iteratorAsyncResult, callbackState.AsyncData, ar);
					asyncResult.TryComplete(null, ar.CompletedSynchronously);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
					{
						throw;
					}
					asyncResult.TryComplete(ex, ar.CompletedSynchronously);
				}
			}
		}

		private static readonly Action<Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult, Exception> onFinally = Finally;

		private static AsyncCompletion stepCallbackDelegate;

		private TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper;

		private IEnumerator<AsyncStep> steps;

		private Exception lastAsyncStepException;

		protected Exception LastAsyncStepException
		{
			get
			{
				return lastAsyncStepException;
			}
			set
			{
				lastAsyncStepException = value;
			}
		}

		public TimeSpan OriginalTimeout => timeoutHelper.OriginalTimeout;

		private static AsyncCompletion StepCallbackDelegate
		{
			get
			{
				if (stepCallbackDelegate == null)
				{
					stepCallbackDelegate = StepCallback;
				}
				return stepCallbackDelegate;
			}
		}

		protected IteratorAsyncResult(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			: base(callback, state)
		{
			timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
			base.OnCompleting = (Action<Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult, Exception>)Delegate.Combine(base.OnCompleting, onFinally);
		}

		public IAsyncResult Start()
		{
			try
			{
				steps = GetAsyncSteps();
				EnumerateSteps(CurrentThreadType.StartingThread);
			}
			catch (Exception operationException)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(operationException))
				{
					throw;
				}
				Complete(operationException);
			}
			return this;
		}

		public TIteratorAsyncResult RunSynchronously()
		{
			try
			{
				steps = GetAsyncSteps();
				EnumerateSteps(CurrentThreadType.Synchronous);
			}
			catch (Exception operationException)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(operationException))
				{
					throw;
				}
				Complete(operationException);
			}
			return Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult.End<TIteratorAsyncResult>(this);
		}

		protected AsyncStep CallAsync(BeginCall beginCall, EndCall endCall, Call call, ExceptionPolicy policy)
		{
			return new AsyncStep(null, beginCall, endCall, call, policy);
		}

		protected AsyncStep CallAsync(BeginCall beginCall, EndCall endCall, ExceptionPolicy policy)
		{
			return new AsyncStep(null, beginCall, endCall, null, policy);
		}

		protected AsyncStep CallParallelAsync<TWorkItem>(ICollection<TWorkItem> workItems, BeginCall<TWorkItem> beginCall, EndCall<TWorkItem> endCall, ExceptionPolicy policy)
		{
			return CallAsync((TIteratorAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => new ParallelAsyncResult<TWorkItem>(thisPtr, workItems, beginCall, endCall, t, c, s), delegate(TIteratorAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
			{
				AsyncResult<ParallelAsyncResult<TWorkItem>>.End(r);
			}, policy);
		}

		protected AsyncStep CallParallelAsync<TWorkItem>(ICollection<TWorkItem> workItems, BeginCall<TWorkItem> beginCall, EndCall<TWorkItem> endCall, TimeSpan timeout, ExceptionPolicy policy)
		{
			return CallAsync((TIteratorAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => new ParallelAsyncResult<TWorkItem>(thisPtr, workItems, beginCall, endCall, timeout, c, s), delegate(TIteratorAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
			{
				AsyncResult<ParallelAsyncResult<TWorkItem>>.End(r);
			}, policy);
		}

		protected AsyncStep CallTask(Func<TIteratorAsyncResult, TimeSpan, Task> taskFunc, ExceptionPolicy policy)
		{
			return CallAsync(delegate(TIteratorAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s)
			{
				Task task = taskFunc(thisPtr, t);
				if (task.Status == TaskStatus.Created)
				{
					task.Start();
				}
				return task.ToAsyncResult(c, s);
			}, delegate(TIteratorAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
			{
				TaskHelpers.EndAsyncResult(r);
			}, policy);
		}

		protected AsyncStep CallTransactionalAsync(Transaction transaction, BeginCall beginCall, EndCall endCall, Call call, ExceptionPolicy policy)
		{
			return new AsyncStep(transaction, beginCall, endCall, call, policy);
		}

		protected AsyncStep CallTransactionalAsync(Transaction transaction, BeginCall beginCall, EndCall endCall, ExceptionPolicy policy)
		{
			return new AsyncStep(transaction, beginCall, endCall, null, policy);
		}

		protected AsyncStep CallAsyncSleep(TimeSpan amountToSleep)
		{
			return CallAsyncSleep(amountToSleep, CancellationToken.None);
		}

		protected AsyncStep CallAsyncSleep(TimeSpan amountToSleep, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			return CallAsync((TIteratorAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => new SleepAsyncResult(amountToSleep, cancellationToken, c, s), delegate(TIteratorAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
			{
				SleepAsyncResult.End(r);
			}, delegate
			{
				Thread.Sleep(amountToSleep);
			}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
		}

		protected AsyncStep CallCompletedAsyncStep()
		{
			return CallAsync((TIteratorAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => new CompletedAsyncResult(c, s), delegate(TIteratorAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
			{
				CompletedAsyncResult.End(r);
			}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
		}

		protected TimeSpan RemainingTime()
		{
			return timeoutHelper.RemainingTime();
		}

		protected TimeSpan ElapsedTime()
		{
			return timeoutHelper.ElapsedTime();
		}

		protected abstract IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps();

		protected void Complete(Exception operationException)
		{
			Complete(!base.StepsEverCompletedAsynchronously, operationException);
		}

		protected bool TryComplete(Exception operationException)
		{
			return TryComplete(!base.StepsEverCompletedAsynchronously, operationException);
		}

		private static bool StepCallback(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			IteratorAsyncResult<TIteratorAsyncResult> iteratorAsyncResult = (IteratorAsyncResult<TIteratorAsyncResult>)result.AsyncState;
			bool flag = result.CompletedSynchronously;
			flag = iteratorAsyncResult.CheckForInvalidCallback(result);
			if (!flag)
			{
				try
				{
					iteratorAsyncResult.steps.Current.EndCall((TIteratorAsyncResult)iteratorAsyncResult, result);
				}
				catch (Exception e)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(e) || !iteratorAsyncResult.HandleException(e))
					{
						throw;
					}
				}
				iteratorAsyncResult.EnumerateSteps(CurrentThreadType.Callback);
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private static void Finally(Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult result, Exception exception)
		{
			IteratorAsyncResult<TIteratorAsyncResult> iteratorAsyncResult = (IteratorAsyncResult<TIteratorAsyncResult>)result;
			try
			{
				iteratorAsyncResult.steps?.Dispose();
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
				{
					throw;
				}
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteExceptionAsWarning(ex.ToStringSlim());
				if (exception == null)
				{
					throw;
				}
			}
		}

		private bool MoveNextStep()
		{
			return steps.MoveNext();
		}

		private void EnumerateSteps(CurrentThreadType state)
		{
			while (!base.IsCompleted && MoveNextStep())
			{
				LastAsyncStepException = null;
				AsyncStep current = steps.Current;
				if (current.BeginCall == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				IAsyncResult asyncResult = null;
				if (state == CurrentThreadType.Synchronous && current.HasSynchronous)
				{
					if (current.Policy == ExceptionPolicy.Transfer)
					{
						using (PrepareTransactionalCall(current.Transaction))
						{
							current.Call((TIteratorAsyncResult)this, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
						}
					}
					else
					{
						try
						{
							using (PrepareTransactionalCall(current.Transaction))
							{
								current.Call((TIteratorAsyncResult)this, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
							}
						}
						catch (Exception e)
						{
							if (Fx.IsFatal(e) || !HandleException(e))
							{
								throw;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				else if (current.Policy == ExceptionPolicy.Transfer)
				{
					using (PrepareTransactionalCall(current.Transaction))
					{
						asyncResult = current.BeginCall((TIteratorAsyncResult)this, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime(), PrepareAsyncCompletion(StepCallbackDelegate), this);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					try
					{
						using (PrepareTransactionalCall(current.Transaction))
						{
							asyncResult = current.BeginCall((TIteratorAsyncResult)this, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime(), PrepareAsyncCompletion(StepCallbackDelegate), this);
						}
					}
					catch (Exception e2)
					{
						if (Fx.IsFatal(e2) || !HandleException(e2))
						{
							throw;
						}
					}
				}
				if (asyncResult == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (!TrySyncContinue(asyncResult, out var _))
				{
					return;
				}
				try
				{
					steps.Current.EndCall((TIteratorAsyncResult)this, asyncResult);
				}
				catch (Exception e3)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(e3) || !HandleException(e3))
					{
						throw;
					}
				}
			}
			if (!base.IsCompleted)
			{
				Complete(!base.StepsEverCompletedAsynchronously);
			}
		}

		private bool HandleException(Exception e)
		{
			LastAsyncStepException = e;
			bool result;
			switch (steps.Current.Policy)
			{
			case ExceptionPolicy.Continue:
				result = true;
				break;
			case ExceptionPolicy.Transfer:
				result = false;
				if (!base.IsCompleted)
				{
					Complete(e);
					result = true;
				}
				break;
			default:
				result = false;
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
