	internal class MessageComparer : IComparer<BrokeredMessage>
	{
		private readonly bool useTransferSequenceNumber;

		public MessageComparer()
		{
			useTransferSequenceNumber = false;
		}

		public MessageComparer(bool useTransferSequenceNumber)
		{
			this.useTransferSequenceNumber = useTransferSequenceNumber;
		}

		public int Compare(BrokeredMessage x, BrokeredMessage y)
		{
			if (useTransferSequenceNumber)
			{
				return x.TransferSequenceNumber.CompareTo(y.TransferSequenceNumber);
			}
			return x.SequenceNumber.CompareTo(y.SequenceNumber);
		}
	}

	public class MessagingFactorySettings
	{
		private const string DisableEntityLevelPerformanceCountersKeyName = "Microsoft.ServiceBus.DisableEntityLevelPerformanceCounters";

		private TimeSpan operationTimeout;

		private NetMessagingTransportSettings netMessagingTransportSettings;

		private AmqpTransportSettings amqpTransportSettings;

		public bool EnableAdditionalClientTimeout { get; set; }

		public TimeSpan OperationTimeout
		{
			get
			{
				return operationTimeout;
			}
			set
			{
				TimeoutHelper.ThrowIfNonPositiveArgument(value, "OperationTimeout");
				operationTimeout = value;
			}
		}

		public TransportType TransportType { get; set; }

		public NetMessagingTransportSettings NetMessagingTransportSettings
		{
			get
			{
				if (netMessagingTransportSettings == null)
				{
					netMessagingTransportSettings = new NetMessagingTransportSettings();
				}
				return netMessagingTransportSettings;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNull("value");
				}
				netMessagingTransportSettings = value;
			}
		}

		public AmqpTransportSettings AmqpTransportSettings
		{
			get
			{
				if (amqpTransportSettings == null)
				{
					amqpTransportSettings = new AmqpTransportSettings();
				}
				return amqpTransportSettings;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNull("value");
				}
				amqpTransportSettings = value;
			}
		}

		public bool DisableEntityLevelPerformanceCounters
		{
			get
			{
				return MessagingPerformanceCounters.DisableEntityLevelCounters;
			}
			set
			{
				MessagingPerformanceCounters.SetCollectEntityLevelCounters(value);
			}
		}

		public TokenProvider TokenProvider { get; set; }

		public MessagingFactorySettings()
		{
			operationTimeout = Constants.DefaultOperationTimeout;
			TokenProvider = null;
			TransportType = TransportType.NetMessaging;
			EnableAdditionalClientTimeout = true;
			string value = null;
			try
			{
				if (WebConfigurationManager.AppSettings != null && WebConfigurationManager.AppSettings.Count > 0)
				{
					value = WebConfigurationManager.AppSettings["Microsoft.ServiceBus.DisableEntityLevelPerformanceCounters"];
					if (bool.TryParse(value, out var result))
					{
						DisableEntityLevelPerformanceCounters = result;
					}
				}
			}
			catch (ConfigurationErrorsException)
			{
			}
			try
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value) && ConfigurationManager.AppSettings != null && ConfigurationManager.AppSettings.Count > 0)
				{
					value = ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["Microsoft.ServiceBus.DisableEntityLevelPerformanceCounters"];
					if (bool.TryParse(value, out var result2))
					{
						DisableEntityLevelPerformanceCounters = result2;
					}
				}
			}
			catch (ConfigurationErrorsException)
			{
			}
			catch (NotSupportedException)
			{
			}
		}

		public MessagingFactorySettings(MessagingFactorySettings other)
		{
			operationTimeout = other.OperationTimeout;
			EnableAdditionalClientTimeout = other.EnableAdditionalClientTimeout;
			DisableEntityLevelPerformanceCounters = other.DisableEntityLevelPerformanceCounters;
			TokenProvider = other.TokenProvider;
			TransportType = other.TransportType;
			if (other.TransportType == TransportType.NetMessaging)
			{
				NetMessagingTransportSettings = (NetMessagingTransportSettings)other.NetMessagingTransportSettings.Clone();
			}
			else
			{
				AmqpTransportSettings = (AmqpTransportSettings)other.AmqpTransportSettings.Clone();
			}
		}

		public virtual MessagingFactorySettings Clone()
		{
			return new MessagingFactorySettings(this);
		}

		internal IAsyncResult BeginCreateFactory(IEnumerable<Uri> uriAddresses, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return OnBeginCreateFactory(uriAddresses, callback, state);
		}

		internal MessagingFactory EndCreateFactory(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			return OnEndCreateFactory(result);
		}

		protected virtual IAsyncResult OnBeginCreateFactory(Uri uri, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return OnBeginCreateFactory(new List<Uri> { uri }, callback, state);
		}

		protected virtual IAsyncResult OnBeginCreateFactory(IEnumerable<Uri> uriAddresses, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			ITransportSettings transportSettings = GetTransportSettings();
			if (transportSettings is IServiceBusSecuritySettings serviceBusSecuritySettings)
			{
				serviceBusSecuritySettings.TokenProvider = TokenProvider;
			}
			return transportSettings.BeginCreateFactory(uriAddresses, callback, state);
		}

		protected virtual MessagingFactory OnEndCreateFactory(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			return GetTransportSettings().EndCreateFactory(result);
		}

		private ITransportSettings GetTransportSettings()
		{
			if (TransportType == TransportType.NetMessaging)
			{
				return NetMessagingTransportSettings;
			}
			return AmqpTransportSettings;
		}
	}

	internal sealed class OpenCollectionIteratedAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<OpenCollectionIteratedAsyncResult>
	{
		private ICommunicationObject currentCommunicationObject;

		private IEnumerable<ICommunicationObject> CommunicationObjects { get; set; }

		public OpenCollectionIteratedAsyncResult(IEnumerable<ICommunicationObject> communicationObjects, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			: base(timeout, callback, state)
		{
			CommunicationObjects = communicationObjects;
			Start();
		}

		protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
		{
			foreach (ICommunicationObject communicationObject in CommunicationObjects)
			{
				currentCommunicationObject = communicationObject;
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((OpenCollectionIteratedAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.currentCommunicationObject.BeginOpen(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(OpenCollectionIteratedAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					thisPtr.currentCommunicationObject.EndOpen(r);
				}, (Call)delegate(OpenCollectionIteratedAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t)
				{
					thisPtr.currentCommunicationObject.Open(t);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
			}
		}
	}
	internal sealed class OpenOnceManager : SingletonManager<ClientEntity>
	{
		internal delegate bool EndOperation<T>(IAsyncResult result, out T output);

		private sealed class OpenOnceManagerAsyncResult<T> : Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult
		{
			private static readonly AsyncCompletion openComplete = OpenComplete;

			private static readonly AsyncCompletion operationComplete = OperationComplete;

			private readonly OpenOnceManager openOnceManager;

			private readonly Func<AsyncCallback, object, IAsyncResult> beginOperation;

			private readonly EndOperation<T> endOperation;

			private readonly Transaction transaction;

			private T output;

			private bool operationResult;

			public OpenOnceManagerAsyncResult(OpenOnceManager openOnceManager, TimeSpan openTimeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state, Func<AsyncCallback, object, IAsyncResult> beginOperation, EndOperation<T> endOperation)
				: base(callback, state)
			{
				transaction = Transaction.Current;
				this.openOnceManager = openOnceManager;
				this.beginOperation = beginOperation;
				this.endOperation = endOperation;
				if (openOnceManager.ShouldOpen)
				{
					IAsyncResult result = this.openOnceManager.BeginOpen(openTimeout, PrepareAsyncCompletion(openComplete), this);
					if (SyncContinue(result))
					{
						Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: true);
					}
				}
				else if (BeginOperation())
				{
					Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: true);
				}
			}

			private static bool OpenComplete(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				OpenOnceManagerAsyncResult<T> openOnceManagerAsyncResult = (OpenOnceManagerAsyncResult<T>)result.AsyncState;
				openOnceManagerAsyncResult.openOnceManager.EndOpen(result);
				return openOnceManagerAsyncResult.BeginOperation();
			}

			private bool BeginOperation()
			{
				IAsyncResult result;
				using (PrepareTransactionalCall(transaction))
				{
					result = beginOperation(PrepareAsyncCompletion(operationComplete), this);
				}
				return SyncContinue(result);
			}

			private static bool OperationComplete(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				OpenOnceManagerAsyncResult<T> openOnceManagerAsyncResult = (OpenOnceManagerAsyncResult<T>)result.AsyncState;
				openOnceManagerAsyncResult.operationResult = openOnceManagerAsyncResult.endOperation(result, out openOnceManagerAsyncResult.output);
				return true;
			}

			public static bool End(IAsyncResult result, out T output)
			{
				OpenOnceManagerAsyncResult<T> openOnceManagerAsyncResult = Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult.End<OpenOnceManagerAsyncResult<T>>(result);
				output = openOnceManagerAsyncResult.output;
				return openOnceManagerAsyncResult.operationResult;
			}
		}

		private readonly ClientEntity clientEntity;

		private readonly TimeSpan openTimeout;

		public bool ShouldOpen => !clientEntity.IsOpened;

		public OpenOnceManager(ClientEntity clientEntity)
			: base(new object())
		{
			this.clientEntity = clientEntity;
			openTimeout = clientEntity.OperationTimeout;
		}

		public IAsyncResult Begin(AsyncCallback callback, object state, Func<AsyncCallback, object, IAsyncResult> beginOperation, Action<IAsyncResult> endOperation)
		{
			return new OpenOnceManagerAsyncResult<bool>(this, openTimeout, callback, state, beginOperation, delegate(IAsyncResult r, out bool output)
			{
				endOperation(r);
				output = true;
				return true;
			});
		}

		public IAsyncResult Begin<T>(AsyncCallback callback, object state, Func<AsyncCallback, object, IAsyncResult> beginOperation, EndOperation<T> endOperation)
		{
			return new OpenOnceManagerAsyncResult<T>(this, openTimeout, callback, state, beginOperation, endOperation);
		}

		public IAsyncResult Begin<T>(AsyncCallback callback, object state, Func<AsyncCallback, object, IAsyncResult> beginOperation, Func<IAsyncResult, T> endOperation)
		{
			return new OpenOnceManagerAsyncResult<T>(this, openTimeout, callback, state, beginOperation, delegate(IAsyncResult r, out T output)
			{
				T val = endOperation(r);
				output = val;
				return true;
			});
		}

		public void Open()
		{
			End(Begin(null, null, (AsyncCallback c, object s) => new CompletedAsyncResult(c, s), delegate
			{
			}));
		}

		public static void End(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			OpenOnceManagerAsyncResult<bool>.End(result, out var _);
		}

		public static bool ShouldEnd<T>(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			return result is OpenOnceManagerAsyncResult<T>;
		}

		public static bool ShouldEnd(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			return result is OpenOnceManagerAsyncResult<bool>;
		}

		public static T End<T>(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			OpenOnceManagerAsyncResult<T>.End(result, out var output);
			return output;
		}

		public static bool End<T>(IAsyncResult result, out T output)
		{
			return OpenOnceManagerAsyncResult<T>.End(result, out output);
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginCreateInstance(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return clientEntity.BeginOpen(timeout, callback, state);
		}

		protected override ClientEntity OnEndCreateInstance(IAsyncResult asyncResult)
		{
			clientEntity.EndOpen(asyncResult);
			return clientEntity;
		}

		private IAsyncResult BeginOpen(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return BeginGetInstance(timeout, callback, state);
		}

		private void EndOpen(IAsyncResult asyncResult)
		{
			EndGetInstance(asyncResult);
		}
	}
	[Serializable]
	public sealed class PartitionNotOwnedException : MessagingException
	{
		public PartitionNotOwnedException(string message)
			: base(message)
		{
			base.IsTransient = false;
		}

		public PartitionNotOwnedException(string message, Exception innerException)
			: base(message, innerException)
		{
			base.IsTransient = false;
		}

		private PartitionNotOwnedException(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			: base(info, context)
		{
			base.IsTransient = false;
		}
	}
	public abstract class QueueClient : MessagingEntityClient, IMessageSessionEntity, IMessageClientEntity, IMessageSender, IMessageReceiver, IMessageBrowser
	{
		private sealed class RetryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult : RetryAsyncResult<RetryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly QueueClient client;

			private readonly TrackingContext trackingContext;

			private readonly string sessionId;

			private readonly ReceiveMode receiveMode;

			private readonly TimeSpan serverWaitTime;

			private readonly TimeSpan operationTimeout;

			private readonly bool isExclusiveMode;

			private readonly Guid? lockToken;

			private MessageSession Session { get; set; }

			public RetryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult(QueueClient client, TrackingContext trackingContext, string sessionId, ReceiveMode receiveMode, TimeSpan serverWaitTime, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: this(client, trackingContext, sessionId, receiveMode, isExclusiveMode: true, null, serverWaitTime, timeout, callback, state)
			{
			}

			public RetryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult(QueueClient client, TrackingContext trackingContext, string sessionId, ReceiveMode receiveMode, bool isExclusiveMode, Guid? lockToken, TimeSpan serverWaitTime, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(serverWaitTime, callback, state)
			{
				if (client == null)
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("client");
				}
				this.client = client;
				this.sessionId = sessionId;
				this.receiveMode = receiveMode;
				this.isExclusiveMode = isExclusiveMode;
				this.lockToken = lockToken;
				this.serverWaitTime = serverWaitTime;
				operationTimeout = timeout;
				this.trackingContext = trackingContext ?? TrackingContext.Create(Guid.NewGuid(), this.client.Path);
				MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementPendingAcceptMessageSessionCount(this.client.MessagingFactory.Address, 1);
			}

			public new static MessageSession End(IAsyncResult r)
			{
				RetryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult retryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult = r as RetryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult;
				try
				{
					retryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult = AsyncResult<RetryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult>.End(r);
					return retryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult.Session;
				}
				finally
				{
					if (retryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult != null && retryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult.client != null)
					{
						MessagingPerformanceCounters.DecrementPendingAcceptMessageSessionCount(retryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult.client.MessagingFactory.Address, 1);
					}
				}
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				int iteration = 0;
				TimeSpan iterationSleep = (client.RetryPolicy.IsServerBusy ? RetryPolicy.ServerBusyBaseSleepTime : TimeSpan.Zero);
				if (client.RetryPolicy.IsServerBusy && RetryPolicy.ServerBusyBaseSleepTime >= base.OriginalTimeout)
				{
					string serverBusyExceptionMessage = client.RetryPolicy.ServerBusyExceptionMessage;
					yield return CallAsyncSleep(RemainingTime());
					Complete(new ServerBusyException(serverBusyExceptionMessage, trackingContext));
					yield break;
				}
				bool shouldRetry;
				do
				{
					shouldRetry = false;
					if (iterationSleep != TimeSpan.Zero)
					{
						yield return CallAsyncSleep(iterationSleep);
					}
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((RetryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.client.OnBeginAcceptMessageSession(thisPtr.sessionId, thisPtr.receiveMode, thisPtr.client.PrefetchCount, thisPtr.isExclusiveMode, thisPtr.lockToken, thisPtr.serverWaitTime, thisPtr.operationTimeout, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(RetryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.Session = thisPtr.client.OnEndAcceptMessageSession(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
					if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
					{
						MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementExceptionPerSec(client.MessagingFactory.Address, 1, base.LastAsyncStepException);
						shouldRetry = !base.TransactionExists && client.RetryPolicy.ShouldRetry(RemainingTime(), iteration, base.LastAsyncStepException, out iterationSleep);
						if (shouldRetry)
						{
							MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
							{
								MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteRetryPolicyIteration(trackingContext.Activity, trackingContext.TrackingId, client.RetryPolicy.GetType().Name, "AcceptMessageSession", iteration, iterationSleep.ToString(), base.LastAsyncStepException.GetType().FullName, base.LastAsyncStepException.Message);
							});
							iteration++;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						client.RetryPolicy.ResetServerBusy();
					}
				}
				while (shouldRetry);
				Complete(base.LastAsyncStepException);
			}
		}

		private sealed class RetryGetMessageSessionsAsyncResult : RetryAsyncResult<RetryGetMessageSessionsAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly QueueClient client;

			private readonly TrackingContext trackingContext;

			private readonly DateTime lastUpdatedTime;

			public IEnumerable<MessageSession> Sessions { get; private set; }

			public RetryGetMessageSessionsAsyncResult(QueueClient client, TrackingContext trackingContext, DateTime lastUpdatedTime, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(client.OperationTimeout, callback, state)
			{
				if (client == null)
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("client");
				}
				this.client = client;
				this.lastUpdatedTime = lastUpdatedTime;
				this.trackingContext = trackingContext ?? TrackingContext.Create(Guid.NewGuid(), this.client.Path);
				MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementPendingAcceptMessageSessionCount(this.client.MessagingFactory.Address, 1);
			}

			public new static IEnumerable<MessageSession> End(IAsyncResult r)
			{
				RetryGetMessageSessionsAsyncResult retryGetMessageSessionsAsyncResult = r as RetryGetMessageSessionsAsyncResult;
				try
				{
					retryGetMessageSessionsAsyncResult = AsyncResult<RetryGetMessageSessionsAsyncResult>.End(r);
					return retryGetMessageSessionsAsyncResult.Sessions;
				}
				finally
				{
					if (retryGetMessageSessionsAsyncResult != null && retryGetMessageSessionsAsyncResult.client != null)
					{
						MessagingPerformanceCounters.DecrementPendingAcceptMessageSessionCount(retryGetMessageSessionsAsyncResult.client.MessagingFactory.Address, 1);
					}
				}
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				int iteration = 0;
				TimeSpan iterationSleep = (client.RetryPolicy.IsServerBusy ? RetryPolicy.ServerBusyBaseSleepTime : TimeSpan.Zero);
				if (client.RetryPolicy.IsServerBusy && RetryPolicy.ServerBusyBaseSleepTime >= base.OriginalTimeout)
				{
					string serverBusyExceptionMessage = client.RetryPolicy.ServerBusyExceptionMessage;
					yield return CallAsyncSleep(RemainingTime());
					Complete(new ServerBusyException(serverBusyExceptionMessage, trackingContext));
					yield break;
				}
				bool shouldRetry;
				do
				{
					shouldRetry = false;
					if (iterationSleep != TimeSpan.Zero)
					{
						yield return CallAsyncSleep(iterationSleep);
					}
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((RetryGetMessageSessionsAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.client.OnBeginGetMessageSessions(thisPtr.lastUpdatedTime, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(RetryGetMessageSessionsAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.Sessions = thisPtr.client.OnEndGetMessageSessions(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
					if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
					{
						MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementExceptionPerSec(client.MessagingFactory.Address, 1, base.LastAsyncStepException);
						shouldRetry = !base.TransactionExists && client.RetryPolicy.ShouldRetry(RemainingTime(), iteration, base.LastAsyncStepException, out iterationSleep);
						if (shouldRetry)
						{
							MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
							{
								MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteRetryPolicyIteration(trackingContext.Activity, trackingContext.TrackingId, client.RetryPolicy.GetType().Name, "GetMessageSessions", iteration, iterationSleep.ToString(), base.LastAsyncStepException.GetType().FullName, base.LastAsyncStepException.Message);
							});
							iteration++;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						client.RetryPolicy.ResetServerBusy();
					}
				}
				while (shouldRetry);
				Complete(base.LastAsyncStepException);
			}
		}

		private sealed class CloseOrAbortAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<CloseOrAbortAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly QueueClient owner;

			private readonly bool shouldAbort;

			public CloseOrAbortAsyncResult(QueueClient owner, bool shouldAbort, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.owner = owner;
				this.shouldAbort = shouldAbort;
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				if (shouldAbort)
				{
					owner.ClientEntityManager.Abort();
				}
				else
				{
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((CloseOrAbortAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.owner.ClientEntityManager.BeginClose(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(CloseOrAbortAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.owner.ClientEntityManager.EndClose(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
				}
				if (owner.pumpHost == null)
				{
					yield break;
				}
				if (shouldAbort)
				{
					owner.pumpHost.Abort();
					yield break;
				}
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((CloseOrAbortAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.owner.pumpHost.BeginClose(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(CloseOrAbortAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					thisPtr.owner.pumpHost.EndClose(r);
				}, (Call)delegate(CloseOrAbortAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t)
				{
					thisPtr.owner.pumpHost.Close(t);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
			}
		}

			: base(path, MessagingEntityType.Queue)

			openOnceManager = new OpenOnceManager(this);
			Mode = receiveMode;
			IsSubQueue = MessagingUtilities.IsSubQueue(path);
			InternalReceiver = null;
			InternalSender = null;
			InternalBrowser = null;
			base.RetryPolicy = messagingFactory.RetryPolicy.Clone();

		}

		public static QueueClient CreateFromConnectionString(string connectionString, string path)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(connectionString))
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNullOrWhiteSpace("connectionString");
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path))
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNullOrWhiteSpace("path");
			}
			ServiceBusConnectionStringBuilder serviceBusConnectionStringBuilder = new ServiceBusConnectionStringBuilder(connectionString);
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(serviceBusConnectionStringBuilder.EntityPath))
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("entityPath", SRClient.SpecifyEntityNameInPathArg("Queue"));
			}
			return MessagingFactory.CreateFromConnectionString(connectionString, useCache: true).CreateQueueClient(path);
		}

		{
			ThrowIfReceiverNull("RenewMessageLock");

		}

		public Task<DateTime> RenewMessageLockAsync(Guid lockToken)
		{
			ThrowIfReceiverNull("RenewMessageLock");
			return TaskHelpers.FromAsync((AsyncCallback c, object s) => InternalReceiver.BeginRenewMessageLocks(null, new Guid[1] { lockToken }, InternalReceiver.OperationTimeout, c, s), (IAsyncResult r) => InternalReceiver.EndRenewMessageLocks(r).First());
		}

		private IAsyncResult BeginCreateSender(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			if (openOnceManager.ShouldOpen)
			{
				return openOnceManager.Begin(callback, state, (Func<AsyncCallback, object, IAsyncResult>)((AsyncCallback c, object s) => OnBeginCreateSender(timeout, c, s)), (Func<IAsyncResult, MessageSender>)OnEndCreateSender);
			}
			return OnBeginCreateSender(timeout, callback, state);
		}

		private MessageSender EndCreateSender(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			MessageSender messageSender = ((!OpenOnceManager.ShouldEnd<MessageSender>(result)) ? OnEndCreateSender(result) : OpenOnceManager.End<MessageSender>(result));
			messageSender.ShouldLinkRetryPolicy = true;
			RegisterMessageClientEntity(messageSender);
			IPairedNamespaceFactory pairedNamespaceFactory = MessagingFactory.PairedNamespaceFactory;
			if (pairedNamespaceFactory != null)
			{
				messageSender = pairedNamespaceFactory.CreateMessageSender(messageSender);
				RegisterMessageClientEntity(messageSender);
			}
			return messageSender;
		}

		private IAsyncResult BeginCreateReceiver(string subQueuePath, ReceiveMode receiveMode, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			if (openOnceManager.ShouldOpen)
			{
				return openOnceManager.Begin(callback, state, (Func<AsyncCallback, object, IAsyncResult>)((AsyncCallback c, object s) => OnBeginCreateReceiver(subQueuePath, receiveMode, timeout, c, s)), (Func<IAsyncResult, MessageReceiver>)OnEndCreateReceiver);
			}
			return OnBeginCreateReceiver(subQueuePath, receiveMode, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		private IAsyncResult BeginCreateReceiver(ReceiveMode receiveMode, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			if (openOnceManager.ShouldOpen)
			{
				return openOnceManager.Begin(callback, state, (Func<AsyncCallback, object, IAsyncResult>)((AsyncCallback c, object s) => OnBeginCreateReceiver(receiveMode, timeout, c, s)), (Func<IAsyncResult, MessageReceiver>)OnEndCreateReceiver);
			}
			return OnBeginCreateReceiver(receiveMode, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		private MessageReceiver EndCreateReceiver(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			MessageReceiver messageReceiver = ((!OpenOnceManager.ShouldEnd<MessageReceiver>(result)) ? OnEndCreateReceiver(result) : OpenOnceManager.End<MessageReceiver>(result));
			messageReceiver.ShouldLinkRetryPolicy = true;
			RegisterMessageClientEntity(messageReceiver);
			return messageReceiver;
		}

		internal IAsyncResult BeginAcceptMessageSession(string sessionId, bool isExclusiveMode, Guid? lockToken, TimeSpan serverWaitTime, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			TimeoutHelper.ThrowIfNonPositiveArgument(serverWaitTime, "serverWaitTime");
			if (openOnceManager.ShouldOpen)
			{
				return openOnceManager.Begin(callback, state, (Func<AsyncCallback, object, IAsyncResult>)delegate(AsyncCallback c, object s)
				{
					RetryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult retryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult2 = new RetryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult(this, null, sessionId, Mode, isExclusiveMode, lockToken, serverWaitTime, timeout, c, s);
					retryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult2.Start();
					return retryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult2;
				}, (Func<IAsyncResult, MessageSession>)RetryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult.End);
			}
			RetryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult retryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult = new RetryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult(this, null, sessionId, Mode, isExclusiveMode, lockToken, serverWaitTime, timeout, callback, state);
			retryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult.Start();
			return retryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult;
		}

		internal IAsyncResult BeginAcceptMessageSession(string sessionId, TimeSpan serverWaitTime, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)

				return openOnceManager.Begin(callback, state, (Func<AsyncCallback, object, IAsyncResult>)delegate(AsyncCallback c, object s)
				{
					RetryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult retryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult2 = new RetryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult(this, null, sessionId, Mode, serverWaitTime, timeout, c, s);
					retryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult2.Start();
					return retryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult2;
				}, (Func<IAsyncResult, MessageSession>)RetryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult.End);

		internal MessageSession EndAcceptMessageSession(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			MessageSession messageSession = ((!OpenOnceManager.ShouldEnd<MessageSession>(result)) ? RetryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult.End(result) : OpenOnceManager.End<MessageSession>(result));

		internal IEnumerable<MessageSession> EndGetMessageSessions(IAsyncResult result)

		protected override void OnAbort()
		{
			CloseOrAbortAsyncResult closeOrAbortAsyncResult = new CloseOrAbortAsyncResult(this, shouldAbort: true, TimeSpan.MaxValue, null, null);
			closeOrAbortAsyncResult.RunSynchronously();
		}

		protected override void OnClose(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			CloseOrAbortAsyncResult closeOrAbortAsyncResult = new CloseOrAbortAsyncResult(this, shouldAbort: false, timeout, null, null);
			closeOrAbortAsyncResult.RunSynchronously();
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			CloseOrAbortAsyncResult closeOrAbortAsyncResult = new CloseOrAbortAsyncResult(this, shouldAbort: false, timeout, callback, state);
			return closeOrAbortAsyncResult.Start();
		}

		protected override void OnEndClose(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			AsyncResult<CloseOrAbortAsyncResult>.End(result);
		}

		{
			ThrowIfSenderNull("BeginScheduleMessage");
			return InternalSender.BeginScheduleMessage(message, scheduleEnqueueTime, callback, state);
		}

		internal long EndScheduleMessage(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			ThrowIfSenderNull("EndScheduleMessage");
			return InternalSender.EndScheduleMessage(result).First();
		}

		internal IAsyncResult BeginCancelScheduledMessage(long sequenceNumber, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			ThrowIfSenderNull("BeginCancelScheduledMessage");
			return InternalSender.BeginCancelScheduledMessage(sequenceNumber, callback, state);
		}

		internal void EndCancelScheduledMessage(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			ThrowIfSenderNull("EndCancelScheduledMessage");
			InternalSender.EndCancelScheduledMessage(result);
		}

		private void ThrowIfSenderNull(string operationName)
		{
			EnsureCreateInternalSender();
			if (InternalSender == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException(SRCore.UnsupportedOperation(operationName)));
			}
		}

		private void EnsureCreateInternalSender()
		{
			if (IsSubQueue || InternalSender != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			lock (base.ThisLock)
			{
				if (InternalSender == null)
				{
					InternalSender = EndCreateSender(BeginCreateSender(MessagingFactory.OperationTimeout, null, null));
				}
			}
		}

		private void ThrowIfReceiverNull(string operationName)
		{
			EnsureCreateInternalReceiver();
			if (InternalReceiver == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException(SRCore.UnsupportedOperation(operationName)));
			}
		}

		private void ThrowIfBrowserNull(string operationName)
		{
			EnsureCreateInternalBrowser();
			if (InternalBrowser == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException(SRCore.UnsupportedOperation(operationName)));
			}
		}

		private void EnsureCreateInternalReceiver()
		{
			if (InternalReceiver != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			lock (base.ThisLock)
			{
				if (InternalReceiver == null)
				{
					if (!IsSubQueue)
					{
						InternalReceiver = EndCreateReceiver(BeginCreateReceiver(Mode, MessagingFactory.OperationTimeout, null, null));
					}
					else
					{
						InternalReceiver = EndCreateReceiver(BeginCreateReceiver(base.Path, Mode, MessagingFactory.OperationTimeout, null, null));
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void EnsureCreateInternalBrowser()
		{
			if (InternalBrowser != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			lock (base.ThisLock)
			{
				if (InternalBrowser == null)
				{
					InternalBrowser = EndCreateBrowser(BeginCreateBrowser(MessagingFactory.OperationTimeout, null, null));
				}
			}
		}
	}

		internal override void UpdateForVersion(ApiVersion version, EntityDescription existingDescription = null)
		{
			QueueDescription queueDescription = existingDescription as QueueDescription;
			base.UpdateForVersion(version, existingDescription);
			bool flag = false;
			if (version < ApiVersion.Two)
			{
				InternalAuthorization = queueDescription?.InternalAuthorization;
				flag = true;
				InternalIsAnonymousAccessible = queueDescription?.InternalIsAnonymousAccessible;
				InternalStatus = queueDescription?.InternalStatus;
				InternalForwardTo = queueDescription?.InternalForwardTo;
				InternalCreatedAt = queueDescription?.InternalCreatedAt;
				InternalUpdatedAt = queueDescription?.InternalUpdatedAt;
				InternalAccessedAt = queueDescription?.InternalAccessedAt;
				InternalUserMetadata = queueDescription?.InternalUserMetadata;
				InternalSupportOrdering = queueDescription?.InternalSupportOrdering;
				InternalMessageCountDetails = queueDescription?.InternalMessageCountDetails;
			}
			if (version < ApiVersion.Three)
			{
				if (InternalAuthorization != null && !flag)
				{
					InternalAuthorization.UpdateForVersion(version, queueDescription?.Authorization);
				}
				if (Status == EntityStatus.ReceiveDisabled || Status == EntityStatus.SendDisabled)
				{
					Status = EntityStatus.Active;
				}
				InternalAutoDeleteOnIdle = queueDescription?.InternalAutoDeleteOnIdle;
			}
			if (version < ApiVersion.Four)
			{
				InternalAvailabilityStatus = queueDescription?.InternalAvailabilityStatus;
			}
			if (version < ApiVersion.Six)
			{
				InternalEnablePartitioning = queueDescription?.InternalEnablePartitioning;
			}
			if (version < ApiVersion.Eight)
			{
				InternalForwardDeadLetteredMessagesTo = queueDescription?.InternalForwardDeadLetteredMessagesTo;
				InternalEnableExpress = queueDescription?.InternalEnableExpress;
			}
			if (version < ApiVersion.Ten)
			{
				if (Status == EntityStatus.Renaming)
				{
					Status = EntityStatus.Active;
				}
				if (AvailabilityStatus == EntityAvailabilityStatus.Renaming)
				{
					OverrideEntityAvailabilityStatus(EntityAvailabilityStatus.Unknown);
				}
			}
			if (version < ApiVersion.Twenty)
			{
				InternalMaxMessageSizeInKilobytes = queueDescription?.InternalMaxMessageSizeInKilobytes;
			}
		}

		internal override bool IsValidForVersion(ApiVersion version)
		{
			if (!base.IsValidForVersion(version))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (version < ApiVersion.Two && (InternalAuthorization != null || InternalIsAnonymousAccessible.HasValue || InternalStatus.HasValue || InternalForwardTo != null || InternalCreatedAt.HasValue || InternalUpdatedAt.HasValue || InternalAccessedAt.HasValue || InternalUserMetadata != null || InternalSupportOrdering.HasValue || InternalMessageCountDetails != null))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (version < ApiVersion.Three)
			{
				if (InternalAuthorization != null)
				{
					InternalAuthorization.IsValidForVersion(version);
				}
				if (InternalAutoDeleteOnIdle.HasValue)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (Status == EntityStatus.SendDisabled || Status == EntityStatus.ReceiveDisabled)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (version < ApiVersion.Four && InternalAvailabilityStatus.HasValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (version < ApiVersion.Six && InternalEnablePartitioning.HasValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (version < ApiVersion.Eight && InternalForwardDeadLetteredMessagesTo != null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (version < ApiVersion.Eight && InternalEnableExpress.HasValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (version < ApiVersion.Ten)
			{
				if (Status == EntityStatus.Renaming)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (AvailabilityStatus == EntityAvailabilityStatus.Renaming)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (version < ApiVersion.Twenty && InternalMaxMessageSizeInKilobytes.HasValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal override bool IsValidForRename()
		{
			if (NewPath.Length > 260 || !ServiceBusUriHelper.SafeMessagingEntityNameExpression.IsMatch(NewPath))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal override void UpdateForRename(EntityDescription renameRequestDescription)
		{
			QueueDescription queueDescription = renameRequestDescription as QueueDescription;
			NewPath = queueDescription.NewPath;
		}

		internal override string GetNewPath()
		{
			return NewPath;
		}

		internal override void SetEntityCreatedAt(DateTime createdAt)
		{
			InternalCreatedAt = createdAt;
		}

		internal override void SetEntityUpdatedAt(DateTime updatedAt)
		{
			InternalUpdatedAt = updatedAt;
		}

		internal override void SetEnabledPartitioning(bool? value)
		{
			InternalEnablePartitioning = value;
		}

		internal override void SetSupportsOrdering(bool? value)
		{
			InternalSupportOrdering = value;
		}
	}

	[DataContract(Name = "RuleDescription", Namespace = "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2010/10/servicebus/connect")]
	public sealed class RuleDescription : EntityDescription, IResourceDescription
	{
		public const string DefaultRuleName = "$Default";

		private Filter filter;

		private RuleAction action;

		private string name;

		[DataMember(Name = "Filter", IsRequired = false, Order = 65537, EmitDefaultValue = false)]
		public Filter Filter
		{
			get
			{
				return filter;
			}
			set
			{
				ThrowIfReadOnly();
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNull("value");
				}
				filter = value;
			}
		}

		[DataMember(Name = "Action", IsRequired = false, Order = 65538, EmitDefaultValue = false)]
		public RuleAction Action
		{
			get
			{
				return action;
			}
			set
			{
				ThrowIfReadOnly();
				action = value;
			}
		}

		[DataMember(Name = "Tag", IsRequired = false, Order = 131073, EmitDefaultValue = false)]
		internal string Tag { get; set; }

		[DataMember(Name = "Name", IsRequired = false, Order = 131077, EmitDefaultValue = false)]
		public string Name
		{
			get
			{
				return name;
			}
			set
			{
				ThrowIfReadOnly();
				if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
				{
					throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNullOrEmpty("Name");
				}
				name = value;
			}
		}

		public DateTime CreatedAt => InternalCreatedAt ?? DateTime.MinValue;

		[DataMember(Name = "CreatedAt", IsRequired = false, Order = 131074, EmitDefaultValue = false)]
		internal DateTime? InternalCreatedAt { get; set; }

		string IResourceDescription.CollectionName => "Rules";

		public RuleDescription()
			: this(TrueFilter.Default)
		{
		}

		public RuleDescription(string name)
			: this(name, TrueFilter.Default)
		{
		}

		public RuleDescription(Filter filter)
		{
			if (filter == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNull("Filter");
			}
			Filter = filter;
		}

		public RuleDescription(string name, Filter filter)
		{
			if (filter == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNull("Filter");
			}
			Filter = filter;
			Name = name;
		}

		internal void Validate()
		{
			Filter.Validate();
			if (Action != null)
			{
				Action.Validate();
			}
		}

		internal override void UpdateForVersion(ApiVersion version, EntityDescription existingDescription = null)
		{
			RuleDescription ruleDescription = existingDescription as RuleDescription;
			base.UpdateForVersion(version, existingDescription);
			bool flag = false;
			if (version < ApiVersion.Two)
			{
				Tag = ruleDescription?.Tag;
				InternalCreatedAt = ruleDescription?.InternalCreatedAt;
				if (action is CompositeAction || action is RuleCreationAction)
				{
					action = ruleDescription?.action;
					flag = true;
				}
				name = ruleDescription?.name;
			}
			if (filter != null)
			{
				filter.UpdateForVersion(version, ruleDescription?.filter);
			}
			if (action != null && !flag)
			{
				action.UpdateForVersion(version, ruleDescription?.action);
			}
		}

		internal override bool IsValidForVersion(ApiVersion version)
		{
			if (!base.IsValidForVersion(version))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (version < ApiVersion.Two && (Tag != null || InternalCreatedAt.HasValue || action is CompositeAction || action is RuleCreationAction))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (filter != null && !filter.IsValidForVersion(version))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (action != null && !action.IsValidForVersion(version))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		[OnDeserialized]
		private void OnDeserialized(StreamingContext context)
		{
			if (filter is TrueFilter)
			{
				filter = TrueFilter.Default;
			}
			else if (filter is FalseFilter)
			{
				filter = FalseFilter.Default;
			}
			if (action == null || action is EmptyRuleAction)
			{
				action = EmptyRuleAction.Default;
			}
		}
	}

	}

		Scheduled
	}
	public abstract class MessageSession : MessageReceiver
	{
		private enum SessionOperation
		{
			GetState,
			SetState,
			RenewSessionLock
		}

		private sealed class RetrySessionAsyncResult : RetryAsyncResult<RetrySessionAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly MessageSession session;

			private readonly TrackingContext trackingContext;

			private readonly SessionOperation operation;

			private Stream sessionState;

			public DateTime LockedUntilUtcTime { get; private set; }

			public Stream Stream { get; private set; }

			public RetrySessionAsyncResult(MessageSession session, TrackingContext trackingContext, SessionOperation operation, Stream sessionState, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				if (trackingContext == null)
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("trackingContext");
				}
				if (session == null)
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("session");
				}
				this.session = session;
				this.operation = operation;
				this.sessionState = sessionState;
				this.trackingContext = trackingContext;
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				int iteration = 0;
				TimeSpan iterationSleep = (session.RetryPolicy.IsServerBusy ? RetryPolicy.ServerBusyBaseSleepTime : TimeSpan.Zero);
				if (session.RetryPolicy.IsServerBusy && RetryPolicy.ServerBusyBaseSleepTime >= base.OriginalTimeout)
				{
					string serverBusyExceptionMessage = session.RetryPolicy.ServerBusyExceptionMessage;
					yield return CallAsyncSleep(RemainingTime());
					Complete(new ServerBusyException(serverBusyExceptionMessage, trackingContext));
					yield break;
				}
				bool shouldRetry;
				do
				{
					shouldRetry = false;
					if (iterationSleep != TimeSpan.Zero)
					{
						yield return CallAsyncSleep(iterationSleep);
					}
					switch (operation)
					{
					case SessionOperation.GetState:
						yield return CallTransactionalAsync(base.AmbientTransaction, (BeginCall)((RetrySessionAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.session.OnBeginGetState(thisPtr.trackingContext, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(RetrySessionAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
						{
							thisPtr.sessionState = thisPtr.session.OnEndGetState(r);
						}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
						Stream = sessionState;
						break;
					case SessionOperation.SetState:
						if (sessionState != null && sessionState.CanSeek && sessionState.Position != 0L)
						{
							sessionState.Position = 0L;
						}
						yield return CallTransactionalAsync(base.AmbientTransaction, (BeginCall)((RetrySessionAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.session.OnBeginSetState(thisPtr.trackingContext, thisPtr.sessionState, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(RetrySessionAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
						{
							thisPtr.session.OnEndSetState(r);
						}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
						break;
					case SessionOperation.RenewSessionLock:
						yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((RetrySessionAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.session.OnBeginRenewLock(thisPtr.trackingContext, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(RetrySessionAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
						{
							thisPtr.LockedUntilUtcTime = thisPtr.session.OnEndRenewLock(r);
						}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
						break;
					}
					if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
					{
						base.LastAsyncStepException = session.ProcessException(base.LastAsyncStepException);
						MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementExceptionPerSec(session.MessagingFactory.Address, 1, base.LastAsyncStepException);
						shouldRetry = !base.TransactionExists && session.RetryPolicy.ShouldRetry(RemainingTime(), iteration, base.LastAsyncStepException, out iterationSleep);
						if (operation == SessionOperation.SetState && sessionState != null && !sessionState.CanSeek)
						{
							shouldRetry = false;
							iterationSleep = TimeSpan.Zero;
							MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
							{
								MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteRetryPolicyStreamNotSeekable(trackingContext.Activity, trackingContext.TrackingId, session.RetryPolicy.GetType().Name, operation.ToString());
							});
						}
						if (shouldRetry)
						{
							MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
							{
								MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteRetryPolicyIteration(trackingContext.Activity, trackingContext.TrackingId, session.RetryPolicy.GetType().Name, operation.ToString(), iteration, iterationSleep.ToString(), base.LastAsyncStepException.GetType().FullName, base.LastAsyncStepException.Message);
							});
							iteration++;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						session.RetryPolicy.ResetServerBusy();
					}
				}
				while (shouldRetry);
				Complete(base.LastAsyncStepException);
			}
		}

		private void InnerReceiverFaulted(object sender, EventArgs args)
		{
			Fault(innerReceiver.GetPendingException());
		}

		public Stream GetState()
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			try
			{
				return GetState(null);
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(exception);
			}
		}

		public Task<Stream> GetStateAsync()
		{
			return TaskHelpers.FromAsync((Func<AsyncCallback, object, IAsyncResult>)BeginGetState, (Func<IAsyncResult, Stream>)EndGetState, (object)null);
		}

		private Stream GetState(TrackingContext trackingContext)
		{
			if (trackingContext == null)
			{
				trackingContext = TrackingContext.Create(Guid.NewGuid(), base.Path);
			}
			TraceGetState(EventTraceActivity.CreateFromThread(), trackingContext, SessionId);
			if (base.OpenOnceManager.ShouldOpen)
			{
				base.OpenOnceManager.Open();
			}
			return OnGetState(trackingContext, OperationTimeout);
		}

		public void SetState(Stream sessionState)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			try
			{
				SetState(null, sessionState);
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(exception);
			}
		}

		public Task SetStateAsync(Stream sessionState)
		{
			return TaskHelpers.FromAsync((AsyncCallback c, object s) => BeginSetState(sessionState, c, s), EndSetState);
		}

		private void SetState(TrackingContext trackingContext, Stream sessionState)
		{
			if (trackingContext == null)
			{
				trackingContext = TrackingContext.Create(Guid.NewGuid(), base.Path);
			}
			TraceSetState(EventTraceActivity.CreateFromThread(), trackingContext, SessionId);
			if (base.OpenOnceManager.ShouldOpen)
			{
				base.OpenOnceManager.Open();
			}
			OnSetState(trackingContext, sessionState, OperationTimeout);
		}

		internal IAsyncResult BeginGetState(AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			try
			{
				TrackingContext trackingContext = TrackingContext.Create(Guid.NewGuid(), base.Path);
				TraceGetState(EventTraceActivity.CreateFromThread(), trackingContext, SessionId);
				if (base.OpenOnceManager.ShouldOpen)
				{
					return base.OpenOnceManager.Begin(callback, state, (Func<AsyncCallback, object, IAsyncResult>)((AsyncCallback c, object s) => new RetrySessionAsyncResult(this, trackingContext, SessionOperation.GetState, null, OperationTimeout, c, s).Start()), (Func<IAsyncResult, RetrySessionAsyncResult>)AsyncResult<RetrySessionAsyncResult>.End);
				}
				return new RetrySessionAsyncResult(this, trackingContext, SessionOperation.GetState, null, OperationTimeout, callback, state).Start();
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(exception);
			}
		}

		internal Stream EndGetState(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			try
			{
				if (OpenOnceManager.ShouldEnd<RetrySessionAsyncResult>(result))
				{
					return OpenOnceManager.End<RetrySessionAsyncResult>(result).Stream;
				}
				return AsyncResult<RetrySessionAsyncResult>.End(result).Stream;
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(exception);
			}
		}

		internal IAsyncResult BeginSetState(Stream sessionState, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			try
			{
				TrackingContext trackingContext = TrackingContext.Create(Guid.NewGuid(), base.Path);
				TraceSetState(EventTraceActivity.CreateFromThread(), trackingContext, SessionId);
				if (base.OpenOnceManager.ShouldOpen)
				{
					return base.OpenOnceManager.Begin(callback, state, (AsyncCallback c, object s) => new RetrySessionAsyncResult(this, trackingContext, SessionOperation.SetState, sessionState, OperationTimeout, c, s).Start(), (IAsyncResult r) => AsyncResult<RetrySessionAsyncResult>.End(r));
				}
				return new RetrySessionAsyncResult(this, trackingContext, SessionOperation.SetState, sessionState, OperationTimeout, callback, state).Start();
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(exception);
			}
		}

		internal void EndSetState(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			try
			{
				if (OpenOnceManager.ShouldEnd<RetrySessionAsyncResult>(result))
				{
					OpenOnceManager.End<RetrySessionAsyncResult>(result);
				}
				else
				{
					AsyncResult<RetrySessionAsyncResult>.End(result);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(exception);
			}
		}

		public void RenewLock()
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			try
			{
				TrackingContext trackingContext = TrackingContext.Create(Guid.NewGuid(), base.Path);
				TraceRenewLock(EventTraceActivity.CreateFromThread(), trackingContext);
				if (base.OpenOnceManager.ShouldOpen)
				{
					base.OpenOnceManager.Open();
				}
				LockedUntilUtc = OnRenewLock(trackingContext, OperationTimeout);
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(exception);
			}
		}

		public Task RenewLockAsync()
		{
			return TaskHelpers.FromAsync(BeginRenewLock, EndRenewLock);
		}

		internal IAsyncResult BeginRenewLock(AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			try
			{
				TrackingContext trackingContext = TrackingContext.Create(Guid.NewGuid(), base.Path);
				TraceRenewLock(EventTraceActivity.CreateFromThread(), trackingContext);
				if (base.OpenOnceManager.ShouldOpen)
				{
					return base.OpenOnceManager.Begin(callback, state, (Func<AsyncCallback, object, IAsyncResult>)((AsyncCallback c, object s) => new RetrySessionAsyncResult(this, trackingContext, SessionOperation.RenewSessionLock, null, OperationTimeout, c, s).Start()), (Func<IAsyncResult, RetrySessionAsyncResult>)AsyncResult<RetrySessionAsyncResult>.End);
				}
				return new RetrySessionAsyncResult(this, trackingContext, SessionOperation.RenewSessionLock, null, OperationTimeout, callback, state).Start();
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(exception);
			}
		}

		internal void EndRenewLock(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			try
			{
				if (OpenOnceManager.ShouldEnd<RetrySessionAsyncResult>(result))
				{
					LockedUntilUtc = OpenOnceManager.End<RetrySessionAsyncResult>(result).LockedUntilUtcTime;
				}
				else
				{
					LockedUntilUtc = AsyncResult<RetrySessionAsyncResult>.End(result).LockedUntilUtcTime;
				}
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(exception);
			}
		}

		protected abstract IAsyncResult OnBeginRenewLock(TrackingContext trackingContext, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state);

		protected abstract DateTime OnEndRenewLock(IAsyncResult result);

		protected virtual DateTime OnRenewLock(TrackingContext trackingContext, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			RetrySessionAsyncResult retrySessionAsyncResult = new RetrySessionAsyncResult(this, trackingContext, SessionOperation.RenewSessionLock, null, OperationTimeout, null, null);
			retrySessionAsyncResult.RunSynchronously();
			return retrySessionAsyncResult.LockedUntilUtcTime;
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginRenewMessageLocks(TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<Guid> lockTokens, bool fromSync, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();

					throw;

		protected abstract IAsyncResult OnBeginGetState(TrackingContext trackingContext, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state);

		{

			retrySessionAsyncResult.RunSynchronously();
			return retrySessionAsyncResult.Stream;
		}

		protected abstract IAsyncResult OnBeginSetState(TrackingContext trackingContext, Stream sessionState, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state);

		protected abstract void OnEndSetState(IAsyncResult result);

		protected virtual void OnSetState(TrackingContext trackingContext, Stream stream, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			RetrySessionAsyncResult retrySessionAsyncResult = new RetrySessionAsyncResult(this, trackingContext, SessionOperation.SetState, stream, timeout, null, null);
			retrySessionAsyncResult.RunSynchronously();
		}

		protected Exception ProcessException(Exception exception)
		{
			if (base.IsClosedOrClosing)
			{
				return new OperationCanceledException(SRClient.EntityClosedOrAborted, exception);
			}
			if (exception is CommunicationException)
			{
				Exception ex = MessagingExceptionHelper.Unwrap((CommunicationException)exception, base.IsClosedOrClosing);
				if (ex is SessionLockLostException)
				{
					AbortInnerReceiverAndFault();
				}
				return ex;
			}
			if (exception is SessionLockLostException)
			{
				AbortInnerReceiverAndFault();
			}
			return exception;
		}

		private void AbortInnerReceiverAndFault()
		{
			if (InnerMessageReceiver != null)
			{
				InnerMessageReceiver.Abort();
			}
			Fault();
		}

		private static void TraceRenewLock(EventTraceActivity fromActivity, TrackingContext trackingContext)
		{
			if (trackingContext != null && fromActivity != null && fromActivity != EventTraceActivity.Empty)
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.RenewSessionLockTransfer(fromActivity, trackingContext.Activity);
				});
			}
		}

		private static void TraceSetState(EventTraceActivity fromActivity, TrackingContext trackingContext, string sessionId)
		{
			if (trackingContext != null && fromActivity != null && fromActivity != EventTraceActivity.Empty)
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.SetStateTransfer(fromActivity, trackingContext.Activity, sessionId);
				});
			}
		}

		private static void TraceGetState(EventTraceActivity fromActivity, TrackingContext trackingContext, string sessionId)
		{
			if (trackingContext != null && fromActivity != null && fromActivity != EventTraceActivity.Empty)
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.GetStateTransfer(fromActivity, trackingContext.Activity, sessionId);
				});
			}
		}
