		private sealed class GetInformationTask : RetryResourceTask<IDictionary<string, string>>
		{
			private IDictionary<string, string> Information { get; }

			public GetInformationTask(TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<Uri> managementAddresses, NamespaceManagerSettings settings)
				: base(trackingContext, managementAddresses, settings, (IResourceDescription[])null, (string[])null, settings.InternalOperationTimeout)
			{
				Information = new ConcurrentDictionary<string, string>();
			}

			protected override async Task<Tuple<bool, IDictionary<string, string>>> OnRunAsync(CancellationTokenSource cancelTokenSource)
			{
				Uri resourceUri = CreateInformationUri(base.UriManager.Current);
				HttpWebRequest request = CreateWebRequest(base.UriManager.Current, resourceUri);
				cancelTokenSource.Token.Register(delegate
				{
					CancelRequest(request);
				});
				TimeSpan timeSpan = RemainingTime();
				if (timeSpan <= TimeSpan.Zero)
				{
					throw new TimeoutException(SRClient.OperationRequestTimedOut(base.OriginalTimeout));
				}
				cancelTokenSource.SafeCancelAfter(timeSpan);
				using (HttpWebResponse httpWebResponse = (HttpWebResponse)(await request.GetResponseAsyncWithoutTaskRun().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false)))
				{
					if (httpWebResponse.StatusCode != HttpStatusCode.OK)
					{
						throw new MessagingException(httpWebResponse.StatusDescription, new WebException(httpWebResponse.StatusDescription, null, WebExceptionStatus.ProtocolError, httpWebResponse));
					}
					string[] allKeys = httpWebResponse.Headers.AllKeys;
					foreach (string text in allKeys)
					{
						Information[text] = httpWebResponse.Headers[text];
					}
				}
				return Tuple.Create(item1: true, Information);
			}
		}

		private sealed class CreateOrUpdateTask<TEntityDescription> : RetryResourceTask<TEntityDescription>
		{
			private readonly SyndicationItem feedItem;

			private readonly bool isAnonymousAccessible;

			private readonly TEntityDescription entityDescription;

			private readonly bool isUpdate;

			public CreateOrUpdateTask(TrackingContext trackingContext, TEntityDescription resourceDescription, IResourceDescription[] collectionDescriptions, string[] resourceNames, IEnumerable<Uri> baseAddresses, bool isAnonymousAccessible, bool isUpdate, NamespaceManagerSettings settings, TimeSpan timeout)
				: base(trackingContext, baseAddresses, settings, collectionDescriptions, resourceNames, timeout)
			{
				this.isAnonymousAccessible = isAnonymousAccessible;
				feedItem = new SyndicationItem
				{
					Content = new XmlSyndicationContent("application/atom+xml;type=entry;charset=utf-8", new SyndicationElementExtension(resourceDescription))
				};
				this.isUpdate = isUpdate;
				entityDescription = resourceDescription;
			}

			protected override async Task<Tuple<bool, TEntityDescription>> OnRunAsync(CancellationTokenSource cancelTokenSource)
			{
				HttpWebRequest request = CreateResourceWebRequest(base.UriManager.Current, GetHttpMethod());
				request.Headers.Add("X-MS-ISANONYMOUSACCESSIBLE", isAnonymousAccessible.ToString());
				if (isUpdate)
				{
					if (NamespaceManager.UseETagInCit && entityDescription != null)
					{
						TopicDescription topicDescription = entityDescription as TopicDescription;
						QueueDescription queueDescription = entityDescription as QueueDescription;
						EventHubDescription eventHubDescription = entityDescription as EventHubDescription;
						DateTime? dateTime = ((topicDescription != null) ? new DateTime?(topicDescription.UpdatedAt) : ((queueDescription != null) ? new DateTime?(queueDescription.UpdatedAt) : eventHubDescription?.UpdatedAt));
						if (dateTime.HasValue)
						{
							request.Headers.Add(HttpRequestHeader.IfMatch, dateTime.Value.Ticks.ToString());
						}
					}
					else
					{
						request.Headers.Add(HttpRequestHeader.IfMatch, "*");
					}
				}
				if (entityDescription is QueueDescription)
				{
					string forwardTo = ((QueueDescription)(object)entityDescription).ForwardTo;
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(forwardTo))
					{
						request.AddServiceBusSupplementaryAuthorizationHeader(base.TokenProvider, base.UriManager.Current, new Uri(forwardTo), "Manage");
					}
					string forwardDeadLetteredMessagesTo = ((QueueDescription)(object)entityDescription).ForwardDeadLetteredMessagesTo;
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(forwardDeadLetteredMessagesTo))
					{
						request.AddServiceBusDlqSupplementaryAuthorizationHeader(base.TokenProvider, base.UriManager.Current, new Uri(forwardDeadLetteredMessagesTo), "Manage");
					}
				}
				else if (entityDescription is SubscriptionDescription)
				{
					string forwardTo2 = ((SubscriptionDescription)(object)entityDescription).ForwardTo;
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(forwardTo2))
					{
						request.AddServiceBusSupplementaryAuthorizationHeader(base.TokenProvider, base.UriManager.Current, new Uri(forwardTo2), "Manage");
					}
					string forwardDeadLetteredMessagesTo2 = ((SubscriptionDescription)(object)entityDescription).ForwardDeadLetteredMessagesTo;
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(forwardDeadLetteredMessagesTo2))
					{
						request.AddServiceBusDlqSupplementaryAuthorizationHeader(base.TokenProvider, base.UriManager.Current, new Uri(forwardDeadLetteredMessagesTo2), "Manage");
					}
				}
				cancelTokenSource.Token.Register(delegate
				{
					CancelRequest(request);
				});
				TimeSpan timeSpan = RemainingTime();
				if (timeSpan <= TimeSpan.Zero)
				{
					throw new TimeoutException(SRClient.OperationRequestTimedOut(base.OriginalTimeout));
				}
				cancelTokenSource.SafeCancelAfter(timeSpan);
				using (Stream output = await request.GetRequestStreamAsync().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false))
				{
					using XmlWriter writer = XmlWriter.Create(output, new XmlWriterSettings
					{
						Encoding = Encoding.UTF8,
						CloseOutput = true
					});
					feedItem.GetAtom10Formatter().WriteTo(writer);
				}
				TimeSpan timeSpan2 = RemainingTime();
				if (timeSpan2 <= TimeSpan.Zero)
				{
					throw new TimeoutException(SRClient.OperationRequestTimedOut(base.OriginalTimeout));
				}
				using HttpWebResponse httpWebResponse = (HttpWebResponse)(await request.GetResponseAsyncWithoutTaskRun().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false));
				if (httpWebResponse.StatusCode != HttpStatusCode.Created && httpWebResponse.StatusCode != HttpStatusCode.OK)
				{
					if (base.UriManager.CanRetry())
					{
						return Tuple.Create(item1: false, default(TEntityDescription));
					}
					throw ConvertWebException(base.TrackingContext, new WebException(httpWebResponse.StatusDescription, null, WebExceptionStatus.ProtocolError, httpWebResponse), request.Timeout, isUpdate);
				}
				using Stream input = httpWebResponse.GetResponseStream();
				using XmlReader reader = XmlReader.Create(input);
				Atom10ItemFormatter atom10ItemFormatter = new Atom10ItemFormatter();
				atom10ItemFormatter.ReadFrom(reader);
				XmlSyndicationContent xmlSyndicationContent = (XmlSyndicationContent)atom10ItemFormatter.Item.Content;
				TEntityDescription item = xmlSyndicationContent.ReadContent<TEntityDescription>();
				return Tuple.Create(item1: true, item);
			}

			protected override bool ShouldRetry(TimeSpan remainingTime, int iteration, Exception exception, out TimeSpan iterationSleep)
			{
				iterationSleep = TimeSpan.Zero;
				if (!base.TransactionExists)
				{
					return IsRetriableException(exception);
				}
				return false;
			}

			private static bool IsRetriableException(Exception exception)
			{
				WebException ex = (exception as WebException) ?? (exception.InnerException as WebException);
				if (ex != null)
				{
					if (ex.Status != WebExceptionStatus.ConnectFailure && ex.Status != WebExceptionStatus.RequestCanceled && ex.Status != WebExceptionStatus.NameResolutionFailure)
					{
						return ex.Status == WebExceptionStatus.Timeout;
					}
					return true;
				}
				if (exception is MessagingCommunicationException)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}

			private string GetHttpMethod()
			{
				if (typeof(TEntityDescription).FullName.Contains("RegistrationDescription"))
				{
					if (!isUpdate)
					{
						return "POST";
					}
					return "PUT";
				}
				if (typeof(TEntityDescription).FullName.Contains("NotificationHubJob"))
				{
					return "POST";
				}
				return "PUT";
			}
		}

		private sealed class DeleteTask : RetryResourceTask<object>
		{
			public DeleteTask(TrackingContext trackingContext, IResourceDescription[] collectionDescriptions, string[] resourceNames, IEnumerable<Uri> baseAddresses, NamespaceManagerSettings settings)
				: base(trackingContext, baseAddresses, settings, collectionDescriptions, resourceNames, settings.InternalOperationTimeout)
			{
			}

			protected override async Task<Tuple<bool, object>> OnRunAsync(CancellationTokenSource cancelTokenSource)
			{
				HttpWebRequest request = CreateResourceWebRequest(base.UriManager.Current, "DELETE");
				cancelTokenSource.Token.Register(delegate
				{
					CancelRequest(request);
				});
				try
				{
					cancelTokenSource.SafeCancelAfter(RemainingTime());
					using (HttpWebResponse httpWebResponse = (HttpWebResponse)(await request.GetResponseAsyncWithoutTaskRun().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false)))
					{
						if (httpWebResponse.StatusCode != HttpStatusCode.OK)
						{
							throw new MessagingException(httpWebResponse.StatusDescription, new WebException(httpWebResponse.StatusDescription, null, WebExceptionStatus.ProtocolError, httpWebResponse));
						}
					}
					return Tuple.Create<bool, object>(item1: true, null);
				}
				catch (Exception ex) when (!Fx.IsFatal(ex))
				{
					Exception ex2 = ConvertToManagementContract(ex, cancelTokenSource.IsCancellationRequested);
					if (ex2 is MessagingEntityNotFoundException)
					{
						return Tuple.Create<bool, object>(item1: true, null);
					}
					if (ex2 != ex)
					{
						throw ex2;
					}
					throw;
				}
			}
		}

		private sealed class GetTask<TEntityDescription> : RetryResourceTask<TEntityDescription>
		{
			public GetTask(TrackingContext trackingContext, IResourceDescription[] collectionDescriptions, string[] collectionResourceNames, IEnumerable<Uri> managementAddresses, NamespaceManagerSettings settings)
				: base(trackingContext, managementAddresses, settings, collectionDescriptions, collectionResourceNames, settings.InternalOperationTimeout)
			{
				if (collectionResourceNames == null)
				{
					throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNull("collectionResourceNames");
				}
			}

			protected override async Task<Tuple<bool, TEntityDescription>> OnRunAsync(CancellationTokenSource cancelTokenSource)
			{
				HttpWebRequest request = CreateResourceWebRequest(base.UriManager.Current);
				cancelTokenSource.Token.Register(delegate
				{
					CancelRequest(request);
				});
				TimeSpan timeSpan = RemainingTime();
				if (timeSpan <= TimeSpan.Zero)
				{
					throw new TimeoutException(SRClient.OperationRequestTimedOut(base.OriginalTimeout));
				}
				cancelTokenSource.SafeCancelAfter(timeSpan);
				using HttpWebResponse httpWebResponse = (HttpWebResponse)(await request.GetResponseAsyncWithoutTaskRun().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false));
				bool flag = httpWebResponse.ContentType.Replace(" ", string.Empty).Equals("application/atom+xml;type=feed;charset=utf-8", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
				string text = ((base.ResourceNames.Length == 0 || string.IsNullOrEmpty(base.ResourceNames[0])) ? "Null" : base.ResourceNames[0]);
				if (httpWebResponse.StatusCode != HttpStatusCode.OK)
				{
					throw new MessagingException(httpWebResponse.StatusDescription, isTransientError: false, new WebException(httpWebResponse.StatusDescription, null, WebExceptionStatus.ProtocolError, httpWebResponse));
				}
				if (flag && (typeof(TEntityDescription).FullName.Contains("TopicDescription") || typeof(TEntityDescription).FullName.Contains("QueueDescription") || typeof(TEntityDescription).FullName.Contains("SubscriptionDescription") || typeof(TEntityDescription).FullName.Contains("RelayDescription") || typeof(TEntityDescription).FullName.Contains("HybridConnectionDescription") || typeof(TEntityDescription).FullName.Contains("NotificationHubDescription") || typeof(TEntityDescription).FullName.Contains("ConsumerGroupDescription") || typeof(TEntityDescription).FullName.Contains("PartitionDescription") || typeof(TEntityDescription).FullName.Contains("EventHubDescription")))
				{
					throw new MessagingEntityNotFoundException(text);
				}
				using Stream stream = httpWebResponse.GetResponseStream();
				try
				{
					TEntityDescription item = MessagingDescriptionSerializer<TEntityDescription>.Serializer.DeserializeFromAtomFeed(stream);
					return Tuple.Create(item1: true, item);
				}
				catch (InvalidCastException innerException)
				{
					throw new MessagingException(SRClient.InvalidManagementEntityType(text, typeof(TEntityDescription).Name), isTransientError: false, innerException);
				}
				catch (SerializationException innerException2)
				{
					throw new MessagingException(SRClient.InvalidManagementEntityType(text, typeof(TEntityDescription).Name), isTransientError: false, innerException2);
				}
			}
		}

		private sealed class GetAllTask : RetryResourceTask<SyndicationFeed>
		{
			private static readonly Func<SyndicationLink, bool> NextLinkPredicate = (SyndicationLink link) => string.Equals(link.RelationshipType, "next", StringComparison.Ordinal);

			private readonly string filter;

			private readonly int skip;

			private readonly int top;

			private readonly bool stopAfterOnePage;

			private bool stopRetries;

			private SyndicationFeed Feed { get; set; }

			private string NewContinuationToken { get; set; }

			public GetAllTask(TrackingContext trackingContext, IResourceDescription[] descriptions, string[] resourceNames, IEnumerable<Uri> addresses, NamespaceManagerSettings settings)
				: this(trackingContext, descriptions, resourceNames, addresses, settings, -1, -1, stopAfterTopEntities: false, string.Empty)
			{
			}

			public GetAllTask(TrackingContext trackingContext, IResourceDescription[] descriptions, string[] resourceNames, IEnumerable<Uri> addresses, NamespaceManagerSettings settings, string filter)
				: this(trackingContext, descriptions, resourceNames, addresses, settings, -1, -1, stopAfterTopEntities: false, filter)
			{
			}

			public GetAllTask(TrackingContext trackingContext, IResourceDescription[] descriptions, string[] resourceNames, IEnumerable<Uri> addresses, NamespaceManagerSettings settings, int skip, int top, bool stopAfterTopEntities, string filter)
				: base(trackingContext, addresses, settings, descriptions, resourceNames, settings.InternalOperationTimeout)
			{
				this.filter = filter;
				this.skip = ((skip >= 0) ? skip : 0);
				this.top = ((top > 0) ? top : settings.GetEntitiesPageSize);
				stopAfterOnePage = stopAfterTopEntities;
			}

			protected override async Task<Tuple<bool, SyndicationFeed>> OnRunAsync(CancellationTokenSource cancelTokenSource)
			{
				Uri resourceUri = CreateCollectionUri(base.UriManager.Current, base.CollectionDescriptions, base.ResourceNames, null, skip, top, filter, base.Settings);
				TimeoutHelper operationTimer = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(base.OriginalTimeout);
				TimeSpan iterationSleep = TimeSpan.Zero;
				int iteration = 0;
				while (true)
				{
					if (iterationSleep != TimeSpan.Zero)
					{
						await Task.Delay(iterationSleep).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					}
					HttpWebRequest request = CreateWebRequest(base.UriManager.Current, resourceUri);
					CancellationTokenSource requestCancelSource = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(cancelTokenSource.Token);
					requestCancelSource.Token.Register(delegate
					{
						CancelRequest(request);
					});
					try
					{
						TimeSpan timeSpan = operationTimer.RemainingTime();
						if (timeSpan <= TimeSpan.Zero)
						{
							throw new TimeoutException(SRClient.OperationRequestTimedOut(base.OriginalTimeout));
						}
						requestCancelSource.SafeCancelAfter(timeSpan);
						try
						{
							Uri nextPageLink = null;
							using (HttpWebResponse httpWebResponse = (HttpWebResponse)(await request.GetResponseAsyncWithoutTaskRun().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false)))
							{
								if (httpWebResponse.StatusCode != HttpStatusCode.OK)
								{
									throw new MessagingException(httpWebResponse.StatusDescription, isTransientError: false, new WebException(httpWebResponse.StatusDescription, null, WebExceptionStatus.ProtocolError, httpWebResponse));
								}
								ProcessResponse(httpWebResponse, resourceUri, out nextPageLink);
							}
							requestCancelSource.CancelAfter(-1);
							base.RetryPolicy.ResetServerBusy();
							if (!(nextPageLink != null) || stopAfterOnePage)
							{
								return Tuple.Create(item1: true, Feed);
							}
							operationTimer = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(base.OriginalTimeout);
							resourceUri = nextPageLink;
						}
						catch (Exception ex) when (!Fx.IsFatal(ex))
						{
							Exception ex2 = ConvertToManagementContract(ex, requestCancelSource.IsCancellationRequested);
							if (!ShouldRetry(operationTimer.RemainingTime(), iteration, ex2, out iterationSleep))
							{
								stopRetries = true;
								ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(ex2, this, EventLevel.Warning, "OnRunAsync", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Messaging\\ServiceBusResourceOperations.cs", 943);
								if (ex2 != ex)
								{
									throw ex2;
								}
								throw;
							}
							MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteRetryPolicyIteration(base.TrackingContext.Activity, base.TrackingContext.TrackingId, base.RetryPolicy.GetType().Name, ToString(), iteration, iterationSleep.ToString(), ex2.GetType().FullName, ex2.Message);
						}
					}
					finally
					{
						requestCancelSource.Dispose();
					}
					iteration++;
					base.UriManager.MoveNextUri();
				}
			}

			protected override bool ShouldRetry(TimeSpan remainingTime, int iteration, Exception exception, out TimeSpan iterationSleep)
			{
				if (stopRetries)
				{
					iterationSleep = TimeSpan.Zero;
					return false;
				}
				return base.ShouldRetry(remainingTime, iteration, exception, out iterationSleep);
			}

			private void ProcessResponse(HttpWebResponse response, Uri initialUri, out Uri nextPageLink)
			{
				nextPageLink = null;
				using (XmlReader reader = XmlReader.Create(response.GetResponseStream(), new XmlReaderSettings
				{
					CloseInput = true
				}))
				{
					SyndicationFeed syndicationFeed = SyndicationFeed.Load<SyndicationFeed>(reader);
					if (syndicationFeed != null && syndicationFeed.Links != null)
					{
						SyndicationLink syndicationLink = syndicationFeed.Links.FirstOrDefault(NextLinkPredicate);
						nextPageLink = ((syndicationLink == null) ? null : FixNextFeedForInternal(initialUri, syndicationLink.Uri));
					}
					if (Feed == null)
					{
						Feed = syndicationFeed;
					}
					else
					{
						SyndicationFeed feed = Feed;
						if (syndicationFeed != null && syndicationFeed.Items != null)
						{
							Feed = new SyndicationFeed(feed.Items.Union(syndicationFeed.Items));
						}
					}
				}
				NewContinuationToken = response.Headers["x-ms-continuationtoken"];
			}

			private static Uri FixNextFeedForInternal(Uri initialUri, Uri nextPageLink)
			{
				string text = "$NS$";
				string value = "/" + text;
				if (initialUri.AbsolutePath.StartsWith(value) && nextPageLink != null && !nextPageLink.AbsolutePath.StartsWith(value))
				{
					UriBuilder uriBuilder = new UriBuilder(initialUri);
					uriBuilder.Path = text + nextPageLink.Host + nextPageLink.LocalPath;
					uriBuilder.Query = nextPageLink.Query.TrimStart('?');
					UriBuilder uriBuilder2 = uriBuilder;
					return uriBuilder2.Uri;
				}
				return nextPageLink;
			}
		}

		private abstract class RetryResourceTask<TResult> : ITraceSource
		{
			private TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper;

			string ITraceSource.Component => "Common";

			public TrackingContext TrackingContext { get; }

			protected IResourceDescription[] CollectionDescriptions { get; }

			protected string[] ResourceNames { get; }

			protected RetryPolicy RetryPolicy => Settings.RetryPolicy;

			protected NamespaceManagerSettings Settings { get; }

			protected TokenProvider TokenProvider => Settings.TokenProvider;

			protected EventTraceActivity RelatedActivity { get; }

			protected Transaction AmbientTransaction { get; }

			protected ServiceBusUriManager UriManager { get; }

			protected bool TransactionExists => AmbientTransaction != null;

			public TimeSpan OriginalTimeout => timeoutHelper.OriginalTimeout;

			public RetryResourceTask(TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<Uri> baseAddresses, NamespaceManagerSettings settings, IResourceDescription[] collectionDescriptions, string[] resourceNames, TimeSpan timeout)
			{
				if (trackingContext == null || settings == null)
				{
					throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new ArgumentNullException((trackingContext == null) ? "trackingContext" : "settings"), this, EventLevel.Warning, ".ctor", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Messaging\\ServiceBusResourceOperations.cs", 1038);
				}
				List<Uri> list = baseAddresses?.ToList();
				if (list == null || list.Count == 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(SRCore.ArgumentNullOrEmpty("baseAddresses"), "baseAddresses");
				}
				TrackingContext = trackingContext;
				UriManager = new ServiceBusUriManager(list, roundRobin: true);
				Settings = settings;
				CollectionDescriptions = collectionDescriptions;
				ResourceNames = resourceNames;
				RelatedActivity = EventTraceActivity.CreateFromThread();
				timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
				AmbientTransaction = Transaction.Current;
			}

			public TimeSpan RemainingTime()
			{
				return timeoutHelper.RemainingTime();
			}

			public async Task<TResult> RunAsync(CancellationToken cancelToken)
			{
				ServiceBusEventSource.Log.Verbose(this, "RunAsync Starting", "RunAsync", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Messaging\\ServiceBusResourceOperations.cs", 1092);
				TimeSpan iterationSleep = (RetryPolicy.IsServerBusy ? RetryPolicy.ServerBusyBaseSleepTime : TimeSpan.Zero);
				if (iterationSleep >= RemainingTime())
				{
					string serverBusyExceptionMessage = RetryPolicy.ServerBusyExceptionMessage;
					await Task.Delay(RemainingTime()).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new ServerBusyException(serverBusyExceptionMessage), this, EventLevel.Warning, "RunAsync", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Messaging\\ServiceBusResourceOperations.cs", 1102);
				}
				Exception lastException = null;
				int iteration = 0;
				while (UriManager.MoveNextUri())
				{
					lastException = null;
					if (iterationSleep != TimeSpan.Zero)
					{
						await Task.Delay(iterationSleep).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					}
					CancellationTokenSource cancelTokenSource = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(cancelToken);
					try
					{
						Tuple<bool, TResult> tuple = await OnRunAsync(cancelTokenSource).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						if (tuple.Item1)
						{
							RetryPolicy.ResetServerBusy();
							ServiceBusEventSource.Log.Verbose(this, "RunAsync Completed", "RunAsync", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Messaging\\ServiceBusResourceOperations.cs", 1129);
							return tuple.Item2;
						}
					}
					catch (Exception ex) when (!Fx.IsFatal(ex))
					{
						Exception ex2 = ConvertToManagementContract(ex, cancelTokenSource.IsCancellationRequested);
						lastException = ex2;
						if (!ShouldRetry(RemainingTime(), iteration, ex2, out iterationSleep))
						{
							ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(ex2, this, EventLevel.Warning, "RunAsync", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Messaging\\ServiceBusResourceOperations.cs", 1151);
							if (ex2 != ex)
							{
								throw ex2;
							}
							throw;
						}
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteRetryPolicyIteration(TrackingContext.Activity, TrackingContext.TrackingId, RetryPolicy.GetType().Name, ToString(), iteration, iterationSleep.ToString(), ex2.GetType().FullName, ex2.Message);
					}
					finally
					{
						cancelTokenSource?.Dispose();
					}
					iteration++;
				}
				Fx.AssertAndThrow(lastException != null, "LastException should never be null here.");
				throw lastException.Rethrow();
			}

			public override string ToString()
			{
				return GetType().Name + "(" + TrackingContext.SystemTracker + ")";
			}

			protected abstract Task<Tuple<bool, TResult>> OnRunAsync(CancellationTokenSource cancelTokenSource);

			protected Exception ConvertToManagementContract(Exception exception, bool wasAborted)
			{
				Exception ex = exception;
				if (exception is WebException webException)
				{
					ex = ConvertWebException(TrackingContext, webException, TimeoutHelper.ToMilliseconds(OriginalTimeout));
				}
				else if (exception is IOException ioException)
				{
					ex = ConvertIOException(TrackingContext, ioException, TimeoutHelper.ToMilliseconds(OriginalTimeout), wasAborted);
				}
				else if (exception is XmlException)
				{
					ex = new MessagingException(SRClient.InvalidXmlFormat, exception);
				}
				if (!(ex is MessagingException) && !(ex is TimeoutException) && !(ex is ArgumentException) && !(ex is UnauthorizedAccessException) && !(ex is InvalidOperationException))
				{
					string message = TrackingContext.CreateTrackableErrorMessage(ex.Message);
					ex = new MessagingException(message, isTransientError: true, ex);
				}
				return ex;
			}

			protected HttpWebRequest CreateResourceWebRequest(Uri baseUri, string httpMethod = "GET")
			{
				Uri resourceUri = CreateResourceUri(baseUri, CollectionDescriptions, ResourceNames);
				return CreateWebRequest(baseUri, resourceUri, httpMethod);
			}

			protected HttpWebRequest CreateWebRequest(Uri baseUri, Uri resourceUri, string httpMethod = "GET")
			{
				HttpWebRequest httpWebRequest = (HttpWebRequest)WebRequest.Create(resourceUri);
				httpWebRequest.ServicePoint.MaxIdleTime = Constants.ServicePointMaxIdleTimeMilliSeconds;
				httpWebRequest.ContentType = "application/atom+xml;type=entry;charset=utf-8";
				httpWebRequest.Method = httpMethod;
				httpWebRequest.Timeout = TimeoutHelper.ToMilliseconds(OriginalTimeout);
				httpWebRequest.SetUserAgentHeader();
				httpWebRequest.AddXProcessAtHeader();
				httpWebRequest.AddAuthorizationHeader(TokenProvider, baseUri, "Manage");
				httpWebRequest.AddTrackingIdHeader(TrackingContext);
				httpWebRequest.AddCorrelationHeader(RelatedActivity);
				httpWebRequest.AddFaultInjectionHeader(Settings.FaultInjectionInfo);
				return httpWebRequest;
			}

			protected void CancelRequest(HttpWebRequest webRequest)
			{
				try
				{
					webRequest?.Abort();
				}
				catch (Exception exception) when (!Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					ServiceBusEventSource.Log.HandledException(exception, this, EventLevel.Warning, "CancelRequest", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Messaging\\ServiceBusResourceOperations.cs", 1240);
				}
			}

			protected virtual bool ShouldRetry(TimeSpan remainingTime, int iteration, Exception exception, out TimeSpan iterationSleep)
			{
				iterationSleep = TimeSpan.Zero;
				if (!TransactionExists)
				{
					return RetryPolicy.ShouldRetry(remainingTime, iteration, exception, out iterationSleep);
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal static readonly string ForbiddenInvalidOperationSubCode = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "SubCode={0}", ExceptionErrorCodes.ForbiddenInvalidOperation.ToString("D"));

		internal static Exception ConvertIOException(TrackingContext trackingContext, IOException ioException, int timeoutInMilliseconds, bool isRequestAborted)
		{
			if (isRequestAborted)
			{
				string message = SRClient.TrackableExceptionMessageFormat(SRClient.OperationRequestTimedOut(timeoutInMilliseconds), trackingContext.CreateClientTrackingExceptionInfo());
				return new TimeoutException(message, ioException);
			}
			string message2 = SRClient.TrackableExceptionMessageFormat(ioException.Message, trackingContext.CreateClientTrackingExceptionInfo());
			return new MessagingException(message2, ioException);
		}

		internal static Exception ConvertWebException(TrackingContext trackingContext, WebException webException, int timeoutInMilliseconds, bool isUpdate = false)
		{
			HttpWebResponse httpWebResponse = (HttpWebResponse)webException.Response;
			string text = webException.Message;
			try
			{
				if (httpWebResponse == null)
				{
					if (webException.Status == WebExceptionStatus.RequestCanceled || webException.Status == WebExceptionStatus.Timeout)
					{
						text = SRClient.TrackableExceptionMessageFormat(SRClient.OperationRequestTimedOut(timeoutInMilliseconds), trackingContext.CreateClientTrackingExceptionInfo());
						return new TimeoutException(text, webException);
					}
					if (webException.Status == WebExceptionStatus.ConnectFailure || webException.Status == WebExceptionStatus.NameResolutionFailure)
					{
						text = SRClient.TrackableExceptionMessageFormat(text, trackingContext.CreateClientTrackingExceptionInfo());
						return new MessagingCommunicationException(text, webException);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					ServiceBusErrorData serviceBusErrorData = ServiceBusErrorData.GetServiceBusErrorData(httpWebResponse);
					text = ((string.IsNullOrEmpty(serviceBusErrorData.Detail) || serviceBusErrorData.Detail.Equals(httpWebResponse.StatusDescription, StringComparison.Ordinal)) ? SRClient.TrackableExceptionMessageFormat(text, trackingContext.CreateClientTrackingExceptionInfo()) : string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0} {1}", text, serviceBusErrorData.Detail));
					if (httpWebResponse.StatusCode == HttpStatusCode.NotFound || httpWebResponse.StatusCode == HttpStatusCode.NoContent)
					{
						return new MessagingEntityNotFoundException(text, webException);
					}
					if (httpWebResponse.StatusCode == HttpStatusCode.Conflict)
					{
						if (httpWebResponse.Method.Equals("DELETE"))
						{
							return new MessagingException(text, webException);
						}
						if (httpWebResponse.Method.Equals("PUT") && isUpdate)
						{
							return new MessagingException(text, webException);
						}
						if (text.Contains(ConflictOperationInProgressSubCode))
						{
							return new MessagingException(text, webException);
						}
						return new MessagingEntityAlreadyExistsException(text, null, webException);
					}
					if (httpWebResponse.StatusCode == HttpStatusCode.Unauthorized)
					{
						return new UnauthorizedAccessException(text, webException);
					}
					if (httpWebResponse.StatusCode == HttpStatusCode.Forbidden)
					{
						if (text.Contains(ForbiddenInvalidOperationSubCode))
						{
							return new InvalidOperationException(text, webException);
						}
						return new QuotaExceededException(text, webException);
					}
					if (httpWebResponse.StatusCode == HttpStatusCode.BadRequest)
					{
						return new ArgumentException(text, webException);
					}
					if (httpWebResponse.StatusCode == HttpStatusCode.ServiceUnavailable)
					{
						return new ServerBusyException(text, webException);
					}
					if (httpWebResponse.StatusCode == HttpStatusCode.GatewayTimeout)
					{
						return new MessagingCommunicationException(text, webException);
					}
				}
				text = trackingContext.CreateTrackableErrorMessage(text);
				return new MessagingException(text, webException);
			}
			finally
			{
				httpWebResponse?.Close();
			}
		}

		private static Uri CreateCollectionUri(Uri baseUri, IResourceDescription[] resourceDescriptions, string[] resourceNames, ContinuationToken continuationToken, int skip, int top, string filter, NamespaceManagerSettings settings)
		{
			if (resourceDescriptions == null || resourceDescriptions.Length == 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.NullResourceDescription);
			}
			UriBuilder uriBuilder = new UriBuilder(baseUri);
			if (uriBuilder.Port == -1)
			{
				uriBuilder.Port = RelayEnvironment.RelayHttpsPort;
			}
			uriBuilder.Scheme = (settings.UseInternalCommunication ? baseUri.Scheme : Uri.UriSchemeHttps);
			MessagingUtilities.EnsureTrailingSlash(uriBuilder);
			if (resourceNames == null || resourceNames.Length == 0)
			{
				uriBuilder.Path = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}{1}/{2}", uriBuilder.Path, "$Resources", resourceDescriptions[0].CollectionName);
			}
			else
			{
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(uriBuilder.Path);
				for (int i = 0; i < resourceDescriptions.Length; i++)
				{
					if (resourceNames != null && i < resourceNames.Length)
					{
						stringBuilder.AppendFormat(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}/{1}/", resourceNames[i], resourceDescriptions[i].CollectionName);
					}
				}
				uriBuilder.Path = stringBuilder.ToString();
			}
			MessagingUtilities.EnsureTrailingSlash(uriBuilder);
			string empty = string.Empty;
			empty = ((continuationToken == null) ? string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "$skip={0}&$top={1}", skip, top) : (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(continuationToken.Token) ? string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "$top={0}", top) : string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}={1}&$top={2}", "continuationtoken", continuationToken.Token, top)));
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(filter))
			{
				empty = AddQueryParameter(empty, "$filter", HttpUtility.UrlEncode(filter));
			}
			uriBuilder.Query = AddQueryParameter(empty, "api-version", NamespaceManager.ProtocolVersion);
			return uriBuilder.Uri;
		}

		private static Uri CreateInformationUri(Uri baseUri)
		{
			UriBuilder uriBuilder = MessagingUtilities.CreateUriBuilderWithHttpsSchemeAndPort(baseUri);
			MessagingUtilities.EnsureTrailingSlash(uriBuilder);
			uriBuilder.Path = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}{1}/", uriBuilder.Path, "$protocol-version");
			return uriBuilder.Uri;
		}

		private static Uri CreateResourceUri(Uri baseUri, IResourceDescription[] resourceDescriptions, string[] resourceNames)
		{
			if (resourceNames == null || resourceNames.Length == 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.NullResourceName);
			}
			UriBuilder uriBuilder = MessagingUtilities.CreateUriBuilderWithHttpsSchemeAndPort(baseUri);
			MessagingUtilities.EnsureTrailingSlash(uriBuilder);
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.AppendFormat(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}{1}/", uriBuilder.Path, resourceNames[0]);
			for (int i = 1; i < resourceNames.Length; i++)
			{
				if (resourceDescriptions != null && i <= resourceDescriptions.Length)
				{
					if (resourceNames[i] != string.Empty)
					{
						stringBuilder.AppendFormat(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}/{1}/", resourceDescriptions[i - 1].CollectionName, resourceNames[i]);
					}
					else
					{
						stringBuilder.AppendFormat(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}/", resourceDescriptions[i - 1].CollectionName);
					}
				}
			}
			uriBuilder.Path = stringBuilder.ToString();
			string query = AddQueryParameter(string.Empty, "api-version", NamespaceManager.ProtocolVersion);
			uriBuilder.Query = query;
			return uriBuilder.Uri;
		}

		private static string AddQueryParameter(string currentQuery, string name, string value)
		{
			string text = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}={1}", name, value);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(currentQuery))
			{
				currentQuery += "&";
			}
			return currentQuery + text;
		}
	}

	{

			: base(message)

			base.IsTransient = false;
		}

			base.IsTransient = false;

		{
			base.IsTransient = false;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class SingletonManager<TSingleton> where TSingleton : class
	{
		private enum SingletonState
		{
			NeedCreate,
			Creating,
			Created
		}

		private class AsyncWaiter : Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult
		{
			private static readonly Action<object> timerCallback = TimerCallback;

			private readonly IOThreadTimer timer;

			private bool timedOut;

			private TSingleton value;

			internal AsyncWaiter(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(callback, state)
			{
				if (timeout != TimeSpan.MaxValue)
				{
					timer = new IOThreadTimer(timerCallback, this, isTypicallyCanceledShortlyAfterBeingSet: true);
					timer.Set(timeout);
				}
			}

			public static bool End(IAsyncResult asyncResult, out TSingleton result)
			{
				AsyncWaiter asyncWaiter = Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult.End<AsyncWaiter>(asyncResult);
				result = asyncWaiter.value;
				if (!asyncWaiter.timedOut)
				{
					return result != null;
				}
				return false;
			}

			public void Signal(TSingleton result, Exception completeException)
			{
				if (timer == null || timer.Cancel())
				{
					value = result;
					if (completeException == null && value == null)
					{
						completeException = new TimeoutException();
						timedOut = true;
					}
					Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: false, completeException);
				}
			}

			private static void TimerCallback(object state)
			{
				AsyncWaiter asyncWaiter = (AsyncWaiter)state;
				asyncWaiter.timedOut = true;
				asyncWaiter.Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: false);
			}
		}

		private class SingletonValidAsyncResult : CompletedAsyncResult<TSingleton>
		{
			public SingletonValidAsyncResult(TSingleton data, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(data, callback, state)
			{
			}
		}

		private readonly object syncRoot;

		private TSingleton singletonInstance;

		private SingletonState singletonState;

		private Queue<AsyncWaiter> waiters;

		protected TSingleton UnsafeInstance => singletonInstance;

		public SingletonManager(object syncRoot)
		{
			this.syncRoot = syncRoot;
			singletonState = SingletonState.NeedCreate;
		}

		public SingletonManager(object syncRoot, TSingleton initialSingleton)
		{
			this.syncRoot = syncRoot;
			singletonInstance = initialSingleton;
			singletonState = SingletonState.Created;
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginGetInstance(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			IAsyncResult asyncResult = null;
			TSingleton data = null;
			lock (syncRoot)
			{
				if (singletonState == SingletonState.NeedCreate)
				{
					singletonState = SingletonState.Creating;
					flag = true;
				}
				else if (singletonState == SingletonState.Creating)
				{
					if (waiters == null)
					{
						waiters = new Queue<AsyncWaiter>();
					}
					AsyncWaiter asyncWaiter = new AsyncWaiter(timeout, callback, state);
					waiters.Enqueue(asyncWaiter);
					asyncResult = asyncWaiter;
				}
				else
				{
					data = singletonInstance;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				try
				{
					asyncResult = OnBeginCreateInstance(timeout, callback, state);
				}
				catch (Exception completeException)
				{
					CompleteWaiters(null, completeException);
					throw;
				}
			}
			else if (asyncResult == null)
			{
				asyncResult = new SingletonValidAsyncResult(data, callback, state);
			}
			return asyncResult;
		}

		public TSingleton EndGetInstance(IAsyncResult asyncResult)
		{
			TSingleton result;
			if (asyncResult is SingletonValidAsyncResult)
			{
				result = CompletedAsyncResult<TSingleton>.End(asyncResult);
			}
			else if (asyncResult is AsyncWaiter)
			{
				if (!AsyncWaiter.End(asyncResult, out result))
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.AsWarning(new TimeoutException());
				}
			}
			else
			{
				result = null;
				Exception completeException = null;
				try
				{
					result = OnEndCreateInstance(asyncResult);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					completeException = ex;
					throw;
				}
				finally
				{
					CompleteWaiters(result, completeException);
				}
			}
			OnGetInstance(result);
			return result;
		}

		public bool Invalidate(TSingleton instanceToInvalidate)
		{
			if (instanceToInvalidate == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("instanceToInvalidate");
			}
			return InvalidateCore(instanceToInvalidate) == instanceToInvalidate;
		}

		public bool Invalidate(out TSingleton invalidatedInstance)
		{
			invalidatedInstance = InvalidateCore(null);
			return invalidatedInstance != null;
		}

		protected abstract IAsyncResult OnBeginCreateInstance(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state);

		protected abstract TSingleton OnEndCreateInstance(IAsyncResult asyncResult);

		protected virtual void OnGetInstance(TSingleton instance)
		{
		}

		private TSingleton InvalidateCore(TSingleton instanceToInvalidate)
		{
			lock (syncRoot)
			{
				if (singletonState == SingletonState.Created && (instanceToInvalidate == null || (instanceToInvalidate != null && singletonInstance == instanceToInvalidate)))
				{
					singletonState = SingletonState.NeedCreate;
					TSingleton result = singletonInstance;
					singletonInstance = null;
					return result;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void CompleteWaiters(TSingleton singleton, Exception completeException)
		{
			Queue<AsyncWaiter> queue;
			lock (syncRoot)
			{
				if (completeException == null)
				{
					singletonState = SingletonState.Created;
					singletonInstance = singleton;
				}
				else
				{
					singletonState = SingletonState.NeedCreate;
				}
				queue = waiters;
				waiters = null;
			}
			if (queue == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ExceptionInfo exceptionInfo = new ExceptionInfo(completeException);
			foreach (AsyncWaiter item in queue)
			{
				item.Signal(singleton, exceptionInfo.CreateException());
			}
		}
	}
	internal enum SubqueueType
	{
		Active = 0,
		DeadLettered = 3,
		Scheduled = 4,
		System = 5
	}

		private sealed class RetryRemoveRuleAsyncResult : RetryAsyncResult<RetryRemoveRuleAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly SubscriptionClient client;

			private readonly TrackingContext trackingContext;

			private readonly string ruleName;

			private readonly string tag;

			public RetryRemoveRuleAsyncResult(SubscriptionClient client, TrackingContext trackingContext, string ruleName, string tag, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				if (client == null)
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("client");
				}
				this.client = client;
				this.ruleName = ruleName;
				this.tag = tag;
				this.trackingContext = trackingContext ?? TrackingContext.Create(Guid.NewGuid(), this.client.Name);
			}

			public new static void End(IAsyncResult r)
			{
				AsyncResult<RetryRemoveRuleAsyncResult>.End(r);
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				int iteration = 0;
				TimeSpan iterationSleep = (client.RetryPolicy.IsServerBusy ? RetryPolicy.ServerBusyBaseSleepTime : TimeSpan.Zero);
				if (client.RetryPolicy.IsServerBusy && RetryPolicy.ServerBusyBaseSleepTime >= base.OriginalTimeout)
				{
					string serverBusyExceptionMessage = client.RetryPolicy.ServerBusyExceptionMessage;
					yield return CallAsyncSleep(RemainingTime());
					Complete(new ServerBusyException(serverBusyExceptionMessage, trackingContext));
					yield break;
				}
				bool shouldRetry;
				do
				{
					shouldRetry = false;
					if (iterationSleep != TimeSpan.Zero)
					{
						yield return CallAsyncSleep(iterationSleep);
					}
					if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ruleName))
					{
						yield return CallTransactionalAsync(base.AmbientTransaction, (BeginCall)((RetryRemoveRuleAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.client.OnBeginRemoveRule(thisPtr.ruleName, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(RetryRemoveRuleAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
						{
							thisPtr.client.OnEndRemoveRule(r);
						}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
					}
					else
					{
						yield return CallTransactionalAsync(base.AmbientTransaction, (BeginCall)((RetryRemoveRuleAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.client.OnBeginRemoveRulesByTag(thisPtr.tag, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(RetryRemoveRuleAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
						{
							thisPtr.client.OnEndRemoveRules(r);
						}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
					}
					if (base.LastAsyncStepException is MessagingEntityNotFoundException)
					{
						base.LastAsyncStepException = null;
					}
					if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
					{
						MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementExceptionPerSec(client.MessagingFactory.Address, 1, base.LastAsyncStepException);
						shouldRetry = !base.TransactionExists && client.RetryPolicy.ShouldRetry(RemainingTime(), iteration, base.LastAsyncStepException, out iterationSleep);
						if (shouldRetry)
						{
							MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
							{
								MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteRetryPolicyIteration(trackingContext.Activity, trackingContext.TrackingId, client.RetryPolicy.GetType().Name, string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ruleName) ? "RemoveRulesByTag" : "RemoveRule", iteration, iterationSleep.ToString(), base.LastAsyncStepException.GetType().FullName, base.LastAsyncStepException.Message);
							});
							iteration++;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						client.RetryPolicy.ResetServerBusy();
					}
				}
				while (shouldRetry);
				Complete(base.LastAsyncStepException);
			}
		}

			public RetryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult(SubscriptionClient client, TrackingContext trackingContext, string sessionId, ReceiveMode receiveMode, bool isExclusiveMode, Guid? lockToken, TimeSpan serverWaitTime, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)

				this.serverWaitTime = serverWaitTime;
				operationTimeout = timeout;
				this.trackingContext = trackingContext ?? TrackingContext.Create(Guid.NewGuid(), this.client.Name);
				MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementPendingAcceptMessageSessionCount(this.client.MessagingFactory.Address, 1);
			}

			public new static MessageSession End(IAsyncResult r)
			{
				RetryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult retryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult = r as RetryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult;

				{
					retryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult = AsyncResult<RetryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult>.End(r);
					return retryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult.Session;
				}
				finally
				{
					if (retryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult != null && retryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult.client != null)
					{
						MessagingPerformanceCounters.DecrementPendingAcceptMessageSessionCount(retryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult.client.MessagingFactory.Address, 1);
					}
				}
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				int iteration = 0;
				TimeSpan iterationSleep = (client.RetryPolicy.IsServerBusy ? RetryPolicy.ServerBusyBaseSleepTime : TimeSpan.Zero);

					Complete(new ServerBusyException(serverBusyExceptionMessage, trackingContext));
					yield break;
				}
				bool shouldRetry;
				do
				{
					shouldRetry = false;
					if (iterationSleep != TimeSpan.Zero)
					{
						yield return CallAsyncSleep(iterationSleep);
					}
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((RetryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.client.OnBeginAcceptMessageSession(thisPtr.sessionId, thisPtr.receiveMode, thisPtr.isExclusiveMode, thisPtr.lockToken, thisPtr.serverWaitTime, thisPtr.operationTimeout, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(RetryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.Session = thisPtr.client.OnEndAcceptMessageSession(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
					if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
					{
						MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementExceptionPerSec(client.MessagingFactory.Address, 1, base.LastAsyncStepException);
						shouldRetry = !base.TransactionExists && client.RetryPolicy.ShouldRetry(RemainingTime(), iteration, base.LastAsyncStepException, out iterationSleep);
						if (shouldRetry)
						{
							MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate

							});

					}
					else

					}
				}
				while (shouldRetry);
				Complete(base.LastAsyncStepException);
			}

		private sealed class CloseOrAbortAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<CloseOrAbortAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly SubscriptionClient owner;

			private readonly bool shouldAbort;

			public CloseOrAbortAsyncResult(SubscriptionClient owner, bool shouldAbort, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.owner = owner;
				this.shouldAbort = shouldAbort;
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				if (shouldAbort)
				{
					owner.ClientEntityManager.Abort();
				}
				else
				{
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((CloseOrAbortAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.owner.ClientEntityManager.BeginClose(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(CloseOrAbortAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.owner.ClientEntityManager.EndClose(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
				}
				if (owner.pumpHost == null)
				{
					yield break;
				}
				if (shouldAbort)
				{
					owner.pumpHost.Abort();
					yield break;
				}
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((CloseOrAbortAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.owner.pumpHost.BeginClose(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(CloseOrAbortAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					thisPtr.owner.pumpHost.EndClose(r);
				}, (Call)delegate(CloseOrAbortAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t)
				{
					thisPtr.owner.pumpHost.Close(t);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
			}
		}

		public static SubscriptionClient CreateFromConnectionString(string connectionString, string topicPath, string name, ReceiveMode mode)
		{
			KeyValueConfigurationManager keyValueConfigurationManager = new KeyValueConfigurationManager(connectionString);
			return keyValueConfigurationManager.CreateMessagingFactory().CreateSubscriptionClient(topicPath, name, mode);
		}

		private IAsyncResult BeginCreateReceiver(string subQueuePath, ReceiveMode receiveMode, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			string entityName = EntityNameHelper.FormatSubQueueEntityName(Name);
			if (openOnceManager.ShouldOpen)
			{
				return openOnceManager.Begin(callback, state, (Func<AsyncCallback, object, IAsyncResult>)((AsyncCallback c, object s) => OnBeginCreateReceiver(subQueuePath, entityName, receiveMode, timeout, c, s)), (Func<IAsyncResult, MessageReceiver>)OnEndCreateReceiver);
			}
			return OnBeginCreateReceiver(subQueuePath, entityName, receiveMode, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		private IAsyncResult BeginCreateReceiver(ReceiveMode receiveMode, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			if (openOnceManager.ShouldOpen)
			{
				return openOnceManager.Begin(callback, state, (Func<AsyncCallback, object, IAsyncResult>)((AsyncCallback c, object s) => OnBeginCreateReceiver(receiveMode, timeout, c, s)), (Func<IAsyncResult, MessageReceiver>)OnEndCreateReceiver);
			}
			return OnBeginCreateReceiver(receiveMode, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		private MessageReceiver EndCreateReceiver(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			MessageReceiver messageReceiver = ((!OpenOnceManager.ShouldEnd<MessageReceiver>(result)) ? OnEndCreateReceiver(result) : OpenOnceManager.End<MessageReceiver>(result));
			messageReceiver.ShouldLinkRetryPolicy = true;
			RegisterMessageClientEntity(messageReceiver);
			return messageReceiver;
		}

				{
					RetryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult retryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult2 = new RetryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult(this, null, sessionId, Mode, isExclusiveMode, lockToken, serverWaitTime, timeout, c, s);
					retryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult2.Start();

				}, (Func<IAsyncResult, MessageSession>)RetryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult.End);
			}
			RetryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult retryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult = new RetryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult(this, null, sessionId, Mode, isExclusiveMode, lockToken, serverWaitTime, timeout, callback, state);
			retryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult.Start();
			return retryAcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult;
		}

		internal IAsyncResult BeginAddRule(RuleDescription description, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			if (description == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNull("description");
			}
			MessagingFactory.CheckValidEntityName(description.Name, 50, allowSeparator: false, "description.Name");
			if (openOnceManager.ShouldOpen)
			{
				return openOnceManager.Begin(callback, state, (AsyncCallback c, object s) => OnBeginAddRule(description, timeout, c, s), OnEndAddRule);
			}
			return OnBeginAddRule(description, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		internal void EndAddRule(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (OpenOnceManager.ShouldEnd(result))
			{
				OpenOnceManager.End(result);
			}
			else
			{
				OnEndAddRule(result);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnAbort()
		{
			CloseOrAbortAsyncResult closeOrAbortAsyncResult = new CloseOrAbortAsyncResult(this, shouldAbort: true, TimeSpan.MaxValue, null, null);
			closeOrAbortAsyncResult.RunSynchronously();
		}

		protected override void OnClose(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			CloseOrAbortAsyncResult closeOrAbortAsyncResult = new CloseOrAbortAsyncResult(this, shouldAbort: false, timeout, null, null);
			closeOrAbortAsyncResult.RunSynchronously();
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			CloseOrAbortAsyncResult closeOrAbortAsyncResult = new CloseOrAbortAsyncResult(this, shouldAbort: false, timeout, callback, state);
			return closeOrAbortAsyncResult.Start();
		}

		protected override void OnEndClose(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			AsyncResult<CloseOrAbortAsyncResult>.End(result);
		}

		private void ThrowIfBrowserNull(string operationName)
		{
			EnsureCreateInternalBrowser();
			if (InternalBrowser == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException(SRCore.UnsupportedOperation(operationName)));
			}
		}

		private void ThrowIfReceiverNull(string operationName)
		{
			EnsureCreateInternalReceiver();
			if (InternalReceiver == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException(SRCore.UnsupportedOperation(operationName)));
			}
		}

		private void EnsureCreateInternalReceiver()
		{
			if (InternalReceiver != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			lock (base.ThisLock)
			{
				if (InternalReceiver == null)
				{
					if (!IsSubQueue)
					{
						InternalReceiver = EndCreateReceiver(BeginCreateReceiver(Mode, MessagingFactory.OperationTimeout, null, null));
					}
					else
					{
						InternalReceiver = EndCreateReceiver(BeginCreateReceiver(SubscriptionPath, Mode, MessagingFactory.OperationTimeout, null, null));
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void EnsureCreateInternalBrowser()
		{
			if (InternalBrowser != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			lock (base.ThisLock)
			{
				if (InternalBrowser == null)
				{
					InternalBrowser = EndCreateBrowser(BeginCreateBrowser(MessagingFactory.OperationTimeout, null, null));
				}
			}
		}
	}

		internal SubscriptionDescription()

		internal override void OverrideEntityStatus(EntityStatus status)
		{
			Status = status;
		}

		internal override void OverrideEntityAvailabilityStatus(EntityAvailabilityStatus availabilityStatus)
		{
			InternalAvailabilityStatus = availabilityStatus;
		}

		internal override void UpdateForVersion(ApiVersion version, EntityDescription existingDescription = null)
		{
			SubscriptionDescription subscriptionDescription = existingDescription as SubscriptionDescription;
			base.UpdateForVersion(version, existingDescription);
			if (version < ApiVersion.Two)
			{
				InternalStatus = subscriptionDescription?.InternalStatus;
				InternalForwardTo = subscriptionDescription?.InternalForwardTo;
				InternalCreatedAt = subscriptionDescription?.InternalCreatedAt;
				InternalUpdatedAt = subscriptionDescription?.InternalUpdatedAt;
				InternalAccessedAt = subscriptionDescription?.InternalAccessedAt;
				InternalUserMetadata = subscriptionDescription?.InternalUserMetadata;
				InternalMessageCountDetails = subscriptionDescription?.InternalMessageCountDetails;
			}
			if (version < ApiVersion.Three)
			{
				if (Status == EntityStatus.ReceiveDisabled || Status == EntityStatus.SendDisabled)
				{
					Status = EntityStatus.Active;
				}
				InternalAutoDeleteOnIdle = subscriptionDescription?.InternalAutoDeleteOnIdle;
			}
			if (version < ApiVersion.Four)
			{
				InternalAvailabilityStatus = subscriptionDescription?.InternalAvailabilityStatus;
			}
			if (version < ApiVersion.Eight)
			{
				InternalForwardDeadLetteredMessagesTo = subscriptionDescription?.InternalForwardDeadLetteredMessagesTo;
			}
			if (version < MinimalApiVersionFor.ClientAffineSubscriberSupport)
			{
				InternalIsClientAffine = subscriptionDescription?.InternalIsClientAffine;
				InternalClientAffineProperties = subscriptionDescription?.InternalClientAffineProperties;
			}
		}

		internal override bool IsValidForVersion(ApiVersion version)
		{
			if (!base.IsValidForVersion(version))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (version < ApiVersion.Two && (InternalStatus.HasValue || InternalForwardTo != null || InternalCreatedAt.HasValue || InternalUpdatedAt.HasValue || InternalAccessedAt.HasValue || InternalUserMetadata != null || InternalMessageCountDetails != null))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (version < ApiVersion.Three)
			{
				if (InternalAutoDeleteOnIdle.HasValue)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (Status != EntityStatus.SendDisabled)
				{
					return Status != EntityStatus.ReceiveDisabled;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (version < ApiVersion.Four && InternalAvailabilityStatus.HasValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (version < ApiVersion.Eight && InternalForwardDeadLetteredMessagesTo != null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (version < MinimalApiVersionFor.ClientAffineSubscriberSupport && (InternalClientAffineProperties != null || InternalIsClientAffine.HasValue))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	[DataContract(Name = "PartitionDescription", Namespace = "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2010/10/servicebus/connect")]
	public sealed class PartitionDescription : EntityDescription, IResourceDescription
	{
		private string eventHubPath;

		private string partitionId;

		private string consumerGroupName;

		public string PartitionId
		{
			get
			{
				return partitionId;
			}
			internal set
			{
				ThrowIfReadOnly();
				if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))

		{
		}

		internal override void UpdateForVersion(ApiVersion version, EntityDescription existingDescription = null)
		{
			PartitionDescription partitionDescription = existingDescription as PartitionDescription;
			base.UpdateForVersion(version, existingDescription);
			if (version < ApiVersion.Twelve)
			{
				InternalLastEnqueuedOffset = partitionDescription?.InternalLastEnqueuedOffset;
				InternalLastEnqueuedTimeUtc = partitionDescription?.InternalLastEnqueuedTimeUtc;
			}
		}

		internal override bool IsValidForVersion(ApiVersion version)
		{
			if (!base.IsValidForVersion(version))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (version < ApiVersion.Eight)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (version < ApiVersion.Twelve)
			{
				if (InternalLastEnqueuedOffset != null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (InternalLastEnqueuedTimeUtc.HasValue)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

	public sealed class MessageCountDetails
	{
		private long activeMessageCount;

		private long deadLetterMessageCount;

		private long scheduledMessageCount;

		private long transferMessageCount;

		private long transferDeadLetterMessageCount;

		[DataMember(Order = 65537)]
		public long ActiveMessageCount

		public long ScheduledMessageCount

		}

		[DataMember(Order = 65540)]
		public long TransferMessageCount
		{
			get

				return transferMessageCount;
			}
			private set
			{
				transferMessageCount = value;
			}
		}

		[DataMember(Order = 65541)]
		public long TransferDeadLetterMessageCount
		{

			}
			private set

				transferDeadLetterMessageCount = value;
			}
		}

		public MessageCountDetails()
			: this(0L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 0L)
		{
		}

		public MessageCountDetails(long activeMessageCount, long deadletterMessageCount, long scheduledMessageCount, long transferMessageCount, long transferDlqMessageCount)
		{
			ActiveMessageCount = activeMessageCount;
			DeadLetterMessageCount = deadletterMessageCount;
			ScheduledMessageCount = scheduledMessageCount;
			TransferMessageCount = transferMessageCount;
			TransferDeadLetterMessageCount = transferDlqMessageCount;
		}

		internal void InitializeMessageCounts(long initialActiveMessageCount, long initialScheduledMessageCount, long initialDeadLetterMessageCount, long initialTransferMessageCount = 0L, long initialTransferDeadLetterMessageCount = 0L)
		{
			Interlocked.Exchange(ref activeMessageCount, initialActiveMessageCount);
			Interlocked.Exchange(ref scheduledMessageCount, initialScheduledMessageCount);
			Interlocked.Exchange(ref deadLetterMessageCount, initialDeadLetterMessageCount);
			Interlocked.Exchange(ref transferMessageCount, initialTransferMessageCount);
			Interlocked.Exchange(ref transferDeadLetterMessageCount, initialTransferDeadLetterMessageCount);
		}

		internal void AddMessageCounts(long activeMessageDelta, long scheduledMessageDelta, long deadLetterMessageDelta = 0L, long transferMessageDelta = 0L, long transferDeadLetterMessageDelta = 0L)
		{
			AddMessageCount(ref activeMessageCount, activeMessageDelta);
			AddMessageCount(ref scheduledMessageCount, scheduledMessageDelta);
			AddMessageCount(ref deadLetterMessageCount, deadLetterMessageDelta);
			AddMessageCount(ref transferMessageCount, transferMessageDelta);
			AddMessageCount(ref transferDeadLetterMessageCount, transferDeadLetterMessageDelta);
		}

		private static void AddMessageCount(ref long value, long delta)
		{
			if (delta != 0L)
			{
				Interlocked.Add(ref value, delta);
			}
		}
	}
	internal sealed class ThrottledBufferManager
	{
		private sealed class WrappedBufferManager : InternalBufferManager
		{
			private ThrottledBufferManager ThrottledBufferManager { get; set; }

			public WrappedBufferManager(ThrottledBufferManager bufferManager)
			{
				ThrottledBufferManager = bufferManager;
			}

			public override void Clear()
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new NotImplementedException());
			}

			public override void ReturnBuffer(byte[] buffer)
			{
				ThrottledBufferManager.ReturnBuffer(buffer);
			}

			public override byte[] TakeBuffer(int bufferSize)
			{
				ThrottledBufferManager.TryTakeBuffer(bufferSize, out var buffer);
				return buffer;
			}
		}

		private const int DefaultMaxSize = 104857600;

		private static readonly object syncLock = new object();

		private static ThrottledBufferManager instance;

		private readonly InternalBufferManager bufferManager;

		private long currentAllocationSize;

		private InternalBufferManager ProxyBufferManager { get; set; }

		private ThrottledBufferManager(int maxSize)
		{
			bufferManager = InternalBufferManager.CreatePooledBufferManager(maxSize, int.MaxValue);
			ProxyBufferManager = new WrappedBufferManager(this);
		}

		public static InternalBufferManager GetBufferManager()
		{
			return GetThrottledBufferManager().ProxyBufferManager;
		}

		public static ThrottledBufferManager GetThrottledBufferManager()
		{
			return GetThrottledBufferManager(104857600);
		}

		public static ThrottledBufferManager GetThrottledBufferManager(int maxSize)
		{
			if (instance == null)
			{
				lock (syncLock)
				{
					if (instance == null)
					{
						instance = new ThrottledBufferManager(maxSize);
					}
				}
			}
			return instance;
		}

		public bool TryTakeBuffer(int bufferSize, out byte[] buffer)
		{
			buffer = bufferManager.TakeBuffer(bufferSize);
			Interlocked.Add(ref currentAllocationSize, buffer.Length);
			return true;
		}

		public void ReturnBuffer(byte[] buffer)
		{
			Interlocked.Add(ref currentAllocationSize, -buffer.Length);
			bufferManager.ReturnBuffer(buffer);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class MessagingAddress
	{
		internal const string UriScheme = "sb";

		private const string EntityVariableName = "entityname";

		private static readonly UriTemplate CanonicalAddressTemplate = new UriTemplate("applications/{appid}/modules/{modname}/components/{compname}/exports/{exportname}");

		private static readonly UriTemplate CanonicalAddressWithEntityNameTemplate = new UriTemplate("applications/{appid}/modules/{modname}/components/{compname}/exports/{exportname}/{entityname}");

		private static readonly UriTemplate PublishedAddressTemplate = new UriTemplate("applications/{appid}/{containername}");

		private static readonly UriTemplate PublishedAddressWithEntityNameTemplate = new UriTemplate("applications/{appid}/{containername}/{entityname}");

		private readonly bool preservePathSegmentAsBaseAddress;

		public Uri NormalizedLogicalAddress { get; private set; }

		public Uri NamingAuthority { get; private set; }

		public Uri ResourceAddress { get; private set; }

		public string EntityName { get; private set; }

		public MessagingAddressType Type { get; private set; }

		public MessagingAddress(Uri logicalAddress, bool preservePathSegmentAsBaseAddress)
		{
			this.preservePathSegmentAsBaseAddress = preservePathSegmentAsBaseAddress;
			Initialize(logicalAddress);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return NormalizedLogicalAddress.AbsoluteUri;
		}

		private static Uri RemoveTrailingSlash(Uri uri)
		{
			string absoluteUri = uri.AbsoluteUri;
			if (absoluteUri.EndsWith("/", StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				return new Uri(absoluteUri.Substring(0, absoluteUri.Length - 1));
			}
			return uri;
		}

		private void SetNamingAuthority(Uri logicalAddress)
		{
			Uri uri = new UriBuilder(logicalAddress.Scheme, logicalAddress.Host, logicalAddress.Port).Uri;
			NamingAuthority = uri;
		}

		private Uri GetResourceAddress(Uri normalizedAddress)
		{
			return new Uri(NamingAuthority, normalizedAddress.PathAndQuery);
		}

		private void Initialize(Uri logicalAddress)
		{
			SetNamingAuthority(logicalAddress);
			Uri uri = new Uri(logicalAddress.Scheme + Uri.SchemeDelimiter + logicalAddress.Authority);
			logicalAddress = RemoveTrailingSlash(logicalAddress);
			UriTemplateMatch uriTemplateMatch;
			if ((uriTemplateMatch = CanonicalAddressTemplate.Match(uri, logicalAddress)) != null)
			{
				NormalizedLogicalAddress = logicalAddress;
				Type = MessagingAddressType.Container;
			}
			else if ((uriTemplateMatch = CanonicalAddressWithEntityNameTemplate.Match(uri, logicalAddress)) != null)
			{
				string[] segments = logicalAddress.Segments;
				NormalizedLogicalAddress = new Uri(uri, string.Join(string.Empty, segments, 0, segments.Length - 1));
				Type = MessagingAddressType.Entity;
				EntityName = uriTemplateMatch.BoundVariables["entityname"];
			}
			else if ((uriTemplateMatch = PublishedAddressTemplate.Match(uri, logicalAddress)) != null)
			{
				NormalizedLogicalAddress = logicalAddress;
				Type = MessagingAddressType.Container;
			}
			else if ((uriTemplateMatch = PublishedAddressWithEntityNameTemplate.Match(uri, logicalAddress)) != null)
			{
				string[] segments2 = logicalAddress.Segments;
				NormalizedLogicalAddress = new Uri(uri, string.Join(string.Empty, segments2, 0, segments2.Length - 1));
				Type = MessagingAddressType.Entity;
				EntityName = uriTemplateMatch.BoundVariables["entityname"];
			}
			else
			{
				string[] segments3 = logicalAddress.Segments;
				int num = 1;
				if (preservePathSegmentAsBaseAddress && segments3.Length > 2)
				{
					num = 2;
				}
				Type = MessagingAddressType.Entity;
				EntityName = string.Join(string.Empty, segments3, num, segments3.Length - num);
				NormalizedLogicalAddress = new Uri(uri, string.Join(string.Empty, segments3, 0, num));
			}
			NormalizedLogicalAddress = RemoveTrailingSlash(NormalizedLogicalAddress);
			ResourceAddress = GetResourceAddress(NormalizedLogicalAddress);
		}
	}

	}
