		public static CommunicationException ConvertToCommunicationException(MessagingException exception)
		{
			bool shouldFault;
			return ConvertToCommunicationException(exception, out shouldFault);
		}

		public static CommunicationException ConvertToCommunicationException(MessagingException exception, out bool shouldFault)
		{
			shouldFault = false;
			if (exception is MessagingEntityNotFoundException)
			{
				shouldFault = true;
				return new EndpointNotFoundException(exception.Message, exception);
			}
			if (exception is MessagingCommunicationException && exception.InnerException is EndpointNotFoundException result)
			{
				shouldFault = true;
				return result;
			}
			CommunicationException ex = exception.InnerException as CommunicationException;
			if (ex == null)
			{
				ex = new CommunicationException(exception.Message, exception);
			}
			return ex;
		}

		public static HttpStatusCode ConvertStatusCodeFromDetail(string type)
		{
			if (ErrorCodes.TryGetValue(type, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return HttpStatusCode.InternalServerError;
		}

		public static Exception UnwrapWithoutInnerFault(CommunicationException exception, bool isCancelling)
		{
			return Unwrap(exception, isCancelling, includeFaultAsInnerException: false);
		}

		public static Exception UnwrapWithoutInnerFault(CommunicationException exception)
		{
			return Unwrap(exception, isCancelling: false, includeFaultAsInnerException: false);
		}

		public static Exception Unwrap(CommunicationException exception, bool isCancelling)
		{
			return Unwrap(exception, isCancelling, includeFaultAsInnerException: true);
		}

		public static Exception Unwrap(CommunicationException exception)
		{
			return Unwrap(exception, isCancelling: false, includeFaultAsInnerException: true);
		}

		internal static MessagingErrorSubCode GetSubCodeFromDetail(Exception exception)
		{
			if (exception is ServerBusyException ex)
			{
				return ex.SubCode;
			}
			return MessagingErrorSubCode.Unknown;
		}

		private static Exception Unwrap(CommunicationException exception, bool isCancelling, bool includeFaultAsInnerException)
		{
			if (isCancelling)
			{
				if (exception is CommunicationObjectAbortedException)
				{
					return new OperationCanceledException(SRClient.EntityClosedOrAborted, exception);
				}
				return new OperationCanceledException(SRClient.EntityClosedOrAborted, Unwrap(exception));
			}
			if (exception == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (exception is FaultException faultException)
			{
				return Unwrap(faultException, includeFaultAsInnerException);
			}
			if (exception is EndpointNotFoundException ex)
			{
				return new MessagingCommunicationException(ex.Message, ex);
			}
			if (exception is CommunicationObjectAbortedException)
			{
				return new OperationCanceledException(SRClient.EntityClosedOrAborted, exception);
			}
			if (exception is CommunicationObjectFaultedException)
			{
				return new MessagingCommunicationException(SRClient.MessagingCommunicationError, exception);
			}
			return new MessagingCommunicationException(exception.Message, exception);
		}

		public static bool IsWrappedExceptionTransient(this Exception exception)
		{
			if (exception is CommunicationException exception2)
			{
				Exception ex = Unwrap(exception2);
				if (!(ex is MessagingException { IsTransient: var isTransient }))
				{
					if (ex is TimeoutException)
					{
						return true;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return isTransient;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static Exception Unwrap(FaultException faultException, bool includeFaultExceptionAsInnerException = true)
		{
			if (faultException is FaultException<ExceptionDetailNoStackTrace> { Detail: not null } ex)
			{
				string type = ex.Detail.Type;
				return ConvertExceptionFromDetail(type, ex, includeFaultExceptionAsInnerException);
			}
			if (faultException is FaultException<ExceptionDetail> { Detail: not null } ex2)
			{
				string type2 = ex2.Detail.Type;
				return ConvertExceptionFromDetail(type2, ex2, includeFaultExceptionAsInnerException);
			}
			return ConvertExceptionFromStatusCode(faultException);
		}

		private static Exception ConvertExceptionFromStatusCode(FaultException faultException)
		{
			FaultCode subCode = faultException.Code.SubCode;
			if (subCode == null)
			{
				return new MessagingException(faultException.Message, faultException);
			}
			if (faultException.Code.SubCode.Name.Equals("ConnectionFailedFault", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				return new TimeoutException(faultException.Message, faultException);
			}
			if (faultException.Code.SubCode.Name.Equals("EndpointNotFoundFault", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				return new MessagingEntityNotFoundException(faultException.Message, faultException);
			}
			if (faultException.Code.SubCode.Name.Equals("AuthorizationFailedFault", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || faultException.Code.SubCode.Name.Equals("NoTransportSecurityFault", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				return new UnauthorizedAccessException(faultException.Message, faultException);
			}
			if (faultException.Code.SubCode.Name.Equals("QuotaExceededFault", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				return new QuotaExceededException(faultException.Message, faultException);
			}
			if (faultException.Code.SubCode.Name.Equals("PartitionNotOwnedException", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				return new PartitionNotOwnedException(faultException.Message, faultException);
			}
			return new MessagingException(faultException.Message, faultException);
		}

		private static Exception ConvertExceptionFromDetail(string type, FaultException exceptionDetailFaultException, bool includeFaultExceptionAsInnerException = true)
		{
			return CreateException(type, exceptionDetailFaultException.Message, includeFaultExceptionAsInnerException ? exceptionDetailFaultException : null);
		}

		internal static Exception CreateException(string type, string exceptionMessage, Exception innerException = null)
		{
			if (string.Equals(type, typeof(TimeoutException).FullName, StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				return new TimeoutException(exceptionMessage, innerException);
			}
			if (string.Equals(type, typeof(ArgumentException).FullName, StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				return new ArgumentException(exceptionMessage, innerException);
			}
			if (string.Equals(type, typeof(ArgumentNullException).FullName, StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				return new ArgumentNullException(exceptionMessage, innerException);
			}
			if (string.Equals(type, typeof(ArgumentOutOfRangeException).FullName, StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				return new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(exceptionMessage, innerException);
			}
			if (string.Equals(type, typeof(MessageLockLostException).FullName, StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				return new MessageLockLostException(exceptionMessage, innerException);
			}
			if (string.Equals(type, typeof(SessionLockLostException).FullName, StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				return new SessionLockLostException(exceptionMessage, innerException);
			}
			if (string.Equals(type, typeof(MessageNotFoundException).FullName, StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				return new MessageNotFoundException(exceptionMessage, innerException);
			}
			if (string.Equals(type, typeof(MessagingEntityNotFoundException).FullName, StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				return new MessagingEntityNotFoundException(exceptionMessage, innerException);
			}
			if (string.Equals(type, typeof(MessagingEntityAlreadyExistsException).FullName, StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				return new MessagingEntityAlreadyExistsException(exceptionMessage, null, innerException);
			}
			if (string.Equals(type, typeof(MessageStoreLockLostException).FullName, StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				return new MessageStoreLockLostException(exceptionMessage, innerException);
			}
			if (string.Equals(type, typeof(UnauthorizedAccessException).FullName, StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				return new UnauthorizedAccessException(exceptionMessage, innerException);
			}
			if (string.Equals(type, typeof(AuthorizationFailedException).FullName, StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				return new AuthorizationFailedException(exceptionMessage, innerException);
			}
			if (string.Equals(type, typeof(TransactionSizeExceededException).FullName, StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				return new TransactionSizeExceededException(exceptionMessage, innerException);
			}
			if (string.Equals(type, typeof(QuotaExceededException).FullName, StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				return new QuotaExceededException(exceptionMessage, innerException);
			}
			if (string.Equals(type, typeof(RuleActionException).FullName, StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				return new RuleActionException(exceptionMessage, innerException);
			}
			if (string.Equals(type, typeof(FilterException).FullName, StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				return new FilterException(exceptionMessage, innerException);
			}
			if (string.Equals(type, typeof(SessionCannotBeLockedException).FullName, StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				return new SessionCannotBeLockedException(exceptionMessage, innerException);
			}
			if (string.Equals(type, typeof(PartitionNotOwnedException).FullName, StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				return new PartitionNotOwnedException(exceptionMessage, innerException);
			}
			if (string.Equals(type, typeof(ServerBusyException).FullName, StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				return new ServerBusyException(exceptionMessage, innerException);
			}
			if (string.Equals(type, typeof(InvalidOperationException).FullName, StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				return new InvalidOperationException(exceptionMessage.Replace("BR0012", string.Empty), innerException);
			}
			if (string.Equals(type, typeof(EndpointNotFoundException).FullName, StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				return new MessagingException(exceptionMessage, innerException);
			}
			if (string.Equals(type, typeof(MessagingEntityDisabledException).FullName, StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				return new MessagingEntityDisabledException(exceptionMessage, innerException);
			}
			if (string.Equals(type, typeof(PublisherRevokedException).FullName, StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				return new PublisherRevokedException(exceptionMessage, innerException);
			}
			if (string.Equals(type, typeof(NoMatchingSubscriptionException).FullName, StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				return new NoMatchingSubscriptionException(exceptionMessage, innerException);
			}
			if (string.Equals(type, typeof(MessagingEntityMovedException).FullName, StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				return new MessagingEntityMovedException(exceptionMessage, innerException);
			}
			if (string.Equals(type, typeof(MessagingCommunicationException).FullName, StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				return new MessagingCommunicationException(exceptionMessage, innerException);
			}
			if (string.Equals(type, typeof(MessageSizeExceededException).FullName, StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				return new MessageSizeExceededException(exceptionMessage, innerException);
			}
			if (string.Equals(type, typeof(ReceiverDisconnectedException).FullName, StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				return new ReceiverDisconnectedException(exceptionMessage, innerException);
			}
			if (string.Equals(type, typeof(InternalServerErrorException).FullName, StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				return new MessagingException(exceptionMessage, innerException);
			}
			if (string.Equals(type, typeof(InvalidLinkTypeException).FullName, StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				return new MessagingException(exceptionMessage, innerException);
			}
			if (string.Equals(type, typeof(SoapActionNotSupportedException).FullName, StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				return new MessagingException(exceptionMessage, innerException);
			}
			if (string.Equals(type, typeof(TransactionMessagingException).FullName, StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				return new MessagingException(exceptionMessage, innerException);
			}
			if (string.Equals(type, typeof(ManagementConflictOperationException).FullName, StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				return new ManagementConflictOperationException(exceptionMessage, innerException);
			}
			return new MessagingException(exceptionMessage, innerException);
		}
	}

		private sealed class HeaderSerializationItem
		{
			public FieldId FieldId { get; private set; }

			public MessageMembers MessageMember { get; private set; }

			public PropertyValueType ValueType { get; private set; }

			public Func<BrokeredMessage, object> Accessor { get; private set; }

			public Func<BrokeredMessage, SerializationTarget, byte[]> Extractor { get; private set; }

			public HeaderSerializationItem(FieldId fieldId, MessageMembers messageMember, PropertyValueType valueType, Func<BrokeredMessage, object> accessor, Func<BrokeredMessage, SerializationTarget, byte[]> extractor)
			{
				FieldId = fieldId;
				MessageMember = messageMember;
				ValueType = valueType;
				Accessor = accessor;
				Extractor = extractor;
			}

			public bool IsHeaderPresent(BrokeredMessage message)
			{
				return (message.initializedMembers & MessageMember) != 0;
			}

			public int GetSize(BrokeredMessage message)
			{
				return SerializationUtilities.GetTypeSize(ValueType, Accessor(message));
			}
		}

		public string CorrelationId
		{
			get
			{
				ThrowIfDisposed();
				EnsureHeaderDeserialized();
				return correlationId;
			}
			set
			{
				ThrowIfDisposed();
				correlationId = value;
				if (value == null)
				{
					ClearInitializedMember(MessageMembers.CorrelationId);
				}
				else
				{
					SetInitializedMember(MessageMembers.CorrelationId);
				}
			}
		}

				return sessionId;
			}

				if (version >= MessageVersion8)
				{
					PartitionKey = value;
				}
			}

		internal string Publisher
		{
			get
			{
				ThrowIfDisposed();
				EnsureHeaderDeserialized();
				return publisher;
			}
			set
			{
				ThrowIfDisposed();
				ValidatePartitionKey("Publisher", value);
				if (value != null)
				{
					ThrowIfDominatingPropertyIsNotEqualToNonNullDormantProperty(MessageMembers.Publisher, MessageMembers.PartitionKey, value, partitionKey);
				}
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
				{
					ClearInitializedMember(MessageMembers.Publisher);
				}
				else
				{
					SetInitializedMember(MessageMembers.Publisher);
				}
				if (version < MessageVersion10)
				{
					version = MessageVersion10;
				}
				publisher = value;
			}
		}

		public DateTime ExpiresAtUtc
		{
			get
			{
				ThrowIfDisposed();
				ThrowIfNotReceived();
				if (RecordedExpiredAtUtc.HasValue)
				{
					return RecordedExpiredAtUtc.Value;
				}
				if (TimeToLive >= DateTime.MaxValue.Subtract(enqueuedTimeUtc))
				{
					return DateTime.MaxValue;
				}
				return EnqueuedTimeUtc.Add(TimeToLive);
			}
		}

		{

		internal bool IsConsumed
		{
			get
			{
				return Interlocked.Exchange(ref messageConsumed, 1) == 1;
			}
			set
			{
				int value2 = (value ? 1 : 0);
				Interlocked.Exchange(ref messageConsumed, value2);
			}
		}

		internal bool SupportsEmptySerializedHeader
		{
			get
			{
				if (supportsEmptySerializedHeader.HasValue && !supportsEmptySerializedHeader.Value)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (originalDeliveryCount.HasValue && receiverHeaders != null && DeliveryCount != originalDeliveryCount)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (ArePropertiesModifiedByBroker)
				{
					return false;
				}
				MessageMembers messageMembers = InitializedMembers | (MessageMembers.MessageId | MessageMembers.EnqueuedTimeUtc | MessageMembers.SequenceNumber | MessageMembers.DeliveryCount | MessageMembers.EnqueuedSequenceNumber);
				return messageMembers == (MessageMembers.MessageId | MessageMembers.EnqueuedTimeUtc | MessageMembers.SequenceNumber | MessageMembers.DeliveryCount | MessageMembers.EnqueuedSequenceNumber);
			}
			set
			{
				supportsEmptySerializedHeader = value;
			}
		}

		internal bool SupportsEmptySerializedHeaderInFileStore
		{
			get
			{
				if (supportsEmptySerializedHeader.HasValue && !supportsEmptySerializedHeader.Value)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (originalDeliveryCount.HasValue && receiverHeaders != null && DeliveryCount != originalDeliveryCount)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (ArePropertiesModifiedByBroker)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsPingMessage
		{
			get
			{
				if (ContentType != null)
				{
					return string.Equals("application/vnd.ms-servicebus-ping", ContentType, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private static HeaderSerializationItem CreateHeaderSerializationItem(FieldId fieldId, MessageMembers messageMember, PropertyValueType propertyValueType, Func<BrokeredMessage, object> propertyAccessor)
		{
			return new HeaderSerializationItem(fieldId, messageMember, propertyValueType, propertyAccessor, (BrokeredMessage message, SerializationTarget serializationTarget) => SerializationUtilities.ConvertNativeValueToByteArray(message.version, propertyValueType, propertyAccessor(message)));
		}

		private static HeaderSerializationItem[] BuildHeaderSerializationItems(BrokeredMessageMode type)
		{
			return new HeaderSerializationItem[34]
			{
				CreateHeaderSerializationItem(FieldId.MessageId, MessageMembers.MessageId, PropertyValueType.String, (BrokeredMessage msg) => msg.MessageId),
				CreateHeaderSerializationItem(FieldId.CorrelationId, MessageMembers.CorrelationId, PropertyValueType.String, (BrokeredMessage msg) => msg.CorrelationId),
				CreateHeaderSerializationItem(FieldId.SessionId, MessageMembers.SessionId, PropertyValueType.String, (BrokeredMessage msg) => msg.SessionId),
				CreateHeaderSerializationItem(FieldId.TimeToLive, MessageMembers.TimeToLive, PropertyValueType.TimeSpan, (BrokeredMessage msg) => msg.TimeToLive),
				CreateHeaderSerializationItem(FieldId.ReplyTo, MessageMembers.ReplyTo, PropertyValueType.String, (BrokeredMessage msg) => msg.ReplyTo),
				CreateHeaderSerializationItem(FieldId.To, MessageMembers.To, PropertyValueType.String, (BrokeredMessage msg) => msg.To),
				CreateHeaderSerializationItem(FieldId.ReplyToSessionId, MessageMembers.ReplyToSessionId, PropertyValueType.String, (BrokeredMessage msg) => msg.ReplyToSessionId),
				CreateHeaderSerializationItem(FieldId.EnqueuedTimeUtc, MessageMembers.EnqueuedTimeUtc, PropertyValueType.DateTime, (BrokeredMessage msg) => msg.EnqueuedTimeUtc),
				CreateHeaderSerializationItem(FieldId.ScheduledEnqueueTimeUtc, MessageMembers.ScheduledEnqueueTimeUtc, PropertyValueType.DateTime, (BrokeredMessage msg) => msg.ScheduledEnqueueTimeUtc),
				(type == BrokeredMessageMode.Broker) ? new HeaderSerializationItem(FieldId.SequenceNumber, MessageMembers.SequenceNumber, PropertyValueType.Int64, (BrokeredMessage msg) => msg.SequenceNumber, delegate(BrokeredMessage message, SerializationTarget serializationTarget)
				{
					long num = message.SequenceNumber;
					if (serializationTarget == SerializationTarget.Communication && message.HasHeader(MessageMembers.PartitionId))
					{
						num = ((long)message.PartitionId << 48) + message.SequenceNumber;
					}
					return SerializationUtilities.ConvertNativeValueToByteArray(message.version, PropertyValueType.Int64, num);
				}) : CreateHeaderSerializationItem(FieldId.SequenceNumber, MessageMembers.SequenceNumber, PropertyValueType.Int64, (BrokeredMessage msg) => msg.SequenceNumber),
				CreateHeaderSerializationItem(FieldId.LockToken, MessageMembers.LockToken, PropertyValueType.Guid, (BrokeredMessage msg) => msg.LockToken),
				CreateHeaderSerializationItem(FieldId.LockedUntilUtc, MessageMembers.LockedUntilUtc, PropertyValueType.DateTime, (BrokeredMessage msg) => msg.LockedUntilUtc),
				CreateHeaderSerializationItem(FieldId.DeliveryCount, MessageMembers.DeliveryCount, PropertyValueType.Int32, (BrokeredMessage msg) => msg.DeliveryCount),
				CreateHeaderSerializationItem(FieldId.PartitionKey, MessageMembers.PartitionKey, PropertyValueType.String, (BrokeredMessage msg) => msg.PartitionKey),
				CreateHeaderSerializationItem(FieldId.Label, MessageMembers.Label, PropertyValueType.String, (BrokeredMessage msg) => msg.Label),
				CreateHeaderSerializationItem(FieldId.ContentType, MessageMembers.ContentType, PropertyValueType.String, (BrokeredMessage msg) => msg.ContentType),
				CreateHeaderSerializationItem(FieldId.PrefilteredMessageHeaders, MessageMembers.PrefilteredHeaders, PropertyValueType.Stream, (BrokeredMessage msg) => msg.PrefilteredHeaders),
				CreateHeaderSerializationItem(FieldId.PrefilteredMessageProperties, MessageMembers.PrefilteredProperties, PropertyValueType.Stream, (BrokeredMessage msg) => msg.PrefilteredProperties),
				CreateHeaderSerializationItem(FieldId.TransferDestination, MessageMembers.TransferDestination, PropertyValueType.String, (BrokeredMessage msg) => msg.TransferDestination),
				CreateHeaderSerializationItem(FieldId.TransferDestinationResourceId, MessageMembers.TransferDestinationEntityId, PropertyValueType.Int64, (BrokeredMessage msg) => msg.TransferDestinationResourceId),
				CreateHeaderSerializationItem(FieldId.PartitionId, MessageMembers.PartitionId, PropertyValueType.Int16, (BrokeredMessage msg) => msg.PartitionId),
				CreateHeaderSerializationItem(FieldId.TransferSessionId, MessageMembers.TransferSessionId, PropertyValueType.String, (BrokeredMessage msg) => msg.TransferSessionId),
				CreateHeaderSerializationItem(FieldId.TransferSource, MessageMembers.TransferSource, PropertyValueType.String, (BrokeredMessage msg) => msg.TransferSource),
				CreateHeaderSerializationItem(FieldId.TransferSequenceNumber, MessageMembers.TransferSequenceNumber, PropertyValueType.Int64, (BrokeredMessage msg) => msg.TransferSequenceNumber),
				CreateHeaderSerializationItem(FieldId.TransferHopCount, MessageMembers.TransferHopCount, PropertyValueType.Int32, (BrokeredMessage msg) => msg.TransferHopCount),
				CreateHeaderSerializationItem(FieldId.MessageState, MessageMembers.MessageState, PropertyValueType.Int32, (BrokeredMessage msg) => (int)msg.State),
				CreateHeaderSerializationItem(FieldId.EnqueuedSequenceNumber, MessageMembers.EnqueuedSequenceNumber, PropertyValueType.Int64, (BrokeredMessage msg) => msg.EnqueuedSequenceNumber),
				CreateHeaderSerializationItem(FieldId.ViaPartitionKey, MessageMembers.ViaPartitionKey, PropertyValueType.String, (BrokeredMessage msg) => msg.ViaPartitionKey),
				CreateHeaderSerializationItem(FieldId.Destination, MessageMembers.Destination, PropertyValueType.String, (BrokeredMessage msg) => msg.Destination),
				CreateHeaderSerializationItem(FieldId.ForcePersistence, MessageMembers.ForcePersistence, PropertyValueType.Boolean, (BrokeredMessage msg) => msg.ForcePersistence),
				CreateHeaderSerializationItem(FieldId.Publisher, MessageMembers.Publisher, PropertyValueType.String, (BrokeredMessage msg) => msg.Publisher),
				CreateHeaderSerializationItem(FieldId.DeadLetterSource, MessageMembers.DeadLetterSource, PropertyValueType.String, (BrokeredMessage msg) => msg.DeadLetterSource),
				CreateHeaderSerializationItem(FieldId.IsHeaderEncrypted, MessageMembers.IsHeaderEncrypted, PropertyValueType.Boolean, (BrokeredMessage msg) => msg.IsHeaderEncrypted),
				CreateHeaderSerializationItem(FieldId.IsHeaderPlatformEncrypted, MessageMembers.IsHeaderPlatformEncrypted, PropertyValueType.Boolean, (BrokeredMessage msg) => msg.IsHeaderPlatformEncrypted)
			};
		}

		public BrokeredMessage()
			: this(NewMessageId())
		{
		}

		public BrokeredMessage(object serializableObject)
			: this(serializableObject, (serializableObject == null) ? null : new DataContractBinarySerializer(GetObjectType(serializableObject)))
		{
			bodyObject = serializableObject;
		}

		public BrokeredMessage(object serializableObject, XmlObjectSerializer serializer)
			: this(NewMessageId())
		{
			if (serializableObject != null)
			{
				if (serializer == null)
				{
					throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new ArgumentNullException("serializer"));
				}
				MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream(256);
				serializer.WriteObject(memoryStream, serializableObject);
				memoryStream.Flush();
				memoryStream.Position = 0L;
				BodyStream = memoryStream;
				ownsBodyStream = true;
			}
		}

		public BrokeredMessage(Stream messageBodyStream)
			: this(messageBodyStream, ownsStream: false)
		{
		}

		public BrokeredMessage(Stream messageBodyStream, bool ownsStream)
			: this(NewMessageId())
		{
			ownsBodyStream = ownsStream;
			BodyStream = messageBodyStream;
		}

		internal BrokeredMessage(Stream messageBodyStream, bool ownsBodyStream, BrokeredMessageFormat format)
			: this(NewMessageId())
		{
			this.ownsBodyStream = false;
			BodyStream = messageBodyStream;
			this.ownsBodyStream = ownsBodyStream;
			messageFormat = format;
		}

		internal BrokeredMessage(BufferedInputStream headerStream, Stream bodyStream)
		{
			this.headerStream = headerStream;
			BodyStream = bodyStream;
			isBodyLoaded = true;
			ownsBodyStream = true;
			InternalBrokeredMessageState = BrokeredMessageState.Active;
			isFromCache = false;
			if (this.headerStream.CanSeek)
			{
				headerSize = this.headerStream.Length;
			}
		}

		internal BrokeredMessage(object bodyObject, Stream bodyStream)
			: this()
		{
			this.bodyObject = bodyObject;
			bodyObjectDecoded = true;
			this.bodyStream = bodyStream;
			ownsBodyStream = true;
		}

		private BrokeredMessage(string messageId)
		{
			ValidateMessageId(messageId);
			MessageId = messageId;
			headersDeserialized = true;
			InternalBrokeredMessageState = BrokeredMessageState.Active;
			isFromCache = false;
			version = MessageVersion;
		}

		private BrokeredMessage(BrokeredMessage originalMessage, bool clientSideCloning, bool transferBodyStreamOwnership)
		{
			version = originalMessage.version;
			messageFormat = originalMessage.messageFormat;
			messageEncoder = originalMessage.messageEncoder;
			arePropertiesModifiedByBroker = originalMessage.arePropertiesModifiedByBroker;
			CopyMessageHeaders(originalMessage, clientSideCloning);
			bodyObject = originalMessage.bodyObject;
			bodyObjectDecoded = originalMessage.bodyObjectDecoded;
			Stream stream = originalMessage.BodyStream;
			if (stream != null)
			{
				if (transferBodyStreamOwnership)
				{
					BodyStream = originalMessage.BodyStream;
					originalMessage.ownsBodyStream = false;
					originalMessage.BodyStream = null;
				}
				else
				{
					BodyStream = CloneStream(originalMessage.BodyStream, clientSideCloning);
				}
				ownsBodyStream = true;
			}
			if (originalMessage.IsLargeMessage)
			{
				BodySize = originalMessage.BodySize;
			}
			attachment = originalMessage.attachment?.Clone();
			InternalId = originalMessage.InternalId;
			InternalBrokeredMessageState = originalMessage.InternalBrokeredMessageState;
			SubqueueType = originalMessage.SubqueueType;
			IsActivatingScheduledMessage = originalMessage.IsActivatingScheduledMessage;
			isFromCache = originalMessage.isFromCache;
			IsBodyLoaded = originalMessage.isBodyLoaded;
			persistedMessageSize = originalMessage.persistedMessageSize;
			AllowOverflowOnPersist = originalMessage.AllowOverflowOnPersist;
			RecordInfoAsGuid = originalMessage.RecordInfoAsGuid;
			supportsEmptySerializedHeader = originalMessage.supportsEmptySerializedHeader;
			originalDeliveryCount = originalMessage.receiverHeaders?.DeliveryCount;
			LargeMessageId = originalMessage.LargeMessageId;
		}

		internal static Stream CloneStream(Stream originalStream, bool canThrowException = false)
		{
			Stream result = null;
			if (originalStream != null)
			{
				if (originalStream is MemoryStream memoryStream)
				{
					result = new MemoryStream(memoryStream.ToArray(), 0, (int)memoryStream.Length, writable: false, publiclyVisible: true);
				}
				else if (originalStream is ICloneable cloneable)
				{
					result = (Stream)cloneable.Clone();
				}
				else if (canThrowException)
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.BrokeredMessageStreamNotCloneable(originalStream.GetType().FullName)));
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public T GetBody<T>()
		{
			if (typeof(T) == typeof(Stream))
			{
				SetGetBodyCalled();
				return (T)(object)BodyStream;
			}
			if (bodyObjectDecoded && bodyObject != null)
			{
				SetGetBodyCalled();
				return (T)bodyObject;
			}
			return GetBody<T>(new DataContractBinarySerializer(typeof(T)));
		}

		public T GetBody<T>(XmlObjectSerializer serializer)
		{
			if (serializer == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new ArgumentNullException("serializer"));
			}
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			SetGetBodyCalled();
			if (BodyStream == null)
			{
				if (typeof(T).IsValueType)
				{
					throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.MessageBodyNull));
				}
				return default(T);
			}
			if (BodyStream.CanSeek)
			{
				if (BodyStream.Length == 0L)
				{
					throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.MessageBodyNull));
				}
				BodyStream.Position = 0L;
			}
			return (T)serializer.ReadObject(BodyStream);
		}

		internal static void ValidateMessageProperties(IDictionary<string, object> properties, string propertyName)
		{
			if (properties == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (properties.Count > 32767)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.Argument(propertyName, SRClient.TooManyMessageProperties(short.MaxValue, properties.Count));
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, object> property in properties)
			{
				int stringSize = SerializationUtilities.GetStringSize(property.Key);
				if (stringSize > 32767)
				{
					throw FxTrace.Exception.Argument(propertyName, SRClient.ExceededMessagePropertySizeLimit(property.Key, short.MaxValue));
				}
				PropertyValueType typeId = SerializationUtilities.GetTypeId(property.Value);
				if (typeId != PropertyValueType.Null)
				{
					byte[] array = SerializationUtilities.ConvertNativeValueToByteArray(MessageVersion3, typeId, property.Value);
					if (array.Length > 32767)
					{
						throw FxTrace.Exception.Argument(propertyName, SRClient.ExceededMessagePropertySizeLimit(property.Key, short.MaxValue));
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal static void ValidatePropertyString(string propertyString, string propertyName)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(propertyString))
			{
				int stringSize = SerializationUtilities.GetStringSize(propertyString);
				if (stringSize > 32767)
				{
					throw FxTrace.Exception.Argument(propertyName, SRClient.ExceededMessagePropertySizeLimit(propertyName, short.MaxValue));
				}
			}
		}

			reader.ReadEndElement();

		internal static BrokeredMessage CreateMessage(BrokeredMessage originalMessage)
		{
			BrokeredMessage brokeredMessage = originalMessage.CreateCopy();
			brokeredMessage.DeliveryCount = 0;
			brokeredMessage.LockedUntilUtc = DateTime.MinValue;
			brokeredMessage.LockToken = Guid.Empty;
			brokeredMessage.EnqueuedTimeUtc = DateTime.MinValue;
			brokeredMessage.InternalBrokeredMessageState = BrokeredMessageState.Active;
			brokeredMessage.SubqueueType = SubqueueType.Active;
			brokeredMessage.IsActivatingScheduledMessage = false;
			brokeredMessage.initializedMembers &= ~(MessageMembers.EnqueuedTimeUtc | MessageMembers.LockToken | MessageMembers.LockedUntilUtc | MessageMembers.DeliveryCount);
			return brokeredMessage;
		}

		internal BufferedInputStream GetHeaderStream(InternalBufferManager bufferManager, SerializationTarget serializationTarget)
		{
			if (headerStream == null)
			{
				lock (headerSerializationSyncObject)
				{
					if (headerStream == null)
					{
						try
						{
							using BufferedOutputStream bufferedOutputStream = new BufferedOutputStream(512, HeaderStreamMaxSize, bufferManager);
							using XmlDictionaryWriter xmlDictionaryWriter = XmlDictionaryWriter.CreateBinaryWriter(bufferedOutputStream);
							xmlDictionaryWriter.WriteStartElement("MessageHeaders");
							WriteHeader(xmlDictionaryWriter, serializationTarget);
							xmlDictionaryWriter.WriteEndElement();
							xmlDictionaryWriter.Flush();
							int bufferSize;
							byte[] bytes = bufferedOutputStream.ToArray(out bufferSize);
							headerStream = new BufferedInputStream(bytes, bufferSize, bufferManager);
							headerSize = headerStream.Length;
						}
						catch (InvalidOperationException ex)
						{
							throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new SerializationException(ex.Message, ex));
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return headerStream;
		}

		internal void SetHeaderStreamSize(SerializationTarget serializationTarget)
		{
			if (headerStream != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			lock (headerSerializationSyncObject)
			{
				if (headerStream != null)
				{
					return;
				}
				using MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream(512);
				using (XmlDictionaryWriter xmlDictionaryWriter = XmlDictionaryWriter.CreateBinaryWriter(memoryStream, null, null, ownsStream: false))
				{
					xmlDictionaryWriter.WriteStartElement("MessageHeaders");
					WriteHeader(xmlDictionaryWriter, serializationTarget);
					xmlDictionaryWriter.WriteEndElement();
				}
				headerSize = memoryStream.Length;
			}
		}

		internal long GetSerializedSize(SerializationTarget serializationTarget)
		{
			if (headerSize == 0L)
			{
				lock (headerSerializationSyncObject)
				{
					if (headerSize == 0L)
					{
						headerSize = CalculateSerializedHeadersSize(this, serializationTarget) + CalculateSerializedPropertiesSize(this);
					}
				}
			}
			return headerSize + BodySize;
		}

		private void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposed)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (disposing)
			{
				if (PrefilteredHeaders != null)
				{
					PrefilteredHeaders.Dispose();
					PrefilteredHeaders = null;
				}
				if (PrefilteredProperties != null)
				{
					PrefilteredProperties.Dispose();
					PrefilteredProperties = null;
				}
				if (headerStream != null)
				{
					headerStream.Dispose();
					headerStream = null;
				}
				if (bodyStream != null && ownsBodyStream)
				{
					bodyStream.Dispose();
					bodyStream = null;
				}
				bodyObject = null;
				attachment?.Dispose();
			}
			disposed = true;
		}

			if (value != null)
			{
				return value.GetType();
			}
			return typeof(object);
		}

		private static long DeserializeBodyStream(BrokeredMessage message, XmlReader reader)
		{
			byte[] array = ReadBytes(reader, 9);
			if (array[0] != 31)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new SerializationException($"Expected FieldId = {FieldId.BodyStream}, Actual FieldId = {array[0]}"));
			}
			long num = BitConverter.ToInt64(array, 1);
			if (num == 0L)
			{
				return num;
			}
			int num2 = 1024;
			while (num > num2)
			{
				num2 *= 2;
			}
			InternalBufferManager bufferManager = ThrottledBufferManager.GetBufferManager();
			using BufferedOutputStream bufferedOutputStream = new BufferedOutputStream(num2, int.MaxValue, bufferManager);
			byte[] array2 = bufferManager.TakeBuffer(num2);
			long num3 = 0L;
			try
			{
				while (true)
				{
					int num4 = reader.ReadContentAsBase64(array2, 0, array2.Length);
					if (num4 == 0)
					{
						break;
					}
					num3 += num4;
					bufferedOutputStream.Write(array2, 0, num4);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				bufferManager.ReturnBuffer(array2);
			}
			int bufferSize;
			byte[] bytes = bufferedOutputStream.ToArray(out bufferSize);
			message.BodyStream = new BufferedInputStream(bytes, bufferSize, bufferManager);
			message.ownsBodyStream = true;
			if (num > 0 && num3 != num)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.FailedToDeSerializeEntireBodyStream));
			}
			return num3;
		}

		private static long DeserializeVersionAndFlagsFromBinary(BrokeredMessage message, XmlReader reader)
		{
			int num = BitConverter.ToInt32(ReadBytes(reader, 4), 0);
			byte[] array = ReadBytes(reader, 2);
			if (message != null)
			{
				message.version = num;
				message.messageFormat = (BrokeredMessageFormat)array[0];
			}
			return 6L;
		}

		internal static long DeserializeHeadersFromBinary(BrokeredMessage message, XmlReader reader, SerializationTarget serializationTarget)
		{
			long num = 2L;
			int num2 = BitConverter.ToInt16(ReadBytes(reader, 2), 0);
			for (int i = 0; i < num2; i++)
			{
				byte[] array = ReadBytes(reader, 3);
				short num3 = BitConverter.ToInt16(array, 1);
				if (serializationTarget == SerializationTarget.Storing && num3 > Constants.MaximumMessageHeaderPropertySize)
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new SerializationException(SRClient.ExceededMessagePropertySizeLimit(array[0].ToString(), Constants.MaximumMessageHeaderPropertySize)));
				}
				byte[] array2 = ReadBytes(reader, num3);
				message?.SetMessageHeader(array[0], array2, message.version > MessageVersion);
				num += array.Length + array2.Length;
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal static long DeserializePropertiesFromBinary(BrokeredMessage message, XmlReader reader, SerializationTarget serializationTarget)
		{
			long num = 4L;
			byte[] array = ReadBytes(reader, 3);
			if (array[0] != 30)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new SerializationException($"Expected FieldId = {FieldId.Properties}, Actual FieldId = {array[0]}"));
			}
			short num2 = BitConverter.ToInt16(array, 1);
			bool flag = message.version > MessageVersion;
			for (short num3 = 0; num3 < num2; num3++)
			{
				byte[] value = ReadBytes(reader, 2);
				short num4 = BitConverter.ToInt16(value, 0);
				if (serializationTarget == SerializationTarget.Storing && num4 > Constants.MaximumMessageHeaderPropertySize)
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new SerializationException($"Property {num3}'s name is too long.  Length = {num4}, MaxLength = {Constants.MaximumMessageHeaderPropertySize}"));
				}
				byte[] bytes = ReadBytes(reader, num4);
				string text = Encoding.UTF8.GetString(bytes);
				int num5 = ReadBytes(reader, 1)[0];
				num += 2 + num4 + 1;
				object obj = null;
				if (num5 != 0)
				{
					value = ReadBytes(reader, 2);
					int num6 = BitConverter.ToInt16(value, 0);
					if (serializationTarget == SerializationTarget.Storing && num6 > Constants.MaximumMessageHeaderPropertySize)
					{
						throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new SerializationException(SRClient.ExceededMessagePropertySizeLimit(text, Constants.MaximumMessageHeaderPropertySize)));
					}
					byte[] bytes2 = ReadBytes(reader, num6);
					num += num6 + 2;
					if (num5 < 21 || !flag)
					{
						obj = SerializationUtilities.ConvertByteArrayToNativeValue(message.version, (PropertyValueType)num5, bytes2);
					}
				}
				if (num5 == 0 || obj != null)
				{
					message.InternalProperties.Add(text, obj);
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private static byte[] ReadBytes(XmlReader reader, int bytesToRead)
		{
			return SerializationUtilities.ReadBytes(reader, bytesToRead);
		}

		internal static long SerializeBodyStream(BrokeredMessage message, XmlWriter writer)
		{
			writer.WriteBase64(new byte[1] { 31 }, 0, 1);
			long num = 0L;
			if (message.BodyStream != null)
			{
				num = (message.BodyStream.CanSeek ? message.BodyStream.Length : (-1));
			}
			writer.WriteBase64(BitConverter.GetBytes(num), 0, 8);
			if (num != 0L)
			{
				if (message.BodyStream.CanSeek && message.BodyStream.Position != 0L)
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.CannotSerializeMessageWithPartiallyConsumedBodyStream));
				}
				byte[] array = new byte[1024];
				long num2 = 0L;
				while (true)
				{
					int num3 = message.BodyStream.Read(array, 0, array.Length);
					if (num3 == 0)
					{
						break;
					}
					num2 += num3;
					writer.WriteBase64(array, 0, num3);
				}
				if (num > 0 && num2 != num)
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.FailedToSerializeEntireBodyStream));
				}
				return num2;
			}
			return 0L;
		}

		private static long SerializeVersionAndFlagsAsBinary(BrokeredMessage message, XmlWriter writer)
		{
			long result = 6L;
			writer.WriteBase64(BitConverter.GetBytes(message.version), 0, 4);
			writer.WriteBase64(new byte[2]
			{
				(byte)message.messageFormat,
				0
			}, 0, 2);
			return result;
		}

		internal static long SerializeHeadersAsBinary(BrokeredMessage message, XmlWriter writer, SerializationTarget serializationTarget)
		{
			long num = 2L;
			short num2 = 0;
			HeaderSerializationItem[] array = headerSerializationItems;
			foreach (HeaderSerializationItem headerSerializationItem in array)
			{
				if (headerSerializationItem.IsHeaderPresent(message))
				{
					num2++;
				}
			}
			writer.WriteBase64(BitConverter.GetBytes(num2), 0, 2);
			byte[] array2 = new byte[3];
			short num3 = 0;
			HeaderSerializationItem[] array3 = headerSerializationItems;
			foreach (HeaderSerializationItem headerSerializationItem2 in array3)
			{
				if (headerSerializationItem2.IsHeaderPresent(message))
				{
					num3++;
					array2[0] = (byte)headerSerializationItem2.FieldId;
					byte[] array4 = headerSerializationItem2.Extractor(message, serializationTarget);
					if (serializationTarget == SerializationTarget.Storing && array4.Length > Constants.MaximumMessageHeaderPropertySize)
					{
						throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new SerializationException(SRClient.ExceededMessagePropertySizeLimit(headerSerializationItem2.FieldId.ToString(), Constants.MaximumMessageHeaderPropertySize)));
					}
					array2[1] = (byte)(array4.Length & 0xFF);
					array2[2] = (byte)((array4.Length & 0xFF00) >> 8);
					num += array4.Length + 3;
					writer.WriteBase64(array2, 0, 3);
					writer.WriteBase64(array4, 0, array4.Length);
				}
			}
			if (num3 != num2)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new SerializationException());
			}
			writer.Flush();
			return num;
		}

		internal static long SerializePropertiesAsBinary(BrokeredMessage message, XmlWriter writer, SerializationTarget serializationTarget)
		{
			long num = 1L;
			writer.WriteBase64(new byte[1] { 30 }, 0, 1);
			if (message.Properties.Count > 32767)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new SerializationException(SRClient.TooManyMessageProperties(short.MaxValue, message.Properties.Count)));
			}
			num += 2;
			writer.WriteBase64(BitConverter.GetBytes((short)message.Properties.Count), 0, 2);
			byte[] array = new byte[3];
			if (message.Properties.Count > 0)
			{
				foreach (KeyValuePair<string, object> property in message.Properties)
				{
					byte[] bytes = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(property.Key);
					if (serializationTarget == SerializationTarget.Storing && bytes.Length > 32767)
					{
						throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new SerializationException(SRClient.ExceededMessagePropertySizeLimit(property.Key, short.MaxValue)));
					}
					num += bytes.Length + 2;
					writer.WriteBase64(BitConverter.GetBytes((short)bytes.Length), 0, 2);
					writer.WriteBase64(bytes, 0, bytes.Length);
					PropertyValueType typeId = SerializationUtilities.GetTypeId(property.Value);
					array[0] = (byte)typeId;
					if (typeId != PropertyValueType.Null)
					{
						byte[] array2 = SerializationUtilities.ConvertNativeValueToByteArray(message.version, typeId, property.Value);
						if (serializationTarget == SerializationTarget.Storing && array2.Length > 32767)
						{
							throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new SerializationException(SRClient.ExceededMessagePropertySizeLimit(property.Key, short.MaxValue)));
						}
						array[1] = (byte)(array2.Length & 0xFF);
						array[2] = (byte)((array2.Length & 0xFF00) >> 8);
						num += array2.Length + 3;
						writer.WriteBase64(array, 0, 3);
						writer.WriteBase64(array2, 0, array2.Length);
					}
					else
					{
						num++;
						writer.WriteBase64(array, 0, 1);
					}
				}
				writer.Flush();
			}
			return num;
		}

		private static long CalculateSerializedHeadersSize(BrokeredMessage message, SerializationTarget serializationTarget)
		{
			long num = 0L;
			num += 4 + messageFlags.Length + 2;
			HeaderSerializationItem[] array = headerSerializationItems;
			foreach (HeaderSerializationItem headerSerializationItem in array)
			{
				if (headerSerializationItem.IsHeaderPresent(message))
				{
					num += 3 + headerSerializationItem.GetSize(message);
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private static long CalculateSerializedPropertiesSize(BrokeredMessage message)
		{
			long num = 3L;
			if (message.Properties.Count > 0)
			{
				foreach (KeyValuePair<string, object> property in message.Properties)
				{
					num += 2 + SerializationUtilities.GetStringSize(property.Key);
					num++;
					PropertyValueType typeId = SerializationUtilities.GetTypeId(property.Value);
					if (typeId != PropertyValueType.Null)
					{
						byte[] array = SerializationUtilities.ConvertNativeValueToByteArray(message.version, typeId, property.Value);
						num += 2 + array.Length;
					}
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private void ClearInitializedMember(MessageMembers memberToClear)
		{
			initializedMembers &= ~memberToClear;
		}

		private void SetInitializedMember(MessageMembers memberToSet)
		{
			initializedMembers |= memberToSet;
		}

		private void SetGetBodyCalled()
		{
			if (Interlocked.Exchange(ref getBodyCalled, 1) == 1)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.MessageBodyConsumed));
			}
		}

		private void CopyMessageHeaders(BrokeredMessage originalMessage, bool clientSideCloning = false)
		{
			messageFormat = originalMessage.messageFormat;
			headersDeserialized = true;
			MessageId = originalMessage.MessageId;
			headerSize = originalMessage.HeaderSize;
			if ((originalMessage.InitializedMembers & MessageMembers.SessionId) != (MessageMembers)0uL)
			{
				CopySessionId(originalMessage.SessionId);
			}
			if ((originalMessage.initializedMembers & MessageMembers.PartitionKey) != (MessageMembers)0uL)
			{
				CopyPartitionKey(originalMessage.PartitionKey);
			}
			if ((originalMessage.initializedMembers & MessageMembers.ViaPartitionKey) != (MessageMembers)0uL)
			{
				ViaPartitionKey = originalMessage.ViaPartitionKey;
			}
			if ((originalMessage.InitializedMembers & MessageMembers.ScheduledEnqueueTimeUtc) != (MessageMembers)0uL)

			{
				TimeToLive = originalMessage.TimeToLive;
			}
			string text = originalMessage.Label;
			if (text != null)
			{
				Label = text;
			}
			if (originalMessage.CorrelationId != null)
			{
				CorrelationId = originalMessage.CorrelationId;
			}
			if (originalMessage.ReplyTo != null)
			{
				ReplyTo = originalMessage.ReplyTo;
			}
			if (originalMessage.To != null)
			{
				To = originalMessage.To;
			}
			if ((originalMessage.InitializedMembers & MessageMembers.ReplyToSessionId) != (MessageMembers)0uL)
			{
				ReplyToSessionId = originalMessage.ReplyToSessionId;
			}
			if (originalMessage.ContentType != null)
			{
				ContentType = originalMessage.ContentType;
			}
			if ((originalMessage.InitializedMembers & MessageMembers.ForcePersistence) != (MessageMembers)0uL)
			{
				ForcePersistence = originalMessage.ForcePersistence;
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, object> property in originalMessage.Properties)
			{
				InternalProperties.Add(property);
			}
			if ((originalMessage.initializedMembers & MessageMembers.Destination) != (MessageMembers)0uL)
			{
				Destination = originalMessage.Destination;
			}
			if (originalMessage.Publisher != null)
			{
				Publisher = originalMessage.Publisher;
			}
			if (clientSideCloning)
			{
				return;
			}
			if ((originalMessage.InitializedMembers & MessageMembers.PartitionId) != (MessageMembers)0uL)
			{
				PartitionId = originalMessage.PartitionId;
			}
			ReceiverHeaders receiverHeaders = originalMessage.receiverHeaders;
			if (receiverHeaders != null)
			{
				BodyId = originalMessage.BodyId;

					DeliveryCount = receiverHeaders.DeliveryCount;

				{
					SequenceNumber = receiverHeaders.SequenceNumber;
				}
				if ((originalMessage.InitializedMembers & MessageMembers.EnqueuedTimeUtc) != (MessageMembers)0uL)
				{
					EnqueuedTimeUtc = originalMessage.EnqueuedTimeUtc;
				}
				if ((originalMessage.InitializedMembers & MessageMembers.EnqueuedSequenceNumber) != (MessageMembers)0uL)
				{
					EnqueuedSequenceNumber = receiverHeaders.EnqueuedSequenceNumber;
				}
			}
			if ((originalMessage.initializedMembers & MessageMembers.PrefilteredHeaders) != (MessageMembers)0uL)
			{
				PrefilteredHeaders = CloneStream(originalMessage.PrefilteredHeaders);
			}
			if ((originalMessage.initializedMembers & MessageMembers.PrefilteredProperties) != (MessageMembers)0uL)
			{
				PrefilteredProperties = CloneStream(originalMessage.PrefilteredProperties);
			}
			if ((originalMessage.initializedMembers & MessageMembers.DeadLetterSource) != (MessageMembers)0uL)
			{
				DeadLetterSource = originalMessage.DeadLetterSource;
			}
			if ((originalMessage.initializedMembers & MessageMembers.TransferDestination) != (MessageMembers)0uL)
			{
				TransferDestination = originalMessage.TransferDestination;
			}
			if ((originalMessage.initializedMembers & MessageMembers.TransferDestinationEntityId) != (MessageMembers)0uL)
			{
				TransferDestinationResourceId = originalMessage.TransferDestinationResourceId;
			}
			if ((originalMessage.initializedMembers & MessageMembers.TransferSessionId) != (MessageMembers)0uL)

				TransferSessionId = originalMessage.TransferSessionId;
			}
			if ((originalMessage.initializedMembers & MessageMembers.TransferSource) != (MessageMembers)0uL)

		internal void EnsureHeaderDeserialized()
		{
			if (headersDeserialized)
			{
				return;
			}
			lock (headerSerializationSyncObject)
			{
				if (!headersDeserialized)
				{
					ThrowIfDisposed();
					using BufferedInputStream stream = (BufferedInputStream)headerStream.Clone();
					using XmlDictionaryReader xmlDictionaryReader = XmlDictionaryReader.CreateBinaryReader(stream, XmlDictionaryReaderQuotas.Max);
					xmlDictionaryReader.Read();
					xmlDictionaryReader.ReadStartElement();
					ReadHeader(xmlDictionaryReader, SerializationTarget.Storing);
					xmlDictionaryReader.ReadEndElement();
				}
				headersDeserialized = true;
			}
		}

		internal long ReadHeader(XmlReader reader, SerializationTarget serializationTarget)
		{
			long num = 0L;
			num += DeserializeVersionAndFlagsFromBinary(this, reader);
			messageEncoder = messageEncoder ?? BrokeredMessageEncoder.GetEncoder(messageFormat);
			return num + messageEncoder.ReadHeader(reader, this, serializationTarget);
		}

		internal long WriteHeader(XmlWriter writer, SerializationTarget serializationTarget)
		{
			long num = 0L;
			num += SerializeVersionAndFlagsAsBinary(this, writer);
			messageEncoder = messageEncoder ?? BrokeredMessageEncoder.GetEncoder(messageFormat);
			return num + messageEncoder.WriteHeader(writer, this, serializationTarget);
		}

		internal object GetSystemProperty(string propertyName)
		{
			return SystemPropertyAccessorDictionary[propertyName](this);
		}

		internal void BrokerUpdateProperty(string name, object value)

			Properties[name] = value;
			SetPropertiesAreModifiedByBroker();
			attachment?.OnApplicationPropertyChanged(name, value);
		}

		{
			Properties.Remove(name);
			SetPropertiesAreModifiedByBroker();
			attachment?.OnApplicationPropertyChanged(name, null);
		}

			arePropertiesModifiedByBroker = false;
		}

		internal void SetPropertiesAreModifiedByBroker()

			arePropertiesModifiedByBroker = true;
		}

		internal void CopySessionId(string sessionId)

			this.sessionId = sessionId;

			}
		}

			}
		}

		internal void DownGradeToVersion1()
		{
			version = MessageVersion1;
			initializedMembers &= MessageMembers.MessageId | MessageMembers.CorrelationId | MessageMembers.To | MessageMembers.ReplyTo | MessageMembers.TimeToLive | MessageMembers.SessionId | MessageMembers.Label | MessageMembers.ContentType | MessageMembers.ScheduledEnqueueTimeUtc | MessageMembers.PartitionKey | MessageMembers.ReplyToSessionId | MessageMembers.EnqueuedTimeUtc | MessageMembers.SequenceNumber | MessageMembers.LockToken | MessageMembers.LockedUntilUtc | MessageMembers.DeliveryCount;
			List<string> list = new List<string>(8);
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, object> property in Properties)
			{
				if (property.Value is Stream)
				{
					list.Add(property.Key);
				}
			}
			foreach (string item in list)
			{
				Properties.Remove(item);
			}
		}

		internal bool IsMembersSet(MessageMembers member)
		{
			return (InitializedMembers & member) != 0;
		}

				receiverHeaders = new ReceiverHeaders();
			}
		}

				return;

				return;

				return;
			case 11:
				ReplyToSessionId = (string)SerializationUtilities.ConvertByteArrayToNativeValue(version, PropertyValueType.String, value);
				return;

				return;

				DeliveryCount = (int)SerializationUtilities.ConvertByteArrayToNativeValue(version, PropertyValueType.Int32, value);
				return;
			case 10:
				CopyPartitionKey((string)SerializationUtilities.ConvertByteArrayToNativeValue(version, PropertyValueType.String, value));
				return;
			case 7:
				Label = (string)SerializationUtilities.ConvertByteArrayToNativeValue(version, PropertyValueType.String, value);
				return;
			case 8:
				ContentType = (string)SerializationUtilities.ConvertByteArrayToNativeValue(version, PropertyValueType.String, value);

				return;
			}

			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentOutOfRange("memberId", memberId, string.Empty);

		private void ThrowIfNotLocked()
		{
			if (receiverHeaders == null || receiverHeaders.LockToken == Guid.Empty)
			{
				if (ReceiveContext != null && ReceiveContext.MessageReceiver != null && ReceiveContext.MessageReceiver.Mode == ReceiveMode.ReceiveAndDelete)
				{
					throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.PeekLockModeRequired));
				}
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException());
			}
		}

		private void ThrowIfReceiveContextIsNull()
		{
			ThrowIfReceiveContextIsNull(SRClient.ReceiveContextNull);
		}

		private void ThrowIfReceiveContextIsNull(string message)
		{
			if (receiveContext == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException(message));
			}
		}

		private void ThrowIfDisposed()
		{
			if (disposed)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ObjectDisposed($"BrokeredMessage has been disposed. SequenceNumber:{sequenceNumberForTracing}");
			}
		}

		private void ThrowIfNotReceived()
		{
			if (receiverHeaders == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException());
			}
		}

		private void ThrowIfDominatingPropertyIsNotEqualToNonNullDormantProperty(MessageMembers dominatingProperty, MessageMembers dormantProperty, string dominatingPropsValue, string dormantPropsValue)
		{
			if ((initializedMembers & dormantProperty) != (MessageMembers)0uL && !string.Equals(dominatingPropsValue, dormantPropsValue))
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.DominatingPropertyMustBeEqualsToNonNullDormantProperty(dominatingProperty, dormantProperty)));
			}
		}

		internal static void SetBrokerMode()
		{
			mode = BrokeredMessageMode.Broker;
			headerSerializationItems = BuildHeaderSerializationItems(mode);
		}

		private void RaiseEvent(EventHandler handler)
		{
			handler?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
		}
	}
	public abstract class MessagingFactory : ClientEntity
	{
		private sealed class CreateMessageSenderAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<CreateMessageSenderAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly MessagingFactory factory;

			private readonly string entityName;

			private readonly string transferDestinationEntityName;

			private readonly bool tryPairSender;

			public MessageSender Sender { get; private set; }

			public CreateMessageSenderAsyncResult(MessagingFactory factory, string entityName, string transferDestinationEntityName, bool tryPairSender, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.factory = factory;
				this.entityName = entityName;
				this.transferDestinationEntityName = transferDestinationEntityName;
				this.tryPairSender = tryPairSender;
				this.factory.ThrowIfDisposed();
				CheckValidEntityName(entityName);
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(transferDestinationEntityName))
				{
					MessagingUtilities.ThrowIfContainsSubQueueName(entityName);
				}
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((CreateMessageSenderAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.factory.OnBeginCreateMessageSender(thisPtr.transferDestinationEntityName, thisPtr.entityName, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(CreateMessageSenderAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					thisPtr.Sender = thisPtr.factory.OnEndCreateMessageSender(r);
				}, (Call)delegate(CreateMessageSenderAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t)
				{
					thisPtr.Sender = thisPtr.factory.OnCreateMessageSender(thisPtr.transferDestinationEntityName, thisPtr.entityName, t);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
				if (tryPairSender && Sender != null)
				{
					IPairedNamespaceFactory pairedNamespaceFactory = factory.PairedNamespaceFactory;
					if (pairedNamespaceFactory != null)
					{
						Sender = pairedNamespaceFactory.CreateMessageSender(Sender);
					}
				}
				factory.ClientEntityManager.Add(Sender);
			}
		}

		private sealed class CreateMessageReceiverAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<CreateMessageReceiverAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly MessagingFactory factory;

			private readonly string entityName;

			private readonly ReceiveMode receiveMode;

			public MessageReceiver Receiver { get; private set; }

			public CreateMessageReceiverAsyncResult(MessagingFactory factory, string entityName, ReceiveMode receiveMode, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.factory = factory;
				this.entityName = entityName;
				this.receiveMode = receiveMode;
				this.factory.ThrowIfDisposed();
				CheckValidEntityName(entityName);
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((CreateMessageReceiverAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.factory.OnBeginCreateMessageReceiver(thisPtr.entityName, thisPtr.receiveMode, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(CreateMessageReceiverAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					thisPtr.Receiver = thisPtr.factory.OnEndCreateMessageReceiver(r);
				}, (Call)delegate(CreateMessageReceiverAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t)
				{
					thisPtr.Receiver = thisPtr.factory.OnCreateMessageReceiver(thisPtr.entityName, thisPtr.receiveMode, t);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
				factory.ClientEntityManager.Add(Receiver);
			}
		}

		private sealed class AcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult : RetryAsyncResult<AcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly MessagingFactory factory;

			private readonly string entityName;

			private readonly ReceiveMode receiveMode;

			private readonly string sessionId;

			private readonly EventTraceActivity relatedActivity;

			private readonly TimeSpan serverWaitTime;

			private readonly TrackingContext trackingContext;

			private TimeoutHelper retryHelper;

			public MessageSession MessageSession { get; private set; }

			public bool IsScaledReceive { get; private set; }

			public AcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult(MessagingFactory factory, string entityName, string sessionId, ReceiveMode receiveMode, TimeSpan serverWaitTime, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.factory = factory;
				this.sessionId = sessionId;
				this.entityName = entityName;
				this.receiveMode = receiveMode;
				this.serverWaitTime = serverWaitTime;
				retryHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(serverWaitTime);
				this.factory.ThrowIfDisposed();
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(entityName))
				{
					CheckValidEntityName(entityName);
					ThrowIfContainsSubQueueName(entityName);
				}
				else
				{
					IsScaledReceive = true;
					MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementPendingAcceptMessageSessionByNamespaceCount(this.factory.Address, 1);
				}
				relatedActivity = EventTraceActivity.CreateFromThread();
				trackingContext = TrackingContext.Create(Guid.NewGuid(), this.entityName);
			}

			public new static MessageSession End(IAsyncResult r)
			{
				AcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult acceptMessageSessionAsyncResult = r as AcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult;
				try
				{
					acceptMessageSessionAsyncResult = AsyncResult<AcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult>.End(r);
					return acceptMessageSessionAsyncResult.MessageSession;
				}
				finally
				{
					if (acceptMessageSessionAsyncResult != null && acceptMessageSessionAsyncResult.factory != null && acceptMessageSessionAsyncResult.IsScaledReceive)
					{
						MessagingPerformanceCounters.DecrementPendingAcceptMessageSessionByNamespaceCount(acceptMessageSessionAsyncResult.factory.Address, 1);
					}
				}
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				if (relatedActivity != null && relatedActivity != EventTraceActivity.Empty)
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAcceptSessionRequestTransfer(relatedActivity, trackingContext.Activity);
					});
				}
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAcceptSessionRequestBegin(trackingContext.Activity, trackingContext.TrackingId, trackingContext.SystemTracker, entityName ?? string.Empty, sessionId ?? string.Empty);
				});
				if (IsScaledReceive)
				{
					int iteration = 0;
					Stopwatch perfWatch = Stopwatch.StartNew();
					try
					{
						TimeSpan iterationSleep = (factory.RetryPolicy.IsServerBusy ? RetryPolicy.ServerBusyBaseSleepTime : TimeSpan.Zero);
						if (factory.RetryPolicy.IsServerBusy && RetryPolicy.ServerBusyBaseSleepTime >= base.OriginalTimeout)
						{
							string serverBusyExceptionMessage = factory.RetryPolicy.ServerBusyExceptionMessage;
							yield return CallAsyncSleep(RemainingTime());
							Complete(new ServerBusyException(serverBusyExceptionMessage, trackingContext));
							yield break;
						}
						bool shouldRetry;
						do
						{
							shouldRetry = false;
							if (iterationSleep != TimeSpan.Zero)
							{
								yield return CallAsyncSleep(iterationSleep);
							}
							yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((AcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.factory.OnBeginAcceptMessageSession(thisPtr.receiveMode, thisPtr.serverWaitTime, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(AcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
							{
								thisPtr.MessageSession = thisPtr.factory.OnEndAcceptMessageSession(r);
							}, (Call)delegate(AcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t)
							{
								thisPtr.MessageSession = thisPtr.factory.OnAcceptMessageSession(thisPtr.receiveMode, thisPtr.serverWaitTime, t);
							}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
							if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
							{
								MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementAcceptMessageSessionByNamespaceFailurePerSec(factory.Address, 1);
								MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementExceptionPerSec(factory.Address, 1, base.LastAsyncStepException);
								shouldRetry = !base.TransactionExists && factory.RetryPolicy.ShouldRetry(retryHelper.RemainingTime(), iteration, base.LastAsyncStepException, out iterationSleep);
								if (shouldRetry)
								{
									MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
									{
										MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteRetryPolicyIteration(trackingContext.Activity, trackingContext.TrackingId, factory.RetryPolicy.GetType().Name, "AcceptMessageSessionByNamespace:" + factory.Address.AbsoluteUri, iteration, iterationSleep.ToString(), base.LastAsyncStepException.GetType().FullName, base.LastAsyncStepException.Message);
									});
									iteration++;
								}
							}
							else
							{
								MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementAcceptMessageSessionByNamespaceSuccessPerSec(factory.Address, 1);
								factory.RetryPolicy.ResetServerBusy();
							}
						}
						while (shouldRetry);
					}
					finally
					{
						AcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult acceptMessageSessionAsyncResult = this;
						perfWatch.Stop();
						MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementAcceptMessageSessionByNamespaceLatency(acceptMessageSessionAsyncResult.factory.Address, perfWatch.ElapsedTicks);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((AcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.factory.OnBeginAcceptSessionReceiver(thisPtr.entityName, thisPtr.sessionId, thisPtr.receiveMode, thisPtr.serverWaitTime, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(AcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.MessageSession = thisPtr.factory.OnEndAcceptSessionReceiver(r);
					}, (Call)delegate(AcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t)
					{
						thisPtr.MessageSession = thisPtr.factory.OnAcceptSessionReceiver(thisPtr.entityName, thisPtr.sessionId, thisPtr.receiveMode, thisPtr.serverWaitTime);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
				}
				if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAcceptSessionRequestFailed(trackingContext.Activity, trackingContext.TrackingId, trackingContext.SystemTracker, entityName ?? string.Empty, sessionId ?? string.Empty, base.LastAsyncStepException.ToString());
					});
					if (factory.IsClosed && !(base.LastAsyncStepException is OperationCanceledException))
					{
						Complete(new OperationCanceledException(SRClient.MessageEntityDisposed, base.LastAsyncStepException));
					}
					else
					{
						Complete(base.LastAsyncStepException);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAcceptSessionRequestEnd(trackingContext.Activity, trackingContext.TrackingId, trackingContext.SystemTracker, entityName ?? string.Empty, sessionId ?? string.Empty);
					});
					factory.ClientEntityManager.Add(MessageSession);
				}
			}

			private void ThrowIfContainsSubQueueName(string path)
			{
				if (path.Contains("$"))
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.CannotCreateMessageSessionForSubQueue));
				}
			}
		}

		private sealed class CreateMessagingFactoryAsyncResult : Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult
		{
			private static readonly AsyncCompletion createComplete = CreateComplete;

			private readonly MessagingFactorySettings settings;

			private readonly IEnumerable<Uri> addresses;

			private MessagingFactory messagingFactory;

			public CreateMessagingFactoryAsyncResult(MessagingFactorySettings settings, IEnumerable<Uri> addresses, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(callback, state)
			{
				this.settings = settings.Clone();
				Uri[] array = (addresses as Uri[]) ?? addresses.ToArray();
				this.addresses = array;
				IAsyncResult result = this.settings.BeginCreateFactory(this.addresses, PrepareAsyncCompletion(createComplete), this);
				if (SyncContinue(result))
				{
					Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: true);
				}
			}

			public static MessagingFactory End(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				CreateMessagingFactoryAsyncResult createMessagingFactoryAsyncResult = Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult.End<CreateMessagingFactoryAsyncResult>(result);
				return createMessagingFactoryAsyncResult.messagingFactory;
			}

			private static bool CreateComplete(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				CreateMessagingFactoryAsyncResult createMessagingFactoryAsyncResult = (CreateMessagingFactoryAsyncResult)result.AsyncState;
				createMessagingFactoryAsyncResult.messagingFactory = createMessagingFactoryAsyncResult.settings.EndCreateFactory(result);
				createMessagingFactoryAsyncResult.messagingFactory.hasPrefetchCountChanged = false;
				createMessagingFactoryAsyncResult.messagingFactory.Address = createMessagingFactoryAsyncResult.addresses.First();
				createMessagingFactoryAsyncResult.messagingFactory.settings = createMessagingFactoryAsyncResult.settings.Clone();
				createMessagingFactoryAsyncResult.messagingFactory.NamespaceEndpoints = new List<Uri>(createMessagingFactoryAsyncResult.addresses);
				MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementMessagingFactoryCount(createMessagingFactoryAsyncResult.messagingFactory.Address, 1);
				return true;
			}
		}

		private class ClosePairedNamesaceFactoryAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<ClosePairedNamesaceFactoryAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly IPairedNamespaceFactory pairedNamespaceFactory;

			public ClosePairedNamesaceFactoryAsyncResult(MessagingFactory factory, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				pairedNamespaceFactory = factory.PairedNamespaceFactory;
				Start();
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				if (pairedNamespaceFactory != null)
				{
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((ClosePairedNamesaceFactoryAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.pairedNamespaceFactory.BeginClose(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(ClosePairedNamesaceFactoryAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.pairedNamespaceFactory.EndClose(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
				}
			}
		}

		private class CloseFactoryAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<CloseFactoryAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly MessagingFactory messagingFactory;

			private readonly bool shouldDecrement;

			public CloseFactoryAsyncResult(MessagingFactory factory, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				messagingFactory = factory;
				shouldDecrement = !factory.IsClosed;
				Start();
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((CloseFactoryAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.messagingFactory.ClientEntityManager.BeginClose(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(CloseFactoryAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					thisPtr.messagingFactory.ClientEntityManager.EndClose(r);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
				if (shouldDecrement)
				{
					MessagingPerformanceCounters.DecrementMessagingFactoryCount(messagingFactory.Address, 1);
				}
				if (messagingFactory.PairedNamespaceFactory != null)
				{
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((CloseFactoryAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => new ClosePairedNamesaceFactoryAsyncResult(thisPtr.messagingFactory, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(CloseFactoryAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						AsyncResult<ClosePairedNamesaceFactoryAsyncResult>.End(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
				}
			}
		}

		private class PairNamespaceAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<PairNamespaceAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly MessagingFactory messagingFactory;

			public PairNamespaceAsyncResult(MessagingFactory messagingFactory, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.messagingFactory = messagingFactory;
				Start();
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				IPairedNamespaceFactory pairedNamespaceFactory = messagingFactory.PairedNamespaceFactory;
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((PairNamespaceAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => pairedNamespaceFactory.BeginStart(thisPtr.messagingFactory, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(PairNamespaceAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					pairedNamespaceFactory.EndStart(r);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
				if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
				{
					Exception pairNamespaceException = base.LastAsyncStepException;
					messagingFactory.ClearPairing();
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((PairNamespaceAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => new ClosePairedNamesaceFactoryAsyncResult(thisPtr.messagingFactory, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(PairNamespaceAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						AsyncResult<ClosePairedNamesaceFactoryAsyncResult>.End(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
					Complete(pairNamespaceException);
				}
			}
		}

		private class CreatePartitionReceiverAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<CreatePartitionReceiverAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly MessagingFactory factory;

			private readonly string entityName;

			private readonly string consumerGroupName;

			private readonly string partitionId;

			private readonly EventPosition position;

			private readonly ReceiveMode userRequestedMode;

			private readonly long? epoch;

			public MessageReceiver MessageReceiver { get; set; }

			public CreatePartitionReceiverAsyncResult(MessagingFactory factory, string entityName, string consumerGroupName, ReceiveMode userRequestedMode, string partitionId, EventPosition position, long? epoch, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(Constants.DefaultOperationTimeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.factory = factory;
				this.entityName = entityName;
				this.consumerGroupName = consumerGroupName;
				this.partitionId = partitionId;
				this.userRequestedMode = userRequestedMode;
				this.position = position;
				this.epoch = epoch;
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				string entityPath = (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(consumerGroupName) ? entityName : EntityNameHelper.FormatConsumerGroupPath(entityName, consumerGroupName));
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((CreatePartitionReceiverAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.factory.BeginCreateMessageReceiver(entityPath, thisPtr.userRequestedMode, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(CreatePartitionReceiverAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					thisPtr.MessageReceiver = thisPtr.factory.EndCreateMessageReceiver(r);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
				MessageReceiver.EntityType = MessagingEntityType.ConsumerGroup;
				MessageReceiver.EventPosition = position;
				if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(partitionId))
				{
					MessageReceiver.PartitionId = partitionId;
				}
				if (epoch.HasValue)
				{
					MessageReceiver.Epoch = epoch;
				}
			}
		}

		private class CreatePartitionSenderAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<CreatePartitionSenderAsyncResult>

		}

		private TrackingContext instanceTrackingContext;

		public Uri Address { get; internal set; }

		public virtual int PrefetchCount
		{
			get
			{
				return prefetchCount;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value < 0)
				{
					throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentOutOfRange("PrefetchCount", value, SRClient.ArgumentOutOfRange(0, int.MaxValue));
				}
				prefetchCount = value;
				hasPrefetchCountChanged = true;
			}
		}

		internal TrackingContext InstanceTrackingContext
		{
			get
			{
				if (instanceTrackingContext == null)
				{
					instanceTrackingContext = TrackingContext.Create(Guid.NewGuid());
				}
				return instanceTrackingContext;
			}
		}

		public static MessagingFactory CreateFromConnectionString(string connectionString)
		{
			KeyValueConfigurationManager keyValueConfigurationManager = new KeyValueConfigurationManager(connectionString);
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(keyValueConfigurationManager["EntityPath"]))
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.Argument("connectionString", SRClient.UnsupportedConnStr4MsgFactory(typeof(MessagingFactory).Name));
			}
			return keyValueConfigurationManager.CreateMessagingFactory(useCachedFactory: false);
		}

		}

		internal static MessagingFactory Create(Uri address, TokenProvider tokenProvider, TimeSpan? operationTimeout, TransportType transportType, bool enableAmqpLinkRedirect = false)
		{
			MessagingFactorySettings messagingFactorySettings = new MessagingFactorySettings();
			if (operationTimeout.HasValue)
			{
				messagingFactorySettings.OperationTimeout = operationTimeout.Value;
			}
			messagingFactorySettings.TransportType = transportType;
			messagingFactorySettings.TokenProvider = tokenProvider;
			if (transportType == TransportType.Amqp)
			{
				messagingFactorySettings.AmqpTransportSettings.EnableLinkRedirect = enableAmqpLinkRedirect;
			}
			return Create(address, messagingFactorySettings);
		}

		internal static Task<MessagingFactory> CreateAsync(IEnumerable<Uri> addresses, MessagingFactorySettings factorySettings, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			if (factorySettings == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNull("factorySettings");
			}
			return TaskHelpers.FromAsync((Func<AsyncCallback, object, IAsyncResult>)((AsyncCallback c, object s) => BeginCreate(addresses, factorySettings, timeout, c, s)), (Func<IAsyncResult, MessagingFactory>)EndCreate, (object)null);
		}

		internal static IAsyncResult BeginCreate(Uri address, MessagingFactorySettings factorySettings, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			if (factorySettings == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNull("factorySettings");
			}
			return BeginCreate(new Uri[1] { address }, factorySettings, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		internal static IAsyncResult BeginCreate(IEnumerable<Uri> addresses, MessagingFactorySettings factorySettings, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			if (factorySettings == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNull("factorySettings");
			}
			if (addresses == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNull("addresses");
			}
			Uri[] array = (addresses as Uri[]) ?? addresses.ToArray();
			if (!array.Any())
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNullOrEmpty("addresses");
			}
			if (!factorySettings.NetMessagingTransportSettings.GatewayMode)
			{
				MessagingUtilities.ThrowIfNullAddressesOrPathExists(array, "addresses");
			}
			return new CreateMessagingFactoryAsyncResult(factorySettings, array, callback, state);
		}

		internal static MessagingFactory EndCreate(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			return CreateMessagingFactoryAsyncResult.End(result);
		}
