		public QueueClient CreateQueueClient(string path, ReceiveMode receiveMode)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path))
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNullOrEmpty(path);
			}
			string text = Constants.SupportedSubQueueNames.Find((string s) => path.EndsWith(s, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
			int num = 260;
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
			{
				num += text.Length + 1;
			}
			CheckValidEntityName(path, num);
			MessagingUtilities.ThrowIfInvalidSubQueueNameString(path, "path");
			if (OpenOnceManager.ShouldOpen)
			{
				OpenOnceManager.Open();
			}
			QueueClient queueClient = OnCreateQueueClient(path, receiveMode);
			base.ClientEntityManager.Add(queueClient);
			return queueClient;
		}

		public EventHubClient CreateEventHubClient(string path)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			CheckEventHubValidTransportType(settings);
			CheckValidEntityName(path, 260);
			MessagingUtilities.ThrowIfContainsSubQueueName(path);
			if (OpenOnceManager.ShouldOpen)
			{
				OpenOnceManager.Open();
			}
			EventHubClient eventHubClient = OnCreateEventHubClient(path);
			if (hasPrefetchCountChanged)
			{
				eventHubClient.PrefetchCount = PrefetchCount;
			}
			base.ClientEntityManager.Add(eventHubClient);
			return eventHubClient;
		}

		public SubscriptionClient CreateSubscriptionClient(string topicPath, string name, ReceiveMode receiveMode)

			MessagingUtilities.ThrowIfContainsSubQueueName(topicPath);
			MessagingUtilities.ThrowIfInvalidSubQueueNameString(name, "name");
			string text = Constants.SupportedSubQueueNames.Find((string s) => name.EndsWith(s, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
			int num = 104;

		internal void ClearPairing()
		{
			if (Options != null)
			{
				Options.ClearPairing();
				if (Options.SecondaryMessagingFactory != null)
				{
					Options.SecondaryMessagingFactory.IsPaired = false;
				}
				Options = null;
			}
			PairedNamespaceFactory = null;
		}

		private IAsyncResult BeginPairNamespace(PairedNamespaceOptions options, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			if (options == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new ArgumentNullException("options"));
			}
			IPairedNamespaceFactory pairedNamespaceFactory = options.CreatePairedNamespaceFactory();
			if (pairedNamespaceFactory == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new ArgumentException("options"));
			}
			if (options.SecondaryMessagingFactory == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new ArgumentNullException("options.MessagingFactory"));
			}
			if (options.SecondaryNamespaceManager == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new ArgumentNullException("options.NamespaceManager"));
			}
			if (Uri.Compare(Address, options.SecondaryMessagingFactory.Address, UriComponents.HostAndPort, UriFormat.Unescaped, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) == 0)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new ArgumentException(SRClient.PairedNamespacePrimaryAndSecondaryEqual, "options"));
			}
			if (Options != null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.PairedNamespaceOnlyCallOnce));
			}
			if (options.SecondaryMessagingFactory != null && options.SecondaryMessagingFactory.Options != null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.PairedNamespaceMessagingFactoryInOptionsAlreadyPaired));
			}
			if (options.SecondaryMessagingFactory != null && options.SecondaryMessagingFactory.IsPaired)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.PairedNamespaceMessagingFactoryAlreadyPaired));
			}
			Options = options;
			PairedNamespaceFactory = pairedNamespaceFactory;
			Options.SecondaryMessagingFactory.IsPaired = true;
			Options.PrimaryMessagingFactory = this;
			return new PairNamespaceAsyncResult(this, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		private void EndPairNamespace(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			AsyncResult<PairNamespaceAsyncResult>.End(result);
		}

		public Task PairNamespaceAsync(PairedNamespaceOptions options)
		{
			return TaskHelpers.FromAsync((AsyncCallback c, object s) => BeginPairNamespace(options, TimeSpan.MaxValue, c, s), EndPairNamespace);
		}

		internal MessageSession AcceptMessageSession(string entityName, string sessionId, ReceiveMode receiveMode, TimeSpan serverWaitTime, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			if (OpenOnceManager.ShouldOpen)
			{
				OpenOnceManager.Open();
			}
			AcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult acceptMessageSessionAsyncResult = new AcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult(this, entityName, sessionId, receiveMode, serverWaitTime, timeout, null, null);
			try
			{
				acceptMessageSessionAsyncResult.RunSynchronously();
			}
			finally
			{
				if (acceptMessageSessionAsyncResult.IsScaledReceive)
				{
					MessagingPerformanceCounters.DecrementPendingAcceptMessageSessionByNamespaceCount(Address, 1);
				}
			}
			return acceptMessageSessionAsyncResult.MessageSession;
		}

		internal static void CheckValidEntityName(string entityName)
		{
			CheckValidEntityName(entityName, Constants.MaximumEntityNameLength);
		}

		internal static void CheckValidEntityName(string entityName, int maxEntityNameLength)
		{
			CheckValidEntityName(entityName, maxEntityNameLength, allowSeparator: true);
		}

		internal static void CheckValidEntityName(string entityName, int maxEntityNameLength, bool allowSeparator)
		{
			CheckValidEntityName(entityName, maxEntityNameLength, allowSeparator, "entityName");
		}

		internal static void CheckValidEntityName(string entityName, int maxEntityNameLength, bool allowSeparator, string paramName)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(entityName))
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNullOrEmpty(paramName);
			}
			string text = entityName.Replace("\\", "/");
			if (text.Length > maxEntityNameLength)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentOutOfRange(paramName, text, SRClient.EntityNameLengthExceedsLimit(text, maxEntityNameLength));
			}
			if (text.StartsWith("/", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || text.EndsWith("/", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.Argument(paramName, SRClient.InvalidEntityNameFormatWithSlash(text));
			}
			if (!allowSeparator && text.Contains("/"))
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.Argument(paramName, SRClient.InvalidCharacterInEntityName("/", text));
			}
			MessagingUtilities.CheckUriSchemeKey(entityName, paramName);
		}

		private static void CheckEventHubValidTransportType(MessagingFactorySettings settings)
		{
			if (settings.TransportType != TransportType.Amqp)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new NotSupportedException(SRClient.EventHubUnsupportedTransport(settings.TransportType)));
			}
		}

		internal void RegisterForCachedFactoriesCleanup()
		{
			base.ClientEntityManager.ManagerEmptied += OnClientEntityManagerOnManagerEmptied;
		}

		private static void OnClientEntityManagerOnManagerEmptied(object entityManager, EventArgs args)
		{
			KeyValueConfigurationManager.StartCachedFactoriesCleanup();
		}
	}
	public abstract class MessageReceiver : MessagingEntityClient, IMessageReceiver, IMessageBrowser
	{
		private sealed class RetryReceiveAsyncResult : RetryAsyncResult<RetryReceiveAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly MessageReceiver receiver;

			private readonly TrackingContext trackingContext;

			private readonly int messageCount;

			private readonly long fromSequenceNumber;

			private readonly IEnumerable<long> sequenceNumbers;

			private IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages;

			public IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> Messages => messages;

			public bool TryReceive { get; private set; }

			public RetryReceiveAsyncResult(MessageReceiver receiver, TrackingContext trackingContext, int messageCount, long fromSequenceNumber, IEnumerable<long> sequenceNumbers, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				if (trackingContext == null)
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("trackingContext");
				}
				if (receiver == null)
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("receiver");
				}
				this.receiver = receiver;
				this.trackingContext = trackingContext;
				this.messageCount = messageCount;
				this.fromSequenceNumber = fromSequenceNumber;
				this.sequenceNumbers = sequenceNumbers;
				MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementPendingReceiveMessageCount(this.receiver.MessagingFactory.Address, this.receiver.Address, 1);
			}

			public new static IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> End(IAsyncResult r)
			{
				RetryReceiveAsyncResult retryReceiveAsyncResult = null;
				try
				{
					retryReceiveAsyncResult = AsyncResult<RetryReceiveAsyncResult>.End(r);
					return retryReceiveAsyncResult.Messages;
				}
				finally
				{
					if (retryReceiveAsyncResult != null && retryReceiveAsyncResult.receiver != null)
					{
						MessagingPerformanceCounters.DecrementPendingReceiveMessageCount(retryReceiveAsyncResult.receiver.MessagingFactory.Address, retryReceiveAsyncResult.receiver.Address, 1);
					}
				}
			}

			public static bool TryReceiveEnd(IAsyncResult r, out IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages)
			{
				RetryReceiveAsyncResult retryReceiveAsyncResult = r as RetryReceiveAsyncResult;
				try
				{
					retryReceiveAsyncResult = AsyncResult<RetryReceiveAsyncResult>.End(r);
					messages = retryReceiveAsyncResult.Messages;
					return retryReceiveAsyncResult.TryReceive;
				}
				finally
				{
					if (retryReceiveAsyncResult != null && retryReceiveAsyncResult.receiver != null)
					{
						MessagingPerformanceCounters.DecrementPendingReceiveMessageCount(retryReceiveAsyncResult.receiver.MessagingFactory.Address, retryReceiveAsyncResult.receiver.Address, 1);
					}
				}
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				int iteration = 0;
				Stopwatch perfWatch = Stopwatch.StartNew();
				try
				{
					TimeSpan iterationSleep = (receiver.RetryPolicy.IsServerBusy ? RetryPolicy.ServerBusyBaseSleepTime : TimeSpan.Zero);
					TimeSpan timeSpan = ((base.OriginalTimeout > receiver.OperationTimeout) ? base.OriginalTimeout : receiver.OperationTimeout);
					if (receiver.RetryPolicy.IsServerBusy && RetryPolicy.ServerBusyBaseSleepTime >= timeSpan)
					{
						string serverBusyExceptionMessage = receiver.RetryPolicy.ServerBusyExceptionMessage;
						yield return CallAsyncSleep(RemainingTime());
						Complete(new ServerBusyException(serverBusyExceptionMessage, trackingContext));
						yield break;
					}
					bool shouldRetry;
					do
					{
						shouldRetry = false;
						if (iterationSleep != TimeSpan.Zero)
						{
							yield return CallAsyncSleep(iterationSleep);
						}
						string operation = "Unknown";
						if (fromSequenceNumber >= 0)
						{
							operation = "Peek";
							yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((RetryReceiveAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.receiver.OnBeginPeek(thisPtr.trackingContext, thisPtr.fromSequenceNumber, thisPtr.messageCount, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(RetryReceiveAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
							{
								thisPtr.messages = thisPtr.receiver.OnEndPeek(r);
							}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
							if (messages != null && messages.AnySlim())
							{
								receiver.LastPeekedSequenceNumber = messages.LastSlim().SequenceNumber;
							}
						}
						else if (sequenceNumbers == null || !sequenceNumbers.Any())
						{
							operation = "Receive";
							yield return CallTransactionalAsync(base.AmbientTransaction, (BeginCall)((RetryReceiveAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.receiver.OnBeginTryReceive(thisPtr.trackingContext, thisPtr.messageCount, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(RetryReceiveAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
							{
								thisPtr.TryReceive = thisPtr.receiver.OnEndTryReceive(r, out thisPtr.messages);
							}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
						}
						else
						{
							operation = "ReceiveWithSequences";
							yield return CallTransactionalAsync(base.AmbientTransaction, (BeginCall)((RetryReceiveAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.receiver.OnBeginTryReceive(thisPtr.trackingContext, thisPtr.sequenceNumbers, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(RetryReceiveAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
							{
								thisPtr.TryReceive = thisPtr.receiver.OnEndTryReceive(r, out thisPtr.messages);
							}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
						}
						if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
						{
							MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementReceiveMessageFailurePerSec(receiver.MessagingFactory.Address, receiver.Address, 1);
							MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementExceptionPerSec(receiver.MessagingFactory.Address, 1, base.LastAsyncStepException);
							shouldRetry = !base.TransactionExists && receiver.RetryPolicy.ShouldRetry(RemainingTime(), iteration, base.LastAsyncStepException, out iterationSleep);
							if (shouldRetry)
							{
								MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
								{
									MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteRetryPolicyIteration(trackingContext.Activity, trackingContext.TrackingId, receiver.RetryPolicy.GetType().Name, operation, iteration, iterationSleep.ToString(), base.LastAsyncStepException.GetType().FullName, base.LastAsyncStepException.Message);
								});
								int num = iteration;
								iteration = num + 1;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementReceiveMessageSuccessPerSec(receiver.MessagingFactory.Address, receiver.Address, (messages != null) ? messages.Count() : 0);
							receiver.RetryPolicy.ResetServerBusy();
						}
					}
					while (shouldRetry);
				}
				finally
				{
					RetryReceiveAsyncResult retryReceiveAsyncResult = this;
					perfWatch.Stop();
					MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementReceiveMessageLatency(retryReceiveAsyncResult.receiver.MessagingFactory.Address, retryReceiveAsyncResult.receiver.Address, perfWatch.ElapsedTicks);
				}
				Complete(base.LastAsyncStepException);
			}
		}

		private sealed class RetryMessagesOperationAsyncResult : RetryAsyncResult<RetryMessagesOperationAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly MessageReceiver receiver;

			private readonly TrackingContext trackingContext;

			private readonly IEnumerable<Guid> lockTokens;

			private readonly IEnumerable<ArraySegment<byte>> deliveryTags;

			private readonly IDictionary<string, object> propertiesToModify;

			private readonly string deadLetterReason;

			private readonly string deadLetterErrorDescription;

			private readonly DispositionStatus operation;

			private readonly bool fromSync;

			private ConcurrentDictionary<int, List<Guid>> lockTokenGroups;

			public IEnumerable<DateTime> LockedUntilUtcTimes { get; private set; }

			public RetryMessagesOperationAsyncResult(MessageReceiver receiver, TrackingContext trackingContext, DispositionStatus operation, IEnumerable<Guid> lockTokens, IDictionary<string, object> propertiesToModify, string deadLetterReason, string deadLetterErrorDescription, bool fromSync, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: this(receiver, trackingContext, operation, propertiesToModify, deadLetterReason, deadLetterErrorDescription, fromSync, timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.lockTokens = lockTokens;
				if (this.lockTokens == null || !this.lockTokens.Any())
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNullOrEmpty("lockTokens");
				}
			}

			public RetryMessagesOperationAsyncResult(MessageReceiver receiver, TrackingContext trackingContext, DispositionStatus operation, IEnumerable<ArraySegment<byte>> deliveryTags, IDictionary<string, object> propertiesToModify, string deadLetterReason, string deadLetterErrorDescription, bool fromSync, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: this(receiver, trackingContext, operation, propertiesToModify, deadLetterReason, deadLetterErrorDescription, fromSync, timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.deliveryTags = deliveryTags;
				if (this.deliveryTags == null || !this.deliveryTags.Any())
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNullOrEmpty("deliveryTags");
				}
			}

			private RetryMessagesOperationAsyncResult(MessageReceiver receiver, TrackingContext trackingContext, DispositionStatus operation, IDictionary<string, object> propertiesToModify, string deadLetterReason, string deadLetterErrorDescription, bool fromSync, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				if (trackingContext == null)
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("trackingContext");
				}
				if (receiver == null)
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("receiver");
				}
				this.receiver = receiver;
				this.trackingContext = trackingContext;
				this.propertiesToModify = propertiesToModify;
				this.deadLetterErrorDescription = deadLetterErrorDescription;
				this.deadLetterReason = deadLetterReason;
				this.operation = operation;
				this.fromSync = fromSync;
			}

			public static IEnumerable<DateTime> RenewLockEnd(IAsyncResult r)
			{
				return AsyncResult<RetryMessagesOperationAsyncResult>.End(r).LockedUntilUtcTimes;
			}

			public new static void End(IAsyncResult r)
			{
				AsyncResult<RetryMessagesOperationAsyncResult>.End(r);
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				int iteration = 0;
				int groupsCount = 0;
				Stopwatch perfWatch = Stopwatch.StartNew();
				try
				{
					TimeSpan iterationSleep = (receiver.RetryPolicy.IsServerBusy ? RetryPolicy.ServerBusyBaseSleepTime : TimeSpan.Zero);
					if (receiver.RetryPolicy.IsServerBusy && RetryPolicy.ServerBusyBaseSleepTime >= base.OriginalTimeout)
					{
						string serverBusyExceptionMessage = receiver.RetryPolicy.ServerBusyExceptionMessage;
						yield return CallAsyncSleep(RemainingTime());
						Complete(new ServerBusyException(serverBusyExceptionMessage, trackingContext));
						yield break;
					}
					bool shouldRetry;
					do
					{
						int completionCount = 0;
						shouldRetry = false;
						if (iterationSleep != TimeSpan.Zero)
						{
							yield return CallAsyncSleep(iterationSleep);
						}
						switch (operation)
						{
						case DispositionStatus.Completed:
							if (lockTokens != null && lockTokens.Any())
							{
								completionCount = lockTokens.Count();
								if (receiver.SupportsGetRuntimeEntityDescription && ((completionCount > 1 && receiver.RuntimeEntityDescription == null) || receiver.RefreshEntityRuntimeDescription))
								{
									yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((RetryMessagesOperationAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.receiver.BeginGetRuntimeEntityDescriptionAsyncResult(thisPtr.trackingContext, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(RetryMessagesOperationAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
									{
										thisPtr.receiver.RuntimeEntityDescription = thisPtr.receiver.EndGetRuntimeEntityDescriptionAsyncResult(r);
									}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
									receiver.RefreshEntityRuntimeDescription = false;
								}
								if (lockTokenGroups == null && completionCount > 1 && receiver.SupportsGetRuntimeEntityDescription && receiver.RuntimeEntityDescription != null && receiver.RuntimeEntityDescription.EnableMessagePartitioning)
								{
									lockTokenGroups = lockTokens.GroupByToConcurrentDictionary((Guid lockToken) => ScaledEntityPartitionResolver.LockTokenToEntityPhysicalPartition(receiver.RuntimeEntityDescription.PartitionRanges, lockToken));
									groupsCount = lockTokenGroups.Count;
									if (groupsCount > 1 && base.TransactionExists)
									{
										throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.CompleteBatchUnsuportedTransaction), trackingContext.Activity);
									}
								}
								if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
								{
									break;
								}
								if (lockTokenGroups == null || groupsCount <= 1)
								{
									yield return CallTransactionalAsync(base.AmbientTransaction, (BeginCall)((RetryMessagesOperationAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.receiver.OnBeginComplete(thisPtr.trackingContext, thisPtr.lockTokens, thisPtr.fromSync, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(RetryMessagesOperationAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
									{
										thisPtr.receiver.OnEndComplete(r);
									}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
									break;
								}
								yield return CallParallelAsync<KeyValuePair<int, List<Guid>>>((ICollection<KeyValuePair<int, List<Guid>>>)lockTokenGroups, (BeginCall<KeyValuePair<int, List<Guid>>>)((RetryMessagesOperationAsyncResult thisPtr, KeyValuePair<int, List<Guid>> lockTokenGroup, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.receiver.OnBeginComplete(thisPtr.trackingContext, lockTokenGroup.Value, thisPtr.fromSync, t, c, s)), (EndCall<KeyValuePair<int, List<Guid>>>)delegate(RetryMessagesOperationAsyncResult thisPtr, KeyValuePair<int, List<Guid>> lockTokenGroup, IAsyncResult r)
								{
									thisPtr.receiver.OnEndComplete(r);
									thisPtr.lockTokenGroups.Remove(lockTokenGroup.Key);
								}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
							}
							else if (deliveryTags != null && deliveryTags.Any())
							{
								completionCount = deliveryTags.Count();
								yield return CallTransactionalAsync(base.AmbientTransaction, (BeginCall)((RetryMessagesOperationAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.receiver.OnBeginComplete(thisPtr.trackingContext, thisPtr.deliveryTags, thisPtr.fromSync, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(RetryMessagesOperationAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
								{
									thisPtr.receiver.OnEndComplete(r);
								}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
							}
							break;
						case DispositionStatus.Abandoned:
							if (lockTokens != null && lockTokens.Any())
							{
								BrokeredMessage.ValidateMessageProperties(propertiesToModify, "propertiesToModify");
								yield return CallTransactionalAsync(base.AmbientTransaction, (BeginCall)((RetryMessagesOperationAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.receiver.OnBeginAbandon(thisPtr.trackingContext, thisPtr.lockTokens, thisPtr.propertiesToModify, thisPtr.fromSync, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(RetryMessagesOperationAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
								{
									thisPtr.receiver.OnEndAbandon(r);
								}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
							}
							break;
						case DispositionStatus.Defered:
							BrokeredMessage.ValidateMessageProperties(propertiesToModify, "propertiesToModify");
							yield return CallTransactionalAsync(base.AmbientTransaction, (BeginCall)((RetryMessagesOperationAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.receiver.OnBeginDefer(thisPtr.trackingContext, thisPtr.lockTokens, thisPtr.propertiesToModify, thisPtr.fromSync, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(RetryMessagesOperationAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
							{
								thisPtr.receiver.OnEndDefer(r);
							}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
							break;
						case DispositionStatus.Renewed:
							yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((RetryMessagesOperationAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.receiver.OnBeginRenewMessageLocks(thisPtr.trackingContext, thisPtr.lockTokens, thisPtr.fromSync, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(RetryMessagesOperationAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
							{
								thisPtr.LockedUntilUtcTimes = thisPtr.receiver.OnEndRenewMessageLocks(r);
							}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
							break;
						case DispositionStatus.Suspended:
							BrokeredMessage.ValidateMessageProperties(propertiesToModify, "propertiesToModify");
							BrokeredMessage.ValidatePropertyString(deadLetterReason, "deadLetterReason");
							BrokeredMessage.ValidatePropertyString(deadLetterErrorDescription, "deadLetterErrorDescription");
							yield return CallTransactionalAsync(base.AmbientTransaction, (BeginCall)((RetryMessagesOperationAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.receiver.OnBeginDeadLetter(thisPtr.trackingContext, thisPtr.lockTokens, thisPtr.propertiesToModify, thisPtr.deadLetterReason, thisPtr.deadLetterErrorDescription, thisPtr.fromSync, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(RetryMessagesOperationAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
							{
								thisPtr.receiver.OnEndDeadLetter(r);
							}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
							break;
						}
						if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
						{
							MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementExceptionPerSec(receiver.MessagingFactory.Address, 1, base.LastAsyncStepException);
							if (operation == DispositionStatus.Completed)
							{
								MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementCompleteMessageFailurePerSec(receiver.MessagingFactory.Address, 1);
							}
							shouldRetry = !base.TransactionExists && receiver.RetryPolicy.ShouldRetry(RemainingTime(), iteration, base.LastAsyncStepException, out iterationSleep);
							if (shouldRetry)
							{
								MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
								{
									MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteRetryPolicyIteration(trackingContext.Activity, trackingContext.TrackingId, receiver.RetryPolicy.GetType().Name, operation.ToString(), iteration, iterationSleep.ToString(), base.LastAsyncStepException.GetType().FullName, base.LastAsyncStepException.Message);
								});
								int num = iteration;
								iteration = num + 1;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							if (operation == DispositionStatus.Completed)
							{
								MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementCompleteMessageSuccessPerSec(receiver.MessagingFactory.Address, completionCount);
							}
							receiver.RetryPolicy.ResetServerBusy();
						}
					}
					while (shouldRetry);
				}
				finally
				{
					RetryMessagesOperationAsyncResult retryMessagesOperationAsyncResult = this;
					perfWatch.Stop();
					if (retryMessagesOperationAsyncResult.operation == DispositionStatus.Completed)
					{
						MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementCompleteMessageLatency(retryMessagesOperationAsyncResult.receiver.MessagingFactory.Address, perfWatch.ElapsedTicks);
					}
				}
				Complete(base.LastAsyncStepException);
			}
		}

		private sealed class RetryReceiveEventDataAsyncResult : RetryAsyncResult<RetryReceiveEventDataAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly MessageReceiver receiver;

			private readonly TrackingContext trackingContext;

			private readonly int messageCount;

			private IEnumerable<EventData> messages;

			public IEnumerable<EventData> Messages => messages;

			public bool TryReceive { get; private set; }

			public RetryReceiveEventDataAsyncResult(MessageReceiver receiver, TrackingContext trackingContext, int messageCount, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				if (trackingContext == null)
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("trackingContext");
				}
				if (receiver == null)
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("receiver");
				}
				this.receiver = receiver;
				this.trackingContext = trackingContext;
				this.messageCount = messageCount;
				MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementPendingReceiveMessageCount(this.receiver.MessagingFactory.Address, this.receiver.Address, 1);
			}

			public static bool TryReceiveEnd(IAsyncResult r, out IEnumerable<EventData> messages)
			{
				RetryReceiveEventDataAsyncResult retryReceiveEventDataAsyncResult = r as RetryReceiveEventDataAsyncResult;
				try
				{
					retryReceiveEventDataAsyncResult = AsyncResult<RetryReceiveEventDataAsyncResult>.End(r);
					messages = retryReceiveEventDataAsyncResult.Messages;
					return retryReceiveEventDataAsyncResult.TryReceive;
				}
				finally
				{
					if (retryReceiveEventDataAsyncResult != null && retryReceiveEventDataAsyncResult.receiver != null)
					{
						MessagingPerformanceCounters.DecrementPendingReceiveMessageCount(retryReceiveEventDataAsyncResult.receiver.MessagingFactory.Address, retryReceiveEventDataAsyncResult.receiver.Address, 1);
					}
				}
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				int iteration = 0;
				Stopwatch perfWatch = Stopwatch.StartNew();
				try
				{
					TimeSpan iterationSleep = (receiver.RetryPolicy.IsServerBusy ? RetryPolicy.ServerBusyBaseSleepTime : TimeSpan.Zero);
					TimeSpan timeSpan = ((base.OriginalTimeout > receiver.OperationTimeout) ? base.OriginalTimeout : receiver.OperationTimeout);
					if (receiver.RetryPolicy.IsServerBusy && RetryPolicy.ServerBusyBaseSleepTime >= timeSpan)
					{
						string serverBusyExceptionMessage = receiver.RetryPolicy.ServerBusyExceptionMessage;
						yield return CallAsyncSleep(RemainingTime());
						Complete(new ServerBusyException(serverBusyExceptionMessage, trackingContext));
						yield break;
					}
					bool shouldRetry;
					do
					{
						shouldRetry = false;
						if (iterationSleep != TimeSpan.Zero)
						{
							yield return CallAsyncSleep(iterationSleep);
						}
						yield return CallTransactionalAsync(base.AmbientTransaction, (BeginCall)((RetryReceiveEventDataAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.receiver.OnBeginTryReceiveEventData(thisPtr.trackingContext, thisPtr.messageCount, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(RetryReceiveEventDataAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
						{
							thisPtr.TryReceive = thisPtr.receiver.OnEndTryReceiveEventData(r, out thisPtr.messages);
						}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
						receiver.IncrementConnectionFailures(base.LastAsyncStepException);
						if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
						{
							receiver.IncrementContinuousErrorCount();
							MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementReceiveMessageFailurePerSec(receiver.MessagingFactory.Address, receiver.Address, 1);
							MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementExceptionPerSec(receiver.MessagingFactory.Address, 1, base.LastAsyncStepException);
							shouldRetry = !base.TransactionExists && receiver.RetryPolicy.ShouldRetry(RemainingTime(), iteration, base.LastAsyncStepException, out iterationSleep);
							if (shouldRetry)
							{
								MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
								{
									MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteRetryPolicyIteration(trackingContext.Activity, trackingContext.TrackingId, receiver.RetryPolicy.GetType().Name, "ReceiveEventData", iteration, iterationSleep.ToString(), base.LastAsyncStepException.GetType().FullName, base.LastAsyncStepException.Message);
								});
								iteration++;
							}
							continue;
						}
						MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementReceiveMessageSuccessPerSec(receiver.MessagingFactory.Address, receiver.Address, (messages != null) ? messages.Count() : 0);
						if (TryReceive)
						{
							EventData eventData = messages.Last();
							receiver.RuntimeInfo.LastSequenceNumber = eventData.LastSequenceNumber;
							receiver.RuntimeInfo.LastEnqueuedOffset = eventData.LastEnqueuedOffset;
							receiver.RuntimeInfo.LastEnqueuedTimeUtc = eventData.LastEnqueuedTime;
							receiver.RuntimeInfo.RetrievalTime = eventData.RetrievalTime;
						}
						receiver.ResetContinuousErrorCount();
						receiver.RetryPolicy.ResetServerBusy();
					}
					while (shouldRetry);
				}
				finally
				{
					RetryReceiveEventDataAsyncResult retryReceiveEventDataAsyncResult = this;
					perfWatch.Stop();
					MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementReceiveMessageLatency(retryReceiveEventDataAsyncResult.receiver.MessagingFactory.Address, retryReceiveEventDataAsyncResult.receiver.Address, perfWatch.ElapsedTicks);
				}
				Complete(base.LastAsyncStepException);
			}
		}

		private readonly OpenOnceManager openOnceManager;

		private readonly TimeSpan operationTimeout;

		private readonly object receivePumpSyncRoot;

		private readonly object synclock;

		private long lastPeekedSequenceNumber;

		private TimeSpan batchFlushInterval;

		private int prefetchCount;

		private long? prefetchEventSizeInBytes;

		private long connectionFailures;

		private Uri entityAddress;

		private MessageReceivePump receivePump;

		private bool refreshEntityRuntimeDescription;

		{
			get

				return batchFlushInterval;

			{
				ThrowIfDisposedOrImmutable();
				batchFlushInterval = value;
			}
		}

		{
			get
			{
				return lastPeekedSequenceNumber;
			}
			internal set
			{
				if (value < 0)
				{
					throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentOutOfRange("LastPeekedSequenceNumber", value, SRClient.ArgumentOutOfRange(0, long.MaxValue));
				}
				lastPeekedSequenceNumber = value;
			}
		}

		{
			get
			{
				return refreshEntityRuntimeDescription;
			}

				lock (synclock)
				{
					refreshEntityRuntimeDescription = value;
				}
			}
		}

		internal EventPosition EventPosition { get; set; }

		{

				return prefetchCount;
			}

		{

		}

		internal long TestConnectionFailures => connectionFailures;

		internal Uri Address
		{
			get
			{
				if (entityAddress == null)
				{
					bool flag = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(PartitionId);
					UriBuilder uriBuilder = new UriBuilder(MessagingFactory.Address);
					string text = string.Format("{0}{1}{2}{3}", uriBuilder.Path.EndsWith("/") ? string.Empty : "/", base.Path, flag ? string.Empty : "/", flag ? string.Empty : PartitionId);
					uriBuilder.Path += text;
					entityAddress = uriBuilder.Uri;
				}
				return entityAddress;
			}
		}

		internal bool EnableReceiverRuntimeMetric { get; set; }

		internal string Identifier { get; set; }

		internal MessageReceiver(MessagingFactory messagingFactory, string entityName, MessagingEntityType? entityType, RetryPolicy retryPolicy, ReceiveMode receiveMode, Filter filter)
			: base(entityName, entityType)
		{
			MessagingFactory = messagingFactory;
			operationTimeout = messagingFactory.OperationTimeout;
			Mode = receiveMode;
			lastPeekedSequenceNumber = Constants.DefaultLastPeekedSequenceNumber;
			base.RetryPolicy = retryPolicy ?? messagingFactory.RetryPolicy.Clone();
			openOnceManager = new OpenOnceManager(this);
			receivePumpSyncRoot = new object();
			synclock = new object();
			Filter = filter;
			RuntimeInfo = new ReceiverRuntimeInfo();
		}

		internal void Abandon(TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<Guid> lockTokens, IDictionary<string, object> propertiesToModify, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			ThrowIfNotPeekLockMode();
			TimeoutHelper.ThrowIfNegativeArgument(timeout);
			if (trackingContext == null)
			{
				trackingContext = TrackingContext.Create(Guid.NewGuid(), base.Path);
			}
			if (openOnceManager.ShouldOpen)
			{
				openOnceManager.Open();
			}
			lockTokens = new List<Guid>(lockTokens);
			OnAbandon(trackingContext, lockTokens, propertiesToModify, timeout);
		}

		internal IAsyncResult BeginAbandon(TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<Guid> lockTokens, IDictionary<string, object> propertiesToModify, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			ThrowIfNotPeekLockMode();
			TimeoutHelper.ThrowIfNegativeArgument(timeout);
			if (trackingContext == null)
			{
				trackingContext = TrackingContext.Create(Guid.NewGuid(), base.Path);
			}
			lockTokens = new List<Guid>(lockTokens);
			if (openOnceManager.ShouldOpen)
			{
				return openOnceManager.Begin(callback, state, delegate(AsyncCallback c, object s)
				{
					RetryMessagesOperationAsyncResult retryMessagesOperationAsyncResult2 = new RetryMessagesOperationAsyncResult(this, trackingContext, DispositionStatus.Abandoned, lockTokens, propertiesToModify, null, null, fromSync: false, timeout, c, s);
					retryMessagesOperationAsyncResult2.Start();
					return retryMessagesOperationAsyncResult2;
				}, RetryMessagesOperationAsyncResult.End);
			}
			RetryMessagesOperationAsyncResult retryMessagesOperationAsyncResult = new RetryMessagesOperationAsyncResult(this, trackingContext, DispositionStatus.Abandoned, lockTokens, propertiesToModify, null, null, fromSync: false, timeout, callback, state);
			retryMessagesOperationAsyncResult.Start();
			return retryMessagesOperationAsyncResult;
		}

		internal void EndAbandon(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (OpenOnceManager.ShouldEnd(result))
			{
				OpenOnceManager.End(result);
			}
			else
			{
				RetryMessagesOperationAsyncResult.End(result);
			}
		}

		internal void Complete(TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<Guid> lockTokens, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			ThrowIfNotPeekLockMode();
			TimeoutHelper.ThrowIfNegativeArgument(timeout);
			if (lockTokens == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNullOrEmpty("lockTokens");
			}
			List<Guid> list = new List<Guid>(lockTokens);
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNullOrEmpty("lockTokens");
			}
			if (trackingContext == null)
			{
				trackingContext = TrackingContext.Create(Guid.NewGuid(), base.Path);
			}
			if (openOnceManager.ShouldOpen)
			{
				openOnceManager.Open();
			}
			OnComplete(trackingContext, list, timeout);
		}

		internal IAsyncResult BeginComplete(TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<Guid> lockTokens, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			ThrowIfNotPeekLockMode();
			TimeoutHelper.ThrowIfNegativeArgument(timeout);
			if (lockTokens == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNullOrEmpty("lockTokens");
			}
			List<Guid> clonedLockTokens = new List<Guid>(lockTokens);
			if (clonedLockTokens.Count == 0)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNullOrEmpty("lockTokens");
			}
			if (trackingContext == null)
			{
				trackingContext = TrackingContext.Create(Guid.NewGuid(), base.Path);
			}
			if (openOnceManager.ShouldOpen)
			{
				return openOnceManager.Begin(callback, state, delegate(AsyncCallback c, object s)
				{
					RetryMessagesOperationAsyncResult retryMessagesOperationAsyncResult2 = new RetryMessagesOperationAsyncResult(this, trackingContext, DispositionStatus.Completed, clonedLockTokens, null, null, null, fromSync: false, timeout, c, s);
					retryMessagesOperationAsyncResult2.Start();
					return retryMessagesOperationAsyncResult2;
				}, RetryMessagesOperationAsyncResult.End);
			}
			RetryMessagesOperationAsyncResult retryMessagesOperationAsyncResult = new RetryMessagesOperationAsyncResult(this, trackingContext, DispositionStatus.Completed, clonedLockTokens, null, null, null, fromSync: false, timeout, callback, state);
			retryMessagesOperationAsyncResult.Start();
			return retryMessagesOperationAsyncResult;
		}

		internal IAsyncResult BeginRenewMessageLocks(TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<Guid> lockTokens, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			ThrowIfNotPeekLockMode();
			TimeoutHelper.ThrowIfNegativeArgument(timeout);
			if (trackingContext == null)
			{
				trackingContext = TrackingContext.Create(Guid.NewGuid(), base.Path);
			}
			if (openOnceManager.ShouldOpen)
			{
				return openOnceManager.Begin(callback, state, (Func<AsyncCallback, object, IAsyncResult>)delegate(AsyncCallback c, object s)
				{
					RetryMessagesOperationAsyncResult retryMessagesOperationAsyncResult2 = new RetryMessagesOperationAsyncResult(this, trackingContext, DispositionStatus.Renewed, lockTokens, null, null, null, fromSync: false, timeout, c, s);
					retryMessagesOperationAsyncResult2.Start();
					return retryMessagesOperationAsyncResult2;
				}, (Func<IAsyncResult, IEnumerable<DateTime>>)RetryMessagesOperationAsyncResult.RenewLockEnd);
			}
			RetryMessagesOperationAsyncResult retryMessagesOperationAsyncResult = new RetryMessagesOperationAsyncResult(this, trackingContext, DispositionStatus.Renewed, lockTokens, null, null, null, fromSync: false, timeout, callback, state);
			retryMessagesOperationAsyncResult.Start();
			return retryMessagesOperationAsyncResult;
		}

		internal IEnumerable<DateTime> EndRenewMessageLocks(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			return OpenOnceManager.ShouldEnd<IEnumerable<DateTime>>(result) ? OpenOnceManager.End<IEnumerable<DateTime>>(result) : RetryMessagesOperationAsyncResult.RenewLockEnd(result);
		}

		internal bool TryReceive(TimeSpan serverWaitTime, out BrokeredMessage message)
		{
			message = null;
			IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages;
			bool result = TryReceive(1, serverWaitTime, out messages);
			if (messages != null)
			{
				message = GetTopMessage(messages);
			}
			return result;
		}

		{
			return TryReceive(null, messageCount, serverWaitTime, out messages);
		}

		internal bool TryReceive(TrackingContext trackingContext, int messageCount, TimeSpan serverWaitTime, out IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			TimeoutHelper.ThrowIfNegativeArgument(serverWaitTime);
			if (messageCount < 1)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("messageCount"));
			}

		protected virtual bool OnTryReceive(TrackingContext trackingContext, int messageCount, TimeSpan serverWaitTime, out IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages)
		{
			RetryReceiveAsyncResult retryReceiveAsyncResult = new RetryReceiveAsyncResult(this, trackingContext, messageCount, -1L, null, serverWaitTime, null, null);
			try
			{
				retryReceiveAsyncResult = retryReceiveAsyncResult.RunSynchronously();
			}
			finally
			{
				MessagingPerformanceCounters.DecrementPendingReceiveMessageCount(MessagingFactory.Address, Address, 1);
			}
			messages = retryReceiveAsyncResult.Messages;
			return retryReceiveAsyncResult.TryReceive;
		}

		private static BrokeredMessage GetTopMessage(IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages)
		{
			using (IEnumerator<BrokeredMessage> enumerator = messages.GetEnumerator())
			{
				if (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					return enumerator.Current;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void SetReceiveContext(IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages)
		{
			if (messages == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (BrokeredMessage message in messages)
			{
				message.ReceiveContext = OnCreateReceiveContext(message);
			}
		}

		}

		private void OnMessage(MessageReceivePump pump)
		{
			lock (receivePumpSyncRoot)
			{
				if (receivePump != null)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.OnMessageAlreadyCalled);
				}
				try
				{
					receivePump = pump;
					receivePump.Start();
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
					receivePump = null;
					throw;
				}
			}
		}

		private void IncrementConnectionFailures(Exception exception)
		{
			if (exception == null)
			{
				Interlocked.Exchange(ref connectionFailures, 0L);
			}
			else if (exception is TimeoutException && Interlocked.Increment(ref connectionFailures) % 10 == 0L)
			{
				MessagingFactory.ResetConnection(Address);
			}
		}

		private void ThrowIfNotPeekLockMode()
		{
			if (Mode != ReceiveMode.PeekLock)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.PeekLockModeRequired));
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class MessageSender : MessagingEntityClient, IMessageSender
	{
		private sealed class RetrySenderAsyncResult : RetryAsyncResult<RetrySenderAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly MessageSender sender;

			private readonly TrackingContext trackingContext;

			private readonly IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages;

			private readonly List<BrokeredMessage> messagesBuffer;

			private readonly bool fromSync;

			private readonly int messageCount;

			private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<int, bool> sentGroups;

			private IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messagesToSend;

			private Dictionary<int, List<BrokeredMessage>> messageGroupsToSend;

			public RetrySenderAsyncResult(MessageSender sender, TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages, bool fromSync, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				RetrySenderAsyncResult retrySenderAsyncResult = this;
				if (trackingContext == null)
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("trackingContext");
				}
				if (sender == null)
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("sender");
				}
				foreach (BrokeredMessage message in messages)
				{
					BrokeredMessage.ValidateMessageProperties(message.Properties, "Properties");
				}
				this.fromSync = fromSync;
				this.sender = sender;
				this.trackingContext = trackingContext;
				this.messages = messages;
				messagesBuffer = new List<BrokeredMessage>();
				BrokeredMessage[] array = (this.messages as BrokeredMessage[]) ?? this.messages.ToArray();
				messageCount = array.Count();
				sentGroups = new ConcurrentDictionary<int, bool>();
				if (sender.RetryPolicy is NoRetry)
				{
					return;
				}
				try
				{
					BrokeredMessage[] array2 = array;
					foreach (BrokeredMessage brokeredMessage in array2)
					{
						messagesBuffer.Add(brokeredMessage.Clone());
					}
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					Exception e = ex;
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteRetryPolicyStreamNotClonable(retrySenderAsyncResult.trackingContext.Activity, retrySenderAsyncResult.trackingContext.TrackingId, retrySenderAsyncResult.sender.RetryPolicy.GetType().Name, "Send", e.GetType().FullName, e.Message);
					});
					foreach (BrokeredMessage item in messagesBuffer)
					{
						item.Dispose();
					}
					messagesBuffer.Clear();
				}
			}

			public new static void End(IAsyncResult r)
			{
				AsyncResult<RetrySenderAsyncResult>.End(r);
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				int iteration = 0;
				int? groupsCount = null;
				Stopwatch perfWatch = Stopwatch.StartNew();
				try
				{
					TimeSpan iterationSleep = (sender.RetryPolicy.IsServerBusy ? RetryPolicy.ServerBusyBaseSleepTime : TimeSpan.Zero);
					if (sender.RetryPolicy.IsServerBusy && RetryPolicy.ServerBusyBaseSleepTime >= base.OriginalTimeout)
					{
						string serverBusyExceptionMessage = sender.RetryPolicy.ServerBusyExceptionMessage;
						yield return CallAsyncSleep(RemainingTime());
						Complete(new ServerBusyException(serverBusyExceptionMessage, trackingContext));
						yield break;
					}
					Dictionary<int, List<BrokeredMessage>> messageGroupsBuffer = null;
					bool shouldRetry;
					do
					{
						shouldRetry = false;
						if (iterationSleep != TimeSpan.Zero)
						{
							yield return CallAsyncSleep(iterationSleep);
						}
						if (sender.SupportsGetRuntimeEntityDescription && !sender.DisableSendBatchAutoGrouping && ((messageCount > 1 && sender.RuntimeEntityDescription == null) || sender.RefreshEntityRuntimeDescription))
						{
							yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((RetrySenderAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.sender.BeginGetRuntimeEntityDescriptionAsyncResult(thisPtr.trackingContext, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(RetrySenderAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
							{
								thisPtr.sender.RuntimeEntityDescription = thisPtr.sender.EndGetRuntimeEntityDescriptionAsyncResult(r);
							}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
							sender.RefreshEntityRuntimeDescription = false;
						}
						if (messageCount > 1 && sender.SupportsGetRuntimeEntityDescription && !sender.DisableSendBatchAutoGrouping && sender.RuntimeEntityDescription != null && sender.RuntimeEntityDescription.EnableMessagePartitioning)
						{
							Dictionary<int, List<BrokeredMessage>> messageGroups = null;
							if (!groupsCount.HasValue)
							{
								groupsCount = ((iteration == 0) ? (messageGroups = GroupByFragment(messages)) : (messageGroupsBuffer = GroupByFragment(messagesBuffer))).Count;
								if (groupsCount > 1 && base.TransactionExists)
								{
									throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.SendBatchUnsuportedTransaction), trackingContext.Activity);
								}
							}
							if (iteration > 0 && groupsCount > 1)
							{
								messageGroupsBuffer = messageGroupsBuffer ?? GroupByFragment(messagesBuffer);
								messageGroups = new Dictionary<int, List<BrokeredMessage>>();
								sentGroups.Keys.ForEach(delegate(int groupKey)
								{
									messageGroupsBuffer.Remove(groupKey);
								});
								messageGroupsBuffer.ForEach(delegate(KeyValuePair<int, List<BrokeredMessage>> group)
								{
									messageGroups.Add(group.Key, group.Value.Select((BrokeredMessage bm) => bm.Clone()).ToList());
								});
							}
							messageGroupsToSend = ((groupsCount > 1) ? messageGroups : null);
						}
						try
						{
							if (messageGroupsToSend == null)
							{
								messagesToSend = ((iteration == 0) ? messages : messagesBuffer.Select((BrokeredMessage brokeredMessage) => brokeredMessage.Clone()));
								yield return CallTransactionalAsync(base.AmbientTransaction, (BeginCall)((RetrySenderAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.sender.OnBeginSend(thisPtr.trackingContext, thisPtr.messagesToSend, thisPtr.fromSync, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(RetrySenderAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
								{
									thisPtr.sender.OnEndSend(r);
								}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
							}
							else
							{
								sentGroups.Clear();
								yield return CallParallelAsync<KeyValuePair<int, List<BrokeredMessage>>>((ICollection<KeyValuePair<int, List<BrokeredMessage>>>)messageGroupsToSend, (BeginCall<KeyValuePair<int, List<BrokeredMessage>>>)((RetrySenderAsyncResult thisPtr, KeyValuePair<int, List<BrokeredMessage>> messageGroup, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.sender.OnBeginSend(thisPtr.trackingContext, messageGroup.Value, thisPtr.fromSync, t, c, s)), (EndCall<KeyValuePair<int, List<BrokeredMessage>>>)delegate(RetrySenderAsyncResult thisPtr, KeyValuePair<int, List<BrokeredMessage>> messageGroup, IAsyncResult r)
								{
									thisPtr.sender.OnEndSend(r);
									thisPtr.sentGroups.TryAdd(messageGroup.Key, value: true);
								}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
							}
						}
						finally
						{
							DisposeClonedMessages(iteration);
						}
						if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
						{
							MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementSendMessageFailurePerSec(sender.MessagingFactory.Address, sender.Address, messageCount);
							MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementExceptionPerSec(sender.MessagingFactory.Address, 1, base.LastAsyncStepException);
							bool flag = sender.RetryPolicy.ShouldRetry(RemainingTime(), iteration, base.LastAsyncStepException, out iterationSleep);
							shouldRetry = messagesBuffer.Count > 0 && !base.TransactionExists && flag;
							if (shouldRetry)
							{
								MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
								{
									MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteRetryPolicyIteration(trackingContext.Activity, trackingContext.TrackingId, sender.RetryPolicy.GetType().Name, "Send", iteration, iterationSleep.ToString(), base.LastAsyncStepException.GetType().FullName, base.LastAsyncStepException.Message);
								});
								iteration++;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementSendMessageSuccessPerSec(sender.MessagingFactory.Address, sender.Address, messageCount);
							sender.RetryPolicy.ResetServerBusy();
						}
					}
					while (shouldRetry);
				}
				finally
				{
					RetrySenderAsyncResult retrySenderAsyncResult = this;
					perfWatch.Stop();
					MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementSendMessageLatency(retrySenderAsyncResult.sender.MessagingFactory.Address, retrySenderAsyncResult.sender.Address, perfWatch.ElapsedTicks);
					retrySenderAsyncResult.messagesBuffer.ForEach(delegate(BrokeredMessage brokeredMessage)
					{
						brokeredMessage.Dispose();
					});
					retrySenderAsyncResult.messagesBuffer.Clear();
				}
				Complete(base.LastAsyncStepException);
			}

			private void DisposeClonedMessages(int iteration)
			{
				if (messagesToSend != null)
				{
					if (iteration > 0)
					{
						messagesToSend.ForEach(delegate(BrokeredMessage bm)
						{
							bm.Dispose();
						});
					}
					messagesToSend = null;
				}
				if (messageGroupsToSend == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (iteration > 0)
				{
					messageGroupsToSend.ForEach(delegate(KeyValuePair<int, List<BrokeredMessage>> group)
					{
						group.Value.ForEach(delegate(BrokeredMessage bm)
						{
							bm.Dispose();
						});
					});
				}
				messageGroupsToSend = null;
			}

			private Dictionary<int, List<BrokeredMessage>> GroupByFragment(IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages)
			{
				Dictionary<int, List<BrokeredMessage>> dictionary = new Dictionary<int, List<BrokeredMessage>>();
				foreach (BrokeredMessage message in messages)
				{
					object obj;
					if (!sender.ViaSender)
					{
						if (!sender.RuntimeEntityDescription.RequiresDuplicateDetection)
						{
							obj = message.SessionId ?? message.PartitionKey;
						}
						else
						{
							obj = message.SessionId ?? message.PartitionKey;
							if (obj == null)
							{
								obj = message.MessageId;
							}
						}
					}
					else
					{
						obj = message.ViaPartitionKey;
					}
					string value = (string)obj;
					short num = ScaledEntityPartitionResolver.ResolveToEntityLogicalPartition(value, sender.RuntimeEntityDescription.PartitionCount);
					int key = ((sender.RuntimeEntityDescription.PartitionRanges != null) ? ScaledEntityPartitionResolver.ResolveLogicalPartitionToPhysicalFragmentIndex(sender.RuntimeEntityDescription.PartitionRanges, num) : num);
					if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(key, out var value2))
					{
						value2 = new List<BrokeredMessage>();
						dictionary.Add(key, value2);
					}
					value2.Add(message);
				}
				return dictionary;
			}
		}

		private sealed class RetrySenderEventDataAsyncResult : RetryAsyncResult<RetrySenderEventDataAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly MessageSender sender;

			private readonly TrackingContext trackingContext;

			private readonly EventData[] eventDatas;

			private readonly List<EventData> eventBuffer;

			private readonly int messageCount;

			public RetrySenderEventDataAsyncResult(MessageSender sender, TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<EventData> messages, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				RetrySenderEventDataAsyncResult retrySenderEventDataAsyncResult = this;
				if (trackingContext == null)
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("trackingContext");
				}
				if (sender == null)
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("sender");
				}
				this.sender = sender;
				this.trackingContext = trackingContext;
				eventDatas = messages.ToArray();
				eventBuffer = new List<EventData>();
				messageCount = eventDatas.Length;
				if (eventDatas.Any((EventData eventData2) => eventData2.SerializedAmqpMessage == null && eventData2.BodyStream != null && eventData2.BodyStream.CanSeek && eventData2.BodyStream.Position != 0))
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.MessageBodyConsumed), this.trackingContext.Activity);
				}
				if (sender.RetryPolicy is NoRetry)
				{
					return;
				}
				try
				{
					EventData[] array = eventDatas;
					foreach (EventData eventData in array)
					{
						eventBuffer.Add(eventData.Clone());
					}
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					Exception e = ex;
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteRetryPolicyStreamNotClonable(retrySenderEventDataAsyncResult.trackingContext.Activity, retrySenderEventDataAsyncResult.trackingContext.TrackingId, retrySenderEventDataAsyncResult.sender.RetryPolicy.GetType().Name, "Send", e.GetType().FullName, e.Message);
					});
					foreach (EventData item in eventBuffer)
					{
						item.Dispose();
					}
					eventBuffer.Clear();
				}
			}

			public new static void End(IAsyncResult r)
			{
				AsyncResult<RetrySenderEventDataAsyncResult>.End(r);
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				int iteration = 0;
				Stopwatch perfWatch = Stopwatch.StartNew();
				try
				{
					TimeSpan iterationSleep = (sender.RetryPolicy.IsServerBusy ? RetryPolicy.ServerBusyBaseSleepTime : TimeSpan.Zero);
					if (sender.RetryPolicy.IsServerBusy && RetryPolicy.ServerBusyBaseSleepTime >= base.OriginalTimeout)
					{
						string serverBusyExceptionMessage = sender.RetryPolicy.ServerBusyExceptionMessage;
						yield return CallAsyncSleep(RemainingTime());
						Complete(new ServerBusyException(serverBusyExceptionMessage, trackingContext));
						yield break;
					}
					bool shouldRetry;
					do
					{
						shouldRetry = false;
						if (iterationSleep != TimeSpan.Zero)
						{
							yield return CallAsyncSleep(iterationSleep);
						}
						EventData[] tmpDatas = null;
						if (iteration != 0)
						{
							tmpDatas = eventBuffer.Select((EventData eventData) => eventData.Clone()).ToArray();
						}
						try
						{
							yield return CallTransactionalAsync(base.AmbientTransaction, (BeginCall)((RetrySenderEventDataAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.sender.OnBeginSendEventData(thisPtr.trackingContext, tmpDatas ?? thisPtr.eventDatas, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(RetrySenderEventDataAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
							{
								thisPtr.sender.OnEndSendEventData(r);
							}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
						}
						finally
						{
							if (tmpDatas != null)
							{
								tmpDatas.ForEach(delegate(EventData eventData)
								{
									eventData.Dispose();
								});
								tmpDatas = null;
							}
						}
						sender.IncrementConnectionFailures(base.LastAsyncStepException);
						if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
						{
							MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementSendMessageFailurePerSec(sender.MessagingFactory.Address, sender.Address, messageCount);
							MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementExceptionPerSec(sender.MessagingFactory.Address, 1, base.LastAsyncStepException);
							bool flag = sender.RetryPolicy.ShouldRetry(RemainingTime(), iteration, base.LastAsyncStepException, out iterationSleep);
							shouldRetry = eventBuffer.Count > 0 && !base.TransactionExists && flag;
							if (shouldRetry)
							{
								MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
								{
									MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteRetryPolicyIteration(trackingContext.Activity, trackingContext.TrackingId, sender.RetryPolicy.GetType().Name, "Send", iteration, iterationSleep.ToString(), base.LastAsyncStepException.GetType().FullName, base.LastAsyncStepException.Message);
								});
								iteration++;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementSendMessageSuccessPerSec(sender.MessagingFactory.Address, sender.Address, messageCount);
							sender.RetryPolicy.ResetServerBusy();
						}
					}
					while (shouldRetry);
				}
				finally
				{
					RetrySenderEventDataAsyncResult retrySenderEventDataAsyncResult = this;
					perfWatch.Stop();
					MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementSendMessageLatency(retrySenderEventDataAsyncResult.sender.MessagingFactory.Address, retrySenderEventDataAsyncResult.sender.Address, perfWatch.ElapsedTicks);
				}
				eventBuffer.ForEach(delegate(EventData eventData)
				{
					eventData.Dispose();
				});
				eventBuffer.Clear();
				Complete(base.LastAsyncStepException);
			}
		}

		private sealed class RetryScheduleSenderAsyncResult : RetryAsyncResult<RetryScheduleSenderAsyncResult>
		{

			private readonly TrackingContext trackingContext;

			private readonly IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages;

			private readonly List<BrokeredMessage> messagesBuffer;

			public IEnumerable<long> SequenceNumbers { get; private set; }

			public RetryScheduleSenderAsyncResult(MessageSender sender, TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)

					throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("trackingContext");

				{
					throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("sender");
				}
				this.sender = sender;
				this.trackingContext = trackingContext;
				this.messages = messages;
				messagesBuffer = new List<BrokeredMessage>();
				BrokeredMessage[] array = (this.messages as BrokeredMessage[]) ?? this.messages.ToArray();
				if (sender.RetryPolicy is NoRetry)
				{
					return;
				}
				try
				{
					BrokeredMessage[] array2 = array;
					foreach (BrokeredMessage brokeredMessage in array2)

			public static IEnumerable<long> ScheduleSenderEnd(IAsyncResult r)
			{
				return AsyncResult<RetryScheduleSenderAsyncResult>.End(r).SequenceNumbers;
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				int iteration = 0;
				Stopwatch perfWatch = Stopwatch.StartNew();
				try
				{
					TimeSpan iterationSleep = (sender.RetryPolicy.IsServerBusy ? RetryPolicy.ServerBusyBaseSleepTime : TimeSpan.Zero);
					if (sender.RetryPolicy.IsServerBusy && RetryPolicy.ServerBusyBaseSleepTime >= base.OriginalTimeout)
					{
						string serverBusyExceptionMessage = sender.RetryPolicy.ServerBusyExceptionMessage;
						yield return CallAsyncSleep(RemainingTime());
						Complete(new ServerBusyException(serverBusyExceptionMessage, trackingContext));
						yield break;
					}
					bool shouldRetry;
					do
					{
						shouldRetry = false;
						if (iterationSleep != TimeSpan.Zero)
						{
							yield return CallAsyncSleep(iterationSleep);
						}
						List<BrokeredMessage> tmpMessages = null;
						if (iteration != 0)
						{
							tmpMessages = messagesBuffer.Select((BrokeredMessage brokeredMessage) => brokeredMessage.Clone()).ToList();
						}
						try
						{
							yield return CallTransactionalAsync(base.AmbientTransaction, (BeginCall)delegate(RetryScheduleSenderAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s)
							{
								MessageSender messageSender = thisPtr.sender;
								TrackingContext obj = thisPtr.trackingContext;
								IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> enumerable = tmpMessages;
								return messageSender.OnBeginScheduleMessage(obj, enumerable ?? thisPtr.messages, t, c, s);
							}, (EndCall)delegate(RetryScheduleSenderAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
							{
								thisPtr.SequenceNumbers = thisPtr.sender.OnEndScheduleMessage(r);
							}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
						}
						finally
						{
							if (tmpMessages != null)
							{
								tmpMessages.ForEach(delegate(BrokeredMessage brokeredMessage)
								{
									brokeredMessage.Dispose();
								});
								tmpMessages.Clear();
							}
						}
						if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
						{
							MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementExceptionPerSec(sender.MessagingFactory.Address, 1, base.LastAsyncStepException);
							bool flag = sender.RetryPolicy.ShouldRetry(RemainingTime(), iteration, base.LastAsyncStepException, out iterationSleep);
							shouldRetry = messagesBuffer.Count > 0 && !base.TransactionExists && flag;
							if (shouldRetry)
							{
								MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
								{
									MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteRetryPolicyIteration(trackingContext.Activity, trackingContext.TrackingId, sender.RetryPolicy.GetType().Name, "ScheduleMessage", iteration, iterationSleep.ToString(), base.LastAsyncStepException.GetType().FullName, base.LastAsyncStepException.Message);
								});
								iteration++;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							sender.RetryPolicy.ResetServerBusy();
						}
					}
					while (shouldRetry);
				}
				finally
				{
					perfWatch.Stop();
				}
				messagesBuffer.ForEach(delegate(BrokeredMessage brokeredMessage)
				{
					brokeredMessage.Dispose();
				});
				messagesBuffer.Clear();
				Complete(base.LastAsyncStepException);
			}
		}

		private sealed class RetryCancelScheduledSenderAsyncResult : RetryAsyncResult<RetryCancelScheduledSenderAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly MessageSender sender;

			private readonly TrackingContext trackingContext;

			private readonly IEnumerable<long> sequenceNumbers;

			private readonly List<long> sequenceNumbersBuffer;

			private readonly int messageCount;

			public RetryCancelScheduledSenderAsyncResult(MessageSender sender, TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<long> sequenceNumbers, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				RetryCancelScheduledSenderAsyncResult retryCancelScheduledSenderAsyncResult = this;
				if (trackingContext == null)
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("trackingContext");
				}
				if (sender == null)
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("sender");
				}
				this.sender = sender;
				this.trackingContext = trackingContext;
				this.sequenceNumbers = sequenceNumbers;
				sequenceNumbersBuffer = new List<long>();
				messageCount = this.sequenceNumbers.Count();
				if (sender.RetryPolicy is NoRetry)
				{
					return;
				}
				try
				{
					foreach (long sequenceNumber in this.sequenceNumbers)
					{
						sequenceNumbersBuffer.Add(sequenceNumber);
					}
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					Exception e = ex;
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteRetryPolicyStreamNotClonable(retryCancelScheduledSenderAsyncResult.trackingContext.Activity, retryCancelScheduledSenderAsyncResult.trackingContext.TrackingId, retryCancelScheduledSenderAsyncResult.sender.RetryPolicy.GetType().Name, "CancelScheduledMessage", e.GetType().FullName, e.Message);
					});
					sequenceNumbersBuffer.Clear();
				}
			}

			public new static void End(IAsyncResult r)
			{
				AsyncResult<RetryCancelScheduledSenderAsyncResult>.End(r);
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				int iteration = 0;
				Stopwatch perfWatch = Stopwatch.StartNew();
				try
				{
					TimeSpan iterationSleep = (sender.RetryPolicy.IsServerBusy ? RetryPolicy.ServerBusyBaseSleepTime : TimeSpan.Zero);
					if (sender.RetryPolicy.IsServerBusy && RetryPolicy.ServerBusyBaseSleepTime >= base.OriginalTimeout)
					{
						string serverBusyExceptionMessage = sender.RetryPolicy.ServerBusyExceptionMessage;
						yield return CallAsyncSleep(RemainingTime());
						Complete(new ServerBusyException(serverBusyExceptionMessage, trackingContext));
						yield break;
					}
					bool shouldRetry;
					do
					{
						shouldRetry = false;
						if (iterationSleep != TimeSpan.Zero)
						{
							yield return CallAsyncSleep(iterationSleep);
						}
						List<long> tmpMessages = null;
						if (iteration != 0)
						{
							tmpMessages = sequenceNumbersBuffer.Select((long num) => num).ToList();
						}
						try
						{
							yield return CallTransactionalAsync(base.AmbientTransaction, (BeginCall)delegate(RetryCancelScheduledSenderAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s)
							{
								MessageSender messageSender = thisPtr.sender;
								TrackingContext obj = thisPtr.trackingContext;
								IEnumerable<long> enumerable = tmpMessages;
								return messageSender.OnBeginCancelScheduledMessage(obj, enumerable ?? thisPtr.sequenceNumbers, t, c, s);
							}, (EndCall)delegate(RetryCancelScheduledSenderAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
							{
								thisPtr.sender.OnEndCancelScheduledMessage(r);
							}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
						}
						finally
						{
							if (tmpMessages != null)
							{
								tmpMessages.Clear();
							}
						}
						if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
						{
							MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementCancelScheduledMessageFailurePerSec(sender.MessagingFactory.Address, messageCount);
							MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementExceptionPerSec(sender.MessagingFactory.Address, 1, base.LastAsyncStepException);
							bool flag = sender.RetryPolicy.ShouldRetry(RemainingTime(), iteration, base.LastAsyncStepException, out iterationSleep);
							shouldRetry = sequenceNumbersBuffer.Count > 0 && !base.TransactionExists && flag;
							if (shouldRetry)
							{
								MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
								{
									MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteRetryPolicyIteration(trackingContext.Activity, trackingContext.TrackingId, sender.RetryPolicy.GetType().Name, "CancelScheduledMessage", iteration, iterationSleep.ToString(), base.LastAsyncStepException.GetType().FullName, base.LastAsyncStepException.Message);
								});
								iteration++;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementCancelScheduledMessageSuccessPerSec(sender.MessagingFactory.Address, messageCount);
							sender.RetryPolicy.ResetServerBusy();
						}
					}
					while (shouldRetry);
				}
				finally
				{
					RetryCancelScheduledSenderAsyncResult retryCancelScheduledSenderAsyncResult = this;
					perfWatch.Stop();
					MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementCancelScheduledMessageLatency(retryCancelScheduledSenderAsyncResult.sender.MessagingFactory.Address, perfWatch.ElapsedTicks);
				}
				sequenceNumbersBuffer.Clear();
				Complete(base.LastAsyncStepException);
			}
		}

					uriBuilder.Path += text;

		internal void Send(TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			MessagingUtilities.CheckValidMessages(messages, validateOnSend: true);
			TimeoutHelper.ThrowIfNegativeArgument(timeout);
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			if (trackingContext == null)
			{
				trackingContext = TrackingContext.Create(Guid.NewGuid(), base.Path);
			}
			if (openOnceManager.ShouldOpen)
			{
				openOnceManager.Open();
			}
			MessagingUtilities.ValidateAndSetConsumedMessages(messages);
			OnSend(trackingContext, messages, timeout);
		}

		internal IAsyncResult BeginSend(TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			MessagingUtilities.CheckValidMessages(messages, validateOnSend: true);
			TimeoutHelper.ThrowIfNegativeArgument(timeout);
			if (trackingContext == null)
			{
				trackingContext = TrackingContext.Create(Guid.NewGuid(), base.Path);
			}
			MessagingUtilities.ValidateAndSetConsumedMessages(messages);
			if (openOnceManager.ShouldOpen)
			{
				return openOnceManager.Begin(callback, state, (AsyncCallback c, object s) => new RetrySenderAsyncResult(this, trackingContext, messages, fromSync: false, timeout, c, s).Start(), RetrySenderAsyncResult.End);
			}
			return new RetrySenderAsyncResult(this, trackingContext, messages, fromSync: false, timeout, callback, state).Start();
		}

		internal void EndSend(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (OpenOnceManager.ShouldEnd(result))
			{
				OpenOnceManager.End(result);
			}
			else
			{
				RetrySenderAsyncResult.End(result);
			}
		}

		internal void EndSendBatch(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (OpenOnceManager.ShouldEnd(result))

		}

		internal IAsyncResult BeginSendEventData(TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<EventData> eventDatas, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			TimeoutHelper.ThrowIfNegativeArgument(timeout);
			Validate(eventDatas);
			if (trackingContext == null)
			{
				trackingContext = TrackingContext.Create(Guid.NewGuid(), base.Path);
			}
			if (openOnceManager.ShouldOpen)
			{
				return openOnceManager.Begin(callback, state, delegate(AsyncCallback c, object s)
				{
					RetrySenderEventDataAsyncResult retrySenderEventDataAsyncResult = new RetrySenderEventDataAsyncResult(this, trackingContext, eventDatas, timeout, c, s);
					retrySenderEventDataAsyncResult.Start();
					return retrySenderEventDataAsyncResult;
				}, RetrySenderEventDataAsyncResult.End);
			}
			return new RetrySenderEventDataAsyncResult(this, trackingContext, eventDatas, timeout, callback, state).Start();
		}

		internal void EndSendEventData(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (OpenOnceManager.ShouldEnd(result))
			{
				OpenOnceManager.End(result);

			else

		protected abstract IAsyncResult OnBeginSend(TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages, bool fromSync, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state);

		protected abstract IAsyncResult OnBeginSendEventData(TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<EventData> eventDatas, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state);

		protected virtual void OnSend(TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			RetrySenderAsyncResult retrySenderAsyncResult = new RetrySenderAsyncResult(this, trackingContext, messages, fromSync: true, timeout, null, null);
			retrySenderAsyncResult.RunSynchronously();
		}

		internal IAsyncResult BeginScheduleMessage(BrokeredMessage message, DateTimeOffset scheduleEnqueueTime, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			if (message == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNullOrEmpty("message");
			}
			message.ScheduledEnqueueTimeUtc = scheduleEnqueueTime.UtcDateTime;
			return BeginScheduleMessage(null, new BrokeredMessage[1] { message }, OperationTimeout, callback, state);
		}

		internal IAsyncResult BeginScheduleMessage(TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			MessagingUtilities.CheckValidMessages(messages, validateOnSend: true);
			TimeoutHelper.ThrowIfNegativeArgument(timeout);
			if (trackingContext == null)
			{
				trackingContext = TrackingContext.Create(Guid.NewGuid(), base.Path);
			}
			MessagingUtilities.ValidateAndSetConsumedMessages(messages);
			if (openOnceManager.ShouldOpen)
			{
				return openOnceManager.Begin(callback, state, (Func<AsyncCallback, object, IAsyncResult>)delegate(AsyncCallback c, object s)
				{
					RetryScheduleSenderAsyncResult retryScheduleSenderAsyncResult2 = new RetryScheduleSenderAsyncResult(this, trackingContext, messages, timeout, c, s);
					retryScheduleSenderAsyncResult2.Start();
					return retryScheduleSenderAsyncResult2;
				}, (Func<IAsyncResult, IEnumerable<long>>)RetryScheduleSenderAsyncResult.ScheduleSenderEnd);
			}
			RetryScheduleSenderAsyncResult retryScheduleSenderAsyncResult = new RetryScheduleSenderAsyncResult(this, trackingContext, messages, timeout, callback, state);
			retryScheduleSenderAsyncResult.Start();
			return retryScheduleSenderAsyncResult;
		}

		internal IEnumerable<long> EndScheduleMessage(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (OpenOnceManager.ShouldEnd<IEnumerable<long>>(result))
			{
				return OpenOnceManager.End<IEnumerable<long>>(result);
			}
			return RetryScheduleSenderAsyncResult.ScheduleSenderEnd(result);
		}

		internal IAsyncResult BeginCancelScheduledMessage(long sequenceNumber, AsyncCallback callback, object state)

		internal IAsyncResult BeginCancelScheduledMessage(TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<long> sequenceNumbers, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)

			}
			if (openOnceManager.ShouldOpen)
			{
				return openOnceManager.Begin(callback, state, delegate(AsyncCallback c, object s)
				{
					RetryCancelScheduledSenderAsyncResult retryCancelScheduledSenderAsyncResult2 = new RetryCancelScheduledSenderAsyncResult(this, trackingContext, sequenceNumbers, timeout, c, s);
					retryCancelScheduledSenderAsyncResult2.Start();
					return retryCancelScheduledSenderAsyncResult2;
				}, RetryCancelScheduledSenderAsyncResult.End);
			}
			RetryCancelScheduledSenderAsyncResult retryCancelScheduledSenderAsyncResult = new RetryCancelScheduledSenderAsyncResult(this, trackingContext, sequenceNumbers, timeout, callback, state);
			retryCancelScheduledSenderAsyncResult.Start();

		protected abstract IAsyncResult OnBeginScheduleMessage(TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state);

		protected abstract IEnumerable<long> OnEndScheduleMessage(IAsyncResult result);
