		private void IncrementConnectionFailures(Exception exception)
		{
			if (exception == null)
			{
				Interlocked.Exchange(ref connectionFailures, 0L);
			}
			else if (exception is TimeoutException && Interlocked.Increment(ref connectionFailures) % 10 == 0L)
			{
				MessagingFactory.ResetConnection(Address);
			}
		}

		private void Validate(IEnumerable<EventData> events)
		{
			if (events == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new ArgumentException(SRClient.EventDataListIsNullOrEmpty));
			}
			bool flag = false;
			foreach (EventData @event in events)
			{
				flag = true;
				if (PartitionId != null && @event.PartitionKey != null)
				{
					throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new ArgumentException(SRClient.PartitionInvalidPartitionKey(@event.PartitionKey, PartitionId)));
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new ArgumentException(SRClient.EventDataListIsNullOrEmpty));
			}
		}

		internal IAsyncResult BeginGetRuntimeEntityDescriptionAsyncResult(TrackingContext trackingContext, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			if (trackingContext == null)
			{
				trackingContext = TrackingContext.Create(Guid.NewGuid(), base.Path);
			}
			if (openOnceManager.ShouldOpen)
			{
				return openOnceManager.Begin(callback, state, (Func<AsyncCallback, object, IAsyncResult>)((AsyncCallback c, object s) => OnBeginGetRuntimeEntityDescriptionAsyncResult(trackingContext, timeout, c, s)), (Func<IAsyncResult, RuntimeEntityDescription>)OnEndGetRuntimeEntityDescriptionAsyncResult);
			}
			return OnBeginGetRuntimeEntityDescriptionAsyncResult(trackingContext, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		internal RuntimeEntityDescription EndGetRuntimeEntityDescriptionAsyncResult(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (OpenOnceManager.ShouldEnd<RuntimeEntityDescription>(result))
			{
				return OpenOnceManager.End<RuntimeEntityDescription>(result);
			}
			return OnEndGetRuntimeEntityDescriptionAsyncResult(result);
		}

		internal abstract IAsyncResult OnBeginGetRuntimeEntityDescriptionAsyncResult(TrackingContext trackingContext, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state);

		internal abstract RuntimeEntityDescription OnEndGetRuntimeEntityDescriptionAsyncResult(IAsyncResult result);
	}
	[Serializable]
	public class MessagingException : Exception
	{
		public MessagingExceptionDetail Detail { get; private set; }

		internal TrackingContext Tracker { get; private set; }

		public DateTime Timestamp { get; private set; }

		public bool IsTransient { get; protected set; }

		internal MessagingErrorSubCode SubCode { get; private set; }

		public sealed override IDictionary Data => base.Data;

		public MessagingException(string message)
			: base(message)
		{
			MessagingExceptionDetail detail = MessagingExceptionDetail.UnknownDetail(message);
			Initialize(detail, null, DateTime.UtcNow);
		}

		public MessagingException(string message, Exception innerException)
			: base(message, innerException)
		{
			MessagingExceptionDetail detail = MessagingExceptionDetail.UnknownDetail(message);
			Initialize(detail, null, DateTime.UtcNow);
		}

		public MessagingException(string message, bool isTransientError, Exception innerException)
			: base(message, innerException)
		{
			MessagingExceptionDetail detail = MessagingExceptionDetail.UnknownDetail(message);
			Initialize(detail, null, DateTime.UtcNow);
			IsTransient = isTransientError;
		}

		internal MessagingException(string message, TrackingContext trackingContext, Exception innerException)
			: base(message, innerException)
		{
			MessagingExceptionDetail detail = MessagingExceptionDetail.UnknownDetail(message);
			Initialize(detail, trackingContext, DateTime.UtcNow);
		}

		internal MessagingException(MessagingExceptionDetail detail, TrackingContext trackingContext)
			: base(detail.Message)
		{
			Initialize(detail, trackingContext, DateTime.UtcNow);
		}

		internal MessagingException(MessagingExceptionDetail detail, TrackingContext trackingContext, Exception innerException)
			: base(detail.Message, innerException)
		{
			Initialize(detail, trackingContext, DateTime.UtcNow);
		}

		internal MessagingException(MessagingExceptionDetail detail, TrackingContext trackingContext, Exception innerException, MessagingErrorSubCode subCode)
			: base(detail.Message, innerException)
		{
			Initialize(detail, trackingContext, DateTime.UtcNow, subCode);
		}

		protected MessagingException(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			: base(info, context)
		{
			Initialize((MessagingExceptionDetail)info.GetValue("Detail", typeof(MessagingExceptionDetail)), TrackingContext.Create((string)info.GetValue("TrackingId", typeof(string)), (string)info.GetValue("SubsystemId", typeof(string)), appendRole: false), (DateTime)info.GetValue("Timestamp", typeof(DateTime)));
			IsTransient = (bool)info.GetValue("IsTransient", typeof(bool));
		}

		public override void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			base.GetObjectData(info, context);
			info.AddValue("Detail", Detail);
			info.AddValue("TrackingId", Tracker.TrackingId);
			info.AddValue("SubsystemId", Tracker.SystemTracker);
			info.AddValue("Timestamp", Timestamp.ToString());
			info.AddValue("IsTransient", IsTransient);
			info.AddValue("SubSode", SubCode);
		}

		private void Initialize(MessagingExceptionDetail detail, TrackingContext currentTracker, DateTime timestamp, MessagingErrorSubCode subSode = MessagingErrorSubCode.Unknown)
		{
			IsTransient = true;
			Detail = detail;
			Tracker = currentTracker ?? TrackingContext.Create(Guid.NewGuid());
			Timestamp = timestamp;
			SubCode = subSode;
			if (GetType() != typeof(MessagingException))
			{
				this.SuppressStackTraceOnRethrow();
			}
		}
	}
	internal static class MessagingUtilities
	{
		private static AsyncCallback safeCloseMessageEntityCallback;

		private static AsyncCallback safeCloseCommunicationObjectCallback;

		public static TimeSpan CalculateRenewAfterDuration(DateTime lockedUntilUtc)
		{
			TimeSpan timeSpan = lockedUntilUtc - DateTime.UtcNow;
			if (timeSpan < TimeSpan.Zero)
			{
				timeSpan = TimeSpan.FromTicks(Constants.MinimumLockDuration.Ticks / 2);
			}
			TimeSpan timeSpan2 = TimeSpan.FromTicks(Math.Min(timeSpan.Ticks / 2, Constants.MaximumRenewBufferDuration.Ticks));
			return timeSpan - timeSpan2;
		}

		public static string GetIoTHubName(this Uri endpoint)
		{
			if (endpoint == null || !endpoint.IsIoTDeviceUri())
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			string[] array = endpoint.Host.ToLowerInvariant().Split(new string[1] { "." }, 2, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
			return array[0];
		}

		public static bool IsIoTDeviceUri(this Uri endpoint)
		{
			if (endpoint == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			string text = endpoint.Host.ToLowerInvariant();
			if (!text.EndsWith(".azure-devices.net") && !text.EndsWith(".azure-devices-int.net") && !text.EndsWith(".azure-devices.de") && !text.EndsWith(".azure-devices.us"))
			{
				return text.EndsWith(".azure-devices.cn");
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static void EnsureTrailingSlash(UriBuilder uriBuilder)
		{
			if (!uriBuilder.Path.EndsWith("/", StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				uriBuilder.Path += "/";
			}
		}

		public static string TryGetName(this AmqpObject link)
		{
			AmqpLink amqpLink = link as AmqpLink;
			RequestResponseAmqpLink requestResponseAmqpLink = link as RequestResponseAmqpLink;
			if (amqpLink != null)
			{
				return amqpLink.Name;
			}
			return requestResponseAmqpLink?.Name;
		}

		public static UriBuilder CreateUriBuilderWithHttpsSchemeAndPort(Uri baseUri)
		{
			if (baseUri == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new ArgumentNullException("baseUri", SRClient.UseOverloadWithBaseAddress));
			}
			UriBuilder uriBuilder = new UriBuilder(baseUri);
			if (uriBuilder.Port == -1)
			{
				uriBuilder.Port = RelayEnvironment.RelayHttpsPort;
			}
			uriBuilder.Scheme = Uri.UriSchemeHttps;
			EnsureTrailingSlash(uriBuilder);
			return uriBuilder;
		}

		public static void ValidateAndSetConsumedMessages(IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages)
		{
			List<BrokeredMessage> list = new List<BrokeredMessage>();
			foreach (BrokeredMessage message in messages)
			{
				if (message.IsConsumed)
				{
					foreach (BrokeredMessage item in list)
					{
						item.IsConsumed = false;
					}
					throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.CannotUseSameMessageInstanceInMultipleOperations(message.MessageId)));
				}
				list.Add(message);
			}
		}

		public static void CheckValidMessages(IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages, bool validateOnSend)
		{
			if (messages == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNullOrEmpty("messages");
			}
			using IEnumerator<BrokeredMessage> enumerator = messages.GetEnumerator();
			if (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				do
				{
					CheckValidMessage(enumerator.Current, validateOnSend);
				}
				while (enumerator.MoveNext());
				return;
			}
			throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNullOrEmpty("messages");
		}

		public static void CheckValidMessage(BrokeredMessage message, bool validateOnSend)
		{
			if (message == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNull("message");
			}
			if (validateOnSend && message.IsLockTokenSet)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.CannotSendReceivedMessage));
			}
		}

		public static void CheckValidSequenceNumbers(IEnumerable<long> sequenceNumbers)
		{
			if (sequenceNumbers == null || !sequenceNumbers.Any())
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNullOrEmpty("sequenceNumbers");
			}
		}

		public static void CheckUriSchemeKey(string entityName, string paramName)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(entityName))
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNullOrWhiteSpace(paramName);
			}
			string[] array = new string[3] { "@", "?", "#" };
			string[] array2 = array;
			foreach (string text in array2)
			{
				if (entityName.Contains(text))
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.Argument(paramName, SR.GetString(Resources.CharacterReservedForUriScheme, paramName, text));
				}
			}
		}

		public static void AbortIfNotNull(ICommunicationObject communicationObject)
		{
			communicationObject?.Abort();
		}

		public static void SafeAddFaulted(this ICommunicationObject communicationObject, EventHandler handler)
		{
			communicationObject.Faulted += handler;
			CommunicationState state = communicationObject.State;
			if (state != CommunicationState.Created && state != CommunicationState.Opening && state != CommunicationState.Opened)
			{
				handler(communicationObject, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		public static void SafeAddClosing(this ICommunicationObject communicationObject, EventHandler handler)
		{
			communicationObject.Closing += handler;
			CommunicationState state = communicationObject.State;
			if (state == CommunicationState.Closed || state == CommunicationState.Closing)
			{
				handler(communicationObject, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		public static void SafeAddClosed(this ICommunicationObject communicationObject, EventHandler handler)
		{
			communicationObject.Closed += handler;
			if (communicationObject.State == CommunicationState.Closed)
			{
				handler(communicationObject, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		public static void SafeAddClosed(this ClientEntity clientEntity, EventHandler handler)
		{
			clientEntity.Closed += handler;
			if (clientEntity.IsClosed)
			{
				handler(clientEntity, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		public static void SafeAddFaulted(this ClientEntity clientEntity, EventHandler handler)
		{
			clientEntity.Faulted += handler;
			if (clientEntity.IsFaulted)
			{
				handler(clientEntity, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		public static void SafeClose(this System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message)
		{
			try
			{
				if (message != null && message.State != System.ServiceModel.Channels.MessageState.Closed)
				{
					message.Close();
				}
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				Fx.Exception.TraceHandled(exception, "MessagingUtilities.SafeClose(Message)");
			}
		}

		public static void SafeClose(this ICommunicationObject communicationObject, TimeSpan? timeout = null)
		{
			communicationObject.SafeClose(timeout, syncClose: false);
		}

		public static void SafeClose(this ICommunicationObject communicationObject, bool syncClose, TimeSpan? timeout = null)
		{
			communicationObject.SafeClose(timeout, syncClose);
		}

		private static void SafeClose(this ICommunicationObject communicationObject, TimeSpan? timeout, bool syncClose)
		{
			try
			{
				if (communicationObject == null || communicationObject.State == CommunicationState.Closed)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (syncClose)
				{
					if (timeout.HasValue)
					{
						communicationObject.Close(timeout.Value);
					}
					else
					{
						communicationObject.Close();
					}
					return;
				}
				if (safeCloseCommunicationObjectCallback == null)
				{
					safeCloseCommunicationObjectCallback = SafeCloseCommunicationObjectCallback;
				}
				if (timeout.HasValue)
				{
					communicationObject.BeginClose(timeout.Value, safeCloseCommunicationObjectCallback, communicationObject);
				}
				else
				{
					communicationObject.BeginClose(safeCloseCommunicationObjectCallback, communicationObject);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				Fx.Exception.TraceHandled(exception, "MessagingUtilities.SafeClose(CommunicationObject)");
				communicationObject?.Abort();
			}
		}

		public static void ScheduleCloseOrAbort(this ClientEntity clientEntity)
		{
			try
			{
				if (clientEntity != null && !clientEntity.IsClosed)
				{
					if (safeCloseMessageEntityCallback == null)
					{
						safeCloseMessageEntityCallback = SafeCloseMessageEntityCallback;
					}
					clientEntity.CloseAsync().ToAsyncResult(safeCloseMessageEntityCallback, clientEntity);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				Fx.Exception.TraceHandled(exception, "MessagingUtilities.ScheduleCloseOrAbort");
				clientEntity?.Abort();
			}
		}

		public static void ThrowIfContainsSubQueueName(string path)
		{
			if (path.Contains("$"))
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.CannotCreateClientOnSubQueue));
			}
		}

		public static void ThrowIfInvalidSubQueueNameString(string path, string paramName)
		{
			string[] array = EntityNameHelper.SplitSubQueuePath(path);
			if (array.Length == 2 && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(array[1]) && !EntityNameHelper.ValidateSubQueueName(array[1]))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.InvalidSubQueueNameString(string.Join(", ", Constants.SupportedSubQueueNames.ToArray())), paramName);
			}
		}

		public static bool IsSubQueue(string path)
		{
			return path?.Contains("$") ?? false;
		}

		public static void ThrowIfNullAddressesOrPathExists(IEnumerable<Uri> addresses, string paramName)
		{
			if (addresses == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNull(paramName);
			}
			if (addresses.Count() == 0)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.Argument("addresses", SRClient.NoAddressesFound(addresses));
			}
			foreach (Uri address in addresses)
			{
				ThrowIfNullAddressOrPathExists(address, "address");
			}
		}

		public static void ThrowIfNullAddressOrPathExists(Uri address, string paramName)
		{
			if (address == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNull(paramName);
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(address.AbsolutePath) && address.Segments.Length > 3)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.Argument(paramName, SRClient.InvalidAddressPath(address.AbsoluteUri));
			}
		}

		public static IEnumerable<Uri> GetUriList(IEnumerable<string> addresses)
		{
			if (addresses == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNull("addresses");
			}
			List<Uri> list = new List<Uri>();
			foreach (string address in addresses)
			{
				Uri uri = null;
				try
				{
					uri = new Uri(address);
				}
				catch (UriFormatException e)
				{
					throw new UriFormatException(SRClient.BadUriFormat(address), e);
				}
				ThrowIfNullAddressOrPathExists(uri, "uriAddress");
				list.Add(uri);
			}
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNullOrEmpty("addresses");
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static void SafeCloseCommunicationObjectCallback(IAsyncResult asyncResult)
		{
			ICommunicationObject communicationObject = (ICommunicationObject)asyncResult.AsyncState;
			try
			{
				communicationObject.EndClose(asyncResult);
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				Fx.Exception.TraceHandled(exception, "MessagingUtilities.SafeCloseCommunicationObjectCallback");
				communicationObject.Abort();
			}
		}

		private static void SafeCloseMessageEntityCallback(IAsyncResult asyncResult)
		{
			ClientEntity clientEntity = (ClientEntity)asyncResult.AsyncState;
			try
			{
				TaskHelpers.EndAsyncResult(asyncResult);
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				Fx.Exception.TraceHandled(exception, "MessagingUtilities.SafeCloseMessageEntityCallback");
			}
		}

		public static string ConvertToString(this SecureString str)
		{
			if (str == null || str.Length == 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			IntPtr intPtr = IntPtr.Zero;
			try
			{
				intPtr = Marshal.SecureStringToGlobalAllocUnicode(str);
				return Marshal.PtrToStringUni(intPtr);
			}
			finally
			{
				Marshal.ZeroFreeGlobalAllocUnicode(intPtr);
			}
		}

		public static void ForEach<T>(this IEnumerable<T> items, Action<T> action)
		{
			foreach (T item in items)
			{
				action(item);
			}
		}

		public static void ForEach<T>(this IEnumerable<T> items, Action<T, int> action)
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (T item in items)
			{
				action(item, num);
				num++;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class ReceiveContext
	{
		public TimeSpan OperationTimeout { get; protected set; }

		public ReceiveContext InnerContext { get; protected set; }

		public Guid LockToken { get; protected set; }

		public MessageReceiver MessageReceiver { get; protected set; }

		public ReceiveContext(ReceiveContext innerContext)
		{
			if (innerContext == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNull("innerContext");
			}
			InnerContext = innerContext;
			LockToken = innerContext.LockToken;
			OperationTimeout = innerContext.OperationTimeout;
		}

		public ReceiveContext(MessageReceiver messageReceiver, Guid lockToken)
		{
			if (messageReceiver == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNull("messageReceiver");
			}
			MessageReceiver = messageReceiver;
			LockToken = lockToken;
			OperationTimeout = messageReceiver.OperationTimeout;
		}

		internal ReceiveContext(Guid lockToken)
		{
			MessageReceiver = null;
			LockToken = lockToken;
			OperationTimeout = Constants.DefaultOperationTimeout;
		}

		public virtual void Complete()
		{
			if (MessageReceiver != null)
			{
				MessageReceiver.Complete(new Guid[1] { LockToken }, OperationTimeout);
			}
			else
			{
				InnerContext.Complete();
			}
		}

		public virtual IAsyncResult BeginComplete(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			if (MessageReceiver != null)
			{
				return MessageReceiver.BeginComplete(new Guid[1] { LockToken }, timeout, callback, state);
			}
			return InnerContext.BeginComplete(timeout, callback, state);
		}

		public virtual void EndComplete(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (MessageReceiver != null)
			{
				MessageReceiver.EndComplete(result);
			}
			else
			{
				InnerContext.EndComplete(result);
			}
		}

		public virtual IAsyncResult BeginRenewLock(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			if (MessageReceiver != null)
			{
				return MessageReceiver.BeginRenewMessageLocks(null, new Guid[1] { LockToken }, timeout, callback, state);
			}
			return InnerContext.BeginRenewLock(timeout, callback, state);
		}

		public virtual IEnumerable<DateTime> EndRenewLock(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (MessageReceiver != null)
			{
				return MessageReceiver.EndRenewMessageLocks(result);
			}
			return InnerContext.EndRenewLock(result);
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginDefer(AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return BeginDefer(null, OperationTimeout, callback, state);
		}

		public virtual IAsyncResult BeginDefer(IDictionary<string, object> propertiesToModify, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			if (MessageReceiver != null)
			{
				return MessageReceiver.BeginDefer(new Guid[1] { LockToken }, propertiesToModify, timeout, callback, state);
			}
			return InnerContext.BeginDefer(propertiesToModify, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		public virtual void EndDefer(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (MessageReceiver != null)
			{
				MessageReceiver.EndDefer(result);
			}
			else
			{
				InnerContext.EndDefer(result);
			}
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginDeadLetter(string deadLetterReason, string deadLetterErrorDescription, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return BeginDeadLetter(null, deadLetterReason, deadLetterErrorDescription, OperationTimeout, callback, state);
		}

		public virtual IAsyncResult BeginDeadLetter(IDictionary<string, object> propertiesToModify, string deadLetterReason, string deadLetterErrorDescription, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			if (MessageReceiver != null)
			{
				return MessageReceiver.BeginDeadLetter(new Guid[1] { LockToken }, propertiesToModify, deadLetterReason, deadLetterErrorDescription, timeout, callback, state);
			}
			return InnerContext.BeginDeadLetter(propertiesToModify, deadLetterReason, deadLetterErrorDescription, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		public virtual void EndDeadLetter(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (MessageReceiver != null)
			{
				MessageReceiver.EndDeadLetter(result);
			}
			else
			{
				InnerContext.EndDeadLetter(result);
			}
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginAbandon(AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return BeginAbandon(null, OperationTimeout, callback, state);
		}

		public virtual IAsyncResult BeginAbandon(IDictionary<string, object> propertiesToModify, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			if (MessageReceiver != null)
			{
				return MessageReceiver.BeginAbandon(new Guid[1] { LockToken }, propertiesToModify, timeout, callback, state);
			}
			return InnerContext.BeginAbandon(propertiesToModify, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		public virtual void EndAbandon(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (MessageReceiver != null)
			{
				MessageReceiver.EndAbandon(result);
			}
			else
			{
				InnerContext.EndAbandon(result);
			}
		}

		public virtual T GetProperty<T>()
		{
			if (MessageReceiver != null)
			{
				return MessageReceiver.GetProperty<T>();
			}
			if (InnerContext != null)
			{
				return InnerContext.GetProperty<T>();
			}
			return default(T);
		}
	}

	internal static class SerializationUtilities
	{
		public const long MaxBufferPoolSize = 5242880L;

		public const int MaxBufferSize = 65536;

		private const int ShortSize = 2;

		private const int IntSize = 4;

		private const int LongSize = 8;

		private const int DateTimeSize = 8;

		private const int TimeSpanSize = 8;

		private const int GuidSize = 16;

		private const int BooleanSize = 1;

		private static Dictionary<Type, PropertyValueType> typeToIntMap = new Dictionary<Type, PropertyValueType>
		{
			{
				typeof(byte),
				PropertyValueType.Byte
			},
			{
				typeof(sbyte),
				PropertyValueType.SByte
			},
			{
				typeof(char),
				PropertyValueType.Char
			},
			{
				typeof(short),
				PropertyValueType.Int16
			},
			{
				typeof(ushort),
				PropertyValueType.UInt16
			},
			{
				typeof(int),
				PropertyValueType.Int32
			},
			{
				typeof(uint),
				PropertyValueType.UInt32
			},
			{
				typeof(long),
				PropertyValueType.Int64
			},
			{
				typeof(ulong),
				PropertyValueType.UInt64
			},
			{
				typeof(float),
				PropertyValueType.Single
			},
			{
				typeof(double),
				PropertyValueType.Double
			},
			{
				typeof(decimal),
				PropertyValueType.Decimal
			},
			{
				typeof(bool),
				PropertyValueType.Boolean
			},
			{
				typeof(Guid),
				PropertyValueType.Guid
			},
			{
				typeof(string),
				PropertyValueType.String
			},
			{
				typeof(Uri),
				PropertyValueType.Uri
			},
			{
				typeof(DateTime),
				PropertyValueType.DateTime
			},
			{
				typeof(DateTimeOffset),
				PropertyValueType.DateTimeOffset
			},
			{
				typeof(TimeSpan),
				PropertyValueType.TimeSpan
			},
			{
				typeof(BufferedInputStream),
				PropertyValueType.Stream
			}
		};

		public static bool IsSupportedPropertyType(Type type)
		{
			return typeToIntMap.ContainsKey(type);
		}

		public static PropertyValueType GetTypeId(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return PropertyValueType.Null;
			}
			if (typeToIntMap.TryGetValue(value.GetType(), out var value2))
			{
				return value2;
			}
			return PropertyValueType.Unknown;
		}

		public static object ConvertByteArrayToNativeValue(int messageVersion, PropertyValueType propertyTypeId, byte[] bytes)
		{
			switch (propertyTypeId)
			{
			case PropertyValueType.Guid:
				return new Guid(bytes);
			case PropertyValueType.Boolean:
				return BitConverter.ToBoolean(bytes, 0);
			case PropertyValueType.Byte:
				return bytes[0];
			case PropertyValueType.SByte:
				return (sbyte)bytes[0];
			case PropertyValueType.Char:
				return BitConverter.ToChar(bytes, 0);
			case PropertyValueType.TimeSpan:
			{
				if (messageVersion >= BrokeredMessage.MessageVersion3)
				{
					long value2 = BitConverter.ToInt64(bytes, 0);
					return TimeSpan.FromTicks(value2);
				}
				double value3 = BitConverter.ToDouble(bytes, 0);
				if (value3.CompareTo(TimeSpan.MaxValue.TotalMilliseconds) == 0)
				{
					return TimeSpan.MaxValue;
				}
				return TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(value3);
			}
			case PropertyValueType.DateTime:
				return DateTime.FromBinary(BitConverter.ToInt64(bytes, 0));
			case PropertyValueType.Double:
				return BitConverter.ToDouble(bytes, 0);
			case PropertyValueType.Single:
				return BitConverter.ToSingle(bytes, 0);
			case PropertyValueType.Int32:
				return BitConverter.ToInt32(bytes, 0);
			case PropertyValueType.Int64:
				return BitConverter.ToInt64(bytes, 0);
			case PropertyValueType.Int16:
				return BitConverter.ToInt16(bytes, 0);
			case PropertyValueType.UInt32:
				return BitConverter.ToUInt32(bytes, 0);
			case PropertyValueType.UInt64:
				return BitConverter.ToUInt64(bytes, 0);
			case PropertyValueType.UInt16:
				return BitConverter.ToUInt16(bytes, 0);
			case PropertyValueType.String:
				return Encoding.UTF8.GetString(bytes);
			case PropertyValueType.Uri:
				return new Uri(Encoding.UTF8.GetString(bytes));
			case PropertyValueType.DateTimeOffset:
				if (messageVersion >= BrokeredMessage.MessageVersion3)
				{
					long ticks = BitConverter.ToInt64(bytes, 0);
					long value = BitConverter.ToInt64(bytes, 8);
					return new DateTimeOffset(ticks, TimeSpan.FromTicks(value));
				}
				return XmlConvert.ToDateTimeOffset(Encoding.UTF8.GetString(bytes));
			case PropertyValueType.Decimal:
				if (messageVersion >= BrokeredMessage.MessageVersion3)
				{
					return new decimal(new int[4]
					{
						BitConverter.ToInt32(bytes, 0),
						BitConverter.ToInt32(bytes, 4),
						BitConverter.ToInt32(bytes, 8),
						BitConverter.ToInt32(bytes, 12)
					});
				}
				return XmlConvert.ToDecimal(Encoding.UTF8.GetString(bytes));
			case PropertyValueType.Stream:
			{
				InternalBufferManager bufferManager = ThrottledBufferManager.GetBufferManager();
				int num = bytes.Length;
				byte[] array = bufferManager.TakeBuffer(num);
				Buffer.BlockCopy(bytes, 0, array, 0, num);
				return new BufferedInputStream(array, num, bufferManager);
			}
			case PropertyValueType.Null:
				return null;
			default:
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new SerializationException(SRClient.FailedToDeserializeUnsupportedProperty(propertyTypeId.ToString())));
			}
		}

		public static byte[] ConvertNativeValueToByteArray(int messageVersion, PropertyValueType propertyTypeId, object value)
		{
			switch (propertyTypeId)
			{
			case PropertyValueType.Guid:
				return ((Guid)value).ToByteArray();
			case PropertyValueType.Boolean:
				return BitConverter.GetBytes((bool)value);
			case PropertyValueType.Byte:
				return new byte[1] { (byte)value };
			case PropertyValueType.SByte:
				return new byte[1] { (byte)(sbyte)value };
			case PropertyValueType.Char:
				return BitConverter.GetBytes((char)value);
			case PropertyValueType.TimeSpan:
				if (messageVersion >= BrokeredMessage.MessageVersion3)
				{
					return BitConverter.GetBytes(((TimeSpan)value).Ticks);
				}
				return BitConverter.GetBytes(((TimeSpan)value).TotalMilliseconds);
			case PropertyValueType.DateTime:
				return BitConverter.GetBytes(((DateTime)value).ToBinary());
			case PropertyValueType.Double:
				return BitConverter.GetBytes((double)value);
			case PropertyValueType.Single:
				return BitConverter.GetBytes((float)value);
			case PropertyValueType.Int32:
				return BitConverter.GetBytes((int)value);
			case PropertyValueType.Int64:
				return BitConverter.GetBytes((long)value);
			case PropertyValueType.Int16:
				return BitConverter.GetBytes((short)value);
			case PropertyValueType.UInt32:
				return BitConverter.GetBytes((uint)value);
			case PropertyValueType.UInt64:
				return BitConverter.GetBytes((ulong)value);
			case PropertyValueType.UInt16:
				return BitConverter.GetBytes((ushort)value);
			case PropertyValueType.String:
				return Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes((string)value);
			case PropertyValueType.Uri:
				return Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(value.ToString());
			case PropertyValueType.DateTimeOffset:
				if (messageVersion >= BrokeredMessage.MessageVersion3)
				{
					DateTimeOffset dateTimeOffset = (DateTimeOffset)value;
					byte[] bytes5 = BitConverter.GetBytes(dateTimeOffset.Ticks);
					byte[] bytes6 = BitConverter.GetBytes(dateTimeOffset.Offset.Ticks);
					byte[] array3 = new byte[16];
					Buffer.BlockCopy(bytes5, 0, array3, 0, 8);
					Buffer.BlockCopy(bytes6, 0, array3, 8, 8);
					return array3;
				}
				return Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(XmlConvert.ToString((DateTimeOffset)value));
			case PropertyValueType.Decimal:
				if (messageVersion >= BrokeredMessage.MessageVersion3)
				{
					int[] bits = decimal.GetBits((decimal)value);
					byte[] bytes = BitConverter.GetBytes(bits[0]);
					byte[] bytes2 = BitConverter.GetBytes(bits[1]);
					byte[] bytes3 = BitConverter.GetBytes(bits[2]);
					byte[] bytes4 = BitConverter.GetBytes(bits[3]);
					byte[] array2 = new byte[16];
					Buffer.BlockCopy(bytes, 0, array2, 0, 4);
					Buffer.BlockCopy(bytes2, 0, array2, 4, 4);
					Buffer.BlockCopy(bytes3, 0, array2, 8, 4);
					Buffer.BlockCopy(bytes4, 0, array2, 12, 4);
					return array2;
				}
				return Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(XmlConvert.ToString((decimal)value));
			case PropertyValueType.Stream:
			{
				Stream stream = value as BufferedInputStream;
				if (stream == null)
				{
					stream = value as MemoryStream;
				}
				if (stream != null)
				{
					long length = stream.Length;
					byte[] array = new byte[length];
					stream.Position = 0L;
					stream.Read(array, 0, (int)length);
					return array;
				}
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new NotImplementedException());
			}
			default:
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new SerializationException(SRClient.FailedToSerializeUnsupportedType(value.GetType().FullName)));
			}
		}

		public static int GetTypeSize(PropertyValueType propertyTypeId, object value)
		{
			switch (propertyTypeId)
			{
			case PropertyValueType.Int16:
				return 2;
			case PropertyValueType.Int32:
				return 4;
			case PropertyValueType.Int64:
				return 8;
			case PropertyValueType.Boolean:
				return 1;
			case PropertyValueType.Guid:
				return 16;
			case PropertyValueType.String:
				return GetStringSize((string)value);
			case PropertyValueType.DateTime:
				return 8;
			case PropertyValueType.TimeSpan:
				return 8;
			case PropertyValueType.Stream:
			{
				Stream stream = (Stream)value;
				if (!stream.CanSeek)
				{
					return int.MaxValue;
				}
				return (int)stream.Length;
			}
			default:
				throw new Exception(string.Format("No size defined for {0} {1}", "PropertyValueType", propertyTypeId));
			}
		}

		public static int GetStringSize(string value)
		{
			return Encoding.UTF8.GetByteCount(value);
		}

		public static byte[] ReadBytes(XmlReader reader, int bytesToRead)
		{
			byte[] array = new byte[bytesToRead];
			int num = 0;
			while (num < bytesToRead)
			{
				int num2 = reader.ReadContentAsBase64(array, num, array.Length - num);
				num += num2;
				if (num2 == 0)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			if (num < bytesToRead)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException($"Insufficient data in the byte-stream: expected = {bytesToRead}, actual = {num}"));
			}
			return array;
		}
	}
	public abstract class TopicClient : MessagingEntityClient, IMessageSender, IMessageBrowser
	{
		private readonly OpenOnceManager openOnceManager;

		public MessagingFactory MessagingFactory { get; private set; }

		internal override TimeSpan OperationTimeout => MessagingFactory.OperationTimeout;

		internal MessageSender InternalSender { get; set; }

		protected bool IsSubQueue { get; private set; }

		private MessageBrowser InternalBrowser { get; set; }

		internal TopicClient(MessagingFactory messagingFactory, string path)
			: base(path, MessagingEntityType.Topic)
		{
			MessagingFactory = messagingFactory;
			openOnceManager = new OpenOnceManager(this);
			base.ClientEntityManager = new MessageClientEntityManager();
			IsSubQueue = MessagingUtilities.IsSubQueue(path);
			base.RetryPolicy = messagingFactory.RetryPolicy.Clone();
		}

		public static TopicClient Create(string path)
		{
			KeyValueConfigurationManager keyValueConfigurationManager = new KeyValueConfigurationManager();
			return keyValueConfigurationManager.CreateMessagingFactory().CreateTopicClient(path);
		}

		public static TopicClient CreateWithAzureActiveDirectory(Uri endpointAddress, string path, AzureActiveDirectoryTokenProvider.AuthenticationCallback authCallback, string authority, TimeSpan? operationTimeout = null, TransportType transportType = TransportType.NetMessaging)
		{
			TokenProvider tokenProvider = TokenProvider.CreateAzureActiveDirectoryTokenProvider(authCallback, ServiceAudience.ServiceBusAudience, authority);
			return MessagingFactory.Create(endpointAddress, tokenProvider, operationTimeout, transportType).CreateTopicClient(path);
		}

		public static TopicClient CreateWithManagedIdentity(Uri endpointAddress, string path, TimeSpan? operationTimeout = null, TransportType transportType = TransportType.NetMessaging)
		{
			TokenProvider tokenProvider = TokenProvider.CreateManagedIdentityTokenProvider(ServiceAudience.ServiceBusAudience);
			return MessagingFactory.Create(endpointAddress, tokenProvider, operationTimeout, transportType).CreateTopicClient(path);
		}

		public static TopicClient CreateFromConnectionString(string connectionString, string path)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(connectionString))
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNullOrWhiteSpace("connectionString");
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path))
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNullOrWhiteSpace("path");
			}
			ServiceBusConnectionStringBuilder serviceBusConnectionStringBuilder = new ServiceBusConnectionStringBuilder(connectionString);
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(serviceBusConnectionStringBuilder.EntityPath))
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("entityPath", SRClient.SpecifyEntityNameInPathArg("Topic"));
			}
			return MessagingFactory.CreateFromConnectionString(connectionString, useCache: true).CreateTopicClient(path);
		}

		public static TopicClient CreateFromConnectionString(string connectionString)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(connectionString))
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNullOrWhiteSpace("connectionString");
			}
			ServiceBusConnectionStringBuilder serviceBusConnectionStringBuilder = new ServiceBusConnectionStringBuilder(connectionString);
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(serviceBusConnectionStringBuilder.EntityPath))
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("entityPath", SRClient.SpecifyConnStrEntityPath("Topic"));
			}
			return MessagingFactory.CreateFromConnectionString(connectionString, useCache: true).CreateTopicClient(serviceBusConnectionStringBuilder.EntityPath);
		}

		public static string FormatTransferDeadLetterPath(string topicPath)
		{
			return EntityNameHelper.FormatSubQueuePath(EntityNameHelper.FormatSubQueuePath(topicPath, "$Transfer"), "$DeadLetterQueue");
		}

		private IAsyncResult BeginCreateSender(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			if (openOnceManager.ShouldOpen)
			{
				return openOnceManager.Begin(callback, state, (Func<AsyncCallback, object, IAsyncResult>)((AsyncCallback c, object s) => OnBeginCreateSender(timeout, c, s)), (Func<IAsyncResult, MessageSender>)OnEndCreateSender);
			}
			return OnBeginCreateSender(timeout, callback, state);
		}

		private MessageSender EndCreateSender(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			MessageSender messageSender = ((!OpenOnceManager.ShouldEnd<MessageSender>(result)) ? OnEndCreateSender(result) : OpenOnceManager.End<MessageSender>(result));
			messageSender.ShouldLinkRetryPolicy = true;
			RegisterMessageClientEntity(messageSender);
			IPairedNamespaceFactory pairedNamespaceFactory = MessagingFactory.PairedNamespaceFactory;
			if (pairedNamespaceFactory != null)
			{
				messageSender = pairedNamespaceFactory.CreateMessageSender(messageSender);
				RegisterMessageClientEntity(messageSender);
			}
			return messageSender;
		}

		protected abstract IAsyncResult OnBeginCreateSender(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state);

		protected abstract MessageSender OnEndCreateSender(IAsyncResult result);

		protected override void OnAbort()
		{
			base.ClientEntityManager.Abort();
		}

		protected override void OnClose(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			OnEndClose(OnBeginClose(timeout, null, null));
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return base.ClientEntityManager.BeginClose(timeout, callback, state);
		}

		protected override void OnEndClose(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			base.ClientEntityManager.EndClose(result);
		}

		internal void RegisterMessageClientEntity(ClientEntity child)
		{
			base.ClientEntityManager.Add(child);
		}

		public void Send(BrokeredMessage message)

		}

		}

		internal void EndSendBatch(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			ThrowIfSenderNull("EndSendBatch");

		public Task<long> ScheduleMessageAsync(BrokeredMessage message, DateTimeOffset scheduleEnqueueTimeUtc)
		{
			return TaskHelpers.FromAsync((Func<AsyncCallback, object, IAsyncResult>)((AsyncCallback c, object s) => BeginScheduleMessage(message, scheduleEnqueueTimeUtc, c, s)), (Func<IAsyncResult, long>)EndScheduleMessage, (object)null);
		}

		public Task CancelScheduledMessageAsync(long sequenceNumber)
		{
			return TaskHelpers.FromAsync((AsyncCallback c, object s) => BeginCancelScheduledMessage(sequenceNumber, c, s), EndCancelScheduledMessage);
		}

		internal IAsyncResult BeginScheduleMessage(BrokeredMessage message, DateTimeOffset scheduleEnqueueTime, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			ThrowIfSenderNull("BeginScheduleMessage");
			return InternalSender.BeginScheduleMessage(message, scheduleEnqueueTime, callback, state);
		}

		internal long EndScheduleMessage(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			ThrowIfSenderNull("EndScheduleMessage");
			return InternalSender.EndScheduleMessage(result).First();
		}

		{
			ThrowIfSenderNull("BeginCancelScheduledMessage");
			return InternalSender.BeginCancelScheduledMessage(sequenceNumber, callback, state);
		}

		internal void EndCancelScheduledMessage(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			ThrowIfSenderNull("EndCancelScheduledMessage");
			InternalSender.EndCancelScheduledMessage(result);
		}

		private void ThrowIfSenderNull(string operationName)
		{
			EnsureCreateInternalSender();
			if (InternalSender == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new NotSupportedException(SRCore.UnsupportedOperation(operationName)));
			}
		}

		private void EnsureCreateInternalSender()
		{
			if (IsSubQueue || InternalSender != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			lock (base.ThisLock)
			{
				if (InternalSender == null)
				{
					InternalSender = EndCreateSender(BeginCreateSender(MessagingFactory.OperationTimeout, null, null));
				}
			}
		}

		private void ThrowIfBrowserNull(string operationName)
		{
			EnsureCreateInternalBrowser();
			if (InternalBrowser == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException(SRCore.UnsupportedOperation(operationName)));
			}
		}

		private void EnsureCreateInternalBrowser()
		{
			if (InternalBrowser != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			lock (base.ThisLock)
			{
				if (InternalBrowser == null)
				{
					InternalBrowser = EndCreateBrowser(BeginCreateBrowser(MessagingFactory.OperationTimeout, null, null));
				}
			}
		}

		private IAsyncResult BeginCreateBrowser(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			if (openOnceManager.ShouldOpen)
			{
				return openOnceManager.Begin(callback, state, (Func<AsyncCallback, object, IAsyncResult>)((AsyncCallback c, object s) => OnBeginCreateBrowser(timeout, c, s)), (Func<IAsyncResult, MessageBrowser>)OnEndCreateBrowser);
			}
			return OnBeginCreateBrowser(timeout, callback, state);
		}

		private MessageBrowser EndCreateBrowser(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			MessageBrowser messageBrowser = ((!OpenOnceManager.ShouldEnd<MessageBrowser>(result)) ? OnEndCreateBrowser(result) : OpenOnceManager.End<MessageBrowser>(result));
			messageBrowser.ShouldLinkRetryPolicy = true;
			RegisterMessageClientEntity(messageBrowser);
			return messageBrowser;
		}
	}

		internal override void UpdateForVersion(ApiVersion version, EntityDescription existingDescription = null)
		{
			TopicDescription topicDescription = existingDescription as TopicDescription;
			base.UpdateForVersion(version, existingDescription);
			bool flag = false;
			if (version < ApiVersion.Two)
			{
				InternalAuthorization = topicDescription?.InternalAuthorization;
				flag = true;
				InternalEnableFilteringMessagesBeforePublishing = topicDescription?.InternalEnableFilteringMessagesBeforePublishing;
				InternalIsAnonymousAccessible = topicDescription?.InternalIsAnonymousAccessible;
				InternalStatus = topicDescription?.InternalStatus;
				InternalForwardTo = topicDescription?.InternalForwardTo;
				InternalCreatedAt = topicDescription?.InternalCreatedAt;
				InternalUpdatedAt = topicDescription?.InternalUpdatedAt;
				InternalAccessedAt = topicDescription?.InternalAccessedAt;
				InternalUserMetadata = topicDescription?.InternalUserMetadata;
				InternalSupportOrdering = topicDescription?.InternalSupportOrdering;
				InternalMessageCountDetails = topicDescription?.InternalMessageCountDetails;
				InternalSubscriptionCount = topicDescription?.InternalSubscriptionCount;
			}
			if (version < ApiVersion.Three)
			{
				if (InternalAuthorization != null && !flag)
				{
					InternalAuthorization.UpdateForVersion(version, topicDescription?.InternalAuthorization);
				}
				if (Status == EntityStatus.ReceiveDisabled || Status == EntityStatus.SendDisabled)
				{
					Status = EntityStatus.Active;
				}
				InternalAutoDeleteOnIdle = topicDescription?.InternalAutoDeleteOnIdle;
			}
			if (version < ApiVersion.Four)
			{
				InternalAvailabilityStatus = topicDescription?.InternalAvailabilityStatus;
			}
			if (version < ApiVersion.Six)
			{
				InternalEnablePartitioning = topicDescription?.InternalEnablePartitioning;
			}
			if (version < ApiVersion.Eight)
			{
				InternalEnableSubscriptionPartitioning = topicDescription?.InternalEnableSubscriptionPartitioning;
				InternalEnableExpress = topicDescription?.InternalEnableExpress;
			}
			if (version < ApiVersion.Ten)
			{
				if (Status == EntityStatus.Renaming)
				{
					Status = EntityStatus.Active;
				}
				if (AvailabilityStatus == EntityAvailabilityStatus.Renaming)
				{
					OverrideEntityAvailabilityStatus(EntityAvailabilityStatus.Unknown);
				}
			}
			if (version < ApiVersion.Twenty)
			{
				InternalMaxMessageSizeInKilobytes = topicDescription?.InternalMaxMessageSizeInKilobytes;
			}
		}

		internal override bool IsValidForVersion(ApiVersion version)
		{
			if (!base.IsValidForVersion(version))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (version < ApiVersion.Two && (InternalAuthorization != null || InternalEnableFilteringMessagesBeforePublishing.HasValue || InternalIsAnonymousAccessible.HasValue || InternalStatus.HasValue || InternalForwardTo != null || InternalCreatedAt.HasValue || InternalUpdatedAt.HasValue || InternalAccessedAt.HasValue || InternalUserMetadata != null || InternalSupportOrdering.HasValue || InternalMessageCountDetails != null || InternalSubscriptionCount.HasValue))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (version < ApiVersion.Three)
			{
				if (InternalAuthorization != null)
				{
					InternalAuthorization.IsValidForVersion(version);
				}
				if (InternalAutoDeleteOnIdle.HasValue)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (Status == EntityStatus.SendDisabled || Status == EntityStatus.ReceiveDisabled)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (version < ApiVersion.Four && InternalAvailabilityStatus.HasValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (version < ApiVersion.Six && InternalEnablePartitioning.HasValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (version < ApiVersion.Eight)
			{
				if (InternalEnableSubscriptionPartitioning.HasValue)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (InternalEnableExpress.HasValue)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (version < ApiVersion.Ten)
			{
				if (Status == EntityStatus.Renaming)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (AvailabilityStatus == EntityAvailabilityStatus.Renaming)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (version < ApiVersion.Twenty && InternalMaxMessageSizeInKilobytes.HasValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal override bool IsValidForRename()
		{
			if (NewPath.Length > 260 || !ServiceBusUriHelper.SafeMessagingEntityNameExpression.IsMatch(NewPath))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal override void UpdateForRename(EntityDescription renameRequestDescription)
		{
			TopicDescription topicDescription = renameRequestDescription as TopicDescription;
			NewPath = topicDescription.NewPath;
		}

		internal override string GetNewPath()
		{
			return NewPath;
		}

		internal override void SetEntityCreatedAt(DateTime createdAt)
		{
			InternalCreatedAt = createdAt;
		}

		internal override void SetEntityUpdatedAt(DateTime updatedAt)
		{
			InternalUpdatedAt = updatedAt;
		}

		internal override void SetEnabledPartitioning(bool? value)
		{
			InternalEnablePartitioning = value;
		}

		internal override void SetSupportsOrdering(bool? value)
		{
			InternalSupportOrdering = value;
		}
	}
	internal interface ITransportSettings
	{
		object Clone();

		IAsyncResult BeginCreateFactory(IEnumerable<Uri> physicalUriAddresses, AsyncCallback callback, object state);

		MessagingFactory EndCreateFactory(IAsyncResult result);
	}

namespace Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Channels

	internal class NetMessagingBindingElementImporter : IPolicyImportExtension, IWsdlImportExtension
	{
		void IPolicyImportExtension.ImportPolicy(MetadataImporter importer, PolicyConversionContext context)
		{
			if (importer == null || context == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNull((importer == null) ? "importer" : "context");
			}
			PolicyAssertionCollection bindingAssertions = context.GetBindingAssertions();
			XmlElement xmlElement = bindingAssertions.Remove("netMessaging", "http://sample.schemas.microsoft.com/policy/netMessaging");
			if (xmlElement != null)
			{
				NetMessagingTransportBindingElement item = new NetMessagingTransportBindingElement();
				context.BindingElements.Add(item);
			}
		}

		public void BeforeImport(ServiceDescriptionCollection wsdlDocuments, XmlSchemaSet xmlSchemas, ICollection<XmlElement> policy)
		{
		}

		public void ImportContract(WsdlImporter importer, WsdlContractConversionContext context)
		{
		}

		public void ImportEndpoint(WsdlImporter importer, WsdlEndpointConversionContext context)
		{
			if (context == null || context.Endpoint.Binding == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNull((context == null) ? "context" : "context.Endpoint.Binding");
			}
			BindingElementCollection bindingElementCollection = context.Endpoint.Binding.CreateBindingElements();
			NetMessagingTransportBindingElement netMessagingTransportBindingElement = bindingElementCollection.Find<TransportBindingElement>() as NetMessagingTransportBindingElement;
			if (netMessagingTransportBindingElement != null)
			{
				ImportAddress(context);
			}
			if (context.Endpoint.Binding is CustomBinding && netMessagingTransportBindingElement != null && NetMessagingBinding.TryCreate(bindingElementCollection, out var binding))
			{
				binding.Name = context.Endpoint.Binding.Name;
				binding.Namespace = context.Endpoint.Binding.Namespace;
				context.Endpoint.Binding = binding;
			}
		}

		private static void ImportAddress(WsdlEndpointConversionContext context)
		{
			EndpointAddress endpointAddress = null;
			if (context.WsdlPort != null)
			{
				XmlElement xmlElement = context.WsdlPort.Extensions.Find("EndpointReference", "http://www.w3.org/2005/08/addressing");
				XmlElement xmlElement2 = context.WsdlPort.Extensions.Find("EndpointReference", "http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2004/08/addressing");
				SoapAddressBinding soapAddressBinding = (SoapAddressBinding)context.WsdlPort.Extensions.Find(typeof(SoapAddressBinding));
				if (xmlElement != null)
				{
					endpointAddress = EndpointAddress.ReadFrom(AddressingVersion.WSAddressing10, new XmlNodeReader(xmlElement));
				}
				if (xmlElement2 != null)
				{
					endpointAddress = EndpointAddress.ReadFrom(AddressingVersion.WSAddressingAugust2004, new XmlNodeReader(xmlElement2));
				}
				else if (soapAddressBinding != null)
				{
					endpointAddress = new EndpointAddress(soapAddressBinding.Location);
				}
			}
			if (endpointAddress != null)
			{
				context.Endpoint.Address = endpointAddress;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class ReconnectBindingElement : BindingElement
	{
		private class ReconnectChannelFactory<TChannel> : ChannelFactoryBase<TChannel>
		{
			private class RequestSessionChannel : ChannelBase, IRequestSessionChannel, IRequestChannel, IChannel, ICommunicationObject, ISessionChannel<IOutputSession>
			{
				private class OutputSession : IOutputSession, ISession
				{
					public string Id { get; set; }
				}

				private class RequestAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<RequestAsyncResult>
				{
					private const int MaxRetriesOnCommunicationException = 1;

					private readonly RequestSessionChannel requestSessionChannel;

					private readonly System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message;

					private IRequestSessionChannel innerChannel;

					public System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message ResponseMessage { get; private set; }

					public RequestAsyncResult(RequestSessionChannel requestSessionChannel, System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
						: base(timeout, callback, state)
					{
						this.requestSessionChannel = requestSessionChannel;
						this.message = message;
					}

					protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
					{
						int retries = 0;
						TimeSpan remainingTime = RemainingTime();
						while (remainingTime > TimeSpan.Zero)
						{
							yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((RequestAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.requestSessionChannel.sharedChannel.BeginGetInstance(remainingTime, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(RequestAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
							{
								thisPtr.innerChannel = thisPtr.requestSessionChannel.sharedChannel.EndGetInstance(r);
							}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
							yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((RequestAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.innerChannel.BeginRequest(thisPtr.message, remainingTime, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(RequestAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
							{
								thisPtr.ResponseMessage = thisPtr.innerChannel.EndRequest(r);
							}, (Call)delegate(RequestAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t)
							{
								thisPtr.ResponseMessage = thisPtr.innerChannel.Request(thisPtr.message, t);
							}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
							Exception lastException = base.LastAsyncStepException;
							if (lastException == null)
							{
								yield break;
							}
							if (IsRetryable(message, lastException))
							{
								if (retries < 1 && requestSessionChannel.State == CommunicationState.Opened)
								{
									int num = retries + 1;
									retries = num;
									MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
									{
										MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteRetryOperation("SharedChannel.Request", retries, lastException.Message);
									});
									yield return CallAsyncSleep(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(500.0));
									remainingTime = RemainingTime();
									continue;
								}
								if (message != null)
								{
									message.SafeClose();
								}
								Complete(lastException);
								yield break;
							}
							Complete(lastException);
							yield break;
						}
						throw new TimeoutException(SRClient.OperationRequestTimedOut(base.OriginalTimeout.TotalMilliseconds));
					}
				}

				private IChannelFactory<IRequestSessionChannel> innerFactory;

				private SharedChannel<IRequestSessionChannel> sharedChannel;

				public Uri Via { get; private set; }

				public EndpointAddress RemoteAddress { get; private set; }

				public IOutputSession Session { get; private set; }

				public RequestSessionChannel(ReconnectChannelFactory<IRequestSessionChannel> factory, EndpointAddress address, IEnumerable<Uri> viaAddresses)
					: base(factory)
				{
					innerFactory = factory.innerFactory;
					RemoteAddress = address;
					Via = viaAddresses.First();
					Session = new OutputSession
					{
						Id = Guid.NewGuid().ToString()
					};
					sharedChannel = new SharedChannel<IRequestSessionChannel>(innerFactory, viaAddresses, address.Identity);
				}

				public System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message Request(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message)
				{
					return Request(message, base.DefaultSendTimeout);
				}

				public System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message Request(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, TimeSpan timeout)
				{
					return EndRequest(BeginRequest(message, timeout, null, null));
				}

				public IAsyncResult BeginRequest(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				{
					return BeginRequest(message, base.DefaultSendTimeout, callback, state);
				}

				public IAsyncResult BeginRequest(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				{
					TimeoutHelper.ThrowIfNegativeArgument(timeout);
					return new RequestAsyncResult(this, message, timeout, callback, state).Start();
				}

				public System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message EndRequest(IAsyncResult result)
				{
					return AsyncResult<RequestAsyncResult>.End(result).ResponseMessage;
				}

				protected override void OnAbort()
				{
					sharedChannel.Abort();
				}

				protected override void OnClose(TimeSpan timeout)
				{
					sharedChannel.Close(timeout);
				}

				protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				{
					return sharedChannel.BeginClose(timeout, callback, state);
				}

				protected override void OnEndClose(IAsyncResult result)
				{
					sharedChannel.EndClose(result);
				}

				protected override void OnOpen(TimeSpan timeout)
				{
				}

				protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginOpen(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				{
					return new CompletedAsyncResult(callback, state);
				}

				protected override void OnEndOpen(IAsyncResult result)
				{
					CompletedAsyncResult.End(result);
				}
			}

			private readonly IChannelFactory<TChannel> innerFactory;

			private readonly IEnumerable<Uri> viaAddresses;

			public ReconnectChannelFactory(BindingContext context, IEnumerable<Uri> viaAddresses)
				: base((IDefaultCommunicationTimeouts)context.Binding)
			{
				this.viaAddresses = viaAddresses;
				innerFactory = context.BuildInnerChannelFactory<TChannel>();
			}

			public override T GetProperty<T>()
			{
				return innerFactory.GetProperty<T>();
			}

			protected override TChannel OnCreateChannel(EndpointAddress address, Uri via)
			{
				return (TChannel)(object)new RequestSessionChannel((ReconnectChannelFactory<IRequestSessionChannel>)(object)this, address, viaAddresses);
			}

			protected override void OnOpening()
			{
				base.OnOpening();
				innerFactory.SafeAddFaulted(OnInnerFactoryFaulted);
			}

			protected override void OnOpen(TimeSpan timeout)
			{
				innerFactory.Open(timeout);
			}

			protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginOpen(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{
				return innerFactory.BeginOpen(timeout, callback, state);
			}

			protected override void OnEndOpen(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				innerFactory.EndOpen(result);
			}

			protected override void OnClose(TimeSpan timeout)
			{
				innerFactory.Close(timeout);
			}

			protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{
				return innerFactory.BeginClose(timeout, callback, state);
			}

			protected override void OnEndClose(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				innerFactory.EndClose(result);
			}

			private void OnInnerFactoryFaulted(object sender, EventArgs e)
			{
				Fault();
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable<Uri> viaAddresses;

		public ReconnectBindingElement(IEnumerable<Uri> viaAddresses)
		{
			this.viaAddresses = viaAddresses;
		}

		public static bool IsRetryable(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, Exception lastException)
		{
			if (lastException is CommunicationObjectFaultedException || lastException is CommunicationObjectAbortedException)
			{
				return message.State == System.ServiceModel.Channels.MessageState.Created;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override BindingElement Clone()
		{
			return new ReconnectBindingElement(viaAddresses);
		}

		public override T GetProperty<T>(BindingContext context)
		{
			return context.GetInnerProperty<T>();
		}

		public override bool CanBuildChannelFactory<TChannel>(BindingContext context)
		{
			if (context == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNull("context");
			}
			if (typeof(TChannel) == typeof(IRequestSessionChannel))
			{
				return base.CanBuildChannelFactory<TChannel>(context);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override IChannelFactory<TChannel> BuildChannelFactory<TChannel>(BindingContext context)
		{
			if (!CanBuildChannelFactory<TChannel>(context))
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.Argument("TChannel", SRClient.ChannelTypeNotSupported(typeof(TChannel)));
			}
			return new ReconnectChannelFactory<TChannel>(context, viaAddresses);
		}
	}
	internal class SharedChannel<TChannel> : SingletonManager<TChannel> where TChannel : class, IRequestSessionChannel
	{
		private class CreateChannelAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<CreateChannelAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly SharedChannel<TChannel> sharedChannel;

			public TChannel Channel { get; private set; }

			public CreateChannelAsyncResult(SharedChannel<TChannel> sharedChannel, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.sharedChannel = sharedChannel;
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				ServiceBusUriManager uriManager = new ServiceBusUriManager(sharedChannel.viaAddresses.ToList());
				while (uriManager.MoveNextUri())
				{
					Channel = sharedChannel.innerFactory.CreateChannel(new EndpointAddress(uriManager.Current, sharedChannel.identity), uriManager.Current);
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((CreateChannelAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.Channel.BeginOpen(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(CreateChannelAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.Channel.EndOpen(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
					if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
					{
						Channel.Abort();
						continue;
					}
					yield break;
				}
				if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
				{
					if (base.LastAsyncStepException is TimeoutException)
					{
						throw new CommunicationException(SRClient.OpenChannelFailed(base.OriginalTimeout), base.LastAsyncStepException);
					}
					throw base.LastAsyncStepException;
				}
			}
		}

		private class CloseOrAbortAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<CloseOrAbortAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly TChannel channel;

			private readonly bool abort;

			public CloseOrAbortAsyncResult(SharedChannel<TChannel> sharedChannel, bool abort, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.abort = abort;
				sharedChannel.Invalidate(out channel);
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				if (channel == null)
				{
					yield break;
				}
				if (abort)
				{
					channel.Abort();
					yield break;
				}
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((CloseOrAbortAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.channel.BeginClose(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(CloseOrAbortAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					thisPtr.channel.EndClose(r);
				}, (Call)delegate(CloseOrAbortAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t)
				{
					thisPtr.channel.Close(t);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
			}
		}

		private readonly IChannelFactory<TChannel> innerFactory;

		private readonly EventHandler onInnerChannelFaulted;

		private readonly IEnumerable<Uri> viaAddresses;

		private readonly EndpointIdentity identity;

		public SharedChannel(IChannelFactory<TChannel> innerFactory, IEnumerable<Uri> viaAddresses, EndpointIdentity identity)
			: base(new object())
		{
			this.innerFactory = innerFactory;
			this.viaAddresses = viaAddresses;
			this.identity = identity;
			onInnerChannelFaulted = OnInnerChannelFaulted;
		}

		public void Abort()
		{
			new CloseOrAbortAsyncResult(this, abort: true, TimeSpan.Zero, null, null).RunSynchronously();
		}

		public void Close(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			new CloseOrAbortAsyncResult(this, abort: false, timeout, null, null).RunSynchronously();
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new CloseOrAbortAsyncResult(this, abort: false, timeout, callback, state).Start();
		}

		public void EndClose(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			AsyncResult<CloseOrAbortAsyncResult>.End(result);
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginCreateInstance(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			if (timeout > TransportDefaults.OpenTimeout)
			{
				timeout = TransportDefaults.OpenTimeout;
			}
			return new CreateChannelAsyncResult(this, timeout, callback, state).Start();
		}

		protected override TChannel OnEndCreateInstance(IAsyncResult asyncResult)
		{
			TChannel channel = AsyncResult<CreateChannelAsyncResult>.End(asyncResult).Channel;
			channel.SafeAddFaulted(onInnerChannelFaulted);
			return channel;
		}

		protected override void OnGetInstance(TChannel channel)
		{
			if (channel.State != CommunicationState.Opened)
			{
				Invalidate(channel);
			}
		}

		private void OnInnerChannelFaulted(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			TChannel val = (TChannel)sender;
			string traceMessage = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}, Session = {1}, Via = {2}, RemoveAddress = {3}", typeof(TChannel).FullName, (val.Session != null) ? val.Session.Id : "null", (val.Via != null) ? val.Via.AbsoluteUri : "null", (val.RemoteAddress != null && val.RemoteAddress.Uri != null) ? val.RemoteAddress.Uri.AbsoluteUri : "null");
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteChannelFaulted(traceMessage);
			});
			Invalidate(val);
			val.Abort();
			val.Faulted -= onInnerChannelFaulted;
		}
	}
	internal static class CommunicationObjectExtension
	{
		public static bool DoneReceivingInCurrentState(this ICommunicationObjectInternals communicationObject)
		{
			switch (communicationObject.State)
			{
			case CommunicationState.Opened:
				return false;
			case CommunicationState.Closing:
			case CommunicationState.Closed:
			case CommunicationState.Faulted:
				return true;
			default:
				communicationObject.ThrowIfDisposedOrNotOpen();
				return false;
			}
		}

		public static Task OpenAsync(this ICommunicationObject communicationObject, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			return TaskHelpers.FromAsync((TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => ((ICommunicationObject)s).BeginOpen(t, c, s), delegate(IAsyncResult a)
			{
				((ICommunicationObject)a.AsyncState).EndOpen(a);
			}, timeout, communicationObject);
		}

		public static Task CloseAsync(this ICommunicationObject communicationObject)
		{
			return TaskHelpers.FromAsync((AsyncCallback c, object s) => ((ICommunicationObject)s).BeginClose(c, s), delegate(IAsyncResult a)
			{
				((ICommunicationObject)a.AsyncState).EndClose(a);
			}, communicationObject);
		}

		public static Task SendAsync(this IOutputChannel outputChannel, System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			return TaskHelpers.FromAsync((System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message m, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => ((IOutputChannel)s).BeginSend(m, t, c, s), delegate(IAsyncResult a)
			{
				((IOutputChannel)a.AsyncState).EndSend(a);
			}, message, timeout, outputChannel);
		}

		internal static void Fault(this ICommunicationObject communicationObject, Exception exception)
		{
			InvokeHelper.InvokeInstanceMethod(communicationObject.GetType(), communicationObject, "Fault", exception);
		}

		internal static Exception GetPendingException(this ICommunicationObjectInternals communicationObject)
		{
			try
			{
				communicationObject.ThrowPending();
				return null;
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
				{
					throw;
				}
				return ex;
			}
		}

		internal static void ThrowIfNotOpened(this ICommunicationObjectInternals communicationObject)
		{
			CommunicationState state = communicationObject.State;
			if (state == CommunicationState.Created || state == CommunicationState.Opening)
			{
				communicationObject.ThrowIfDisposedOrNotOpen();
			}
		}

		internal static void ThrowIfFaulted(this CommunicationObject communicationObject)
		{
			CommunicationState state = communicationObject.State;
			if ((uint)state > 4u)
			{
				_ = 5;
				throw Fx.Exception.AsWarning(communicationObject.CreateFaultedException());
			}
		}

		internal static Exception CreateFaultedException(this CommunicationObject communicationObject)
		{
			return new CommunicationObjectFaultedException(SRClient.CommunicationObjectFaulted(communicationObject.GetType().ToString()));
		}

		internal static void ThrowPending(this ICommunicationObjectInternals communicationObject)
		{
			switch (communicationObject.State)
			{
			case CommunicationState.Created:
			case CommunicationState.Opening:
			case CommunicationState.Opened:
				communicationObject.ThrowIfDisposed();
				break;
			case CommunicationState.Closing:
			case CommunicationState.Closed:
			case CommunicationState.Faulted:
				break;
			default:
				throw Fx.AssertAndThrow("ThrowIfDisposed: Unknown CommunicationObject.state");
			}
		}
	}
	internal interface ICommunicationObjectInternals : ICommunicationObject
	{
		void ThrowIfDisposed();

		void ThrowIfDisposedOrNotOpen();
	}
