	internal sealed class ServiceBusChannelFactory : ChannelFactoryBase<IOutputChannel>
	{
		private BufferManager bufferManager;

		internal MessagingFactorySettings MessagingFactorySettings { get; private set; }

		internal BufferManager BufferManager => bufferManager;

		internal bool ManualAddressing { get; private set; }

		internal long MaxBufferPoolSize { get; private set; }

		internal int MaxBufferSize { get; private set; }

		internal MessageEncoderFactory MessageEncoderFactory { get; private set; }

		public ServiceBusChannelFactory(BindingContext context, NetMessagingTransportBindingElement transport)
			: base((IDefaultCommunicationTimeouts)context.Binding)
		{
			MessagingFactorySettings = transport.CreateMessagingFactorySettings(context);
			ManualAddressing = transport.ManualAddressing;
			MaxBufferPoolSize = transport.MaxBufferPoolSize;
			MaxBufferSize = (int)Math.Min(transport.MaxReceivedMessageSize, 2147483647L);
			MessageEncodingBindingElement messageEncodingBindingElement = context.BindingParameters.Find<MessageEncodingBindingElement>();
			if (messageEncodingBindingElement == null)
			{
				messageEncodingBindingElement = TransportDefaults.CreateDefaultEncoder();
			}
			MessageEncoderFactory = messageEncodingBindingElement.CreateMessageEncoderFactory();
		}

		public override T GetProperty<T>()
		{
			if (typeof(T) == typeof(MessageVersion))
			{
				return (T)(object)MessageEncoderFactory.MessageVersion;
			}
			if (typeof(T) == typeof(FaultConverter))
			{
				return MessageEncoderFactory.Encoder.GetProperty<T>();
			}
			return base.GetProperty<T>();
		}

		protected override void OnAbort()
		{
			ClearBufferManager();
		}

		protected override void OnClose(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			ClearBufferManager();
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new CompletedAsyncResult(callback, state);
		}

		protected override void OnEndClose(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			CompletedAsyncResult.End(result);
			ClearBufferManager();
		}

		protected override IOutputChannel OnCreateChannel(EndpointAddress endpointAddress, Uri via)
		{
			ValidateScheme(via);
			return new ServiceBusOutputChannel(this, endpointAddress, via);
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginOpen(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			OnOpen(timeout);
			return new CompletedAsyncResult(callback, state);
		}

		protected override void OnEndOpen(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			CompletedAsyncResult.End(result);
		}

		protected override void OnOpen(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			bufferManager = BufferManager.CreateBufferManager(MaxBufferPoolSize, MaxBufferSize);
		}

		private static void ValidateScheme(Uri via)
		{
			if (!string.Equals(via.Scheme, "sb", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.Argument("via", SRClient.InvalidUriScheme(via.Scheme, "sb"));
			}
		}

		private void ClearBufferManager()
		{
			if (bufferManager != null)
			{
				bufferManager.Clear();
			}
		}
	}
	internal abstract class ServiceBusChannelListener<TChannel> : ChannelListenerBaseInternals<TChannel> where TChannel : class, IChannel
	{
		private class OpenAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<OpenAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly ServiceBusChannelListener<TChannel> channelListener;

			private readonly Uri messagingFactoryAddress;

			private readonly MessagingFactorySettings factorySettings;

			public OpenAsyncResult(ServiceBusChannelListener<TChannel> channelListener, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.channelListener = channelListener;
				factorySettings = this.channelListener.MessagingFactorySettings;
				if (!factorySettings.NetMessagingTransportSettings.GatewayMode)
				{
					messagingFactoryAddress = this.channelListener.MessagingAddress.NamingAuthority;
				}
				else
				{
					messagingFactoryAddress = this.channelListener.MessagingAddress.ResourceAddress;
				}
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				yield return CallTask((Func<OpenAsyncResult, TimeSpan, Task>)async delegate(OpenAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t)
				{
					ServiceBusChannelListener<TChannel> serviceBusChannelListener = thisPtr.channelListener;
					serviceBusChannelListener.MessagingFactory = await MessagingFactory.CreateAsync(thisPtr.messagingFactoryAddress, thisPtr.factorySettings).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
				if (ContineAfterMessagingException(base.LastAsyncStepException))
				{
					channelListener.MessagingFactory.SafeAddFaulted(channelListener.OnMessagingFactoryFaulted);
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((OpenAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.channelListener.MessagingFactory.BeginOpen(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(OpenAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult a)
					{
						thisPtr.channelListener.MessagingFactory.EndOpen(a);
					}, (Call)delegate(OpenAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t)
					{
						thisPtr.channelListener.MessagingFactory.Open(t);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
					ContineAfterMessagingException(base.LastAsyncStepException);
				}
			}

			private bool ContineAfterMessagingException(Exception exception)
			{
				if (exception == null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (exception is MessagingException ex)
				{
					Complete(MessagingExceptionHelper.ConvertToCommunicationException(ex));
				}
				else
				{
					Complete(exception);
				}
				return !base.IsCompleted;
			}
		}

		private Uri listenUri;

		public override Uri Uri => listenUri;

		internal int MaxBufferSize { get; private set; }

		internal MessageEncoderFactory MessageEncoderFactory { get; private set; }

		internal MessagingAddress MessagingAddress { get; private set; }

		internal bool ReceiveContextEnabled { get; private set; }

		internal ReceiveMode ReceiveMode
		{
			get
			{
				if (!ReceiveContextEnabled)
				{
					return ReceiveMode.ReceiveAndDelete;
				}
				return ReceiveMode.PeekLock;
			}
		}

		internal int PrefetchCount { get; private set; }

		internal MessagingFactory MessagingFactory { get; private set; }

		internal MessagingFactorySettings MessagingFactorySettings { get; private set; }

		internal NetMessagingTransportBindingElement TransportBindingElement { get; private set; }

		protected ServiceBusChannelListener(BindingContext context, NetMessagingTransportBindingElement transport)
			: base((IDefaultCommunicationTimeouts)context.Binding)
		{
			listenUri = context.ListenUriBaseAddress;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(context.ListenUriRelativeAddress))
			{
				listenUri = new Uri(context.ListenUriBaseAddress, context.ListenUriRelativeAddress);
			}
			MaxBufferSize = (int)Math.Min(transport.MaxReceivedMessageSize, 2147483647L);
			ReceiveContextEnabled = transport.ReceiveContextEnabled;
			MessageEncodingBindingElement messageEncodingBindingElement = context.BindingParameters.Find<MessageEncodingBindingElement>();
			if (messageEncodingBindingElement == null)
			{
				messageEncodingBindingElement = TransportDefaults.CreateDefaultEncoder();
			}
			MessageEncoderFactory = messageEncodingBindingElement.CreateMessageEncoderFactory();
			MessagingFactorySettings = transport.CreateMessagingFactorySettings(context);
			MessagingAddress = new MessagingAddress(Uri, MessagingFactorySettings.NetMessagingTransportSettings.GatewayMode);
			if (MessagingAddress.Type != MessagingAddressType.Entity)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.Argument("ListenUriBaseAddress", SRClient.EntityNameNotFound(MessagingAddress.ToString()));
			}
			TransportBindingElement = transport;
			PrefetchCount = transport.PrefetchCount;
		}

		public override T GetProperty<T>()
		{
			if (typeof(T) == typeof(MessageVersion))
			{
				return (T)(object)MessageEncoderFactory.MessageVersion;
			}
			if (typeof(T) == typeof(FaultConverter))
			{
				return MessageEncoderFactory.Encoder.GetProperty<T>();
			}
			return base.GetProperty<T>();
		}

		internal void InternalFault()
		{
			Fault();
		}

		protected override void OnAbort()
		{
			MessagingFactory?.Abort();
		}

		protected override void OnClose(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			try
			{
				MessagingFactory.Close(timeout);
			}
			catch (MessagingException messagingException)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(ConvertException(messagingException));
			}
			catch (OperationCanceledException ex)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new CommunicationObjectAbortedException(SRClient.EntityClosedOrAborted, ex.InnerException ?? ex));
			}
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			try
			{
				return MessagingFactory.BeginClose(timeout, callback, state);
			}
			catch (MessagingException messagingException)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(ConvertException(messagingException));
			}
			catch (OperationCanceledException ex)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new CommunicationObjectAbortedException(SRClient.EntityClosedOrAborted, ex.InnerException ?? ex));
			}
		}

		protected override void OnEndClose(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			try
			{
				MessagingFactory.EndClose(result);
			}
			catch (MessagingException messagingException)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(ConvertException(messagingException));
			}
			catch (OperationCanceledException ex)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new CommunicationObjectAbortedException(SRClient.EntityClosedOrAborted, ex.InnerException ?? ex));
			}
		}

		protected override void OnOpen(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			new OpenAsyncResult(this, timeout, null, null).RunSynchronously();
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginOpen(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			OpenAsyncResult openAsyncResult = new OpenAsyncResult(this, timeout, callback, state);
			openAsyncResult.Start();
			return openAsyncResult;
		}

		protected override void OnEndOpen(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			AsyncResult<OpenAsyncResult>.End(result);
		}

		private void OnMessagingFactoryFaulted(object sender, EventArgs args)
		{
			Fault();
		}

		private Exception ConvertException(MessagingException messagingException)
		{
			bool shouldFault;
			Exception result = MessagingExceptionHelper.ConvertToCommunicationException(messagingException, out shouldFault);
			if (shouldFault)
			{
				Fault();
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	internal sealed class ServiceBusInputChannel : ServiceBusInputChannelBase<IInputChannel>
	{
		private class CreateAndOpenMessageReceiverAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<CreateAndOpenMessageReceiverAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly ServiceBusInputChannel inputChannel;

			private readonly ServiceBusChannelListener<IInputChannel> channelListener;

			private readonly MessagingFactory messagingFactory;

			private readonly string entityName;

			private readonly ReceiveMode receiveMode;

			private readonly int prefetchCount;

			public CreateAndOpenMessageReceiverAsyncResult(ServiceBusInputChannel inputChannel, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.inputChannel = inputChannel;
				channelListener = inputChannel.ChannelListener;
				messagingFactory = channelListener.MessagingFactory;
				entityName = channelListener.MessagingAddress.EntityName;
				receiveMode = channelListener.ReceiveMode;
				prefetchCount = channelListener.PrefetchCount;
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				yield return CallTask((Func<CreateAndOpenMessageReceiverAsyncResult, TimeSpan, Task>)async delegate(CreateAndOpenMessageReceiverAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t)
				{
					ServiceBusInputChannel serviceBusInputChannel = thisPtr.inputChannel;
					serviceBusInputChannel.MessageReceiver = await thisPtr.messagingFactory.CreateMessageReceiverAsync(thisPtr.entityName, thisPtr.receiveMode, t).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
				if (prefetchCount >= 0)
				{
					inputChannel.MessageReceiver.PrefetchCount = prefetchCount;
				}
				if (base.LastAsyncStepException == null)
				{
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((CreateAndOpenMessageReceiverAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.inputChannel.MessageReceiver.BeginOpen(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(CreateAndOpenMessageReceiverAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult a)
					{
						thisPtr.inputChannel.MessageReceiver.EndOpen(a);
					}, (Call)delegate(CreateAndOpenMessageReceiverAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t)
					{
						thisPtr.inputChannel.MessageReceiver.Open(t);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
				}
				Exception ex = base.LastAsyncStepException;
				if (ex != null)
				{
					if (ex is MessagingEntityNotFoundException)
					{
						channelListener.InternalFault();
						base.LastAsyncStepException = new EndpointNotFoundException(ex.Message, ex);
					}
					else if (ex is UnauthorizedAccessException)
					{
						channelListener.InternalFault();
					}
					Complete(base.LastAsyncStepException);
				}
			}
		}

		public ServiceBusInputChannel(ServiceBusChannelListener<IInputChannel> parent)
			: base(parent)
		{
		}

		protected override void OnOpen(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			CreateAndOpenMessageReceiverAsyncResult createAndOpenMessageReceiverAsyncResult = new CreateAndOpenMessageReceiverAsyncResult(this, timeout, null, null);
			createAndOpenMessageReceiverAsyncResult.RunSynchronously();
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginOpen(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			CreateAndOpenMessageReceiverAsyncResult createAndOpenMessageReceiverAsyncResult = new CreateAndOpenMessageReceiverAsyncResult(this, timeout, callback, state);
			createAndOpenMessageReceiverAsyncResult.Start();
			return createAndOpenMessageReceiverAsyncResult;
		}

		protected override void OnEndOpen(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			AsyncResult<CreateAndOpenMessageReceiverAsyncResult>.End(result);
		}

		protected override void OnFaulted()
		{
			base.OnFaulted();
			Abort();
		}
	}
	internal abstract class ServiceBusInputChannelBase<TChannel> : ChannelBase, IInputChannel, IChannel, ICommunicationObject, ICommunicationObjectInternals where TChannel : class, IChannel
	{
		private sealed class AfmsReceiveContext : System.ServiceModel.Channels.ReceiveContext
		{
			private Guid lockToken;

			private MessageReceiver receiver;

			private AfmsReceiveContext()
			{
			}

			public static AfmsReceiveContext ApplyTo(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, MessageReceiver receiver, Guid lockToken)
			{
				AfmsReceiveContext afmsReceiveContext = new AfmsReceiveContext();
				afmsReceiveContext.receiver = receiver;
				afmsReceiveContext.lockToken = lockToken;
				message.Properties.Add(System.ServiceModel.Channels.ReceiveContext.Name, afmsReceiveContext);
				return afmsReceiveContext;
			}

			protected override void OnAbandon(TimeSpan timeout)
			{
				TraceAbandon();
				receiver.Abandon(new Guid[1] { lockToken }, timeout);
			}

			protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginAbandon(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{
				TraceAbandon();
				return receiver.BeginAbandon(new Guid[1] { lockToken }, timeout, callback, state);
			}

			protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginComplete(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{
				TraceComplete();
				return receiver.BeginComplete(new Guid[1] { lockToken }, timeout, callback, state);
			}

			protected override void OnComplete(TimeSpan timeout)
			{
				TraceComplete();
				receiver.Complete(new Guid[1] { lockToken }, timeout);
			}

			protected override void OnEndAbandon(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				receiver.EndAbandon(result);
			}

			protected override void OnEndComplete(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				receiver.EndComplete(result);
			}

			private void TraceAbandon()
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteChannelReceiveContextAbandon(lockToken);
				});
			}

			private void TraceComplete()
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteChannelReceiveContextComplete(lockToken);
				});
			}
		}

		private MessageReceiver messageReceiver;

		public EndpointAddress LocalAddress { get; private set; }

		protected ServiceBusChannelListener<TChannel> ChannelListener { get; private set; }

		protected MessageReceiver MessageReceiver
		{
			get
			{
				return messageReceiver;
			}
			set
			{
				messageReceiver = value;
				value.SafeAddFaulted(OnReceiverFaulted);
			}
		}

		public ServiceBusInputChannelBase(ServiceBusChannelListener<TChannel> channelListener)
			: base(channelListener)
		{
			ChannelListener = channelListener;
			LocalAddress = new EndpointAddress(channelListener.Uri);
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginReceive(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposedOrNotOpen();
			try
			{
				return MessageReceiver.BeginReceive(timeout, callback, state);
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				OnException(exception);
				throw;
			}
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginReceive(AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return BeginReceive(base.DefaultReceiveTimeout, callback, state);
		}

		void ICommunicationObjectInternals.ThrowIfDisposed()
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
		}

		void ICommunicationObjectInternals.ThrowIfDisposedOrNotOpen()
		{
			ThrowIfDisposedOrNotOpen();
		}

		IAsyncResult IInputChannel.BeginTryReceive(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			if (this.DoneReceivingInCurrentState())
			{
				return new DoneAsyncResult(data: true, callback, state);
			}
			try
			{
				return OnBeginTryReceive(timeout, callback, state);
			}
			catch (OperationCanceledException)
			{
				return new DoneAsyncResult(data: true, callback, state);
			}
		}

		System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message IInputChannel.EndReceive(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			try
			{
				BrokeredMessage brokeredMessage = MessageReceiver.EndReceive(result);
				if (brokeredMessage == null)
				{
					throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new TimeoutException());
				}
				System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message = ConvertToWcfMessage(brokeredMessage);
				TraceReceivedMessage(message);
				return message;
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				OnException(exception);
				throw;
			}
		}

		bool IInputChannel.EndTryReceive(IAsyncResult result, out System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message wcfMessage)
		{
			if (result is DoneAsyncResult)
			{
				wcfMessage = null;
				return CompletedAsyncResult<bool>.End(result);
			}
			BrokeredMessage brokeredMessage;
			bool result2 = OnEndTryReceive(result, out brokeredMessage);
			if (brokeredMessage != null)
			{
				wcfMessage = ConvertToWcfMessage(brokeredMessage);
				TraceReceivedMessage(wcfMessage);
			}
			else
			{
				wcfMessage = null;
			}
			return result2;
		}

		public System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message Receive(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposedOrNotOpen();
			try
			{
				BrokeredMessage brokeredMessage = MessageReceiver.Receive(timeout);
				if (brokeredMessage == null)
				{
					throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new TimeoutException());
				}
				System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message = ConvertToWcfMessage(brokeredMessage);
				TraceReceivedMessage(message);
				return message;
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				OnException(exception);
				throw;
			}
		}

		public System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message Receive()
		{
			return Receive(base.DefaultReceiveTimeout);
		}

		bool IInputChannel.TryReceive(TimeSpan timeout, out System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message wcfMessage)
		{
			if (this.DoneReceivingInCurrentState())
			{
				wcfMessage = null;
				return true;
			}
			BrokeredMessage brokeredMessage;
			bool result = OnTryReceive(timeout, out brokeredMessage);
			if (brokeredMessage != null)
			{
				wcfMessage = ConvertToWcfMessage(brokeredMessage);
				TraceReceivedMessage(wcfMessage);
			}
			else
			{
				wcfMessage = null;
			}
			return result;
		}

		IAsyncResult IInputChannel.BeginWaitForMessage(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new NotSupportedException());
		}

		bool IInputChannel.EndWaitForMessage(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new NotSupportedException());
		}

		public bool WaitForMessage(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new NotSupportedException());
		}

		protected virtual IAsyncResult OnBeginTryReceive(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			try
			{
				return MessageReceiver.BeginTryReceive((timeout == TimeSpan.MaxValue) ? base.DefaultReceiveTimeout : timeout, callback, state);
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				OnException(exception);
				throw;
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool OnEndTryReceive(IAsyncResult result, out BrokeredMessage brokeredMessage)
		{
			try
			{
				return MessageReceiver.EndTryReceive(result, out brokeredMessage);
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				OnException(exception);
				throw;
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool OnTryReceive(TimeSpan timeout, out BrokeredMessage brokeredMessage)
		{
			try
			{
				return MessageReceiver.TryReceive(timeout, out brokeredMessage);
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				OnException(exception);
				throw;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnAbort()
		{
			messageReceiver?.Abort();
		}

		protected override void OnClose(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			try
			{
				messageReceiver?.Close(timeout);
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				OnException(exception);
				throw;
			}
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			try
			{
				return new CloseEntityCollectionAsyncResult(new ClientEntity[1] { messageReceiver }, timeout, callback, state);
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				OnException(exception);
				throw;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnEndClose(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			try
			{
				CloseEntityCollectionAsyncResult.End(result);
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				OnException(exception);
				throw;
			}
		}

		private void OnException(Exception exception)
		{
			if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (exception is MessagingEntityNotFoundException)
			{
				Fault();
				ChannelListener.InternalFault();
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new EndpointNotFoundException(exception.Message, exception));
			}
			if (exception is OperationCanceledException)
			{
				if (exception.InnerException is MessagingException exception2)
				{
					MessagingExceptionHelper.ConvertToCommunicationException(exception2, out var shouldFault);
					if (shouldFault)
					{
						Fault();
						ChannelListener.InternalFault();
					}
				}
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new CommunicationObjectAbortedException(SRClient.EntityClosedOrAborted, exception.InnerException ?? exception));
			}
			if (exception is UnauthorizedAccessException)
			{
				Fault();
				ChannelListener.InternalFault();
				return;
			}
			if (exception is MessagingException exception3)
			{
				CommunicationException exception4 = MessagingExceptionHelper.ConvertToCommunicationException(exception3);
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(exception4);
			}
			if (exception is InvalidOperationException)
			{
				Fault();
				ChannelListener.InternalFault();
			}
		}

		private void OnReceiverFaulted(object sender, EventArgs args)
		{
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteChannelFaulted(GetCommunicationObjectType().ToString());
			});
			Fault();
		}

		private System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message ConvertToWcfMessage(BrokeredMessage brokeredMessage)
		{
			MessageEncoder encoder = ChannelListener.MessageEncoderFactory.Encoder;
			System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message = encoder.ReadMessage(brokeredMessage.BodyStream, ChannelListener.MaxBufferSize);
			BrokeredMessageProperty.AddPropertyToWcfMessage(brokeredMessage, message);
			if (ChannelListener.ReceiveContextEnabled)
			{
				AfmsReceiveContext.ApplyTo(message, messageReceiver, brokeredMessage.LockToken);
			}
			message.Properties.Via = LocalAddress.Uri;
			return message;
		}

		private void TraceReceivedMessage(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message wcfMessage)
		{
			string messageId = string.Empty;
			MessageHeaders headers = wcfMessage.Headers;
			if (headers.MessageVersion.Addressing != AddressingVersion.None && headers.MessageId != null)
			{
				messageId = headers.MessageId.ToString();
			}
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteChannelReceivedMessage(LocalAddress.Uri.AbsoluteUri, headers.Action ?? "NoAction", messageId);
			});
		}
	}

		private class TryReceiveAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<TryReceiveAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly ServiceBusInputSessionChannel sessionChannel;

			private readonly TimeSpan innerTimeout;

			private bool returnValue;

			private BrokeredMessage brokeredMessage;

			public BrokeredMessage BrokeredMessage => brokeredMessage;

			public bool ReturnValue => returnValue;

			public TryReceiveAsyncResult(ServiceBusInputSessionChannel sessionChannel, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.sessionChannel = sessionChannel;
				innerTimeout = TimeoutHelper.Min(timeout, this.sessionChannel.sessionIdleTimeout);
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((TryReceiveAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.sessionChannel.MessageReceiver.BeginTryReceive(thisPtr.innerTimeout, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(TryReceiveAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult a)
				{
					thisPtr.returnValue = thisPtr.sessionChannel.MessageReceiver.EndTryReceive(a, out thisPtr.brokeredMessage);
				}, (Call)delegate(TryReceiveAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t)
				{
					thisPtr.returnValue = thisPtr.sessionChannel.MessageReceiver.TryReceive(thisPtr.innerTimeout, out thisPtr.brokeredMessage);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
				if (!returnValue && base.OriginalTimeout > sessionChannel.sessionIdleTimeout)
				{
					returnValue = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private TimeSpan sessionIdleTimeout;

		public IInputSession Session { get; private set; }

	internal sealed class ServiceBusInputSessionChannelListener : ServiceBusChannelListener<IInputSessionChannel>
	{
		private class AcceptChannelAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<AcceptChannelAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly ServiceBusInputSessionChannelListener owner;

			private readonly TimeSpan acceptMessageSessionTimeout;

			private readonly TimeSpan retryTimeSpan;

			public ServiceBusInputSessionChannel Channel { get; private set; }

			public AcceptChannelAsyncResult(ServiceBusInputSessionChannelListener owner, TimeSpan retryTimeSpan, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.owner = owner;
				this.retryTimeSpan = retryTimeSpan;
				acceptMessageSessionTimeout = ((base.OriginalTimeout == TimeSpan.MaxValue) ? this.owner.DefaultReceiveTimeout : timeout);
				Channel = null;
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				if (owner.DoneReceivingInCurrentState())
				{
					Complete(null);
					yield break;
				}
				Stopwatch elapsedTime = Stopwatch.StartNew();
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((AcceptChannelAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.owner.MessagingFactory.BeginAcceptMessageSession(owner.MessagingAddress.EntityName, null, owner.ReceiveMode, thisPtr.acceptMessageSessionTimeout, thisPtr.acceptMessageSessionTimeout, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(AcceptChannelAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					thisPtr.Channel = new ServiceBusInputSessionChannel(thisPtr.owner.MessagingFactory.EndAcceptMessageSession(r), thisPtr.owner);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
				elapsedTime.Stop();
				if (base.LastAsyncStepException == null)
				{
					owner.ResetRetryTimeSpan();
					Complete(null);
					yield break;
				}
				Exception returnException = owner.OnException(base.LastAsyncStepException) ?? base.LastAsyncStepException;
				TimeSpan timeSpan = TimeSpan.FromTicks(Math.Min(RemainingTime().Ticks, retryTimeSpan.Ticks - elapsedTime.Elapsed.Ticks));
				if (timeSpan > TimeSpan.Zero)
				{
					yield return CallAsyncSleep(timeSpan);
				}
				owner.IncrementRetryTimeSpan(retryTimeSpan);
				Complete(returnException);
			}
		}

		private static readonly TimeSpan InitialRetrySleepTime = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(500.0);

		private static readonly TimeSpan MaxRetrySleepTime = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(60.0);

		private object retryTimeoutLock = new object();

		private TimeSpan retryTimeSpan;

		public ServiceBusInputSessionChannelListener(BindingContext context, NetMessagingTransportBindingElement transport)
			: base(context, transport)
		{
			retryTimeSpan = InitialRetrySleepTime;
		}

		public void IncrementRetryTimeSpan(TimeSpan currentRetryTimeSpan)
		{
			if (!(currentRetryTimeSpan == retryTimeSpan) || !(retryTimeSpan < MaxRetrySleepTime))
			{
				return;
			}
			lock (retryTimeoutLock)
			{
				if (currentRetryTimeSpan == retryTimeSpan && retryTimeSpan < MaxRetrySleepTime)
				{
					retryTimeSpan += retryTimeSpan;
					if (retryTimeSpan > MaxRetrySleepTime)
					{
						retryTimeSpan = MaxRetrySleepTime;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public void ResetRetryTimeSpan()
		{
			if (retryTimeSpan == InitialRetrySleepTime)
			{
				return;
			}
			lock (retryTimeoutLock)
			{
				retryTimeSpan = InitialRetrySleepTime;
			}
		}

		protected override IInputSessionChannel OnAcceptChannel(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			TimeSpan timeSpan = retryTimeSpan;
			AcceptChannelAsyncResult acceptChannelAsyncResult = new AcceptChannelAsyncResult(this, timeSpan, timeout, null, null);
			return acceptChannelAsyncResult.RunSynchronously().Channel;
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginAcceptChannel(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			TimeSpan timeSpan = retryTimeSpan;
			return new AcceptChannelAsyncResult(this, timeSpan, timeout, callback, state).Start();
		}

		protected override IInputSessionChannel OnEndAcceptChannel(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			return AsyncResult<AcceptChannelAsyncResult>.End(result).Channel;
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginWaitForChannel(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new NotSupportedException());
		}

		protected override bool OnEndWaitForChannel(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new NotSupportedException());
		}

		protected override bool OnWaitForChannel(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new NotSupportedException());
		}

		private CommunicationException HandleMessagingException(MessagingException messagingException)
		{
			bool shouldFault;
			CommunicationException ex = MessagingExceptionHelper.ConvertToCommunicationException(messagingException, out shouldFault);
			if (ex is CommunicationObjectFaultedException || ex is CommunicationObjectAbortedException)
			{
				ex = new CommunicationException(messagingException.Message, messagingException);
			}
			return ex;
		}

		private CommunicationException OnException(Exception exception)
		{
			if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (exception is MessagingException messagingException)
			{
				return HandleMessagingException(messagingException);
			}
			if (exception is OperationCanceledException && exception.InnerException is MessagingException messagingException2)
			{
				return HandleMessagingException(messagingException2);
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

					if (SyncContinue(result))

		private sealed class SendAsyncResult : Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult
		{
			private static AsyncCompletion onSendComplete = OnSendComplete;

			private byte[] bufferToReturn;

			private ServiceBusOutputChannel outputChannel;

			public SendAsyncResult(ServiceBusOutputChannel outputChannel, System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(callback, state)
			{
				this.outputChannel = outputChannel;
				outputChannel.AddHeadersTo(message);
				outputChannel.TraceSendingMessage(message);
				BrokeredMessage brokeredMessage = null;
				try
				{
					brokeredMessage = outputChannel.ConvertToBrokerMessage(message, out bufferToReturn);
					IAsyncResult result = outputChannel.MessageSender.BeginSend(new BrokeredMessage[1] { brokeredMessage }, timeout, PrepareAsyncCompletion(onSendComplete), this);
					if (SyncContinue(result))
					{
						Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: true);
					}
				}
				catch (MessagingException ex)
				{
					bool shouldFault;
					CommunicationException ex2 = MessagingExceptionHelper.ConvertToCommunicationException(ex, out shouldFault);
					if (shouldFault)
					{
						this.outputChannel.Fault();
					}
					throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(ex2);
				}
				catch (OperationCanceledException ex3)
				{
					if (ex3.InnerException is MessagingException ex4)
					{
						MessagingExceptionHelper.ConvertToCommunicationException(ex4, out var shouldFault2);
						if (shouldFault2)
						{
							this.outputChannel.Fault();
						}
					}
					throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new CommunicationObjectAbortedException(SRClient.EntityClosedOrAborted, ex3.InnerException ?? ex3));
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
					if (bufferToReturn != null)
					{
						this.outputChannel.ChannelFactory.BufferManager.ReturnBuffer(bufferToReturn);
					}
					throw;
				}
			}

			public static void End(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult.End<SendAsyncResult>(result);
			}

			private static bool OnSendComplete(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				SendAsyncResult sendAsyncResult = (SendAsyncResult)result.AsyncState;
				try
				{
					sendAsyncResult.outputChannel.MessageSender.EndSend(result);
					return true;
				}
				catch (MessagingException ex)
				{
					bool shouldFault;
					CommunicationException ex2 = MessagingExceptionHelper.ConvertToCommunicationException(ex, out shouldFault);
					if (shouldFault)
					{
						sendAsyncResult.outputChannel.Fault();
					}
					throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(ex2);
				}
				catch (OperationCanceledException ex3)
				{
					if (ex3.InnerException is MessagingException ex4)
					{
						MessagingExceptionHelper.ConvertToCommunicationException(ex4, out var shouldFault2);
						if (shouldFault2)
						{
							sendAsyncResult.outputChannel.Fault();
						}
					}
					throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new CommunicationObjectAbortedException(SRClient.EntityClosedOrAborted, ex3.InnerException ?? ex3));
				}
				finally
				{
					if (sendAsyncResult.bufferToReturn != null)
					{
						sendAsyncResult.outputChannel.ChannelFactory.BufferManager.ReturnBuffer(sendAsyncResult.bufferToReturn);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginSend(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			if (message == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNull("message");
			}
			TimeoutHelper.ThrowIfNegativeArgument(timeout);
			ThrowIfDisposedOrNotOpen();
			return new SendAsyncResult(this, message, timeout, callback, state);

		public void Send(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			if (message == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNull("message");
			}
			TimeoutHelper.ThrowIfNegativeArgument(timeout);
			ThrowIfDisposedOrNotOpen();
			AddHeadersTo(message);
			TraceSendingMessage(message);
			byte[] bufferToReturn = null;
			BrokeredMessage brokeredMessage = null;
			try
			{
				brokeredMessage = ConvertToBrokerMessage(message, out bufferToReturn);
				MessageSender.Send(new BrokeredMessage[1] { brokeredMessage }, timeout);
			}
			catch (MessagingException exception)
			{
				bool shouldFault;
				CommunicationException exception2 = MessagingExceptionHelper.ConvertToCommunicationException(exception, out shouldFault);
				if (shouldFault)
				{
					Fault();
				}
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(exception2);
			}
			catch (OperationCanceledException ex)
			{
				if (ex.InnerException is MessagingException exception3)
				{
					MessagingExceptionHelper.ConvertToCommunicationException(exception3, out var shouldFault2);
					if (shouldFault2)
					{
						Fault();
					}
				}
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new CommunicationObjectAbortedException(SRClient.EntityClosedOrAborted, ex.InnerException ?? ex));
			}
			finally
			{
				if (brokeredMessage != null && bufferToReturn != null)
				{
					ChannelFactory.BufferManager.ReturnBuffer(bufferToReturn);
				}
			}
		}

		public void Send(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message)
		{
			Send(message, base.DefaultSendTimeout);
		}

				messageSender.Close(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
			}
			if (messagingFactory != null)
			{
				messagingFactory.Close(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
			}
		}

		protected sealed override IAsyncResult OnBeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			List<ClientEntity> list = new List<ClientEntity>();
			if (messageSender != null)
			{
				list.Add(messageSender);
			}
			if (messagingFactory != null)
			{
				list.Add(messagingFactory);
			}
			return new CloseEntityCollectionIteratedAsyncResult(list, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		protected sealed override void OnEndClose(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			AsyncResult<CloseEntityCollectionIteratedAsyncResult>.End(result);
		}

		protected sealed override void OnOpen(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			OpenMessagingFactoryAndMessageSenderAsyncResult result = new OpenMessagingFactoryAndMessageSenderAsyncResult(this, timeout, null, null);
			MessageSender = OpenMessagingFactoryAndMessageSenderAsyncResult.End(result);
		}

		protected sealed override IAsyncResult OnBeginOpen(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new OpenMessagingFactoryAndMessageSenderAsyncResult(this, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		protected sealed override void OnEndOpen(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			MessageSender = OpenMessagingFactoryAndMessageSenderAsyncResult.End(result);
		}

		private void AddHeadersTo(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message wcfMessage)
		{
			if (!ChannelFactory.ManualAddressing && to != null)
			{
				to.ApplyTo(wcfMessage);
			}
		}

		private BrokeredMessage ConvertToBrokerMessage(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message wcfMessage, out byte[] bufferToReturn)
		{
			bufferToReturn = null;
			BrokeredMessage brokeredMessage;
			if (BrokeredMessageProperty.TryGet(wcfMessage.Properties, out var property))
			{
				brokeredMessage = property.Message;
				brokeredMessage.ContentType = property.ContentType;
			}
			else
			{
				brokeredMessage = new BrokeredMessage();
				EndpointAddress replyTo = wcfMessage.Headers.ReplyTo;
				if (replyTo != null)
				{
					brokeredMessage.ReplyTo = replyTo.Uri.AbsoluteUri;
				}
			}
			byte[] array = null;
			try
			{
				ArraySegment<byte> arraySegment = encoder.WriteMessage(wcfMessage, maxBufferSize, ChannelFactory.BufferManager);
				array = arraySegment.Array;
				MemoryStream bodyStream = new MemoryStream(arraySegment.Array, arraySegment.Offset, arraySegment.Count, writable: true, publiclyVisible: true);
				brokeredMessage.BodyStream = bodyStream;
				bufferToReturn = array;
				array = null;
				return brokeredMessage;
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				if (array != null)
				{
					ChannelFactory.BufferManager.ReturnBuffer(array);
				}
				throw;
			}
		}

		private void OnMessageSenderFaulted(object sender, EventArgs args)
		{
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteChannelFaulted(GetCommunicationObjectType().ToString());
			});
			Fault();
		}

		private void TraceSendingMessage(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message wcfMessage)
		{
			string messageId = string.Empty;
			MessageHeaders headers = wcfMessage.Headers;
			if (headers.MessageVersion.Addressing != AddressingVersion.None && headers.MessageId != null)
			{
				messageId = headers.MessageId.ToString();
			}
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteChannelSendingMessage(RemoteAddress.Uri.AbsoluteUri, headers.Action ?? "NoAction", messageId);
			});
		}
	}

	internal static class WSAddressingHelper
	{
		private static XmlDocument xmlDocument;

		private static XmlDocument XmlDoc
		{
			get
			{
				if (xmlDocument == null)
				{
					NameTable nameTable = new NameTable();
					nameTable.Add("Policy");
					nameTable.Add("All");
					nameTable.Add("ExactlyOne");
					nameTable.Add("PolicyURIs");
					nameTable.Add("UsingAddressing");
					nameTable.Add("UsingAddressing");
					nameTable.Add("Addressing");
					nameTable.Add("AnonymousResponses");
					nameTable.Add("NonAnonymousResponses");
					xmlDocument = new XmlDocument(nameTable);
				}
				return xmlDocument;
			}
		}

		internal static void AddAddressToWsdlPort(Port wsdlPort, EndpointAddress addr, AddressingVersion addressing)
		{
			if (addressing == AddressingVersion.None)
			{
				return;
			}
			MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			XmlWriter xmlWriter = XmlWriter.Create(memoryStream);
			xmlWriter.WriteStartElement("temp");
			if (addressing == AddressingVersion.WSAddressing10)
			{
				xmlWriter.WriteAttributeString("xmlns", "wsa10", null, "http://www.w3.org/2005/08/addressing");
			}
			else
			{
				if (addressing != AddressingVersion.WSAddressingAugust2004)
				{
					throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException("This addressing version is not supported: " + addressing.ToString()));
				}
				xmlWriter.WriteAttributeString("xmlns", "wsa", null, "http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2004/08/addressing");
			}
			addr.WriteTo(addressing, xmlWriter);
			xmlWriter.WriteEndElement();
			xmlWriter.Flush();
			memoryStream.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
			XmlReader xmlReader = XmlReader.Create(memoryStream);
			xmlReader.MoveToContent();
			XmlElement extension = (XmlElement)XmlDoc.ReadNode(xmlReader).ChildNodes[0];
			wsdlPort.Extensions.Add(extension);
		}

		internal static void AddWSAddressingAssertion(MetadataExporter exporter, PolicyConversionContext context, AddressingVersion addressVersion)
		{
			XmlElement xmlElement;
			if (addressVersion == AddressingVersion.WSAddressingAugust2004)
			{
				xmlElement = XmlDoc.CreateElement("wsap", "UsingAddressing", "http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2004/08/addressing/policy");
			}
			else if (addressVersion == AddressingVersion.WSAddressing10)
			{
				if (exporter.PolicyVersion == PolicyVersion.Policy12)
				{
					xmlElement = XmlDoc.CreateElement("wsaw", "UsingAddressing", "http://www.w3.org/2006/05/addressing/wsdl");
				}
				else
				{
					xmlElement = XmlDoc.CreateElement("wsam", "Addressing", "http://www.w3.org/2007/05/addressing/metadata");
					SupportedAddressingMode supportedAddressingMode = SupportedAddressingMode.Anonymous;
					string name = typeof(SupportedAddressingMode).Name;
					if (exporter.State.ContainsKey(name) && exporter.State[name] is SupportedAddressingMode)
					{
						supportedAddressingMode = (SupportedAddressingMode)exporter.State[name];
					}
					if (supportedAddressingMode != SupportedAddressingMode.Mixed)
					{
						string localName = ((supportedAddressingMode != SupportedAddressingMode.Anonymous) ? "NonAnonymousResponses" : "AnonymousResponses");
						XmlElement xmlElement2 = XmlDoc.CreateElement("wsp", "Policy", "http://www.w3.org/ns/ws-policy");
						XmlElement newChild = XmlDoc.CreateElement("wsam", localName, "http://www.w3.org/2007/05/addressing/metadata");
						xmlElement2.AppendChild(newChild);
						xmlElement.AppendChild(xmlElement2);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (addressVersion != AddressingVersion.None)
				{
					throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException("This addressing version is not supported: " + addressVersion.ToString()));
				}
				xmlElement = null;
			}
			if (xmlElement != null)
			{
				context.GetBindingAssertions().Add(xmlElement);
			}
		}
	}

	internal sealed class DelegateFilter : Filter
	{
		private readonly Func<BrokeredMessage, IDictionary<string, object>, bool?> function;

		private readonly IDictionary<string, object> parameters;

		public override bool RequiresPreprocessing => false;

		internal override FilterType FilterType => FilterType.LambdaExpressionFilter;

		public DelegateFilter(Func<BrokeredMessage, IDictionary<string, object>, bool?> function, IDictionary<string, object> parameters)
		{
			if (function == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("function");
			}
			this.function = function;
			this.parameters = parameters;
		}

		public override Filter Preprocess()
		{
			return this;
		}

		public override bool Match(BrokeredMessage message)
		{
			try
			{
				return function(message, parameters) == true;
			}
			catch (FilterException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception ex2)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(ex2))
				{
					throw;
				}
				throw new FilterException(ex2.Message, ex2);
			}
		}

		public override void Validate()
		{
		}
	}
	internal sealed class DelegateRuleAction : RuleAction
	{
		private readonly Action<BrokeredMessage, IDictionary<string, object>> action;

		private readonly IDictionary<string, object> parameters;

		public override bool RequiresPreprocessing => false;

		public DelegateRuleAction(Action<BrokeredMessage, IDictionary<string, object>> action, IDictionary<string, object> parameters)
		{
			if (action == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("action");
			}
			this.action = action;
			this.parameters = parameters;
		}

		public override RuleAction Preprocess()
		{
			return this;
		}

		public override BrokeredMessage Execute(BrokeredMessage message)
		{
			try
			{
				action(message, parameters);
				return message;
			}
			catch (RuleActionException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception ex2)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(ex2))
				{
					throw;
				}
				throw new RuleActionException(ex2.Message, ex2);
			}
		}

		public override void Validate()
		{
		}

		internal override BrokeredMessage Execute(BrokeredMessage message, RuleExecutionContext context)
		{
			return Execute(message);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class GetParameterExpression : Expression
	{
		private static readonly MethodInfo GetParameterMethodInfo = typeof(GetParameterExpression).GetMethod("GetParameterMethod", BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.NonPublic);

		private readonly ParameterExpression parametersParameter;

		private readonly string parameterName;

		public override ExpressionType NodeType => ExpressionType.Extension;

		public override Type Type => Constants.ObjectType;

		public override bool CanReduce => true;

		public string ParameterName => parameterName;

		public GetParameterExpression(ParameterExpression parametersParameter, string parameterName)
		{
			this.parametersParameter = parametersParameter;
			this.parameterName = parameterName;
		}

		public override Expression Reduce()
		{
			return Expression.Call(GetParameterMethodInfo, parametersParameter, Expression.Constant(ParameterName));
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "@{0}", ParameterName);
		}

		private static object GetParameterMethod(IDictionary<string, object> parameters, string name)
		{
			if (parameters == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("parameters");
			}
			return parameters[name];
		}
	}
	internal static class ParametersValidator
	{
		public static void Validate(bool isFilter, IEnumerable<string> requiredParameters, IDictionary<string, object> suppliedParameters)
		{
			HashSet<string> hashSet = new HashSet<string>(suppliedParameters.Keys, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
			foreach (string requiredParameter in requiredParameters)
			{
				if (!suppliedParameters.ContainsKey(requiredParameter))
				{
					string message = SRClient.ParameterNotSpecifiedForSqlExpression(requiredParameter);
					throw isFilter ? ((MessagingException)new FilterException(message)) : ((MessagingException)new RuleActionException(message));
				}
				hashSet.Remove(requiredParameter);
			}
			if (hashSet.Count != 0)
			{
				string param = hashSet.First();
				string message2 = SRClient.ExtraParameterSpecifiedForSqlExpression(param);
				throw isFilter ? ((MessagingException)new FilterException(message2)) : ((MessagingException)new RuleActionException(message2));
			}
		}
	}

		public static Expression MakeFunction(ParameterExpression message, string functionName, List<Expression> arguments)
		{
			if (string.Equals(functionName, "NEWID", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				if (arguments.Count != 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.FilterFunctionIncorrectNumberOfArguments(functionName, 0, arguments.Count), "arguments");
				}
				return Expression.Call(Constants.NewGuid);
			}
			if (string.Equals(functionName, "P", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || string.Equals(functionName, "Property", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				if (arguments.Count != 1)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.FilterFunctionIncorrectNumberOfArguments(functionName, 1, arguments.Count), "arguments");
				}
				Expression propertyScope = Expression.Constant(PropertyScope.User);
				Expression propertyName = arguments[0];
				return new GetPropertyExpression(message, propertyScope, propertyName);
			}
			throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.FilterUnknownFunctionName(functionName));
		}

		private static void EnsureMaxAllowedStringLength(object stringObject)
		{
			if (stringObject is string { Length: >32767 } text)
			{
				string param = text.Substring(0, Math.Min(20, text.Length));
				throw new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.StringIsTooLong(param, text.Length, short.MaxValue));
			}
		}

		private static object AddCheckedMethod(object operand1, object operand2)
		{
			if (Convert.IsDBNull(operand1) || Convert.IsDBNull(operand2))
			{
				return DBNull.Value;
			}
			EnsureMaxAllowedStringLength(operand1);
			EnsureMaxAllowedStringLength(operand2);
			object obj = checked((dynamic)operand1 + (dynamic)operand2);
			EnsureMaxAllowedStringLength(obj);
			return obj;
		}

		private static object SubtractCheckedMethod(object operand1, object operand2)
		{
			if (Convert.IsDBNull(operand1) || Convert.IsDBNull(operand2))
			{
				return DBNull.Value;
			}
			return checked((dynamic)operand1 - (dynamic)operand2);
		}

		{
			if (Convert.IsDBNull(operand1) || Convert.IsDBNull(operand2))
			{
				return DBNull.Value;
			}
			return checked((dynamic)operand1 * (dynamic)operand2);
		}

		private static object DivideMethod(object operand1, object operand2)
		{
			if (Convert.IsDBNull(operand1) || Convert.IsDBNull(operand2))

				return DBNull.Value;
			}

		{
			if (Convert.IsDBNull(operand1) || Convert.IsDBNull(operand2))
			{
				return DBNull.Value;
			}
			return (dynamic)operand1 % (dynamic)operand2;
		}

		private static bool? EqualMethod(object operand1, object operand2)
		{
			if (Convert.IsDBNull(operand1) || Convert.IsDBNull(operand2))
			{
				return null;
			}
			dynamic val;
			dynamic val2;
			if (operand1 is Guid && operand2 is string)
			{
				val = operand1;
				val2 = new Guid((string)operand2);
			}
			else if (operand1 is string && operand2 is Guid)
			{
				val = new Guid((string)operand1);
				val2 = operand2;
			}
			else
			{
				val = operand1;
				val2 = operand2;
			}
			return val == val2;
		}

		private static bool? NotEqualMethod(object operand1, object operand2)
		{
			if (Convert.IsDBNull(operand1) || Convert.IsDBNull(operand2))
			{
				return null;
			}
			dynamic val;
			dynamic val2;
			if (operand1 is Guid && operand2 is string)
			{
				val = operand1;
				val2 = new Guid((string)operand2);
			}
			else if (operand1 is string && operand2 is Guid)
			{
				val = new Guid((string)operand1);
				val2 = operand2;
			}
			else
			{
				val = operand1;
				val2 = operand2;
			}
			return val != val2;
		}

		private static bool? LessThanMethod(object operand1, object operand2)
		{

			{
				return null;
			}

		private static object NegateCheckedMethod(object value)
		{
			if (Convert.IsDBNull(value))
			{
				return DBNull.Value;
			}

	internal sealed class GetPropertyExpression : Expression
	{
		private static readonly MethodInfo GetPropertyMethodInfo = typeof(GetPropertyExpression).GetMethod("GetPropertyMethod", BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.NonPublic);

		private readonly ParameterExpression message;

		private readonly Expression propertyScope;

		private readonly Expression propertyName;

		public override ExpressionType NodeType => ExpressionType.Extension;

		public override Type Type => Constants.ObjectType;

		public override bool CanReduce => true;

		public GetPropertyExpression(ParameterExpression message, QualifiedPropertyName qualifiedPropertyName)
		{
			if (message == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("message");
			}
			if (qualifiedPropertyName.Scope == PropertyScope.System && !SystemPropertyAccessor.HasGetProperty(qualifiedPropertyName.Name))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.MessageGetPropertyNotFound(qualifiedPropertyName.Name, typeof(BrokeredMessage)), "qualifiedPropertyName");
			}
			this.message = message;
			propertyScope = Expression.Constant(qualifiedPropertyName.Scope);
			propertyName = Expression.Constant(qualifiedPropertyName.Name);
		}

		public GetPropertyExpression(ParameterExpression message, Expression propertyScope, Expression propertyName)
		{
			if (message == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("message");
			}
			if (propertyScope == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("propertyScope");
			}
			if (propertyName == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("propertyName");
			}
			this.message = message;
			this.propertyScope = propertyScope;
			this.propertyName = propertyName;
			if (propertyName.Type != typeof(string))
			{
				this.propertyName = Expression.Convert(propertyName, typeof(string));
			}
		}

		public override Expression Reduce()
		{
			return Expression.Call(GetPropertyMethodInfo, message, propertyScope, propertyName);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "GetProperty({0}, {1})", propertyScope, propertyName);
		}

		private static object GetPropertyMethod(BrokeredMessage message, PropertyScope scope, string name)
		{
			return scope switch
			{
				PropertyScope.System => GetSystemProperty(message, name), 
				PropertyScope.User => GetUserProperty(message, name), 
				_ => throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.FilterScopeNotSupported(scope), "scope"), 
			};
		}

		private static object GetUserProperty(BrokeredMessage message, string propertyName)
		{
			if (!message.Properties.TryGetValue(propertyName, out var value))
			{
				return DBNull.Value;
			}
			return value;
		}

		private static object GetSystemProperty(BrokeredMessage message, string propertyName)
		{
			return SystemPropertyAccessor.GetProperty(message, propertyName);
		}
	}

	internal abstract class DelayExpression
	{
		private sealed class NormalExpression : DelayExpression
		{
			private readonly Expression expression;

			public NormalExpression(Expression expression)
			{
				if (expression == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("expression");
				}
				this.expression = expression;
			}

			public override Expression GetExpression()
			{
				return expression;
			}
		}

		private sealed class NumericConstantExpression : DelayExpression
		{
			private readonly LexLocation location;

			private readonly string token;

			private readonly TypeCode typeCode;

			public NumericConstantExpression(LexLocation location, string token, TypeCode typeCode)
			{
				if (location == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("location");
				}
				if (token == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("token");
				}
				this.location = location;
				this.token = token;
				this.typeCode = typeCode;
			}

			public override Expression GetExpression()
			{
				return GetExpression(token);
			}

			public override bool TryGetConstantNumericLiteral(ExpressionType expressionType, out Expression expression)
			{
				string literal = ((expressionType == ExpressionType.Negate || expressionType == ExpressionType.NegateChecked) ? ("-" + token) : token);
				expression = GetExpression(literal);
				return true;
			}

			private Expression GetExpression(string literal)
			{
				try
				{
					return System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Constant(Convert.ChangeType(literal, typeCode, NumberFormatInfo.InvariantInfo));
				}
				catch (OverflowException ex)
				{
					throw new OverflowException(SRClient.SQLSyntaxErrorDetailed(location.sLin, location.sCol, literal, ex.Message));
				}
				catch (InvalidCastException ex2)
				{
					throw new InvalidCastException(SRClient.SQLSyntaxErrorDetailed(location.sLin, location.sCol, literal, ex2.Message));
				}
				catch (FormatException ex3)
				{
					throw new FormatException(SRClient.SQLSyntaxErrorDetailed(location.sLin, location.sCol, literal, ex3.Message));
				}
				catch (ArgumentException ex4)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.SQLSyntaxErrorDetailed(location.sLin, location.sCol, literal, ex4.Message));
				}
			}
		}

		public static DelayExpression Expression(Expression expression)
		{
			return new NormalExpression(expression);
		}

		public static DelayExpression NumericConstant(LexLocation location, string token, TypeCode typeCode)
		{
			return new NumericConstantExpression(location, token, typeCode);
		}

		public virtual Expression GetExpression()
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException();
		}

		public virtual bool TryGetConstantNumericLiteral(ExpressionType expressionType, out Expression expression)
		{
			expression = null;
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal static class SystemPropertyAccessor
	{
		private static readonly Dictionary<string, PropertyInfo> PublicProperties;

		private static readonly Dictionary<string, Func<BrokeredMessage, object>> GetPropertyFunctions;

		private static readonly Dictionary<string, Action<BrokeredMessage, object>> SetPropertyActions;

		static SystemPropertyAccessor()
		{
			PublicProperties = new Dictionary<string, PropertyInfo>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
			GetPropertyFunctions = new Dictionary<string, Func<BrokeredMessage, object>>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
			SetPropertyActions = new Dictionary<string, Action<BrokeredMessage, object>>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
			ParameterExpression parameterExpression = Expression.Parameter(typeof(BrokeredMessage), "message");
			PropertyInfo[] properties = typeof(BrokeredMessage).GetProperties(BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.GetProperty | BindingFlags.SetProperty);
			foreach (PropertyInfo propertyInfo in properties)
			{
				PublicProperties.Add(propertyInfo.Name, propertyInfo);
				Expression expression = Expression.Property(parameterExpression, propertyInfo);
				MethodInfo getMethod = propertyInfo.GetGetMethod(nonPublic: false);
				if (getMethod != null)
				{
					Expression body = Expression.Convert(expression, typeof(object));
					Func<BrokeredMessage, object> value = Expression.Lambda<Func<BrokeredMessage, object>>(body, new ParameterExpression[1] { parameterExpression }).Compile();
					GetPropertyFunctions.Add(propertyInfo.Name, value);
				}
				MethodInfo setMethod = propertyInfo.GetSetMethod(nonPublic: false);
				if (setMethod != null)
				{
					ParameterExpression parameterExpression2 = Expression.Parameter(typeof(object), "value");
					Expression body2 = Expression.Assign(expression, Expression.Convert(parameterExpression2, expression.Type));
					Action<BrokeredMessage, object> value2 = Expression.Lambda<Action<BrokeredMessage, object>>(body2, new ParameterExpression[2] { parameterExpression, parameterExpression2 }).Compile();
					SetPropertyActions.Add(propertyInfo.Name, value2);
				}
			}
		}

		public static bool HasGetProperty(string propertyName)
		{
			return GetPropertyFunctions.ContainsKey(propertyName);
		}

		public static bool HasSetProperty(string propertyName)
		{
			return SetPropertyActions.ContainsKey(propertyName);
		}

		public static Type GetPropertyType(string propertyName)
		{
			return PublicProperties[propertyName].PropertyType;
		}

		public static void SetProperty(BrokeredMessage message, string propertyName, object value)
		{
			if (!SetPropertyActions.TryGetValue(propertyName, out var value2))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.MessageSetPropertyNotFound(propertyName, typeof(BrokeredMessage).Name));
			}
			value2(message, value);
		}

		public static object GetProperty(BrokeredMessage message, string propertyName)
		{
			if (!GetPropertyFunctions.TryGetValue(propertyName, out var value))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.MessageSetPropertyNotFound(propertyName, typeof(BrokeredMessage).Name));
			}
			return value(message);
		}
	}

	internal sealed class RemovePropertyExpression : Expression
	{
		private static readonly MethodInfo RemovePropertyMethodInfo = typeof(RemovePropertyExpression).GetMethod("RemoveProperty", BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.NonPublic);

		private readonly ParameterExpression message;

		private readonly QualifiedPropertyName property;

		public override ExpressionType NodeType => ExpressionType.Extension;

		public override Type Type => typeof(void);

		public override bool CanReduce => true;

		public RemovePropertyExpression(ParameterExpression message, QualifiedPropertyName property)
		{

			}
			this.message = message;
			this.property = property;
		}

		private static void RemoveProperty(BrokeredMessage message, PropertyScope scope, string name)
		{
			switch (scope)
			{
			case PropertyScope.System:
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.SqlFilterActionCannotRemoveSystemProperty(name), "name");
			default:
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.FilterScopeNotSupported(scope), "scope");
			case PropertyScope.User:
				message.BrokerRemoveProperty(name);
				break;
			}
		}

	internal sealed class SetPropertyExpression : Expression
	{
		private static readonly MethodInfo SetPropertyMethodInfo = typeof(SetPropertyExpression).GetMethod("SetPropertyMethod", BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.NonPublic);

		private readonly ParameterExpression message;

		private readonly QualifiedPropertyName property;

		private readonly Expression value;

		public override ExpressionType NodeType => ExpressionType.Extension;

		public override Type Type => typeof(object);

		public override bool CanReduce => true;

		public SetPropertyExpression(ParameterExpression message, QualifiedPropertyName property, Expression value)
		{
			if (message == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("message");
			}
			if (value == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("value");
			}
			if (property.Scope == PropertyScope.System && !SystemPropertyAccessor.HasSetProperty(property.Name))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.MessageSetPropertyNotFound(property.Name, typeof(BrokeredMessage)), "property");
			}
			this.message = message;
			this.property = property;
			this.value = value;
		}

		public override Expression Reduce()
		{
			return Expression.Call(SetPropertyMethodInfo, message, Expression.Constant(property.Scope), Expression.Constant(property.Name), value);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "SET {0} = ({1})", property, value);
		}

		private static object SetPropertyMethod(BrokeredMessage message, PropertyScope scope, string name, object value)
		{
			if (value is DBNull)
			{
				value = null;
			}
			return scope switch
			{
				PropertyScope.System => SetSystemProperty(message, name, value), 
				PropertyScope.User => SetUserProperty(message, name, value), 
				_ => throw new ArgumentException(SRClient.FilterScopeNotSupported(scope), "scope"), 
			};
		}

		private static object SetUserProperty(BrokeredMessage message, string propertyName, object value)
		{
			Type type = null;
			if (message.Properties.TryGetValue(propertyName, out var obj) && obj != null)
			{
				type = obj.GetType();
			}
			object result = ((type == null) ? value : ImplicitConvert(value, type));
			message.BrokerUpdateProperty(propertyName, result);
			return result;
		}

		private static object SetSystemProperty(BrokeredMessage message, string propertyName, object value)
		{
			Type propertyType = SystemPropertyAccessor.GetPropertyType(propertyName);
			object result = ((value == null || !(value.GetType() != propertyType)) ? value : ImplicitConvert(value, propertyType));
			SystemPropertyAccessor.SetProperty(message, propertyName, result);
			return result;
		}

		private static object ImplicitConvert(object value, Type conversionType)
		{
			if (conversionType == typeof(Guid) && value is string)
			{
				return new Guid((string)value);
			}
			if (conversionType == typeof(Uri) && value is string)
			{
				return new Uri((string)value, UriKind.RelativeOrAbsolute);
			}
			if (conversionType == typeof(DateTimeOffset) && value is string)
			{
				return DateTimeOffset.Parse((string)value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			}
			if (conversionType == typeof(TimeSpan) && value is string)
			{
				return TimeSpan.Parse((string)value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			}
			if (conversionType == typeof(string) && (value is Guid || value is DateTimeOffset || value is TimeSpan || value is Uri))
			{
				return System.Convert.ToString(value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			}
			return System.Convert.ChangeType(value, conversionType, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class InExpression : Expression
	{
		private static readonly MethodInfo InMethodInfo = typeof(InExpression).GetMethod("InMethod", BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.NonPublic);

		public override ExpressionType NodeType => ExpressionType.Extension;

		public Expression Left { get; private set; }

		public IEnumerable<Expression> Right { get; private set; }

		public override Type Type => typeof(bool?);

		public override bool CanReduce => true;

		public InExpression(Expression operand, IEnumerable<Expression> elementList)
		{
			Left = operand;
			Right = elementList;
		}

		public override Expression Reduce()
		{
			Expression arg = Expression.ListInit(Expression.New(typeof(List<object>)), Right);
			return Expression.Call(InMethodInfo, Left, arg);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(Left.ToString() + " IN (");
			int num = 0;
			foreach (Expression item in Right)
			{
				if (num != 0)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(", ");
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(item);
				num++;
			}
			stringBuilder.Append(')');
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		private static bool? InMethod(object left, List<object> rightList)
		{
			if (left is DBNull)
			{
				return null;
			}
			foreach (object right in rightList)
			{
				dynamic val = right;
				if ((dynamic)left == val)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal sealed class LambdaExpressionRuleAction : RuleAction
	{
		private Action<BrokeredMessage> compiledExpression;

		private bool requiresPreprocessing;

		public Expression<Action<BrokeredMessage>> Expression { get; private set; }

		public override bool RequiresPreprocessing => requiresPreprocessing;

		public LambdaExpressionRuleAction(Expression<Action<BrokeredMessage>> expression)
			: this(expression, requiresPreprocessing: true)
		{
		}

		public LambdaExpressionRuleAction(Expression<Action<BrokeredMessage>> expression, bool requiresPreprocessing)
		{
			if (expression == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("expression");
			}
			Expression = expression;
			this.requiresPreprocessing = requiresPreprocessing;
		}

		public override void Validate()
		{
		}

		public override RuleAction Preprocess()
		{
			if (!RequiresPreprocessing)
			{
				return this;
			}
			return new LambdaExpressionRuleAction(Expression, requiresPreprocessing: false);
		}

		public override BrokeredMessage Execute(BrokeredMessage message)
		{
			if (compiledExpression == null)
			{
				compiledExpression = Expression.Compile();
			}
			try
			{
				compiledExpression(message);
				return message;
			}
			catch (RuleActionException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception ex2)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(ex2))
				{
					throw;
				}
				throw new RuleActionException(ex2.Message, ex2);
			}
		}

		internal override BrokeredMessage Execute(BrokeredMessage message, RuleExecutionContext context)
		{
			return Execute(message);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class LambdaExpressionFilter : Filter
	{
		private sealed class ExpressionValidator : ExpressionVisitor
		{
			private int nodeCount;

			private int currentDepth;

			public void Validate(Expression expression)
			{
				nodeCount = 0;
				currentDepth = 0;
				try
				{
					Visit(expression);
				}
				catch (FilterException ex)
				{
					throw ex;
				}
			}

			public override Expression Visit(Expression node)
			{
				nodeCount++;
				currentDepth++;
				if (currentDepth > 32)
				{
					throw new FilterException(SRClient.FilterExpressionTooComplex);
				}
				if (nodeCount > 1024)
				{
					throw new FilterException(SRClient.FilterExpressionTooComplex);
				}
				try
				{
					return base.Visit(node);
				}
				finally
				{
					currentDepth--;
				}
			}
		}

		private Func<BrokeredMessage, bool?> filterDelegate;

		public Expression<Func<BrokeredMessage, bool?>> Expression { get; private set; }

		public override bool RequiresPreprocessing => false;

		internal override FilterType FilterType => FilterType.SqlFilter;

		public LambdaExpressionFilter(Expression<Func<BrokeredMessage, bool?>> expression)
		{
			if (expression == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("expression");
			}
			Expression = expression;
		}

		public override void Validate()
		{
			Expression<Func<BrokeredMessage, bool?>> expression = Expression;
			ExpressionValidator expressionValidator = new ExpressionValidator();
			expressionValidator.Validate(expression);
		}

		public override Filter Preprocess()
		{
			return this;
		}

		public override bool Match(BrokeredMessage message)
		{
			if (message == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("message");
			}
			if (filterDelegate == null)
			{
				filterDelegate = Expression.Compile();
			}
			try
			{
				bool? flag = filterDelegate(message);
				return flag.HasValue && flag.Value;
			}
			catch (FilterException)
			{
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception ex2)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(ex2))
				{
					throw;
				}
				throw new FilterException(ex2.Message, ex2);
			}
		}
	}
	internal sealed class LikeExpression : Expression
	{
		private static readonly MethodInfo LikeMethodInfo = typeof(LikeExpression).GetMethod("LikeMethod", BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.NonPublic);

		public override bool CanReduce => true;

		public override Type Type => typeof(bool?);

		public override ExpressionType NodeType => ExpressionType.Extension;

		public Expression Expression { get; private set; }

		public Expression Pattern { get; private set; }

		public Expression Escape { get; private set; }

		public LikeExpression(Expression expression, Expression pattern, Expression escape)
		{
			if (expression == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNull("expression");
			}
			if (pattern == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNull("pattern");
			}
			Expression = expression;
			Pattern = pattern;
			Escape = escape;
		}

		public override Expression Reduce()
		{
			return Expression.Call(LikeMethodInfo, Expression, Pattern, Escape);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (Escape != null)
			{
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0} LIKE {1} ESCAPE {2}", Expression.ToString(), Pattern, Escape);
			}
			return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0} LIKE {1}", Expression.ToString(), Pattern);
		}

		private static bool? LikeMethod(object expression, object pattern, object escape)
		{
			if (expression is DBNull || pattern is DBNull || escape is DBNull)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string input = System.Convert.ToString(expression, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			string likePattern = System.Convert.ToString(pattern, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			string escapeString = System.Convert.ToString(escape, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			string pattern2 = CreateRegex(escapeString, likePattern);
			return Regex.IsMatch(input, pattern2);
		}

		private static string CreateRegex(string escapeString, string likePattern)
		{
			char c = ((!string.IsNullOrEmpty(escapeString)) ? escapeString[0] : '\0');
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.Append("^");
			bool flag = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < likePattern.Length; i++)
			{
				char c2 = likePattern[i];
				if (!flag && c2 == c)
				{
					flag = true;
					continue;
				}
				if (!flag && c2 == '%')
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(".*");
					continue;
				}
				if (!flag && c2 == '_')
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(".");
					continue;
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(Regex.Escape(c2.ToString()));
				flag = false;
			}
			stringBuilder.Append("$");
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
	}

		protected override string TerminalToString(int terminal)
		{
			Tokens tokens = (Tokens)terminal;
			if (tokens.ToString() != terminal.ToString())
			{
				tokens = (Tokens)terminal;
				return tokens.ToString();
			}
			return CharToString((char)terminal);
		}

			public static TextBuff NewTextBuff(Stream strm)
			{
				int num = strm.ReadByte();
				int num2 = strm.ReadByte();
				if (num == 254 && num2 == 255)
				{
					return new BigEndTextBuff(strm);
				}
				if (num == 255 && num2 == 254)
				{
					return new LittleEndTextBuff(strm);
				}
				int num3 = strm.ReadByte();
				if (num == 239 && num2 == 187 && num3 == 191)
				{
					return new TextBuff(strm);
				}
				strm.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
				return new TextBuff(strm);
			}

			protected TextBuff(Stream str)
			{
				bStrm = new BufferedStream(str);
			}

			public override int Read()
			{
				int num = bStrm.ReadByte();
				if (num < 127)
				{
					delta = ((num != -1) ? 1 : 0);
					return num;
				}
				if ((num & 0xE0) == 192)
				{
					delta = 2;
					int num2 = bStrm.ReadByte();
					if ((num2 & 0xC0) == 128)
					{
						return ((num & 0x1F) << 6) + (num2 & 0x3F);
					}
					throw BadUTF8();
				}
				if ((num & 0xF0) == 224)
				{
					delta = 3;
					int num2 = bStrm.ReadByte();
					int num3 = bStrm.ReadByte();
					if ((num2 & num3 & 0xC0) == 128)
					{
						return ((num & 0xF) << 12) + ((num2 & 0x3F) << 6) + (num3 & 0x3F);

			}
		}

		internal int YY_START
		{
			get
			{
				return CurrentSc;
			}
			set
			{
				CurrentSc = value;
			}
		}

		private static int GetMaxParseToken()
		{
			FieldInfo field = typeof(Tokens).GetField("maxParseToken");
			if (!(field == null))
			{
				return (int)field.GetValue(null);
			}
			return int.MaxValue;
		}

		public Scanner(string source)
		{
			SetSource(source, 0);
			Handler = new ErrorHandler();
			yylloc = new LexLocation();
		}

		public override void yyerror(string format, params object[] values)
		{
			if (handler != null)
			{
				string message = string.Format(format, values);
				handler.AddError(message, yytext, tokLin, tokCol, tokLen, 0);
			}
		}

		private void LoadYylloc()
		{
			yylloc = new LexLocation(tokLin, tokCol, tokLin, tokCol + tokLen);
		}
