		private int NextState(int qStat)
		{
			if (chr == -1)
			{
				if (qStat > 28 || qStat == currentStart)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return currentStart;
			}
			int num = Map(chr) - NxS[qStat].min;
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num += 26;
			}
			int num2 = (((uint)num < (uint)NxS[qStat].rng) ? NxS[qStat].nxt[num] : NxS[qStat].dflt);
			if (num2 != -1)
			{
				return num2;
			}
			return currentStart;
		}

		private int NextState()
		{
			if (chr == -1)
			{
				if (state > 28 || state == currentStart)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return currentStart;
			}
			int num = Map(chr) - NxS[state].min;
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num += 26;
			}
			int num2 = (((uint)num < (uint)NxS[state].rng) ? NxS[state].nxt[num] : NxS[state].dflt);
			if (num2 != -1)
			{
				return num2;
			}
			return currentStart;
		}

		public Scanner(Stream file)
		{
			buffer = TextBuff.NewTextBuff(file);
			cNum = -1;
			chr = 10;
			GetChr();
		}

		public Scanner()
		{
		}

		private void GetChr()
		{
			if (chr == 10)
			{
				lineStartNum = cNum + 1;
				lNum++;
			}
			chr = buffer.Read();
			cNum++;
		}

		private void MarkToken()
		{
			tokPos = buffer.ReadPos;
			tokNum = cNum;
			tokLin = lNum;
			tokCol = cNum - lineStartNum;
		}

		private void MarkEnd()
		{
			tokTxt = null;
			tokLen = cNum - tokNum;
			tokEPos = buffer.ReadPos;
			tokELin = lNum;
			tokECol = cNum - lineStartNum;
		}

		public void SetSource(string source, int offset)
		{
			buffer = new StringBuff(source);
			buffer.Pos = offset;
			cNum = offset - 1;
			chr = 10;
			GetChr();
		}

		public int GetNext(ref int state, out int start, out int end)
		{
			EolState = state;
			Tokens result = (Tokens)Scan();
			state = EolState;
			start = tokPos;
			end = tokEPos - 1;
			return (int)result;
		}

		public override int yylex()
		{
			int num;
			do
			{
				num = Scan();
			}
			while (num >= parserMax);
			return num;
		}

		private void yyless(int n)
		{
			buffer.Pos = tokPos;
			cNum = tokNum;
			for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++)
			{
				GetChr();
			}
			MarkEnd();
		}

		private int Scan()
		{
			try
			{
				while (true)
				{
					bool flag = false;
					Result result = Result.noMatch;
					state = currentStart;
					while (NextState() == state)
					{
						GetChr();
					}
					MarkToken();
					int num;
					while ((num = NextState()) != currentStart)
					{
						if (flag && num > 28)
						{
							Context ctx = new Context();
							result = Recurse2(ctx, num);
							if (result == Result.noMatch)
							{
								RestoreStateAndPos(ctx);
							}
							break;
						}
						state = num;
						GetChr();
						if (state <= 28)
						{
							flag = true;
						}
					}
					if (state > 28)
					{
						state = currentStart;
						continue;
					}
					MarkEnd();
					switch (state)
					{
					case 0:
						switch (currentStart)
						{
						case 33:
							yyerror(SRClient.StringLiteralNotTerminated(builder.ToString()));
							return 48;
						case 34:
							yyerror(SRClient.DelimitedIdentifierNotTerminated(builder.ToString()));
							return 48;
						case 35:
							yyerror(SRClient.DelimitedIdentifierNotTerminated(builder.ToString()));
							return 48;
						default:
							return 49;
						}
					case 1:
					case 4:
					case 8:
						yyerror("Unrecognized character. '{0}'", yytext);
						return 48;
					case 3:
					{
						if (Keywords.TryGetValue(yytext, out var value))
						{
							if (value == Tokens.RESERVED)
							{
								yyerror(SRClient.SqlFilterReservedKeyword(yytext));
							}
							return (int)value;
						}
						yylval.value = yytext;
						return 50;
					}
					case 5:
						yylval.value = yytext;
						return 53;
					case 6:
						return yytext[0];
					case 7:
						return 67;
					case 9:
						return 69;
					case 10:
						return 71;
					case 11:
						yy_push_state(2);
						builder.Clear();
						break;
					case 12:
						yy_push_state(3);
						builder.Clear();
						break;
					case 13:
						yy_push_state(1);
						builder.Clear();
						break;
					case 14:
						return 72;
					case 15:
						return 70;
					case 16:
						return 68;
					case 17:
						yylval.value = yytext;
						return 55;
					case 18:
						yylval.value = yytext;
						return 55;
					case 19:
						yylval.value = yytext;
						return 52;
					case 20:
						builder.Append(yytext);
						break;
					case 21:
						yy_pop_state();
						yylval.value = builder.ToString();
						return 56;
					case 22:
						builder.Append("'");
						break;
					case 23:
						builder.Append(yytext);
						break;
					case 24:
						yy_pop_state();
						yylval.value = builder.ToString();
						return 51;
					case 25:
						builder.Append("\"");
						break;
					case 26:
						yy_pop_state();
						yylval.value = builder.ToString();
						return 51;
					case 27:
						builder.Append(yytext);
						break;
					case 28:
						builder.Append("]");
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				LoadYylloc();
			}
		}

		private Result Recurse2(Context ctx, int next)
		{
			SaveStateAndPos(ctx);
			state = next;
			if (state == 0)
			{
				return Result.accept;
			}
			GetChr();
			bool flag = false;
			while ((next = NextState()) != currentStart)
			{
				if (flag && next > 28)
				{
					SaveStateAndPos(ctx);
				}
				state = next;
				if (state == 0)
				{
					return Result.accept;
				}
				GetChr();
				flag = state <= 28;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				return Result.accept;
			}
			return Result.noMatch;
		}

		private void SaveStateAndPos(Context ctx)
		{
			ctx.bPos = buffer.Pos;
			ctx.cNum = cNum;
			ctx.state = state;
			ctx.cChr = chr;
		}

		private void RestoreStateAndPos(Context ctx)
		{
			buffer.Pos = ctx.bPos;
			cNum = ctx.cNum;
			state = ctx.state;
			chr = ctx.cChr;
		}

		private void RestorePos(Context ctx)
		{
			buffer.Pos = ctx.bPos;
			cNum = ctx.cNum;
		}

		internal void BEGIN(int next)
		{
			CurrentSc = next;
		}

		internal void yy_clear_stack()
		{
			scStack.Clear();
		}

		internal int yy_top_state()
		{
			return scStack.Peek();
		}

		internal void yy_push_state(int state)
		{
			scStack.Push(CurrentSc);
			CurrentSc = state;
		}

		internal void yy_pop_state()
		{
			if (scStack.Count > 0)
			{
				int currentSc = scStack.Pop();
				CurrentSc = currentSc;
			}
		}

		internal void ECHO()
		{
			Console.Out.Write(yytext);
		}
	}

		}

	internal sealed class ErrorHandler : IErrorHandler
	{
		public void AddError(string message, string token, int line, int column, int length, int severity)
		{
			string message2 = (string.IsNullOrEmpty(message) ? SRClient.SQLSyntaxError(line, column, token) : SRClient.SQLSyntaxErrorDetailed(line, column, token, message));
			throw new RuleActionException(message2);
		}
	}
	internal class SqlActionParser : ShiftReduceParser<LexValue, LexLocation>
	{
		private readonly ParameterExpression messageParameter;

		private readonly ParameterExpression parametersParameter;

		private readonly HashSet<string> requiredParameters;

		private Expression<Action<BrokeredMessage, IDictionary<string, object>>> expressionTree;

		private IList<Expression> expressionList;

		public Expression<Action<BrokeredMessage, IDictionary<string, object>>> ExpressionTree
		{
			get
			{
				if (expressionTree == null)
				{
					expressionTree = Expression.Lambda<Action<BrokeredMessage, IDictionary<string, object>>>(Expression.Block(expressionList), new ParameterExpression[2] { messageParameter, parametersParameter });
				}
				return expressionTree;
			}
		}

		public SqlActionParser()
		{
			messageParameter = Expression.Parameter(Constants.MessageType, "@message");
			parametersParameter = Expression.Parameter(typeof(IDictionary<string, object>), "@parameters");
			expressionList = new List<Expression>();
			requiredParameters = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
		}

		public static SqlActionParserOutput Parse(string sqlExpression)
		{
			SqlActionParser sqlActionParser = ParseAndValidate(sqlExpression);
			return new SqlActionParserOutput(sqlActionParser.ExpressionTree, sqlActionParser.requiredParameters);
		}

		public static void Validate(string sqlExpression)
		{
			ParseAndValidate(sqlExpression);
		}

		private static SqlActionParser ParseAndValidate(string sqlExpression)
		{
			SqlActionParser sqlActionParser = new SqlActionParser();
			sqlActionParser.scanner = new Scanner(sqlExpression);
			sqlActionParser.Parse();
			if (sqlActionParser.expressionList.Count > 32)
			{
				throw new RuleActionException(SRClient.FilterActionTooManyStatements(sqlActionParser.expressionList.Count, 32));
			}
			return sqlActionParser;
		}

		protected override void DoAction(int action)
		{
			switch (action)
			{
			case 2:
				expressionList = value_stack.array[value_stack.top - 1].expressions;
				break;
			case 3:
			{
				List<Expression> list2 = new List<Expression>();
				list2.Add(value_stack.array[value_stack.top - 1].expression);
				yyval.expressions = list2;
				break;
			}
			case 4:

				List<Expression> expressions = value_stack.array[value_stack.top - 2].expressions;

				yyval.expressions = expressions;
				break;

				break;

				break;

				DelayExpression delay16 = value_stack.array[value_stack.top - 1].delay;

				break;
			}
			case 11:

				QualifiedPropertyName qname2 = value_stack.array[value_stack.top - 1].qname;

				yyval.delay = value_stack.array[value_stack.top - 1].delay;

		protected override string TerminalToString(int terminal)
		{
			Tokens tokens = (Tokens)terminal;
			if (tokens.ToString() != terminal.ToString())
			{

		}

			public static TextBuff NewTextBuff(Stream strm)
			{
				int num = strm.ReadByte();
				int num2 = strm.ReadByte();
				if (num == 254 && num2 == 255)
				{
					return new BigEndTextBuff(strm);
				}
				if (num == 255 && num2 == 254)
				{
					return new LittleEndTextBuff(strm);
				}
				int num3 = strm.ReadByte();
				if (num == 239 && num2 == 187 && num3 == 191)
				{
					return new TextBuff(strm);
				}
				strm.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
				return new TextBuff(strm);
			}

			protected TextBuff(Stream str)
			{
				bStrm = new BufferedStream(str);
			}

			public override int Read()
			{
				int num = bStrm.ReadByte();
				if (num < 127)
				{
					delta = ((num != -1) ? 1 : 0);
					return num;
				}
				if ((num & 0xE0) == 192)
				{
					delta = 2;
					int num2 = bStrm.ReadByte();
					if ((num2 & 0xC0) == 128)
					{
						return ((num & 0x1F) << 6) + (num2 & 0x3F);
					}
					throw BadUTF8();
				}
				if ((num & 0xF0) == 224)
				{
					delta = 3;
					int num2 = bStrm.ReadByte();
					int num3 = bStrm.ReadByte();
					if ((num2 & num3 & 0xC0) == 128)
					{
						return ((num & 0xF) << 12) + ((num2 & 0x3F) << 6) + (num3 & 0x3F);
					}
					throw BadUTF8();
				}
				throw BadUTF8();
			}

			public sealed override int Peek()
			{

				return result;

			{

					return "";
				}

				char[] array = new char[end - beg];
				bStrm.Position = beg;
				int num = 0;
				while (bStrm.Position < end)
				{
					array[num] = (char)Read();
					num++;
				}
				bStrm.Position = position;
				return new string(array, 0, num);
			}

		private int NextState(int qStat)
		{
			if (chr == -1)
			{
				if (qStat > 21 || qStat == currentStart)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return currentStart;
			}
			int num = Map(chr) - NxS[qStat].min;
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num += 23;
			}
			int num2 = (((uint)num < (uint)NxS[qStat].rng) ? NxS[qStat].nxt[num] : NxS[qStat].dflt);
			if (num2 != -1)
			{
				return num2;
			}
			return currentStart;
		}

		private int NextState()
		{
			if (chr == -1)
			{
				if (state > 21 || state == currentStart)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return currentStart;
			}
			int num = Map(chr) - NxS[state].min;
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num += 23;
			}
			int num2 = (((uint)num < (uint)NxS[state].rng) ? NxS[state].nxt[num] : NxS[state].dflt);
			if (num2 != -1)
			{
				return num2;
			}
			return currentStart;
		}

		public Scanner(Stream file)
		{
			buffer = TextBuff.NewTextBuff(file);
			cNum = -1;
			chr = 10;
			GetChr();
		}

		public Scanner()
		{
		}

		private void GetChr()
		{
			if (chr == 10)
			{
				lineStartNum = cNum + 1;
				lNum++;
			}
			chr = buffer.Read();
			cNum++;
		}

		private void MarkToken()
		{
			tokPos = buffer.ReadPos;
			tokNum = cNum;
			tokLin = lNum;
			tokCol = cNum - lineStartNum;
		}

		private void MarkEnd()
		{
			tokTxt = null;
			tokLen = cNum - tokNum;
			tokEPos = buffer.ReadPos;
			tokELin = lNum;
			tokECol = cNum - lineStartNum;
		}

		public void SetSource(string source, int offset)
		{
			buffer = new StringBuff(source);
			buffer.Pos = offset;
			cNum = offset - 1;
			chr = 10;
			GetChr();
		}

		public int GetNext(ref int state, out int start, out int end)
		{
			EolState = state;
			Tokens result = (Tokens)Scan();
			state = EolState;
			start = tokPos;
			end = tokEPos - 1;
			return (int)result;
		}

		public override int yylex()
		{
			int num;
			do
			{
				num = Scan();
			}
			while (num >= parserMax);
			return num;
		}

		private void yyless(int n)
		{
			buffer.Pos = tokPos;
			cNum = tokNum;
			for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++)
			{
				GetChr();
			}
			MarkEnd();
		}

		private int Scan()
		{
			try
			{
				while (true)
				{
					bool flag = false;
					Result result = Result.noMatch;
					state = currentStart;
					while (NextState() == state)
					{
						GetChr();
					}
					MarkToken();
					int num;
					while ((num = NextState()) != currentStart)
					{
						if (flag && num > 21)
						{
							Context ctx = new Context();
							result = Recurse2(ctx, num);
							if (result == Result.noMatch)
							{
								RestoreStateAndPos(ctx);
							}
							break;
						}
						state = num;
						GetChr();
						if (state <= 21)
						{
							flag = true;
						}
					}
					if (state > 21)
					{
						state = currentStart;
						continue;
					}
					MarkEnd();
					switch (state)
					{
					case 0:
						switch (currentStart)
						{
						case 26:
							yyerror(SRClient.StringLiteralNotTerminated(builder.ToString()));
							return 62;
						case 27:
							yyerror(SRClient.DelimitedIdentifierNotTerminated(builder.ToString()));
							return 62;
						case 28:
							yyerror(SRClient.DelimitedIdentifierNotTerminated(builder.ToString()));
							return 62;
						default:
							return 63;
						}
					case 1:
					case 4:
						yyerror("Unrecognized character. '{0}'", yytext);
						return 62;
					case 3:
					{
						yylval.value = yytext;
						if (Keywords.TryGetValue(yytext, out var value))
						{
							if (value == Tokens.RESERVED)
							{
								yyerror(SRClient.SqlFilterReservedKeyword(yytext));
							}
							return (int)value;
						}
						return 64;
					}
					case 5:
						yylval.value = yytext;
						return 67;
					case 6:
						return yytext[0];
					case 7:
						yy_push_state(2);
						builder.Clear();
						break;
					case 8:
						yy_push_state(3);
						builder.Clear();
						break;
					case 9:
						yy_push_state(1);
						builder.Clear();
						break;
					case 10:
						yylval.value = yytext;
						return 69;
					case 11:
						yylval.value = yytext;
						return 69;
					case 12:
						yylval.value = yytext;
						return 66;
					case 13:
						builder.Append(yytext);
						break;
					case 14:
						yy_pop_state();
						yylval.value = builder.ToString();
						return 70;
					case 15:
						builder.Append("'");
						break;
					case 16:
						builder.Append(yytext);
						break;
					case 17:
						yy_pop_state();
						yylval.value = builder.ToString();
						return 65;
					case 18:
						builder.Append("\"");
						break;
					case 19:
						yy_pop_state();
						yylval.value = builder.ToString();
						return 65;
					case 20:
						builder.Append(yytext);
						break;
					case 21:
						builder.Append("]");
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				LoadYylloc();
			}
		}

		private Result Recurse2(Context ctx, int next)
		{
			SaveStateAndPos(ctx);
			state = next;
			if (state == 0)
			{
				return Result.accept;
			}
			GetChr();
			bool flag = false;
			while ((next = NextState()) != currentStart)
			{
				if (flag && next > 21)
				{
					SaveStateAndPos(ctx);
				}
				state = next;
				if (state == 0)
				{
					return Result.accept;
				}
				GetChr();
				flag = state <= 21;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				return Result.accept;
			}
			return Result.noMatch;
		}

		private void SaveStateAndPos(Context ctx)
		{
			ctx.bPos = buffer.Pos;
			ctx.cNum = cNum;
			ctx.state = state;
			ctx.cChr = chr;
		}

		private void RestoreStateAndPos(Context ctx)
		{
			buffer.Pos = ctx.bPos;
			cNum = ctx.cNum;
			state = ctx.state;
			chr = ctx.cChr;
		}

		private void RestorePos(Context ctx)
		{
			buffer.Pos = ctx.bPos;
			cNum = ctx.cNum;
		}

		internal void BEGIN(int next)
		{
			CurrentSc = next;
		}

		internal void yy_clear_stack()
		{
			scStack.Clear();
		}

		internal int yy_top_state()
		{
			return scStack.Peek();
		}

		internal void yy_push_state(int state)
		{
			scStack.Push(CurrentSc);
			CurrentSc = state;
		}

		internal void yy_pop_state()
		{
			if (scStack.Count > 0)
			{
				int currentSc = scStack.Pop();
				CurrentSc = currentSc;
			}
		}

		internal void ECHO()
		{
			Console.Out.Write(yytext);
		}
	}
}
namespace Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Configuration
{
	internal class KeyValueConfigurationManager
	{
		internal sealed class ReadonlyNameValueCollectionComparer : IEqualityComparer<ReadonlyNameValueCollection>
		{
			public bool Equals(ReadonlyNameValueCollection x, ReadonlyNameValueCollection y)
			{
				if (x == y)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (x == null || y == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				string[] array = ((x.Count == y.Count) ? x.AllKeys : x.AllKeys.Union(y.AllKeys).ToArray());
				string[] array2 = array;
				foreach (string name in array2)
				{
					if (!string.Equals(x[name], y[name], StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}

			public int GetHashCode(ReadonlyNameValueCollection obj)
			{
				int num = 0;
				for (int i = 0; i < obj.Count; i++)
				{
					if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(obj[i]))
					{
						num ^= obj[i].GetHashCode();
					}
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		private class CleanupCachedFactoriesAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<CleanupCachedFactoriesAsyncResult>
		{
			public CleanupCachedFactoriesAsyncResult(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				if (CachedFactories.IsValueCreated)
				{
					yield return CallAsyncSleep(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5.0));
					if (CachedFactories.IsValueCreated)
					{
						lock (CachedFactories.Value)
						{
							List<ReadonlyNameValueCollection> list = new List<ReadonlyNameValueCollection>();
							foreach (ReadonlyNameValueCollection key in CachedFactories.Value.Keys)
							{
								MessagingFactory messagingFactory = CachedFactories.Value[key];
								if (messagingFactory.ClientEntityManager.IsEmpty)
								{
									list.Add(key);
									messagingFactory.Abort();
								}
							}
							foreach (ReadonlyNameValueCollection item in list)
							{
								CachedFactories.Value.Remove(item);
							}
						}
					}
				}
				Interlocked.Exchange(ref cachedFactoryCleanupStarted, 0);
			}
		}

		public static IList<Uri> GetEndpointAddresses(string uriEndpoints, string hostNames, string portString)
		{
			List<Uri> list = new List<Uri>();
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(uriEndpoints) && string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(hostNames))
			{
				return list;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			string[] array;
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(uriEndpoints))
			{
				array = uriEndpoints.Split(new string[1] { "," }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
				if (array.Length == 0)
				{
					return list;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				flag = true;
				array = hostNames.Split(new string[1] { "," }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
				if (array.Length == 0)
				{
					return list;
				}
			}
			if (!int.TryParse(portString, out var result))
			{
				result = -1;
			}
			string[] array2 = array;
			foreach (string uri in array2)
			{
				UriBuilder uriBuilder = new UriBuilder(uri);
				if (result > 0)
				{
					uriBuilder.Port = result;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					uriBuilder.Scheme = "sb";
				}
				list.Add(uriBuilder.Uri);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static NameValueCollection CreateNameValueCollectionFromConnectionString(string connectionString)
		{
			NameValueCollection nameValueCollection = new NameValueCollection();
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(connectionString))
			{
				string input = ";" + connectionString;
				string[] array = Regex.Split(input, ";(OperationTimeout|Endpoint|EntityPath|Publisher|RuntimePort|ManagementPort|StsEndpoint|ViaEndpoint|WindowsDomain|WindowsUsername|WindowsPassword|OAuthDomain|OAuthUsername|OAuthPassword|SharedSecretIssuer|SharedSecretValue|SharedAccessKeyName|SharedAccessKey|SharedAccessSignature|TransportType|EnableAmqpLinkRedirect|AmqpSecurityScheme|Authentication|Audience|HostName)=", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);
				if (array.Length != 0)
				{
					if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(array[0]))
					{
						throw new ConfigurationErrorsException(SRClient.ConnectionStringInvalidFormat);
					}
					if (array.Length % 2 != 1)
					{
						throw new ConfigurationErrorsException(SRClient.ConnectionStringInvalidFormat);
					}
					int num;
					for (num = 1; num < array.Length; num++)
					{
						string text = array[num];
						if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text) || !KeyRegex.IsMatch(text))
						{
							if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
							{
								text = "NullKeyName";
							}
							throw new ConfigurationErrorsException(SRClient.AppSettingsConfigSettingInvalidKey(text));
						}
						string text2 = array[num + 1];
						if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text2) || !ValueRegex.IsMatch(text2))
						{
							throw new ConfigurationErrorsException(SRClient.AppSettingsConfigSettingInvalidValue(text));
						}
						if (nameValueCollection[text] != null)
						{
							throw new ConfigurationErrorsException(SRClient.AppSettingsConfigDuplicateSetting(text));
						}
						nameValueCollection[text] = text2;
						num++;
					}
				}
			}
			return nameValueCollection;
		}

		private unsafe SecureString GetSecurePassword(string configName)
		{
			SecureString result = null;
			string text = connectionProperties[configName];
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
			{
				char[] array = text.ToCharArray();
				fixed (char* value = array)
				{
					result = new SecureString(value, array.Length);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private MessagingFactory GetOrUpdateFactory(IEnumerable<Uri> endpoints, IEnumerable<Uri> stsEndpoints, IEnumerable<Uri> viaEndpoints, string operationTimeout, string issuerName, string issuerKey, string sasKeyName, string sasKey, string sasToken, string windowsDomain, string windowsUser, SecureString windowsPassword, string oauthDomain, string oauthUser, SecureString oauthPassword, string transportType, string enableAmqpLinkRedirect, string amqpSecurityScheme, string aadManagedIdentity, string aadAudience)
		{
			lock (CachedFactories.Value)
			{
				if (CachedFactories.Value.ContainsKey(connectionProperties))
				{
					MessagingFactory messagingFactory = CachedFactories.Value[connectionProperties];
					if (!messagingFactory.IsClosedOrClosing)
					{
						return messagingFactory;
					}
				}
				MessagingFactory messagingFactory2 = CreateFactory(endpoints, stsEndpoints, viaEndpoints, operationTimeout, issuerName, issuerKey, sasKeyName, sasKey, sasToken, windowsDomain, windowsUser, windowsPassword, oauthDomain, oauthUser, oauthPassword, transportType, enableAmqpLinkRedirect, amqpSecurityScheme, aadManagedIdentity, aadAudience);
				messagingFactory2.RegisterForCachedFactoriesCleanup();
				CachedFactories.Value[connectionProperties] = messagingFactory2;
				return messagingFactory2;
			}
		}

		private MessagingFactory CreateFactory(IEnumerable<Uri> endpoints, IEnumerable<Uri> stsEndpoints, IEnumerable<Uri> viaEndpoints, string operationTimeout, string issuerName, string issuerKey, string sasKeyName, string sasKey, string sasToken, string windowsDomain, string windowsUser, SecureString windowsPassword, string oauthDomain, string oauthUser, SecureString oauthPassword, string transportType, string enableAmqpLinkRedirect, string amqpSecurityScheme, string aadManagedIdentity, string aadAudience)
		{
			try
			{
				MessagingFactorySettings messagingFactorySettings = new MessagingFactorySettings();
				if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(transportType))
				{
					messagingFactorySettings.TransportType = (TransportType)Enum.Parse(typeof(TransportType), transportType);
				}
				if (viaEndpoints != null && messagingFactorySettings.TransportType == TransportType.NetMessaging)
				{
					messagingFactorySettings.NetMessagingTransportSettings.Via = viaEndpoints.FirstOrDefault();
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(enableAmqpLinkRedirect) && messagingFactorySettings.TransportType == TransportType.Amqp)
				{
					bool enableLinkRedirect = bool.Parse(enableAmqpLinkRedirect);
					messagingFactorySettings.AmqpTransportSettings.EnableLinkRedirect = enableLinkRedirect;
				}
				bool flag = endpoints?.FirstOrDefault().IsIoTDeviceUri() ?? false;
				AmqpSecurityScheme amqpSecurityScheme2 = AmqpSecurityScheme.Cbs;
				if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(amqpSecurityScheme) && messagingFactorySettings.TransportType == TransportType.Amqp)
				{
					amqpSecurityScheme2 = (AmqpSecurityScheme)Enum.Parse(typeof(AmqpSecurityScheme), amqpSecurityScheme, ignoreCase: true);
				}
				messagingFactorySettings.TokenProvider = CreateTokenProvider(stsEndpoints, issuerName, issuerKey, sasKeyName, sasKey, sasToken, windowsDomain, windowsUser, windowsPassword, oauthDomain, oauthUser, oauthPassword, flag, aadManagedIdentity, aadAudience);
				if (amqpSecurityScheme2 == AmqpSecurityScheme.SaslPlain)
				{
					string unsecureString = sasKey;
					string userName = sasKeyName;
					Uri uri = endpoints.FirstOrDefault();
					Func<string, byte[]> keyEncoder = Constants.MessagingTokenProviderKeyEncoder;
					if (flag)
					{
						string ioTHubName = uri.GetIoTHubName();
						userName = $"{sasKeyName}@sas.root.{ioTHubName}";
						keyEncoder = Constants.IoTTokenProviderKeyEncoder;
					}
					if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(sasKey))
					{
						unsecureString = SharedAccessSignatureTokenProvider.SharedAccessSignatureBuilder.BuildSignature(sasKeyName, sasKey, keyEncoder, uri.Host, TimeSpan.FromHours(2.0));
					}
					messagingFactorySettings.AmqpTransportSettings.NetworkCredential = new NetworkCredential(userName, unsecureString.ToSecureString());
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(operationTimeout))
				{
					messagingFactorySettings.OperationTimeout = TimeSpan.Parse(operationTimeout, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
				}
				return MessagingFactory.Create(endpoints, messagingFactorySettings);
			}
			catch (ArgumentException ex)
			{
				throw new ConfigurationErrorsException(SRClient.AppSettingsCreateFactoryWithInvalidConnectionString(ex.Message), ex);
			}
			catch (UriFormatException ex2)
			{
				throw new ConfigurationErrorsException(SRClient.AppSettingsCreateFactoryWithInvalidConnectionString(ex2.Message), ex2);
			}
		}

		internal TokenProvider CreateTokenProvider()
		{
			IEnumerable<Uri> endpointAddresses = GetEndpointAddresses(connectionProperties["Endpoint"], connectionProperties["ManagementPort"]);
			IEnumerable<Uri> endpointAddresses2 = GetEndpointAddresses(connectionProperties["StsEndpoint"], null);
			string issuerName = connectionProperties["SharedSecretIssuer"];
			string issuerKey = connectionProperties["SharedSecretValue"];
			string sharedAccessKeyName = connectionProperties["SharedAccessKeyName"];
			string sharedAccessKey = connectionProperties["SharedAccessKey"];
			string sharedAccessToken = connectionProperties["SharedAccessSignature"];
			string windowsDomain = connectionProperties["WindowsDomain"];
			string windowsUser = connectionProperties["WindowsUsername"];
			SecureString windowsPassword = GetWindowsPassword();
			string oauthDomain = connectionProperties["OAuthDomain"];
			string oauthUser = connectionProperties["OAuthUsername"];
			string aadManagedIdentity = connectionProperties["Authentication"];
			string aadAudience = connectionProperties["Audience"];
			SecureString oAuthPassword = GetOAuthPassword();
			bool isIoTDeviceUri = endpointAddresses?.FirstOrDefault().IsIoTDeviceUri() ?? false;
			return CreateTokenProvider(endpointAddresses2, issuerName, issuerKey, sharedAccessKeyName, sharedAccessKey, sharedAccessToken, windowsDomain, windowsUser, windowsPassword, oauthDomain, oauthUser, oAuthPassword, isIoTDeviceUri, aadManagedIdentity, aadAudience);
		}

		private static TokenProvider CreateTokenProvider(IEnumerable<Uri> stsEndpoints, string issuerName, string issuerKey, string sharedAccessKeyName, string sharedAccessKey, string sharedAccessToken, string windowsDomain, string windowsUser, SecureString windowsPassword, string oauthDomain, string oauthUser, SecureString oauthPassword, bool isIoTDeviceUri, string aadManagedIdentity, string aadAudience)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(sharedAccessKey))
			{
				if (isIoTDeviceUri)
				{
					return TokenProvider.CreateIoTTokenProvider(sharedAccessKeyName, sharedAccessKey);
				}
				return TokenProvider.CreateSharedAccessSignatureTokenProvider(sharedAccessKeyName, sharedAccessKey);
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(sharedAccessToken))
			{
				return TokenProvider.CreateSharedAccessSignatureTokenProvider(sharedAccessToken);
			}
			if (string.Equals(aadManagedIdentity, "Managed Identity", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
			{
				return TokenProvider.CreateManagedIdentityTokenProvider(new Uri(aadAudience));
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(issuerName))
			{
				bool flag = stsEndpoints?.Any() ?? false;
				bool flag2 = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(windowsUser) && windowsPassword != null && windowsPassword.Length > 0;
				bool flag3 = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(oauthUser) && oauthPassword != null && oauthPassword.Length > 0;
				if (!flag)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (flag3)
				{
					NetworkCredential credential = (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(oauthDomain) ? new NetworkCredential(oauthUser, oauthPassword) : new NetworkCredential(oauthUser, oauthPassword, oauthDomain));
					return TokenProvider.CreateOAuthTokenProvider(stsEndpoints, credential);
				}
				if (flag2)
				{
					NetworkCredential credential2 = (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(windowsDomain) ? new NetworkCredential(windowsUser, windowsPassword) : new NetworkCredential(windowsUser, windowsPassword, windowsDomain));
					return TokenProvider.CreateWindowsTokenProvider(stsEndpoints, credential2);
				}
				return TokenProvider.CreateWindowsTokenProvider(stsEndpoints);
			}
			if (stsEndpoints != null && stsEndpoints.Any())
			{
				return TokenProvider.CreateSharedSecretTokenProvider(issuerName, issuerKey, stsEndpoints.First());
			}
			return TokenProvider.CreateSharedSecretTokenProvider(issuerName, issuerKey);
		}

		public void Validate()
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(connectionProperties["Endpoint"]) && string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(connectionProperties["HostName"]))
			{
				string param = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}/{1}", "Endpoint", "HostName");
				throw new ConfigurationErrorsException(SRClient.AppSettingsConfigMissingSetting(param, "Microsoft.ServiceBus.ConnectionString"));
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(connectionProperties["Publisher"]) && string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(connectionProperties["EntityPath"]))
			{
				throw new ConfigurationErrorsException(SRClient.SpecifyPublisherIdOnlyWithEntityPath);
			}
			bool flag = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(connectionProperties["SharedSecretIssuer"]);
			bool flag2 = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(connectionProperties["SharedSecretValue"]);
			if (flag && !flag2)
			{
				throw new ConfigurationErrorsException(SRClient.AppSettingsConfigMissingSetting("SharedSecretValue", "Microsoft.ServiceBus.ConnectionString"));
			}
			if (!flag && flag2)
			{
				throw new ConfigurationErrorsException(SRClient.AppSettingsConfigMissingSetting("SharedSecretIssuer", "Microsoft.ServiceBus.ConnectionString"));
			}
			bool flag3 = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(connectionProperties["SharedAccessKeyName"]);
			bool flag4 = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(connectionProperties["SharedAccessKey"]);
			bool flag5 = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(connectionProperties["SharedAccessSignature"]);
			if (flag5)
			{
				if (flag3)
				{
					throw new ConfigurationErrorsException(SRClient.AppSettingsConfigInvalidCombination("SharedAccessSignature", "SharedAccessKeyName"));
				}
				if (flag4)
				{
					throw new ConfigurationErrorsException(SRClient.AppSettingsConfigInvalidCombination("SharedAccessSignature", "SharedAccessKey"));
				}
			}
			if (!(flag3 && flag4) && (flag3 || flag4))
			{
				string param2 = string.Format(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, "{0},{1}", "SharedAccessKeyName", "SharedAccessKey");
				throw new ConfigurationErrorsException(SRClient.AppSettingsConfigIncompleteSettingCombination("Microsoft.ServiceBus.ConnectionString", param2));
			}
			bool flag6 = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(connectionProperties["WindowsUsername"]);
			bool flag7 = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(connectionProperties["WindowsPassword"]);
			if (!(flag6 && flag7) && (flag6 || flag7))
			{
				string param3 = string.Format(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, "{0},{1}", "WindowsUsername", "WindowsPassword");
				throw new ConfigurationErrorsException(SRClient.AppSettingsConfigIncompleteSettingCombination("Microsoft.ServiceBus.ConnectionString", param3));
			}
			bool flag8 = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(connectionProperties["OAuthUsername"]);
			bool flag9 = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(connectionProperties["OAuthPassword"]);
			if (!(flag8 && flag9) && (flag8 || flag9))
			{
				string param4 = string.Format(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, "{0},{1}", "OAuthUsername", "OAuthPassword");
				throw new ConfigurationErrorsException(SRClient.AppSettingsConfigIncompleteSettingCombination("Microsoft.ServiceBus.ConnectionString", param4));
			}
			string text = connectionProperties["OperationTimeout"];
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text) && !TimeSpan.TryParse(text, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, out var _))
			{
				throw new ConfigurationErrorsException(SRClient.AppSettingsConfigSettingInvalidValueSafe("OperationTimeout", text));
			}
			string text2 = connectionProperties["RuntimePort"];
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text2) && !int.TryParse(text2, out var _))
			{
				throw new ConfigurationErrorsException(SRClient.AppSettingsConfigSettingInvalidValueSafe("RuntimePort", text2));
			}
			string text3 = connectionProperties["ManagementPort"];
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text3) && !int.TryParse(text3, out var _))
			{
				throw new ConfigurationErrorsException(SRClient.AppSettingsConfigSettingInvalidValueSafe("ManagementPort", text3));
			}
			string text4 = connectionProperties["EnableAmqpLinkRedirect"];
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text4) && !bool.TryParse(text4, out var _))
			{
				throw new ConfigurationErrorsException(SRClient.AppSettingsConfigSettingInvalidValueSafe("EnableAmqpLinkRedirect", text4));
			}
			string text5 = connectionProperties["AmqpSecurityScheme"];
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text5) && !Enum.TryParse<AmqpSecurityScheme>(text5, ignoreCase: true, out var _))
			{

			base.OnCompleting = (Action<Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult, Exception>)Delegate.Combine(base.OnCompleting, onFinally);
		}

		private System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message CreateOrGetRequestMessage()
		{
			if (messageBuffer == null)
			{
				RequestInfo requestInfo = new RequestInfo
				{
					ServerTimeout = factory.OperationTimeout
				};
				System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message = messageCreator.CreateWcfMessage("http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2011/06/servicebus/SbmpGetRuntimeEntityDescription/GetRuntimeEntityDescription", null, null, RetryPolicy.NoRetry, trackingContext, requestInfo);
				messageBuffer = message.CreateBufferedCopy(65536);
			}
			return messageBuffer.CreateMessage();
		}

		protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
		{
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteGetRuntimeEntityDescriptionStarted(trackingContext.Activity, trackingContext.TrackingId, trackingContext.SystemTracker, entityAddress);
			});
			if (executeOnce)
			{
				if (!RuntimeEntityDescriptionCache.TryGet(entityAddress, out runtimeEntityDescription))
				{
					request = CreateOrGetRequestMessage();
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((GetRuntimeEntityDescriptionAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.factory.Channel.BeginRequest(thisPtr.request, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(GetRuntimeEntityDescriptionAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult a)
					{
						thisPtr.response = thisPtr.factory.Channel.EndRequest(a);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
					runtimeEntityDescription = BuildRuntimeEntityDescription(response);
					RuntimeEntityDescriptionCache.AddOrUpdate(entityAddress, new RuntimeEntityDescriptionRecord(runtimeEntityDescription));
				}
				clientEntity.RuntimeEntityDescription = runtimeEntityDescription;
				yield break;
			}
			while (ShouldGetEntityInfo(MessagingExceptionHelper.Unwrap(base.LastAsyncStepException as CommunicationException)))
			{
				if (RuntimeEntityDescriptionCache.TryGet(entityAddress, out runtimeEntityDescription))
				{
					clientEntity.RuntimeEntityDescription = runtimeEntityDescription;
					continue;
				}
				request = CreateOrGetRequestMessage();
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((GetRuntimeEntityDescriptionAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.factory.Channel.BeginRequest(thisPtr.request, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(GetRuntimeEntityDescriptionAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult a)
				{
					thisPtr.response = thisPtr.factory.Channel.EndRequest(a);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
				if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
				{
					if (base.LastAsyncStepException.IsWrappedExceptionTransient())
					{
						yield return CallAsyncSleep(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(attempt % 60) + TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(ConcurrentRandom.Next(1, 1000)));
					}
					else
					{
						if (!ShouldGetEntityInfo(MessagingExceptionHelper.Unwrap(base.LastAsyncStepException as CommunicationException)))
						{
							Complete(base.LastAsyncStepException);
							break;
						}
						yield return CallAsyncSleep(Constants.GetRuntimeEntityDescriptionNonTransientSleepTimeout);
					}
					attempt++;
				}
				else
				{
					runtimeEntityDescription = BuildRuntimeEntityDescription(response);
					RuntimeEntityDescriptionCache.AddOrUpdate(entityAddress, new RuntimeEntityDescriptionRecord(runtimeEntityDescription));
					clientEntity.RuntimeEntityDescription = runtimeEntityDescription;
				}
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldGetEntityInfo(Exception exception)
		{
			return clientEntity.RuntimeEntityDescription == null && !factory.Settings.EnableRedirect && factory.IsOpened && RemainingTime() > TimeSpan.Zero && !(exception is MessagingEntityNotFoundException) && !(exception is UnauthorizedAccessException);
		}

		private void ReScheduleIfNeeded(Exception exception)
		{
			if (ShouldGetEntityInfo(exception))
			{
				IOThreadScheduler.ScheduleCallbackNoFlow(delegate
				{
					new GetRuntimeEntityDescriptionAsyncResult(trackingContext, clientEntity, entityAddress, factory, messageCreator, executeOnce: false, RemainingTime(), null, null).Start();
				}, null);
			}
		}

		public new static RuntimeEntityDescription End(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			return AsyncResult<GetRuntimeEntityDescriptionAsyncResult>.End(result).runtimeEntityDescription;
		}

		private static RuntimeEntityDescription BuildRuntimeEntityDescription(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message response)
		{
			GetRuntimeEntityDescriptionResponseCommand body = response.GetBody<GetRuntimeEntityDescriptionResponseCommand>();
			return new RuntimeEntityDescription
			{
				EnableMessagePartitioning = body.EnablePartitioning,
				RequiresDuplicateDetection = body.RequiresDuplicateDetection,
				PartitionCount = body.PartitionCount,
				EnableSubscriptionPartitioning = body.EnableSubscriptionPartitioning,
				PartitionRanges = body.PartitionRanges
			};
		}

		private static void OnFinally(Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult asyncResult, Exception exception)
		{
			GetRuntimeEntityDescriptionAsyncResult thisPtr = (GetRuntimeEntityDescriptionAsyncResult)asyncResult;
			if (exception == null)
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteGetRuntimeEntityDescriptionCompleted(thisPtr.trackingContext.Activity, thisPtr.trackingContext.TrackingId, thisPtr.trackingContext.SystemTracker, thisPtr.entityAddress, thisPtr.clientEntity.RuntimeEntityDescription.ToString());
				});
			}
			else
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteGetRuntimeEntityDescriptionFailed(thisPtr.trackingContext.Activity, thisPtr.trackingContext.TrackingId, thisPtr.trackingContext.SystemTracker, thisPtr.entityAddress, exception.ToString());
				});
			}
			if (!thisPtr.executeOnce)
			{
				thisPtr.ReScheduleIfNeeded(MessagingExceptionHelper.Unwrap(exception as CommunicationException));
			}
		}
	}

		public void ReadXml(XmlReader reader)
		{
			reader.Read();
			reader.ReadStartElement();
			version = BitConverter.ToInt32(SerializationUtilities.ReadBytes(reader, 4), 0);
			int num = BitConverter.ToInt16(SerializationUtilities.ReadBytes(reader, 2), 0);
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				byte[] array = SerializationUtilities.ReadBytes(reader, 3);
				int bytesToRead = BitConverter.ToInt16(array, 1);
				byte[] value = SerializationUtilities.ReadBytes(reader, bytesToRead);
				SetFieldValue(array[0], value);
			}
			reader.ReadEndElement();
		}

		public void WriteXml(XmlWriter writer)
		{
			writer.WriteStartElement("s");
			writer.WriteBase64(BitConverter.GetBytes(version), 0, 4);
			writer.WriteBase64(BitConverter.GetBytes(GetFieldCount()), 0, 2);
			byte[] array = new byte[3];
			BinarySerializationItem[] binarySerializationItems = BinarySerializationItems;
			foreach (BinarySerializationItem binarySerializationItem in binarySerializationItems)
			{
				if (binarySerializationItem.ShouldSerialize(this))
				{
					array[0] = (byte)binarySerializationItem.FieldId;
					byte[] array2 = binarySerializationItem.Extractor(this);
					if (array2.Length > 65535)
					{
						throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new SerializationException(SRClient.ExceededMessagePropertySizeLimit(binarySerializationItem.FieldId.ToString(), 65535)));
					}
					array[1] = (byte)(array2.Length & 0xFF);
					array[2] = (byte)((array2.Length & 0xFF00) >> 8);
					writer.WriteBase64(array, 0, 3);
					writer.WriteBase64(array2, 0, array2.Length);
				}
			}
			writer.Flush();
			writer.WriteEndElement();
		}

		private bool IsSet(RequestInfoFields requestInfoFields)
		{
			return (initializedMembers & requestInfoFields) != 0;
		}

		private short GetFieldCount()
		{
			int num = (int)initializedMembers;
			short num2 = 0;
			while (num != 0)
			{
				num2++;
				num &= num - 1;
			}
			return num2;
		}

	internal sealed class GetMessageSessionsAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<GetMessageSessionsAsyncResult>
	{
		private readonly List<MessageSession> messageSessions;

		private readonly DateTime lastUpdatedTime;

		private readonly SbmpMessageCreator messageCreator;

		private readonly string entityName;

		private readonly int sessionsPageSize;

		private readonly MessagingEntityType entityType;

		private readonly RetryPolicy retryPolicy;

		public SbmpMessagingFactory MessagingFactory { get; private set; }

		private string LastSessionId { get; set; }

		private int Skip { get; set; }

		public GetMessageSessionsAsyncResult(SbmpMessagingFactory messagingFactory, string entityName, DateTime lastUpdatedTime, SbmpMessageCreator messageCreator, RetryPolicy retryPolicy, MessagingEntityType entityType, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			: base(timeout, callback, state)
		{
			this.lastUpdatedTime = lastUpdatedTime;
			MessagingFactory = messagingFactory;
			this.messageCreator = messageCreator;
			this.entityName = entityName;
			messageSessions = new List<MessageSession>();
			this.entityType = entityType;
			sessionsPageSize = 100;
			this.retryPolicy = retryPolicy;
			Start();
		}

		protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
		{
			System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message responseMessage = null;
			do
			{
				System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message requestMessage = CreateRequestMessage();
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((GetMessageSessionsAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.MessagingFactory.Channel.BeginRequest(requestMessage, SbmpProtocolDefaults.BufferTimeout(t, thisPtr.MessagingFactory.GetSettings().EnableAdditionalClientTimeout), c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(GetMessageSessionsAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					responseMessage = thisPtr.MessagingFactory.Channel.EndRequest(r);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
			}
			while (base.LastAsyncStepException == null && responseMessage != null && ShouldContinue(responseMessage));
			Complete(base.LastAsyncStepException);
		}

		private System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message CreateRequestMessage()
		{
			GetMessageSessionsCommand getMessageSessionsCommand = new GetMessageSessionsCommand
			{
				Skip = Skip,
				Top = sessionsPageSize,
				LastUpdatedTime = lastUpdatedTime,
				Timeout = RemainingTime()
			};
			RequestInfo requestInfo = new RequestInfo
			{
				ServerTimeout = getMessageSessionsCommand.Timeout,
				SessionId = LastSessionId,
				Skip = Skip,
				Top = getMessageSessionsCommand.Top,
				LastUpdatedTime = lastUpdatedTime
			};
			return messageCreator.CreateWcfMessage("http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2011/06/servicebus/SbmpMessageReceiver/GetMessageSessions", getMessageSessionsCommand, null, retryPolicy, null, requestInfo);
		}

		private bool ShouldContinue(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message responseMessage)
		{
			int num = 0;
			GetMessageSessionsResponseCommand body = responseMessage.GetBody<GetMessageSessionsResponseCommand>();
			Skip = body.Skip;
			foreach (Tuple<string, SessionState> session in body.Sessions)
			{
				string item = session.Item1;
				messageSessions.Add(new SbmpBrowsableMessageSession(entityName, item, entityType, MessagingFactory, retryPolicy));
				LastSessionId = item;
				num++;
			}
			return num > 0;
		}

		public new static IEnumerable<MessageSession> End(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			GetMessageSessionsAsyncResult getMessageSessionsAsyncResult = AsyncResult<GetMessageSessionsAsyncResult>.End(result);
			return getMessageSessionsAsyncResult.messageSessions;
		}
	}

	internal class SbmpMessageEncoder : IBrokeredMessageEncoder
	{
		public long WriteHeader(XmlWriter writer, BrokeredMessage brokeredMessage, SerializationTarget serializationTarget)
		{
			long num = 0L;
			num += BrokeredMessage.SerializeHeadersAsBinary(brokeredMessage, writer, serializationTarget);
			return num + BrokeredMessage.SerializePropertiesAsBinary(brokeredMessage, writer, serializationTarget);
		}

		public long ReadHeader(XmlReader reader, BrokeredMessage brokeredMessage, SerializationTarget serializationTarget)
		{
			long num = 0L;
			num += BrokeredMessage.DeserializeHeadersFromBinary(brokeredMessage, reader, serializationTarget);
			return num + BrokeredMessage.DeserializePropertiesFromBinary(brokeredMessage, reader, serializationTarget);
		}
	}

		private IAsyncResult BeginPeekCommand(PeekOptions peekOptions, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			try
			{
				PeekCommand peekCommand = new PeekCommand
				{
					FromSequenceNumber = peekOptions.FromSequenceNumber,
					MessageCount = peekOptions.MessageCount,
					Timeout = timeout,
					MessageVersion = BrokeredMessage.MessageVersion
				};
				RequestInfo requestInfo = new RequestInfo
				{
					ServerTimeout = peekCommand.Timeout,
					SequenceNumber = peekCommand.FromSequenceNumber,
					MessageCount = peekCommand.MessageCount
				};
				System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message = MessageCreator.CreateWcfMessage("http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2011/06/servicebus/SbmpMessageBrowser/Peek", peekCommand, null, base.RetryPolicy, peekOptions.TrackingContext, requestInfo);
				return SbmpMessagingFactory.Channel.BeginRequest(message, SbmpProtocolDefaults.BufferTimeout(timeout, SbmpMessagingFactory.GetSettings().EnableAdditionalClientTimeout), callback, state);
			}
			catch (CommunicationException exception)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(MessagingExceptionHelper.Unwrap(exception, base.IsClosedOrClosing));
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				if (!Fx.IsFatal(ex) && base.IsClosedOrClosing)
				{
					throw new OperationCanceledException(SRClient.EntityClosedOrAborted, ex);
				}
				throw;
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> EndPeekCommand(IAsyncResult result)

			try

				System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message = SbmpMessagingFactory.Channel.EndRequest(result);
				PeekResponseCommand body = message.GetBody<PeekResponseCommand>();

			}
			catch (CommunicationException exception)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(MessagingExceptionHelper.Unwrap(exception, base.IsClosedOrClosing));
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				if (!Fx.IsFatal(ex) && base.IsClosedOrClosing)
				{
					throw new OperationCanceledException(SRClient.EntityClosedOrAborted, ex);
				}
				throw;
			}
		}

		{

			public XmlDictionaryString Sanitize(XmlDictionaryString value)
			{
				if (value.Dictionary is XmlBinaryReaderSession)
				{
					if (!TryLookup(value.Value, out var result))
					{
						int id = Interlocked.Increment(ref nextKey);
						result = Add(id, value.Value);
					}
					value = result;
				}
				return value;
			}
		}

			private static Action<XmlDictionaryWriter, XmlDictionaryReader, bool> CompileWriteTextNodeDelegate()
			{
				Type typeFromHandle = typeof(XmlDictionaryWriter);
				MethodInfo method = typeFromHandle.GetMethod("WriteTextNode", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic, null, CallingConventions.Any, new Type[2]
				{
					typeof(XmlDictionaryReader),
					typeof(bool)
				}, null);
				ParameterExpression parameterExpression = Expression.Parameter(typeof(XmlDictionaryWriter), "@writer");
				ParameterExpression parameterExpression2 = Expression.Parameter(typeof(XmlDictionaryReader), "@reader");
				ParameterExpression parameterExpression3 = Expression.Parameter(typeof(bool), "@isAttribute");
				Expression<Action<XmlDictionaryWriter, XmlDictionaryReader, bool>> expression = Expression.Lambda<Action<XmlDictionaryWriter, XmlDictionaryReader, bool>>(Expression.Call(parameterExpression, method, parameterExpression2, parameterExpression3), new ParameterExpression[3] { parameterExpression, parameterExpression2, parameterExpression3 });
				return expression.Compile();
			}

		protected IChannelFactory<IRequestSessionChannel> defaultChannelFactory;

		protected IChannelFactory<IRequestSessionChannel> securedChannelFactory;

		private readonly bool clientMode;

		private readonly bool includeExceptionDetails;

		private readonly DnsEndpointIdentity endpointIdentity;

		private readonly EventHandler onInnerChannelFaulted;

		private readonly TimeSpan? leaseTimeout;

		public MessageVersion MessageVersion { get; private set; }

		public event EventHandler NotifyCleanup;

		public ContainerChannelManager(bool clientMode, bool useSslStreamSecurity, string clientAuthThumbprint, bool includeExceptionDetails, DnsEndpointIdentity endpointIdentity, TimeSpan? leaseTimeout)
		{
			this.clientMode = clientMode;
			this.includeExceptionDetails = includeExceptionDetails;
			this.endpointIdentity = endpointIdentity;
			this.leaseTimeout = leaseTimeout;
			onInnerChannelFaulted = OnInnerChannelFaulted;
			defaultChannelFactory = CreateChannelFactory(useSslStreamSecurity, clientAuthThumbprint);
			securedChannelFactory = CreateChannelFactory(useSslStreamSecurity: true, clientAuthThumbprint);
			defaultChannelFactory.Open();
			securedChannelFactory.Open();
		}

		internal ContainerChannelManager(bool includeExceptionDetails, DnsEndpointIdentity endpointIdentity, TimeSpan? leaseTimeout)
		{
			clientMode = false;
			this.includeExceptionDetails = includeExceptionDetails;
			this.endpointIdentity = endpointIdentity;
			this.leaseTimeout = leaseTimeout;
			onInnerChannelFaulted = OnInnerChannelFaulted;
			defaultChannelFactory = CreateChannelFactory(useSslStreamSecurity: true, null);
			securedChannelFactory = CreateChannelFactory(useSslStreamSecurity: true, null);
			defaultChannelFactory.Open();
			securedChannelFactory.Open();
		}

		private IChannelFactory<IRequestSessionChannel> CreateChannelFactory(bool useSslStreamSecurity, string clientAuthThumbprint)
		{
			int num = 0;
			BindingParameterCollection bindingParameterCollection = new BindingParameterCollection();
			bool flag = clientAuthThumbprint != null && !clientMode;
			CustomBinding customBinding = SbmpProtocolDefaults.CreateBinding(portSharingEnabled: false, SbmpProtocolDefaults.SbmpConnectionProtocol.Tcp, int.MaxValue, useSslStreamSecurity, flag, endpointIdentity, leaseTimeout);
			if (!clientMode)
			{
				customBinding.ReceiveTimeout = TimeSpan.MaxValue;
			}
			DuplexRequestBindingElement item = new DuplexRequestBindingElement
			{
				IncludeExceptionDetails = includeExceptionDetails,
				ClientMode = clientMode
			};
			customBinding.Elements.Insert(num++, item);
			if (useSslStreamSecurity)
			{
				ClientCredentials clientCredentials = new ClientCredentials();
				clientCredentials.ServiceCertificate.Authentication.CertificateValidationMode = X509CertificateValidationMode.Custom;
				clientCredentials.ServiceCertificate.Authentication.CustomCertificateValidator = RetriableCertificateValidator.Instance;
				if (flag && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(clientAuthThumbprint))
				{
					clientCredentials.ClientCertificate.SetCertificate(StoreLocation.LocalMachine, StoreName.My, X509FindType.FindByThumbprint, clientAuthThumbprint);
				}
				bindingParameterCollection.Add(clientCredentials);
			}
			MessageVersion = customBinding.MessageVersion;
			return customBinding.BuildChannelFactory<IRequestSessionChannel>(bindingParameterCollection);
		}

		private void OnInnerChannelFaulted(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			IRequestSessionChannel requestSessionChannel = (IRequestSessionChannel)sender;
			requestSessionChannel.Faulted -= onInnerChannelFaulted;
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginGetCorrelator(string containerUri, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return BeginLoadInstance(containerUri, null, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginGetCorrelator(string containerUri, long containerId, bool secured, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return BeginLoadInstance(containerUri, new LoadingContext(containerId, secured), timeout, callback, state);
		}

		public IRequestSessionChannel EndGetCorrelator(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			return EndLoadInstance(result);
		}

		public void TryRemoveSingletonContext(string key)
		{
			OnTryRemoveSingletonContext(key);
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginCreateInstance(SingletonContext singletonContext, string key, object loadingContext, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			Uri physicalAddress = new Uri(key);
			long containerId = 0L;
			EndpointAddress to = new EndpointAddress(physicalAddress, SbmpProtocolDefaults.GetEndpointIdentity(physicalAddress));
			IChannelFactory<IRequestSessionChannel> channelFactory = defaultChannelFactory;
			if (!clientMode && loadingContext != null && loadingContext is LoadingContext)
			{
				containerId = ((LoadingContext)loadingContext).ContainerId;
				if (((LoadingContext)loadingContext).IsSecured)
				{
					channelFactory = securedChannelFactory;
				}
			}
			IRequestSessionChannel requestSessionChannel = channelFactory.CreateChannel(to);
			EventHandler handler = delegate
			{
				RaiseNotifyCleanup(physicalAddress, containerId);
				try
				{
					BeginUnloadInstance(key, null, shouldAbort: true, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10.0), UnloadCallback, this);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					Exception ex2 = ex;
					Exception exception = ex2;
					if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
					{
						throw;
					}
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteExceptionAsWarning(exception.ToString());
					});
				}
			};
			requestSessionChannel.SafeAddFaulted(handler);
			return new CompletedAsyncResult<IRequestSessionChannel>(requestSessionChannel, callback, state);
		}

		private static void UnloadCallback(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			ContainerChannelManager containerChannelManager = (ContainerChannelManager)result.AsyncState;
			try
			{
				containerChannelManager.EndUnloadInstance(result);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				Exception ex2 = ex;
				Exception exception = ex2;
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteExceptionAsWarning(exception.ToString());
				});
			}
		}

		protected override IRequestSessionChannel OnEndCreateInstance(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			IRequestSessionChannel requestSessionChannel = CompletedAsyncResult<IRequestSessionChannel>.End(result);
			if (!clientMode)
			{
				return new WrappedRequestSessionChannel(requestSessionChannel);
			}
			return requestSessionChannel;
		}

		protected override IRequestSessionChannel OnCreateInstance(SingletonContext singletonContext, string key, object loadingContext, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			IAsyncResult result = OnBeginCreateInstance(singletonContext, key, loadingContext, timeout, null, null);
			return OnEndCreateInstance(result);
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginOpenInstance(SingletonContext singletonContext, string key, IRequestSessionChannel instance, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new OpenInstanceAsyncResult(key, instance, timeout, callback, state).Start();
		}

		protected override void OnEndOpenInstance(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			AsyncResult<OpenInstanceAsyncResult>.End(result);
		}

		protected override void OnOpenInstance(SingletonContext singletonContext, string key, IRequestSessionChannel instance, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			new OpenInstanceAsyncResult(key, instance, timeout, null, null).RunSynchronously();
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginCloseInstance(SingletonContext singletonContext, string key, IRequestSessionChannel instance, object unloadingContext, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new CloseInstanceAsyncResult(key, instance, timeout, callback, state).Start();
		}

		protected override void OnEndCloseInstance(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			AsyncResult<CloseInstanceAsyncResult>.End(result);
		}

		protected override void OnCloseInstance(SingletonContext singletonContext, string key, IRequestSessionChannel instance, object unloadingContext, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			new CloseInstanceAsyncResult(key, instance, timeout, null, null).RunSynchronously();
		}

		protected override void OnAbortInstance(SingletonContext singletonContext, string key, IRequestSessionChannel instance, object unloadingContext)
		{
			instance.Abort();
		}

		private void RaiseNotifyCleanup(Uri physicalAddress, long containerId)
		{
			this.NotifyCleanup?.Invoke(this, new NotifyCleanupEventArgs(physicalAddress, containerId));
		}
