	internal sealed class PrefetchAsyncWaitHandle
	{
		private sealed class WaitAsyncResult : Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult
		{
			private static readonly Action<object, TimeoutException> onWaitCallback = OnWaitCallback;

			private readonly AsyncWaitHandle waitHandle;

			public WaitAsyncResult(AsyncWaitHandle waitHandle, AsyncCallback callback, object state, TimeSpan timeout)
				: base(callback, state)
			{
				this.waitHandle = waitHandle;
				if (this.waitHandle.WaitAsync(onWaitCallback, this, timeout))
				{
					Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: true);
				}
			}

			private static void OnWaitCallback(object state, TimeoutException ex)
			{
				WaitAsyncResult waitAsyncResult = (WaitAsyncResult)state;
				waitAsyncResult.Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: false, ex);
			}

			public static void End(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult.End<WaitAsyncResult>(result);
			}
		}

		private readonly AsyncWaitHandle waitHandle;

		public PrefetchAsyncWaitHandle()
		{
			waitHandle = new AsyncWaitHandle(EventResetMode.AutoReset);
		}

		public Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult BeginWait(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new WaitAsyncResult(waitHandle, callback, state, timeout);
		}

		public void EndWait(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			WaitAsyncResult.End(result);
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			waitHandle.Reset();
		}

		public void Set()
		{
			waitHandle.Set();
		}
	}
	internal class RedirectBindingElement : BindingElement
	{
		private class RedirectContainerChannelFactory<TChannel> : ChannelFactoryBase<TChannel>
		{
			private class RedirectContainerSessionChannel : ChannelBase, IRequestSessionChannel, IRequestChannel, IChannel, ICommunicationObject, ISessionChannel<IOutputSession>
			{
				private sealed class OutputSession : IOutputSession, ISession
				{
					public string Id { get; set; }
				}

				private sealed class RequestAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<RequestAsyncResult>
				{
					private readonly RedirectContainerSessionChannel sessionChannel;

					private readonly System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message incomingMessage;

					private readonly string incomingMessageAction;

					public System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message ResponseMessage { get; private set; }

					public RequestAsyncResult(RedirectContainerSessionChannel parent, System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message incomingMessage, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
						: base(timeout, callback, state)
					{
						sessionChannel = parent;
						this.incomingMessage = incomingMessage;
						incomingMessageAction = this.incomingMessage.Headers.Action;
					}

					protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
					{
						ThrowIfNotSupportedClientSettings();
						System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message responseMessage = null;
						int num = incomingMessage.Headers.FindHeader("Authorization", "http://schemas.microsoft.com/servicebus/2010/08/protocol/");
						string text = string.Empty;
						if (incomingMessage.Properties != null && incomingMessage.Properties.TryGetValue("ParentLinkId", out var value))
						{
							text = (string)value;
						}
						LinkInfo linkInfo = LinkInfo.GetHeader(incomingMessage.Headers);
						bool hasParentLink = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text);
						string linkId = (hasParentLink ? text : linkInfo.LinkId);
						EntityLinkKey entityLinkKey = new EntityLinkKey(linkInfo.EntityName, linkId);
						EntityLinkValue entityLinkValue = null;
						IRequestSessionChannel channelToUse = null;
						if (sessionChannel.containerNameResolutionMode != ContainerNameResolutionMode.DisableRedirect && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(entityLinkKey.EntityName) && !sessionChannel.entityMap.TryGetValue(entityLinkKey, out entityLinkValue))
						{
							if (sessionChannel.bindingElement.EnableRedirect)
							{
								RedirectCommand body = new RedirectCommand();
								System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message redirectMessage = System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message.CreateMessage(incomingMessage.Version, "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2011/06/servicebus/SbmpRedirect/Redirect", body);
								redirectMessage.Headers.To = incomingMessage.Headers.To;
								linkInfo.AddTo(redirectMessage.Headers);
								if (num >= 0)
								{
									redirectMessage.Headers.CopyHeaderFrom(incomingMessage.Headers, num);
								}
								yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((RequestAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.sessionChannel.primaryChannel.BeginRequest(redirectMessage, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(RequestAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
								{
									responseMessage = thisPtr.sessionChannel.primaryChannel.EndRequest(r);
								}, (Call)delegate(RequestAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t)
								{
									responseMessage = thisPtr.sessionChannel.primaryChannel.Request(redirectMessage, t);
								}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
							}
							else
							{
								yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((RequestAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.sessionChannel.primaryChannel.BeginRequest(thisPtr.incomingMessage, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(RequestAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
								{
									responseMessage = thisPtr.sessionChannel.primaryChannel.EndRequest(r);
								}, (Call)delegate(RequestAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t)
								{
									responseMessage = thisPtr.sessionChannel.primaryChannel.Request(thisPtr.incomingMessage, t);
								}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
							}
							if (responseMessage != null && string.Equals(responseMessage.Headers.Action, "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2011/06/servicebus/SbmpRedirect/RedirectResponse", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
							{
								LinkInfo header = LinkInfo.GetHeader(responseMessage.Headers);
								RedirectResponseCommand body2 = responseMessage.GetBody<RedirectResponseCommand>();
								string redirectTo = body2.RedirectTo;
								entityLinkValue = new EntityLinkValue(redirectTo, header);
								sessionChannel.containerNameResolutionMode = body2.ContainerNameResolutionMode;
								ThrowIfNotSupportedClientSettings();
								if (body2.ContainerNameResolutionMode != ContainerNameResolutionMode.DisableRedirect)
								{
									sessionChannel.entityMap.TryAdd(entityLinkKey, entityLinkValue);
								}
							}
							else if (base.LastAsyncStepException == null)
							{
								ResponseMessage = responseMessage;
								if (!hasParentLink && string.Equals(incomingMessageAction, "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2011/06/servicebus/SbmpConnection/CloseLink", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
								{
									sessionChannel.entityMap.TryRemove(entityLinkKey, out var _);
								}
								yield break;
							}
						}
						if (entityLinkValue == null || sessionChannel.containerNameResolutionMode == ContainerNameResolutionMode.DisableRedirect || (!sessionChannel.bindingElement.EnableRedirect && sessionChannel.containerNameResolutionMode == ContainerNameResolutionMode.AllowRedirect))
						{
							channelToUse = sessionChannel.primaryChannel;
						}
						else
						{
							yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((RequestAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.sessionChannel.correlatorManager.BeginGetCorrelator(entityLinkValue.ContainerLocation, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(RequestAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult a)
							{
								channelToUse = thisPtr.sessionChannel.correlatorManager.EndGetCorrelator(a);
							}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
							incomingMessage.Headers.RemoveAll("LinkInfo", "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2011/06/servicebus");
							linkInfo.TransferDestinationEntityAddress = entityLinkValue.UpdatedLinkInfo.TransferDestinationEntityAddress;
							linkInfo.TransferDestinationMessagingInstanceHandle = entityLinkValue.UpdatedLinkInfo.TransferDestinationMessagingInstanceHandle;
							linkInfo.TransferDestinationResourceResourceId = entityLinkValue.UpdatedLinkInfo.TransferDestinationResourceResourceId;
							linkInfo.EntityType = entityLinkValue.UpdatedLinkInfo.EntityType;
							linkInfo.EntityName = entityLinkValue.UpdatedLinkInfo.EntityName;
							linkInfo.AddTo(incomingMessage.Headers);
						}
						if (!hasParentLink && string.Equals(incomingMessageAction, "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2011/06/servicebus/SbmpConnection/CloseLink", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
						{
							sessionChannel.entityMap.TryRemove(entityLinkKey, out var _);
						}
						yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((RequestAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => channelToUse.BeginRequest(thisPtr.incomingMessage, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(RequestAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
						{
							thisPtr.ResponseMessage = channelToUse.EndRequest(r);
						}, (Call)delegate(RequestAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t)
						{
							thisPtr.ResponseMessage = channelToUse.Request(thisPtr.incomingMessage, t);
						}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
					}

					private void ThrowIfNotSupportedClientSettings()
					{
						if (!sessionChannel.bindingElement.EnableRedirect && sessionChannel.containerNameResolutionMode == ContainerNameResolutionMode.AlwaysRedirect)
						{
							Complete(new NotSupportedException(SR.GetString(Resources.SbmpClientMustEnableRedirect)));
						}
					}
				}

				private struct EntityLinkKey : IEquatable<EntityLinkKey>
				{
					private readonly string entityName;

					private readonly string linkId;

					public string EntityName => entityName;

					public EntityLinkKey(string entityName, string linkId)
					{
						this.entityName = entityName;
						this.linkId = linkId;
					}

					public bool Equals(EntityLinkKey other)
					{
						if (StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase.Equals(entityName, other.entityName))
						{
							return StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase.Equals(linkId, other.linkId);
						}
						return false;
					}

					public override bool Equals(object obj)
					{
						if (obj is EntityLinkKey)
						{
							return Equals((EntityLinkKey)obj);
						}
						return false;
					}

					public override int GetHashCode()
					{
						int hashCode = StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase.GetHashCode(entityName);
						int hashCode2 = StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase.GetHashCode(linkId);
						return HashCode.CombineHashCodes(hashCode, hashCode2);
					}
				}

				private class EntityLinkValue
				{
					public string ContainerLocation { get; private set; }

					public LinkInfo UpdatedLinkInfo { get; private set; }

					public EntityLinkValue(string containerLocation, LinkInfo updatedLinkInfo)
					{
						ContainerLocation = containerLocation;
						UpdatedLinkInfo = updatedLinkInfo;
					}
				}

				private readonly EventHandler onCorrelatorNotifyCleanup;

				private readonly IChannelFactory<IRequestSessionChannel> innerFactory;

				private readonly IRequestSessionChannel primaryChannel;

				private readonly ContainerChannelManager correlatorManager;

				private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<EntityLinkKey, EntityLinkValue> entityMap;

				private readonly RedirectBindingElement bindingElement;

				private ContainerNameResolutionMode containerNameResolutionMode;

				public Uri Via { get; private set; }

				public EndpointAddress RemoteAddress { get; private set; }

				public IOutputSession Session { get; private set; }

				public RedirectContainerSessionChannel(RedirectContainerChannelFactory<IRequestSessionChannel> factory, EndpointAddress address, Uri via)
					: base(factory)
				{
					innerFactory = factory.innerFactory;
					bindingElement = factory.BindingElement;
					RemoteAddress = address;
					Via = via;
					entityMap = new ConcurrentDictionary<EntityLinkKey, EntityLinkValue>();
					primaryChannel = innerFactory.CreateChannel(address, via);
					Session = new OutputSession
					{
						Id = primaryChannel.Session.Id
					};
					onCorrelatorNotifyCleanup = OnCorrelatorNotifyCleanup;
					correlatorManager = new ContainerChannelManager(clientMode: true, bindingElement.UseSslStreamSecurity, bindingElement.ClientAuthThumbprint, bindingElement.IncludeExceptionDetails, bindingElement.EndpointIdentity, bindingElement.LeaseTimeout);
					correlatorManager.NotifyCleanup += OnCorrelatorNotifyCleanup;
				}

				public System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message Request(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message)
				{
					return Request(message, base.DefaultSendTimeout);
				}

				public System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message Request(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, TimeSpan timeout)
				{
					return EndRequest(BeginRequest(message, timeout, null, null));
				}

				public IAsyncResult BeginRequest(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				{
					return BeginRequest(message, base.DefaultSendTimeout, callback, state);
				}

				public IAsyncResult BeginRequest(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				{
					return new RequestAsyncResult(this, message, timeout, callback, state).Start();
				}

				public System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message EndRequest(IAsyncResult result)
				{
					return AsyncResult<RequestAsyncResult>.End(result).ResponseMessage;
				}

				protected override void OnAbort()
				{
					correlatorManager.NotifyCleanup -= onCorrelatorNotifyCleanup;
					primaryChannel.Abort();
					correlatorManager.Abort();
				}

				protected override void OnClose(TimeSpan timeout)
				{
					correlatorManager.NotifyCleanup -= onCorrelatorNotifyCleanup;
					TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
					primaryChannel.Close(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
					correlatorManager.Close(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
				}

				protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				{
					correlatorManager.NotifyCleanup -= onCorrelatorNotifyCleanup;
					return new CloseCollectionIteratedAsyncResult(new ICommunicationObject[2] { primaryChannel, correlatorManager }, timeout, callback, state);
				}

				protected override void OnEndClose(IAsyncResult result)
				{
					AsyncResult<CloseCollectionIteratedAsyncResult>.End(result);
				}

				protected override void OnOpen(TimeSpan timeout)
				{
					TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
					primaryChannel.Open(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
					correlatorManager.Open(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
				}

				protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginOpen(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				{
					return new OpenCollectionIteratedAsyncResult(new ICommunicationObject[2] { primaryChannel, correlatorManager }, timeout, callback, state);
				}

				protected override void OnEndOpen(IAsyncResult result)
				{
					AsyncResult<OpenCollectionIteratedAsyncResult>.End(result);
				}

				private void OnCorrelatorNotifyCleanup(object sender, EventArgs args)
				{
					NotifyCleanupEventArgs e = args as NotifyCleanupEventArgs;
					Uri keyToCleanup = e.ChannelAddress;
					IEnumerable<EntityLinkKey> enumerable = entityMap.Where(delegate(KeyValuePair<EntityLinkKey, EntityLinkValue> kvp)
					{
						KeyValuePair<EntityLinkKey, EntityLinkValue> keyValuePair = kvp;
						return keyValuePair.Value.ContainerLocation == keyToCleanup.AbsoluteUri;
					}).Select(delegate(KeyValuePair<EntityLinkKey, EntityLinkValue> kvp)
					{
						KeyValuePair<EntityLinkKey, EntityLinkValue> keyValuePair = kvp;
						return keyValuePair.Key;
					});
					foreach (EntityLinkKey item in enumerable)
					{
						entityMap.TryRemove(item, out var _);
					}
				}
			}

			private readonly IChannelFactory<TChannel> innerFactory;

			public RedirectBindingElement BindingElement { get; private set; }

			public RedirectContainerChannelFactory(BindingContext context, RedirectBindingElement bindingElement)
				: base((IDefaultCommunicationTimeouts)context.Binding)
			{
				BindingElement = bindingElement;
				innerFactory = context.BuildInnerChannelFactory<TChannel>();
			}

			public override T GetProperty<T>()
			{
				return innerFactory.GetProperty<T>();
			}

			protected override TChannel OnCreateChannel(EndpointAddress address, Uri via)
			{
				return (TChannel)(object)new RedirectContainerSessionChannel((RedirectContainerChannelFactory<IRequestSessionChannel>)(object)this, address, via);
			}

			protected override void OnOpening()
			{
				base.OnOpening();
				innerFactory.SafeAddFaulted(OnInnerFactoryFaulted);
			}

			protected override void OnOpen(TimeSpan timeout)
			{
				innerFactory.Open(timeout);
			}

			protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginOpen(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{
				return innerFactory.BeginOpen(timeout, callback, state);
			}

			protected override void OnEndOpen(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				innerFactory.EndOpen(result);
			}

			protected override void OnClose(TimeSpan timeout)
			{
				innerFactory.Close(timeout);
			}

			protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{
				return innerFactory.BeginClose(timeout, callback, state);
			}

			protected override void OnEndClose(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				innerFactory.EndClose(result);
			}

			private void OnInnerFactoryFaulted(object sender, EventArgs e)
			{
				Fault();
			}
		}

		public bool EnableRedirect { get; set; }

		public bool IncludeExceptionDetails { get; set; }

		public bool UseSslStreamSecurity { get; set; }

		public string ClientAuthThumbprint { get; set; }

		public DnsEndpointIdentity EndpointIdentity { get; set; }

		public TimeSpan LeaseTimeout { get; set; }

		public RedirectBindingElement()
		{
			EnableRedirect = true;
		}

		public RedirectBindingElement(RedirectBindingElement other)
		{
			EnableRedirect = other.EnableRedirect;
			IncludeExceptionDetails = other.IncludeExceptionDetails;
			UseSslStreamSecurity = other.UseSslStreamSecurity;
			ClientAuthThumbprint = other.ClientAuthThumbprint;
			EndpointIdentity = other.EndpointIdentity;
			LeaseTimeout = other.LeaseTimeout;
		}

		public override BindingElement Clone()
		{
			return new RedirectBindingElement(this);
		}

		public override T GetProperty<T>(BindingContext context)
		{
			return context.GetInnerProperty<T>();
		}

		public override bool CanBuildChannelFactory<TChannel>(BindingContext context)
		{
			if (context == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNull("context");
			}
			if (typeof(TChannel) == typeof(IRequestSessionChannel))
			{
				return base.CanBuildChannelFactory<TChannel>(context);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override IChannelFactory<TChannel> BuildChannelFactory<TChannel>(BindingContext context)
		{
			if (!CanBuildChannelFactory<TChannel>(context))
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.Argument("TChannel", SRClient.ChannelTypeNotSupported(typeof(TChannel)));
			}
			return new RedirectContainerChannelFactory<TChannel>(context, this);
		}
	}

	internal sealed class AcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult : Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult
	{
		private static readonly AsyncCompletion operationComplete = OperationComplete;

		private readonly CreateLinkSettings createLinkSettings;

		private readonly int prefetchCount;

		private readonly string sessionId;

		private readonly bool isExclusiveMode;

		private readonly Guid? lockToken;

		private RetryPolicy retryPolicy;

		private MessageSession result;

		private SbmpMessagingFactory MessagingFactory { get; set; }

		public AcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult(SbmpMessagingFactory messagingFactory, string entityName, string sessionId, MessagingEntityType? entityType, ReceiveMode receiveMode, int prefetchCount, Lazy<SbmpMessageCreator> controlMessageCreator, TimeSpan serverWaitTime, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			: this(messagingFactory, entityName, sessionId, entityType, receiveMode, prefetchCount, isExclusiveMode: true, null, controlMessageCreator, null, serverWaitTime, timeout, callback, state)
		{
		}

		public AcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult(SbmpMessagingFactory messagingFactory, string entityName, string sessionId, MessagingEntityType? entityType, ReceiveMode receiveMode, int prefetchCount, Lazy<SbmpMessageCreator> controlMessageCreator, RetryPolicy retryPolicy, TimeSpan serverWaitTime, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			: this(messagingFactory, entityName, sessionId, entityType, receiveMode, prefetchCount, isExclusiveMode: true, null, controlMessageCreator, retryPolicy, serverWaitTime, timeout, callback, state)
		{
		}

		public AcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult(SbmpMessagingFactory messagingFactory, string entityName, string sessionId, MessagingEntityType? entityType, ReceiveMode receiveMode, int prefetchCount, bool isExclusiveMode, Guid? lockToken, Lazy<SbmpMessageCreator> controlMessageCreator, RetryPolicy retryPolicy, TimeSpan serverWaitTime, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			: base(callback, state)
		{
			this.prefetchCount = prefetchCount;
			this.sessionId = sessionId;
			this.isExclusiveMode = isExclusiveMode;
			this.lockToken = lockToken;
			MessagingFactory = messagingFactory;
			this.retryPolicy = retryPolicy ?? messagingFactory.RetryPolicy.Clone();
			LinkInfo linkInfo = new LinkInfo
			{
				LinkId = messagingFactory.GetNextLinkId(),
				ConnectionId = messagingFactory.ConnectionId,
				LinkType = LinkType.Receive,
				IsSessionReceiver = true,
				ReceiveMode = receiveMode,
				EntityName = entityName,
				EntityType = entityType
			};
			createLinkSettings = new CreateLinkSettings(messagingFactory, entityName, entityName, linkInfo, controlMessageCreator);
			AcceptMessageSessionCommand acceptMessageSessionCommand = new AcceptMessageSessionCommand
			{
				SessionId = this.sessionId,
				Timeout = serverWaitTime,
				OperationTimeout = timeout,
				PrefetchCount = this.prefetchCount,
				IsExclusiveMode = this.isExclusiveMode,
				LockToken = this.lockToken
			};
			string parentLinkId = null;
			if (createLinkSettings.ControlMessageCreator != null && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(createLinkSettings.ControlMessageCreator.Value.LinkInfo.LinkId))
			{
				parentLinkId = createLinkSettings.ControlMessageCreator.Value.LinkInfo.LinkId;
			}
			RequestInfo requestInfo = new RequestInfo
			{
				ServerTimeout = acceptMessageSessionCommand.Timeout,
				SessionId = acceptMessageSessionCommand.SessionId
			};
			System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message = createLinkSettings.MessageCreator.CreateWcfMessage("http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2011/06/servicebus/SbmpMessageReceiver/AcceptMessageSession", acceptMessageSessionCommand, parentLinkId, this.retryPolicy, null, requestInfo);
			IAsyncResult asyncResult = MessagingFactory.Channel.BeginRequest(message, SbmpProtocolDefaults.BufferTimeout(timeout, MessagingFactory.GetSettings().EnableAdditionalClientTimeout), PrepareAsyncCompletion(operationComplete), this);
			if (SyncContinue(asyncResult))
			{
				Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: true);
			}
		}

		public static MessageSession End(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			AcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult acceptMessageSessionAsyncResult = Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult.End<AcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult>(result);
			return acceptMessageSessionAsyncResult.result;
		}

		private static bool OperationComplete(IAsyncResult asyncResult)
		{
			AcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult acceptMessageSessionAsyncResult = (AcceptMessageSessionAsyncResult)asyncResult.AsyncState;
			System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message = acceptMessageSessionAsyncResult.MessagingFactory.Channel.EndRequest(asyncResult);
			AcceptMessageSessionResponseCommand body = message.GetBody<AcceptMessageSessionResponseCommand>();
			SessionState sessionState = body.SessionState;
			MessageCollection messages = body.Messages;
			DateTime lockedUntilUtc = body.LockedUntilUtc;
			acceptMessageSessionAsyncResult.createLinkSettings.LinkInfo.LinkId = ((body.LinkId != null) ? body.LinkId : acceptMessageSessionAsyncResult.createLinkSettings.LinkInfo.LinkId);
			acceptMessageSessionAsyncResult.createLinkSettings.LinkInfo.SessionId = body.SessionId;
			SbmpMessageReceiver sbmpMessageReceiver = new SbmpMessageReceiver(acceptMessageSessionAsyncResult.createLinkSettings.EntityName, abortLinkOnReceiveTimeout: false, acceptMessageSessionAsyncResult.createLinkSettings.MessagingFactory, acceptMessageSessionAsyncResult.createLinkSettings.MessageCreator, acceptMessageSessionAsyncResult.createLinkSettings.ControlMessageCreator, acceptMessageSessionAsyncResult.createLinkSettings.LinkInfo, embedParentLinkId: true, acceptMessageSessionAsyncResult.retryPolicy, messages);
			sbmpMessageReceiver.Open();
			acceptMessageSessionAsyncResult.result = new SbmpMessageSession(body.SessionId, lockedUntilUtc, sessionState, sbmpMessageReceiver, acceptMessageSessionAsyncResult.isExclusiveMode, body.LockToken);
			acceptMessageSessionAsyncResult.result.PrefetchCount = acceptMessageSessionAsyncResult.prefetchCount;
			return true;
		}
	}

	internal class CloseOrAbortLinkAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<CloseOrAbortLinkAsyncResult>
	{
		private readonly SbmpMessageCreator linkMessageCreator;

		private readonly IRequestSessionChannel channel;

		private readonly ICommunicationObject batchManager;

		private readonly bool aborting;

		private readonly string parentLinkId;

		private System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message closeMessage;

		public CloseOrAbortLinkAsyncResult(SbmpMessageCreator linkMessageCreator, IRequestSessionChannel channel, ICommunicationObject batchManager, TimeSpan closeTimeout, bool aborting, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			: this(linkMessageCreator, channel, batchManager, string.Empty, closeTimeout, aborting, callback, state)
		{
		}

		public CloseOrAbortLinkAsyncResult(SbmpMessageCreator linkMessageCreator, IRequestSessionChannel channel, ICommunicationObject batchManager, string parentLinkId, TimeSpan closeTimeout, bool aborting, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			: base(closeTimeout, callback, state)
		{
			this.linkMessageCreator = linkMessageCreator;
			this.channel = channel;
			this.batchManager = batchManager;
			this.aborting = aborting;
			this.parentLinkId = parentLinkId;
		}

		public void Schedule()
		{
			ActionItem.Schedule(delegate(object s)
			{
				((CloseOrAbortLinkAsyncResult)s).Start();
			}, this);
		}

		protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
		{
			if (batchManager != null)
			{
				if (aborting)
				{
					batchManager.Abort();
				}
				else
				{
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((CloseOrAbortLinkAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.batchManager.BeginClose(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(CloseOrAbortLinkAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult a)
					{
						thisPtr.batchManager.EndClose(a);
					}, (Call)delegate(CloseOrAbortLinkAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t)
					{
						thisPtr.batchManager.Close(t);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
				}
			}
			try
			{
				RequestInfo requestInfo = new RequestInfo
				{
					ServerTimeout = SbmpProtocolDefaults.BufferTimeout(RemainingTime(), enableAdditionalClientTimeout: true)
				};
				closeMessage = linkMessageCreator.CreateWcfMessage("http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2011/06/servicebus/SbmpConnection/CloseLink", new CloseLinkCommand(), parentLinkId, null, null, requestInfo);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
				{
					throw;
				}
				Complete(aborting ? null : ex);
				yield break;
			}
			ExceptionPolicy policy = (ExceptionPolicy)(aborting ? ExceptionPolicy.Continue : ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
			yield return CallAsync((CloseOrAbortLinkAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.channel.BeginRequest(thisPtr.closeMessage, SbmpProtocolDefaults.BufferTimeout(t, enableAdditionalClientTimeout: true), c, s), delegate(CloseOrAbortLinkAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult a)
			{
				thisPtr.channel.EndRequest(a);
			}, policy);
		}
	}

	internal class SbmpMessageCreator
	{
		private readonly SbmpMessagingFactory messagingFactory;

		private readonly Uri baseAddress;

		private readonly Uri logicalAddress;

		private readonly IServiceBusSecuritySettings serviceBusSecuritySettings;

		private readonly MessageVersion messageVersion;

		private readonly LinkInfo linkInfo;

		private readonly bool disableClientOperationTimeBuffer;

		public LinkInfo LinkInfo => linkInfo;

		public bool DisableClientOperationTimeBuffer => disableClientOperationTimeBuffer;

		public SbmpMessageCreator(SbmpMessagingFactory messagingFactory, Uri baseAddress, MessageVersion messageVersion, IServiceBusSecuritySettings serviceBusSecuritySettings, bool disableClientOperationTimeBuffer, Uri logicalAddress)
		{
			if (baseAddress == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new ArgumentNullException("baseAddress"));
			}
			if (logicalAddress == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new ArgumentNullException("logicalAddress"));
			}
			this.messagingFactory = messagingFactory;
			this.baseAddress = baseAddress;
			this.logicalAddress = logicalAddress;
			this.messageVersion = messageVersion;
			this.serviceBusSecuritySettings = serviceBusSecuritySettings;
			this.disableClientOperationTimeBuffer = disableClientOperationTimeBuffer;
		}

		private SbmpMessageCreator(SbmpMessagingFactory messagingFactory, Uri baseAddress, MessageVersion messageVersion, IServiceBusSecuritySettings serviceBusSecuritySettings, bool disableClientOperationTimeBuffer, Uri logicalAddress, LinkInfo linkInfo)
			: this(messagingFactory, baseAddress, messageVersion, serviceBusSecuritySettings, disableClientOperationTimeBuffer, logicalAddress)
		{
			this.linkInfo = linkInfo;
		}

		public SbmpMessageCreator CreateLinkMessageCreator(LinkInfo linkInfo)
		{
			return new SbmpMessageCreator(messagingFactory, baseAddress, messageVersion, serviceBusSecuritySettings, disableClientOperationTimeBuffer, logicalAddress, linkInfo);
		}

		public System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message CreateWcfMessageNoTokenHeader(string action, object body, RequestInfo requestInfo)
		{
			return CreateWcfMessageInternal(action, body, includeToken: false, null, null, null, requestInfo);
		}

		public System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message CreateWcfMessage(string action, object body, RequestInfo requestInfo)
		{
			return CreateWcfMessageInternal(action, body, includeToken: true, null, null, null, requestInfo);
		}

		public System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message CreateWcfMessage(string action, object body, string parentLinkId, RetryPolicy policy, TrackingContext trackingContext, RequestInfo requestInfo)
		{
			return CreateWcfMessageInternal(action, body, includeToken: true, parentLinkId, policy, trackingContext, requestInfo);
		}

		public string GetTokenString()
		{
			return GetAuthorizationHeader(GetSufficientClaims())?.TokenString;
		}

		private System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message CreateWcfMessageInternal(string action, object body, bool includeToken, string parentLinkId, RetryPolicy policy, TrackingContext trackingContext, RequestInfo requestInfo)
		{
			System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message = System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message.CreateMessage(messageVersion, action, body);
			MessageHeaders headers = message.Headers;
			headers.To = logicalAddress;
			string sufficientClaims = GetSufficientClaims();
			if (linkInfo != null)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(linkInfo.TransferDestinationEntityAddress))
				{
					SecurityToken authorizationToken = GetAuthorizationToken(linkInfo.TransferDestinationEntityAddress, sufficientClaims);
					if (authorizationToken is SimpleWebSecurityToken)
					{
						linkInfo.TransferDestinationAuthorizationToken = (authorizationToken as SimpleWebSecurityToken).Token;
					}
					else if (authorizationToken is JsonSecurityToken)
					{
						linkInfo.TransferDestinationAuthorizationToken = (authorizationToken as JsonSecurityToken).Token;
					}
				}
				linkInfo.AddTo(headers);
			}
			if (includeToken)
			{
				ServiceBusAuthorizationHeader authorizationHeader = GetAuthorizationHeader(sufficientClaims);
				if (authorizationHeader != null)
				{
					headers.Add(authorizationHeader);
				}
			}
			if (messagingFactory.FaultInjectionInfo != null)
			{
				messagingFactory.FaultInjectionInfo.AddToHeader(message);
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(parentLinkId))
			{
				message.Properties["ParentLinkId"] = parentLinkId;
			}
			if (trackingContext != null)
			{
				TrackingIdHeader.TryAddOrUpdate(headers, trackingContext.TrackingId);
			}
			message.AddHeaderIfNotNull("RequestInfo", "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2011/06/servicebus", requestInfo);
			return message;
		}

		private string GetSufficientClaims()
		{
			return linkInfo.LinkType switch
			{
				LinkType.Send => "Send", 
				LinkType.Receive => "Listen", 
				LinkType.Control => "Listen", 
				_ => throw new NotImplementedException(SRClient.UnsupportedGetClaim(linkInfo.LinkType)), 
			};
		}

		private SecurityToken GetAuthorizationToken(string appliesTo, string action)
		{
			SecurityToken result = null;
			if (serviceBusSecuritySettings != null && serviceBusSecuritySettings.TokenProvider != null)
			{
				result = serviceBusSecuritySettings.TokenProvider.GetMessagingToken(baseAddress, appliesTo, action, bypassCache: false, Constants.TokenRequestOperationTimeout);
			}
			return result;
		}

		private ServiceBusAuthorizationHeader GetAuthorizationHeader(string action)
		{
			SecurityToken authorizationToken = GetAuthorizationToken(logicalAddress.AbsoluteUri, action);
			if (authorizationToken != null)
			{
				return new ServiceBusAuthorizationHeader(authorizationToken);
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	internal sealed class SbmpMessageReceiver : MessageReceiver
	{
		private sealed class RenewLockAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<RenewLockAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly SbmpMessageReceiver receiver;

			private readonly TrackingContext trackingContext;

			private readonly IEnumerable<Guid> lockTokens;

			private System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message wcfMessage;

			private System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message response;

			public List<DateTime> LockedUntilUtcCollection { get; private set; }

			public RenewLockAsyncResult(SbmpMessageReceiver sbmpMessageReceiver, TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<Guid> lockTokens, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				receiver = sbmpMessageReceiver;
				this.trackingContext = trackingContext;
				this.lockTokens = lockTokens;
				LockedUntilUtcCollection = new List<DateTime>();
				Start();
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				MessageRenewLockCommand messageRenewLockCommand = new MessageRenewLockCommand
				{
					LockTokens = lockTokens,
					Timeout = RemainingTime()
				};
				RequestInfo requestInfo = new RequestInfo
				{
					ServerTimeout = messageRenewLockCommand.Timeout,
					LockToken = ((!receiver.MessageCreator.LinkInfo.IsSessionReceiver && messageRenewLockCommand.LockTokens != null) ? new Guid?(messageRenewLockCommand.LockTokens.FirstOrDefault()) : ((Guid?)null))
				};
				wcfMessage = receiver.MessageCreator.CreateWcfMessage("http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2011/06/servicebus/SbmpMessageReceiver/MessageRenewLock", messageRenewLockCommand, receiver.GetParentLinkId(), receiver.RetryPolicy, trackingContext, requestInfo);
				if (trackingContext != null)
				{
					TraceRenewed(trackingContext, lockTokens);
				}
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((RenewLockAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.receiver.SbmpMessagingFactory.Channel.BeginRequest(thisPtr.wcfMessage, SbmpProtocolDefaults.BufferTimeout(t, receiver.SbmpMessagingFactory.GetSettings().EnableAdditionalClientTimeout), c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(RenewLockAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult a)
				{
					thisPtr.response = thisPtr.receiver.SbmpMessagingFactory.Channel.EndRequest(a);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
				if (response == null)
				{
					yield break;
				}
				MessageRenewLockResponseCommand body = response.GetBody<MessageRenewLockResponseCommand>();
				if (body.LockedUntilUtcs == null)
				{
					yield break;
				}
				foreach (DateTime lockedUntilUtc in body.LockedUntilUtcs)
				{
					LockedUntilUtcCollection.Add(lockedUntilUtc);
				}
			}
		}

		private sealed class ReceiveAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<ReceiveAsyncResult>
		{
			private static readonly TimeSpan MinimumSemaphoreWaitTime = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(500.0);

			private readonly SbmpMessageReceiver receiver;

			private readonly int messageCount;

			private readonly TrackingContext trackingContext;

			private readonly bool abortLinkOnReceiveTimeout;

			private readonly bool shouldThrowTimeout;

			private readonly TimeSpan serverWaitTime;

			private IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages;

			private bool hasReceivedMessages;

			public IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> Messages => messages;

			public ReceiveAsyncResult(SbmpMessageReceiver receiver, TrackingContext trackingContext, int messageCount, bool abortLinkOnReceiveTimeout, bool shouldThrowTimeout, TimeSpan serverWaitTime, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.receiver = receiver;
				this.trackingContext = trackingContext;
				this.messageCount = messageCount;
				this.abortLinkOnReceiveTimeout = abortLinkOnReceiveTimeout;
				this.shouldThrowTimeout = shouldThrowTimeout;
				this.serverWaitTime = serverWaitTime;
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				if (receiver.PrefetchCount > 0)
				{
					TimeSpan semaphoreWaitTime = RemainingTime();
					if (semaphoreWaitTime < MinimumSemaphoreWaitTime)
					{
						semaphoreWaitTime = MinimumSemaphoreWaitTime;
					}
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((ReceiveAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.receiver.prefetchWaitHandle.BeginWait(semaphoreWaitTime, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(ReceiveAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult a)
					{
						thisPtr.receiver.prefetchWaitHandle.EndWait(a);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
					if (base.LastAsyncStepException == null)
					{
						try
						{
							BrokeredMessage message = null;
							if (receiver.TryRemoveFromCache(out message))
							{
								List<BrokeredMessage> list = new List<BrokeredMessage>();
								int num = 0;
								do
								{
									list.Add(message);
									message.IsFromCache = true;
								}
								while (++num < messageCount && receiver.TryRemoveFromCache(out message));
								messages = list;
							}
							else
							{
								yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((ReceiveAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.receiver.BeginReceiveCommand(thisPtr.trackingContext, thisPtr.receiver.PrefetchCount + thisPtr.messageCount, serverWaitTime, thisPtr.receiver.PartitionId, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(ReceiveAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult a)
								{
									thisPtr.hasReceivedMessages = thisPtr.receiver.EndReceiveCommand(a, out thisPtr.messages);
								}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
								if (hasReceivedMessages && messages.Count() > messageCount)
								{
									List<BrokeredMessage> list2 = new List<BrokeredMessage>(messages);
									int num2 = Math.Min(messageCount, list2.Count);
									messages = list2.GetRange(0, num2);
									for (int num3 = num2; num3 < list2.Count; num3++)
									{
										receiver.InsertInCache(list2[num3]);
									}
								}
							}
						}
						finally
						{
							receiver.prefetchWaitHandle.Set();
						}
					}
					if ((base.LastAsyncStepException is TimeoutException || base.LastAsyncStepException is MessagingCommunicationException) && abortLinkOnReceiveTimeout)
					{
						receiver.AbortLink(receiverAborting: false);
					}
					if (shouldThrowTimeout || !(base.LastAsyncStepException is TimeoutException))
					{
						Complete(base.LastAsyncStepException);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((ReceiveAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.receiver.BeginReceiveCommand(thisPtr.trackingContext, thisPtr.receiver.PrefetchCount + thisPtr.messageCount, serverWaitTime, thisPtr.receiver.PartitionId, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(ReceiveAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult a)
					{
						thisPtr.receiver.EndReceiveCommand(a, out thisPtr.messages);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
					if (shouldThrowTimeout || !(base.LastAsyncStepException is TimeoutException))
					{
						Complete(base.LastAsyncStepException);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private sealed class UpdateAsyncResult : SbmpTransactionalAsyncResult<UpdateAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly IEnumerable<Guid> lockTokens;

			private readonly DispositionStatus messageDisposition;

			private readonly SbmpMessageReceiver messageReceiver;

			private readonly TrackingContext trackingContext;

			private readonly DeadLetterInfo deadLetterInfo;

			private readonly IDictionary<string, object> propertiesToModify;

			public UpdateAsyncResult(SbmpMessageReceiver messageReceiver, TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<Guid> lockTokens, IDictionary<string, object> propertiesToModify, DispositionStatus messageDisposition, DeadLetterInfo deadLetterInfo, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(messageReceiver.SbmpMessagingFactory, messageReceiver.MessageCreator, messageReceiver.ControlMessageCreator, timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.messageReceiver = messageReceiver;
				this.trackingContext = trackingContext;
				this.lockTokens = lockTokens;
				this.messageDisposition = messageDisposition;
				this.deadLetterInfo = deadLetterInfo;
				this.propertiesToModify = propertiesToModify;
				Start();
			}

			protected override System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message CreateWcfMessage()
			{
				Transaction transaction = base.Transaction;
				UpdateMessageStateCommand updateMessageStateCommand = new UpdateMessageStateCommand
				{
					LockTokens = lockTokens,
					MessageDisposition = messageDisposition,
					Timeout = RemainingTime(),
					TransactionId = ((transaction != null) ? transaction.TransactionInformation.LocalIdentifier : null),
					DeadLetterInfo = deadLetterInfo,
					PropertiesToModify = propertiesToModify
				};
				RequestInfo requestInfo = new RequestInfo
				{
					ServerTimeout = updateMessageStateCommand.Timeout,
					LockToken = ((!messageReceiver.MessageCreator.LinkInfo.IsSessionReceiver && updateMessageStateCommand.LockTokens != null) ? new Guid?(updateMessageStateCommand.LockTokens.FirstOrDefault()) : ((Guid?)null)),
					TransactionId = updateMessageStateCommand.TransactionId
				};
				System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message result = messageReceiver.MessageCreator.CreateWcfMessage("http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2011/06/servicebus/SbmpMessageReceiver/UpdateMessageState", updateMessageStateCommand, messageReceiver.GetParentLinkId(), messageReceiver.RetryPolicy, trackingContext, requestInfo);
				if (trackingContext != null)
				{
					switch (messageDisposition)
					{
					case DispositionStatus.Abandoned:
						TraceAbandon(trackingContext, lockTokens);
						break;
					case DispositionStatus.Completed:
						TraceComplete(trackingContext, lockTokens);
						break;
					case DispositionStatus.Suspended:
						TraceSuspend(trackingContext, lockTokens);
						break;
					case DispositionStatus.Defered:
						TraceDefer(trackingContext, lockTokens);
						break;
					}
				}
				return result;
			}

			protected override void PartitionInfoSetter(RequestInfo requestInfo)
			{
				requestInfo.LockToken = lockTokens.FirstOrDefault();
			}
		}

		private sealed class AbandonPrefetchedMessagesCloseAbortAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<AbandonPrefetchedMessagesCloseAbortAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly SbmpMessageReceiver receiver;

			public AbandonPrefetchedMessagesCloseAbortAsyncResult(SbmpMessageReceiver receiver, TimeSpan closeTimeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(closeTimeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.receiver = receiver;
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				if (!receiver.prefetchedMessages.IsEmpty)
				{
					if (receiver.Mode == ReceiveMode.PeekLock)
					{
						List<Guid> lockTokens = new List<Guid>();
						BrokeredMessage result;
						while (receiver.prefetchedMessages.TryDequeue(out result))
						{
							lockTokens.Add(result.LockToken);
						}
						yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((AbandonPrefetchedMessagesCloseAbortAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.receiver.BeginAbandon(lockTokens, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(AbandonPrefetchedMessagesCloseAbortAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult a)
						{
							thisPtr.receiver.EndAbandon(a);
						}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
					}
					receiver.DisposePrefetchedMessages();
				}
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((AbandonPrefetchedMessagesCloseAbortAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.receiver.BeginCloseLink(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(AbandonPrefetchedMessagesCloseAbortAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					thisPtr.receiver.EndCloseLink(r);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
			}
		}

		public SbmpMessageReceiver(string path, bool abortLinkOnReceiveTimeout, SbmpMessagingFactory messagingFactory, SbmpMessageCreator messageCreator, Lazy<SbmpMessageCreator> controlMessageCreator, LinkInfo linkInfo, bool embedParentLinkId, RetryPolicy retryPolicy, MessageCollection prefetchMessages)
			: base(messagingFactory, path, linkInfo.EntityType, retryPolicy, linkInfo.ReceiveMode, null)
		{
			SbmpMessagingFactory = messagingFactory;
			this.abortLinkOnReceiveTimeout = abortLinkOnReceiveTimeout;
			MessageCreator = messageCreator;
			this.embedParentLinkId = embedParentLinkId;
			ControlMessageCreator = controlMessageCreator;
			base.InstanceTrackingContext = TrackingContext.Create(Guid.NewGuid(), base.Path);
			LinkInfo = linkInfo;
			BatchManager = new BatchManager<Guid>((TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<Guid> lockTokens, string transactionId, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state) => BeginUpdateCommand(trackingContext, lockTokens, null, DispositionStatus.Completed, null, timeout, callback, state), delegate(IAsyncResult result, bool forceCleanUp)
			{
				EndUpdateCommand(result);
			}, (IEnumerable<Guid> lockTokens) => lockTokens.Count(), IsCompleteRetryable, null, null, Constants.FlushBatchThreshold, Constants.FlushBatchThreshold);
			BatchManager.FlushInterval = SbmpMessagingFactory.Settings.BatchFlushInterval;
			SbmpReceiverBatchingEnabled = SbmpMessagingFactory.Settings.GatewayMode || (!SbmpMessagingFactory.Settings.GatewayMode && SbmpMessagingFactory.Settings.EnableRedirect);
			PrefetchCount = Constants.DefaultPrefetchCount;
			prefetchWaitHandle = new PrefetchAsyncWaitHandle();
			prefetchWaitHandle.Set();
			if (base.Mode == ReceiveMode.PeekLock)
			{
				PrefetchCount = Constants.DefaultPrefetchCount;
			}
			if (prefetchMessages == null || prefetchMessages.Count == 0)
			{
				prefetchedMessages = new ConcurrentQueue<BrokeredMessage>();
				return;
			}
			foreach (BrokeredMessage prefetchMessage in prefetchMessages)
			{
				prefetchMessage.IsFromCache = true;
			}
			PrefetchCount = prefetchMessages.Count;
			prefetchedMessages = new ConcurrentQueue<BrokeredMessage>(prefetchMessages);
		}

		{
			short logicalPartition = ScaledEntityPartitionResolver.LockTokenToEntityLogicalPartition(batchedObjects.First());

			return num;
		}

		internal override void OnRuntimeDescriptionChanged(RuntimeEntityDescription newValue)
		{
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				if (newValue.EnableSubscriptionPartitioning)
				{
					BatchManager.GroupByKeySelector = null;
					SbmpReceiverBatchingEnabled = true;
				}
				else if (newValue.EnableMessagePartitioning)
				{
					BatchManager.GroupByKeySelector = MessagePartitioningGroupByKeySelector;
					SbmpReceiverBatchingEnabled = true;
				}
				else
				{
					BatchManager.GroupByKeySelector = null;
					SbmpReceiverBatchingEnabled = true;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				SbmpReceiverBatchingEnabled = false;
			}
			base.OnRuntimeDescriptionChanged(newValue);
		}

		private IAsyncResult BeginReceiveCommand(TrackingContext trackingContext, int messageCount, TimeSpan serverWaitTime, string partitionId, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			try
			{
				TryReceiveCommand tryReceiveCommand = new TryReceiveCommand
				{
					MessageCount = messageCount,
					Timeout = serverWaitTime,
					OperationTimeout = timeout,
					MessageVersion = BrokeredMessage.MessageVersion
				};
				RequestInfo requestInfo = new RequestInfo
				{
					ServerTimeout = tryReceiveCommand.Timeout,
					OperationTimeout = tryReceiveCommand.OperationTimeout
				};
				System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message = MessageCreator.CreateWcfMessage("http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2011/06/servicebus/SbmpMessageReceiver/TryReceive", tryReceiveCommand, GetParentLinkId(), base.RetryPolicy, trackingContext, requestInfo);
				return SbmpMessagingFactory.Channel.BeginRequest(message, SbmpProtocolDefaults.BufferTimeout(timeout, SbmpMessagingFactory.GetSettings().EnableAdditionalClientTimeout), callback, state);
			}
			catch (CommunicationException exception)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(MessagingExceptionHelper.Unwrap(exception, base.IsClosedOrClosing));
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				if (!Fx.IsFatal(ex) && base.IsClosedOrClosing)
				{
					throw new OperationCanceledException(SRClient.EntityClosedOrAborted, ex);
				}
				throw;
			}
		}

		private string GetParentLinkId()
		{
			if (embedParentLinkId && ControlMessageCreator != null && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ControlMessageCreator.Value.LinkInfo.LinkId))
			{
				return ControlMessageCreator.Value.LinkInfo.LinkId;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private bool EndReceiveCommand(IAsyncResult result, out IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages)
		{
			try
			{
				System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message = SbmpMessagingFactory.Channel.EndRequest(result);
				TryReceiveResponseCommand body = message.GetBody<TryReceiveResponseCommand>();
				bool result2 = body.Result;
				messages = body.Messages;
				if (result2)
				{
					TrackingContext instance = TrackingContext.GetInstance(message, base.Path, appendRole: false);
					TraceReceive(instance, messages);
					if (base.Mode == ReceiveMode.ReceiveAndDelete)
					{
						foreach (BrokeredMessage message2 in messages)
						{
							message2.LockToken = Guid.Empty;
						}
					}
				}
				return result2;
			}
			catch (CommunicationException exception)
			{
				Exception ex = MessagingExceptionHelper.Unwrap(exception, base.IsClosedOrClosing);
				if (ex is TimeoutException)
				{
					if (abortLinkOnReceiveTimeout)
					{
						AbortLink(receiverAborting: false);
					}
					throw ex;
				}
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(ex);
			}
			catch (TimeoutException)
			{
				if (abortLinkOnReceiveTimeout)
				{
					AbortLink(receiverAborting: false);
				}
				throw;
			}
			catch (MessagingCommunicationException)
			{
				if (abortLinkOnReceiveTimeout)
				{
					AbortLink(receiverAborting: false);
				}
				throw;
			}
			catch (Exception ex4)
			{
				if (!Fx.IsFatal(ex4) && base.IsClosedOrClosing)
				{
					throw new OperationCanceledException(SRClient.EntityClosedOrAborted, ex4);
				}
				throw;
			}
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginDefer(TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<Guid> lockTokens, IDictionary<string, object> propertiesToModify, bool fromSync, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return BeginUpdateCommand(trackingContext, lockTokens, propertiesToModify, DispositionStatus.Defered, null, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		protected override void OnEndDefer(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			EndUpdateCommand(result);
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginDeadLetter(TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<Guid> lockTokens, IDictionary<string, object> propertiesToModify, string deadLetterReason, string deadLetterErrorDescription, bool fromSync, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			DeadLetterInfo deadLetterInfo = null;
			if (deadLetterReason != null || deadLetterErrorDescription != null)
			{
				deadLetterInfo = new DeadLetterInfo(deadLetterReason, deadLetterErrorDescription);
			}
			return BeginUpdateCommand(trackingContext, lockTokens, propertiesToModify, DispositionStatus.Suspended, deadLetterInfo, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		protected override void OnEndDeadLetter(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			EndUpdateCommand(result);
		}

		protected sealed override void OnAbort()
		{
			MessagingPerformanceCounters.DecrementEntityCount(base.Address, 1);
			AbortLink(receiverAborting: true);
		}

		private void AbortLink(bool receiverAborting)
		{
			if (!prefetchedMessages.IsEmpty)
			{
				DisposePrefetchedMessages();
			}
			string parentLinkId = string.Empty;
			if (embedParentLinkId && ControlMessageCreator != null && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ControlMessageCreator.Value.LinkInfo.LinkId))
			{
				parentLinkId = ControlMessageCreator.Value.LinkInfo.LinkId;
			}
			CloseOrAbortLinkAsyncResult closeOrAbortLinkAsyncResult = new CloseOrAbortLinkAsyncResult(MessageCreator, SbmpMessagingFactory.Channel, (receiverAborting && base.BatchingEnabled) ? BatchManager : null, parentLinkId, OperationTimeout, aborting: true, receiverAborting ? new AsyncCallback(AbortCallback) : null, null);
			if (receiverAborting)
			{
				closeOrAbortLinkAsyncResult.Schedule();
				return;
			}
			closeOrAbortLinkAsyncResult.Start();
			AsyncResult<CloseOrAbortLinkAsyncResult>.End(closeOrAbortLinkAsyncResult);
		}

		protected sealed override IAsyncResult OnBeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			try
			{
				AbandonPrefetchedMessagesCloseAbortAsyncResult abandonPrefetchedMessagesCloseAbortAsyncResult = new AbandonPrefetchedMessagesCloseAbortAsyncResult(this, timeout, callback, state);
				return abandonPrefetchedMessagesCloseAbortAsyncResult.Start();
			}
			catch (CommunicationException exception)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(MessagingExceptionHelper.Unwrap(exception, isCancelling: false));
			}
		}

		protected sealed override void OnEndClose(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			try
			{
				AsyncResult<AbandonPrefetchedMessagesCloseAbortAsyncResult>.End(result);
				MessagingPerformanceCounters.DecrementEntityCount(base.Address, 1);
			}
			catch (CommunicationException exception)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(MessagingExceptionHelper.Unwrap(exception, isCancelling: false));
			}
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginOpen(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			if (base.BatchingEnabled)
			{
				return BatchManager.BeginOpen(timeout, callback, state);
			}
			return new CompletedAsyncResult(callback, state);
		}

		protected override void OnEndOpen(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (base.BatchingEnabled)
			{
				BatchManager.EndOpen(result);
			}
			else
			{
				CompletedAsyncResult.End(result);
			}
			MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementEntityCount(base.Address, 1);
			SbmpMessagingFactory.ScheduleGetRuntimeEntityDescription(TrackingContext.Create(Guid.NewGuid()), this, base.Path, MessageCreator);
		}

		private static void AbortCallback(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			AsyncResult<CloseOrAbortLinkAsyncResult>.End(result);
		}

		private static bool IsCompleteRetryable(IEnumerable<Guid> lockTokens, Exception exception, bool isMultiBatchCommand)
		{
			return false;
		}

		private static string GetFormattedLockToken(IEnumerable<Guid> lockTokens)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			foreach (Guid lockToken in lockTokens)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendLine(string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "<LockToken>{0}</LockToken>", lockToken));
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		private void ClearEntityDescriptionAndSetRefreshFlagIfNecessary(string exceptionMessage, string entityAddress)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(exceptionMessage) && (exceptionMessage.StartsWith(SRClient.UnsupportedBatchingSequenceNumbersForDistinctPartitions, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || exceptionMessage.StartsWith(SRClient.MessagingPartitioningUnsupportedBatchingLockTockens, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
			{
				RuntimeEntityDescriptionCache.CheckLastRefreshAndTryRemove(entityAddress);
				base.RefreshEntityRuntimeDescription = true;
			}
		}

		private IAsyncResult BeginCloseLink(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			string parentLinkId = string.Empty;
			if (embedParentLinkId && ControlMessageCreator != null && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ControlMessageCreator.Value.LinkInfo.LinkId))
			{
				parentLinkId = ControlMessageCreator.Value.LinkInfo.LinkId;
			}
			return new CloseOrAbortLinkAsyncResult(MessageCreator, SbmpMessagingFactory.Channel, base.BatchingEnabled ? BatchManager : null, parentLinkId, timeout, aborting: false, callback, state).Start();
		}

		private void EndCloseLink(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			AsyncResult<CloseOrAbortLinkAsyncResult>.End(result);
		}

		private string GetFormattedMessageId(IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			foreach (BrokeredMessage message in messages)
			{
				if (base.Mode == ReceiveMode.PeekLock)
				{
					stringBuilder.AppendLine(string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "<MessageId>{0}</MessageId>, <LockToken>{1}</LockToken>", message.MessageId, message.LockToken));
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder.AppendLine(string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "<MessageId>{0}</MessageId>", message.MessageId));
				}
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		[Conditional("CLIENT")]

			MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteMessageReceived(requestTracker.Activity, requestTracker.TrackingId, requestTracker.SystemTracker, SRClient.SbmpTransport, formattedMessageId);
			});
		}
