		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginComplete(TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<Guid> lockTokens, bool fromSync, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object asyncState)
		{
			try
			{
				if (Transaction.Current == null && !fromSync && base.BatchingEnabled && SbmpReceiverBatchingEnabled)
				{
					return new BatchManagerAsyncResult<Guid>(trackingContext, BatchManager, lockTokens, timeout, callback, asyncState);
				}
			}
			catch (CommunicationObjectAbortedException innerException)
			{
				throw new OperationCanceledException(SRClient.EntityClosedOrAborted, innerException);
			}
			return BeginUpdateCommand(trackingContext, lockTokens, null, DispositionStatus.Completed, null, timeout, callback, asyncState);
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginComplete(TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<ArraySegment<byte>> deliveryTags, bool fromSync, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException("The NetMessaging protocol does not support EventData related operations.");
		}

		private IAsyncResult BeginUpdateCommand(TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<Guid> lockTokens, IDictionary<string, object> propertiesToModify, DispositionStatus disposition, DeadLetterInfo deadLetterInfo, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object asyncState)
		{
			try
			{
				return new UpdateAsyncResult(this, trackingContext, lockTokens, propertiesToModify, disposition, deadLetterInfo, timeout, callback, asyncState);
			}
			catch (CommunicationException exception)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(MessagingExceptionHelper.Unwrap(exception, base.IsClosedOrClosing));
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				if (!Fx.IsFatal(ex) && base.IsClosedOrClosing)
				{
					throw new OperationCanceledException(SRClient.EntityClosedOrAborted, ex);
				}
				if (ex is InvalidOperationException)
				{
					ClearEntityDescriptionAndSetRefreshFlagIfNecessary(ex.Message, SbmpMessagingFactory.BaseAddress.AbsoluteUri + base.Path);
				}
				throw;
			}
		}

		private void EndUpdateCommand(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			try
			{
				AsyncResult<UpdateAsyncResult>.End(result);
			}
			catch (CommunicationException exception)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(MessagingExceptionHelper.Unwrap(exception, base.IsClosedOrClosing));
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				if (!Fx.IsFatal(ex) && base.IsClosedOrClosing)
				{
					throw new OperationCanceledException(SRClient.EntityClosedOrAborted, ex);
				}
				if (ex is InvalidOperationException)
				{
					ClearEntityDescriptionAndSetRefreshFlagIfNecessary(ex.Message, SbmpMessagingFactory.BaseAddress.AbsoluteUri + base.Path);
				}
				throw;
			}
		}

		private void InsertInCache(BrokeredMessage message)
		{
			prefetchedMessages.Enqueue(message);
		}

		private bool TryRemoveFromCache(out BrokeredMessage message)
		{
			return prefetchedMessages.TryDequeue(out message);
		}

		private void DisposePrefetchedMessages()
		{
			BrokeredMessage result;
			while (prefetchedMessages.TryDequeue(out result))
			{
				result.Dispose();
			}
		}

		internal override IAsyncResult OnBeginGetRuntimeEntityDescriptionAsyncResult(TrackingContext trackingContext, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new GetRuntimeEntityDescriptionAsyncResult(trackingContext, this, SbmpMessagingFactory.BaseAddress.AbsoluteUri + base.Path, SbmpMessagingFactory, MessageCreator, executeOnce: true, timeout, callback, state).Start();
		}

		internal override RuntimeEntityDescription OnEndGetRuntimeEntityDescriptionAsyncResult(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			return GetRuntimeEntityDescriptionAsyncResult.End(result);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class SbmpMessageSender : MessageSender
	{
		private sealed class SendCommandAsyncResult : SbmpTransactionalAsyncResult<SendCommandAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages;

			private readonly SbmpMessageSender messageSender;

			private readonly TrackingContext trackingContext;

			private readonly EventTraceActivity relatedActivity;

			public SendCommandAsyncResult(SbmpMessageSender messageSender, TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(messageSender.SbmpMessagingFactory, messageSender.MessageCreator, (Lazy<SbmpMessageCreator>)null, timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.messageSender = messageSender;
				this.trackingContext = trackingContext;
				this.messages = messages;
				relatedActivity = EventTraceActivity.CreateFromThread();
				Start();
			}

			protected override System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message CreateWcfMessage()
			{
				Transaction transaction = base.Transaction;
				SendCommand sendCommand = new SendCommand
				{
					Messages = MessageCollection.Wrap(messages),
					Timeout = RemainingTime(),
					TransactionId = ((transaction != null) ? transaction.TransactionInformation.LocalIdentifier : null)
				};
				RequestInfo requestInfo = new RequestInfo
				{
					ServerTimeout = sendCommand.Timeout,
					TransactionId = sendCommand.TransactionId
				};
				messageSender.AddRequestInfoHeader(requestInfo, messages);
				if (trackingContext != null)
				{
					TraceSend(relatedActivity, trackingContext, messages);
				}
				return base.MessageCreator.CreateWcfMessage("http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2011/06/servicebus/SbmpMessageSender/Send", sendCommand, null, messageSender.RetryPolicy, trackingContext, requestInfo);
			}

			protected override void PartitionInfoSetter(RequestInfo requestInfo)
			{
				if (messageSender.ViaSender)
				{
					requestInfo.ViaPartitionKey = (from bm in messages
						where bm.ViaPartitionKey != null
						select bm.ViaPartitionKey).FirstOrDefault();
					return;
				}
				requestInfo.SessionId = (from bm in messages
					where bm.SessionId != null
					select bm.SessionId).FirstOrDefault();
				requestInfo.PartitionKey = (from bm in messages
					where bm.PartitionKey != null
					select bm.PartitionKey).FirstOrDefault();
				requestInfo.MessageId = (from bm in messages
					where bm.MessageId != null
					select bm.MessageId).FirstOrDefault();
			}
		}

		private sealed class ScheduleMessageCommandAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<ScheduleMessageCommandAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages;

			private readonly SbmpMessageSender messageSender;

			private readonly TrackingContext trackingContext;

			private readonly EventTraceActivity relatedActivity;

			private System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message wcfMessage;

			private System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message response;

			public List<long> SequenceNumbers { get; private set; }

			public ScheduleMessageCommandAsyncResult(SbmpMessageSender messageSender, TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.messageSender = messageSender;
				this.trackingContext = trackingContext;
				this.messages = messages;
				relatedActivity = EventTraceActivity.CreateFromThread();
				SequenceNumbers = new List<long>();
				Start();
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				ScheduleMessageCommand scheduleMessageCommand = new ScheduleMessageCommand
				{
					Messages = MessageCollection.Wrap(messages),
					Timeout = RemainingTime(),
					TransactionId = null
				};
				RequestInfo requestInfo = new RequestInfo
				{
					ServerTimeout = scheduleMessageCommand.Timeout,
					TransactionId = scheduleMessageCommand.TransactionId
				};
				messageSender.AddRequestInfoHeader(requestInfo, messages);
				if (trackingContext != null)
				{
					TraceSend(relatedActivity, trackingContext, messages);
				}
				wcfMessage = messageSender.MessageCreator.CreateWcfMessage("http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2011/06/servicebus/SbmpMessageSender/ScheduleMessage", scheduleMessageCommand, null, messageSender.RetryPolicy, trackingContext, requestInfo);
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((ScheduleMessageCommandAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.messageSender.SbmpMessagingFactory.Channel.BeginRequest(thisPtr.wcfMessage, thisPtr.OriginalTimeout, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(ScheduleMessageCommandAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult a)
				{
					thisPtr.response = thisPtr.messageSender.SbmpMessagingFactory.Channel.EndRequest(a);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
				ScheduleMessageResponseCommand body = response.GetBody<ScheduleMessageResponseCommand>();
				if (body.SequenceNumbers == null)
				{
					yield break;
				}
				foreach (long sequenceNumber in body.SequenceNumbers)
				{
					SequenceNumbers.Add(sequenceNumber);
				}
			}
		}

		private sealed class CancelScheduledMessageCommandAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<CancelScheduledMessageCommandAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly IEnumerable<long> sequenceNumbers;

			private readonly SbmpMessageSender messageSender;

			private readonly TrackingContext trackingContext;

			private readonly EventTraceActivity relatedActivity;

			private System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message wcfMessage;

			public CancelScheduledMessageCommandAsyncResult(SbmpMessageSender messageSender, TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<long> sequenceNumbers, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.messageSender = messageSender;
				this.trackingContext = trackingContext;
				this.sequenceNumbers = sequenceNumbers;
				relatedActivity = EventTraceActivity.CreateFromThread();
				Start();
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				CancelScheduledMessageCommand cancelScheduledMessageCommand = new CancelScheduledMessageCommand
				{
					SequenceNumbers = sequenceNumbers,
					Timeout = RemainingTime(),
					TransactionId = null
				};
				RequestInfo requestInfo = new RequestInfo
				{
					ServerTimeout = cancelScheduledMessageCommand.Timeout,
					TransactionId = cancelScheduledMessageCommand.TransactionId
				};
				requestInfo.SequenceNumber = sequenceNumbers.First();
				if (trackingContext != null)
				{
					TraceCancel(relatedActivity, trackingContext, sequenceNumbers);
				}
				wcfMessage = messageSender.MessageCreator.CreateWcfMessage("http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2011/06/servicebus/SbmpMessageSender/CancelScheduledMessage", cancelScheduledMessageCommand, null, messageSender.RetryPolicy, trackingContext, requestInfo);
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((CancelScheduledMessageCommandAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.messageSender.SbmpMessagingFactory.Channel.BeginRequest(thisPtr.wcfMessage, thisPtr.OriginalTimeout, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(CancelScheduledMessageCommandAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					thisPtr.messageSender.SbmpMessagingFactory.Channel.EndRequest(r);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
			}
		}

		private const int SendBatchSizeThreshold = 204800;

		private const int MaximumAllowedSendBatchSize = 225280;

		private readonly bool viaSender;

		public override TimeSpan BatchFlushInterval
		{
			get
			{
				return BatchManager.FlushInterval;
			}
			internal set
			{
				ThrowIfDisposedOrImmutable();
				BatchManager.FlushInterval = value;
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool SupportsGetRuntimeEntityDescription => !SbmpMessagingFactory.Settings.GatewayMode;

		internal override bool ViaSender => viaSender;

		internal SbmpMessagingFactory SbmpMessagingFactory { get; private set; }

		internal SbmpMessageCreator MessageCreator { get; private set; }

		internal bool SbmpSenderBatchingEnabled { get; private set; }

		internal BatchManager<BrokeredMessage> BatchManager { get; private set; }

		internal bool EnableMessagePartitioning { get; private set; }

		internal bool EnableSubscriptionPartitioning { get; private set; }

		internal bool RequiresDuplicateDetection { get; private set; }

		internal bool ShouldAddPartitioningHeaders { get; private set; }

		public SbmpMessageSender(string path, MessagingEntityType? entityType, SbmpMessagingFactory messagingFactory, SbmpMessageCreator messageCreator, RetryPolicy retryPolicy)
			: base(messagingFactory, path, entityType, retryPolicy)
		{
			SbmpMessagingFactory = messagingFactory;
			MessageCreator = messageCreator;
			viaSender = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(messageCreator.LinkInfo.TransferDestinationEntityAddress);
			BatchManager = new BatchManager<BrokeredMessage>((TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages, string transactionId, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state) => BeginSendCommand(trackingContext, messages, timeout, callback, state), delegate(IAsyncResult result, bool forceCleanUp)
			{
				EndSendCommand(result);
			}, null, IsSendCommandRetryable, null, null, 204800L, 225280L, GetOverheadSize());
			BatchManager.FlushInterval = SbmpMessagingFactory.Settings.BatchFlushInterval;
			if (SbmpMessagingFactory.Settings.GatewayMode || (!SbmpMessagingFactory.Settings.GatewayMode && SbmpMessagingFactory.Settings.EnableRedirect))
			{
				BatchManager.CalculateBatchSize = DefaultCalculateSizeOfMessages;
				SbmpSenderBatchingEnabled = true;
				ShouldAddPartitioningHeaders = false;
			}
			else
			{
				ShouldAddPartitioningHeaders = true;
			}
		}

		internal IComparable MessagePartitioningKeyGroupByKeySelector(IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> batchedObjects)
		{
			BrokeredMessage brokeredMessage = batchedObjects.First();
			string partitionTag = brokeredMessage.SessionId ?? brokeredMessage.PartitionKey;
			int num = ScaledEntityPartitionResolver.ResolveToEntityPhysicalPartition(RuntimeEntityDescription.PartitionCount, RuntimeEntityDescription.PartitionRanges, partitionTag);
			return num;
		}

		internal IComparable DeDupMessagePartitioningKeyGroupByKeySelector(IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> batchedObjects)
		{
			BrokeredMessage brokeredMessage = batchedObjects.First();
			object obj = brokeredMessage.SessionId ?? brokeredMessage.PartitionKey;
			if (obj == null)
			{
				obj = brokeredMessage.MessageId;
			}
			string partitionTag = (string)obj;
			int num = ScaledEntityPartitionResolver.ResolveToEntityPhysicalPartition(RuntimeEntityDescription.PartitionCount, RuntimeEntityDescription.PartitionRanges, partitionTag);
			return num;
		}

		internal IComparable ViaSenderMessagePartitioningKeyGroupByKeySelector(IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> batchedObjects)
		{
			BrokeredMessage brokeredMessage = batchedObjects.First();
			string viaPartitionKey = brokeredMessage.ViaPartitionKey;
			int num = ScaledEntityPartitionResolver.ResolveToEntityPhysicalPartition(RuntimeEntityDescription.PartitionCount, RuntimeEntityDescription.PartitionRanges, viaPartitionKey);
			return num;
		}

		internal IComparable SubscriptionPartitioningGroupByKeySelector(IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> batchedObjects)
		{
			BrokeredMessage brokeredMessage = batchedObjects.First();
			object obj = brokeredMessage.Destination ?? brokeredMessage.SessionId;
			if (obj == null)
			{
				obj = brokeredMessage.PartitionKey;
			}
			string partitionTag = (string)obj;
			int num = ScaledEntityPartitionResolver.ResolveToEntityPhysicalPartition(RuntimeEntityDescription.PartitionCount, RuntimeEntityDescription.PartitionRanges, partitionTag);
			return num;
		}

		internal void AddRequestInfoHeader(RequestInfo requestInfo, IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages)
		{
			if (EnableSubscriptionPartitioning)
			{
				requestInfo.SessionId = (from bm in messages
					where bm.SessionId != null
					select bm.SessionId).FirstOrDefault();
				requestInfo.PartitionKey = (from bm in messages
					where bm.PartitionKey != null
					select bm.PartitionKey).FirstOrDefault();
				requestInfo.Destination = (from bm in messages
					where bm.Destination != null
					select bm.Destination).FirstOrDefault();
			}
			else if (EnableMessagePartitioning)
			{
				if (ViaSender)
				{
					requestInfo.ViaPartitionKey = (from bm in messages
						where bm.ViaPartitionKey != null
						select bm.ViaPartitionKey).FirstOrDefault();
				}
				else if (RequiresDuplicateDetection)
				{
					requestInfo.SessionId = (from bm in messages
						where bm.SessionId != null
						select bm.SessionId).FirstOrDefault();
					requestInfo.PartitionKey = (from bm in messages
						where bm.PartitionKey != null
						select bm.PartitionKey).FirstOrDefault();
					requestInfo.MessageId = (from bm in messages
						where bm.MessageId != null
						select bm.MessageId).FirstOrDefault();
				}
				else
				{
					requestInfo.SessionId = (from bm in messages
						where bm.SessionId != null
						select bm.SessionId).FirstOrDefault();
					requestInfo.PartitionKey = (from bm in messages
						where bm.PartitionKey != null
						select bm.PartitionKey).FirstOrDefault();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (!ShouldAddPartitioningHeaders)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (ViaSender)
				{
					requestInfo.ViaPartitionKey = (from bm in messages
						where bm.ViaPartitionKey != null
						select bm.ViaPartitionKey).FirstOrDefault();
					return;
				}
				requestInfo.SessionId = (from bm in messages
					where bm.SessionId != null
					select bm.SessionId).FirstOrDefault();
				requestInfo.PartitionKey = (from bm in messages
					where bm.PartitionKey != null
					select bm.PartitionKey).FirstOrDefault();
				requestInfo.MessageId = (from bm in messages
					where bm.MessageId != null
					select bm.MessageId).FirstOrDefault();
				requestInfo.Destination = (from bm in messages
					where bm.Destination != null
					select bm.Destination).FirstOrDefault();
			}
		}

		internal override void OnRuntimeDescriptionChanged(RuntimeEntityDescription newValue)
		{
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				RequiresDuplicateDetection = newValue.RequiresDuplicateDetection;
				if (newValue.EnableSubscriptionPartitioning)
				{
					EnableSubscriptionPartitioning = true;
					EnableMessagePartitioning = false;
					ShouldAddPartitioningHeaders = true;
					BatchManager.GroupByKeySelector = SubscriptionPartitioningGroupByKeySelector;
					BatchManager.CalculateBatchSize = SubscriptionPartitioningCalculateSizeOfMessages;
					SbmpSenderBatchingEnabled = true;
				}
				else if (newValue.EnableMessagePartitioning)
				{
					EnableMessagePartitioning = true;
					EnableSubscriptionPartitioning = false;
					ShouldAddPartitioningHeaders = true;
					if (ViaSender)
					{
						BatchManager.GroupByKeySelector = ViaSenderMessagePartitioningKeyGroupByKeySelector;
						BatchManager.CalculateBatchSize = ViaSenderMessagePartitioningCalculateSizeOfMessages;
					}
					else if (newValue.RequiresDuplicateDetection)
					{
						BatchManager.GroupByKeySelector = DeDupMessagePartitioningKeyGroupByKeySelector;
						BatchManager.CalculateBatchSize = DeDupMessagePartitioningCalculateSizeOfMessages;
					}
					else
					{
						BatchManager.GroupByKeySelector = MessagePartitioningKeyGroupByKeySelector;
						BatchManager.CalculateBatchSize = MessagePartitioningCalculateSizeOfMessages;
					}
					SbmpSenderBatchingEnabled = true;
				}
				else
				{
					EnableMessagePartitioning = false;
					EnableSubscriptionPartitioning = false;
					ShouldAddPartitioningHeaders = false;
					BatchManager.GroupByKeySelector = null;
					BatchManager.CalculateBatchSize = DefaultCalculateSizeOfMessages;
					SbmpSenderBatchingEnabled = true;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				SbmpSenderBatchingEnabled = false;
			}
			base.OnRuntimeDescriptionChanged(newValue);
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginSend(TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages, bool fromSync, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			if (Transaction.Current == null && !fromSync && base.BatchingEnabled && SbmpSenderBatchingEnabled)
			{
				return new BatchManagerAsyncResult<BrokeredMessage>(trackingContext, BatchManager, messages, timeout, callback, state);
			}
			return BeginSendCommand(trackingContext, messages, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		protected override void OnEndSend(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			try
			{
				if (result is BatchManagerAsyncResult<BrokeredMessage>)
				{
					BatchManagerAsyncResult<BrokeredMessage>.End(result);
				}
				else
				{
					EndSendCommand(result);
				}
			}
			catch (CommunicationException exception)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(MessagingExceptionHelper.Unwrap(exception, base.IsClosedOrClosing));
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				if (!Fx.IsFatal(ex) && base.IsClosedOrClosing)
				{
					throw new OperationCanceledException(SRClient.EntityClosedOrAborted, ex);
				}
				if (ex is InvalidOperationException)
				{
					ClearEntityDescriptionAndSetRefreshFlagIfNecessary(ex.Message, SbmpMessagingFactory.BaseAddress.AbsoluteUri + base.Path);
				}
				throw;
			}
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginSendEventData(TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<EventData> eventDatas, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		protected override void OnEndSendEventData(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			OnEndSend(result);
		}

		protected override void OnAbort()
		{
			MessagingPerformanceCounters.DecrementEntityCount(base.Address, 1);
			CloseOrAbortLinkAsyncResult closeOrAbortLinkAsyncResult = new CloseOrAbortLinkAsyncResult(MessageCreator, SbmpMessagingFactory.Channel, base.BatchingEnabled ? BatchManager : null, OperationTimeout, aborting: true, AbortCallback, null);
			closeOrAbortLinkAsyncResult.Schedule();
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			try
			{
				return new CloseOrAbortLinkAsyncResult(MessageCreator, SbmpMessagingFactory.Channel, base.BatchingEnabled ? BatchManager : null, timeout, aborting: false, callback, state).Start();
			}
			catch (CommunicationException exception)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(MessagingExceptionHelper.Unwrap(exception, isCancelling: false));
			}
		}

		protected override void OnEndClose(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			try
			{
				AsyncResult<CloseOrAbortLinkAsyncResult>.End(result);
				MessagingPerformanceCounters.DecrementEntityCount(base.Address, 1);
			}
			catch (CommunicationException exception)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(MessagingExceptionHelper.Unwrap(exception, isCancelling: false));
			}
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginOpen(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			if (base.BatchingEnabled)
			{
				return BatchManager.BeginOpen(timeout, callback, state);
			}
			return new CompletedAsyncResult(callback, state);
		}

		protected override void OnEndOpen(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (base.BatchingEnabled)
			{
				BatchManager.EndOpen(result);
			}
			else
			{
				CompletedAsyncResult.End(result);
			}
			MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementEntityCount(base.Address, 1);
			SbmpMessagingFactory.ScheduleGetRuntimeEntityDescription(TrackingContext.Create(Guid.NewGuid()), this, base.Path, MessageCreator);
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginScheduleMessage(TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			try
			{
				return new ScheduleMessageCommandAsyncResult(this, trackingContext, messages, timeout, callback, state);
			}
			catch (CommunicationException exception)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(MessagingExceptionHelper.Unwrap(exception, base.IsClosedOrClosing));
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				if (!Fx.IsFatal(ex) && base.IsClosedOrClosing)
				{
					throw new OperationCanceledException(SRClient.EntityClosedOrAborted, ex);
				}
				if (ex is InvalidOperationException)
				{
					ClearEntityDescriptionAndSetRefreshFlagIfNecessary(ex.Message, SbmpMessagingFactory.BaseAddress.AbsoluteUri + base.Path);
				}
				throw;
			}
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<long> OnEndScheduleMessage(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			try
			{
				return AsyncResult<ScheduleMessageCommandAsyncResult>.End(result).SequenceNumbers;
			}
			catch (CommunicationException exception)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(MessagingExceptionHelper.Unwrap(exception, base.IsClosedOrClosing));
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				if (!Fx.IsFatal(ex) && base.IsClosedOrClosing)
				{
					throw new OperationCanceledException(SRClient.EntityClosedOrAborted, ex);
				}
				if (ex is InvalidOperationException)
				{
					ClearEntityDescriptionAndSetRefreshFlagIfNecessary(ex.Message, SbmpMessagingFactory.BaseAddress.AbsoluteUri + base.Path);

		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginCancelScheduledMessage(TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<long> sequenceNumbers, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{

		protected override void OnEndCancelScheduledMessage(IAsyncResult result)

			{
				if (!Fx.IsFatal(ex) && base.IsClosedOrClosing)

				}
				throw;
			}
		}

		internal override IAsyncResult OnBeginGetRuntimeEntityDescriptionAsyncResult(TrackingContext trackingContext, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new GetRuntimeEntityDescriptionAsyncResult(trackingContext, this, SbmpMessagingFactory.BaseAddress.AbsoluteUri + base.Path, SbmpMessagingFactory, MessageCreator, executeOnce: true, timeout, callback, state).Start();
		}

		internal override RuntimeEntityDescription OnEndGetRuntimeEntityDescriptionAsyncResult(IAsyncResult result)
		{

		}

		private static void AbortCallback(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			AsyncResult<CloseOrAbortLinkAsyncResult>.End(result);
		}

		private static string GetFormattedMessageId(IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			foreach (BrokeredMessage message in messages)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendLine(string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "<MessageId>{0}</MessageId>", message.MessageId));
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		private static string GetFormattedSequenceNumbers(IEnumerable<long> sequenceNumbers)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			foreach (long sequenceNumber in sequenceNumbers)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendLine(string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "<SequenceNumber>{0}</SequenceNumber>", sequenceNumber));
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		internal static int DefaultCalculateSizeOfMessages(IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages)
		{
			long num = 0L;
			foreach (BrokeredMessage message in messages)
			{
				num += message.GetSerializedSize(SerializationTarget.Communication);
			}
			return (int)num;
		}

		internal static int MessagePartitioningCalculateSizeOfMessages(IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages)
		{
			long num = 0L;
			foreach (BrokeredMessage message in messages)
			{
				num += message.GetSerializedSize(SerializationTarget.Communication);
				if (message.SessionId != null)
				{
					num += Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(message.SessionId).Length;
				}
				else if (message.PartitionKey != null)
				{
					num += Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(message.PartitionKey).Length;
				}
			}
			return (int)num;
		}

		internal static int DeDupMessagePartitioningCalculateSizeOfMessages(IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages)
		{
			long num = 0L;
			foreach (BrokeredMessage message in messages)
			{
				num += message.GetSerializedSize(SerializationTarget.Communication);
				if (message.SessionId != null)
				{
					num += Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(message.SessionId).Length;
				}
				else if (message.PartitionKey != null)
				{
					num += Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(message.PartitionKey).Length;
				}
				else if (message.MessageId != null)
				{
					num += Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(message.MessageId).Length;
				}
			}
			return (int)num;
		}

		internal static int ViaSenderMessagePartitioningCalculateSizeOfMessages(IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages)
		{
			long num = 0L;
			foreach (BrokeredMessage message in messages)
			{
				num += message.GetSerializedSize(SerializationTarget.Communication);
				if (message.ViaPartitionKey != null)
				{
					num += Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(message.ViaPartitionKey).Length;
				}
			}
			return (int)num;
		}

		internal static int SubscriptionPartitioningCalculateSizeOfMessages(IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages)
		{
			long num = 0L;
			foreach (BrokeredMessage message in messages)
			{
				num += message.GetSerializedSize(SerializationTarget.Communication);
				if (message.Destination != null)
				{
					num += Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(message.Destination).Length;
				}
			}
			return (int)num;
		}

		private static void TraceSend(EventTraceActivity fromActivity, TrackingContext requestTracker, IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages)
		{
			if (fromActivity != null && fromActivity != EventTraceActivity.Empty)
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.MessageSendingTransfer(fromActivity, requestTracker.Activity);
				});
			}
			string formattedMessageId = GetFormattedMessageId(messages);
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteMessageSending(requestTracker.Activity, requestTracker.TrackingId, requestTracker.SystemTracker, SRClient.SbmpTransport, formattedMessageId);
			});
		}

		private static void TraceCancel(EventTraceActivity fromActivity, TrackingContext requestTracker, IEnumerable<long> sequenceNumbers)
		{
			if (fromActivity != null && fromActivity != EventTraceActivity.Empty)
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.MessageSendingTransfer(fromActivity, requestTracker.Activity);
				});
			}
			string formattedSequenceNumbers = GetFormattedSequenceNumbers(sequenceNumbers);
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteMessageCanceling(requestTracker.Activity, requestTracker.TrackingId, requestTracker.SystemTracker, SRClient.SbmpTransport, formattedSequenceNumbers);
			});
		}

		private void ClearEntityDescriptionAndSetRefreshFlagIfNecessary(string exceptionMessage, string entityAddress)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(exceptionMessage) && (exceptionMessage.StartsWith(SRClient.UnsupportedDeDupBatchingDistinctPartitionKey, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || exceptionMessage.StartsWith(SRClient.UnsupportedBatchingDistinctPartitionKey, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || exceptionMessage.StartsWith(SRClient.PartitionedEntityViaSenderNeedsViaPatitionKey, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || exceptionMessage.StartsWith(SRClient.TransactionPartitionKeyMissing, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
			{
				RuntimeEntityDescriptionCache.CheckLastRefreshAndTryRemove(entityAddress);
				base.RefreshEntityRuntimeDescription = true;
			}
		}

		private int GetOverheadSize()
		{
			long num = 0L;
			using (MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream(1024))
			{
				BrokeredMessage brokeredMessage = new BrokeredMessage();
				BrokeredMessage brokeredMessage2 = new BrokeredMessage();
				SendCommand sendCommand = new SendCommand();
				sendCommand.Messages = new MessageCollection(new BrokeredMessage[2] { brokeredMessage, brokeredMessage2 });
				sendCommand.Timeout = TimeSpan.MaxValue;
				sendCommand.TransactionId = new string('A', 32);
				SendCommand sendCommand2 = sendCommand;
				RequestInfo requestInfo = new RequestInfo
				{
					ServerTimeout = sendCommand2.Timeout,
					OperationTimeout = sendCommand2.Timeout,
					MessageId = Guid.NewGuid().ToString(),
					SessionId = Guid.NewGuid().ToString(),
					PartitionKey = Guid.NewGuid().ToString(),
					ViaPartitionKey = Guid.NewGuid().ToString(),
					TransactionId = Guid.NewGuid().ToString(),
					Destination = Guid.NewGuid().ToString()
				};
				using (System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message = MessageCreator.CreateWcfMessage("http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2011/06/servicebus/SbmpMessageSender/Send", sendCommand2, null, base.RetryPolicy, TrackingContext.Create(Guid.NewGuid(), null), requestInfo))
				{
					MessageEncoder encoder = new BinaryMessageEncodingBindingElement().CreateMessageEncoderFactory().Encoder;
					encoder.WriteMessage(message, memoryStream);
				}
				memoryStream.Flush();
				num = memoryStream.Length;
				num -= brokeredMessage.Size + brokeredMessage2.Size;
				num += 512;
				brokeredMessage.Dispose();
				brokeredMessage2.Dispose();
			}
			return (int)num;
		}

		private static bool IsSendCommandRetryable(IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages, Exception exception, bool isMultiCommandBatch)
		{
			foreach (BrokeredMessage message in messages)
			{
				Stream bodyStream = message.BodyStream;
				if (bodyStream != null && !bodyStream.CanSeek)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (bodyStream != null)
				{
					bodyStream.Position = 0L;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	internal sealed class SbmpMessagingFactory : MessagingFactory
	{
		private sealed class OpenAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<OpenAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly SbmpMessagingFactory factory;

			private InternalConnectivityMode Mode { get; set; }

			public OpenAsyncResult(SbmpMessagingFactory factory, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.factory = factory;
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				if (factory.ShouldIntialize)
				{
					List<Uri> physicalAddresses = factory.baseAddresses;
					if (factory.Settings.Via != null)
					{
						physicalAddresses = new List<Uri> { factory.Settings.Via };
					}
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((OpenAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => NetworkDetector.BeginCheckConnectivity(physicalAddresses, SbmpProtocolDefaults.BufferTimeout(t, thisPtr.factory.GetSettings().EnableAdditionalClientTimeout), c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(OpenAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.Mode = NetworkDetector.EndCheckConnectivity(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
					SbmpProtocolDefaults.SbmpConnectionProtocol protocol = SbmpProtocolDefaults.SbmpConnectionProtocol.WebStreamHttp;
					switch (Mode)
					{
					case InternalConnectivityMode.Tcp:
						protocol = SbmpProtocolDefaults.SbmpConnectionProtocol.Tcp;
						break;
					case InternalConnectivityMode.Http:
					case InternalConnectivityMode.Https:
					case InternalConnectivityMode.HttpsWebSocket:
						protocol = SbmpProtocolDefaults.SbmpConnectionProtocol.WebSocket;
						break;
					}
					factory.Initialize(protocol, physicalAddresses);
				}
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((OpenAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.factory.ChannelFactory.BeginOpen(SbmpProtocolDefaults.BufferTimeout(t, thisPtr.factory.GetSettings().EnableAdditionalClientTimeout), c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(OpenAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					thisPtr.factory.ChannelFactory.EndOpen(r);
				}, (Call)delegate(OpenAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t)
				{
					thisPtr.factory.ChannelFactory.Open(SbmpProtocolDefaults.BufferTimeout(t, thisPtr.factory.GetSettings().EnableAdditionalClientTimeout));
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
				if (ContinueAfterCommunicationException(base.LastAsyncStepException))
				{
					EndpointAddress to = factory.CreateEndpointAddress(string.Empty);
					factory.Channel = factory.ChannelFactory.CreateChannel(to);
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((OpenAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.factory.Channel.BeginOpen(SbmpProtocolDefaults.BufferTimeout(t, thisPtr.factory.GetSettings().EnableAdditionalClientTimeout), c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(OpenAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.factory.Channel.EndOpen(r);
					}, (Call)delegate(OpenAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t)
					{
						thisPtr.factory.Channel.Open(SbmpProtocolDefaults.BufferTimeout(t, thisPtr.factory.GetSettings().EnableAdditionalClientTimeout));
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
					ContinueAfterCommunicationException(base.LastAsyncStepException);
				}
			}

			private bool ContinueAfterCommunicationException(Exception exception)
			{
				if (exception == null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (exception is CommunicationException ex)
				{
					Complete(MessagingExceptionHelper.Unwrap(ex, isCancelling: false));
				}
				else
				{
					Complete(exception);
				}
				return !base.IsCompleted;
			}
		}

		private sealed class CloseAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<CloseAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly SbmpMessagingFactory factory;

			private readonly IRequestSessionChannel channel;

			public CloseAsyncResult(SbmpMessagingFactory factory, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.factory = factory;
				channel = factory.Channel;
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((CloseAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.factory.BaseOnBeginClose(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(CloseAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					thisPtr.factory.BaseOnEndClose(r);
				}, (Call)delegate(CloseAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t)
				{
					thisPtr.factory.BaseClose(t);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
				if (!ContinueAfterCommunicationException(base.LastAsyncStepException))
				{
					yield break;
				}
				if (channel != null)
				{
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((CloseAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.channel.BeginClose(SbmpProtocolDefaults.BufferTimeout(t, thisPtr.factory.GetSettings().EnableAdditionalClientTimeout), c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(CloseAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.channel.EndClose(r);
					}, (Call)delegate(CloseAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t)
					{
						thisPtr.channel.Close(SbmpProtocolDefaults.BufferTimeout(t, thisPtr.factory.GetSettings().EnableAdditionalClientTimeout));
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
					if (!ContinueAfterCommunicationException(base.LastAsyncStepException))
					{
						yield break;
					}
				}
				if (factory.ChannelFactory != null)
				{
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((CloseAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.factory.ChannelFactory.BeginClose(SbmpProtocolDefaults.BufferTimeout(t, thisPtr.factory.GetSettings().EnableAdditionalClientTimeout), c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(CloseAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.factory.ChannelFactory.EndClose(r);
					}, (Call)delegate(CloseAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t)
					{
						thisPtr.factory.ChannelFactory.Close(SbmpProtocolDefaults.BufferTimeout(t, thisPtr.factory.GetSettings().EnableAdditionalClientTimeout));
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
				}
				ContinueAfterCommunicationException(base.LastAsyncStepException);
			}

			private bool ContinueAfterCommunicationException(Exception exception)
			{
				if (exception == null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (exception is CommunicationException ex)
				{
					Complete(MessagingExceptionHelper.Unwrap(ex, isCancelling: false));
				}
				else
				{
					Complete(exception);
				}
				return !base.IsCompleted;
			}
		}

		public SbmpMessagingFactory(IEnumerable<Uri> baseAddresses, NetMessagingTransportSettings settings)
		{
			ConnectivityMode systemConnectivityMode = ConnectivityModeHelper.SystemConnectivityMode;
			connectionId = Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N");
			Settings = (NetMessagingTransportSettings)settings.Clone();
			if (systemConnectivityMode == ConnectivityMode.AutoDetect && !Settings.GatewayMode)
			{
				this.baseAddresses = new List<Uri>(baseAddresses);
				FirstInBaseAddress = this.baseAddresses.First();
			}
			else
			{
				Initialize((systemConnectivityMode == ConnectivityMode.Http || systemConnectivityMode == ConnectivityMode.Https) ? SbmpProtocolDefaults.SbmpConnectionProtocol.WebSocket : SbmpProtocolDefaults.SbmpConnectionProtocol.Tcp, baseAddresses);
			}
		}

		public SbmpMessagingFactory(Uri baseAddress, NetMessagingTransportSettings settings)
			: this(new List<Uri> { baseAddress }, settings)
		{
		}

		internal string GetNextLinkId()
		{
			return Interlocked.Increment(ref nextLinkId).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginOpen(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object asyncState)
		{
			try
			{
				return new OpenAsyncResult(this, timeout, callback, asyncState).Start();
			}
			catch (CommunicationException exception)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(MessagingExceptionHelper.Unwrap(exception, base.IsClosedOrClosing));
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				if (!Fx.IsFatal(ex) && base.IsClosedOrClosing)
				{
					throw new OperationCanceledException(SRClient.EntityClosedOrAborted, ex);
				}
				throw;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnEndOpen(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			try
			{
				AsyncResult<OpenAsyncResult>.End(result);
			}
			catch (CommunicationException exception)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(MessagingExceptionHelper.Unwrap(exception, base.IsClosedOrClosing));
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				if (!Fx.IsFatal(ex) && base.IsClosedOrClosing)
				{
					throw new OperationCanceledException(SRClient.EntityClosedOrAborted, ex);
				}
				throw;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnOpen(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			try
			{
				new OpenAsyncResult(this, timeout, null, null).RunSynchronously();
			}
			catch (CommunicationException exception)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(MessagingExceptionHelper.Unwrap(exception, base.IsClosedOrClosing));
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				if (!Fx.IsFatal(ex) && base.IsClosedOrClosing)
				{
					throw new OperationCanceledException(SRClient.EntityClosedOrAborted, ex);
				}
				throw;
			}
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			try
			{
				return new CloseAsyncResult(this, timeout, callback, state).Start();
			}
			catch (CommunicationException exception)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(MessagingExceptionHelper.Unwrap(exception, isCancelling: false));
			}
		}

		protected override void OnEndClose(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			try
			{
				AsyncResult<CloseAsyncResult>.End(result);
			}
			catch (CommunicationException exception)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(MessagingExceptionHelper.Unwrap(exception, isCancelling: false));
			}
		}

		protected override void OnClose(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			try
			{
				CloseAsyncResult closeAsyncResult = new CloseAsyncResult(this, timeout, null, null);
				closeAsyncResult.RunSynchronously();
			}
			catch (CommunicationException exception)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(MessagingExceptionHelper.Unwrap(exception, isCancelling: false));
			}
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginAcceptMessageSession(ReceiveMode receiveMode, TimeSpan serverWaitTime, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			if (Settings.EnableRedirect)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(SR.GetString(Resources.AcceptMessageSessionRedirectNotSupported));
			}
			try
			{
				return new AcceptMessageSessionForNamespaceAsyncResult(this, receiveMode, PrefetchCount, acceptMessageSessionForNamespaceLinkSettings, serverWaitTime, timeout, callback, state);
			}
			catch (CommunicationException exception)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(MessagingExceptionHelper.Unwrap(exception));
			}
		}

		protected override MessageSession OnEndAcceptMessageSession(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			try
			{
				return AcceptMessageSessionForNamespaceAsyncResult.End(result);
			}
			catch (CommunicationException exception)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(MessagingExceptionHelper.Unwrap(exception));
			}
		}

		protected override void OnAbort()
		{
			base.OnAbort();
			Channel?.Abort();
			if (ChannelFactory != null)
			{
				ChannelFactory.Abort();
			}
		}

		internal Uri CreateLogicalUri(string path)
		{
			UriBuilder uriBuilder = new UriBuilder(GetLogicalUri());
			MessagingUtilities.EnsureTrailingSlash(uriBuilder);
			uriBuilder.Path += path;
			return uriBuilder.Uri;
		}

		internal Uri CreatePhysicalUri(string path)
		{
			UriBuilder uriBuilder = new UriBuilder(GetPhysicalUri());
			MessagingUtilities.EnsureTrailingSlash(uriBuilder);
			uriBuilder.Path += path;
			return uriBuilder.Uri;
		}

		internal EndpointAddress CreateEndpointAddress(string entityName)
		{
			return new EndpointAddress(CreatePhysicalUri(entityName), SbmpProtocolDefaults.GetEndpointIdentity(GetLogicalUri()));
		}

		private Uri GetPhysicalUri()
		{
			Uri result = BaseAddress;
			if (Settings.Via != null)
			{
				result = Settings.Via;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private Uri GetLogicalUri()
		{
			Uri result = BaseAddress;
			if (Settings.Via != null)
			{
				result = base.Address;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public void ScheduleGetRuntimeEntityDescription(TrackingContext trackingContext, ClientEntity clientEntity, string entityName, SbmpMessageCreator messageCreator)
		{
			if (Settings.GatewayMode || clientEntity.RuntimeEntityDescription != null || Settings.EnableRedirect || !base.IsOpened)
			{
				return;
			}
			string entityAddress = BaseAddress.AbsoluteUri + entityName;
			if (RuntimeEntityDescriptionCache.TryGet(entityAddress, out var entityDescription))
			{
				clientEntity.RuntimeEntityDescription = entityDescription;
				return;
			}
			IOThreadScheduler.ScheduleCallbackNoFlow(delegate
			{
				new GetRuntimeEntityDescriptionAsyncResult(trackingContext, clientEntity, entityAddress, this, messageCreator, executeOnce: false, Constants.GetRuntimeEntityDescriptionTimeout, null, null).Start();
			}, null);
		}

		private void OnInnerFactoryFaulted(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Fault();
		}

		}

		{
			base.OnEndClose(result);
		}

		private void BaseClose(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			base.OnClose(timeout);
		}

		private void Initialize(SbmpProtocolDefaults.SbmpConnectionProtocol protocol, IEnumerable<Uri> baseAddresses)
		{
			TestProtocol = protocol;
			List<Uri> list = new List<Uri>();
			foreach (Uri baseAddress in baseAddresses)
			{
				if (base.Address == null)
				{
					base.Address = baseAddress;
				}
				UriBuilder uriBuilder = new UriBuilder(baseAddress);
				if (Settings.Via == null && !Settings.GatewayMode && string.Compare(uriBuilder.Scheme, "sb", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) != 0)
				{
					throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new ArgumentException(SR.GetString(Resources.InvalidUriScheme, uriBuilder.Scheme, "sb")));
				}
				uriBuilder.Scheme = ((protocol == SbmpProtocolDefaults.SbmpConnectionProtocol.Tcp) ? SbmpProtocolDefaults.TransportUriScheme : "sb");
				switch (protocol)
				{
				case SbmpProtocolDefaults.SbmpConnectionProtocol.WebStreamHttp:
					uriBuilder.Port = RelayEnvironment.RelayHttpPort;
					break;
				case SbmpProtocolDefaults.SbmpConnectionProtocol.WebStreamHttps:
				case SbmpProtocolDefaults.SbmpConnectionProtocol.WebSocket:
					uriBuilder.Port = RelayEnvironment.RelayHttpsPort;
					break;
				}
				if (!Settings.GatewayMode && uriBuilder.Port == -1 && protocol == SbmpProtocolDefaults.SbmpConnectionProtocol.Tcp)
				{
					uriBuilder.Port = RelayEnvironment.RelayNmfPort;
				}
				MessagingUtilities.EnsureTrailingSlash(uriBuilder);
				list.Add(uriBuilder.Uri);
			}
			this.baseAddresses = null;
			BaseAddress = list.First();
			bool flag = Settings.ClientAuthThumbprint != null && Settings.GatewayMode;
			SbmpProtocolDefaults.SbmpConnectionProtocol testCheckProtocol;
			CustomBinding customBinding = SbmpProtocolDefaults.CreateBinding(portSharingEnabled: false, protocol, int.MaxValue, Settings.UseSslStreamSecurity, flag, Settings.EndpointIdentity, Settings.LeaseTimeout, out testCheckProtocol);
			TestProtocol = testCheckProtocol;
			DuplexRequestBindingElement item = new DuplexRequestBindingElement
			{
				ClientMode = !Settings.GatewayMode,
				EnablePing = Settings.EnablePing,
				IncludeExceptionDetails = true
			};
			int num = 0;
			if (!Settings.GatewayMode)
			{
				RedirectBindingElement item2 = new RedirectBindingElement
				{
					EnableRedirect = Settings.EnableRedirect,
					UseSslStreamSecurity = Settings.UseSslStreamSecurity,
					IncludeExceptionDetails = true,
					EndpointIdentity = Settings.EndpointIdentity,
					LeaseTimeout = Settings.LeaseTimeout
				};
				customBinding.Elements.Insert(num++, new ReconnectBindingElement(list));
				customBinding.Elements.Insert(num++, item2);
			}
			customBinding.Elements.Insert(num++, new ReconnectBindingElement(list));
			customBinding.Elements.Insert(num++, item);
			BindingParameterCollection bindingParameterCollection = new BindingParameterCollection();
			if (Settings.UseSslStreamSecurity)
			{
				ClientCredentials clientCredentials = new ClientCredentials();
				clientCredentials.ServiceCertificate.Authentication.CertificateValidationMode = X509CertificateValidationMode.Custom;
				clientCredentials.ServiceCertificate.Authentication.CustomCertificateValidator = RetriableCertificateValidator.Instance;
				if (flag && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(Settings.ClientAuthThumbprint))
				{
					clientCredentials.ClientCertificate.SetCertificate(StoreLocation.LocalMachine, StoreName.My, X509FindType.FindByThumbprint, Settings.ClientAuthThumbprint);
				}
				bindingParameterCollection.Add(clientCredentials);
			}
			ChannelFactory = customBinding.BuildChannelFactory<IRequestSessionChannel>(bindingParameterCollection);
			MessageVersion = customBinding.MessageVersion;
			ResourceManager = SbmpResourceManager.Instance;
			acceptMessageSessionForNamespaceLinkSettings = new CreateControlLinkSettings(this, string.Empty, "||", MessagingEntityType.Namespace);
			EventHandler handler = OnInnerFactoryFaulted;
			ChannelFactory.SafeAddFaulted(handler);
		}
	}
	internal static class SbmpProtocolDefaults
	{
		internal enum SbmpConnectionProtocol
		{
			Tcp,
			WebStreamHttp,
			WebStreamHttps,
			WebSocket
		}

		public const int DefaultMaxFaultSize = 65536;

		public const bool DefaultPortSharingEnabled = false;

		public const string UriScheme = "sb";

		internal const double DefaultClientToBrokerTimeout = 10.0;

		public static readonly string TransportUriScheme = Uri.UriSchemeNetTcp;

		private static readonly TimeSpan ClientToBrokerTimeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10.0);

		private static double internalClientToBrokerTimeout = 10.0;

		public static bool TestUseWebSocketAsWebStream { get; set; }

		internal static double InternalClientToBrokerTimeout
		{
			get
			{
				return internalClientToBrokerTimeout;
			}
			set
			{
				internalClientToBrokerTimeout = value;
			}
		}

		public static CustomBinding CreateBinding(bool portSharingEnabled, SbmpConnectionProtocol protocol, int maxReceivedMessageSize, bool useSslStreamSecurity, bool clientCertificateAuthEnabled, DnsEndpointIdentity endpointIdentity, TimeSpan? leaseTimeout)
		{
			SbmpConnectionProtocol testCheckProtocol;
			return CreateBinding(portSharingEnabled, protocol, maxReceivedMessageSize, useSslStreamSecurity, clientCertificateAuthEnabled, endpointIdentity, leaseTimeout, out testCheckProtocol);
		}

		internal static CustomBinding CreateBinding(bool portSharingEnabled, SbmpConnectionProtocol protocol, int maxReceivedMessageSize, bool useSslStreamSecurity, bool clientCertificateAuthEnabled, DnsEndpointIdentity endpointIdentity, TimeSpan? leaseTimeout, out SbmpConnectionProtocol testCheckProtocol)
		{
			testCheckProtocol = protocol;
			BinaryMessageEncodingBindingElement binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement = new BinaryMessageEncodingBindingElement();
			binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement.ReaderQuotas.MaxStringContentLength = 50000;
			bool flag = protocol == SbmpConnectionProtocol.Tcp && useSslStreamSecurity;
			TransportBindingElement transportBindingElement;
			if (protocol != SbmpConnectionProtocol.Tcp)
			{
				flag = !TestUseWebSocketAsWebStream && protocol == SbmpConnectionProtocol.WebStreamHttp && useSslStreamSecurity;
				SocketSecurityRole socketSecurityMode = (flag ? SocketSecurityRole.SslClient : SocketSecurityRole.None);
				IConnectionElement connectionElement;
				if (TestUseWebSocketAsWebStream || protocol == SbmpConnectionProtocol.WebSocket)
				{
					testCheckProtocol = SbmpConnectionProtocol.WebSocket;
					connectionElement = new WebSocketOnewayClientConnectionElement(socketSecurityMode, "wsmessaging");
				}
				else
				{
					connectionElement = new WebStreamOnewayClientConnectionElement(socketSecurityMode, "messaging", protocol == SbmpConnectionProtocol.WebStreamHttps);
				}
				SocketConnectionBindingElement socketConnectionBindingElement = new SocketConnectionBindingElement(connectionElement, enableKeepAlive: false);
				if (leaseTimeout.HasValue)
				{
					socketConnectionBindingElement.ConnectionPoolSettings.LeaseTimeout = leaseTimeout.Value;
				}
				transportBindingElement = socketConnectionBindingElement;
			}
			else
			{
				TcpTransportBindingElement tcpTransportBindingElement = new TcpTransportBindingElement
				{
					PortSharingEnabled = portSharingEnabled
				};
				if (leaseTimeout.HasValue)
				{
					tcpTransportBindingElement.ConnectionPoolSettings.LeaseTimeout = leaseTimeout.Value;
				}
				transportBindingElement = tcpTransportBindingElement;
			}
			transportBindingElement.ManualAddressing = true;
			transportBindingElement.MaxReceivedMessageSize = maxReceivedMessageSize;
			CustomBinding customBinding = new CustomBinding();
			if (flag)
			{
				SslStreamSecurityBindingElement item = new SslStreamSecurityBindingElement
				{
					IdentityVerifier = new LenientDnsIdentityVerifier(endpointIdentity),
					RequireClientCertificate = clientCertificateAuthEnabled
				};
				customBinding.Elements.Add(item);
			}
			customBinding.Elements.Add(binaryMessageEncodingBindingElement);
			customBinding.Elements.Add(transportBindingElement);
			return customBinding;
		}

		public static ChannelProtectionRequirements GetChannelProtectionRequirements(ProtectionLevel protectionLevel)
		{
			MessagePartSpecification parts = new MessagePartSpecification(isBodyIncluded: true);
			MessagePartSpecification parts2 = new MessagePartSpecification();
			ChannelProtectionRequirements channelProtectionRequirements = new ChannelProtectionRequirements();
			switch (protectionLevel)
			{
			case ProtectionLevel.None:
				channelProtectionRequirements.IncomingSignatureParts.AddParts(parts2, "*");
				channelProtectionRequirements.OutgoingSignatureParts.AddParts(parts2, "*");
				channelProtectionRequirements.IncomingEncryptionParts.AddParts(parts2, "*");
				channelProtectionRequirements.OutgoingEncryptionParts.AddParts(parts2, "*");
				break;
			case ProtectionLevel.Sign:
				channelProtectionRequirements.IncomingSignatureParts.AddParts(parts, "*");
				channelProtectionRequirements.OutgoingSignatureParts.AddParts(parts, "*");
				channelProtectionRequirements.IncomingEncryptionParts.AddParts(parts2, "*");
				channelProtectionRequirements.OutgoingEncryptionParts.AddParts(parts2, "*");
				break;
			case ProtectionLevel.EncryptAndSign:
				channelProtectionRequirements.IncomingSignatureParts.AddParts(parts, "*");
				channelProtectionRequirements.OutgoingSignatureParts.AddParts(parts, "*");
				channelProtectionRequirements.IncomingEncryptionParts.AddParts(parts, "*");
				channelProtectionRequirements.OutgoingEncryptionParts.AddParts(parts, "*");
				break;
			}
			return channelProtectionRequirements;
		}

		public static EndpointIdentity GetEndpointIdentity(Uri address)
		{
			return new DnsEndpointIdentity(address.Host);
		}

		internal static TimeSpan BufferTimeout(TimeSpan timeout, bool enableAdditionalClientTimeout)
		{
			TimeSpan timeSpan = ((timeout < TimeSpan.Zero) ? TimeSpan.Zero : timeout);
			if (!enableAdditionalClientTimeout)
			{
				return timeSpan;
			}
			if (InternalClientToBrokerTimeout != 10.0)
			{
				return TimeoutHelper.Add(timeSpan, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(InternalClientToBrokerTimeout));
			}
			return TimeoutHelper.Add(timeSpan, ClientToBrokerTimeout);
		}
	}

	internal class CreateLinkSettings
	{
		internal SbmpMessageCreator MessageCreator { get; private set; }

		internal string EntityName { get; private set; }

		internal string EntityPath { get; private set; }

		internal LinkInfo LinkInfo { get; private set; }

		internal SbmpMessagingFactory MessagingFactory { get; private set; }

		internal Lazy<SbmpMessageCreator> ControlMessageCreator { get; private set; }

		public CreateLinkSettings(SbmpMessagingFactory messagingFactory, string entityPath, string entityName, LinkInfo linkInfo, Lazy<SbmpMessageCreator> controlMessageCreator = null)
		{
			LinkInfo = linkInfo;
			MessagingFactory = messagingFactory;
			EntityName = entityName;
			EntityPath = entityPath;
			ControlMessageCreator = controlMessageCreator;
			MessagingFactorySettings settings = MessagingFactory.GetSettings();
			Uri logicalAddress = MessagingFactory.CreateLogicalUri(entityPath);
			MessageCreator = new SbmpMessageCreator(MessagingFactory, MessagingFactory.BaseAddress, MessagingFactory.MessageVersion, MessagingFactory.Settings, settings.EnableAdditionalClientTimeout, logicalAddress);
			if (LinkInfo != null)
			{
				MessageCreator = MessageCreator.CreateLinkMessageCreator(LinkInfo);
				if (settings.NetMessagingTransportSettings.GatewayMode)
				{
					LinkInfo.IsHttp = true;
					LinkInfo.ApiVersion = ApiVersionHelper.CurrentRuntimeApiVersion;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal sealed class CreateControlLinkSettings : CreateLinkSettings

				ConnectionId = messagingFactory.ConnectionId,
				LinkType = LinkType.Control,
				EntityName = entityName,
				EntityType = entityType,
				FromOffset = fromOffset
			})
		{
		}
	}
	internal sealed class CreateReceiverLinkSettings : CreateLinkSettings
	{

		public CreateReceiverLinkSettings(SbmpMessagingFactory messagingFactory, string entityPath, string entityName, MessagingEntityType? entityType, ReceiveMode receiveMode, Lazy<SbmpMessageCreator> controlMessageCreator, bool isSessionful)

	internal sealed class SbmpMessageSession : MessageSession

		private sealed class RenewLockAsyncResult : SbmpTransactionalAsyncResult<RenewLockAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly SbmpMessageSession sbmpMessageSession;

			private readonly TrackingContext trackingContext;

			public RenewLockAsyncResult(SbmpMessageSession sbmpMessageSession, TrackingContext trackingContext, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base((SbmpMessagingFactory)sbmpMessageSession.MessagingFactory, ((SbmpMessageReceiver)sbmpMessageSession.InnerMessageReceiver).MessageCreator, ((SbmpMessageReceiver)sbmpMessageSession.InnerMessageReceiver).ControlMessageCreator, timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.sbmpMessageSession = sbmpMessageSession;
				this.trackingContext = trackingContext;
				Start();
			}

			protected override System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message CreateWcfMessage()
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteLogOperation("SbmpSession.RenewLock", "Transaction: null");
				});
				Transaction transaction = base.Transaction;
				SessionRenewLockCommand sessionRenewLockCommand = new SessionRenewLockCommand
				{
					SessionId = sbmpMessageSession.SessionId,
					Timeout = RemainingTime()
				};
				RequestInfo requestInfo = new RequestInfo
				{
					ServerTimeout = sessionRenewLockCommand.Timeout,
					TransactionId = ((transaction != null) ? transaction.TransactionInformation.LocalIdentifier : null)
				};
				return base.MessageCreator.CreateWcfMessage("http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2011/06/servicebus/SbmpMessageReceiver/SessionRenewLock", sessionRenewLockCommand, sbmpMessageSession.parentLinkId, sbmpMessageSession.RetryPolicy, trackingContext, requestInfo);
			}

			protected override void PartitionInfoSetter(RequestInfo requestInfo)
			{
				requestInfo.SessionId = sbmpMessageSession.SessionId;
			}
		}

		private sealed class GetStateAsyncResult : SbmpTransactionalAsyncResult<GetStateAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly SbmpMessageSession sbmpMessageSession;

			private readonly TrackingContext trackingContext;

			public GetStateAsyncResult(SbmpMessageSession sbmpMessageSession, TrackingContext trackingContext, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base((SbmpMessagingFactory)sbmpMessageSession.MessagingFactory, ((SbmpMessageReceiver)sbmpMessageSession.InnerMessageReceiver).MessageCreator, ((SbmpMessageReceiver)sbmpMessageSession.InnerMessageReceiver).ControlMessageCreator, timeout, callback, state)

					TransactionId = getSessionStateCommand.TransactionId
				};
				return base.MessageCreator.CreateWcfMessage("http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2011/06/servicebus/SbmpMessageReceiver/GetSessionState", getSessionStateCommand, sbmpMessageSession.parentLinkId, sbmpMessageSession.RetryPolicy, trackingContext, requestInfo);

		private sealed class SetStateAsyncResult : SbmpTransactionalAsyncResult<SetStateAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly SbmpMessageSession sbmpMessageSession;

			private readonly TrackingContext trackingContext;

			private readonly Stream sessionState;

			public SetStateAsyncResult(SbmpMessageSession sbmpMessageSession, TrackingContext trackingContext, Stream sessionState, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(sbmpMessageSession.messagingFactory, ((SbmpMessageReceiver)sbmpMessageSession.InnerMessageReceiver).MessageCreator, ((SbmpMessageReceiver)sbmpMessageSession.InnerMessageReceiver).ControlMessageCreator, timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.sbmpMessageSession = sbmpMessageSession;
				this.trackingContext = trackingContext;
				this.sessionState = sessionState;
				Start();
			}

			protected override System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message CreateWcfMessage()
			{
				string transactionId = ((base.Transaction != null) ? base.Transaction.TransactionInformation.LocalIdentifier : null);
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteLogOperation("SbmpSession.SetState", "TransactionId:" + transactionId);
				});
				SetSessionStateCommand setSessionStateCommand = new SetSessionStateCommand
				{
					SessionId = sbmpMessageSession.SessionId,
					SessionState = new SessionState(sessionState),
					Timeout = RemainingTime(),
					TransactionId = transactionId
				};
				RequestInfo requestInfo = new RequestInfo
				{
					ServerTimeout = setSessionStateCommand.Timeout,
					TransactionId = setSessionStateCommand.TransactionId
				};
				return base.MessageCreator.CreateWcfMessage("http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2011/06/servicebus/SbmpMessageReceiver/SetSessionState", setSessionStateCommand, sbmpMessageSession.parentLinkId, sbmpMessageSession.RetryPolicy, trackingContext, requestInfo);
			}

			protected override void PartitionInfoSetter(RequestInfo requestInfo)
			{
				requestInfo.SessionId = sbmpMessageSession.SessionId;
			}
		}

		private readonly SbmpMessagingFactory messagingFactory;

		private readonly string parentLinkId;

		private SessionState sessionState;

		internal bool CachedState { get; private set; }

		public SbmpMessageSession(string sessionId, DateTime lockedUntilUtc, SessionState sessionState, SbmpMessageReceiver innerReceiver, bool isExclusiveMode, Guid? lockToken)
			: base(innerReceiver.Mode, sessionId, lockedUntilUtc, innerReceiver, isExclusiveMode, lockToken)
		{
			this.sessionState = sessionState;
			parentLinkId = ((innerReceiver.ControlMessageCreator == null) ? string.Empty : innerReceiver.ControlMessageCreator.Value.LinkInfo.LinkId);
			CachedState = sessionState != null;
			messagingFactory = (SbmpMessagingFactory)innerReceiver.MessagingFactory;
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginGetState(TrackingContext trackingContext, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			if (CachedState)
			{
				return new CompletedAsyncResult(callback, state);
			}
			return new GetStateAsyncResult(this, trackingContext, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		protected override Stream OnEndGetState(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (CachedState)
			{
				CompletedAsyncResult.End(result);
				Stream result2 = null;
				if (sessionState != null)
				{
					result2 = sessionState.Stream;
					sessionState = null;
					CachedState = false;
				}
				return result2;
			}
			System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message response = AsyncResult<GetStateAsyncResult>.End(result).Response;
			GetSessionStateResponseCommand body = response.GetBody<GetSessionStateResponseCommand>();
			CachedState = body.SessionState.Stream == null;
			return body.SessionState.Stream;
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginSetState(TrackingContext trackingContext, Stream sessionState, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			this.sessionState = null;
			CachedState = false;
			return new SetStateAsyncResult(this, trackingContext, sessionState, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		protected override void OnEndSetState(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			AsyncResult<SetStateAsyncResult>.End(result);
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginRenewLock(TrackingContext trackingContext, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new RenewLockAsyncResult(this, trackingContext, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		protected override DateTime OnEndRenewLock(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message response = AsyncResult<RenewLockAsyncResult>.End(result).Response;
			SessionRenewLockResponseCommand body = response.GetBody<SessionRenewLockResponseCommand>();
			return body.LockedUntilUtc;
		}
	}

				: base((IDefaultCommunicationTimeouts)context.Binding)
			{
				BindingElement = bindingElement;
				innerFactory = context.BuildInnerChannelFactory<IDuplexSessionChannel>();
			}

			{

			}

				IDuplexSessionChannel innerChannel = innerFactory.CreateChannel(address, via);
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate

					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteRuntimeChannelCreated(innerChannel.GetType().Name, innerChannel.LocalAddress.Uri.AbsoluteUri, innerChannel.RemoteAddress.Uri.AbsoluteUri, innerChannel.Via.AbsoluteUri, innerChannel.Session.Id);
				});
				return new DuplexRequestSessionChannel(this, innerChannel);
			}

			protected override void OnOpening()

				base.OnOpening();
				innerFactory.SafeAddFaulted(OnInnerFactoryFaulted);
			}

			protected override void OnOpen(TimeSpan timeout)
			{
				innerFactory.Open();
			}

			}
