			{
				return innerFactory.BeginClose(timeout, callback, state);
			}

			protected override void OnEndClose(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				innerFactory.EndClose(result);
			}

			private void OnInnerFactoryFaulted(object sender, EventArgs e)
			{
				Fault();
			}
		}

		private sealed class DuplexRequestSessionChannel : ChannelBase, IRequestSessionChannel, IRequestChannel, IChannel, ICommunicationObject, ISessionChannel<IOutputSession>
		{
			private sealed class DuplexCorrelationAsyncResult : Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult
			{
				private static readonly AsyncCompletion sendCompletion = SendCompletion;

				private static readonly Action<object> timerCallback = TimerCallback;

				private DuplexRequestSessionChannel parent;

				private System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message wcfRequest;

				private string clientTrackingId;

				private IOThreadTimer timer;

				private int completed;

				private string requestAction;

				internal UniqueId RequestMessageId { get; private set; }

				internal System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message ReplyMessage { get; set; }

				private TimeSpan OriginalTimeout { get; set; }

				public DuplexCorrelationAsyncResult(DuplexRequestSessionChannel parent, System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message wcfRequest, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
					: base(callback, state)
				{
					this.parent = parent;
					OriginalTimeout = timeout;
					this.wcfRequest = wcfRequest;
					RequestMessageId = this.wcfRequest.Headers.MessageId;
					if (RequestMessageId == null)
					{
						RequestMessageId = new UniqueId();
						this.wcfRequest.Headers.MessageId = RequestMessageId;
					}
					requestAction = this.wcfRequest.Headers.Action;
					if (TrackingIdHeader.TryRead(this.wcfRequest.Headers, out var trackingIdHeader))
					{
						clientTrackingId = trackingIdHeader.Id;
					}
					else
					{
						clientTrackingId = RequestMessageId.ToString();
					}
					this.parent.inflightRequests[RequestMessageId] = this;
					this.parent.OnBeginRequest();
					if (timeout != TimeSpan.MaxValue)
					{
						timer = new IOThreadTimer(timerCallback, this, isTypicallyCanceledShortlyAfterBeingSet: false);
						timer.Set(timeout);
					}
					lock (base.ThisLock)
					{
						try
						{
							IAsyncResult result = this.parent.innerChannel.BeginSend(this.wcfRequest, timeout, PrepareAsyncCompletion(sendCompletion), this);
							if (SyncContinue(result))
							{
								TryComplete(completedSynchronously: true, null);
							}
						}
						catch (Exception ex)
						{
							if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
							{
								throw;
							}
							this.parent.inflightRequests.TryRemove(RequestMessageId, out var _);
							TryComplete(completedSynchronously: true, ex);
						}
					}
				}

				internal string CreateClientTrackingExceptionInfo()
				{
					DateTime utcNow = DateTime.UtcNow;
					return SRClient.TrackingIdAndTimestampFormat(clientTrackingId, utcNow);
				}

				public static System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message End(IAsyncResult result)
				{
					return Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult.End<DuplexCorrelationAsyncResult>(result).ReplyMessage;
				}

				public new void TryComplete(bool completedSynchronously, Exception exception)
				{
					bool flag = false;
					lock (base.ThisLock)
					{
						if (Interlocked.Exchange(ref completed, 1) == 0)
						{
							if (timer != null)
							{
								timer.Cancel();
								timer = null;
							}
							flag = true;
						}
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						if (exception != null && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(requestAction) && (requestAction.Equals("http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2011/06/servicebus/SbmpMessageSender/Send", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || requestAction.Equals("http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2011/06/servicebus/SbmpMessageReceiver/SetSessionState", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) && parent.IsMaxMessageSizeExceededFault)
						{
							string text = SRClient.TrackableExceptionMessageFormat(SRClient.MessageSizeExceeded, CreateClientTrackingExceptionInfo());
							ExceptionDetail detail = new ExceptionDetail(new MessageSizeExceededException(text));
							FaultCode code = FaultCode.CreateReceiverFaultCode("InternalServiceFault", "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2011/06/servicebus");
							FaultReason reason = new FaultReason(new FaultReasonText(text, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture));
							exception = ((!parent.includeExceptionDetails) ? ((FaultException)new FaultException<ExceptionDetailNoStackTrace>(new ExceptionDetailNoStackTrace(detail, includeInnerException: true), reason, code)) : ((FaultException)new FaultException<ExceptionDetail>(detail, reason, code)));
						}
						parent.OnEndRequest();
						Complete(completedSynchronously, exception);
					}
				}

				private static bool SendCompletion(IAsyncResult result)
				{
					bool flag = false;
					bool flag2 = true;
					Exception lastException = null;
					DuplexCorrelationAsyncResult duplexCorrelationAsyncResult = (DuplexCorrelationAsyncResult)result.AsyncState;
					try
					{
						duplexCorrelationAsyncResult.parent.innerChannel.EndSend(result);
					}
					catch (Exception ex)
					{
						if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
						{
							throw;
						}
						lastException = ex;
						flag = true;
						if (ReconnectBindingElement.IsRetryable(duplexCorrelationAsyncResult.wcfRequest, lastException))
						{
							flag2 = false;
						}
					}
					finally
					{
						if (flag2 && duplexCorrelationAsyncResult.wcfRequest != null)
						{
							duplexCorrelationAsyncResult.wcfRequest.SafeClose();
						}
						duplexCorrelationAsyncResult.wcfRequest = null;
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						duplexCorrelationAsyncResult.parent.inflightRequests.TryRemove(duplexCorrelationAsyncResult.RequestMessageId, out var _);
						duplexCorrelationAsyncResult.TryComplete(result.CompletedSynchronously, lastException);
					}
					return false;
				}

				private static void TimerCallback(object state)
				{
					DuplexCorrelationAsyncResult result = (DuplexCorrelationAsyncResult)state;
					if (result.parent.inflightRequests.TryRemove(result.RequestMessageId, out result))
					{
						string trackableExceptionMessage = SRClient.TrackableExceptionMessageFormat(SR.GetString(Resources.TimeoutOnRequest, result.OriginalTimeout), result.CreateClientTrackingExceptionInfo());
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
						{
							MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteLogOperationWarning("DuplexMessageCorrelation.TimerCallback", string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "In IO Thread Time callback , removing Request with Message Id:{0} and terminating the request with error: {1}", result.RequestMessageId.ToString(), trackableExceptionMessage));
						});
						result.TryComplete(completedSynchronously: false, new TimeoutException(trackableExceptionMessage));
					}
				}
			}

			private class CloseAsyncResult : Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult
			{
				private static readonly AsyncCallback closeOutputSessionCallback = CloseOutputSessionCallback;

				private static readonly AsyncCallback closeChannelCallback = CloseChannelCallback;

				private static readonly WaitOrTimerCallback serverShutdownCallback = ServerShutdownCallback;

				private TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper;

				private readonly DuplexRequestSessionChannel correlator;

				private readonly RegisteredWaitHandle shutdownWaitHandle;

				private int completed;

				public CloseAsyncResult(DuplexRequestSessionChannel correlator, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
					: base(callback, state)
				{
					this.correlator = correlator;
					timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
					shutdownWaitHandle = ThreadPool.RegisterWaitForSingleObject(this.correlator.serverShutdownEvent, serverShutdownCallback, this, TimeoutHelper.ToMilliseconds(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime()), executeOnlyOnce: true);
					TryOperation(completeSync: true, delegate(CloseAsyncResult t)
					{
						IAsyncResult asyncResult = t.correlator.innerChannel.Session.BeginCloseOutputSession(t.timeoutHelper.RemainingTime(), closeOutputSessionCallback, t);
						if (asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
						{
							t.correlator.innerChannel.Session.EndCloseOutputSession(asyncResult);
						}
					});
				}

				public static void End(IAsyncResult asyncResult)
				{
					Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult.End<CloseAsyncResult>(asyncResult);
				}

				private static void CloseOutputSessionCallback(IAsyncResult asyncResult)
				{
					if (!asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
					{
						CloseAsyncResult closeAsyncResult = (CloseAsyncResult)asyncResult.AsyncState;
						closeAsyncResult.TryOperation(completeSync: false, delegate(CloseAsyncResult t)
						{
							t.correlator.innerChannel.Session.EndCloseOutputSession(asyncResult);
						});
					}
				}

				private static void ServerShutdownCallback(object state, bool timedOut)
				{
					CloseAsyncResult closeAsyncResult = (CloseAsyncResult)state;
					if (timedOut)
					{
						closeAsyncResult.TryComplete(completedSync: false, new TimeoutException());
						return;
					}
					closeAsyncResult.TryOperation(completeSync: false, delegate(CloseAsyncResult t)
					{
						IAsyncResult asyncResult = t.correlator.innerChannel.BeginClose(t.timeoutHelper.RemainingTime(), closeChannelCallback, t);
						if (asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
						{
							t.correlator.innerChannel.EndClose(asyncResult);
							t.TryComplete(completedSync: false, null);
						}
					});
				}

				private static void CloseChannelCallback(IAsyncResult asyncResult)
				{
					if (!asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
					{
						CloseAsyncResult closeAsyncResult = (CloseAsyncResult)asyncResult.AsyncState;
						closeAsyncResult.TryOperation(completeSync: false, delegate(CloseAsyncResult t)
						{
							t.correlator.innerChannel.EndClose(asyncResult);
							t.TryComplete(completedSync: false, null);
						});
					}
				}

				private void TryOperation(bool completeSync, Action<CloseAsyncResult> operation)
				{
					Exception ex = null;
					try
					{
						operation(this);
					}
					catch (Exception ex2)
					{
						if (Fx.IsFatal(ex2))
						{
							throw;
						}
						ex = ex2;
					}
					if (ex != null)
					{
						TryComplete(completeSync, ex);
					}
				}

				private new void TryComplete(bool completedSync, Exception completeException)
				{
					if (Interlocked.Exchange(ref completed, 1) == 0)
					{
						correlator.CancelPendingOperations(isFaulted: false);
						shutdownWaitHandle.Unregister(null);
						Complete(completedSync, completeException);
					}
				}
			}

			private static readonly Action<object> messageReceivePump = MessageReceivePump;

			private static readonly AsyncCallback onMessageReceived = OnMessageReceived;

			private static readonly Action<object> beginPing = BeginPing;

			private static readonly AsyncCallback endPing = EndPing;

			private readonly EventHandler onInnerChannelFaulted;

			private readonly IDuplexSessionChannel innerChannel;

			private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<UniqueId, DuplexCorrelationAsyncResult> inflightRequests;

			private readonly bool includeExceptionDetails;

			private readonly IOThreadTimer pingTimer;

			private readonly ManualResetEvent serverShutdownEvent;

			private int interlockedSync;

			private bool clientMode;

			private bool enablePing;

			private MessageVersion messageVersion;

			public bool IsMaxMessageSizeExceededFault { get; private set; }

			public EndpointAddress RemoteAddress => innerChannel.RemoteAddress;

			public IOutputSession Session => innerChannel.Session;

			public Uri Via => innerChannel.Via;

			protected override TimeSpan DefaultCloseTimeout => Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Channels.TransportDefaults.CloseTimeout;

			protected override TimeSpan DefaultOpenTimeout => Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Channels.TransportDefaults.OpenTimeout;

			public DuplexRequestSessionChannel(DuplexRequestChannelFactory channelFactory, IDuplexSessionChannel innerChannel)
				: base(channelFactory)
			{
				this.innerChannel = innerChannel;
				includeExceptionDetails = channelFactory.BindingElement.IncludeExceptionDetails;
				inflightRequests = new ConcurrentDictionary<UniqueId, DuplexCorrelationAsyncResult>();
				onInnerChannelFaulted = OnInnerChannelFaulted;
				clientMode = channelFactory.BindingElement.ClientMode;
				enablePing = channelFactory.BindingElement.EnablePing;
				messageVersion = innerChannel.GetProperty<MessageVersion>();
				serverShutdownEvent = new ManualResetEvent(initialState: false);
				if (enablePing)
				{
					pingTimer = new IOThreadTimer(beginPing, this, isTypicallyCanceledShortlyAfterBeingSet: true);
				}
			}

			public override TProperty GetProperty<TProperty>()
			{
				return innerChannel.GetProperty<TProperty>();
			}

			public System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message Request(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message wcfRequest)
			{
				return Request(wcfRequest, base.DefaultSendTimeout);
			}

			public System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message Request(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message wcfRequest, TimeSpan timeout)
			{
				return EndRequest(BeginRequest(wcfRequest, timeout, null, null));
			}

			public IAsyncResult BeginRequest(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message wcfRequest, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{
				return BeginRequest(wcfRequest, base.DefaultSendTimeout, callback, state);
			}

			public IAsyncResult BeginRequest(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message wcfRequest, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{
				ThrowIfDisposedOrNotOpen();
				return new DuplexCorrelationAsyncResult(this, wcfRequest, timeout, callback, state);
			}

			public System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message EndRequest(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				return DuplexCorrelationAsyncResult.End(result);
			}

			protected override void OnAbort()
			{
				CancelPendingOperations(isFaulted: false);
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteRuntimeChannelAborting(innerChannel.GetType().Name, innerChannel.LocalAddress.Uri.AbsoluteUri, innerChannel.RemoteAddress.Uri.AbsoluteUri, innerChannel.Via.AbsoluteUri, innerChannel.Session.Id);
				});
				innerChannel.Abort();
			}

			protected override void OnClose(TimeSpan timeout)
			{
				OnEndClose(OnBeginClose(timeout, null, null));
			}

			protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{
				return new CloseAsyncResult(this, timeout, callback, state);
			}

			protected override void OnEndClose(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				CloseAsyncResult.End(result);
			}

			protected override void OnClosed()
			{
				base.OnClosed();
				UnregisterInnerChannelEvents();
			}

			protected override void OnOpen(TimeSpan timeout)
			{
				OnEndOpen(OnBeginOpen(timeout, null, null));
			}

			protected override void OnOpened()
			{
				base.OnOpened();
				ActionItem.Schedule(messageReceivePump, this);
			}

			protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginOpen(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{
				innerChannel.SafeAddFaulted(onInnerChannelFaulted);
				return innerChannel.BeginOpen(timeout, callback, state);
			}

			protected override void OnEndOpen(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				innerChannel.EndOpen(result);
			}

			protected override void OnFaulted()
			{
				CancelPendingOperations(isFaulted: true);
				base.OnFaulted();
			}

			private bool HandleMessageReceived(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				Exception error = null;
				DuplexCorrelationAsyncResult requestAsyncResult = null;
				try
				{
					System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message = null;
					if (innerChannel.EndTryReceive(result, out message))
					{
						if (message != null)
						{
							UniqueId relatesTo = message.Headers.RelatesTo;
							if (inflightRequests.TryRemove(relatesTo, out requestAsyncResult))
							{
								requestAsyncResult.ReplyMessage = message;
								ThrowIfFaultMessage(requestAsyncResult.ReplyMessage);
							}
							else
							{
								MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
								{
									MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteLogOperation("DuplexMessageCorrelator.HandleMessageReceived", SRClient.NoCorrelationForChannelMessageId(innerChannel.Session.Id, relatesTo));
								});
							}
						}
						else
						{
							if (base.State != CommunicationState.Opened)
							{
								serverShutdownEvent.Set();
								return false;
							}
							MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
							{
								MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteRuntimeChannelFaulting(innerChannel.GetType().Name, innerChannel.LocalAddress.Uri.AbsoluteUri, innerChannel.RemoteAddress.Uri.AbsoluteUri, innerChannel.Via.AbsoluteUri, innerChannel.Session.Id, "HandleMessageReceived: Received null message.");
							});
							Fault();
						}
					}
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					Exception ex2 = ex;
					Exception exception = ex2;
					if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
					{
						throw;
					}
					if (requestAsyncResult == null && (!base.IsDisposed || !(exception is CommunicationObjectAbortedException)))
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
						{
							MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteRuntimeChannelFaulting(innerChannel.GetType().Name, innerChannel.LocalAddress.Uri.AbsoluteUri, innerChannel.RemoteAddress.Uri.AbsoluteUri, innerChannel.Via.AbsoluteUri, innerChannel.Session.Id, "HandleMessageReceived: " + exception.ToString());
						});
						Fault();
					}
					error = exception;
				}
				if (requestAsyncResult != null)
				{
					ActionItem.Schedule(delegate
					{
						requestAsyncResult.TryComplete(completedSynchronously: false, error);
					}, null);
				}
				return true;
			}

			private static void MessageReceivePump(object state)
			{
				DuplexRequestSessionChannel thisPtr = (DuplexRequestSessionChannel)state;
				try
				{
					bool flag;
					do
					{
						flag = false;
						if (thisPtr.State == CommunicationState.Opened || thisPtr.State == CommunicationState.Closing)
						{
							IAsyncResult asyncResult = thisPtr.innerChannel.BeginTryReceive(TimeSpan.MaxValue, onMessageReceived, thisPtr);
							if (asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
							{
								flag = thisPtr.HandleMessageReceived(asyncResult);
							}
						}
					}
					while (flag);
				}
				catch (CommunicationException ex)
				{
					CommunicationException communicationException = ex;
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteRuntimeChannelFaulting(thisPtr.innerChannel.GetType().Name, thisPtr.innerChannel.LocalAddress.Uri.AbsoluteUri, thisPtr.innerChannel.RemoteAddress.Uri.AbsoluteUri, thisPtr.innerChannel.Via.AbsoluteUri, thisPtr.innerChannel.Session.Id, "MessageReceivePump: " + communicationException.ToString());
					});
					thisPtr.Fault();
				}
			}

			private static void OnMessageReceived(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				if (!result.CompletedSynchronously)
				{
					DuplexRequestSessionChannel duplexRequestSessionChannel = (DuplexRequestSessionChannel)result.AsyncState;
					if (duplexRequestSessionChannel.HandleMessageReceived(result))
					{
						MessageReceivePump(duplexRequestSessionChannel);
					}
				}
			}

			private static void BeginPing(object state)
			{
				DuplexRequestSessionChannel thisPtr = (DuplexRequestSessionChannel)state;
				CommunicationState channelState = thisPtr.State;
				if (channelState != CommunicationState.Opened)
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteRuntimeChannelPingIncorrectState(thisPtr.innerChannel.GetType().Name, thisPtr.innerChannel.LocalAddress.Uri.AbsoluteUri, (thisPtr.innerChannel.RemoteAddress == null) ? "Null" : thisPtr.innerChannel.RemoteAddress.Uri.AbsoluteUri, (thisPtr.innerChannel.Via == null) ? "Null" : thisPtr.innerChannel.Via.AbsoluteUri, thisPtr.innerChannel.Session.Id, channelState.ToString());
					});
					return;
				}
				System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message = System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message.CreateMessage(thisPtr.messageVersion, "http://schemas.microsoft.com/servicebus/2010/08/protocol/Ping", new Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Channels.PingMessage());
				try
				{
					thisPtr.innerChannel.BeginSend(message, SbmpConstants.ConnectionPingOperationTimeout, endPing, thisPtr);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					Exception ex2 = ex;
					Exception exception = ex2;
					if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
					{
						throw;
					}
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteRuntimeChannelPingFailed(thisPtr.innerChannel.GetType().Name, thisPtr.innerChannel.LocalAddress.Uri.AbsoluteUri, (thisPtr.innerChannel.RemoteAddress == null) ? "Null" : thisPtr.innerChannel.RemoteAddress.Uri.AbsoluteUri, (thisPtr.innerChannel.Via == null) ? "Null" : thisPtr.innerChannel.Via.AbsoluteUri, thisPtr.innerChannel.Session.Id, exception.ToString());
					});
				}
			}

			private static void EndPing(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				DuplexRequestSessionChannel thisPtr = (DuplexRequestSessionChannel)result.AsyncState;
				try
				{
					thisPtr.innerChannel.EndSend(result);
					lock (thisPtr.pingTimer)
					{
						CommunicationState channelState = thisPtr.State;
						if (channelState == CommunicationState.Opened)
						{
							if (!thisPtr.clientMode || thisPtr.inflightRequests.Count > 0)
							{
								thisPtr.pingTimer.Set(SbmpConstants.ConnectionPingTimeout);
							}
						}
						else if (channelState != CommunicationState.Opened)
						{
							MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
							{
								MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteRuntimeChannelStopPingWithIncorrectState(thisPtr.innerChannel.GetType().Name, thisPtr.innerChannel.LocalAddress.Uri.AbsoluteUri, (thisPtr.innerChannel.RemoteAddress == null) ? "Null" : thisPtr.innerChannel.RemoteAddress.Uri.AbsoluteUri, (thisPtr.innerChannel.Via == null) ? "Null" : thisPtr.innerChannel.Via.AbsoluteUri, thisPtr.innerChannel.Session.Id, channelState.ToString(), thisPtr.inflightRequests.Count);
							});
						}
					}
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					Exception ex2 = ex;
					Exception exception = ex2;
					if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
					{
						throw;
					}
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteRuntimeChannelPingFailed(thisPtr.innerChannel.GetType().Name, thisPtr.innerChannel.LocalAddress.Uri.AbsoluteUri, (thisPtr.innerChannel.RemoteAddress == null) ? "Null" : thisPtr.innerChannel.RemoteAddress.Uri.AbsoluteUri, (thisPtr.innerChannel.Via == null) ? "Null" : thisPtr.innerChannel.Via.AbsoluteUri, thisPtr.innerChannel.Session.Id, exception.ToString());
					});
				}
			}

			private void ThrowIfFaultMessage(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message wcfMessage)
			{
				if (!wcfMessage.IsFault)
				{
					return;
				}
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteLogOperation("DuplexMessageCorrelator.ThrowIfFaultMessage", "Fault message received from server");
				});
				string action = wcfMessage.Headers.Action;
				MessageFault messageFault = MessageFault.CreateFault(wcfMessage, 65536);
				FaultConverter property = innerChannel.GetProperty<FaultConverter>();
				if (property != null && property.TryCreateException(wcfMessage, messageFault, out var exception))
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.AsWarning(exception);
				}
				if (messageFault.HasDetail)
				{
					ExceptionDetail detail = messageFault.GetDetail<ExceptionDetail>();
					if (!clientMode && string.Equals(detail.Type, typeof(CommunicationException).FullName, StringComparison.Ordinal))
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
						{
							MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteRuntimeChannelFaulting(innerChannel.GetType().Name, innerChannel.LocalAddress.Uri.AbsoluteUri, innerChannel.RemoteAddress.Uri.AbsoluteUri, innerChannel.Via.AbsoluteUri, innerChannel.Session.Id, "ThrowIfFaultMessage: Received CommunicationException as fault message. " + detail.ToString());
						});
						Fault();
					}
					if (includeExceptionDetails)
					{
						throw FxTrace.Exception.AsInformation(new FaultException<ExceptionDetail>(detail, messageFault.Reason, messageFault.Code, action));
					}
					throw FxTrace.Exception.AsInformation(new FaultException<ExceptionDetailNoStackTrace>(new ExceptionDetailNoStackTrace(detail, includeInnerException: true), messageFault.Reason, messageFault.Code, action));
				}
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsWarning(new FaultException(messageFault, action));
			}

			private void OnInnerChannelFaulted(object sender, EventArgs args)
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteRuntimeChannelFaulting(innerChannel.GetType().Name, innerChannel.LocalAddress.Uri.AbsoluteUri, innerChannel.RemoteAddress.Uri.AbsoluteUri, innerChannel.Via.AbsoluteUri, innerChannel.Session.Id, "OnInnerChannelFaulted");
				});
				try
				{
					Type type = innerChannel.GetType();
					FieldInfo field = type.GetField("decoder", BindingFlags.IgnoreCase | BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
					if (field != null)
					{
						object value = field.GetValue(innerChannel);
						Type type2 = value.GetType();
						FieldInfo field2 = type2.GetField("faultDecoder", BindingFlags.IgnoreCase | BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
						if (field2 != null)
						{
							object value2 = field2.GetValue(value);
							if (value2 != null)
							{
								PropertyInfo property = type2.GetProperty("Fault");
								if (property != null)
								{
									string text = (string)property.GetValue(value, null);
									IsMaxMessageSizeExceededFault = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text) && text.Contains("http://schemas.microsoft.com/ws/2006/05/framing/faults/MaxMessageSizeExceededFault");
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					Exception ex2 = ex;
					Exception e = ex2;
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteExceptionAsInformation(e.Message);
					});
				}
				Fault();
			}

			private void UnregisterInnerChannelEvents()
			{
				innerChannel.Faulted -= onInnerChannelFaulted;
			}

			private void CancelPendingOperations(bool isFaulted)
			{
				CancelPing();
				if (Interlocked.Exchange(ref interlockedSync, 1) != 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (DuplexCorrelationAsyncResult value in inflightRequests.Values)
				{
					DuplexCorrelationAsyncResult duplexCorrelationAsyncResult = value;
					string message = SRClient.TrackableExceptionMessageFormat(SRClient.ServerDidNotReply, duplexCorrelationAsyncResult.CreateClientTrackingExceptionInfo());
					Exception exceptionToThrow = new CommunicationObjectAbortedException(message);
					if (isFaulted)
					{
						exceptionToThrow = new CommunicationObjectFaultedException(message);
					}
					ActionItem.Schedule(delegate
					{
						duplexCorrelationAsyncResult.TryComplete(completedSynchronously: false, exceptionToThrow);
					}, null);
				}
				inflightRequests.Clear();
			}

			private void CancelPing()
			{
				if (pingTimer != null)
				{
					lock (pingTimer)
					{
						pingTimer.Cancel();
					}
				}
			}

			private void OnBeginRequest()
			{
				if (pingTimer != null)
				{
					lock (pingTimer)
					{
						pingTimer.Set(SbmpConstants.ConnectionPingTimeout);
					}
				}
			}

			private void OnEndRequest()
			{
				if (!clientMode || pingTimer == null || inflightRequests.Count != 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				lock (pingTimer)
				{
					if (inflightRequests.Count == 0)
					{
						pingTimer.Cancel();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public bool ClientMode { get; set; }

		public bool EnablePing { get; set; }

		public bool IncludeExceptionDetails { get; set; }

		public DuplexRequestBindingElement()
		{
			ClientMode = true;
			EnablePing = true;
		}

		private DuplexRequestBindingElement(DuplexRequestBindingElement other)
		{
			ClientMode = other.ClientMode;
			EnablePing = other.EnablePing;
			IncludeExceptionDetails = other.IncludeExceptionDetails;
		}

		public override BindingElement Clone()
		{
			return new DuplexRequestBindingElement(this);
		}

		public override T GetProperty<T>(BindingContext context)
		{
			return context.GetInnerProperty<T>();
		}

		public override bool CanBuildChannelFactory<TChannel>(BindingContext context)
		{
			if (context == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNull("context");
			}
			if (typeof(TChannel) == typeof(IRequestSessionChannel))
			{
				return base.CanBuildChannelFactory<IDuplexSessionChannel>(context);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override IChannelFactory<TChannel> BuildChannelFactory<TChannel>(BindingContext context)
		{
			if (!CanBuildChannelFactory<TChannel>(context))
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.Argument("TChannel", SRClient.ChannelTypeNotSupported(typeof(TChannel)));
			}
			return (IChannelFactory<TChannel>)new DuplexRequestChannelFactory(context, this);
		}

	[XmlRoot("SessionState", Namespace = "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2011/06/servicebus")]
	internal class SessionState : IXmlSerializable, IDisposable
	{
		private enum FieldId : byte
		{
			SessionState = 1
		}

		private bool disposed;

		public Stream Stream { get; set; }

		internal SessionState(Stream sessionState)
		{
			Stream = sessionState;
		}

		private SessionState()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		XmlSchema IXmlSerializable.GetSchema()
		{
			return null;
		}

		void IXmlSerializable.ReadXml(XmlReader reader)
		{
			reader.Read();
			reader.ReadStartElement();
			DeserializeGroupState(this, reader);
			reader.ReadEndElement();
		}

		void IXmlSerializable.WriteXml(XmlWriter writer)
		{
			writer.WriteStartElement("SessionState");
			SerializeSessionState(this, writer);
			writer.WriteEndElement();
		}

		private static byte[] ReadBytes(XmlReader reader, int bytesToRead)
		{
			byte[] array = new byte[bytesToRead];
			int num = 0;
			while (num < bytesToRead)
			{
				int num2 = reader.ReadContentAsBase64(array, num, array.Length - num);
				num += num2;
				if (num2 == 0)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			if (num < bytesToRead)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException("Insufficient data in the byte-stream"));
			}
			return array;
		}

		private static void SerializeSessionState(SessionState sessionState, XmlWriter writer)
		{
			writer.WriteBase64(new byte[1] { 1 }, 0, 1);
			long num = 0L;
			if (sessionState.Stream != null)
			{
				num = (sessionState.Stream.CanSeek ? sessionState.Stream.Length : (-1));
			}
			writer.WriteBase64(BitConverter.GetBytes(num), 0, 8);
			if (sessionState.Stream == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (sessionState.Stream.CanSeek && sessionState.Stream.Position != 0L)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.CannotSerializeSessionStateWithPartiallyConsumedStream));
			}
			byte[] array = new byte[1024];
			long num2 = 0L;
			while (true)
			{
				int num3 = sessionState.Stream.Read(array, 0, array.Length);
				if (num3 == 0)
				{
					break;
				}
				num2 += num3;
				writer.WriteBase64(array, 0, num3);
			}
			if (num > 0 && num2 != num)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.FailedToSerializeEntireSessionStateStream));
			}
		}

		private static void DeserializeGroupState(SessionState messageGroupState, XmlReader reader)
		{
			byte[] value = ReadBytes(reader, 9);
			long num = BitConverter.ToInt64(value, 1);
			if (num == 0L)
			{
				return;
			}
			InternalBufferManager bufferManager = ThrottledBufferManager.GetBufferManager();
			using BufferedOutputStream bufferedOutputStream = new BufferedOutputStream(1024, int.MaxValue, bufferManager);
			byte[] array = bufferManager.TakeBuffer(1024);
			long num2 = 0L;
			try
			{
				while (true)
				{
					int num3 = reader.ReadContentAsBase64(array, 0, array.Length);
					if (num3 == 0)
					{
						break;
					}
					num2 += num3;
					bufferedOutputStream.Write(array, 0, num3);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				bufferManager.ReturnBuffer(array);
			}
			int bufferSize;
			byte[] bytes = bufferedOutputStream.ToArray(out bufferSize);
			messageGroupState.Stream = new BufferedInputStream(bytes, bufferSize, bufferManager);
			if (num > 0 && num2 != num)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.FailedToDeSerializeEntireSessionStateStream));
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		private void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (!disposed)
			{
				if (disposing && Stream != null)
				{
					Stream.Dispose();
					Stream = null;
				}
				disposed = true;
			}
		}
	}
	internal sealed class SbmpQueueClient : QueueClient
	{
		private sealed class CloseAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<CloseAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly bool aborting;

			private readonly SbmpQueueClient parent;

			public CloseAsyncResult(SbmpQueueClient parent, bool aborting, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.aborting = aborting;
				this.parent = parent;
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				if (aborting)
				{
					if (parent.ControlMessageCreator.IsValueCreated)
					{
						CloseOrAbortLinkAsyncResult closeOrAbortLinkAsyncResult = new CloseOrAbortLinkAsyncResult(parent.ControlMessageCreator.Value, ((SbmpMessagingFactory)parent.MessagingFactory).Channel, null, RemainingTime(), aborting: true, null, null);
						closeOrAbortLinkAsyncResult.Schedule();
					}
					parent.BaseAbort();
					yield break;
				}
				if (parent.ControlMessageCreator.IsValueCreated)
				{
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((CloseAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => new CloseOrAbortLinkAsyncResult(thisPtr.parent.ControlMessageCreator.Value, ((SbmpMessagingFactory)thisPtr.parent.MessagingFactory).Channel, null, t, aborting: false, c, s).Start()), (EndCall)delegate(CloseAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						AsyncResult<CloseOrAbortLinkAsyncResult>.End(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
				}
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((CloseAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.parent.BaseBeginClose(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(CloseAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					thisPtr.parent.EndBaseClose(r);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
			}
		}

		public SbmpQueueClient(SbmpMessagingFactory messagingFactory, string name, ReceiveMode receiveMode)

					AsyncResult<CloseAsyncResult>.End(r);
				}

						throw;
					}
				}
			}, null).Start();
		}

		}

	internal class SbmpResourceManager
	{
		private class EnlistAsyncResult : Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult
		{
			private static readonly AsyncCompletion getInstanceComplete = GetInstanceComplete;

			private readonly TransactionEnlistment transactionEnlistment;

			private int sequenceNumber;

			public EnlistAsyncResult(SbmpResourceManager resourceManager, Transaction transaction, IRequestSessionChannel channel, SbmpMessageCreator messageCreator, Action<RequestInfo> partitionInfoSetter, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(callback, state)
			{
				if (transaction.IsolationLevel != IsolationLevel.Serializable)
				{
					throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.IsolationLevelNotSupported));
				}
				string localIdentifier = transaction.TransactionInformation.LocalIdentifier;
				lock (resourceManager.syncRoot)
				{
					if (!resourceManager.enlistmentMap.TryGetValue(localIdentifier, out transactionEnlistment))
					{
						transactionEnlistment = new TransactionEnlistment(transaction, resourceManager, channel, messageCreator, partitionInfoSetter);
						resourceManager.enlistmentMap.Add(localIdentifier, transactionEnlistment);
						if (!transaction.EnlistPromotableSinglePhase(transactionEnlistment))
						{
							resourceManager.enlistmentMap.Remove(localIdentifier);
							throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.MultipleResourceManagersNotSupported));
						}
					}
				}
				sequenceNumber = transactionEnlistment.GetNextSequenceNumber();
				IAsyncResult result = transactionEnlistment.BeginGetInstance(timeout, PrepareAsyncCompletion(getInstanceComplete), this);
				if (SyncContinue(result))
				{
					Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: true);
				}
			}

			public static int End(IAsyncResult asyncResult)
			{
				return Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult.End<EnlistAsyncResult>(asyncResult).sequenceNumber;
			}

			private static bool GetInstanceComplete(IAsyncResult asyncResult)
			{
				EnlistAsyncResult enlistAsyncResult = (EnlistAsyncResult)asyncResult.AsyncState;
				enlistAsyncResult.transactionEnlistment.EndGetInstance(asyncResult);
				return true;
			}
		}

		public class TransactionEnlistment : SingletonManager<IRequestSessionChannel>, IPromotableSinglePhaseNotification, ITransactionPromoter
		{
			private sealed class CreateInstanceAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<CreateInstanceAsyncResult>
			{
				private static readonly Action<Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult, Exception> Finally = OnFinally;

				private readonly TransactionEnlistment owner;

				private System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message request;

				private System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message response;

				public CreateInstanceAsyncResult(TransactionEnlistment owner, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
					: base(timeout, callback, state)
				{
					this.owner = owner;
					base.OnCompleting = (Action<Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult, Exception>)Delegate.Combine(base.OnCompleting, Finally);
					Start();
				}

				protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
				{
					CreateTransactionCommand createTransactionCommand = new CreateTransactionCommand();
					createTransactionCommand.TransactionId = owner.transactionId;
					createTransactionCommand.Timeout = RemainingTime();
					RequestInfo requestInfo = owner.RequestInfo.Clone();
					requestInfo.ServerTimeout = createTransactionCommand.Timeout;
					requestInfo.TransactionId = createTransactionCommand.TransactionId;
					request = owner.messageCreator.CreateWcfMessage("http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2011/06/servicebus/SbmpConnection/CreateTransaction", createTransactionCommand, requestInfo);
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((CreateInstanceAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.owner.channel.BeginRequest(thisPtr.request, SbmpProtocolDefaults.BufferTimeout(t, thisPtr.owner.messageCreator.DisableClientOperationTimeBuffer), c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(CreateInstanceAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.response = thisPtr.owner.channel.EndRequest(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
					if (response.IsFault)
					{
						Complete(new MessagingException(response.ToString()));
					}
				}

				public new static IRequestSessionChannel End(IAsyncResult result)
				{
					CreateInstanceAsyncResult createInstanceAsyncResult = AsyncResult<CreateInstanceAsyncResult>.End(result);
					return createInstanceAsyncResult.owner.channel;
				}

				private static void OnFinally(Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult result, Exception exception)
				{
					if (exception != null)
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
						{
							MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteLogOperationWarning(exception.ToString(), "SbmpResourceManager.TransactionEnlistment.CreateInstanceAsyncResult.OnFinally");
						});
					}
				}
			}

			private class CompleteTransactionHelper
			{
				private static readonly AsyncCallback operationCallback = OperationCallback;

				private readonly TransactionEnlistment transactionEnlistment;

				private readonly SinglePhaseEnlistment singlePhaseEnlistment;

				private readonly bool commit;

				public CompleteTransactionHelper(TransactionEnlistment transactionEnlistment, SinglePhaseEnlistment singlePhaseEnlistment, bool commit)
				{
					this.transactionEnlistment = transactionEnlistment;
					this.singlePhaseEnlistment = singlePhaseEnlistment;
					this.commit = commit;
				}

				public void Start()
				{
					lock (transactionEnlistment.resourceManager.syncRoot)
					{
						transactionEnlistment.resourceManager.enlistmentMap.Remove(transactionEnlistment.transactionId);
					}
					try
					{
						CompleteTransactionCommand completeTransactionCommand = new CompleteTransactionCommand();
						completeTransactionCommand.TransactionId = transactionEnlistment.transactionId;
						completeTransactionCommand.Timeout = rollbackTimeout;
						completeTransactionCommand.Commit = commit;
						RequestInfo requestInfo = transactionEnlistment.RequestInfo.Clone();
						requestInfo.ServerTimeout = completeTransactionCommand.Timeout;
						requestInfo.TransactionId = completeTransactionCommand.TransactionId;
						System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message = transactionEnlistment.messageCreator.CreateWcfMessage("http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2011/06/servicebus/SbmpConnection/CompleteTransaction", completeTransactionCommand, requestInfo);
						WorkUnitInfo.AddTo(message.Headers, "TxnWorkUnit", completeTransactionCommand.TransactionId, transactionEnlistment.GetNextSequenceNumber());
						IAsyncResult asyncResult = transactionEnlistment.channel.BeginRequest(message, SbmpProtocolDefaults.BufferTimeout(rollbackTimeout, transactionEnlistment.messageCreator.DisableClientOperationTimeBuffer), operationCallback, this);
						if (asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
						{
							OperationComplete(asyncResult);
						}
					}
					catch (Exception exception)
					{
						if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
						{
							throw;
						}
						OnError(exception);
					}
				}

				private static void OperationCallback(IAsyncResult result)
				{
					if (result.CompletedSynchronously)
					{
						return;
					}
					CompleteTransactionHelper completeTransactionHelper = (CompleteTransactionHelper)result.AsyncState;
					try
					{
						completeTransactionHelper.OperationComplete(result);
					}
					catch (Exception exception)
					{
						if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
						{
							throw;
						}
						completeTransactionHelper.OnError(exception);
					}
				}

				private void OperationComplete(IAsyncResult result)
				{
					System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message = transactionEnlistment.channel.EndRequest(result);
					CompleteTransactionResponseCommand body = message.GetBody<CompleteTransactionResponseCommand>();
					if (commit)
					{
						switch (body.TransactionStatus)
						{
						case TransactionStatus.Committed:
							singlePhaseEnlistment.Committed();
							break;
						case TransactionStatus.Aborted:
							singlePhaseEnlistment.Aborted(new MessagingException(body.Details));
							break;
						default:
							singlePhaseEnlistment.InDoubt(new MessagingException(body.Details));
							break;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						switch (body.TransactionStatus)
						{
						case TransactionStatus.Aborted:
							singlePhaseEnlistment.Aborted();
							break;
						case TransactionStatus.Committed:
							throw Fx.AssertAndThrow("The server Committed the Transaction even though the client requested it Abort!");
						default:
							singlePhaseEnlistment.InDoubt(new MessagingException(body.Details));
							break;
						}
					}
				}

				private void OnError(Exception exception)
				{
					if (exception is CommunicationException exception2)
					{
						exception = MessagingExceptionHelper.Unwrap(exception2, isCancelling: false);
					}
					if (commit)
					{
						singlePhaseEnlistment.InDoubt(exception);
					}
					else
					{
						singlePhaseEnlistment.Aborted(exception);
					}
				}
			}

			private static readonly TimeSpan rollbackTimeout = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1.0);

			private readonly Transaction transaction;

			private readonly string transactionId;

			private readonly SbmpResourceManager resourceManager;

			private readonly IRequestSessionChannel channel;

			private readonly SbmpMessageCreator messageCreator;

			private int sequenceNumber;

			public RequestInfo RequestInfo { get; private set; }

			public TransactionEnlistment(Transaction transaction, SbmpResourceManager resourceManager, IRequestSessionChannel channel, SbmpMessageCreator messageCreator, Action<RequestInfo> partitionInfoSetter)
				: base(new object())
			{
				this.transaction = transaction;
				transactionId = this.transaction.TransactionInformation.LocalIdentifier;
				this.resourceManager = resourceManager;
				this.channel = channel;
				this.messageCreator = messageCreator;
				sequenceNumber = -1;
				RequestInfo = new RequestInfo();
				partitionInfoSetter(RequestInfo);
			}

			public int GetNextSequenceNumber()
			{
				return Interlocked.Increment(ref sequenceNumber);
			}

			void IPromotableSinglePhaseNotification.Initialize()
			{
			}

			void IPromotableSinglePhaseNotification.Rollback(SinglePhaseEnlistment singlePhaseEnlistment)
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteLogOperation("TransactionEnlistment.Rollback", transactionId);
				});
				new CompleteTransactionHelper(this, singlePhaseEnlistment, commit: false).Start();
			}

			void IPromotableSinglePhaseNotification.SinglePhaseCommit(SinglePhaseEnlistment singlePhaseEnlistment)
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteLogOperation("TransactionEnlistment.Commit", transactionId);
				});
				new CompleteTransactionHelper(this, singlePhaseEnlistment, commit: true).Start();
			}

			byte[] ITransactionPromoter.Promote()
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new TransactionPromotionException(SRClient.MultipleResourceManagersNotSupported));
			}

			protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginCreateInstance(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{
				return new CreateInstanceAsyncResult(this, timeout, callback, state);
			}

			protected override IRequestSessionChannel OnEndCreateInstance(IAsyncResult asyncResult)
			{
				return CreateInstanceAsyncResult.End(asyncResult);
			}
		}

		private static readonly SbmpResourceManager singletonInstance = new SbmpResourceManager();

		private readonly object syncRoot;

		private Dictionary<string, TransactionEnlistment> enlistmentMap;

		public static SbmpResourceManager Instance => singletonInstance;

		private SbmpResourceManager()
		{
			syncRoot = new object();
			enlistmentMap = new Dictionary<string, TransactionEnlistment>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginEnlist(Transaction transaction, IRequestSessionChannel channel, SbmpMessageCreator messageCreator, Action<RequestInfo> partitionInfoSetter, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new EnlistAsyncResult(this, transaction, channel, messageCreator, partitionInfoSetter, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		public int EndEnlist(IAsyncResult asyncResult)
		{
			return EnlistAsyncResult.End(asyncResult);
		}
	}

		private sealed class CloseAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<CloseAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly bool aborting;

			private readonly SbmpSubscriptionClient parent;

			public CloseAsyncResult(SbmpSubscriptionClient parent, bool aborting, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.aborting = aborting;
				this.parent = parent;
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				if (aborting)
				{
					if (parent.ControlMessageCreator.IsValueCreated)
					{
						CloseOrAbortLinkAsyncResult closeOrAbortLinkAsyncResult = new CloseOrAbortLinkAsyncResult(parent.ControlMessageCreator.Value, ((SbmpMessagingFactory)parent.MessagingFactory).Channel, null, RemainingTime(), aborting: true, null, null);
						closeOrAbortLinkAsyncResult.Schedule();
					}
					parent.BaseAbort();
					yield break;
				}
				if (parent.ControlMessageCreator.IsValueCreated)
				{
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((CloseAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => new CloseOrAbortLinkAsyncResult(thisPtr.parent.ControlMessageCreator.Value, ((SbmpMessagingFactory)thisPtr.parent.MessagingFactory).Channel, null, t, aborting: false, c, s).Start()), (EndCall)delegate(CloseAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						AsyncResult<CloseOrAbortLinkAsyncResult>.End(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
				}
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((CloseAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.parent.BaseBeginClose(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(CloseAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					thisPtr.parent.EndBaseClose(r);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
			}
		}

					ServerTimeout = addRuleCommand.Timeout,
					TransactionId = addRuleCommand.TransactionId
				};

	internal abstract class SbmpTransactionalAsyncResult<TIteratorAsyncResult> : IteratorAsyncResult<TIteratorAsyncResult> where TIteratorAsyncResult : SbmpTransactionalAsyncResult<TIteratorAsyncResult>
	{
		private readonly SbmpMessagingFactory messagingFactory;

		private readonly IRequestSessionChannel channel;

		private readonly Lazy<SbmpMessageCreator> controlMessageCreator;

		private System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message wcfMessage;

		private int txnSeqNumber;

		public SbmpMessageCreator MessageCreator { get; private set; }

		public System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message Response { get; private set; }

		public Transaction Transaction { get; private set; }

		protected SbmpTransactionalAsyncResult(SbmpMessagingFactory messagingFactory, SbmpMessageCreator messageCreator, Lazy<SbmpMessageCreator> controlMessageCreator, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			: base(timeout, callback, state)
		{
			this.messagingFactory = messagingFactory;
			MessageCreator = messageCreator;
			channel = this.messagingFactory.Channel;
			this.controlMessageCreator = controlMessageCreator;
			Transaction = Transaction.Current;
		}

		protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
		{
			if (Transaction != null)
			{
				SbmpMessageCreator messageCreator;
				if (controlMessageCreator != null)
				{
					messageCreator = controlMessageCreator.Value;
				}
				else
				{
					messageCreator = MessageCreator;
				}
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((TIteratorAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.messagingFactory.ResourceManager.BeginEnlist(thisPtr.Transaction, thisPtr.channel, messageCreator, thisPtr.PartitionInfoSetter, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(TIteratorAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult a)
				{
					thisPtr.txnSeqNumber = thisPtr.messagingFactory.ResourceManager.EndEnlist(a);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
				wcfMessage = CreateWcfMessage();
				WorkUnitInfo.AddTo(wcfMessage.Headers, "TxnWorkUnit", Transaction.TransactionInformation.LocalIdentifier, txnSeqNumber);
			}
			else
			{
				wcfMessage = CreateWcfMessage();
			}
			yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((TIteratorAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.channel.BeginRequest(thisPtr.wcfMessage, SbmpProtocolDefaults.BufferTimeout(t, messagingFactory.GetSettings().EnableAdditionalClientTimeout), c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(TIteratorAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult a)
			{
				thisPtr.Response = thisPtr.channel.EndRequest(a);
			}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
		}

		protected abstract System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message CreateWcfMessage();

		protected abstract void PartitionInfoSetter(RequestInfo requestInfo);
	}

	[DataContract(Name = "TryReceive", Namespace = "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2011/06/servicebus")]
	internal class TryReceiveCommand : IExtensibleDataObject
	{
		[DataMember(Name = "messageCount", EmitDefaultValue = true, IsRequired = false, Order = 65537)]
		private int messageCount;

		[DataMember(Name = "appMessageIds", EmitDefaultValue = true, IsRequired = false, Order = 65538)]
		private IEnumerable<long> appMessageIds;

		[DataMember(Name = "timeout", EmitDefaultValue = true, IsRequired = false, Order = 65539)]
		private TimeSpan timeout;

		[DataMember(Name = "messageVersion", EmitDefaultValue = false, IsRequired = false, Order = 131073)]
		private int messageVersion;

		[DataMember(Name = "operationTimeout", EmitDefaultValue = true, IsRequired = false, Order = 131074)]
		private TimeSpan operationTimeout;

		private ExtensionDataObject extensionData;

		public int MessageCount
		{
			get
			{
				return messageCount;
			}
			set
			{
				messageCount = value;
			}
		}

		public IEnumerable<long> AppMessageIds
		{
			get
			{
				return appMessageIds;
			}
			set
			{
				appMessageIds = value;
			}
		}

		public TimeSpan Timeout
		{
			get
			{
				return timeout;
			}
			set
			{
				timeout = value;
			}
		}

		public int MessageVersion
		{
			get
			{
				if (messageVersion != 0)
				{
					return messageVersion;
				}
				return BrokeredMessage.MessageVersion1;
			}
			set
			{
				messageVersion = value;
			}
		}

		public TimeSpan OperationTimeout
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(operationTimeout == TimeSpan.Zero))
				{
					return operationTimeout;
				}
				return Timeout;
			}
			set
			{
				operationTimeout = value;
			}
		}

		public ExtensionDataObject ExtensionData
		{
			get
			{
				return extensionData;
			}
			set
			{
				extensionData = value;
			}
		}
	}

		public string TrackingId { get; private set; }

		public AmqpMap Map { get; private set; }

		protected AmqpResponseMessage(AmqpMessage responseMessage)
		{
			this.responseMessage = responseMessage;
			StatusCode = this.responseMessage.GetResponseStatusCode();
			if (this.responseMessage.ApplicationProperties.Map.TryGetValue<string>(ManagementConstants.Properties.TrackingId, out var value))
			{
				TrackingId = value;
			}
			if (responseMessage.ValueBody != null)
			{
				Map = responseMessage.ValueBody.Value as AmqpMap;
			}
		}

		public TValue GetValue<TValue>(string key)
		{
			if (Map == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(AmqpValue.Name);
			}
			object obj = Map[key];
			if (obj == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException(key.ToString());
			}
			if (!(obj is TValue))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(key.ToString());
			}
			return (TValue)Map[key];
		}

		public IEnumerable<TValue> GetListValue<TValue>(string key)
		{
			if (Map == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(AmqpValue.Name);
			}
			List<object> source = (List<object>)Map[key];
			return source.Cast<TValue>();
		}

		public AmqpSymbol GetResponseErrorCondition()
		{
			object obj = responseMessage.ApplicationProperties.Map["errorCondition"];
			if (!(obj is AmqpSymbol))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return (AmqpSymbol)obj;
		}

		public Exception ToMessagingContractException()
		{
			return responseMessage.ToMessagingContractException(StatusCode);
		}

	public class AmqpTransactionEnlistment : IPromotableSinglePhaseNotification, ITransactionPromoter
	{
		public ArraySegment<byte> AmqpTransactionId { get; set; }

		public Transaction Transaction { get; set; }

		internal AmqpTransactionManager TransactionManager { get; set; }

		internal AmqpMessagingFactory MessagingFactory { get; set; }

		public byte[] Promote()
		{
			throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new TransactionPromotionException(SRClient.MultipleResourceManagersNotSupported));
		}

		public void Initialize()
		{
		}

		public void SinglePhaseCommit(SinglePhaseEnlistment singlePhaseEnlistment)
		{
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteLogOperation("TransactionEnlistment.Commit", Transaction.TransactionInformation.LocalIdentifier);
			SinglePhaseCommitAsync(singlePhaseEnlistment).Fork();
		}

		private async Task SinglePhaseCommitAsync(SinglePhaseEnlistment singlePhaseEnlistment)
		{
			try
			{
				await Task.Factory.FromAsync(TransactionManager.BeginDischarge(singlePhaseEnlistment, this, fail: false, MessagingFactory.OperationTimeout, null, null), TransactionManager.EndDischarge).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				singlePhaseEnlistment.Committed();
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				Exception clientException = AmqpExceptionHelper.GetClientException(exception, null);
				singlePhaseEnlistment.InDoubt(clientException);
			}
		}

		public void Rollback(SinglePhaseEnlistment singlePhaseEnlistment)
		{
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteLogOperation("TransactionEnlistment.Rollback", Transaction.TransactionInformation.LocalIdentifier);
			RollbackAsync(singlePhaseEnlistment).Fork();
		}

		private async Task RollbackAsync(SinglePhaseEnlistment singlePhaseEnlistment)
		{
			try
			{
				await Task.Factory.FromAsync(TransactionManager.BeginDischarge(singlePhaseEnlistment, this, fail: true, MessagingFactory.OperationTimeout, null, null), TransactionManager.EndDischarge).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				singlePhaseEnlistment.Aborted();
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				Exception clientException = AmqpExceptionHelper.GetClientException(exception, null);
				singlePhaseEnlistment.Aborted(clientException);
			}
		}
	}

	internal class ByteBufferReadStream : Stream, ICloneable
	{
		private readonly ByteBuffer buffer;

		private int pos;

		private bool disposed;

		internal ByteBuffer Buffer => buffer;

		public override bool CanRead => true;

		public override bool CanWrite => false;

		public override bool CanSeek => true;

		public override long Position
		{
			get
			{
				return pos;
			}
			set
			{
				pos = (int)value;
			}
		}

		public override long Length => buffer.Length;

		public ByteBufferReadStream(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			this.buffer = buffer;
		}

		public object Clone()
		{
			return new ByteBufferReadStream(buffer.GetSlice(buffer.Offset, buffer.Length));
		}

		public override long Seek(long offset, SeekOrigin origin)
		{
			switch (origin)
			{
			case SeekOrigin.Begin:
				pos = (int)offset;
				break;
			case SeekOrigin.Current:
				pos += (int)offset;
				break;
			default:
				pos = buffer.Length + (int)offset;
				break;
			}
			return pos;
		}

		public override void SetLength(long value)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public override void Flush()
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public override int Read(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)
		{
			if (pos >= this.buffer.Length)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int num = Math.Min(this.buffer.Length - pos, count);
			System.Buffer.BlockCopy(this.buffer.Buffer, this.buffer.Offset + pos, buffer, offset, num);
			pos += num;
			return num;
		}

		public override int ReadByte()
		{
			if (pos >= buffer.Length)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			int result = buffer.Buffer[buffer.Offset + pos];
			pos++;
			return result;
		}

		public override void Write(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public override void WriteByte(byte value)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (!disposed)
			{
				disposed = true;
				base.Dispose(disposing);
				buffer.Dispose();
			}
		}
	}

	internal sealed class AmqpMessageAttachment : BrokeredMessage.IAttachment, IDisposable
	{
		private sealed class MutableMessage : AmqpMessage
		{
			private bool updating;

			public void Update(BrokeredMessage brokeredMessage, SerializationTarget target, bool amqpClient, bool partitioning)
			{
				lock (this)
				{
					updating = true;
					try
					{
						if (amqpClient)
						{
							AmqpMessageConverter.UpdateAmqpMessageHeadersAndProperties(this, brokeredMessage, brokeredMessage.InitializedMembers, amqpClient, partitioning, target);
							if (brokeredMessage.IsLockTokenSet)
							{
								base.DeliveryAnnotations.Map["x-opt-lock-token"] = brokeredMessage.LockToken;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							AmqpMessageEncoder.UpdateAmqpMessageHeadersAndProperties(brokeredMessage, this, target);
						}
					}
					finally
					{
						updating = false;
					}
				}
			}

			public override void Initialize(SectionFlag desiredSections)
			{
			}

			protected override void EnsureInitialized<T>(ref T obj, SectionFlag section)
			{
				if (updating)
				{
					base.EnsureInitialized(ref obj, section);
				}
			}
		}

		private readonly AmqpMessage message;

		private MutableMessage modified;

		public AmqpMessage Message => message;

		public AmqpMessageAttachment(AmqpMessage message)
		{
			this.message = message;
		}

		public void WriteMessage(ByteBuffer buffer, Stream bodyStream, bool skipFooterSection = false)
		{
			WriteSection(buffer, message, modified, (AmqpMessage m) => m.Header);
			WriteSection(buffer, message, modified, (AmqpMessage m) => m.DeliveryAnnotations);
			WriteSection(buffer, message, modified, (AmqpMessage m) => m.MessageAnnotations);
			WriteSection(buffer, message, modified, (AmqpMessage m) => m.Properties);
			WriteSection(buffer, message, modified, (AmqpMessage m) => m.ApplicationProperties);
			if (bodyStream != null)
			{
				int num = (int)bodyStream.Length;
				buffer.Validate(write: true, num);
				while (num > 0)
				{
					int num2 = bodyStream.Read(buffer.Buffer, buffer.WritePos, num);
					buffer.Append(num2);
					num -= num2;
				}
			}
			if (!skipFooterSection)
			{
				WriteSection(buffer, message, modified, (AmqpMessage m) => m.Footer);
			}
		}

		public void Update(BrokeredMessage brokeredMessage, SerializationTarget target, bool amqpClient, bool partitioning)
		{
			if (modified == null)
			{
				modified = new MutableMessage();
				modified.CloneFrom(message, includeBody: false);
			}
			modified.Update(brokeredMessage, target, amqpClient, partitioning);
		}

		public BrokeredMessage.IAttachment Clone()
		{
			AmqpMessageAttachment amqpMessageAttachment = new AmqpMessageAttachment(message);
			amqpMessageAttachment.Message.Buffer.AddReference();
			if (modified != null)
			{
				amqpMessageAttachment.modified = new MutableMessage();
				amqpMessageAttachment.modified.CloneFrom(modified, includeBody: false);
			}
			return amqpMessageAttachment;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			message.Buffer.RemoveReference();
		}

		public void OnApplicationPropertyChanged(string name, object value)
		{
		}

		internal void RemoveAddedCustomJmsProperties()
		{
			if (modified != null)
			{
				AmqpMessageConverter.RemoveAddedJmsPropertiesFromAmqpMessage(modified);
			}
		}

		private static void WriteSection(ByteBuffer buffer, AmqpMessage original, AmqpMessage modified, Func<AmqpMessage, AmqpDescribed> getter)
		{
			if (modified != null)
			{
				AmqpDescribed amqpDescribed = getter(modified);
				if (amqpDescribed != null)
				{
					lock (modified)
					{
						amqpDescribed.Encode(buffer);
						return;
					}
				}
			}
			AmqpDescribed amqpDescribed2 = getter(original);
			if (amqpDescribed2 != null)
			{
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteBytes(buffer, original.Buffer.Buffer, amqpDescribed2.Offset, amqpDescribed2.Length);
			}
		}
	}
	internal sealed class AmqpMessageEncoder : IBrokeredMessageEncoder
	{
		public long WriteHeader(XmlWriter writer, BrokeredMessage brokeredMessage, SerializationTarget serializationTarget)
		{
			if (serializationTarget == SerializationTarget.Communication)
			{
				writer.WriteStartElement("MessageHeaders");
			}
			AmqpMessageAttachment amqpMessageAttachment = (AmqpMessageAttachment)brokeredMessage.Attachment;
			int length;
			using (ByteBuffer byteBuffer = new ByteBuffer(512, autoGrow: true))
			{
				amqpMessageAttachment.Update(brokeredMessage, serializationTarget, amqpClient: false, partitioning: false);
				amqpMessageAttachment.WriteMessage(byteBuffer, null);
				writer.WriteBase64(byteBuffer.Buffer, byteBuffer.Offset, byteBuffer.Length);
				length = byteBuffer.Length;
			}
			if (serializationTarget == SerializationTarget.Communication)
			{
				writer.WriteEndElement();
			}
			return length;
		}

		public long ReadHeader(XmlReader reader, BrokeredMessage brokeredMessage, SerializationTarget serializationTarget)
		{
			if (serializationTarget == SerializationTarget.Communication)
			{
				reader.ReadStartElement();
			}
			ByteBuffer byteBuffer = ReadBuffer(reader, (int)brokeredMessage.HeaderSize);
			AmqpMessage amqpMessage = AmqpMessage.CreateBufferMessage(byteBuffer);
			amqpMessage.Initialize(SectionFlag.All);
			brokeredMessage.MessageId = "nil";
			UpdateBrokeredMessageHeaderAndProperties(amqpMessage, brokeredMessage, serializationTarget);
			brokeredMessage.Attachment = new AmqpMessageAttachment(amqpMessage);
			if (serializationTarget == SerializationTarget.Communication)
			{
				reader.ReadEndElement();
			}
			return byteBuffer.Length;
		}

		public static ByteBuffer ReadBuffer(XmlReader reader, int size)
		{
			ByteBuffer byteBuffer = new ByteBuffer(1024, autoGrow: true);
			while (true)
			{
				byteBuffer.Validate(write: true, 512);
				int num = reader.ReadContentAsBase64(byteBuffer.Buffer, byteBuffer.WritePos, 512);
				if (num == 0)
				{
					break;
				}
				byteBuffer.Append(num);
			}
			return byteBuffer;
		}

		public static void UpdateBrokeredMessageHeaderAndProperties(AmqpMessage source, BrokeredMessage target, SerializationTarget serializationTarget)
		{
			AmqpMessageConverter.UpdateBrokeredMessageHeaderAndProperties(source, target);
			SectionFlag sections = source.Sections;
			if ((sections & SectionFlag.Header) != 0 && source.Header.DeliveryCount.HasValue)
			{
				target.DeliveryCount = (int)source.Header.DeliveryCount.Value;
			}
			if ((sections & SectionFlag.MessageAnnotations) != 0)
			{
				if (((RestrictedMap<AmqpSymbol>)source.MessageAnnotations.Map).TryGetValue((AmqpSymbol)"x-opt-enqueued-time", out DateTime value))
				{
					target.EnqueuedTimeUtc = value;
				}
				if (((RestrictedMap<AmqpSymbol>)source.MessageAnnotations.Map).TryGetValue((AmqpSymbol)"x-opt-sequence-number", out long value2))
				{
					target.SequenceNumber = value2;
				}
				if (((RestrictedMap<AmqpSymbol>)source.MessageAnnotations.Map).TryGetValue((AmqpSymbol)"x-opt-locked-until", out DateTime value3))
				{
					target.LockedUntilUtc = value3;
				}
				if (((RestrictedMap<AmqpSymbol>)source.MessageAnnotations.Map).TryGetValue((AmqpSymbol)"x-opt-partition-id", out short value4))
				{
					target.PartitionId = value4;
				}
			}
			if ((sections & SectionFlag.DeliveryAnnotations) != 0)
			{
				if (((RestrictedMap<AmqpSymbol>)source.DeliveryAnnotations.Map).TryGetValue((AmqpSymbol)"x-opt-prefiltered-headers", out ArraySegment<byte> value5))
				{
					target.PrefilteredHeaders = new MemoryStream(value5.Array, value5.Offset, value5.Count);
				}
				if (((RestrictedMap<AmqpSymbol>)source.DeliveryAnnotations.Map).TryGetValue((AmqpSymbol)"x-opt-prefiltered-headers", out ArraySegment<byte> value6))
				{
					target.PrefilteredProperties = new MemoryStream(value6.Array, value6.Offset, value6.Count);
				}
				if (((RestrictedMap<AmqpSymbol>)source.DeliveryAnnotations.Map).TryGetValue((AmqpSymbol)"x-opt-transfer-destination", out string value7))
				{
					target.TransferDestination = value7;
				}
				if (((RestrictedMap<AmqpSymbol>)source.DeliveryAnnotations.Map).TryGetValue((AmqpSymbol)"x-opt-transfer-source", out string value8))
				{
					target.TransferSource = value8;
				}
				if (((RestrictedMap<AmqpSymbol>)source.DeliveryAnnotations.Map).TryGetValue((AmqpSymbol)"x-opt-transfer-sn", out long value9))
				{
					target.TransferSequenceNumber = value9;
				}
				if (((RestrictedMap<AmqpSymbol>)source.DeliveryAnnotations.Map).TryGetValue((AmqpSymbol)"x-opt-transfer-hop-count", out int value10))
				{
					target.TransferHopCount = value10;
				}
				if (((RestrictedMap<AmqpSymbol>)source.DeliveryAnnotations.Map).TryGetValue((AmqpSymbol)"x-opt-transfer-resource", out long value11))
				{
					target.TransferDestinationResourceId = value11;
				}
				if (((RestrictedMap<AmqpSymbol>)source.DeliveryAnnotations.Map).TryGetValue((AmqpSymbol)"x-opt-transfer-session", out string value12))
				{
					target.CopySessionId(value12);
					target.TransferSessionId = ((source.Properties == null) ? null : source.Properties.GroupId);
				}
				if (((RestrictedMap<AmqpSymbol>)source.DeliveryAnnotations.Map).TryGetValue((AmqpSymbol)"x-opt-deadletter-source", out string value13))
				{
					target.DeadLetterSource = value13;
				}
				if (((RestrictedMap<AmqpSymbol>)source.DeliveryAnnotations.Map).TryGetValue((AmqpSymbol)"x-opt-lock-token", out Guid value14))
				{
					target.LockToken = value14;
				}
			}
		}
