	internal struct Section
	{
		public SectionFlag Flag;

		public int Offset;

		public int Length;

		public AmqpDescribed Value;
	}
	internal sealed class AmqpMessageReader
	{
		private struct SectionInfo
		{
			public SectionFlag Flag;

			public ulong Code;

			public string Name;

			public Func<AmqpDescribed> Ctor;

			public Func<byte, ByteBuffer, Error> Scanner;
		}

		private static readonly SectionInfo[] MessageSections;

		static AmqpMessageReader()
		{
			MessageSections = new SectionInfo[9]
			{
				new SectionInfo
				{
					Flag = SectionFlag.Header,
					Code = Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Amqp.Framing.Header.Code,
					Name = Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Amqp.Framing.Header.Name,
					Ctor = () => new Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Amqp.Framing.Header(),
					Scanner = (byte a, ByteBuffer b) => ScanListSection(a, b)
				},
				new SectionInfo
				{
					Flag = SectionFlag.DeliveryAnnotations,
					Code = DeliveryAnnotations.Code,
					Name = DeliveryAnnotations.Name,
					Ctor = () => new DeliveryAnnotations(),
					Scanner = (byte a, ByteBuffer b) => ScanMapSection(a, b)
				},
				new SectionInfo
				{
					Flag = SectionFlag.MessageAnnotations,
					Code = MessageAnnotations.Code,
					Name = MessageAnnotations.Name,
					Ctor = () => new MessageAnnotations(),
					Scanner = (byte a, ByteBuffer b) => ScanMapSection(a, b)
				},
				new SectionInfo
				{
					Flag = SectionFlag.Properties,
					Code = Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Amqp.Framing.Properties.Code,
					Name = Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Amqp.Framing.Properties.Name,
					Ctor = () => new Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Amqp.Framing.Properties(),
					Scanner = (byte a, ByteBuffer b) => ScanListSection(a, b)
				},
				new SectionInfo
				{
					Flag = SectionFlag.ApplicationProperties,
					Code = ApplicationProperties.Code,
					Name = ApplicationProperties.Name,
					Ctor = () => new ApplicationProperties(),
					Scanner = (byte a, ByteBuffer b) => ScanMapSection(a, b)
				},
				new SectionInfo
				{
					Flag = SectionFlag.Data,
					Code = Data.Code,
					Name = Data.Name,
					Ctor = () => new Data(),
					Scanner = (byte a, ByteBuffer b) => ScanDataSection(a, b)
				},
				new SectionInfo
				{
					Flag = SectionFlag.AmqpSequence,
					Code = AmqpSequence.Code,
					Name = AmqpSequence.Name,
					Ctor = () => new AmqpSequence(),
					Scanner = (byte a, ByteBuffer b) => ScanListSection(a, b)
				},
				new SectionInfo
				{
					Flag = SectionFlag.AmqpValue,
					Code = AmqpValue.Code,
					Name = AmqpValue.Name,
					Ctor = () => new AmqpValue(),
					Scanner = (byte a, ByteBuffer b) => ScanValueSection(a, b)
				},
				new SectionInfo
				{
					Flag = SectionFlag.Footer,
					Code = Footer.Code,
					Name = Footer.Name,
					Ctor = () => new Footer(),
					Scanner = (byte a, ByteBuffer b) => ScanMapSection(a, b)
				}
			};
			for (int num = 0; num < MessageSections.Length; num++)
			{
				SectionInfo sectionInfo = MessageSections[num];
				AmqpCodec.RegisterKnownTypes(sectionInfo.Name, sectionInfo.Code, sectionInfo.Ctor);
			}
		}

		public static bool TryRead<T1, T2>(T1 t1, T2 t2, ByteBuffer buffer, SectionFlag sections, Func<T1, T2, Section, bool> sectionHandler, string context, out Error error, bool skipBodyAndFooterSections = false)
		{
			error = null;
			if (buffer.TryAddReference())
			{
				int seekPosition = buffer.Offset;
				try
				{
					while (buffer.Length > 0)
					{
						int offset = buffer.Offset;
						if (!TryReadSectionInfo(buffer, out var info, out error))
						{
							return false;
						}
						SectionFlag sectionFlag = SectionFlag.Body | SectionFlag.Footer;
						if (skipBodyAndFooterSections && (info.Flag & sectionFlag) > (SectionFlag)0)
						{
							seekPosition = offset;
							break;
						}
						AmqpDescribed amqpDescribed;
						int length;
						if ((info.Flag & sections) > (SectionFlag)0)
						{
							amqpDescribed = info.Ctor();
							if (amqpDescribed.DescriptorCode == Data.Code)
							{
								amqpDescribed.Value = BinaryEncoding.Decode(buffer, (byte)0, copy: false);
							}
							else
							{
								amqpDescribed.DecodeValue(buffer);
							}
							amqpDescribed.Offset = offset;
							length = (amqpDescribed.Length = buffer.Offset - offset);
						}
						else
						{
							FormatCode formatCode = AmqpEncoding.ReadFormatCode(buffer);
							if (formatCode != (byte)64)
							{
								error = info.Scanner(formatCode, buffer);
								if (error != null)
								{
									return false;
								}
							}
							amqpDescribed = null;
							length = buffer.Offset - offset;
						}
						Section arg = new Section
						{
							Flag = info.Flag,
							Offset = offset,
							Length = length,
							Value = amqpDescribed
						};
						if (!sectionHandler(t1, t2, arg))
						{
							break;
						}
					}
					return true;
				}
				catch (SerializationException ex)
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogError(context, "read-1", ex.ToStringSlim());
					error = GetDecodeError(ex.Message);
				}
				catch (AmqpException ex2)
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogError(context, "read-2", ex2.ToStringSlim());
					error = ex2.Error;
				}
				catch (Exception ex3)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(ex3))
					{
						throw;
					}
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogError(context, "read-3", ex3.ToStringSlim());
					error = GetDecodeError(ex3.Message);
				}
				finally
				{
					buffer.Seek(seekPosition);
					buffer.RemoveReference();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				error = GetDecodeError(SRAmqp.AmqpBufferAlreadyReclaimed);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool TryReadSectionInfo(ByteBuffer buffer, out SectionInfo info, out Error error)
		{
			info = default(SectionInfo);
			FormatCode formatCode = AmqpEncoding.ReadFormatCode(buffer);
			if (formatCode != (byte)0)
			{
				error = GetDecodeError(SRAmqp.AmqpInvalidFormatCode(formatCode, buffer.Offset - 1));
				return false;
			}
			ulong num = ulong.MaxValue;
			formatCode = AmqpEncoding.ReadFormatCode(buffer);
			switch (formatCode)
			{
			case 83:
				num = AmqpBitConverter.ReadUByte(buffer);
				break;
			case 128:
				num = AmqpBitConverter.ReadULong(buffer);
				break;
			case 163:
			case 179:
			{
				AmqpSymbol amqpSymbol = SymbolEncoding.Decode(buffer, formatCode);
				for (int i = 0; i < MessageSections.Length; i++)
				{
					if (MessageSections[i].Name.Equals(amqpSymbol.Value))
					{
						num = MessageSections[i].Code;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (num == ulong.MaxValue)
				{
					error = GetDecodeError(SRAmqp.AmqpInvalidMessageSectionCode(amqpSymbol));
					return false;
				}
				break;
			}
			default:
				error = GetDecodeError(SRAmqp.AmqpInvalidFormatCode(formatCode, buffer.Offset - 1));
				return false;
			}
			int num2 = (int)(num - MessageSections[0].Code);
			if (num2 < 0 || num2 >= MessageSections.Length)
			{
				error = GetDecodeError(SRAmqp.AmqpInvalidMessageSectionCode(num));
				return false;
			}
			info = MessageSections[num2];
			error = null;
			return true;
		}

		private static Error ScanListSection(byte formatCode, ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			return formatCode switch
			{
				69 => null, 
				192 => AdvanceBuffer(buffer, AmqpBitConverter.ReadUByte(buffer)), 
				208 => AdvanceBuffer(buffer, AmqpBitConverter.ReadUInt(buffer)), 
				_ => GetDecodeError(SRAmqp.AmqpInvalidFormatCode(formatCode, buffer.Offset)), 
			};
		}

		private static Error ScanMapSection(byte formatCode, ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			return formatCode switch
			{
				193 => AdvanceBuffer(buffer, AmqpBitConverter.ReadUByte(buffer)), 
				209 => AdvanceBuffer(buffer, AmqpBitConverter.ReadUInt(buffer)), 
				_ => GetDecodeError(SRAmqp.AmqpInvalidFormatCode(formatCode, buffer.Offset)), 
			};
		}

		private static Error ScanDataSection(byte formatCode, ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			return formatCode switch
			{
				160 => AdvanceBuffer(buffer, AmqpBitConverter.ReadUByte(buffer)), 
				176 => AdvanceBuffer(buffer, AmqpBitConverter.ReadUInt(buffer)), 
				_ => GetDecodeError(SRAmqp.AmqpInvalidFormatCode(formatCode, buffer.Offset)), 
			};
		}

		private static Error ScanValueSection(byte formatCode, ByteBuffer buffer, int depth = 0)
		{
			if (formatCode == 0)
			{
				if (depth > 10)
				{
					return GetDecodeError(SRAmqp.AmqpInvalidFormatCode(formatCode, buffer.Offset));
				}
				Error error = ScanValueSection(AmqpEncoding.ReadFormatCode(buffer), buffer, depth + 1);
				if (error != null)
				{
					return error;
				}
				formatCode = AmqpEncoding.ReadFormatCode(buffer);
			}
			uint size = ((formatCode < 160) ? ((uint)(1 << (formatCode >> 4) - 4 >> 1)) : (((formatCode & 0x10) == 0) ? AmqpBitConverter.ReadUByte(buffer) : AmqpBitConverter.ReadUInt(buffer)));
			return AdvanceBuffer(buffer, size);
		}

		private static Error AdvanceBuffer(ByteBuffer buffer, uint size)
		{
			if (size > buffer.Length)
			{
				return GetDecodeError(SRAmqp.AmqpInsufficientBufferSize(size, buffer.Length));
			}
			buffer.Complete((int)size);
			return null;
		}

		private static Error GetDecodeError(string description)
		{
			return new Error
			{
				Condition = AmqpErrorCode.DecodeError,
				Description = description
			};
		}
	}

		ExplicitEnabled,
		Disabled
	}

	internal sealed class AmqpMessageBrowser : MessageBrowser
	{
		private abstract class AmqpBrowserRequestAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<AmqpBrowserRequestAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly AmqpMessageBrowser parent;

			private RequestResponseAmqpLink requestResponseAmqpLink;

			private AmqpMessage requestMessage;

			private AmqpMessage responseMessage;

			protected AmqpBrowserRequestAsyncResult(AmqpMessageBrowser parent, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.parent = parent;
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((AmqpBrowserRequestAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.parent.RequestResponseLink.BeginGetOpenedObject(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(AmqpBrowserRequestAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					thisPtr.requestResponseAmqpLink = thisPtr.parent.RequestResponseLink.EndGetOpenedObject(r);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
				if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
				{
					base.LastAsyncStepException = AmqpExceptionHelper.GetClientException(base.LastAsyncStepException, ((AmqpMessagingFactory)parent.MessagingFactory).RemoteContainerId);
					Complete(base.LastAsyncStepException);
					yield break;
				}
				requestMessage = CreateRequestMessage();
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((AmqpBrowserRequestAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.requestResponseAmqpLink.BeginRequest(thisPtr.requestMessage, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(AmqpBrowserRequestAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					thisPtr.responseMessage = thisPtr.requestResponseAmqpLink.EndRequest(r);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
				if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
				{
					base.LastAsyncStepException = AmqpExceptionHelper.GetClientException(base.LastAsyncStepException, null);
					Complete(base.LastAsyncStepException);
				}
				else
				{
					ProcessResponseMessage(responseMessage);
				}
			}

			protected abstract AmqpMessage CreateRequestMessage();

			protected abstract void ProcessResponseMessage(AmqpMessage responseMessage);
		}

		private sealed class PeekAsyncResult : AmqpBrowserRequestAsyncResult
		{
			private readonly AmqpMessageBrowser parent;

			private readonly TrackingContext trackingContext;

			private readonly long fromSequenceNumber;

			private readonly int messageCount;

			private readonly string sessionId;

			public IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> Messages { get; private set; }

			public PeekAsyncResult(AmqpMessageBrowser parent, TrackingContext trackingContext, long fromSequenceNumber, int messageCount, string sessionId, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(parent, timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.parent = parent;
				this.trackingContext = trackingContext;
				this.fromSequenceNumber = fromSequenceNumber;
				this.messageCount = messageCount;
				this.sessionId = sessionId;
				Start();
			}

			protected override AmqpMessage CreateRequestMessage()
			{
				AmqpRequestMessage amqpRequestMessage = AmqpRequestMessage.CreateRequest("com.microsoft:peek-message", RemainingTime(), trackingContext.TrackingId);
				amqpRequestMessage.Map[ManagementConstants.Properties.FromSequenceNumber] = fromSequenceNumber;
				amqpRequestMessage.Map[ManagementConstants.Properties.MessageCount] = messageCount;
				if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(sessionId))
				{
					amqpRequestMessage.Map[ManagementConstants.Properties.SessionId] = sessionId;
				}
				return amqpRequestMessage.RequestMessage;
			}

			protected override void ProcessResponseMessage(AmqpMessage responseMessage)
			{
				AmqpResponseMessage amqpResponseMessage = AmqpResponseMessage.CreateResponse(responseMessage);
				if (amqpResponseMessage.StatusCode == AmqpResponseStatusCode.OK)
				{
					IEnumerable<AmqpMap> listValue = amqpResponseMessage.GetListValue<AmqpMap>(ManagementConstants.Properties.Messages);
					List<BrokeredMessage> list = new List<BrokeredMessage>();
					foreach (AmqpMap item2 in listValue)
					{
						ArraySegment<byte> arraySegment = (ArraySegment<byte>)item2[ManagementConstants.Properties.Message];
						AmqpMessage amqpMessage = AmqpMessage.CreateBufferMessage(new ByteBuffer(arraySegment.Array, arraySegment.Offset, arraySegment.Count));
						BrokeredMessage item = AmqpMessageConverter.ClientGetMessage(amqpMessage);
						list.Add(item);
					}
					Messages = list;
				}
				else if (amqpResponseMessage.StatusCode == AmqpResponseStatusCode.NoContent || (amqpResponseMessage.StatusCode == AmqpResponseStatusCode.NotFound && object.Equals(AmqpClientConstants.MessageNotFoundError, amqpResponseMessage.GetResponseErrorCondition())))
				{
					Messages = new List<BrokeredMessage>();
				}
				else
				{
					Complete(amqpResponseMessage.ToMessagingContractException());
				}
			}

			public new static IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> End(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				PeekAsyncResult peekAsyncResult = (PeekAsyncResult)result;
				AsyncResult<AmqpBrowserRequestAsyncResult>.End(result);
				return peekAsyncResult.Messages ?? new List<BrokeredMessage>();
			}
		}

		private static readonly string[] RequiredClaims = new string[2] { "Manage", "Listen" };

		private readonly AmqpMessagingFactory messagingFactory;

		private readonly string entityName;

		private readonly MessagingEntityType entityType;

		private readonly ActiveClientLinkManager clientLinkManager;

		private readonly FaultTolerantObject<ReceivingAmqpLink> receiveLink;

		private readonly FaultTolerantObject<RequestResponseAmqpLink> requestResponseLink;

		internal FaultTolerantObject<ReceivingAmqpLink> ReceiveLink => receiveLink;

		internal FaultTolerantObject<RequestResponseAmqpLink> RequestResponseLink => requestResponseLink;

		public AmqpMessageBrowser(AmqpMessagingFactory messagingFactory, string entityName, MessagingEntityType entityType, RetryPolicy retryPolicy)
			: base(messagingFactory, entityName, entityType, retryPolicy)
		{
			receiveLink = new FaultTolerantObject<ReceivingAmqpLink>(this, CloseLink, BeginCreateLink, EndCreateLink);
			clientLinkManager = new ActiveClientLinkManager(this.messagingFactory);
			requestResponseLink = new FaultTolerantObject<RequestResponseAmqpLink>(this, CloseRequestResponseLink, BeginCreateRequestResponseLink, EndCreateRequestResponseLink);
			this.messagingFactory = messagingFactory;
			this.entityName = entityName;
			this.entityType = entityType;
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginOpen(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return receiveLink.BeginGetInstance(timeout, callback, state);
		}

		protected override void OnEndOpen(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			receiveLink.EndGetInstance(result);
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			ReceivingAmqpLink obj = null;
			if (receiveLink.TryGetOpenedObject(out obj))
			{
				return messagingFactory.BeginCloseEntity(obj, timeout, callback, state);
			}
			return new CompletedAsyncResult(callback, state);
		}

		protected override void OnEndClose(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (result is CompletedAsyncResult)
			{
				CompletedAsyncResult.End(result);
			}
			else
			{
				messagingFactory.EndCloseEntity(result);
			}
			clientLinkManager.Close();
		}

		protected override void OnClosed()
		{
			CloseRequestResponseLink();
			base.OnClosed();
		}

		protected override void OnFaulted()
		{
			CloseRequestResponseLink();
			base.OnFaulted();
		}

		protected override void OnAbort()
		{
			ReceivingAmqpLink obj = null;
			if (receiveLink.TryGetOpenedObject(out obj))
			{
				CloseLink(obj);
			}
			CloseRequestResponseLink();
			clientLinkManager.Close();
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginPeek(PeekOptions peekOptions, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new PeekAsyncResult(this, peekOptions.TrackingContext, peekOptions.FromSequenceNumber, peekOptions.MessageCount, peekOptions.SessionId, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> OnEndPeek(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			return PeekAsyncResult.End(result);
		}

		private IAsyncResult BeginCreateLink(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return messagingFactory.BeginOpenEntity(this, entityName, entityType, 0, 0L, null, sessionReceiver: false, browseable: true, ReceiveMode.PeekLock, null, 0L, enableReceiverMetric: false, null, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		private ReceivingAmqpLink EndCreateLink(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			ActiveClientLink activeClientLink = messagingFactory.EndOpenReceiveEntity(result);
			clientLinkManager.SetActiveLink(activeClientLink);
			return (ReceivingAmqpLink)activeClientLink.LinkObject;
		}

		private void CloseLink(ReceivingAmqpLink link)
		{
			link.Session.SafeClose();
		}

		private IAsyncResult BeginCreateRequestResponseLink(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return messagingFactory.BeginOpenReceiveEntityRequestResponseLink(ReceiveLink, entityName, entityType, RequiredClaims, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		private RequestResponseAmqpLink EndCreateRequestResponseLink(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			return messagingFactory.EndOpenReceiveEntityRequestResponseLink(result).Link;
		}

		private void CloseRequestResponseLink(RequestResponseAmqpLink link)
		{
			link.Session.SafeClose();
		}

		private void CloseRequestResponseLink()
		{
			if (requestResponseLink.TryGetOpenedObject(out var obj))
			{
				CloseRequestResponseLink(obj);
			}
		}

		internal Error GetLinkTerminalError()
		{
			AmqpLink unsafeInnerObject = receiveLink.UnsafeInnerObject;
			if (unsafeInnerObject != null && unsafeInnerObject.TerminalException is AmqpException ex)
			{
				return ex.Error;
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

		private int responseSkip;

		private int Skip { get; set; }

		public AmqpGetMessageSessionsAsyncResult(FaultTolerantObject<RequestResponseAmqpLink> faultTolerantLink, AmqpMessagingFactory factory, string path, MessagingEntityType entityType, DateTime lastUpdatedTime, RetryPolicy retryPolicy, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)

				{
					AmqpGetMessageSessionsRequestAsyncResult.End(r, out thisPtr.sessionsIds, out thisPtr.responseSkip);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
				flag = sessionsIds.Length != 0;
				if (flag)
				{
					Skip = responseSkip;
					LastSessionId = sessionsIds[sessionsIds.Length - 1];
					string[] array = sessionsIds;
					foreach (string sessionId in array)
					{
						messageSessions.Add(new AmqpBrowsableMessageSession(path, sessionId, entityType, factory, retryPolicy));

		}

					throw;
				}
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(ProcessException(exception));
			}
		}

		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			try
			{
				return messageSession.EndGetState(result);
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(ProcessException(exception));
			}
		}

	internal sealed class AmqpCbsLink : ICloseable
	{
		private sealed class OpenCbsRequestResponseLinkAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<OpenCbsRequestResponseLinkAsyncResult>, ILinkFactory
		{
			private readonly AmqpConnection connection;

			private AmqpSession session;

			public RequestResponseAmqpLink Link { get; private set; }

			public OpenCbsRequestResponseLinkAsyncResult(AmqpConnection connection, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.connection = connection;
				Start();
			}

			AmqpLink ILinkFactory.CreateLink(AmqpSession session, AmqpLinkSettings settings)
			{
				AmqpLink link;
				if (settings.IsReceiver())
				{
					link = new ReceivingAmqpLink(session, settings);
				}
				else
				{
					link = new SendingAmqpLink(session, settings);
				}
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogOperation(this, TraceOperation.Create, link);
				});
				return link;
			}

			IAsyncResult ILinkFactory.BeginOpenLink(AmqpLink link, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{
				return new CompletedAsyncResult(callback, state);
			}

			void ILinkFactory.EndOpenLink(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				CompletedAsyncResult.End(result);
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				string address = "$cbs";
				if (RemainingTime() > TimeSpan.Zero)
				{
					try
					{
						AmqpSessionSettings settings = new AmqpSessionSettings
						{
							Properties = new Fields()
						};
						session = new AmqpSession(connection, settings, this);
						connection.AddSession(session, null);
					}
					catch (InvalidOperationException ex)
					{
						Complete(new MessagingException(ex.Message, isTransientError: false, ex));
						yield break;
					}
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((OpenCbsRequestResponseLinkAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.session.BeginOpen(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(OpenCbsRequestResponseLinkAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.session.EndOpen(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
					Exception lastException = base.LastAsyncStepException;
					if (lastException != null)
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
						{
							MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpOpenEntityFailed(connection, session, string.Empty, address, lastException.Message);
						});
						session.Abort();
						Complete(AmqpExceptionHelper.ToMessagingContract(lastException, (connection.RemoteEndpoint != null) ? connection.RemoteEndpoint.ToString() : string.Empty));
						yield break;
					}
					Fields fields = new Fields();
					fields.Add(AmqpClientConstants.TimeoutName, (uint)RemainingTime().TotalMilliseconds);
					Link = new RequestResponseAmqpLink("cbs", session, address, fields);
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((OpenCbsRequestResponseLinkAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.Link.BeginOpen(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(OpenCbsRequestResponseLinkAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.Link.EndOpen(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
					lastException = base.LastAsyncStepException;
					if (lastException != null)
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpOpenEntityFailed(connection, Link, Link.Name, address, lastException.Message);
						session.SafeClose();
						Link = null;
						Complete(AmqpExceptionHelper.ToMessagingContract(lastException, (connection.RemoteEndpoint != null) ? connection.RemoteEndpoint.ToString() : string.Empty));
					}
					else
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpOpenEntitySucceeded(connection, Link, Link.Name, address);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (session != null)
					{
						session.SafeClose();
					}
					Complete(new TimeoutException(SRAmqp.AmqpTimeout(base.OriginalTimeout, address)));
				}
			}
		}

		private sealed class SendTokenAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<SendTokenAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly TokenProvider tokenProvider;

			private readonly AmqpCbsLink cbsLink;

			private readonly string[] requiredClaims;

			private readonly Uri namespaceAddress;

			private readonly string audience;

			private readonly string resource;

			private SecurityToken swt;

			private RequestResponseAmqpLink requestResponseLink;

			public DateTime ValidTo { get; private set; }

			public SendTokenAsyncResult(AmqpCbsLink cbsLink, TokenProvider tokenProvider, Uri namespaceAddress, string audience, string resource, string[] requiredClaims, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.cbsLink = cbsLink;
				this.namespaceAddress = namespaceAddress;
				this.audience = audience;
				this.resource = resource;
				this.requiredClaims = requiredClaims;
				this.tokenProvider = tokenProvider;
				Start();
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((SendTokenAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.tokenProvider.BeginGetMessagingToken(namespaceAddress, thisPtr.resource, thisPtr.requiredClaims[0], bypassCache: false, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(SendTokenAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					thisPtr.swt = thisPtr.tokenProvider.EndGetMessagingToken(r);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
				DateTime expiresOn = swt.ValidTo;
				string tokenType;
				object token;
				if (swt is SharedAccessSignatureToken)
				{
					tokenType = "servicebus.windows.net:sastoken";
					token = (swt as SimpleWebSecurityToken).Token;
				}
				else if (swt is SimpleWebSecurityToken)
				{
					tokenType = "amqp:swt";
					token = (swt as SimpleWebSecurityToken).Token;
				}
				else
				{
					if (!(swt is JsonSecurityToken))
					{
						Complete(new InvalidOperationException(SRAmqp.AmqpUnssuportedTokenType));
						yield break;
					}
					tokenType = "jwt";
					token = (swt as JsonSecurityToken).Token;
				}
				if (!cbsLink.FaultTolerantLink.TryGetOpenedObject(out requestResponseLink))
				{
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((SendTokenAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.cbsLink.FaultTolerantLink.BeginGetInstance(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(SendTokenAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.requestResponseLink = thisPtr.cbsLink.FaultTolerantLink.EndGetInstance(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
				}
				AmqpValue amqpValue = new AmqpValue();
				amqpValue.Value = token;
				AmqpMessage putTokenRequest = AmqpMessage.Create(amqpValue);
				putTokenRequest.ApplicationProperties = new ApplicationProperties();
				putTokenRequest.ApplicationProperties.Map["operation"] = "put-token";
				putTokenRequest.ApplicationProperties.Map["type"] = tokenType;
				putTokenRequest.ApplicationProperties.Map["name"] = ((tokenProvider.TokenScope == TokenScope.Namespace) ? namespaceAddress.AbsoluteUri : audience);
				putTokenRequest.ApplicationProperties.Map["expiration"] = expiresOn;
				AmqpMessage putTokenResponse = null;
				Fx.AssertIsNotNull(requestResponseLink, "requestResponseLink cannot be null without exception");
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((SendTokenAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.requestResponseLink.BeginRequest(putTokenRequest, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(SendTokenAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					putTokenResponse = thisPtr.requestResponseLink.EndRequest(r);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
				int num = (int)putTokenResponse.ApplicationProperties.Map["status-code"];
				string description = (string)putTokenResponse.ApplicationProperties.Map["status-description"];
				if (num == 202 || num == 200)
				{
					ValidTo = swt.ValidTo;
					yield break;
				}
				AmqpSymbol responseErrorCondition = AmqpExceptionHelper.GetResponseErrorCondition(putTokenResponse, (AmqpResponseStatusCode)num);
				Complete(new AmqpException(responseErrorCondition, description));
			}
		}

	internal enum Metric
	{
		FrameOpen = 0,
		FrameBegin = 1,
		FrameAttach = 2,
		FrameFlow = 3,
		FrameTransfer = 4,
		FrameDisposition = 5,
		FrameDetach = 6,
		FrameEnd = 7,
		FrameClose = 8,
		TransportIo = 9,
		TransportBufferSize = 10,
		TransportWriteQueueSize = 11,
		TransportReadCacheHits = 11,
		TransportLatency = 12,
		Total = 13
	}
	internal abstract class AmqpLogger : IAmqpUsageMeter, ITransportMonitor
	{
		public const string WriteOperation = "write";

		public const string ReadOperation = "read";

		private const ulong FrameCodeStart = 16uL;

		private const ulong FrameCodeEnd = 24uL;

		private static readonly Action<AmqpLogger> aggregateWriteState = AggregateWriteState;

		private static readonly Action<AmqpLogger> aggregateReadState = AggregateReadState;

		private static readonly Action<AmqpLogger> resetWriteState = ResetWriteState;

		private static readonly Action<AmqpLogger> resetReadState = ResetReadState;

		private readonly long durationTicksThreshold;

		private long readStartTicks;

		private int[] readMetrics;

		private int readTotalBytes;

		private long readLatencyTicks;

		private long writeStartTicks;

		private int[] writeMetrics;

		private int writeTotalBytes;

		private long writeBufferQueueSize;

		private long writeLatencyTicks;

		public abstract TimeSpan Elapsed { get; }

		protected AmqpLogger(long durationTicksThreshold)
		{
			this.durationTicksThreshold = durationTicksThreshold;
			int num = 13;
			readMetrics = new int[num];
			writeMetrics = new int[num];
			readStartTicks = DateTime.UtcNow.Ticks;
			writeStartTicks = DateTime.UtcNow.Ticks;
		}

		public virtual void OnWrite(AmqpConnection connection, ulong frameCode, int numberOfBytes)
		{
			UpdateMetric(connection, "write", writeStartTicks, writeTotalBytes, frameCode, writeMetrics, aggregateWriteState, resetWriteState);
		}

		public virtual void OnRead(AmqpConnection connection, ulong frameCode, int numberOfBytes)
		{
			UpdateMetric(connection, "read", readStartTicks, readTotalBytes, frameCode, readMetrics, aggregateReadState, resetReadState);
		}

		public void OnTransportWrite(int bufferSize, int writeSize, long queueSize, long latencyTicks)
		{
			writeMetrics[9]++;
			writeMetrics[10] = bufferSize;
			writeTotalBytes += writeSize;
			writeBufferQueueSize += queueSize;
			writeLatencyTicks += latencyTicks;
		}

		public void OnTransportRead(int bufferSize, int readSize, int cacheHits, long latencyTicks)
		{
			readMetrics[9]++;
			readMetrics[10] = bufferSize;
			readMetrics[11] += cacheHits;
			readTotalBytes += readSize;
			readLatencyTicks += latencyTicks;
		}

		private static void AggregateReadState(AmqpLogger logger)
		{
			int num = logger.readMetrics[9];
			if (num > 0 && logger.readLatencyTicks > 0)
			{
				logger.readMetrics[12] = (int)(logger.readLatencyTicks / num);
			}
		}

		private static void AggregateWriteState(AmqpLogger logger)
		{
			int num = logger.writeMetrics[9];
			if (num > 0)
			{
				if (logger.writeBufferQueueSize > 0)
				{
					logger.writeMetrics[11] = (int)(logger.writeBufferQueueSize / num);
				}
				if (logger.writeLatencyTicks > 0)
				{
					logger.writeMetrics[12] = (int)(logger.writeLatencyTicks / num);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void ResetWriteState(AmqpLogger logger)
		{
			logger.writeStartTicks = DateTime.UtcNow.Ticks;
			logger.writeTotalBytes = 0;
			logger.writeBufferQueueSize = 0L;
			logger.writeLatencyTicks = 0L;
			for (int i = 0; i < logger.writeMetrics.Length; i++)
			{
				logger.writeMetrics[i] = 0;
			}
		}

		private static void ResetReadState(AmqpLogger logger)
		{
			logger.readStartTicks = DateTime.UtcNow.Ticks;
			logger.readTotalBytes = 0;
			logger.readLatencyTicks = 0L;
			for (int i = 0; i < logger.readMetrics.Length; i++)
			{
				logger.readMetrics[i] = 0;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateMetric(AmqpConnection connection, string op, long startTime, int totalBytes, ulong frameCode, int[] metrics, Action<AmqpLogger> aggregateAction, Action<AmqpLogger> resetAction)
		{
			if (frameCode >= 16 && frameCode <= 24)
			{
				int num = (int)(frameCode - 16);
				metrics[num]++;
			}
			long num2 = DateTime.UtcNow.Ticks - startTime;
			if (num2 >= durationTicksThreshold)
			{
				aggregateAction(this);
				WriteMetrics(connection, op, num2, totalBytes, FormatCountString(metrics));
				resetAction(this);
			}
		}

		private static string FormatCountString(int[] countArray)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(512);
			ulong num = 16uL;
			int num2 = 0;
			while (num2 < countArray.Length)
			{
				if (num2 > 0)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(',');
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(num);
				stringBuilder.Append(':');
				stringBuilder.Append(countArray[num2]);
				num2++;
				num++;
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		protected abstract void WriteMetrics(AmqpConnection connection, string op, long duration, int bytes, string metricDetails);
	}
	internal abstract class AmqpReceiverRequestAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<AmqpReceiverRequestAsyncResult>
	{
		private readonly AmqpMessageReceiver parent;

		private readonly System.Transactions.Transaction transaction;

		private RequestResponseAmqpLink requestResponseAmqpLink;

		private AmqpMessage requestMessage;

		private AmqpMessage responseMessage;

		private ArraySegment<byte> transactionId;

		private AmqpMessagingFactory amqpMessagingFactory;

		protected AmqpReceiverRequestAsyncResult(AmqpMessageReceiver parent, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			: base(timeout, callback, state)
		{
			transaction = System.Transactions.Transaction.Current;
			this.parent = parent;
			amqpMessagingFactory = (AmqpMessagingFactory)this.parent.MessagingFactory;
		}

		protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
		{
			if (parent.SessionReceiver)
			{
				Error sessionLockLostError = parent.GetSessionLockLostError();
				if (sessionLockLostError != null)
				{
					Complete(AmqpExceptionHelper.ToMessagingContract(sessionLockLostError));
					yield break;
				}
			}
			if (transaction != null)
			{
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((AmqpReceiverRequestAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => amqpMessagingFactory.TransactionManager.BeginEnlist(thisPtr.transaction, thisPtr.amqpMessagingFactory, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(AmqpReceiverRequestAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					thisPtr.transactionId = amqpMessagingFactory.TransactionManager.EndEnlist(r);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
			}
			else
			{
				transactionId = AmqpConstants.NullBinary;
			}
			yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((AmqpReceiverRequestAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.parent.RequestResponseLink.BeginGetOpenedObject(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(AmqpReceiverRequestAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
			{
				thisPtr.requestResponseAmqpLink = thisPtr.parent.RequestResponseLink.EndGetOpenedObject(r);
			}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
			if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
			{
				base.LastAsyncStepException = AmqpExceptionHelper.GetClientException(base.LastAsyncStepException, ((AmqpMessagingFactory)parent.MessagingFactory).RemoteContainerId);
				Complete(base.LastAsyncStepException);
				yield break;
			}
			using (requestMessage = CreateRequestMessage())
			{
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((AmqpReceiverRequestAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.requestResponseAmqpLink.BeginRequest(thisPtr.requestMessage, thisPtr.transactionId, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(AmqpReceiverRequestAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					thisPtr.responseMessage = thisPtr.requestResponseAmqpLink.EndRequest(r);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
			}
			if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
			{
				if (base.LastAsyncStepException is OperationCanceledException && requestResponseAmqpLink.State != AmqpObjectState.Opened)
				{
					if (parent.SessionReceiver)
					{
						Error sessionLockLostError2 = parent.GetSessionLockLostError();
						base.LastAsyncStepException = ((sessionLockLostError2 != null) ? AmqpExceptionHelper.ToMessagingContract(sessionLockLostError2) : new SessionLockLostException(SRClient.SessionLockExpiredOnMessageSession, base.LastAsyncStepException));
					}
					else
					{
						base.LastAsyncStepException = new MessageLockLostException(SRClient.MessageLockLost, base.LastAsyncStepException);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					base.LastAsyncStepException = AmqpExceptionHelper.GetClientException(base.LastAsyncStepException, null);
				}
				Complete(base.LastAsyncStepException);
			}
			else
			{
				ProcessResponseMessage(responseMessage);
			}
		}

		protected abstract AmqpMessage CreateRequestMessage();

		protected abstract void ProcessResponseMessage(AmqpMessage responseMessage);
	}
	internal class AmqpServiceClient<T> : ClientEntity
	{
		private class RequestAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<RequestAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly AmqpServiceClient<T> client;

			private readonly MethodData md;

			private readonly MethodCallMessage mcm;

			private readonly int argCount;

			private RequestResponseAmqpLink link;

			private AmqpMessage request;

			private AmqpMessage response;

			private object result;

			public RequestAsyncResult(AmqpServiceClient<T> client, MethodData md, MethodCallMessage mcm, int argCount, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(client.OperationTimeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.client = client;
				this.md = md;
				this.mcm = mcm;
				this.argCount = argCount;
				base.OnCompleting = (Action<Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult, Exception>)Delegate.Combine(base.OnCompleting, (Action<Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult, Exception>)delegate(Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult r, Exception e)
				{
					Finally(r, e);
				});
				Start();
			}

			public static object End(IAsyncResult result, MethodData md, MethodCallMessage mcm)
			{
				RequestAsyncResult requestAsyncResult = AsyncResult<RequestAsyncResult>.End(result);
				bool flag = true;
				try
				{
					object obj = requestAsyncResult.result;
					if (md.ReturnType.HasValue && obj != null)
					{
						Type type = md.ReturnType.Type;
						SerializableType serializable = md.ReturnType.Serializable;
						if (serializable == null)
						{
							type = mcm.GenericTypes[md.ReturnType.Type.GenericParameterPosition];
							serializable = SerializationHelper.GetSerializable(type);
						}
						obj = SerializationHelper.FromAmqp(serializable, obj);
						if (!type.IsAssignableFrom(obj.GetType()))
						{
							throw new InvalidOperationException($"Return type mismatch in {mcm.MethodBase.Name}. Expect {type.Name} Actual {obj.GetType().Name}");
						}
						if (md.IsOperationResult)
						{
							((Result)obj).Response = requestAsyncResult.response;
							flag = false;
						}
					}
					return obj;
				}
				finally
				{
					if (flag && requestAsyncResult.response != null)
					{
						requestAsyncResult.response.Dispose();
					}
				}
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((RequestAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.client.BeginCreateInnerRequestResponseLink(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(RequestAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					thisPtr.link = thisPtr.client.EndCreateInnerRequestResponseLink(r);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
				ApplicationProperties applicationProperties = new ApplicationProperties();
				applicationProperties.Map["operation"] = md.Operation.Name;
				object obj = null;
				AmqpMap amqpMap = null;
				for (int num = 0; num < argCount; num++)
				{
					ParameterAttribute parameterAttribute = md.Parameters[num];
					object obj2 = SerializationHelper.ToAmqp(md.ParameterTypes[num].Serializable, mcm.InArgs[num]);
					if (parameterAttribute.Location == Location.ApplicationProperties)
					{
						applicationProperties.Map[parameterAttribute.Name] = obj2;
					}
					else if (parameterAttribute.Location == Location.MapBody)
					{
						if (amqpMap == null)
						{
							amqpMap = new AmqpMap();
						}
						amqpMap[parameterAttribute.Name] = obj2;
					}
					else
					{
						obj = obj2;
					}
				}
				foreach (KeyValuePair<string, object> requestProperty in link.RequestProperties)
				{
					applicationProperties.Map[requestProperty.Key] = requestProperty.Value;
				}
				request = AmqpMessage.Create(new AmqpValue
				{
					Value = (amqpMap ?? obj)
				});
				request.ApplicationProperties = applicationProperties;
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((RequestAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.link.BeginRequest(thisPtr.request, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(RequestAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					thisPtr.response = thisPtr.link.EndRequest(r);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
				if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
				{
					Complete(AmqpExceptionHelper.ToMessagingContract(base.LastAsyncStepException, link.Session.Connection.Settings.RemoteContainerId));
					yield break;
				}
				int num2 = (int)response.ApplicationProperties.Map["status-code"];
				if (num2 != 202 && num2 != 200)
				{
					AmqpSymbol responseErrorCondition = AmqpExceptionHelper.GetResponseErrorCondition(response, (AmqpResponseStatusCode)num2);
					string description = (string)response.ApplicationProperties.Map["status-description"];
					Complete(ToServiceContractException(response, responseErrorCondition, description));
				}
				else if (response.ValueBody != null)
				{
					result = response.ValueBody.Value;
				}
			}

			private static void Finally(Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult result, Exception exception)
			{
				RequestAsyncResult requestAsyncResult = (RequestAsyncResult)result;
				requestAsyncResult.request?.Dispose();
				if (exception != null)
				{
					requestAsyncResult.response?.Dispose();
				}
			}

			private static Exception ToServiceContractException(AmqpMessage response, AmqpSymbol condition, string description)
			{
				if (condition.Equals(AmqpClientConstants.ManagementOperationConflictError))
				{
					TrackingContext trackingContext = null;
					if (response.ApplicationProperties.Map.TryGetValue<string>("tracking-Id", out var value) && response.ApplicationProperties.Map.TryGetValue<string>("system-tracker", out var value2))
					{
						trackingContext = TrackingContext.Create(value, value2, appendRole: false);
					}
					int errorCode = (int)response.ApplicationProperties.Map["error-code"];
					string message = (string)response.ApplicationProperties.Map["error-message"];
					return new ManagementConflictOperationException(new MessagingExceptionDetail(errorCode, message), trackingContext);
				}
				return AmqpExceptionHelper.ToMessagingContract(condition.Value, description);
			}
		}

		private class AmqpClientProxy : RealProxy
		{
			private readonly AmqpServiceClient<T> client;

			private readonly Dictionary<string, MethodData> methodCache;

			public AmqpClientProxy(AmqpServiceClient<T> client, Type proxiedtype)
				: base(proxiedtype, typeof(object))
			{
				this.client = client;
				methodCache = AmqpServiceClient<T>.GetMethodCache(proxiedtype);
			}

			public T GetChannel()
			{
				return (T)GetTransparentProxy();
			}

			protected override ReturnMessage Invoke(MethodCallMessage mcm)
			{
				if (!methodCache.TryGetValue(mcm.MethodBase.Name, out var value))
				{
					throw new NotImplementedException();
				}
				object ret = null;
				if (value.Operation.AsyncPattern == AsyncPattern.None)
				{
					ret = client.EndRequest(client.BeginRequest(value, mcm, mcm.InArgs.Length, null, null), value, mcm);
				}
				else if (value.Operation.AsyncPattern == AsyncPattern.APM)
				{
					if (value.IsBeginCall)
					{
						int num = mcm.InArgs.Length - 2;
						if (num < 0)
						{
							throw new ArgumentException("missing async callback and state");
						}
						AsyncCallback callback = (AsyncCallback)mcm.InArgs[num];
						object state = mcm.InArgs[num + 1];
						ret = client.BeginRequest(value, mcm, num, callback, state);
					}
					else if (value.IsEndCall)
					{
						ret = client.EndRequest((IAsyncResult)mcm.InArgs[0], value, mcm);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (value.Operation.AsyncPattern != AsyncPattern.Task)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException();
					}
					Type type = value.TcsType;
					if (value.ReturnType.Type.IsGenericParameter)
					{
						type = typeof(TaskSource<>).MakeGenericType(typeof(T), mcm.GenericTypes[value.ReturnType.Type.GenericParameterPosition]);
					}
					ITaskSource taskSource = (ITaskSource)Activator.CreateInstance(type);
					taskSource.Proxy = this;
					taskSource.MethodData = value;
					taskSource.CallMessage = mcm;
					client.BeginRequest(value, mcm, mcm.InArgs.Length, OnRequestComplete, taskSource);
					ret = taskSource.TaskObject;
				}
				return new ReturnMessage(ret, null, 0, mcm);
			}

			private static void OnRequestComplete(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				ITaskSource taskSource = (ITaskSource)result.AsyncState;
				try
				{
					object result2 = taskSource.Proxy.client.EndRequest(result, taskSource.MethodData, taskSource.CallMessage);
					taskSource.Complete(result2, null);
				}
				catch (Exception exception)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
					{
						throw;
					}
					taskSource.Complete(null, exception);
				}
			}
		}

		private class MethodData
		{
			public OperationAttribute Operation;

			public ParameterAttribute[] Parameters;

			public Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Amqp.Management.DataType[] ParameterTypes;

			public Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Amqp.Management.DataType ReturnType;

			public bool IsOperationResult;

			public bool IsBeginCall;

			public bool IsEndCall;

			public Type TcsType;
		}

		private interface ITaskSource
		{
			object TaskObject { get; }

			AmqpClientProxy Proxy { get; set; }

			MethodData MethodData { get; set; }

			MethodCallMessage CallMessage { get; set; }

			void Complete(object result, Exception exception);
		}

		private class TaskSource<TResult> : TaskCompletionSource<TResult>, ITaskSource
		{
			public object TaskObject => base.Task;

			public AmqpClientProxy Proxy { get; set; }

			public MethodData MethodData { get; set; }

			public MethodCallMessage CallMessage { get; set; }

			public void Complete(object result, Exception exception)
			{
				if (exception != null)
				{
					SetException(exception);
				}
				else
				{
					SetResult((TResult)result);
				}
			}
		}

		private static readonly string[] RequiredClaims = new string[2] { "Manage", "Listen" };

		private readonly AmqpMessagingFactory factory;

		private readonly string address;

		private readonly T channel;

		private readonly FaultTolerantObject<RequestResponseAmqpLink> link;

		private readonly ActiveClientLinkManager clientLinkManager;

		private const BindingFlags MethodFlags = BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic;

		private static ConcurrentDictionary<Type, Dictionary<string, MethodData>> typeCache = new ConcurrentDictionary<Type, Dictionary<string, MethodData>>();

		public string Address => address;

		public TimeSpan RequestTimeout { get; set; }

		public T Channel => channel;

		internal override TimeSpan OperationTimeout => RequestTimeout;

		private AmqpServiceClient(string address)
		{
			if (!typeof(T).IsInterface)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException("Not an interface");
			}
			this.address = address;
			channel = new AmqpClientProxy(this, typeof(T)).GetChannel();
			RequestTimeout = AmqpConstants.DefaultTimeoutTimeSpan;
		}

		public AmqpServiceClient(AmqpMessagingFactory factory, string address)
			: this(address)
		{
			this.factory = factory;
			link = new FaultTolerantObject<RequestResponseAmqpLink>(this.factory, delegate(RequestResponseAmqpLink link)
			{
				link.SafeClose();
			}, BeginOpenLink, EndOpenLink);
			clientLinkManager = new ActiveClientLinkManager(this.factory);
		}

		public AmqpServiceClient(FaultTolerantObject<RequestResponseAmqpLink> link, string address)
			: this(address)
		{
			this.link = link;
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginOpen(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return link.BeginGetInstance(timeout, callback, state);
		}

		protected override void OnEndOpen(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			link.EndGetInstance(result);
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return link.BeginClose(timeout, callback, state);
		}

			link.EndClose(result);
		}

		protected override void OnAbort()
		{
			link.UnsafeInnerObject?.Abort();
		}

		internal IAsyncResult BeginCreateInnerRequestResponseLink(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new CreateInnerRequestResponseLinkAsyncResult(this, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		internal RequestResponseAmqpLink EndCreateInnerRequestResponseLink(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			return AsyncResult<CreateInnerRequestResponseLinkAsyncResult>.End(result).Result;
		}

		private IAsyncResult BeginOpenLink(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return factory.BeginOpenRequestResponseLink("svc", address, null, RequiredClaims, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		private RequestResponseAmqpLink EndOpenLink(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			ActiveClientRequestResponseLink activeClientRequestResponseLink = factory.EndOpenRequestResponseLink(result);
			if (clientLinkManager != null)
			{
				clientLinkManager.SetActiveLink(activeClientRequestResponseLink);
			}
			return activeClientRequestResponseLink.Link;
		}

		private IAsyncResult BeginRequest(MethodData md, MethodCallMessage mcm, int argCount, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new RequestAsyncResult(this, md, mcm, argCount, callback, state);
		}

		private object EndRequest(IAsyncResult result, MethodData md, MethodCallMessage mcm)
		{
			return RequestAsyncResult.End(result, md, mcm);
		}

		private static Dictionary<string, MethodData> GetMethodCache(Type type)
		{
			if (typeCache.TryGetValue(type, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			value = new Dictionary<string, MethodData>();
			GetMethodCache(type, value);
			return typeCache.GetOrAdd(type, value);
		}

		private static Dictionary<string, MethodData> GetMethodCache(Type type, Dictionary<string, MethodData> cache)
		{
			Type[] interfaces = type.GetInterfaces();
			foreach (Type type2 in interfaces)
			{
				GetMethodCache(type2, cache);
			}
			MethodInfo[] methods = type.GetMethods(BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
			foreach (MethodInfo methodInfo in methods)
			{
				OperationAttribute attribute = methodInfo.GetCustomAttribute<OperationAttribute>();
				if (attribute == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				MethodData methodData = cache.Values.FirstOrDefault((MethodData v) => v.Operation.Name == attribute.Name);
				if (methodData != null)
				{
					throw new SerializationException(methodData.Operation.Name + " operation already exists.");
				}
				int ignoreCount = ((attribute.AsyncPattern == AsyncPattern.APM) ? 2 : 0);
				methodInfo.GetParameters(ignoreCount, out var attributes, out var paramTypes);
				MethodData methodData2 = new MethodData
				{
					Operation = attribute,
					Parameters = attributes,
					ParameterTypes = paramTypes
				};
				if (attribute.AsyncPattern == AsyncPattern.APM)
				{
					methodData2.IsBeginCall = true;
					string name = "End" + methodInfo.Name.Substring(5);
					MethodInfo method = type.GetMethod(name, BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic, null, new Type[1] { typeof(IAsyncResult) }, null);
					if (method == null)
					{
						throw new NotSupportedException("Cannot find End method for async contract " + methodInfo.Name);
					}
					cache[methodInfo.Name] = methodData2;
					MethodData methodData3 = new MethodData();
					methodData3.Operation = new OperationAttribute
					{
						Name = method.Name,
						AsyncPattern = AsyncPattern.APM
					};
					methodData3.IsEndCall = true;
					methodData3.ReturnType = Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Amqp.Management.DataType.Wrap(method.ReturnType);
					methodData3.IsOperationResult = typeof(Result).IsAssignableFrom(method.ReturnType);
					MethodData value = methodData3;
					cache[method.Name] = value;
				}
				else if (typeof(Task).IsAssignableFrom(methodInfo.ReturnType))
				{
					attribute.AsyncPattern = AsyncPattern.Task;
					Type[] array = null;
					if (methodInfo.ReturnType.IsGenericType)
					{
						array = methodInfo.ReturnType.GetGenericArguments();
						if (array.Length > 1)
						{
							throw new NotSupportedException(methodInfo.Name + ": Return type can have at most one generic argument");
						}
						methodData2.ReturnType = Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Amqp.Management.DataType.Wrap(array[0]);
						methodData2.IsOperationResult = typeof(Result).IsAssignableFrom(array[0]);
						methodData2.TcsType = typeof(TaskSource<>).MakeGenericType(typeof(T), array[0]);
					}
					else
					{
						methodData2.ReturnType = Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Amqp.Management.DataType.Wrap(typeof(void));
						methodData2.TcsType = typeof(TaskSource<object>);
					}
					cache[methodInfo.Name] = methodData2;
				}
				else
				{
					attribute.AsyncPattern = AsyncPattern.None;
					methodData2.ReturnType = Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Amqp.Management.DataType.Wrap(methodInfo.ReturnType);
					cache[methodInfo.Name] = methodData2;
				}
			}
			return typeCache.GetOrAdd(type, cache);
		}

	internal class RequestResponseAmqpLink : AmqpObject
	{
		private sealed class OperationState
		{
			private int pending = 2;

			public RequestResponseAmqpLink Owner { get; set; }

			public bool Complete()
			{
				return Interlocked.Decrement(ref pending) <= 0;
			}
		}

		private sealed class RequestAsyncResult : TimeoutAsyncResult<MessageId>, IWork<AmqpMessage>
		{
			private readonly RequestResponseAmqpLink parent;

			private readonly MessageId requestId;

			private ArraySegment<byte> transactionId;

			private AmqpMessage request;

			private AmqpMessage response;

			protected override MessageId Target => requestId;

			public RequestAsyncResult(RequestResponseAmqpLink parent, AmqpMessage request, ArraySegment<byte> txnId, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.parent = parent;
				this.request = request;
				transactionId = txnId;
				requestId = this.parent.ToString() + ":r" + (uint)Interlocked.Increment(ref this.parent.nextRequestId);
				this.request.Properties.MessageId = requestId;
				this.request.Properties.ReplyTo = this.parent.replyTo;
				this.parent.inflightRequests.StartWork(requestId, this);
			}

			public static AmqpMessage End(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				return Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult.End<RequestAsyncResult>(result).response;
			}

			public void Start()
			{
				SetTimer();
				request.Initialize(SectionFlag.All);
				parent.sender.SendMessageNoWait(request, AmqpConstants.EmptyBinary, transactionId);
			}

			public void Done(bool completedSynchronously, AmqpMessage response)
			{
				this.response = response;
				CompleteSelf(completedSynchronously);
			}

			public void Cancel(bool completedSynchronously, Exception exception)
			{
				CompleteSelf(completedSynchronously, exception);
			}

			protected override void CompleteOnTimer()
			{
				if (parent.inflightRequests.TryRemoveWork(requestId, out var _))
				{
					base.CompleteOnTimer();
				}
			}
		}

		private static readonly TimeSpan OperationTimeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(60.0);

		private static readonly AsyncCallback onSenderOpen = OnSenderOpen;

		private static readonly AsyncCallback onReceiverOpen = OnReceiverOpen;

		private static readonly AsyncCallback onSenderClose = OnSenderClose;

		private static readonly AsyncCallback onReceiverClose = OnReceiverClose;

		private readonly Address replyTo;

		private readonly SendingAmqpLink sender;

		private readonly ReceivingAmqpLink receiver;

		private readonly WorkCollection<MessageId, RequestAsyncResult, AmqpMessage> inflightRequests;

		private Dictionary<string, object> requestProperties;

		private int nextRequestId;

		public string Name { get; private set; }

		public SendingAmqpLink SendingLink => sender;

		public ReceivingAmqpLink ReceivingLink => receiver;

		public Dictionary<string, object> RequestProperties
		{
			get
			{
				if (requestProperties == null)
				{
					lock (base.ThisLock)
					{
						if (requestProperties == null)
						{
							requestProperties = new Dictionary<string, object>();
						}
					}
				}
				return requestProperties;
			}
		}

		public AmqpSession Session => sender.Session;

		public RequestResponseAmqpLink(string type, AmqpSession session, string address, Fields properties)
			: this(type, null, session, address, properties)
		{
		}

		public RequestResponseAmqpLink(string type, string name, AmqpSession session, string address, Fields properties)
			: base(type)
		{
			Name = name ?? string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "duplex{0}:{1}:{2}", session.Connection.Identifier, session.Identifier, base.Identifier);
			replyTo = Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N");
			sender = new SendingAmqpLink(session, new AmqpLinkSettings
			{
				Role = false,
				LinkName = Name + ":sender",
				SettleType = SettleMode.SettleOnSend,
				Source = new Source(),
				Target = new Target
				{
					Address = address
				},
				Properties = properties
			});
			try
			{
				AmqpLinkSettings amqpLinkSettings = new AmqpLinkSettings
				{
					Role = true,
					LinkName = Name + ":receiver",
					SettleType = SettleMode.SettleOnSend,
					Source = new Source
					{
						Address = address
					},
					TotalLinkCredit = uint.MaxValue,
					AutoSendFlow = true,
					Target = new Target
					{
						Address = replyTo
					}
				};
				if (properties != null)
				{
					amqpLinkSettings.Properties = new Fields();
					amqpLinkSettings.Properties.Merge(properties);
				}
				receiver = new ReceivingAmqpLink(session, amqpLinkSettings);
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				sender.SafeClose();
				throw;
			}
			sender.Closed += OnLinkClosed;
			receiver.RegisterMessageListener(OnResponseMessage);
			receiver.Closed += OnLinkClosed;
			inflightRequests = new WorkCollection<MessageId, RequestAsyncResult, AmqpMessage>();
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginRequest(AmqpMessage request, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return BeginRequest(request, AmqpConstants.NullBinary, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginRequest(AmqpMessage request, ArraySegment<byte> txnId, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new RequestAsyncResult(this, request, txnId, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		public AmqpMessage EndRequest(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			return RequestAsyncResult.End(result);
		}

		public void SendProperties(Fields fields)
		{
			receiver.SendProperties(fields);
			sender.SendProperties(fields);
		}

		protected override bool OpenInternal()
		{
			OperationState state = new OperationState
			{
				Owner = this
			};
			IAsyncResult asyncResult = sender.BeginOpen(OperationTimeout, onSenderOpen, state);
			IAsyncResult asyncResult2 = receiver.BeginOpen(OperationTimeout, onReceiverOpen, state);
			if (asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
			{
				return asyncResult2.CompletedSynchronously;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool CloseInternal()
		{
			inflightRequests.Abort();
			OperationState state = new OperationState
			{
				Owner = this
			};
			IAsyncResult asyncResult = sender.BeginClose(OperationTimeout, onSenderClose, state);
			IAsyncResult asyncResult2 = receiver.BeginClose(OperationTimeout, onReceiverClose, state);
			if (asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
			{
				return asyncResult2.CompletedSynchronously;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void AbortInternal()
		{
			sender.Abort();
			receiver.Abort();
			inflightRequests.Abort();
		}

		private static void OnSenderOpen(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			OnOperationComplete(result, isSender: true, isOpen: true);
		}

		private static void OnReceiverOpen(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			OnOperationComplete(result, isSender: false, isOpen: true);
		}

		private static void OnSenderClose(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			OnOperationComplete(result, isSender: true, isOpen: false);
		}

		private static void OnReceiverClose(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			OnOperationComplete(result, isSender: false, isOpen: false);
		}

		private void OnLinkClosed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			SafeClose();
		}

		private static void OnOperationComplete(IAsyncResult result, bool isSender, bool isOpen)
		{
			OperationState operationState = (OperationState)result.AsyncState;
			RequestResponseAmqpLink owner = operationState.Owner;
			AmqpLink amqpLink = (isSender ? ((AmqpLink)owner.sender) : ((AmqpLink)owner.receiver));
			Exception ex = null;
			try
			{
				if (isOpen)
				{
					amqpLink.EndOpen(result);
				}
				else
				{
					amqpLink.EndClose(result);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex2)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(ex2))
				{
					throw;
				}
				ex = ex2;
			}
			if (operationState.Complete() || ex != null)
			{
				if (isOpen)
				{
					owner.CompleteOpen(syncComplete: false, ex);
				}
				else
				{
					owner.CompleteClose(syncComplete: false, ex);
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnResponseMessage(AmqpMessage response)
		{
			receiver.DisposeDelivery(response, settled: true, AmqpConstants.AcceptedOutcome);
			if (response.Properties != null && response.Properties.CorrelationId != null)
			{
				inflightRequests.CompleteWork(response.Properties.CorrelationId, syncComplete: false, response);
			}
		}
	}

		private class GetRuntimeInfoAsyncResult<T> : IteratorAsyncResult<GetRuntimeInfoAsyncResult<T>>
		{
			private readonly AmqpEventHubClient client;

			private readonly AmqpMessagingFactory factory;

			private readonly string entityType;

			private readonly string partitionId;

			private AmqpServiceClient<IAmqpEntityManagement> serviceClient;

			private string token;

			public T RuntimeInfo { get; private set; }

			protected virtual string ServiceClientAddress => "$management";

			public static GetRuntimeInfoAsyncResult<T> Create(AmqpEventHubClient client, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{
				if (!client.amqpMessagingFactory.Address.IsIoTDeviceUri())
				{
					return new GetRuntimeInfoAsyncResult<T>(client, timeout, callback, state);
				}
				return new GetIoTRuntimeInfoAsyncResult<T>(client, timeout, callback, state);
			}

			public static GetRuntimeInfoAsyncResult<T> Create(AmqpEventHubClient client, string partitionId, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{
				if (!client.amqpMessagingFactory.Address.IsIoTDeviceUri())
				{
					return new GetRuntimeInfoAsyncResult<T>(client, partitionId, timeout, callback, state);
				}
				return new GetIoTRuntimeInfoAsyncResult<T>(client, partitionId, timeout, callback, state);
			}

			protected GetRuntimeInfoAsyncResult(AmqpEventHubClient client, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: this(client, (string)null, timeout, callback, state)
			{
				entityType = "com.microsoft:eventhub";
			}

			protected GetRuntimeInfoAsyncResult(AmqpEventHubClient client, string partitionId, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.client = client;
				entityType = "com.microsoft:partition";
				this.partitionId = partitionId;
				factory = this.client.amqpMessagingFactory;
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				client.ThrowIfDisposed();
				serviceClient = factory.GetManagementServiceClient(ServiceClientAddress);
				if (client.securityTokenProvider != null)
				{
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((GetRuntimeInfoAsyncResult<T> thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.BeginGetSecurityToken(thisPtr.serviceClient, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(GetRuntimeInfoAsyncResult<T> thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.token = thisPtr.EndGetSecurityToken(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
				}
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((GetRuntimeInfoAsyncResult<T> thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.serviceClient.Channel.BeginGetRuntimeInfo(thisPtr.entityType, thisPtr.client.Path, thisPtr.partitionId, thisPtr.token, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(GetRuntimeInfoAsyncResult<T> thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					thisPtr.RuntimeInfo = thisPtr.serviceClient.Channel.EndGetRuntimeInfo<T>(r);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
			}

			protected virtual IAsyncResult BeginGetSecurityToken(AmqpServiceClient<IAmqpEntityManagement> serviceClient, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{
				string appliesTo = EntityNameHelper.FormatEntityEndpointUri("amqp", factory.Address.Host, client.Path);
				return client.securityTokenProvider.BeginGetMessagingToken(factory.Address, appliesTo, "Listen", bypassCache: false, timeout, callback, state);
			}

			protected virtual SecurityToken OnEndGetSecurityToken(IAsyncResult asyncResult)
			{
				return client.securityTokenProvider.EndGetMessagingToken(asyncResult);
			}

			protected string EndGetSecurityToken(IAsyncResult asyncResult)
			{
				SecurityToken securityToken = OnEndGetSecurityToken(asyncResult);
				if (securityToken is SimpleWebSecurityToken)
				{
					return (securityToken as SimpleWebSecurityToken).Token;
				}
				if (securityToken is JsonSecurityToken)
				{
					return (securityToken as JsonSecurityToken).Token;
				}
				throw new InvalidOperationException(SRAmqp.AmqpUnssuportedTokenType);
			}
		}

	internal sealed class AmqpTransportManager : TransportManager, ITransportManagerRegistration, IRuntimeProvider, IConnectionFactory, ISessionFactory, ILinkFactory
	{
		private sealed class OpenLinkAsyncResult : AsyncResult<OpenLinkAsyncResult>
		{
			private static readonly AsyncCompletion openLinkComplete = OpenLinkComplete;

			private readonly ILinkFactory linkFactory;

			public OpenLinkAsyncResult(ILinkFactory linkFactory, AmqpLink link, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(callback, state)
			{
				this.linkFactory = linkFactory;
				IAsyncResult result = this.linkFactory.BeginOpenLink(link, timeout, PrepareAsyncCompletion(openLinkComplete), this);
				if (SyncContinue(result))
				{
					Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: true);
				}
			}

			private static bool OpenLinkComplete(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				OpenLinkAsyncResult openLinkAsyncResult = (OpenLinkAsyncResult)result.AsyncState;
				openLinkAsyncResult.linkFactory.EndOpenLink(result);
				return true;
			}
		}

		private sealed class ConnectionHandler
		{
			private static readonly AsyncCallback openCallback = OpenCallback;

			private readonly AmqpConnection connection;

			private readonly TimeSpan openTimeout;

			public ConnectionHandler(AmqpConnection connection, TimeSpan openTimeout)
			{
				this.connection = connection;
				this.openTimeout = openTimeout;
			}

			public void Start()
			{
				try
				{
					IAsyncResult asyncResult = connection.BeginOpen(openTimeout, openCallback, this);
					if (asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
					{
						OpenComplete(asyncResult);
					}
				}
				catch (Exception exception)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
					{
						throw;
					}
					Fx.Exception.TraceHandled(exception, "AmqpTransportManager.ConnectionHandler.Start");
					connection.SafeClose(exception);
				}
			}

			private static void OpenCallback(IAsyncResult asyncResult)
			{
				ConnectionHandler connectionHandler = (ConnectionHandler)asyncResult.AsyncState;
				try
				{
					connectionHandler.OpenComplete(asyncResult);
				}
				catch (Exception exception)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
					{
						throw;
					}
					Fx.Exception.TraceHandled(exception, "AmqpTransportManager.ConnectionHandler.OpenCallback");
					connectionHandler.connection.SafeClose(exception);
				}
			}

			private void OpenComplete(IAsyncResult asyncResult)
			{
				connection.EndOpen(asyncResult);
			}
		}

		internal static readonly UriPrefixTable<ITransportManagerRegistration> TransportManagerTable = new UriPrefixTable<ITransportManagerRegistration>(includePortInComparison: true);

		private static readonly AsyncCallback sessionOpenCallback = SessionOpenCallback;

		private readonly UriPrefixTable<AmqpChannelListenerBase> addressTable;

		private readonly AmqpSettings amqpSettings;

		private readonly AmqpConnectionSettings amqpConnectionSettings;

		private readonly string id;

		private AmqpTransportListener amqpTransportListener;

		public Uri ListenUri { get; private set; }

		internal override string Scheme => "amqp";

		public TimeSpan OpenTimeout { get; private set; }

		private bool IsOpen { get; set; }

		HostNameComparisonMode ITransportManagerRegistration.HostNameComparisonMode => HostNameComparisonMode.StrongWildcard;

		public AmqpTransportManager(Uri listenUri, AmqpSettings amqpSettings, TimeSpan openTimeout)
		{
			ListenUri = new Uri(listenUri.GetLeftPart(UriPartial.Authority));
			addressTable = new UriPrefixTable<AmqpChannelListenerBase>(includePortInComparison: false);
			OpenTimeout = openTimeout;
			this.amqpSettings = amqpSettings.Clone();
			this.amqpSettings.RuntimeProvider = this;
			amqpConnectionSettings = new AmqpConnectionSettings();
			amqpConnectionSettings.ContainerId = Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N");
			id = GetType().Name + GetHashCode();
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogOperation(this, TraceOperation.Create, ListenUri);
			});
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return id;
		}

		IList<TransportManager> ITransportManagerRegistration.Select(TransportChannelListener channelListener)
		{
			IList<TransportManager> result = null;
			if (IsCompatible(channelListener))
			{
				result = new List<TransportManager> { this };
			}
			return result;
		}

		public AmqpConnection CreateConnection(TransportBase transport, ProtocolHeader protocolHeader, bool isInitiator, AmqpSettings amqpSettings, AmqpConnectionSettings connectionSettings)
		{
			AmqpConnection connection = new AmqpConnection(transport, protocolHeader, isInitiator, amqpSettings, connectionSettings);
			connection.SessionFactory = this;
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogOperation(this, TraceOperation.Connect, connection);
			});
			return connection;
		}

		public AmqpSession CreateSession(AmqpConnection connection, AmqpSessionSettings settings)
		{
			settings.DispositionInterval = TimeSpan.Zero;
			AmqpSession session = new AmqpSession(connection, settings, this);
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogOperation(this, TraceOperation.Create, session);
			});
			session.BeginOpen(OpenTimeout, sessionOpenCallback, session);
			return session;
		}

		public AmqpLink CreateLink(AmqpSession session, AmqpLinkSettings settings)
		{
			return new ReceivingAmqpLink(session, settings);
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginOpenLink(AmqpLink link, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			string text = ((Target)link.Settings.Target).Address.ToString();
			if (!Uri.TryCreate(text, UriKind.Absolute, out var result))
			{
				result = new UriBuilder("amqp", Environment.MachineName, -1, text).Uri;
			}
			if (addressTable.TryLookupUri(result, HostNameComparisonMode.StrongWildcard, out var item))
			{
				return new OpenLinkAsyncResult(item, link, timeout, callback, state);
			}
			throw Fx.Exception.AsWarning(new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.NotFound, "No link with name '" + link.Name + "' could be found."));
		}

		public void EndOpenLink(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			AsyncResult<OpenLinkAsyncResult>.End(result);
		}

		internal override void OnClose(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			IsOpen = false;
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogOperation(this, TraceOperation.Close, ListenUri);
			});
			AmqpTransportListener amqpTransportListener = this.amqpTransportListener;
			if (amqpTransportListener != null)
			{
				amqpTransportListener.Closed -= OnAmqpTransportListenerClosed;
				amqpTransportListener.Close(timeout);
			}
		}

		internal override void OnOpen(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogOperation(this, TraceOperation.Open, ListenUri);
			});
			amqpTransportListener = CreateTransportListener();
			amqpTransportListener.Closed += OnAmqpTransportListenerClosed;
			amqpTransportListener.Open(timeout);
			amqpTransportListener.Listen(OnAcceptTransport);
			IsOpen = true;
		}

		internal override void Register(TimeSpan timeout, TransportChannelListener channelListener)
		{
			addressTable.RegisterUri(channelListener.Uri, channelListener.HostNameComparisonModeInternal, (AmqpChannelListenerBase)channelListener);
		}

		internal override void Unregister(TimeSpan timeout, TransportChannelListener channelListener)
		{
			TransportManager.EnsureRegistered(addressTable, (AmqpChannelListenerBase)channelListener);
			addressTable.UnregisterUri(channelListener.Uri, channelListener.HostNameComparisonModeInternal);
		}

		private static void SessionOpenCallback(IAsyncResult asyncResult)
		{
			AmqpSession amqpSession = (AmqpSession)asyncResult.AsyncState;
			try
			{
				amqpSession.EndOpen(asyncResult);
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				Fx.Exception.TraceHandled(exception, "AmqpTransportManager.SessionOpenCallback");
				amqpSession.SafeClose(exception);
			}
		}

		private bool IsCompatible(TransportChannelListener channelListener)
		{
			return true;
		}

		private AmqpTransportListener CreateTransportListener()
		{
			TcpTransportSettings tcpTransportSettings = new TcpTransportSettings();
			int num = ListenUri.Port;
			if (num <= 0)
			{
				num = 5672;
			}
			tcpTransportSettings.Host = ListenUri.Host;
			tcpTransportSettings.Port = num;
			TransportListener transportListener;
			if (ListenUri.Scheme.Equals("amqps", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				TlsTransportProvider transportProvider = amqpSettings.GetTransportProvider<TlsTransportProvider>();
				if (transportProvider == null)
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.Argument("TlsSecurityProvider", "Tls provider must be set.");
				}
				TlsTransportSettings tlsTransportSettings = new TlsTransportSettings(tcpTransportSettings, isInitiator: false);
				tlsTransportSettings.Certificate = transportProvider.Settings.Certificate;
				transportListener = tlsTransportSettings.CreateListener();
			}
			else
			{
				transportListener = tcpTransportSettings.CreateListener();
			}
			return new AmqpTransportListener(new TransportListener[1] { transportListener }, amqpSettings);
		}

		private void OnAmqpTransportListenerClosed(object sender, EventArgs args)
		{
			if (IsOpen)
			{
				Fx.AssertAndFailFastService("AmqpTransportListener shutdown unexpectedly.");
			}
		}

		private void OnAcceptTransport(TransportListener innerListener, TransportAsyncCallbackArgs args)
		{
			AmqpConnectionSettings connectionSettings = amqpConnectionSettings;
			AmqpConnection amqpConnection = null;
			try
			{
				amqpConnection = CreateConnection(args.Transport, (ProtocolHeader)args.UserToken, isInitiator: false, amqpSettings, connectionSettings);
				new ConnectionHandler(amqpConnection, OpenTimeout).Start();
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				Fx.Exception.TraceHandled(exception, "AmqpTransportManager.OnAcceptTransport");
				amqpConnection?.SafeClose(exception);
			}
		}
	}
