	internal sealed class SegmentBufferPool
	{
		private readonly int segmentSize;

		private readonly byte[] heap;

		private readonly int[] offsets;

		private readonly object lockObject = new object();

		private int top;

		public int SegmentSize => segmentSize;

		public SegmentBufferPool(int segmentSize, int count)
		{
			this.segmentSize = segmentSize;
			heap = new byte[segmentSize * count];
			offsets = new int[count];
			top = count - 1;
			int num = count - 1;
			int num2 = 0;
			while (num >= 0)
			{
				offsets[num] = num2;
				num--;
				num2 += segmentSize;
			}
		}

		public ArraySegment<byte> TakeBuffer(int bufferSize)
		{
			if (bufferSize > segmentSize)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("bufferSize");
			}
			int num;
			lock (lockObject)
			{
				if (top >= 0)
				{
					num = offsets[top];
					top--;
				}
				else
				{
					num = -1;
				}
			}
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				return new ArraySegment<byte>(heap, num, bufferSize);
			}
			return new ArraySegment<byte>(new byte[bufferSize]);
		}

		public void ReturnBuffer(ArraySegment<byte> buffer)
		{
			if (buffer.Array != heap)
			{
				return;
			}
			lock (lockObject)
			{
				if (top < offsets.Length - 1)
				{
					top++;
					offsets[top] = buffer.Offset;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal sealed class DuplexAmqpLink : AmqpObject
	{
		private static readonly AsyncCallback onSenderOpen = OnSenderOpen;

		private static readonly AsyncCallback onReceiverOpen = OnReceiverOpen;

		private static readonly AsyncCallback onSenderClose = OnSenderClose;

		private static readonly AsyncCallback onReceiverClose = OnReceiverClose;

		private readonly SendingAmqpLink sender;

		private readonly ReceivingAmqpLink receiver;

		internal SendingAmqpLink SendingLink => sender;

		public DuplexAmqpLink(AmqpSession session, AmqpLinkSettings settings)
			: base("duplex")
		{
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogOperation(this, TraceOperation.Create, settings.LinkName);
			AmqpLinkSettings settings2 = new AmqpLinkSettings
			{
				Role = false,
				LinkName = settings.LinkName + ":out",
				SettleType = settings.SettleType,
				Source = new Source(),
				TotalLinkCredit = settings.TotalLinkCredit,
				AutoSendFlow = settings.AutoSendFlow,
				Target = settings.Target,
				Properties = settings.Properties
			};
			sender = new SendingAmqpLink(session, settings2);
			AmqpLinkSettings amqpLinkSettings = new AmqpLinkSettings
			{
				Role = true,
				LinkName = settings.LinkName + ":in",
				SettleType = settings.SettleType,
				Source = settings.Source,
				TotalLinkCredit = settings.TotalLinkCredit,
				AutoSendFlow = settings.AutoSendFlow,
				Target = new Target(),
				Properties = settings.Properties
			};
			receiver = new ReceivingAmqpLink(session, amqpLinkSettings);
			receiver.SetTotalLinkCredit(amqpLinkSettings.TotalLinkCredit, applyNow: true);
			sender.SafeAddClosed(OnLinkClosed);
			receiver.SafeAddClosed(OnLinkClosed);
		}

		public DuplexAmqpLink(SendingAmqpLink sender, ReceivingAmqpLink receiver)
			: base("duplex")
		{
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogOperation(this, TraceOperation.Create, receiver.Settings.LinkName);
			this.sender = sender;
			this.receiver = receiver;
			this.sender.SafeAddClosed(OnLinkClosed);
			this.receiver.SafeAddClosed(OnLinkClosed);
		}

		public Task<Outcome> SendMessageAsync(AmqpMessage message, ArraySegment<byte> deliveryTag, ArraySegment<byte> txnId, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			return sender.SendMessageAsync(message, deliveryTag, txnId, timeout);
		}

		public void RegisterMessageListener(Action<AmqpMessage> messageListener)
		{
			receiver.RegisterMessageListener(messageListener);
		}

		public void DisposeMessage(AmqpMessage message, DeliveryState deliveryState, bool settled, bool batchable)
		{
			receiver.DisposeMessage(message, deliveryState, settled, batchable);
		}

		internal void SendProperties(Fields fields)
		{
			receiver.SendProperties(fields);
			sender.SendProperties(fields);
		}

		protected override bool OpenInternal()
		{
			IAsyncResult asyncResult = sender.BeginOpen(base.DefaultOpenTimeout, onSenderOpen, this);
			IAsyncResult asyncResult2 = receiver.BeginOpen(base.DefaultOpenTimeout, onReceiverOpen, this);
			if (asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
			{
				return asyncResult2.CompletedSynchronously;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool CloseInternal()
		{
			if (base.TerminalException != null)
			{
				sender.SafeClose(base.TerminalException);
				receiver.SafeClose(base.TerminalException);
				return true;
			}
			IAsyncResult asyncResult = sender.BeginClose(base.DefaultCloseTimeout, onSenderClose, this);
			IAsyncResult asyncResult2 = receiver.BeginClose(base.DefaultCloseTimeout, onReceiverClose, this);
			if (asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
			{
				return asyncResult2.CompletedSynchronously;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void AbortInternal()
		{
			sender.Abort();
			receiver.Abort();
		}

		private static void OnSenderOpen(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			DuplexAmqpLink duplexAmqpLink = (DuplexAmqpLink)result.AsyncState;
			duplexAmqpLink.OnOperationComplete(duplexAmqpLink.sender, result, isOpen: true);
		}

		private static void OnReceiverOpen(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			DuplexAmqpLink duplexAmqpLink = (DuplexAmqpLink)result.AsyncState;
			duplexAmqpLink.OnOperationComplete(duplexAmqpLink.receiver, result, isOpen: true);
		}

		private static void OnSenderClose(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			DuplexAmqpLink duplexAmqpLink = (DuplexAmqpLink)result.AsyncState;
			duplexAmqpLink.OnOperationComplete(duplexAmqpLink.sender, result, isOpen: false);
		}

		private static void OnReceiverClose(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			DuplexAmqpLink duplexAmqpLink = (DuplexAmqpLink)result.AsyncState;
			duplexAmqpLink.OnOperationComplete(duplexAmqpLink.receiver, result, isOpen: false);
		}

		private void OnLinkClosed(object closedObject, EventArgs e)
		{
			SafeClose(((AmqpObject)closedObject).TerminalException);
		}

		private void OnOperationComplete(AmqpObject link, IAsyncResult result, bool isOpen)
		{
			Exception ex = null;
			try
			{
				if (isOpen)
				{
					link.EndOpen(result);
				}
				else
				{
					link.EndClose(result);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex2)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(ex2))
				{
					throw;
				}
				ex = ex2;
			}
			bool flag = true;
			if (ex == null)
			{
				AmqpObjectState amqpObjectState = (isOpen ? AmqpObjectState.OpenSent : AmqpObjectState.CloseSent);
				lock (base.ThisLock)
				{
					flag = sender.State != amqpObjectState && receiver.State != amqpObjectState;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				if (isOpen)
				{
					CompleteOpen(syncComplete: false, ex);
				}
				else
				{
					CompleteClose(syncComplete: false, ex);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	internal abstract class TimeoutAsyncResult<T> : Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult where T : class
	{
		private static readonly Action<object> timerCallback = OnTimerCallback;

		private readonly TimeSpan timeout;

		private IOThreadTimer timer;

		protected abstract T Target { get; }

		protected TimeoutAsyncResult(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			: base(callback, state)
		{
			this.timeout = timeout;
		}

		protected void SetTimer()
		{
			if (timeout != TimeSpan.MaxValue)
			{
				timer = new IOThreadTimer(timerCallback, this, isTypicallyCanceledShortlyAfterBeingSet: true);
				timer.Set(timeout);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void CompleteOnTimer()
		{
			CompleteInternal(syncComplete: false, new TimeoutException(SRAmqp.AmqpTimeout(timeout, Target)));
		}

		protected void CompleteSelf(bool syncComplete)
		{
			CompleteSelf(syncComplete, null);
		}

		protected bool CompleteSelf(bool syncComplete, Exception exception)
		{
			if (timer != null)
			{
				timer.Cancel();
			}
			return CompleteInternal(syncComplete, exception);
		}

		private static void OnTimerCallback(object state)
		{
			TimeoutAsyncResult<T> timeoutAsyncResult = (TimeoutAsyncResult<T>)state;
			timeoutAsyncResult.CompleteOnTimer();
		}

		private bool CompleteInternal(bool syncComplete, Exception exception)
		{
			return TryComplete(syncComplete, exception);
		}
	}

		}
	}

		private sealed class AmqpOutputChannel : ChannelBase, IOutputChannel, IChannel, ICommunicationObject
		{
			private sealed class EstablishConnectionAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<EstablishConnectionAsyncResult>
			{
				private static readonly Action<Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult, Exception> onFinally = OnFinally;

				private readonly AmqpOutputChannel channel;

				private readonly SharedAmqpLink sharedAmqpLink;

				public EstablishConnectionAsyncResult(SharedAmqpLink sharedAmqpLink, AmqpOutputChannel channel, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
					: base(timeout, callback, state)
				{
					this.channel = channel;
					this.sharedAmqpLink = sharedAmqpLink;
					base.OnCompleting = (Action<Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult, Exception>)Delegate.Combine(base.OnCompleting, onFinally);
				}

				protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
				{
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((EstablishConnectionAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.sharedAmqpLink.BeginGetInstance(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(EstablishConnectionAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult a)
					{
						thisPtr.channel.Link = thisPtr.sharedAmqpLink.EndGetInstance(a);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
					channel.Connection = channel.Link.Session.Connection;
				}

				private static void OnFinally(Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult asyncResult, Exception exception)
				{
					if (exception != null)
					{
						throw AmqpExceptionHelper.ToCommunicationContract(exception);
					}
				}
			}

			private static int instanceIdCounter;

			private static int messageDeliveryTag;

			private readonly SharedAmqpLink sharedAmqpLink;

			private readonly string id;

			private readonly EventHandler onAmqpObjectClosed;

			private AmqpConnection connection;

			private SendingAmqpLink link;

			public EndpointAddress RemoteAddress { get; private set; }

			public Uri Via { get; private set; }

			private AmqpChannelFactory ChannelFactory => (AmqpChannelFactory)base.Manager;

			private MessageEncoder MessageEncoder => ChannelFactory.MessageEncoderFactory.Encoder;

			private AmqpConnection Connection
			{
				get
				{
					return connection;
				}
				set
				{
					if (value != null)
					{
						value.Closed += onAmqpObjectClosed;
						if (value.State != AmqpObjectState.Opened)
						{
							Fault();
						}
					}
					connection = value;
				}
			}

			private SendingAmqpLink Link
			{
				get
				{
					return link;
				}
				set
				{
					if (value != null)
					{
						value.Closed += onAmqpObjectClosed;
						if (value.State != AmqpObjectState.Opened)
						{
							Fault();
						}
					}
					link = value;
				}
			}

			public AmqpOutputChannel(SharedAmqpLink sharedAmqpLink, AmqpChannelFactory channelFactory, EndpointAddress address, Uri via)
				: base(channelFactory)
			{
				this.sharedAmqpLink = sharedAmqpLink;
				RemoteAddress = address;
				Via = via;
				id = GetType().Name + Interlocked.Increment(ref instanceIdCounter);
				onAmqpObjectClosed = OnAmqpObjectClosed;
			}

			public void Send(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message)
			{
				Send(message, base.DefaultSendTimeout);
			}

			public void Send(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, TimeSpan timeout)
			{
				EndSend(BeginSend(message, timeout, null, null));
			}

			public IAsyncResult BeginSend(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{
				return BeginSend(message, base.DefaultSendTimeout, callback, state);
			}

			public IAsyncResult BeginSend(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{
				ThrowIfDisposedOrNotOpen();
				try
				{
					AddHeadersTo(message);
					int maxBufferSize = ChannelFactory.GetMaxBufferSize();
					ArraySegment<byte> buffer = MessageEncoder.WriteMessage(message, maxBufferSize, ChannelFactory.BufferManager);
					AmqpMessage message2 = FinishEncodingMessage(buffer, message);
					return Link.BeginSendMessage(message2, GetDeliveryTag(), default(ArraySegment<byte>), timeout, callback, state);
				}
				catch (Exception exception) when (!Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw AmqpExceptionHelper.ToCommunicationContract(exception);
				}
			}

			public void EndSend(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				Outcome outcome;
				try
				{
					outcome = Link.EndSendMessage(result);
				}
				catch (Exception exception) when (!Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw AmqpExceptionHelper.ToCommunicationContract(exception);
				}
				if (outcome.DescriptorCode != Accepted.Code)
				{
					if (outcome is Rejected rejected)
					{
						AmqpException exception2 = new AmqpException(rejected.Error);
						throw AmqpExceptionHelper.ToCommunicationContract(exception2);
					}
					Fault();
					throw Fx.Exception.AsWarning(new CommunicationObjectFaultedException(outcome.ToString()));
				}
			}

			protected override void OnAbort()
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogOperation(id, TraceOperation.Abort, Via.AbsoluteUri);
				if (sharedAmqpLink != null && sharedAmqpLink.Invalidate(out var invalidatedInstance))
				{
					invalidatedInstance.SafeClose();
				}
			}

			protected override void OnClosing()
			{
				SendingAmqpLink sendingAmqpLink = Link;
				if (sendingAmqpLink != null)
				{
					sendingAmqpLink.Closed -= onAmqpObjectClosed;
				}
				AmqpConnection amqpConnection = Connection;
				if (amqpConnection != null)
				{
					amqpConnection.Closed -= onAmqpObjectClosed;
				}
				base.OnClosing();
			}

			protected override void OnClose(TimeSpan timeout)
			{
			}

			protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{
				return new CompletedAsyncResult(callback, state);
			}

			protected override void OnEndClose(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				CompletedAsyncResult.End(result);
			}

			protected override void OnOpen(TimeSpan timeout)
			{
				new EstablishConnectionAsyncResult(sharedAmqpLink, this, timeout, null, null).RunSynchronously();
			}

			protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginOpen(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{
				return new EstablishConnectionAsyncResult(sharedAmqpLink, this, timeout, callback, state).Start();
			}

			protected override void OnEndOpen(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				AsyncResult<EstablishConnectionAsyncResult>.End(result);
			}

			protected override void OnFaulted()
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteChannelFaulted(id);
				base.OnFaulted();
			}

			private void AddHeadersTo(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message channelMessage)
			{
				if (!ChannelFactory.ManualAddressing && RemoteAddress != null)
				{
					RemoteAddress.ApplyTo(channelMessage);
				}
			}

			private void OnAmqpObjectClosed(object sender, EventArgs args)
			{
				Fault();
			}

			private static AmqpMessage FinishEncodingMessage(ArraySegment<byte> buffer, System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message channelMessage)
			{
				AmqpMessageProperty amqpMessageProperty = null;
				AmqpMessage amqpMessage;
				if (channelMessage.Properties.TryGetValue(AmqpMessageProperty.KeyName, out var value))
				{
					amqpMessageProperty = (AmqpMessageProperty)value;
					amqpMessage = ((amqpMessageProperty.BodyStream == null) ? AmqpMessage.Create(new Data[1]
					{
						new Data
						{
							Value = buffer
						}
					}) : AmqpMessage.Create(amqpMessageProperty.BodyStream, ownStream: false));
					if (amqpMessageProperty.CorrelationId.HasValue)
					{
						amqpMessage.Properties.CorrelationId = amqpMessageProperty.CorrelationId.Value;
					}
					foreach (KeyValuePair<string, string> applicationProperty in amqpMessageProperty.ApplicationProperties)
					{
						amqpMessage.ApplicationProperties.Map.Add(applicationProperty.Key, applicationProperty.Value);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					amqpMessage = AmqpMessage.Create(new Data[1]
					{
						new Data
						{
							Value = buffer
						}
					});
				}
				if (channelMessage.Headers.To != null)
				{
					amqpMessage.Properties.To = channelMessage.Headers.To.AbsoluteUri;
				}
				if (channelMessage.Headers.MessageId != null)
				{
					amqpMessage.Properties.MessageId = channelMessage.Headers.MessageId.ToString();
				}
				if (channelMessage.Headers.ReplyTo != null)
				{
					amqpMessage.Properties.ReplyTo = channelMessage.Headers.ReplyTo.Uri.AbsoluteUri;
				}
				return amqpMessage;
			}

			private static ArraySegment<byte> GetDeliveryTag()
			{
				int value = Interlocked.Increment(ref messageDeliveryTag);
				return new ArraySegment<byte>(BitConverter.GetBytes(value));
			}
		}

		private sealed class SharedAmqpConnection : SingletonManager<Tuple<AmqpConnection, AmqpSession>>
		{
			private sealed class ConnectAsyncResult : AsyncResult<ConnectAsyncResult>
			{
				private readonly AmqpSettings amqpSettings;

				public AmqpConnection AmqpConnection { get; private set; }

				protected override EventLevel TraceEventType => EventLevel.Warning;

				public ConnectAsyncResult(string host, int port, AmqpSettings amqpSettings, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
					: base(callback, state)
				{
					if (port <= 0)
					{
						port = 5672;
					}
					this.amqpSettings = amqpSettings;
					TcpTransportSettings transportSettings = new TcpTransportSettings
					{
						Host = host,
						Port = port
					};
					AmqpTransportInitiator amqpTransportInitiator = new AmqpTransportInitiator(this.amqpSettings, transportSettings);
					amqpTransportInitiator.ConnectAsync(timeout, new TransportAsyncCallbackArgs
					{
						CompletedCallback = OnTransportCallback,
						UserToken = this
					});
				}

				private void OnTransportCallback(TransportAsyncCallbackArgs args)
				{
					if (args.Exception != null)
					{
						Complete(args.CompletedSynchronously, args.Exception);
						return;
					}
					AmqpConnectionSettings amqpConnectionSettings = new AmqpConnectionSettings();
					amqpConnectionSettings.ContainerId = Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N");
					AmqpConnection = new AmqpConnection(args.Transport, amqpSettings, amqpConnectionSettings);
					Complete(args.CompletedSynchronously);
				}
			}

			private sealed class OpenConnectionAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<OpenConnectionAsyncResult>
			{
				private static readonly Action<Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult, Exception> onFinally = OnFinally;

				private readonly SharedAmqpConnection sharedAmqpConnection;

				private readonly string host;

				private readonly int port;

				private readonly AmqpSettings settings;

				public AmqpConnection Connection { get; private set; }

				public AmqpSession Session { get; private set; }

				protected override EventLevel TraceEventType => EventLevel.Warning;

				public OpenConnectionAsyncResult(SharedAmqpConnection sharedAmqpConnection, string host, int port, AmqpSettings settings, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
					: base(timeout, callback, state)
				{
					this.sharedAmqpConnection = sharedAmqpConnection;
					this.host = host;
					this.port = port;
					this.settings = settings;
					base.OnCompleting = (Action<Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult, Exception>)Delegate.Combine(base.OnCompleting, onFinally);
				}

				protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
				{
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((OpenConnectionAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => new ConnectAsyncResult(thisPtr.host, thisPtr.port, thisPtr.settings, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(OpenConnectionAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult a)
					{
						thisPtr.Connection = AsyncResult<ConnectAsyncResult>.End(a).AmqpConnection;
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
					Connection.Closed += sharedAmqpConnection.OnSessionClosed;
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((OpenConnectionAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.Connection.BeginOpen(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(OpenConnectionAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult a)
					{
						thisPtr.Connection.EndOpen(a);
					}, (Call)delegate(OpenConnectionAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t)
					{
						thisPtr.Connection.Open(t);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
					AmqpSessionSettings sessionSettings = new AmqpSessionSettings
					{
						DispositionInterval = TimeSpan.Zero
					};
					Session = Connection.CreateSession(sessionSettings);
					Session.Closed += sharedAmqpConnection.OnSessionClosed;
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((OpenConnectionAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.Session.BeginOpen(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(OpenConnectionAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.Session.EndOpen(r);
					}, (Call)delegate(OpenConnectionAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t)
					{
						thisPtr.Session.Open(t);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
				}

				private static void OnFinally(Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult asyncResult, Exception exception)
				{
					OpenConnectionAsyncResult openConnectionAsyncResult = (OpenConnectionAsyncResult)asyncResult;
					if (exception != null)
					{
						openConnectionAsyncResult.sharedAmqpConnection.Cleanup();
						if (openConnectionAsyncResult.Session != null)
						{
							openConnectionAsyncResult.Session.Closed -= openConnectionAsyncResult.sharedAmqpConnection.OnSessionClosed;
						}
						if (openConnectionAsyncResult.Connection != null)
						{
							openConnectionAsyncResult.Connection.Closed -= openConnectionAsyncResult.sharedAmqpConnection.OnSessionClosed;
							openConnectionAsyncResult.Connection.SafeClose();
						}
					}
				}
			}

			private readonly AmqpChannelFactory amqpChannelFactory;

			private readonly string host;

			private readonly int port;

			private readonly AmqpSettings settings;

			public SharedAmqpConnection(AmqpChannelFactory amqpChannelFactory, string host, int port, AmqpSettings settings)
				: base(new object())
			{
				this.amqpChannelFactory = amqpChannelFactory;
				this.host = host;
				this.port = port;
				this.settings = settings;
			}

			private void OnSessionClosed(object sender, EventArgs e)
			{
				Cleanup();
			}

			private void Cleanup()
			{
				string key = CreateSharedAmqpConnectionsKey(host, port);
				amqpChannelFactory.sharedAmqpConnections.TryRemove(key, out var _);
				amqpChannelFactory.amqpChannelEvents.OnSessionClosed();
			}

			protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginCreateInstance(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{
				return new OpenConnectionAsyncResult(this, host, port, settings, timeout, callback, state).Start();
			}

			protected override Tuple<AmqpConnection, AmqpSession> OnEndCreateInstance(IAsyncResult asyncResult)
			{
				OpenConnectionAsyncResult openConnectionAsyncResult = AsyncResult<OpenConnectionAsyncResult>.End(asyncResult);
				Tuple<AmqpConnection, AmqpSession> result = new Tuple<AmqpConnection, AmqpSession>(openConnectionAsyncResult.Connection, openConnectionAsyncResult.Session);
				amqpChannelFactory.amqpChannelEvents.OnSessionOpened();
				return result;
			}

			protected override void OnGetInstance(Tuple<AmqpConnection, AmqpSession> connectionAndSession)
			{
				if ((connectionAndSession.Item1.State != AmqpObjectState.Opened || connectionAndSession.Item2.State != AmqpObjectState.Opened) && Invalidate(connectionAndSession))
				{
					connectionAndSession.Item1.SafeClose();
				}
			}
		}

		private sealed class SharedAmqpLink : SingletonManager<SendingAmqpLink>
		{
			private sealed class OpenLinkAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<OpenLinkAsyncResult>
			{
				private static readonly Action<Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult, Exception> onFinally = OnFinally;

				private readonly SharedAmqpConnection sharedAmqpConnection;

				private readonly SharedAmqpLink sharedAmqpLink;

				private readonly Uri via;

				private Tuple<AmqpConnection, AmqpSession> amqpConnectionSession;

				public SendingAmqpLink Link { get; private set; }

				protected override EventLevel TraceEventType => EventLevel.Warning;

				public OpenLinkAsyncResult(SharedAmqpConnection sharedAmqpConnection, SharedAmqpLink sharedAmqpLink, Uri via, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
					: base(timeout, callback, state)
				{
					this.sharedAmqpConnection = sharedAmqpConnection;
					this.sharedAmqpLink = sharedAmqpLink;
					this.via = via;
					base.OnCompleting = (Action<Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult, Exception>)Delegate.Combine(base.OnCompleting, onFinally);
				}

				protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
				{
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((OpenLinkAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.sharedAmqpConnection.BeginGetInstance(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(OpenLinkAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult a)
					{
						thisPtr.amqpConnectionSession = thisPtr.sharedAmqpConnection.EndGetInstance(a);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
					AmqpLinkSettings amqpLinkSettings = new AmqpLinkSettings();
					amqpLinkSettings.LinkName = via.PathAndQuery + "/" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString();
					amqpLinkSettings.AddProperty(AmqpClientConstants.TimeoutName, (uint)RemainingTime().TotalMilliseconds);
					amqpLinkSettings.Role = false;
					amqpLinkSettings.InitialDeliveryCount = 0u;
					amqpLinkSettings.Target = new Target
					{
						Address = via.PathAndQuery
					};
					Link = new SendingAmqpLink(amqpConnectionSession.Item2, amqpLinkSettings);
					Link.Closed += sharedAmqpLink.OnLinkClosed;
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((OpenLinkAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.Link.BeginOpen(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(OpenLinkAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.Link.EndOpen(r);
					}, (Call)delegate(OpenLinkAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t)
					{
						thisPtr.Link.Open(t);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
				}

				private static void OnFinally(Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult asyncResult, Exception exception)
				{
					OpenLinkAsyncResult openLinkAsyncResult = (OpenLinkAsyncResult)asyncResult;
					if (exception != null)
					{
						if (openLinkAsyncResult.Link != null)
						{
							openLinkAsyncResult.Link.Closed -= openLinkAsyncResult.sharedAmqpLink.OnLinkClosed;
							openLinkAsyncResult.Link.SafeClose();
						}
						openLinkAsyncResult.sharedAmqpLink.Cleanup();
					}
				}
			}

			private readonly AmqpChannelFactory amqpChannelFactory;

			private readonly SharedAmqpConnection sharedAmqpConnection;

			private readonly Uri via;

			public SharedAmqpLink(AmqpChannelFactory amqpChannelFactory, SharedAmqpConnection sharedConnection, Uri via)
				: base(new object())
			{
				this.amqpChannelFactory = amqpChannelFactory;
				sharedAmqpConnection = sharedConnection;
				this.via = via;
			}

			private void OnLinkClosed(object sender, EventArgs e)
			{
				Cleanup();
			}

			private void Cleanup()
			{
				amqpChannelFactory.sharedAmqpLinks.TryRemove(via.AbsoluteUri, out var _);
				amqpChannelFactory.amqpChannelEvents.OnLinkClosed();
			}

			protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginCreateInstance(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{
				return new OpenLinkAsyncResult(sharedAmqpConnection, this, via, timeout, callback, state).Start();
			}

			protected override SendingAmqpLink OnEndCreateInstance(IAsyncResult asyncResult)
			{
				SendingAmqpLink link = AsyncResult<OpenLinkAsyncResult>.End(asyncResult).Link;
				amqpChannelFactory.amqpChannelEvents.OnLinkOpened();
				return link;
			}
		}

		private readonly AmqpTransportBindingElement transportBindingElement;

		private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string, SharedAmqpConnection> sharedAmqpConnections;

		private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string, SharedAmqpLink> sharedAmqpLinks;

		private readonly AmqpChannelEvents amqpChannelEvents;

		public override string Scheme => "amqp";

		public AmqpChannelFactory(AmqpTransportBindingElement transportBindingElement, BindingContext context)
			: base((TransportBindingElement)transportBindingElement, context)
		{
			this.transportBindingElement = transportBindingElement;
			sharedAmqpConnections = new ConcurrentDictionary<string, SharedAmqpConnection>();
			sharedAmqpLinks = new ConcurrentDictionary<string, SharedAmqpLink>();
			amqpChannelEvents = new AmqpChannelEvents(this);
		}

		public override T GetProperty<T>()
		{
			if (typeof(T) == typeof(IAmqpChannelEvents))
			{
				return (T)(object)amqpChannelEvents;
			}
			return base.GetProperty<T>();
		}

		protected override IOutputChannel OnCreateChannel(EndpointAddress address, Uri via)
		{
			if (!sharedAmqpLinks.TryGetValue(via.AbsoluteUri, out var value))
			{
				string key = CreateSharedAmqpConnectionsKey(via.Host, via.Port);
				if (!sharedAmqpConnections.TryGetValue(key, out var value2))
				{
					value2 = sharedAmqpConnections.GetOrAdd(key, new SharedAmqpConnection(this, via.Host, via.Port, transportBindingElement.AmqpSettings));
				}
				value = sharedAmqpLinks.GetOrAdd(via.AbsoluteUri, new SharedAmqpLink(this, value2, via));
			}
			return new AmqpOutputChannel(value, this, address, via);
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginOpen(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new CompletedAsyncResult(callback, state);
		}

		protected override void OnEndOpen(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			CompletedAsyncResult.End(result);
		}

		protected override void OnOpen(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
		}

		protected override void OnAbort()
		{
			OnCloseOrAbort(graceful: false);
			base.OnAbort();
		}

		protected override void OnClose(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			OnCloseOrAbort(graceful: true);
			base.OnClose(timeout);
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			OnCloseOrAbort(graceful: true);
			return base.OnBeginClose(timeout, callback, state);
		}

		private void OnCloseOrAbort(bool graceful)
		{
			foreach (SharedAmqpConnection value in sharedAmqpConnections.Values)
			{
				if (value.Invalidate(out var invalidatedInstance))
				{
					if (graceful)
					{
						invalidatedInstance.Item1.SafeClose();
					}
					else
					{
						invalidatedInstance.Item1.Abort();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnFaulted()
		{
			Fx.AssertAndFailFastService("AmqpChannelFactory is not designed to fault. If this is required, please update ConnectBindings and the users of ConnectBindings.P2PChannelFactory");
			base.OnFaulted();
		}

		private static string CreateSharedAmqpConnectionsKey(string host, int port)
		{
			return host + ":" + port;
		}
	}
	internal sealed class AmqpChannelListener : AmqpChannelListenerBase, IChannelListener<IInputSessionChannel>, IChannelListener, ICommunicationObject
	{
		private sealed class AmqpInputSessionChannel : ChannelBase, IInputSessionChannel, IInputChannel, IChannel, ICommunicationObject, ISessionChannel<IInputSession>, ICommunicationObjectInternals
		{
			private sealed class InputSession : IInputSession, ISession
			{
				public string Id { get; private set; }

				public InputSession(AmqpInputSessionChannel channel)
				{
					Id = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0},{1},{2}", channel.link.Session.Connection, channel.link.Session, channel.link);
				}
			}

			private sealed class TryReceiveAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<TryReceiveAsyncResult>
			{
				private readonly AmqpInputSessionChannel inputChannel;

				private AmqpMessage amqpMessage;

				public System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message Message { get; private set; }

				public bool Outcome { get; private set; }

				public TryReceiveAsyncResult(AmqpInputSessionChannel inputChannel, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
					: base(timeout, callback, state)
				{
					this.inputChannel = inputChannel;
				}

				protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
				{
					if (inputChannel.DoneReceivingInCurrentState())
					{
						Message = null;
						Outcome = true;
						yield break;
					}
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((TryReceiveAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.inputChannel.link.BeginReceiveMessage(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(TryReceiveAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult a)
					{
						thisPtr.Outcome = thisPtr.inputChannel.link.EndReceiveMessage(a, out thisPtr.amqpMessage);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
					Message = inputChannel.AmqpMessageToChannelMessage(amqpMessage);
					if (amqpMessage != null)
					{
						inputChannel.link.DisposeMessage(amqpMessage, AmqpConstants.AcceptedOutcome, settled: true, amqpMessage.Batchable);
					}
				}
			}

			private readonly ReceivingAmqpLink link;

			private readonly string id;

			private IInputSession inputSession;

			public IInputSession Session
			{
				get
				{
					if (inputSession == null)
					{
						lock (base.ThisLock)
						{
							if (inputSession == null)
							{
								inputSession = new InputSession(this);
							}
						}
					}
					return inputSession;
				}
			}

			internal AmqpChannelListener ChannelListener => (AmqpChannelListener)base.Manager;

			public EndpointAddress LocalAddress { get; private set; }

			public AmqpInputSessionChannel(AmqpChannelListener channelListener, ReceivingAmqpLink link)
				: base(channelListener)
			{
				this.link = link;
				LocalAddress = new EndpointAddress(channelListener.Uri);
				id = GetType().Name + GetHashCode();
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogOperation(this, TraceOperation.Create, LocalAddress);
			}

			public override string ToString()
			{
				return id;
			}

			void ICommunicationObjectInternals.ThrowIfDisposed()
			{
				ThrowIfDisposed();
			}

			void ICommunicationObjectInternals.ThrowIfDisposedOrNotOpen()
			{
				ThrowIfDisposedOrNotOpen();
			}

			protected override void OnAbort()
			{
				link.SafeClose();
			}

			protected override void OnOpen(TimeSpan timeout)
			{
			}

			protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginOpen(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)

			public IAsyncResult BeginReceive(AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{
				return BeginReceive(base.DefaultReceiveTimeout, callback, state);
			}

			public IAsyncResult BeginReceive(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{
				return new TryReceiveAsyncResult(this, timeout, callback, state).Start();
			}

			System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message IInputChannel.EndReceive(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				TryReceiveAsyncResult tryReceiveAsyncResult = AsyncResult<TryReceiveAsyncResult>.End(result);
				if (!tryReceiveAsyncResult.Outcome)
				{
					throw new TimeoutException(SRCore.TimeoutOnOperation(tryReceiveAsyncResult.OriginalTimeout));
				}
				return tryReceiveAsyncResult.Message;
			}

			IAsyncResult IInputChannel.BeginTryReceive(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{
				return new TryReceiveAsyncResult(this, timeout, callback, state).Start();
			}

			IAsyncResult IInputChannel.BeginWaitForMessage(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{
				ThrowIfDisposedOrNotOpen();
				throw new NotImplementedException();
			}

			bool IInputChannel.EndTryReceive(IAsyncResult result, out System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message)
			{
				TryReceiveAsyncResult tryReceiveAsyncResult = AsyncResult<TryReceiveAsyncResult>.End(result);
				message = tryReceiveAsyncResult.Message;
				return tryReceiveAsyncResult.Outcome;
			}

			bool IInputChannel.EndWaitForMessage(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				throw new NotImplementedException();
			}

			public System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message Receive()
			{
				return Receive(base.DefaultReceiveTimeout);
			}

			public System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message Receive(TimeSpan timeout)
			{
				TryReceiveAsyncResult tryReceiveAsyncResult = new TryReceiveAsyncResult(this, timeout, null, null);
				tryReceiveAsyncResult.RunSynchronously();
				if (!tryReceiveAsyncResult.Outcome)
				{
					throw new TimeoutException(SRCore.TimeoutOnOperation(timeout));
				}
				return tryReceiveAsyncResult.Message;
			}

			public bool TryReceive(TimeSpan timeout, out System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message)
			{
				TryReceiveAsyncResult tryReceiveAsyncResult = new TryReceiveAsyncResult(this, timeout, null, null);
				tryReceiveAsyncResult.RunSynchronously();
				message = tryReceiveAsyncResult.Message;
				return tryReceiveAsyncResult.Outcome;
			}

			public bool WaitForMessage(TimeSpan timeout)
			{
				ThrowIfDisposedOrNotOpen();
				throw new NotImplementedException();
			}

			private System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message AmqpMessageToChannelMessage(AmqpMessage amqpMessage)
			{
				if (amqpMessage == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (amqpMessage.ApplicationProperties == null || !amqpMessage.ApplicationProperties.Map.TryGetValue<string>("Action", out var value))
				{
					value = string.Empty;
				}
				System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message = null;
				if (amqpMessage.BodyType == SectionFlag.AmqpValue)
				{
					message = System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message.CreateMessage(MessageVersion.Default, value, amqpMessage.ValueBody.Value);
					amqpMessage.Dispose();
				}
				else if (amqpMessage.BodyType == SectionFlag.Data)
				{
					Data data = null;
					foreach (Data item in amqpMessage.DataBody)
					{
						Fx.AssertAndThrow(data == null, "Serialization of AMQP messages with multiple body frames is not implemented.");
						data = item;
					}
					ArraySegment<byte> buffer = (ArraySegment<byte>)data.Value;
					message = ChannelListener.MessageEncoderFactory.Encoder.ReadMessage(buffer, AmqpChannelListenerBase.GCBufferManager);
					message.Properties["AmqpMessageProperty"] = amqpMessage;
				}
				if (message == null)
				{
					throw Fx.AssertAndThrow("Serialization of this type of AmqpMessage is not yet implemented: " + amqpMessage.BodyType);
				}
				message.Properties.Via = LocalAddress.Uri;
				if (amqpMessage.Properties != null)
				{
					if (amqpMessage.Properties.To != null)
					{
						message.Headers.To = new Uri(amqpMessage.Properties.To.ToString());
					}
					if (amqpMessage.Properties.MessageId != null)
					{
						message.Headers.MessageId = new UniqueId(amqpMessage.Properties.MessageId.ToString());
					}
				}
				return message;
			}
		}

		private readonly InputQueue<IInputSessionChannel> availableChannels;

		private readonly string id;

		}

			availableChannels.EnqueueAndDispatch(item, null, canDispatchOnThisThread: false);
		}

	internal class AmqpTransportBindingElement : TransportBindingElement
	{
		public override string Scheme => "amqp";

		internal AmqpSettings AmqpSettings { get; set; }

		public AmqpTransportBindingElement()
		{
			AmqpTransportProvider item = new AmqpTransportProvider
			{
				Versions = 
				{
					new AmqpVersion(1, 0, 0)
				}
			};
			AmqpSettings = new AmqpSettings();
			AmqpSettings.TransportProviders.Add(item);
		}

		private AmqpTransportBindingElement(AmqpTransportBindingElement elementToBeCloned)
			: base(elementToBeCloned)
		{
			AmqpSettings = elementToBeCloned.AmqpSettings.Clone();
		}

		public override BindingElement Clone()
		{
			return new AmqpTransportBindingElement(this);
		}

		public override bool CanBuildChannelFactory<TChannel>(BindingContext context)
		{
			return typeof(TChannel) == typeof(IOutputChannel);
		}

		public override IChannelFactory<TChannel> BuildChannelFactory<TChannel>(BindingContext context)
		{
			if (context == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("context");
			}
			if (!CanBuildChannelFactory<TChannel>(context))
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.Argument("TChannel", SRClient.UnsupportedChannelType(typeof(TChannel)));
			}
			return (IChannelFactory<TChannel>)(object)new AmqpChannelFactory(this, context);
		}

		public override bool CanBuildChannelListener<TChannel>(BindingContext context)
		{
			return typeof(TChannel) == typeof(IInputSessionChannel);
		}

		public override IChannelListener<TChannel> BuildChannelListener<TChannel>(BindingContext context)
		{
			if (context == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("context");
			}
			if (!CanBuildChannelListener<TChannel>(context))
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.Argument("TChannel", SRClient.UnsupportedChannelType(typeof(TChannel)));
			}
			return (IChannelListener<TChannel>)(object)new AmqpChannelListener(this, context);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class FaultTolerantObject<T> : SingletonManager<T> where T : AmqpObject
	{
		private sealed class CreateAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<CreateAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly FaultTolerantObject<T> parent;

			private T innerObject;

			public T Object => innerObject;

			public CreateAsyncResult(FaultTolerantObject<T> parent, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(FaultTolerantObject<T>.CreateInstanceTimeout(timeout), callback, state)
			{
				this.parent = parent;
				Start();
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((CreateAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.parent.beginCreateObject(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(CreateAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					thisPtr.innerObject = thisPtr.parent.endCreateObject(r);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
				Exception ex = base.LastAsyncStepException;
				if (ex != null)
				{
					if (innerObject != null)
					{
						parent.disposeObject(innerObject);
					}
					Complete(ex);
				}
				else if (innerObject == null)
				{
					Complete(new InvalidOperationException($"Amqp InnerObject returns unexpected null value. Type:{typeof(T).Name}"));
				}
				else if (parent.owner.IsClosedOrClosing)
				{
					parent.disposeObject(innerObject);
				}
			}
		}

		private const int BufferredOperationTimeout = 20;

		private static readonly TimeSpan MinCreateInstanceTimeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(20.0);

		private readonly ICloseable owner;

		private readonly Func<TimeSpan, AsyncCallback, object, IAsyncResult> beginCreateObject;

		private readonly Func<IAsyncResult, T> endCreateObject;

		private readonly EventHandler onObjectClosed;

		private readonly Action<T> disposeObject;

		private T innerObject;

		public T UnsafeInnerObject => innerObject;

		public FaultTolerantObject(ICloseable owner, Action<T> disposeObject, Func<TimeSpan, AsyncCallback, object, IAsyncResult> beginCreateObject, Func<IAsyncResult, T> endCreateObject)
			: base(new object())
		{
			this.owner = owner;
			this.beginCreateObject = beginCreateObject;
			this.endCreateObject = endCreateObject;
			this.disposeObject = disposeObject;
			onObjectClosed = OnObjectClosed;
		}

		public bool TryGetOpenedObject(out T obj)
		{
			obj = null;
			if (innerObject != null && innerObject.State == AmqpObjectState.Opened)
			{
				obj = innerObject;
			}
			return obj != null;
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginGetOpenedObject(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			if (TryGetOpenedObject(out var obj))
			{
				return new CompletedAsyncResult<T>(obj, callback, state);
			}
			return BeginGetInstance(timeout, callback, state);
		}

		public T EndGetOpenedObject(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (result is CompletedAsyncResult<T>)
			{
				return CompletedAsyncResult<T>.End(result);
			}
			return EndGetInstance(result);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (innerObject != null)
			{
				return innerObject.ToString();
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			if (innerObject != null)
			{
				return innerObject.BeginClose(timeout, callback, state);
			}
			return new CompletedAsyncResult(callback, state);
		}

		public void EndClose(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (innerObject != null)
			{
				innerObject.EndClose(result);
			}
			else
			{
				CompletedAsyncResult.End(result);
			}
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginCreateInstance(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new CreateAsyncResult(this, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		protected override T OnEndCreateInstance(IAsyncResult asyncResult)
		{
			innerObject = AsyncResult<CreateAsyncResult>.End(asyncResult).Object;
			innerObject.Closed += onObjectClosed.Invoke;
			return innerObject;
		}

		protected override void OnGetInstance(T instance)
		{
			if (instance.State != AmqpObjectState.Opened)
			{
				Invalidate(instance);
			}
		}

		private static TimeSpan CreateInstanceTimeout(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			if (!(timeout < MinCreateInstanceTimeout))
			{
				return timeout;
			}
			return MinCreateInstanceTimeout;
		}

		private void OnObjectClosed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			T val = (T)sender;
			if (val.TerminalException != null)
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteChannelFaulted(sender.ToString());
			}
			disposeObject(val);
			Invalidate(val);
		}
	}
	internal interface IWork<TOutcome>
	{
		void Start();

		void Done(bool completedSynchronously, TOutcome outcome);

		void Cancel(bool completedSynchronously, Exception exception);
	}
	internal sealed class WorkCollection<TKey, TWork, TOutcome> where TWork : class, IWork<TOutcome>
	{
		private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<TKey, TWork> pendingWork;

		private volatile bool closed;

		public WorkCollection()
			: this((IEqualityComparer<TKey>)null)
		{
		}

		public WorkCollection(IEqualityComparer<TKey> comparer)
		{
			if (comparer == null)
			{
				pendingWork = new ConcurrentDictionary<TKey, TWork>();
			}
			else
			{
				pendingWork = new ConcurrentDictionary<TKey, TWork>(comparer);
			}
		}

		public void StartWork(TKey key, TWork work)
		{
			if (!pendingWork.TryAdd(key, work))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			if (closed)
			{
				if (pendingWork.TryRemove(key, out work))
				{
					work.Cancel(completedSynchronously: true, new OperationCanceledException());
				}
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				work.Start();
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				if (pendingWork.TryRemove(key, out work))
				{
					work.Cancel(completedSynchronously: true, exception);
				}
			}
		}

		public void CompleteWork(TKey key, bool syncComplete, TOutcome outcome)
		{
			if (!pendingWork.TryRemove(key, out var value))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (syncComplete)
			{
				value.Done(completedSynchronously: true, outcome);
				return;
			}
			ActionItem.Schedule(delegate(object o)
			{
				Tuple<TWork, TOutcome> tuple = (Tuple<TWork, TOutcome>)o;
				tuple.Item1.Done(completedSynchronously: false, tuple.Item2);
			}, new Tuple<TWork, TOutcome>(value, outcome));
		}

		public bool TryRemoveWork(TKey key, out TWork work)
		{
			return pendingWork.TryRemove(key, out work);
		}

		public void Abort()
		{
			closed = true;
			ActionItem.Schedule(delegate(object o)
			{
				WorkCollection<TKey, TWork, TOutcome> workCollection = (WorkCollection<TKey, TWork, TOutcome>)o;
				List<TKey> list = new List<TKey>(workCollection.pendingWork.Keys);
				foreach (TKey item in list)
				{
					if (workCollection.pendingWork.TryRemove(item, out var value))
					{
						value.Cancel(completedSynchronously: false, new OperationCanceledException());
					}
				}
			}, this);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class ActiveClientLink : ActiveClientLinkObject
	{
		private readonly AmqpLink link;

		public AmqpLink Link => link;

		public override AmqpConnection Connection => link.Session.Connection;

		public ActiveClientLink(AmqpLink link, string audience, string endpointUri, string[] requiredClaims, bool isClientToken, DateTime authorizationValidToUtc)
			: base(link, audience, endpointUri, requiredClaims, isClientToken, authorizationValidToUtc)
		{
			this.link = link;
		}
	}
	internal sealed class ActiveClientLinkManager
	{
		private static readonly TimeSpan SendTokenTimeout = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1.0);

		private static readonly TimeSpan TokenRefreshBuffer = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10.0);

		private static readonly Action<object> onLinkExpiration = OnLinkExpiration;

		private readonly IOThreadTimer validityTimer;

		private readonly AmqpMessagingFactory factory;

		private readonly object syncRoot;

		private ActiveClientLinkObject activeClientLink;

		public ActiveClientLinkManager(AmqpMessagingFactory factory)
		{
			this.factory = factory;
			validityTimer = new IOThreadTimer(onLinkExpiration, this, isTypicallyCanceledShortlyAfterBeingSet: false);
			syncRoot = new object();
		}

		public void SetActiveLink(ActiveClientLinkObject activeClientLink)
		{
			lock (syncRoot)
			{
				this.activeClientLink = activeClientLink;
				this.activeClientLink.LinkObject.Closed += OnLinkClosed;
				if (this.activeClientLink.LinkObject.State == AmqpObjectState.Opened && this.activeClientLink.IsClientToken)
				{
					ScheduleValidityTimer();
				}
			}
		}

		public void Close()
		{
			CancelValidityTimer();
		}

		private static void OnLinkExpiration(object state)
		{
			ActiveClientLinkManager thisPtr = (ActiveClientLinkManager)state;
			try
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpManageLink("BeginSendToken", thisPtr.activeClientLink.LinkObject, string.Empty);
				});
				AmqpCbsLink amqpCbsLink = thisPtr.activeClientLink.Connection.Extensions.Find<AmqpCbsLink>();
				if (amqpCbsLink == null)
				{
					amqpCbsLink = new AmqpCbsLink(thisPtr.activeClientLink.Connection);
				}
				amqpCbsLink.BeginSendToken(thisPtr.factory.ServiceBusSecuritySettings.TokenProvider, thisPtr.factory.Address, thisPtr.activeClientLink.Audience, thisPtr.activeClientLink.EndpointUri, thisPtr.activeClientLink.RequiredClaims, SendTokenTimeout, OnSendTokenComplete, thisPtr);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				Exception ex2 = ex;
				Exception exception = ex2;
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogError(thisPtr.activeClientLink.LinkObject, "BeginSendToken", exception.Message);
				});
			}
		}

		private static void OnSendTokenComplete(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			ActiveClientLinkManager thisPtr = (ActiveClientLinkManager)result.AsyncState;
			try
			{
				AmqpCbsLink amqpCbsLink = thisPtr.activeClientLink.Connection.Extensions.Find<AmqpCbsLink>();
				if (amqpCbsLink == null)
				{
					amqpCbsLink = new AmqpCbsLink(thisPtr.activeClientLink.Connection);
				}
				DateTime validTo = amqpCbsLink.EndSendToken(result);
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpManageLink("EndSendToken", thisPtr.activeClientLink.LinkObject, validTo.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
				});
				lock (thisPtr.syncRoot)
				{
					thisPtr.activeClientLink.AuthorizationValidToUtc = validTo;
					thisPtr.ScheduleValidityTimer();
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				Exception ex2 = ex;
				Exception exception = ex2;
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogError(thisPtr.activeClientLink.LinkObject, "EndSendToken", exception.Message);
				});
				thisPtr.CancelValidityTimer();
			}
		}

		private void ScheduleValidityTimer()
		{
			if (!(activeClientLink.AuthorizationValidToUtc < DateTime.UtcNow))
			{
				TimeSpan interval = activeClientLink.AuthorizationValidToUtc.Subtract(DateTime.UtcNow);
				interval += TokenRefreshBuffer;
				interval = ((interval < AmqpClientConstants.ClientMinimumTokenRefreshInterval) ? AmqpClientConstants.ClientMinimumTokenRefreshInterval : interval);
				validityTimer.Set(interval);
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.TraceClient(delegate
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpManageLink("SetTimer", activeClientLink.LinkObject, interval.ToString("c", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
				});
			}
		}

		private void OnLinkClosed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			activeClientLink.LinkObject.Closed -= OnLinkClosed;
			Close();
		}

		private void CancelValidityTimer()
		{
			validityTimer.Cancel();
		}

		internal void ForceRenewToken()
		{
			AmqpCbsLink amqpCbsLink = activeClientLink.Connection.Extensions.Find<AmqpCbsLink>();
			if (amqpCbsLink == null)
			{
				amqpCbsLink = new AmqpCbsLink(activeClientLink.Connection);
			}
			DateTime authorizationValidToUtc = amqpCbsLink.EndSendToken(amqpCbsLink.BeginSendToken(factory.ServiceBusSecuritySettings.TokenProvider, factory.Address, activeClientLink.Audience, activeClientLink.EndpointUri, activeClientLink.RequiredClaims, SendTokenTimeout, null, null));
			lock (syncRoot)
			{
				activeClientLink.AuthorizationValidToUtc = authorizationValidToUtc;
			}
		}
	}
	internal sealed class AmqpMessageReceiver : MessageReceiver
	{
		private abstract class ReceiveAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<ReceiveAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly AmqpMessageReceiver parent;

			private readonly bool shouldThrowTimeout;

			private ReceivingAmqpLink amqpLink;

			protected AmqpMessageReceiver Receiver => parent;

			protected ReceivingAmqpLink Link => amqpLink;

			protected IEnumerable<AmqpMessage> AmqpMessages { get; set; }

			protected ReceiveAsyncResult(AmqpMessageReceiver parent, bool shouldThrowTimeout, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.parent = parent;
				this.shouldThrowTimeout = shouldThrowTimeout;
			}

			protected abstract IAsyncResult BeginReceive(ReceivingAmqpLink link, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state);

			protected abstract IEnumerable<AmqpMessage> EndReceive(ReceivingAmqpLink link, IAsyncResult result);

			protected abstract bool ProcessMessage(IEnumerable<AmqpMessage> amqpMessages);

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				if (!parent.receiveLink.TryGetOpenedObject(out amqpLink))
				{
					Error linkTerminalError = parent.GetLinkTerminalError();
					if (linkTerminalError != null && ((parent.sessionReceiver && linkTerminalError.Condition.Equals(AmqpClientConstants.SessionLockLostError)) || linkTerminalError.Condition.Equals(AmqpErrorCode.Stolen)))
					{
						Complete(AmqpExceptionHelper.ToMessagingContract(linkTerminalError));
						yield break;
					}
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((ReceiveAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.parent.receiveLink.BeginGetInstance(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(ReceiveAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.amqpLink = thisPtr.parent.receiveLink.EndGetInstance(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
					if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
					{
						if (!shouldThrowTimeout && base.LastAsyncStepException is TimeoutException)
						{
							Complete(null);
						}
						else
						{
							Complete(AmqpExceptionHelper.GetClientException(base.LastAsyncStepException, parent.messagingFactory.RemoteContainerId));
						}
						yield break;
					}
				}
				bool flag = true;
				while (flag)
				{
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((ReceiveAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.BeginReceive(thisPtr.amqpLink, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(ReceiveAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.AmqpMessages = thisPtr.EndReceive(thisPtr.amqpLink, r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
					MessagingPerformanceCounters.SetMessageQueueInfo(Receiver.Address, Link.MessageQueueCount, Link.MessageQueueSize);
					if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
					{
						Complete(AmqpExceptionHelper.GetClientException(base.LastAsyncStepException, amqpLink.GetTrackingId()));
						break;
					}
					try
					{
						flag = false;
						if (AmqpMessages != null && AmqpMessages.Any())
						{
							flag = !ProcessMessage(AmqpMessages);
						}
					}
					catch (AmqpException ex)
					{
						if (AmqpExceptionHelper.IsAmqpError(ex, AmqpErrorCode.InvalidField, AmqpErrorCode.DecodeError))
						{
							Complete(new SerializationException(SRClient.AmqpMessageDecodeFailure(amqpLink.GetTrackingId(), ex.Error.Condition, ex.Error.Description)));
						}
						else
						{
							Complete(AmqpExceptionHelper.ToMessagingContract(ex.Error));
						}
						break;
					}
					if (RemainingTime() <= TimeSpan.Zero)
					{
						flag = false;
						if (shouldThrowTimeout)
						{
							Complete(new TimeoutException(SRCore.TimeoutOnOperation(base.OriginalTimeout)));
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private sealed class ReceiveMessageAsyncResult : ReceiveAsyncResult
		{
			private readonly int messageCount;

			private IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages;

			public ReceiveMessageAsyncResult(AmqpMessageReceiver parent, int messageCount, bool shouldThrowTimeout, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(parent, shouldThrowTimeout, timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.messageCount = messageCount;
				Start();
			}

			public static bool End(IAsyncResult result, out IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages)
			{
				ReceiveMessageAsyncResult receiveMessageAsyncResult = Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult.End<ReceiveMessageAsyncResult>(result);
				messages = receiveMessageAsyncResult.messages;
				return messages != null;
			}

			protected override IAsyncResult BeginReceive(ReceivingAmqpLink link, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{
				return link.BeginReceiveRemoteMessages(messageCount, base.Receiver.BatchFlushInterval, timeout, callback, state);
			}

			protected override IEnumerable<AmqpMessage> EndReceive(ReceivingAmqpLink link, IAsyncResult result)
			{
				link.EndReceiveMessages(result, out var result2);
				return result2;
			}

			protected override bool ProcessMessage(IEnumerable<AmqpMessage> messages)
			{
				List<BrokeredMessage> list = new List<BrokeredMessage>();
				foreach (AmqpMessage message in messages)
				{
					BrokeredMessage brokeredMessage = AmqpMessageConverter.ClientGetMessage(message);
					if (base.Receiver.Mode == ReceiveMode.PeekLock && brokeredMessage.IsLockTokenSet && brokeredMessage.LockedUntilUtc <= DateTime.UtcNow)
					{
						base.Link.ReleaseMessage(message);
						if (base.Receiver.PrefetchCount == 0)
						{
							brokeredMessage.Dispose();
							return false;
						}
					}
					if (base.Receiver.Mode == ReceiveMode.ReceiveAndDelete)
					{
						brokeredMessage.LockToken = Guid.Empty;
						base.Link.DisposeDelivery(message, settled: true, AmqpConstants.AcceptedOutcome);
					}
					else if (base.Receiver.Mode == ReceiveMode.PeekLock && !brokeredMessage.IsLockTokenSet)
					{
						brokeredMessage.LockToken = Guid.NewGuid();
						base.Receiver.lockedMessages.TryAdd(brokeredMessage.LockToken, message.DeliveryTag);
					}
					list.Add(brokeredMessage);
				}
				this.messages = list.ToArray();
				return true;
			}
		}

		private sealed class ReceiveEventAsyncResult : ReceiveAsyncResult
		{
			private readonly int maxCount;

			public ReceiveEventAsyncResult(AmqpMessageReceiver parent, int maxCount, bool shouldThrowTimeout, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(parent, shouldThrowTimeout, timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.maxCount = maxCount;
				Start();
			}

			public static bool End(IAsyncResult result, out IEnumerable<AmqpMessage> messages)
			{
				ReceiveEventAsyncResult receiveEventAsyncResult = Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult.End<ReceiveEventAsyncResult>(result);
				messages = receiveEventAsyncResult.AmqpMessages;
				return receiveEventAsyncResult.AmqpMessages != null;
			}

			protected override IAsyncResult BeginReceive(ReceivingAmqpLink link, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{
				Fx.AssertAndThrow(maxCount > 0, "we should not have maxCount = 0");
				return link.BeginReceiveMessages(maxCount, timeout, callback, state);
			}

			protected override IEnumerable<AmqpMessage> EndReceive(ReceivingAmqpLink link, IAsyncResult result)
			{
				link.EndReceiveMessages(result, out var messages);
				return messages;
			}

			protected override bool ProcessMessage(IEnumerable<AmqpMessage> messages)
			{
				if (base.Receiver.Mode != ReceiveMode.PeekLock)
				{
					foreach (AmqpMessage message in messages)
					{
						base.Link.DisposeDelivery(message, settled: true, AmqpConstants.AcceptedOutcome);
					}
				}
				foreach (AmqpMessage message2 in messages)
				{
					message2.Initialize(SectionFlag.All);
					MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementEntityEgressRate(base.Receiver.Address, message2.SerializedMessageSize);
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private abstract class DisposeAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<DisposeAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly AmqpMessageReceiver parent;

			private readonly System.Transactions.Transaction transaction;

			private readonly Outcome outcome;

			private readonly bool batchable;

			private ReceivingAmqpLink amqpLink;

			private IList<ArraySegment<byte>> deliveryTags;

			private ConcurrentBag<Outcome> disposeOutcomes;

			private ArraySegment<byte> transactionId;

			protected AmqpMessageReceiver Receiver => parent;

			protected DisposeAsyncResult(AmqpMessageReceiver parent, Outcome outcome, bool batchable, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.parent = parent;
				transaction = System.Transactions.Transaction.Current;
				this.outcome = outcome;
				this.batchable = batchable;
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				deliveryTags = PopulateDeliveryTags();
				if (!parent.receiveLink.TryGetOpenedObject(out amqpLink))
				{
					Error sessionLockLostError = parent.GetSessionLockLostError();
					if (sessionLockLostError != null)
					{
						Complete(AmqpExceptionHelper.ToMessagingContract(sessionLockLostError));
						yield break;
					}
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((DisposeAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.parent.receiveLink.BeginGetInstance(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(DisposeAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.amqpLink = thisPtr.parent.receiveLink.EndGetInstance(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
					if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
					{
						base.LastAsyncStepException = ProcessException(AmqpExceptionHelper.GetClientException(base.LastAsyncStepException, parent.messagingFactory.RemoteContainerId));
						Complete(base.LastAsyncStepException);
						yield break;
					}
				}
				disposeOutcomes = new ConcurrentBag<Outcome>();
				if (transaction != null)
				{
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((DisposeAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.parent.messagingFactory.TransactionManager.BeginEnlist(thisPtr.transaction, thisPtr.parent.messagingFactory, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(DisposeAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.transactionId = thisPtr.parent.messagingFactory.TransactionManager.EndEnlist(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
					yield return CallParallelAsync<ArraySegment<byte>>((ICollection<ArraySegment<byte>>)deliveryTags, (BeginCall<ArraySegment<byte>>)((DisposeAsyncResult thisPtr, ArraySegment<byte> deliveryTag, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.amqpLink.BeginDisposeMessage(deliveryTag, thisPtr.transactionId, thisPtr.outcome, thisPtr.batchable, t, c, s)), (EndCall<ArraySegment<byte>>)delegate(DisposeAsyncResult thisPtr, ArraySegment<byte> deliveryTag, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.disposeOutcomes.Add(thisPtr.amqpLink.EndDisposeMessage(r));
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
				}
				else
				{
					yield return CallParallelAsync<ArraySegment<byte>>((ICollection<ArraySegment<byte>>)deliveryTags, (BeginCall<ArraySegment<byte>>)((DisposeAsyncResult thisPtr, ArraySegment<byte> deliveryTag, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.amqpLink.BeginDisposeMessage(deliveryTag, thisPtr.outcome, thisPtr.batchable, t, c, s)), (EndCall<ArraySegment<byte>>)delegate(DisposeAsyncResult thisPtr, ArraySegment<byte> deliveryTag, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.disposeOutcomes.Add(thisPtr.amqpLink.EndDisposeMessage(r));
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
				}
				if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
				{
					if (base.LastAsyncStepException is OperationCanceledException && amqpLink.State != AmqpObjectState.Opened)
					{
						if (parent.sessionReceiver)
						{
							Error sessionLockLostError2 = parent.GetSessionLockLostError();
							base.LastAsyncStepException = ((sessionLockLostError2 != null) ? AmqpExceptionHelper.ToMessagingContract(sessionLockLostError2) : new SessionLockLostException(SRClient.SessionLockExpiredOnMessageSession, base.LastAsyncStepException));
						}
						else
						{
							base.LastAsyncStepException = new MessageLockLostException(SRClient.MessageLockLost, base.LastAsyncStepException);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						base.LastAsyncStepException = AmqpExceptionHelper.GetClientException(base.LastAsyncStepException, amqpLink.GetTrackingId());
					}
					Complete(ProcessException(base.LastAsyncStepException));
					yield break;
				}
				Error error = null;
				Outcome outcome = disposeOutcomes.FirstOrDefault((Outcome o) => o.DescriptorCode == Rejected.Code && (error = ((Rejected)o).Error) != null);
				if (outcome == null)
				{
					yield break;
				}
				if (error.Condition.Equals(AmqpErrorCode.NotFound))
				{
					if (IsDisposeWithoutSideEffect())
					{
						base.LastAsyncStepException = null;
					}
					else if (parent.sessionReceiver)
					{
						base.LastAsyncStepException = new SessionLockLostException(SRClient.SessionLockExpiredOnMessageSession);
					}
					else
					{
						base.LastAsyncStepException = new MessageLockLostException(SRClient.MessageLockLost);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					base.LastAsyncStepException = AmqpExceptionHelper.ToMessagingContract(error);
				}
				Complete(ProcessException(base.LastAsyncStepException));
			}

			protected abstract IList<ArraySegment<byte>> PopulateDeliveryTags();

			protected virtual Exception ProcessException(Exception exception)
			{
				return exception;
			}

			private bool IsDisposeWithoutSideEffect()
			{
				if (outcome.DescriptorCode == Released.Code)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (outcome is Modified { UndeliverableHere: null } modified)
				{
					return modified.MessageAnnotations == null;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private sealed class DisposeMessageAsyncResult : DisposeAsyncResult
		{
			private readonly IEnumerable<Guid> lockTokens;

			public DisposeMessageAsyncResult(AmqpMessageReceiver parent, IEnumerable<Guid> lockTokens, Outcome outcome, bool batchable, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(parent, outcome, batchable, timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.lockTokens = lockTokens;
				Fx.AssertIsNotNull(this.lockTokens, "lockToken collection should not be null");
				Start();
			}

			protected override IList<ArraySegment<byte>> PopulateDeliveryTags()
			{
				IList<ArraySegment<byte>> list = new List<ArraySegment<byte>>();
				foreach (Guid lockToken in lockTokens)
				{
					if (!base.Receiver.lockedMessages.TryRemove(lockToken, out var value))
					{
						value = new ArraySegment<byte>(lockToken.ToByteArray());
					}
					list.Add(value);
				}
				return list;
			}

			private Guid CheckAndGetLockToken(IEnumerable<Guid> lockTokens)
			{
				Guid guid = Guid.Empty;
				foreach (Guid lockToken in lockTokens)
				{
					if (guid != Guid.Empty)
					{
						throw new NotSupportedException(SRClient.FeatureNotSupported("CompleteBatch"));
					}
					guid = lockToken;
				}
				return guid;
			}
		}

		private sealed class DisposeEventAsyncResult : DisposeAsyncResult
		{
			private readonly IEnumerable<ArraySegment<byte>> deliveryTags;

			public DisposeEventAsyncResult(AmqpMessageReceiver parent, IEnumerable<ArraySegment<byte>> deliveryTags, Outcome outcome, bool batchable, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(parent, outcome, batchable, timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.deliveryTags = deliveryTags;
				Fx.AssertIsNotNull(this.deliveryTags, "offsets collection should not be null");
				Start();
			}

			protected override IList<ArraySegment<byte>> PopulateDeliveryTags()
			{
				return new ArraySegment<byte>[1] { deliveryTags.Last() };
			}

			protected override Exception ProcessException(Exception exception)
			{
				Exception ex = base.ProcessException(exception);
				if (ex != null && ex is MessageLockLostException)
				{
					ex = null;
				}
				return ex;
			}
		}

		private sealed class RenewLockAsyncResult : AmqpReceiverRequestAsyncResult
		{
			private readonly AmqpMessageReceiver parent;

			private readonly TrackingContext trackingContext;

			private readonly IEnumerable<Guid> lockTokens;

			public IEnumerable<DateTime> Expirations { get; private set; }

			public RenewLockAsyncResult(AmqpMessageReceiver parent, TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<Guid> lockTokens, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(parent, timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.parent = parent;
				this.trackingContext = trackingContext;
				this.lockTokens = lockTokens;
				Start();
			}

			protected override AmqpMessage CreateRequestMessage()
			{
				AmqpRequestMessage amqpRequestMessage = AmqpRequestMessage.CreateRequest("com.microsoft:renew-lock", RemainingTime(), trackingContext.TrackingId);
				amqpRequestMessage.Map[ManagementConstants.Properties.LockTokens] = lockTokens.ToArray();
				if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(parent.SessionId))
				{
					amqpRequestMessage.Map[ManagementConstants.Properties.SessionId] = parent.SessionId;
				}
				if (parent.receiveLink.TryGetOpenedObject(out var obj))
				{
					amqpRequestMessage.RequestMessage.ApplicationProperties.Map["associated-link-name"] = obj.Name;
				}
				return amqpRequestMessage.RequestMessage;
			}

			protected override void ProcessResponseMessage(AmqpMessage responseMessage)
			{
				AmqpResponseMessage amqpResponseMessage = AmqpResponseMessage.CreateResponse(responseMessage);
				if (amqpResponseMessage.StatusCode == AmqpResponseStatusCode.OK)
				{
					Expirations = amqpResponseMessage.GetValue<DateTime[]>(ManagementConstants.Properties.Expirations);
				}
				else
				{
					Complete(amqpResponseMessage.ToMessagingContractException());
				}
			}

			public new static IEnumerable<DateTime> End(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				RenewLockAsyncResult renewLockAsyncResult = (RenewLockAsyncResult)result;
				AsyncResult<AmqpReceiverRequestAsyncResult>.End(result);
				return renewLockAsyncResult.Expirations;
			}
		}

		private sealed class ReceiveBySequenceNumberAsyncResult : AmqpReceiverRequestAsyncResult
		{
			private readonly AmqpMessageReceiver parent;

			private readonly TrackingContext trackingContext;

			private readonly IEnumerable<long> sequenceNumbers;

			public IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> Messages { get; private set; }

			public ReceiveBySequenceNumberAsyncResult(AmqpMessageReceiver parent, TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<long> sequenceNumbers, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(parent, timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.parent = parent;
				this.trackingContext = trackingContext;
				this.sequenceNumbers = sequenceNumbers;
				Start();
			}

			protected override AmqpMessage CreateRequestMessage()
			{
				AmqpRequestMessage amqpRequestMessage = AmqpRequestMessage.CreateRequest("com.microsoft:receive-by-sequence-number", RemainingTime(), trackingContext.TrackingId);
				amqpRequestMessage.Map[ManagementConstants.Properties.SequenceNumbers] = sequenceNumbers.ToArray();
				amqpRequestMessage.Map[ManagementConstants.Properties.ReceiverSettleMode] = ((parent.Mode != ReceiveMode.ReceiveAndDelete) ? 1u : 0u);
				if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(parent.SessionId))
				{
					amqpRequestMessage.Map[ManagementConstants.Properties.SessionId] = parent.SessionId;
				}
				if (parent.receiveLink.TryGetOpenedObject(out var obj))
				{
					amqpRequestMessage.RequestMessage.ApplicationProperties.Map["associated-link-name"] = obj.Name;
				}
				return amqpRequestMessage.RequestMessage;
			}

			protected override void ProcessResponseMessage(AmqpMessage responseMessage)
			{
				AmqpResponseMessage amqpResponseMessage = AmqpResponseMessage.CreateResponse(responseMessage);
				if (amqpResponseMessage.StatusCode == AmqpResponseStatusCode.OK)
				{
					IEnumerable<AmqpMap> listValue = amqpResponseMessage.GetListValue<AmqpMap>(ManagementConstants.Properties.Messages);
					List<BrokeredMessage> list = new List<BrokeredMessage>();
					foreach (AmqpMap item in listValue)
					{
						ArraySegment<byte> arraySegment = (ArraySegment<byte>)item[ManagementConstants.Properties.Message];
						AmqpMessage amqpMessage = AmqpMessage.CreateBufferMessage(new ByteBuffer(arraySegment.Array, arraySegment.Offset, arraySegment.Count));
						BrokeredMessage brokeredMessage = AmqpMessageConverter.ClientGetMessage(amqpMessage);
						if (((IDictionary<object, object>)item).TryGetValue((object)ManagementConstants.Properties.LockToken, out Guid value))
						{
							brokeredMessage.LockToken = value;
							parent.requestResponseLockedMessages.AddOrUpdate(brokeredMessage.LockToken, brokeredMessage.LockedUntilUtc);
						}
						list.Add(brokeredMessage);
					}
					Messages = list;
				}
				else
				{
					Complete(amqpResponseMessage.ToMessagingContractException());
				}
			}

			public static bool End(IAsyncResult result, out IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages)
			{
				ReceiveBySequenceNumberAsyncResult receiveBySequenceNumberAsyncResult = (ReceiveBySequenceNumberAsyncResult)result;
				AsyncResult<AmqpReceiverRequestAsyncResult>.End(result);
				messages = receiveBySequenceNumberAsyncResult.Messages;
				if (receiveBySequenceNumberAsyncResult.Messages != null)
				{
					return receiveBySequenceNumberAsyncResult.Messages.Any();
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private sealed class DisposeMessageRequestResponseAsyncResult : AmqpReceiverRequestAsyncResult
		{
			private readonly AmqpMessageReceiver parent;

			private readonly TrackingContext trackingContext;

			private readonly DispositionStatus dispositionStatus;

			private readonly IEnumerable<Guid> lockTokens;

			private readonly string deadLetterReason;

			private readonly string deadLetterDescription;

			private readonly IDictionary<string, object> propertiesToModify;

			public DisposeMessageRequestResponseAsyncResult(AmqpMessageReceiver parent, TrackingContext trackingContext, DispositionStatus dispositionStatus, IEnumerable<Guid> lockTokens, string deadLetterReason, string deadLetterDescription, IDictionary<string, object> propertiesToModify, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(parent, timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.parent = parent;
				this.trackingContext = trackingContext;
				this.dispositionStatus = dispositionStatus;
				this.lockTokens = lockTokens;
				this.deadLetterReason = deadLetterReason;
				this.deadLetterDescription = deadLetterDescription;
				this.propertiesToModify = propertiesToModify;
				Start();
			}

			protected override AmqpMessage CreateRequestMessage()
			{
				AmqpRequestMessage amqpRequestMessage = AmqpRequestMessage.CreateRequest("com.microsoft:update-disposition", RemainingTime(), trackingContext.TrackingId);
				amqpRequestMessage.Map[ManagementConstants.Properties.LockTokens] = lockTokens.ToArray();
				amqpRequestMessage.Map[ManagementConstants.Properties.DispositionStatus] = dispositionStatus.ToString().ToLowerInvariant();
				if (deadLetterReason != null)
				{
					amqpRequestMessage.Map[ManagementConstants.Properties.DeadLetterReason] = deadLetterReason;
				}
				if (deadLetterDescription != null)
				{
					amqpRequestMessage.Map[ManagementConstants.Properties.DeadLetterDescription] = deadLetterDescription;
				}
				if (propertiesToModify != null)
				{
					AmqpMap amqpMap = new AmqpMap();
					foreach (KeyValuePair<string, object> item in propertiesToModify)
					{
						if (AmqpMessageConverter.TryGetAmqpObjectFromNetObject(item.Value, MappingType.ApplicationProperty, out var amqpObject))
						{
							amqpMap[item.Key] = amqpObject;
						}
					}
					if (amqpMap.Count > 0)
					{
						amqpRequestMessage.Map[ManagementConstants.Properties.PropertiesToModify] = amqpMap;
					}
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(parent.SessionId))
				{
					amqpRequestMessage.Map[ManagementConstants.Properties.SessionId] = parent.SessionId;
				}
				if (parent.receiveLink.TryGetOpenedObject(out var obj))
				{
					amqpRequestMessage.RequestMessage.ApplicationProperties.Map["associated-link-name"] = obj.Name;
				}
				return amqpRequestMessage.RequestMessage;
			}

			protected override void ProcessResponseMessage(AmqpMessage responseMessage)
			{
				AmqpResponseMessage amqpResponseMessage = AmqpResponseMessage.CreateResponse(responseMessage);
				if (amqpResponseMessage.StatusCode != AmqpResponseStatusCode.OK)
				{
					Complete(amqpResponseMessage.ToMessagingContractException());
				}
			}
		}

		private sealed class PeekAsyncResult : AmqpReceiverRequestAsyncResult
		{
			private readonly AmqpMessageReceiver parent;

			private readonly TrackingContext trackingContext;
