			private readonly long fromSequenceNumber;

			private readonly int messageCount;

			private readonly string sessionId;

			public IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> Messages { get; private set; }

			public PeekAsyncResult(AmqpMessageReceiver parent, TrackingContext trackingContext, long fromSequenceNumber, int messageCount, string sessionId, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(parent, timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.parent = parent;
				this.trackingContext = trackingContext;
				this.fromSequenceNumber = fromSequenceNumber;
				this.messageCount = messageCount;
				this.sessionId = sessionId;
				Start();
			}

			protected override AmqpMessage CreateRequestMessage()
			{
				AmqpRequestMessage amqpRequestMessage = AmqpRequestMessage.CreateRequest("com.microsoft:peek-message", RemainingTime(), trackingContext.TrackingId);
				amqpRequestMessage.Map[ManagementConstants.Properties.FromSequenceNumber] = fromSequenceNumber;
				amqpRequestMessage.Map[ManagementConstants.Properties.MessageCount] = messageCount;
				if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(sessionId))
				{
					amqpRequestMessage.Map[ManagementConstants.Properties.SessionId] = sessionId;
				}
				if (parent.receiveLink.TryGetOpenedObject(out var obj))
				{
					amqpRequestMessage.RequestMessage.ApplicationProperties.Map["associated-link-name"] = obj.Name;
				}
				return amqpRequestMessage.RequestMessage;
			}

			protected override void ProcessResponseMessage(AmqpMessage responseMessage)
			{
				AmqpResponseMessage amqpResponseMessage = AmqpResponseMessage.CreateResponse(responseMessage);
				if (amqpResponseMessage.StatusCode == AmqpResponseStatusCode.OK)
				{
					IEnumerable<AmqpMap> listValue = amqpResponseMessage.GetListValue<AmqpMap>(ManagementConstants.Properties.Messages);
					List<BrokeredMessage> list = new List<BrokeredMessage>();
					foreach (AmqpMap item2 in listValue)
					{
						ArraySegment<byte> arraySegment = (ArraySegment<byte>)item2[ManagementConstants.Properties.Message];
						AmqpMessage amqpMessage = AmqpMessage.CreateBufferMessage(new ByteBuffer(arraySegment.Array, arraySegment.Offset, arraySegment.Count));
						BrokeredMessage item = AmqpMessageConverter.ClientGetMessage(amqpMessage);
						list.Add(item);
					}
					Messages = list;
				}
				else if (amqpResponseMessage.StatusCode == AmqpResponseStatusCode.NoContent || (amqpResponseMessage.StatusCode == AmqpResponseStatusCode.NotFound && object.Equals(AmqpClientConstants.MessageNotFoundError, amqpResponseMessage.GetResponseErrorCondition())))
				{
					Messages = new List<BrokeredMessage>();
				}
				else
				{
					Complete(amqpResponseMessage.ToMessagingContractException());
				}
			}

			public new static IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> End(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				PeekAsyncResult peekAsyncResult = (PeekAsyncResult)result;
				AsyncResult<AmqpReceiverRequestAsyncResult>.End(result);
				return peekAsyncResult.Messages ?? new List<BrokeredMessage>();
			}
		}

		private static readonly string[] RequiredClaims = new string[1] { "Listen" };

		private readonly AmqpMessagingFactory messagingFactory;

		private readonly bool sessionReceiver;

		private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<Guid, ArraySegment<byte>> lockedMessages;

		private readonly ConcurrentExpiringSet<Guid> requestResponseLockedMessages;

		private readonly ActiveClientLinkManager clientLinkManager;

		private readonly ActiveClientLinkManager requestResponseLinkManager;

		private readonly FaultTolerantObject<ReceivingAmqpLink> receiveLink;

		private readonly FaultTolerantObject<RequestResponseAmqpLink> requestResponseLink;

		private readonly bool browsable;

		private string sessionId;

		private DateTime lockedUntilUtc;

		private TimeSpan batchFlushInterval;

		public string SessionId => sessionId;

		public DateTime LockedUntilUtc => lockedUntilUtc;

		public override TimeSpan BatchFlushInterval
		{
			get
			{
				return batchFlushInterval;
			}
			internal set
			{
				ThrowIfDisposedOrImmutable();
				batchFlushInterval = value;
			}
		}

		public override int PrefetchCount
		{
			get
			{
				return base.PrefetchCount;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != base.PrefetchCount)
				{
					ReceivingAmqpLink unsafeInnerObject = receiveLink.UnsafeInnerObject;
					if (value != 0)
					{
						base.PrefetchEventSizeInBytes = null;
						unsafeInnerObject?.SetCacheSizeInBytes(null);
					}
					base.PrefetchCount = value;
					unsafeInnerObject?.SetTotalLinkCredit((uint)value, applyNow: true, updateAutoFlow: true);
				}
			}
		}

		internal override long? PrefetchEventSizeInBytes
		{
			get
			{
				return base.PrefetchEventSizeInBytes;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != base.PrefetchEventSizeInBytes)
				{
					ReceivingAmqpLink unsafeInnerObject = receiveLink.UnsafeInnerObject;
					if (value.HasValue)
					{
						base.PrefetchCount = 0;
						unsafeInnerObject?.SetTotalLinkCredit(0u, applyNow: true, updateAutoFlow: true);
					}
					base.PrefetchEventSizeInBytes = value;
					unsafeInnerObject?.SetCacheSizeInBytes(value);
				}
			}
		}

		internal FaultTolerantObject<ReceivingAmqpLink> ReceiveLink => receiveLink;

		internal FaultTolerantObject<RequestResponseAmqpLink> RequestResponseLink => requestResponseLink;

		internal bool SessionReceiver => sessionReceiver;

		protected internal override bool SupportsGetRuntimeEntityDescription => true;

		private AmqpMessageReceiver(AmqpMessagingFactory messagingFactory, string entityName, MessagingEntityType? entityType, string sessionId, bool sessionReceiver, RetryPolicy retryPolicy, ReceiveMode receiveMode, Filter filter, int prefetchCount, bool browsable)
			: base(messagingFactory, entityName, entityType, retryPolicy, receiveMode, filter)
		{
			receiveLink = new FaultTolerantObject<ReceivingAmqpLink>(this, CloseLink, BeginCreateLink, EndCreateLink);
			requestResponseLink = new FaultTolerantObject<RequestResponseAmqpLink>(this, CloseRequestResponseLink, BeginCreateRequestResponseLink, EndCreateRequestResponseLink);
			this.messagingFactory = messagingFactory;
			this.sessionId = sessionId;
			this.sessionReceiver = sessionReceiver;
			PrefetchCount = prefetchCount;
			lockedMessages = new ConcurrentDictionary<Guid, ArraySegment<byte>>();
			requestResponseLockedMessages = new ConcurrentExpiringSet<Guid>();
			clientLinkManager = new ActiveClientLinkManager(this.messagingFactory);
			requestResponseLinkManager = new ActiveClientLinkManager(this.messagingFactory);
			batchFlushInterval = this.messagingFactory.TransportSettings.BatchFlushInterval;
			this.browsable = browsable;
		}

		public AmqpMessageReceiver(AmqpMessagingFactory messagingFactory, string entityName, MessagingEntityType? entityType, RetryPolicy retryPolicy, ReceiveMode receiveMode, int prefetchCount)
			: this(messagingFactory, entityName, entityType, null, sessionReceiver: false, retryPolicy, receiveMode, null, prefetchCount, browsable: false)
		{
		}

		public AmqpMessageReceiver(AmqpMessagingFactory messagingFactory, string entityName, MessagingEntityType? entityType, RetryPolicy retryPolicy, ReceiveMode receiveMode, Filter filter, int prefetchCount)
			: this(messagingFactory, entityName, entityType, null, sessionReceiver: false, retryPolicy, receiveMode, filter, prefetchCount, browsable: false)
		{
		}

		public AmqpMessageReceiver(AmqpMessagingFactory messagingFactory, string entityName, MessagingEntityType? entityType, string sessionId, RetryPolicy retryPolicy, ReceiveMode receiveMode, int prefetchCount, bool browsable)
			: this(messagingFactory, entityName, entityType, sessionId, sessionReceiver: true, retryPolicy, receiveMode, null, prefetchCount, browsable)
		{
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginOpen(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return receiveLink.BeginGetInstance(timeout, callback, state);
		}

		protected override void OnEndOpen(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			ReceivingAmqpLink receivingAmqpLink = receiveLink.EndGetInstance(result);
			base.Mode = ((receivingAmqpLink.Settings.SettleType != SettleMode.SettleOnDispose) ? ReceiveMode.ReceiveAndDelete : ReceiveMode.PeekLock);
			if (sessionReceiver)
			{
				Source source = (Source)receivingAmqpLink.Settings.Source;
				if (!source.FilterSet.TryGetValue<string>(AmqpClientConstants.SessionFilterName, out sessionId))
				{
					receivingAmqpLink.Session.SafeClose();
					throw new MessagingException(SRAmqp.AmqpFieldSessionId);
				}
				lockedUntilUtc = (((RestrictedMap<AmqpSymbol>)receivingAmqpLink.Settings.Properties).TryGetValue((AmqpSymbol)"com.microsoft:locked-until-utc", out long value) ? new DateTime(value, DateTimeKind.Utc) : DateTime.MinValue);
			}
			MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementEntityCount(base.Address, 1);
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			ReceivingAmqpLink obj = null;
			if (receiveLink.TryGetOpenedObject(out obj))
			{
				return messagingFactory.BeginCloseEntity(obj, timeout, callback, state);
			}
			return new CompletedAsyncResult(callback, state);
		}

		protected override void OnEndClose(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (result is CompletedAsyncResult)
			{
				CompletedAsyncResult.End(result);
			}
			else
			{
				messagingFactory.EndCloseEntity(result);
			}
			clientLinkManager.Close();
			requestResponseLinkManager.Close();
			MessagingPerformanceCounters.DecrementEntityCount(base.Address, 1);
		}

		protected override void OnClosed()
		{
			CloseRequestResponseLink();
			base.OnClosed();
		}

		protected override void OnFaulted()
		{
			CloseRequestResponseLink();
			base.OnFaulted();
		}

		protected override void OnAbort()
		{
			ReceivingAmqpLink obj = null;
			MessagingPerformanceCounters.DecrementEntityCount(base.Address, 1);
			if (receiveLink.TryGetOpenedObject(out obj))
			{
				CloseLink(obj);
			}
			CloseRequestResponseLink();
			requestResponseLinkManager.Close();
			clientLinkManager.Close();
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginTryReceiveEventData(TrackingContext trackingContext, int messageCount, TimeSpan serverWaitTime, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			Fx.AssertAndThrow(messageCount > 0, "messageCount needs to be at least 1");
			return new ReceiveEventAsyncResult(this, messageCount, shouldThrowTimeout: false, serverWaitTime, callback, state);
		}

		protected override bool OnEndTryReceiveEventData(IAsyncResult result, out IEnumerable<EventData> messages)
		{
			List<EventData> list = new List<EventData>();
			if (ReceiveEventAsyncResult.End(result, out var messages2))
			{
				list.AddRange(messages2.Select((AmqpMessage amqpMessage) => new EventData(amqpMessage, ownMessage: true)));
			}
			messages = list;
			return list.Count > 0;
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginTryReceive(TrackingContext trackingContext, int messageCount, TimeSpan serverWaitTime, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new ReceiveMessageAsyncResult(this, messageCount, shouldThrowTimeout: false, serverWaitTime, callback, state);
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginTryReceive(TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<long> receipts, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new ReceiveBySequenceNumberAsyncResult(this, trackingContext, receipts, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		protected override bool OnEndTryReceive(IAsyncResult result, out IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages)
		{
			bool result2 = ((result is ReceiveBySequenceNumberAsyncResult) ? ReceiveBySequenceNumberAsyncResult.End(result, out messages) : ReceiveMessageAsyncResult.End(result, out messages));
			if (messages == null)
			{
				messages = new BrokeredMessage[0];
			}
			return result2;
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginTryReceive2(TrackingContext trackingContext, int messageCount, TimeSpan serverWaitTime, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new ReceiveMessageAsyncResult(this, messageCount, shouldThrowTimeout: true, serverWaitTime, callback, state);
		}

		protected override bool OnEndTryReceive2(IAsyncResult result, out IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages)
		{
			if (!(result is ReceiveBySequenceNumberAsyncResult))
			{
				return ReceiveMessageAsyncResult.End(result, out messages);
			}
			return ReceiveBySequenceNumberAsyncResult.End(result, out messages);
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginComplete(TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<Guid> lockTokens, bool fromSync, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			if (lockTokens.Any((Guid lt) => requestResponseLockedMessages.Contains(lt)))
			{
				return new DisposeMessageRequestResponseAsyncResult(this, trackingContext, DispositionStatus.Completed, lockTokens, null, null, null, timeout, callback, state);
			}
			return BeginDisposeMessages(lockTokens, AmqpConstants.AcceptedOutcome, !fromSync, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginComplete(TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<ArraySegment<byte>> deliveryTags, bool fromSync, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return BeginDisposeEvents(deliveryTags, AmqpConstants.AcceptedOutcome, !fromSync, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		protected override void OnEndComplete(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (result is DisposeMessageRequestResponseAsyncResult)
			{
				AsyncResult<AmqpReceiverRequestAsyncResult>.End(result);
			}
			else if (result is DisposeEventAsyncResult)
			{
				EndDisposeEvents(result);
			}
			else
			{
				EndDisposeMessages(result);
			}
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginPeek(TrackingContext trackingContext, long fromSequenceNumber, int messageCount, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new PeekAsyncResult(this, trackingContext, fromSequenceNumber, messageCount, SessionId, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> OnEndPeek(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			return PeekAsyncResult.End(result);
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginAbandon(TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<Guid> lockTokens, IDictionary<string, object> propertiesToModify, bool fromSync, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			if (lockTokens.Any((Guid lt) => requestResponseLockedMessages.Contains(lt)))
			{
				return new DisposeMessageRequestResponseAsyncResult(this, trackingContext, DispositionStatus.Abandoned, lockTokens, null, null, propertiesToModify, timeout, callback, state);
			}
			return BeginDisposeMessages(lockTokens, GetAbandonOutcome(unlockOnly: false, propertiesToModify), !fromSync, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		protected override void OnEndAbandon(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (result is DisposeMessageRequestResponseAsyncResult)
			{
				AsyncResult<AmqpReceiverRequestAsyncResult>.End(result);
			}
			else
			{
				EndDisposeMessages(result);
			}
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginDefer(TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<Guid> lockTokens, IDictionary<string, object> propertiesToModify, bool fromSync, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			if (lockTokens.Any((Guid lt) => requestResponseLockedMessages.Contains(lt)))
			{
				return new DisposeMessageRequestResponseAsyncResult(this, trackingContext, DispositionStatus.Defered, lockTokens, null, null, propertiesToModify, timeout, callback, state);
			}
			return BeginDisposeMessages(lockTokens, GetDeferOutcome(propertiesToModify), !fromSync, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		protected override void OnEndDefer(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (result is DisposeMessageRequestResponseAsyncResult)
			{
				AsyncResult<AmqpReceiverRequestAsyncResult>.End(result);
			}
			else
			{
				EndDisposeMessages(result);
			}
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginDeadLetter(TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<Guid> lockTokens, IDictionary<string, object> propertiesToModify, string deadLetterReason, string deadLetterErrorDescription, bool fromSync, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			if (lockTokens.Any((Guid lt) => requestResponseLockedMessages.Contains(lt)))
			{
				return new DisposeMessageRequestResponseAsyncResult(this, trackingContext, DispositionStatus.Suspended, lockTokens, deadLetterReason, deadLetterErrorDescription, propertiesToModify, timeout, callback, state);
			}
			return BeginDisposeMessages(lockTokens, GetRejectedOutcome(propertiesToModify, deadLetterReason, deadLetterErrorDescription), !fromSync, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		protected override void OnEndDeadLetter(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (result is DisposeMessageRequestResponseAsyncResult)
			{
				AsyncResult<AmqpReceiverRequestAsyncResult>.End(result);
			}
			else
			{
				EndDisposeMessages(result);
			}
		}

		private IAsyncResult BeginCreateLink(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			IList<AmqpDescribed> filters = CreateFilters();
			string entityName = ((!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(base.PartitionId)) ? EntityNameHelper.FormatPartitionReceiverPath(base.Path, base.PartitionId) : base.Path);
			return messagingFactory.BeginOpenEntity(this, entityName, base.EntityType, PrefetchCount, PrefetchEventSizeInBytes, SessionId, sessionReceiver, browsable, base.Mode, filters, base.Epoch, base.EnableReceiverRuntimeMetric, base.Identifier, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		private ReceivingAmqpLink EndCreateLink(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			ActiveClientLink activeClientLink = messagingFactory.EndOpenReceiveEntity(result);
			RuntimeEntityDescription = new RuntimeEntityDescription
			{
				EnableMessagePartitioning = activeClientLink.Link.ExtractSettingPropertyValueOrDefault(AmqpClientConstants.RuntimeEntityDescription.EnableMessagePartitioning, defaultValue: false),
				RequiresDuplicateDetection = activeClientLink.Link.ExtractSettingPropertyValueOrDefault(AmqpClientConstants.RuntimeEntityDescription.RequiresDuplicateDetection, defaultValue: false),
				PartitionCount = activeClientLink.Link.ExtractSettingPropertyValueOrDefault(AmqpClientConstants.RuntimeEntityDescription.LogicalPartitionCount, (short)0),
				EnableSubscriptionPartitioning = activeClientLink.Link.ExtractSettingPropertyValueOrDefault(AmqpClientConstants.RuntimeEntityDescription.EnableSubscriptionPartitioning, defaultValue: false),
				PartitionRanges = activeClientLink.Link.ExtractSettingPropertyValueOrDefault<int[]>(AmqpClientConstants.RuntimeEntityDescription.LogicalPartitionRanges, null)
			};
			clientLinkManager.SetActiveLink(activeClientLink);
			return (ReceivingAmqpLink)activeClientLink.LinkObject;
		}

		private IList<AmqpDescribed> CreateFilters()
		{
			List<AmqpDescribed> list = null;
			if (base.Filter != null)
			{
				list = new List<AmqpDescribed> { AmqpMessageConverter.GetFilter(base.Filter) };
			}
			if (base.EventPosition != null)
			{
				if (list == null)
				{
					list = new List<AmqpDescribed>();
				}
				list.Add(new AmqpSelectorFilter(base.EventPosition.GetExpression()));
			}
			return list;
		}

		private void CloseLink(ReceivingAmqpLink link)
		{
			link.Session.SafeClose();
		}

		private IAsyncResult BeginCreateRequestResponseLink(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return messagingFactory.BeginOpenReceiveEntityRequestResponseLink(ReceiveLink, base.Path, base.EntityType, RequiredClaims, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		private RequestResponseAmqpLink EndCreateRequestResponseLink(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			ActiveClientRequestResponseLink activeClientRequestResponseLink = messagingFactory.EndOpenReceiveEntityRequestResponseLink(result);
			requestResponseLinkManager.SetActiveLink(activeClientRequestResponseLink);
			return activeClientRequestResponseLink.Link;
		}

		private void CloseRequestResponseLink()
		{
			if (requestResponseLink.TryGetOpenedObject(out var obj))
			{
				CloseRequestResponseLink(obj);
			}
		}

		private void CloseRequestResponseLink(RequestResponseAmqpLink link)
		{
			link.Session.SafeClose();
		}

		private Outcome GetAbandonOutcome(bool unlockOnly, IDictionary<string, object> propertiesToModify)
		{
			if (!unlockOnly)
			{
				return GetModifiedOutcome(propertiesToModify, undeliverableHere: false);
			}
			return AmqpConstants.ReleasedOutcome;
		}

		private Outcome GetDeferOutcome(IDictionary<string, object> propertiesToModify)
		{
			return GetModifiedOutcome(propertiesToModify, undeliverableHere: true);
		}

		private Outcome GetModifiedOutcome(IDictionary<string, object> propertiesToModify, bool undeliverableHere)
		{
			Modified modified = new Modified();
			if (undeliverableHere)
			{
				modified.UndeliverableHere = true;
			}
			if (propertiesToModify != null)
			{
				modified.MessageAnnotations = new Fields();
				foreach (KeyValuePair<string, object> item in propertiesToModify)
				{
					if (AmqpMessageConverter.TryGetAmqpObjectFromNetObject(item.Value, MappingType.ApplicationProperty, out var amqpObject))
					{
						modified.MessageAnnotations.Add(item.Key, amqpObject);
					}
				}
			}
			return modified;
		}

		private Rejected GetRejectedOutcome(IDictionary<string, object> propertiesToModify, string deadLetterReason, string deadLetterErrorDescription)
		{
			Rejected rejected = AmqpConstants.RejectedOutcome;
			if (deadLetterReason != null || deadLetterErrorDescription != null || propertiesToModify != null)
			{
				rejected = new Rejected
				{
					Error = new Error
					{
						Condition = AmqpClientConstants.DeadLetterName,
						Info = new Fields()
					}
				};
				if (deadLetterReason != null)
				{
					rejected.Error.Info.Add("DeadLetterReason", deadLetterReason);
				}
				if (deadLetterErrorDescription != null)
				{
					rejected.Error.Info.Add("DeadLetterErrorDescription", deadLetterErrorDescription);
				}
				if (propertiesToModify != null)
				{
					foreach (KeyValuePair<string, object> item in propertiesToModify)
					{
						if (AmqpMessageConverter.TryGetAmqpObjectFromNetObject(item.Value, MappingType.ApplicationProperty, out var amqpObject))
						{
							rejected.Error.Info.Add(item.Key, amqpObject);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return rejected;
		}

		private IAsyncResult BeginDisposeMessages(IEnumerable<Guid> lockTokens, Outcome outcome, bool batchable, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new DisposeMessageAsyncResult(this, lockTokens, outcome, batchable, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		private void EndDisposeMessages(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			AsyncResult<DisposeAsyncResult>.End(result);
		}

		private IAsyncResult BeginDisposeEvents(IEnumerable<ArraySegment<byte>> deliveryTags, Outcome outcome, bool batchable, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			if (System.Transactions.Transaction.Current != null)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(SRClient.FeatureNotSupported("Transaction"));
			}
			return new DisposeEventAsyncResult(this, deliveryTags, outcome, batchable, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		private void EndDisposeEvents(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			AsyncResult<DisposeAsyncResult>.End(result);
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginRenewMessageLocks(TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<Guid> lockTokens, bool fromSync, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			if (System.Transactions.Transaction.Current != null)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(SRClient.FeatureNotSupported("Transaction"));
			}
			return new RenewLockAsyncResult(this, trackingContext, lockTokens, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<DateTime> OnEndRenewMessageLocks(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			return RenewLockAsyncResult.End(result);
		}

		internal override IAsyncResult OnBeginGetRuntimeEntityDescriptionAsyncResult(TrackingContext trackingContext, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new CompletedAsyncResult<RuntimeEntityDescription>(RuntimeEntityDescription, callback, state);
		}

		internal override RuntimeEntityDescription OnEndGetRuntimeEntityDescriptionAsyncResult(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			return CompletedAsyncResult<RuntimeEntityDescription>.End(result);
		}

		internal override void IncrementContinuousErrorCount()
		{
			int num = Interlocked.Increment(ref messagingFactory.TransportSettings.ContinousErrorCount);
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpReceiverContinuousErrorCountChanged(base.MessagingFactory.Address, base.Path, num);
			if (messagingFactory.TransportSettings.RedirectionSetting == AmqpRedirectionSetting.DefaultEnabled && num >= 3)
			{
				messagingFactory.TransportSettings.EnableLinkRedirect = false;
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpReceiverAutoRedirectDisabled(base.MessagingFactory.Address, base.Path, 3);
				if (receiveLink.TryGetOpenedObject(out var obj))
				{
					CloseLink(obj);
				}
			}
		}

		internal override void ResetContinuousErrorCount()
		{
			int errorCount = Interlocked.Exchange(ref messagingFactory.TransportSettings.ContinousErrorCount, 0);
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpReceiverContinuousErrorCountChanged(base.MessagingFactory.Address, base.Path, errorCount);
		}

		internal Error GetSessionLockLostError()
		{
			if (sessionReceiver)
			{
				Error linkTerminalError = GetLinkTerminalError();
				if (linkTerminalError != null && linkTerminalError.Condition.Equals(AmqpClientConstants.SessionLockLostError))
				{
					return linkTerminalError;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal Error GetLinkTerminalError()
		{
			AmqpLink unsafeInnerObject = receiveLink.UnsafeInnerObject;
			if (unsafeInnerObject != null && unsafeInnerObject.TerminalException is AmqpException ex)
			{
				return ex.Error;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal uint TestGetCredit()
		{
			if (receiveLink == null)
			{
				return 0u;
			}
			return receiveLink.UnsafeInnerObject.LinkCredit;
		}
	}
	internal sealed class AmqpMessageSender : MessageSender
	{
		private abstract class SendAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<SendAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly AmqpMessageSender parent;

			private readonly System.Transactions.Transaction transaction;

			private SendingAmqpLink amqpLink;

			private AmqpMessage amqpMessage;

			private Outcome outcome;

			private ArraySegment<byte> transactionId;

			protected AmqpMessageSender Parent => parent;

			protected bool Batchable { get; private set; }

			protected SendAsyncResult(AmqpMessageSender parent, bool batchable, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.parent = parent;
				Batchable = batchable;
				transaction = System.Transactions.Transaction.Current;
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				if (!parent.sendLink.TryGetOpenedObject(out amqpLink))
				{
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((SendAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.parent.sendLink.BeginGetInstance(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(SendAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.amqpLink = thisPtr.parent.sendLink.EndGetInstance(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
					if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
					{
						Complete(AmqpExceptionHelper.GetClientException(base.LastAsyncStepException, parent.messagingFactory.RemoteContainerId));
						yield break;
					}
					parent.PopulateIdempotentProducerStates();
				}
				try
				{
					amqpMessage = CreateAmqpMessage();
				}
				catch (Exception operationException)
				{
					Complete(operationException);
					yield break;
				}
				if (amqpLink.Settings.MaxMessageSize.HasValue)
				{
					ulong serializedMessageSize = (ulong)amqpMessage.SerializedMessageSize;
					if (serializedMessageSize > Convert.ToUInt64(amqpLink.Settings.MaxMessageSize))
					{
						Complete(new MessageSizeExceededException(SRAmqp.AmqpMessageSizeExceeded(amqpMessage.DeliveryId.Value, serializedMessageSize, amqpLink.Settings.MaxMessageSize.Value)));
						yield break;
					}
				}
				if (transaction != null)
				{
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((SendAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.parent.messagingFactory.TransactionManager.BeginEnlist(thisPtr.transaction, thisPtr.parent.messagingFactory, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(SendAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.transactionId = thisPtr.parent.messagingFactory.TransactionManager.EndEnlist(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
				}
				else
				{
					transactionId = AmqpConstants.NullBinary;
				}
				long sizeInBytes = amqpMessage.SerializedMessageSize;
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((SendAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.amqpLink.BeginSendMessage(thisPtr.amqpMessage, thisPtr.parent.GetDeliveryTag(), thisPtr.transactionId, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(SendAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					thisPtr.outcome = thisPtr.amqpLink.EndSendMessage(r);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
				if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
				{
					Complete(AmqpExceptionHelper.GetClientException(base.LastAsyncStepException, amqpLink.GetTrackingId()));
				}
				else if (outcome.DescriptorCode == Rejected.Code)
				{
					Rejected rejected = (Rejected)outcome;
					Complete(AmqpExceptionHelper.ToMessagingContract(rejected.Error));
				}
				else
				{
					MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementEntityIngressRate(parent.Address, sizeInBytes);
				}
			}

			protected abstract AmqpMessage CreateAmqpMessage();
		}

		private sealed class SendBrokeredMessageAsyncResult : SendAsyncResult
		{
			private readonly IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> brokeredMessages;

			public SendBrokeredMessageAsyncResult(AmqpMessageSender parent, IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages, bool batchable, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(parent, batchable, timeout, callback, state)
			{
				brokeredMessages = messages;
				Start();
			}

			protected override AmqpMessage CreateAmqpMessage()
			{
				AmqpMessage amqpMessage;
				if (brokeredMessages.CountSlim() == 1)
				{
					BrokeredMessage brokeredMessage = brokeredMessages.Single();
					amqpMessage = AmqpMessageConverter.ClientGetMessage(brokeredMessage);
				}
				else
				{
					List<Data> list = new List<Data>();
					foreach (BrokeredMessage brokeredMessage3 in brokeredMessages)
					{
						AmqpMessage amqpMessage2 = AmqpMessageConverter.ClientGetMessage(brokeredMessage3);
						amqpMessage2.Initialize(SectionFlag.All);
						ArraySegment<byte> arraySegment = amqpMessage2.Buffer.AsSegment();
						list.Add(new Data
						{
							Value = arraySegment
						});
					}
					BrokeredMessage brokeredMessage2 = brokeredMessages.First();
					amqpMessage = AmqpMessage.Create(list);
					amqpMessage.MessageFormat = 2147563264u;
					if (brokeredMessage2.MessageId != null)
					{
						amqpMessage.Properties.MessageId = brokeredMessage2.MessageId;
					}
					if (brokeredMessage2.SessionId != null)
					{
						amqpMessage.Properties.GroupId = brokeredMessage2.SessionId;
					}
					if (brokeredMessage2.PartitionKey != null)
					{
						amqpMessage.MessageAnnotations.Map["x-opt-partition-key"] = brokeredMessage2.PartitionKey;
					}
					if (brokeredMessage2.ViaPartitionKey != null)
					{
						amqpMessage.MessageAnnotations.Map["x-opt-via-partition-key"] = brokeredMessage2.ViaPartitionKey;
					}
				}
				amqpMessage.Batchable = base.Batchable;
				return amqpMessage;
			}

			[Conditional("DEBUG")]
			private void ProcessFaultInjectionInfo(BrokeredMessage message)
			{
				base.Parent.MessagingFactory.FaultInjectionInfo?.AddToProperty(message);
			}
		}

		private sealed class SendEventDataAsyncResult : SendAsyncResult
		{
			private const SectionFlag ClientAmqpPropsSetOnSendToEventHub = SectionFlag.DeliveryAnnotations | SectionFlag.MessageAnnotations | SectionFlag.Properties | SectionFlag.ApplicationProperties;

			private readonly IEnumerable<EventData> eventDatas;

			public SendEventDataAsyncResult(AmqpMessageSender parent, IEnumerable<EventData> eventDatas, bool batchable, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(parent, batchable, timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.eventDatas = eventDatas;
				Start();
			}

			protected override AmqpMessage CreateAmqpMessage()
			{
				AmqpMessage amqpMessage = null;
				int num = eventDatas.Count();
				if (eventDatas != null && num > 1)
				{
					IList<Data> list = new List<Data>();
					EventData eventData = null;
					foreach (EventData eventData3 in eventDatas)
					{
						if (eventData == null)
						{
							eventData = eventData3;
						}
						else
						{
							if (eventData.PartitionKey != eventData3.PartitionKey)
							{
								throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.EventHubSendBatchMismatchPartitionKey(eventData.PartitionKey ?? "(null)", eventData3.PartitionKey ?? "(null)")));
							}
							if (eventData.Publisher != eventData3.Publisher)
							{
								throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.EventHubSendBatchMismatchPublisher(eventData.Publisher ?? "(null)", eventData3.Publisher ?? "(null)")));
							}
						}
						AmqpMessage amqpMessage2 = eventData3.ToAmqpMessage();
						amqpMessage2.Batchable = base.Batchable;
						if (base.Parent.idempotentProducerId >= 0)
						{
							amqpMessage2.MessageAnnotations.Map.Add(AmqpClientConstants.ProducerId, base.Parent.idempotentProducerId);
							amqpMessage2.MessageAnnotations.Map.Add(AmqpClientConstants.ProducerEpoch, base.Parent.idempotentProducerEpoch);
							amqpMessage2.MessageAnnotations.Map.Add(AmqpClientConstants.ProducerSequenceNumber, base.Parent.idempotentProducerSequence++);
						}
						if ((amqpMessage2.Sections & (SectionFlag.DeliveryAnnotations | SectionFlag.MessageAnnotations | SectionFlag.Properties | SectionFlag.ApplicationProperties)) == 0 && (eventData3.BodyStream == null || eventData3.BodyStream == Stream.Null))
						{
							throw new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.CannotSendAnEmptyEvent(eventData3.GetType().Name));
						}
						amqpMessage2.Initialize(SectionFlag.All);
						list.Add(new Data
						{
							Value = amqpMessage2.Buffer.AsSegment()
						});
					}
					amqpMessage = AmqpMessage.Create(list);
					amqpMessage.Batchable = true;
					amqpMessage.MessageFormat = 2147563264u;
					AmqpMessageConverter.UpdateAmqpMessageHeadersAndProperties(amqpMessage, eventData, copyUserProeperties: false);
				}
				else if (eventDatas != null && num == 1)
				{
					EventData eventData2 = eventDatas.First();
					amqpMessage = eventData2.ToAmqpMessage();
					amqpMessage.Batchable = base.Batchable;
					if (base.Parent.idempotentProducerId >= 0)
					{
						amqpMessage.MessageAnnotations.Map.Add(AmqpClientConstants.ProducerId, base.Parent.idempotentProducerId);
						amqpMessage.MessageAnnotations.Map.Add(AmqpClientConstants.ProducerEpoch, base.Parent.idempotentProducerEpoch);
						amqpMessage.MessageAnnotations.Map.Add(AmqpClientConstants.ProducerSequenceNumber, base.Parent.idempotentProducerSequence++);
					}
					if ((amqpMessage.Sections & (SectionFlag.DeliveryAnnotations | SectionFlag.MessageAnnotations | SectionFlag.Properties | SectionFlag.ApplicationProperties)) == 0 && (eventData2.BodyStream == null || eventData2.BodyStream == Stream.Null))
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.CannotSendAnEmptyEvent(eventData2.GetType().Name));
					}
				}
				return amqpMessage;
			}

			[Conditional("DEBUG")]
			private void ProcessFaultInjectionInfo(EventData data)
			{
				FaultInjectionInfo faultInjectionInfo = base.Parent.MessagingFactory.FaultInjectionInfo;
				if (faultInjectionInfo != null && !data.Properties.ContainsKey("FaultInjectionInfo"))
				{
					faultInjectionInfo.AddToProperty(data);
				}
			}
		}

		private abstract class AmqpSenderRequestAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<AmqpSenderRequestAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly AmqpMessageSender parent;

			private readonly System.Transactions.Transaction transaction;

			private RequestResponseAmqpLink requestResponseAmqpLink;

			private ArraySegment<byte> transactionId;

			private AmqpMessage requestMessage;

			private AmqpMessage responseMessage;

			protected AmqpSenderRequestAsyncResult(AmqpMessageSender parent, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				transaction = System.Transactions.Transaction.Current;
				this.parent = parent;
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				if (transaction != null)
				{
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((AmqpSenderRequestAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.parent.messagingFactory.TransactionManager.BeginEnlist(thisPtr.transaction, thisPtr.parent.messagingFactory, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(AmqpSenderRequestAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.transactionId = thisPtr.parent.messagingFactory.TransactionManager.EndEnlist(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
				}
				else
				{
					transactionId = AmqpConstants.NullBinary;
				}
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((AmqpSenderRequestAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.parent.RequestResponseLink.BeginGetOpenedObject(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(AmqpSenderRequestAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					thisPtr.requestResponseAmqpLink = thisPtr.parent.RequestResponseLink.EndGetOpenedObject(r);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
				if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
				{
					base.LastAsyncStepException = AmqpExceptionHelper.GetClientException(base.LastAsyncStepException, ((AmqpMessagingFactory)parent.MessagingFactory).RemoteContainerId);
					Complete(base.LastAsyncStepException);
					yield break;
				}
				using (requestMessage = CreateRequestMessage())
				{
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((AmqpSenderRequestAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.requestResponseAmqpLink.BeginRequest(thisPtr.requestMessage, thisPtr.transactionId, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(AmqpSenderRequestAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.responseMessage = thisPtr.requestResponseAmqpLink.EndRequest(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
				}
				if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
				{
					base.LastAsyncStepException = AmqpExceptionHelper.GetClientException(base.LastAsyncStepException, null);
					Complete(base.LastAsyncStepException);
					yield break;
				}
				using (responseMessage)
				{
					ProcessResponseMessage(responseMessage);
				}
			}

			protected abstract AmqpMessage CreateRequestMessage();

			protected abstract void ProcessResponseMessage(AmqpMessage responseMessage);
		}

		private sealed class ScheduleMessagesAsyncResult : AmqpSenderRequestAsyncResult
		{
			private readonly AmqpMessageSender parent;

			private readonly TrackingContext trackingContext;

			private readonly IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> brokeredMessages;

			public IEnumerable<long> SequenceNumbers { get; private set; }

			public ScheduleMessagesAsyncResult(AmqpMessageSender parent, TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> brokeredMessages, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(parent, timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.parent = parent;
				this.trackingContext = trackingContext;
				this.brokeredMessages = brokeredMessages;
				Start();
			}

			protected override AmqpMessage CreateRequestMessage()
			{
				AmqpRequestMessage amqpRequestMessage = AmqpRequestMessage.CreateRequest("com.microsoft:schedule-message", RemainingTime(), trackingContext.TrackingId);
				List<AmqpMap> list = new List<AmqpMap>();
				foreach (BrokeredMessage brokeredMessage in brokeredMessages)
				{
					AmqpMessage amqpMessage = AmqpMessageConverter.ClientGetMessage(brokeredMessage);
					amqpMessage.Initialize(SectionFlag.All);
					ArraySegment<byte> arraySegment = amqpMessage.Buffer.AsSegment();
					AmqpMap amqpMap = new AmqpMap();
					amqpMap[ManagementConstants.Properties.Message] = arraySegment;
					amqpMap[ManagementConstants.Properties.MessageId] = brokeredMessage.MessageId;
					if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(brokeredMessage.SessionId))
					{
						amqpMap[ManagementConstants.Properties.SessionId] = brokeredMessage.SessionId;
					}
					if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(brokeredMessage.PartitionKey))
					{
						amqpMap[ManagementConstants.Properties.PartitionKey] = brokeredMessage.PartitionKey;
					}
					if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(brokeredMessage.ViaPartitionKey))
					{
						amqpMap[ManagementConstants.Properties.ViaPartitionKey] = brokeredMessage.ViaPartitionKey;
					}
					list.Add(amqpMap);
				}
				amqpRequestMessage.Map[ManagementConstants.Properties.Messages] = list;
				if (parent.sendLink.TryGetOpenedObject(out var obj))
				{
					amqpRequestMessage.RequestMessage.ApplicationProperties.Map["associated-link-name"] = obj.Name;
				}
				return amqpRequestMessage.RequestMessage;
			}

			protected override void ProcessResponseMessage(AmqpMessage responseMessage)
			{
				AmqpResponseMessage amqpResponseMessage = AmqpResponseMessage.CreateResponse(responseMessage);
				if (amqpResponseMessage.StatusCode == AmqpResponseStatusCode.OK)
				{
					SequenceNumbers = amqpResponseMessage.GetValue<long[]>(ManagementConstants.Properties.SequenceNumbers);
				}
				else
				{
					Complete(amqpResponseMessage.ToMessagingContractException());
				}
			}

			public new static IEnumerable<long> End(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				ScheduleMessagesAsyncResult scheduleMessagesAsyncResult = (ScheduleMessagesAsyncResult)result;
				AsyncResult<AmqpSenderRequestAsyncResult>.End(result);
				return scheduleMessagesAsyncResult.SequenceNumbers ?? new long[0];
			}
		}

		private sealed class CancelScheduledMessagesAsyncResult : AmqpSenderRequestAsyncResult
		{
			private readonly AmqpMessageSender parent;

			private readonly TrackingContext trackingContext;

			private readonly IEnumerable<long> sequenceNumbers;

			public CancelScheduledMessagesAsyncResult(AmqpMessageSender parent, TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<long> sequenceNumbers, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(parent, timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.parent = parent;
				this.trackingContext = trackingContext;
				this.sequenceNumbers = sequenceNumbers;
				Start();
			}

			protected override AmqpMessage CreateRequestMessage()
			{
				AmqpRequestMessage amqpRequestMessage = AmqpRequestMessage.CreateRequest("com.microsoft:cancel-scheduled-message", RemainingTime(), trackingContext.TrackingId);
				amqpRequestMessage.Map[ManagementConstants.Properties.SequenceNumbers] = sequenceNumbers.ToArray();
				if (parent.sendLink.TryGetOpenedObject(out var obj))
				{
					amqpRequestMessage.RequestMessage.ApplicationProperties.Map["associated-link-name"] = obj.Name;
				}
				return amqpRequestMessage.RequestMessage;
			}

			protected override void ProcessResponseMessage(AmqpMessage responseMessage)
			{
				AmqpResponseMessage amqpResponseMessage = AmqpResponseMessage.CreateResponse(responseMessage);
				if (amqpResponseMessage.StatusCode != AmqpResponseStatusCode.OK)
				{
					Complete(amqpResponseMessage.ToMessagingContractException());
				}
			}
		}

		private static readonly string[] RequiredClaims = new string[1] { "Send" };

		private readonly AmqpMessagingFactory messagingFactory;

		private readonly FaultTolerantObject<SendingAmqpLink> sendLink;

		private readonly FaultTolerantObject<RequestResponseAmqpLink> requestResponseLink;

		private readonly ActiveClientLinkManager clientLinkManager;

		private readonly ActiveClientLinkManager requestResponseLinkManager;

		private int deliveryCount;

		private TimeSpan batchFlushInterval;

		private long idempotentProducerId;

		private short idempotentProducerEpoch;

		private int idempotentProducerSequence;

		public override TimeSpan BatchFlushInterval
		{
			get
			{
				return batchFlushInterval;
			}
			internal set
			{
				ThrowIfDisposedOrImmutable();
				batchFlushInterval = value;
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool SupportsGetRuntimeEntityDescription => true;

		internal FaultTolerantObject<SendingAmqpLink> SendLink => sendLink;

		internal override bool ViaSender { get; }

		internal string TransferDestinationEntityName { get; }

		private FaultTolerantObject<RequestResponseAmqpLink> RequestResponseLink => requestResponseLink;

		public AmqpMessageSender(AmqpMessagingFactory factory, string entityName, string transferDestinationEntityName, MessagingEntityType? entityType, RetryPolicy retryPolicy)
			: base(factory, entityName, entityType, retryPolicy)
		{
			sendLink = new FaultTolerantObject<SendingAmqpLink>(this, CloseLink, BeginCreateLink, EndCreateLink);
			requestResponseLink = new FaultTolerantObject<RequestResponseAmqpLink>(this, CloseRequestResponseLink, BeginCreateRequestResponseLink, EndCreateRequestResponseLink);
			messagingFactory = factory;
			clientLinkManager = new ActiveClientLinkManager(messagingFactory);
			requestResponseLinkManager = new ActiveClientLinkManager(messagingFactory);
			batchFlushInterval = messagingFactory.TransportSettings.BatchFlushInterval;
			base.MaxMessageSize = -1L;
			ViaSender = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(transferDestinationEntityName);
			TransferDestinationEntityName = transferDestinationEntityName;
			idempotentProducerId = -1L;
			idempotentProducerEpoch = -1;
			idempotentProducerSequence = -1;
			if (factory.TransportSettings.ProducerState != null)
			{
				idempotentProducerId = factory.TransportSettings.ProducerState.Id;
				idempotentProducerEpoch = factory.TransportSettings.ProducerState.Epoch;
				idempotentProducerSequence = factory.TransportSettings.ProducerState.Sequence;
			}
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginOpen(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return sendLink.BeginGetInstance(timeout, callback, state);
		}

		protected override void OnEndOpen(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			sendLink.EndGetInstance(result);
			PopulateIdempotentProducerStates();
			MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementEntityCount(base.Address, 1);
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			SendingAmqpLink obj = null;
			if (sendLink.TryGetOpenedObject(out obj))
			{
				return messagingFactory.BeginCloseEntity(obj, timeout, callback, state);
			}
			return new CompletedAsyncResult(callback, state);
		}

		protected override void OnEndClose(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (result is CompletedAsyncResult)
			{
				CompletedAsyncResult.End(result);
			}
			else
			{
				messagingFactory.EndCloseEntity(result);
			}
			clientLinkManager.Close();
			requestResponseLinkManager.Close();
			MessagingPerformanceCounters.DecrementEntityCount(base.Address, 1);
		}

		protected override void OnClosed()
		{
			CloseRequestResponseLink();
			base.OnClosed();
		}

		protected override void OnFaulted()
		{
			CloseRequestResponseLink();
			base.OnFaulted();
		}

		protected override void OnAbort()
		{
			SendingAmqpLink obj = null;
			MessagingPerformanceCounters.DecrementEntityCount(base.Address, 1);
			if (sendLink.TryGetOpenedObject(out obj))
			{
				CloseLink(obj);
			}
			CloseRequestResponseLink();
			clientLinkManager.Close();
			requestResponseLinkManager.Close();
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginSend(TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages, bool fromSync, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return OnBeginSend(trackingContext, messages, timeout, !fromSync, callback, state);
		}

		protected override void OnEndSend(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			AsyncResult<SendAsyncResult>.End(result);
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginSendEventData(TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<EventData> eventDatas, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			if (System.Transactions.Transaction.Current != null)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(SRClient.FeatureNotSupported("Transaction"));
			}
			return new SendEventDataAsyncResult(this, eventDatas, batchable: true, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		protected override void OnEndSendEventData(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			AsyncResult<SendAsyncResult>.End(result);
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginScheduleMessage(TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new ScheduleMessagesAsyncResult(this, trackingContext, messages, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<long> OnEndScheduleMessage(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			return ScheduleMessagesAsyncResult.End(result);
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginCancelScheduledMessage(TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<long> sequenceNumbers, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			if (System.Transactions.Transaction.Current != null)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(SRClient.FeatureNotSupported("Transaction"));
			}
			return new CancelScheduledMessagesAsyncResult(this, trackingContext, sequenceNumbers, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		protected override void OnEndCancelScheduledMessage(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			AsyncResult<AmqpSenderRequestAsyncResult>.End(result);
		}

		internal override IAsyncResult OnBeginGetRuntimeEntityDescriptionAsyncResult(TrackingContext trackingContext, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new CompletedAsyncResult<RuntimeEntityDescription>(RuntimeEntityDescription, callback, state);
		}

		internal override RuntimeEntityDescription OnEndGetRuntimeEntityDescriptionAsyncResult(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			return CompletedAsyncResult<RuntimeEntityDescription>.End(result);
		}

		private IAsyncResult BeginCreateLink(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			string entityName = ((!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(base.PartitionId)) ? EntityNameHelper.FormatPartitionSenderPath(base.Path, base.PartitionId) : base.Path);
			return messagingFactory.BeginOpenEntity(this, entityName, TransferDestinationEntityName, base.EntityType, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		private SendingAmqpLink EndCreateLink(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			ActiveClientLink activeClientLink = messagingFactory.EndOpenSendEntity(result);
			RuntimeEntityDescription = new RuntimeEntityDescription
			{
				EnableMessagePartitioning = activeClientLink.Link.ExtractSettingPropertyValueOrDefault(AmqpClientConstants.RuntimeEntityDescription.EnableMessagePartitioning, defaultValue: false),
				RequiresDuplicateDetection = activeClientLink.Link.ExtractSettingPropertyValueOrDefault(AmqpClientConstants.RuntimeEntityDescription.RequiresDuplicateDetection, defaultValue: false),
				PartitionCount = activeClientLink.Link.ExtractSettingPropertyValueOrDefault(AmqpClientConstants.RuntimeEntityDescription.LogicalPartitionCount, (short)0),
				EnableSubscriptionPartitioning = activeClientLink.Link.ExtractSettingPropertyValueOrDefault(AmqpClientConstants.RuntimeEntityDescription.EnableSubscriptionPartitioning, defaultValue: false),
				PartitionRanges = activeClientLink.Link.ExtractSettingPropertyValueOrDefault<int[]>(AmqpClientConstants.RuntimeEntityDescription.LogicalPartitionRanges, null)
			};
			clientLinkManager.SetActiveLink(activeClientLink);
			SendingAmqpLink sendingAmqpLink = (SendingAmqpLink)activeClientLink.LinkObject;
			base.MaxMessageSize = (long)sendingAmqpLink.Settings.MaxMessageSize();
			return sendingAmqpLink;
		}

		private void CloseLink(SendingAmqpLink link)
		{
			link.Session.SafeClose();
		}

		private IAsyncResult BeginCreateRequestResponseLink(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return messagingFactory.BeginOpenSendEntityRequestResponseLink(sendLink, base.Path, TransferDestinationEntityName, base.EntityType, RequiredClaims, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		private RequestResponseAmqpLink EndCreateRequestResponseLink(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			ActiveClientRequestResponseLink activeClientRequestResponseLink = messagingFactory.EndOpenSendEntityRequestResponseLink(result);
			requestResponseLinkManager.SetActiveLink(activeClientRequestResponseLink);
			return activeClientRequestResponseLink.Link;
		}

		private void CloseRequestResponseLink()
		{
			if (requestResponseLink.TryGetOpenedObject(out var obj))
			{
				CloseRequestResponseLink(obj);
			}
		}

		private void CloseRequestResponseLink(RequestResponseAmqpLink link)
		{
			link.Session.SafeClose();
		}

		private IAsyncResult OnBeginSend(TrackingContext trackingContext, IEnumerable<BrokeredMessage> messages, TimeSpan timeout, bool batchable, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new SendBrokeredMessageAsyncResult(this, messages, batchable, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		internal ArraySegment<byte> GetDeliveryTag()
		{
			int value = Interlocked.Increment(ref deliveryCount);
			return new ArraySegment<byte>(BitConverter.GetBytes(value));
		}

		private void PopulateIdempotentProducerStates()
		{
			if (sendLink.TryGetOpenedObject(out var obj) && obj.Settings.Properties != null && obj.Settings.OfferedCapabilities != null && obj.Settings.OfferedCapabilities.Contains(AmqpClientConstants.IdempotentProducer))
			{
				if (idempotentProducerId == -1)
				{
					obj.Settings.Properties.TryGetValue<long>(AmqpClientConstants.ProducerId, out idempotentProducerId);
					obj.Settings.Properties.TryGetValue<short>(AmqpClientConstants.ProducerEpoch, out idempotentProducerEpoch);
					obj.Settings.Properties.TryGetValue<int>(AmqpClientConstants.ProducerSequenceNumber, out idempotentProducerSequence);
				}
				idempotentProducerSequence++;
			}
		}
	}
	internal sealed class AmqpMessageSession : MessageSession
	{
		private sealed class RenewSessionLockAsyncResult : AmqpReceiverRequestAsyncResult
		{
			private readonly AmqpMessageSession parent;

			private readonly TrackingContext trackingContext;

			public DateTime LockedUntilUtc { get; private set; }

			public RenewSessionLockAsyncResult(AmqpMessageSession parent, TrackingContext trackingContext, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base((AmqpMessageReceiver)parent.InnerMessageReceiver, timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.parent = parent;
				this.trackingContext = trackingContext;
				Start();
			}

			protected override AmqpMessage CreateRequestMessage()
			{
				AmqpRequestMessage amqpRequestMessage = AmqpRequestMessage.CreateRequest("com.microsoft:renew-session-lock", RemainingTime(), trackingContext.TrackingId);
				amqpRequestMessage.Map[ManagementConstants.Properties.SessionId] = parent.SessionId;
				if (((AmqpMessageReceiver)parent.InnerMessageReceiver).ReceiveLink.TryGetOpenedObject(out var obj))
				{
					amqpRequestMessage.RequestMessage.ApplicationProperties.Map["associated-link-name"] = obj.Name;
				}
				return amqpRequestMessage.RequestMessage;
			}

			protected override void ProcessResponseMessage(AmqpMessage responseMessage)
			{
				AmqpResponseMessage amqpResponseMessage = AmqpResponseMessage.CreateResponse(responseMessage);
				if (amqpResponseMessage.StatusCode == AmqpResponseStatusCode.OK)
				{
					LockedUntilUtc = amqpResponseMessage.GetValue<DateTime>(ManagementConstants.Properties.Expiration);
				}
				else
				{
					Complete(responseMessage.ToMessagingContractException());
				}
			}

			public new static DateTime End(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				RenewSessionLockAsyncResult renewSessionLockAsyncResult = (RenewSessionLockAsyncResult)result;
				AsyncResult<AmqpReceiverRequestAsyncResult>.End(result);
				return renewSessionLockAsyncResult.LockedUntilUtc;
			}
		}

		private sealed class SetStateAsyncResult : AmqpReceiverRequestAsyncResult
		{
			private readonly AmqpMessageSession parent;

			private readonly TrackingContext trackingContext;

			private readonly Stream sessionStateStream;

			public SetStateAsyncResult(AmqpMessageSession parent, TrackingContext trackingContext, Stream sessionState, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base((AmqpMessageReceiver)parent.InnerMessageReceiver, timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.parent = parent;
				this.trackingContext = trackingContext;
				sessionStateStream = sessionState;
				Start();
			}

			protected override AmqpMessage CreateRequestMessage()
			{
				if (sessionStateStream != null && sessionStateStream.CanSeek && sessionStateStream.Position != 0L)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.CannotSerializeSessionStateWithPartiallyConsumedStream);
				}
				AmqpRequestMessage amqpRequestMessage = AmqpRequestMessage.CreateRequest("com.microsoft:set-session-state", RemainingTime(), trackingContext.TrackingId);
				amqpRequestMessage.Map[ManagementConstants.Properties.SessionId] = parent.SessionId;
				if (((AmqpMessageReceiver)parent.InnerMessageReceiver).ReceiveLink.TryGetOpenedObject(out var obj))
				{
					amqpRequestMessage.RequestMessage.ApplicationProperties.Map["associated-link-name"] = obj.Name;
				}
				if (sessionStateStream != null)
				{
					BufferListStream bufferListStream = BufferListStream.Create(sessionStateStream, 512);
					ArraySegment<byte> arraySegment = bufferListStream.ReadBytes((int)bufferListStream.Length);
					amqpRequestMessage.Map[ManagementConstants.Properties.SessionState] = arraySegment;
				}
				else
				{
					amqpRequestMessage.Map[ManagementConstants.Properties.SessionState] = null;
				}
				return amqpRequestMessage.RequestMessage;
			}

			protected override void ProcessResponseMessage(AmqpMessage responseMessage)
			{
				AmqpResponseMessage amqpResponseMessage = AmqpResponseMessage.CreateResponse(responseMessage);
				if (amqpResponseMessage.StatusCode != AmqpResponseStatusCode.OK)
				{
					Complete(amqpResponseMessage.ToMessagingContractException());
				}
			}
		}

		private sealed class GetStateAsyncResult : AmqpReceiverRequestAsyncResult
		{
			private readonly AmqpMessageSession parent;

			private readonly TrackingContext trackingContext;

			private Stream sessionStateStream;

			public GetStateAsyncResult(AmqpMessageSession parent, TrackingContext trackingContext, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base((AmqpMessageReceiver)parent.InnerMessageReceiver, timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.parent = parent;
				this.trackingContext = trackingContext;
				Start();
			}

			protected override AmqpMessage CreateRequestMessage()
			{
				AmqpRequestMessage amqpRequestMessage = AmqpRequestMessage.CreateRequest("com.microsoft:get-session-state", RemainingTime(), trackingContext.TrackingId);
				amqpRequestMessage.Map[ManagementConstants.Properties.SessionId] = parent.SessionId;
				if (((AmqpMessageReceiver)parent.InnerMessageReceiver).ReceiveLink.TryGetOpenedObject(out var obj))
				{
					amqpRequestMessage.RequestMessage.ApplicationProperties.Map["associated-link-name"] = obj.Name;
				}
				return amqpRequestMessage.RequestMessage;
			}

			protected override void ProcessResponseMessage(AmqpMessage responseMessage)
			{
				AmqpResponseMessage amqpResponseMessage = AmqpResponseMessage.CreateResponse(responseMessage);
				if (amqpResponseMessage.StatusCode == AmqpResponseStatusCode.OK)
				{
					if (amqpResponseMessage.Map[ManagementConstants.Properties.SessionState] != null)
					{
						sessionStateStream = new BufferListStream(new ArraySegment<byte>[1] { amqpResponseMessage.GetValue<ArraySegment<byte>>(ManagementConstants.Properties.SessionState) });
					}
					else
					{
						sessionStateStream = null;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					Complete(amqpResponseMessage.ToMessagingContractException());
				}
			}

			public new static Stream End(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				GetStateAsyncResult getStateAsyncResult = (GetStateAsyncResult)result;
				AsyncResult<AmqpReceiverRequestAsyncResult>.End(result);
				return getStateAsyncResult.sessionStateStream;
			}
		}

		public AmqpMessageSession(ReceiveMode receiveMode, string sessionId, DateTime lockedUntilUtc, MessageReceiver innerReceiver)
			: base(receiveMode, sessionId, lockedUntilUtc, innerReceiver)
		{
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginGetState(TrackingContext trackingContext, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new GetStateAsyncResult(this, trackingContext, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		protected override Stream OnEndGetState(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			return GetStateAsyncResult.End(result);
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginSetState(TrackingContext trackingContext, Stream sessionState, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new SetStateAsyncResult(this, trackingContext, sessionState, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		protected override void OnEndSetState(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			AsyncResult<AmqpReceiverRequestAsyncResult>.End(result);
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginRenewLock(TrackingContext trackingContext, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new RenewSessionLockAsyncResult(this, trackingContext, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		protected override DateTime OnEndRenewLock(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			return RenewSessionLockAsyncResult.End(result);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class AmqpMessagingFactory : MessagingFactory
	{
		private static class ClientInfo
		{
			private static readonly string productString;

			private static readonly string versionString;

			private static readonly string frameworkString;

			private static readonly string platformString;

			static ClientInfo()
			{
				try
				{
					productString = GetAssemblyInfo((AssemblyProductAttribute p) => p.Product);
					versionString = GetAssemblyInfo((AssemblyFileVersionAttribute v) => v.Version);
					frameworkString = GetAssemblyInfo((TargetFrameworkAttribute f) => f.FrameworkName);
					platformString = Environment.OSVersion.VersionString;
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}

			private static string GetAssemblyInfo<T>(Func<T, string> getter) where T : Attribute
			{
				if (!(typeof(AmqpMessagingFactory).Assembly.GetCustomAttribute(typeof(T)) is T arg))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return getter(arg);
			}

			public static void AddTo(AmqpConnectionSettings connectionSettings)
			{
				connectionSettings.AddProperty("product", productString);
				connectionSettings.AddProperty("version", versionString);
				connectionSettings.AddProperty("framework", frameworkString);
				connectionSettings.AddProperty("platform", platformString);
			}
		}

		private sealed class CreateControllerAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<CreateControllerAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly AmqpMessagingFactory amqpMessagingFactory;

			private AmqpSession amqpSession;

			public Controller Controller { get; set; }

			public CreateControllerAsyncResult(AmqpMessagingFactory messagingFactory, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				amqpMessagingFactory = messagingFactory;
				Start();
			}

			public new Controller End(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				CreateControllerAsyncResult createControllerAsyncResult = Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult.End<CreateControllerAsyncResult>(result);
				return Controller;
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((CreateControllerAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.amqpMessagingFactory.BeginCreateAmqpSession(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(CreateControllerAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					thisPtr.amqpSession = thisPtr.amqpMessagingFactory.EndCreateAmqpSession(r);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
				if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
				{
					Complete(AmqpExceptionHelper.GetClientException(base.LastAsyncStepException, null));
					yield break;
				}
				Controller = new Controller(amqpSession, amqpMessagingFactory.OperationTimeout);
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((CreateControllerAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.Controller.BeginInitialize(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(CreateControllerAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					thisPtr.Controller.EndInitialize(r);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
				if (base.LastAsyncStepException == null)
				{
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((CreateControllerAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.Controller.BeginOpen(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(CreateControllerAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.Controller.EndOpen(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
				}
				if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogError(amqpMessagingFactory, "CreateController", base.LastAsyncStepException.Message);
					amqpSession.SafeClose(base.LastAsyncStepException);
					Complete(AmqpExceptionHelper.GetClientException(base.LastAsyncStepException, null));
				}
			}
		}

		private sealed class ConnectAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<ConnectAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly AmqpMessagingFactory messagingFactory;

			private readonly List<Uri> addresses;

			private ConnectInfo connectInfo;

			private AmqpTransportInitiator initiator;

			private TransportBase transport;

			private AmqpConnection amqpConnection;

			private Exception completeException;

			private InternalConnectivityMode ConnectivityMode { get; set; }

			public ConnectAsyncResult(AmqpMessagingFactory messagingFactory, ConnectInfo directConnect, List<Uri> addresses, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.messagingFactory = messagingFactory;
				connectInfo = directConnect;
				this.addresses = addresses;
				Start();
			}

			public static AmqpConnection End(IAsyncResult result, out ConnectInfo info)
			{
				ConnectAsyncResult connectAsyncResult = Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult.End<ConnectAsyncResult>(result);
				info = connectAsyncResult.connectInfo;
				return connectAsyncResult.amqpConnection;
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				bool directConnection = connectInfo != null;
				bool redirected = false;
				ServiceBusUriManager uriManager = null;
				if (addresses != null && addresses.Count > 0)
				{
					uriManager = new ServiceBusUriManager(addresses);
				}
				while ((connectInfo != null || (uriManager != null && uriManager.MoveNextUri())) && RemainingTime() > TimeSpan.Zero)
				{
					completeException = null;
					if (connectInfo == null)
					{
						Uri current = uriManager.Current;
						string hostName = messagingFactory.settings.OpenHostName ?? current.Host;
						connectInfo = new ConnectInfo(hostName, current.Host, current.Port);
						if (current.LocalPath.Length > 1)
						{
							connectInfo.Path = current.LocalPath.TrimStart('/');
							if (!connectInfo.Path.EndsWith("/", StringComparison.Ordinal))
							{
								connectInfo.Path += "/";
							}
						}
					}
					ConnectivityMode connectivityMode = ServiceBusEnvironment.SystemConnectivity.Mode;
					if (connectivityMode == Microsoft.ServiceBus.ConnectivityMode.AutoDetect && !messagingFactory.settings.DirectMode)
					{
						yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((ConnectAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => NetworkDetector.BeginCheckConnectivity(thisPtr.addresses, (thisPtr.connectInfo.Port < 0) ? thisPtr.messagingFactory.settings.DefaultPort : thisPtr.connectInfo.Port, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(ConnectAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
						{
							thisPtr.ConnectivityMode = NetworkDetector.EndCheckConnectivity(r);
						}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
						switch (ConnectivityMode)
						{
						case InternalConnectivityMode.Tcp:
							connectivityMode = Microsoft.ServiceBus.ConnectivityMode.Tcp;
							break;
						case InternalConnectivityMode.Https:
						case InternalConnectivityMode.HttpsWebSocket:
							connectivityMode = Microsoft.ServiceBus.ConnectivityMode.Https;
							break;
						default:
							connectivityMode = Microsoft.ServiceBus.ConnectivityMode.Http;
							break;
						}
					}
					messagingFactory.settings.UseWebSockets = connectivityMode == Microsoft.ServiceBus.ConnectivityMode.Http || connectivityMode == Microsoft.ServiceBus.ConnectivityMode.Https;
					TransportSettings transportSettings = (messagingFactory.settings.UseWebSockets ? CreateWebSocketsTransportSettings(connectInfo, Microsoft.ServiceBus.ConnectivityMode.Https, useCustomValidator: false) : CreateTcpTransportSettings(connectInfo, directConnection || redirected));
					AmqpSettings amqpSettings = messagingFactory.settings.CreateAmqpSettings(connectInfo.HostName, messagingFactory.settings.MaxFrameSize, connectInfo.Redirected);
					initiator = new AmqpTransportInitiator(amqpSettings, transportSettings);
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((ConnectAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.initiator.BeginConnect(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(ConnectAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.transport = thisPtr.initiator.EndConnect(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
					if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogError(messagingFactory, "Connect " + connectInfo.ToString(), base.LastAsyncStepException.Message);
						completeException = base.LastAsyncStepException;
						if (directConnection)
						{
							directConnection = false;
							connectInfo = null;
							continue;
						}
						if (redirected)
						{
							break;
						}
						connectInfo = null;
						continue;
					}
					AmqpConnectionSettings amqpConnectionSettings = new AmqpConnectionSettings();
					amqpConnectionSettings.MaxFrameSize = (uint)messagingFactory.settings.MaxFrameSize;
					amqpConnectionSettings.ContainerId = messagingFactory.containerId;
					amqpConnectionSettings.HostName = connectInfo.HostName;
					ClientInfo.AddTo(amqpConnectionSettings);
					amqpConnection = new AmqpConnection(transport, amqpSettings, amqpConnectionSettings);
					amqpConnection.UsageMeter = AmqpClientLogger.Default;
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((ConnectAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.amqpConnection.BeginOpen(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(ConnectAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.amqpConnection.EndOpen(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
					completeException = base.LastAsyncStepException;
					if (completeException == null)
					{
						break;
					}
					amqpConnection.SafeClose();
					amqpConnection = null;
					if (redirected)
					{
						break;
					}
					if (directConnection)
					{
						directConnection = false;
						connectInfo = null;
					}
					else
					{
						redirected = TryGetRedirectConnectInfo(base.LastAsyncStepException, connectionRedirect: true, null, out connectInfo);
					}
				}
				if (amqpConnection == null && RemainingTime() == TimeSpan.Zero && completeException == null)
				{
					completeException = new TimeoutException(SRAmqp.AmqpTimeout(base.OriginalTimeout, GetType().Name));
				}
				Complete(completeException);
			}

			private TransportSettings CreateTcpTransportSettings(ConnectInfo info, bool useCustomValidator)
			{
				TcpTransportSettings tcpTransportSettings = new TcpTransportSettings();
				tcpTransportSettings.Host = info.NetworkHost;
				tcpTransportSettings.Port = ((info.Port < 0) ? messagingFactory.settings.DefaultPort : info.Port);
				tcpTransportSettings.ReceiveBufferSize = 8192;
				tcpTransportSettings.SendBufferSize = 8192;
				TransportSettings result = tcpTransportSettings;
				if (messagingFactory.settings.UseSslStreamSecurity && !messagingFactory.settings.SslStreamUpgrade)
				{
					TlsTransportSettings tlsTransportSettings = new TlsTransportSettings(tcpTransportSettings);
					tlsTransportSettings.TargetHost = messagingFactory.settings.SslHostName ?? GetDomainName(connectInfo.HostName);
					tlsTransportSettings.Certificate = messagingFactory.settings.Certificate;
					if (useCustomValidator)
					{
						tlsTransportSettings.CertificateValidationCallback = new CertificateValidator(connectInfo.HostName).ValidateCertificate;
					}
					else
					{
						tlsTransportSettings.CertificateValidationCallback = messagingFactory.settings.CertificateValidationCallback;
					}
					result = tlsTransportSettings;
				}
				return result;
			}

			private TransportSettings CreateWebSocketsTransportSettings(ConnectInfo info, ConnectivityMode mode, bool useCustomValidator)
			{
				string arg;
				int num;
				if (messagingFactory.settings.UseSslStreamSecurity && mode == Microsoft.ServiceBus.ConnectivityMode.Https)
				{
					arg = Uri.UriSchemeHttps;
					num = ((info.Port < 0) ? RelayEnvironment.RelayHttpsPort : info.Port);
				}
				else
				{
					arg = Uri.UriSchemeHttp;
					num = ((info.Port < 0) ? RelayEnvironment.RelayHttpPort : info.Port);
				}
				string uriString = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}://{1}:{2}", arg, info.HostName, num);
				return new Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Amqp.Transport.WebSocketTransportSettings(new Uri(uriString), "AMQPWSB10");
			}
		}

		private sealed class CertificateValidator
		{
			private readonly string hostName;

			public CertificateValidator(string hostName)
			{
				this.hostName = hostName;
			}

			public bool ValidateCertificate(object sender, X509Certificate certificate, X509Chain chain, SslPolicyErrors sslPolicyErrors)
			{
				if (hostName == null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return SecureSocketUtil.CustomizedCertificateValidator(sender, certificate, chain, sslPolicyErrors, GetDomainName(hostName));
			}
		}

		private sealed class CloseAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<CloseAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly AmqpMessagingFactory factory;

			private AmqpConnection amqpConnection;

			public CloseAsyncResult(AmqpMessagingFactory factory, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.factory = factory;
				Start();
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((CloseAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.factory.BaseOnBeginClose(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(CloseAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					thisPtr.factory.BaseOnEndClose(r);
				}, (Call)delegate(CloseAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t)
				{
					thisPtr.factory.BaseClose(t);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
				factory.redirectedConnectInfoCache.Clear();
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((CloseAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.factory.redirectConnectionManager.BeginClose(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(CloseAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					thisPtr.factory.redirectConnectionManager.EndClose(r);
				}, (Call)delegate(CloseAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t)
				{
					thisPtr.factory.redirectConnectionManager.Close(t);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
				if (factory.connection.TryGetOpenedObject(out amqpConnection))
				{
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((CloseAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.amqpConnection.BeginClose(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(CloseAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.amqpConnection.EndClose(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
				}
			}
		}

		internal sealed class ConnectInfo
		{
			private readonly string hostName;

			private readonly string networkHost;

			private readonly int port;

			public string HostName => hostName;

			public string NetworkHost => networkHost;

			public int Port => port;

			public bool Redirected { get; set; }

			public string Path { get; set; }

			public string EndpointUri { get; set; }

			public ConnectInfo(string hostName, string networkHost, int port)
			{
				this.hostName = hostName;
				this.networkHost = networkHost;
				this.port = port;
			}

			public override int GetHashCode()
			{
				return HashCode.CombineHashCodes(hostName.ToUpper(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture).GetHashCode(), networkHost.ToUpper(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture).GetHashCode(), port.GetHashCode());
			}

			public override bool Equals(object obj)
			{
				if (obj == null || !(obj is ConnectInfo))
				{
					return false;
				}
				ConnectInfo connectInfo = (ConnectInfo)obj;
				if (string.Equals(hostName, connectInfo.hostName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) && string.Equals(networkHost, connectInfo.networkHost, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
				{
					return port == connectInfo.port;
				}
				return false;
			}

			public override string ToString()
			{
				if (!string.Equals(hostName, networkHost))
				{
					return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}@{1}:{2}", hostName, networkHost, port);
				}
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}:{1}", hostName, port);
			}
		}

		private sealed class RedirectConnectionManager : SingletonDictionaryManager<ConnectInfo, AmqpConnection>
		{
			private sealed class CloseInstanceAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<CloseInstanceAsyncResult>
			{
				private readonly AmqpConnection connection;

				public CloseInstanceAsyncResult(AmqpConnection connection, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
					: base(timeout, callback, state)
				{
					this.connection = connection;
					Start();
				}

				protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
				{
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((CloseInstanceAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.connection.BeginClose(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(CloseInstanceAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.connection.EndClose(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
				}
			}

			private const string ConnectInfoName = "connect-info";
