			private readonly AmqpMessagingFactory factory;

			public RedirectConnectionManager(AmqpMessagingFactory factory)
			{
				this.factory = factory;
			}

			public IAsyncResult BeginGetConnection(ConnectInfo connectInfo, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{
				return BeginLoadInstance(connectInfo, null, timeout, callback, state);
			}

			public AmqpConnection EndGetConnection(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				return EndLoadInstance(result);
			}

			protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginCreateInstance(SingletonContext singletonContext, ConnectInfo key, object loadingContext, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{
				return new ConnectAsyncResult(factory, key, null, timeout, callback, state);
			}

			protected override AmqpConnection OnEndCreateInstance(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				ConnectInfo info;
				AmqpConnection amqpConnection = ConnectAsyncResult.End(result, out info);
				amqpConnection.UsageMeter = AmqpClientLogger.Default;
				amqpConnection.Settings.AddProperty("connect-info", info);
				amqpConnection.Closed += OnConnectionClosed;
				if (amqpConnection.State != AmqpObjectState.Opened)
				{
					OnConnectionClosed(amqpConnection, EventArgs.Empty);
				}
				if (amqpConnection.State == AmqpObjectState.Opened)
				{
					MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementRedirectedConnectionCount(new Uri(info.EndpointUri), 1);
				}
				return amqpConnection;
			}

			protected override AmqpConnection OnCreateInstance(SingletonContext singletonContext, ConnectInfo key, object loadingContext, TimeSpan timeout)
			{
				IAsyncResult result = OnBeginCreateInstance(singletonContext, key, loadingContext, timeout, null, null);
				return OnEndCreateInstance(result);
			}

			protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginOpenInstance(SingletonContext singletonContext, ConnectInfo key, AmqpConnection instance, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{
				return new CompletedAsyncResult(callback, state);
			}

			protected override void OnEndOpenInstance(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				CompletedAsyncResult.End(result);
			}

			protected override void OnOpenInstance(SingletonContext singletonContext, ConnectInfo key, AmqpConnection instance, TimeSpan timeout)
			{
			}

			protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginCloseInstance(SingletonContext singletonContext, ConnectInfo key, AmqpConnection instance, object unloadingContext, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{
				return new CloseInstanceAsyncResult(instance, timeout, callback, state);
			}

			protected override void OnEndCloseInstance(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				AsyncResult<CloseInstanceAsyncResult>.End(result);
			}

			protected override void OnCloseInstance(SingletonContext singletonContext, ConnectInfo key, AmqpConnection instance, object unloadingContext, TimeSpan timeout)
			{
				instance.Close(timeout);
			}

			protected override void OnAbortInstance(SingletonContext singletonContext, ConnectInfo key, AmqpConnection instance, object unloadingContext)
			{
				instance.Abort();
			}

			private void OnConnectionClosed(object sender, EventArgs e)
			{
				AmqpConnection amqpConnection = (AmqpConnection)sender;
				if (amqpConnection.Settings.Properties != null && ((RestrictedMap<AmqpSymbol>)amqpConnection.Settings.Properties).TryGetValue((AmqpSymbol)"connect-info", out ConnectInfo value))
				{
					if (base.State == CommunicationState.Opened)
					{
						OnTryRemoveSingletonContext(value);
					}
					MessagingPerformanceCounters.DecrementRedirectedConnectionCount(new Uri(value.EndpointUri), 1);
				}
			}
		}

		private sealed class CreateAmqpSessionAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<CreateAmqpSessionAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly AmqpMessagingFactory factory;

			private AmqpConnection amqpConnection;

			private AmqpSession amqpSession;

			public AmqpSession Session => amqpSession;

			public CreateAmqpSessionAsyncResult(AmqpMessagingFactory factory, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.factory = factory;
				Start();
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				if (!factory.connection.TryGetOpenedObject(out amqpConnection))
				{
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((CreateAmqpSessionAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.factory.connection.BeginGetInstance(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(CreateAmqpSessionAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.amqpConnection = thisPtr.factory.connection.EndGetInstance(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
					if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
					{
						Complete(AmqpExceptionHelper.ToMessagingContract(base.LastAsyncStepException, GetEndpoint(factory.connectInfo), connectionError: true));
						yield break;
					}
				}
				try
				{
					AmqpSessionSettings sessionSettings = new AmqpSessionSettings
					{
						Properties = new Fields()
					};
					amqpSession = amqpConnection.CreateSession(sessionSettings);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					Complete(AmqpExceptionHelper.ToMessagingContract(ex, amqpConnection.Settings.RemoteContainerId));
					yield break;
				}
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((CreateAmqpSessionAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.amqpSession.BeginOpen(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(CreateAmqpSessionAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					thisPtr.amqpSession.EndOpen(r);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
				Exception ex2 = base.LastAsyncStepException;
				if (ex2 != null)
				{
					amqpSession.SafeClose();
					Complete(AmqpExceptionHelper.ToMessagingContract(ex2, amqpConnection.Settings.RemoteContainerId));
				}
			}
		}

		private abstract class OpenLinkAsyncResult<T> : IteratorAsyncResult<T> where T : OpenLinkAsyncResult<T>
		{
			private readonly AmqpMessagingFactory factory;

			private readonly ClientEntity clientEntity;

			private readonly MessagingEntityType? entityType;

			private readonly string[] requiredClaims;

			private string entityName;

			private ConnectInfo connectInfo;

			private AmqpConnection amqpConnection;

			private AmqpObject link;

			public ActiveClientLinkObject ActiveClientLink { get; protected set; }

			protected ClientEntity ClientEntity => clientEntity;

			protected ConnectInfo ConnectInfo => connectInfo;

			protected AmqpMessagingFactory Factory => factory;

			protected AmqpConnection Connection => amqpConnection;

			protected string[] RequiredClaims => requiredClaims;

			protected TokenProvider TokenProvider => factory.ServiceBusSecuritySettings.TokenProvider;

			protected AmqpCbsLink CbsLink { get; set; }

			protected DateTime AuthorizationValidToUtc { get; set; }

			protected OpenLinkAsyncResult(AmqpMessagingFactory factory, ClientEntity clientEntity, string entityName, MessagingEntityType? entityType, string[] requiredClaims, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.factory = factory;
				this.clientEntity = clientEntity;
				this.entityName = entityName;
				this.entityType = entityType;
				this.requiredClaims = requiredClaims;
			}

			protected abstract bool ShouldGetToken();

			protected abstract void UpdateLinkSettings(AmqpLinkSettings settings, string address);

			protected abstract AmqpObject CreateAmqpLink(AmqpLinkSettings settings, AmqpSession session);

			protected abstract ActiveClientLinkObject CreateActiveClientLink(AmqpObject link, bool isClientToken);

			protected abstract void HandleRedirectionError(ConnectInfo redirectedConnectInfo);

			protected virtual IEnumerator<AsyncStep> OnLinkAuthorized()
			{
				yield return AsyncStep.Empty;
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				string entityId = null;
				ConnectInfo value = null;
				if (factory.connectInfo != null)
				{
					entityId = GetEntityNameWithPath(factory.connectInfo.Path, entityName);
					if (factory.settings.EnableLinkRedirect && factory.redirectedConnectInfoCache.TryGetValue(entityId, out value))
					{
						connectInfo = value;
						yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((T thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.factory.redirectConnectionManager.BeginGetConnection(thisPtr.connectInfo, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(T thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
						{
							thisPtr.amqpConnection = thisPtr.factory.redirectConnectionManager.EndGetConnection(r);
						}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
						if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null || amqpConnection.IsClosing())
						{
							factory.redirectedConnectInfoCache.TryRemove(entityId, out value);
							connectInfo = null;
						}
					}
				}
				if (connectInfo == null)
				{
					if (!factory.connection.TryGetOpenedObject(out amqpConnection))
					{
						yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((T thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.factory.connection.BeginGetInstance(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(T thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
						{
							thisPtr.amqpConnection = thisPtr.factory.connection.EndGetInstance(r);
						}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
						if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
						{
							Complete(AmqpExceptionHelper.ToMessagingContract(base.LastAsyncStepException, GetEndpoint(factory.connectInfo), connectionError: true));
							yield break;
						}
					}
					entityId = GetEntityNameWithPath(factory.connectInfo.Path, entityName);
					connectInfo = new ConnectInfo(factory.connectInfo.HostName, factory.connectInfo.NetworkHost, factory.connectInfo.Port);
					connectInfo.Path = entityId;
					connectInfo.EndpointUri = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}://{1}/{2}", "amqp", GetDomainName(connectInfo.HostName), entityId);
				}
				AmqpSession session = null;
				while (RemainingTime() > TimeSpan.Zero)
				{
					TimeSpan batchFlushInterval = GetBatchFlushInterval();
					try
					{
						AmqpSessionSettings amqpSessionSettings = new AmqpSessionSettings
						{
							Properties = new Fields()
						};
						amqpSessionSettings.Properties[AmqpClientConstants.BatchFlushIntervalName] = (uint)batchFlushInterval.TotalMilliseconds;
						session = amqpConnection.CreateSession(amqpSessionSettings);
					}
					catch (Exception ex)
					{
						Complete(AmqpExceptionHelper.ToMessagingContract(ex, amqpConnection.Settings.RemoteContainerId, connectionError: true));
						yield break;
					}
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((T thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => session.BeginOpen(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(T thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						session.EndOpen(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
					Exception ex2 = base.LastAsyncStepException;
					if (ex2 != null)
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpOpenEntityFailed(factory, session, string.Empty, entityName, ex2.Message);
						session.SafeClose();
						Complete(AmqpExceptionHelper.ToMessagingContract(ex2, amqpConnection.Settings.RemoteContainerId, connectionError: true));
						yield break;
					}
					bool isClientToken = false;
					AuthorizationValidToUtc = DateTime.MaxValue;
					if (TokenProvider != null && ShouldGetToken() && (connectInfo.Redirected || factory.settings.NetworkCredential == null))
					{
						isClientToken = true;
						CbsLink = amqpConnection.Extensions.Find<AmqpCbsLink>() ?? new AmqpCbsLink(amqpConnection);
						yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((T thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.CbsLink.BeginSendToken(thisPtr.TokenProvider, ServiceBusUriHelper.CreateServiceUri("sb", GetDomainName(thisPtr.connectInfo.HostName), string.Empty), thisPtr.connectInfo.Redirected ? thisPtr.connectInfo.Path : thisPtr.connectInfo.EndpointUri, thisPtr.connectInfo.EndpointUri, thisPtr.requiredClaims, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(T thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
						{
							thisPtr.AuthorizationValidToUtc = thisPtr.CbsLink.EndSendToken(r);
						}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
						ex2 = base.LastAsyncStepException;
						if (ex2 != null)
						{
							session.SafeClose();
							factory.redirectedConnectInfoCache.TryRemove(entityId, out value);
							if (connectInfo.Redirected)
							{
								MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLinkRedirectionFailed(CbsLink.ToString(), connectInfo.EndpointUri, connectInfo.HostName, connectInfo.NetworkHost, connectInfo.Port, ex2.ToString());
							}
							else
							{
								MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpOpenEntityFailed(factory, session, string.Empty, entityId, ex2.Message);
							}
							Complete(AmqpExceptionHelper.ToMessagingContract(ex2, amqpConnection.Settings.RemoteContainerId));
							yield break;
						}
						using (IEnumerator<AsyncStep> asyncStep = OnLinkAuthorized())
						{
							while (asyncStep.MoveNext())
							{
								yield return asyncStep.Current;
							}
						}
						ex2 = base.LastAsyncStepException;
						if (ex2 != null)
						{
							session.SafeClose();
							factory.redirectedConnectInfoCache.TryRemove(entityId, out value);
							if (connectInfo.Redirected)
							{
								MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLinkRedirectionFailed(CbsLink.ToString(), connectInfo.EndpointUri, connectInfo.HostName, connectInfo.NetworkHost, connectInfo.Port, ex2.ToString());
							}
							else
							{
								MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpOpenEntityFailed(factory, session, string.Empty, entityId, ex2.Message);
							}
							Complete(AmqpExceptionHelper.ToMessagingContract(ex2, amqpConnection.Settings.RemoteContainerId));
							yield break;
						}
					}
					AmqpLinkSettings amqpLinkSettings = new AmqpLinkSettings();
					TimeSpan timeSpan = RemainingTime();
					if (timeSpan > NetworkLatencyBuffer)
					{
						timeSpan -= NetworkLatencyBuffer;
					}
					amqpLinkSettings.AddProperty(AmqpClientConstants.TimeoutName, (uint)timeSpan.TotalMilliseconds);
					amqpLinkSettings.AddProperty(AmqpClientConstants.RuntimeEntityDescription.GetRuntimeEntityDescription, true);
					if (entityType.HasValue)
					{
						amqpLinkSettings.AddProperty(AmqpClientConstants.EntityTypeName, (int)entityType.Value);
					}
					try
					{
						UpdateLinkSettings(amqpLinkSettings, connectInfo.Redirected ? connectInfo.Path : entityId);
						link = CreateAmqpLink(amqpLinkSettings, session);
					}
					catch (Exception ex3)
					{
						ex2 = ex3;
					}
					if (ex2 == null)
					{
						yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((T thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.link.BeginOpen(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(T thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
						{
							thisPtr.link.EndOpen(r);
						}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
						ex2 = base.LastAsyncStepException;
					}
					if (ex2 != null)
					{
						session.SafeClose();
						factory.redirectedConnectInfoCache.TryRemove(entityId, out value);
						if (ex2 is AmqpException ex4 && TryGetRedirectConnectInfo(ex4, connectionRedirect: false, connectInfo.EndpointUri, out connectInfo))
						{
							if (Uri.TryCreate(connectInfo.Path, UriKind.Absolute, out var result) && IsAmqpScheme(result.Scheme))
							{
								connectInfo.EndpointUri = connectInfo.Path;
							}
							HandleRedirectionError(connectInfo);
							MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLinkRedirectionBegin(link?.TryGetName(), connectInfo.EndpointUri, connectInfo.HostName, connectInfo.NetworkHost, connectInfo.Port);
							yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((T thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.factory.redirectConnectionManager.BeginGetConnection(thisPtr.connectInfo, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(T thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
							{
								thisPtr.amqpConnection = thisPtr.factory.redirectConnectionManager.EndGetConnection(r);
							}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
							if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
							{
								string remoteContainerId = factory.RemoteContainerId;
								Complete(AmqpExceptionHelper.ToMessagingContract(base.LastAsyncStepException, (remoteContainerId != null) ? (remoteContainerId + ":" + GetEndpoint(connectInfo)) : GetEndpoint(connectInfo), connectionError: true));
								yield break;
							}
							continue;
						}
						if (connectInfo != null && connectInfo.Redirected)
						{
							MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLinkRedirectionFailed(link?.TryGetName(), connectInfo.EndpointUri, connectInfo.HostName, connectInfo.NetworkHost, connectInfo.Port, ex2.ToString());
						}
						else
						{
							MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpOpenEntityFailed(factory, ((object)link) ?? ((object)string.Empty), (link == null) ? string.Empty : link.TryGetName(), entityName, ex2.Message);
						}
						Complete(AmqpExceptionHelper.ToMessagingContract(ex2, amqpConnection.Settings.RemoteContainerId));
						yield break;
					}
					if (connectInfo != null && connectInfo.Redirected)
					{
						factory.redirectedConnectInfoCache[entityId] = connectInfo;
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLinkRedirectionSucceeded(link.TryGetName(), connectInfo.EndpointUri, connectInfo.HostName, connectInfo.NetworkHost, connectInfo.Port);
					}
					else
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpOpenEntitySucceeded(factory, link, link.TryGetName(), entityName);
					}
					ActiveClientLink = CreateActiveClientLink(link, isClientToken);
					yield break;
				}
				if (session != null)
				{
					session.SafeClose();
				}
				Complete(new TimeoutException(SRAmqp.AmqpTimeout(base.OriginalTimeout, entityName)));
			}

			private TimeSpan GetBatchFlushInterval()
			{
				TimeSpan result = TimeSpan.Zero;
				if (clientEntity != null)
				{
					if (clientEntity is MessageSender messageSender)
					{
						result = messageSender.BatchFlushInterval;
					}
					else if (clientEntity is MessageReceiver messageReceiver)
					{
						result = messageReceiver.BatchFlushInterval;
					}
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		private abstract class OpenEntityLinkAsyncResult<T> : OpenLinkAsyncResult<T> where T : OpenLinkAsyncResult<T>
		{
			protected OpenEntityLinkAsyncResult(AmqpMessagingFactory factory, ClientEntity clientEntity, string entityName, MessagingEntityType? entityType, string[] requiredClaims, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(factory, clientEntity, entityName, entityType, requiredClaims, timeout, callback, state)
			{
			}

			protected override bool ShouldGetToken()
			{
				return true;
			}

			protected override AmqpObject CreateAmqpLink(AmqpLinkSettings settings, AmqpSession session)
			{
				AmqpLink amqpLink = (settings.IsReceiver() ? ((AmqpLink)new ReceivingAmqpLink(settings)) : ((AmqpLink)new SendingAmqpLink(settings)));
				settings.LinkName = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0};{1}:{2}:{3}", base.Factory.containerId, base.Connection.Identifier, session.Identifier, amqpLink.Identifier);
				amqpLink.AttachTo(session);
				return amqpLink;
			}

			protected override ActiveClientLinkObject CreateActiveClientLink(AmqpObject link, bool isClientToken)
			{
				return new ActiveClientLink((AmqpLink)link, base.ConnectInfo.Redirected ? base.ConnectInfo.Path : base.ConnectInfo.EndpointUri, base.ConnectInfo.EndpointUri, base.RequiredClaims, isClientToken, base.AuthorizationValidToUtc);
			}

			protected override void HandleRedirectionError(ConnectInfo redirectedConnectInfo)
			{
			}
		}

		private sealed class OpenSendEntityAsyncResult : OpenEntityLinkAsyncResult<OpenSendEntityAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly string transferDestinationEntityName;

			private string transferDestinationEndpointUri;

			public DateTime TransferDestinationAuthorizationValidToUtc { get; set; }

			public OpenSendEntityAsyncResult(AmqpMessagingFactory factory, ClientEntity clientEntity, string entityName, string transferDestinationEntityName, MessagingEntityType? entityType, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(factory, clientEntity, entityName, entityType, new string[1] { "Send" }, timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.transferDestinationEntityName = transferDestinationEntityName;
				Start();
			}

			protected override void UpdateLinkSettings(AmqpLinkSettings settings, string address)
			{
				settings.Role = false;
				settings.InitialDeliveryCount = 0u;
				settings.Target = new Target
				{
					Address = address
				};
				if (base.Factory.settings != null && base.Factory.settings.EnableIdempotentProducer)
				{
					settings.DesiredCapabilities = new Multiple<AmqpSymbol>(new List<AmqpSymbol> { AmqpClientConstants.IdempotentProducer });
					if (base.Factory.settings.ProducerState != null)
					{
						settings.Properties.Add(AmqpClientConstants.ProducerId, base.Factory.settings.ProducerState.Id);
						settings.Properties.Add(AmqpClientConstants.ProducerEpoch, base.Factory.settings.ProducerState.Epoch);
						settings.Properties.Add(AmqpClientConstants.ProducerSequenceNumber, base.Factory.settings.ProducerState.Sequence);
					}
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(transferDestinationEntityName))
				{
					settings.AddProperty(AmqpClientConstants.TransferDestinationAddress, transferDestinationEntityName);
				}
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> OnLinkAuthorized()
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(transferDestinationEntityName))
				{
					transferDestinationEndpointUri = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}://{1}/{2}", "amqp", GetDomainName(base.ConnectInfo.HostName), transferDestinationEntityName);
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((OpenSendEntityAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.CbsLink.BeginSendToken(thisPtr.TokenProvider, ServiceBusUriHelper.CreateServiceUri("sb", GetDomainName(thisPtr.ConnectInfo.HostName), string.Empty), thisPtr.ConnectInfo.Redirected ? thisPtr.transferDestinationEntityName : thisPtr.transferDestinationEndpointUri, thisPtr.transferDestinationEndpointUri, thisPtr.RequiredClaims, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(OpenSendEntityAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.TransferDestinationAuthorizationValidToUtc = thisPtr.CbsLink.EndSendToken(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
				}
				else
				{
					yield return AsyncStep.Empty;
				}
			}
		}

		private sealed class OpenReceiveEntityAsyncResult : OpenEntityLinkAsyncResult<OpenReceiveEntityAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly int prefetchCount;

			private readonly string sessionId;

			private readonly ReceiveMode receiveMode;

			private readonly bool sessionReceiver;

			private readonly IList<AmqpDescribed> filters;

			private readonly long? epoch;

			private readonly long? cacheSizeInBytes;

			private readonly bool browseable;

			private readonly bool enableReceiverMetric;

			private readonly string receiverName;

			public OpenReceiveEntityAsyncResult(AmqpMessagingFactory factory, ClientEntity clientEntity, string entityName, MessagingEntityType? entityType, int prefetchCount, long? cacheSizeInBytes, string sessionId, bool sessionReceiver, bool browseable, ReceiveMode receiveMode, IList<AmqpDescribed> filters, long? epoch, bool enableReceiverMetric, string receiverName, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(factory, clientEntity, entityName, entityType, new string[1] { "Listen" }, timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.prefetchCount = prefetchCount;
				this.sessionId = sessionId;
				this.sessionReceiver = sessionReceiver;
				this.receiveMode = receiveMode;
				this.filters = filters;
				this.epoch = epoch;
				this.cacheSizeInBytes = cacheSizeInBytes;
				this.browseable = browseable;
				this.enableReceiverMetric = enableReceiverMetric;
				this.receiverName = receiverName;
			}

			protected override void UpdateLinkSettings(AmqpLinkSettings settings, string address)
			{
				FilterSet filterSet = null;
				if (sessionReceiver)
				{
					filterSet = new FilterSet { 
					{
						AmqpClientConstants.SessionFilterName,
						sessionId
					} };
				}
				if (filters != null && filters.Count > 0)
				{
					if (filterSet == null)
					{
						filterSet = new FilterSet();
					}
					foreach (AmqpDescribed filter in filters)
					{
						filterSet.Add(filter.DescriptorName, filter);
					}
				}
				if (base.Factory.settings.EnableLinkRedirect)
				{
					settings.DesiredCapabilities = new Multiple<AmqpSymbol>(new List<AmqpSymbol> { AmqpErrorCode.LinkRedirect });
				}
				if (enableReceiverMetric)
				{
					if (settings.DesiredCapabilities != null)
					{
						settings.DesiredCapabilities.Add(AmqpClientConstants.EnableReceiverRuntimeMetricName);
					}
					else
					{
						settings.DesiredCapabilities = new Multiple<AmqpSymbol>(new List<AmqpSymbol> { AmqpClientConstants.EnableReceiverRuntimeMetricName });
					}
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(receiverName))
				{
					settings.AddProperty(AmqpClientConstants.ReceiverName, receiverName);
				}
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLinkRedirectClientSetting(base.Factory.Address.ToString(), base.Factory.settings.EnableLinkRedirect, base.Factory.settings.RedirectionSetting.ToString());
				settings.Role = true;
				settings.TotalLinkCredit = (uint)prefetchCount;
				settings.TotalCacheSizeInBytes = cacheSizeInBytes;
				settings.AutoSendFlow = prefetchCount > 0 && !cacheSizeInBytes.HasValue;
				settings.Source = new Source
				{
					Address = address,
					FilterSet = filterSet
				};
				settings.SettleType = ((receiveMode == ReceiveMode.PeekLock) ? SettleMode.SettleOnDispose : SettleMode.SettleOnSend);
				if (epoch.HasValue)
				{
					settings.AddProperty(AmqpClientConstants.AttachEpoch, epoch);
				}
				if (browseable)
				{
					settings.AddProperty(AmqpClientConstants.PeekMode, browseable);
				}
			}
		}

		private sealed class AcceptSessionReceiverAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<AcceptSessionReceiverAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly AmqpMessagingFactory factory;

			private readonly bool browsable;

			private AmqpMessageReceiver receiver;

			private AmqpMessageSession messageSession;

			public MessageSession MessageSession => messageSession;

			public AcceptSessionReceiverAsyncResult(AmqpMessagingFactory factory, string entityName, MessagingEntityType? entityType, string sessionId, RetryPolicy retryPolicy, ReceiveMode receiveMode, int prefetchCount, bool browsable, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.factory = factory;
				this.browsable = browsable;
				receiver = new AmqpMessageReceiver(this.factory, entityName, entityType, sessionId, retryPolicy, receiveMode, prefetchCount, browsable);
				Start();
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((AcceptSessionReceiverAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.receiver.BeginOpen(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(AcceptSessionReceiverAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					thisPtr.receiver.EndOpen(r);
				}, (Call)delegate(AcceptSessionReceiverAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t)
				{
					thisPtr.receiver.Open(t);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
				Exception ex = base.LastAsyncStepException;
				if (ex != null)
				{
					receiver.Abort();
					Complete(AmqpExceptionHelper.ToMessagingContract(ex, factory.RemoteContainerId));
				}
				else
				{
					messageSession = new AmqpMessageSession(receiver.Mode, receiver.SessionId, receiver.LockedUntilUtc, receiver);
				}
			}
		}

		private sealed class OpenIoTManagementRequestResponseLinkAsyncResult : OpenRequestResponseLinkAsyncResult
		{
			private string redirectedEntityName;

			public OpenIoTManagementRequestResponseLinkAsyncResult(AmqpMessagingFactory factory, string address, MessagingEntityType? entityType, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base("iot-mgmt", factory, address, entityType, new string[2] { "Listen", "Manage" }, timeout, callback, state)
			{
			}

			protected override bool ShouldGetToken()
			{
				if (base.ConnectInfo.Redirected)
				{
					if (redirectedEntityName == null)
					{
						UriBuilder uriBuilder = new UriBuilder(base.ConnectInfo.Path);
						redirectedEntityName = uriBuilder.Path.Trim('/').Replace("/$management", string.Empty);
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}

			protected override AmqpObject CreateAmqpLink(AmqpLinkSettings settings, AmqpSession session)
			{
				RequestResponseAmqpLink requestResponseAmqpLink = (RequestResponseAmqpLink)base.CreateAmqpLink(settings, session);
				if (base.ConnectInfo.Redirected && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(redirectedEntityName))
				{
					requestResponseAmqpLink.RequestProperties["name"] = redirectedEntityName;
				}
				return requestResponseAmqpLink;
			}

			protected override void UpdateLinkSettings(AmqpLinkSettings settings, string address)
			{
				if (base.ConnectInfo.Redirected && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(redirectedEntityName))
				{
					base.NodeName = "$management";
				}
			}

			protected override void HandleRedirectionError(ConnectInfo redirectedConnectInfo)
			{
				UriBuilder uriBuilder = new UriBuilder(redirectedConnectInfo.Path);
				redirectedEntityName = uriBuilder.Path.Trim('/').Replace("/$management", string.Empty);
				uriBuilder.Path = "$management";
				redirectedConnectInfo.EndpointUri = uriBuilder.Uri.AbsoluteUri;
			}
		}

		private sealed class OpenSendEntityRequestResponseLinkAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<OpenSendEntityRequestResponseLinkAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly AmqpMessagingFactory factory;

			private readonly FaultTolerantObject<SendingAmqpLink> sendLink;

			private readonly string entityName;

			private readonly MessagingEntityType? entityType;

			private readonly string[] requiredClaims;

			private string address;

			private string transferDestinationEntityName;

			private SendingAmqpLink link;

			public ActiveClientRequestResponseLink ActiveClientLink { get; private set; }

			public OpenSendEntityRequestResponseLinkAsyncResult(AmqpMessagingFactory factory, FaultTolerantObject<SendingAmqpLink> sendLink, string entityName, string transferDestinationEntityName, MessagingEntityType? entityType, string[] requiredClaims, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.factory = factory;
				this.sendLink = sendLink;
				this.entityName = entityName;
				this.transferDestinationEntityName = transferDestinationEntityName;
				this.entityType = entityType;
				this.requiredClaims = requiredClaims;
				Start();
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				if (!sendLink.TryGetOpenedObject(out link))
				{
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((OpenSendEntityRequestResponseLinkAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.sendLink.BeginGetInstance(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(OpenSendEntityRequestResponseLinkAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.link = thisPtr.sendLink.EndGetInstance(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Continue);
					if (base.LastAsyncStepException != null)
					{
						base.LastAsyncStepException = AmqpExceptionHelper.GetClientException(base.LastAsyncStepException, factory.RemoteContainerId);
						Complete(base.LastAsyncStepException);
						yield break;
					}
				}
				address = entityName.TrimEnd('/') + "/$management";
				if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(transferDestinationEntityName))
				{
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((OpenSendEntityRequestResponseLinkAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.factory.BeginOpenRequestResponseLink("entity-mgmt", thisPtr.address, thisPtr.entityType, thisPtr.requiredClaims, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(OpenSendEntityRequestResponseLinkAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.ActiveClientLink = thisPtr.factory.EndOpenRequestResponseLink(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
				}
				else
				{
					yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((OpenSendEntityRequestResponseLinkAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.factory.BeginOpenSendViaRequestResponseLink("entity-mgmt", thisPtr.address, thisPtr.transferDestinationEntityName, thisPtr.entityType, thisPtr.requiredClaims, t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(OpenSendEntityRequestResponseLinkAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
					{
						thisPtr.ActiveClientLink = thisPtr.factory.EndOpenRequestResponseLink(r);
					}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
				}
			}
		}

		private sealed class AmqpClientLogger : AmqpLogger
		{
			private const long LoggingDurationTicksThreshold = 600000000L;

			public static readonly AmqpClientLogger Default = new AmqpClientLogger();

			public override TimeSpan Elapsed => TimeSpan.Zero;

			public AmqpClientLogger()
				: base(600000000L)
			{
			}

			public override void OnRead(AmqpConnection connection, ulong frameCode, int numberOfBytes)
			{
				base.OnRead(connection, frameCode, numberOfBytes);
				MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementNamespaceEgressRate(connection.Settings.HostName, numberOfBytes);
			}

			public override void OnWrite(AmqpConnection connection, ulong frameCode, int numberOfBytes)
			{
				base.OnWrite(connection, frameCode, numberOfBytes);
				MessagingPerformanceCounters.IncrementNamespaceIngressRate(connection.Settings.HostName, numberOfBytes);
			}

			protected override void WriteMetrics(AmqpConnection connection, string op, long duration, int bytes, string metricDetails)
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpConnectionMetrics(connection, connection.Settings.HostName, op, duration, bytes, metricDetails);
			}
		}

		private static readonly TimeSpan MinConnectionResetThreshold;

		private static readonly TimeSpan NetworkLatencyBuffer;

		private readonly List<Uri> addresses;

		private readonly string containerId;

		private readonly AmqpTransportSettings settings;

		private readonly FaultTolerantObject<AmqpConnection> connection;

		private readonly RedirectConnectionManager redirectConnectionManager;

		private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string, ConnectInfo> redirectedConnectInfoCache;

		private ConnectInfo connectInfo;

		private AmqpServiceClient<IAmqpEntityManagement> managementServiceClient;

		private long connectionResetCount;

		private DateTime lastConnectionResetTime;

		private object connectionResetLock;

		public FaultTolerantObject<Controller> Controller { get; }

		internal AmqpTransportSettings TransportSettings => settings;

		internal IDictionary<string, ConnectInfo> RedirectedConnectInfoCache => redirectedConnectInfoCache;

		internal bool DirectMode => settings.DirectMode;

		internal override IServiceBusSecuritySettings ServiceBusSecuritySettings => settings;

		internal FaultTolerantObject<AmqpConnection> Connection => connection;

		internal string RemoteContainerId => connection.UnsafeInnerObject?.Settings.RemoteContainerId;

		internal AmqpTransactionManager TransactionManager { get; private set; }

		internal long TestConnectionResetCount => connectionResetCount;

		internal TimeSpan? TestMinConnectionResetThreshold { get; set; }

		internal HashSet<string> RedirectedEntities => new HashSet<string>(redirectedConnectInfoCache.Keys, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

		static AmqpMessagingFactory()
		{
			MinConnectionResetThreshold = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5.0);
			NetworkLatencyBuffer = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(200.0);
			AmqpCodec.RegisterKnownTypes(AmqpSqlFilter.Name, AmqpSqlFilter.Code, () => new AmqpSqlFilter());
			AmqpCodec.RegisterKnownTypes(AmqpTrueFilter.Name, AmqpTrueFilter.Code, () => new AmqpTrueFilter());
			AmqpCodec.RegisterKnownTypes(AmqpFalseFilter.Name, AmqpFalseFilter.Code, () => new AmqpFalseFilter());
			AmqpCodec.RegisterKnownTypes(AmqpCorrelationFilter.Name, AmqpCorrelationFilter.Code, () => new AmqpCorrelationFilter());
			AmqpCodec.RegisterKnownTypes(AmqpRuleDescription.Name, AmqpRuleDescription.Code, () => new AmqpRuleDescription());
			AmqpCodec.RegisterKnownTypes(AmqpEmptyRuleAction.Name, AmqpEmptyRuleAction.Code, () => new AmqpEmptyRuleAction());
			AmqpCodec.RegisterKnownTypes(AmqpSqlRuleAction.Name, AmqpSqlRuleAction.Code, () => new AmqpSqlRuleAction());
			AmqpCodec.RegisterKnownTypes(AmqpSelectorFilter.Name, AmqpSelectorFilter.Code, () => new AmqpSelectorFilter(string.Empty));
			AmqpCodec.RegisterKnownTypes(JmsSelectorFilter.Name, JmsSelectorFilter.Code, () => new JmsSelectorFilter(string.Empty));
			AmqpCodec.RegisterKnownTypes(AmqpSessionFilter.Name, AmqpSessionFilter.Code, () => new AmqpSessionFilter(string.Empty));
		}

		public AmqpMessagingFactory(IEnumerable<Uri> baseAddresses, AmqpTransportSettings settings)
		{
			containerId = settings.AmqpContainerId ?? Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N");
			connection = new FaultTolerantObject<AmqpConnection>(this, CloseConnection, BeginCreateConnection, EndCreateConnection);
			redirectConnectionManager = new RedirectConnectionManager(this);
			this.settings = settings;
			PrefetchCount = 0;
			addresses = new List<Uri>();
			lastConnectionResetTime = DateTime.MinValue;
			connectionResetCount = 0L;
			connectionResetLock = new object();
			redirectedConnectInfoCache = new ConcurrentDictionary<string, ConnectInfo>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
			Controller = new FaultTolerantObject<Controller>(this, CloseController, BeginCreateController, EndCreateController);
			foreach (Uri baseAddress in baseAddresses)
			{
				if (base.Address == null)
				{
					base.Address = baseAddress;
				}
				UriBuilder uriBuilder = new UriBuilder(baseAddress);
				if (!settings.DirectMode && string.Compare(uriBuilder.Scheme, "sb", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) != 0)
				{
					throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new ArgumentException(SR.GetString(Resources.InvalidUriScheme, uriBuilder.Scheme, "sb")));
				}
				MessagingUtilities.EnsureTrailingSlash(uriBuilder);
				addresses.Add(uriBuilder.Uri);
			}
			base.Address = addresses[0];
			TransactionManager = AmqpTransactionManager.Instance;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "factory";
		}

		internal IAsyncResult BeginOpenEntity(ClientEntity clientEntity, string entityName, string transferDestinationEntityName, MessagingEntityType? entityType, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new OpenSendEntityAsyncResult(this, clientEntity, entityName, transferDestinationEntityName, entityType, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		public override void ResetConnection()
		{
			ResetConnection(base.Address);
		}

		internal AmqpServiceClient<T> CreateServiceClient<T>(string address)
		{
			return new AmqpServiceClient<T>(this, address);
		}

		internal AmqpServiceClient<IAmqpEntityManagement> GetManagementServiceClient(string address)
		{
			if (managementServiceClient == null)
			{
				lock (base.ThisLock)
				{
					if (managementServiceClient == null)
					{
						managementServiceClient = new AmqpServiceClient<IAmqpEntityManagement>(this, address);
					}
				}
			}
			return managementServiceClient;
		}

		internal IAsyncResult BeginCreateAmqpSession(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new CreateAmqpSessionAsyncResult(this, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		internal AmqpSession EndCreateAmqpSession(IAsyncResult result)
		{

		internal void TestSetRedirectedContainerId(string entityPath, int redirectContainerId)
		{
			if (!RedirectedEntities.Contains(entityPath))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException($"Entity: {entityPath}, not found in redirected entities list");
			}
			string key = RedirectedEntities.First((string s) => s.Equals(entityPath, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
			ConnectInfo connectInfo = redirectedConnectInfoCache[key];
			string hostName = connectInfo.HostName;
			hostName = hostName.Substring(0, hostName.IndexOf(':'));
			hostName = hostName + ':' + redirectContainerId.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			redirectedConnectInfoCache[key] = new ConnectInfo(hostName, connectInfo.NetworkHost, connectInfo.Port)
			{
				EndpointUri = connectInfo.EndpointUri,
				Redirected = connectInfo.Redirected
			};
		}

		internal override void ResetConnection(Uri endpoint)
		{
			DateTime utcNow = DateTime.UtcNow;
			TimeSpan timeSpan = TestMinConnectionResetThreshold ?? MinConnectionResetThreshold;
			if (!(utcNow - lastConnectionResetTime >= timeSpan))
			{
				return;
			}
			lock (connectionResetLock)
			{
				if (utcNow - lastConnectionResetTime >= timeSpan && connection.TryGetOpenedObject(out var obj) && obj != null)
				{
					lastConnectionResetTime = utcNow;
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogOperation(this, TraceOperation.ResetConnection, obj.Identifier);
					connectionResetCount++;
					IncrementConnectionResetCount(endpoint);
					obj.SafeClose();
				}
			}
		}

		internal static string GetDomainName(string hostName)
		{
			string text = hostName;
			int num = text.IndexOf(':');
			if (num > 0)
			{
				text = text.Substring(0, num);
			}
			return text;
		}

		private static bool IsAmqpScheme(string scheme)
		{
			if (!string.Equals(scheme, "amqp", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				return string.Equals(scheme, "amqps", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static string GetEntityNameWithPath(string path, string entityName)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path))
			{
				return path + entityName;
			}
			return entityName;
		}

		private static string GetEndpoint(ConnectInfo info)
		{
			if (info != null)
			{
				return string.Join(":", info.NetworkHost, info.Port);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static bool TryGetRedirectConnectInfo(Exception exception, bool connectionRedirect, string audience, out ConnectInfo connectInfo)
		{
			if (exception is AmqpException ex && ((connectionRedirect && ex.Error.Condition.Equals(AmqpErrorCode.ConnectionRedirect)) || (!connectionRedirect && ex.Error.Condition.Equals(AmqpErrorCode.LinkRedirect))))
			{
				Fields info = ex.Error.Info;
				string value = null;
				string value2 = null;
				int value3 = -1;
				string value4 = null;
				if (info != null)
				{
					info.TryGetValue<string>(AmqpConstants.HostName, out value);
					info.TryGetValue<string>(AmqpConstants.NetworkHost, out value2);
					info.TryGetValue<int>(AmqpConstants.Port, out value3);
					info.TryGetValue<string>(AmqpConstants.Address, out value4);
				}
				if (value != null && value2 != null && value3 > 0 && (connectionRedirect || value4 != null))
				{
					connectInfo = new ConnectInfo(value, value2, value3);
					connectInfo.Redirected = true;
					connectInfo.Path = value4;
					connectInfo.EndpointUri = audience;
					return true;
				}
			}
			connectInfo = null;
			return false;
		}
	}

		{
		}

		{

			clientControlLinkManager.Close();
			base.OnClosed();
		}

		protected override void OnFaulted()
		{

			clientControlLinkManager.SetActiveLink(activeClientRequestResponseLink);
			return activeClientRequestResponseLink.Link;
		}

		private void CloseRequestResponseLink()
		{

				CloseRequestResponseLink(obj);
			}
		}

		{

		}

		{
			private readonly RuleDescription description;

			public AddRuleControlRequestAsyncResult(AmqpSubscriptionClient amqpSubscriptionClient, RuleDescription description, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(amqpSubscriptionClient.RequestResponseLink, amqpSubscriptionClient.AmqpMessagingFactory, timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.description = description;
				Start();
			}

			protected override AmqpMessage CreateRequestMessage()
			{
				AmqpRequestMessage amqpRequestMessage = AmqpRequestMessage.CreateRequest("com.microsoft:add-rule", RemainingTime(), null);
				amqpRequestMessage.Map[ManagementConstants.Properties.RuleName] = description.Name;
				amqpRequestMessage.Map[ManagementConstants.Properties.RuleDescription] = AmqpMessageConverter.GetRuleDescriptionMap(description);
				return amqpRequestMessage.RequestMessage;
			}

			protected override void ProcessResponseMessage(AmqpMessage responseMessage)
			{
				AmqpResponseMessage amqpResponseMessage = AmqpResponseMessage.CreateResponse(responseMessage);
				if (amqpResponseMessage.StatusCode != AmqpResponseStatusCode.OK)
				{
					Complete(amqpResponseMessage.ToMessagingContractException());
				}
			}
		}

				: base(amqpSubscriptionClient.RequestResponseLink, amqpSubscriptionClient.AmqpMessagingFactory, timeout, callback, state)

				amqpRequestMessage.Map[ManagementConstants.Properties.RuleName] = ruleName;
				return amqpRequestMessage.RequestMessage;
			}

			protected override void ProcessResponseMessage(AmqpMessage responseMessage)
			{
				AmqpResponseMessage amqpResponseMessage = AmqpResponseMessage.CreateResponse(responseMessage);

				{
					Complete(amqpResponseMessage.ToMessagingContractException());
				}
			}
		}

		private sealed class GetRulesControlRequestAsyncResult : AmqpControlRequestAsyncResult
		{
			private readonly int top;

			private readonly int skip;

			private List<RuleDescription> rules;

			public GetRulesControlRequestAsyncResult(AmqpSubscriptionClient amqpSubscriptionClient, int top, int skip, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(amqpSubscriptionClient.RequestResponseLink, amqpSubscriptionClient.AmqpMessagingFactory, timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.top = top;
				this.skip = skip;
				Start();
			}

			protected override AmqpMessage CreateRequestMessage()
			{
				AmqpRequestMessage amqpRequestMessage = AmqpRequestMessage.CreateRequest("com.microsoft:enumerate-rules", RemainingTime(), null);
				amqpRequestMessage.Map[ManagementConstants.Properties.Top] = top;
				amqpRequestMessage.Map[ManagementConstants.Properties.Skip] = skip;
				return amqpRequestMessage.RequestMessage;
			}

			protected override void ProcessResponseMessage(AmqpMessage responseMessage)
			{
				AmqpResponseMessage amqpResponseMessage = AmqpResponseMessage.CreateResponse(responseMessage);
				try
				{
					if (amqpResponseMessage.StatusCode == AmqpResponseStatusCode.OK)
					{
						IEnumerable<AmqpMap> listValue = amqpResponseMessage.GetListValue<AmqpMap>(ManagementConstants.Properties.Rules);
						rules = new List<RuleDescription>();
						{
							foreach (AmqpMap item in listValue)
							{
								AmqpRuleDescription amqpDescription = (AmqpRuleDescription)item[ManagementConstants.Properties.RuleDescription];
								RuleDescription ruleDescription = AmqpMessageConverter.GetRuleDescription(amqpDescription);
								rules.Add(ruleDescription);
							}
							return;
						}
					}
					if (amqpResponseMessage.StatusCode == AmqpResponseStatusCode.NoContent)
					{
						rules = new List<RuleDescription>();
					}
					else
					{
						Complete(amqpResponseMessage.ToMessagingContractException());
					}
				}
				catch (Exception value)
				{
					Console.WriteLine(value);
				}
			}

			public new static IEnumerable<RuleDescription> End(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				GetRulesControlRequestAsyncResult getRulesControlRequestAsyncResult = (GetRulesControlRequestAsyncResult)result;
				AsyncResult<AmqpControlRequestAsyncResult>.End(result);
				return getRulesControlRequestAsyncResult.rules;
			}
		}

		private sealed class CloseAsyncResult : IteratorAsyncResult<CloseAsyncResult>
		{
			private readonly AmqpSubscriptionClient client;

			public CloseAsyncResult(AmqpSubscriptionClient client, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.client = client;
				Start();
			}

			protected override IEnumerator<AsyncStep> GetAsyncSteps()
			{
				yield return CallAsync((BeginCall)((CloseAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => thisPtr.client.BaseOnBeginClose(t, c, s)), (EndCall)delegate(CloseAsyncResult thisPtr, IAsyncResult r)
				{
					thisPtr.client.BaseOnEndClose(r);
				}, (Call)delegate(CloseAsyncResult thisPtr, TimeSpan t)
				{
					thisPtr.client.BaseOnClose(t);
				}, ExceptionPolicy.Transfer);
			}
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginCreateReceiver(string subQueuePath, string subQueueName, ReceiveMode receiveMode, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new CompletedAsyncResult<AmqpMessageReceiver>(new AmqpMessageReceiver(amqpMessagingFactory, base.SubscriptionPath, MessagingEntityType.Subscriber, base.RetryPolicy, receiveMode, amqpMessagingFactory.PrefetchCount), callback, state);
		}

		protected override MessageReceiver OnEndCreateReceiver(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			return CompletedAsyncResult<AmqpMessageReceiver>.End(result);
		}

		internal override IAsyncResult OnBeginCreateBrowser(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new CompletedAsyncResult<AmqpMessageBrowser>(new AmqpMessageBrowser(amqpMessagingFactory, base.SubscriptionPath, MessagingEntityType.Subscriber, base.RetryPolicy), callback, state);
		}

		internal override MessageBrowser OnEndCreateBrowser(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			return CompletedAsyncResult<AmqpMessageBrowser>.End(result);
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginAcceptMessageSession(string sessionId, ReceiveMode receiveMode, bool isExclusiveMode, Guid? lockToken, TimeSpan serverWaitTime, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			if (!isExclusiveMode)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException("BR0012" + SRClient.NotSupportedNoneExclusiveSessionMode);
			}
			return amqpMessagingFactory.BeginAcceptSessionInternal(base.SubscriptionPath, MessagingEntityType.Subscriber, sessionId, base.RetryPolicy, receiveMode, base.PrefetchCount, browsable: false, serverWaitTime, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		protected override MessageSession OnEndAcceptMessageSession(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			return amqpMessagingFactory.EndAcceptSessionInternal(result);
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginGetMessageSessions(DateTime lastUpdatedTime, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new AmqpGetMessageSessionsAsyncResult(RequestResponseLink, AmqpMessagingFactory, base.SubscriptionPath, MessagingEntityType.Subscriber, lastUpdatedTime, base.RetryPolicy, OperationTimeout, callback, state);
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<MessageSession> OnEndGetMessageSessions(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			return AmqpGetMessageSessionsAsyncResult.End(result);
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginAddRule(RuleDescription description, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new AddRuleControlRequestAsyncResult(this, description, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		protected override void OnEndAddRule(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			AsyncResult<AmqpControlRequestAsyncResult>.End(result);
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginRemoveRule(string ruleName, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new RemoveRuleControlRequestAsyncResult(this, ruleName, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		protected override void OnEndRemoveRule(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			AsyncResult<AmqpControlRequestAsyncResult>.End(result);
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginRemoveRulesByTag(string tag, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		protected override void OnEndRemoveRules(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginGetRules(int top, int skip, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new GetRulesControlRequestAsyncResult(this, top, skip, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<RuleDescription> OnEndGetRules(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			return GetRulesControlRequestAsyncResult.End(result);
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginOpen(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new CompletedAsyncResult(callback, state);
		}

		protected override void OnEndOpen(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			CompletedAsyncResult.End(result);
		}

		protected override void OnOpen(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new CloseAsyncResult(this, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		protected override void OnEndClose(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			AsyncResult<CloseAsyncResult>.End(result);
			clientControlLinkManager.Close();
		}

		protected override void OnClosed()
		{
			CloseRequestResponseLink();
			base.OnClosed();
		}

		protected override void OnFaulted()
		{
			CloseRequestResponseLink();
			base.OnFaulted();
		}

		protected override void OnAbort()
		{
			CloseRequestResponseLink();
			clientControlLinkManager.Close();
			base.OnAbort();
		}

		protected override void OnClose(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			AsyncResult<CloseAsyncResult>.End(new CloseAsyncResult(this, timeout, null, null));
		}

		private IAsyncResult BeginCreateEntityControlRequestResponseLink(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return amqpMessagingFactory.BeginOpenEntityControlRequestResponseLink(base.SubscriptionPath, MessagingEntityType.Subscriber, RequiredClaims, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		private RequestResponseAmqpLink EndCreateEntityControlRequestResponseLink(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			ActiveClientRequestResponseLink activeClientRequestResponseLink = amqpMessagingFactory.EndOpenEntityControlRequestResponseLink(result);
			clientControlLinkManager.SetActiveLink(activeClientRequestResponseLink);
			return activeClientRequestResponseLink.Link;
		}

		private void CloseRequestResponseLink()
		{
			if (controlRequestResponseLink.TryGetOpenedObject(out var obj))
			{
				CloseRequestResponseLink(obj);
			}
		}

		private void CloseRequestResponseLink(RequestResponseAmqpLink link)
		{
			link.Session.SafeClose();
		}

		private IAsyncResult BaseOnBeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return base.OnBeginClose(timeout, callback, state);
		}

		private void BaseOnEndClose(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			base.OnEndClose(result);
		}

		private void BaseOnClose(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			base.OnClose(timeout);
		}
	}

	public sealed class AmqpTransportSettings : ITransportSettings, IServiceBusSecuritySettings
	{
		private int maxFrameSize;

		private bool sslStreamUpgrade;

		private TimeSpan batchFlushInterval;

		private bool? useWebSocket;

		internal int ContinousErrorCount;

		public bool UseSslStreamSecurity { get; set; }

		public int MaxFrameSize
		{
			get
			{
				return maxFrameSize;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value < 512)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
				}
				maxFrameSize = value;
			}
		}

		public TimeSpan BatchFlushInterval
		{
			get
			{
				return batchFlushInterval;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value < TimeSpan.Zero)
				{
					throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentOutOfRange("BatchFlushInterval", value, SRClient.InvalidBatchFlushInterval);
				}
				batchFlushInterval = value;
			}
		}

		public bool EnableReceiverRuntimeMetric { get; set; }

		public bool EnableLinkRedirect
		{
			get
			{
				if (RedirectionSetting != AmqpRedirectionSetting.DefaultEnabled)
				{
					return RedirectionSetting == AmqpRedirectionSetting.ExplicitEnabled;
				}
				return true;
			}
			set
			{
				RedirectionSetting = (value ? AmqpRedirectionSetting.ExplicitEnabled : AmqpRedirectionSetting.Disabled);
			}
		}

		internal bool SslStreamUpgrade
		{
			get
			{
				return sslStreamUpgrade;
			}
			set
			{
				sslStreamUpgrade = value;
				if (sslStreamUpgrade)
				{
					UseSslStreamSecurity = true;
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool EnableIdempotentProducer { get; set; }

		internal IdempotentProducerState ProducerState { get; set; }

		internal NetworkCredential NetworkCredential { get; set; }

		internal RemoteCertificateValidationCallback CertificateValidationCallback { get; set; }

		internal X509Certificate2 Certificate { get; set; }

		internal Version AmqpVersion { get; set; }

		internal bool DirectMode { get; set; }

		internal string OpenHostName { get; set; }

		internal string SslHostName { get; set; }

		internal string AmqpContainerId { get; set; }

		internal int DefaultPort
		{
			get
			{
				if (!UseSslStreamSecurity || SslStreamUpgrade)
				{
					return 5672;
				}
				return 5671;
			}
		}

		internal bool UseWebSockets
		{
			get
			{
				if (useWebSocket.HasValue)
				{
					return useWebSocket.Value;
				}
				if (ServiceBusEnvironment.SystemConnectivity.Mode != ConnectivityMode.Http)
				{
					return ServiceBusEnvironment.SystemConnectivity.Mode == ConnectivityMode.Https;
				}
				return true;
			}
			set
			{
				useWebSocket = value;
			}
		}

		internal AmqpRedirectionSetting RedirectionSetting { get; private set; }

		TokenProvider IServiceBusSecuritySettings.TokenProvider { get; set; }

		public AmqpTransportSettings()
		{
			AmqpVersion = new Version(1, 0, 0, 0);
			UseSslStreamSecurity = true;
			MaxFrameSize = 65536;
			batchFlushInterval = Constants.DefaultBatchFlushInterval;
			RedirectionSetting = AmqpRedirectionSetting.DefaultEnabled;
		}

		public object Clone()
		{
			AmqpTransportSettings amqpTransportSettings = new AmqpTransportSettings();
			amqpTransportSettings.BatchFlushInterval = batchFlushInterval;
			((IServiceBusSecuritySettings)amqpTransportSettings).TokenProvider = ((IServiceBusSecuritySettings)this).TokenProvider;
			amqpTransportSettings.UseSslStreamSecurity = UseSslStreamSecurity;
			amqpTransportSettings.sslStreamUpgrade = sslStreamUpgrade;
			amqpTransportSettings.NetworkCredential = NetworkCredential;
			amqpTransportSettings.CertificateValidationCallback = CertificateValidationCallback;
			amqpTransportSettings.Certificate = Certificate;
			amqpTransportSettings.AmqpVersion = AmqpVersion;
			amqpTransportSettings.MaxFrameSize = MaxFrameSize;
			amqpTransportSettings.DirectMode = DirectMode;
			amqpTransportSettings.OpenHostName = OpenHostName;
			amqpTransportSettings.SslHostName = SslHostName;
			amqpTransportSettings.AmqpContainerId = AmqpContainerId;
			amqpTransportSettings.RedirectionSetting = RedirectionSetting;
			amqpTransportSettings.useWebSocket = useWebSocket;
			amqpTransportSettings.EnableReceiverRuntimeMetric = EnableReceiverRuntimeMetric;
			amqpTransportSettings.EnableIdempotentProducer = EnableIdempotentProducer;
			if (ProducerState != null)
			{
				amqpTransportSettings.ProducerState = new IdempotentProducerState
				{
					Id = ProducerState.Id,
					Epoch = ProducerState.Epoch,
					Sequence = ProducerState.Sequence
				};
			}
			return amqpTransportSettings;
		}

		internal AmqpSettings CreateAmqpSettings(string sslHostName, int maxFrameSize, bool forceTokenProvider)
		{
			AmqpSettings amqpSettings = new AmqpSettings();
			if (UseSslStreamSecurity && !UseWebSockets && SslStreamUpgrade)
			{
				TlsTransportSettings tlsTransportSettings = new TlsTransportSettings();
				tlsTransportSettings.CertificateValidationCallback = CertificateValidationCallback;
				tlsTransportSettings.TargetHost = sslHostName;
				TlsTransportProvider tlsTransportProvider = new TlsTransportProvider(tlsTransportSettings);
				tlsTransportProvider.Versions.Add(new AmqpVersion(1, 0, 0));
				amqpSettings.TransportProviders.Add(tlsTransportProvider);
			}
			if (((IServiceBusSecuritySettings)this).TokenProvider != null || NetworkCredential != null)
			{
				SaslTransportProvider saslTransportProvider = new SaslTransportProvider();
				saslTransportProvider.MaxFrameSize = maxFrameSize;
				saslTransportProvider.Versions.Add(new AmqpVersion(1, 0, 0));
				amqpSettings.TransportProviders.Add(saslTransportProvider);
				if (forceTokenProvider)
				{
					saslTransportProvider.AddHandler(new SaslAnonymousHandler("MSSBCBS"));
				}
				else if (NetworkCredential != null)
				{
					SaslPlainHandler saslPlainHandler = new SaslPlainHandler();
					saslPlainHandler.AuthenticationIdentity = NetworkCredential.UserName;
					saslPlainHandler.Password = NetworkCredential.Password;
					saslTransportProvider.AddHandler(saslPlainHandler);
				}
				else
				{
					saslTransportProvider.AddHandler(new SaslExternalHandler());
				}
			}
			AmqpTransportProvider amqpTransportProvider = new AmqpTransportProvider();
			amqpTransportProvider.Versions.Add(new AmqpVersion(AmqpVersion));
			amqpSettings.TransportProviders.Add(amqpTransportProvider);
			return amqpSettings;
		}

		IAsyncResult ITransportSettings.BeginCreateFactory(IEnumerable<Uri> physicalUriAddresses, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			MessagingFactory data = new AmqpMessagingFactory(physicalUriAddresses, this);
			return new CompletedAsyncResult<MessagingFactory>(data, callback, state);
		}

		MessagingFactory ITransportSettings.EndCreateFactory(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			return CompletedAsyncResult<MessagingFactory>.End(result);
		}
	}

		public static readonly AmqpSymbol GatewayClientProtocol = "com.microsoft:gateway-client-protocol";

		public const int RedirectionFallbackThreshold = 3;

		public static readonly TimeSpan MinimumTokenRefreshInterval = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5.0);
	}
