		public static bool IncludeExceptionDetails { get; set; } = true;

		public static TrackingContext GetTracker(Exception exception)
		{
			if (!(exception is MessagingException { Tracker: not null } ex))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return ex.Tracker;
		}

		public static MessagingExceptionDetail GetManagementMessagingExceptionDetail(Exception exception)
		{
			if (exception is ManagementConflictOperationException ex)
			{
				return ex.Detail;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static Error ToAmqpError(Exception exception, string errorComponent)
		{
			if (exception == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Error error = new Error();
			error.Description = GetExceptionMessage(exception, out var hasBrokerInvalidOperationPrefix);
			if (exception is AmqpException)
			{
				AmqpException ex = (AmqpException)exception;
				error.Condition = ex.Error.Condition;
				error.Info = ex.Error.Info;
			}
			else if (exception is UnauthorizedAccessException)
			{
				error.Condition = AmqpErrorCode.UnauthorizedAccess;
			}
			else if (exception is TransactionAbortedException)
			{
				error.Condition = AmqpErrorCode.TransactionRollback;
			}
			else if (exception is NotSupportedException)
			{
				error.Condition = AmqpErrorCode.NotImplemented;
			}
			else if (exception is MessagingEntityNotFoundException)
			{
				error.Condition = AmqpErrorCode.NotFound;
			}
			else if (exception is MessagingEntityAlreadyExistsException)
			{
				error.Condition = AmqpClientConstants.EntityAlreadyExistsError;
			}
			else if (exception is AddressAlreadyInUseException)
			{
				error.Condition = AmqpClientConstants.AddressAlreadyInUseError;
			}
			else if (exception is AuthorizationFailedException)
			{
				error.Condition = AmqpClientConstants.AuthorizationFailedError;
			}
			else if (exception is MessageLockLostException)
			{
				error.Condition = AmqpClientConstants.MessageLockLostError;
			}
			else if (exception is SessionLockLostException)
			{
				error.Condition = AmqpClientConstants.SessionLockLostError;
			}
			else if (exception is QuotaExceededException || exception is System.ServiceModel.QuotaExceededException)
			{
				error.Condition = AmqpErrorCode.ResourceLimitExceeded;
			}
			else if (exception is TimeoutException)
			{
				error.Condition = AmqpClientConstants.TimeoutError;
			}
			else if (exception is NoMatchingSubscriptionException)
			{
				error.Condition = AmqpClientConstants.NoMatchingSubscriptionError;
			}
			else if (exception is ServerBusyException)
			{
				error.Condition = AmqpClientConstants.ServerBusyError;
			}
			else if (exception is MessageStoreLockLostException)
			{
				error.Condition = AmqpClientConstants.StoreLockLostError;
			}
			else if (exception is SessionCannotBeLockedException)
			{
				error.Condition = AmqpClientConstants.SessionCannotBeLockedError;
			}
			else if (exception is PartitionNotOwnedException)
			{
				error.Condition = AmqpClientConstants.PartitionNotOwnedError;
			}
			else if (exception is MessagingEntityDisabledException)
			{
				error.Condition = AmqpClientConstants.EntityDisabledError;
			}
			else if (exception is PublisherRevokedException)
			{
				error.Condition = AmqpClientConstants.PublisherRevokedError;
			}
			else if (exception is OperationCanceledException)
			{
				error.Condition = AmqpClientConstants.OperationCancelledError;
			}
			else if (exception is RelayNotFoundException)
			{
				error.Condition = AmqpClientConstants.RelayNotFoundError;
			}
			else if (exception is MessageSizeExceededException)
			{
				error.Condition = AmqpErrorCode.MessageSizeExceeded;
			}
			else if (exception is ReceiverDisconnectedException)
			{
				error.Condition = AmqpErrorCode.Stolen;
			}
			else if (exception is SenderDisconnectedException)
			{
				error.Condition = AmqpClientConstants.ProducerEpochStolen;
			}
			else if (exception is OutOfSequenceException)
			{
				error.Condition = AmqpClientConstants.OutOfOrderSequence;
			}
			else if (exception is MessageNotFoundException)
			{
				error.Condition = AmqpClientConstants.MessageNotFoundError;
			}
			else if (exception is MessagingEntityMovedException)
			{
				error.Condition = AmqpClientConstants.EntityMovedError;
			}
			else if (exception is ManagementConflictOperationException)
			{
				error.Condition = AmqpClientConstants.ManagementOperationConflictError;
			}
			else if (exception is ClientAffineManagementConflictOperationException)
			{
				error.Condition = AmqpClientConstants.ClientAffineManagementConflict;
			}
			else
			{
				error.Condition = AmqpErrorCode.InternalError;
				if (hasBrokerInvalidOperationPrefix)
				{
					if (exception is InvalidOperationException)
					{
						error.Condition = AmqpErrorCode.NotAllowed;
					}
					else if (exception is ArgumentOutOfRangeException)
					{
						error.Condition = AmqpClientConstants.ArgumentOutOfRangeError;
					}
					else if (exception is ArgumentException)
					{
						error.Condition = AmqpClientConstants.ArgumentError;
					}
				}
				error.Description = ((IncludeExceptionDetails || hasBrokerInvalidOperationPrefix) ? error.Description : SRClient.InternalServerError);
			}
			if (error.Condition.Equals(AmqpErrorCode.InternalError))
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.InternalServerError(null, null, null, errorComponent, exception.GetType().Name + ": " + exception.Message);
			}
			if (IncludeExceptionDetails)
			{
				string text = exception.StackTrace;
				if (text != null)
				{
					if (text.Length > 32768)
					{
						text = text.Substring(0, 32768);
					}
					if (error.Info == null)
					{
						error.Info = new Fields();
					}
					error.Info.Add(AmqpClientConstants.StackTraceName, text);
				}
			}
			return error;
		}

		public static Exception ToMessagingContract(Exception exception, string referenceId, bool connectionError = false)
		{
			if (exception == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (exception is AmqpException { Error: var error })
			{
				if (connectionError && (error.Condition.Equals(AmqpErrorCode.DecodeError) || error.Condition.Equals(AmqpErrorCode.InvalidField)))
				{
					return new MessagingCommunicationException(SRClient.MessagingEndpointCommunicationError(referenceId ?? "N/A"), exception);
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(referenceId))
				{
					error.Description += ", referenceId: " + referenceId;
				}
				return ToMessagingContract(error, connectionError);
			}
			if (connectionError)
			{
				return new MessagingCommunicationException(SRClient.MessagingEndpointCommunicationError(referenceId ?? "N/A"), exception);
			}
			return GetClientException(exception, referenceId);
		}

		public static Exception ToMessagingContract(Error error, bool connectionError = false)
		{
			if (error == null)
			{
				return new MessagingException("Unknown error.");
			}
			return ToMessagingContract(error.Condition.Value, error.Description, connectionError);
		}

		public static Exception ToCommunicationContract(Exception exception)
		{
			Exception ex = null;
			if (exception is AmqpException ex2)
			{
				ex = ToCommunicationContract(ex2.Error, ex2);
			}
			else if (exception is CommunicationException || exception is TimeoutException)
			{
				ex = exception;
			}
			else if (exception is SocketException ex3)
			{
				if (ex3.SocketErrorCode == SocketError.ConnectionRefused || ex3.SocketErrorCode == SocketError.HostDown || ex3.SocketErrorCode == SocketError.HostNotFound || ex3.SocketErrorCode == SocketError.HostUnreachable)
				{
					ex = new EndpointNotFoundException(ex3.Message, ex3);
				}
				else if (ex3.SocketErrorCode == SocketError.TimedOut)
				{
					ex = new TimeoutException(ex3.Message, ex3);
				}
			}
			if (ex == null)
			{
				ex = new CommunicationException(exception.Message, exception);
			}
			return ex;
		}

		public static Exception ToCommunicationContract(Error error, Exception innerException)
		{
			if (error == null)
			{
				return new CommunicationException("Unknown error.", innerException);
			}
			string description = error.Description;
			if (error.Condition.Equals(AmqpClientConstants.TimeoutError))
			{
				return new TimeoutException(description, innerException);
			}
			if (error.Condition.Equals(AmqpErrorCode.NotFound))
			{
				return new EndpointNotFoundException(description, innerException);
			}
			if (error.Condition.Equals(AmqpErrorCode.ResourceLimitExceeded))
			{
				return new System.ServiceModel.QuotaExceededException(description, innerException);
			}
			if (error.Condition.Equals(AmqpClientConstants.AddressAlreadyInUseError))
			{
				return new AddressAlreadyInUseException(description);
			}
			return new CommunicationException(description, innerException);
		}

		public static Exception ToRelayContract(Exception exception)
		{
			if (exception is AmqpException { Error: not null } ex)
			{
				if (ex.Error.Condition.Equals(AmqpClientConstants.RelayNotFoundError))
				{
					return new RelayNotFoundException(exception.Message, exception);
				}
				if (ex.Error.Condition.Equals(AmqpClientConstants.AuthorizationFailedError))
				{
					return new AuthorizationFailedException(exception.Message, exception);
				}
			}
			return ToCommunicationContract(exception);
		}

		public static bool IsAmqpError(Exception exception, AmqpSymbol errorCode)
		{
			if (exception is AmqpException ex && ex.Error.Condition.Equals(errorCode))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsAmqpError(Exception exception, params AmqpSymbol[] errorCodes)
		{
			if (exception is AmqpException ex)
			{
				return IsAmqpError(ex.Error.Condition, errorCodes);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsAmqpError(AmqpSymbol error, params AmqpSymbol[] errorCodes)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < errorCodes.Length; i++)
			{
				if (error.Equals(errorCodes[i]))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static string GetExceptionMessage(Exception exception, out bool hasBrokerInvalidOperationPrefix)
		{
			hasBrokerInvalidOperationPrefix = false;
			string text = exception.Message;
			if ((exception is InvalidOperationException || exception is MessagingException || exception is ArgumentException || exception is ArgumentOutOfRangeException || exception is NoMatchingSubscriptionException) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && text.StartsWith("BR0012"))
			{
				text = text.Remove(0, "BR0012".Length);
				hasBrokerInvalidOperationPrefix = true;
			}
			return text;
		}

		public static Exception GetClientException(Exception exception, string referenceId)
		{
			if (exception == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string text = exception.Message;
			if (referenceId != null)
			{
				text = SRClient.TrackableExceptionReferenceFormat(text, referenceId, SRClient.TrackingIdAndTimestampFormat("N/A", DateTime.UtcNow));
			}
			if (exception is SocketException || exception is IOException)
			{
				return new MessagingCommunicationException(text, exception);
			}
			if (exception is AmqpException)
			{
				return new MessagingException(text, exception);
			}
			if (exception is OperationCanceledException)
			{
				if (exception.InnerException is AmqpException { Error: not null } ex)
				{
					if (object.Equals(ex.Error.Condition, AmqpClientConstants.EntityDisabledError))
					{
						return new MessagingEntityDisabledException(text, null);
					}
					if (object.Equals(ex.Error.Condition, AmqpErrorCode.NotAllowed))
					{
						return new InvalidOperationException(text);
					}
				}
				return new MessagingException(text, exception);
			}
			if (exception is TimeoutException && referenceId != null)
			{
				return new TimeoutException(text, exception);
			}
			return exception;
		}

		public static string GetTrackingId(this AmqpLink link)
		{
			string value = null;
			if (link.Settings.Properties != null && link.Settings.Properties.TryGetValue<string>(AmqpClientConstants.TrackingIdName, out value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static AmqpResponseStatusCode ToAmqpResponseStatusCode(string condition)
		{
			if (!conditionToStatusMap.TryGetValue(condition, out var value))
			{
				return AmqpResponseStatusCode.InternalServerError;
			}
			return value;
		}

		public static AmqpSymbol GetResponseErrorCondition(AmqpMessage response, AmqpResponseStatusCode statusCode)
		{
			object obj = response.ApplicationProperties.Map["errorCondition"] ?? response.ApplicationProperties.Map["error-condition"];
			if (obj != null)
			{
				return (AmqpSymbol)obj;
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, AmqpResponseStatusCode> item in conditionToStatusMap)
			{
				if (item.Value == statusCode)
				{
					return item.Key;
				}
			}
			return AmqpErrorCode.InternalError;
		}

		public static Exception ToMessagingContract(string condition, string message, bool connectionError = false)
		{
			if (string.Equals(condition, AmqpClientConstants.TimeoutError.Value))
			{
				return new TimeoutException(message);
			}
			if (string.Equals(condition, AmqpErrorCode.NotFound.Value))
			{
				if (connectionError)
				{
					return new MessagingCommunicationException(message, null);
				}
				return new MessagingEntityNotFoundException(message, null);
			}
			if (string.Equals(condition, AmqpErrorCode.NotImplemented.Value))
			{
				return new NotSupportedException(message);
			}
			if (string.Equals(condition, AmqpClientConstants.EntityAlreadyExistsError.Value))
			{
				return new MessagingEntityAlreadyExistsException(message, null, null);
			}
			if (string.Equals(condition, AmqpClientConstants.MessageLockLostError.Value))
			{
				return new MessageLockLostException(message);
			}
			if (string.Equals(condition, AmqpClientConstants.SessionLockLostError.Value))
			{
				return new SessionLockLostException(message);
			}
			if (string.Equals(condition, AmqpErrorCode.ResourceLimitExceeded.Value))
			{
				return new QuotaExceededException(message);
			}
			if (string.Equals(condition, AmqpClientConstants.NoMatchingSubscriptionError.Value))
			{
				return new NoMatchingSubscriptionException(message);
			}
			if (string.Equals(condition, AmqpErrorCode.NotAllowed.Value))
			{
				return new InvalidOperationException(message);
			}
			if (string.Equals(condition, AmqpErrorCode.UnauthorizedAccess.Value) || string.Equals(condition, AmqpClientConstants.AuthorizationFailedError.Value))
			{
				return new UnauthorizedAccessException(message);
			}
			if (string.Equals(condition, AmqpErrorCode.MessageSizeExceeded.Value))
			{
				return new MessageSizeExceededException(message);
			}
			if (string.Equals(condition, AmqpClientConstants.ServerBusyError.Value))
			{
				return new ServerBusyException(message);
			}
			if (string.Equals(condition, AmqpClientConstants.ArgumentError.Value))
			{
				return new ArgumentException(message);
			}
			if (string.Equals(condition, AmqpClientConstants.ArgumentOutOfRangeError.Value))
			{
				return new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(message);
			}
			if (string.Equals(condition, AmqpClientConstants.StoreLockLostError.Value))
			{
				return new MessageStoreLockLostException(message);
			}
			if (string.Equals(condition, AmqpClientConstants.SessionCannotBeLockedError.Value))
			{
				return new SessionCannotBeLockedException(message);
			}
			if (string.Equals(condition, AmqpClientConstants.PartitionNotOwnedError.Value))
			{
				return new PartitionNotOwnedException(message);
			}
			if (string.Equals(condition, AmqpClientConstants.EntityDisabledError.Value))
			{
				return new MessagingEntityDisabledException(message, null);
			}
			if (string.Equals(condition, AmqpClientConstants.PublisherRevokedError.Value))
			{
				return new PublisherRevokedException(message, null);
			}
			if (string.Equals(condition, AmqpErrorCode.Stolen.Value))
			{
				return new ReceiverDisconnectedException(message);
			}
			if (string.Equals(condition, AmqpClientConstants.ProducerEpochStolen.Value))
			{
				return new SenderDisconnectedException(message);
			}
			if (string.Equals(condition, AmqpClientConstants.OutOfOrderSequence.Value))
			{
				return new OutOfSequenceException(message);
			}
			if (string.Equals(condition, AmqpClientConstants.UnknownProducerId.Value))
			{
				return new SenderDisconnectedException(message);
			}
			if (string.Equals(condition, AmqpClientConstants.MessageNotFoundError.Value))
			{
				return new MessageNotFoundException(message);
			}
			if (string.Equals(condition, AmqpClientConstants.EntityUpdated.Value))
			{
				return new EntityMetadataUpdatedException(message);
			}
			string.Equals(condition, AmqpClientConstants.EntityMovedError.Value);
			return new MessagingException(message);
		}

		public static AmqpResponseStatusCode GetResponseStatusCode(this AmqpMessage responseMessage)
		{
			AmqpResponseStatusCode result = AmqpResponseStatusCode.Undefined;
			if (responseMessage != null)
			{
				object obj = responseMessage.ApplicationProperties.Map["statusCode"] ?? responseMessage.ApplicationProperties.Map["status-code"];
				if (obj is int && Enum.IsDefined(typeof(AmqpResponseStatusCode), obj))
				{
					result = (AmqpResponseStatusCode)obj;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static Exception ToMessagingContractException(this AmqpMessage responseMessage)
		{
			AmqpResponseStatusCode responseStatusCode = responseMessage.GetResponseStatusCode();
			AmqpSymbol responseErrorCondition = GetResponseErrorCondition(responseMessage, responseStatusCode);
			object obj = responseMessage.ApplicationProperties.Map["statusDescription"] ?? responseMessage.ApplicationProperties.Map["status-description"];
			return ToMessagingContract(responseErrorCondition.Value, (obj as string) ?? responseErrorCondition.Value);
		}

		public static Exception ToMessagingContractException(this AmqpMessage responseMessage, AmqpResponseStatusCode statusCode)
		{
			AmqpSymbol responseErrorCondition = GetResponseErrorCondition(responseMessage, statusCode);
			object obj = responseMessage.ApplicationProperties.Map["statusDescription"] ?? responseMessage.ApplicationProperties.Map["status-description"];
			return ToMessagingContract(responseErrorCondition.Value, (obj as string) ?? responseErrorCondition.Value);
		}

		public static AmqpSymbol GetResponseErrorCondition(this AmqpMessage response)
		{
			object obj = response.ApplicationProperties.Map["errorCondition"] ?? response.ApplicationProperties.Map["error-condition"];
			if (!(obj is AmqpSymbol))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return (AmqpSymbol)obj;
		}
	}

		public static AmqpDescribed DecodeAmqpDescribed(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			return AmqpCodec.DecodeAmqpDescribed(buffer, knownTypesByName, knownTypesByCode);
		}
	}

	{

		public static void UpdateBrokeredMessageHeaderAndProperties(AmqpMessage amqpMessage, BrokeredMessage message, bool isFromJmsClient = false)
		{
			SectionFlag sections = amqpMessage.Sections;
			if ((sections & SectionFlag.Header) != 0 && amqpMessage.Header.Ttl.HasValue)
			{
				message.TimeToLive = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(amqpMessage.Header.Ttl.Value);
			}
			string text = null;
			if ((sections & SectionFlag.Properties) != 0)
			{
				if (amqpMessage.Properties.MessageId != null)
				{
					message.MessageId = amqpMessage.Properties.MessageId.ToString();
				}
				if (amqpMessage.Properties.CorrelationId != null)
				{
					message.CorrelationId = amqpMessage.Properties.CorrelationId.ToString();
				}
				if (amqpMessage.Properties.ContentType.Value != null)
				{
					message.ContentType = amqpMessage.Properties.ContentType.Value;
				}
				if (amqpMessage.Properties.Subject != null)
				{
					message.Label = amqpMessage.Properties.Subject;
				}
				if (amqpMessage.Properties.To != null)
				{
					message.To = amqpMessage.Properties.To.ToString();
				}
				if (amqpMessage.Properties.ReplyTo != null)
				{
					message.ReplyTo = amqpMessage.Properties.ReplyTo.ToString();
				}
				if (amqpMessage.Properties.GroupId != null)
				{
					text = amqpMessage.Properties.GroupId;
				}
				if (amqpMessage.Properties.ReplyToGroupId != null)
				{
					message.ReplyToSessionId = amqpMessage.Properties.ReplyToGroupId;
				}
				if (amqpMessage.Properties.AbsoluteExpiryTime.HasValue && amqpMessage.Properties.CreationTime.HasValue)
				{
					TimeSpan timeSpan = amqpMessage.Properties.AbsoluteExpiryTime.Value - amqpMessage.Properties.CreationTime.Value;
					if (timeSpan > TimeSpan.Zero)
					{
						message.TimeToLive = timeSpan;
					}
				}
			}
			if ((sections & SectionFlag.MessageAnnotations) != 0)
			{
				if (((RestrictedMap<AmqpSymbol>)amqpMessage.MessageAnnotations.Map).TryGetValue((AmqpSymbol)"x-opt-scheduled-enqueue-time", out DateTime value))
				{
					message.ScheduledEnqueueTimeUtc = value;
				}
				if (((RestrictedMap<AmqpSymbol>)amqpMessage.MessageAnnotations.Map).TryGetValue((AmqpSymbol)"x-opt-publisher", out string value2))
				{
					message.Publisher = value2;
				}
				if (((RestrictedMap<AmqpSymbol>)amqpMessage.MessageAnnotations.Map).TryGetValue((AmqpSymbol)"x-opt-partition-key", out string value3))
				{
					message.CopyPartitionKey(value3);
				}
				if (((RestrictedMap<AmqpSymbol>)amqpMessage.MessageAnnotations.Map).TryGetValue((AmqpSymbol)"x-opt-via-partition-key", out string value4))
				{
					message.CopyViaPartitionKey(value4);
				}
				if (((RestrictedMap<AmqpSymbol>)amqpMessage.MessageAnnotations.Map).TryGetValue((AmqpSymbol)"x-opt-enqueue-sequence-number", out long value5))
				{
					message.EnqueuedSequenceNumber = value5;
				}
				if (((RestrictedMap<AmqpSymbol>)amqpMessage.MessageAnnotations.Map).TryGetValue((AmqpSymbol)"x-opt-message-state", out int value6) && Enum.IsDefined(typeof(MessageState), value6))
				{
					message.State = (MessageState)value6;
				}
			}
			if ((sections & SectionFlag.ApplicationProperties) != 0)
			{
				foreach (KeyValuePair<string, object> item in amqpMessage.ApplicationProperties.Map)
				{
					object netObject = null;
					if (TryGetNetObjectFromAmqpObject(item.Value, MappingType.ApplicationProperty, out netObject))
					{
						message.InternalProperties[item.Key.ToString()] = netObject;
					}
				}
			}
			if (text != null)
			{
				message.SessionId = text;
			}
			if (isFromJmsClient)
			{
				UpdateBrokeredMessageFromJmsHeadersAndProperties(amqpMessage, message);
			}
		}

		public static void UpdateEventDataHeaderAndProperties(AmqpMessage amqpMessage, EventData data, bool updateAllProperties = true)
		{
			_ = amqpMessage.DeliveryTag;
			Fx.AssertAndThrow(condition: true, "AmqpMessage should always contain delivery tag.");
			data.DeliveryTag = amqpMessage.DeliveryTag;
			SectionFlag sections = amqpMessage.Sections;
			if ((sections & SectionFlag.MessageAnnotations) != 0)
			{
				foreach (KeyValuePair<AmqpSymbol, object> item in amqpMessage.MessageAnnotations.Map)
				{
					data.SystemProperties.Add(item.Key.ToString(), item.Value);
				}
				if (((RestrictedMap<AmqpSymbol>)amqpMessage.MessageAnnotations.Map).TryGetValue((AmqpSymbol)"x-opt-publisher", out string value))
				{
					data.Publisher = value;
				}
				if (((RestrictedMap<AmqpSymbol>)amqpMessage.MessageAnnotations.Map).TryGetValue((AmqpSymbol)"x-opt-partition-key", out string value2))
				{
					data.PartitionKey = value2;
				}
				if (((RestrictedMap<AmqpSymbol>)amqpMessage.MessageAnnotations.Map).TryGetValue((AmqpSymbol)"x-opt-enqueued-time", out DateTime value3))
				{
					data.EnqueuedTimeUtc = value3;
				}
				if (((RestrictedMap<AmqpSymbol>)amqpMessage.MessageAnnotations.Map).TryGetValue((AmqpSymbol)"x-opt-sequence-number", out long value4))
				{
					data.SequenceNumber = value4;
				}
				if (((RestrictedMap<AmqpSymbol>)amqpMessage.MessageAnnotations.Map).TryGetValue((AmqpSymbol)"x-opt-offset", out string value5))
				{
					data.Offset = value5;
				}
			}
			if ((sections & SectionFlag.DeliveryAnnotations) != 0)
			{
				if (((RestrictedMap<AmqpSymbol>)amqpMessage.DeliveryAnnotations.Map).TryGetValue((AmqpSymbol)"last_enqueued_sequence_number", out long value6))
				{
					data.LastSequenceNumber = value6;
				}
				if (((RestrictedMap<AmqpSymbol>)amqpMessage.DeliveryAnnotations.Map).TryGetValue((AmqpSymbol)"last_enqueued_offset", out string value7))
				{
					data.LastEnqueuedOffset = value7;
				}
				if (((RestrictedMap<AmqpSymbol>)amqpMessage.DeliveryAnnotations.Map).TryGetValue((AmqpSymbol)"last_enqueued_time_utc", out DateTime value8))
				{
					data.LastEnqueuedTime = value8;
				}
				if (((RestrictedMap<AmqpSymbol>)amqpMessage.DeliveryAnnotations.Map).TryGetValue((AmqpSymbol)"runtime_info_retrieval_time_utc", out DateTime value9))
				{
					data.RetrievalTime = value9;
				}
			}
			if (updateAllProperties && (sections & SectionFlag.ApplicationProperties) != 0)
			{
				foreach (KeyValuePair<string, object> item2 in amqpMessage.ApplicationProperties.Map)
				{
					object netObject = null;
					if (TryGetNetObjectFromAmqpObject(item2.Value, MappingType.ApplicationProperty, out netObject))
					{
						data.Properties[item2.Key.ToString()] = netObject;
					}
				}
			}
			if ((sections & SectionFlag.Properties) != 0)
			{
				UpdateEventDataSystemPropertiesWithAmqpProperties(data.SystemProperties, amqpMessage.Properties);
			}
		}

			AddIfTrue(systemProperties, amqpProperties, (Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Amqp.Framing.Properties p) => p.UserId.Array != null, "user-id", (Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Amqp.Framing.Properties p) => p.UserId);
			AddIfTrue(systemProperties, amqpProperties, (Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Amqp.Framing.Properties p) => p.To != null, "to", (Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Amqp.Framing.Properties p) => p.To.ToString());
			AddIfTrue(systemProperties, amqpProperties, (Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Amqp.Framing.Properties p) => p.Subject != null, "subject", (Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Amqp.Framing.Properties p) => p.Subject);
			AddIfTrue(systemProperties, amqpProperties, (Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Amqp.Framing.Properties p) => p.ReplyTo != null, "reply-to", (Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Amqp.Framing.Properties p) => p.ReplyTo.ToString());
			AddIfTrue(systemProperties, amqpProperties, (Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Amqp.Framing.Properties p) => p.CorrelationId != null, "correlation-id", (Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Amqp.Framing.Properties p) => p.CorrelationId.ToString());
			AddIfTrue(systemProperties, amqpProperties, (Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Amqp.Framing.Properties p) => p.ContentType.Value != null, "content-type", (Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Amqp.Framing.Properties p) => p.ContentType.ToString());
			AddIfTrue(systemProperties, amqpProperties, (Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Amqp.Framing.Properties p) => p.ContentEncoding.Value != null, "content-encoding", (Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Amqp.Framing.Properties p) => p.ContentEncoding.ToString());
			AddIfTrue(systemProperties, amqpProperties, (Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Amqp.Framing.Properties p) => p.AbsoluteExpiryTime.HasValue, "absolute-expiry-time", (Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Amqp.Framing.Properties p) => p.AbsoluteExpiryTime);
			AddIfTrue(systemProperties, amqpProperties, (Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Amqp.Framing.Properties p) => p.CreationTime.HasValue, "creation-time", (Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Amqp.Framing.Properties p) => p.CreationTime);
			AddIfTrue(systemProperties, amqpProperties, (Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Amqp.Framing.Properties p) => p.GroupId != null, "group-id", (Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Amqp.Framing.Properties p) => p.GroupId);
			AddIfTrue(systemProperties, amqpProperties, (Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Amqp.Framing.Properties p) => p.GroupSequence.HasValue, "group-sequence", (Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Amqp.Framing.Properties p) => p.GroupSequence);

		}

		public static void UpdateAmqpMessageHeadersAndProperties(AmqpMessage message, EventData eventData, bool copyUserProeperties = true)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(eventData.Publisher))
			{
				message.MessageAnnotations.Map["x-opt-publisher"] = eventData.Publisher;
			}
			if (eventData.PartitionKey != null)
			{
				message.MessageAnnotations.Map["x-opt-partition-key"] = eventData.PartitionKey;
			}
			if (!copyUserProeperties || eventData.Properties.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (message.ApplicationProperties == null)
			{
				message.ApplicationProperties = new ApplicationProperties();
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, object> property in eventData.Properties)
			{
				object amqpObject = null;
				if (TryGetAmqpObjectFromNetObject(property.Value, MappingType.ApplicationProperty, out amqpObject))
				{
					message.ApplicationProperties.Map[property.Key] = amqpObject;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void UpdateAmqpMessageHeadersAndProperties(AmqpMessage message, BrokeredMessage brokeredMessage, BrokeredMessage.MessageMembers messageMembers, bool amqpClient, bool stampPartitionIdToSequenceNumber, SerializationTarget serializationTarget = SerializationTarget.Communication)
		{
			if ((messageMembers & BrokeredMessage.MessageMembers.DeliveryCount) != (BrokeredMessage.MessageMembers)0uL)
			{
				message.Header.DeliveryCount = (uint)(brokeredMessage.DeliveryCount - (amqpClient ? 1 : 0));
			}
			if ((messageMembers & BrokeredMessage.MessageMembers.TimeToLive) != (BrokeredMessage.MessageMembers)0uL && brokeredMessage.TimeToLive != TimeSpan.MaxValue)
			{
				message.Header.Ttl = ((brokeredMessage.TimeToLive.TotalMilliseconds < 4294967295.0) ? ((uint)brokeredMessage.TimeToLive.TotalMilliseconds) : uint.MaxValue);
				DateTime dateTime;
				if (message.Properties.CreationTime.HasValue)
				{
					dateTime = message.Properties.CreationTime.Value;
				}
				else
				{
					dateTime = (((messageMembers & BrokeredMessage.MessageMembers.EnqueuedTimeUtc) == (BrokeredMessage.MessageMembers)0uL) ? DateTime.UtcNow : brokeredMessage.EnqueuedTimeUtc);
					message.Properties.CreationTime = dateTime;
				}
				if (brokeredMessage.TimeToLive >= DateTime.MaxValue.Subtract(dateTime))
				{
					message.Properties.AbsoluteExpiryTime = DateTime.MaxValue;
				}
				else
				{
					message.Properties.AbsoluteExpiryTime = dateTime + brokeredMessage.TimeToLive;
				}
			}
			if ((messageMembers & BrokeredMessage.MessageMembers.EnqueuedTimeUtc) != (BrokeredMessage.MessageMembers)0uL)
			{
				message.MessageAnnotations.Map["x-opt-enqueued-time"] = brokeredMessage.EnqueuedTimeUtc;
			}
			if ((messageMembers & BrokeredMessage.MessageMembers.SequenceNumber) != (BrokeredMessage.MessageMembers)0uL)
			{
				message.MessageAnnotations.Map["x-opt-sequence-number"] = (stampPartitionIdToSequenceNumber ? ScaledEntityPartitionResolver.StampPartitionIntoSequenceNumber(brokeredMessage.PartitionId, brokeredMessage.SequenceNumber) : brokeredMessage.SequenceNumber);
			}
			if ((messageMembers & BrokeredMessage.MessageMembers.EnqueuedSequenceNumber) != (BrokeredMessage.MessageMembers)0uL)
			{
				message.MessageAnnotations.Map["x-opt-enqueue-sequence-number"] = brokeredMessage.EnqueuedSequenceNumber;
			}
			if ((messageMembers & BrokeredMessage.MessageMembers.PartitionId) != (BrokeredMessage.MessageMembers)0uL)
			{
				message.MessageAnnotations.Map["x-opt-partition-id"] = brokeredMessage.PartitionId;
			}
			if ((messageMembers & BrokeredMessage.MessageMembers.PartitionKey) != (BrokeredMessage.MessageMembers)0uL)
			{
				if (serializationTarget == SerializationTarget.Storing && brokeredMessage.PartitionKey != null && SerializationUtilities.GetStringSize(brokeredMessage.PartitionKey) > Constants.MaximumMessageHeaderPropertySize)
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new SerializationException(SRClient.ExceededMessagePropertySizeLimit(BrokeredMessage.MessageMembers.PartitionKey.ToString(), Constants.MaximumMessageHeaderPropertySize)));
				}
				message.MessageAnnotations.Map["x-opt-partition-key"] = brokeredMessage.PartitionKey;
			}
			if ((messageMembers & BrokeredMessage.MessageMembers.ViaPartitionKey) != (BrokeredMessage.MessageMembers)0uL)
			{
				if (serializationTarget == SerializationTarget.Storing && brokeredMessage.ViaPartitionKey != null && SerializationUtilities.GetStringSize(brokeredMessage.ViaPartitionKey) > Constants.MaximumMessageHeaderPropertySize)
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new SerializationException(SRClient.ExceededMessagePropertySizeLimit(BrokeredMessage.MessageMembers.ViaPartitionKey.ToString(), Constants.MaximumMessageHeaderPropertySize)));
				}
				message.MessageAnnotations.Map["x-opt-via-partition-key"] = brokeredMessage.ViaPartitionKey;
			}
			if (amqpClient && (messageMembers & BrokeredMessage.MessageMembers.LockedUntilUtc) != (BrokeredMessage.MessageMembers)0uL)
			{
				message.MessageAnnotations.Map["x-opt-locked-until"] = brokeredMessage.LockedUntilUtc;
			}
			if (amqpClient && (messageMembers & BrokeredMessage.MessageMembers.Publisher) != (BrokeredMessage.MessageMembers)0uL)
			{
				if (serializationTarget == SerializationTarget.Storing && brokeredMessage.Publisher != null && SerializationUtilities.GetStringSize(brokeredMessage.Publisher) > Constants.MaximumMessageHeaderPropertySize)
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new SerializationException(SRClient.ExceededMessagePropertySizeLimit(BrokeredMessage.MessageMembers.Publisher.ToString(), Constants.MaximumMessageHeaderPropertySize)));
				}
				message.MessageAnnotations.Map["x-opt-publisher"] = brokeredMessage.Publisher;
			}
			if (amqpClient && (messageMembers & BrokeredMessage.MessageMembers.DeadLetterSource) != (BrokeredMessage.MessageMembers)0uL)
			{
				if (serializationTarget == SerializationTarget.Storing && brokeredMessage.DeadLetterSource != null && SerializationUtilities.GetStringSize(brokeredMessage.DeadLetterSource) > Constants.MaximumMessageHeaderPropertySize)
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new SerializationException(SRClient.ExceededMessagePropertySizeLimit(BrokeredMessage.MessageMembers.DeadLetterSource.ToString(), Constants.MaximumMessageHeaderPropertySize)));
				}
				message.MessageAnnotations.Map["x-opt-deadletter-source"] = brokeredMessage.DeadLetterSource;
			}
			if (amqpClient && (messageMembers & BrokeredMessage.MessageMembers.ScheduledEnqueueTimeUtc) != (BrokeredMessage.MessageMembers)0uL)
			{
				message.MessageAnnotations.Map["x-opt-scheduled-enqueue-time"] = brokeredMessage.ScheduledEnqueueTimeUtc;
			}
			if (amqpClient && (messageMembers & BrokeredMessage.MessageMembers.MessageState) != (BrokeredMessage.MessageMembers)0uL)
			{
				message.MessageAnnotations.Map["x-opt-message-state"] = (int)brokeredMessage.State;
			}
			if (!brokeredMessage.ArePropertiesModifiedByBroker || brokeredMessage.Properties.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (serializationTarget == SerializationTarget.Storing && brokeredMessage.Properties.Count > 32767)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new SerializationException(SRClient.TooManyMessageProperties(short.MaxValue, brokeredMessage.Properties.Count)));
			}
			if (message.ApplicationProperties == null)
			{
				message.ApplicationProperties = new ApplicationProperties();
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, object> property in brokeredMessage.Properties)
			{
				if (serializationTarget == SerializationTarget.Storing && SerializationUtilities.GetStringSize(property.Key) > 32767)
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new SerializationException(SRClient.ExceededMessagePropertySizeLimit(property.Key, short.MaxValue)));
				}
				object amqpObject = null;
				if (!TryGetAmqpObjectFromNetObject(property.Value, MappingType.ApplicationProperty, out amqpObject))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (serializationTarget == SerializationTarget.Storing && amqpObject != null)
				{
					if (amqpObject is string)
					{
						if (SerializationUtilities.GetStringSize((string)amqpObject) > 32767)
						{
							throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new SerializationException(SRClient.ExceededMessagePropertySizeLimit(property.Key, short.MaxValue)));
						}
					}
					else if (amqpObject is ArraySegment<byte> arraySegment)
					{
						if (arraySegment.Count > 32767)
						{
							throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new SerializationException(SRClient.ExceededMessagePropertySizeLimit(property.Key, short.MaxValue)));
						}
					}
					else if (amqpObject is DescribedType)
					{
						DescribedType describedType = (DescribedType)amqpObject;
						if (describedType.Value is string && SerializationUtilities.GetStringSize((string)describedType.Value) > 32767)
						{
							throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new SerializationException(SRClient.ExceededMessagePropertySizeLimit(property.Key, short.MaxValue)));
						}
					}
				}
				message.ApplicationProperties.Map[property.Key] = amqpObject;
			}
		}

		public static BrokeredMessage ClientGetMessage(AmqpMessage amqpMessage)
		{
			BrokeredMessage brokeredMessage;
			if ((amqpMessage.BodyType & SectionFlag.Data) != 0 || (amqpMessage.BodyType & SectionFlag.AmqpSequence) != 0)
			{
				Stream messageBodyStream = GetMessageBodyStream(amqpMessage);
				brokeredMessage = new BrokeredMessage(messageBodyStream, ownsStream: true);
			}
			else if ((amqpMessage.BodyType & SectionFlag.AmqpValue) != 0)
			{
				object netObject = null;
				if (!TryGetNetObjectFromAmqpObject(amqpMessage.ValueBody.Value, MappingType.MessageBody, out netObject))
				{
					netObject = amqpMessage.ValueBody.Value;
				}
				brokeredMessage = new BrokeredMessage(netObject, amqpMessage.BodyStream);
			}
			else
			{
				brokeredMessage = new BrokeredMessage();
			}
			brokeredMessage.MessageId = "nil";
			brokeredMessage.MessageFormat = BrokeredMessageFormat.Amqp;
			SectionFlag sections = amqpMessage.Sections;
			if ((sections & SectionFlag.Header) != 0)
			{
				if (amqpMessage.Header.Ttl.HasValue)
				{
					brokeredMessage.TimeToLive = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(amqpMessage.Header.Ttl.Value);
				}
				if (amqpMessage.Header.DeliveryCount.HasValue)
				{
					brokeredMessage.DeliveryCount = (int)(amqpMessage.Header.DeliveryCount.Value + 1);
				}
			}
			if ((sections & SectionFlag.Properties) != 0)
			{
				if (amqpMessage.Properties.MessageId != null)
				{
					brokeredMessage.MessageId = amqpMessage.Properties.MessageId.ToString();
				}
				if (amqpMessage.Properties.CorrelationId != null)
				{
					brokeredMessage.CorrelationId = amqpMessage.Properties.CorrelationId.ToString();
				}
				if (amqpMessage.Properties.ContentType.Value != null)
				{
					brokeredMessage.ContentType = amqpMessage.Properties.ContentType.Value;
				}
				if (amqpMessage.Properties.Subject != null)
				{
					brokeredMessage.Label = amqpMessage.Properties.Subject;
				}
				if (amqpMessage.Properties.To != null)
				{
					brokeredMessage.To = amqpMessage.Properties.To.ToString();
				}
				if (amqpMessage.Properties.ReplyTo != null)
				{
					brokeredMessage.ReplyTo = amqpMessage.Properties.ReplyTo.ToString();
				}
				if (amqpMessage.Properties.GroupId != null)
				{
					brokeredMessage.SessionId = amqpMessage.Properties.GroupId;
				}
				if (amqpMessage.Properties.ReplyToGroupId != null)
				{
					brokeredMessage.ReplyToSessionId = amqpMessage.Properties.ReplyToGroupId;
				}
				if (amqpMessage.Properties.CreationTime.HasValue && amqpMessage.Properties.AbsoluteExpiryTime.HasValue)
				{
					brokeredMessage.TimeToLive = amqpMessage.Properties.AbsoluteExpiryTime.Value - amqpMessage.Properties.CreationTime.Value;
				}
			}
			if ((sections & SectionFlag.ApplicationProperties) != 0)
			{
				foreach (KeyValuePair<string, object> item in amqpMessage.ApplicationProperties.Map)
				{
					object netObject2 = null;
					if (TryGetNetObjectFromAmqpObject(item.Value, MappingType.ApplicationProperty, out netObject2))
					{
						brokeredMessage.Properties[item.Key.ToString()] = netObject2;
					}
				}
			}
			if ((sections & SectionFlag.MessageAnnotations) != 0)
			{
				foreach (KeyValuePair<AmqpSymbol, object> item2 in amqpMessage.MessageAnnotations.Map)
				{
					string text = item2.Key.ToString();
					switch (text)
					{
					case "x-opt-enqueued-time":
						brokeredMessage.EnqueuedTimeUtc = (DateTime)item2.Value;
						continue;
					case "x-opt-scheduled-enqueue-time":
						brokeredMessage.ScheduledEnqueueTimeUtc = (DateTime)item2.Value;
						continue;
					case "x-opt-sequence-number":
						brokeredMessage.SequenceNumber = (long)item2.Value;
						continue;
					case "x-opt-enqueue-sequence-number":
						brokeredMessage.EnqueuedSequenceNumber = (long)item2.Value;
						continue;
					case "x-opt-locked-until":
						brokeredMessage.LockedUntilUtc = (DateTime)item2.Value;
						continue;
					case "x-opt-publisher":
						brokeredMessage.Publisher = (string)item2.Value;
						continue;
					case "x-opt-partition-key":
						brokeredMessage.PartitionKey = (string)item2.Value;
						continue;
					case "x-opt-partition-id":
						brokeredMessage.PartitionId = (short)item2.Value;
						continue;
					case "x-opt-via-partition-key":
						brokeredMessage.ViaPartitionKey = (string)item2.Value;
						continue;
					case "x-opt-deadletter-source":
						brokeredMessage.DeadLetterSource = (string)item2.Value;
						continue;
					case "x-opt-message-state":
						if (Enum.IsDefined(typeof(MessageState), (int)item2.Value))
						{
							brokeredMessage.State = (MessageState)(int)item2.Value;
						}
						continue;
					}
					object netObject3 = null;
					if (TryGetNetObjectFromAmqpObject(item2.Value, MappingType.ApplicationProperty, out netObject3))
					{
						brokeredMessage.Properties[text] = netObject3;
					}
				}
			}
			if (amqpMessage.DeliveryTag.Count == 16)
			{
				byte[] array = new byte[16];
				Buffer.BlockCopy(amqpMessage.DeliveryTag.Array, amqpMessage.DeliveryTag.Offset, array, 0, 16);
				brokeredMessage.LockToken = new Guid(array);
			}
			brokeredMessage.Attachment = new AmqpMessageAttachment(amqpMessage);
			return brokeredMessage;
		}

		public static AmqpMessage ClientGetMessage(BrokeredMessage brokeredMessage)
		{
			AmqpMessage amqpMessage = CreateBodyOnlyAmqpMessageFromSbmpMessage(brokeredMessage);
			amqpMessage.Properties.MessageId = brokeredMessage.MessageId;
			amqpMessage.Properties.CorrelationId = brokeredMessage.CorrelationId;
			amqpMessage.Properties.ContentType = brokeredMessage.ContentType;
			amqpMessage.Properties.Subject = brokeredMessage.Label;
			amqpMessage.Properties.To = brokeredMessage.To;
			amqpMessage.Properties.ReplyTo = brokeredMessage.ReplyTo;
			amqpMessage.Properties.GroupId = brokeredMessage.SessionId;
			amqpMessage.Properties.ReplyToGroupId = brokeredMessage.ReplyToSessionId;
			if ((brokeredMessage.InitializedMembers & BrokeredMessage.MessageMembers.TimeToLive) != (BrokeredMessage.MessageMembers)0uL)
			{
				amqpMessage.Header.Ttl = ((brokeredMessage.TimeToLive.TotalMilliseconds < 4294967295.0) ? ((uint)brokeredMessage.TimeToLive.TotalMilliseconds) : uint.MaxValue);
				amqpMessage.Properties.CreationTime = DateTime.UtcNow;
				if (AmqpConstants.MaxAbsoluteExpiryTime - amqpMessage.Properties.CreationTime.Value > brokeredMessage.TimeToLive)
				{
					amqpMessage.Properties.AbsoluteExpiryTime = amqpMessage.Properties.CreationTime.Value + brokeredMessage.TimeToLive;
				}
				else
				{
					amqpMessage.Properties.AbsoluteExpiryTime = AmqpConstants.MaxAbsoluteExpiryTime;
				}
			}
			if ((brokeredMessage.InitializedMembers & BrokeredMessage.MessageMembers.ScheduledEnqueueTimeUtc) != (BrokeredMessage.MessageMembers)0uL && brokeredMessage.ScheduledEnqueueTimeUtc > DateTime.MinValue)
			{
				amqpMessage.MessageAnnotations.Map.Add("x-opt-scheduled-enqueue-time", brokeredMessage.ScheduledEnqueueTimeUtc);
			}
			if ((brokeredMessage.InitializedMembers & BrokeredMessage.MessageMembers.Publisher) != (BrokeredMessage.MessageMembers)0uL && brokeredMessage.Publisher != null)
			{
				amqpMessage.MessageAnnotations.Map.Add("x-opt-publisher", brokeredMessage.Publisher);
			}
			if ((brokeredMessage.InitializedMembers & BrokeredMessage.MessageMembers.DeadLetterSource) != (BrokeredMessage.MessageMembers)0uL && brokeredMessage.DeadLetterSource != null)
			{
				amqpMessage.MessageAnnotations.Map.Add("x-opt-deadletter-source", brokeredMessage.DeadLetterSource);
			}
			if ((brokeredMessage.InitializedMembers & BrokeredMessage.MessageMembers.PartitionKey) != (BrokeredMessage.MessageMembers)0uL && brokeredMessage.PartitionKey != null)
			{
				amqpMessage.MessageAnnotations.Map.Add("x-opt-partition-key", brokeredMessage.PartitionKey);
			}
			if ((brokeredMessage.InitializedMembers & BrokeredMessage.MessageMembers.ViaPartitionKey) != (BrokeredMessage.MessageMembers)0uL && brokeredMessage.ViaPartitionKey != null)
			{
				amqpMessage.MessageAnnotations.Map.Add("x-opt-via-partition-key", brokeredMessage.ViaPartitionKey);
			}
			if ((brokeredMessage.InitializedMembers & BrokeredMessage.MessageMembers.MessageState) != (BrokeredMessage.MessageMembers)0uL)
			{
				amqpMessage.MessageAnnotations.Map.Add("x-opt-message-state", (int)brokeredMessage.State);
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, object> property in brokeredMessage.Properties)
			{
				object amqpObject = null;
				if (TryGetAmqpObjectFromNetObject(property.Value, MappingType.ApplicationProperty, out amqpObject))
				{
					amqpMessage.ApplicationProperties.Map.Add(property.Key, amqpObject);
				}
			}
			return amqpMessage;
		}

		public static BrokeredMessage ConvertMessageFromAmqpToSbmpFormat(BrokeredMessage brokeredMessage, ReceiveMode receiveMode)
		{
			BrokeredMessage brokeredMessage2 = brokeredMessage.CreateCopy();
			brokeredMessage2.MessageFormat = BrokeredMessageFormat.Sbmp;
			if (receiveMode == ReceiveMode.PeekLock && brokeredMessage.IsLockTokenSet)
			{
				brokeredMessage2.LockToken = brokeredMessage.LockToken;
				brokeredMessage2.LockedUntilUtc = brokeredMessage.LockedUntilUtc;
			}
			Stream bodyStream = brokeredMessage2.BodyStream;
			if (bodyStream != null)
			{
				int size = (int)bodyStream.Length;
				ByteBuffer byteBuffer = new ByteBuffer(size, autoGrow: false);
				int size2 = bodyStream.Read(byteBuffer.Buffer, byteBuffer.WritePos, byteBuffer.Size);
				byteBuffer.Append(size2);
				AmqpMessage amqpMessage = AmqpMessage.CreateBufferMessage(byteBuffer);
				brokeredMessage2.Attachment = new AmqpMessageAttachment(amqpMessage);
				if ((amqpMessage.BodyType & SectionFlag.Data) != 0)
				{
					brokeredMessage2.BodyStream = GetMessageBodyStream(amqpMessage);
				}
				else if ((amqpMessage.BodyType & SectionFlag.AmqpSequence) != 0)
				{
					brokeredMessage2.BodyStream = new MemoryStream(byteBuffer.Buffer, amqpMessage.BodyOffset, amqpMessage.BodyLength);
				}
				else if ((amqpMessage.BodyType & SectionFlag.AmqpValue) != 0)
				{
					object netObject = null;
					if (!TryGetNetObjectFromAmqpObject(amqpMessage.ValueBody.Value, MappingType.MessageBody, out netObject))
					{
						netObject = amqpMessage.ValueBody.Value;
					}
					if (netObject != null)
					{
						DataContractBinarySerializer dataContractBinarySerializer = new DataContractBinarySerializer(netObject.GetType());
						MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream(256);
						dataContractBinarySerializer.WriteObject(memoryStream, netObject);
						memoryStream.Flush();
						memoryStream.Position = 0L;
						brokeredMessage2.BodyStream = memoryStream;
					}
				}
				bodyStream.Dispose();
			}
			RemoveAddedJmsPropertiesFromBrokeredMessage(brokeredMessage2);
			return brokeredMessage2;
		}

		public static Filter GetFilter(AmqpFilter amqpFilter)
		{
			if (amqpFilter.DescriptorCode == AmqpSqlFilter.Code)
			{
				AmqpSqlFilter amqpSqlFilter = (AmqpSqlFilter)amqpFilter;
				return new SqlFilter(amqpSqlFilter.Expression);
			}
			if (amqpFilter.DescriptorCode == AmqpTrueFilter.Code)
			{
				return new TrueFilter();
			}
			if (amqpFilter.DescriptorCode == AmqpFalseFilter.Code)
			{
				return new FalseFilter();
			}
			if (amqpFilter.DescriptorCode == AmqpCorrelationFilter.Code)
			{
				AmqpCorrelationFilter amqpCorrelationFilter = (AmqpCorrelationFilter)amqpFilter;
				CorrelationFilter correlationFilter = new CorrelationFilter
				{
					CorrelationId = amqpCorrelationFilter.CorrelationId,
					MessageId = amqpCorrelationFilter.MessageId,
					To = amqpCorrelationFilter.To,
					ReplyTo = amqpCorrelationFilter.ReplyTo,
					Label = amqpCorrelationFilter.Label,
					SessionId = amqpCorrelationFilter.SessionId,
					ReplyToSessionId = amqpCorrelationFilter.ReplyToSessionId,
					ContentType = amqpCorrelationFilter.ContentType
				};
				foreach (KeyValuePair<object, object> property in amqpCorrelationFilter.Properties)
				{
					correlationFilter.Properties.Add(property.Key.ToString(), property.Value);
				}
				return correlationFilter;
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		private static RuleAction GetRuleAction(AmqpRuleAction amqpAction)
		{
			if (amqpAction.DescriptorCode == AmqpEmptyRuleAction.Code)
			{
				return EmptyRuleAction.Default;
			}
			if (amqpAction.DescriptorCode == AmqpSqlRuleAction.Code)
			{
				AmqpSqlRuleAction amqpSqlRuleAction = (AmqpSqlRuleAction)amqpAction;
				return (!amqpSqlRuleAction.CompatibilityLevel.HasValue) ? new SqlRuleAction(amqpSqlRuleAction.SqlExpression) : new SqlRuleAction(amqpSqlRuleAction.SqlExpression, amqpSqlRuleAction.CompatibilityLevel.Value);
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public static RuleDescription GetRuleDescription(AmqpRuleDescription amqpDescription)
		{
			Filter filter = GetFilter(amqpDescription.Filter);
			RuleAction ruleAction = GetRuleAction(amqpDescription.Action);
			RuleDescription ruleDescription = new RuleDescription(filter)
			{
				Action = ruleAction,
				InternalCreatedAt = amqpDescription.CreatedAt
			};
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(amqpDescription.RuleName))
			{
				ruleDescription.Name = amqpDescription.RuleName;
			}
			return ruleDescription;
		}

		public static AmqpFilter GetFilter(Filter filter)
		{
			AmqpFilter amqpFilter = null;
			if (filter is TrueFilter)
			{
				return new AmqpTrueFilter();
			}
			if (filter is FalseFilter)
			{
				return new AmqpFalseFilter();
			}
			if (filter is SqlFilter)
			{
				AmqpSqlFilter amqpSqlFilter = new AmqpSqlFilter();
				SqlFilter sqlFilter = (SqlFilter)filter;
				amqpSqlFilter.Expression = sqlFilter.SqlExpression;
				amqpSqlFilter.CompatibilityLevel = sqlFilter.CompatibilityLevel;
				return amqpSqlFilter;
			}
			if (filter is CorrelationFilter)
			{
				CorrelationFilter correlationFilter = (CorrelationFilter)filter;
				AmqpCorrelationFilter amqpCorrelationFilter = new AmqpCorrelationFilter
				{
					CorrelationId = correlationFilter.CorrelationId,
					MessageId = correlationFilter.MessageId,
					To = correlationFilter.To,
					ReplyTo = correlationFilter.ReplyTo,
					Label = correlationFilter.Label,
					SessionId = correlationFilter.SessionId,
					ReplyToSessionId = correlationFilter.ReplyToSessionId,
					ContentType = correlationFilter.ContentType
				};
				foreach (KeyValuePair<string, object> property in correlationFilter.Properties)
				{
					amqpCorrelationFilter.Properties.Add(property.Key, property.Value);
				}
				return amqpCorrelationFilter;
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		private static AmqpRuleAction GetRuleAction(RuleAction ruleAction)
		{
			AmqpRuleAction amqpRuleAction = null;
			if (ruleAction == null || ruleAction is EmptyRuleAction)
			{
				return new AmqpEmptyRuleAction();
			}
			if (ruleAction is SqlRuleAction)
			{
				AmqpSqlRuleAction amqpSqlRuleAction = new AmqpSqlRuleAction();
				SqlRuleAction sqlRuleAction = (SqlRuleAction)ruleAction;
				amqpSqlRuleAction.SqlExpression = sqlRuleAction.SqlExpression;
				amqpSqlRuleAction.CompatibilityLevel = sqlRuleAction.CompatibilityLevel;
				return amqpSqlRuleAction;
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public static AmqpRuleDescription GetRuleDescription(RuleDescription description)
		{
			AmqpFilter filter = GetFilter(description.Filter);
			AmqpRuleAction ruleAction = GetRuleAction(description.Action);
			return new AmqpRuleDescription
			{
				Filter = filter,
				Action = ruleAction,
				RuleName = description.Name,
				CreatedAt = description.CreatedAt
			};
		}

		{
			return new SqlFilter(amqpSqlFilterMap[ManagementConstants.Properties.Expression] as string);
		}

		public static CorrelationFilter GetCorrelationFilter(AmqpMap amqpCorrelationFilterMap)
		{
			CorrelationFilter correlationFilter = new CorrelationFilter
			{
				CorrelationId = (string)amqpCorrelationFilterMap[ManagementConstants.Properties.CorrelationId],
				MessageId = (string)amqpCorrelationFilterMap[ManagementConstants.Properties.MessageId],
				To = (string)amqpCorrelationFilterMap[ManagementConstants.Properties.To],
				ReplyTo = (string)amqpCorrelationFilterMap[ManagementConstants.Properties.ReplyTo],
				Label = (string)amqpCorrelationFilterMap[ManagementConstants.Properties.Label],
				SessionId = (string)amqpCorrelationFilterMap[ManagementConstants.Properties.SessionId],
				ReplyToSessionId = (string)amqpCorrelationFilterMap[ManagementConstants.Properties.ReplyToSessionId],
				ContentType = (string)amqpCorrelationFilterMap[ManagementConstants.Properties.ContentType]
			};
			if (amqpCorrelationFilterMap[ManagementConstants.Properties.CorrelationFilterProperties] is AmqpMap amqpMap)
			{
				foreach (KeyValuePair<object, object> item in amqpMap)
				{
					correlationFilter.Properties.Add(item.Key.ToString(), item.Value);
				}
			}
			return correlationFilter;
		}

		private static RuleAction GetRuleAction(AmqpMap amqpRuleActionMap)
		{
			RuleAction result = EmptyRuleAction.Default;
			if (amqpRuleActionMap != null)
			{
				string text = (string)amqpRuleActionMap[ManagementConstants.Properties.Expression];
				if (text != null)
				{
					result = new SqlRuleAction(text);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static RuleDescription GetRuleDescription(AmqpMap amqpDescriptionMap)
		{
			Filter filter = null;
			if (amqpDescriptionMap[ManagementConstants.Properties.SqlFilter] is AmqpMap amqpSqlFilterMap)
			{
				filter = GetSqlFilter(amqpSqlFilterMap);
			}
			else if (amqpDescriptionMap[ManagementConstants.Properties.CorrelationFilter] is AmqpMap amqpCorrelationFilterMap)
			{
				filter = GetCorrelationFilter(amqpCorrelationFilterMap);
			}
			RuleAction ruleAction = GetRuleAction(amqpDescriptionMap[ManagementConstants.Properties.SqlRuleAction] as AmqpMap);
			((IDictionary<object, object>)amqpDescriptionMap).TryGetValue((object)ManagementConstants.Properties.RuleCreatedAt, out DateTime? value);
			((IDictionary<object, object>)amqpDescriptionMap).TryGetValue((object)ManagementConstants.Properties.RuleName, out string value2);
			RuleDescription ruleDescription = new RuleDescription(filter)
			{
				Action = ruleAction,
				InternalCreatedAt = value
			};
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value2))
			{
				ruleDescription.Name = value2;
			}
			return ruleDescription;
		}

		{

				amqpMap[ManagementConstants.Properties.Expression] = sqlRuleAction.SqlExpression;
			}
			else
			{
				amqpMap = null;
			}

		public static AmqpMap GetRuleDescriptionMap(RuleDescription description)
		{
			AmqpMap amqpMap = new AmqpMap();
			if (description.Filter is SqlFilter)
			{
				AmqpMap sqlFilterMap = GetSqlFilterMap(description.Filter as SqlFilter);
				amqpMap[ManagementConstants.Properties.SqlFilter] = sqlFilterMap;
			}
			else
			{
				if (!(description.Filter is CorrelationFilter))
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException();
				}
				AmqpMap correlationFilterMap = GetCorrelationFilterMap(description.Filter as CorrelationFilter);
				amqpMap[ManagementConstants.Properties.CorrelationFilter] = correlationFilterMap;
			}
			AmqpMap ruleActionMap = GetRuleActionMap(description.Action as SqlRuleAction);
			amqpMap[ManagementConstants.Properties.SqlRuleAction] = ruleActionMap;
			amqpMap[ManagementConstants.Properties.RuleName] = description.Name;
			amqpMap[ManagementConstants.Properties.RuleCreatedAt] = description.CreatedAt;
			return amqpMap;
		}

		public static AmqpMessage CreateBodyOnlyAmqpMessageFromSbmpMessage(BrokeredMessage brokeredMessage)
		{
			object obj = brokeredMessage.ClearBodyObject();
			object amqpObject = null;
			if (obj != null)
			{
				TryGetAmqpObjectFromNetObject(obj, MappingType.MessageBody, out amqpObject);
			}
			if (amqpObject != null)
			{
				return AmqpMessage.Create(new AmqpValue
				{
					Value = amqpObject
				});
			}
			if (brokeredMessage.BodyStream != null)
			{
				if (brokeredMessage.BodyStream.CanSeek && brokeredMessage.BodyStream.Position != 0L)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.CannotSerializeMessageWithPartiallyConsumedBodyStream);
				}
				return AmqpMessage.Create(brokeredMessage.BodyStream, ownStream: false);
			}
			return AmqpMessage.Create();
		}

		private static Stream GetMessageBodyStream(AmqpMessage message)
		{
			if ((message.BodyType & SectionFlag.Data) != 0 && message.DataBody != null)
			{
				List<ArraySegment<byte>> list = new List<ArraySegment<byte>>();
				foreach (Data item in message.DataBody)
				{
					list.Add((ArraySegment<byte>)item.Value);
				}
				return new BufferListStream(list.ToArray());
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static void AddIfTrue(IDictionary<string, object> dictionary, Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Amqp.Framing.Properties properties, Func<Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Amqp.Framing.Properties, bool> condition, string key, Func<Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Amqp.Framing.Properties, object> getValueFunc)
		{
			if (condition(properties))
			{
				dictionary.Add(key, getValueFunc(properties));
			}
		}

		public static bool TryGetAmqpObjectFromNetObject(object netObject, MappingType mappingType, out object amqpObject)
		{
			amqpObject = null;
			if (netObject == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			switch (SerializationUtilities.GetTypeId(netObject))
			{
			case PropertyValueType.Byte:
			case PropertyValueType.SByte:
			case PropertyValueType.Char:
			case PropertyValueType.Int16:
			case PropertyValueType.UInt16:
			case PropertyValueType.Int32:
			case PropertyValueType.UInt32:
			case PropertyValueType.Int64:
			case PropertyValueType.UInt64:
			case PropertyValueType.Single:
			case PropertyValueType.Double:
			case PropertyValueType.Decimal:
			case PropertyValueType.Boolean:
			case PropertyValueType.Guid:
			case PropertyValueType.String:
			case PropertyValueType.DateTime:
				amqpObject = netObject;
				break;
			case PropertyValueType.Stream:
				if (mappingType == MappingType.ApplicationProperty)
				{
					amqpObject = ReadStream((Stream)netObject);
				}
				break;
			case PropertyValueType.Uri:
				amqpObject = new DescribedType((AmqpSymbol)"com.microsoft:uri", ((Uri)netObject).AbsoluteUri);
				break;
			case PropertyValueType.DateTimeOffset:
				amqpObject = new DescribedType((AmqpSymbol)"com.microsoft:datetime-offset", ((DateTimeOffset)netObject).UtcTicks);
				break;
			case PropertyValueType.TimeSpan:
				amqpObject = new DescribedType((AmqpSymbol)"com.microsoft:timespan", ((TimeSpan)netObject).Ticks);
				break;
			case PropertyValueType.Unknown:
				if (netObject is Stream)
				{
					if (mappingType == MappingType.ApplicationProperty)
					{
						amqpObject = ReadStream((Stream)netObject);
					}
					break;
				}
				if (mappingType == MappingType.ApplicationProperty)
				{
					throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new SerializationException(SRClient.FailedToSerializeUnsupportedType(netObject.GetType().FullName)));
				}
				if (netObject is byte[])
				{
					amqpObject = new ArraySegment<byte>((byte[])netObject);
				}
				else if (netObject is IList)
				{
					amqpObject = netObject;
				}
				else
				{
					if (!(netObject is IDictionary))
					{
						break;
					}
					AmqpMap amqpMap = new AmqpMap();
					foreach (DictionaryEntry item in (IDictionary)netObject)
					{
						amqpMap[item.Key] = item.Value;
					}
					amqpObject = amqpMap;
				}
				break;
			}
			return amqpObject != null;
		}

		public static bool TryGetNetObjectFromAmqpObject(object amqpObject, MappingType mappingType, out object netObject)
		{
			netObject = null;
			if (amqpObject == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			switch (SerializationUtilities.GetTypeId(amqpObject))
			{
			case PropertyValueType.Byte:
			case PropertyValueType.SByte:
			case PropertyValueType.Char:
			case PropertyValueType.Int16:
			case PropertyValueType.UInt16:
			case PropertyValueType.Int32:
			case PropertyValueType.UInt32:
			case PropertyValueType.Int64:
			case PropertyValueType.UInt64:
			case PropertyValueType.Single:
			case PropertyValueType.Double:
			case PropertyValueType.Decimal:
			case PropertyValueType.Boolean:
			case PropertyValueType.Guid:
			case PropertyValueType.String:
			case PropertyValueType.DateTime:
				netObject = amqpObject;
				break;
			case PropertyValueType.Unknown:
				if (amqpObject is AmqpSymbol)
				{
					netObject = ((AmqpSymbol)amqpObject).Value;
					break;
				}
				if (amqpObject is ArraySegment<byte> arraySegment)
				{
					if (arraySegment.Count == arraySegment.Array.Length)
					{
						netObject = arraySegment.Array;
						break;
					}
					byte[] array = new byte[arraySegment.Count];
					Buffer.BlockCopy(arraySegment.Array, arraySegment.Offset, array, 0, arraySegment.Count);
					netObject = array;
					break;
				}
				if (amqpObject is DescribedType)
				{
					DescribedType describedType = (DescribedType)amqpObject;
					if (describedType.Descriptor is AmqpSymbol)
					{
						AmqpSymbol amqpSymbol = (AmqpSymbol)describedType.Descriptor;
						if (amqpSymbol.Equals("com.microsoft:uri"))
						{
							netObject = new Uri((string)describedType.Value);
						}
						else if (amqpSymbol.Equals("com.microsoft:timespan"))
						{
							netObject = new TimeSpan((long)describedType.Value);
						}
						else if (amqpSymbol.Equals("com.microsoft:datetime-offset"))
						{
							netObject = new DateTimeOffset(new DateTime((long)describedType.Value, DateTimeKind.Utc));
						}
					}
					break;
				}
				if (mappingType == MappingType.ApplicationProperty)
				{
					throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new SerializationException(SRClient.FailedToSerializeUnsupportedType(amqpObject.GetType().FullName)));
				}
				if (amqpObject is AmqpMap)
				{
					AmqpMap amqpMap = (AmqpMap)amqpObject;
					Dictionary<string, object> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, object>();
					foreach (KeyValuePair<object, object> item in amqpMap)
					{
						dictionary.Add(item.Key.ToString(), item.Value);
					}
					netObject = dictionary;
				}
				else
				{
					netObject = amqpObject;
				}
				break;
			}
			return netObject != null;
		}

		public static ArraySegment<byte> ReadStream(Stream stream)
		{
			MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			stream.CopyTo(memoryStream);
			return new ArraySegment<byte>(memoryStream.GetBuffer(), 0, (int)memoryStream.Length);
		}

		internal static void RemoveAddedJmsPropertiesFromAmqpMessage(AmqpMessage amqpMessage)
		{
			amqpMessage.ApplicationProperties.Map.TryRemoveValue<object>("JMSTimestamp", out var value);
			amqpMessage.ApplicationProperties.Map.TryRemoveValue<object>("JMSExpiration", out value);
			amqpMessage.ApplicationProperties.Map.TryRemoveValue<object>("JMSMessageID", out value);
			amqpMessage.ApplicationProperties.Map.TryRemoveValue<object>("JMSCorrelationID", out value);
			amqpMessage.ApplicationProperties.Map.TryRemoveValue<object>("JMSType", out value);
			amqpMessage.ApplicationProperties.Map.TryRemoveValue<object>("JMSDestination", out value);
			amqpMessage.ApplicationProperties.Map.TryRemoveValue<object>("JMSReplyTo", out value);
			amqpMessage.ApplicationProperties.Map.TryRemoveValue<object>("JMSXGroupID", out value);
			amqpMessage.ApplicationProperties.Map.TryRemoveValue<object>("JMSXGroupSeq", out value);
			amqpMessage.ApplicationProperties.Map.TryRemoveValue<object>("JMSPriority", out value);
			amqpMessage.ApplicationProperties.Map.TryRemoveValue<object>("JMSDeliveryMode", out value);
			amqpMessage.ApplicationProperties.Map.TryRemoveValue<object>("JMS_Azure_Flag", out value);
		}

		private static void UpdateBrokeredMessageFromJmsHeadersAndProperties(AmqpMessage amqpMessage, BrokeredMessage message)
		{
			message.Properties.Add("JMS_Azure_Flag", true);
			SectionFlag sections = amqpMessage.Sections;
			if ((sections & SectionFlag.MessageAnnotations) != 0 && ((RestrictedMap<AmqpSymbol>)amqpMessage.MessageAnnotations.Map).TryGetValue((AmqpSymbol)"x-opt-delivery-time", out long value))
			{
				message.ScheduledEnqueueTimeUtc = TimeStampEncoding.ToDateTime(value);
			}
			if ((sections & SectionFlag.Properties) != 0)
			{
				if (amqpMessage.Properties.AbsoluteExpiryTime.HasValue && amqpMessage.Properties.CreationTime.HasValue)
				{
					TimeSpan timeSpan;
					if (amqpMessage.Properties.AbsoluteExpiryTime.Value == AmqpConstants.StartOfEpoch)
					{
						timeSpan = TimeSpan.Zero;
					}
					else if (amqpMessage.Properties.CreationTime.Value == AmqpConstants.StartOfEpoch)
					{
						timeSpan = TimeSpan.Zero;
					}
					else
					{
						timeSpan = amqpMessage.Properties.AbsoluteExpiryTime.Value - amqpMessage.Properties.CreationTime.Value;
						message.Properties.Add("JMSTimestamp", TimeStampEncoding.GetMilliseconds(amqpMessage.Properties.CreationTime.Value));
						message.Properties.Add("JMSExpiration", TimeStampEncoding.GetMilliseconds(amqpMessage.Properties.AbsoluteExpiryTime.Value));
					}
					message.TimeToLive = ((timeSpan > TimeSpan.Zero) ? timeSpan : TimeSpan.Zero);
				}
				if (message.MessageId != null)
				{
					message.Properties.Add("JMSMessageID", message.MessageId);
				}
				if (message.CorrelationId != null)
				{
					message.Properties.Add("JMSCorrelationID", message.CorrelationId);
				}
				if (message.Label != null)
				{
					message.Properties.Add("JMSType", message.Label);
				}
				if (message.To != null)
				{
					message.Properties.Add("JMSDestination", message.To);
				}
				if (message.ReplyTo != null)
				{
					message.Properties.Add("JMSReplyTo", message.ReplyTo);
				}
				if (message.SessionId != null)
				{
					message.Properties.Add("JMSXGroupID", message.SessionId);
					message.SessionId = null;
				}
				if (amqpMessage.Properties.GroupSequence.HasValue)
				{
					message.Properties.Add("JMSXGroupSeq", amqpMessage.Properties.GroupSequence.Value);
				}
			}
			if ((sections & SectionFlag.Header) != 0)
			{
				if (amqpMessage.Header.Priority.HasValue)
				{
					message.Properties.Add("JMSPriority", amqpMessage.Header.Priority.Value);
				}
				if (amqpMessage.Header.Durable.HasValue)
				{
					message.ForcePersistence = amqpMessage.Header.Durable.Value;
					message.Properties.Add("JMSDeliveryMode", amqpMessage.Header.Durable.Value ? "PERSISTENT" : "NON_PERSISTENT");
				}
			}
		}

		private static void RemoveAddedJmsPropertiesFromBrokeredMessage(BrokeredMessage message)
		{
			if (message.Properties.ContainsKey("JMS_Azure_Flag"))
			{
				message.Properties.Remove("JMSTimestamp");
				message.Properties.Remove("JMSExpiration");
				message.Properties.Remove("JMSMessageID");
				message.Properties.Remove("JMSCorrelationID");
				message.Properties.Remove("JMSType");
				message.Properties.Remove("JMSDestination");
				message.Properties.Remove("JMSReplyTo");
				message.Properties.Remove("JMSXGroupID");
				message.Properties.Remove("JMSXGroupSeq");
				message.Properties.Remove("JMSPriority");
				message.Properties.Remove("JMSDeliveryMode");
				message.Properties.Remove("JMS_Azure_Flag");
			}
		}
	}

		public static int GetFrameSize(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			return (int)AmqpBitConverter.PeekUInt(buffer);
		}

		public static void RegisterKnownTypes(string name, ulong code, Func<AmqpDescribed> ctor)
		{
			lock (knownTypesByCode)
			{
				if (!knownTypesByName.ContainsKey(name))
				{
					knownTypesByName.Add(name, ctor);
					knownTypesByCode.Add(code, ctor);
				}
			}
		}
