		public static object DecodeObject(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			FormatCode formatCode = AmqpEncoding.ReadFormatCode(buffer);
			if (formatCode == (byte)64)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (formatCode == (byte)0)
			{
				object obj = DecodeObject(buffer);
				Func<AmqpDescribed> value = null;
				if (obj is AmqpSymbol)
				{
					knownTypesByName.TryGetValue(((AmqpSymbol)obj).Value, out value);
				}
				else if (obj is ulong)
				{
					knownTypesByCode.TryGetValue((ulong)obj, out value);
				}
				if (value != null)
				{
					AmqpDescribed amqpDescribed = value();
					amqpDescribed.DecodeValue(buffer);
					return amqpDescribed;
				}
				object value2 = DecodeObject(buffer);
				return new DescribedType(obj, value2);
			}
			return AmqpEncoding.DecodeObject(buffer, formatCode);
		}

		public static AmqpDescribed DecodeAmqpDescribed(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			return DecodeAmqpDescribed(buffer, knownTypesByName, knownTypesByCode);
		}

		public static AmqpDescribed DecodeAmqpDescribed(ByteBuffer buffer, Dictionary<string, Func<AmqpDescribed>> byName, Dictionary<ulong, Func<AmqpDescribed>> byCode)
		{
			AmqpDescribed amqpDescribed = CreateAmqpDescribed(buffer, byName, byCode);
			amqpDescribed?.DecodeValue(buffer);
			return amqpDescribed;
		}

		public static AmqpDescribed CreateAmqpDescribed(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			return CreateAmqpDescribed(buffer, knownTypesByName, knownTypesByCode);
		}

		public static AmqpDescribed CreateAmqpDescribed(ByteBuffer buffer, Dictionary<string, Func<AmqpDescribed>> byName, Dictionary<ulong, Func<AmqpDescribed>> byCode)
		{
			FormatCode formatCode = AmqpEncoding.ReadFormatCode(buffer);
			if (formatCode == (byte)64)
			{
				return null;
			}
			EncodingBase.VerifyFormatCode(formatCode, buffer.Offset, (byte)0);
			Func<AmqpDescribed> value = null;
			formatCode = AmqpEncoding.ReadFormatCode(buffer);
			if (formatCode == (byte)163 || formatCode == (byte)179)
			{
				byName.TryGetValue(SymbolEncoding.Decode(buffer, formatCode).Value, out value);
			}
			else if (formatCode == (byte)68 || formatCode == (byte)128 || formatCode == (byte)83)
			{
				ulong value2 = ULongEncoding.Decode(buffer, formatCode).Value;
				byCode.TryGetValue(value2, out value);
			}
			if (value == null)
			{
				throw AmqpEncoding.GetEncodingException(SRAmqp.AmqpInvalidFormatCode(formatCode, buffer.Offset));
			}
			return value();
		}

		public static T DecodeKnownType<T>(ByteBuffer buffer) where T : class, IAmqpSerializable, new()
		{
			FormatCode formatCode = AmqpEncoding.ReadFormatCode(buffer);
			if (formatCode == (byte)64)
			{
				return null;
			}
			T val = new T();
			val.Decode(buffer);
			return val;
		}
	}
	internal class AmqpConnection : AmqpConnectionBase, ISessionFactory
	{
		private abstract class HeartBeat
		{
			private sealed class NoneHeartBeat : HeartBeat
			{
				public override void OnSend()
				{
				}

				public override void OnReceive()
				{
				}

				public override void Stop()
				{
				}
			}

			private sealed class TimedHeartBeat : HeartBeat
			{
				private readonly AmqpConnection connection;

				private readonly IOThreadTimer heartBeatTimer;

				private readonly uint localInterval;

				private readonly uint remoteInterval;

				private DateTime lastSendTime;

				private DateTime lastReceiveTime;

				public TimedHeartBeat(AmqpConnection connection, uint local, uint remote)
				{
					this.connection = connection;
					lastReceiveTime = (lastSendTime = DateTime.UtcNow);
					localInterval = local;
					remoteInterval = ((remote < uint.MaxValue) ? (remote * 7 / 8) : uint.MaxValue);
					heartBeatTimer = new IOThreadTimer(OnHeartBeatTimer, this, isTypicallyCanceledShortlyAfterBeingSet: false);
					SetTimer(lastSendTime);
				}

				public override void OnSend()
				{
					if (remoteInterval < uint.MaxValue)
					{
						lastSendTime = DateTime.UtcNow;
					}
				}

				public override void OnReceive()
				{
					if (localInterval < uint.MaxValue)
					{
						lastReceiveTime = DateTime.UtcNow;
					}
				}

				public override void Stop()
				{
					heartBeatTimer.Cancel();
				}

				private void SetTimer(DateTime time)
				{
					uint nextInterval = GetNextInterval(remoteInterval, time, lastSendTime);
					uint nextInterval2 = GetNextInterval(localInterval, time, lastReceiveTime);
					uint num = Math.Min(nextInterval, nextInterval2);
					heartBeatTimer.Set((int)((num > int.MaxValue) ? int.MaxValue : num));
				}

				private static uint GetNextInterval(uint interval, DateTime now, DateTime previous)
				{
					if (interval == uint.MaxValue)
					{
						return interval;
					}
					uint num = (uint)((now > previous) ? (now - previous).TotalMilliseconds : 0.0);
					if (interval <= num)
					{
						return 0u;
					}
					return interval - num;
				}

				private static void OnHeartBeatTimer(object state)
				{
					TimedHeartBeat timedHeartBeat = (TimedHeartBeat)state;
					if (timedHeartBeat.connection.IsClosing())
					{
						return;
					}
					DateTime utcNow = DateTime.UtcNow;
					try
					{
						if (timedHeartBeat.localInterval < uint.MaxValue && utcNow.Subtract(timedHeartBeat.lastReceiveTime).TotalMilliseconds > (double)timedHeartBeat.localInterval)
						{
							string text = SRAmqp.AmqpConnectionInactive(timedHeartBeat.localInterval, timedHeartBeat.connection.Settings.ContainerId);
							MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogError(timedHeartBeat.connection, "OnHeartBeatTimer", text);
							timedHeartBeat.connection.SafeClose(new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.ConnectionForced, text));
							return;
						}
						if (timedHeartBeat.remoteInterval < uint.MaxValue && utcNow.Subtract(timedHeartBeat.lastSendTime).TotalMilliseconds >= (double)timedHeartBeat.remoteInterval)
						{
							timedHeartBeat.connection.SendCommand(null, 0, null);
						}
						timedHeartBeat.SetTimer(utcNow);
					}
					catch (Exception ex)
					{
						if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
						{
							throw;
						}
						if (!timedHeartBeat.connection.IsClosing())
						{
							MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogError(timedHeartBeat.connection, "OnHeartBeatTimer", ex.Message);
							timedHeartBeat.connection.SafeClose(ex);
						}
					}
				}
			}

			public static readonly HeartBeat None = new NoneHeartBeat();

			public abstract void OnSend();

			public abstract void OnReceive();

			public abstract void Stop();

			public static HeartBeat Initialize(AmqpConnection connection, uint local, uint remote)
			{
				return new TimedHeartBeat(connection, local, remote);
			}
		}

		private static readonly EventHandler onSessionClosed = OnSessionClosed;

		private readonly bool isInitiator;

		private readonly ProtocolHeader initialHeader;

		private readonly AmqpSettings amqpSettings;

		private readonly HandleTable<AmqpSession> sessionsByLocalHandle;

		private readonly HandleTable<AmqpSession> sessionsByRemoteHandle;

		private HeartBeat heartBeat;

		private KeyedByTypeCollection<object> extensions;

		public AmqpSettings AmqpSettings => amqpSettings;

		public ISessionFactory SessionFactory { get; set; }

		public KeyedByTypeCollection<object> Extensions => LazyInitializer.EnsureInitialized(ref extensions);

		public bool IsInitiator => isInitiator;

		internal IEnumerable<AmqpSession> Sessions
		{
			get
			{
				lock (base.ThisLock)
				{
					return sessionsByLocalHandle.Values;
				}
			}
		}

		internal AmqpConnection(TransportBase transport, AmqpSettings amqpSettings, AmqpConnectionSettings connectionSettings)
			: this(transport, amqpSettings.GetDefaultHeader(), isInitiator: true, amqpSettings, connectionSettings)
		{
		}

		internal AmqpConnection(TransportBase transport, ProtocolHeader protocolHeader, bool isInitiator, AmqpSettings amqpSettings, AmqpConnectionSettings connectionSettings)
			: this((isInitiator ? "out" : "in") + "-connection", transport, protocolHeader, isInitiator, amqpSettings, connectionSettings)
		{
		}

		internal AmqpConnection(string type, TransportBase transport, ProtocolHeader protocolHeader, bool isInitiator, AmqpSettings amqpSettings, AmqpConnectionSettings connectionSettings)
			: base(type, transport, connectionSettings, isInitiator)
		{
			if (amqpSettings == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("amqpSettings");
			}
			initialHeader = protocolHeader;
			this.isInitiator = isInitiator;
			this.amqpSettings = amqpSettings;
			sessionsByLocalHandle = new HandleTable<AmqpSession>(base.Settings.ChannelMax ?? 8191);
			sessionsByRemoteHandle = new HandleTable<AmqpSession>(base.Settings.ChannelMax ?? 8191);
			SessionFactory = this;
			heartBeat = HeartBeat.None;
		}

		public AmqpSession CreateSession(AmqpSessionSettings sessionSettings)
		{
			AmqpSession amqpSession = SessionFactory.CreateSession(this, sessionSettings);
			AddSession(amqpSession, null);
			return amqpSession;
		}

		public void SendCommand(Performative command, ushort channel, ByteBuffer payload)
		{
			int numberOfBytes;
			if (payload == null)
			{
				ByteBuffer byteBuffer = Frame.EncodeCommand(FrameType.Amqp, channel, command, 0);
				numberOfBytes = byteBuffer.Length;
				SendBuffer(byteBuffer);
			}
			else
			{
				ByteBuffer byteBuffer2 = Frame.EncodeCommand(FrameType.Amqp, channel, command, payload.Length);
				numberOfBytes = byteBuffer2.Length + payload.Length;
				SendBuffer(byteBuffer2, payload);
			}
			heartBeat.OnSend();
			if (base.UsageMeter != null)
			{
				base.UsageMeter.OnWrite(this, command?.DescriptorCode ?? 0, numberOfBytes);
			}
		}

		protected override bool OpenInternal()
		{
			if (isInitiator)
			{
				SendProtocolHeader(initialHeader);
				SendOpen();
				base.AsyncIO.Open();
			}
			else if (initialHeader != null)
			{
				OnProtocolHeader(initialHeader);
				base.AsyncIO.Open();
			}
			else
			{
				base.AsyncIO.Open();
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool CloseInternal()
		{
			heartBeat.Stop();
			CloseSessions(!SessionFrameAllowed());
			if (base.State == AmqpObjectState.OpenReceived)
			{
				SendOpen();
			}
			try
			{
				SendClose();
			}
			catch (AmqpException)
			{
				base.State = AmqpObjectState.End;
			}
			bool flag = base.State == AmqpObjectState.End;
			if (flag)
			{
				base.AsyncIO.SafeClose();
			}
			return flag;
		}

		protected override void AbortInternal()
		{
			heartBeat.Stop();
			CloseSessions(abort: true);
			base.AsyncIO.Abort();
		}

		protected override void OnProtocolHeader(ProtocolHeader header)
		{
			heartBeat.OnReceive();
			if (base.UsageMeter != null)
			{
				base.UsageMeter.OnRead(this, 0uL, header.EncodeSize);
			}
			TransitState("R:HDR", StateTransition.ReceiveHeader);
			Exception ex = null;
			if (isInitiator)
			{
				if (!initialHeader.Equals(header))
				{
					ex = new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.NotImplemented, SRAmqp.AmqpProtocolVersionNotSupported(initialHeader.ToString(), header.ToString()));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ProtocolHeader supportedHeader = amqpSettings.GetSupportedHeader(header);
				SendProtocolHeader(supportedHeader);
				if (!supportedHeader.Equals(header))
				{
					ex = new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.NotImplemented, SRAmqp.AmqpProtocolVersionNotSupported(initialHeader.ToString(), header.ToString()));
				}
			}
			if (ex != null)
			{
				CompleteOpen(syncComplete: false, ex);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnFrameBuffer(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			if (base.State == AmqpObjectState.End)
			{
				buffer.Dispose();
				return;
			}
			using Frame frame = new Frame();
			frame.Decode(buffer);
			heartBeat.OnReceive();
			if (base.UsageMeter != null)
			{
				base.UsageMeter.OnRead(this, (frame.Command != null) ? frame.Command.DescriptorCode : 0, buffer.Length);
			}
			if (frame.Command != null)
			{
				ProcessFrame(frame);
			}
		}

		protected override void HandleIoEvent(IoEvent ioEvent)
		{
			IEnumerator<AmqpSession> safeEnumerator = sessionsByLocalHandle.GetSafeEnumerator();
			while (safeEnumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				safeEnumerator.Current.OnIoEvent(ioEvent);
			}
		}

		private bool SessionFrameAllowed()
		{
			if (base.State != AmqpObjectState.OpenPipe && base.State != AmqpObjectState.OpenSent)
			{
				return base.State == AmqpObjectState.Opened;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void CloseSessions(bool abort)
		{
			IEnumerable<AmqpSession> enumerable = null;
			lock (base.ThisLock)
			{
				enumerable = sessionsByLocalHandle.Values;
				if (abort)
				{
					sessionsByLocalHandle.Clear();
					sessionsByRemoteHandle.Clear();
				}
			}
			foreach (AmqpSession item in enumerable)
			{
				if (abort)
				{
					item.Abort();
				}
				else
				{
					item.SafeClose();
				}
			}
		}

		private void ProcessFrame(Frame frame)
		{
			Performative command = frame.Command;
			if (command.DescriptorCode == Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Amqp.Framing.Open.Code)
			{
				OnReceiveOpen((Open)frame.Command);
			}
			else if (command.DescriptorCode == Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Amqp.Framing.Close.Code)
			{
				OnReceiveClose((Close)frame.Command);
			}
			else
			{
				OnReceiveSessionFrame(frame);
			}
		}

		private void SendProtocolHeader(ProtocolHeader header)
		{
			TransitState("S:HDR", StateTransition.SendHeader);
			SendDatablock(header);
		}

		private void SendOpen()
		{
			TransitState("S:OPEN", StateTransition.SendOpen);
			if (base.TerminalException != null)
			{
				base.Settings.AddProperty("com.microsoft:open-error", Error.FromException(base.TerminalException));
			}
			SendCommand(base.Settings, 0, null);
		}

		private void SendClose()
		{
			TransitState("S:CLOSE", StateTransition.SendClose);
			Close close = new Close();
			if (base.TerminalException != null && !base.IsTerminalExceptionFromRemote)
			{
				close.Error = Error.FromException(base.TerminalException);
			}
			SendCommand(close, 0, null);
		}

		private void OnReceiveOpen(Open open)
		{
			StateTransition stateTransition = TransitState("R:OPEN", StateTransition.ReceiveOpen);
			uint num = open.IdleTimeOut();
			if (num < base.Settings.MinIdleTimeout)
			{
				CompleteOpen(syncComplete: false, new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.NotAllowed, SRAmqp.AmqpIdleTimeoutNotSupported(num, base.Settings.MinIdleTimeout)));
				return;
			}
			Negotiate(open);
			NotifyOpening(open);
			if (stateTransition.To == AmqpObjectState.OpenReceived)
			{
				SendOpen();
			}
			if (isInitiator)
			{
				if (open.Properties != null && ((RestrictedMap<AmqpSymbol>)open.Properties).TryGetValue((AmqpSymbol)"com.microsoft:open-error", out Error value))
				{
					CompleteOpen(stateTransition.From == AmqpObjectState.Start, new AmqpException(value));
					return;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				base.Settings.Properties = open.Properties;
			}
			uint actualIdleTimeout = base.Settings.ActualIdleTimeout;
			num = open.IdleTimeOut();
			if (num != uint.MaxValue || actualIdleTimeout != uint.MaxValue)
			{
				heartBeat = HeartBeat.Initialize(this, actualIdleTimeout, num);
			}
			CompleteOpen(stateTransition.From == AmqpObjectState.Start, null);
		}

		private void OnReceiveClose(Close close)
		{
			OnReceiveCloseCommand("R:CLOSE", close.Error);
			if (base.State == AmqpObjectState.End)
			{
				base.AsyncIO.SafeClose();
			}
		}

		private void OnReceiveSessionFrame(Frame frame)
		{
			AmqpSession value = null;
			Performative command = frame.Command;
			ushort channel = frame.Channel;
			if (command.DescriptorCode == Begin.Code)
			{
				Begin begin = (Begin)command;
				if (begin.RemoteChannel.HasValue)
				{
					lock (base.ThisLock)
					{
						if (!sessionsByLocalHandle.TryGetObject(begin.RemoteChannel.Value, out value))
						{
							throw new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.NotFound, SRAmqp.AmqpChannelNotFound(begin.RemoteChannel.Value, this));
						}
						value.Settings.RemoteChannel = channel;
						sessionsByRemoteHandle.Add(channel, value);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					AmqpSessionSettings amqpSessionSettings = AmqpSessionSettings.Create(begin);
					amqpSessionSettings.RemoteChannel = channel;
					value = SessionFactory.CreateSession(this, amqpSessionSettings);
					AddSession(value, channel);
				}
			}
			else if (!sessionsByRemoteHandle.TryGetObject(channel, out value))
			{
				if (command.DescriptorCode == End.Code || command.DescriptorCode == Detach.Code || base.Settings.IgnoreMissingSessions)
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpMissingHandle(this, string.Empty, "session", channel);
					return;
				}
				throw new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.NotFound, SRAmqp.AmqpChannelNotFound(channel, this));
			}
			value.ProcessFrame(frame);
		}

		private void Negotiate(Open open)
		{
			base.Settings.RemoteContainerId = open.ContainerId;
			base.Settings.RemoteHostName = open.HostName;
			base.Settings.ChannelMax = Math.Min(base.Settings.ChannelMax(), open.ChannelMax());
			sessionsByLocalHandle.SetMaxHandle(base.Settings.ChannelMax.Value);
			sessionsByRemoteHandle.SetMaxHandle(base.Settings.ChannelMax.Value);
			if (isInitiator)
			{
				FindMutualCapabilites(base.Settings.DesiredCapabilities, open.OfferedCapabilities);
			}
			else
			{
				FindMutualCapabilites(base.Settings.OfferedCapabilities, open.DesiredCapabilities);
			}
			if (open.MaxFrameSize.HasValue)
			{
				base.Settings.MaxFrameSize = Math.Min(base.Settings.MaxFrameSize.Value, open.MaxFrameSize.Value);
			}
		}

		AmqpSession ISessionFactory.CreateSession(AmqpConnection connection, AmqpSessionSettings sessionSettings)
		{
			return new AmqpSession(this, sessionSettings, amqpSettings.RuntimeProvider);
		}

		public void AddSession(AmqpSession session, ushort? channel)
		{
			lock (base.ThisLock)
			{
				if (IsClosing())
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(SRAmqp.AmqpObjectClosing(this, "begin"));
				}
				session.Closed += onSessionClosed;
				session.LocalChannel = (ushort)sessionsByLocalHandle.Add(session);
				if (channel.HasValue)
				{
					sessionsByRemoteHandle.Add(channel.Value, session);
				}
			}
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpAddSession(this, session, session.LocalChannel, channel.GetValueOrDefault());
		}

		private static void OnSessionClosed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			AmqpSession amqpSession = (AmqpSession)sender;
			AmqpConnection connection = amqpSession.Connection;
			if (connection == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			lock (connection.ThisLock)
			{
				connection.sessionsByLocalHandle.Remove(amqpSession.LocalChannel);
				if (amqpSession.Settings.RemoteChannel.HasValue)
				{
					connection.sessionsByRemoteHandle.Remove(amqpSession.Settings.RemoteChannel.Value);
				}
			}
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpRemoveSession(connection, amqpSession, amqpSession.LocalChannel, amqpSession.Settings.RemoteChannel.GetValueOrDefault());
		}
	}
	internal abstract class AmqpConnectionBase : AmqpObject, IIoHandler
	{
		private readonly AmqpConnectionSettings settings;

		private readonly AsyncIO asyncIO;

		private IAmqpUsageMeter usageMeter;

		public AmqpConnectionSettings Settings => settings;

		public IPrincipal Principal => asyncIO.Transport.Principal;

		public EndPoint LocalEndpoint => asyncIO.Transport.LocalEndPoint;

		public EndPoint RemoteEndpoint => asyncIO.Transport.RemoteEndPoint;

		public IAmqpUsageMeter UsageMeter
		{
			get
			{
				return usageMeter;
			}
			set
			{
				usageMeter = value;
				if (value != null)
				{
					asyncIO.Transport.SetMonitor(usageMeter);
				}
			}
		}

		protected AsyncIO AsyncIO => asyncIO;

		protected AmqpConnectionBase(string type, TransportBase transport, AmqpConnectionSettings settings, bool isInitiator)
			: base(type, transport.Identifier)
		{
			if (settings == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("settings");
			}
			this.settings = settings;
			asyncIO = new AsyncIO(this, (int)this.settings.MaxFrameSize(), this.settings.WriteBufferFullLimit, this.settings.WriteBufferEmptyLimit, transport, isInitiator);
		}

		public void SendDatablock(IAmqpSerializable dataBlock)
		{
			ByteBuffer buffer = new ByteBuffer(new byte[dataBlock.EncodeSize]);
			dataBlock.Encode(buffer);
			asyncIO.WriteBuffer(buffer);
		}

		public void SendBuffer(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			asyncIO.WriteBuffer(buffer);
		}

		public void SendBuffer(ByteBuffer cmdBuffer, ByteBuffer payload)
		{
			asyncIO.WriteBuffer(cmdBuffer, payload);
		}

		protected abstract void OnProtocolHeader(ProtocolHeader header);

		protected abstract void OnFrameBuffer(ByteBuffer buffer);

		protected virtual void HandleIoEvent(IoEvent ioEvent)
		{
		}

		ByteBuffer IIoHandler.CreateBuffer(int size, bool autoGrow)
		{
			return new ByteBuffer(size, autoGrow);
		}

		void IIoHandler.OnReceiveBuffer(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			OnReceiveFrameBuffer(buffer);
		}

		void IIoHandler.OnIoFault(Exception exception)
		{
			if (!IsClosing())
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogError(this, "AsyncIoFault", exception.ToStringSlim());
			}
			base.TerminalException = exception;
			Abort();
		}

		void IIoHandler.OnIoEvent(IoEvent ioEvent, long queueSize)
		{
			if (!IsClosing())
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpIoEvent(this, string.Empty, string.Empty, (int)ioEvent, "buffer", queueSize);
				HandleIoEvent(ioEvent);
			}
		}

		private void OnReceiveFrameBuffer(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			if (base.State <= AmqpObjectState.OpenClosePipe)
			{
				try
				{
					ProtocolHeader protocolHeader = new ProtocolHeader();
					protocolHeader.Decode(buffer);
					OnProtocolHeader(protocolHeader);
					return;
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
					{
						throw;
					}
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogError(this, "OnProtocolHeader", ex.Message);
					base.TerminalException = ex;
					Abort();
					return;
				}
			}
			try
			{
				OnFrameBuffer(buffer);
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogError(this, "OnFrame", exception.ToStringSlim());
				SafeClose(exception);
			}
		}
	}
	internal sealed class AmqpConnectionSettings : Open
	{
		public string RemoteContainerId { get; set; }

		public string RemoteHostName { get; set; }

		public int SendBufferSize { get; set; }

		public int ReceiveBufferSize { get; set; }

		public bool IgnoreMissingSessions { get; set; }

		public int WriteBufferFullLimit { get; set; }

		public int WriteBufferEmptyLimit { get; set; }

		public uint ActualIdleTimeout
		{
			get
			{
				if (!base.IdleTimeOut.HasValue || base.IdleTimeOut.Value == uint.MaxValue)
				{
					return uint.MaxValue;
				}
				if (base.IdleTimeOut.Value > int.MaxValue)
				{
					return base.IdleTimeOut.Value;
				}
				return base.IdleTimeOut.Value * 2;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value < MinIdleTimeout)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("ActualIdleTimeout", "Value is less than MinIdleTimeout.");
				}
				base.IdleTimeOut = value / 2;
			}
		}

		public uint MinIdleTimeout { get; set; }

		public AmqpConnectionSettings()
		{
			SendBufferSize = 8192;
			ReceiveBufferSize = 8192;
			base.MaxFrameSize = 65536u;
			base.ChannelMax = (ushort)8191;
			WriteBufferFullLimit = int.MaxValue;
			MinIdleTimeout = 10000u;
		}

		public AmqpConnectionSettings Clone()
		{
			AmqpConnectionSettings amqpConnectionSettings = new AmqpConnectionSettings();
			amqpConnectionSettings.ContainerId = base.ContainerId;
			amqpConnectionSettings.HostName = base.HostName;
			amqpConnectionSettings.MaxFrameSize = base.MaxFrameSize;
			amqpConnectionSettings.ChannelMax = base.ChannelMax;
			amqpConnectionSettings.IdleTimeOut = base.IdleTimeOut;
			amqpConnectionSettings.OutgoingLocales = base.OutgoingLocales;
			amqpConnectionSettings.IncomingLocales = base.IncomingLocales;
			amqpConnectionSettings.OfferedCapabilities = base.OfferedCapabilities;
			amqpConnectionSettings.DesiredCapabilities = base.DesiredCapabilities;
			amqpConnectionSettings.Properties = base.Properties;
			amqpConnectionSettings.SendBufferSize = SendBufferSize;
			amqpConnectionSettings.ReceiveBufferSize = ReceiveBufferSize;
			amqpConnectionSettings.IgnoreMissingSessions = IgnoreMissingSessions;
			amqpConnectionSettings.WriteBufferFullLimit = WriteBufferFullLimit;
			amqpConnectionSettings.WriteBufferEmptyLimit = WriteBufferEmptyLimit;
			amqpConnectionSettings.MinIdleTimeout = MinIdleTimeout;
			return amqpConnectionSettings;
		}
	}
	internal enum AmqpObjectState
	{
		Start,
		HeaderSent,
		OpenPipe,
		OpenClosePipe,
		HeaderReceived,
		HeaderExchanged,
		OpenSent,
		OpenReceived,
		ClosePipe,
		Opened,
		CloseSent,
		CloseReceived,
		End,
		Faulted
	}
	internal static class AmqpConstants
	{
		public static class SupportedCapabilities
		{
			public static readonly AmqpSymbol Queue = "queue";

			public static readonly AmqpSymbol Topic = "topic";

			public static readonly AmqpSymbol TemporaryQueue = "temporary-queue";

			public static readonly AmqpSymbol TemporaryTopic = "temporary-topic";

			public static readonly AmqpSymbol Global = "global";

			public static readonly AmqpSymbol DelayedDelivery = "DELAYED_DELIVERY";

			public static readonly AmqpSymbol SharedSource = "shared";

			public static readonly AmqpSymbol SharedSubsCapability = "SHARED-SUBS";

			public static readonly Multiple<AmqpSymbol> EntityTypeCapabilities = new Multiple<AmqpSymbol>(new List<AmqpSymbol> { Queue, Topic, TemporaryQueue, TemporaryTopic });

			public static readonly Multiple<AmqpSymbol> TemporaryCapabilities = new Multiple<AmqpSymbol>(new List<AmqpSymbol> { TemporaryQueue, TemporaryTopic });

	[Serializable]
	internal sealed class AmqpException : Exception
	{
		public Error Error { get; private set; }

		public AmqpException(Error error)
			: base(error.Description ?? SRAmqp.AmqpErrorOccurred(error.Condition.Value))
		{
			Error = error;
		}

		public AmqpException(AmqpSymbol condition, string description)
			: this(new Error
			{
				Condition = condition,
				Description = description
			})
		{
		}

		private AmqpException(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			: base(info, context)
		{
			Error = (Error)info.GetValue("Error", typeof(Error));
		}

		public static AmqpException FromError(Error error)
		{
			if (error == null || error.Condition.Value == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new AmqpException(error);
		}

		public override void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			base.GetObjectData(info, context);
			info.AddValue("Error", Error);
		}
	}
	internal abstract class AmqpLink : AmqpObject, IWorkDelegate<Delivery>
	{
		private static readonly AsyncCallback onProviderLinkOpened = OnProviderLinkOpened;

		private readonly object syncRoot;

		private readonly AmqpLinkSettings settings;

		private readonly Outcome defaultOutcome;

		private readonly Dictionary<ArraySegment<byte>, Delivery> unsettledMap;

		private readonly SerializedWorker<Delivery> inflightDeliveries;

		private Action<uint, bool, ArraySegment<byte>> creditListener;

		private SequenceNumber deliveryCount;

		private uint available;

		private uint linkCredit;

		private bool drain;

		private uint needFlowCount;

		private int sendingFlow;

		private uint? tempTotalCredit;

		private uint bufferedCredit;

		private bool sessionClosed;

		private int references;

		public string Name => settings.LinkName;

		public uint? LocalHandle
		{
			get
			{
				return settings.Handle;
			}
			set
			{
				settings.Handle = value;
			}
		}

		public uint? RemoteHandle { get; set; }

		public AmqpSession Session { get; private set; }

		public AmqpLinkSettings Settings => settings;

		public bool IsReceiver => settings.Role.Value;

		public uint LinkCredit
		{
			get
			{
				return linkCredit;
			}
			protected set
			{
				linkCredit = value;
			}
		}

		public virtual uint Available => available;

		public uint MaxFrameSize { get; set; }

		protected Dictionary<ArraySegment<byte>, Delivery> UnsettledMap => unsettledMap;

		protected object SyncRoot => syncRoot;

		internal bool Drain => drain;

		public int UnsettledDeliveryCount => unsettledMap.Count;

		public bool? ReceivedDetachClosed { get; set; }

		public bool HasReceivedDetach { get; set; }

		internal event EventHandler PropertyReceived;

		protected AmqpLink(AmqpSession session, AmqpLinkSettings linkSettings)
			: this("link", session, linkSettings)
		{
			inflightDeliveries = new SerializedWorker<Delivery>(this);
		}

		protected AmqpLink(string type, AmqpSession session, AmqpLinkSettings linkSettings)
			: base(type)
		{
			if (linkSettings == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("linkSettings");
			}
			references = 1;
			syncRoot = new object();
			settings = linkSettings;
			linkCredit = settings.TotalLinkCredit;
			Source source = (Source)settings.Source;
			if (source != null)
			{
				defaultOutcome = source.DefaultOutcome;
			}
			if (defaultOutcome == null)
			{
				defaultOutcome = AmqpConstants.ReleasedOutcome;
			}
			unsettledMap = new Dictionary<ArraySegment<byte>, Delivery>(ByteArrayComparer.Instance);
			if (session != null)
			{
				AttachTo(session);
			}
		}

		public void RegisterCreditListener(Action<uint, bool, ArraySegment<byte>> creditListener)
		{
			lock (syncRoot)
			{
				if (this.creditListener == null)
				{
					this.creditListener = creditListener;
					return;
				}
				throw new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.CreditListenerAlreadyRegistered);
			}
		}

		public void AttachTo(AmqpSession session)
		{
			MaxFrameSize = session.Connection.Settings.MaxFrameSize();
			Session = session;
			session.AttachLink(this);
		}

		public void ProcessFrame(Frame frame)
		{
			Performative command = frame.Command;
			try
			{
				if (command.DescriptorCode == Attach.Code)
				{
					OnReceiveAttach((Attach)command);
					return;
				}
				if (command.DescriptorCode == Detach.Code)
				{
					OnReceiveDetach((Detach)command);
					return;
				}
				if (command.DescriptorCode == Transfer.Code)
				{
					OnReceiveTransfer((Transfer)command, frame);
					return;
				}
				if (command.DescriptorCode == Flow.Code)
				{
					OnReceiveFlow((Flow)command);
					return;
				}
				throw new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.InvalidField, SRAmqp.AmqpInvalidPerformativeCode(command.DescriptorCode));
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogError(this, "ProcessFrame", exception.ToStringSlim());
				SafeClose(exception);
			}
		}

		public void OnFlow(Flow flow)
		{
			OnReceiveFlow(flow);
		}

		public bool TrySendDelivery(Delivery delivery)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			lock (syncRoot)
			{
				if (linkCredit != 0)
				{
					flag = true;
					deliveryCount.Increment();
					if (linkCredit != uint.MaxValue)
					{
						linkCredit--;
					}
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogOperationVerbose(this, TraceOperation.Send, "NoCredit");
				return false;
			}
			StartSendDelivery(delivery);
			return true;
		}

		public void ForceSendDelivery(Delivery delivery)
		{
			lock (syncRoot)
			{
				deliveryCount.Increment();
				if (linkCredit != 0 && linkCredit < uint.MaxValue)
				{
					linkCredit--;
				}
			}
			StartSendDelivery(delivery);
		}

		public void DisposeDelivery(Delivery delivery, bool settled, DeliveryState state)
		{
			DisposeDelivery(delivery, settled, state, noFlush: false);
		}

		public void DisposeDelivery(Delivery delivery, bool settled, DeliveryState state, bool noFlush)
		{
			DoActionIfNotClosed(delegate(AmqpLink thisPtr, Delivery paramDelivery, bool paramSettled, DeliveryState paramState, bool paramNoFlush)
			{
				thisPtr.DisposeDeliveryInternal(paramDelivery, paramSettled, paramState, paramNoFlush);
				return true;
			}, delivery, settled, state, noFlush);
		}

		public bool DisposeDelivery(ArraySegment<byte> deliveryTag, bool settled, DeliveryState state, bool batchable)
		{
			Delivery value = null;
			lock (syncRoot)
			{
				unsettledMap.TryGetValue(deliveryTag, out value);
			}
			if (value != null)
			{
				value.Batchable = batchable;
				DisposeDelivery(value, settled, state);
				return true;
			}
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpDeliveryNotFound(this, deliveryTag.GetString());
			return false;
		}

		public void SetTotalLinkCredit(uint totalCredit, bool applyNow, bool updateAutoFlow = false)
		{
			lock (syncRoot)
			{
				bool flag = !tempTotalCredit.HasValue && linkCredit == 0 && totalCredit != 0;
				tempTotalCredit = totalCredit;
				if (updateAutoFlow)
				{
					settings.AutoSendFlow = totalCredit != 0;
				}
				if ((applyNow || flag) && ApplyTempTotalLinkCredit() && base.State == AmqpObjectState.Opened)
				{
					SendFlow(echo: false, drain: false, null);
				}
			}
		}

		public void DrainCredits()
		{
			lock (syncRoot)
			{
				deliveryCount += (int)linkCredit;
				linkCredit = 0u;
				if (!IsReceiver)
				{
					SendFlow(echo: false, drain: true, null);
				}
			}
		}

		public void IssueCredit(uint credit, bool drain, ArraySegment<byte> txnId)
		{
			if (!settings.AutoSendFlow)
			{
				lock (syncRoot)
				{
					settings.TotalLinkCredit = credit;
					linkCredit = credit;
				}
				SendFlow(echo: false, drain, txnId);
			}
		}

		public void NotifySessionCredit(int credit)
		{
			if (inflightDeliveries != null)
			{
				inflightDeliveries.ContinueWork();
			}
			else
			{
				OnCreditAvailable(credit, 0u, drain: false, AmqpConstants.NullBinary);
			}
		}

		public void OnDisposeDelivery(Delivery delivery)
		{
			if (delivery.Settled)
			{
				lock (syncRoot)
				{
					unsettledMap.Remove(delivery.DeliveryTag);
				}
				OnDeliverySettled();
			}
			OnDisposeDeliveryInternal(delivery);
			if (!IsReceiver && settings.SettleType != SettleMode.SettleOnDispose && !delivery.Settled && !delivery.Transactional())
			{
				CompleteDelivery(delivery.DeliveryTag);
			}
		}

		public void CompleteDelivery(ArraySegment<byte> deliveryTag)
		{
			Delivery value = null;
			lock (syncRoot)
			{
				unsettledMap.TryGetValue(deliveryTag, out value);
			}
			if (value != null)
			{
				DisposeDelivery(value, settled: true, value.State);
			}
		}

		public void SendProperties(Fields properties)
		{
			SendFlow(echo: false, drain: false, properties);
		}

		public uint ProcessFlow(Flow flow)
		{
			uint num = 0u;
			if (flow.Properties != null)
			{
				EventHandler eventHandler = this.PropertyReceived;
				if (eventHandler != null)
				{
					eventHandler(flow.Properties, EventArgs.Empty);
					return num;
				}
			}
			uint num2 = flow.LinkCredit();
			lock (syncRoot)
			{
				drain = flow.Drain == true;
				if (IsReceiver)
				{
					available = (uint)(((int?)flow.Available) ?? (-1));
					if (drain)
					{
						DrainCredits();
					}
					ApplyTempTotalLinkCredit();
				}
				else if (num2 != uint.MaxValue)
				{
					if (linkCredit == uint.MaxValue)
					{
						linkCredit = num2;
						num = 0u;
					}
					else
					{
						SequenceNumber sequenceNumber = flow.DeliveryCount.GetValueOrDefault() + num2;
						SequenceNumber sequenceNumber2 = deliveryCount.Value + linkCredit;
						int num3 = sequenceNumber - sequenceNumber2;
						if (num3 > 0)
						{
							linkCredit += (uint)num3;
							num = (uint)num3;
						}
						else if (num3 < 0)
						{
							uint num4 = (uint)(-num3);
							linkCredit = ((num4 <= linkCredit) ? (linkCredit - num4) : 0u);
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					linkCredit = uint.MaxValue;
					num = uint.MaxValue;
				}
			}
			if (num != 0 || drain)
			{
				ArraySegment<byte> txnIdFromFlow = GetTxnIdFromFlow(flow);
				OnCreditAvailable(0, num, drain, txnIdFromFlow);
			}
			if (flow.Echo())
			{
				SendFlow(echo: false, drain, null);
			}
			return num;
		}

		public abstract bool CreateDelivery(Transfer transfer, out Delivery delivery);

		internal virtual void OnIoEvent(IoEvent ioEvent)
		{
			EventHandler eventHandler = this.PropertyReceived;
			if (eventHandler != null)
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpIoEvent(Session.Connection, Session, this, (int)ioEvent, "credit", linkCredit);
				Fields fields = new Fields();
				fields.Add(AmqpConstants.IoEvent, (int)ioEvent);
				eventHandler(fields, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		bool IWorkDelegate<Delivery>.Invoke(Delivery delivery)
		{
			return DoActionIfNotClosed(delegate(AmqpLink thisPtr, Delivery paramDelivery, int p1, int p2, int p3)
			{
				bool flag = thisPtr.SendDelivery(paramDelivery);
				if (!flag)
				{
					if (!thisPtr.sessionClosed)
					{
						thisPtr.sessionClosed = true;
						thisPtr.OnIoEvent(IoEvent.WriteBufferQueueFull);
					}
				}
				else if (thisPtr.sessionClosed)
				{
					thisPtr.sessionClosed = false;
					thisPtr.OnIoEvent(IoEvent.WriteBufferQueueEmpty);
				}
				return flag;
			}, delivery, 0, 0, 0);
		}

		protected override bool OpenInternal()
		{
			AmqpObjectState amqpObjectState = SendAttach(settings);
			if (IsReceiver)
			{
				lock (syncRoot)
				{
					ApplyTempTotalLinkCredit();
				}
			}
			return amqpObjectState == AmqpObjectState.Opened;
		}

		protected override bool CloseInternal()
		{
			AmqpObjectState state = base.State;
			if (state == AmqpObjectState.OpenReceived || state == AmqpObjectState.ClosePipe)
			{
				SendAttach(CreateAttachForClose());
			}
			if (inflightDeliveries != null)
			{
				inflightDeliveries.Abort();
			}
			if (Interlocked.Decrement(ref references) > 0)
			{
				SpinWait.SpinUntil(() => references <= 0, 10000);
			}
			Session.Flush();
			lock (syncRoot)
			{
				unsettledMap.Clear();
			}
			state = SendDetach();
			return state == AmqpObjectState.End;
		}

		protected override void AbortInternal()
		{
			Interlocked.Decrement(ref references);
			if (inflightDeliveries != null)
			{
				inflightDeliveries.Abort();
			}
		}

		protected void SendFlow(bool echo)
		{
			SendFlow(echo, drain: false, null);
		}

		protected void ProcessTransfer(Transfer transfer, Frame rawFrame, Delivery delivery, bool newDelivery)
		{
			if (newDelivery)
			{
				if (linkCredit < uint.MaxValue)
				{
					bool flag = true;
					lock (syncRoot)
					{
						if (tempTotalCredit.HasValue && ApplyTempTotalLinkCredit())
						{
							SendFlow(echo: false, drain: false, null);
						}
						if (linkCredit == 0 && bufferedCredit == 0)
						{
							flag = false;
						}
						else
						{
							deliveryCount.Increment();
							if (bufferedCredit != 0)
							{
								bufferedCredit--;
							}
							else if (linkCredit < uint.MaxValue)
							{
								linkCredit--;
							}
						}
					}
					if (!flag)
					{
						throw new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.TransferLimitExceeded, SRAmqp.AmqpTransferLimitExceeded(delivery.DeliveryId.Value));
					}
				}
				if (!delivery.Settled)
				{
					lock (syncRoot)
					{
						unsettledMap.Add(delivery.DeliveryTag, delivery);
					}
				}
			}
			OnProcessTransfer(delivery, transfer, rawFrame);
		}

		protected virtual void OnReceiveFlow(Flow flow)
		{
			ProcessFlow(flow);
		}

		protected abstract void OnProcessTransfer(Delivery delivery, Transfer transfer, Frame rawFrame);

		protected virtual void OnCreditAvailable(int session, uint moreCredit, bool drain, ArraySegment<byte> txnId)
		{
			if (creditListener != null && (LinkCredit != 0 || drain))
			{
				creditListener(moreCredit, drain, txnId);
			}
		}

		protected abstract void OnDisposeDeliveryInternal(Delivery delivery);

		protected virtual void OnReceiveStateOpenSent(Attach attach)
		{
		}

		protected bool SendDelivery(Delivery delivery)
		{
			bool settled = delivery.Settled;
			bool more = true;
			while (more)
			{
				bool flag = delivery.BytesTransfered == 0;
				Transfer transfer = new Transfer();
				transfer.Handle = LocalHandle;
				transfer.More = more;
				if (flag)
				{
					transfer.DeliveryId = uint.MaxValue;
					transfer.DeliveryTag = delivery.DeliveryTag;
					transfer.MessageFormat = delivery.MessageFormat.GetValueOrDefault();
					transfer.Batchable = delivery.Batchable;
					transfer.State = delivery.State;
					if (settled)
					{
						transfer.Settled = true;
					}
					if (delivery.TxnId.Array != null)
					{
						transfer.State = new TransactionalState
						{
							TxnId = delivery.TxnId
						};
					}
				}
				uint num = ((MaxFrameSize == uint.MaxValue) ? 65536u : MaxFrameSize);
				int num2 = 8 + transfer.EncodeSize;
				if (num2 > num)
				{
					throw new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.FrameSizeTooSmall, null);
				}
				int payloadSize = (int)num - num2;
				ByteBuffer payload = delivery.GetPayload(payloadSize, out more);
				transfer.More = more;
				if (!flag && payload == null)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (!Session.TrySendTransfer(flag ? delivery : null, transfer, payload))
				{
					payload.Dispose();
					more = true;
					break;
				}
				delivery.CompletePayload(payload.Length);
			}
			if (!more && settled)
			{
				delivery.State = AmqpConstants.AcceptedOutcome;
				OnDisposeDeliveryInternal(delivery);
			}
			return !more;
		}

		protected bool DoActionIfNotClosed<T1, T2, T3, T4>(Func<AmqpLink, T1, T2, T3, T4, bool> action, T1 p1, T2 p2, T3 p3, T4 p4)
		{
			int num = Interlocked.Increment(ref references);
			try
			{
				if (num > 1)
				{
					return action(this, p1, p2, p3, p4);
				}
				return false;
			}
			finally
			{
				Interlocked.Decrement(ref references);
			}
		}

		private void StartSendDelivery(Delivery delivery)
		{
			delivery.Settled = settings.SettleType == SettleMode.SettleOnSend;
			if (!delivery.Settled)
			{
				lock (syncRoot)
				{
					unsettledMap.Add(delivery.DeliveryTag, delivery);
				}
			}
			delivery.Link = this;
			inflightDeliveries.DoWork(delivery);
		}

		private void DisposeDeliveryInternal(Delivery delivery, bool settled, DeliveryState state, bool noFlush)
		{
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpDispose(this, delivery.DeliveryId.Value, settled, state);
			if (settled && !delivery.Settled)
			{
				lock (syncRoot)
				{
					unsettledMap.Remove(delivery.DeliveryTag);
				}
			}
			Session.DisposeDelivery(this, delivery, settled, state, noFlush);
			if (delivery.Settled)
			{
				OnDeliverySettled();
			}
		}

		private void OnDeliverySettled()
		{
			if (!IsReceiver || !settings.AutoSendFlow || linkCredit >= uint.MaxValue)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			lock (syncRoot)
			{
				if (linkCredit < settings.TotalLinkCredit)
				{
					linkCredit++;
				}
				needFlowCount++;
				if (needFlowCount >= settings.FlowThreshold)
				{
					flag = true;
					needFlowCount = 0u;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				SendFlow(echo: false, drain: false, null);
			}
		}

		private AmqpObjectState SendAttach(Attach attach)
		{
			StateTransition stateTransition = TransitState("S:ATTACH", StateTransition.SendOpen);
			Session.SendCommand(attach);
			return stateTransition.To;
		}

		private AmqpObjectState SendDetach()
		{
			StateTransition stateTransition = TransitState("S:DETACH", StateTransition.SendClose);
			Detach detach = new Detach();
			detach.Handle = LocalHandle;
			Exception terminalException = base.TerminalException;
			detach.Closed = (HasReceivedDetach ? ReceivedDetachClosed : new bool?(true));
			if (terminalException != null && !base.IsTerminalExceptionFromRemote)
			{
				detach.Error = Error.FromException(terminalException);
			}
			Session.SendCommand(detach);
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLinkDetach(this, Name, LocalHandle.GetValueOrDefault(), "S:DETACH", (detach.Error != null) ? detach.Error.Condition.Value : string.Empty, detach.Closed == true);
			return stateTransition.To;
		}

		private void OnReceiveAttach(Attach attach)
		{
			StateTransition stateTransition = TransitState("R:ATTACH", StateTransition.ReceiveOpen);
			Error error = Negotiate(attach);
			if (error != null)
			{
				OnLinkOpenFailed(new AmqpException(error));
				return;
			}
			NotifyOpening(attach);
			if (stateTransition.From == AmqpObjectState.OpenSent)
			{
				if (IsReceiver)
				{
					if (settings.Source is Source source && source.Dynamic())
					{
						source.Address = ((Source)attach.Source).Address;
					}
					OnReceiveStateOpenSent(attach);
				}
				else if (settings.Target is Target target && target.Dynamic())
				{
					target.Address = ((Target)attach.Target).Address;
				}
				if (attach.Properties != null)
				{
					if (Settings.Properties == null)
					{
						settings.Properties = attach.Properties;
					}
					else
					{
						settings.Properties.Merge(attach.Properties);
					}
				}
				if (attach.OfferedCapabilities != null)
				{
					settings.OfferedCapabilities = attach.OfferedCapabilities;
				}
			}
			if (stateTransition.To == AmqpObjectState.Opened)
			{
				if ((!IsReceiver || attach.Source != null) && (IsReceiver || attach.Target != null))
				{
					if (IsReceiver)
					{
						deliveryCount = attach.InitialDeliveryCount.Value;
						settings.Source = attach.Source;
						settings.SndSettleMode = attach.SndSettleMode;
					}
					else
					{
						settings.Target = attach.Target;
						settings.RcvSettleMode = attach.RcvSettleMode;
						settings.MaxMessageSize = attach.MaxMessageSize;
					}
					CompleteOpen(syncComplete: false, null);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (stateTransition.To != AmqpObjectState.OpenReceived)
				{
					return;
				}
				try
				{
					Session.LinkFactory.BeginOpenLink(this, base.DefaultOpenTimeout, onProviderLinkOpened, this);
				}
				catch (Exception exception)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
					{
						throw;
					}
					OnLinkOpenFailed(exception);
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnReceiveDetach(Detach detach)
		{
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLinkDetach(this, Name, LocalHandle.GetValueOrDefault(), "R:DETACH", (detach.Error != null) ? detach.Error.Condition.Value : string.Empty, detach.Closed == true);
			HasReceivedDetach = true;
			ReceivedDetachClosed = detach.Closed;
			OnReceiveCloseCommand("R:DETACH", detach.Error);
		}

		private void OnReceiveTransfer(Transfer transfer, Frame rawFrame)
		{
			Delivery delivery = null;
			bool flag = CreateDelivery(transfer, out delivery);
			if (flag)
			{
				delivery.Link = this;
				delivery.DeliveryId = transfer.DeliveryId.Value;
				delivery.DeliveryTag = transfer.DeliveryTag;
				delivery.Settled = transfer.Settled();
				delivery.Batchable = transfer.Batchable();
				delivery.MessageFormat = transfer.MessageFormat;
				delivery.State = transfer.State;
				if (transfer.State != null && transfer.State.DescriptorCode == TransactionalState.Code)
				{
					delivery.TxnId = ((TransactionalState)transfer.State).TxnId;
				}
			}
			else if (delivery == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (Session.OnAcceptTransfer(delivery, transfer, flag))
			{
				ProcessTransfer(transfer, rawFrame, delivery, flag);
			}
		}

		private ArraySegment<byte> GetTxnIdFromFlow(Flow flow)
		{
			object obj;
			if (flow.Properties != null && (obj = flow.Properties["txn-id"]) != null)
			{
				return (ArraySegment<byte>)obj;
			}
			return AmqpConstants.NullBinary;
		}

		private Error Negotiate(Attach attach)
		{
			if (attach.MaxMessageSize() != 0L)
			{
				settings.MaxMessageSize = Math.Min(settings.MaxMessageSize(), attach.MaxMessageSize());
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static void OnProviderLinkOpened(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			AmqpLink amqpLink = (AmqpLink)result.AsyncState;
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogOperationVerbose(amqpLink, TraceOperation.Execute, "OnProviderLinkOpened");
			Exception ex = null;
			try
			{
				amqpLink.Session.LinkFactory.EndOpenLink(result);
			}
			catch (Exception ex2)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(ex2))
				{
					throw;
				}
				ex = ex2;
			}
			try
			{
				if (ex != null)
				{
					amqpLink.OnLinkOpenFailed(ex);
				}
				else
				{
					amqpLink.Open();
				}
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				amqpLink.OnLinkOpenFailed(exception);
			}
		}

		private void OnLinkOpenFailed(Exception exception)
		{
			if (base.State == AmqpObjectState.OpenReceived)
			{
				SendAttach(CreateAttachForClose());
			}
			SafeClose(exception);
		}

		private bool ApplyTempTotalLinkCredit()
		{
			if (!tempTotalCredit.HasValue || tempTotalCredit.Value == settings.TotalLinkCredit)
			{
				return false;
			}
			uint totalLinkCredit = settings.TotalLinkCredit;
			uint value = tempTotalCredit.Value;
			settings.TotalLinkCredit = value;
			tempTotalCredit = null;
			if (value == uint.MaxValue)
			{
				linkCredit = value;
				bufferedCredit = 0u;
			}
			else if (value > totalLinkCredit)
			{
				uint num = value - totalLinkCredit;
				linkCredit += num;
				bufferedCredit -= Math.Min(bufferedCredit, num);
			}
			else if (totalLinkCredit < int.MaxValue)
			{
				uint num2 = totalLinkCredit - value;
				linkCredit -= Math.Min(linkCredit, num2);
				bufferedCredit += num2;
			}
			else
			{
				linkCredit = value;
				bufferedCredit = 0u;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void SendFlow(bool echo, bool drain, ArraySegment<byte> txnId)
		{
			Fields fields = null;
			if (txnId.Array != null)
			{
				fields = new Fields();
				fields["txn-id"] = txnId;
			}
			SendFlow(echo, drain, fields);
		}

		protected void SendFlow(bool echo, bool drain, Fields properties)
		{
			DoActionIfNotClosed(delegate(AmqpLink thisPtr, bool paramEcho, bool paramDrain, Fields paramProperties, int p5)
			{
				thisPtr.SendFlowInternal(paramEcho, paramDrain, paramProperties);
				return true;
			}, echo, drain, properties, 0);
		}

		private void SendFlowInternal(bool echo, bool drain, Fields properties)
		{
			this.drain = drain;
			bool flag = echo || properties != null;
			if (!flag && Interlocked.Increment(ref sendingFlow) != 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			do
			{
				Flow flow = new Flow();
				flow.Handle = LocalHandle;
				lock (syncRoot)
				{
					flow.LinkCredit = linkCredit;
					flow.Available = Available;
					flow.DeliveryCount = deliveryCount.Value;
					if (this.drain)
					{
						flow.Drain = true;
					}
				}
				flow.Echo = echo;
				flow.Properties = properties;
				if (!IsClosing())
				{
					Session.SendFlow(flow);
				}
			}
			while (!flag && Interlocked.Decrement(ref sendingFlow) > 0);
		}

		private Attach CreateAttachForClose()
		{
			Attach attach = new Attach();
			attach.LinkName = settings.LinkName;
			attach.Role = settings.Role;
			attach.Handle = settings.Handle;
			attach.OfferedCapabilities = settings.OfferedCapabilities;
			return attach;
		}
	}
	internal sealed class AmqpLinkCollection
	{
	}
	internal sealed class AmqpLinkSettings : Attach
	{
		private uint linkCredit;

		public uint TotalLinkCredit
		{
			get
			{
				return linkCredit;
			}
			set
			{
				linkCredit = value;
				FlowThreshold = Math.Min(100, (int)(linkCredit * 2 / 3));
			}
		}

		public long? TotalCacheSizeInBytes { get; set; }

		public int FlowThreshold { get; set; }

		public bool AutoSendFlow { get; set; }

		public SettleMode SettleType
		{
			get
			{
				return this.SettleType();
			}
			set
			{
				switch (value)
				{
				case SettleMode.SettleOnSend:
					base.SndSettleMode = 1;
					break;
				case SettleMode.SettleOnReceive:
					base.RcvSettleMode = 0;
					break;
				case SettleMode.SettleOnDispose:
					base.RcvSettleMode = 1;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static AmqpLinkSettings Create(Attach attach)
		{
			AmqpLinkSettings amqpLinkSettings = new AmqpLinkSettings();
			amqpLinkSettings.LinkName = attach.LinkName;
			amqpLinkSettings.Role = !attach.Role.Value;
			amqpLinkSettings.Source = attach.Source;
			amqpLinkSettings.Target = attach.Target;
			amqpLinkSettings.SndSettleMode = attach.SndSettleMode;
			amqpLinkSettings.RcvSettleMode = attach.RcvSettleMode;
			amqpLinkSettings.MaxMessageSize = attach.MaxMessageSize;
			amqpLinkSettings.DesiredCapabilities = attach.DesiredCapabilities;
			amqpLinkSettings.OfferedCapabilities = attach.OfferedCapabilities;
			amqpLinkSettings.Properties = attach.Properties;
			if (amqpLinkSettings.Role.Value)
			{
				amqpLinkSettings.TotalLinkCredit = 1000u;
				amqpLinkSettings.AutoSendFlow = true;
			}
			else
			{
				amqpLinkSettings.InitialDeliveryCount = 0u;
			}
			return amqpLinkSettings;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is AmqpLinkSettings { LinkName: not null } amqpLinkSettings))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (base.LinkName.Equals(amqpLinkSettings.LinkName, StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase))
			{
				return base.Role == amqpLinkSettings.Role;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.LinkName.GetHashCode() * 397 + base.Role.GetHashCode();
		}
	}
	[Flags]
	internal enum SectionFlag
	{
		Header = 1,
		DeliveryAnnotations = 2,
		MessageAnnotations = 4,
		Properties = 8,
		ApplicationProperties = 0x10,
		Data = 0x20,
		AmqpSequence = 0x40,
		AmqpValue = 0x80,
		Footer = 0x100,
		All = 0x1FF,
		Body = 0xE0,
		NonBody = 0x11F,
		Mutable = 0x107,
		Immutable = 0xF8
	}
	internal abstract class AmqpMessage : Delivery
	{
		private abstract class AmqpSectionMessage : AmqpMessage
		{
			public override void Initialize(SectionFlag desiredSections)
			{
				if (buffer == null)
				{
					buffer = Encode();
					messageSize = buffer.Length;
				}
			}

			public override void CompletePayload(int payloadSize)
			{
				base.CompletePayload(payloadSize);
				buffer.Complete(payloadSize);
				if (buffer.Length == 0)
				{
					ReleaseBuffer();
				}
			}

			protected virtual void EncodeBody(ByteBuffer buffer)
			{
				int writePos = buffer.WritePos;
				if ((sectionFlags & SectionFlag.Data) != 0)
				{
					foreach (Data data in dataList)
					{
						EncodeSection(buffer, data);
					}
				}
				else if ((sectionFlags & SectionFlag.AmqpValue) != 0)
				{
					EncodeSection(buffer, amqpValue);
				}
				else if ((sectionFlags & SectionFlag.AmqpSequence) != 0)
				{
					foreach (AmqpSequence sequence in sequenceList)
					{
						EncodeSection(buffer, sequence);
					}
				}
				if (buffer.WritePos > writePos)
				{
					bodyOffset = writePos;
					bodyLength = buffer.WritePos - writePos;
				}
			}

			private ByteBuffer Encode()
			{
				ByteBuffer result = new ByteBuffer(1024, autoGrow: true);
				EncodeSection(result, header);
				EncodeSection(result, deliveryAnnotations);
				EncodeSection(result, messageAnnotations);
				EncodeSection(result, properties);
				EncodeSection(result, applicationProperties);
				EncodeBody(result);
				EncodeSection(result, footer);
				return result;
			}
		}

		private sealed class AmqpEmptyBodyMessage : AmqpSectionMessage
		{
		}

		private sealed class AmqpValueMessage : AmqpSectionMessage
		{
			public AmqpValueMessage(AmqpValue value)
			{
				amqpValue = value;
				sectionFlags |= SectionFlag.AmqpValue;
			}
		}

		private sealed class AmqpDataMessage : AmqpSectionMessage
		{
			public AmqpDataMessage(IList<Data> dataList)
			{
				base.dataList = dataList;
				sectionFlags |= SectionFlag.Data;
			}
		}

		private sealed class AmqpSequenceMessage : AmqpSectionMessage
		{
			public AmqpSequenceMessage(IList<AmqpSequence> sequence)
			{
				sequenceList = sequence;
				sectionFlags |= SectionFlag.AmqpSequence;
			}
		}

		private sealed class AmqpClonedMessage : AmqpSectionMessage
		{
			private readonly ByteBuffer source;

			public AmqpClonedMessage(AmqpMessage source)
			{
				CopyFrom(source, includeBody: true);
				this.source = source.buffer?.AddReference();
			}

			public override void Initialize(SectionFlag desiredSections)
			{
				int size = ((buffer == null) ? 1024 : buffer.Length);
				ByteBuffer byteBuffer = new ByteBuffer(size, autoGrow: true);
				EncodeSection(byteBuffer, header);
				EncodeSection(byteBuffer, deliveryAnnotations);
				EncodeSection(byteBuffer, messageAnnotations);
				WriteSection(byteBuffer, properties, source);
				WriteSection(byteBuffer, applicationProperties, source);
				if (source != null && bodyOffset >= 0)
				{
					AmqpBitConverter.WriteBytes(byteBuffer, source.Buffer, bodyOffset, bodyLength);
				}
				else
				{
					EncodeBody(byteBuffer);
				}
				EncodeSection(byteBuffer, footer);
				buffer?.Dispose();
				buffer = byteBuffer;
				messageSize = byteBuffer.Length;
			}

			public override void Dispose()
			{
				source?.Dispose();
				base.Dispose();
			}

			private static void WriteSection(ByteBuffer buffer, AmqpDescribed section, ByteBuffer source)
			{
				if (section != null)
				{
					if (source != null)
					{
						AmqpBitConverter.WriteBytes(buffer, source.Buffer, section.Offset, section.Length);
					}
					else
					{
						EncodeSection(buffer, section);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private sealed class AmqpBodyStreamMessage : AmqpSectionMessage
		{
			private readonly Stream bodyStream;

			private readonly bool ownStream;

			public override Stream BodyStream => bodyStream;

			public AmqpBodyStreamMessage(Stream bodyStream, bool ownStream)
			{
				sectionFlags |= SectionFlag.Data;
				this.bodyStream = bodyStream;
				this.ownStream = ownStream;
			}

			protected override void EncodeBody(ByteBuffer buffer)
			{
				int writePos = buffer.WritePos;
				buffer.Validate(write: true, 8);
				buffer.Append(8);
				int num = 0;
				long position = (bodyStream.CanSeek ? bodyStream.Position : (-1));
				try
				{
					while (true)
					{
						buffer.Validate(write: true, 512);
						int num2 = bodyStream.Read(buffer.Buffer, buffer.WritePos, 512);
						if (num2 == 0)
						{
							break;
						}
						buffer.Append(num2);
						num += num2;
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					if (bodyStream.CanSeek)
					{
						bodyStream.Position = position;
					}
				}
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer.Buffer, writePos, 0);
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer.Buffer, writePos + 1, 83);
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer.Buffer, writePos + 2, (byte)Data.Code);
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer.Buffer, writePos + 3, 176);
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteUInt(buffer.Buffer, writePos + 4, (uint)num);
				bodyOffset = writePos;
				bodyLength = buffer.WritePos - writePos;
				dataList = new Data[1]
				{
					new Data
					{
						Value = new ArraySegment<byte>(buffer.Buffer, writePos, num),
						Offset = writePos,
						Length = num
					}
				};
			}

			public override void Dispose()
			{
				base.Dispose();
				if (ownStream)
				{
					bodyStream.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		private sealed class AmqpBufferMessage : AmqpMessage
		{
			public AmqpBufferMessage()
			{
			}

			public AmqpBufferMessage(ByteBuffer buffer)
			{
				base.buffer = buffer;
				messageSize = buffer.Length;
			}

			public override void AddPayload(ByteBuffer payload, bool isLast)
			{
				base.BytesTransfered += payload.Length;
				buffer = Delivery.AddPayload(buffer, payload, isLast);
				messageSize = buffer.Length;
			}

			public override ByteBuffer GetPayload(int payloadSize, out bool more)
			{
				return Delivery.GetPayload(buffer, payloadSize, out more);
			}

			public override void Initialize(SectionFlag desiredSections)
			{
				if (sectionFlags > (SectionFlag)0 || AmqpMessageReader.TryRead(this, 0, buffer, desiredSections, (AmqpBufferMessage a, int b, Section s) => HandleSection(a, b, s), GetType().Name, out var error))
				{
					return;
				}
				throw new AmqpException(error);
			}

			protected override void EnsureInitialized<T>(ref T obj, SectionFlag section)
			{
				Initialize(SectionFlag.All);
			}

			internal static bool HandleSection(AmqpMessage thisPtr, int unused, Section section)
			{
				if (section.Flag == SectionFlag.Header)
				{
					thisPtr.Header = (Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Amqp.Framing.Header)section.Value;
				}
				else if (section.Flag == SectionFlag.DeliveryAnnotations)
				{
					thisPtr.DeliveryAnnotations = (DeliveryAnnotations)section.Value;
				}
				else if (section.Flag == SectionFlag.MessageAnnotations)
				{
					thisPtr.MessageAnnotations = (MessageAnnotations)section.Value;
				}
				else if (section.Flag == SectionFlag.Properties)
				{
					thisPtr.Properties = (Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Amqp.Framing.Properties)section.Value;
				}
				else if (section.Flag == SectionFlag.ApplicationProperties)
				{
					thisPtr.ApplicationProperties = (ApplicationProperties)section.Value;
				}
				else if (section.Flag == SectionFlag.Data)
				{
					if (thisPtr.dataList == null)
					{
						thisPtr.bodyOffset = section.Offset;
						thisPtr.dataList = new List<Data>();
						thisPtr.sectionFlags |= SectionFlag.Data;
					}
					thisPtr.bodyLength += section.Length;
					thisPtr.dataList.Add((Data)section.Value);
				}
				else if (section.Flag == SectionFlag.AmqpSequence)
				{
					if (thisPtr.sequenceList == null)
					{
						thisPtr.bodyOffset = section.Offset;
						thisPtr.sequenceList = new List<AmqpSequence>();
						thisPtr.sectionFlags |= SectionFlag.AmqpSequence;
					}
					thisPtr.bodyLength += section.Length;
					thisPtr.sequenceList.Add((AmqpSequence)section.Value);
				}
				else if (section.Flag == SectionFlag.AmqpValue)
				{
					thisPtr.bodyOffset = section.Offset;
					thisPtr.bodyLength = section.Length;
					thisPtr.amqpValue = (AmqpValue)section.Value;
					thisPtr.sectionFlags |= SectionFlag.AmqpValue;
				}
				else
				{
					if (section.Flag != SectionFlag.Footer)
					{
						throw new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.DecodeError, SRAmqp.AmqpInvalidMessageSectionCode(section.Flag));
					}
					thisPtr.Footer = (Footer)section.Value;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private sealed class AmqpClientLargeMessage : AmqpMessage
		{
			private const int InitialBufferSize = 32768;

			private const int MaxBufferSize = 98304;

			private const int StreamReadSize = 16384;

			private readonly Stream bodyStream;

			private bool streamReadCompleted;

			private long initialStreamPosition;

			internal AmqpClientLargeMessage(ByteBuffer buffer, Stream bodyStream)
				: this(bodyStream)
			{
				base.buffer = buffer;
			}

			public AmqpClientLargeMessage(Stream messageStream)
			{
				bodyStream = messageStream ?? throw new ArgumentNullException("messageStream");
				if (bodyStream.CanSeek)
				{
					initialStreamPosition = bodyStream.Position;
				}
			}

			public override void Dispose()
			{
				base.Dispose();
				bodyStream?.Dispose();
			}

			public override void Initialize(SectionFlag desiredSections)
			{
				if (buffer == null)
				{
					buffer = Encode();
				}
			}

			public override ByteBuffer GetPayload(int payloadSize, out bool more)
			{
				ByteBuffer byteBuffer = null;
				bool more2 = true;
				bool flag = false;
				try
				{
					if (buffer == null)
					{
						Initialize(SectionFlag.Header | SectionFlag.DeliveryAnnotations | SectionFlag.MessageAnnotations | SectionFlag.Properties | SectionFlag.ApplicationProperties);
					}
					if (buffer.Length > 0)
					{
						byteBuffer = Delivery.GetPayload(buffer, payloadSize, out more2);
					}
					else if (!streamReadCompleted)
					{
						ReleaseBuffer();
						buffer = InitializeBuffer();
						GetNextBodyChunk(buffer);
						byteBuffer = Delivery.GetPayload(buffer, payloadSize, out more2);
					}
				}
				catch
				{
					flag = true;
					byteBuffer?.Dispose();
					throw;
				}
				finally
				{
					more = !streamReadCompleted || more2;
					if ((flag || !more) && bodyStream.CanSeek)
					{
						bodyStream.Position = initialStreamPosition;
					}
				}
				return byteBuffer;
			}

			public override void CompletePayload(int payloadSize)
			{
				base.CompletePayload(payloadSize);
				buffer.Complete(payloadSize);
				if (streamReadCompleted && buffer.Length == 0)
				{
					ReleaseBuffer();
				}
			}

			private ByteBuffer InitializeBuffer()
			{
				return new ByteBuffer(32768, autoGrow: true);
			}

			private ByteBuffer Encode()
			{
				ByteBuffer result = InitializeBuffer();
				EncodeSection(result, header);
				EncodeSection(result, deliveryAnnotations);
				EncodeSection(result, messageAnnotations);
				EncodeSection(result, properties);
				EncodeSection(result, applicationProperties);
				return result;
			}

			private void GetNextBodyChunk(ByteBuffer buffer)
			{
				int num = 0;
				do
				{
					buffer.Validate(write: true, 16384);
					int num2 = bodyStream.Read(buffer.Buffer, buffer.WritePos, 16384);
					if (num2 == 0)
					{
						streamReadCompleted = true;
						break;
					}
					buffer.Append(num2);
					num += num2;
				}
				while (buffer.WritePos < 98304);
			}
		}

		internal sealed class AmqpServiceLargeMessage : AmqpMessage
		{
			private const int LargeMessageSize = 1048576;

			private LargeMessageStream bodyStream;

			public override Stream BodyStream => bodyStream;

			private bool HasStream => BodyStream != null;

			public override void AddPayload(ByteBuffer payload, bool isLastFrame)
			{
				int length = payload.Length;
				if (base.BytesTransfered + length <= 1048576)
				{
					buffer = Delivery.AddPayload(buffer, payload, isLastFrame);
				}
				else if (bodyStream == null)
				{
					bodyStream = new LargeMessageStream();
					Initialize(SectionFlag.Header | SectionFlag.DeliveryAnnotations | SectionFlag.MessageAnnotations | SectionFlag.Properties | SectionFlag.ApplicationProperties);
					int offset = buffer.Offset;
					bodyStream.Write(buffer.Buffer, buffer.Offset, buffer.Length);
					buffer.AdjustPosition(0, offset);
					bodyStream.Write(payload.Buffer, payload.Offset, payload.Length);
				}
				else
				{
					bodyStream.Write(payload.Buffer, payload.Offset, payload.Length);
				}
				base.BytesTransfered += length;
				messageSize += length;
				if (HasStream && isLastFrame)
				{
					bodyStream.Commit();
				}
			}

			public override void Initialize(SectionFlag desiredSections)
			{
				if (sectionFlags > (SectionFlag)0 || AmqpMessageReader.TryRead(this, 0, buffer, desiredSections, (AmqpServiceLargeMessage a, int b, Section s) => AmqpBufferMessage.HandleSection(a, b, s), GetType().Name, out var error, HasStream))
				{
					return;
				}
				throw new AmqpException(error);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void EnsureInitialized<T>(ref T obj, SectionFlag section) where T : class, new()
		{
			if (EnsureInitialized(ref obj))
			{
				sectionFlags |= section;
			}
		}

		private void ReleaseBuffer()
		{
			int comparand = disposeState & -3;
			int value = disposeState | 2;
			int num = Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref disposeState, value, comparand);
			if ((num & 2) == 0)
			{
				buffer?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		private static bool EnsureInitialized<T>(ref T obj) where T : class, new()
		{
			if (obj == null)
			{
				obj = new T();
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static void EncodeSection(ByteBuffer buffer, AmqpDescribed section)
		{
			if (section != null)
			{
				section.Offset = buffer.WritePos;
				section.Encode(buffer);
				section.Length = buffer.WritePos - section.Offset;
			}
		}

		internal void CopyFrom(AmqpMessage source, bool includeBody)
		{
			header = source.header;
			deliveryAnnotations = source.deliveryAnnotations;
			messageAnnotations = source.messageAnnotations;
			properties = source.properties;
			applicationProperties = source.applicationProperties;
			footer = source.footer;
			sectionFlags |= source.sectionFlags & SectionFlag.NonBody;
			if (includeBody)
			{
				dataList = source.dataList;
				sequenceList = source.sequenceList;
				amqpValue = source.amqpValue;
				bodyOffset = source.bodyOffset;
				bodyLength = source.bodyLength;
				sectionFlags |= source.sectionFlags & SectionFlag.Body;
			}
		}

		internal void CloneFrom(AmqpMessage source, bool includeBody)
		{
			header = source.header?.Clone();
			if (source?.deliveryAnnotations?.Map != null)
			{
				deliveryAnnotations = new DeliveryAnnotations();
				deliveryAnnotations.Map.Merge(source.deliveryAnnotations.Map);
			}
			if (source?.messageAnnotations?.Map != null)
			{
				messageAnnotations = new MessageAnnotations();
				messageAnnotations.Map.Merge(source.messageAnnotations.Map);
			}
			if (source?.applicationProperties?.Map != null)
			{
				applicationProperties = new ApplicationProperties();
				applicationProperties.Map.Merge(source.applicationProperties.Map);
			}
			if (source?.footer?.Map != null)
			{
				footer = new Footer();
				footer.Map.Merge(source.footer.Map);
			}
			properties = source.properties?.Clone();
			sectionFlags |= source.sectionFlags & SectionFlag.NonBody;
			if (includeBody)
			{
				dataList = source.dataList;
				sequenceList = source.sequenceList;
				amqpValue = source.amqpValue;
				bodyOffset = source.bodyOffset;
				bodyLength = source.bodyLength;
				sectionFlags |= source.sectionFlags & SectionFlag.Body;
			}
		}

		private void EnsureBodyType(SectionFlag expected)
		{
			if (sectionFlags == (SectionFlag)0 && buffer != null)
			{
				Initialize(SectionFlag.All);
			}
			SectionFlag sectionFlag = sectionFlags & SectionFlag.Body;
			if (sectionFlag > (SectionFlag)0 && sectionFlag != expected)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(SRAmqp.AmqpInvalidMessageBodyType(sectionFlag, expected));
			}
		}

		private void UpdateSectionFlag(bool set, SectionFlag flag)
		{
			if (set)
			{
				sectionFlags |= flag;
			}
			else
			{
				sectionFlags &= ~flag;
			}
		}

	internal abstract class AmqpObject

		private abstract class AmqpObjectAsyncResult : TimeoutAsyncResult<AmqpObject>
		{
			private readonly AmqpObject amqpObject;

			protected override AmqpObject Target => amqpObject;

			protected AmqpObjectAsyncResult(AmqpObject amqpObject, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object asyncState)
				: base(timeout, callback, asyncState)
			{
				this.amqpObject = amqpObject;
			}

			public void Signal(bool syncComplete, Exception exception)
			{
				UpdateState(exception);
				CompleteSelf(syncComplete, exception);
			}

			protected void Start()
			{
				SetTimer();
				bool flag = false;
				Exception ex = null;
				try
				{
					flag = OnStart();
				}
				catch (Exception ex2)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(ex2))
					{
						throw;
					}
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogError(amqpObject, "OnStart", ex2.ToStringSlim());
					flag = true;
					ex = ex2;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					Signal(syncComplete: true, ex);
				}
			}

			protected abstract bool OnStart();

			protected abstract void UpdateState(Exception exception);
		}

		private sealed class OpenAsyncResult : AmqpObjectAsyncResult
		{
			public OpenAsyncResult(AmqpObject amqpObject, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object asyncState)
				: base(amqpObject, timeout, callback, asyncState)
			{
				amqpObject.pendingOpen = this;
				Start();
			}

			public static void End(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				OpenAsyncResult openAsyncResult = Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult.End<OpenAsyncResult>(result);
				openAsyncResult.Target.NotifyOpened();
			}

			protected override bool OnStart()
			{
				lock (Target.thisLock)
				{
					if ((Target.closeCalled || Target.abortCalled) && !base.IsCompleted)
					{
						throw new OperationCanceledException();
					}
				}
				return Target.OpenInternal();
			}

			protected override void UpdateState(Exception exception)
			{
				if (exception == null)
				{
					Target.State = AmqpObjectState.Opened;
				}
				Interlocked.Exchange(ref Target.pendingOpen, null);
			}
		}

		private sealed class CloseAsyncResult : AmqpObjectAsyncResult
		{
			public CloseAsyncResult(AmqpObject amqpObject, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object asyncState)
				: base(amqpObject, timeout, callback, asyncState)
			{
				amqpObject.pendingClose = this;
				Start();
			}

			public static void End(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult.End<CloseAsyncResult>(result);
			}

			protected override bool OnStart()
			{
				return Target.CloseInternal();
			}

			protected override void UpdateState(Exception exception)
			{
				Target.State = AmqpObjectState.End;
				Interlocked.Exchange(ref Target.pendingClose, null);
				Target.NotifyClosed();
			}
		}

		private static readonly AsyncCallback onSafeCloseComplete = OnSafeCloseComplete;

		private readonly SequenceNumber identifier;

		private string name;

		private OpenAsyncResult pendingOpen;

		protected AmqpObject(string type)
			: this(type, SequenceNumber.Increment(ref nextId))

		{
			this.identifier = identifier;

			DefaultOpenTimeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(60.0);
			DefaultCloseTimeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(60.0);

		public void Open()
		{
			Open(DefaultOpenTimeout);
		}

		public void Open(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			lock (thisLock)
			{
				if (openCalled)
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.AsWarning(new InvalidOperationException(SRAmqp.AmqpInvalidReOpenOperation(this, State)));
				}
				openCalled = true;
				if (State == AmqpObjectState.OpenReceived)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				bool flag2 = OpenInternal();
				NotifyOpened();
			}
			else
			{
				OnOpen(timeout);
			}
		}

		internal void SetName(string name)
		{
			this.name = name;
		}

		internal Task OpenAsync(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			return Task.Factory.FromAsync((TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => ((AmqpObject)s).BeginOpen(t, c, s), delegate(IAsyncResult a)
			{
				((AmqpObject)a.AsyncState).EndOpen(a);
			}, timeout, this);
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginOpen(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			lock (thisLock)
			{
				if (openCalled)
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.AsWarning(new InvalidOperationException(SRAmqp.AmqpInvalidReOpenOperation(this, State)));
				}
				openCalled = true;
			}
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogOperationVerbose(this, TraceOperation.Execute, "BeginOpen");
			return new OpenAsyncResult(this, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		public void EndOpen(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			OpenAsyncResult.End(result);
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogOperationVerbose(this, TraceOperation.Execute, "EndOpen");
		}

		public void Close()
		{
			Close(DefaultCloseTimeout);
		}

		public void Close(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (closeCalled || State == AmqpObjectState.End || State == AmqpObjectState.CloseSent)
				{
					return;
				}
				closeCalled = true;
				if (State == AmqpObjectState.CloseReceived)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				bool flag2 = CloseInternal();
				NotifyClosed();
			}
			else
			{
				CancelOpen();
				OnClose(timeout);
			}
		}

		internal Task CloseAsync(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			return Task.Factory.FromAsync((TimeSpan t, AsyncCallback c, object s) => ((AmqpObject)s).BeginClose(t, c, s), delegate(IAsyncResult a)
			{
				((AmqpObject)a.AsyncState).EndClose(a);
			}, timeout, this);
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				flag = closeCalled || State == AmqpObjectState.End || State == AmqpObjectState.CloseSent;
				closeCalled = true;
			}
			CancelOpen();
			if (flag)
			{
				return new CompletedAsyncResult(callback, state);
			}
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogOperationVerbose(this, TraceOperation.Execute, "BeginClose");
			return new CloseAsyncResult(this, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		public void EndClose(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (result is CompletedAsyncResult)
			{
				CompletedAsyncResult.End(result);
				return;
			}
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogOperationVerbose(this, TraceOperation.Execute, "EndClose");
			CloseAsyncResult.End(result);
		}

		public void Abort()
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (abortCalled || State == AmqpObjectState.End)
				{
					return;
				}
				State = AmqpObjectState.End;
				abortCalled = true;
			}
			try
			{
				AbortInternal();
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.ThrowingExceptionError(EventTraceActivity.Empty, exception);
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				NotifyClosed();
			}
		}

		public void SafeClose()
		{
			SafeClose(null);
		}

		public void SafeClose(Exception exception)
		{
			TerminalException = exception;
			lock (thisLock)
			{
				if (State != AmqpObjectState.OpenReceived && !IsClosing() && !StateTransition.CanTransite(State, StateTransition.SendClose))
				{
					State = AmqpObjectState.Faulted;
				}
			}
			try
			{
				BeginClose(AmqpConstants.DefaultTimeoutTimeSpan, onSafeCloseComplete, this);
			}
			catch (Exception exception2)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception2))
				{
					throw;
				}
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogError(this, "SafeClose", exception2.ToStringSlim());
				Abort();
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return name;
		}

		internal void SafeAddClosed(EventHandler handler)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (closedHandlerInvoked)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				else
				{
					Closed += handler;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				handler(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}
