		internal bool IsClosing()
		{
			AmqpObjectState state = State;
			if (state != AmqpObjectState.CloseSent && state != AmqpObjectState.CloseReceived && state != AmqpObjectState.ClosePipe && state != AmqpObjectState.End)
			{
				return state == AmqpObjectState.Faulted;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual void OnOpen(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			OpenAsyncResult.End(new OpenAsyncResult(this, timeout, null, null));
		}

		protected virtual void OnClose(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			CloseAsyncResult.End(new CloseAsyncResult(this, timeout, null, null));
		}

		protected abstract bool OpenInternal();

		protected abstract bool CloseInternal();

		protected abstract void AbortInternal();

		protected void FindMutualCapabilites(Multiple<AmqpSymbol> desired, Multiple<AmqpSymbol> offered)
		{
			mutualCapabilities = Multiple<AmqpSymbol>.Intersect(desired, offered);
		}

		protected void NotifyOpening(Performative command)
		{
			this.Opening?.Invoke(this, new OpenEventArgs(command));
		}

		protected void CompleteOpen(bool syncComplete, Exception exception)
		{
			Interlocked.Exchange(ref pendingOpen, null)?.Signal(syncComplete, exception);
		}

		protected virtual void CompleteClose(bool syncComplete, Exception exception)
		{
			Interlocked.Exchange(ref pendingClose, null)?.Signal(syncComplete, exception);
		}

		protected StateTransition TransitState(string operation, StateTransition[] states)
		{
			StateTransition stateTransition = null;
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				foreach (StateTransition stateTransition2 in states)
				{
					if (stateTransition2.From == State)
					{
						State = stateTransition2.To;
						stateTransition = stateTransition2;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (stateTransition == null)
			{
				throw new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.IllegalState, SRAmqp.AmqpIllegalOperationState(operation, State));
			}
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpStateTransition(this, operation, stateTransition.From, stateTransition.To);
			return stateTransition;
		}

		protected void OnReceiveCloseCommand(string command, Error error)
		{
			Exception ex = null;
			if (error != null && TerminalException == null)
			{
				ex = new AmqpException(error);
				IsTerminalExceptionFromRemote = true;
				TerminalException = ex;
			}
			try
			{
				StateTransition stateTransition = TransitState(command, StateTransition.ReceiveClose);
				if (stateTransition.To == AmqpObjectState.End)
				{
					CompleteClose(syncComplete: false, ex);
					return;
				}
				if (TerminalException != null)
				{
					CompleteOpen(syncComplete: false, TerminalException);
				}
				if (CloseCommandHandler != null)
				{
					CloseCommandHandler(this);
				}
				else
				{
					Close();
				}
			}
			catch (AmqpException exception)
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogError(this, command, exception.ToStringSlim());
				Abort();
			}
		}

		private static void OnSafeCloseComplete(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			AmqpObject amqpObject = (AmqpObject)result.AsyncState;
			try
			{
				amqpObject.EndClose(result);
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogError(amqpObject, "SafeCloseComplete", exception.ToStringSlim());
				amqpObject.Abort();
			}
		}

		private void CancelOpen()
		{
			if (pendingOpen != null)
			{
				CompleteOpen(syncComplete: false, TerminalException ?? new OperationCanceledException(SRAmqp.AmqpObjectAborted(name)));
			}
		}

		private void CancelClose()
		{
			if (pendingClose != null)
			{
				CompleteClose(syncComplete: false, TerminalException ?? new OperationCanceledException(SRAmqp.AmqpObjectAborted(name)));
			}
		}

		private void NotifyOpened()
		{
			Interlocked.Exchange(ref this.Opened, null)?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		private void NotifyClosed()
		{
			CancelOpen();
			CancelClose();
			EventHandler eventHandler = null;
			lock (thisLock)
			{
				if (!closedHandlerInvoked)
				{
					eventHandler = this.Closed;
					closedHandlerInvoked = true;
				}
			}
			eventHandler?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
		}
	}
	internal class AmqpSession : AmqpObject
	{
		private abstract class SessionChannel
		{
			private struct DispositionInfo
			{
				public Delivery First;

				public uint? Last;
			}

			private static readonly Action<object> dispositionTimerCallback = DispositionTimerCallback;

			private readonly AmqpSession session;

			private readonly object syncRoot;

			private readonly IOThreadTimer dispositionTimer;

			private SequenceNumber nextDeliveryId;

			private int needDispositionCount;

			private bool sendingDisposition;

			private bool timerScheduled;

			private Delivery firstUnsettled;

			private Delivery lastUnsettled;

			protected AmqpSession Session => session;

			protected bool IsReceiver { get; set; }

			protected object SyncRoot => syncRoot;

			public SessionChannel(AmqpSession session)
			{
				this.session = session;
				nextDeliveryId = session.settings.InitialDeliveryId;
				syncRoot = new object();
				if (session.settings.DispositionInterval > TimeSpan.Zero)
				{
					dispositionTimer = new IOThreadTimer(dispositionTimerCallback, this, isTypicallyCanceledShortlyAfterBeingSet: false);
				}
			}

			public void OnLinkClosed(AmqpLink link)
			{
				int num = 0;
				lock (syncRoot)
				{
					Delivery next = firstUnsettled;
					while (next != null)
					{
						Delivery delivery = next;
						next = next.Next;
						if (delivery.Link == link)
						{
							Delivery.Remove(ref firstUnsettled, ref lastUnsettled, delivery);
							num++;
						}
					}
				}
				if (num > 0)
				{
					OnWindowMoved(num);
				}
			}

			public void OnReceiveDisposition(Disposition disposition)
			{
				SequenceNumber sequenceNumber = disposition.First.Value;
				SequenceNumber sequenceNumber2 = ((SequenceNumber?)disposition.Last) ?? sequenceNumber;
				if (sequenceNumber2 < sequenceNumber)
				{
					return;
				}
				List<Delivery> list = new List<Delivery>();
				int num = 0;
				lock (syncRoot)
				{
					if (sequenceNumber >= nextDeliveryId)
					{
						return;
					}
					if (sequenceNumber2 > nextDeliveryId)
					{
						sequenceNumber2 = nextDeliveryId;
					}
					bool flag = disposition.Settled();
					Delivery next = firstUnsettled;
					while (next != null)
					{
						SequenceNumber sequenceNumber3 = next.DeliveryId.Value;
						if (sequenceNumber3 < sequenceNumber)
						{
							next = next.Next;
							continue;
						}
						if (sequenceNumber3 > sequenceNumber2)
						{
							break;
						}
						Delivery delivery = next;
						next = next.Next;
						delivery.Settled = flag;
						delivery.State = disposition.State;
						if (flag)
						{
							num++;
							Delivery.Remove(ref firstUnsettled, ref lastUnsettled, delivery);
						}
						list.Add(delivery);
					}
				}
				if (list.Count <= 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (Delivery item in list)
				{
					item.Link.OnDisposeDelivery(item);
				}
				if (num > 0)
				{
					OnWindowMoved(num);
				}
			}

			public void Flush()
			{
				SpinWait.SpinUntil(() => TrySendDisposition());
			}

			public void DisposeDelivery(Delivery delivery, bool settled, DeliveryState state, bool noFlush)
			{
				if (delivery.Settled)
				{
					OnWindowMoved(1);
					return;
				}
				bool flag = false;
				Delivery delivery2 = null;
				lock (syncRoot)
				{
					delivery.StateChanged = true;
					delivery.Settled = settled;
					delivery.State = state;
					if (sendingDisposition)
					{
						return;
					}
					if (noFlush)
					{
						if (delivery.Batchable)
						{
							return;
						}
						delivery.StateChanged = false;
						delivery2 = delivery;
						if (delivery.Settled)
						{
							Delivery.Remove(ref firstUnsettled, ref lastUnsettled, delivery);
						}
					}
					else if (session.settings.DispositionInterval == TimeSpan.Zero || ++needDispositionCount >= session.settings.DispositionThreshold)
					{
						sendingDisposition = true;
						needDispositionCount = 0;
					}
					else if (!timerScheduled)
					{
						timerScheduled = true;
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				if (delivery2 != null)
				{
					SendDisposition(new DispositionInfo
					{
						First = delivery2
					});
					if (delivery.Settled)
					{
						OnWindowMoved(1);
					}
				}
				else if (flag)
				{
					dispositionTimer.Set(session.settings.DispositionInterval);
				}
				else
				{
					SendDisposition();
				}
			}

			protected void OnSendDelivery(Delivery delivery)
			{
				delivery.DeliveryId = nextDeliveryId;
				nextDeliveryId.Increment();
				if (!delivery.Settled)
				{
					Delivery.Add(ref firstUnsettled, ref lastUnsettled, delivery);
				}
			}

			protected void OnReceiveDelivery(Delivery delivery)
			{
				nextDeliveryId = delivery.DeliveryId + 1;
				if (!delivery.Settled)
				{
					Delivery.Add(ref firstUnsettled, ref lastUnsettled, delivery);
				}
			}

			protected void OnReceiveFirstTransfer(Transfer transfer)
			{
				nextDeliveryId = transfer.DeliveryId.Value;
			}

			protected abstract void OnWindowMoved(int count);

			private static bool CanBatch(Outcome outcome1, Outcome outcome2)
			{
				if (outcome1 != null && outcome2 != null && outcome1.DescriptorCode == outcome2.DescriptorCode)
				{
					if (outcome1.DescriptorCode != Accepted.Code)
					{
						return outcome1.DescriptorCode == Released.Code;
					}
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}

			private static void DispositionTimerCallback(object state)
			{
				SessionChannel sessionChannel = (SessionChannel)state;
				if (sessionChannel.session.State != AmqpObjectState.Opened)
				{
					return;
				}
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogOperationVerbose(sessionChannel, TraceOperation.Execute, "DispositionTimerCallback");
				lock (sessionChannel.syncRoot)
				{
					sessionChannel.timerScheduled = false;
					if (sessionChannel.sendingDisposition)
					{
						return;
					}
					sessionChannel.sendingDisposition = true;
				}
				try
				{
					sessionChannel.SendDisposition();
				}
				catch (Exception exception)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
					{
						throw;
					}
					sessionChannel.session.SafeClose(exception);
				}
			}

			private bool TrySendDisposition()
			{
				lock (syncRoot)
				{
					if (sendingDisposition)
					{
						return false;
					}
					sendingDisposition = true;
					needDispositionCount = 0;
				}
				SendDisposition();
				return true;
			}

			private void SendDisposition()
			{
				List<DispositionInfo> list = new List<DispositionInfo>();
				int num = 0;
				lock (syncRoot)
				{
					Delivery next = firstUnsettled;
					Delivery delivery = null;
					uint? last = null;
					while (next != null)
					{
						if (next.StateChanged)
						{
							if (delivery == null)
							{
								delivery = next;
							}
							else if (next.Settled == delivery.Settled && CanBatch(next.State as Outcome, delivery.State as Outcome))
							{
								last = next.DeliveryId.Value;
							}
							else
							{
								list.Add(new DispositionInfo
								{
									First = delivery,
									Last = last
								});
								delivery = next;
								last = null;
							}
							if (next.Settled)
							{
								Delivery delivery2 = next;
								next = next.Next;
								num++;
								Delivery.Remove(ref firstUnsettled, ref lastUnsettled, delivery2);
							}
							else
							{
								next.StateChanged = false;
								next = next.Next;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							if (delivery != null)
							{
								list.Add(new DispositionInfo
								{
									First = delivery,
									Last = last
								});
								delivery = null;
								last = null;
							}
							next = next.Next;
						}
					}
					if (delivery != null)
					{
						list.Add(new DispositionInfo
						{
							First = delivery,
							Last = last
						});
					}
					sendingDisposition = false;
				}
				if (list.Count > 0)
				{
					foreach (DispositionInfo item in list)
					{
						SendDisposition(item);
					}
				}
				if (num > 0)
				{
					OnWindowMoved(num);
				}
			}

			private void SendDisposition(DispositionInfo info)
			{
				Disposition disposition = new Disposition();
				disposition.First = info.First.DeliveryId.Value;
				disposition.Last = info.Last;
				disposition.Settled = info.First.Settled;
				disposition.State = info.First.State;
				disposition.Role = IsReceiver;
				lock (session.ThisLock)
				{
					if (session.State < AmqpObjectState.CloseSent)
					{
						session.SendCommand(disposition);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private sealed class OutgoingSessionChannel : SessionChannel
		{
			private SequenceNumber nextOutgoingId;

			private uint outgoingWindow;

			public OutgoingSessionChannel(AmqpSession session)
				: base(session)
			{
				nextOutgoingId = session.settings.NextOutgoingId.Value;
				outgoingWindow = session.settings.OutgoingWindow.Value;
				base.IsReceiver = false;
			}

			public bool TrySendTransfer(Delivery delivery, Transfer transfer, ByteBuffer payload)
			{
				lock (base.SyncRoot)
				{
					if (outgoingWindow == 0)
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpSessionWindowClosed(base.Session.connection, this, base.Session.settings.OutgoingWindow.Value, (int)nextOutgoingId.Value);
						return false;
					}
					nextOutgoingId.Increment();
					if (outgoingWindow < uint.MaxValue)
					{
						outgoingWindow--;
					}
					if (delivery != null)
					{
						OnSendDelivery(delivery);
						transfer.DeliveryId = delivery.DeliveryId.Value;
					}
					base.Session.SendCommand(transfer, payload);
				}
				return true;
			}

			public void SendFlow(Flow flow)
			{
				lock (base.SyncRoot)
				{
					AddFlowState(flow, reset: false);
					base.Session.incomingChannel.AddFlowState(flow, reset: true);
					base.Session.SendCommand(flow, null);
				}
			}

			public void OnBegin(Begin begin)
			{
				lock (base.SyncRoot)
				{
					uint num = base.Session.settings.OutgoingWindow.Value - outgoingWindow;
					if (num > begin.IncomingWindow.Value)
					{
						outgoingWindow = 0u;
					}
					else
					{
						outgoingWindow = begin.IncomingWindow.Value - num;
					}
					base.Session.settings.OutgoingWindow = outgoingWindow;
				}
			}

			public void OnFlow(Flow flow)
			{
				uint num = 0u;
				lock (base.SyncRoot)
				{
					if (flow.IncomingWindow.Value < uint.MaxValue)
					{
						uint valueOrDefault = flow.NextIncomingId.GetValueOrDefault();
						outgoingWindow = valueOrDefault + flow.IncomingWindow.Value - nextOutgoingId.Value;
						num = outgoingWindow;
					}
					else
					{
						num = ((outgoingWindow != uint.MaxValue) ? uint.MaxValue : 0u);
						outgoingWindow = uint.MaxValue;
					}
				}
				if (num != 0)
				{
					base.Session.NotifyCreditAvailable((int)((num > int.MaxValue) ? int.MaxValue : num));
				}
			}

			public void AddFlowState(Flow flow, bool reset)
			{
				lock (base.SyncRoot)
				{
					flow.OutgoingWindow = outgoingWindow;
					flow.NextOutgoingId = nextOutgoingId.Value;
				}
			}

			public override string ToString()
			{
				return base.Session.ToString() + "-out";
			}

			protected override void OnWindowMoved(int count)
			{
			}
		}

		private sealed class IncomingSessionChannel : SessionChannel
		{
			private SequenceNumber nextIncomingId;

			private uint incomingWindow;

			private uint flowThreshold;

			private uint needFlowCount;

			private bool transferEverReceived;

			public IncomingSessionChannel(AmqpSession session)
				: base(session)
			{
				incomingWindow = session.settings.IncomingWindow();
				flowThreshold = incomingWindow * 2 / 3;
				base.IsReceiver = true;
			}

			public void OnAcceptTransfer(Delivery delivery, Transfer transfer, bool newDelivery)
			{
				if (!transferEverReceived)
				{
					OnReceiveFirstTransfer(transfer);
					transferEverReceived = true;
				}
				bool flag = false;
				lock (base.SyncRoot)
				{
					if (incomingWindow != 0)
					{
						flag = true;
						if (newDelivery)
						{
							OnReceiveDelivery(delivery);
						}
						nextIncomingId.Increment();
						if (incomingWindow < uint.MaxValue)
						{
							incomingWindow--;
						}
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpSessionWindowClosed(base.Session.connection, this, base.Session.settings.IncomingWindow(), (int)nextIncomingId.Value);
					throw new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.WindowViolation, null);
				}
				if (!newDelivery)
				{
					OnWindowMoved(1);
				}
			}

			public void OnBegin(Begin begin)
			{
				lock (base.SyncRoot)
				{
					nextIncomingId = begin.NextOutgoingId.Value;
				}
			}

			public void OnFlow(Flow flow)
			{
			}

			public void AddFlowState(Flow flow, bool reset)
			{
				lock (base.SyncRoot)
				{
					flow.NextIncomingId = nextIncomingId.Value;
					flow.IncomingWindow = incomingWindow;
					if (reset)
					{
						needFlowCount = 0u;
					}
				}
			}

			public override string ToString()
			{
				return base.Session.ToString() + "-in";
			}

			protected override void OnWindowMoved(int count)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				lock (base.SyncRoot)
				{
					if (incomingWindow < uint.MaxValue)
					{
						incomingWindow += (uint)count;
						needFlowCount += (uint)count;
						if (needFlowCount >= flowThreshold)
						{
							needFlowCount = 0u;
							flag = true;
						}
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					base.Session.SendFlow();
				}
			}
		}

		private sealed class ErrorLink : AmqpLink
		{
			public ErrorLink(AmqpSession session, AmqpLinkSettings settings)
				: base("error-link", session, settings)
			{
				settings.Properties = null;
			}

			protected override bool CloseInternal()
			{
				base.State = AmqpObjectState.OpenReceived;
				return base.CloseInternal();
			}

			public override bool CreateDelivery(Transfer transfer, out Delivery delivery)
			{
				throw new NotImplementedException();
			}

			protected override void OnCreditAvailable(int session, uint link, bool drain, ArraySegment<byte> txnId)
			{
				throw new NotImplementedException();
			}

			protected override void OnProcessTransfer(Delivery delivery, Transfer transfer, Frame rawFrame)
			{
				throw new NotImplementedException();
			}

			protected override void OnDisposeDeliveryInternal(Delivery delivery)
			{
				throw new NotImplementedException();
			}
		}

		private static readonly EventHandler onLinkClosed = OnLinkClosed;

		private readonly AmqpConnection connection;

		private readonly AmqpSessionSettings settings;

		private readonly ILinkFactory linkFactory;

		private Dictionary<string, AmqpLink> links;

		private HandleTable<AmqpLink> linksByLocalHandle;

		private HandleTable<AmqpLink> linksByRemoteHandle;

		private OutgoingSessionChannel outgoingChannel;

		private IncomingSessionChannel incomingChannel;

		public AmqpSessionSettings Settings => settings;

		public AmqpConnection Connection => connection;

		public ushort LocalChannel { get; set; }

		public ILinkFactory LinkFactory => linkFactory;

		internal Dictionary<string, AmqpLink> Links => links;

		protected HandleTable<AmqpLink> LinksByRemoteHandle => linksByRemoteHandle;

		public AmqpSession(AmqpConnection connection, AmqpSessionSettings settings, ILinkFactory linkFactory)
			: this("session", connection, settings, linkFactory)
		{
		}

		protected AmqpSession(string type, AmqpConnection connection, AmqpSessionSettings settings, ILinkFactory linkFactory)
			: base(type)
		{
			this.connection = connection;
			this.settings = settings;
			this.linkFactory = linkFactory;
			base.State = AmqpObjectState.Start;
			links = new Dictionary<string, AmqpLink>();
			linksByLocalHandle = new HandleTable<AmqpLink>(settings.HandleMax ?? 262143);
			linksByRemoteHandle = new HandleTable<AmqpLink>(settings.HandleMax ?? 262143);
			outgoingChannel = new OutgoingSessionChannel(this);
			incomingChannel = new IncomingSessionChannel(this);
		}

		public void AttachLink(AmqpLink link)
		{
			lock (base.ThisLock)
			{
				if (IsClosing())
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(SRAmqp.AmqpObjectClosing(this, "attach"));
				}
				if (links.ContainsKey(link.Name))
				{
					throw new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.ResourceLocked, SRAmqp.AmqpLinkNameInUse(link.Name, LocalChannel));
				}
				link.Closed += onLinkClosed;
				links.Add(link.Name, link);
				link.LocalHandle = linksByLocalHandle.Add(link);
			}
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpAttachLink(connection, this, link, link.LocalHandle.Value, link.RemoteHandle.GetValueOrDefault(), link.Name, link.IsReceiver ? "receiver" : "sender", link.Settings.Source, link.Settings.Target);
		}

		public virtual void ProcessFrame(Frame frame)
		{
			Performative command = frame.Command;
			try
			{
				if (command.DescriptorCode == Begin.Code)
				{
					OnReceiveBegin((Begin)command);
				}
				else if (command.DescriptorCode == End.Code)
				{
					OnReceiveEnd((End)command);
				}
				else if (command.DescriptorCode == Disposition.Code)
				{
					OnReceiveDisposition((Disposition)command);
				}
				else if (command.DescriptorCode == Flow.Code)
				{
					OnReceiveFlow((Flow)command);
				}
				else
				{
					OnReceiveLinkFrame(frame);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogError(this, "ProcessFrame", exception.ToStringSlim());
				SafeClose(exception);
			}
		}

		public void SendFlow(Flow flow)
		{
			lock (base.ThisLock)
			{
				if (!IsClosing())
				{
					outgoingChannel.SendFlow(flow);
				}
			}
		}

		public void SendCommand(Performative command)
		{
			SendCommand(command, null);
		}

		public void SendCommand(Performative command, ByteBuffer payload)
		{
			connection.SendCommand(command, LocalChannel, payload);
		}

		public bool TrySendTransfer(Delivery delivery, Transfer transfer, ByteBuffer payload)
		{
			return outgoingChannel.TrySendTransfer(delivery, transfer, payload);
		}

		public void DisposeDelivery(AmqpLink link, Delivery delivery, bool settled, DeliveryState state, bool noFlush)
		{
			if (link.IsReceiver)
			{
				incomingChannel.DisposeDelivery(delivery, settled, state, noFlush);
			}
			else
			{
				outgoingChannel.DisposeDelivery(delivery, settled, state, noFlush);
			}
		}

		public bool OnAcceptTransfer(Delivery delivery, Transfer transfer, bool newDelivery)
		{
			try
			{
				incomingChannel.OnAcceptTransfer(delivery, transfer, newDelivery);
				return true;
			}
			catch (AmqpException exception)
			{
				SafeClose(exception);
				return false;
			}
		}

		public void Flush()
		{
			outgoingChannel.Flush();
			incomingChannel.Flush();
		}

		internal void OnIoEvent(IoEvent ioEvent)
		{
			IEnumerator<AmqpLink> safeEnumerator = linksByLocalHandle.GetSafeEnumerator();
			while (safeEnumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				safeEnumerator.Current.OnIoEvent(ioEvent);
			}
		}

		protected override bool OpenInternal()
		{
			AmqpObjectState amqpObjectState = SendBegin();
			return amqpObjectState == AmqpObjectState.Opened;
		}

		protected override bool CloseInternal()
		{
			if (base.State == AmqpObjectState.OpenReceived)
			{
				SendBegin();
			}
			CloseLinks(!LinkFrameAllowed());
			AmqpObjectState amqpObjectState = SendEnd();
			return amqpObjectState == AmqpObjectState.End;
		}

		protected override void AbortInternal()
		{
			CloseLinks(abort: true);
		}

		protected AmqpObjectState SendBegin()
		{
			StateTransition stateTransition = TransitState("S:BEGIN", StateTransition.SendOpen);
			SendCommand(settings);
			return stateTransition.To;
		}

		protected AmqpObjectState SendEnd()
		{
			StateTransition stateTransition = TransitState("S:END", StateTransition.SendClose);
			End end = new End();
			Exception terminalException = base.TerminalException;
			if (terminalException != null && !base.IsTerminalExceptionFromRemote)
			{
				end.Error = Error.FromException(terminalException);
			}
			SendCommand(end);
			return stateTransition.To;
		}

		protected bool TryCreateRemoteLink(Attach attach, out AmqpLink link)
		{
			link = null;
			if (linkFactory == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			AmqpLinkSettings amqpLinkSettings = AmqpLinkSettings.Create(attach);
			Exception ex = null;
			try
			{
				link = LinkFactory.CreateLink(this, amqpLinkSettings);
			}
			catch (Exception ex2)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(ex2))
				{
					throw;
				}
				if (ex2 is AmqpException { Error: not null } ex3 && (ex3.Error.Condition.Equals(AmqpErrorCode.ResourceLimitExceeded) || ex3.Error.Condition.Equals(AmqpErrorCode.ResourceLocked)))
				{
					throw;
				}
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogError(this, "CreateLink", ex2.Message);
				if (IsClosing())
				{
					return false;
				}
				link = new ErrorLink(this, amqpLinkSettings);
				ex = ex2;
			}
			link.RemoteHandle = attach.Handle;
			linksByRemoteHandle.Add(attach.Handle.Value, link);
			if (ex != null)
			{
				link.SafeClose(ex);
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void CloseLinks(bool abort)
		{
			IEnumerable<AmqpLink> enumerable = null;
			lock (base.ThisLock)
			{
				enumerable = linksByLocalHandle.Values;
				if (abort)
				{
					linksByLocalHandle.Clear();
					linksByRemoteHandle.Clear();
				}
			}
			foreach (AmqpLink item in enumerable)
			{
				if (abort)
				{
					item.Abort();
				}
				else
				{
					item.SafeClose(connection.TerminalException);
				}
			}
		}

		private bool LinkFrameAllowed()
		{
			if (base.State != AmqpObjectState.OpenSent)
			{
				return base.State == AmqpObjectState.Opened;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void SendFlow()
		{
			SendFlow(new Flow());
		}

		private void OnReceiveBegin(Begin begin)
		{
			StateTransition stateTransition = TransitState("R:BEGIN", StateTransition.ReceiveOpen);
			incomingChannel.OnBegin(begin);
			NotifyOpening(begin);
			if (stateTransition.To == AmqpObjectState.OpenReceived)
			{
				outgoingChannel.OnBegin(begin);
				UpdateHandleTable(begin);
				Open();
				return;
			}
			Exception ex = null;
			Error error = Negotiate(begin);
			if (error != null)
			{
				ex = new AmqpException(error);
			}
			CompleteOpen(syncComplete: false, ex);
			if (ex != null)
			{
				SafeClose(ex);
			}
		}

		private void OnReceiveEnd(End end)
		{
			OnReceiveCloseCommand("R:END", end.Error);
		}

		private void OnReceiveDisposition(Disposition disposition)
		{
			if (disposition.Role.Value)
			{
				outgoingChannel.OnReceiveDisposition(disposition);
			}
			else
			{
				incomingChannel.OnReceiveDisposition(disposition);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnReceiveFlow(Flow flow)
		{
			outgoingChannel.OnFlow(flow);
			incomingChannel.OnFlow(flow);
			if (flow.Handle.HasValue)
			{
				AmqpLink value = null;
				if (!linksByRemoteHandle.TryGetObject(flow.Handle.Value, out value))
				{
					if (Settings.IgnoreMissingLinks)
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpMissingHandle(connection, this, "link", flow.Handle.Value);
					}
					else
					{
						SafeClose(new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.UnattachedHandle, SRAmqp.AmqpHandleNotFound(flow.Handle.Value, this)));
					}
				}
				else
				{
					value.OnFlow(flow);
				}
			}
			else if (flow.Echo())
			{
				SendFlow();
			}
		}

		private void OnReceiveLinkFrame(Frame frame)
		{
			AmqpLink value = null;
			Performative command = frame.Command;
			if (command.DescriptorCode == Attach.Code)
			{
				Attach attach = (Attach)command;
				lock (base.ThisLock)
				{
					links.TryGetValue(attach.LinkName, out value);
				}
				if (value == null)
				{
					if (!TryCreateRemoteLink(attach, out value))
					{
						return;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					lock (base.ThisLock)
					{
						value.RemoteHandle = attach.Handle;
						linksByRemoteHandle.Add(attach.Handle.Value, value);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				LinkPerformative linkPerformative = (LinkPerformative)command;
				if (!linksByRemoteHandle.TryGetObject(linkPerformative.Handle.Value, out value))
				{
					if (Settings.IgnoreMissingLinks)
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpMissingHandle(connection, this, linkPerformative.DescriptorName.Value, linkPerformative.Handle.Value);
					}
					else if (linkPerformative.DescriptorCode != Detach.Code)
					{
						SafeClose(new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.UnattachedHandle, SRAmqp.AmqpHandleNotFound(linkPerformative.Handle.Value, this)));
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			value.ProcessFrame(frame);
		}

		private void UpdateHandleTable(Begin begin)
		{
			settings.HandleMax = Math.Min(settings.HandleMax(), begin.HandleMax());
			linksByLocalHandle.SetMaxHandle(settings.HandleMax.Value);
			linksByRemoteHandle.SetMaxHandle(settings.HandleMax.Value);
		}

		private Error Negotiate(Begin begin)
		{
			outgoingChannel.OnBegin(begin);
			UpdateHandleTable(begin);
			return null;
		}

		private void NotifyCreditAvailable(int credit)
		{
			IEnumerable<AmqpLink> enumerable = null;
			lock (base.ThisLock)
			{
				enumerable = linksByLocalHandle.Values;
			}
			foreach (AmqpLink item in enumerable)
			{
				if (!item.IsReceiver)
				{
					item.NotifySessionCredit(credit);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void OnLinkClosed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			AmqpLink amqpLink = (AmqpLink)sender;
			AmqpSession session = amqpLink.Session;
			lock (session.ThisLock)
			{
				session.links.Remove(amqpLink.Name);
				if (amqpLink.LocalHandle.HasValue)
				{
					session.linksByLocalHandle.Remove(amqpLink.LocalHandle.Value);
				}
				if (amqpLink.RemoteHandle.HasValue)
				{
					session.linksByRemoteHandle.Remove(amqpLink.RemoteHandle.Value);
				}
			}
			session.incomingChannel.OnLinkClosed(amqpLink);
			session.outgoingChannel.OnLinkClosed(amqpLink);
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpRemoveLink(session.connection, session, amqpLink, amqpLink.LocalHandle.GetValueOrDefault(), amqpLink.RemoteHandle.GetValueOrDefault(), amqpLink.Name);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class AmqpSessionSettings : Begin
	{
		public int DispositionThreshold { get; set; }

		public TimeSpan DispositionInterval { get; set; }

		public SequenceNumber InitialDeliveryId { get; set; }

		public bool IgnoreMissingLinks { get; set; }

		public AmqpSessionSettings()
		{
			base.NextOutgoingId = 1u;
			base.IncomingWindow = 5000u;
			base.OutgoingWindow = 5000u;
			base.HandleMax = 262143u;
			DispositionThreshold = Math.Min(500, 3333);
			DispositionInterval = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(20.0);
		}

		public static AmqpSessionSettings Create(Begin begin)
		{
			AmqpSessionSettings amqpSessionSettings = new AmqpSessionSettings();
			amqpSessionSettings.Properties = begin.Properties;
			return amqpSessionSettings;
		}

		public AmqpSessionSettings Clone()
		{
			AmqpSessionSettings amqpSessionSettings = new AmqpSessionSettings();
			amqpSessionSettings.DispositionThreshold = DispositionThreshold;
			amqpSessionSettings.DispositionInterval = DispositionInterval;
			amqpSessionSettings.NextOutgoingId = base.NextOutgoingId;
			amqpSessionSettings.IncomingWindow = base.IncomingWindow;
			amqpSessionSettings.OutgoingWindow = base.OutgoingWindow;
			amqpSessionSettings.HandleMax = base.HandleMax;
			amqpSessionSettings.OfferedCapabilities = base.OfferedCapabilities;
			amqpSessionSettings.DesiredCapabilities = base.DesiredCapabilities;
			amqpSessionSettings.Properties = base.Properties;
			return amqpSessionSettings;
		}
	}
	internal sealed class AmqpSettings
	{
		private List<TransportProvider> transportProviders;

		public int MaxConcurrentConnectionsPerNode { get; set; }

		public int MaxLinksPerSession { get; set; }

		public uint DefaultLinkCredit { get; set; }

		public bool RequireSecureTransport { get; set; }

		public bool AllowAnonymousConnection { get; set; }

		public IList<TransportProvider> TransportProviders
		{
			get
			{
				if (transportProviders == null)
				{
					transportProviders = new List<TransportProvider>();
				}
				return transportProviders;
			}
		}

		public IRuntimeProvider RuntimeProvider { get; set; }

		public AmqpSettings()
		{
			MaxConcurrentConnectionsPerNode = int.MaxValue;
			MaxLinksPerSession = int.MaxValue;
			DefaultLinkCredit = 1000u;
			AllowAnonymousConnection = true;
		}

		public T GetTransportProvider<T>() where T : TransportProvider
		{
			foreach (TransportProvider transportProvider in transportProviders)
			{
				if (transportProvider is T)
				{
					return (T)transportProvider;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public bool TryGetTransportProvider(ProtocolHeader header, out TransportProvider provider)
		{
			if (TransportProviders.Count == 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("TransportProviders");
			}
			provider = null;
			foreach (TransportProvider transportProvider in TransportProviders)
			{
				if (transportProvider.ProtocolId == header.ProtocolId)
				{
					provider = transportProvider;
					return true;
				}
			}
			provider = GetDefaultProvider();
			return false;
		}

		public ProtocolHeader GetDefaultHeader()
		{
			TransportProvider defaultProvider = GetDefaultProvider();
			return new ProtocolHeader(defaultProvider.ProtocolId, defaultProvider.DefaultVersion);
		}

		public ProtocolHeader GetSupportedHeader(ProtocolHeader requestedHeader)
		{
			TransportProvider provider = null;
			if (!TryGetTransportProvider(requestedHeader, out provider))
			{
				return GetDefaultHeader();
			}
			if (!provider.TryGetVersion(requestedHeader.Version, out var _))
			{
				return new ProtocolHeader(provider.ProtocolId, provider.DefaultVersion);
			}
			return requestedHeader;
		}

		public AmqpSettings Clone()
		{
			AmqpSettings amqpSettings = new AmqpSettings();
			amqpSettings.DefaultLinkCredit = DefaultLinkCredit;
			amqpSettings.transportProviders = new List<TransportProvider>(TransportProviders);
			amqpSettings.RuntimeProvider = RuntimeProvider;
			amqpSettings.RequireSecureTransport = RequireSecureTransport;
			amqpSettings.AllowAnonymousConnection = AllowAnonymousConnection;
			return amqpSettings;
		}

		public void ValidateInitiatorSettings()
		{
			if (TransportProviders.Count == 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("TransportProviders");
			}
		}

		public void ValidateListenerSettings()
		{
			if (TransportProviders.Count == 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("TransportProviders");
			}
		}

		private TransportProvider GetDefaultProvider()
		{
			TransportProvider transportProvider = null;
			if (RequireSecureTransport)
			{
				return GetTransportProvider<TlsTransportProvider>();
			}
			if (!AllowAnonymousConnection)
			{
				return GetTransportProvider<SaslTransportProvider>();
			}
			return GetTransportProvider<AmqpTransportProvider>();
		}
	}
	internal struct AmqpVersion : IEquatable<AmqpVersion>
	{
		private byte major;

		private byte minor;

		private byte revision;

		public byte Major => major;

		public byte Minor => minor;

		public byte Revision => revision;

		public AmqpVersion(byte major, byte minor, byte revision)
		{
			this.major = major;
			this.minor = minor;
			this.revision = revision;
		}

		public AmqpVersion(Version version)
			: this((byte)version.Major, (byte)version.Minor, (byte)version.Revision)
		{
		}

		public bool Equals(AmqpVersion other)
		{
			if (Major == other.Major)
			{
				return Minor == other.Minor;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}.{1}.{2}", Major, Minor, Revision);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class AsyncIO : AmqpObject
	{
		private sealed class AsyncReader
		{
			private enum ReadState : byte
			{
				ProtocolHeader,
				FrameSize,
				FrameBody
			}

			private static readonly SegmentBufferPool FrameSizeSegmentPool = new SegmentBufferPool(4, 100000);

			private static readonly Action<TransportAsyncCallbackArgs> onReadBufferComplete = OnReadBufferComplete;

			private readonly AsyncIO asyncIo;

			private readonly int maxFrameSize;

			private readonly bool readProtocolHeader;

			private readonly TransportAsyncCallbackArgs readAsyncEventArgs;

			private readonly bool writeFrameSize;

			private ReadState readState;

			private ArraySegment<byte> frameSizeBuffer;

			private int remainingBytes;

			public AsyncReader(AsyncIO parent, int maxFrameSize, bool readProtocolHeader, bool writeFrameSize)
			{
				asyncIo = parent;
				this.maxFrameSize = maxFrameSize;
				this.readProtocolHeader = readProtocolHeader;
				frameSizeBuffer = FrameSizeSegmentPool.TakeBuffer(4);
				readAsyncEventArgs = new TransportAsyncCallbackArgs();
				readAsyncEventArgs.CompletedCallback = onReadBufferComplete;
				readAsyncEventArgs.UserToken = this;
				this.writeFrameSize = writeFrameSize;
			}

			public void StartReading()
			{
				if (readProtocolHeader)
				{
					SetReadProtocolHeader();
				}
				else
				{
					SetReadFrameSize();
				}
				ReadBuffer();
			}

			private void Cleanup()
			{
				ArraySegment<byte> buffer;
				lock (readAsyncEventArgs)
				{
					buffer = frameSizeBuffer;
					frameSizeBuffer = default(ArraySegment<byte>);
				}
				if (buffer.Array != null)
				{
					FrameSizeSegmentPool.ReturnBuffer(buffer);
				}
			}

			private void SetReadProtocolHeader()
			{
				readState = ReadState.ProtocolHeader;
				byte[] array = new byte[8];
				remainingBytes = array.Length;
				readAsyncEventArgs.SetBuffer(array, 0, array.Length);
			}

			private void SetReadFrameSize()
			{
				readState = ReadState.FrameSize;
				remainingBytes = 4;
				readAsyncEventArgs.SetBuffer(frameSizeBuffer.Array, frameSizeBuffer.Offset, frameSizeBuffer.Count);
				readAsyncEventArgs.UserToken2 = null;
			}

			private void SetReadFrameBody(int frameSize)
			{
				ByteBuffer byteBuffer = asyncIo.ioHandler.CreateBuffer(frameSize, autoGrow: false);
				if (writeFrameSize)
				{
					AmqpBitConverter.WriteUInt(byteBuffer, (uint)frameSize);
				}
				readState = ReadState.FrameBody;
				remainingBytes = byteBuffer.Size;
				readAsyncEventArgs.SetBuffer(byteBuffer.Buffer, byteBuffer.Length, remainingBytes);
				readAsyncEventArgs.UserToken2 = byteBuffer;
			}

			private static void OnReadBufferComplete(TransportAsyncCallbackArgs args)
			{
				AsyncReader asyncReader = (AsyncReader)args.UserToken;
				bool flag;
				try
				{
					flag = asyncReader.HandleReadBufferComplete(args);
				}
				catch (Exception exception)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
					{
						throw;
					}
					asyncReader.asyncIo.ioHandler.OnIoFault(exception);
					asyncReader.Cleanup();
					flag = false;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					asyncReader.ReadBuffer();
				}
			}

			private void ReadBuffer()
			{
				try
				{
					if (asyncIo.State == AmqpObjectState.End)
					{
						Cleanup();
						((ByteBuffer)readAsyncEventArgs.UserToken2)?.Dispose();
					}
					else
					{
						while (asyncIo.State != AmqpObjectState.End && !asyncIo.transport.ReadAsync(readAsyncEventArgs) && HandleReadBufferComplete(readAsyncEventArgs))
						{
						}
					}
				}
				catch (Exception exception)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
					{
						throw;
					}
					asyncIo.ioHandler.OnIoFault(exception);
					Cleanup();
				}
			}

			private bool HandleReadBufferComplete(TransportAsyncCallbackArgs args)
			{
				bool flag;
				if (args.Exception != null)
				{
					asyncIo.ioHandler.OnIoFault(args.Exception);
					flag = false;
				}
				else if (args.BytesTransfered == 0)
				{
					asyncIo.ioHandler.OnIoFault(new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.ConnectionForced, null));
					flag = false;
				}
				else
				{
					flag = true;
					remainingBytes -= args.BytesTransfered;
					if (remainingBytes > 0)
					{
						args.SetBuffer(args.Buffer, args.Offset + args.BytesTransfered, args.Count - args.BytesTransfered);
					}
					else
					{
						switch (readState)
						{
						case ReadState.FrameBody:
							HandleFrameBodyReadComplete(args);
							break;
						case ReadState.FrameSize:
							HandleFrameSizeReadComplete(args);
							break;
						case ReadState.ProtocolHeader:
							HandleProtocolHeaderReadComplete(args);
							break;
						default:
							throw new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.IllegalState, null);
						}
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					Cleanup();
				}
				return flag;
			}

			private void HandleProtocolHeaderReadComplete(TransportAsyncCallbackArgs args)
			{
				asyncIo.ioHandler.OnReceiveBuffer(new ByteBuffer(args.Buffer, 0, 8));
				SetReadFrameSize();
			}

			private void HandleFrameSizeReadComplete(TransportAsyncCallbackArgs args)
			{
				int num = (int)AmqpBitConverter.ReadUInt(frameSizeBuffer.Array, frameSizeBuffer.Offset, 4);
				if (num == 0 && !writeFrameSize)
				{
					asyncIo.ioHandler.OnReceiveBuffer(null);
					SetReadFrameSize();
					return;
				}
				if (num > 0 && num <= maxFrameSize)
				{
					SetReadFrameBody(num);
					return;
				}
				throw new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.FramingError, SRClient.InvalidFrameSize(num, maxFrameSize));
			}

			private void HandleFrameBodyReadComplete(TransportAsyncCallbackArgs args)
			{
				ByteBuffer byteBuffer = (ByteBuffer)args.UserToken2;
				byteBuffer.Append(byteBuffer.Size);
				asyncIo.ioHandler.OnReceiveBuffer(byteBuffer);
				SetReadFrameSize();
			}
		}

		public class AsyncBufferReader
		{
			private static Action<TransportAsyncCallbackArgs> onReadComplete = OnReadComplete;

			private readonly TransportBase transport;

			public AsyncBufferReader(TransportBase transport)
			{
				this.transport = transport;
			}

			public void ReadBuffer(TransportAsyncCallbackArgs args)
			{
				TransportAsyncCallbackArgs transportAsyncCallbackArgs = new TransportAsyncCallbackArgs();
				transportAsyncCallbackArgs.SetBuffer(args.Buffer, args.Offset, args.Count);
				transportAsyncCallbackArgs.UserToken = this;
				transportAsyncCallbackArgs.UserToken2 = args;
				transportAsyncCallbackArgs.CompletedCallback = onReadComplete;
				Read(transportAsyncCallbackArgs);
			}

			private void Read(TransportAsyncCallbackArgs args)
			{
				try
				{
					while (!transport.ReadAsync(args) && !HandleReadComplete(args))
					{
					}
				}
				catch (Exception exception)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
					{
						throw;
					}
					args.Exception = exception;
					HandleReadComplete(args);
				}
			}

			private bool HandleReadComplete(TransportAsyncCallbackArgs args)
			{
				bool flag = true;
				Exception exception = null;
				if (args.Exception != null)
				{
					exception = args.Exception;
				}
				else if (args.BytesTransfered == 0)
				{
					exception = new ObjectDisposedException(transport.ToString());
				}
				else if (args.BytesTransfered < args.Count)
				{
					args.SetBuffer(args.Buffer, args.Offset + args.BytesTransfered, args.Count - args.BytesTransfered);
					flag = false;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					TransportAsyncCallbackArgs transportAsyncCallbackArgs = (TransportAsyncCallbackArgs)args.UserToken2;
					transportAsyncCallbackArgs.Exception = exception;
					transportAsyncCallbackArgs.BytesTransfered = transportAsyncCallbackArgs.Count;
					transportAsyncCallbackArgs.CompletedCallback(transportAsyncCallbackArgs);
				}
				return flag;
			}

			private static void OnReadComplete(TransportAsyncCallbackArgs args)
			{
				AsyncBufferReader asyncBufferReader = (AsyncBufferReader)args.UserToken;
				if (!asyncBufferReader.HandleReadComplete(args) && !args.CompletedSynchronously)
				{
					asyncBufferReader.Read(args);
				}
			}
		}

		public sealed class FrameBufferReader
		{
			private static readonly Action<TransportAsyncCallbackArgs> onSizeComplete = OnReadSizeComplete;

			private static readonly Action<TransportAsyncCallbackArgs> onFrameComplete = OnReadFrameComplete;

			private readonly TransportBase transport;

			private readonly int maxFrameSize;

			private readonly byte[] sizeBuffer;

			private IIoHandler parent;

			public FrameBufferReader(IIoHandler parent, TransportBase transport, int maxFrameSize)
			{
				this.parent = parent;
				this.transport = transport;
				this.maxFrameSize = maxFrameSize;
				sizeBuffer = new byte[4];
			}

			public void ReadFrame()
			{
				TransportAsyncCallbackArgs transportAsyncCallbackArgs = new TransportAsyncCallbackArgs();
				transportAsyncCallbackArgs.UserToken = this;
				transportAsyncCallbackArgs.SetBuffer(sizeBuffer, 0, sizeBuffer.Length);
				transportAsyncCallbackArgs.CompletedCallback = onSizeComplete;
				ReadCore(transportAsyncCallbackArgs);
			}

			private void ReadCore(TransportAsyncCallbackArgs args)
			{
				try
				{
					while (!transport.ReadAsync(args) && !HandleReadComplete(args))
					{
					}
				}
				catch (Exception exception)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
					{
						throw;
					}
					args.Exception = exception;
					HandleReadComplete(args);
				}
			}

			private static void OnReadSizeComplete(TransportAsyncCallbackArgs args)
			{
				FrameBufferReader frameBufferReader = (FrameBufferReader)args.UserToken;
				if (!frameBufferReader.HandleReadComplete(args))
				{
					frameBufferReader.ReadCore(args);
				}
			}

			private static void OnReadFrameComplete(TransportAsyncCallbackArgs args)
			{
				FrameBufferReader frameBufferReader = (FrameBufferReader)args.UserToken;
				if (!frameBufferReader.HandleReadComplete(args))
				{
					frameBufferReader.ReadCore(args);
				}
			}

			private bool HandleReadComplete(TransportAsyncCallbackArgs args)
			{
				bool flag = true;
				Exception ex = null;
				if (args.Exception != null)
				{
					ex = args.Exception;
				}
				else if (args.BytesTransfered == 0)
				{
					ex = new ObjectDisposedException(transport.ToString());
				}
				else if (args.BytesTransfered == args.Count)
				{
					args.ByteBuffer?.Append(args.BytesTransfered);
				}
				else
				{
					flag = false;
					if (args.ByteBuffer == null)
					{
						args.SetBuffer(args.Buffer, args.Offset + args.BytesTransfered, args.Count - args.BytesTransfered);
					}
					else
					{
						args.ByteBuffer.Append(args.BytesTransfered);
						args.SetReadBuffer(args.ByteBuffer);
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					if (ex != null || (object)args.CompletedCallback == onFrameComplete)
					{
						ByteBuffer byteBuffer = args.ByteBuffer;
						try
						{
							if (ex == null)
							{
								int size = byteBuffer.Length + sizeBuffer.Length;
								byteBuffer.Reset();
								byteBuffer.Append(size);
								parent.OnReceiveBuffer(byteBuffer);
							}
							else
							{
								parent.OnIoFault(ex);
							}
						}
						finally
						{
							byteBuffer?.Dispose();
						}
					}
					else
					{
						uint num = AmqpBitConverter.ReadUInt(sizeBuffer, 0, sizeBuffer.Length);
						if (num > maxFrameSize)
						{
							flag = true;
							ex = new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.FramingError, SRClient.InvalidFrameSize(num, maxFrameSize));
							parent.OnIoFault(ex);
						}
						else
						{
							ByteBuffer byteBuffer2 = parent.CreateBuffer((int)num, autoGrow: false);
							AmqpBitConverter.WriteBytes(byteBuffer2, sizeBuffer, 0, sizeBuffer.Length);
							byteBuffer2.Complete(sizeBuffer.Length);
							args.SetReadBuffer(byteBuffer2);
							args.CompletedCallback = onFrameComplete;
							flag = false;
						}
					}
				}
				return flag;
			}
		}

		public class AsyncWriter
		{
			private const int MaxBatchSize = 32768;

			private static readonly Action<TransportAsyncCallbackArgs> writeCompleteCallback = WriteCompleteCallback;

			private readonly TransportBase transport;

			private readonly int writeQueueFullLimit;

			private readonly int writeQueueEmptyLimit;

			private readonly TransportAsyncCallbackArgs writeAsyncEventArgs;

			private readonly Queue<ByteBuffer> bufferQueue;

			private readonly IIoHandler parent;

			private long bufferQueueSize;

			private bool writing;

			private bool closed;

			private bool isQueueFull;

			public long BufferQueueSize => bufferQueueSize;

			private object SyncRoot => bufferQueue;

			public AsyncWriter(TransportBase transport, int writeQueueFullLimit, int writeQueueEmptyLimit, IIoHandler parent)
			{
				this.transport = transport;
				this.writeQueueFullLimit = writeQueueFullLimit;
				this.writeQueueEmptyLimit = writeQueueEmptyLimit;
				this.parent = parent;
				bufferQueue = new Queue<ByteBuffer>();
				writeAsyncEventArgs = new TransportAsyncCallbackArgs();
				writeAsyncEventArgs.CompletedCallback = writeCompleteCallback;
			}

			public void WriteBuffer(ByteBuffer buffer)
			{
				lock (SyncRoot)
				{
					if (writing)
					{
						EnqueueBuffer(buffer);
						return;
					}
					writing = true;
				}
				writeAsyncEventArgs.SetWriteBuffer(buffer);
				if (WriteCore())
				{
					ContinueWrite();
				}
			}

			public virtual void WriteBuffer(ByteBuffer buffer, ByteBuffer extra)
			{
				lock (SyncRoot)
				{
					if (writing)
					{
						EnqueueBuffer(buffer);
						EnqueueBuffer(extra);
						return;
					}
					writing = true;
				}
				writeAsyncEventArgs.SetBuffer(new ByteBuffer[2] { buffer, extra });
				if (WriteCore())
				{
					ContinueWrite();
				}
			}

			public void IssueClose()
			{
				lock (SyncRoot)
				{
					closed = true;
					if (writing)
					{
						return;
					}
				}
				transport.SafeClose();
			}

			private static void WriteCompleteCallback(TransportAsyncCallbackArgs args)
			{
				AsyncWriter asyncWriter = (AsyncWriter)args.UserToken;
				if (asyncWriter.HandleWriteBufferComplete(args))
				{
					asyncWriter.ContinueWrite();
				}
			}

			private void EnqueueBuffer(ByteBuffer buffer)
			{
				bufferQueueSize += buffer.Length;
				bufferQueue.Enqueue(buffer);
				if (bufferQueueSize >= writeQueueFullLimit && !isQueueFull)
				{
					isQueueFull = true;
					parent.OnIoEvent(IoEvent.WriteBufferQueueFull, bufferQueueSize);
				}
			}

			private void OnBufferDequeued(int size)
			{
				bufferQueueSize -= size;
				if (bufferQueueSize <= writeQueueEmptyLimit && isQueueFull)
				{
					isQueueFull = false;
					parent.OnIoEvent(IoEvent.WriteBufferQueueEmpty, bufferQueueSize);
				}
			}

			private bool WriteCore()
			{
				try
				{
					writeAsyncEventArgs.UserToken = this;
					if (transport.WriteAsync(writeAsyncEventArgs))
					{
						return false;
					}
					return HandleWriteBufferComplete(writeAsyncEventArgs);
				}
				catch (Exception exception)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
					{
						throw;
					}
					writeAsyncEventArgs.Exception = exception;
					writeAsyncEventArgs.UserToken = this;
					return HandleWriteBufferComplete(writeAsyncEventArgs);
				}
			}

			private void ContinueWrite()
			{
				do
				{
					lock (SyncRoot)
					{
						int count = bufferQueue.Count;
						switch (count)
						{
						case 0:
							writing = false;
							if (closed)
							{
								transport.SafeClose();
							}
							return;
						case 1:
						{
							ByteBuffer byteBuffer = bufferQueue.Dequeue();
							OnBufferDequeued(byteBuffer.Length);
							writeAsyncEventArgs.SetWriteBuffer(byteBuffer);
							continue;
						}
						}
						List<ByteBuffer> list = new List<ByteBuffer>(Math.Min(count, 64));
						int num = 0;
						for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
						{
							if (num >= 32768)
							{
								break;
							}
							ByteBuffer byteBuffer2 = bufferQueue.Dequeue();
							list.Add(byteBuffer2);
							num += byteBuffer2.Length;
						}
						OnBufferDequeued(num);
						writeAsyncEventArgs.SetBuffer(list);
					}
				}
				while (WriteCore());
			}

			private bool HandleWriteBufferComplete(TransportAsyncCallbackArgs args)
			{
				bool result;
				if (args.Exception != null)
				{
					result = false;
					parent.OnIoFault(args.Exception);
					lock (SyncRoot)
					{
						foreach (ByteBuffer item in bufferQueue)
						{
							item.Dispose();
						}
						bufferQueue.Clear();
					}
				}
				else
				{
					result = true;
				}
				args.Reset();
				return result;
			}
		}

		public class AsyncBufferWriter
		{
			private readonly TransportBase transport;

			private static Action<TransportAsyncCallbackArgs> onWriteComplete = OnWriteComplete;

			public AsyncBufferWriter(TransportBase transport)
			{
				this.transport = transport;
			}

			public void WriteBuffer(TransportAsyncCallbackArgs args)
			{
				TransportAsyncCallbackArgs transportAsyncCallbackArgs = new TransportAsyncCallbackArgs();
				transportAsyncCallbackArgs.SetBuffer(args.Buffer, args.Offset, args.Count);
				transportAsyncCallbackArgs.CompletedCallback = onWriteComplete;
				transportAsyncCallbackArgs.UserToken = this;
				transportAsyncCallbackArgs.UserToken2 = args;
				Write(transportAsyncCallbackArgs);
			}

			private void Write(TransportAsyncCallbackArgs args)
			{
				try
				{
					while (!transport.WriteAsync(args) && !HandleWriteComplete(args))
					{
					}
				}
				catch (Exception exception)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
					{
						throw;
					}
					args.Exception = exception;
					HandleWriteComplete(args);
				}
			}

			private bool HandleWriteComplete(TransportAsyncCallbackArgs args)
			{
				bool flag = true;
				Exception exception = null;
				if (args.Exception != null)
				{
					exception = args.Exception;
				}
				else if (args.BytesTransfered == 0)
				{
					exception = new ObjectDisposedException(transport.ToString());
				}
				else if (args.BytesTransfered < args.Count)
				{
					args.SetBuffer(args.Buffer, args.Offset + args.BytesTransfered, args.Count - args.BytesTransfered);
					flag = false;
				}
				TransportAsyncCallbackArgs transportAsyncCallbackArgs = (TransportAsyncCallbackArgs)args.UserToken2;
				if (flag && transportAsyncCallbackArgs.CompletedCallback != null)
				{
					transportAsyncCallbackArgs.Exception = exception;
					transportAsyncCallbackArgs.BytesTransfered = transportAsyncCallbackArgs.Count;
					transportAsyncCallbackArgs.CompletedCallback(transportAsyncCallbackArgs);
				}
				return flag;
			}

			private static void OnWriteComplete(TransportAsyncCallbackArgs args)
			{
				AsyncBufferWriter asyncBufferWriter = (AsyncBufferWriter)args.UserToken;
				if (!asyncBufferWriter.HandleWriteComplete(args) && !args.CompletedSynchronously)
				{
					asyncBufferWriter.Write(args);
				}
			}
		}

		private readonly IIoHandler ioHandler;

		private readonly TransportBase transport;

		private readonly AsyncWriter writer;

		private readonly AsyncReader reader;

		public TransportBase Transport => transport;

		public long WriteBufferQueueSize => writer.BufferQueueSize;

		public AsyncIO(IIoHandler parent, int maxFrameSize, int writeQueueFullLimit, int writeQueueEmptyLimit, TransportBase transport, bool isInitiator, bool writeFrameSize = true)
			: base("async-io", transport.Identifier)
		{
			ioHandler = parent;
			this.transport = transport;
			writer = new AsyncWriter(this.transport, writeQueueFullLimit, writeQueueEmptyLimit, parent);
			reader = new AsyncReader(this, maxFrameSize, isInitiator, writeFrameSize);
		}

		public void WriteBuffer(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			writer.WriteBuffer(buffer);
		}

		public void WriteBuffer(ByteBuffer buffer, ByteBuffer extra)
		{
			writer.WriteBuffer(buffer, extra);
		}

		protected override void OnOpen(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			OpenInternal();
			base.State = AmqpObjectState.Opened;
		}

		protected override void OnClose(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			writer.IssueClose();
		}

		protected override bool OpenInternal()
		{
			reader.StartReading();
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool CloseInternal()
		{
			writer.IssueClose();
			return true;
		}

		protected override void AbortInternal()
		{
			transport.Abort();
		}
	}
	internal sealed class BufferListStream : Stream, ICloneable
	{
		private IList<ArraySegment<byte>> bufferList;

		private int readArray;

		private int readOffset;

		private long length;

		private long position;

		private bool disposed;

		public override bool CanRead => true;

		public override bool CanSeek => true;

		public override bool CanWrite => false;

		public override long Length
		{
			get
			{
				ThrowIfDisposed();
				return length;
			}
		}

		public override long Position
		{
			get
			{
				ThrowIfDisposed();
				return position;
			}
			set
			{
				ThrowIfDisposed();
				SetPosition(value);
			}
		}

		public BufferListStream(IList<ArraySegment<byte>> arraySegments)
		{
			if (arraySegments == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("arraySegments");
			}
			bufferList = arraySegments;
			for (int num = bufferList.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				ArraySegment<byte> arraySegment = bufferList[num];
				if (arraySegment.Count == 0 && length > 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException("segment" + num);
				}
				length += arraySegment.Count;
			}
		}

		public object Clone()
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			return new BufferListStream(bufferList);
		}

		public override void Flush()
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException();
		}

		public override int ReadByte()
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			if (position >= length)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			ArraySegment<byte> arraySegment = bufferList[readArray];
			int result = arraySegment.Array[arraySegment.Offset + readOffset];
			Advance(1, arraySegment.Count);
			return result;
		}

		public override int Read(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			if (readArray == bufferList.Count)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int num = 0;
			while (count > 0 && readArray < bufferList.Count)
			{
				ArraySegment<byte> arraySegment = bufferList[readArray];
				int val = arraySegment.Count - readOffset;
				int num2 = Math.Min(val, count);
				Buffer.BlockCopy(arraySegment.Array, arraySegment.Offset + readOffset, buffer, offset, num2);
				Advance(num2, arraySegment.Count);
				count -= num2;
				offset += num2;
				num += num2;
			}
			return num;
		}

		public override long Seek(long offset, SeekOrigin origin)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			long num = 0L;
			switch (origin)
			{
			case SeekOrigin.Begin:
				num = offset;
				break;
			case SeekOrigin.Current:
				num += position + offset;
				break;
			case SeekOrigin.End:
				num = length + offset;
				break;
			}
			SetPosition(num);
			return num;
		}

		public override void SetLength(long value)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public override void Write(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public ArraySegment<byte> ReadBytes(int count)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			if (readArray == bufferList.Count)
			{
				return default(ArraySegment<byte>);
			}
			ArraySegment<byte> arraySegment = bufferList[readArray];
			if (arraySegment.Count - readOffset >= count)
			{
				int count2 = arraySegment.Count;
				arraySegment = new ArraySegment<byte>(arraySegment.Array, arraySegment.Offset + readOffset, count);
				Advance(count, count2);
				return arraySegment;
			}
			count = Math.Min(count, (int)(length - position));
			byte[] array = new byte[count];
			Read(array, 0, count);
			return new ArraySegment<byte>(array);
		}

		public ArraySegment<byte>[] ReadBuffers(int count, bool advance, out bool more)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposed();
			more = false;
			if (readArray == bufferList.Count)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<ArraySegment<byte>> list = new List<ArraySegment<byte>>();
			int num = readArray;
			int num2 = readOffset;
			long num3 = position;
			while (count > 0 && readArray < bufferList.Count)
			{
				ArraySegment<byte> arraySegment = bufferList[readArray];
				int val = arraySegment.Count - readOffset;
				int num4 = Math.Min(val, count);
				list.Add(new ArraySegment<byte>(arraySegment.Array, arraySegment.Offset + readOffset, num4));
				Advance(num4, arraySegment.Count);
				count -= num4;
			}
			more = readArray < bufferList.Count;
			if (!advance)
			{
				readArray = num;
				readOffset = num2;
				position = num3;
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			try
			{
				if (!disposed && disposing)
				{
					bufferList = null;
					disposed = true;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				base.Dispose(disposing);
			}
		}

		private void ThrowIfDisposed()
		{
			if (disposed)
			{
				throw new ObjectDisposedException(GetType().Name);
			}
		}

		private void SetPosition(long pos)
		{
			if (pos < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("position");
			}
			position = pos;
			int i;
			for (i = 0; i < bufferList.Count; i++)
			{
				if (pos <= 0)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (pos < bufferList[i].Count)
				{
					break;
				}
				pos -= bufferList[i].Count;
			}
			readArray = i;
			readOffset = (int)pos;
		}

		private void Advance(int count, int segmentCount)
		{
			if (count > segmentCount)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("count");
			}
			position += count;
			readOffset += count;
			if (readOffset == segmentCount)
			{
				readArray++;
				readOffset = 0;
			}
		}

		public static BufferListStream Create(Stream stream, int segmentSize)
		{
			return Create(stream, segmentSize, forceCopyStream: false);
		}

		public static BufferListStream Create(Stream stream, int segmentSize, bool forceCopyStream)
		{
			if (stream == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNull("stream");
			}
			if (stream is BufferListStream && !forceCopyStream)
			{
				return (BufferListStream)((BufferListStream)stream).Clone();
			}
			stream.Position = 0L;
			int num;
			return new BufferListStream(ReadStream(stream, segmentSize, out num));
		}

		public static ArraySegment<byte>[] ReadStream(Stream stream, int segmentSize, out int length)
		{
			if (stream == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.ArgumentNull("stream");
			}
			ArraySegment<byte>[] result;
			if (stream is BufferListStream bufferListStream)
			{
				result = bufferListStream.bufferList.ToArray();
				length = (int)bufferListStream.length;
			}
			else
			{
				length = 0;
				List<ArraySegment<byte>> list = new List<ArraySegment<byte>>();
				while (true)
				{
					byte[] array = new byte[segmentSize];
					int num = stream.Read(array, 0, array.Length);
					if (num == 0)
					{
						break;
					}
					list.Add(new ArraySegment<byte>(array, 0, num));
					length += num;
				}
				result = list.ToArray();
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	internal sealed class ByteArrayComparer : IEqualityComparer<ArraySegment<byte>>
	{
		private static ByteArrayComparer instance = new ByteArrayComparer();

		public static ByteArrayComparer Instance => instance;

		private ByteArrayComparer()
		{
		}

		public bool Equals(ArraySegment<byte> x, ArraySegment<byte> y)
		{
			return AreEqual(x, y);
		}

		public int GetHashCode(ArraySegment<byte> obj)
		{
			int num = obj.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < obj.Count; i++)
			{
				num = ((num << 4) - num) ^ obj.Array[i + obj.Offset];
			}
			return num;
		}

		public static bool AreEqual(ArraySegment<byte> x, ArraySegment<byte> y)
		{
			if (x.Array == null || y.Array == null)
			{
				if (x.Array == null)
				{
					return y.Array == null;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (x.Count != y.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < x.Count; i++)
			{
				if (x.Array[i + x.Offset] != y.Array[i + y.Offset])
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	internal class ByteBuffer : IDisposable, IAmqpSerializable
	{
		private struct ManagedBuffer
		{
			public readonly InternalBufferManager BufferManager;

			public readonly byte[] Buffer;

			public ManagedBuffer(byte[] buffer, InternalBufferManager bufferManager)
			{
				Buffer = buffer;
				BufferManager = bufferManager;
			}
		}

		internal const int BufferSizeForPreallocateBufferManager = 8192;

		private const long SizeForPooledBufferManager = 67108864L;

		private const int MaxPooledBufferSize = 2097152;

		private static readonly object syncRoot = new object();

		private static InternalBufferManager pooledBufferManager = InternalBufferManager.CreatePooledBufferManager(67108864L, 2097152);

		private static InternalBufferManager transportBufferManager;

		private static int maxNumberOfBuffersForPreallocateBufferManager = 50000;

		private byte[] buffer;

		private int start;

		private int read;

		private int write;

		private int end;

		private bool autoGrow;

		private int references;

		private InternalBufferManager bufferManager;

		private ByteBuffer innerBuffer;

		public byte[] Buffer => buffer;

		public int Capacity => end - start;

		public int Offset => read;

		public int Size => end - write;

		public int Length => write - read;

		public int WritePos => write;

		int IAmqpSerializable.EncodeSize => BinaryEncoding.GetEncodeSize(new ArraySegment<byte>(buffer, Offset, Length));

		public static void InitPooledBufferManager(long maxMemorySize, int maxBufferSize, int rangeCount)
		{
			pooledBufferManager = InternalBufferManager.CreatePooledBufferManager(maxMemorySize, maxBufferSize, rangeCount);
		}

		public static void InitTransportBufferManager()
		{
			if (transportBufferManager != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			lock (syncRoot)
			{
				if (transportBufferManager == null)
				{
					transportBufferManager = InternalBufferManager.CreatePreallocateBufferManager(8192, maxNumberOfBuffersForPreallocateBufferManager);
				}
			}
		}

		public ByteBuffer(byte[] buffer)
			: this(buffer, 0, 0, buffer.Length, autoGrow: false, null)
		{
		}

		public ByteBuffer(byte[] buffer, bool autoGrow)
			: this(buffer, 0, 0, buffer.Length, autoGrow, null)
		{
		}

		public ByteBuffer(ArraySegment<byte> array)
			: this(array.Array, array.Offset, array.Count, array.Count, autoGrow: false, null)
		{
		}

		public ByteBuffer(int size, bool autoGrow)
			: this(size, autoGrow, isTransportBuffer: false)
		{
		}

		public ByteBuffer(int size, bool autoGrow, bool isTransportBuffer)
			: this(AllocateBufferFromPool(size, isTransportBuffer), autoGrow, size)
		{
		}

		public ByteBuffer(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)
			: this(buffer, offset, count, count, autoGrow: false, null)
		{
		}

		private ByteBuffer()
		{
		}

		private ByteBuffer(ManagedBuffer bufferReference, bool autoGrow, int size)
			: this(bufferReference.Buffer, 0, 0, size, autoGrow, bufferReference.BufferManager)
		{
		}

		private ByteBuffer(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count, int size, bool autoGrow, InternalBufferManager bufferManager)
		{
			this.buffer = buffer;
			start = offset;
			read = offset;
			write = offset + count;
			end = offset + size;
			this.autoGrow = autoGrow;
			this.bufferManager = bufferManager;
			references = 1;
		}

		private static ManagedBuffer AllocateBufferFromPool(int size, bool isTransportBuffer)
		{
			return AllocateBuffer(size, isTransportBuffer ? transportBufferManager : pooledBufferManager);
		}

		private static ManagedBuffer AllocateBuffer(int size, InternalBufferManager bufferManager)
		{
			if (bufferManager != null)
			{
				byte[] array = bufferManager.TakeBuffer(size);
				if (array != null)
				{
					return new ManagedBuffer(array, bufferManager);
				}
			}
			return new ManagedBuffer(pooledBufferManager.TakeBuffer(size), pooledBufferManager);
		}

		public void Validate(bool write, int dataSize)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (write)
			{
				if (Size < dataSize && autoGrow)
				{
					if (references != 1)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot grow the current buffer because it has more than one references");
					}
					int num = Math.Max(Capacity * 2, Capacity + dataSize);
					ManagedBuffer managedBuffer = ((bufferManager == null) ? new ManagedBuffer(new byte[num], null) : AllocateBuffer(num, bufferManager));
					System.Buffer.BlockCopy(buffer, start, managedBuffer.Buffer, 0, Capacity);
					int num2 = read - start;
					int num3 = this.write - start;
					start = 0;
					read = num2;
					this.write = num3;
					end = num;
					if (bufferManager != null)
					{
						bufferManager.ReturnBuffer(buffer);
					}
					buffer = managedBuffer.Buffer;
					bufferManager = managedBuffer.BufferManager;
				}
				flag = Size >= dataSize;
			}
			else
			{
				flag = Length >= dataSize;
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				throw new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.DecodeError, SRAmqp.AmqpInsufficientBufferSize(dataSize, write ? Size : Length));
			}
		}

		public void Append(int size)
		{
			write += size;
		}

		public void Complete(int size)
		{
			read += size;
		}

		public void Seek(int seekPosition)
		{
			read = seekPosition;
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			read = start;
			write = start;
		}

		public ByteBuffer GetSlice(int position, int length)
		{
			if (innerBuffer != null)
			{
				return innerBuffer.GetSlice(position, length);
			}
			ByteBuffer byteBuffer = AddReference();
			return new ByteBuffer(byteBuffer.buffer, position, length, length, autoGrow: false, null)
			{
				innerBuffer = byteBuffer
			};
		}

		public void AdjustPosition(int offset, int length)
		{
			read = offset;
			write = read + length;
		}

		public virtual void Dispose()
		{
			RemoveReference();
		}

		public bool TryAddReference()
		{
			if (Interlocked.Increment(ref references) <= 1)
			{
				Interlocked.Decrement(ref references);
				return false;
			}
			if (innerBuffer != null && !innerBuffer.TryAddReference())
			{
				Interlocked.Decrement(ref references);
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public ByteBuffer AddReference()
		{
			if (!TryAddReference())
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(SRAmqp.AmqpBufferAlreadyReclaimed);
			}
			return this;
		}

		public void RemoveReference()
		{
			int num = Interlocked.Decrement(ref references);
			if (innerBuffer != null)
			{
				innerBuffer.RemoveReference();
			}
			else if (num == 0)
			{
				byte[] array = buffer;
				buffer = null;
				if (array != null && bufferManager != null)
				{
					bufferManager.ReturnBuffer(array);
				}
			}
		}

		[Conditional("DEBUG")]
		internal void AssertReferences(int value)
		{
			_ = innerBuffer;
		}

		void IAmqpSerializable.Encode(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			BinaryEncoding.Encode(new ArraySegment<byte>(this.buffer, Offset, Length), buffer);
		}

		void IAmqpSerializable.Decode(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			ArraySegment<byte> arraySegment = BinaryEncoding.Decode(buffer, (byte)0, copy: false);
			innerBuffer = buffer.AddReference();
			references = 1;
			this.buffer = arraySegment.Array;
			start = (read = arraySegment.Offset);
			write = (end = arraySegment.Offset + arraySegment.Count);
		}
	}
	internal abstract class Delivery : IDisposable
	{
		public ArraySegment<byte> DeliveryTag { get; set; }

		public SequenceNumber DeliveryId { get; set; }

		public ArraySegment<byte> TxnId { get; set; }

		public bool Settled { get; set; }

		public bool Batchable { get; set; }

		public DeliveryState State { get; set; }

		public bool StateChanged { get; set; }

		public AmqpLink Link { get; set; }

		public long BytesTransfered { get; protected set; }

		public int Segments { get; protected set; }

		public Delivery Previous { get; set; }

		public Delivery Next { get; set; }

		public uint? MessageFormat { get; set; }

		public static void Add(ref Delivery first, ref Delivery last, Delivery delivery)
		{
			if (first == null)
			{
				first = (last = delivery);
				return;
			}
			last.Next = delivery;
			delivery.Previous = last;
			last = delivery;
		}

		public static void Remove(ref Delivery first, ref Delivery last, Delivery delivery)
		{
			if (delivery == first)
			{
				first = delivery.Next;
				if (first == null)
				{
					last = null;
				}
				else
				{
					first.Previous = null;
				}
			}
			else if (delivery == last)
			{
				last = delivery.Previous;
				last.Next = null;
			}
			else if (delivery.Previous != null && delivery.Next != null)
			{
				delivery.Previous.Next = delivery.Next;
				delivery.Next.Previous = delivery.Previous;
			}
			delivery.Previous = null;
			delivery.Next = null;
		}

		public abstract ByteBuffer GetPayload(int payloadSize, out bool more);

		public abstract void AddPayload(ByteBuffer payload, bool isLast);

		public virtual void CompletePayload(int payloadSize)
		{
			Segments++;
			BytesTransfered += payloadSize;
		}

		public abstract void Dispose();

		protected static ByteBuffer GetPayload(ByteBuffer source, int payloadSize, out bool more)
		{
			int length;
			if (source.Length <= payloadSize)
			{
				length = source.Length;
				more = false;
			}
			else
			{
				length = payloadSize;
				more = true;
			}
			return source.GetSlice(source.Offset, length);
		}

		protected static ByteBuffer AddPayload(ByteBuffer dest, ByteBuffer payload, bool isLast)
		{
			if (dest == null && isLast)
			{
				dest = payload.AddReference();
			}
			else
			{
				if (dest == null)
				{
					dest = new ByteBuffer(payload.Length * 2, autoGrow: true);
				}
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteBytes(dest, payload.Buffer, payload.Offset, payload.Length);
			}
			return dest;
		}
	}

		{
			if (other.Array == null)
			{
				return default(ArraySegment<byte>);
			}
			byte[] array = new byte[other.Count];
			Array.Copy(other.Array, other.Offset, array, 0, other.Count);
			return new ArraySegment<byte>(array);
		}
