	internal sealed class FrameDecoder
	{
		private int maxFrameSize;

		private ByteBuffer currentFrameBuffer;

		public FrameDecoder(int maxFrameSize)
		{
			this.maxFrameSize = maxFrameSize;
		}

		public ProtocolHeader ExtractProtocolHeader(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			if (buffer.Length < 8)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ProtocolHeader protocolHeader = new ProtocolHeader();
			protocolHeader.Decode(buffer);
			return protocolHeader;
		}

		public void ExtractFrameBuffers(ByteBuffer buffer, SerializedWorker<ByteBuffer> bufferHandler)
		{
			if (currentFrameBuffer != null)
			{
				int num = Math.Min(currentFrameBuffer.Size, buffer.Length);
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteBytes(currentFrameBuffer, buffer.Buffer, buffer.Offset, num);
				buffer.Complete(num);
				if (currentFrameBuffer.Size == 0)
				{
					ByteBuffer work = currentFrameBuffer;
					currentFrameBuffer = null;
					bufferHandler.DoWork(work);
				}
			}
			while (buffer.Length >= AmqpCodec.MinimumFrameDecodeSize)
			{
				int frameSize = AmqpCodec.GetFrameSize(buffer);
				if (frameSize < AmqpCodec.MinimumFrameDecodeSize || frameSize > maxFrameSize)
				{
					throw new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.FramingError, SRClient.InvalidFrameSize(frameSize, maxFrameSize));
				}
				int num2 = Math.Min(frameSize, buffer.Length);
				currentFrameBuffer = new ByteBuffer(frameSize, autoGrow: false);
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteBytes(currentFrameBuffer, buffer.Buffer, buffer.Offset, num2);
				buffer.Complete(num2);
				if (frameSize == num2)
				{
					ByteBuffer work2 = currentFrameBuffer;
					currentFrameBuffer = null;
					bufferHandler.DoWork(work2);
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}
		}
	}
	internal sealed class HandleTable<T> where T : class
	{
		private class SafeEnumerator : IEnumerator<T>, IDisposable, IEnumerator
		{
			private readonly HandleTable<T> table;

			private int index;

			private T current;

			T IEnumerator<T>.Current => current;

			object IEnumerator.Current => current;

			public SafeEnumerator(HandleTable<T> table)
			{
				this.table = table;
				index = -1;
			}

			bool IEnumerator.MoveNext()
			{
				try
				{
					index++;
					while (index < table.handleArray.Length)
					{
						current = table.handleArray[index];
						if (current != null)
						{
							return true;
						}
						index++;
					}
				}
				catch (IndexOutOfRangeException)
				{
				}
				current = null;
				return false;
			}

			void IEnumerator.Reset()
			{
				index = -1;
				current = null;
			}

			void IDisposable.Dispose()
			{
			}
		}

		private const int InitialCapacity = 4;

		private const int ResetThreshold = 4096;

		private uint maxHandle;

		private T[] handleArray;

		private int count;

		public IEnumerable<T> Values
		{
			get
			{
				List<T> list = new List<T>();
				T[] array = handleArray;
				foreach (T val in array)
				{
					if (val != null)
					{
						list.Add(val);
					}
				}
				return list;
			}
		}

		public HandleTable(uint maxHandle)
		{
			this.maxHandle = maxHandle;
			handleArray = new T[4];
		}

		public void SetMaxHandle(uint maxHandle)
		{
			this.maxHandle = maxHandle;
		}

		public IEnumerator<T> GetSafeEnumerator()
		{
			return new SafeEnumerator(this);
		}

		public bool TryGetObject(uint handle, out T value)
		{
			value = null;
			if (handle < handleArray.Length)
			{
				value = handleArray[handle];
			}
			return value != null;
		}

		public uint Add(T value)
		{
			if (count > maxHandle)
			{
				throw new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.ResourceLimitExceeded, SRAmqp.AmqpHandleExceeded(maxHandle));
			}
			if (count >= handleArray.Length)
			{
				GrowHandleArray(handleArray.Length * 2);
				int num = count;
				handleArray[num] = value;
				count++;
				return (uint)num;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < handleArray.Length; i++)
			{
				if (handleArray[i] == null)
				{
					handleArray[i] = value;
					count++;
					return (uint)i;
				}
			}
			throw new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.InternalError, null);
		}

		public void Add(uint handle, T value)
		{
			if (handle > maxHandle)
			{
				throw new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.ResourceLimitExceeded, SRAmqp.AmqpHandleExceeded(maxHandle));
			}
			if ((int)handle >= handleArray.Length)
			{
				int capacity = UpperPowerOfTwo(handleArray.Length, (int)handle);
				GrowHandleArray(capacity);
			}
			else if (handleArray[handle] != null)
			{
				throw new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.HandleInUse, SRAmqp.AmqpHandleInUse((int)handle, handleArray[handle]));
			}
			handleArray[handle] = value;
			count++;
		}

		public void Remove(uint handle)
		{
			if ((int)handle < handleArray.Length && handleArray[handle] != null)
			{
				handleArray[handle] = null;
				count--;
				if (count == 0 && handleArray.Length >= 4096)
				{
					handleArray = new T[4];
				}
			}
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			count = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < handleArray.Length; i++)
			{
				handleArray[i] = null;
			}
		}

		private void GrowHandleArray(int capacity)
		{
			T[] destinationArray = new T[capacity];
			Array.Copy(handleArray, destinationArray, handleArray.Length);
			handleArray = destinationArray;
		}

		private static int UpperPowerOfTwo(int from, int num)
		{
			while (from <= num)
			{
				from *= 2;
			}
			return from;
		}
	}

		private sealed class ReceiveAsyncResult : Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult
		{
			private static Action<object> onTimer = OnTimer;

			private readonly ReceivingAmqpLink parent;

			private readonly int requestedMessageCount;

			private readonly TimeSpan batchWaitTimeout;

			private readonly TimeSpan timeout;

			private IOThreadTimer timer;

			private LinkedListNode<ReceiveAsyncResult> node;

			private int completed;

			private List<AmqpMessage> messages;

			public int RequestedMessageCount => requestedMessageCount;

			public int MessageCount
			{
				get
				{
					if (messages == null)
					{
						return 0;
					}
					return messages.Count;
				}
			}

			public ReceiveAsyncResult(ReceivingAmqpLink parent, int requestedMessageCount, TimeSpan batchWaitTimeout, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(callback, state)
			{
				this.parent = parent;
				this.batchWaitTimeout = batchWaitTimeout;
				this.requestedMessageCount = requestedMessageCount;
				this.timeout = timeout;
			}

			public void Initialize(LinkedListNode<ReceiveAsyncResult> node)
			{
				this.node = node;
				if (timeout != TimeSpan.MaxValue)
				{
					timer = new IOThreadTimer(onTimer, this, isTypicallyCanceledShortlyAfterBeingSet: false);
					timer.Set(timeout);
				}
			}

			public void Add(AmqpMessage message)
			{
				if (messages == null)
				{
					messages = new List<AmqpMessage>();
					messages.Add(message);
					if (requestedMessageCount > 1 && batchWaitTimeout != TimeSpan.MaxValue)
					{
						timer.Set(batchWaitTimeout);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					messages.Add(message);
				}
			}

			public static bool End(IAsyncResult result, out IEnumerable<AmqpMessage> messages)
			{
				ReceiveAsyncResult receiveAsyncResult = Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult.End<ReceiveAsyncResult>(result);
				messages = receiveAsyncResult.messages;
				return receiveAsyncResult.completed == 1;
			}

			public void OnRemoved()
			{
				node = null;
			}

			public void Cancel()
			{
				if (parent.TerminalException != null)
				{
					Signal(syncComplete: false, new OperationCanceledException(parent.TerminalException.Message, parent.TerminalException));
				}
				else
				{
					Signal(syncComplete: false, new OperationCanceledException());
				}
			}

			public void Signal(bool syncComplete)
			{
				Signal(syncComplete, null);
			}

			public void Signal(List<AmqpMessage> messages, bool syncComplete)
			{
				if (this.messages != null)
				{
					this.messages.AddRange(messages);
				}
				else
				{
					this.messages = messages;
				}
				Signal(syncComplete, null);
			}

			public void Signal(bool syncComplete, Exception exception)
			{
				timer?.Cancel();
				CompleteInternal(syncComplete, 1, exception);
			}

			private void CompleteInternal(bool syncComplete, int code, Exception exception)
			{
				if (Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref completed, code, 0) == 0)
				{
					if (messages == null)
					{
						messages = new List<AmqpMessage>();
					}
					if (exception != null)
					{
						Complete(syncComplete, exception);
					}
					else
					{
						Complete(syncComplete);
					}
				}
			}

			private static void OnTimer(object state)
			{
				ReceiveAsyncResult receiveAsyncResult = (ReceiveAsyncResult)state;
				lock (receiveAsyncResult.parent.SyncRoot)
				{
					if (receiveAsyncResult.parent.waiterList == null || receiveAsyncResult.node == null)
					{
						return;
					}
					receiveAsyncResult.parent.waiterList.Remove(receiveAsyncResult.node);
					receiveAsyncResult.node = null;
				}
				receiveAsyncResult.CompleteInternal(syncComplete: false, (receiveAsyncResult.MessageCount > 0) ? 1 : 2, null);
			}
		}

		private sealed class DisposeAsyncResult : TimeoutAsyncResult<string>, IWork<DeliveryState>
		{
			private readonly ReceivingAmqpLink link;

			private readonly ArraySegment<byte> deliveryTag;

			private readonly bool batchable;

			private Outcome outcome;

			private ArraySegment<byte> txnId;

			protected override string Target => "dispose";

			public DisposeAsyncResult(ReceivingAmqpLink link, ArraySegment<byte> deliveryTag, ArraySegment<byte> txnId, Outcome outcome, bool batchable, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.link = link;
				this.deliveryTag = deliveryTag;
				this.batchable = batchable;
				this.outcome = outcome;
				this.txnId = txnId;
				this.link.pendingDispositions.StartWork(deliveryTag, this);
			}

			public static Outcome End(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				return Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult.End<DisposeAsyncResult>(result).outcome;
			}

			public void Start()
			{
				SetTimer();
				DeliveryState deliveryState = ((txnId.Array == null) ? ((DeliveryState)outcome) : ((DeliveryState)new TransactionalState
				{
					Outcome = outcome,
					TxnId = txnId
				}));
				if (!link.DisposeDelivery(deliveryTag, settled: false, deliveryState, batchable))
				{
					link.pendingDispositions.CompleteWork(deliveryTag, syncComplete: true, AmqpConstants.RejectedNotFoundOutcome);
				}
			}

			public void Done(bool completedSynchronously, DeliveryState state)
			{
				if (state is Outcome outcome)
				{
					this.outcome = outcome;
				}
				else
				{
					if (!(state is TransactionalState))
					{
						CompleteSelf(completedSynchronously, new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.IllegalState, $"DeliveryState '{state.GetType()}' is not valid for disposition."));
						return;
					}
					this.outcome = ((TransactionalState)state).Outcome;
				}
				CompleteSelf(completedSynchronously);
			}

			public void Cancel(bool completedSynchronously, Exception exception)
			{
				CompleteSelf(completedSynchronously, exception);
			}

			protected override void CompleteOnTimer()
			{
				if (link.pendingDispositions.TryRemoveWork(deliveryTag, out var _))
				{
					base.CompleteOnTimer();
				}
			}
		}

		private sealed class SizeBasedFlowQueue : Queue<AmqpMessage>
		{
			private const double IssueCreditThresholdRatio = 0.5;

			private const double StoppCreditThresholdRatio = 0.9;

			private const long DefaultMessageSizeForCacheSizeCalulation = 262144L;

			private const uint MaxCreditToIssuePerFlow = 500u;

			private readonly ReceivingAmqpLink receivingLink;

			private long cacheSizeCredit;

			private long inQueueAverageMessageSizeInBytes;

			private long thresholdCacheSizeInBytes;

			private long overflowBufferCacheSizeInBytes;

			private uint boundedTotalLinkCredit;

			internal long AverageMessageSizeInBytes
			{
				get
				{
					if (inQueueAverageMessageSizeInBytes <= 0)
					{
						return 262144L;
					}
					return inQueueAverageMessageSizeInBytes;
				}
			}

			internal bool IsPrefetchingBySize => receivingLink.Settings.TotalCacheSizeInBytes.HasValue;

			internal long CacheSizeCredit => cacheSizeCredit;

			internal uint BoundedTotalLinkCredit => boundedTotalLinkCredit;

			public SizeBasedFlowQueue(ReceivingAmqpLink receivingLink)
			{
				Fx.AssertAndThrow(receivingLink != null, "Receive link should not be null");
				Fx.AssertAndThrow(receivingLink.Settings != null, "Setting should not be null");
				this.receivingLink = receivingLink;
				SetLinkCreditUsingTotalCacheSize(setTotalLinkCredit: true);
			}

			public void SetLinkCreditUsingTotalCacheSize(bool setTotalLinkCredit = false)
			{
				if (receivingLink.Settings != null && IsPrefetchingBySize)
				{
					cacheSizeCredit = receivingLink.Settings.TotalCacheSizeInBytes.GetValueOrDefault();
					thresholdCacheSizeInBytes = (long)((double)cacheSizeCredit * 0.5);
					overflowBufferCacheSizeInBytes = (long)((double)cacheSizeCredit * 0.09999999999999998);
					boundedTotalLinkCredit = Convert.ToUInt32(cacheSizeCredit / AverageMessageSizeInBytes);
					if (boundedTotalLinkCredit == 0)
					{
						boundedTotalLinkCredit = 1u;
					}
					if (boundedTotalLinkCredit > 500)
					{
						boundedTotalLinkCredit = 500u;
					}
					receivingLink.LinkCredit = boundedTotalLinkCredit;
					if (setTotalLinkCredit)
					{
						receivingLink.Settings.TotalLinkCredit = boundedTotalLinkCredit;
					}
					receivingLink.SetTotalLinkCredit(boundedTotalLinkCredit, applyNow: true, updateAutoFlow: true);
				}
			}

			public new void Enqueue(AmqpMessage amqpMessage)
			{
				if (amqpMessage == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				base.Enqueue(amqpMessage);
				if (IsPrefetchingBySize)
				{
					cacheSizeCredit -= amqpMessage.SerializedMessageSize;
					bool flag = false;
					if (cacheSizeCredit > 0 && cacheSizeCredit > overflowBufferCacheSizeInBytes)
					{
						flag = UpdateCreditToIssue();
					}
					else if (cacheSizeCredit <= 0)
					{
						flag = boundedTotalLinkCredit != 0;
						boundedTotalLinkCredit = 0u;
					}
					else
					{
						flag = boundedTotalLinkCredit != 1;
						boundedTotalLinkCredit = 1u;
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						receivingLink.SetTotalLinkCredit(boundedTotalLinkCredit, applyNow: true);
					}
				}
			}

			public new AmqpMessage Dequeue()
			{
				AmqpMessage amqpMessage = base.Dequeue();
				if (amqpMessage != null && IsPrefetchingBySize)
				{
					cacheSizeCredit += amqpMessage.SerializedMessageSize;
					bool flag = false;
					if (cacheSizeCredit >= thresholdCacheSizeInBytes)
					{
						flag = UpdateCreditToIssue();
					}
					else if (cacheSizeCredit > 0)
					{
						flag = boundedTotalLinkCredit != 1;
						boundedTotalLinkCredit = 1u;
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						receivingLink.SetTotalLinkCredit(boundedTotalLinkCredit, applyNow: true);
					}
				}
				return amqpMessage;
			}

			internal bool UpdateCreditToIssue(AmqpMessage externalMessage = null)
			{
				uint num = boundedTotalLinkCredit;
				long valueOrDefault = receivingLink.Settings.TotalCacheSizeInBytes.GetValueOrDefault();
				long num2 = externalMessage?.SerializedMessageSize ?? 0;
				int num3 = ((externalMessage == null) ? base.Count : (base.Count + 1));
				if (num3 > 0)
				{
					inQueueAverageMessageSizeInBytes = (valueOrDefault - (cacheSizeCredit - num2)) / num3;
					if (inQueueAverageMessageSizeInBytes <= 0)
					{
						inQueueAverageMessageSizeInBytes = 262144L;
					}
				}
				boundedTotalLinkCredit = ((cacheSizeCredit > 0) ? Convert.ToUInt32(cacheSizeCredit / AverageMessageSizeInBytes) : 0u);
				if (boundedTotalLinkCredit == 0 && cacheSizeCredit > 0)
				{
					boundedTotalLinkCredit = 1u;
				}
				if (boundedTotalLinkCredit > 500)
				{
					boundedTotalLinkCredit = 500u;
				}
				return num != boundedTotalLinkCredit;
			}
		}

		private static readonly TimeSpan MinReceiveTimeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10.0);

		public long? TotalCacheSizeInBytes => base.Settings.TotalCacheSizeInBytes;

		internal int MessageQueueCount => messageQueue?.Count ?? 0;

		internal long AvgMessageSize => messageQueue?.AverageMessageSizeInBytes ?? 0;

		internal long MessageQueueSize
		{
			get
			{
				SizeBasedFlowQueue sizeBasedFlowQueue = messageQueue;
				if (sizeBasedFlowQueue != null && sizeBasedFlowQueue.IsPrefetchingBySize)
				{
					long num = 0L;
					if (TotalCacheSizeInBytes.HasValue)
					{
						num = TotalCacheSizeInBytes.Value;
					}
					return num - sizeBasedFlowQueue.CacheSizeCredit;
				}
				return 0L;
			}
		}

				bool result2 = ReceiveAsyncResult.End(result, out messages);
				message = messages.FirstOrDefault();
				return result2;
			}
			message = CompletedAsyncResult<IEnumerable<AmqpMessage>>.End(result).FirstOrDefault();
			return true;
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginReceiveMessages(int messageCount, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{

		}

		private IAsyncResult BeginReceiveMessages(int messageCount, TimeSpan batchWaitTimeout, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			List<AmqpMessage> list = new List<AmqpMessage>();
			lock (base.SyncRoot)
			{
				if (messageQueue != null && messageQueue.Count > 0)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < messageCount; i++)
					{
						if (messageQueue.Count <= 0)
						{
							break;
						}
						list.Add(messageQueue.Dequeue());
					}
				}
			}
			if (!list.Any() && timeout > TimeSpan.Zero)
			{
				ReceiveAsyncResult receiveAsyncResult = new ReceiveAsyncResult(this, messageCount, batchWaitTimeout, timeout, callback, state);
				bool flag = true;
				lock (base.SyncRoot)
				{
					if (messageQueue != null)
					{
						if (messageQueue.Count > 0)
						{
							for (int j = 0; j < messageCount; j++)
							{
								if (messageQueue.Count <= 0)
								{
									break;
								}
								list.Add(messageQueue.Dequeue());
							}
						}
						else
						{
							LinkedListNode<ReceiveAsyncResult> node = waiterList.AddLast(receiveAsyncResult);
							receiveAsyncResult.Initialize(node);
							flag = false;
							int num = ((!base.Settings.AutoSendFlow) ? GetOnDemandReceiveCredit() : 0);
							if (num > 0)
							{
								IssueCredit((uint)num, drain: false, AmqpConstants.NullBinary);
							}
						}
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					receiveAsyncResult.Signal(list, syncComplete: true);
				}
				return receiveAsyncResult;
			}
			return new CompletedAsyncResult<IEnumerable<AmqpMessage>>(list, callback, state);
		}

		protected override void OnReceiveStateOpenSent(Attach attach)

			}
		}

		}

		public void DisposeMessage(AmqpMessage message, DeliveryState state, bool settled, bool batchable)

		}

		public override bool CreateDelivery(Transfer transfer, out Delivery delivery)
		{
			if (currentMessage != null)
			{
				delivery = currentMessage;
				return false;
			}
			delivery = (currentMessage = AmqpMessage.CreateReceivedMessage());
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool OpenInternal()
		{
			messageQueue = new SizeBasedFlowQueue(this);
			waiterList = new LinkedList<ReceiveAsyncResult>();
			pendingDispositions = new WorkCollection<ArraySegment<byte>, DisposeAsyncResult, DeliveryState>(ByteArrayComparer.Instance);
			bool result = base.OpenInternal();
			if (base.LinkCredit != 0)
			{
				SendFlow(echo: false);
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override void OnDisposeDeliveryInternal(Delivery delivery)
		{
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpDispose(this, delivery.DeliveryId.Value, delivery.Settled, delivery.State);
			DeliveryState state = delivery.State;
			if (state != null)
			{
				pendingDispositions.CompleteWork(delivery.DeliveryTag, syncComplete: false, state);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnProcessTransfer(Delivery delivery, Transfer transfer, Frame frame)
		{
			if (base.Settings.MaxMessageSize.HasValue && base.Settings.MaxMessageSize.Value != 0)
			{
				ulong num = (ulong)(currentMessage.BytesTransfered + frame.Payload.Count);
				if (num > base.Settings.MaxMessageSize.Value)
				{
					if (IsClosing())
					{
						return;
					}
					throw new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.MessageSizeExceeded, SRAmqp.AmqpMessageSizeExceeded(currentMessage.DeliveryId.Value, num, base.Settings.MaxMessageSize.Value));
				}
			}
			ArraySegment<byte> payload = frame.Payload;
			frame.RawByteBuffer.AdjustPosition(payload.Offset, payload.Count);
			currentMessage.AddPayload(frame.RawByteBuffer, !transfer.More());
			if (!transfer.More())
			{
				AmqpMessage amqpMessage = currentMessage;
				currentMessage = null;
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpReceiveMessage(this, amqpMessage.DeliveryId.Value, amqpMessage.Segments);
				OnReceiveMessage(amqpMessage);
			}
		}

		protected override void AbortInternal()
		{
			Queue<AmqpMessage> messagesToRelease = null;
			CancelPendingOperations(aborted: true, out messagesToRelease);
			if (messagesToRelease != null)
			{
				foreach (AmqpMessage item in messagesToRelease)
				{
					item.Dispose();
				}
			}
			currentMessage?.Dispose();
			base.AbortInternal();
		}

		protected override bool CloseInternal()
		{
			Queue<AmqpMessage> messagesToRelease = null;
			CancelPendingOperations(aborted: false, out messagesToRelease);
			if (messagesToRelease != null)
			{
				foreach (AmqpMessage item in messagesToRelease)
				{
					ReleaseMessage(item);
					item.Dispose();
				}
			}
			currentMessage?.Dispose();
			return base.CloseInternal();
		}

		private void CancelPendingOperations(bool aborted, out Queue<AmqpMessage> messagesToRelease)
		{
			messagesToRelease = null;
			LinkedList<ReceiveAsyncResult> linkedList = null;
			lock (base.SyncRoot)
			{
				messagesToRelease = messageQueue;
				linkedList = waiterList;
				messageQueue = null;
				waiterList = null;
			}
			if (linkedList != null)
			{
				ActionItem.Schedule(delegate(object o)
				{
					Tuple<LinkedList<ReceiveAsyncResult>, bool> tuple = (Tuple<LinkedList<ReceiveAsyncResult>, bool>)o;
					LinkedList<ReceiveAsyncResult> item = tuple.Item1;
					foreach (ReceiveAsyncResult item2 in item)
					{
						if (tuple.Item2)
						{
							item2.Cancel();
						}
						else
						{
							item2.Signal(syncComplete: false, null);
						}
					}
				}, new Tuple<LinkedList<ReceiveAsyncResult>, bool>(linkedList, aborted));
			}
			if (pendingDispositions != null)
			{
				pendingDispositions.Abort();
			}
		}

		private void OnReceiveMessage(AmqpMessage message)
		{
			if (messageListener != null)
			{
				messageListener(message);
				return;
			}
			ReceiveAsyncResult receiveAsyncResult = null;
			int num = 0;
			bool flag = false;
			lock (base.SyncRoot)
			{
				if (waiterList != null && waiterList.Count > 0)
				{
					ReceiveAsyncResult value = waiterList.First.Value;
					if (messageQueue.IsPrefetchingBySize && messageQueue.UpdateCreditToIssue(message))
					{
						SetTotalLinkCredit(messageQueue.BoundedTotalLinkCredit, applyNow: true);
					}
					value.Add(message);
					if (value.RequestedMessageCount == 1 || value.MessageCount >= value.RequestedMessageCount)
					{
						waiterList.RemoveFirst();
						value.OnRemoved();
						num = ((!base.Settings.AutoSendFlow) ? GetOnDemandReceiveCredit() : 0);
						receiveAsyncResult = value;
					}
				}
				else if (!base.Settings.AutoSendFlow && base.Settings.SettleType != SettleMode.SettleOnSend)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				else if (messageQueue != null)
				{
					messageQueue.Enqueue(message);
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpCacheMessage(this, message.DeliveryId.Value, messageQueue.Count, messageQueue.IsPrefetchingBySize, TotalCacheSizeInBytes.GetValueOrDefault(), (base.Settings != null) ? base.Settings.TotalLinkCredit : 0u, base.LinkCredit);
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				ReleaseMessage(message);
				message.Dispose();
			}
			if (num > 0)
			{
				IssueCredit((uint)num, drain: false, AmqpConstants.NullBinary);
			}
			if (receiveAsyncResult != null)
			{
				ActionItem.Schedule(delegate(object o)
				{
					ReceiveAsyncResult receiveAsyncResult2 = (ReceiveAsyncResult)o;
					receiveAsyncResult2.Signal(syncComplete: false);
				}, receiveAsyncResult);
			}
		}

		private int GetOnDemandReceiveCredit()
		{
			int result = 0;
			int num = (int)base.LinkCredit;
			int num2 = 0;
			foreach (ReceiveAsyncResult waiter in waiterList)
			{
				num2 += waiter.RequestedMessageCount;
			}
			if (waiterList.Count == num2)
			{
				if (waiterList.Count > num && num < 200)
				{
					int num3 = Math.Min(waiterList.Count, 200) - num;
					if (waiterList.Count <= 20 || num3 % 20 == 0)
					{
						result = num + num3;
					}
				}
			}
			else if (num2 > num)
			{
				int num4 = num2 - num;
				if (waiterList.Count <= 20 || waiterList.Count % 20 == 0)
				{
					result = num + num4;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	internal sealed class SendingAmqpLink : AmqpLink, IWorkDelegate<AmqpMessage>
	{
		private sealed class SendAsyncResult : TimeoutAsyncResult<string>, IWork<Outcome>
		{
			private readonly SendingAmqpLink link;

			private readonly AmqpMessage message;

			private readonly ArraySegment<byte> deliveryTag;

			private readonly ArraySegment<byte> txnId;

			private Outcome outcome;

			protected override string Target => "message";

			public SendAsyncResult(SendingAmqpLink link, AmqpMessage message, ArraySegment<byte> deliveryTag, ArraySegment<byte> txnId, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.link = link;
				this.message = message;
				this.deliveryTag = deliveryTag;
				this.txnId = txnId;
				this.link.inflightSends.StartWork(deliveryTag, this);
			}

			public static Outcome End(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				return Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult.End<SendAsyncResult>(result).outcome;
			}

			public void Start()
			{
				SetTimer();
				link.SendMessageInternal(message, deliveryTag, txnId);
			}

			public void Done(bool completedSynchronously, Outcome outcome)
			{
				this.outcome = outcome;
				CompleteSelf(completedSynchronously);
			}

			public void Cancel(bool completedSynchronously, Exception exception)
			{
				Exception ex = exception;
				if (exception is OperationCanceledException && link.TerminalException != null)
				{
					ex = new OperationCanceledException(link.TerminalException.Message, link.TerminalException);
				}
				CompleteSelf(completedSynchronously, ex);
			}

			protected override void CompleteOnTimer()
			{
				if (link.inflightSends.TryRemoveWork(deliveryTag, out var _))
				{
					if (message.Link != null)
					{
						link.DisposeDelivery(message, settled: true, AmqpConstants.ReleasedOutcome);
					}
					else
					{
						message.State = AmqpConstants.ReleasedOutcome;
					}
				}
				base.CompleteOnTimer();
			}
		}

		private static readonly TimeSpan MinRequestCreditWindow = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10.0);

		private static readonly Action<object> onRequestCredit = OnRequestCredit;

		private readonly SerializedWorker<AmqpMessage> pendingDeliveries;

		private readonly WorkCollection<ArraySegment<byte>, SendAsyncResult, Outcome> inflightSends;

		private Action<Delivery> dispositionListener;

		private DateTime lastFlowRequestTime;

		public override uint Available => (uint)pendingDeliveries.Count;

		public SendingAmqpLink(AmqpLinkSettings settings)
			: this(null, settings)
		{
		}

		public SendingAmqpLink(AmqpSession session, AmqpLinkSettings settings)
			: base(session, settings)
		{
			pendingDeliveries = new SerializedWorker<AmqpMessage>(this);
			inflightSends = new WorkCollection<ArraySegment<byte>, SendAsyncResult, Outcome>(ByteArrayComparer.Instance);
			lastFlowRequestTime = DateTime.UtcNow;
		}

		public void RegisterDispositionListener(Action<Delivery> dispositionListener)
		{
			if (Interlocked.Exchange(ref this.dispositionListener, dispositionListener) != null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.DispositionListenerAlreadyRegistered);
			}
		}

		public void SendMessageNoWait(AmqpMessage message, ArraySegment<byte> deliveryTag, ArraySegment<byte> txnId)
		{
			SendMessageInternal(message, deliveryTag, txnId);
		}

		internal Task<Outcome> SendMessageAsync(AmqpMessage message, ArraySegment<byte> deliveryTag, ArraySegment<byte> txnId, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			return Task.Factory.FromAsync((Func<AsyncCallback, object, IAsyncResult>)((AsyncCallback c, object s) => BeginSendMessage(message, deliveryTag, txnId, timeout, c, s)), (Func<IAsyncResult, Outcome>)EndSendMessage, (object)null);
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginSendMessage(AmqpMessage message, ArraySegment<byte> deliveryTag, ArraySegment<byte> txnId, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			if (dispositionListener != null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.DispositionListenerSetNotSupported);
			}
			message.ThrowIfDisposed();
			if (message.Sections == (SectionFlag)0)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(SRAmqp.AmqpEmptyMessageNotAllowed);
			}
			if (message.Link != null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(SRAmqp.AmqpCannotResendMessage);
			}
			return new SendAsyncResult(this, message, deliveryTag, txnId, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		public Outcome EndSendMessage(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			return SendAsyncResult.End(result);
		}

		public override bool CreateDelivery(Transfer transfer, out Delivery delivery)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		protected override void OnDisposeDeliveryInternal(Delivery delivery)
		{
			if (dispositionListener != null)
			{
				dispositionListener(delivery);
				return;
			}
			DeliveryState deliveryState = delivery.State;
			if (deliveryState.DescriptorCode != Received.Code)
			{
				if (deliveryState is TransactionalState transactionalState)
				{
					deliveryState = transactionalState.Outcome;
				}
				inflightSends.CompleteWork(delivery.DeliveryTag, syncComplete: false, (Outcome)deliveryState);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnProcessTransfer(Delivery delivery, Transfer transfer, Frame frame)
		{
			throw new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.NotAllowed, null);
		}

		protected override void OnCreditAvailable(int session, uint moreCredit, bool drain, ArraySegment<byte> txnId)
		{
			if (base.LinkCredit != 0)
			{
				pendingDeliveries.ContinueWork();
			}
			base.OnCreditAvailable(session, moreCredit, drain, txnId);
		}

		protected override bool CloseInternal()
		{
			AbortDeliveries();
			return base.CloseInternal();
		}

		protected override void AbortInternal()
		{
			AbortDeliveries();
			base.AbortInternal();
		}

		private static void OnRequestCredit(object state)
		{
			try
			{
				SendingAmqpLink sendingAmqpLink = (SendingAmqpLink)state;
				if (sendingAmqpLink.State == AmqpObjectState.OpenSent || sendingAmqpLink.State == AmqpObjectState.Opened)
				{
					sendingAmqpLink.SendFlow(echo: true);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
			}
		}

		private void AbortDeliveries()
		{
			if (pendingDeliveries != null)
			{
				pendingDeliveries.Abort();
			}
			if (inflightSends != null)
			{
				inflightSends.Abort();
			}
		}

		private void SendMessageInternal(AmqpMessage message, ArraySegment<byte> deliveryTag, ArraySegment<byte> txnId)
		{
			message.DeliveryTag = deliveryTag;
			message.Settled = base.Settings.SettleType == SettleMode.SettleOnSend;
			message.TxnId = txnId;
			pendingDeliveries.DoWork(message);
		}

		bool IWorkDelegate<AmqpMessage>.Invoke(AmqpMessage message)
		{
			DeliveryState state = message.State;
			if (state != null && state.DescriptorCode == Released.Code)
			{
				return true;
			}
			bool flag = TrySendDelivery(message);
			if (!flag && base.Session.State == AmqpObjectState.Opened && DateTime.UtcNow - lastFlowRequestTime >= MinRequestCreditWindow)
			{
				lastFlowRequestTime = DateTime.UtcNow;
				ActionItem.Schedule(onRequestCredit, this);
			}
			return flag;
		}
	}
	internal struct SequenceNumber : IComparable<SequenceNumber>, IEquatable<SequenceNumber>
	{
		private int sequenceNumber;

		public uint Value => (uint)sequenceNumber;

		public SequenceNumber(uint value)
		{
			sequenceNumber = (int)value;
		}

		public static SequenceNumber Increment(ref int sn)
		{
			return (uint)Interlocked.Increment(ref sn);
		}

		public static int Compare(int x, int y)
		{
			int num = x - y;
			if (num == int.MinValue)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(SRAmqp.AmqpInvalidSequenceNumberComparison(x, y));
			}
			return num;
		}

		public int CompareTo(SequenceNumber value)
		{
			return Compare(sequenceNumber, value.sequenceNumber);
		}

		public bool Equals(SequenceNumber obj)
		{
			return sequenceNumber == obj.sequenceNumber;
		}

		public static implicit operator SequenceNumber(uint value)
		{
			return new SequenceNumber(value);
		}

		public static SequenceNumber operator +(SequenceNumber value1, int delta)
		{
			return (uint)(value1.sequenceNumber + delta);
		}

		public static SequenceNumber operator -(SequenceNumber value1, int delta)
		{
			return (uint)(value1.sequenceNumber - delta);
		}

		public static int operator -(SequenceNumber value1, SequenceNumber value2)
		{
			return value1.sequenceNumber - value2.sequenceNumber;
		}

		public static bool operator ==(SequenceNumber value1, SequenceNumber value2)
		{
			return value1.sequenceNumber == value2.sequenceNumber;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(SequenceNumber value1, SequenceNumber value2)
		{
			return value1.sequenceNumber != value2.sequenceNumber;
		}

		public static bool operator >(SequenceNumber value1, SequenceNumber value2)
		{
			return value1.CompareTo(value2) > 0;
		}

		public static bool operator >=(SequenceNumber value1, SequenceNumber value2)
		{
			return value1.CompareTo(value2) >= 0;
		}

		public static bool operator <(SequenceNumber value1, SequenceNumber value2)
		{
			return value1.CompareTo(value2) < 0;
		}

		public static bool operator <=(SequenceNumber value1, SequenceNumber value2)
		{
			return value1.CompareTo(value2) <= 0;
		}

		public uint Increment()
		{
			return (uint)(++sequenceNumber);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return sequenceNumber.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is SequenceNumber)
			{
				return Equals((SequenceNumber)obj);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return sequenceNumber.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class SerializedWorker<T> where T : class
	{
		private enum State
		{
			Idle,
			Busy,
			BusyWithContinue,
			WaitingForContinue,
			Aborted
		}

		private readonly IWorkDelegate<T> workDelegate;

		private readonly LinkedList<T> pendingWorkList;

		private State state;

		public int Count => pendingWorkList.Count;

		private object SyncRoot => pendingWorkList;

		public SerializedWorker(IWorkDelegate<T> workProcessor)
		{
			workDelegate = workProcessor;
			state = State.Idle;
			pendingWorkList = new LinkedList<T>();
		}

		public void DoWork(T work)
		{
			lock (SyncRoot)
			{
				if (state == State.Aborted)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (state != State.Idle)
				{
					pendingWorkList.AddLast(work);
					return;
				}
				state = State.Busy;
			}
			DoWorkInternal(work, fromList: false);
		}

		public void ContinueWork()
		{
			T val = null;
			lock (SyncRoot)
			{
				if (state == State.BusyWithContinue || state == State.Aborted)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (state == State.Busy)
				{
					state = State.BusyWithContinue;
					return;
				}
				if (pendingWorkList.First != null)
				{
					val = pendingWorkList.First.Value;
					state = State.Busy;
				}
			}
			if (val != null)
			{
				DoWorkInternal(val, fromList: true);
			}
		}

		public void Abort()
		{
			lock (SyncRoot)
			{
				pendingWorkList.Clear();
				state = State.Aborted;
			}
		}

		private void DoWorkInternal(T work, bool fromList)
		{
			while (work != null)
			{
				if (workDelegate.Invoke(work))
				{
					lock (SyncRoot)
					{
						work = null;
						if (state != State.Aborted)
						{
							if (fromList && pendingWorkList.First != null)
							{
								pendingWorkList.RemoveFirst();
							}
							if (pendingWorkList.First != null)
							{
								work = pendingWorkList.First.Value;
								fromList = true;
							}
							if (work == null)
							{
								state = State.Idle;
								break;
							}
							state = State.Busy;
						}
					}
					continue;
				}
				lock (SyncRoot)
				{
					if (state == State.Aborted)
					{
						work = null;
						continue;
					}
					if (state == State.BusyWithContinue)
					{
						state = State.Busy;
						continue;
					}
					if (!fromList)
					{
						pendingWorkList.AddFirst(work);
					}
					state = State.WaitingForContinue;
					work = null;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal enum SettleMode : byte
	{
		SettleOnSend,
		SettleOnReceive,
		SettleOnDispose
	}
	internal sealed class StateTransition
	{
		private static StateTransition[] sendHeader = new StateTransition[2]
		{
			new StateTransition(AmqpObjectState.Start, AmqpObjectState.HeaderSent),
			new StateTransition(AmqpObjectState.HeaderReceived, AmqpObjectState.HeaderExchanged)
		};

		private static StateTransition[] sendOpen = new StateTransition[5]
		{
			new StateTransition(AmqpObjectState.Start, AmqpObjectState.OpenSent),
			new StateTransition(AmqpObjectState.OpenReceived, AmqpObjectState.Opened),
			new StateTransition(AmqpObjectState.HeaderSent, AmqpObjectState.OpenPipe),
			new StateTransition(AmqpObjectState.HeaderExchanged, AmqpObjectState.OpenSent),
			new StateTransition(AmqpObjectState.ClosePipe, AmqpObjectState.CloseReceived)
		};

		private static StateTransition[] sendClose = new StateTransition[5]
		{
			new StateTransition(AmqpObjectState.Opened, AmqpObjectState.CloseSent),
			new StateTransition(AmqpObjectState.CloseReceived, AmqpObjectState.End),
			new StateTransition(AmqpObjectState.OpenSent, AmqpObjectState.ClosePipe),
			new StateTransition(AmqpObjectState.OpenPipe, AmqpObjectState.OpenClosePipe),
			new StateTransition(AmqpObjectState.Faulted, AmqpObjectState.Faulted)
		};

		private static StateTransition[] receiveHeader = new StateTransition[4]
		{
			new StateTransition(AmqpObjectState.Start, AmqpObjectState.HeaderReceived),
			new StateTransition(AmqpObjectState.HeaderSent, AmqpObjectState.HeaderExchanged),
			new StateTransition(AmqpObjectState.OpenPipe, AmqpObjectState.OpenSent),
			new StateTransition(AmqpObjectState.OpenClosePipe, AmqpObjectState.ClosePipe)
		};

		private static StateTransition[] receiveOpen = new StateTransition[5]
		{
			new StateTransition(AmqpObjectState.Start, AmqpObjectState.OpenReceived),
			new StateTransition(AmqpObjectState.OpenSent, AmqpObjectState.Opened),
			new StateTransition(AmqpObjectState.HeaderReceived, AmqpObjectState.OpenReceived),
			new StateTransition(AmqpObjectState.HeaderExchanged, AmqpObjectState.OpenReceived),
			new StateTransition(AmqpObjectState.ClosePipe, AmqpObjectState.CloseSent)
		};

		private static StateTransition[] receiveClose = new StateTransition[4]
		{
			new StateTransition(AmqpObjectState.Opened, AmqpObjectState.CloseReceived),
			new StateTransition(AmqpObjectState.CloseSent, AmqpObjectState.End),
			new StateTransition(AmqpObjectState.OpenReceived, AmqpObjectState.ClosePipe),
			new StateTransition(AmqpObjectState.Faulted, AmqpObjectState.End)
		};

		public static StateTransition[] SendHeader => sendHeader;

		public static StateTransition[] SendOpen => sendOpen;

		public static StateTransition[] SendClose => sendClose;

		public static StateTransition[] ReceiveHeader => receiveHeader;

		public static StateTransition[] ReceiveOpen => receiveOpen;

		public static StateTransition[] ReceiveClose => receiveClose;

		public AmqpObjectState From { get; private set; }

		public AmqpObjectState To { get; private set; }

		public StateTransition(AmqpObjectState from, AmqpObjectState to)
		{
			From = from;
			To = to;
		}

		public static bool CanTransite(AmqpObjectState from, StateTransition[] states)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < states.Length; i++)
			{
				if (states[i].From == from)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

namespace Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging.Amqp.Transaction
{
	internal sealed class Controller : AmqpObject
	{
		private readonly SendingAmqpLink controllerLink;

		private long messageTag;

		private readonly TimeSpan operationTimeout;

		public Controller(AmqpSession amqpSession, TimeSpan operationTimeout)
			: base("controller")
		{
			this.operationTimeout = operationTimeout;
			string text = "control-link:" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N");
			Source source = new Source
			{
				Address = text,
				DistributionMode = DistributionMode.Move
			};
			Coordinator target = new Coordinator();
			AmqpLinkSettings settings = new AmqpLinkSettings
			{
				Source = source,
				Target = target,
				LinkName = text,
				Role = false
			};
			controllerLink = new SendingAmqpLink(amqpSession, settings);
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginInitialize(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return controllerLink.BeginOpen(timeout, callback, state);
		}

		public void EndInitialize(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			controllerLink.EndOpen(result);
			controllerLink.SafeAddClosed(delegate
			{
				SafeClose();
			});
		}

		public static AmqpMessage CreateCommandMessage(IAmqpSerializable command)
		{
			AmqpValue value = new AmqpValue
			{
				Value = command
			};
			return AmqpMessage.Create(value);
		}

		public async Task<ArraySegment<byte>> DeclareAsync()
		{
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogOperation(this, TraceOperation.Execute, "BeginDeclare");
			Declare command = new Declare();
			AmqpMessage message = CreateCommandMessage(command);
			DeliveryState deliveryState = await Task<DeliveryState>.Factory.FromAsync(controllerLink.BeginSendMessage(message, GetDeliveryTag(), AmqpConstants.NullBinary, operationTimeout, null, null), controllerLink.EndSendMessage).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			ThrowIfRejected(deliveryState);
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogOperation(this, TraceOperation.Execute, "EndDeclare");
			return ((Declared)deliveryState).TxnId;
		}

		public async Task DischargeAsync(ArraySegment<byte> txnId, bool fail)
		{
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogOperation(this, TraceOperation.Execute, "BeginDischange");
			Discharge command = new Discharge
			{
				TxnId = txnId,
				Fail = fail
			};
			AmqpMessage message = CreateCommandMessage(command);
			ThrowIfRejected(await Task<DeliveryState>.Factory.FromAsync(controllerLink.BeginSendMessage(message, GetDeliveryTag(), AmqpConstants.NullBinary, operationTimeout, null, null), controllerLink.EndSendMessage).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false));
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogOperation(this, TraceOperation.Execute, "EndDischange");
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "controller";
		}

		protected override bool OpenInternal()
		{
			return controllerLink.State == AmqpObjectState.Opened;
		}

		protected override bool CloseInternal()
		{
			controllerLink.Close();
			controllerLink.Session.Close();
			return true;
		}

		protected override void AbortInternal()
		{
			controllerLink.Abort();
			controllerLink.Session.Abort();
		}

		private void ThrowIfRejected(DeliveryState deliveryState)
		{
			if (deliveryState.DescriptorCode == Rejected.Code)
			{
				Rejected rejected = (Rejected)deliveryState;
				throw AmqpException.FromError(rejected.Error);
			}
		}

		private ArraySegment<byte> GetDeliveryTag()
		{
			long value = Interlocked.Increment(ref messageTag);
			return new ArraySegment<byte>(BitConverter.GetBytes(value));
		}
	}
	internal sealed class Coordinator : DescribedList
	{
		public static readonly string Name = "amqp:coordinator:list";

		public static readonly ulong Code = 48uL;

		private const int Fields = 1;

		public Multiple<AmqpSymbol> Capabilities { get; set; }

		protected override int FieldCount => 1;

		public Coordinator()
			: base(Name, Code)
		{
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder("coordinator(");
			int count = 0;
			AddFieldToString(Capabilities != null, stringBuilder, "capabilities", Capabilities, ref count);
			stringBuilder.Append(')');
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		protected override void EnsureRequired()
		{
		}

		protected override void OnEncode(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			AmqpCodec.EncodeMultiple(Capabilities, buffer);
		}

		protected override void OnDecode(ByteBuffer buffer, int count)
		{
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				Capabilities = AmqpCodec.DecodeMultiple<AmqpSymbol>(buffer);
			}
		}

		protected override int OnValueSize()
		{
			int num = 0;
			return num + AmqpCodec.GetMultipleEncodeSize(Capabilities);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class Declare : Performative
	{
		public static readonly string Name = "amqp:declare:list";

		public static readonly ulong Code = 49uL;

		private const int Fields = 1;

		public object GlobalId { get; set; }

		protected override int FieldCount => 1;

		public Declare()
			: base(Name, Code)
		{
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "declare()";
		}

		protected override void OnEncode(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			AmqpCodec.EncodeObject(GlobalId, buffer);
		}

		protected override void OnDecode(ByteBuffer buffer, int count)
		{
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				GlobalId = AmqpEncoding.DecodeObject(buffer);
			}
		}

		protected override int OnValueSize()
		{
			int num = 0;
			return num + AmqpCodec.GetObjectEncodeSize(GlobalId);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class Declared : Outcome
	{
		public static readonly string Name = "amqp:declared:list";

		public static readonly ulong Code = 51uL;

		private const int Fields = 1;

		public ArraySegment<byte> TxnId { get; set; }

		protected override int FieldCount => 1;

		public Declared()
			: base(Name, Code)
		{
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder("declared(");
			int count = 0;
			AddFieldToString(TxnId.Array != null, stringBuilder, "txn-id", TxnId, ref count);
			stringBuilder.Append(')');
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		protected override void OnEncode(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			AmqpCodec.EncodeBinary(TxnId, buffer);
		}

		protected override void OnDecode(ByteBuffer buffer, int count)
		{
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				TxnId = AmqpCodec.DecodeBinary(buffer);
			}
		}

		protected override int OnValueSize()
		{
			int num = 0;
			return num + AmqpCodec.GetBinaryEncodeSize(TxnId);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class Discharge : Performative
	{
		public static readonly string Name = "amqp:discharge:list";

		public static readonly ulong Code = 50uL;

		private const int Fields = 2;

		public ArraySegment<byte> TxnId { get; set; }

		public bool? Fail { get; set; }

		protected override int FieldCount => 2;

		public Discharge()
			: base(Name, Code)
		{
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder("discharge(");
			int count = 0;
			AddFieldToString(TxnId.Array != null, stringBuilder, "txn-id", TxnId, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(Fail.HasValue, stringBuilder, "fail", Fail, ref count);
			stringBuilder.Append(')');
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		protected override void OnEncode(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			AmqpCodec.EncodeBinary(TxnId, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeBoolean(Fail, buffer);
		}

		protected override void OnDecode(ByteBuffer buffer, int count)
		{
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				TxnId = AmqpCodec.DecodeBinary(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				Fail = AmqpCodec.DecodeBoolean(buffer);
			}
		}

		protected override int OnValueSize()
		{
			int num = 0;
			num = AmqpCodec.GetBinaryEncodeSize(TxnId);
			return num + AmqpCodec.GetBooleanEncodeSize(Fail);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class TransactionalState : DeliveryState
	{
		public static readonly string Name = "amqp:transactional-state:list";

		public static readonly ulong Code = 52uL;

		private const int Fields = 2;

		public ArraySegment<byte> TxnId { get; set; }

		public Outcome Outcome { get; set; }

		protected override int FieldCount => 2;

		public TransactionalState()
			: base(Name, Code)
		{
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder("txn-state(");
			int count = 0;
			AddFieldToString(TxnId.Array != null, stringBuilder, "txn-id", TxnId, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(Outcome != null, stringBuilder, "outcome", Outcome, ref count);
			stringBuilder.Append(')');
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		protected override void OnEncode(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			AmqpCodec.EncodeBinary(TxnId, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeSerializable(Outcome, buffer);
		}

		protected override void OnDecode(ByteBuffer buffer, int count)
		{
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				TxnId = AmqpCodec.DecodeBinary(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				Outcome = (Outcome)AmqpCodec.DecodeAmqpDescribed(buffer);
			}
		}

		protected override int OnValueSize()
		{
			int num = 0;
			num += AmqpCodec.GetBinaryEncodeSize(TxnId);
			return num + AmqpCodec.GetSerializableEncodeSize(Outcome);
		}
	}

	}

			buffer.Validate(write: false, 2);

			{
				byte* ptr2 = (byte*)(&result);
				*ptr2 = ptr[1];
				ptr2[1] = *ptr;
			}
			buffer.Complete(2);
			return result;
		}

		private static void Validate(int bufferSize, int dataSize)
		{
			if (bufferSize < dataSize)
			{
				throw new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.DecodeError, SRAmqp.AmqpInsufficientBufferSize(dataSize, bufferSize));
			}
		}

	internal static class AmqpEncoding
	{
		private static readonly AmqpEncoding<object> objectEncoder;

		private static readonly AmqpEncoding<string> stringEncoder;

		private static readonly AmqpEncoding<AmqpSymbol> symbolEncoder;

		private static readonly Dictionary<Type, EncodingBase> encodingsByType;

		private static readonly Dictionary<FormatCode, EncodingBase> encodingsByCode;

		private static readonly BooleanEncoding booleanEncoding;

		private static readonly UByteEncoding ubyteEncoding;

		private static readonly UShortEncoding ushortEncoding;

		private static readonly UIntEncoding uintEncoding;

		private static readonly ULongEncoding ulongEncoding;

		private static readonly ByteEncoding byteEncoding;

		private static readonly ShortEncoding shortEncoding;

		private static readonly IntEncoding intEncoding;

		private static readonly LongEncoding longEncoding;

		private static readonly FloatEncoding floatEncoding;

		private static readonly DoubleEncoding doubleEncoding;

		private static readonly DecimalEncoding decimal128Encoding;

		private static readonly CharEncoding charEncoding;

		private static readonly TimeStampEncoding timeStampEncoding;

		private static readonly UuidEncoding uuidEncoding;

		private static readonly BinaryEncoding binaryEncoding;

		private static readonly SymbolEncoding symbolEncoding;

		private static readonly StringEncoding stringEncoding;

		private static readonly ListEncoding listEncoding;

		private static readonly MapEncoding mapEncoding;

		private static readonly ArrayEncoding arrayEncoding;

		private static readonly DescribedEncoding describedTypeEncoding;

		public static AmqpEncoding<object> Object => objectEncoder;

		public static AmqpEncoding<string> String => stringEncoder;

		public static AmqpEncoding<AmqpSymbol> Symbol => symbolEncoder;

		static AmqpEncoding()
		{
			booleanEncoding = new BooleanEncoding();
			ubyteEncoding = new UByteEncoding();
			ushortEncoding = new UShortEncoding();
			uintEncoding = new UIntEncoding();
			ulongEncoding = new ULongEncoding();
			byteEncoding = new ByteEncoding();
			shortEncoding = new ShortEncoding();
			intEncoding = new IntEncoding();
			longEncoding = new LongEncoding();
			floatEncoding = new FloatEncoding();
			doubleEncoding = new DoubleEncoding();
			decimal128Encoding = new DecimalEncoding();
			charEncoding = new CharEncoding();
			timeStampEncoding = new TimeStampEncoding();
			uuidEncoding = new UuidEncoding();
			binaryEncoding = new BinaryEncoding();
			symbolEncoding = new SymbolEncoding();
			stringEncoding = new StringEncoding();
			listEncoding = new ListEncoding();
			mapEncoding = new MapEncoding();
			arrayEncoding = new ArrayEncoding();
			describedTypeEncoding = new DescribedEncoding();
			objectEncoder = new AmqpEncoding<object>((object obj) => GetObjectEncodeSize(obj), delegate(object obj, ByteBuffer buffer)
			{
				EncodeObject(obj, buffer);
			}, (ByteBuffer buffer) => DecodeObject(buffer));
			stringEncoder = new AmqpEncoding<string>((string obj) => StringEncoding.GetEncodeSize(obj), delegate(string obj, ByteBuffer buffer)
			{
				StringEncoding.Encode(obj, buffer);
			}, (ByteBuffer buffer) => StringEncoding.Decode(buffer, (byte)0));
			symbolEncoder = new AmqpEncoding<AmqpSymbol>((AmqpSymbol obj) => SymbolEncoding.GetEncodeSize(obj), delegate(AmqpSymbol obj, ByteBuffer buffer)
			{
				SymbolEncoding.Encode(obj, buffer);
			}, (ByteBuffer buffer) => DecodeSymbolRelaxed(buffer));
			encodingsByType = new Dictionary<Type, EncodingBase>
			{
				{
					typeof(bool),

				},
				{

				},
				{

					stringEncoding

					mapEncoding
				}
			};

				{
					(byte)115,
					charEncoding
				},
				{
					(byte)131,
					timeStampEncoding
				},
				{
					(byte)152,
					uuidEncoding
				},
				{
					(byte)160,
					binaryEncoding
				},
				{
					(byte)176,
					binaryEncoding
				},
				{
					(byte)163,
					symbolEncoding
				},
				{
					(byte)179,
					symbolEncoding
				},
				{
					(byte)161,
					stringEncoding
				},
				{
					(byte)177,
					stringEncoding
				},
				{
					(byte)69,
					listEncoding
				},
				{
					(byte)192,
					listEncoding
				},
				{
					(byte)208,
					listEncoding
				},
				{
					(byte)193,
					mapEncoding
				},
				{
					(byte)209,
					mapEncoding
				},
				{
					(byte)224,
					arrayEncoding
				},
				{
					(byte)240,
					arrayEncoding
				},
				{
					(byte)0,
					describedTypeEncoding
				}
			};
		}

		public static EncodingBase GetEncoding(object value)
		{
			EncodingBase value2 = null;
			Type type = value.GetType();
			if (encodingsByType.TryGetValue(type, out value2))
			{
				return value2;
			}
			if (type.IsArray)
			{
				return arrayEncoding;
			}
			if (value is IList)
			{
				return listEncoding;
			}
			if (value is DescribedType)
			{
				return describedTypeEncoding;
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException(SRAmqp.AmqpInvalidType(type.ToString()));
		}

		public static EncodingBase GetEncoding(Type type)
		{
			EncodingBase value = null;
			if (encodingsByType.TryGetValue(type, out value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			if (type.IsArray)
			{
				return arrayEncoding;
			}
			if (typeof(IList).IsAssignableFrom(type))
			{
				return listEncoding;
			}
			if (typeof(DescribedType).IsAssignableFrom(type))
			{
				return describedTypeEncoding;
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException(SRAmqp.AmqpInvalidType(type.ToString()));
		}

		public static EncodingBase GetEncoding(FormatCode formatCode)
		{
			if (encodingsByCode.TryGetValue(formatCode, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static int GetEncodeWidthBySize(int size)
		{
			if (size > 255)
			{
				return 4;
			}
			return 1;
		}

		public static int GetEncodeWidthByCountAndSize(int count, int valueSize)
		{
			if (count >= 255 || valueSize >= 255)
			{
				return 4;
			}
			return 1;
		}

		public static FormatCode ReadFormatCode(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			byte type = AmqpBitConverter.ReadUByte(buffer);
			byte extType = 0;
			if (FormatCode.HasExtType(type))
			{
				extType = AmqpBitConverter.ReadUByte(buffer);
			}
			return new FormatCode(type, extType);
		}

		public static void ReadCount(ByteBuffer buffer, FormatCode formatCode, FormatCode formatCode8, FormatCode formatCode32, out int count)
		{
			if (formatCode == formatCode8)
			{
				count = AmqpBitConverter.ReadUByte(buffer);
				return;
			}
			if (formatCode == formatCode32)
			{
				count = (int)AmqpBitConverter.ReadUInt(buffer);
				return;
			}
			throw GetEncodingException(SRAmqp.AmqpInvalidFormatCode(formatCode, buffer.Offset));
		}

		public static void ReadSizeAndCount(ByteBuffer buffer, FormatCode formatCode, FormatCode formatCode8, FormatCode formatCode32, out int size, out int count)
		{
			if (formatCode == formatCode8)
			{
				size = AmqpBitConverter.ReadUByte(buffer);
				count = AmqpBitConverter.ReadUByte(buffer);
				return;
			}
			if (formatCode == formatCode32)
			{
				size = (int)AmqpBitConverter.ReadUInt(buffer);
				count = (int)AmqpBitConverter.ReadUInt(buffer);
				return;
			}
			throw GetEncodingException(SRAmqp.AmqpInvalidFormatCode(formatCode, buffer.Offset));
		}

		public static int GetObjectEncodeSize(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (value is IAmqpSerializable amqpSerializable)
			{
				return amqpSerializable.EncodeSize;
			}
			EncodingBase encoding = GetEncoding(value);
			return encoding.GetObjectEncodeSize(value, arrayEncoding: false);
		}

		public static void EncodeNull(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer, 64);
		}

		public static void EncodeObject(object value, ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				EncodeNull(buffer);
				return;
			}
			if (value is IAmqpSerializable amqpSerializable)
			{
				amqpSerializable.Encode(buffer);
				return;
			}
			EncodingBase encoding = GetEncoding(value);
			encoding.EncodeObject(value, arrayEncoding: false, buffer);
		}

		public static object DecodeObject(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			FormatCode formatCode = ReadFormatCode(buffer);
			if (formatCode == (byte)64)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return DecodeObject(buffer, formatCode);
		}

		public static object DecodeObject(ByteBuffer buffer, FormatCode formatCode)
		{
			if (encodingsByCode.TryGetValue(formatCode, out var value))
			{
				return value.DecodeObject(buffer, formatCode);
			}
			throw GetEncodingException(SRAmqp.AmqpInvalidFormatCode(formatCode, buffer.Offset));
		}

		public static AmqpException GetEncodingException(string message)
		{
			return new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.InvalidField, message);
		}

		private static AmqpSymbol DecodeSymbolRelaxed(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			FormatCode formatCode = ReadFormatCode(buffer);
			if (formatCode == (byte)64)
			{
				return default(AmqpSymbol);
			}
			if (formatCode == (byte)161 || formatCode == (byte)177)
			{
				return StringEncoding.Decode(buffer, formatCode);
			}
			return SymbolEncoding.Decode(buffer, formatCode);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class AmqpEncoding<T>
	{
		private readonly Func<T, int> sizeFunc;

		private readonly Action<T, ByteBuffer> writeFunc;

		private readonly Func<ByteBuffer, T> readFunc;

		public AmqpEncoding(Func<T, int> sizeFunc, Action<T, ByteBuffer> writeFunc, Func<ByteBuffer, T> readFunc)
		{
			this.sizeFunc = sizeFunc;
			this.writeFunc = writeFunc;
			this.readFunc = readFunc;
		}

		public int GetEncodeSize(T value)
		{
			return sizeFunc(value);
		}

		public void Encode(T value, ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			writeFunc(value, buffer);
		}

		public T Decode(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			return readFunc(buffer);
		}
	}
	internal abstract class AmqpMap<TKey> : IDictionary<TKey, object>, ICollection<KeyValuePair<TKey, object>>, IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<TKey, object>>, IEnumerable
	{
		private sealed class MapEnumerator : IEnumerator<KeyValuePair<TKey, object>>, IDisposable, IEnumerator
		{
			private readonly AmqpMap<TKey> map;

			private readonly IEnumerator<KeyValuePair<TKey, object>> enumerator;

			public KeyValuePair<TKey, object> Current
			{
				get
				{
					KeyValuePair<TKey, object> current = enumerator.Current;
					return new KeyValuePair<TKey, object>(map.NullableKey(current.Key), current.Value);
				}
			}

			object IEnumerator.Current => Current;

			public MapEnumerator(AmqpMap<TKey> map)
			{
				this.map = map;
				enumerator = map.value.GetEnumerator();
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
				enumerator.Dispose();
			}

			public bool MoveNext()
			{
				return enumerator.MoveNext();
			}

			public void Reset()
			{
				enumerator.Reset();
			}
		}

		private readonly IDictionary<TKey, object> value;

		public object this[TKey key]
		{
			get
			{
				if (!value.TryGetValue(NonNullableKey(key), out var result))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return result;
			}
			set
			{
				this.value[NonNullableKey(key)] = value;
			}
		}

		public ICollection<TKey> Keys
		{
			get
			{
				TKey[] array = new TKey[Count];
				int num = 0;
				foreach (KeyValuePair<TKey, object> item in value)
				{
					array[num++] = NullableKey(item.Key);
				}
				return array;
			}
		}

		public ICollection<object> Values => value.Values;

		public int Count => value.Count;

		public bool IsReadOnly => value.IsReadOnly;

		protected AmqpMap()
		{
			value = new Dictionary<TKey, object>();
		}

		public void Add(TKey key, object value)
		{
			this.value.Add(NonNullableKey(key), value);
		}

		public void Add(KeyValuePair<TKey, object> item)
		{
			value.Add(NonNullableKey(item.Key), item.Value);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			value.Clear();
		}

		public bool Contains(KeyValuePair<TKey, object> item)
		{
			return value.ContainsKey(NonNullableKey(item.Key));
		}

		public bool ContainsKey(TKey key)
		{
			return value.ContainsKey(NonNullableKey(key));
		}

		public void CopyTo(KeyValuePair<TKey, object>[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			if (array == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("array");
			}
			if (arrayIndex < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("arrayIndex");
			}
			if (Count > array.Length - arrayIndex)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Not enough space in array.");
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<TKey, object> item in value)
			{
				array[arrayIndex++] = new KeyValuePair<TKey, object>(NullableKey(item.Key), item.Value);
			}
		}

		public bool Remove(TKey key)
		{
			return value.Remove(NonNullableKey(key));
		}

		public bool Remove(KeyValuePair<TKey, object> item)
		{
			return value.Remove(NonNullableKey(item.Key));
		}

		public bool TryGetValue(TKey key, out object value)
		{
			return this.value.TryGetValue(NonNullableKey(key), out value);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return AmqpExtensions.ToString(value);
		}

		protected virtual TKey NonNullableKey(TKey key)
		{
			return key;
		}

		protected virtual TKey NullableKey(TKey key)
		{
			return key;
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetEnumerator();
		}

		public IEnumerator<KeyValuePair<TKey, object>> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new MapEnumerator(this);
		}

	internal sealed class AmqpMap : AmqpMap<object>
	{
		private static readonly object NullKey = new object();

		protected override object NonNullableKey(object key)
		{
			return key ?? NullKey;
		}

		protected override object NullableKey(object key)
		{
			if (key != NullKey)
			{
				return key;
			}
			return null;
		}

	internal struct AmqpSymbol : IEquatable<AmqpSymbol>
	{
		public string Value { get; private set; }

		public AmqpSymbol(string value)
		{
			this = default(AmqpSymbol);
			Value = value;
		}

		public static implicit operator AmqpSymbol(string value)
		{
			return new AmqpSymbol
			{
				Value = value
			};
		}

		public bool Equals(AmqpSymbol other)
		{
			if (Value == null && other.Value == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (Value == null || other.Value == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return string.Compare(Value, other.Value, StringComparison.Ordinal) == 0;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is AmqpSymbol)
			{
				return Equals((AmqpSymbol)obj);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			if (Value == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return Value.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return Value;
		}
	}
	internal sealed class ArrayEncoding : EncodingBase
	{
		public ArrayEncoding()
			: base((byte)240)
		{
		}

		public static int GetEncodeSize<T>(T[] value)
		{
			if (value != null)
			{
				return GetEncodeSize(value, arrayEncoding: false);
			}
			return 1;
		}

		public static void Encode<T>(T[] value, ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				AmqpEncoding.EncodeNull(buffer);
				return;
			}
			int width;
			int encodeSize = GetEncodeSize(value, arrayEncoding: false, out width);
			AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer, (byte)((width == 1) ? 224 : 240));
			Encode(value, width, encodeSize, buffer);
		}

		public static T[] Decode<T>(ByteBuffer buffer, FormatCode formatCode)
		{
			if (formatCode == (byte)0 && (formatCode = AmqpEncoding.ReadFormatCode(buffer)) == (byte)64)
			{
				return null;
			}
			AmqpEncoding.ReadSizeAndCount(buffer, formatCode, (byte)224, (byte)240, out var size, out var count);
			formatCode = AmqpEncoding.ReadFormatCode(buffer);
			return Decode<T>(buffer, size, count, formatCode);
		}

		public override int GetObjectEncodeSize(object value, bool arrayEncoding)
		{
			return GetEncodeSize((Array)value, arrayEncoding);
		}

		public override void EncodeObject(object value, bool arrayEncoding, ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			Array array = (Array)value;
			int width;
			int encodeSize = GetEncodeSize(array, arrayEncoding, out width);
			AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer, (byte)((width == 1) ? 224 : 240));
			Encode(array, width, encodeSize, buffer);
		}

		public override object DecodeObject(ByteBuffer buffer, FormatCode formatCode)
		{
			if (formatCode == (byte)0 && (formatCode = AmqpEncoding.ReadFormatCode(buffer)) == (byte)64)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int size = 0;
			int count = 0;
			AmqpEncoding.ReadSizeAndCount(buffer, formatCode, (byte)224, (byte)240, out size, out count);
			formatCode = AmqpEncoding.ReadFormatCode(buffer);
			Array array = null;
			switch (formatCode)
			{
			case 86:
				return Decode<bool>(buffer, size, count, formatCode);
			case 80:
				return Decode<byte>(buffer, size, count, formatCode);
			case 96:
				return Decode<ushort>(buffer, size, count, formatCode);
			case 82:
			case 112:
				return Decode<uint>(buffer, size, count, formatCode);
			case 83:
			case 128:
				return Decode<ulong>(buffer, size, count, formatCode);
			case 81:
				return Decode<sbyte>(buffer, size, count, formatCode);
			case 97:
				return Decode<short>(buffer, size, count, formatCode);
			case 84:
			case 113:
				return Decode<int>(buffer, size, count, formatCode);
			case 85:
			case 129:
				return Decode<long>(buffer, size, count, formatCode);
			case 114:
				return Decode<float>(buffer, size, count, formatCode);
			case 130:
				return Decode<double>(buffer, size, count, formatCode);
			case 115:
				return Decode<char>(buffer, size, count, formatCode);
			case 131:
				return Decode<DateTime>(buffer, size, count, formatCode);
			case 152:
				return Decode<Guid>(buffer, size, count, formatCode);
			case 160:
			case 176:
				return Decode<ArraySegment<byte>>(buffer, size, count, formatCode);
			case 161:
			case 177:
				return Decode<string>(buffer, size, count, formatCode);
			case 163:
			case 179:
				return Decode<AmqpSymbol>(buffer, size, count, formatCode);
			case 192:
			case 208:
				return Decode<IList>(buffer, size, count, formatCode);
			case 193:
			case 209:
				return Decode<AmqpMap>(buffer, size, count, formatCode);
			case 224:
			case 240:
				return Decode<Array>(buffer, size, count, formatCode);
			default:
				throw new NotSupportedException(SRClient.NotSupportFrameCode(formatCode));
			}
		}

		private static int GetEncodeSize(Array array, bool arrayEncoding)
		{
			int width;
			return GetEncodeSize(array, arrayEncoding, out width);
		}

		private static int GetEncodeSize(Array array, bool arrayEncoding, out int width)
		{
			int num = 1 + GetValueSize(array, null);
			width = (arrayEncoding ? 4 : AmqpEncoding.GetEncodeWidthByCountAndSize(array.Length, num));
			return num + (1 + width + width);
		}

		private static int GetValueSize(Array value, Type type)
		{
			if (value.Length == 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (type == null)
			{
				type = value.GetValue(0).GetType();
			}
			EncodingBase encoding = AmqpEncoding.GetEncoding(type);
			int num = 0;
			foreach (object item in value)
			{
				bool arrayEncoding = true;
				if (encoding.FormatCode == (byte)0 && num == 0)
				{
					arrayEncoding = false;
				}
				num += encoding.GetObjectEncodeSize(item, arrayEncoding);
			}
			return num;
		}

		private static void Encode(Array value, int width, int encodeSize, ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			encodeSize -= 1 + width;
			if (width == 1)
			{
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer, (byte)encodeSize);
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer, (byte)value.Length);
			}
			else
			{
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteUInt(buffer, (uint)encodeSize);
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteUInt(buffer, (uint)value.Length);
			}
			if (value.Length <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			object value2 = value.GetValue(0);
			EncodingBase encoding = AmqpEncoding.GetEncoding(value2);
			AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer, encoding.FormatCode);
			if (encoding.FormatCode == (byte)0)
			{
				DescribedType describedType = (DescribedType)value2;
				AmqpEncoding.EncodeObject(describedType.Descriptor, buffer);
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer, AmqpEncoding.GetEncoding(describedType.Value).FormatCode);
			}
			foreach (object item in value)
			{
				encoding.EncodeObject(item, arrayEncoding: true, buffer);
			}
		}

		private static T[] Decode<T>(ByteBuffer buffer, int size, int count, FormatCode formatCode)
		{
			T[] array = new T[count];
			EncodingBase encoding = AmqpEncoding.GetEncoding(formatCode);
			object obj = null;
			if (formatCode == (byte)0)
			{
				obj = AmqpEncoding.DecodeObject(buffer);
				formatCode = AmqpEncoding.ReadFormatCode(buffer);
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				object obj2 = encoding.DecodeObject(buffer, formatCode);
				if (obj != null)
				{
					obj2 = new DescribedType(obj, obj2);
				}
				array[i] = (T)obj2;
			}
			return array;
		}
	}
	internal sealed class BinaryEncoding : EncodingBase
	{
		public BinaryEncoding()
			: base((byte)176)
		{
		}

		public static int GetEncodeSize(ArraySegment<byte> value)
		{
			if (value.Array != null)
			{
				return 1 + AmqpEncoding.GetEncodeWidthBySize(value.Count) + value.Count;
			}
			return 1;
		}

		public static void Encode(ArraySegment<byte> value, ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			if (value.Array == null)
			{
				AmqpEncoding.EncodeNull(buffer);
				return;
			}
			int encodeWidthBySize = AmqpEncoding.GetEncodeWidthBySize(value.Count);
			if (encodeWidthBySize == 1)
			{
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer, 160);
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer, (byte)value.Count);
			}
			else
			{
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer, 176);
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteUInt(buffer, (uint)value.Count);
			}
			AmqpBitConverter.WriteBytes(buffer, value.Array, value.Offset, value.Count);
		}

		public static ArraySegment<byte> Decode(ByteBuffer buffer, FormatCode formatCode)
		{
			return Decode(buffer, formatCode, copy: true);
		}

		public static ArraySegment<byte> Decode(ByteBuffer buffer, FormatCode formatCode, bool copy)
		{
			if (formatCode == (byte)0 && (formatCode = AmqpEncoding.ReadFormatCode(buffer)) == (byte)64)
			{
				return AmqpConstants.NullBinary;
			}
			AmqpEncoding.ReadCount(buffer, formatCode, (byte)160, (byte)176, out var count);
			if (count == 0)
			{
				return AmqpConstants.EmptyBinary;
			}
			ArraySegment<byte> result;
			if (copy)
			{
				byte[] array = new byte[count];
				Buffer.BlockCopy(buffer.Buffer, buffer.Offset, array, 0, count);
				result = new ArraySegment<byte>(array, 0, count);
			}
			else
			{
				result = new ArraySegment<byte>(buffer.Buffer, buffer.Offset, count);
			}
			buffer.Complete(count);
			return result;
		}

		public override int GetObjectEncodeSize(object value, bool arrayEncoding)
		{
			if (arrayEncoding)
			{
				return 4 + ((ArraySegment<byte>)value).Count;
			}
			return GetEncodeSize((ArraySegment<byte>)value);
		}

		public override void EncodeObject(object value, bool arrayEncoding, ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			if (arrayEncoding)
			{
				ArraySegment<byte> arraySegment = (ArraySegment<byte>)value;
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteUInt(buffer, (uint)arraySegment.Count);
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteBytes(buffer, arraySegment.Array, arraySegment.Offset, arraySegment.Count);
			}
			else
			{
				Encode((ArraySegment<byte>)value, buffer);
			}
		}

		public override object DecodeObject(ByteBuffer buffer, FormatCode formatCode)
		{
			return Decode(buffer, formatCode, copy: false);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class BooleanEncoding : EncodingBase
	{
		public BooleanEncoding()
			: base((byte)86)
		{
		}

		public static int GetEncodeSize(bool? value)
		{
			if (!value.HasValue)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			return 1;
		}

		public static void Encode(bool? value, ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			if (value.HasValue)
			{
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer, (byte)(value.Value ? 65 : 66));
			}
			else
			{
				AmqpEncoding.EncodeNull(buffer);
			}
		}

		public static bool? Decode(ByteBuffer buffer, FormatCode formatCode)
		{
			if (formatCode == (byte)0 && (formatCode = AmqpEncoding.ReadFormatCode(buffer)) == (byte)64)
			{
				return null;
			}
			EncodingBase.VerifyFormatCode(formatCode, buffer.Offset, (byte)86, (byte)66, (byte)65);
			if (formatCode == (byte)86)
			{
				return AmqpBitConverter.ReadUByte(buffer) != 0;
			}
			return (formatCode == (byte)65) ? true : false;
		}
