	internal sealed class DecimalEncoding : EncodingBase
	{
		private const int Decimal32Bias = 101;

		private const int Decimal64Bias = 398;

		private const int Decimal128Bias = 6176;

		public DecimalEncoding()
			: base((byte)148)
		{
		}

		public static int GetEncodeSize(decimal? value)
		{
			if (!value.HasValue)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			return 17;
		}

		public static void Encode(decimal? value, ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			if (value.HasValue)
			{
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer, 148);
				EncodeValue(value.Value, buffer);
			}
			else
			{
				AmqpEncoding.EncodeNull(buffer);
			}
		}

		public static decimal? Decode(ByteBuffer buffer, FormatCode formatCode)
		{
			if (formatCode == (byte)0 && (formatCode = AmqpEncoding.ReadFormatCode(buffer)) == (byte)64)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return DecodeValue(buffer, formatCode);
		}

		public override int GetObjectEncodeSize(object value, bool arrayEncoding)
		{
			if (arrayEncoding)
			{
				return 16;
			}
			return 17;
		}

		public override void EncodeObject(object value, bool arrayEncoding, ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			if (arrayEncoding)
			{
				EncodeValue((decimal)value, buffer);
			}
			else
			{
				Encode((decimal)value, buffer);
			}
		}

		public override object DecodeObject(ByteBuffer buffer, FormatCode formatCode)
		{
			return Decode(buffer, formatCode);
		}

		private unsafe static void EncodeValue(decimal value, ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			int[] bits = decimal.GetBits(value);
			int num = bits[0];
			int num2 = bits[1];
			int num3 = bits[2];
			int num4 = bits[3];
			byte[] array = new byte[16];
			byte* ptr = (byte*)(&num4);
			int num5 = 6176 - ptr[2];
			array[0] = ptr[3];
			array[0] |= (byte)(num5 >> 9);
			array[1] = (byte)((num5 & 0x7F) << 1);
			array[2] = 0;
			array[3] = 0;
			ptr = (byte*)(&num3);
			array[4] = ptr[3];
			array[5] = ptr[2];
			array[6] = ptr[1];
			array[7] = *ptr;
			ptr = (byte*)(&num2);
			array[8] = ptr[3];
			array[9] = ptr[2];
			array[10] = ptr[1];
			array[11] = *ptr;
			ptr = (byte*)(&num);
			array[12] = ptr[3];
			array[13] = ptr[2];
			array[14] = ptr[1];
			array[15] = *ptr;
			AmqpBitConverter.WriteBytes(buffer, array, 0, array.Length);
		}

		private static decimal DecodeValue(ByteBuffer buffer, FormatCode formatCode)
		{
			decimal num = default(decimal);
			return (byte)formatCode switch
			{
				116 => DecodeDecimal32(buffer), 
				132 => DecodeDecimal64(buffer), 
				148 => DecodeDecimal128(buffer), 
				_ => throw AmqpEncoding.GetEncodingException(SRAmqp.AmqpInvalidFormatCode(formatCode, buffer.Offset)), 
			};
		}

		private static decimal DecodeDecimal32(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			byte[] array = new byte[4];
			AmqpBitConverter.ReadBytes(buffer, array, 0, array.Length);
			int num = 1;
			int num2 = 0;
			num = (((array[0] & 0x80) == 0) ? 1 : (-1));
			if ((array[0] & 0x60) != 96)
			{
				num2 = ((array[0] & 0x7F) << 1) | ((array[1] & 0x80) >> 7);
				array[0] = 0;
				array[1] &= 127;
			}
			else if ((array[0] & 0x78) == 0)
			{
				num2 = ((array[0] & 0x1F) << 3) | ((array[1] & 0xE0) >> 5);
				array[0] = 0;
				array[1] &= 31;
				array[1] |= 128;
			}
			int low = (int)AmqpBitConverter.ReadUInt(array, 0, array.Length);
			return CreateDecimal(low, 0, 0, num, num2 - 101);
		}

		private static decimal DecodeDecimal64(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			byte[] array = new byte[8];
			AmqpBitConverter.ReadBytes(buffer, array, 0, array.Length);
			int num = 1;
			int num2 = 0;
			num = (((array[0] & 0x80) == 0) ? 1 : (-1));
			if ((array[0] & 0x60) != 96)
			{
				num2 = ((array[0] & 0x7F) << 3) | ((array[1] & 0xE0) >> 5);
				array[0] = 0;
				array[1] &= 31;
			}
			else if ((array[0] & 0x78) == 0)
			{
				num2 = ((array[0] & 0x1F) << 8) | ((array[1] & 0xF8) >> 3);
				array[0] = 0;
				array[1] &= 7;
				array[1] |= 32;
			}
			int middle = (int)AmqpBitConverter.ReadUInt(array, 0, 4);
			int low = (int)AmqpBitConverter.ReadUInt(array, 4, 4);
			return CreateDecimal(low, middle, 0, num, num2 - 398);
		}

		private static decimal DecodeDecimal128(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			byte[] array = new byte[16];
			AmqpBitConverter.ReadBytes(buffer, array, 0, array.Length);
			int num = 1;
			int num2 = 0;
			num = (((array[0] & 0x80) == 0) ? 1 : (-1));
			if ((array[0] & 0x60) != 96)
			{
				num2 = ((array[0] & 0x7F) << 7) | ((array[1] & 0xFE) >> 1);
				array[0] = 0;
				array[1] &= 1;
			}
			else if ((array[0] & 0x78) == 0)
			{
				return 0m;
			}
			int high = (int)AmqpBitConverter.ReadUInt(array, 4, 4);
			int middle = (int)AmqpBitConverter.ReadUInt(array, 8, 4);
			int low = (int)AmqpBitConverter.ReadUInt(array, 12, 4);
			return CreateDecimal(low, middle, high, num, num2 - 6176);
		}

		private static decimal CreateDecimal(int low, int middle, int high, int sign, int exponent)
		{
			if (exponent <= 0)
			{
				return new decimal(low, middle, high, sign < 0, (byte)(-exponent));
			}
			decimal result = new decimal(low, middle, high, sign < 0, 0);
			for (int i = 0; i < exponent; i++)
			{
				result *= 10m;
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	internal sealed class DescribedEncoding : EncodingBase
	{
		public DescribedEncoding()
			: base((byte)0)
		{
		}

		public static int GetEncodeSize(DescribedType value)
		{
			if (value != null)
			{
				return 1 + AmqpEncoding.GetObjectEncodeSize(value.Descriptor) + AmqpEncoding.GetObjectEncodeSize(value.Value);
			}
			return 1;
		}

		public static void Encode(DescribedType value, ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				AmqpEncoding.EncodeNull(buffer);
				return;
			}
			AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer, 0);
			AmqpEncoding.EncodeObject(value.Descriptor, buffer);
			AmqpEncoding.EncodeObject(value.Value, buffer);
		}

		public static DescribedType Decode(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			FormatCode formatCode;
			if ((formatCode = AmqpEncoding.ReadFormatCode(buffer)) == (byte)64)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return Decode(buffer, formatCode);
		}

		public override int GetObjectEncodeSize(object value, bool arrayEncoding)
		{
			if (arrayEncoding)
			{
				object value2 = ((DescribedType)value).Value;
				EncodingBase encoding = AmqpEncoding.GetEncoding(value2);
				return encoding.GetObjectEncodeSize(value2, arrayEncoding: true);
			}
			return GetEncodeSize((DescribedType)value);
		}

		public override void EncodeObject(object value, bool arrayEncoding, ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			if (arrayEncoding)
			{
				object value2 = ((DescribedType)value).Value;
				EncodingBase encoding = AmqpEncoding.GetEncoding(value2);
				encoding.EncodeObject(value2, arrayEncoding: true, buffer);
			}
			else
			{
				Encode((DescribedType)value, buffer);
			}
		}

		public override object DecodeObject(ByteBuffer buffer, FormatCode formatCode)
		{
			if (formatCode == (byte)0)
			{
				return Decode(buffer, formatCode);
			}
			return AmqpEncoding.DecodeObject(buffer, formatCode);
		}

		private static DescribedType Decode(ByteBuffer buffer, FormatCode formatCode)
		{
			if (formatCode != (byte)0)
			{
				throw AmqpEncoding.GetEncodingException(SRAmqp.AmqpInvalidFormatCode(formatCode, buffer.Offset));
			}
			object descriptor = AmqpEncoding.DecodeObject(buffer);
			object value = AmqpEncoding.DecodeObject(buffer);
			return new DescribedType(descriptor, value);
		}
	}

		}

	internal abstract class EncodingBase
	{
		private FormatCode formatCode;

		public FormatCode FormatCode => formatCode;

		protected EncodingBase(FormatCode formatCode)
		{
			this.formatCode = formatCode;
		}

		public abstract int GetObjectEncodeSize(object value, bool arrayEncoding);

		public abstract void EncodeObject(object value, bool arrayEncoding, ByteBuffer buffer);

		public abstract object DecodeObject(ByteBuffer buffer, FormatCode formatCode);

		public static void VerifyFormatCode(FormatCode formatCode, int offset, FormatCode expected)
		{
			if (formatCode != expected)
			{
				ThrowInvalidFormatCodeException(formatCode, offset);
			}
		}

		public static void VerifyFormatCode(FormatCode formatCode, int offset, FormatCode expected1, FormatCode expected2)
		{
			if (formatCode != expected1 && formatCode != expected2)
			{
				ThrowInvalidFormatCodeException(formatCode, offset);
			}
		}

		public static void VerifyFormatCode(FormatCode formatCode, int offset, FormatCode expected1, FormatCode expected2, FormatCode expected3)
		{
			if (formatCode != expected1 && formatCode != expected2 && formatCode != expected3)
			{
				ThrowInvalidFormatCodeException(formatCode, offset);
			}
		}

		private static void ThrowInvalidFormatCodeException(FormatCode formatCode, int offset)
		{
			throw AmqpEncoding.GetEncodingException(SRAmqp.AmqpInvalidFormatCode(formatCode, offset));
		}
	}

	internal struct FormatCode : IEquatable<FormatCode>
	{
		public const byte Described = 0;

		public const byte Null = 64;

		public const byte Boolean = 86;

		public const byte BooleanTrue = 65;

		public const byte BooleanFalse = 66;

		public const byte UInt0 = 67;

		public const byte ULong0 = 68;

		public const byte UByte = 80;

		public const byte UShort = 96;

		public const byte UInt = 112;

		public const byte ULong = 128;

		public const byte Byte = 81;

		public const byte Short = 97;

		public const byte Int = 113;

		public const byte Long = 129;

		public const byte SmallUInt = 82;

		public const byte SmallULong = 83;

		public const byte SmallInt = 84;

		public const byte SmallLong = 85;

		public const byte Float = 114;

		public const byte Double = 130;

		public const byte Decimal32 = 116;

		public const byte Decimal64 = 132;

		public const byte Decimal128 = 148;

		public const byte Char = 115;

		public const byte TimeStamp = 131;

		public const byte Uuid = 152;

		public const byte Binary8 = 160;

		public const byte Binary32 = 176;

		public const byte String8Utf8 = 161;

		public const byte String32Utf8 = 177;

		public const byte Symbol8 = 163;

		public const byte Symbol32 = 179;

		public const byte List0 = 69;

		public const byte List8 = 192;

		public const byte List32 = 208;

		public const byte Map8 = 193;

		public const byte Map32 = 209;

		public const byte Array8 = 224;

		public const byte Array32 = 240;

		private byte type;

		private byte extType;

		public byte Type => type;

		public byte SubType => (byte)(type & 0xF);

		public byte SubCategory => (byte)((type & 0xF0) >> 4);

		public byte ExtType => extType;

		public FormatCode(byte type)
			: this(type, 0)
		{
		}

		public FormatCode(byte type, byte extType)
		{
			this.type = type;
			this.extType = extType;
		}

		public static bool HasExtType(byte type)
		{
			return (type & 0xF) == 15;
		}

		public static implicit operator FormatCode(byte value)
		{
			return new FormatCode(value);
		}

		public static implicit operator byte(FormatCode value)
		{
			return value.Type;
		}

		public static bool operator ==(FormatCode fc1, FormatCode fc2)
		{
			return fc1.Type == fc2.Type;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(FormatCode fc1, FormatCode fc2)
		{
			return fc1.Type != fc2.Type;
		}

		public bool HasExtType()
		{
			return (type & 0xF) == 15;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is FormatCode)
			{
				return this == (FormatCode)obj;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return type.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (HasExtType())
			{
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "0x{0:X2}.{1:X2}", Type, ExtType);
			}
			return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "0x{0:X2}", Type);
		}

		public bool Equals(FormatCode other)
		{
			return type == other.type;
		}
	}

	internal sealed class IntEncoding : EncodingBase
	{
		public IntEncoding()
			: base((byte)113)
		{
		}

		public static int GetEncodeSize(int? value)
		{
			if (value.HasValue)
			{
				if (value.Value >= -128 && value.Value <= 127)
				{
					return 2;
				}
				return 5;
			}
			return 1;
		}

		public static void Encode(int? value, ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			if (value.HasValue)
			{
				if (value < -128 || value > 127)
				{
					AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer, 113);
					AmqpBitConverter.WriteInt(buffer, value.Value);
				}
				else
				{
					AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer, 84);
					AmqpBitConverter.WriteByte(buffer, (sbyte)value.Value);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				AmqpEncoding.EncodeNull(buffer);
			}
		}

		public static int? Decode(ByteBuffer buffer, FormatCode formatCode)
		{
			if (formatCode == (byte)0 && (formatCode = AmqpEncoding.ReadFormatCode(buffer)) == (byte)64)
			{
				return null;
			}
			EncodingBase.VerifyFormatCode(formatCode, buffer.Offset, (byte)113, (byte)84);
			return (formatCode == (byte)84) ? AmqpBitConverter.ReadByte(buffer) : AmqpBitConverter.ReadInt(buffer);
		}

		public override int GetObjectEncodeSize(object value, bool arrayEncoding)
		{
			if (arrayEncoding)

			}
			else
			{

			}
		}

		{
			return Decode(buffer, formatCode);
		}

	internal sealed class ListEncoding : EncodingBase
	{
		public ListEncoding()
			: base((byte)208)
		{
		}

		public static int GetEncodeSize(IList value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (value.Count == 0)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			int valueSize = GetValueSize(value);
			int encodeWidthByCountAndSize = AmqpEncoding.GetEncodeWidthByCountAndSize(value.Count, valueSize);
			return 1 + encodeWidthByCountAndSize * 2 + valueSize;
		}

		public static void Encode(IList value, ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				AmqpEncoding.EncodeNull(buffer);
				return;
			}
			if (value.Count == 0)
			{
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer, 69);
				return;
			}
			int valueSize = GetValueSize(value);
			int encodeWidthByCountAndSize = AmqpEncoding.GetEncodeWidthByCountAndSize(value.Count, valueSize);
			AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer, (byte)((encodeWidthByCountAndSize == 1) ? 192 : 208));
			int size = encodeWidthByCountAndSize + valueSize;
			Encode(value, encodeWidthByCountAndSize, size, buffer);
		}

		public static IList Decode(ByteBuffer buffer, FormatCode formatCode)
		{
			if (formatCode == (byte)0 && (formatCode = AmqpEncoding.ReadFormatCode(buffer)) == (byte)64)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IList list = new List<object>();
			if (formatCode == (byte)69)
			{
				return list;
			}
			AmqpEncoding.ReadSizeAndCount(buffer, formatCode, (byte)192, (byte)208, out var _, out var count);
			while (count > 0)
			{
				object value = AmqpEncoding.DecodeObject(buffer);
				list.Add(value);
				count--;
			}
			return list;
		}

		public override int GetObjectEncodeSize(object value, bool arrayEncoding)
		{
			if (arrayEncoding)
			{
				return 8 + GetValueSize((IList)value);
			}
			return GetEncodeSize((IList)value);
		}

		public override void EncodeObject(object value, bool arrayEncoding, ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			if (arrayEncoding)
			{
				IList value2 = (IList)value;
				int size = 4 + GetValueSize(value2);
				Encode(value2, 4, size, buffer);
			}
			else
			{
				Encode((IList)value, buffer);
			}
		}

		public override object DecodeObject(ByteBuffer buffer, FormatCode formatCode)
		{
			return Decode(buffer, formatCode);
		}

		public static int GetValueSize(IList value)
		{
			int num = 0;
			if (value.Count > 0)
			{
				foreach (object item in value)
				{
					num += AmqpEncoding.GetObjectEncodeSize(item);
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private static void Encode(IList value, int width, int size, ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			if (width == 1)
			{
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer, (byte)size);
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer, (byte)value.Count);
			}
			else
			{
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteUInt(buffer, (uint)size);
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteUInt(buffer, (uint)value.Count);
			}
			if (value.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (object item in value)
			{
				AmqpEncoding.EncodeObject(item, buffer);
			}
		}
	}

	internal sealed class MapEncoding : EncodingBase
	{
		public MapEncoding()
			: base((byte)209)

		}

		public static int GetEncodeSize(AmqpMap value)

			return GetEncodeSize(value, AmqpEncoding.Object);

		}

		public static AmqpMap Decode(ByteBuffer buffer, FormatCode formatCode)
		{
			return Decode<AmqpMap, object>(buffer, formatCode, AmqpEncoding.Object);
		}

		public static int GetEncodeSize<TKey>(IDictionary<TKey, object> value, AmqpEncoding<TKey> encoder)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			int valueSize = GetValueSize(value, encoder);
			int num = AmqpEncoding.GetEncodeWidthByCountAndSize(value.Count * 2, valueSize) * 2;
			return 1 + num + valueSize;
		}

		public static void Encode<TKey>(IDictionary<TKey, object> value, AmqpEncoding<TKey> encoder, ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				AmqpEncoding.EncodeNull(buffer);
				return;
			}
			int valueSize = GetValueSize(value, encoder);
			int encodeWidthByCountAndSize = AmqpEncoding.GetEncodeWidthByCountAndSize(value.Count * 2, valueSize);
			AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer, (byte)((encodeWidthByCountAndSize == 1) ? 193 : 209));
			int size = encodeWidthByCountAndSize + valueSize;
			EncodeValue(value, encodeWidthByCountAndSize, size, encoder, buffer);
		}

		public static T Decode<T, TKey>(ByteBuffer buffer, FormatCode formatCode, AmqpEncoding<TKey> encoder) where T : IDictionary<TKey, object>, new()
		{
			if (formatCode == (byte)0 && (formatCode = AmqpEncoding.ReadFormatCode(buffer)) == (byte)64)
			{
				return default(T);
			}
			AmqpEncoding.ReadSizeAndCount(buffer, formatCode, (byte)193, (byte)209, out var size, out var count);
			T val = new T();
			ReadMapValue(buffer, val, size, count, encoder);
			return val;
		}

		public static void ReadMapValue<TKey>(ByteBuffer buffer, IDictionary<TKey, object> map, int size, int count, AmqpEncoding<TKey> encoder)
		{
			while (count > 0)
			{
				TKey key = encoder.Decode(buffer);
				object value = AmqpCodec.DecodeObject(buffer);
				map[key] = value;
				count -= 2;
			}
		}

		public override int GetObjectEncodeSize(object value, bool arrayEncoding)
		{
			if (arrayEncoding)
			{
				return 8 + GetValueSize((AmqpMap)value, AmqpEncoding.Object);
			}
			return GetEncodeSize((AmqpMap)value);
		}

		public override void EncodeObject(object value, bool arrayEncoding, ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			if (arrayEncoding)
			{
				AmqpMap value2 = (AmqpMap)value;
				int size = 4 + GetValueSize(value2, AmqpEncoding.Object);
				EncodeValue(value2, 4, size, AmqpEncoding.Object, buffer);
			}
			else
			{
				Encode((AmqpMap)value, buffer);
			}
		}

		public override object DecodeObject(ByteBuffer buffer, FormatCode formatCode)
		{
			return Decode(buffer, formatCode);
		}

		private static int GetValueSize<TKey>(IDictionary<TKey, object> value, AmqpEncoding<TKey> encoder)
		{
			int num = 0;
			if (value.Count > 0)
			{
				foreach (KeyValuePair<TKey, object> item in value)
				{
					num += encoder.GetEncodeSize(item.Key);
					num += AmqpEncoding.GetObjectEncodeSize(item.Value);
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private static void EncodeValue<TKey>(IDictionary<TKey, object> value, int width, int size, AmqpEncoding<TKey> encoder, ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			if (width == 1)
			{
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer, (byte)size);
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer, (byte)(value.Count * 2));
			}
			else
			{
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteUInt(buffer, (uint)size);
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteUInt(buffer, (uint)(value.Count * 2));
			}
			if (value.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<TKey, object> item in value)
			{
				encoder.Encode(item.Key, buffer);
				AmqpEncoding.EncodeObject(item.Value, buffer);
			}
		}
	}

		public static int GetEncodeSize(string value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			int byteCount = System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetByteCount(value);
			return 1 + AmqpEncoding.GetEncodeWidthBySize(byteCount) + byteCount;
		}

		public static void Encode(string value, ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				AmqpEncoding.EncodeNull(buffer);
				return;
			}
			byte[] bytes = System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(value);
			int encodeWidthBySize = AmqpEncoding.GetEncodeWidthBySize(bytes.Length);
			AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer, (byte)((encodeWidthBySize == 1) ? 161 : 177));
			Encode(bytes, encodeWidthBySize, buffer);
		}

		public static string Decode(ByteBuffer buffer, FormatCode formatCode)
		{
			if (formatCode == (byte)0 && (formatCode = AmqpEncoding.ReadFormatCode(buffer)) == (byte)64)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int num;
			System.Text.Encoding uTF;
			if (formatCode == (byte)161)
			{
				num = AmqpBitConverter.ReadUByte(buffer);
				uTF = System.Text.Encoding.UTF8;
			}
			else
			{
				if (!(formatCode == (byte)177))
				{
					throw AmqpEncoding.GetEncodingException(SRAmqp.AmqpInvalidFormatCode(formatCode, buffer.Offset));
				}
				num = (int)AmqpBitConverter.ReadUInt(buffer);
				uTF = System.Text.Encoding.UTF8;
			}
			string result = uTF.GetString(buffer.Buffer, buffer.Offset, num);
			buffer.Complete(num);
			return result;
		}

		public override int GetObjectEncodeSize(object value, bool arrayEncoding)
		{
			if (arrayEncoding)
			{
				return 4 + System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetByteCount((string)value);
			}
			return GetEncodeSize((string)value);
		}

		public override void EncodeObject(object value, bool arrayEncoding, ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			if (arrayEncoding)
			{
				Encode(System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes((string)value), 4, buffer);
			}
			else
			{
				Encode((string)value, buffer);
			}
		}

		public override object DecodeObject(ByteBuffer buffer, FormatCode formatCode)
		{
			return Decode(buffer, formatCode);
		}

		{
			if (width == 1)
			{
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer, (byte)encodedData.Length);
			}
			else
			{
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteUInt(buffer, (uint)encodedData.Length);
			}
			AmqpBitConverter.WriteBytes(buffer, encodedData, 0, encodedData.Length);
		}

	internal sealed class TimeStampEncoding : EncodingBase
	{
		private static readonly long MaxMilliseconds = (long)(DateTime.MaxValue.ToUniversalTime() - AmqpConstants.StartOfEpoch).TotalMilliseconds;

		public TimeStampEncoding()
			: base((byte)131)
		{
		}

		public static int GetEncodeSize(DateTime? value)
		{
			if (!value.HasValue)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			return 9;
		}

		public static void Encode(DateTime? value, ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			if (value.HasValue)
			{
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer, 131);
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteLong(buffer, GetMilliseconds(value.Value));
			}
			else
			{
				AmqpEncoding.EncodeNull(buffer);
			}
		}

		public static DateTime? Decode(ByteBuffer buffer, FormatCode formatCode)
		{
			if (formatCode == (byte)0 && (formatCode = AmqpEncoding.ReadFormatCode(buffer)) == (byte)64)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return ToDateTime(AmqpBitConverter.ReadLong(buffer));
		}

		{

			{
				return 8;
			}

		}

			{

			}
			else
			{

			}
		}

		public override object DecodeObject(ByteBuffer buffer, FormatCode formatCode)
		{
			return Decode(buffer, formatCode);
		}

		public static long GetMilliseconds(DateTime value)
		{
			DateTime dateTime = value.ToUniversalTime();
			double totalMilliseconds = (dateTime - AmqpConstants.StartOfEpoch).TotalMilliseconds;
			return (long)totalMilliseconds;
		}

		public static DateTime ToDateTime(long milliseconds)
		{
			milliseconds = ((milliseconds < 0) ? 0 : milliseconds);
			if (milliseconds >= MaxMilliseconds)
			{
				return DateTime.MaxValue;
			}
			return AmqpConstants.StartOfEpoch.AddMilliseconds(milliseconds);
		}
	}

	internal sealed class UIntEncoding : EncodingBase
	{
		public UIntEncoding()
			: base((byte)112)
		{
		}

		public static int GetEncodeSize(uint? value)
		{
			if (value.HasValue)
			{
				if (value.Value == 0)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				if (value.Value > 255)
				{
					return 5;
				}
				return 2;
			}
			return 1;
		}

		public static void Encode(uint? value, ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			if (value.HasValue)
			{
				if (value == 0)
				{
					AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer, 67);
				}
				else if (value.Value <= 255)
				{
					AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer, 82);
					AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer, (byte)value.Value);
				}
				else
				{
					AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer, 112);
					AmqpBitConverter.WriteUInt(buffer, value.Value);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				AmqpEncoding.EncodeNull(buffer);
			}
		}

		public static uint? Decode(ByteBuffer buffer, FormatCode formatCode)
		{
			if (formatCode == (byte)0 && (formatCode = AmqpEncoding.ReadFormatCode(buffer)) == (byte)64)
			{
				return null;
			}
			EncodingBase.VerifyFormatCode(formatCode, buffer.Offset, (byte)112, (byte)82, (byte)67);
			if (formatCode == (byte)67)
			{
				return 0u;
			}
			return (formatCode == (byte)82) ? AmqpBitConverter.ReadUByte(buffer) : AmqpBitConverter.ReadUInt(buffer);
		}

		public override int GetObjectEncodeSize(object value, bool arrayEncoding)
		{
			if (arrayEncoding)
			{
				return 4;
			}
			return GetEncodeSize((uint)value);
		}

		public override void EncodeObject(object value, bool arrayEncoding, ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			if (arrayEncoding)
			{
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteUInt(buffer, (uint)value);
			}
			else
			{
				Encode((uint)value, buffer);
			}
		}

		public override object DecodeObject(ByteBuffer buffer, FormatCode formatCode)
		{
			return Decode(buffer, formatCode);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class ULongEncoding : EncodingBase
	{
		public ULongEncoding()
			: base((byte)128)
		{
		}

		public static int GetEncodeSize(ulong? value)
		{
			if (value.HasValue)
			{
				if (value.Value == 0L)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				if (value.Value > 255)
				{
					return 9;
				}
				return 2;
			}
			return 1;
		}

		public static void Encode(ulong? value, ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			if (value.HasValue)
			{
				if (value == 0)
				{
					AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer, 68);
				}
				else if (value <= 255u)
				{
					AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer, 83);
					AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer, (byte)value.Value);
				}
				else
				{
					AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer, 128);
					AmqpBitConverter.WriteULong(buffer, value.Value);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				AmqpEncoding.EncodeNull(buffer);
			}
		}

		public static ulong? Decode(ByteBuffer buffer, FormatCode formatCode)
		{
			if (formatCode == (byte)0 && (formatCode = AmqpEncoding.ReadFormatCode(buffer)) == (byte)64)
			{
				return null;
			}
			EncodingBase.VerifyFormatCode(formatCode, buffer.Offset, (byte)128, (byte)83, (byte)68);
			if (formatCode == (byte)68)
			{
				return 0uL;
			}
			return (formatCode == (byte)83) ? AmqpBitConverter.ReadUByte(buffer) : AmqpBitConverter.ReadULong(buffer);
		}

		public override int GetObjectEncodeSize(object value, bool arrayEncoding)
		{
			if (arrayEncoding)
			{
				return 8;
			}
			return GetEncodeSize((ulong)value);
		}

		public override void EncodeObject(object value, bool arrayEncoding, ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			if (arrayEncoding)
			{
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteULong(buffer, (ulong)value);
			}
			else
			{
				Encode((ulong)value, buffer);
			}
		}

		public override object DecodeObject(ByteBuffer buffer, FormatCode formatCode)
		{
			return Decode(buffer, formatCode);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class UShortEncoding : EncodingBase
	{
		public UShortEncoding()
			: base((byte)96)
		{
		}

		public static int GetEncodeSize(ushort? value)
		{
			if (!value.HasValue)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			return 3;
		}

		public static void Encode(ushort? value, ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			if (value.HasValue)
			{
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer, 96);
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteUShort(buffer, value.Value);
			}
			else
			{
				AmqpEncoding.EncodeNull(buffer);
			}
		}

		public static ushort? Decode(ByteBuffer buffer, FormatCode formatCode)
		{
			if (formatCode == (byte)0 && (formatCode = AmqpEncoding.ReadFormatCode(buffer)) == (byte)64)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return AmqpBitConverter.ReadUShort(buffer);
		}

		public override int GetObjectEncodeSize(object value, bool arrayEncoding)
		{
			if (arrayEncoding)
			{
				return 2;
			}
			return GetEncodeSize((ushort)value);
		}

		public override void EncodeObject(object value, bool arrayEncoding, ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			if (arrayEncoding)
			{
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteUShort(buffer, (ushort)value);
			}
			else
			{
				Encode((ushort)value, buffer);
			}
		}

		public override object DecodeObject(ByteBuffer buffer, FormatCode formatCode)
		{
			return Decode(buffer, formatCode);
		}
	}

		}

		protected override int OnValueSize()
		{

		}
	}
	internal enum SaslCode : byte
	{
		Ok,
		Auth,
		Sys,
		SysPerm,
		SysTemp
	}
	internal abstract class SaslHandler
	{
		private SaslNegotiator saslNegotiator;

		public string Mechanism { get; protected set; }

		public IPrincipal Principal { get; protected set; }

		protected SaslNegotiator Negotiator => saslNegotiator;

		public void Start(SaslNegotiator saslNegotiator, SaslInit init, bool isClient)
		{
			this.saslNegotiator = saslNegotiator;
			try
			{
				OnStart(init, isClient);
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				this.saslNegotiator.CompleteNegotiation(SaslCode.Sys, exception);
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return Mechanism;
		}

		public abstract SaslHandler Clone();

		public abstract void OnChallenge(SaslChallenge challenge);

		public abstract void OnResponse(SaslResponse response);

		protected abstract void OnStart(SaslInit init, bool isClient);
	}
	internal sealed class SaslInit : Performative
	{
		public static readonly string Name = "amqp:sasl-init:list";

		public static readonly ulong Code = 65uL;

		private const int Fields = 3;

		protected override int FieldCount => 3;

		public AmqpSymbol Mechanism { get; set; }

		public ArraySegment<byte> InitialResponse { get; set; }

		public string HostName { get; set; }

		public SaslInit()
			: base(Name, Code)
		{
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder("sasl-init(");
			int count = 0;
			AddFieldToString(Mechanism.Value != null, stringBuilder, "mechanism", Mechanism, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(InitialResponse.Array != null, stringBuilder, "initial-response", InitialResponse, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(HostName != null, stringBuilder, "host-name", HostName, ref count);
			stringBuilder.Append(')');
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		protected override void EnsureRequired()
		{
			if (Mechanism.Value == null)
			{
				throw new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.InvalidField, "mechanism");
			}
		}

		protected override void OnEncode(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			AmqpCodec.EncodeSymbol(Mechanism, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeBinary(InitialResponse, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeString(HostName, buffer);
		}

		protected override void OnDecode(ByteBuffer buffer, int count)
		{
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				Mechanism = AmqpCodec.DecodeSymbol(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				InitialResponse = AmqpCodec.DecodeBinary(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				HostName = AmqpCodec.DecodeString(buffer);
			}
		}

		protected override int OnValueSize()
		{
			int num = 0;
			num += AmqpCodec.GetSymbolEncodeSize(Mechanism);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetBinaryEncodeSize(InitialResponse);
			return num + AmqpCodec.GetStringEncodeSize(HostName);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class SaslMechanisms : Performative
	{
		public static readonly string Name = "amqp:sasl-mechanisms:list";

		public static readonly ulong Code = 64uL;

		private const int Fields = 1;

		protected override int FieldCount => 1;

		public Multiple<AmqpSymbol> SaslServerMechanisms { get; set; }

		public SaslMechanisms()
			: base(Name, Code)
		{
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder("sasl-mechanisms(");
			int count = 0;
			AddFieldToString(SaslServerMechanisms != null, stringBuilder, "sasl-server-mechanisms", SaslServerMechanisms, ref count);
			stringBuilder.Append(')');
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		protected override void EnsureRequired()
		{
			if (SaslServerMechanisms == null)
			{
				throw new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.InvalidField, "sasl-mechanisms:sasl-server-mechanisms");
			}
		}

		protected override void OnEncode(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			AmqpCodec.EncodeMultiple(SaslServerMechanisms, buffer);
		}

		protected override void OnDecode(ByteBuffer buffer, int count)
		{
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				SaslServerMechanisms = AmqpCodec.DecodeMultiple<AmqpSymbol>(buffer);
			}
		}

		protected override int OnValueSize()
		{
			int num = 0;
			return num + AmqpCodec.GetMultipleEncodeSize(SaslServerMechanisms);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class SaslNegotiator : IIoHandler
	{
		private enum SaslState
		{
			Start,
			WaitingForServerMechanisms,
			WaitingForInit,
			Negotiating,
			End
		}

		private static readonly string welcome = "Welcome!";

		private static readonly Action<TransportAsyncCallbackArgs> onWriteFrameComplete = OnWriteFrameComplete;

		private readonly SaslTransport transport;

		private readonly SaslTransportProvider provider;

		private readonly bool isInitiator;

		private SaslState state;

		private SaslHandler saslHandler;

		private AsyncIO.FrameBufferReader reader;

		private AsyncIO.AsyncBufferWriter writer;

		private Exception completeException;

		private int completeTransport;

		public SaslNegotiator(SaslTransport transport, SaslTransportProvider provider, bool isInitiator)
		{
			this.transport = transport;
			this.provider = provider;
			this.isInitiator = isInitiator;
			state = SaslState.Start;
		}

		public bool Start()
		{
			reader = new AsyncIO.FrameBufferReader(this, transport, provider.MaxFrameSize);
			writer = new AsyncIO.AsyncBufferWriter(transport);
			if (!isInitiator)
			{
				SendServerMechanisms();
			}
			else
			{
				state = SaslState.WaitingForServerMechanisms;
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogOperationVerbose(this, TraceOperation.Execute, "WaitingForServerMechanisms");
				ReadFrame();
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void ReadFrame()
		{
			try
			{
				reader.ReadFrame();
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				HandleException("ReadFrame", exception);
			}
		}

		public void WriteFrame(Performative command, bool needReply)
		{
			try
			{
				ByteBuffer writeBuffer = Frame.EncodeCommand(FrameType.Sasl, 0, command, 0);
				TransportAsyncCallbackArgs transportAsyncCallbackArgs = new TransportAsyncCallbackArgs();
				transportAsyncCallbackArgs.SetWriteBuffer(writeBuffer);
				transportAsyncCallbackArgs.CompletedCallback = onWriteFrameComplete;
				transportAsyncCallbackArgs.UserToken = this;
				transportAsyncCallbackArgs.UserToken2 = needReply;
				writer.WriteBuffer(transportAsyncCallbackArgs);
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				HandleException("WriteFrame", exception);
			}
		}

		public void CompleteNegotiation(SaslCode code, Exception exception)
		{
			state = SaslState.End;
			completeException = exception;
			if (!isInitiator)
			{
				SaslOutcome saslOutcome = new SaslOutcome();
				saslOutcome.OutcomeCode = code;
				if (code == SaslCode.Ok)
				{
					saslOutcome.AdditionalData = new ArraySegment<byte>(System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(welcome));
				}
				WriteFrame(saslOutcome, needReply: false);
			}
			else
			{
				CompleteTransport();
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "sasl-negotiator";
		}

		private static void OnWriteFrameComplete(TransportAsyncCallbackArgs args)
		{
			args.ByteBuffer.Dispose();
			SaslNegotiator saslNegotiator = (SaslNegotiator)args.UserToken;
			if (args.Exception != null)
			{
				saslNegotiator.HandleException("OnWriteFrameComplete", args.Exception);
			}
			else if ((bool)args.UserToken2)
			{
				saslNegotiator.ReadFrame();
			}
			else if (saslNegotiator.state == SaslState.End)
			{
				saslNegotiator.CompleteTransport();
			}
		}

		private void CompleteTransport()
		{
			if (Interlocked.Exchange(ref completeTransport, 1) == 0)
			{
				if (completeException != null)
				{
					transport.OnNegotiationFail(completeException);
				}
				else
				{
					transport.OnNegotiationSucceed(saslHandler.Principal);
				}
			}
		}

		private void HandleException(string action, Exception exception)
		{
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogError(this, action, exception.Message);
			state = SaslState.End;
			completeException = exception;
			CompleteTransport();
		}

		private void SendServerMechanisms()
		{
			List<AmqpSymbol> list = new List<AmqpSymbol>();
			foreach (string mechanism in provider.Mechanisms)
			{
				list.Add(new AmqpSymbol(mechanism));
			}
			SaslMechanisms saslMechanisms = new SaslMechanisms();
			saslMechanisms.SaslServerMechanisms = new Multiple<AmqpSymbol>(list);
			state = SaslState.WaitingForInit;
			WriteFrame(saslMechanisms, needReply: true);
		}

		void IIoHandler.OnIoFault(Exception exception)
		{
			HandleException("OnIoFault", exception);
		}

		ByteBuffer IIoHandler.CreateBuffer(int size, bool autoGrow)
		{
			return new ByteBuffer(size, autoGrow);
		}

		void IIoHandler.OnReceiveBuffer(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			Frame frame = new Frame();
			try
			{
				frame.Decode(buffer);
				if (frame.Type != FrameType.Sasl)
				{
					throw new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.InvalidField, "sasl-frame-type");
				}
				if (frame.Command == null)
				{
					throw new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.InvalidField, "sasl-frame-body");
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
				{
					throw;
				}
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogError(this, "SaslDecode", ex.Message);
				CompleteNegotiation(SaslCode.Sys, ex);
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				HandleSaslCommand(frame.Command);
			}
			catch (UnauthorizedAccessException ex2)
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogError(this, "Authorize", ex2.Message);
				CompleteNegotiation(SaslCode.Auth, ex2);
			}
			catch (Exception ex3)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(ex3))
				{
					throw;
				}
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogError(this, "HandleSaslCommand", ex3.Message);
				CompleteNegotiation(SaslCode.Sys, ex3);
			}
		}

		void IIoHandler.OnIoEvent(IoEvent ioEvent, long queueSize)
		{
		}

		private void HandleSaslCommand(Performative command)
		{
			if (command.DescriptorCode == SaslMechanisms.Code)
			{
				OnSaslServerMechanisms((SaslMechanisms)command);
				return;
			}
			if (command.DescriptorCode == SaslInit.Code)
			{
				OnSaslInit((SaslInit)command);
				return;
			}
			if (command.DescriptorCode == SaslChallenge.Code)
			{
				saslHandler.OnChallenge((SaslChallenge)command);
				return;
			}
			if (command.DescriptorCode == SaslResponse.Code)
			{
				saslHandler.OnResponse((SaslResponse)command);
				return;
			}
			if (command.DescriptorCode == SaslOutcome.Code)
			{
				OnSaslOutcome((SaslOutcome)command);
				return;
			}
			throw new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.NotAllowed, command.ToString());
		}

		private void OnSaslServerMechanisms(SaslMechanisms mechanisms)
		{
			if (state != SaslState.WaitingForServerMechanisms)
			{
				throw new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.IllegalState, SRAmqp.AmqpIllegalOperationState("R:SASL-MECH", state));
			}
			string text = null;
			foreach (string mechanism in provider.Mechanisms)
			{
				if (mechanisms.SaslServerMechanisms.Contains(new AmqpSymbol(mechanism)))
				{
					text = mechanism;
					break;
				}
				if (text != null)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			if (text == null)
			{
				throw new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.NotFound, SRAmqp.AmqpNotSupportMechanism(mechanisms.SaslServerMechanisms.ToString(), string.Join(",", provider.Mechanisms)));
			}
			state = SaslState.Negotiating;
			saslHandler = provider.GetHandler(text, clone: true);
			SaslInit saslInit = new SaslInit();
			saslInit.Mechanism = text;
			saslHandler.Start(this, saslInit, isClient: true);
		}

		private void OnSaslInit(SaslInit init)
		{
			if (state != SaslState.WaitingForInit)
			{
				throw new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.IllegalState, SRAmqp.AmqpIllegalOperationState("R:SASL-INIT", state));
			}
			state = SaslState.Negotiating;
			saslHandler = provider.GetHandler(init.Mechanism.Value, clone: true);
			saslHandler.Start(this, init, isClient: false);
		}

		private void OnSaslOutcome(SaslOutcome outcome)
		{
			Exception exception = null;
			if (outcome.OutcomeCode.Value != SaslCode.Ok)
			{
				exception = new UnauthorizedAccessException(outcome.OutcomeCode.Value.ToString());
			}
			CompleteNegotiation(outcome.OutcomeCode.Value, exception);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class SaslOutcome : Performative
	{
		public static readonly string Name = "amqp:sasl-outcome:list";

		public static readonly ulong Code = 68uL;

		private const int Fields = 2;

		protected override int FieldCount => 2;

		public SaslCode? OutcomeCode { get; set; }

		public ArraySegment<byte> AdditionalData { get; set; }

		public SaslOutcome()
			: base(Name, Code)
		{
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder("sasl-outcome(");
			int count = 0;
			AddFieldToString(OutcomeCode.HasValue, stringBuilder, "code", OutcomeCode, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(AdditionalData.Array != null, stringBuilder, "additional-data", AdditionalData, ref count);
			stringBuilder.Append(')');
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		protected override void EnsureRequired()
		{
			if (!OutcomeCode.HasValue)
			{
				throw new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.InvalidField, "sasl-outcome:code");
			}
		}

		protected override void OnEncode(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			AmqpCodec.EncodeUByte((byte?)OutcomeCode, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeBinary(AdditionalData, buffer);
		}

		protected override void OnDecode(ByteBuffer buffer, int count)
		{
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				OutcomeCode = (SaslCode?)AmqpCodec.DecodeUByte(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				AdditionalData = AmqpCodec.DecodeBinary(buffer);
			}
		}

		protected override int OnValueSize()
		{
			int num = 0;
			num += AmqpCodec.GetUByteEncodeSize((byte?)OutcomeCode);
			return num + AmqpCodec.GetBinaryEncodeSize(AdditionalData);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class SaslPlainHandler : SaslHandler
	{
		public static readonly string Name = "PLAIN";

		private static readonly string InvalidCredential = "Invalid user name or password.";

		private ISaslPlainAuthenticator authenticator;

		public string AuthorizationIdentity { get; set; }

		public string AuthenticationIdentity { get; set; }

		public string Password { get; set; }

		public SaslPlainHandler()
		{
			base.Mechanism = Name;
		}

		public SaslPlainHandler(ISaslPlainAuthenticator authenticator)
			: this()
		{
			this.authenticator = authenticator;
		}

		public override SaslHandler Clone()
		{
			return new SaslPlainHandler(authenticator)
			{
				AuthorizationIdentity = AuthorizationIdentity,
				AuthenticationIdentity = AuthenticationIdentity,
				Password = Password
			};
		}

		public override void OnChallenge(SaslChallenge challenge)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		public override void OnResponse(SaslResponse response)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		protected override void OnStart(SaslInit init, bool isClient)
		{
			if (isClient)
			{
				string clientMessage = GetClientMessage();
				init.InitialResponse = new ArraySegment<byte>(System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(clientMessage));
				base.Negotiator.WriteFrame(init, needReply: true);
			}
			else
			{
				OnInit(init);
			}
		}

		private void OnInit(SaslInit init)
		{
			string password = null;
			if (init.InitialResponse.Count > 0)
			{
				string text = System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetString(init.InitialResponse.Array, init.InitialResponse.Offset, init.InitialResponse.Count);
				string[] array = text.Split(default(char));
				if (array.Length != 3)
				{
					throw new UnauthorizedAccessException(InvalidCredential);
				}
				AuthorizationIdentity = array[0];
				AuthenticationIdentity = array[1];
				password = array[2];
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(AuthenticationIdentity))
			{
				throw new UnauthorizedAccessException(InvalidCredential);
			}
			if (authenticator != null)
			{
				base.Principal = authenticator.Authenticate(AuthenticationIdentity, password);
			}
			base.Negotiator.CompleteNegotiation(SaslCode.Ok, null);
		}

		private string GetClientMessage()
		{
			return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}\0{1}\0{2}", AuthorizationIdentity, AuthenticationIdentity, Password);
		}
	}

	internal sealed class SaslSwtHandler : SaslHandler
	{
		public static readonly string Name = "SWT";

		private TokenProvider tokenProvider;

		private string action;

		private string appliesTo;

		private Func<string, string[]> tokenAuthenticator;

		private SaslSwtHandler()
		{
			base.Mechanism = Name;
		}

		public SaslSwtHandler(TokenProvider tokenProvider, string action, string appliesTo)
			: this()
		{
			this.action = action;
			this.tokenProvider = tokenProvider;
			this.appliesTo = appliesTo;
		}

		public SaslSwtHandler(Func<string, string[]> tokenAuthenticator)
			: this()
		{
			this.tokenAuthenticator = tokenAuthenticator;
		}

		public override SaslHandler Clone()
		{
			return new SaslSwtHandler(tokenProvider, action, appliesTo);
		}

		public override void OnChallenge(SaslChallenge challenge)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		public override void OnResponse(SaslResponse response)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		protected override void OnStart(SaslInit init, bool isClient)
		{
			if (isClient)
			{
				string clientMessage = GetClientMessage();
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogOperationVerbose(this, TraceOperation.Receive, clientMessage);
				init.InitialResponse = new ArraySegment<byte>(System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(clientMessage));
				base.Negotiator.WriteFrame(init, needReply: true);
			}
			else
			{
				OnInit(init);
			}
		}

		private void OnInit(SaslInit init)
		{
			SaslCode code = SaslCode.Ok;
			if (init.InitialResponse.Count > 0)
			{
				string text = System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetString(init.InitialResponse.Array, init.InitialResponse.Offset, init.InitialResponse.Count);
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogOperationVerbose(this, TraceOperation.Initialize, text);
				if (tokenAuthenticator != null)
				{
					try
					{
						string[] roles = tokenAuthenticator(text);
						base.Principal = new GenericPrincipal(new GenericIdentity("acs-client", Name), roles);
					}
					catch (Exception exception)
					{
						if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
						{
							throw;
						}
						code = SaslCode.Auth;
					}
				}
			}
			base.Negotiator.CompleteNegotiation(code, null);
		}

		private string GetClientMessage()
		{
			SimpleWebSecurityToken simpleWebSecurityToken = (SimpleWebSecurityToken)tokenProvider.GetToken(appliesTo, action, bypassCache: false, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5.0));
			return simpleWebSecurityToken.Token;
		}
	}
	internal sealed class SaslTransport : TransportBase
	{
		private readonly TransportBase innerTransport;

		private SaslNegotiator negotiator;

		public override EndPoint LocalEndPoint => innerTransport.LocalEndPoint;

		public override EndPoint RemoteEndPoint => innerTransport.RemoteEndPoint;

		public override bool IsSecure => innerTransport.IsSecure;

		public override SslStateInfo SslStateInfo => innerTransport.SslStateInfo;

		public SaslTransport(TransportBase transport, SaslTransportProvider provider, bool isInitiator)
			: base("sasl", transport.Identifier)
		{
			innerTransport = transport;
			negotiator = new SaslNegotiator(this, provider, isInitiator);
		}

		public override void SetMonitor(ITransportMonitor usageMeter)
		{
			innerTransport.SetMonitor(usageMeter);
		}

		public override bool WriteAsync(TransportAsyncCallbackArgs args)
		{
			return innerTransport.WriteAsync(args);
		}

		public override bool ReadAsync(TransportAsyncCallbackArgs args)
		{
			return innerTransport.ReadAsync(args);
		}

		public void OnNegotiationSucceed(IPrincipal principal)
		{
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogOperation(this, TraceOperation.Execute, "OnNegotiationSucceed");
			negotiator = null;
			base.Principal = principal;
			CompleteOpen(syncComplete: false, null);
		}

		public void OnNegotiationFail(Exception exception)
		{
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogError(this, "OnNegotiationFail", exception.Message);
			negotiator = null;
			innerTransport.SafeClose(exception);
			CompleteOpen(syncComplete: false, exception);
		}

		protected override bool OpenInternal()
		{
			return negotiator.Start();
		}

		protected override void AbortInternal()
		{
			innerTransport.Abort();
		}

		protected override bool CloseInternal()
		{
			innerTransport.Close();
			return true;
		}
	}
	internal sealed class SaslTransportProvider : TransportProvider
	{
		private Dictionary<string, SaslHandler> handlers;

		public int MaxFrameSize { get; set; }

		public IEnumerable<string> Mechanisms => handlers.Keys;

		public SaslTransportProvider()
		{
			base.ProtocolId = ProtocolId.AmqpSasl;
			handlers = new Dictionary<string, SaslHandler>();
			MaxFrameSize = 512;
		}

		public void AddHandler(SaslHandler handler)
		{
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogOperation(this, TraceOperation.Add, handler);
			handlers.Add(handler.Mechanism, handler);
		}

		public SaslHandler GetHandler(string mechanism, bool clone)
		{
			if (!handlers.TryGetValue(mechanism, out var value))
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogError(this, "GetHandler", mechanism);
				throw new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.NotImplemented, mechanism);
			}
			if (!clone)
			{
				return value;
			}
			return value.Clone();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "sasl-provider";
		}

		protected override TransportBase OnCreateTransport(TransportBase innerTransport, bool isInitiator)
		{
			if (innerTransport.GetType() == typeof(SaslTransport))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(SRAmqp.AmqpTransportUpgradeNotAllowed(innerTransport.GetType().Name, typeof(SaslTransport).Name));
			}
			return new SaslTransport(innerTransport, this, isInitiator);
		}
	}

		{
			get
			{
				if (Code < 0)
				{
					return null;
				}

			}
		}

		}

		{
			public static readonly MemberOrderComparer Instance = new MemberOrderComparer();

			public int Compare(SerialiableMember m1, SerialiableMember m2)
			{
				if (m1.Order != m2.Order)
				{
					if (m1.Order <= m2.Order)
					{
						return -1;
					}
					return 1;
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		private static readonly Dictionary<Type, SerializableType> builtInTypes;

			builtInTypes[typeof(Uri)] = new SerializableType.Converted(AmqpType.Converted, typeof(Uri), typeof(DescribedType), (object o, Type t) => new DescribedType("com.microsoft:uri", ((Uri)o).AbsoluteUri), (object o, Type t) => new Uri((string)((DescribedType)o).Value));
			builtInTypes[typeof(DateTimeOffset)] = new SerializableType.Converted(AmqpType.Converted, typeof(DateTimeOffset), typeof(DescribedType), (object o, Type t) => new DescribedType("com.microsoft:datetime-offset", ((DateTimeOffset)o).UtcTicks), (object o, Type t) => new DateTimeOffset(new DateTime((long)((DescribedType)o).Value, DateTimeKind.Utc)));
