		internal AmqpContractSerializer()
		{
			customTypeCache = new ConcurrentDictionary<Type, SerializableType>();
		}

		internal AmqpContractSerializer(ITypeResolver resolver)
			: this()
		{
			externalResolver = resolver;
		}

		public static void WriteObject(Stream stream, object graph)
		{
			Instance.WriteObjectInternal(stream, graph);
		}

		public static T ReadObject<T>(Stream stream)
		{
			return Instance.ReadObjectInternal<T, T>(stream);
		}

		public static TAs ReadObject<T, TAs>(Stream stream)
		{
			return Instance.ReadObjectInternal<T, TAs>(stream);
		}

		internal void WriteObjectInternal(Stream stream, object graph)
		{
			if (graph == null)
			{
				stream.WriteByte(64);
				return;
			}
			SerializableType type = GetType(graph.GetType());
			using ByteBuffer byteBuffer = new ByteBuffer(1024, autoGrow: true);
			type.WriteObject(byteBuffer, graph);
			stream.Write(byteBuffer.Buffer, byteBuffer.Offset, byteBuffer.Length);
		}

		internal void WriteObjectInternal(ByteBuffer buffer, object graph)
		{
			if (graph == null)
			{
				AmqpEncoding.EncodeNull(buffer);
				return;
			}
			SerializableType type = GetType(graph.GetType());
			type.WriteObject(buffer, graph);
		}

		internal T ReadObjectInternal<T>(Stream stream)
		{
			return ReadObjectInternal<T, T>(stream);
		}

		internal TAs ReadObjectInternal<T, TAs>(Stream stream)
		{
			if (!stream.CanSeek)
			{
				throw new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.DecodeError, "stream.CanSeek must be true.");
			}
			SerializableType type = GetType(typeof(T));
			ByteBuffer byteBuffer = null;
			long position = stream.Position;
			if (stream is BufferListStream bufferListStream)
			{
				ArraySegment<byte> arraySegment = bufferListStream.ReadBytes(int.MaxValue);
				byteBuffer = new ByteBuffer(arraySegment.Array, arraySegment.Offset, arraySegment.Count);
			}
			else
			{
				byteBuffer = new ByteBuffer((int)stream.Length, autoGrow: false);
				int size = stream.Read(byteBuffer.Buffer, 0, byteBuffer.Capacity);
				byteBuffer.Append(size);
			}
			using (byteBuffer)
			{
				TAs result = (TAs)type.ReadObject(byteBuffer);
				if (byteBuffer.Length > 0)
				{
					stream.Position = position + byteBuffer.Offset;
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		internal TAs ReadObjectInternal<T, TAs>(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			SerializableType type = GetType(typeof(T));
			return (TAs)type.ReadObject(buffer);
		}

		internal SerializableType GetType(Type type)
		{
			return GetOrCompileType(type, describedOnly: false);
		}

		internal SerializableType GetType(ulong code, string name)
		{
			return externalResolver?.Resolve(code, name);
		}

		private bool TryGetSerializableType(Type type, out SerializableType serializableType)
		{
			serializableType = null;
			if (builtInTypes.TryGetValue(type, out serializableType))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (customTypeCache.TryGetValue(type, out serializableType))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private SerializableType GetOrCompileType(Type type, bool describedOnly)
		{
			SerializableType serializableType = null;
			if (!TryGetSerializableType(type, out serializableType))
			{
				serializableType = CompileType(type, describedOnly);
				if (serializableType != null)
				{
					customTypeCache.TryAdd(type, serializableType);
				}
			}
			if (serializableType == null)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(type.FullName);
			}
			return serializableType;
		}

		private SerializableType CompileType(Type type, bool describedOnly)
		{
			if (externalResolver != null)
			{
				SerializableType serializableType = externalResolver.Resolve(type);
				if (serializableType != null)
				{
					return serializableType;
				}
			}
			object[] customAttributes = type.GetCustomAttributes(typeof(AmqpContractAttribute), inherit: false);
			if (customAttributes.Length == 0)
			{
				if (describedOnly)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return CompileNonContractTypes(type);
			}
			AmqpContractAttribute amqpContractAttribute = (AmqpContractAttribute)customAttributes[0];
			SerializableType.Composite composite = null;
			if (type.BaseType != typeof(object))
			{
				SerializableType serializableType2 = CompileType(type.BaseType, describedOnly: true);
				if (serializableType2 != null)
				{
					if (serializableType2.AmqpType != AmqpType.Composite)
					{
						throw new SerializationException(SRAmqp.AmqpInvalidType(composite.GetType().Name));
					}
					composite = (SerializableType.Composite)serializableType2;
					if (composite.EncodingType != amqpContractAttribute.Encoding)
					{
						throw new SerializationException(SRAmqp.AmqpEncodingTypeMismatch(type.Name, amqpContractAttribute.Encoding, type.BaseType.Name, composite.EncodingType));
					}
					customTypeCache.TryAdd(type.BaseType, composite);
				}
			}
			string text = amqpContractAttribute.Name;
			ulong? internalCode = amqpContractAttribute.InternalCode;
			if (text == null && !internalCode.HasValue)
			{
				text = type.FullName;
			}
			List<SerialiableMember> list = new List<SerialiableMember>();
			if (composite != null)
			{
				list.AddRange(composite.Members);
			}
			int num = list.Count + 1;
			MemberInfo[] members = type.GetMembers(BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
			MethodAccessor onDesrialized = null;
			MemberInfo[] array = members;
			foreach (MemberInfo memberInfo in array)
			{
				if (memberInfo.DeclaringType != type)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (memberInfo.MemberType == MemberTypes.Field || memberInfo.MemberType == MemberTypes.Property)
				{
					object[] customAttributes2 = memberInfo.GetCustomAttributes(typeof(AmqpMemberAttribute), inherit: true);
					if (customAttributes2.Length == 1)
					{
						AmqpMemberAttribute amqpMemberAttribute = (AmqpMemberAttribute)customAttributes2[0];
						SerialiableMember serialiableMember = new SerialiableMember();
						serialiableMember.Name = amqpMemberAttribute.Name ?? memberInfo.Name;
						serialiableMember.Order = amqpMemberAttribute.InternalOrder ?? num++;
						serialiableMember.Mandatory = amqpMemberAttribute.Mandatory;
						serialiableMember.Accessor = MemberAccessor.Create(memberInfo, requiresSetter: true);
						Type type2 = ((memberInfo.MemberType == MemberTypes.Field) ? ((FieldInfo)memberInfo).FieldType : ((PropertyInfo)memberInfo).PropertyType);
						serialiableMember.Type = GetType(type2);
						list.Add(serialiableMember);
					}
				}
				else if (memberInfo.MemberType == MemberTypes.Method)
				{
					object[] customAttributes3 = memberInfo.GetCustomAttributes(typeof(OnDeserializedAttribute), inherit: false);
					if (customAttributes3.Length == 1)
					{
						onDesrialized = MethodAccessor.Create((MethodInfo)memberInfo);
					}
				}
			}
			if (amqpContractAttribute.Encoding == EncodingType.List)
			{
				list.Sort(MemberOrderComparer.Instance);
				int num2 = -1;
				foreach (SerialiableMember item in list)
				{
					if (num2 > 0 && item.Order == num2)
					{
						throw new SerializationException(SRAmqp.AmqpDuplicateMemberOrder(num2, type.Name));
					}
					num2 = item.Order;
				}
			}
			SerialiableMember[] members2 = list.ToArray();
			List<Type> list2 = new List<Type>();
			object[] customAttributes4 = type.GetCustomAttributes(typeof(KnownTypeAttribute), inherit: false);
			foreach (object obj in customAttributes4)
			{
				KnownTypeAttribute knownTypeAttribute = (KnownTypeAttribute)obj;
				if (knownTypeAttribute.Type.GetCustomAttributes(typeof(AmqpContractAttribute), inherit: false).Length != 0)
				{
					list2.Add(knownTypeAttribute.Type);
				}
			}
			if (amqpContractAttribute.Encoding == EncodingType.List)
			{
				return new SerializableType.CompositeList(this, type, composite, text, internalCode, members2, list2, onDesrialized);
			}
			if (amqpContractAttribute.Encoding == EncodingType.Map)
			{
				return new SerializableType.CompositeMap(this, type, composite, text, internalCode, members2, list2, onDesrialized);
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException(amqpContractAttribute.Encoding.ToString());
		}

		private SerializableType CompileNonContractTypes(Type type)
		{
			if (type == typeof(object))
			{
				return new SerializableType.Object(this, type);
			}
			if (type.IsGenericType && type.GetGenericTypeDefinition() == typeof(Nullable<>))
			{
				Type[] genericArguments = type.GetGenericArguments();
				return GetType(genericArguments[0]);
			}
			if (type.IsInterface)
			{
				if (typeof(IEnumerable).IsAssignableFrom(type))
				{
					Type type2 = typeof(object);
					Type type3 = typeof(ArrayList);
					if (type.IsGenericType)
					{
						Type[] genericArguments2 = type.GetGenericArguments();
						type2 = genericArguments2[0];
						type3 = typeof(List<>).MakeGenericType(genericArguments2);
					}
					if (type.IsAssignableFrom(type3))
					{
						MethodAccessor addAccessor = MethodAccessor.Create(type3.GetMethod("Add", new Type[1] { type2 }));
						return new SerializableType.List(this, type3, type2, addAccessor);
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
			if (type.IsEnum)
			{
				Type underlyingType = Enum.GetUnderlyingType(type);
				return new SerializableType.Converted(AmqpType.Converted, type, underlyingType, (object o, Type t) => Convert.ChangeType(o, t), (object o, Type t) => Enum.ToObject(t, o));
			}
			if (type.GetInterface(typeof(IAmqpSerializable).Name, ignoreCase: false) != null)
			{
				return new SerializableType.Serializable(this, type);
			}
			return CompileCollectionTypes(type);
		}

		private SerializableType CompileCollectionTypes(Type type)
		{
			if (type.IsArray)
			{
				AmqpEncoding.GetEncoding(type.GetElementType());
				return SerializableType.CreatePrimitiveType(type);
			}
			Type[] interfaces = type.GetInterfaces();
			foreach (Type type2 in interfaces)
			{
				if (type2.IsGenericType)
				{
					Type genericTypeDefinition = type2.GetGenericTypeDefinition();
					if (genericTypeDefinition == typeof(IDictionary<, >))
					{
						Type[] genericArguments = type2.GetGenericArguments();
						Type type3 = typeof(KeyValuePair<, >).MakeGenericType(genericArguments);
						MemberAccessor keyAccessor = MemberAccessor.Create(type3.GetProperty("Key"), requiresSetter: false);
						MemberAccessor valueAccessor = MemberAccessor.Create(type3.GetProperty("Value"), requiresSetter: false);
						MethodAccessor addAccessor = MethodAccessor.Create(type.GetMethod("Add", genericArguments));
						return new SerializableType.Map(this, type, keyAccessor, valueAccessor, addAccessor);
					}
					if (genericTypeDefinition == typeof(ICollection<>))
					{
						Type[] genericArguments2 = type2.GetGenericArguments();
						Type itemType = genericArguments2[0];
						MethodAccessor addAccessor2 = MethodAccessor.Create(type.GetMethod("Add", genericArguments2));
						return new SerializableType.List(this, type, itemType, addAccessor2);
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Property | AttributeTargets.Field, AllowMultiple = false, Inherited = true)]
	internal sealed class AmqpMemberAttribute : Attribute
	{
		private int? order;

		private bool? mandatory;

		public string Name { get; set; }

		public int Order
		{
			get
			{
				if (!order.HasValue)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return order.Value;
			}
			set
			{
				order = value;
			}
		}

		public bool Mandatory
		{
			get
			{
				if (!mandatory.HasValue)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return mandatory.Value;
			}
			set
			{
				mandatory = value;
			}
		}

		internal int? InternalOrder => order;

		internal bool? InternalMandatory => mandatory;
	}
	internal abstract class MemberAccessor
	{
		private sealed class FieldMemberAccessor : MemberAccessor
		{
			public FieldMemberAccessor(FieldInfo fieldInfo)
				: base(fieldInfo.FieldType)
			{
				InitializeGetter(fieldInfo);
				InitializeSetter(fieldInfo);
			}

			private void InitializeGetter(FieldInfo fieldInfo)
			{
				DynamicMethod dynamicMethod = new DynamicMethod(GetAccessorName(isGetter: true, fieldInfo.Name), typeof(object), new Type[1] { typeof(object) }, restrictedSkipVisibility: true);
				ILGenerator iLGenerator = dynamicMethod.GetILGenerator();
				iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldarg_0);
				EmitTypeConversion(iLGenerator, fieldInfo.DeclaringType, isContainer: true);
				iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldfld, fieldInfo);
				if (fieldInfo.FieldType.IsValueType)
				{
					iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Box, fieldInfo.FieldType);
				}
				iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ret);
				getter = (Func<object, object>)dynamicMethod.CreateDelegate(typeof(Func<object, object>));
			}

			private void InitializeSetter(FieldInfo fieldInfo)
			{
				DynamicMethod dynamicMethod = new DynamicMethod(GetAccessorName(isGetter: false, fieldInfo.Name), typeof(void), new Type[2]
				{
					typeof(object),
					typeof(object)
				}, restrictedSkipVisibility: true);
				ILGenerator iLGenerator = dynamicMethod.GetILGenerator();
				iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldarg_0);
				EmitTypeConversion(iLGenerator, fieldInfo.DeclaringType, isContainer: true);
				iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldarg_1);
				EmitTypeConversion(iLGenerator, fieldInfo.FieldType, isContainer: false);
				iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Stfld, fieldInfo);
				iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ret);
				setter = (Action<object, object>)dynamicMethod.CreateDelegate(typeof(Action<object, object>));
			}
		}

		private sealed class PropertyMemberAccessor : MemberAccessor
		{
			public PropertyMemberAccessor(PropertyInfo propertyInfo, bool requiresSetter)
				: base(propertyInfo.PropertyType)
			{
				InitializeGetter(propertyInfo);
				InitializeSetter(propertyInfo, requiresSetter);
			}

			private void InitializeGetter(PropertyInfo propertyInfo)
			{
				DynamicMethod dynamicMethod = new DynamicMethod(GetAccessorName(isGetter: true, propertyInfo.Name), typeof(object), new Type[1] { typeof(object) }, restrictedSkipVisibility: true);
				ILGenerator iLGenerator = dynamicMethod.GetILGenerator();
				iLGenerator.DeclareLocal(typeof(object));
				iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldarg_0);
				EmitTypeConversion(iLGenerator, propertyInfo.DeclaringType, isContainer: true);
				EmitCall(iLGenerator, propertyInfo.GetGetMethod(nonPublic: true));
				if (propertyInfo.PropertyType.IsValueType)
				{
					iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Box, propertyInfo.PropertyType);
				}
				iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ret);
				getter = (Func<object, object>)dynamicMethod.CreateDelegate(typeof(Func<object, object>));
			}

			private void InitializeSetter(PropertyInfo propertyInfo, bool requiresSetter)
			{
				MethodInfo setMethod = propertyInfo.GetSetMethod(nonPublic: true);
				if (setMethod == null)
				{
					if (requiresSetter)
					{
						throw new SerializationException("Property annotated with AmqpMemberAttribute must have a setter.");
					}
					return;
				}
				DynamicMethod dynamicMethod = new DynamicMethod(GetAccessorName(isGetter: false, propertyInfo.Name), typeof(void), new Type[2]
				{
					typeof(object),
					typeof(object)
				}, restrictedSkipVisibility: true);
				ILGenerator iLGenerator = dynamicMethod.GetILGenerator();
				iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldarg_0);
				EmitTypeConversion(iLGenerator, propertyInfo.DeclaringType, isContainer: true);
				iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldarg_1);
				EmitTypeConversion(iLGenerator, propertyInfo.PropertyType, isContainer: false);
				EmitCall(iLGenerator, setMethod);
				iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ret);
				setter = (Action<object, object>)dynamicMethod.CreateDelegate(typeof(Action<object, object>));
			}
		}

		private readonly Type type;

		private Func<object, object> getter;

		private Action<object, object> setter;

		public Type Type => type;

		protected MemberAccessor(Type type)
		{
			this.type = type;
		}

		public static MemberAccessor Create(MemberInfo memberInfo, bool requiresSetter)
		{
			if (memberInfo.MemberType == MemberTypes.Field)
			{
				return new FieldMemberAccessor((FieldInfo)memberInfo);
			}
			if (memberInfo.MemberType == MemberTypes.Property)
			{
				return new PropertyMemberAccessor((PropertyInfo)memberInfo, requiresSetter);
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException(memberInfo.MemberType.ToString());
		}

		public object Get(object container)
		{
			return getter(container);
		}

		public void Set(object container, object value)
		{
			setter(container, value);
		}

		private static void EmitTypeConversion(ILGenerator generator, Type castType, bool isContainer)
		{
			if (!(castType == typeof(object)))
			{
				if (castType.IsValueType)
				{
					generator.Emit(isContainer ? OpCodes.Unbox : OpCodes.Unbox_Any, castType);
				}
				else
				{
					generator.Emit(OpCodes.Castclass, castType);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void EmitCall(ILGenerator generator, MethodInfo method)
		{
			OpCode opcode = ((method.IsStatic || method.DeclaringType.IsValueType) ? OpCodes.Call : OpCodes.Callvirt);
			generator.EmitCall(opcode, method, null);
		}

		private static string GetAccessorName(bool isGetter, string name)
		{
			return (isGetter ? "get_" : "set_") + name;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class MethodAccessor
	{
		private delegate object MethodDelegate(object container, object[] parameters);

		private sealed class ConstructorAccessor : MethodAccessor
		{
			public ConstructorAccessor(ConstructorInfo constructorInfo)
			{
				isStatic = true;
				DynamicMethod dynamicMethod = new DynamicMethod("ctor_" + constructorInfo.DeclaringType.Name, typeof(object), delegateParamsType, restrictedSkipVisibility: true);
				Type[] parametersType = GetParametersType(constructorInfo.GetParameters());
				ILGenerator iLGenerator = dynamicMethod.GetILGenerator();
				LoadArguments(iLGenerator, parametersType);
				iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Newobj, constructorInfo);
				if (constructorInfo.DeclaringType.IsValueType)
				{
					iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Box, constructorInfo.DeclaringType);
				}
				iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ret);
				methodDelegate = (MethodDelegate)dynamicMethod.CreateDelegate(typeof(MethodDelegate));
			}
		}

		private sealed class TypeMethodAccessor : MethodAccessor
		{
			public TypeMethodAccessor(MethodInfo methodInfo)
			{
				Type[] parametersType = GetParametersType(methodInfo.GetParameters());
				DynamicMethod dynamicMethod = new DynamicMethod("method_" + methodInfo.Name, typeof(object), delegateParamsType, restrictedSkipVisibility: true);
				ILGenerator iLGenerator = dynamicMethod.GetILGenerator();
				if (!isStatic)
				{
					iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldarg_0);
					if (methodInfo.DeclaringType.IsValueType)
					{
						iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Unbox_Any, methodInfo.DeclaringType);
					}
					else
					{
						iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Castclass, methodInfo.DeclaringType);
					}
				}
				LoadArguments(iLGenerator, parametersType);
				if (methodInfo.IsFinal)
				{
					iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Call, methodInfo);
				}
				else
				{
					iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Callvirt, methodInfo);
				}
				if (methodInfo.ReturnType == typeof(void))
				{
					iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldnull);
				}
				else if (methodInfo.ReturnType.IsValueType)
				{
					iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Box, methodInfo.ReturnType);
				}
				iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ret);
				methodDelegate = (MethodDelegate)dynamicMethod.CreateDelegate(typeof(MethodDelegate));
			}
		}

		private static readonly Type[] delegateParamsType = new Type[2]
		{
			typeof(object),
			typeof(object[])
		};

		private bool isStatic;

		private MethodDelegate methodDelegate;

		public static MethodAccessor Create(MethodInfo methodInfo)
		{
			return new TypeMethodAccessor(methodInfo);
		}

		public static MethodAccessor Create(ConstructorInfo constructorInfo)
		{
			return new ConstructorAccessor(constructorInfo);
		}

		public object Invoke(object[] parameters)
		{
			if (!isStatic)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Instance required to call an instance method.");
			}
			return Invoke(null, parameters);
		}

		public object Invoke(object container, object[] parameters)
		{
			if (isStatic && container != null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Static method must be called with null instance.");
			}
			return methodDelegate(container, parameters);
		}

		private Type[] GetParametersType(ParameterInfo[] paramsInfo)
		{
			Type[] array = new Type[paramsInfo.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < paramsInfo.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = (paramsInfo[i].ParameterType.IsByRef ? paramsInfo[i].ParameterType.GetElementType() : paramsInfo[i].ParameterType);
			}
			return array;
		}

		private void LoadArguments(ILGenerator generator, Type[] paramsType)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < paramsType.Length; i++)
			{
				generator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldarg_1);
				switch (i)
				{
				case 0:
					generator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldc_I4_0);
					break;
				case 1:
					generator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldc_I4_1);
					break;
				case 2:
					generator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldc_I4_2);
					break;
				case 3:
					generator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldc_I4_3);
					break;
				case 4:
					generator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldc_I4_4);
					break;
				case 5:
					generator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldc_I4_5);
					break;
				case 6:
					generator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldc_I4_6);
					break;
				case 7:
					generator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldc_I4_7);
					break;
				case 8:
					generator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldc_I4_8);
					break;
				default:
					generator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldc_I4, i);
					break;
				}
				generator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldelem_Ref);
				if (paramsType[i].IsValueType)
				{
					generator.Emit(OpCodes.Unbox_Any, paramsType[i]);
				}
				else if (paramsType[i] != typeof(object))
				{
					generator.Emit(OpCodes.Castclass, paramsType[i]);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal sealed class SerialiableMember
	{
		public string Name { get; set; }

		public int Order { get; set; }

		public bool Mandatory { get; set; }

		public MemberAccessor Accessor { get; set; }

		public SerializableType Type { get; set; }
	}
	internal enum AmqpType
	{
		Primitive,
		Described,
		Composite,
		Serializable,
		List,
		Map,
		Converted
	}
	internal abstract class SerializableType
	{
		public sealed class Primitive : SerializableType
		{
			private readonly EncodingBase encoder;

			public Primitive(Type type, EncodingBase encoder)
				: base(null, type)
			{
				base.AmqpType = AmqpType.Primitive;
				this.encoder = encoder;
			}

			public override void WriteObject(ByteBuffer buffer, object value)
			{
				encoder.EncodeObject(value, arrayEncoding: false, buffer);
			}

			public override object ReadObject(ByteBuffer buffer)
			{
				return encoder.DecodeObject(buffer, (byte)0);
			}
		}

		public sealed class Serializable : SerializableType
		{
			public Serializable(AmqpContractSerializer serializer, Type type)
				: base(serializer, type)
			{
				base.AmqpType = AmqpType.Serializable;
			}

			public override void WriteObject(ByteBuffer buffer, object value)
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					AmqpEncoding.EncodeNull(buffer);
				}
				else
				{
					((IAmqpSerializable)value).Encode(buffer);
				}
			}

			public override object ReadObject(ByteBuffer buffer)
			{
				buffer.Validate(write: false, 1);
				FormatCode formatCode = buffer.Buffer[buffer.Offset];
				if (formatCode == (byte)64)
				{
					buffer.Complete(1);
					return null;
				}
				object obj = CreateInstance();
				((IAmqpSerializable)obj).Decode(buffer);
				return obj;
			}
		}

		public sealed class Converted : SerializableType
		{
			private readonly EncodingBase encoder;

			private readonly Type source;

			private readonly Type target;

			private readonly Func<object, Type, object> getTarget;

			private readonly Func<object, Type, object> getSource;

			public Converted(AmqpType amqpType, Type source, Type target, Func<object, Type, object> getTarget, Func<object, Type, object> getSource)
				: base(null, target)
			{
				base.AmqpType = amqpType;
				this.source = source;
				this.target = target;
				this.getTarget = getTarget;
				this.getSource = getSource;
				encoder = AmqpEncoding.GetEncoding(target);
			}

			public object GetTarget(object value)
			{
				return getTarget(value, target);
			}

			public object GetSource(object value)
			{
				return getSource(value, source);
			}

			public override void WriteObject(ByteBuffer buffer, object value)
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					AmqpEncoding.EncodeNull(buffer);
				}
				else
				{
					encoder.EncodeObject(getTarget(value, target), arrayEncoding: false, buffer);
				}
			}

			public override object ReadObject(ByteBuffer buffer)
			{
				object obj = AmqpEncoding.DecodeObject(buffer);
				if (obj == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return getSource(obj, source);
			}
		}

		public sealed class Object : SerializableType
		{
			public Object(AmqpContractSerializer serializer, Type type)
				: base(serializer, type)
			{
				base.AmqpType = AmqpType.Primitive;
			}

			public override void WriteObject(ByteBuffer buffer, object value)
			{
				serializer.WriteObjectInternal(buffer, value);
			}

			public override object ReadObject(ByteBuffer buffer)
			{
				FormatCode formatCode = AmqpEncoding.ReadFormatCode(buffer);
				if (formatCode != (byte)0)
				{
					return AmqpEncoding.DecodeObject(buffer, formatCode);
				}
				AmqpDescribed.DecodeDescriptor(buffer, out var name, out var code);
				if (serializer.GetType(code, name.Value) is Composite composite)
				{
					return composite.ReadObject(buffer, formatCode);
				}
				object value = AmqpEncoding.DecodeObject(buffer);
				return new DescribedType((name.Value != null) ? ((object)name) : ((object)code), value);
			}
		}

		public abstract class Collection : SerializableType
		{
			protected Collection(AmqpContractSerializer serializer, Type type)
				: base(serializer, type)
			{
			}

			public abstract int WriteMembers(ByteBuffer buffer, object container);

			public abstract void ReadMembers(ByteBuffer buffer, object container, ref int count);

			protected abstract bool WriteFormatCode(ByteBuffer buffer);

			protected abstract void Initialize(ByteBuffer buffer, FormatCode formatCode, out int size, out int count, out int encodeWidth);

			protected virtual Collection GetEffectivetype(FormatCode formatCode, ByteBuffer buffer)
			{
				return this;
			}

			public override void WriteObject(ByteBuffer buffer, object graph)
			{
				if (graph == null)
				{
					AmqpEncoding.EncodeNull(buffer);
				}
				else if (WriteFormatCode(buffer))
				{
					int writePos = buffer.WritePos;
					AmqpBitConverter.WriteULong(buffer, 0uL);
					int data = WriteMembers(buffer, graph);
					AmqpBitConverter.WriteUInt(buffer.Buffer, writePos, (uint)(buffer.WritePos - writePos - 4));
					AmqpBitConverter.WriteUInt(buffer.Buffer, writePos + 4, (uint)data);
				}
			}

			public override object ReadObject(ByteBuffer buffer)
			{
				FormatCode formatCode = AmqpEncoding.ReadFormatCode(buffer);
				if (formatCode == (byte)64)
				{
					return null;
				}
				Collection effectivetype = GetEffectivetype(formatCode, buffer);
				return effectivetype.ReadObject(buffer, formatCode);
			}

			internal object ReadObject(ByteBuffer buffer, FormatCode formatCode)
			{
				Initialize(buffer, formatCode, out var size, out var count, out var encodeWidth);
				int offset = buffer.Offset;
				object obj = CreateInstance();
				if (count > 0)
				{
					ReadMembers(buffer, obj, ref count);
					if (count > 0)
					{
						buffer.Complete(size - (buffer.Offset - offset) - encodeWidth);
					}
				}
				return obj;
			}
		}

		public sealed class List : Collection
		{
			private readonly SerializableType itemType;

			private readonly MethodAccessor addMethodAccessor;

			public SerializableType ItemType => itemType;

			public MethodAccessor Add => addMethodAccessor;

			public List(AmqpContractSerializer serializer, Type type, Type itemType, MethodAccessor addAccessor)
				: base(serializer, type)
			{
				base.AmqpType = AmqpType.List;
				this.itemType = serializer.GetType(itemType);
				addMethodAccessor = addAccessor;
			}

			protected override bool WriteFormatCode(ByteBuffer buffer)
			{
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer, 208);
				return true;
			}

			public override int WriteMembers(ByteBuffer buffer, object container)
			{
				int num = 0;
				foreach (object item in (IEnumerable)container)
				{
					if (item == null)
					{
						AmqpEncoding.EncodeNull(buffer);
					}
					else
					{
						SerializableType serializableType = itemType;
						if (item.GetType() != serializableType.type)
						{
							serializableType = serializer.GetType(item.GetType());
						}
						serializableType.WriteObject(buffer, item);
					}
					num++;
				}
				return num;
			}

			protected override void Initialize(ByteBuffer buffer, FormatCode formatCode, out int size, out int count, out int encodeWidth)
			{
				if (formatCode == (byte)69)
				{
					size = (count = (encodeWidth = 0));
					return;
				}
				if (formatCode != (byte)208 && formatCode != (byte)192)
				{
					throw new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.InvalidField, SRAmqp.AmqpInvalidFormatCode(formatCode, buffer.Offset));
				}
				encodeWidth = ((formatCode == (byte)192) ? 1 : 4);
				AmqpEncoding.ReadSizeAndCount(buffer, formatCode, (byte)192, (byte)208, out size, out count);
			}

			public override void ReadMembers(ByteBuffer buffer, object container, ref int count)
			{
				while (count > 0)
				{
					object obj = itemType.ReadObject(buffer);
					addMethodAccessor.Invoke(container, new object[1] { obj });
					count--;
				}
			}
		}

		public sealed class Map : Collection
		{
			private readonly SerializableType keyType;

			private readonly SerializableType valueType;

			private readonly MemberAccessor keyAccessor;

			private readonly MemberAccessor valueAccessor;

			private readonly MethodAccessor addMethodAccessor;

			public MemberAccessor Key => keyAccessor;

			public MemberAccessor Value => valueAccessor;

			public MethodAccessor Add => addMethodAccessor;

			public Map(AmqpContractSerializer serializer, Type type, MemberAccessor keyAccessor, MemberAccessor valueAccessor, MethodAccessor addAccessor)
				: base(serializer, type)
			{
				base.AmqpType = AmqpType.Map;
				keyType = base.serializer.GetType(keyAccessor.Type);
				valueType = base.serializer.GetType(valueAccessor.Type);
				this.keyAccessor = keyAccessor;
				this.valueAccessor = valueAccessor;
				addMethodAccessor = addAccessor;
			}

			protected override bool WriteFormatCode(ByteBuffer buffer)
			{
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer, 209);
				return true;
			}

			public override int WriteMembers(ByteBuffer buffer, object container)
			{
				int num = 0;
				foreach (object item in (IEnumerable)container)
				{
					object graph = keyAccessor.Get(item);
					object obj = valueAccessor.Get(item);
					if (obj != null)
					{
						keyType.WriteObject(buffer, graph);
						SerializableType serializableType = valueType;
						if (obj.GetType() != serializableType.type)
						{
							serializableType = serializer.GetType(obj.GetType());
						}
						serializableType.WriteObject(buffer, obj);
						num += 2;
					}
				}
				return num;
			}

			protected override void Initialize(ByteBuffer buffer, FormatCode formatCode, out int size, out int count, out int encodeWidth)
			{
				if (formatCode != (byte)209 && formatCode != (byte)193)
				{
					throw new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.InvalidField, SRAmqp.AmqpInvalidFormatCode(formatCode, buffer.Offset));
				}
				encodeWidth = ((formatCode == (byte)193) ? 1 : 4);
				AmqpEncoding.ReadSizeAndCount(buffer, formatCode, (byte)193, (byte)209, out size, out count);
			}

			public override void ReadMembers(ByteBuffer buffer, object container, ref int count)
			{
				while (count > 0)
				{
					object obj = keyType.ReadObject(buffer);
					object obj2 = valueType.ReadObject(buffer);
					addMethodAccessor.Invoke(container, new object[2] { obj, obj2 });
					count -= 2;
				}
			}
		}

		public abstract class Composite : Collection
		{
			private readonly Composite baseType;

			private readonly AmqpSymbol descriptorName;

			private readonly ulong? descriptorCode;

			private readonly SerialiableMember[] members;

			private readonly MethodAccessor onDeserialized;

			private IList<Type> knownTypes;

			public AmqpSymbol Name => descriptorName;

			public SerialiableMember[] Members => members;

			public EncodingType EncodingType { get; protected set; }

			public IList<Type> KnownTypes => knownTypes;

			protected abstract byte Code { get; }

			protected Composite BaseType => baseType;

			protected Composite(AmqpContractSerializer serializer, Type type, SerializableType baseType, string descriptorName, ulong? descriptorCode, SerialiableMember[] members, IList<Type> knownTypes, MethodAccessor onDesrialized)
				: base(serializer, type)
			{
				base.AmqpType = AmqpType.Composite;
				this.baseType = (Composite)baseType;
				this.descriptorName = descriptorName;
				this.descriptorCode = descriptorCode;
				this.members = members;
				onDeserialized = onDesrialized;
				this.knownTypes = knownTypes;
			}

			protected override bool WriteFormatCode(ByteBuffer buffer)
			{
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer, 0);
				if (descriptorCode.HasValue)
				{
					ULongEncoding.Encode(descriptorCode, buffer);
				}
				else
				{
					SymbolEncoding.Encode(descriptorName, buffer);
				}
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer, Code);
				return true;
			}

			protected override Collection GetEffectivetype(FormatCode formatCode, ByteBuffer buffer)
			{
				if (formatCode != (byte)0)
				{
					throw new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.InvalidField, SRAmqp.AmqpInvalidFormatCode(formatCode, buffer.Offset));
				}
				Collection collection = null;
				formatCode = AmqpEncoding.ReadFormatCode(buffer);
				ulong? num = null;
				AmqpSymbol symbol = default(AmqpSymbol);
				if (formatCode == (byte)68)
				{
					num = 0uL;
				}
				else if (formatCode == (byte)128 || formatCode == (byte)83)
				{
					num = ULongEncoding.Decode(buffer, formatCode);
				}
				else if (formatCode == (byte)163 || formatCode == (byte)179)
				{
					symbol = SymbolEncoding.Decode(buffer, formatCode);
				}
				if (AreEqual(descriptorCode, descriptorName, num, symbol))
				{
					collection = this;
				}
				else if (knownTypes != null)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < knownTypes.Count; i++)
					{
						Composite composite = (Composite)serializer.GetType(knownTypes[i]);
						if (AreEqual(composite.descriptorCode, composite.descriptorName, num, symbol))
						{
							collection = composite;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				if (collection == null)
				{
					ulong? num2 = num;
					throw new SerializationException(SRAmqp.AmqpUnknownDescriptor(num2.HasValue ? ((object)num2.GetValueOrDefault()) : symbol.Value, type.Name));
				}
				return collection;
			}

			protected override void Initialize(ByteBuffer buffer, FormatCode formatCode, out int size, out int count, out int encodeWidth)
			{
				formatCode = AmqpEncoding.ReadFormatCode(buffer);
				if (Code == 208)
				{
					if (formatCode == (byte)69)
					{
						size = (count = (encodeWidth = 0));
						return;
					}
					encodeWidth = ((formatCode == (byte)192) ? 1 : 4);
					AmqpEncoding.ReadSizeAndCount(buffer, formatCode, (byte)192, (byte)208, out size, out count);
				}
				else
				{
					encodeWidth = ((formatCode == (byte)193) ? 1 : 4);
					AmqpEncoding.ReadSizeAndCount(buffer, formatCode, (byte)193, (byte)209, out size, out count);
				}
			}

			protected void InvokeDeserialized(object container)
			{
				if (baseType != null)
				{
					baseType.InvokeDeserialized(container);
				}
				if (onDeserialized != null)
				{
					onDeserialized.Invoke(container, new object[1] { default(StreamingContext) });
				}
			}

			private bool AreEqual(ulong? code1, AmqpSymbol symbol1, ulong? code2, AmqpSymbol symbol2)
			{
				if (code1.HasValue && code2.HasValue)
				{
					return code1.Value == code2.Value;
				}
				if (symbol1.Value != null && symbol2.Value != null)
				{
					return symbol1.Value == symbol2.Value;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public sealed class CompositeList : Composite
		{
			protected override byte Code => 208;

			public CompositeList(AmqpContractSerializer serializer, Type type, SerializableType baseType, string descriptorName, ulong? descriptorCode, SerialiableMember[] members, IList<Type> knownTypes, MethodAccessor onDesrialized)
				: base(serializer, type, baseType, descriptorName, descriptorCode, members, knownTypes, onDesrialized)
			{
				base.EncodingType = EncodingType.List;
			}

			public override int WriteMembers(ByteBuffer buffer, object container)
			{
				SerialiableMember[] array = base.Members;
				foreach (SerialiableMember serialiableMember in array)
				{
					object obj = serialiableMember.Accessor.Get(container);
					if (obj == null)
					{
						AmqpEncoding.EncodeNull(buffer);
						continue;
					}
					SerializableType serializableType = serialiableMember.Type;
					if (obj.GetType() != serializableType.type)
					{
						serializableType = serializer.GetType(obj.GetType());
					}
					serializableType.WriteObject(buffer, obj);
				}
				return base.Members.Length;
			}

			public override void ReadMembers(ByteBuffer buffer, object container, ref int count)
			{
				int num = 0;
				while (num < base.Members.Length && count > 0)
				{
					object value = base.Members[num].Type.ReadObject(buffer);
					base.Members[num].Accessor.Set(container, value);
					num++;
					count--;
				}
				InvokeDeserialized(container);
			}
		}

		public sealed class CompositeMap : Composite
		{
			protected override byte Code => 209;

			public CompositeMap(AmqpContractSerializer serializer, Type type, SerializableType baseType, string descriptorName, ulong? descriptorCode, SerialiableMember[] members, IList<Type> knownTypes, MethodAccessor onDesrialized)
				: base(serializer, type, baseType, descriptorName, descriptorCode, members, knownTypes, onDesrialized)
			{
				base.EncodingType = EncodingType.Map;
			}

			public override int WriteMembers(ByteBuffer buffer, object container)
			{
				int num = 0;
				SerialiableMember[] array = base.Members;
				foreach (SerialiableMember serialiableMember in array)
				{
					AmqpCodec.EncodeSymbol(serialiableMember.Name, buffer);
					object obj = serialiableMember.Accessor.Get(container);
					SerializableType serializableType = serialiableMember.Type;
					if (obj.GetType() != serializableType.type)
					{
						serializableType = serializer.GetType(obj.GetType());
					}
					serializableType.WriteObject(buffer, obj);
					num += 2;
				}
				return num;
			}

			public override void ReadMembers(ByteBuffer buffer, object container, ref int count)
			{
				int num = 0;
				while (num < base.Members.Length && count > 0)
				{
					AmqpSymbol amqpSymbol = AmqpCodec.DecodeSymbol(buffer);
					object value = base.Members[num].Type.ReadObject(buffer);
					base.Members[num].Accessor.Set(container, value);
					num++;
					count -= 2;
				}
				InvokeDeserialized(container);
			}
		}

		private readonly AmqpContractSerializer serializer;

		private readonly Type type;

		private readonly bool hasDefaultCtor;

		public AmqpType AmqpType { get; protected set; }

		public Type UnderlyingType => type;

		protected SerializableType(AmqpContractSerializer serializer, Type type)
		{
			this.serializer = serializer;
			this.type = type;
			hasDefaultCtor = type.GetConstructor(Type.EmptyTypes) != null;
		}

		public static SerializableType CreatePrimitiveType(Type type)
		{
			EncodingBase encoding = AmqpEncoding.GetEncoding(type);
			return new Primitive(type, encoding);
		}

		public object CreateInstance()
		{
			if (!hasDefaultCtor)
			{
				return FormatterServices.GetUninitializedObject(type);
			}
			return Activator.CreateInstance(type);
		}

		public abstract void WriteObject(ByteBuffer buffer, object graph);

		public abstract object ReadObject(ByteBuffer buffer);
	}

	internal sealed class ClientWebSocketTransport : TransportBase
	{
		private readonly ServiceBusClientWebSocket webSocket;

		private readonly Uri uri;

		private readonly EventTraceActivity activity;

		private readonly int asyncReadBufferSize;

		private readonly byte[] asyncReadBuffer;

		private readonly AsyncCallback onReadComplete;

		private int asyncReadBufferOffset;

		private int remainingBytes;

		public override EndPoint LocalEndPoint => webSocket.LocalEndpoint;

		public override EndPoint RemoteEndPoint => webSocket.RemoteEndpoint;

		public ClientWebSocketTransport(ServiceBusClientWebSocket webSocket, Uri uri, TransportSettings transportSettings, EventTraceActivity activity)
			: base("clientwebsocket")
		{
			this.webSocket = webSocket;
			this.uri = uri;
			this.activity = activity;
			asyncReadBufferSize = transportSettings.ReceiveBufferSize;
			asyncReadBuffer = Fx.AllocateByteArray(asyncReadBufferSize);
			onReadComplete = OnReadComplete;
		}

		public override void SetMonitor(ITransportMonitor usageMeter)
		{
		}

		public override bool WriteAsync(TransportAsyncCallbackArgs args)
		{
			ThrowIfNotOpen();
			Fx.AssertAndThrow(args.Buffer != null || args.ByteBufferList != null, "must have a buffer to write");
			Fx.AssertAndThrow(args.CompletedCallback != null, "must have a valid callback");
			return webSocket.WriteAsync(args);
		}

		public override bool ReadAsync(TransportAsyncCallbackArgs args)
		{
			ThrowIfNotOpen();
			Fx.AssertAndThrow(args.Buffer != null, "must have buffer to read");
			Fx.AssertAndThrow(args.CompletedCallback != null, "must have a valid callback");
			Fx.AssertAndThrow(args.Count <= asyncReadBufferSize, Resources.ClientWebSocketTransportReadBufferTooSmall);
			ConnectionUtilities.ValidateBufferBounds(args.Buffer, args.Offset, args.Count);
			args.Exception = null;
			if (asyncReadBufferOffset > 0)
			{
				Fx.AssertAndThrow(remainingBytes > 0, "Must have data in buffer to transfer");
				TransferData(remainingBytes, args);
				return false;
			}
			IAsyncResult asyncResult = webSocket.BeginReceive(asyncReadBuffer, 0, asyncReadBufferSize, TimeSpan.MaxValue, onReadComplete, args);
			if (asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
			{
				HandleReadComplete(asyncResult);
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool OpenInternal()
		{
			ThrowIfNotOpen();
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool CloseInternal()
		{
			ServiceBusEventSource.Log.WebSocketTransportClosed(uri.AbsoluteUri);
			try
			{
				webSocket.EndClose(webSocket.BeginClose(null, null));
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				Fx.Exception.TraceHandled(exception, "ClientWebSocketTransport.CloseInternal", activity);
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override void AbortInternal()
		{
			ServiceBusEventSource.Log.WebSocketTransportAborted(uri.AbsoluteUri);
			if (webSocket.State != ServiceBusClientWebSocket.WebSocketState.Open)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				webSocket.EndClose(webSocket.BeginClose(null, null));
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				Fx.Exception.TraceHandled(exception, "ClientWebSocketTransport.AbortInternal", activity);
			}
		}

		private void OnReadComplete(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (!result.CompletedSynchronously)
			{
				TransportAsyncCallbackArgs transportAsyncCallbackArgs = HandleReadComplete(result);
				transportAsyncCallbackArgs.CompletedCallback(transportAsyncCallbackArgs);
			}
		}

		private TransportAsyncCallbackArgs HandleReadComplete(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			TransportAsyncCallbackArgs transportAsyncCallbackArgs = (TransportAsyncCallbackArgs)result.AsyncState;
			transportAsyncCallbackArgs.CompletedSynchronously = result.CompletedSynchronously;
			try
			{
				int bytesRead = webSocket.EndReceive(result);
				TransferData(bytesRead, transportAsyncCallbackArgs);
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				transportAsyncCallbackArgs.Exception = exception;
			}
			return transportAsyncCallbackArgs;
		}

		private void TransferData(int bytesRead, TransportAsyncCallbackArgs args)
		{
			if (bytesRead <= args.Count)
			{
				Buffer.BlockCopy(asyncReadBuffer, asyncReadBufferOffset, args.Buffer, args.Offset, bytesRead);
				asyncReadBufferOffset = 0;
				remainingBytes = 0;
				args.BytesTransfered = bytesRead;
			}
			else
			{
				Buffer.BlockCopy(asyncReadBuffer, asyncReadBufferOffset, args.Buffer, args.Offset, args.Count);
				asyncReadBufferOffset += args.Count;
				remainingBytes = bytesRead - args.Count;
				args.BytesTransfered = args.Count;
			}
		}

		private void ThrowIfNotOpen()
		{
			if (webSocket.State == ServiceBusClientWebSocket.WebSocketState.Open)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (webSocket.State == ServiceBusClientWebSocket.WebSocketState.Aborted)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsWarning(new ObjectDisposedException(SRAmqp.AmqpObjectAborted(GetType().Name)), activity);
			}
			if (webSocket.State == ServiceBusClientWebSocket.WebSocketState.Closed)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.AsWarning(new ObjectDisposedException(SRAmqp.AmqpUnopenObject), activity);
			}
			throw Fx.Exception.AsWarning(new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.IllegalState, SRAmqp.AmqpUnopenObject), activity);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class WebSocketTransportInitiator : TransportInitiator
	{
		private static readonly AsyncCallback onConnectComplete = OnConnectComplete;

		private readonly Uri uri;

		private readonly WebSocketTransportSettings webSocketTransportSettings;

		private TransportAsyncCallbackArgs callbackArgs;

		internal WebSocketTransportInitiator(Uri uri, WebSocketTransportSettings webSocketTransportSettings)
		{
			this.uri = uri;
			this.webSocketTransportSettings = webSocketTransportSettings;
		}

		public override bool ConnectAsync(TimeSpan timeout, TransportAsyncCallbackArgs callbackArgs)
		{
			this.callbackArgs = callbackArgs;
			IAsyncResult asyncResult = new WebSocketConnectAsyncResult(uri, timeout, webSocketTransportSettings.SubProtocol, null, webSocketTransportSettings.ConnectivitySettings, TrackingContext.Create(uri), onConnectComplete, this).Start();
			if (asyncResult.IsCompleted)
			{
				Complete(asyncResult, completeSynchronously: true);
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static void OnConnectComplete(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (!result.CompletedSynchronously)
			{
				WebSocketTransportInitiator webSocketTransportInitiator = (WebSocketTransportInitiator)result.AsyncState;
				webSocketTransportInitiator.Complete(result, completeSynchronously: false);
			}
		}

		private void Complete(IAsyncResult asyncResult, bool completeSynchronously)
		{
			TransportBase transportBase = null;
			try
			{
				WebSocketConnectAsyncResult webSocketConnectAsyncResult = AsyncResult<WebSocketConnectAsyncResult>.End(asyncResult);
				ServiceBusClientWebSocket clientWebSocket = webSocketConnectAsyncResult.ClientWebSocket;
				TrackingContext trackingContext = webSocketConnectAsyncResult.TrackingContext;
				transportBase = new ClientWebSocketTransport(clientWebSocket, uri, webSocketTransportSettings, trackingContext.Activity);
				transportBase.Open();
				ServiceBusEventSource.Log.WebSocketTransportEstablished(uri.AbsoluteUri);
			}
			catch (Exception exception) when (!Fx.IsFatal(exception))
			{
				callbackArgs.Exception = exception;
				transportBase?.SafeClose(exception);
				transportBase = null;
			}
			finally
			{
				callbackArgs.Transport = transportBase;
				callbackArgs.CompletedSynchronously = completeSynchronously;
				if (!completeSynchronously)
				{
					callbackArgs.CompletedCallback(callbackArgs);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal sealed class WebSocketTransportSettings : TransportSettings
	{
		private readonly Uri uri;

		private readonly string subProtocol;

		public string SubProtocol => subProtocol;

		internal ConnectivitySettings ConnectivitySettings { get; set; }

		public WebSocketTransportSettings(Uri uri, string subProtocol)
		{
