			this.subProtocol = subProtocol;
			base.SendBufferSize = 1048576;
			base.ReceiveBufferSize = 1048576;
		}

		public override TransportInitiator CreateInitiator()
		{
			return new WebSocketTransportInitiator(uri, this);
		}

		public override TransportListener CreateListener()
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException("WebSocketTransportSettings does not support creating a listener object");
		}
	}
	internal sealed class AmqpTransportInitiator : TransportInitiator
	{
		private sealed class ConnectAsyncResult : TimeoutAsyncResult<string>
		{
			private static Action<TransportAsyncCallbackArgs> onConnect = OnConnect;

			private readonly AmqpTransportInitiator initiator;

			private readonly TransportAsyncCallbackArgs args;

			protected override string Target => initiator.transportSettings.ToString();

			public ConnectAsyncResult(AmqpTransportInitiator initiator, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(timeout, callback, state)
			{
				this.initiator = initiator;
				args = new TransportAsyncCallbackArgs();
				args.CompletedCallback = onConnect;
				args.UserToken = this;
				SetTimer();
				if (!initiator.ConnectAsync(timeout, args))
				{
					OnConnect(args);
				}
			}

			public static TransportBase End(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				return Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult.End<ConnectAsyncResult>(result).args.Transport;
			}

			protected override void CompleteOnTimer()
			{
				if (args.Transport != null)
				{
					args.Transport.Abort();
				}
				base.CompleteOnTimer();
			}

			private static void OnConnect(TransportAsyncCallbackArgs args)
			{
				ConnectAsyncResult connectAsyncResult = (ConnectAsyncResult)args.UserToken;
				if (!connectAsyncResult.CompleteSelf(args.CompletedSynchronously, args.Exception) && args.Transport != null)
				{
					args.Transport.Abort();
				}
			}
		}

		private AmqpSettings settings;

		private TransportSettings transportSettings;

		private AsyncIO.AsyncBufferWriter writer;

		private AsyncIO.AsyncBufferReader reader;

		private TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper;

		private int providerIndex;

		private ProtocolHeader sentHeader;

		private int completingThread;

		public AmqpTransportInitiator(AmqpSettings settings, TransportSettings transportSettings)
		{
			settings.ValidateInitiatorSettings();
			this.settings = settings;
			this.transportSettings = transportSettings;
		}

		public override bool ConnectAsync(TimeSpan timeout, TransportAsyncCallbackArgs callbackArgs)
		{
			TransportInitiator transportInitiator = transportSettings.CreateInitiator();
			TransportAsyncCallbackArgs transportAsyncCallbackArgs = new TransportAsyncCallbackArgs();
			transportAsyncCallbackArgs.CompletedCallback = OnConnectComplete;
			transportAsyncCallbackArgs.UserToken = callbackArgs;
			callbackArgs.CompletedSynchronously = false;
			timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateOnly(timeout);
			if (transportInitiator.ConnectAsync(timeout, transportAsyncCallbackArgs))
			{
				return true;
			}
			int managedThreadId = Thread.CurrentThread.ManagedThreadId;
			Interlocked.Exchange(ref completingThread, managedThreadId);
			OnConnectComplete(transportAsyncCallbackArgs);
			return Interlocked.Exchange(ref completingThread, -1) != 0;
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginConnect(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new ConnectAsyncResult(this, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		public TransportBase EndConnect(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			return ConnectAsyncResult.End(result);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "tp-initiator";
		}

		internal Task<TransportBase> ConnectTaskAsync(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			TaskCompletionSource<TransportBase> tcs = new TaskCompletionSource<TransportBase>();
			TransportAsyncCallbackArgs transportAsyncCallbackArgs = new TransportAsyncCallbackArgs
			{
				CompletedCallback = delegate(TransportAsyncCallbackArgs a)
				{
					if (a.Exception != null)
					{
						tcs.SetException(a.Exception);
					}
					else
					{
						tcs.SetResult(a.Transport);
					}
				}
			};
			if (!ConnectAsync(timeout, transportAsyncCallbackArgs))
			{
				transportAsyncCallbackArgs.CompletedCallback(transportAsyncCallbackArgs);
			}
			return tcs.Task;
		}

		private void OnConnectComplete(TransportAsyncCallbackArgs args)
		{
			if (args.Exception != null)
			{
				Complete(args);
				return;
			}
			TransportProvider transportProvider = settings.TransportProviders[providerIndex];
			if (transportProvider.ProtocolId == ProtocolId.Amqp)
			{
				Complete(args);
				return;
			}
			writer = new AsyncIO.AsyncBufferWriter(args.Transport);
			reader = new AsyncIO.AsyncBufferReader(args.Transport);
			WriteSecurityHeader(args);
		}

		private void WriteSecurityHeader(TransportAsyncCallbackArgs args)
		{
			TransportProvider transportProvider = settings.TransportProviders[providerIndex];
			sentHeader = new ProtocolHeader(transportProvider.ProtocolId, transportProvider.DefaultVersion);
			ByteBuffer byteBuffer = new ByteBuffer(new byte[8]);
			sentHeader.Encode(byteBuffer);
			args.SetBuffer(byteBuffer.Buffer, byteBuffer.Offset, byteBuffer.Length);
			args.CompletedCallback = OnWriteHeaderComplete;
			writer.WriteBuffer(args);
		}

		private void OnWriteHeaderComplete(TransportAsyncCallbackArgs args)
		{
			if (args.Exception != null)
			{
				Complete(args);
				return;
			}
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogOperation(this, TraceOperation.Execute, "ReadHeader");
			byte[] array = new byte[8];
			args.SetBuffer(array, 0, array.Length);
			args.CompletedCallback = OnReadHeaderComplete;
			reader.ReadBuffer(args);
		}

		private void OnReadHeaderComplete(TransportAsyncCallbackArgs args)
		{
			if (args.Exception != null)
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogError(this, "ReadHeader", args.Exception.Message);
				Complete(args);
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				ProtocolHeader protocolHeader = new ProtocolHeader();
				protocolHeader.Decode(new ByteBuffer(args.Buffer, args.Offset, args.Count));
				if (!protocolHeader.Equals(sentHeader))
				{
					throw new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.NotImplemented, SRAmqp.AmqpProtocolVersionNotSupported(sentHeader, protocolHeader));
				}
				TransportBase transportBase = settings.TransportProviders[providerIndex].CreateTransport(args.Transport, isInitiator: true);
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpUpgradeTransport(this, args.Transport, transportBase);
				args.Transport = transportBase;
				IAsyncResult asyncResult = args.Transport.BeginOpen(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime(), OnTransportOpenCompete, args);
				if (asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
				{
					HandleTransportOpened(asyncResult);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
				{
					throw;
				}
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogError(this, "OnProtocolHeader", ex.Message);
				args.Exception = ex;
				Complete(args);
			}
		}

		private void OnTransportOpenCompete(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (result.CompletedSynchronously)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				HandleTransportOpened(result);
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				TransportAsyncCallbackArgs transportAsyncCallbackArgs = (TransportAsyncCallbackArgs)result.AsyncState;
				transportAsyncCallbackArgs.Exception = exception;
				Complete(transportAsyncCallbackArgs);
			}
		}

		private void HandleTransportOpened(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			TransportAsyncCallbackArgs transportAsyncCallbackArgs = (TransportAsyncCallbackArgs)result.AsyncState;
			transportAsyncCallbackArgs.Transport.EndOpen(result);
			providerIndex++;
			if (providerIndex == settings.TransportProviders.Count || settings.TransportProviders[providerIndex].ProtocolId == ProtocolId.Amqp)
			{
				writer = null;
				reader = null;
				providerIndex = 0;
				Complete(transportAsyncCallbackArgs);
			}
			else
			{
				writer = new AsyncIO.AsyncBufferWriter(transportAsyncCallbackArgs.Transport);
				reader = new AsyncIO.AsyncBufferReader(transportAsyncCallbackArgs.Transport);
				WriteSecurityHeader(transportAsyncCallbackArgs);
			}
		}

		private void Complete(TransportAsyncCallbackArgs args)
		{
			if (args.Exception != null && args.Transport != null)
			{
				args.Transport.SafeClose(args.Exception);
				args.Transport = null;
			}
			TransportAsyncCallbackArgs transportAsyncCallbackArgs = (TransportAsyncCallbackArgs)args.UserToken;
			transportAsyncCallbackArgs.Transport = args.Transport;
			transportAsyncCallbackArgs.Exception = args.Exception;
			int managedThreadId = Thread.CurrentThread.ManagedThreadId;
			transportAsyncCallbackArgs.CompletedSynchronously = Interlocked.Add(ref completingThread, -managedThreadId) == 0;
			if (!transportAsyncCallbackArgs.CompletedSynchronously)
			{
				transportAsyncCallbackArgs.CompletedCallback(transportAsyncCallbackArgs);
			}
		}
	}
	internal sealed class AmqpTransportListener : TransportListener
	{
		private sealed class TransportHandler
		{
			private static readonly AsyncCallback onTransportOpened = OnTransportOpened;

			private readonly AmqpTransportListener parent;

			private readonly TransportAsyncCallbackArgs args;

			private static Action<TransportAsyncCallbackArgs> readCompleteCallback = OnReadHeaderComplete;

			private static Action<TransportAsyncCallbackArgs> writeCompleteCallback = OnWriteHeaderComplete;

			private static Action<object> startCallback = Start;

			private AsyncIO.AsyncBufferReader bufferReader;

			private AsyncIO.AsyncBufferWriter bufferWriter;

			private byte[] buffer;

			private TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper;

			private TransportHandler(AmqpTransportListener parent, TransportListener innerListener, TransportAsyncCallbackArgs args)
			{
				this.parent = parent;
				this.args = args;
				this.args.UserToken = this;
				this.args.UserToken2 = innerListener;
				buffer = new byte[8];
				bufferReader = new AsyncIO.AsyncBufferReader(args.Transport);
				bufferWriter = new AsyncIO.AsyncBufferWriter(args.Transport);
				timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(60.0));
			}

			public static void SpawnHandler(AmqpTransportListener parent, TransportListener innerListener, TransportAsyncCallbackArgs args)
			{
				TransportHandler state = new TransportHandler(parent, innerListener, args);
				ActionItem.Schedule(startCallback, state);
			}

			public override string ToString()
			{
				return "tp-handler";
			}

			private static void Start(object state)
			{
				TransportHandler transportHandler = (TransportHandler)state;
				transportHandler.ReadProtocolHeader();
			}

			private static void OnTransportOpened(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				if (result.CompletedSynchronously)
				{
					return;
				}
				TransportHandler transportHandler = (TransportHandler)result.AsyncState;
				try
				{
					transportHandler.HandleTransportOpened(result);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
					{
						throw;
					}
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogError(transportHandler, "HandleTransportOpened", ex.Message);
					transportHandler.args.Exception = ex;
					transportHandler.parent.OnHandleTransportComplete(transportHandler.args);
				}
			}

			private void ReadProtocolHeader()
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogOperationVerbose(this, TraceOperation.Execute, "ReadHeader");
				args.SetBuffer(buffer, 0, buffer.Length);
				args.CompletedCallback = readCompleteCallback;
				bufferReader.ReadBuffer(args);
			}

			private static void OnReadHeaderComplete(TransportAsyncCallbackArgs args)
			{
				TransportHandler transportHandler = (TransportHandler)args.UserToken;
				if (args.Exception != null)
				{
					transportHandler.parent.OnHandleTransportComplete(args);
					return;
				}
				ByteBuffer byteBuffer = new ByteBuffer(transportHandler.buffer, 0, transportHandler.buffer.Length);
				try
				{
					transportHandler.OnProtocolHeader(byteBuffer);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
					{
						throw;
					}
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogError(transportHandler, "OnProtocolHeader", ex.Message);
					args.Exception = ex;
					transportHandler.parent.OnHandleTransportComplete(args);
				}
			}

			private void OnProtocolHeader(ByteBuffer buffer)
			{
				ProtocolHeader protocolHeader = new ProtocolHeader();
				protocolHeader.Decode(buffer);
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogOperation(this, TraceOperation.Receive, protocolHeader);
				TransportProvider provider = null;
				if (!parent.settings.TryGetTransportProvider(protocolHeader, out provider))
				{
					WriteReplyHeader(new ProtocolHeader(provider.ProtocolId, provider.DefaultVersion), fail: true);
					return;
				}
				if (!provider.TryGetVersion(protocolHeader.Version, out var supportedVersion))
				{
					WriteReplyHeader(new ProtocolHeader(provider.ProtocolId, supportedVersion), fail: true);
					return;
				}
				TransportBase transportBase = null;
				try
				{
					transportBase = provider.CreateTransport(args.Transport, isInitiator: false);
				}
				catch (InvalidOperationException ex)
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogError(this, "CreateTransport", ex.Message);
					WriteReplyHeader(ProtocolHeader.Amqp100, fail: true);
					return;
				}
				if (transportBase == args.Transport)
				{
					if ((parent.settings.RequireSecureTransport && !transportBase.IsSecure) || (!parent.settings.AllowAnonymousConnection && !transportBase.IsAuthenticated))
					{
						MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpInsecureTransport(parent, transportBase, transportBase.IsSecure, transportBase.IsAuthenticated);
						WriteReplyHeader(parent.settings.GetDefaultHeader(), fail: true);
					}
					else
					{
						args.UserToken = protocolHeader;
						parent.OnHandleTransportComplete(args);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpUpgradeTransport(this, args.Transport, transportBase);
					args.Transport = transportBase;
					WriteReplyHeader(protocolHeader, fail: false);
				}
			}

			private void HandleTransportOpened(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				args.Transport.EndOpen(result);
				bufferReader = new AsyncIO.AsyncBufferReader(args.Transport);
				bufferWriter = new AsyncIO.AsyncBufferWriter(args.Transport);
				ReadProtocolHeader();
			}

			private void WriteReplyHeader(ProtocolHeader header, bool fail)
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogOperation(this, TraceOperation.Send, header);
				ByteBuffer byteBuffer = new ByteBuffer(buffer);
				header.Encode(byteBuffer);
				args.SetBuffer(buffer, 0, buffer.Length);
				args.CompletedCallback = (fail ? null : writeCompleteCallback);
				bufferWriter.WriteBuffer(args);
				if (fail)
				{
					args.Exception = new NotSupportedException(header.ToString());
					parent.OnHandleTransportComplete(args);
				}
			}

			private static void OnWriteHeaderComplete(TransportAsyncCallbackArgs args)
			{
				TransportHandler transportHandler = (TransportHandler)args.UserToken;
				if (args.Exception != null)
				{
					transportHandler.parent.OnHandleTransportComplete(args);
					return;
				}
				try
				{
					IAsyncResult asyncResult = transportHandler.args.Transport.BeginOpen(transportHandler.timeoutHelper.RemainingTime(), onTransportOpened, transportHandler);
					if (asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
					{
						transportHandler.HandleTransportOpened(asyncResult);
					}
				}
				catch (Exception exception)
				{
					args.Exception = exception;
					transportHandler.parent.OnHandleTransportComplete(args);
				}
			}
		}

		private readonly List<TransportListener> innerListeners;

		private readonly AmqpSettings settings;

		public AmqpSettings AmqpSettings => settings;

		public AmqpTransportListener(IEnumerable<TransportListener> listeners, AmqpSettings settings)
			: base("tp-listener")
		{
			innerListeners = new List<TransportListener>(listeners);
			this.settings = settings;
		}

		public T Find<T>() where T : TransportListener
		{
			foreach (TransportListener innerListener in innerListeners)
			{
				if (typeof(T) == innerListener.GetType())
				{
					return (T)innerListener;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override void OnListen()
		{
			Action<TransportListener, TransportAsyncCallbackArgs> callback = OnAcceptTransport;
			EventHandler value = OnListenerClosed;
			foreach (TransportListener innerListener in innerListeners)
			{
				innerListener.Closed += value;
				innerListener.Listen(callback);
			}
		}

		protected override bool CloseInternal()
		{
			base.State = AmqpObjectState.CloseSent;
			TransportListener[] array = innerListeners.ToArray();
			foreach (TransportListener transportListener in array)
			{
				transportListener.Close();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override void AbortInternal()
		{
			base.State = AmqpObjectState.Faulted;
			TransportListener[] array = innerListeners.ToArray();
			foreach (TransportListener transportListener in array)
			{
				transportListener.Abort();
			}
		}

		private void OnListenerClosed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (!IsClosing())
			{
				TransportListener transportListener = (TransportListener)sender;
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogError(this, "OnListenerClosed", transportListener.ToString());
				SafeClose(transportListener.TerminalException);
			}
		}

		private void OnAcceptTransport(TransportListener innerListener, TransportAsyncCallbackArgs args)
		{
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogOperationVerbose(this, TraceOperation.Execute, "OnAcceptTransport");
			TransportHandler.SpawnHandler(this, innerListener, args);
		}

		private void OnHandleTransportComplete(TransportAsyncCallbackArgs args)
		{
			args.SetBuffer(null, 0, 0);
			args.CompletedCallback = null;
			if (args.Exception != null)
			{
				args.Transport.SafeClose(args.Exception);
			}
			else
			{
				OnTransportAccepted(args);
			}
		}
	}
	internal sealed class AmqpTransportProvider : TransportProvider
	{
		public AmqpTransportProvider()
		{
			base.ProtocolId = ProtocolId.Amqp;
		}

		protected override TransportBase OnCreateTransport(TransportBase innerTransport, bool isInitiator)
		{
			return innerTransport;
		}
	}
	internal sealed class TcpTransport : TransportBase
	{
		private sealed class WriteAsyncEventArgs : SocketAsyncEventArgs
		{
			private readonly TcpTransport transport;

			private readonly BufferSizeTracker writeTracker;

			private Timestamp startTime;

			private int bufferSize;

			public TransportAsyncCallbackArgs Args { get; set; }

			public WriteAsyncEventArgs(TcpTransport transport, int bufferSize)
			{
				this.transport = transport;
				this.bufferSize = bufferSize;
				if (bufferSize == 0)
				{
					writeTracker = new BufferSizeTracker(1024);
				}
				else
				{
					this.transport.socket.SendBufferSize = bufferSize;
				}
			}

			public void PrepareWrite(int writeSize)
			{
				startTime = Timestamp.Now;
				if (writeTracker != null && writeTracker.TryUpdateBufferSize(writeSize, out var newSize))
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpDynamicBufferSizeChange(transport, "write", bufferSize, newSize);
					bufferSize = newSize;
					transport.socket.SendBufferSize = Math.Max(1024, bufferSize);
				}
			}

			public void OnComplete(bool syncCompleted)
			{
				transport.HandleWriteComplete(Args, syncCompleted);
			}

			public void ReportWrite(ITransportMonitor monitor)
			{
				monitor.OnTransportWrite(bufferSize, base.BytesTransferred, 0L, startTime.ElapsedTicks);
			}

			public void Reset()
			{
				Args = null;
				SetBuffer(null, 0, 0);
				base.BufferList = null;
			}
		}

		private sealed class ReadAsyncEventArgs : SocketAsyncEventArgs
		{
			private readonly TcpTransport transport;

			private readonly BufferSizeTracker readTracker;

			private int bufferSize;

			private ArraySegment<byte> segment;

			private ByteBuffer readBuffer;

			private Timestamp startTime;

			private int cacheHits;

			public TransportAsyncCallbackArgs Args { get; set; }

			public bool IsSegment { get; set; }

			public ReadAsyncEventArgs(TcpTransport transport, int bufferSize)
			{
				this.transport = transport;
				this.bufferSize = bufferSize;
				segment = SmallBufferPool.TakeBuffer(8);
				if (bufferSize == 0)
				{
					readTracker = new BufferSizeTracker(512);
					return;
				}
				transport.socket.ReceiveBufferSize = bufferSize;
				readBuffer = new ByteBuffer(bufferSize, autoGrow: false, isTransportBuffer: true);
			}

			public ByteBuffer PrepareRead(int count)
			{
				if (readTracker != null && readTracker.TryUpdateBufferSize(count, out var newSize))
				{
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpDynamicBufferSizeChange(transport, "read", bufferSize, newSize);
					bufferSize = newSize;
					transport.socket.ReceiveBufferSize = Math.Max(1024, bufferSize);
				}
				ByteBuffer byteBuffer = readBuffer;
				if (byteBuffer == null)
				{
					startTime = Timestamp.Now;
					if (bufferSize > 0)
					{
						byteBuffer = (readBuffer = new ByteBuffer(bufferSize, autoGrow: false, isTransportBuffer: true));
					}
				}
				else if (byteBuffer.Length == 0)
				{
					startTime = Timestamp.Now;
					if (bufferSize == 0)
					{
						byteBuffer.Dispose();
						readBuffer = null;
						byteBuffer = null;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					cacheHits++;
				}
				return byteBuffer;
			}

			public void OnComplete(bool fromCache, bool completedSynchronously)
			{
				transport.HandleReadComplete(Args, fromCache, completedSynchronously);
			}

			public void ReportRead(ITransportMonitor monitor)
			{
				monitor.OnTransportRead(bufferSize, base.BytesTransferred, cacheHits, startTime.ElapsedTicks);
				cacheHits = 0;
			}

			public void SetReadBuffer(TransportAsyncCallbackArgs args)
			{
				if (args.Count <= SmallBufferPool.SegmentSize)
				{
					Fx.AssertAndThrow(segment.Array != null, "segment buffer already relaimed");
					SetBuffer(segment.Array, segment.Offset, args.Count);
					IsSegment = true;
				}
				else
				{
					SetBuffer(args.Buffer, args.Offset, args.Count);
				}
			}

			public void Reset()
			{
				IsSegment = false;
				Args = null;
				SetBuffer(null, 0, 0);
				base.UserToken = null;
			}

			public new void Dispose()
			{
				readBuffer?.Dispose();
				ArraySegment<byte> buffer = segment;
				if (buffer.Array != null)
				{
					segment = default(ArraySegment<byte>);
					SmallBufferPool.ReturnBuffer(buffer);
				}
				base.Dispose();
			}
		}

		private sealed class BufferSizeTracker
		{
			private static readonly long durationTicks = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(4.0).Ticks;

			private static readonly int[] thresholds = new int[3] { 0, 8192, 4194304 };

			private static readonly int[] bufferSizes = new int[3] { 0, 8192, 8192 };

			private readonly int unitSize;

			private DateTime firstOperation;

			private int transferedBytes;

			private sbyte level;

			private sbyte direction;

			public BufferSizeTracker(int unitSize)
			{
				this.unitSize = unitSize;
				firstOperation = DateTime.UtcNow;
			}

			public bool TryUpdateBufferSize(int bytes, out int bufferSize)
			{
				transferedBytes += Math.Max(bytes, unitSize);
				bufferSize = 0;
				int num = 0;
				bool result = false;
				DateTime utcNow = DateTime.UtcNow;
				if (utcNow.Ticks - firstOperation.Ticks >= durationTicks)
				{
					for (int num2 = thresholds.Length - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
					{
						if (transferedBytes >= thresholds[num2])
						{
							num = num2;
							break;
						}
					}
					if (num > level)
					{
						if (direction > 0)
						{
							level++;
							bufferSize = bufferSizes[level];
							result = true;
						}
						else
						{
							direction = 1;
						}
					}
					else if (num < level)
					{
						if (direction < 0)
						{
							level--;
							bufferSize = bufferSizes[level];
							result = true;
						}
						else
						{
							direction = -1;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						direction = 0;
					}
					transferedBytes = 0;
					firstOperation = utcNow;
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		private const int MinSocketBufferSize = 1024;

		private static readonly SegmentBufferPool SmallBufferPool = new SegmentBufferPool(8, 100000);

		private static readonly EventHandler<SocketAsyncEventArgs> onWriteComplete = OnWriteComplete;

		private static readonly EventHandler<SocketAsyncEventArgs> onReadComplete = OnReadComplete;

		private readonly Socket socket;

		private readonly EndPoint localEndPoint;

		private readonly EndPoint remoteEndPoint;

		private readonly WriteAsyncEventArgs sendEventArgs;

		private readonly ReadAsyncEventArgs receiveEventArgs;

		private ITransportMonitor monitor;

		public override EndPoint LocalEndPoint => localEndPoint;

		public override EndPoint RemoteEndPoint => remoteEndPoint;

		public TcpTransport(Socket socket, TcpTransportSettings transportSettings)
			: base("tcp")
		{
			this.socket = socket;
			this.socket.NoDelay = true;
			localEndPoint = this.socket.LocalEndPoint;
			remoteEndPoint = this.socket.RemoteEndPoint;
			sendEventArgs = new WriteAsyncEventArgs(this, transportSettings.SendBufferSize);
			sendEventArgs.Completed += onWriteComplete;
			receiveEventArgs = new ReadAsyncEventArgs(this, transportSettings.ReceiveBufferSize);
			receiveEventArgs.Completed += onReadComplete;
		}

		public override void SetMonitor(ITransportMonitor monitor)
		{
			this.monitor = monitor;
		}

		public sealed override bool WriteAsync(TransportAsyncCallbackArgs args)
		{
			sendEventArgs.PrepareWrite(args.Count);
			if (args.Buffer != null)
			{
				sendEventArgs.SetBuffer(args.Buffer, args.Offset, args.Count);
			}
			else
			{
				ArraySegment<byte>[] array = new ArraySegment<byte>[args.ByteBufferList.Count];
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					array[i] = new ArraySegment<byte>(args.ByteBufferList[i].Buffer, args.ByteBufferList[i].Offset, args.ByteBufferList[i].Length);
				}
				sendEventArgs.BufferList = array;
			}
			sendEventArgs.Args = args;
			if (!socket.SendAsync(sendEventArgs))
			{
				HandleWriteComplete(args, syncCompleted: true);
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public sealed override bool ReadAsync(TransportAsyncCallbackArgs args)
		{
			ByteBuffer byteBuffer = receiveEventArgs.PrepareRead(args.Count);
			if (byteBuffer != null)
			{
				receiveEventArgs.UserToken = byteBuffer.AddReference();
				if (byteBuffer.Length > 0)
				{
					HandleReadComplete(args, fromCache: true, completedSynchronously: true);
					return false;
				}
				receiveEventArgs.SetBuffer(byteBuffer.Buffer, byteBuffer.Offset, byteBuffer.Size);
			}
			else
			{
				receiveEventArgs.SetReadBuffer(args);
			}
			receiveEventArgs.Args = args;
			bool flag;
			try
			{
				flag = socket.ReceiveAsync(receiveEventArgs);
			}
			catch
			{
				byteBuffer?.Dispose();
				throw;
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				HandleReadComplete(args, fromCache: false, completedSynchronously: true);
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool CloseInternal()
		{
			try
			{
				socket.Shutdown(SocketShutdown.Both);
				socket.Close();
			}
			finally
			{
				sendEventArgs.Dispose();
				receiveEventArgs.Dispose();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override void AbortInternal()
		{
			socket.Close(0);
			sendEventArgs.Dispose();
			receiveEventArgs.Dispose();
		}

		private static void OnWriteComplete(object sender, SocketAsyncEventArgs socketArgs)
		{
			WriteAsyncEventArgs e = (WriteAsyncEventArgs)socketArgs;
			e.OnComplete(syncCompleted: false);
		}

		private static void OnReadComplete(object sender, SocketAsyncEventArgs socketArgs)
		{
			ReadAsyncEventArgs e = (ReadAsyncEventArgs)socketArgs;
			e.OnComplete(fromCache: false, completedSynchronously: false);
		}

		private void HandleWriteComplete(TransportAsyncCallbackArgs args, bool syncCompleted)
		{
			if (sendEventArgs.SocketError == SocketError.Success)
			{
				args.BytesTransfered = sendEventArgs.BytesTransferred;
				args.Exception = null;
				if (monitor != null)
				{
					sendEventArgs.ReportWrite(monitor);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				args.Exception = new SocketException((int)sendEventArgs.SocketError);
			}
			args.CompletedSynchronously = syncCompleted;
			try
			{
				sendEventArgs.Reset();
			}
			catch (ObjectDisposedException exception)
			{
				args.Exception = exception;
			}
			if (!syncCompleted)
			{
				args.CompletedCallback(args);
			}
		}

		private void HandleReadComplete(TransportAsyncCallbackArgs args, bool fromCache, bool completedSynchronously)
		{
			ByteBuffer byteBuffer = receiveEventArgs.UserToken as ByteBuffer;
			try
			{
				if (receiveEventArgs.SocketError == SocketError.Success)
				{
					int num = 0;
					if (receiveEventArgs.IsSegment)
					{
						num = receiveEventArgs.BytesTransferred;
						Buffer.BlockCopy(receiveEventArgs.Buffer, receiveEventArgs.Offset, args.Buffer, args.Offset, num);
					}
					else if (byteBuffer != null)
					{
						int num2;
						if (fromCache)
						{
							num2 = byteBuffer.Length;
						}
						else
						{
							num2 = receiveEventArgs.BytesTransferred;
							byteBuffer.Append(num2);
							if (monitor != null)
							{
								receiveEventArgs.ReportRead(monitor);
							}
						}
						if (num2 > 0)
						{
							if (num2 <= args.Count)
							{
								num = num2;
								Buffer.BlockCopy(byteBuffer.Buffer, byteBuffer.Offset, args.Buffer, args.Offset, num2);
								byteBuffer.Reset();
							}
							else
							{
								num = args.Count;
								Buffer.BlockCopy(byteBuffer.Buffer, byteBuffer.Offset, args.Buffer, args.Offset, num);
								byteBuffer.Complete(num);
							}
						}
					}
					else
					{
						num = receiveEventArgs.BytesTransferred;
					}
					args.BytesTransfered = num;
					args.Exception = null;
				}
				else
				{
					args.Exception = new SocketException((int)receiveEventArgs.SocketError);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				args.Exception = exception;
			}
			finally
			{
				byteBuffer?.Dispose();
			}
			args.CompletedSynchronously = completedSynchronously;
			try
			{
				receiveEventArgs.Reset();
			}
			catch (ObjectDisposedException exception2)
			{
				args.Exception = exception2;
			}
			if (!completedSynchronously)
			{
				args.CompletedCallback(args);
			}
		}
	}
	internal sealed class TcpTransportInitiator : TransportInitiator
	{
		private readonly TcpTransportSettings transportSettings;

		private TransportAsyncCallbackArgs callbackArgs;

		internal TcpTransportInitiator(TcpTransportSettings transportSettings)
		{
			this.transportSettings = transportSettings;
		}

		public override bool ConnectAsync(TimeSpan timeout, TransportAsyncCallbackArgs callbackArgs)
		{
			this.callbackArgs = callbackArgs;
			DnsEndPoint remoteEndPoint = new DnsEndPoint(transportSettings.Host, transportSettings.Port);
			SocketAsyncEventArgs e = new SocketAsyncEventArgs();
			e.Completed += OnConnectComplete;
			e.RemoteEndPoint = remoteEndPoint;
			e.UserToken = this;
			if (Socket.ConnectAsync(SocketType.Stream, ProtocolType.Tcp, e))
			{
				return true;
			}
			Complete(e, completeSynchronously: true);
			return false;
		}

		private static void OnConnectComplete(object sender, SocketAsyncEventArgs e)
		{
			TcpTransportInitiator tcpTransportInitiator = (TcpTransportInitiator)e.UserToken;
			tcpTransportInitiator.Complete(e, completeSynchronously: false);
		}

		private void Complete(SocketAsyncEventArgs e, bool completeSynchronously)
		{
			TransportBase transportBase = null;
			Exception exception = null;
			if (e.SocketError != SocketError.Success)
			{
				exception = new SocketException((int)e.SocketError);
				if (e.AcceptSocket != null)
				{
					e.AcceptSocket.Close(0);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				try
				{
					e.ConnectSocket.NoDelay = true;
					transportBase = new TcpTransport(e.ConnectSocket, transportSettings);
					transportBase.Open();
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
					{
						throw;
					}
					exception = ex;
					transportBase?.SafeClose();
					transportBase = null;
				}
			}
			e.Dispose();
			callbackArgs.CompletedSynchronously = completeSynchronously;
			callbackArgs.Exception = exception;
			callbackArgs.Transport = transportBase;
			if (!completeSynchronously)
			{
				callbackArgs.CompletedCallback(callbackArgs);
			}
		}
	}
	internal sealed class TcpTransportListener : TransportListener
	{
		private readonly Action<object> acceptTransportLoop;

		private readonly TcpTransportSettings transportSettings;

		private Socket[] listenSockets;

		public TcpTransportListener(TcpTransportSettings transportSettings)
			: base("tcp-listener")
		{
			acceptTransportLoop = AcceptTransportLoop;
			this.transportSettings = transportSettings;
		}

		protected override bool CloseInternal()
		{
			CloseOrAbortListenSockets(abort: false);
			return true;
		}

		protected override void AbortInternal()
		{
			CloseOrAbortListenSockets(abort: true);
		}

		protected override void OnListen()
		{
			string host = transportSettings.Host;
			List<IPAddress> list = new List<IPAddress>();
			IPAddress address;
			if (host.Equals(string.Empty))
			{
				list.AddRange(Dns.GetHostAddresses(host));
			}
			else if (host.Equals("localhost", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || host.Equals(Environment.MachineName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || host.Equals(Dns.GetHostEntry(string.Empty).HostName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				if (Socket.OSSupportsIPv4)
				{
					list.Add(IPAddress.Any);
				}
				if (Socket.OSSupportsIPv6)
				{
					list.Add(IPAddress.IPv6Any);
				}
			}
			else if (IPAddress.TryParse(host, out address))
			{
				list.Add(address);
			}
			else
			{
				list.AddRange(Dns.GetHostAddresses(transportSettings.Host));
			}
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(SRAmqp.AmqpNoValidAddressForHost(transportSettings.Host));
			}
			listenSockets = new Socket[list.Count];
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				listenSockets[i] = new Socket(list[i].AddressFamily, SocketType.Stream, ProtocolType.Tcp)
				{
					NoDelay = true
				};
				listenSockets[i].Bind(new IPEndPoint(list[i], transportSettings.Port));
				listenSockets[i].Listen(transportSettings.TcpBacklog);
				for (int j = 0; j < transportSettings.ListenerAcceptorCount; j++)
				{
					SocketAsyncEventArgs e = new SocketAsyncEventArgs();
					e.Completed += OnAcceptComplete;
					e.UserToken = listenSockets[i];
					ActionItem.Schedule(acceptTransportLoop, e);
				}
			}
		}

		private void CloseOrAbortListenSockets(bool abort)
		{
			if (listenSockets == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < listenSockets.Length; i++)
			{
				Socket socket = listenSockets[i];
				listenSockets[i] = null;
				if (socket != null)
				{
					if (abort)
					{
						socket.Close(0);
					}
					else
					{
						socket.Close();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void AcceptTransportLoop(object state)
		{
			SocketAsyncEventArgs e = (SocketAsyncEventArgs)state;
			Socket socket = (Socket)e.UserToken;
			while (base.State != AmqpObjectState.End)
			{
				try
				{
					e.AcceptSocket = null;
					if (socket.AcceptAsync(e) || !HandleAcceptComplete(e, completedSynchronously: true))
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				catch (SocketException ex)
				{
					if (!ShouldRetryAccept(ex.SocketErrorCode))
					{
						e.Dispose();
						SafeClose(ex);
						break;
					}
				}
				catch (Exception ex2)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(ex2))
					{
						throw;
					}
					MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpListenSocketAcceptError(this, willRetry: false, ex2.Message);
					e.Dispose();
					SafeClose(ex2);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnAcceptComplete(object sender, SocketAsyncEventArgs e)
		{
			if (HandleAcceptComplete(e, completedSynchronously: false))
			{
				AcceptTransportLoop(e);
			}
		}

		private bool HandleAcceptComplete(SocketAsyncEventArgs e, bool completedSynchronously)
		{
			if (e.SocketError == SocketError.Success)
			{
				TcpTransport tcpTransport = new TcpTransport(e.AcceptSocket, transportSettings);
				tcpTransport.Open();
				TransportAsyncCallbackArgs transportAsyncCallbackArgs = new TransportAsyncCallbackArgs();
				transportAsyncCallbackArgs.Transport = tcpTransport;
				transportAsyncCallbackArgs.CompletedSynchronously = completedSynchronously;
				OnTransportAccepted(transportAsyncCallbackArgs);
				return true;
			}
			bool flag = ShouldRetryAccept(e.SocketError);
			if (!flag)
			{
				e.Dispose();
				SafeClose(new SocketException((int)e.SocketError));
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private bool ShouldRetryAccept(SocketError error)
		{
			if (error == SocketError.OperationAborted)
			{
				return false;
			}
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpListenSocketAcceptError(this, willRetry: true, error.ToString());
			return true;
		}
	}
	internal sealed class TcpTransportSettings : TransportSettings
	{
		private const int DefaultTcpBacklog = 200;

		private const int DefaultTcpAcceptorCount = 1;

		public string Host { get; set; }

		public int Port { get; set; }

		public int TcpBacklog { get; set; }

		public TcpTransportSettings()
		{
			TcpBacklog = 200;
			base.ListenerAcceptorCount = 1;
		}

		public override TransportInitiator CreateInitiator()
		{
			return new TcpTransportInitiator(this);
		}

		public override TransportListener CreateListener()
		{
			return new TcpTransportListener(this);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}:{1}", Host, Port);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class TlsTransport : TransportBase
	{
		private struct OperationState
		{
			public TransportAsyncCallbackArgs Args;

			public ByteBuffer Buffer;

			public void Reset()
			{
				Args = null;
				Buffer = null;
			}
		}

		private static readonly AsyncCallback onOpenComplete = OnOpenComplete;

		private static readonly AsyncCallback onWriteComplete = OnWriteComplete;

		private static readonly AsyncCallback onReadComplete = OnReadComplete;

		private readonly TransportBase innerTransport;

		private readonly CustomSslStream sslStream;

		private TlsTransportSettings tlsSettings;

		private OperationState writeState;

		private OperationState readState;

		public override EndPoint LocalEndPoint => innerTransport.LocalEndPoint;

		public override EndPoint RemoteEndPoint => innerTransport.RemoteEndPoint;

		public override bool IsSecure => true;

		public override SslStateInfo SslStateInfo => sslStream.SslStateInfo;

		public TlsTransport(TransportBase innerTransport, TlsTransportSettings tlsSettings)
			: base("tls", innerTransport.Identifier)
		{
			this.innerTransport = innerTransport;
			this.tlsSettings = tlsSettings;
			sslStream = ((tlsSettings.CertificateValidationCallback == null) ? new CustomSslStream(new TransportStream(this.innerTransport), leaveInnerStreamOpen: false, tlsSettings.IsInitiator) : new CustomSslStream(new TransportStream(this.innerTransport), leaveInnerStreamOpen: false, tlsSettings.CertificateValidationCallback, tlsSettings.IsInitiator));
		}

		public override void SetMonitor(ITransportMonitor usageMeter)
		{
			innerTransport.SetMonitor(usageMeter);
		}

		public override bool WriteAsync(TransportAsyncCallbackArgs args)
		{
			ArraySegment<byte> arraySegment;
			if (args.Buffer != null)
			{
				arraySegment = new ArraySegment<byte>(args.Buffer, args.Offset, args.Count);
				writeState.Args = args;
			}
			else if (args.ByteBufferList.Count == 1)
			{
				ByteBuffer byteBuffer = args.ByteBufferList[0];
				arraySegment = new ArraySegment<byte>(byteBuffer.Buffer, byteBuffer.Offset, byteBuffer.Length);
				writeState.Args = args;
			}
			else
			{
				ByteBuffer byteBuffer2 = new ByteBuffer(args.Count, autoGrow: false, isTransportBuffer: false);
				for (int i = 0; i < args.ByteBufferList.Count; i++)
				{
					ByteBuffer byteBuffer3 = args.ByteBufferList[i];
					Buffer.BlockCopy(byteBuffer3.Buffer, byteBuffer3.Offset, byteBuffer2.Buffer, byteBuffer2.Length, byteBuffer3.Length);
					byteBuffer2.Append(byteBuffer3.Length);
				}
				arraySegment = new ArraySegment<byte>(byteBuffer2.Buffer, 0, byteBuffer2.Length);
				writeState.Args = args;
				writeState.Buffer = byteBuffer2;
			}
			IAsyncResult asyncResult = sslStream.BeginWrite(arraySegment.Array, arraySegment.Offset, arraySegment.Count, onWriteComplete, this);
			bool completedSynchronously = asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously;
			if (completedSynchronously)
			{
				HandleOperationComplete(asyncResult, write: true, syncComplete: true);
			}
			return !completedSynchronously;
		}

		public override bool ReadAsync(TransportAsyncCallbackArgs args)
		{
			readState.Args = args;
			IAsyncResult asyncResult = sslStream.BeginRead(args.Buffer, args.Offset, args.Count, onReadComplete, this);
			bool completedSynchronously = asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously;
			if (completedSynchronously)
			{
				HandleOperationComplete(asyncResult, write: false, syncComplete: true);
			}
			return !completedSynchronously;
		}

		protected override bool OpenInternal()
		{
			IAsyncResult asyncResult;
			if (tlsSettings.IsInitiator)
			{
				bool checkCertificateRevocation = false;
				X509CertificateCollection x509CertificateCollection = new X509CertificateCollection();
				if (tlsSettings.Certificate != null)
				{
					x509CertificateCollection.Add(tlsSettings.Certificate);
					checkCertificateRevocation = true;
				}
				asyncResult = sslStream.BeginAuthenticateAsClient(tlsSettings.TargetHost, x509CertificateCollection, tlsSettings.Protocols, checkCertificateRevocation, onOpenComplete, this);
			}
			else
			{
				bool flag = tlsSettings.CertificateValidationCallback != null;
				asyncResult = sslStream.BeginAuthenticateAsServer(tlsSettings.Certificate, flag, tlsSettings.Protocols, flag, onOpenComplete, this);
			}
			bool completedSynchronously = asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously;
			if (completedSynchronously)
			{
				HandleOpenComplete(asyncResult, syncComplete: true);
			}
			return completedSynchronously;
		}

		protected override bool CloseInternal()
		{
			sslStream.Close();
			return true;
		}

		protected override void AbortInternal()
		{
			innerTransport.Abort();
		}

		private static void OnOpenComplete(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (!result.CompletedSynchronously)
			{
				TlsTransport tlsTransport = (TlsTransport)result.AsyncState;
				tlsTransport.HandleOpenComplete(result, syncComplete: false);
			}
		}

		private static void OnReadComplete(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (!result.CompletedSynchronously)
			{
				TlsTransport tlsTransport = (TlsTransport)result.AsyncState;
				tlsTransport.HandleOperationComplete(result, write: false, syncComplete: false);
			}
		}

		private static void OnWriteComplete(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (!result.CompletedSynchronously)
			{
				TlsTransport tlsTransport = (TlsTransport)result.AsyncState;
				tlsTransport.HandleOperationComplete(result, write: true, syncComplete: false);
			}
		}

		private void HandleOpenComplete(IAsyncResult result, bool syncComplete)
		{
			Exception exception = null;
			try
			{
				bool isInitiator = tlsSettings.IsInitiator;
				tlsSettings = null;
				if (isInitiator)
				{
					sslStream.EndAuthenticateAsClient(result);
				}
				else
				{
					sslStream.EndAuthenticateAsServer(result);
					if (sslStream.RequireMutualAuthentication && sslStream.IsRemoteCertificateValid && sslStream.RemoteCertificate != null)
					{
						base.Principal = new GenericPrincipal(new GenericIdentity(sslStream.RemoteCertificate.Subject), null);
					}
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(ex) || syncComplete)
				{
					throw;
				}
				exception = ex;
			}
			if (!syncComplete)
			{
				CompleteOpen(syncComplete: false, exception);
			}
		}

		private void HandleOperationComplete(IAsyncResult result, bool write, bool syncComplete)
		{
			TransportAsyncCallbackArgs transportAsyncCallbackArgs = null;
			try
			{
				if (write)
				{
					transportAsyncCallbackArgs = writeState.Args;
					ByteBuffer buffer = writeState.Buffer;
					writeState.Reset();
					buffer?.Dispose();
					sslStream.EndWrite(result);
					transportAsyncCallbackArgs.BytesTransfered = transportAsyncCallbackArgs.Count;
				}
				else
				{
					transportAsyncCallbackArgs = readState.Args;
					readState.Reset();
					transportAsyncCallbackArgs.BytesTransfered = sslStream.EndRead(result);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				transportAsyncCallbackArgs.Exception = exception;
			}
			transportAsyncCallbackArgs.CompletedSynchronously = syncComplete;
			if (!syncComplete)
			{
				Action<TransportAsyncCallbackArgs> completedCallback = transportAsyncCallbackArgs.CompletedCallback;
				if (completedCallback != null)
				{
					transportAsyncCallbackArgs.CompletedCallback(transportAsyncCallbackArgs);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal sealed class TlsTransportInitiator : TransportInitiator
	{
		private static readonly AsyncCallback onTransportOpened = OnTransportOpened;

		private TlsTransportSettings transportSettings;

		private TransportAsyncCallbackArgs callbackArgs;

		private TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper;

		public TlsTransportInitiator(TlsTransportSettings transportSettings)
		{
			this.transportSettings = transportSettings;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "tls-initiator";
		}

		public override bool ConnectAsync(TimeSpan timeout, TransportAsyncCallbackArgs callbackArgs)
		{
			this.callbackArgs = callbackArgs;
			timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateOnly(timeout);
			TransportInitiator transportInitiator = transportSettings.InnerTransportSettings.CreateInitiator();
			TransportAsyncCallbackArgs transportAsyncCallbackArgs = new TransportAsyncCallbackArgs();
			transportAsyncCallbackArgs.CompletedCallback = OnInnerTransportConnected;
			transportAsyncCallbackArgs.UserToken = this;
			if (transportInitiator.ConnectAsync(timeout, transportAsyncCallbackArgs))
			{
				return true;
			}
			HandleInnerTransportConnected(transportAsyncCallbackArgs);
			return !this.callbackArgs.CompletedSynchronously;
		}

		private static void OnInnerTransportConnected(TransportAsyncCallbackArgs innerArgs)
		{
			TlsTransportInitiator tlsTransportInitiator = (TlsTransportInitiator)innerArgs.UserToken;
			tlsTransportInitiator.HandleInnerTransportConnected(innerArgs);
		}

		private static void OnTransportOpened(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (result.CompletedSynchronously)
			{
				return;
			}
			TlsTransportInitiator tlsTransportInitiator = (TlsTransportInitiator)result.AsyncState;
			try
			{
				tlsTransportInitiator.HandleTransportOpened(result);
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				tlsTransportInitiator.callbackArgs.Exception = exception;
			}
			tlsTransportInitiator.Complete();
		}

		private void HandleInnerTransportConnected(TransportAsyncCallbackArgs innerArgs)
		{
			callbackArgs.CompletedSynchronously = innerArgs.CompletedSynchronously;
			if (innerArgs.Exception != null)
			{
				callbackArgs.Exception = innerArgs.Exception;
				Complete();
				return;
			}
			callbackArgs.Transport = new TlsTransport(innerArgs.Transport, transportSettings);
			try
			{
				IAsyncResult asyncResult = callbackArgs.Transport.BeginOpen(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime(), onTransportOpened, this);
				if (asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
				{
					HandleTransportOpened(asyncResult);
					Complete();
				}
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				callbackArgs.Exception = exception;
				Complete();
			}
		}

		private void HandleTransportOpened(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			callbackArgs.Transport.EndOpen(result);
			if (callbackArgs.CompletedSynchronously)
			{
				callbackArgs.CompletedSynchronously = result.CompletedSynchronously;
			}
		}

		private void Complete()
		{
			if (callbackArgs.Exception != null && callbackArgs.Transport != null)
			{
				callbackArgs.Transport.SafeClose(callbackArgs.Exception);
				callbackArgs.Transport = null;
			}
			if (!callbackArgs.CompletedSynchronously)
			{
				callbackArgs.CompletedCallback(callbackArgs);
			}
		}
	}
	internal sealed class TlsTransportListener : TransportListener
	{
		private readonly AsyncCallback onTransportOpened;

		private readonly TlsTransportSettings transportSettings;

		private TransportListener innerListener;

		public TlsTransportListener(TlsTransportSettings transportSettings)
			: base("tls-listener")
		{
			this.transportSettings = transportSettings;
			onTransportOpened = OnTransportOpened;
		}

		protected override bool CloseInternal()
		{
			if (innerListener != null)
			{
				innerListener.Close();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override void AbortInternal()
		{
			if (innerListener != null)
			{
				innerListener.Abort();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnListen()
		{
			TransportSettings innerTransportSettings = transportSettings.InnerTransportSettings;
			innerListener = innerTransportSettings.CreateListener();
			innerListener.Closed += OnInnerListenerClosed;
			innerListener.Listen(OnAcceptInnerTransport);
		}

		private void OnInnerListenerClosed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (!IsClosing())
			{
				TransportListener transportListener = (TransportListener)sender;
				SafeClose(transportListener.TerminalException);
			}
		}

		private void OnAcceptInnerTransport(TransportListener innerListener, TransportAsyncCallbackArgs innerArgs)
		{
			MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteAmqpLogOperation(this, TraceOperation.Accept, innerArgs.Transport);
			try
			{
				innerArgs.Transport = new TlsTransport(innerArgs.Transport, transportSettings);
				IAsyncResult asyncResult = innerArgs.Transport.BeginOpen(innerArgs.Transport.DefaultOpenTimeout, onTransportOpened, innerArgs);
				if (asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
				{
					HandleTransportOpened(asyncResult);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				innerArgs.Transport.SafeClose(exception);
			}
		}

		private void OnTransportOpened(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (result.CompletedSynchronously)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				HandleTransportOpened(result);
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				TransportAsyncCallbackArgs transportAsyncCallbackArgs = (TransportAsyncCallbackArgs)result.AsyncState;
				transportAsyncCallbackArgs.Transport.SafeClose(exception);
			}
		}

		private void HandleTransportOpened(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			TransportAsyncCallbackArgs transportAsyncCallbackArgs = (TransportAsyncCallbackArgs)result.AsyncState;
			transportAsyncCallbackArgs.Transport.EndOpen(result);
			if (transportAsyncCallbackArgs.CompletedSynchronously)
			{
				transportAsyncCallbackArgs.CompletedSynchronously = result.CompletedSynchronously;
			}
			OnTransportAccepted(transportAsyncCallbackArgs);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class TlsTransportProvider : TransportProvider
	{
		private TlsTransportSettings tlsSettings;

		public TlsTransportSettings Settings => tlsSettings;

		public TlsTransportProvider(TlsTransportSettings tlsSettings)
		{
			this.tlsSettings = tlsSettings;
			base.ProtocolId = ProtocolId.AmqpTls;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "tls-provider";
		}

		protected override TransportBase OnCreateTransport(TransportBase innerTransport, bool isInitiator)
		{
			if (innerTransport.GetType() != typeof(TcpTransport))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(SRAmqp.AmqpTransportUpgradeNotAllowed(innerTransport.GetType().Name, typeof(TlsTransport).Name));
			}
			return new TlsTransport(innerTransport, tlsSettings);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class TlsTransportSettings : TransportSettings
	{
		private const SslProtocols DefaultSslProtocols = SslProtocols.Tls | SslProtocols.Tls11 | SslProtocols.Tls12;

		private readonly TransportSettings innerSettings;

		public bool IsInitiator { get; set; }

		public string TargetHost { get; set; }

		public SslProtocols Protocols { get; set; }

		public X509Certificate2 Certificate { get; set; }

		public TransportSettings InnerTransportSettings => innerSettings;

		public RemoteCertificateValidationCallback CertificateValidationCallback { get; set; }

		public TlsTransportSettings()
			: this(null, isInitiator: true)
		{
		}

		public TlsTransportSettings(TransportSettings innerSettings)
			: this(innerSettings, isInitiator: true)
		{
		}

		public TlsTransportSettings(TransportSettings innerSettings, bool isInitiator)
		{
			Protocols = SslProtocols.Tls | SslProtocols.Tls11 | SslProtocols.Tls12;
			this.innerSettings = innerSettings;
			IsInitiator = isInitiator;
		}

		public override TransportInitiator CreateInitiator()
		{
			if (TargetHost == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.TargetHostNotSet);
			}
			return new TlsTransportInitiator(this);
		}

		public override TransportListener CreateListener()
		{
			if (Certificate == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.ServerCertificateNotSet);
			}
			return new TlsTransportListener(this);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return innerSettings.ToString();
		}
	}
	internal sealed class TransportAsyncCallbackArgs : IAsyncResult
	{
		public byte[] Buffer { get; private set; }

		public int Offset { get; private set; }

		public int Count { get; private set; }

		public ByteBuffer ByteBuffer { get; private set; }

		public IList<ByteBuffer> ByteBufferList { get; private set; }

		public Action<TransportAsyncCallbackArgs> CompletedCallback { get; set; }

		public object UserToken2 { get; set; }

		{
			get
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
		}

		bool IAsyncResult.CompletedSynchronously => CompletedSynchronously;

		bool IAsyncResult.IsCompleted => BytesTransfered == Count;

		public void SetBuffer(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)
		{
			Buffer = buffer;
			Offset = offset;
			Count = count;
			ByteBuffer = null;
			ByteBufferList = null;
		}

		public void SetWriteBuffer(ByteBuffer byteBuffer)
		{
			SetBuffer(byteBuffer.Buffer, byteBuffer.Offset, byteBuffer.Length);
			ByteBuffer = byteBuffer;
		}

		public void SetReadBuffer(ByteBuffer byteBuffer)
		{
			SetBuffer(byteBuffer.Buffer, byteBuffer.WritePos, byteBuffer.Size);
			ByteBuffer = byteBuffer;
		}

		public void SetBuffer(IList<ByteBuffer> byteBufferList)
		{
			SetBuffer(null, 0, 0);
			ByteBufferList = byteBufferList;
			Count = 0;
			foreach (ByteBuffer byteBuffer in byteBufferList)
			{
				Count += byteBuffer.Length;
			}
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			if (ByteBuffer != null)
			{
				ByteBuffer.Dispose();
			}
			else if (ByteBufferList != null)
			{
				foreach (ByteBuffer byteBuffer in ByteBufferList)
				{
					byteBuffer.Dispose();
				}
			}
			SetBuffer(null, 0, 0);
			UserToken = null;
			BytesTransfered = 0;
			Exception = null;
		}

		{

			}
			else
			{
				NotifyAccept(args);
			}
		}

		{
			get

				{
					throw new ArgumentException(SRAmqp.AmqpProtocolVersionNotSet(this));
				}
				return Versions[0];
			}
		}

		public bool TryGetVersion(AmqpVersion requestedVersion, out AmqpVersion supportedVersion)
		{
			supportedVersion = DefaultVersion;
			foreach (AmqpVersion version in Versions)
			{
				if (version.Equals(requestedVersion))
				{
					supportedVersion = requestedVersion;
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

			dataType.Disposable = typeof(IDisposable).IsAssignableFrom(type);

			return dataType;

	internal static class SerializationHelper
	{
		private sealed class DataContractTypeResolver : ITypeResolver
		{
			SerializableType ITypeResolver.Resolve(Type type)
			{
				return CompileDataContract(type);
			}

			SerializableType ITypeResolver.Resolve(ulong code, string name)
			{
				return null;
			}
		}

		private static readonly AmqpContractSerializer serializer = new AmqpContractSerializer(new DataContractTypeResolver());

		public static void GetParameters(this MethodInfo mi, int ignoreCount, out ParameterAttribute[] attributes, out DataType[] paramTypes)
		{
			ParameterInfo[] parameters = mi.GetParameters();
			int num = parameters.Length - ignoreCount;
			attributes = new ParameterAttribute[num];
			paramTypes = new DataType[num];
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				if (parameters[i].ParameterType.IsGenericParameter)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException("Generic parameter not supported for " + parameters[i].Name);
				}
				ParameterAttribute parameterAttribute = parameters[i].GetCustomAttribute<ParameterAttribute>();
				if (parameterAttribute == null)
				{
					parameterAttribute = new ParameterAttribute();
				}
				if (parameterAttribute.Name == null)
				{
					parameterAttribute.Name = parameters[i].Name;
				}
				attributes[i] = parameterAttribute;
				paramTypes[i] = DataType.Wrap(parameters[i].ParameterType);
			}
			if (attributes.Where((ParameterAttribute p) => p.Location == Location.MapBody).Any() && attributes.Where((ParameterAttribute p) => p.Location == Location.ValueBody).Any())
			{
				throw new SerializationException("Cannot have both MapBody and ValueBody for parameters in method " + mi.Name);
			}
			if (attributes.Where((ParameterAttribute p) => p.Location == Location.ValueBody).Count() > 1)
			{
				throw new SerializationException("Cannot have more than one ValueBody params in method " + mi.Name);
			}
		}

		public static SerializableType GetSerializable(Type type)
		{
			return serializer.GetType(type);
		}

		public static object ToAmqp(SerializableType serializable, object value)
		{
			if (value == null || serializable.AmqpType == AmqpType.Primitive)
			{
				return value;
			}
			if (serializable.AmqpType == AmqpType.List)
			{
				SerializableType.List list = (SerializableType.List)serializable;
				List<object> list2 = new List<object>();
				{
					foreach (object item in (IEnumerable)value)
					{
						list2.Add(ToAmqp(list.ItemType, item));
					}
					return list2;
				}
			}
			if (serializable.AmqpType == AmqpType.Map)
			{
				SerializableType.Map map = (SerializableType.Map)serializable;
				AmqpMap amqpMap = new AmqpMap();
				{
					foreach (object item2 in (IEnumerable)value)
					{
						object key = map.Key.Get(item2);
						object obj = map.Value.Get(item2);
						amqpMap[key] = ((obj == null) ? obj : ToAmqp(serializer.GetType(obj.GetType()), obj));
					}
					return amqpMap;
				}
			}
			if (serializable.AmqpType == AmqpType.Converted)
			{
				return ((SerializableType.Converted)serializable).GetTarget(value);
			}
			if (serializable.AmqpType == AmqpType.Composite)
			{
				SerializableType.Composite composite = (SerializableType.Composite)serializer.GetType(value.GetType());
				AmqpMap amqpMap2 = new AmqpMap();
				amqpMap2["type"] = composite.Name.Value;
				SerialiableMember[] members = composite.Members;
				foreach (SerialiableMember serialiableMember in members)
				{
					amqpMap2[serialiableMember.Name] = ToAmqp(serialiableMember.Type, serialiableMember.Accessor.Get(value));
				}
				return amqpMap2;
			}
			return value;
		}

		public static object FromAmqp(SerializableType serializable, object value)
		{
			if (value == null || serializable.AmqpType == AmqpType.Primitive)
			{
				return value;
			}
			if (serializable.AmqpType == AmqpType.List)
			{
				SerializableType.List list = (SerializableType.List)serializable;
				object obj = list.CreateInstance();
				{
					foreach (object item in (IEnumerable)value)
					{
						list.Add.Invoke(obj, new object[1] { FromAmqp(list.ItemType, item) });
					}
					return obj;
				}
			}
			if (serializable.AmqpType == AmqpType.Map)
			{
				SerializableType.Map map = (SerializableType.Map)serializable;
				AmqpMap amqpMap = (AmqpMap)value;
				object obj2 = map.CreateInstance();
				{
					foreach (KeyValuePair<object, object> item2 in amqpMap)
					{
						object obj3 = ((item2.Value == null) ? item2.Value : FromAmqp(serializer.GetType(item2.Value.GetType()), item2.Value));
						map.Add.Invoke(obj2, new object[2] { item2.Key, obj3 });
					}
					return obj2;
				}
			}
			if (serializable.AmqpType == AmqpType.Converted)
			{
				return ((SerializableType.Converted)serializable).GetSource(value);
			}
			if (serializable.AmqpType == AmqpType.Composite)
			{
				SerializableType.Composite composite = (SerializableType.Composite)serializable;
				AmqpMap amqpMap2 = (AmqpMap)value;
				if (composite.KnownTypes != null && composite.KnownTypes.Count > 0)
				{
					string text = (string)amqpMap2["type"];
					if (text != null)
					{
						for (int i = 0; i < composite.KnownTypes.Count; i++)
						{
							SerializableType.Composite composite2 = (SerializableType.Composite)serializer.GetType(composite.KnownTypes[i]);
							if (string.Equals(text, composite2.Name.Value))
							{
								composite = composite2;
								break;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				if (composite.UnderlyingType.IsAbstract)
				{
					throw new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.DecodeError, SRAmqp.AmqpInvalidType(composite.UnderlyingType.FullName));
				}
				object obj4 = composite.CreateInstance();
				SerialiableMember[] members = composite.Members;
				foreach (SerialiableMember serialiableMember in members)
				{
					object obj5 = amqpMap2[serialiableMember.Name];
					if (obj5 != null)
					{
						serialiableMember.Accessor.Set(obj4, FromAmqp(serialiableMember.Type, obj5));
					}
				}
				return obj4;
			}
			return value;
		}

		private static SerializableType CompileDataContract(Type type)
		{
			object[] customAttributes = type.GetCustomAttributes(typeof(DataContractAttribute), inherit: false);
			if (customAttributes.Length == 0 || type.IsEnum)
			{
				return null;
			}
			SerializableType serializableType = null;
			if (type.BaseType != typeof(object))
			{
				if (type.BaseType.GetCustomAttributes(typeof(DataContractAttribute), inherit: false).Length == 0)
				{
					throw new SerializationException(SRAmqp.AmqpInvalidType(type.BaseType.FullName));
				}
				serializableType = serializer.GetType(type.BaseType);
			}
			DataContractAttribute dataContractAttribute = (DataContractAttribute)customAttributes[0];
			string descriptorName = dataContractAttribute.Name ?? type.FullName;
			List<SerialiableMember> list = new List<SerialiableMember>();
			if (serializableType != null)
			{
				list.AddRange(((SerializableType.Composite)serializableType).Members);
			}
			int num = list.Count + 1;
			MemberInfo[] members = type.GetMembers(BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
			MethodAccessor onDesrialized = null;
			MemberInfo[] array = members;
			foreach (MemberInfo memberInfo in array)
			{
				if (memberInfo.DeclaringType != type)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (memberInfo.MemberType == MemberTypes.Field || memberInfo.MemberType == MemberTypes.Property)
				{
					object[] customAttributes2 = memberInfo.GetCustomAttributes(typeof(DataMemberAttribute), inherit: true);
					if (customAttributes2.Length == 1)
					{
						DataMemberAttribute dataMemberAttribute = (DataMemberAttribute)customAttributes2[0];
						SerialiableMember serialiableMember = new SerialiableMember();
						serialiableMember.Name = dataMemberAttribute.Name ?? memberInfo.Name;
						serialiableMember.Order = dataMemberAttribute.Order;
						serialiableMember.Mandatory = dataMemberAttribute.IsRequired;
						serialiableMember.Accessor = MemberAccessor.Create(memberInfo, requiresSetter: true);
						Type type2 = ((memberInfo.MemberType == MemberTypes.Field) ? ((FieldInfo)memberInfo).FieldType : ((PropertyInfo)memberInfo).PropertyType);
						serialiableMember.Type = serializer.GetType(type2);
						list.Add(serialiableMember);
					}
				}
				else if (memberInfo.MemberType == MemberTypes.Method)
				{
					object[] customAttributes3 = memberInfo.GetCustomAttributes(typeof(OnDeserializedAttribute), inherit: false);
					if (customAttributes3.Length == 1)
					{
						onDesrialized = MethodAccessor.Create((MethodInfo)memberInfo);
					}
				}
			}
			List<Type> list2 = new List<Type>();
			object[] customAttributes4 = type.GetCustomAttributes(typeof(KnownTypeAttribute), inherit: false);
			foreach (object obj in customAttributes4)
			{
				KnownTypeAttribute knownTypeAttribute = (KnownTypeAttribute)obj;
				if (knownTypeAttribute.Type.GetCustomAttributes(typeof(DataContractAttribute), inherit: false).Length != 0)
				{
					list2.Add(knownTypeAttribute.Type);
				}
			}
			return new SerializableType.CompositeMap(serializer, type, serializableType, descriptorName, null, list.ToArray(), list2, onDesrialized);
		}
	}

		}

	internal abstract class Address
	{
		private sealed class AddressString : Address
		{
			private string address;

			public override int EncodeSize => AmqpCodec.GetStringEncodeSize(address);

			public AddressString(string id)
			{
				address = id;
			}

			public override void OnEncode(ByteBuffer buffer)
			{
				AmqpCodec.EncodeString(address, buffer);
			}

			public override string ToString()
			{
				return address;
			}

			public override Address Clone()
			{
				return new AddressString(address);
			}
		}

		public abstract int EncodeSize { get; }

		public static implicit operator Address(string value)
		{
			return new AddressString(value);
		}

		public static int GetEncodeSize(Address address)
		{
			return address?.EncodeSize ?? 1;
		}

		public static void Encode(ByteBuffer buffer, Address address)
		{
			if (address == null)
			{
				AmqpEncoding.EncodeNull(buffer);
			}
			else
			{
				address.OnEncode(buffer);
			}
		}

		public static Address Decode(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			object obj = AmqpEncoding.DecodeObject(buffer);
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (obj is string)
			{
				return (string)obj;
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException(obj.GetType().ToString());
		}

		public abstract void OnEncode(ByteBuffer buffer);

		public abstract Address Clone();
	}
	internal class AmqpDescribed : IAmqpSerializable
	{
		private AmqpSymbol name;

		private ulong code;

		public AmqpSymbol DescriptorName => name;

		public ulong DescriptorCode => code;

		public object Value { get; set; }

		public int EncodeSize
		{
			get
			{
				int num = 1 + ULongEncoding.GetEncodeSize(DescriptorCode);
				return num + GetValueEncodeSize();
			}
		}

		public int Offset { get; set; }

		public int Length { get; set; }

		public AmqpDescribed(AmqpSymbol name, ulong code)
		{
			this.name = name;
			this.code = code;
		}

		public static void DecodeDescriptor(ByteBuffer buffer, out AmqpSymbol name, out ulong code)
		{
			name = default(AmqpSymbol);
			code = 0uL;
			FormatCode formatCode = AmqpEncoding.ReadFormatCode(buffer);
			if (formatCode == (byte)0)
			{
				formatCode = AmqpEncoding.ReadFormatCode(buffer);
			}
			if (formatCode == (byte)163 || formatCode == (byte)179)
			{
				name = SymbolEncoding.Decode(buffer, formatCode);
				return;
			}
			if (formatCode == (byte)128 || formatCode == (byte)68 || formatCode == (byte)83)
			{
				code = ULongEncoding.Decode(buffer, formatCode).Value;
				return;
			}
			throw AmqpEncoding.GetEncodingException(SRAmqp.AmqpInvalidFormatCode(formatCode, buffer.Offset));
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return name.Value;
		}

		public void Encode(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer, 0);
			ULongEncoding.Encode(DescriptorCode, buffer);
			EncodeValue(buffer);
		}

		public void Decode(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			DecodeDescriptor(buffer, out var _, out var _);
			DecodeValue(buffer);
		}

		public virtual int GetValueEncodeSize()
		{
			return AmqpEncoding.GetObjectEncodeSize(Value);
		}

		public virtual void EncodeValue(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			AmqpEncoding.EncodeObject(Value, buffer);
		}

		public virtual void DecodeValue(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			Value = AmqpEncoding.DecodeObject(buffer);
		}

		protected void AddFieldToString(bool condition, StringBuilder sb, string fieldName, object value, ref int count)
		{
			if (!condition)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (count > 0)
			{
				sb.Append(',');
			}
			if (value is ArraySegment<byte>)
			{
				sb.Append(fieldName);
				sb.Append(':');
				ArraySegment<byte> arraySegment = (ArraySegment<byte>)value;
				int num = Math.Min(arraySegment.Count, 64);
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					sb.AppendFormat(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0:X2}", arraySegment.Array[arraySegment.Offset + i]);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				sb.AppendFormat(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}:{1}", fieldName, value);
			}
			count++;
		}
	}
	internal sealed class AmqpSequence : DescribedList
	{
		public static readonly string Name = "amqp:amqp-sequence:list";

		public static readonly ulong Code = 118uL;

		private IList innerList;

		public IList List => innerList;

		protected override int FieldCount => innerList.Count;

		public AmqpSequence()
			: this(new List<object>())
		{
		}

		public AmqpSequence(IList innerList)
			: base(Name, Code)
		{
			this.innerList = innerList;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "sequence()";
		}

		protected override int OnValueSize()
		{
			return ListEncoding.GetValueSize(innerList);
		}

		protected override void OnEncode(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			foreach (object inner in innerList)
			{
				AmqpEncoding.EncodeObject(inner, buffer);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDecode(ByteBuffer buffer, int count)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				innerList.Add(AmqpEncoding.DecodeObject(buffer));
			}
		}
	}

			AddFieldToString(Role.HasValue, stringBuilder, "role", Role, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(SndSettleMode.HasValue, stringBuilder, "snd-settle-mode", SndSettleMode, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(RcvSettleMode.HasValue, stringBuilder, "rcv-settle-mode", RcvSettleMode, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(Source != null, stringBuilder, "source", Source, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(Target != null, stringBuilder, "target", Target, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(IncompleteUnsettled.HasValue, stringBuilder, "incomplete-unsettled", IncompleteUnsettled, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(InitialDeliveryCount.HasValue, stringBuilder, "initial-delivery-count", InitialDeliveryCount, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(MaxMessageSize.HasValue, stringBuilder, "max-message-size", MaxMessageSize, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(OfferedCapabilities != null, stringBuilder, "offered-capabilities", OfferedCapabilities, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(DesiredCapabilities != null, stringBuilder, "desired-capabilities", DesiredCapabilities, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(Properties != null, stringBuilder, "properties", Properties, ref count);
			stringBuilder.Append(')');
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		protected override void EnsureRequired()
		{
			if (LinkName == null)
			{
				throw AmqpEncoding.GetEncodingException(SRAmqp.AmqpRequiredFieldNotSet("name", Name));
			}
			if (!base.Handle.HasValue)
			{
				throw AmqpEncoding.GetEncodingException(SRAmqp.AmqpRequiredFieldNotSet("handle", Name));
			}
			if (!Role.HasValue)
			{
				throw AmqpEncoding.GetEncodingException(SRAmqp.AmqpRequiredFieldNotSet("role", Name));
			}
		}

		protected override void OnEncode(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			AmqpCodec.EncodeString(LinkName, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeUInt(base.Handle, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeBoolean(Role, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeUByte(SndSettleMode, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeUByte(RcvSettleMode, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeObject(Source, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeObject(Target, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeMap(Unsettled, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeBoolean(IncompleteUnsettled, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeUInt(InitialDeliveryCount, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeULong(MaxMessageSize, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeMultiple(OfferedCapabilities, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeMultiple(DesiredCapabilities, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeMap(Properties, buffer);
		}

		protected override void OnDecode(ByteBuffer buffer, int count)
		{
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				LinkName = AmqpCodec.DecodeString(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				base.Handle = AmqpCodec.DecodeUInt(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				Role = AmqpCodec.DecodeBoolean(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				SndSettleMode = AmqpCodec.DecodeUByte(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				RcvSettleMode = AmqpCodec.DecodeUByte(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				Source = AmqpCodec.DecodeObject(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				Target = AmqpCodec.DecodeObject(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				Unsettled = AmqpCodec.DecodeMap(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				IncompleteUnsettled = AmqpCodec.DecodeBoolean(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				InitialDeliveryCount = AmqpCodec.DecodeUInt(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				MaxMessageSize = AmqpCodec.DecodeULong(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				OfferedCapabilities = AmqpCodec.DecodeMultiple<AmqpSymbol>(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				DesiredCapabilities = AmqpCodec.DecodeMultiple<AmqpSymbol>(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				Properties = AmqpCodec.DecodeMap<Fields>(buffer);
			}
		}

		protected override int OnValueSize()
		{
			int num = 0;
			num += AmqpCodec.GetStringEncodeSize(LinkName);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetUIntEncodeSize(base.Handle);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetBooleanEncodeSize(Role);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetUByteEncodeSize(SndSettleMode);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetUByteEncodeSize(RcvSettleMode);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetObjectEncodeSize(Source);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetObjectEncodeSize(Target);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetMapEncodeSize(Unsettled);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetBooleanEncodeSize(IncompleteUnsettled);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetUIntEncodeSize(InitialDeliveryCount);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetULongEncodeSize(MaxMessageSize);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetMultipleEncodeSize(OfferedCapabilities);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetMultipleEncodeSize(DesiredCapabilities);
			return num + AmqpCodec.GetMapEncodeSize(Properties);
		}
	}

			AddFieldToString(NextOutgoingId.HasValue, stringBuilder, "next-outgoing-id", NextOutgoingId, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(IncomingWindow.HasValue, stringBuilder, "incoming-window", IncomingWindow, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(OutgoingWindow.HasValue, stringBuilder, "outgoing-window", OutgoingWindow, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(HandleMax.HasValue, stringBuilder, "handle-max", HandleMax, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(OfferedCapabilities != null, stringBuilder, "offered-capabilities", OfferedCapabilities, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(DesiredCapabilities != null, stringBuilder, "desired-capabilities", DesiredCapabilities, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(Properties != null, stringBuilder, "properties", Properties, ref count);
			stringBuilder.Append(')');
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		protected override void EnsureRequired()
		{

				throw new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.InvalidField, "begin.next-outgoing-id");
			}

			{
				throw new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.InvalidField, "begin.incoming-window");
			}
			if (!OutgoingWindow.HasValue)
			{
				throw new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.InvalidField, "begin.outgoing-window");
			}
		}

		protected override void OnEncode(ByteBuffer buffer)

			AmqpCodec.EncodeUInt(NextOutgoingId, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeUInt(IncomingWindow, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeUInt(OutgoingWindow, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeUInt(HandleMax, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeMultiple(OfferedCapabilities, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeMultiple(DesiredCapabilities, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeMap(Properties, buffer);
		}

		protected override void OnDecode(ByteBuffer buffer, int count)
		{
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				RemoteChannel = AmqpCodec.DecodeUShort(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				NextOutgoingId = AmqpCodec.DecodeUInt(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				IncomingWindow = AmqpCodec.DecodeUInt(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				OutgoingWindow = AmqpCodec.DecodeUInt(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				HandleMax = AmqpCodec.DecodeUInt(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				OfferedCapabilities = AmqpCodec.DecodeMultiple<AmqpSymbol>(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				DesiredCapabilities = AmqpCodec.DecodeMultiple<AmqpSymbol>(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				Properties = AmqpCodec.DecodeMap<Fields>(buffer);
			}
		}

		protected override int OnValueSize()
		{
			int num = 0;
			num += AmqpCodec.GetUShortEncodeSize(RemoteChannel);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetUIntEncodeSize(NextOutgoingId);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetUIntEncodeSize(IncomingWindow);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetUIntEncodeSize(OutgoingWindow);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetUIntEncodeSize(HandleMax);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetMultipleEncodeSize(OfferedCapabilities);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetMultipleEncodeSize(DesiredCapabilities);
			return num + AmqpCodec.GetMapEncodeSize(Properties);
		}
