	internal sealed class Data : AmqpDescribed
	{
		public static readonly string Name = "amqp:data:binary";

		public static readonly ulong Code = 117uL;

		public Data()
			: base(Name, Code)
		{
		}

		public static ArraySegment<byte> GetEncodedPrefix(int valueLength)
		{
			byte[] array = new byte[8]
			{
				0,
				83,
				(byte)Code,
				0,
				0,
				0,
				0,
				0
			};
			int count;
			if (valueLength <= 255)
			{
				array[3] = 160;
				array[4] = (byte)valueLength;
				count = 5;
			}
			else
			{
				array[3] = 176;
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteUInt(array, 4, (uint)valueLength);
				count = 8;
			}
			return new ArraySegment<byte>(array, 0, count);
		}

		public override int GetValueEncodeSize()
		{
			return BinaryEncoding.GetEncodeSize((ArraySegment<byte>)base.Value);
		}

		public override void EncodeValue(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			BinaryEncoding.Encode((ArraySegment<byte>)base.Value, buffer);
		}

		public override void DecodeValue(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			base.Value = BinaryEncoding.Decode(buffer, (byte)0);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "data()";
		}
	}

	internal abstract class DescribedList : AmqpDescribed
	{
		protected abstract int FieldCount { get; }

		public DescribedList(AmqpSymbol name, ulong code)
			: base(name, code)
		{
		}

		public override int GetValueEncodeSize()
		{
			if (FieldCount == 0)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			int num = OnValueSize();
			int encodeWidthByCountAndSize = AmqpEncoding.GetEncodeWidthByCountAndSize(FieldCount, num);
			return 1 + encodeWidthByCountAndSize + encodeWidthByCountAndSize + num;
		}

		public override void EncodeValue(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			if (FieldCount == 0)
			{
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer, 69);
				return;
			}
			int valueSize = OnValueSize();
			int encodeWidthByCountAndSize = AmqpEncoding.GetEncodeWidthByCountAndSize(FieldCount, valueSize);
			int length;
			if (encodeWidthByCountAndSize == 1)
			{
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer, 192);
				length = buffer.Length;
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer, 0);
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer, (byte)FieldCount);
			}
			else
			{
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer, 208);
				length = buffer.Length;
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteUInt(buffer, 0u);
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteUInt(buffer, (uint)FieldCount);
			}
			OnEncode(buffer);
			int num = buffer.Length - length - encodeWidthByCountAndSize;
			if (encodeWidthByCountAndSize == 1)
			{
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer.Buffer, length, (byte)num);
			}
			else
			{
				AmqpBitConverter.WriteUInt(buffer.Buffer, length, (uint)num);
			}
		}

		public override void DecodeValue(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			FormatCode formatCode = AmqpEncoding.ReadFormatCode(buffer);
			if (!(formatCode == (byte)69))
			{
				int size = 0;
				int count = 0;
				AmqpEncoding.ReadSizeAndCount(buffer, formatCode, (byte)192, (byte)208, out size, out count);
				int offset = buffer.Offset;
				DecodeValue(buffer, size, count);
				int num = count - FieldCount;
				if (num > 0)
				{
					int size2 = size - (buffer.Offset - offset) - ((formatCode == (byte)192) ? 1 : 4);
					buffer.Complete(size2);
				}
			}
		}

		public void DecodeValue(ByteBuffer buffer, int size, int count)
		{
			if (count > 0)
			{
				OnDecode(buffer, count);
				EnsureRequired();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void EnsureRequired()
		{
		}

		protected abstract int OnValueSize();

		protected abstract void OnEncode(ByteBuffer buffer);

		protected abstract void OnDecode(ByteBuffer buffer, int count);
	}
	internal abstract class DescribedMap<TMap, TKey> : AmqpDescribed where TMap : RestrictedMap<TKey>, new()
	{
		private readonly AmqpEncoding<TKey> encoder;

		private TMap innerMap;

		public TMap Map
		{
			get
			{
				if (innerMap == null)
				{
					innerMap = new TMap();
				}
				return innerMap;
			}
		}

		public DescribedMap(AmqpSymbol name, ulong code, AmqpEncoding<TKey> encoder)
			: base(name, code)
		{
			this.encoder = encoder;
		}

		public override int GetValueEncodeSize()
		{
			return MapEncoding.GetEncodeSize(Map, encoder);
		}

		public override void EncodeValue(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			MapEncoding.Encode(Map, encoder, buffer);
		}

		public override void DecodeValue(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			innerMap = MapEncoding.Decode<TMap, TKey>(buffer, (byte)0, encoder);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(128);
			stringBuilder.Append(base.DescriptorName);
			if (innerMap != null)
			{
				AmqpExtensions.Append(stringBuilder, innerMap);
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
	}

	internal sealed class Disposition : Performative
	{
		public static readonly string Name = "amqp:disposition:list";

		public static readonly ulong Code = 21uL;

		private const int Fields = 6;

		public bool? Role { get; set; }

		public uint? First { get; set; }

		public uint? Last { get; set; }

		public bool? Batchable { get; set; }

		protected override int FieldCount => 6;

		public Disposition()
			: base(Name, Code)
		{
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder("disposition(");
			int count = 0;
			AddFieldToString(Role.HasValue, stringBuilder, "role", Role, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(First.HasValue, stringBuilder, "first", First, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(Last.HasValue, stringBuilder, "last", Last, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(Settled.HasValue, stringBuilder, "settled", Settled, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(State != null, stringBuilder, "state", State, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(Batchable.HasValue, stringBuilder, "batchable", Batchable, ref count);
			stringBuilder.Append(')');
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		protected override void EnsureRequired()
		{
			if (!Role.HasValue)
			{
				throw AmqpEncoding.GetEncodingException(SRAmqp.AmqpRequiredFieldNotSet("role", Name));
			}
			if (!First.HasValue)
			{
				throw AmqpEncoding.GetEncodingException(SRAmqp.AmqpRequiredFieldNotSet("first", Name));
			}
		}

		protected override void OnEncode(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			AmqpCodec.EncodeBoolean(Role, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeUInt(First, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeUInt(Last, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeBoolean(Settled, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeSerializable(State, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeBoolean(Batchable, buffer);
		}

		protected override void OnDecode(ByteBuffer buffer, int count)
		{
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				Role = AmqpCodec.DecodeBoolean(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				First = AmqpCodec.DecodeUInt(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				Last = AmqpCodec.DecodeUInt(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				Settled = AmqpCodec.DecodeBoolean(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				State = (DeliveryState)AmqpCodec.DecodeAmqpDescribed(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				Batchable = AmqpCodec.DecodeBoolean(buffer);
			}
		}

		protected override int OnValueSize()
		{
			int num = 0;
			num += AmqpCodec.GetBooleanEncodeSize(Role);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetUIntEncodeSize(First);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetUIntEncodeSize(Last);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetBooleanEncodeSize(Settled);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetSerializableEncodeSize(State);
			return num + AmqpCodec.GetBooleanEncodeSize(Batchable);
		}
	}

			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder("end(");
			int count = 0;
			AddFieldToString(Error != null, stringBuilder, "error", Error, ref count);
			stringBuilder.Append(')');
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		protected override void OnEncode(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			AmqpCodec.EncodeSerializable(Error, buffer);
		}

		protected override void OnDecode(ByteBuffer buffer, int count)
		{
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				Error = AmqpCodec.DecodeKnownType<Error>(buffer);
			}
		}

		protected override int OnValueSize()
		{
			int num = 0;
			return num + AmqpCodec.GetSerializableEncodeSize(Error);
		}
	}
	[Serializable]
	internal sealed class Error : DescribedList, ISerializable
	{
		public static readonly string Name = "amqp:error:list";

		public static readonly ulong Code = 29uL;

		private const int Fields = 3;

		private const int MaxSizeInInfoMap = 8192;

		public AmqpSymbol Condition { get; set; }

		public string Description { get; set; }

		public Fields Info { get; set; }

		protected override int FieldCount => 3;

		public Error()
			: base(Name, Code)
		{
		}

		private Error(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			: base(Name, Code)
		{
			Condition = (string)info.GetValue("Condition", typeof(string));
			Description = (string)info.GetValue("Description", typeof(string));
		}

		public static Error FromException(Exception exception)
		{
			if (exception is AmqpException ex)
			{
				return ex.Error;
			}
			Error error = new Error();
			error.Description = exception.Message;
			if (exception is UnauthorizedAccessException)
			{
				error.Condition = AmqpErrorCode.UnauthorizedAccess;
			}
			else if (exception is InvalidOperationException)
			{
				error.Condition = AmqpErrorCode.NotAllowed;
			}
			else if (exception is TransactionAbortedException)
			{
				error.Condition = AmqpErrorCode.TransactionRollback;
			}
			else if (exception is NotImplementedException)
			{
				error.Condition = AmqpErrorCode.NotImplemented;
			}
			else
			{
				error.Condition = AmqpErrorCode.InternalError;
				error.Description = SRAmqp.AmqpErrorOccurred(AmqpErrorCode.InternalError);
			}
			return error;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder("error(");
			int count = 0;
			AddFieldToString(Condition.Value != null, stringBuilder, "condition", Condition, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(Description != null, stringBuilder, "description", Description, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(Info != null, stringBuilder, "info", Info, ref count);
			stringBuilder.Append(')');
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			info.AddValue("Condition", Condition.Value);
			info.AddValue("Description", Description);
		}

		protected override void EnsureRequired()
		{
			if (Condition.Value == null)
			{
				throw AmqpEncoding.GetEncodingException(SRAmqp.AmqpRequiredFieldNotSet("condition", Name));
			}
		}

		protected override void OnEncode(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			AmqpCodec.EncodeSymbol(Condition, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeString(Description, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeMap(Info, buffer);
		}

		protected override void OnDecode(ByteBuffer buffer, int count)
		{
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				Condition = AmqpCodec.DecodeSymbol(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				Description = AmqpCodec.DecodeString(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				Info = AmqpCodec.DecodeMap<Fields>(buffer);
			}
		}

		protected override int OnValueSize()
		{
			int num = 0;
			num = AmqpCodec.GetSymbolEncodeSize(Condition);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetStringEncodeSize(Description);
			return num + AmqpCodec.GetMapEncodeSize(Info);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class Flow : LinkPerformative
	{
		public static readonly string Name = "amqp:flow:list";

		public static readonly ulong Code = 19uL;

		private const int Fields = 11;

		public uint? NextIncomingId { get; set; }

		public uint? IncomingWindow { get; set; }

		public uint? NextOutgoingId { get; set; }

		public uint? DeliveryCount { get; set; }

		public uint? LinkCredit { get; set; }

		public uint? Available { get; set; }

		public bool? Drain { get; set; }

		public bool? Echo { get; set; }

		public Fields Properties { get; set; }

		protected override int FieldCount => 11;

		public Flow()
			: base(Name, Code)
		{
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder("flow(");
			int count = 0;
			AddFieldToString(NextIncomingId.HasValue, stringBuilder, "next-in-id", NextIncomingId, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(IncomingWindow.HasValue, stringBuilder, "in-window", IncomingWindow, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(NextOutgoingId.HasValue, stringBuilder, "next-out-id", NextOutgoingId, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(OutgoingWindow.HasValue, stringBuilder, "out-window", OutgoingWindow, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(base.Handle.HasValue, stringBuilder, "handle", base.Handle, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(LinkCredit.HasValue, stringBuilder, "link-credit", LinkCredit, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(DeliveryCount.HasValue, stringBuilder, "delivery-count", DeliveryCount, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(Available.HasValue, stringBuilder, "available", Available, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(Drain.HasValue, stringBuilder, "drain", Drain, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(Echo.HasValue, stringBuilder, "echo", Echo, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(Properties != null, stringBuilder, "properties", Properties, ref count);
			stringBuilder.Append(')');
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		protected override void EnsureRequired()
		{
			if (!IncomingWindow.HasValue)
			{
				throw new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.InvalidField, "flow.incoming-window");
			}
			if (!NextOutgoingId.HasValue)
			{
				throw new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.InvalidField, "flow.next-outgoing-id");
			}
			if (!OutgoingWindow.HasValue)
			{
				throw new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.InvalidField, "flow.outgoing-window");
			}
		}

		protected override void OnEncode(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			AmqpCodec.EncodeUInt(NextIncomingId, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeUInt(IncomingWindow, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeUInt(NextOutgoingId, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeUInt(OutgoingWindow, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeUInt(base.Handle, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeUInt(DeliveryCount, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeUInt(LinkCredit, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeUInt(Available, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeBoolean(Drain, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeBoolean(Echo, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeMap(Properties, buffer);
		}

		protected override void OnDecode(ByteBuffer buffer, int count)
		{
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				NextIncomingId = AmqpCodec.DecodeUInt(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				IncomingWindow = AmqpCodec.DecodeUInt(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				NextOutgoingId = AmqpCodec.DecodeUInt(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				OutgoingWindow = AmqpCodec.DecodeUInt(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				base.Handle = AmqpCodec.DecodeUInt(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				DeliveryCount = AmqpCodec.DecodeUInt(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				LinkCredit = AmqpCodec.DecodeUInt(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				Available = AmqpCodec.DecodeUInt(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				Drain = AmqpCodec.DecodeBoolean(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				Echo = AmqpCodec.DecodeBoolean(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				Properties = AmqpCodec.DecodeMap<Fields>(buffer);
			}
		}

		protected override int OnValueSize()
		{
			int num = 0;
			num += AmqpCodec.GetUIntEncodeSize(NextIncomingId);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetUIntEncodeSize(IncomingWindow);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetUIntEncodeSize(NextOutgoingId);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetUIntEncodeSize(OutgoingWindow);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetUIntEncodeSize(base.Handle);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetUIntEncodeSize(DeliveryCount);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetUIntEncodeSize(LinkCredit);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetUIntEncodeSize(Available);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetBooleanEncodeSize(Drain);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetBooleanEncodeSize(Echo);
			return num + AmqpCodec.GetMapEncodeSize(Properties);
		}
	}

	internal sealed class Frame : IDisposable
	{
		public const int HeaderSize = 8;

		private const byte DefaultDataOffset = 2;

		public int Size { get; private set; }

		public byte DataOffset { get; private set; }

		public FrameType Type { get; private set; }

		public ushort Channel { get; set; }

		public Performative Command { get; set; }

		public ArraySegment<byte> Payload { get; set; }

		public ByteBuffer RawByteBuffer { get; private set; }

		public Frame()
			: this(FrameType.Amqp)
		{
		}

		public Frame(FrameType type)
		{
			Type = type;
			DataOffset = 2;
		}

		public static ByteBuffer EncodeCommand(FrameType type, ushort channel, Performative command, int payloadSize)
		{
			int num = 8;
			if (command != null)
			{
				num += AmqpCodec.GetSerializableEncodeSize(command);
			}
			num += payloadSize;
			ByteBuffer byteBuffer = new ByteBuffer(num, autoGrow: false, isTransportBuffer: false);
			AmqpBitConverter.WriteUInt(byteBuffer, (uint)num);
			AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(byteBuffer, 2);
			AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(byteBuffer, (byte)type);
			AmqpBitConverter.WriteUShort(byteBuffer, channel);
			if (command != null)
			{
				AmqpCodec.EncodeSerializable(command, byteBuffer);
			}
			return byteBuffer;
		}

		public void Decode(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			RawByteBuffer = buffer;
			int offset = buffer.Offset;
			int length = buffer.Length;
			DecodeHeader(buffer);
			DecodeCommand(buffer);
			DecodePayload(buffer);
			buffer.AdjustPosition(offset, length);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.AppendFormat(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "FRM({0:X4}|{1}|{2}|{3:X2}", Size, DataOffset, (byte)Type, Channel);
			if (Command != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendFormat(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "  {0}", Command);
			}
			if (Payload.Count > 0)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendFormat(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, ",{0}", Payload.Count);
			}
			stringBuilder.Append(')');
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		private void DecodeHeader(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			Size = (int)AmqpBitConverter.ReadUInt(buffer);
			DataOffset = AmqpBitConverter.ReadUByte(buffer);
			Type = (FrameType)AmqpBitConverter.ReadUByte(buffer);
			Channel = AmqpBitConverter.ReadUShort(buffer);
			buffer.Complete(DataOffset * 4 - 8);
		}

		private void DecodeCommand(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			if (buffer.Length > 0)
			{
				Command = (Performative)AmqpCodec.DecodeAmqpDescribed(buffer);
			}
		}

		private void DecodePayload(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			if (buffer.Length > 0)
			{
				Payload = new ArraySegment<byte>(buffer.Buffer, buffer.Offset, buffer.Length);
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (RawByteBuffer != null)
			{
				RawByteBuffer.Dispose();
			}
		}
	}
	internal enum FrameType : byte
	{
		Amqp,
		Sasl
	}

	internal abstract class MessageId
	{
		private sealed class MessageIdUlong : MessageId
		{
			private ulong id;

			public override int EncodeSize => AmqpCodec.GetULongEncodeSize(id);

			public MessageIdUlong(ulong id)
			{
				this.id = id;
			}

			public override void OnEncode(ByteBuffer buffer)
			{
				AmqpCodec.EncodeULong(id, buffer);
			}

			public override bool Equals(object obj)
			{
				if (!(obj is MessageIdUlong messageIdUlong))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return id == messageIdUlong.id;
			}

			public override string ToString()
			{
				return id.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			}

			public override int GetHashCode()
			{
				return id.GetHashCode();
			}

			public override MessageId Clone()
			{
				return new MessageIdUlong(id);
			}
		}

		private sealed class MessageIdUuid : MessageId
		{
			private Guid id;

			public override int EncodeSize => AmqpCodec.GetUuidEncodeSize(id);

			public MessageIdUuid(Guid id)
			{
				this.id = id;
			}

			public override void OnEncode(ByteBuffer buffer)
			{
				AmqpCodec.EncodeUuid(id, buffer);
			}

			public override bool Equals(object obj)
			{
				if (!(obj is MessageIdUuid messageIdUuid))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return id == messageIdUuid.id;
			}

			public override string ToString()
			{
				return id.ToString();
			}

			public override int GetHashCode()
			{
				return id.GetHashCode();
			}

			public override MessageId Clone()
			{
				return new MessageIdUuid(id);
			}
		}

		private sealed class MessageIdBinary : MessageId
		{
			private ArraySegment<byte> id;

			public override int EncodeSize => AmqpCodec.GetBinaryEncodeSize(id);

			public MessageIdBinary(ArraySegment<byte> id)
			{
				this.id = id;
			}

			public override void OnEncode(ByteBuffer buffer)
			{
				AmqpCodec.EncodeBinary(id, buffer);
			}

			public override bool Equals(object obj)
			{
				if (!(obj is MessageIdBinary messageIdBinary))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return ByteArrayComparer.Instance.Equals(id, messageIdBinary.id);
			}

			public override int GetHashCode()
			{
				return ByteArrayComparer.Instance.GetHashCode(id);
			}

			public override string ToString()
			{
				return id.GetString();
			}

			public override MessageId Clone()
			{
				return new MessageIdBinary(id.Clone());
			}
		}

		private sealed class MessageIdString : MessageId
		{
			private string id;

			public override int EncodeSize => AmqpCodec.GetStringEncodeSize(id);

			public MessageIdString(string id)
			{
				this.id = id;
			}

			public override void OnEncode(ByteBuffer buffer)
			{
				AmqpCodec.EncodeString(id, buffer);
			}

			public override bool Equals(object obj)
			{
				if (!(obj is MessageIdString messageIdString))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return id.Equals(messageIdString.id);
			}

			public override string ToString()
			{
				return id;
			}

			public override int GetHashCode()
			{
				return id.GetHashCode();
			}

			public override MessageId Clone()
			{
				return new MessageIdString(id);
			}
		}

		public abstract int EncodeSize { get; }

		public static implicit operator MessageId(ulong value)
		{
			return new MessageIdUlong(value);
		}

		public static implicit operator MessageId(Guid value)
		{
			return new MessageIdUuid(value);
		}

		public static implicit operator MessageId(ArraySegment<byte> value)
		{
			return new MessageIdBinary(value);
		}

		public static implicit operator MessageId(string value)
		{
			return new MessageIdString(value);
		}

		public static int GetEncodeSize(MessageId messageId)
		{
			return messageId?.EncodeSize ?? 1;
		}

		public static void Encode(ByteBuffer buffer, MessageId messageId)
		{
			if (messageId == null)
			{
				AmqpEncoding.EncodeNull(buffer);
			}
			else
			{
				messageId.OnEncode(buffer);
			}
		}

		public static MessageId Decode(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			object obj = AmqpEncoding.DecodeObject(buffer);
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (obj is ulong)
			{
				return (ulong)obj;
			}
			if (obj is Guid)
			{
				return (Guid)obj;
			}
			if (obj is ArraySegment<byte>)
			{
				return (ArraySegment<byte>)obj;
			}
			if (obj is string)
			{
				return (string)obj;
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException(obj.GetType().ToString());
		}

		public abstract void OnEncode(ByteBuffer buffer);

		public abstract MessageId Clone();
	}

	internal sealed class Multiple<T>
	{
		private List<T> value;

		public Multiple()
		{
			value = new List<T>();
		}

		public Multiple(IList<T> value)
		{
			this.value = new List<T>(value);
		}

		public void Add(T item)
		{
			value.Add(item);
		}

		public bool Contains(T item)
		{
			return value.Contains(item);
		}

		public static int GetEncodeSize(Multiple<T> multiple)
		{
			if (multiple == null)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (multiple.value.Count == 1)
			{
				return AmqpEncoding.GetObjectEncodeSize(multiple.value[0]);
			}
			return ArrayEncoding.GetEncodeSize(multiple.value.ToArray());
		}

		public static void Encode(Multiple<T> multiple, ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			if (multiple == null)
			{
				AmqpEncoding.EncodeNull(buffer);
			}
			else if (multiple.value.Count == 1)
			{
				AmqpEncoding.EncodeObject(multiple.value[0], buffer);
			}
			else
			{
				ArrayEncoding.Encode(multiple.value.ToArray(), buffer);
			}
		}

		public static Multiple<T> Decode(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			object obj = AmqpEncoding.DecodeObject(buffer);
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (obj is T)
			{
				Multiple<T> multiple = new Multiple<T>();
				multiple.Add((T)obj);
				return multiple;
			}
			if (obj.GetType().IsArray)
			{
				return new Multiple<T>((T[])obj);
			}
			throw new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.InvalidField, "Cannot create Multiple<" + typeof(T).Name + "> from " + obj.GetType().Name);
		}

		public static IList<T> Intersect(Multiple<T> multiple1, Multiple<T> multiple2)
		{
			List<T> list = new List<T>();
			if (multiple1 == null || multiple2 == null)
			{
				return list;
			}
			foreach (T item in multiple1.value)
			{
				if (multiple2.value.Contains(item))
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public static IList<T> Union(Multiple<T> multiple1, Multiple<T> multiple2)
		{
			HashSet<T> hashSet = new HashSet<T>();
			if (multiple1 != null)
			{
				foreach (T item in multiple1.value)
				{
					hashSet.Add(item);
				}
			}
			if (multiple2 != null)
			{
				foreach (T item2 in multiple2.value)
				{
					hashSet.Add(item2);
				}
			}
			return new List<T>(hashSet);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder("[");
			bool flag = true;
			foreach (T item in value)
			{
				object obj = item;
				if (!flag)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(',');
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(obj.ToString());
				flag = false;
			}
			stringBuilder.Append(']');
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
	}

	{

			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder("open(");

			AddFieldToString(ContainerId != null, stringBuilder, "container-id", ContainerId, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(HostName != null, stringBuilder, "host-name", HostName, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(MaxFrameSize.HasValue, stringBuilder, "max-frame-size", MaxFrameSize, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(ChannelMax.HasValue, stringBuilder, "channel-max", ChannelMax, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(IdleTimeOut.HasValue, stringBuilder, "idle-time-out", IdleTimeOut, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(OutgoingLocales != null, stringBuilder, "outgoing-locales", OutgoingLocales, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(IncomingLocales != null, stringBuilder, "incoming-locales", IncomingLocales, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(OfferedCapabilities != null, stringBuilder, "offered-capabilities", OfferedCapabilities, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(DesiredCapabilities != null, stringBuilder, "desired-capabilities", DesiredCapabilities, ref count);

			stringBuilder.Append(')');
			return stringBuilder.ToString();

		protected override void EnsureRequired()
		{
			if (ContainerId == null)
			{
				throw AmqpEncoding.GetEncodingException(SRAmqp.AmqpRequiredFieldNotSet("container-id", Name));
			}
		}

		protected override void OnEncode(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			AmqpCodec.EncodeString(ContainerId, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeString(HostName, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeUInt(MaxFrameSize, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeUShort(ChannelMax, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeUInt(IdleTimeOut, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeMultiple(OutgoingLocales, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeMultiple(IncomingLocales, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeMultiple(OfferedCapabilities, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeMultiple(DesiredCapabilities, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeMap(Properties, buffer);
		}

		protected override void OnDecode(ByteBuffer buffer, int count)
		{
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				ContainerId = AmqpCodec.DecodeString(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				HostName = AmqpCodec.DecodeString(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				MaxFrameSize = AmqpCodec.DecodeUInt(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				ChannelMax = AmqpCodec.DecodeUShort(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				IdleTimeOut = AmqpCodec.DecodeUInt(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				OutgoingLocales = AmqpCodec.DecodeMultiple<AmqpSymbol>(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				IncomingLocales = AmqpCodec.DecodeMultiple<AmqpSymbol>(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				OfferedCapabilities = AmqpCodec.DecodeMultiple<AmqpSymbol>(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				DesiredCapabilities = AmqpCodec.DecodeMultiple<AmqpSymbol>(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				Properties = AmqpCodec.DecodeMap<Fields>(buffer);
			}
		}

		protected override int OnValueSize()
		{
			int num = 0;
			num += AmqpCodec.GetStringEncodeSize(ContainerId);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetStringEncodeSize(HostName);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetUIntEncodeSize(MaxFrameSize);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetUShortEncodeSize(ChannelMax);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetUIntEncodeSize(IdleTimeOut);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetMultipleEncodeSize(OutgoingLocales);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetMultipleEncodeSize(IncomingLocales);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetMultipleEncodeSize(OfferedCapabilities);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetMultipleEncodeSize(DesiredCapabilities);
			return num + AmqpCodec.GetMapEncodeSize(Properties);
		}
	}

	internal sealed class ProtocolHeader : IAmqpSerializable
	{
		public static readonly ProtocolHeader Amqp100 = new ProtocolHeader(ProtocolId.Amqp, new AmqpVersion(1, 0, 0));

		public static readonly ProtocolHeader AmqpTls100 = new ProtocolHeader(ProtocolId.AmqpTls, new AmqpVersion(1, 0, 0));

		public static readonly ProtocolHeader AmqpSasl100 = new ProtocolHeader(ProtocolId.AmqpSasl, new AmqpVersion(1, 0, 0));

		private const uint AmqpPrefix = 1095586128u;

		private ProtocolId protocolId;

		private AmqpVersion version;

		public ProtocolId ProtocolId => protocolId;

		public AmqpVersion Version => version;

		public int EncodeSize => 8;

		public ProtocolHeader()
		{
		}

		public ProtocolHeader(ProtocolId id, AmqpVersion version)
		{
			protocolId = id;
			this.version = version;
		}

		public void Encode(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			AmqpBitConverter.WriteUInt(buffer, 1095586128u);
			AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer, (byte)protocolId);
			AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer, version.Major);
			AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer, version.Minor);
			AmqpBitConverter.WriteUByte(buffer, version.Revision);
		}

		public void Decode(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			if (buffer.Length < EncodeSize)
			{
				throw new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.DecodeError, SRAmqp.AmqpInsufficientBufferSize(EncodeSize, buffer.Length));
			}
			uint num = AmqpBitConverter.ReadUInt(buffer);
			if (num != 1095586128)
			{
				throw new AmqpException(AmqpErrorCode.DecodeError, SRAmqp.AmqpIncorrectProtocolName(num.ToString("X8")));
			}
			protocolId = (ProtocolId)AmqpBitConverter.ReadUByte(buffer);
			version = new AmqpVersion(AmqpBitConverter.ReadUByte(buffer), AmqpBitConverter.ReadUByte(buffer), AmqpBitConverter.ReadUByte(buffer));
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "AMQP {0} {1}", (byte)protocolId, version);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is ProtocolHeader protocolHeader))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (protocolHeader.protocolId == protocolId)
			{
				return protocolHeader.version.Equals(version);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return ((int)((uint)protocolId << 24) + (version.Major << 16) + (version.Minor << 8) + version.Revision).GetHashCode();
		}
	}

	internal sealed class Source : DescribedList
	{

			AmqpCodec.EncodeMap(FilterSet, buffer);

			}

			}
		}

		{
			int num = 0;

			num += AmqpCodec.GetSymbolEncodeSize(ExpiryPolicy);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetUIntEncodeSize(Timeout);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetBooleanEncodeSize(Dynamic);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetMapEncodeSize(DynamicNodeProperties);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetSymbolEncodeSize(DistributionMode);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetMapEncodeSize(FilterSet);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetSerializableEncodeSize(DefaultOutcome);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetMultipleEncodeSize(Outcomes);
			return num + AmqpCodec.GetMultipleEncodeSize(Capabilities);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class Target : DescribedList
	{
		public static readonly string Name = "amqp:target:list";

		public static readonly ulong Code = 41uL;

		private const int Fields = 7;

		public Address Address { get; set; }

		public uint? Durable { get; set; }

		public AmqpSymbol ExpiryPolicy { get; set; }

		public uint? Timeout { get; set; }

		public bool? Dynamic { get; set; }

		public Fields DynamicNodeProperties { get; set; }

		public Multiple<AmqpSymbol> Capabilities { get; set; }

		protected override int FieldCount => 7;

		public Target()
			: base(Name, Code)
		{
		}

		public Target(Uri uri)
			: this()
		{
			Address = uri.AbsoluteUri;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder("target(");
			int count = 0;
			AddFieldToString(Address != null, stringBuilder, "address", Address, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(Durable.HasValue, stringBuilder, "durable", Durable, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(ExpiryPolicy.Value != null, stringBuilder, "expiry-policy", ExpiryPolicy, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(Timeout.HasValue, stringBuilder, "timeout", Timeout, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(Dynamic.HasValue, stringBuilder, "dynamic", Dynamic, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(DynamicNodeProperties != null, stringBuilder, "dynamic-node-properties", DynamicNodeProperties, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(Capabilities != null, stringBuilder, "capabilities", Capabilities, ref count);
			stringBuilder.Append(')');
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		protected override void OnEncode(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			Address.Encode(buffer, Address);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeUInt(Durable, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeSymbol(ExpiryPolicy, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeUInt(Timeout, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeBoolean(Dynamic, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeMap(DynamicNodeProperties, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeMultiple(Capabilities, buffer);
		}

		protected override void OnDecode(ByteBuffer buffer, int count)
		{
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				Address = Address.Decode(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				Durable = AmqpCodec.DecodeUInt(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				ExpiryPolicy = AmqpCodec.DecodeSymbol(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				Timeout = AmqpCodec.DecodeUInt(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				Dynamic = AmqpCodec.DecodeBoolean(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				DynamicNodeProperties = AmqpCodec.DecodeMap<Fields>(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				Capabilities = AmqpCodec.DecodeMultiple<AmqpSymbol>(buffer);
			}
		}

		protected override int OnValueSize()
		{
			int num = 0;
			num += Address.GetEncodeSize(Address);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetUIntEncodeSize(Durable);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetSymbolEncodeSize(ExpiryPolicy);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetUIntEncodeSize(Timeout);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetBooleanEncodeSize(Dynamic);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetMapEncodeSize(DynamicNodeProperties);
			return num + AmqpCodec.GetMultipleEncodeSize(Capabilities);
		}
	}

	internal sealed class Transfer : LinkPerformative
	{
		public static readonly string Name = "amqp:transfer:list";

		public static readonly ulong Code = 20uL;

		private const int Fields = 11;

		public uint? DeliveryId { get; set; }

		public ArraySegment<byte> DeliveryTag { get; set; }

		public uint? MessageFormat { get; set; }

		public bool? Settled { get; set; }

		public bool? More { get; set; }

		public byte? RcvSettleMode { get; set; }

		public DeliveryState State { get; set; }

		public bool? Resume { get; set; }

		public bool? Aborted { get; set; }

		public bool? Batchable { get; set; }

		protected override int FieldCount => 11;

		public Transfer()
			: base(Name, Code)
		{
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder("transfer(");
			int count = 0;
			AddFieldToString(base.Handle.HasValue, stringBuilder, "handle", base.Handle, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(DeliveryId.HasValue, stringBuilder, "delivery-id", DeliveryId, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(DeliveryTag.Array != null, stringBuilder, "delivery-tag", DeliveryTag, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(MessageFormat.HasValue, stringBuilder, "message-format", MessageFormat, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(Settled.HasValue, stringBuilder, "settled", Settled, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(More.HasValue, stringBuilder, "more", More, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(RcvSettleMode.HasValue, stringBuilder, "rcv-settle-mode", RcvSettleMode, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(State != null, stringBuilder, "state", State, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(Resume.HasValue, stringBuilder, "resume", Resume, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(Aborted.HasValue, stringBuilder, "aborted", Aborted, ref count);
			AddFieldToString(Batchable.HasValue, stringBuilder, "batchable", Batchable, ref count);
			stringBuilder.Append(')');
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		protected override void EnsureRequired()
		{
			if (!base.Handle.HasValue)
			{
				throw AmqpEncoding.GetEncodingException(SRAmqp.AmqpRequiredFieldNotSet("handle", Name));
			}
		}

		protected override void OnEncode(ByteBuffer buffer)
		{
			AmqpCodec.EncodeUInt(base.Handle, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeUInt(DeliveryId, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeBinary(DeliveryTag, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeUInt(MessageFormat, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeBoolean(Settled, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeBoolean(More, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeUByte(RcvSettleMode, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeSerializable(State, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeBoolean(Resume, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeBoolean(Aborted, buffer);
			AmqpCodec.EncodeBoolean(Batchable, buffer);
		}

		protected override void OnDecode(ByteBuffer buffer, int count)
		{
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				base.Handle = AmqpCodec.DecodeUInt(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				DeliveryId = AmqpCodec.DecodeUInt(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				DeliveryTag = AmqpCodec.DecodeBinary(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				MessageFormat = AmqpCodec.DecodeUInt(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				Settled = AmqpCodec.DecodeBoolean(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				More = AmqpCodec.DecodeBoolean(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				RcvSettleMode = AmqpCodec.DecodeUByte(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				State = (DeliveryState)AmqpCodec.DecodeAmqpDescribed(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				Resume = AmqpCodec.DecodeBoolean(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				Aborted = AmqpCodec.DecodeBoolean(buffer);
			}
			if (count-- > 0)
			{
				Batchable = AmqpCodec.DecodeBoolean(buffer);
			}
		}

		protected override int OnValueSize()
		{
			int num = 0;
			num += AmqpCodec.GetUIntEncodeSize(base.Handle);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetUIntEncodeSize(DeliveryId);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetBinaryEncodeSize(DeliveryTag);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetUIntEncodeSize(MessageFormat);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetBooleanEncodeSize(Settled);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetBooleanEncodeSize(More);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetUByteEncodeSize(RcvSettleMode);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetSerializableEncodeSize(State);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetBooleanEncodeSize(Resume);
			num += AmqpCodec.GetBooleanEncodeSize(Aborted);
			return num + AmqpCodec.GetBooleanEncodeSize(Batchable);
		}
	}

	[DataContract(Name = "Property", Namespace = "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2010/10/servicebus/connect")]
	public class Property : ICloneable
	{
		private const string PropertyName = "Property";

		private const string NameName = "Name";

		private const string ValueName = "Value";

		private const string ModifiedName = "Modified";

		private const string RevisionName = "Revision";

		private const string CreatedName = "Created";

	[DataContract(Name = "UsageCredit", Namespace = "http://schemas.microsoft.com/netservices/2010/10/servicebus/connect")]
	public class UsageCredit : IExtensibleDataObject, IEquatable<UsageCredit>
	{
		public static readonly DataContractSerializer Serializer = new DataContractSerializer(typeof(UsageCredit));

		private const char ConnectChar = '_';

		[DataMember(Name = "KeyName", IsRequired = false, Order = 1001, EmitDefaultValue = false)]
		public string KeyName
		{
			get
			{
				return RequestorService + "_" + Identifier;
			}
			set
			{
			}
		}

		[DataMember(Name = "RequestorService", IsRequired = true, Order = 1002, EmitDefaultValue = false)]
		public string RequestorService { get; set; }

		[DataMember(Name = "Identifier", IsRequired = true, Order = 1003, EmitDefaultValue = false)]
		public string Identifier { get; set; }

		[DataMember(Name = "NHBasicUnit", IsRequired = false, Order = 1004, EmitDefaultValue = false)]
		public int? NHBasicUnit { get; set; }

		[DataMember(Name = "NHStandardUnit", IsRequired = false, Order = 1005, EmitDefaultValue = false)]
		public int? NHStandardUnit { get; set; }

		[DataMember(Name = "Revision", IsRequired = false, Order = 1006, EmitDefaultValue = true)]
		public long Revision { get; set; }

		[DataMember(Name = "UpdatedAt", IsRequired = false, Order = 1007, EmitDefaultValue = false)]
		public DateTime UpdatedAt { get; set; }

		public ExtensionDataObject ExtensionData { get; set; }

		public string SubscriptionId { get; set; }

		public string NamespaceName { get; set; }

		internal long Id { get; set; }

		internal bool Hidden { get; set; }

		public override string ToString()
		{
			using MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			using (XmlWriter.Create(memoryStream, new XmlWriterSettings
			{
				Encoding = Encoding.UTF8
			}))
			{
				Serializer.WriteObject(memoryStream, this);
				memoryStream.Flush();
				return Encoding.UTF8.GetString(memoryStream.ToArray());
			}
		}

		public bool Equals(UsageCredit other)
		{
			if (Id != 0L && other.Id != 0L)
			{
				return Id == other.Id;
			}
			if (SubscriptionId.Equals(other.SubscriptionId, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) && NamespaceName.Equals(other.NamespaceName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) && RequestorService.Equals(other.RequestorService, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				return Identifier.Equals(other.Identifier, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static bool TryParseKey(string key, out string identifier, out string requestorService)
		{
			string[] array = key.Split('_');
			if (array.Length == 2)
			{
				requestorService = array[0];
				identifier = array[1];
				return true;
			}
			identifier = null;
			requestorService = null;
			return false;
		}
	}

	internal sealed class AsyncIOTask
	{
		private sealed class SleepTask : TaskCompletionSource<bool>
		{
			private static readonly Action<object> onTimer = OnTimer;

			private static readonly Action<object> onTimerCancel = OnTimerCancel;

			private readonly IOThreadTimer timer;

			private readonly CancellationTokenRegistration cancellationTokenRegistration;

			public SleepTask(TimeSpan amount, CancellationToken cancellationToken, bool isTypicallyCanceledShortlyAfterBeingSet)
			{
				timer = new IOThreadTimer(onTimer, this, isTypicallyCanceledShortlyAfterBeingSet);
				timer.Set(amount);
				cancellationTokenRegistration = cancellationToken.Register(onTimerCancel, this);
			}

			private static void OnTimerCancel(object state)
			{
				SleepTask sleepTask = (SleepTask)state;
				if (sleepTask.timer.Cancel())
				{
					using (sleepTask.cancellationTokenRegistration)
					{
						sleepTask.TrySetResult(result: false);
					}
				}
			}

			private static void OnTimer(object state)
			{
				SleepTask sleepTask = (SleepTask)state;
				using (sleepTask.cancellationTokenRegistration)
				{
					sleepTask.TrySetResult(result: true);
				}
			}
		}

		public static Task<bool> Delay(TimeSpan delay)
		{
			return Delay(delay, CancellationToken.None);
		}

		public static Task<bool> Delay(TimeSpan delay, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			return Delay(delay, isTypicallyCanceledShortlyAfterBeingSet: false, cancellationToken);
		}

		public static Task<bool> Delay(TimeSpan delay, bool isTypicallyCanceledShortlyAfterBeingSet, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			return new SleepTask(delay, cancellationToken, isTypicallyCanceledShortlyAfterBeingSet).Task;
		}
	}
	internal class ByteUtility
	{
		public static bool EndsWithTwoAsciiNewLines(byte[] buffer, int length)
		{
			if (length >= 4)
			{
				if (buffer[length - 4] == 13 && buffer[length - 3] == 10 && buffer[length - 2] == 13)
				{
					return buffer[length - 1] == 10;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static int IndexOfAsciiChar(byte[] array, int offset, int count, char asciiChar)
		{
			for (int i = offset; i < offset + count; i++)
			{
				if (array[i] == asciiChar)
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public static int IndexOfAsciiChars(byte[] array, int offset, int count, char asciiChar1, char asciiChar2)
		{
			for (int i = offset; i < offset + count - 1; i++)
			{
				if (array[i] == asciiChar1 && array[i + 1] == asciiChar2)
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}
	}
	internal sealed class InternalBufferManagerStream : Stream
	{
		private readonly InternalBufferManager bufferManager;

		private readonly byte[] managedBuffer;

		private int length;

		private int position;

		private int disposed;

		public override bool CanRead => true;

		public override bool CanSeek => true;

		public override bool CanWrite => true;

		public override long Length => length;

		public override long Position
		{
			get
			{
				return position;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value < 0 || value > length)
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentOutOfRange("Position", value, SRClient.ArgumentOutOfRange(0, length), Activity);
				}
				position = checked((int)value);
			}
		}

		private int Capacity => managedBuffer.Length;

		private EventTraceActivity Activity { get; }

		public InternalBufferManagerStream(InternalBufferManager bufferManager, int bufferSize, EventTraceActivity activity)
		{
			if (bufferManager == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("bufferManager", Activity);
			}
			this.bufferManager = bufferManager;
			Activity = activity;
			managedBuffer = this.bufferManager.TakeBuffer(bufferSize);
		}

		public new void CopyTo(Stream destination)
		{
			if (destination == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("destination", Activity);
			}
			destination.Write(managedBuffer, position, length - position);
			position = length;
		}

		public override async Task CopyToAsync(Stream destination, int bufferSize, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			if (destination == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("destination", Activity);
			}
			await destination.WriteAsync(managedBuffer, position, length - position, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			position = length;
		}

		public override void Flush()
		{
		}

		public override Task FlushAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			Flush();
			return Task.CompletedTask;
		}

		public override int Read(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)
		{
			if (buffer == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("buffer", Activity);
			}
			if (offset < 0 || offset > buffer.Length - 1)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentOutOfRange("offset", offset, SRClient.ArgumentOutOfRange(0, buffer.Length - 1), Activity);
			}
			if (count < 0 || count + offset > buffer.Length)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentOutOfRange("count", count, SRClient.ArgumentOutOfRange(0, buffer.Length), Activity);
			}
			int num = Math.Min(count, length - position);
			Buffer.BlockCopy(managedBuffer, position, buffer, offset, num);
			position += num;
			return num;
		}

		public override Task<int> ReadAsync(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			return Task.FromResult(Read(buffer, offset, count));
		}

		public override IAsyncResult BeginRead(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new CompletedAsyncResult<int>(Read(buffer, offset, count), callback, state);
		}

		public override int EndRead(IAsyncResult asyncResult)
		{
			return CompletedAsyncResult<int>.End(asyncResult);
		}

		public override long Seek(long offset, SeekOrigin origin)
		{
			int num = checked((int)offset);
			switch (origin)
			{
			case SeekOrigin.Begin:
				if (offset < 0 || offset > length)
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentOutOfRange("offset", offset, SRClient.ArgumentOutOfRange(0, length), Activity);
				}
				position = num;
				break;
			case SeekOrigin.Current:
				if (offset < -position || offset > length - position)
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentOutOfRange("offset", offset, SRClient.ArgumentOutOfRange(-position, length - position), Activity);
				}
				position += num;
				break;
			default:
				if (offset < -length || offset > 0)
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentOutOfRange("offset", offset, SRClient.ArgumentOutOfRange(-length, 0), Activity);
				}
				position = length + num;
				break;
			}
			return position;
		}

		public override void SetLength(long value)
		{
			if (value < 0 || value > Capacity)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentOutOfRange("value", value, SRClient.ArgumentOutOfRange(0, Capacity), Activity);
			}
			length = checked((int)value);
		}

		public override void Write(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)
		{
			if (buffer == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("buffer", Activity);
			}
			if (offset < 0 || offset > buffer.Length - 1)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentOutOfRange("offset", offset, SRClient.ArgumentOutOfRange(0, buffer.Length - 1), Activity);
			}
			if (count < 0 || count + offset > buffer.Length || count + position > Capacity)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentOutOfRange("count", count, SRClient.ArgumentOutOfRange(0, buffer.Length), Activity);
			}
			Buffer.BlockCopy(buffer, offset, managedBuffer, position, count);
			position += count;
			length = Math.Max(position, length);
		}

		public override Task WriteAsync(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			Write(buffer, offset, count);
			return Task.CompletedTask;
		}

		public override IAsyncResult BeginWrite(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			Write(buffer, offset, count);
			return new CompletedAsyncResult(callback, state);
		}

		public override void EndWrite(IAsyncResult asyncResult)
		{
			CompletedAsyncResult.End(asyncResult);
		}

		public void Write(Stream sourceStream)
		{
			if (sourceStream == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("sourceStream", Activity);
			}
			while (true)
			{
				int num = sourceStream.Read(managedBuffer, position, Capacity - position);
				if (num != 0)
				{
					position += num;
					length = Math.Max(position, length);
					if (position == Capacity && sourceStream.Read(managedBuffer, 0, 1) != 0)
					{
						throw Fx.Exception.AsWarning(new InvalidOperationException(Resources.InsufficentMemory), Activity);
					}
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			base.Dispose(disposing);
			if (disposing && Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref disposed, 1, 0) == 0)
			{
				bufferManager.ReturnBuffer(managedBuffer);
			}
		}
	}
	internal static class MessageExtensionMethods
	{
		public static void AddHeader<T>(this System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message thisMessage, string name, string ns, T value)
		{
			MessageHeader header = MessageHeader.CreateHeader(name, ns, value);
			thisMessage.Headers.Add(header);
		}

		public static void AddHeaderIfNotNull<T>(this System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message thisMessage, string name, string ns, T value) where T : class
		{
			if (value != null)
			{
				MessageHeader header = MessageHeader.CreateHeader(name, ns, value);
				thisMessage.Headers.Add(header);
			}
		}

		public static bool TryGetHeader<T>(this System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message thisMessage, string name, string ns, out T value)
		{
			int num = thisMessage.Headers.FindHeader(name, ns);
			if (num != -1)
			{
				value = thisMessage.Headers.GetHeader<T>(num);
				return true;
			}
			value = default(T);
			return false;
		}

		public static T GetHeaderOrDefault<T>(this System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message thisMessage, string name, string ns, T defaultValue)
		{
			int num = thisMessage.Headers.FindHeader(name, ns);
			if (num != -1)
			{
				return thisMessage.Headers.GetHeader<T>(num);
			}
			return defaultValue;
		}

		public static void UpdateHeader(this System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message thisMessage, string name, string ns, object value)
		{
			int num = thisMessage.Headers.FindHeader(name, ns);
			if (num != -1)
			{
				thisMessage.Headers.RemoveAt(num);
			}
			MessageHeader header = MessageHeader.CreateHeader(name, ns, value);
			thisMessage.Headers.Add(header);
		}

		public static bool HasHeader(this System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message thisMessage, string name, string ns)
		{
			int num = thisMessage.Headers.FindHeader(name, ns);
			return num != -1;
		}
	}
	internal static class TaskCompletionSourceExtensions
	{
		public static bool TrySetFromTask<TResult>(this TaskCompletionSource<TResult> resultSetter, Task task)
		{
			return task.Status switch
			{
				TaskStatus.RanToCompletion => resultSetter.TrySetResult((task is Task<TResult>) ? ((Task<TResult>)task).Result : default(TResult)), 
				TaskStatus.Faulted => resultSetter.TrySetException(task.Exception.InnerExceptions), 
				TaskStatus.Canceled => resultSetter.TrySetCanceled(), 
				_ => throw new InvalidOperationException("The task was not completed."), 
			};
		}
	}
	internal static class TaskExtensions
	{
		public static void Fork(this Task thisTask)
		{
			thisTask.Fork("TaskExtensions.Fork");
		}

		public static void Fork(this Task thisTask, string tracingInfo)
		{
			thisTask.ContinueWith(delegate(Task t, object s)
			{
				Fx.Exception.TraceHandled(t.Exception, (string)s);
			}, tracingInfo, TaskContinuationOptions.OnlyOnFaulted);
		}

		public static Task Then(this Task task, Func<Task> next)
		{
			if (task == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("task");
			}
			if (next == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("next");
			}
			TaskCompletionSource<object> tcs = new TaskCompletionSource<object>();
			task.ContinueWith(delegate
			{
				if (task.IsFaulted)
				{
					tcs.TrySetException(task.Exception.InnerExceptions);
				}
				else
				{
					if (!task.IsCanceled)
					{
						try
						{
							next().ContinueWith((Task t) => tcs.TrySetFromTask(t), TaskScheduler.Default);
							return;
						}
						catch (Exception exception)
						{
							tcs.TrySetException(exception);
							return;
						}
					}
					tcs.TrySetCanceled();
				}
			}, TaskScheduler.Default);
			return tcs.Task;
		}

		public static Task Then<T>(this Task<T> task, Func<T, Task> next)
		{
			if (task == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("task");
			}
			if (next == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("next");
			}
			TaskCompletionSource<object> tcs = new TaskCompletionSource<object>();
			task.ContinueWith(delegate
			{
				if (task.IsFaulted)
				{
					tcs.TrySetException(task.Exception.InnerExceptions);
				}
				else
				{
					if (!task.IsCanceled)
					{
						try
						{
							next(task.Result).ContinueWith((Task t) => tcs.TrySetFromTask(t), TaskScheduler.Default);
							return;
						}
						catch (Exception exception)
						{
							tcs.TrySetException(exception);
							return;
						}
					}
					tcs.TrySetCanceled();
				}
			}, TaskScheduler.Default);
			return tcs.Task;
		}

		public static Task<TResult> Then<TResult>(this Task task, Func<Task<TResult>> next)
		{
			if (task == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("task");
			}
			if (next == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("next");
			}

			task.ContinueWith(delegate
			{
				if (task.IsFaulted)
				{
					tcs.TrySetException(task.Exception.InnerExceptions);
				}

					{
						try
						{
							next().ContinueWith((Task<TResult> t) => tcs.TrySetFromTask(t), TaskScheduler.Default);
							return;
						}
						catch (Exception exception)
						{
							tcs.TrySetException(exception);
							return;
						}
					}
					tcs.TrySetCanceled();
				}
			}, TaskScheduler.Default);
			return tcs.Task;
		}

		public static Task<TNewResult> Then<TResult, TNewResult>(this Task<TResult> task, Func<TResult, Task<TNewResult>> next)
		{
			if (task == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("task");
			}
			if (next == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("next");
			}
			TaskCompletionSource<TNewResult> tcs = new TaskCompletionSource<TNewResult>();
			task.ContinueWith(delegate
			{
				if (task.IsFaulted)
				{
					tcs.TrySetException(task.Exception.InnerExceptions);
				}
				else

					if (!task.IsCanceled)
					{
						try
						{
							next(task.Result).ContinueWith((Task<TNewResult> t) => tcs.TrySetFromTask(t), TaskScheduler.Default);
							return;
						}
						catch (Exception exception)
						{
							tcs.TrySetException(exception);
							return;
						}
					}
					tcs.TrySetCanceled();
				}
			}, TaskScheduler.Default);
			return tcs.Task;
		}

		public static Task CommitAsync(this CommittableTransaction committableTransaction)
		{
			return TaskHelpers.FromAsync((AsyncCallback c, object s) => ((CommittableTransaction)s).BeginCommit(c, s), delegate(IAsyncResult a)
			{
				((CommittableTransaction)a.AsyncState).EndCommit(a);
			}, committableTransaction);
		}

	internal sealed class PendingOperationTracker
	{
		private sealed class WaitPendingOperationsAsyncResult : AsyncResult<WaitPendingOperationsAsyncResult>
		{
			private static readonly AsyncCallback StaticOnWaiterCompleted = OnWaiterCompleted;

			private readonly PendingOperationTracker owner;

			private readonly TimeSpan timeout;

			public WaitPendingOperationsAsyncResult(PendingOperationTracker owner, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(callback, state)
			{
				this.owner = owner;
				this.timeout = timeout;
				AsyncWaiter asyncWaiter = null;
				lock (this.owner.syncLock)
				{
					this.owner.rejectNewRequests = true;
					if (this.owner.pendingOperationCount > 0)
					{
						asyncWaiter = new AsyncWaiter(timeout, StaticOnWaiterCompleted, this);
						this.owner.waiters.Add(asyncWaiter);
					}
				}
				if (asyncWaiter == null)
				{
					Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: true);
				}
			}

			private static void OnWaiterCompleted(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				WaitPendingOperationsAsyncResult waitPendingOperationsAsyncResult = (WaitPendingOperationsAsyncResult)result.AsyncState;
				if (AsyncWaiter.End(result))
				{
					waitPendingOperationsAsyncResult.Complete(result.CompletedSynchronously);
					return;
				}
				TimeoutException e = new TimeoutException(SRCore.TimeoutOnOperation(waitPendingOperationsAsyncResult.timeout));
				waitPendingOperationsAsyncResult.Complete(result.CompletedSynchronously, e);
			}
		}

		private readonly List<AsyncWaiter> waiters;

		private readonly object syncLock;

		private long pendingOperationCount;

		private bool rejectNewRequests;

		public bool RejectNewRequests
		{
			get
			{
				lock (syncLock)
				{
					return rejectNewRequests;
				}
			}
		}

		public PendingOperationTracker()
		{
			waiters = new List<AsyncWaiter>(1);
			syncLock = new object();
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginWaitPendingOperations(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new WaitPendingOperationsAsyncResult(this, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		public void EndWaitPendingOperations(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			AsyncResult<WaitPendingOperationsAsyncResult>.End(result);
		}

		public void DecrementOperationCount()
		{
			DecrementOperationCount(1L);
		}

		public void IncrementOperationCount()
		{
			IncrementOperationCount(1L);
		}

		public void IncrementOperationCount(long count)
		{
			lock (syncLock)
			{
				if (rejectNewRequests)
				{
					throw new OperationCanceledException("Object is in the process of idling");
				}
				pendingOperationCount += count;
			}
		}

		private void DecrementOperationCount(long count)
		{
			List<AsyncWaiter> list = null;
			lock (syncLock)
			{
				pendingOperationCount -= count;
				if (waiters.Count != 0)
				{
					list = new List<AsyncWaiter>(waiters);
					waiters.Clear();
				}
			}
			if (list == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (AsyncWaiter item in list)
			{
				item.Signal();
			}
		}
	}

		void ICollection.CopyTo(Array array, int index)
		{
			if (array == null)
			{
				Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("array");
			}
			if (array.Rank != 1 || array.GetLowerBound(0) != 0)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.Argument("array", SRClient.InvalidBufferSize);
			}
			if (index < 0 || index > array.Length)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentOutOfRange("index", index, SRClient.ValueMustBeNonNegative);
			}
			if (array.Length - index < Count)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.Argument("array", SRClient.InvalidBufferSize);
			}
			if (array is KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue>[] array2)
			{
				m_dictionary.CopyTo(array2, index);
				return;
			}
			if (array is DictionaryEntry[] array3)
			{
				{
					foreach (KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue> item in m_dictionary)
					{
						array3[index++] = new DictionaryEntry(item.Key, item.Value);
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			if (!(array is object[] array4))
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.Argument("array", SRClient.InvalidBufferSize);
			}
			try
			{
				foreach (KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue> item2 in m_dictionary)
				{
					array4[index++] = new KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue>(item2.Key, item2.Value);
				}
			}
			catch (ArrayTypeMismatchException)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.Argument("array", SRClient.InvalidBufferSize);
			}
		}

	internal struct Timestamp : IComparable<Timestamp>, IEquatable<Timestamp>
	{
		private static readonly double TickFrequency = 10000000.0 / (double)Stopwatch.Frequency;

		private readonly long timestamp;

		public static Timestamp Now => new Timestamp(Stopwatch.GetTimestamp());

		public TimeSpan Elapsed => new TimeSpan(GetElapsedDateTimeTicks());

		public long ElapsedTicks => GetElapsedDateTimeTicks();

		private Timestamp(long timestamp)
		{
			this.timestamp = timestamp;
		}

		private static long ConvertRawTicksToTicks(long rawTicks)
		{
			if (Stopwatch.IsHighResolution)
			{
				double num = (double)rawTicks * TickFrequency;
				return (long)num;
			}
			return rawTicks;
		}

		private long GetRawElapsedTicks()
		{
			return Stopwatch.GetTimestamp() - timestamp;
		}

		private long GetElapsedDateTimeTicks()
		{
			long rawElapsedTicks = GetRawElapsedTicks();
			return ConvertRawTicksToTicks(rawElapsedTicks);
		}

		public int CompareTo(Timestamp other)
		{
			return timestamp.CompareTo(other.timestamp);
		}

		public bool Equals(Timestamp other)
		{
			return timestamp == other.timestamp;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return timestamp.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is Timestamp)
			{
				return Equals((Timestamp)obj);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator ==(Timestamp t1, Timestamp t2)
		{
			return t1.timestamp == t2.timestamp;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(Timestamp t1, Timestamp t2)
		{
			return t1.timestamp != t2.timestamp;
		}

		public static bool operator >(Timestamp t1, Timestamp t2)
		{
			return t1.timestamp > t2.timestamp;
		}

		public static bool operator <(Timestamp t1, Timestamp t2)
		{
			return t1.timestamp < t2.timestamp;
		}

		public static bool operator >=(Timestamp t1, Timestamp t2)
		{
			return t1.timestamp >= t2.timestamp;
		}

		public static bool operator <=(Timestamp t1, Timestamp t2)
		{
			return t1.timestamp <= t2.timestamp;
		}

		public static Timestamp operator +(Timestamp t, TimeSpan duration)
		{
			long num = (long)((double)t.timestamp + (double)duration.Ticks / TickFrequency);
			return new Timestamp(num);
		}

		public static Timestamp operator -(Timestamp t, TimeSpan duration)
		{
			long num = (long)((double)t.timestamp - (double)duration.Ticks / TickFrequency);
			return new Timestamp(num);
		}

		public static TimeSpan operator -(Timestamp t1, Timestamp t2)
		{
			long rawTicks = t1.timestamp - t2.timestamp;
			long ticks = ConvertRawTicksToTicks(rawTicks);
			return new TimeSpan(ticks);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class AsyncSemaphore
	{
		private sealed class SemaphoreWaiter : AsyncResult<SemaphoreWaiter>
		{
			private static readonly Action<object> OnTimeoutElapsedStaticDelegate = OnTimeoutElapsed;

			private readonly AsyncSemaphore owner;

			private readonly TimeSpan timeout;

			private IOThreadTimer timer;

			private bool result;

			public LinkedListNode<SemaphoreWaiter> Node { get; private set; }

			public SemaphoreWaiter(AsyncSemaphore owner, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(callback, state)
			{
				this.owner = owner;
				this.timeout = timeout;
				result = true;
			}

			public new static bool End(IAsyncResult asyncResult)
			{
				return AsyncResult<SemaphoreWaiter>.End(asyncResult).result;
			}

			public void Signal(bool completedSynchronously, bool result)
			{
				this.result = result;
				if (completedSynchronously)
				{
					Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: true);
					return;
				}
				IOThreadScheduler.ScheduleCallbackNoFlow(delegate(object o)
				{
					((SemaphoreWaiter)o).Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: false);
				}, this);
			}

			public void StartTimer(LinkedListNode<SemaphoreWaiter> node)
			{
				Node = node;
				timer = new IOThreadTimer(OnTimeoutElapsedStaticDelegate, this, isTypicallyCanceledShortlyAfterBeingSet: true);
				timer.SetIfValid(timeout);
			}

			private static void OnTimeoutElapsed(object state)
			{
				SemaphoreWaiter semaphoreWaiter = (SemaphoreWaiter)state;
				semaphoreWaiter.owner.HandleTimeout(semaphoreWaiter);
			}
		}

		private readonly int maximumCount;

		private readonly LinkedList<SemaphoreWaiter> waiters;

		private int remainingCount;

		private object SyncRoot => waiters;

		public AsyncSemaphore(int maximumCount)
			: this(maximumCount, maximumCount)
		{
		}

		private AsyncSemaphore(int remainingCount, int maximumCount)
		{
			if (remainingCount <= 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("remainingCount", remainingCount, Resources.ValueMustBePositive);
			}
			if (maximumCount <= 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("maximumCount", maximumCount, Resources.ValueMustBePositive);
			}
			if (remainingCount > maximumCount)
			{
				string message = string.Format(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, Resources.ValueMustBeInRange, 0, maximumCount);
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("remainingCount", remainingCount, message);
			}
			this.remainingCount = remainingCount;
			this.maximumCount = maximumCount;
			waiters = new LinkedList<SemaphoreWaiter>();
		}

		public bool TryEnter()
		{
			lock (SyncRoot)
			{
				if (remainingCount > 0)
				{
					remainingCount--;
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginEnter(AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return BeginEnter(TimeSpan.MaxValue, callback, state);
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginEnter(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			bool flag;
			SemaphoreWaiter semaphoreWaiter;
			lock (SyncRoot)
			{
				if (remainingCount > 0)
				{
					flag = true;
					remainingCount--;
					semaphoreWaiter = new SemaphoreWaiter(this, TimeSpan.MaxValue, callback, state);
				}
				else
				{
					flag = false;
					semaphoreWaiter = new SemaphoreWaiter(this, timeout, callback, state);
					LinkedListNode<SemaphoreWaiter> node = waiters.AddLast(semaphoreWaiter);
					semaphoreWaiter.StartTimer(node);
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				semaphoreWaiter.Signal(completedSynchronously: true, result: true);
			}
			return semaphoreWaiter;
		}

		public bool EndEnter(IAsyncResult asyncResult)
		{
			return SemaphoreWaiter.End(asyncResult);
		}

		public void Exit()
		{
			SemaphoreWaiter semaphoreWaiter = null;
			lock (SyncRoot)
			{
				if (remainingCount == maximumCount)
				{
					throw new SemaphoreFullException(SRCore.AsyncSemaphoreExitCalledWithoutEnter);
				}
				if (waiters.Count > 0)
				{
					LinkedListNode<SemaphoreWaiter> first = waiters.First;
					waiters.Remove(first);
					semaphoreWaiter = first.Value;
				}
				else
				{
					remainingCount++;
				}
			}
			semaphoreWaiter?.Signal(completedSynchronously: false, result: true);
		}

		private void HandleTimeout(SemaphoreWaiter waiter)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			lock (SyncRoot)
			{
				if (waiter.Node.List != null)
				{
					flag = true;
					waiters.Remove(waiter.Node);
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				waiter.Signal(completedSynchronously: false, result: false);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class AsyncWaitHandle
	{
		private class AsyncWaiter : ActionItem
		{
			[SecurityCritical]
			private Action<object, TimeoutException> callback;

			[SecurityCritical]
			private object state;

			private IOThreadTimer timer;

			private TimeSpan originalTimeout;

			public AsyncWaitHandle Parent { get; private set; }

			public bool TimedOut { get; set; }

			public AsyncWaiter(AsyncWaitHandle parent, Action<object, TimeoutException> callback, object state)
			{
				Parent = parent;
				this.callback = callback;
				this.state = state;
			}

			public void Call()
			{
				Schedule();
			}

			[SecurityCritical]
			protected override void Invoke()
			{
				callback(state, TimedOut ? new TimeoutException(SRCore.TimeoutOnOperation(originalTimeout)) : null);
			}

			public void SetTimer(Action<object> timerCallback, object timerState, TimeSpan timeout)
			{
				if (timer != null)
				{
					throw Fx.Exception.AsError(new InvalidOperationException(SRCore.MustCancelOldTimer));
				}
				originalTimeout = timeout;
				timer = new IOThreadTimer(timerCallback, timerState, isTypicallyCanceledShortlyAfterBeingSet: false);
				timer.Set(timeout);
			}

			public void CancelTimer()
			{
				if (timer != null)
				{
					timer.Cancel();
					timer = null;
				}
			}
		}

		private static Action<object> timerCompleteCallback;

		private List<AsyncWaiter> asyncWaiters;

		private volatile bool isSignaled;

		private EventResetMode resetMode;

		private object syncObject;

		public AsyncWaitHandle()
			: this(EventResetMode.AutoReset)
		{
		}

		public AsyncWaitHandle(EventResetMode resetMode)
		{
			this.resetMode = resetMode;
			syncObject = new object();
		}

		public bool WaitAsync(Action<object, TimeoutException> callback, object state, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			if (!isSignaled || (isSignaled && resetMode == EventResetMode.AutoReset))
			{
				lock (syncObject)
				{
					if (isSignaled && resetMode == EventResetMode.AutoReset)
					{
						isSignaled = false;
					}
					else if (!isSignaled)
					{
						AsyncWaiter asyncWaiter = new AsyncWaiter(this, callback, state);
						if (asyncWaiters == null)
						{
							asyncWaiters = new List<AsyncWaiter>();
						}
						asyncWaiters.Add(asyncWaiter);
						if (timeout != TimeSpan.MaxValue)
						{
							if (timerCompleteCallback == null)
							{
								timerCompleteCallback = OnTimerComplete;
							}
							asyncWaiter.SetTimer(timerCompleteCallback, asyncWaiter, timeout);
						}
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static void OnTimerComplete(object state)
		{
			AsyncWaiter asyncWaiter = (AsyncWaiter)state;
			AsyncWaitHandle parent = asyncWaiter.Parent;
			bool flag = false;
			lock (parent.syncObject)
			{
				if (parent.asyncWaiters != null && parent.asyncWaiters.Remove(asyncWaiter))
				{
					asyncWaiter.TimedOut = true;
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			asyncWaiter.CancelTimer();
			if (flag)
			{
				asyncWaiter.Call();
			}
		}

		public void Set()
		{
			List<AsyncWaiter> list = null;
			AsyncWaiter asyncWaiter = null;
			if (!isSignaled)
			{
				lock (syncObject)
				{
					if (!isSignaled)
					{
						if (resetMode == EventResetMode.ManualReset)
						{
							isSignaled = true;
							Monitor.PulseAll(syncObject);
							list = asyncWaiters;
							asyncWaiters = null;
						}
						else if (asyncWaiters != null && asyncWaiters.Count > 0)
						{
							asyncWaiter = asyncWaiters[0];
							asyncWaiters.RemoveAt(0);
						}
						else
						{
							isSignaled = true;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (list != null)
			{
				foreach (AsyncWaiter item in list)
				{
					item.CancelTimer();
					item.Call();
				}
			}
			if (asyncWaiter != null)
			{
				asyncWaiter.CancelTimer();
				asyncWaiter.Call();
			}
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			isSignaled = false;
		}
	}
	internal sealed class BeginEndAsyncWaitHandle
	{
		private sealed class WaitAsyncResult : AsyncResult
		{
			private static readonly Action<object, TimeoutException> onWaitCallback = OnWaitCallback;

			private readonly AsyncWaitHandle waitHandle;

			private readonly EventTraceActivity activity;

			protected internal override EventTraceActivity Activity => activity;

			public WaitAsyncResult(AsyncWaitHandle waitHandle, EventTraceActivity activity, AsyncCallback callback, object state, TimeSpan timeout)
				: base(callback, state)
			{
				this.waitHandle = waitHandle;
				this.activity = activity;
				if (this.waitHandle.WaitAsync(onWaitCallback, this, timeout))
				{
					Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: true);
				}
			}

			public static void End(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				AsyncResult.End<WaitAsyncResult>(result);
			}

			private static void OnWaitCallback(object state, TimeoutException ex)
			{
				WaitAsyncResult waitAsyncResult = (WaitAsyncResult)state;
				waitAsyncResult.Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: false, ex);
			}
		}

		private readonly AsyncWaitHandle waitHandle;

		public BeginEndAsyncWaitHandle()
		{
			waitHandle = new AsyncWaitHandle(EventResetMode.AutoReset);
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginWait(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return BeginWait(null, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginWait(EventTraceActivity activity, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new WaitAsyncResult(waitHandle, activity, callback, state, timeout);
		}

		public void EndWait(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			WaitAsyncResult.End(result);
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			waitHandle.Reset();
		}

		public void Set()
		{
			waitHandle.Set();
		}
	}
	internal static class ConcurrentRandom
	{
		private static readonly Random seedGenerator = new Random();

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static Random threadLocalRandom;

		public static int Next(int minValueInclusive, int maxValueExclusive)
		{
			return GetThreadLocalRandom().Next(minValueInclusive, maxValueExclusive);
		}

		public static long NextPositiveLong()
		{
			byte[] array = new byte[8];
			GetThreadLocalRandom().NextBytes(array);
			long value = (long)BitConverter.ToUInt64(array, 0);
			return Math.Abs(value);
		}

		private static Random GetThreadLocalRandom()
		{
			if (threadLocalRandom == null)
			{
				int seed;
				lock (seedGenerator)
				{
					seed = seedGenerator.Next();
				}
				threadLocalRandom = new Random(seed);
			}
			return threadLocalRandom;
		}
	}
