		private void SetReadTimeout(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			if (timeout != lastReadTimeout)
			{
				int readTimeout = TimeoutHelper.ToMilliseconds(timeout);
				if (stream.CanTimeout)
				{
					stream.ReadTimeout = readTimeout;
				}
				innerStream.ReadTimeout = readTimeout;
				lastReadTimeout = timeout;
			}
		}

		private void SetWriteTimeout(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			if (timeout != lastWriteTimeout)
			{
				int writeTimeout = TimeoutHelper.ToMilliseconds(timeout);
				if (stream.CanTimeout)
				{
					stream.WriteTimeout = writeTimeout;
				}
				innerStream.WriteTimeout = writeTimeout;
				lastWriteTimeout = timeout;
			}
		}

		public int Read(byte[] buffer, int offset, int size, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			try
			{
				SetReadTimeout(timeout);
				return stream.Read(buffer, offset, size);
			}
			catch (IOException ioException)
			{
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(ConvertIOException(ioException), this, EventLevel.Warning, "Read", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\Connection.cs", 765);
			}
		}

		public AsyncReadResult BeginRead(int offset, int size, TimeSpan timeout, WaitCallback callback, object state)
		{
			ConnectionUtilities.ValidateBufferBounds(AsyncReadBufferSize, offset, size);
			readCallback = callback;
			try
			{
				SetReadTimeout(timeout);
				IAsyncResult asyncResult = stream.BeginRead(AsyncReadBuffer, offset, size, onRead, state);
				if (!asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
				{
					return AsyncReadResult.Queued;
				}
				bytesRead = stream.EndRead(asyncResult);
			}
			catch (IOException ioException)
			{
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(ConvertIOException(ioException), this, EventLevel.Warning, "BeginRead", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\Connection.cs", 788);
			}
			return AsyncReadResult.Completed;
		}

		public int EndRead()
		{
			if (readResult != null)
			{
				IAsyncResult asyncResult = readResult;
				readResult = null;
				try
				{
					bytesRead = stream.EndRead(asyncResult);
				}
				catch (IOException ioException)
				{
					throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(ConvertIOException(ioException), this, EventLevel.Warning, "EndRead", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\Connection.cs", 807);
				}
			}
			return bytesRead;
		}

		private void OnRead(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (!result.CompletedSynchronously)
			{
				if (readResult != null)
				{
					throw Fx.AssertAndThrow("StreamConnection: OnRead called twice.");
				}
				readResult = result;
				readCallback(result.AsyncState);
			}
		}

		T IConnection.GetProperty<T>()
		{
			return innerStream.Connection.GetProperty<T>();
		}

		internal static void CloseNoThrow(IConnection connection, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			try
			{
				connection.Close(timeout);
				flag = true;
			}
			catch (TimeoutException exception)
			{
				ServiceBusEventSource.Log.HandledException(exception, connection, EventLevel.Warning, "CloseNoThrow", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\Connection.cs", 868);
			}
			catch (CommunicationException exception2)

				ServiceBusEventSource.Log.HandledException(exception2, connection, EventLevel.Warning, "CloseNoThrow", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\Connection.cs", 872);

			finally
			{
				if (!flag)
				{
					connection.Abort();

			}
		}

		internal static void ValidateBufferBounds(byte[] buffer, int offset, int size)
		{
			if (buffer == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("buffer");
			}
			ValidateBufferBounds(buffer.Length, offset, size);
		}

		internal static void ValidateBufferBounds(int bufferSize, int offset, int size)
		{
			if (offset < 0)
			{
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("offset", offset, SR.GetString(Resources.ValueMustBeNonNegative)), null, EventLevel.Warning, "ValidateBufferBounds", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\Connection.cs", 897);
			}
			if (offset > bufferSize)
			{
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("offset", offset, SR.GetString(Resources.OffsetExceedsBufferSize, bufferSize)), null, EventLevel.Warning, "ValidateBufferBounds", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\Connection.cs", 903);
			}
			if (size <= 0)
			{
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("size", size, SR.GetString(Resources.ValueMustBePositive)), null, EventLevel.Warning, "ValidateBufferBounds", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\Connection.cs", 909);
			}
			int num = bufferSize - offset;
			if (size > num)
			{
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("size", size, SR.GetString(Resources.SizeExceedsRemainingBufferSpace, num)), null, EventLevel.Warning, "ValidateBufferBounds", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\Connection.cs", 916);
			}
		}

	internal delegate void ConnectionAvailableCallback(IConnection connection, Action connectionDequeuedCallback);
	internal delegate void ErrorCallback(Exception exception);
	internal class ConnectionAcceptor
	{
		private int maxAccepts;

		private int maxPendingConnections;

		private int connections;

		private int pendingAccepts;

		private IConnectionListener listener;

		private AsyncCallback acceptCompletedCallback;

		private Action<object> scheduleAcceptCallback;

		private Action onConnectionDequeued;

		private bool isDisposed;

		private ConnectionAvailableCallback callback;

		private ErrorCallback errorCallback;

		private bool IsAcceptNecessary
		{
			get
			{
				if (pendingAccepts < maxAccepts && connections + pendingAccepts < maxPendingConnections)
				{
					return !isDisposed;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public int ConnectionCount => connections;

		private object ThisLock => this;

		public ConnectionAcceptor(IConnectionListener listener, int maxAccepts, int maxPendingConnections, ConnectionAvailableCallback callback, ErrorCallback errorCallback)
		{
			if (maxAccepts <= 0)
			{
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("maxAccepts", maxAccepts, SR.GetString(Resources.ValueMustBePositive)), null, EventLevel.Warning, ".ctor", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\ConnectionAcceptor.cs", 37);
			}
			DiagnosticUtility.DebugAssert(maxPendingConnections > 0, "maxPendingConnections must be positive");
			this.listener = listener;
			this.maxAccepts = maxAccepts;
			this.maxPendingConnections = maxPendingConnections;
			this.callback = callback;
			this.errorCallback = errorCallback;
			onConnectionDequeued = OnConnectionDequeued;
			acceptCompletedCallback = DiagnosticUtility.ThunkAsyncCallback(AcceptCompletedCallback);
			scheduleAcceptCallback = ScheduleAcceptCallback;
		}

		private void AcceptIfNecessary(bool startAccepting)
		{
			if (!IsAcceptNecessary)
			{
				return;
			}
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				while (IsAcceptNecessary)
				{
					IAsyncResult asyncResult = null;
					Exception ex = null;
					try
					{
						asyncResult = listener.BeginAccept(acceptCompletedCallback, null);
					}
					catch (CommunicationException exception)
					{
						ServiceBusEventSource.Log.HandledException(exception, null, "Relay", this, EventLevel.Informational, "AcceptIfNecessary", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\ConnectionAcceptor.cs", 89);
					}
					catch (Exception ex2)
					{
						if (Fx.IsFatal(ex2))
						{
							throw;
						}
						if (startAccepting)
						{
							throw;
						}
						if (errorCallback == null && !ExceptionHandler.HandleTransportExceptionHelper(ex2))
						{
							throw;
						}
						ex = ex2;
					}
					if (ex != null && errorCallback != null)
					{
						errorCallback(ex);
					}
					if (asyncResult != null)
					{
						if (asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
						{
							IOThreadScheduler.ScheduleCallbackNoFlow(scheduleAcceptCallback, asyncResult);
						}
						pendingAccepts++;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void AcceptCompletedCallback(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (!result.CompletedSynchronously)
			{
				HandleCompletedAccept(result);
			}
		}

		private void HandleCompletedAccept(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			IConnection connection = null;
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				Exception ex = null;
				try
				{
					if (!isDisposed)
					{
						connection = listener.EndAccept(result);
						if (connection != null)
						{
							if (connections + 1 >= maxPendingConnections)
							{
								ServiceBusEventSource.Log.WcfEventWarning(TraceCode.MaxPendingConnectionsReached, this, maxPendingConnections.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), "HandleCompletedAccept", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\ConnectionAcceptor.cs", 156);
							}
							connections++;
						}
					}
					flag = true;
				}
				catch (CommunicationException exception)
				{
					ServiceBusEventSource.Log.HandledException(exception, null, "Relay", this, EventLevel.Informational, "HandleCompletedAccept", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\ConnectionAcceptor.cs", 168);
				}
				catch (Exception ex2)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(ex2))
					{
						throw;
					}
					if (errorCallback == null && !ExceptionHandler.HandleTransportExceptionHelper(ex2))
					{
						throw;
					}
					ex = ex2;
				}
				finally
				{
					if (!flag)
					{
						connection = null;
					}
					pendingAccepts--;
				}
				if (ex != null && errorCallback != null)
				{
					errorCallback(ex);
				}
			}
			AcceptIfNecessary(startAccepting: false);
			if (connection != null)
			{
				callback(connection, onConnectionDequeued);
			}
		}

		private void OnConnectionDequeued()
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				connections--;
			}
			AcceptIfNecessary(startAccepting: false);
		}

		private void ScheduleAcceptCallback(object state)
		{
			HandleCompletedAccept((IAsyncResult)state);
		}

		public void Open(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			listener.Open(timeout);
			AcceptIfNecessary(startAccepting: true);
		}

		public void Close(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (!isDisposed)
				{
					isDisposed = true;
					listener.Close(timeout);
				}
			}
		}

		public void Abort()
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (!isDisposed)
				{
					isDisposed = true;
					listener.Abort();
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal sealed class ConnectionDemuxer
	{
		private class ReuseConnectionState
		{
			private ConnectionModeReader modeReader;

			private TimeSpan closeTimeout;

			public ConnectionModeReader ModeReader => modeReader;

			public TimeSpan CloseTimeout => closeTimeout;

			public ReuseConnectionState(ConnectionModeReader modeReader, TimeSpan closeTimeout)
			{
				this.modeReader = modeReader;
				this.closeTimeout = closeTimeout;
			}
		}

		private ConnectionAcceptor acceptor;

		private List<InitialServerConnectionReader> connectionReaders;

		private bool isClosed;

		private ConnectionModeCallback onConnectionModeKnown;

		private ConnectionModeCallback onCachedConnectionModeKnown;

		private ConnectionClosedCallback onConnectionClosed;

		private ServerSessionPreambleCallback onSessionPreambleKnown;

		private ServerSingletonPreambleCallback onSingletonPreambleKnown;

		private Action<object> reuseConnectionCallback;

		private ServerSessionPreambleDemuxCallback serverSessionPreambleCallback;

		private SingletonPreambleDemuxCallback singletonPreambleCallback;

		private TransportSettingsCallback transportSettingsCallback;

		private Action pooledConnectionDequeuedCallback;

		private OnViaDelegate viaDelegate;

		private TimeSpan channelInitializationTimeout;

		private TimeSpan idleTimeout;

		private int maxPooledConnections;

		private int pooledConnectionCount;

		private object ThisLock => this;

		public ConnectionDemuxer(IConnectionListener listener, int maxAccepts, int maxPendingConnections, TimeSpan channelInitializationTimeout, TimeSpan idleTimeout, int maxPooledConnections, TransportSettingsCallback transportSettingsCallback, SingletonPreambleDemuxCallback singletonPreambleCallback, ServerSessionPreambleDemuxCallback serverSessionPreambleCallback, ErrorCallback errorCallback)
		{
			connectionReaders = new List<InitialServerConnectionReader>();
			acceptor = new ConnectionAcceptor(listener, maxAccepts, maxPendingConnections, OnConnectionAvailable, errorCallback);
			this.channelInitializationTimeout = channelInitializationTimeout;
			this.idleTimeout = idleTimeout;
			this.maxPooledConnections = maxPooledConnections;
			onConnectionClosed = OnConnectionClosed;
			this.transportSettingsCallback = transportSettingsCallback;
			this.singletonPreambleCallback = singletonPreambleCallback;
			this.serverSessionPreambleCallback = serverSessionPreambleCallback;
		}

		public void Close(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (!isClosed)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < connectionReaders.Count; i++)
					{
						connectionReaders[i].Dispose();
					}
					connectionReaders.Clear();
					acceptor.Close(timeout);
					isClosed = true;
				}
			}
		}

		public void Abort()
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (isClosed)
				{
					return;
				}
				isClosed = true;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < connectionReaders.Count; i++)
			{
				connectionReaders[i].Dispose();
			}
			connectionReaders.Clear();
			acceptor.Abort();
		}

		private ConnectionModeReader SetupModeReader(IConnection connection, bool isCached)
		{
			ConnectionModeReader connectionModeReader;
			if (isCached)
			{
				if (onCachedConnectionModeKnown == null)
				{
					onCachedConnectionModeKnown = OnCachedConnectionModeKnown;
				}
				connectionModeReader = new ConnectionModeReader(connection, onCachedConnectionModeKnown, onConnectionClosed);
			}
			else
			{
				if (onConnectionModeKnown == null)
				{
					onConnectionModeKnown = OnConnectionModeKnown;
				}
				connectionModeReader = new ConnectionModeReader(connection, onConnectionModeKnown, onConnectionClosed);
			}
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (isClosed)
				{
					connectionModeReader.Dispose();
					return null;
				}
				connectionReaders.Add(connectionModeReader);
				return connectionModeReader;
			}
		}

		public void ReuseConnection(IConnection connection, TimeSpan closeTimeout)
		{
			connection.ExceptionEventType = EventLevel.Informational;
			ConnectionModeReader connectionModeReader = SetupModeReader(connection, isCached: true);
			if (connectionModeReader != null)
			{
				if (reuseConnectionCallback == null)
				{
					reuseConnectionCallback = ReuseConnectionCallback;
				}
				IOThreadScheduler.ScheduleCallbackNoFlow(reuseConnectionCallback, new ReuseConnectionState(connectionModeReader, closeTimeout));
			}
		}

		private void ReuseConnectionCallback(object state)
		{
			ReuseConnectionState reuseConnectionState = (ReuseConnectionState)state;
			bool flag = false;
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (pooledConnectionCount >= maxPooledConnections)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				else
				{
					pooledConnectionCount++;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				ServiceBusEventSource.Log.WcfEventWarning(TraceCode.ServerMaxPooledConnectionsQuotaReached, this, SR.GetString(Resources.TraceCodeServerMaxPooledConnectionsQuotaReached, maxPooledConnections), "ReuseConnectionCallback", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\ConnectionDemuxer.cs", 170);
				reuseConnectionState.ModeReader.CloseFromPool(reuseConnectionState.CloseTimeout);
				return;
			}
			if (pooledConnectionDequeuedCallback == null)
			{
				pooledConnectionDequeuedCallback = PooledConnectionDequeuedCallback;
			}
			reuseConnectionState.ModeReader.StartReading(idleTimeout, pooledConnectionDequeuedCallback);
		}

		private void PooledConnectionDequeuedCallback()
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				pooledConnectionCount--;
				DiagnosticUtility.DebugAssert(pooledConnectionCount >= 0, "Connection Throttle should never be negative");
			}
		}

		private void OnConnectionAvailable(IConnection connection, Action connectionDequeuedCallback)
		{
			ConnectionModeReader connectionModeReader = SetupModeReader(connection, isCached: false);
			if (connectionModeReader != null)
			{
				connectionModeReader.StartReading(channelInitializationTimeout, connectionDequeuedCallback);
			}
			else
			{
				connectionDequeuedCallback();
			}
		}

		private void OnCachedConnectionModeKnown(ConnectionModeReader modeReader)
		{
			OnConnectionModeKnownCore(modeReader, isCached: true);
		}

		private void OnConnectionModeKnown(ConnectionModeReader modeReader)
		{
			OnConnectionModeKnownCore(modeReader, isCached: false);
		}

		private void OnConnectionModeKnownCore(ConnectionModeReader modeReader, bool isCached)
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (isClosed)
				{
					return;
				}
				connectionReaders.Remove(modeReader);
			}
			bool flag = true;
			try
			{
				FramingMode connectionMode;
				try
				{
					connectionMode = modeReader.GetConnectionMode();
				}
				catch (CommunicationException exception)
				{
					ServiceBusEventSource.Log.HandledException(exception, null, "Relay", this, EventLevel.Warning, "OnConnectionModeKnownCore", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\ConnectionDemuxer.cs", 243);
					return;
				}
				catch (TimeoutException ex)
				{
					if (!isCached)
					{
						ex = new TimeoutException(SR.GetString(Resources.ChannelInitializationTimeout, channelInitializationTimeout), ex);
						ErrorBehavior.ThrowAndCatch(ex);
					}
					ServiceBusEventSource.Log.HandledException(ex, null, "Relay", this, EventLevel.Warning, "OnConnectionModeKnownCore", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\ConnectionDemuxer.cs", 254);
					return;
				}
				switch (connectionMode)
				{
				case FramingMode.Duplex:
					OnDuplexConnection(modeReader.Connection, modeReader.ConnectionDequeuedCallback, modeReader.StreamPosition, modeReader.BufferOffset, modeReader.BufferSize, modeReader.GetRemainingTimeout());
					break;
				case FramingMode.Singleton:
					OnSingletonConnection(modeReader.Connection, modeReader.ConnectionDequeuedCallback, modeReader.StreamPosition, modeReader.BufferOffset, modeReader.BufferSize, modeReader.GetRemainingTimeout());
					break;
				default:
				{
					Exception ex2 = new InvalidDataException(SR.GetString(Resources.FramingModeNotSupported, connectionMode));
					Exception ex3 = new ProtocolException(ex2.Message, ex2);
					FramingEncodingString.AddFaultString(ex3, "http://schemas.microsoft.com/ws/2006/05/framing/faults/UnsupportedMode");
					ErrorBehavior.ThrowAndCatch(ex3);
					return;
				}
				}
				flag = false;
			}
			catch (Exception exception2)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception2))
				{
					throw;
				}
				ServiceBusEventSource.Log.HandledException(exception2, null, "Relay", this, EventLevel.Warning, "OnConnectionModeKnownCore", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\ConnectionDemuxer.cs", 292);
			}
			finally
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					modeReader.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnConnectionClosed(InitialServerConnectionReader connectionReader)
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (!isClosed)
				{
					connectionReaders.Remove(connectionReader);
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnSingletonConnection(IConnection connection, Action connectionDequeuedCallback, long streamPosition, int offset, int size, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			if (onSingletonPreambleKnown == null)
			{
				onSingletonPreambleKnown = OnSingletonPreambleKnown;
			}
			ServerSingletonPreambleConnectionReader serverSingletonPreambleConnectionReader = new ServerSingletonPreambleConnectionReader(connection, connectionDequeuedCallback, streamPosition, offset, size, transportSettingsCallback, onConnectionClosed, onSingletonPreambleKnown);
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (isClosed)
				{
					serverSingletonPreambleConnectionReader.Dispose();
					return;
				}
				connectionReaders.Add(serverSingletonPreambleConnectionReader);
			}
			serverSingletonPreambleConnectionReader.StartReading(viaDelegate, timeout);
		}

		private void OnSingletonPreambleKnown(ServerSingletonPreambleConnectionReader serverSingletonPreambleReader)
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (isClosed)
				{
					return;
				}
				connectionReaders.Remove(serverSingletonPreambleReader);
			}
			ISingletonChannelListener singletonChannelListener = singletonPreambleCallback(serverSingletonPreambleReader);
			DiagnosticUtility.DebugAssert(singletonChannelListener != null, "singletonPreambleCallback must return a listener or send a Fault/throw");
			TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(singletonChannelListener.ReceiveTimeout);
			IConnection upgradedConnection = serverSingletonPreambleReader.CompletePreamble(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
			ServerSingletonConnectionReader serverSingletonConnectionReader = new ServerSingletonConnectionReader(serverSingletonPreambleReader, upgradedConnection, this);
			RequestContext requestContext = serverSingletonConnectionReader.ReceiveRequest(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
			singletonChannelListener.ReceiveRequest(requestContext, serverSingletonPreambleReader.ConnectionDequeuedCallback, canDispatchOnThisThread: true);
		}

		private void OnSessionPreambleKnown(ServerSessionPreambleConnectionReader serverSessionPreambleReader)
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (isClosed)
				{
					return;
				}
				connectionReaders.Remove(serverSessionPreambleReader);
			}
			serverSessionPreambleCallback(serverSessionPreambleReader, this);
		}

		private void OnDuplexConnection(IConnection connection, Action connectionDequeuedCallback, long streamPosition, int offset, int size, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			if (onSessionPreambleKnown == null)
			{
				onSessionPreambleKnown = OnSessionPreambleKnown;
			}
			ServerSessionPreambleConnectionReader serverSessionPreambleConnectionReader = new ServerSessionPreambleConnectionReader(connection, connectionDequeuedCallback, streamPosition, offset, size, transportSettingsCallback, onConnectionClosed, onSessionPreambleKnown);
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (isClosed)
				{
					serverSessionPreambleConnectionReader.Dispose();
					return;
				}
				connectionReaders.Add(serverSessionPreambleConnectionReader);
			}
			serverSessionPreambleConnectionReader.StartReading(viaDelegate, timeout);
		}

		public void Open(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			StartDemuxing(timeout, null);
		}

		public void StartDemuxing(TimeSpan timeout, OnViaDelegate viaDelegate)
		{
			this.viaDelegate = viaDelegate;
			acceptor.Open(timeout);
		}
	}
	internal delegate void ConnectionModeCallback(ConnectionModeReader connectionModeReader);
	internal sealed class ConnectionModeReader : InitialServerConnectionReader
	{
		private Exception readException;

		private ServerModeDecoder decoder;

		private byte[] buffer;

		private int offset;

		private int size;

		private ConnectionModeCallback callback;

		private static WaitCallback readCallback;

		private TimeoutHelper receiveTimeoutHelper;

		public int BufferOffset => offset;

		public int BufferSize => size;

		public long StreamPosition => decoder.StreamPosition;

		public ConnectionModeReader(IConnection connection, ConnectionModeCallback callback, ConnectionClosedCallback closedCallback)
			: base(connection, closedCallback)
		{
			this.callback = callback;
		}

		public TimeSpan GetRemainingTimeout()
		{
			return receiveTimeoutHelper.RemainingTime();
		}

		private void Complete(Exception e)
		{
			readException = e;
			Complete();
		}

		private void Complete()
		{
			callback(this);
		}

		private bool ContinueReading()
		{
			while (true)
			{
				if (size == 0)
				{
					if (readCallback == null)
					{
						readCallback = ReadCallback;
					}
					if (base.Connection.BeginRead(0, base.Connection.AsyncReadBufferSize, GetRemainingTimeout(), readCallback, this) == AsyncReadResult.Queued)
					{
						break;
					}
					if (!GetReadResult())
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				do
				{
					int num;
					try
					{
						num = decoder.Decode(buffer, offset, size);
					}
					catch (CommunicationException exception)
					{
						if (FramingEncodingString.TryGetFaultString(exception, out var framingFault))
						{
							byte[] drainBuffer = new byte[128];
							InitialServerConnectionReader.SendFault(base.Connection, framingFault, drainBuffer, GetRemainingTimeout(), base.MaxViaSize + base.MaxContentTypeSize);
							Close(GetRemainingTimeout());
						}
						throw;
					}
					if (num > 0)
					{
						offset += num;
						size -= num;
					}
					if (decoder.CurrentState == ServerModeDecoder.State.Done)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				while (size != 0);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static void ReadCallback(object state)
		{
			ConnectionModeReader connectionModeReader = (ConnectionModeReader)state;
			bool flag = false;
			Exception e = null;
			try
			{
				if (connectionModeReader.GetReadResult())
				{
					flag = connectionModeReader.ContinueReading();
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
				{
					throw;
				}
				flag = true;
				e = ex;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				connectionModeReader.Complete(e);
			}
		}

		private bool GetReadResult()
		{
			offset = 0;
			size = base.Connection.EndRead();
			if (size == 0)
			{
				if (decoder.StreamPosition == 0L)
				{
					Close(GetRemainingTimeout());
					return false;
				}
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(decoder.CreatePrematureEOFException(), null, EventLevel.Warning, "GetReadResult", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\ConnectionModeReader.cs", 168);
			}
			base.Connection.ExceptionEventType = EventLevel.Warning;
			if (buffer == null)
			{
				buffer = base.Connection.AsyncReadBuffer;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public FramingMode GetConnectionMode()
		{
			if (readException != null)
			{
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(readException, null, "Relay", this, base.Connection.ExceptionEventType, "GetConnectionMode", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\ConnectionModeReader.cs", 187);
			}
			return decoder.Mode;
		}

		public void StartReading(TimeSpan receiveTimeout, Action connectionDequeuedCallback)
		{
			decoder = new ServerModeDecoder();
			receiveTimeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(receiveTimeout);
			base.ConnectionDequeuedCallback = connectionDequeuedCallback;
			bool flag = false;
			Exception e = null;
			try
			{
				flag = ContinueReading();
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
				{
					throw;
				}
				flag = true;
				e = ex;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				Complete(e);
			}
		}
	}

		public override bool CanBuildChannelFactory<TChannel>(BindingContext context)
		{
			if (context == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("context");
			}
			if (TransferMode == TransferMode.Buffered)
			{
				return typeof(TChannel) == typeof(IDuplexSessionChannel);
			}
			return typeof(TChannel) == typeof(IRequestChannel);
		}

		public override bool CanBuildChannelListener<TChannel>(BindingContext context)
		{
			if (context == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("context");
			}
			if (TransferMode == TransferMode.Buffered)
			{
				return typeof(TChannel) == typeof(IDuplexSessionChannel);
			}
			return typeof(TChannel) == typeof(IReplyChannel);
		}

		public override T GetProperty<T>(BindingContext context)
		{
			if (context == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("context");
			}
			if (typeof(T) == typeof(TransferMode))
			{
				return (T)(object)TransferMode;
			}
			return base.GetProperty<T>(context);
		}

		internal virtual bool IsMatch(BindingElement b)
		{
			if (b == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(b is TransportBindingElement transportBindingElement))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (MaxBufferPoolSize != transportBindingElement.MaxBufferPoolSize)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (MaxReceivedMessageSize != transportBindingElement.MaxReceivedMessageSize)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(b is ConnectionOrientedTransportBindingElement connectionOrientedTransportBindingElement))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (connectionBufferSize != connectionOrientedTransportBindingElement.connectionBufferSize)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (hostNameComparisonMode != connectionOrientedTransportBindingElement.hostNameComparisonMode)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (inheritBaseAddressSettings != connectionOrientedTransportBindingElement.inheritBaseAddressSettings)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (channelInitializationTimeout != connectionOrientedTransportBindingElement.channelInitializationTimeout)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (maxBufferSize != connectionOrientedTransportBindingElement.maxBufferSize)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (maxPendingConnections != connectionOrientedTransportBindingElement.maxPendingConnections)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (maxOutputDelay != connectionOrientedTransportBindingElement.maxOutputDelay)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (maxPendingAccepts != connectionOrientedTransportBindingElement.maxPendingAccepts)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (transferMode != connectionOrientedTransportBindingElement.transferMode)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private class OpenAsyncResult : Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult
		{
			private ICommunicationObject communicationObject;

			private static AsyncCallback onOpenComplete = DiagnosticUtility.ThunkAsyncCallback(OnOpenComplete);

			public OpenAsyncResult(ICommunicationObject communicationObject, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(callback, state)
			{
				this.communicationObject = communicationObject;
				if (this.communicationObject == null)
				{
					Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: true);
					return;
				}
				IAsyncResult asyncResult = this.communicationObject.BeginOpen(timeout, onOpenComplete, this);
				if (asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
				{
					this.communicationObject.EndOpen(asyncResult);
					Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: true);
				}
			}

			private static void OnOpenComplete(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				if (result.CompletedSynchronously)
				{
					return;
				}
				OpenAsyncResult openAsyncResult = (OpenAsyncResult)result.AsyncState;
				Exception e = null;
				try
				{
					openAsyncResult.communicationObject.EndOpen(result);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
					{
						throw;
					}
					e = ex;
				}
				openAsyncResult.Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: false, e);
			}

			public static void End(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult.End<OpenAsyncResult>(result);
			}
		}

		private class CloseAsyncResult : Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult
		{
			private ConnectionOrientedTransportChannelFactory<TChannel> parent;

			private ConnectionPool connectionPool;

			private StreamUpgradeProvider upgradeProvider;

			private TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper;

			private static AsyncCallback onCloseComplete = DiagnosticUtility.ThunkAsyncCallback(OnCloseComplete);

			private static Action<object> onReleaseConnectionPoolScheduled;

			public CloseAsyncResult(ConnectionOrientedTransportChannelFactory<TChannel> parent, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(callback, state)
			{
				this.parent = parent;
				timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
				this.parent.GetUpgradeAndConnectionPool(out upgradeProvider, out connectionPool);
				if (connectionPool == null)
				{
					if (HandleReleaseConnectionPoolComplete())
					{
						Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: true);
					}
					return;
				}
				if (onReleaseConnectionPoolScheduled == null)
				{
					onReleaseConnectionPoolScheduled = OnReleaseConnectionPoolScheduled;
				}
				IOThreadScheduler.ScheduleCallbackNoFlow(onReleaseConnectionPoolScheduled, this);
			}

			private bool HandleReleaseConnectionPoolComplete()
			{
				if (upgradeProvider == null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				IAsyncResult asyncResult = upgradeProvider.BeginClose(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime(), onCloseComplete, this);
				if (asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
				{
					upgradeProvider.EndClose(asyncResult);
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}

			private bool OnReleaseConnectionPoolScheduled()
			{
				parent.ReleaseConnectionPool(connectionPool, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
				return HandleReleaseConnectionPoolComplete();
			}

			private static void OnReleaseConnectionPoolScheduled(object state)
			{
				CloseAsyncResult closeAsyncResult = (CloseAsyncResult)state;
				Exception e = null;
				bool flag;
				try
				{
					flag = closeAsyncResult.OnReleaseConnectionPoolScheduled();
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
					{
						throw;
					}
					flag = true;
					e = ex;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					closeAsyncResult.Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: false, e);
				}
			}

			private static void OnCloseComplete(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				if (result.CompletedSynchronously)
				{
					return;
				}
				CloseAsyncResult closeAsyncResult = (CloseAsyncResult)result.AsyncState;
				Exception e = null;
				try
				{
					closeAsyncResult.upgradeProvider.EndClose(result);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
					{
						throw;
					}
					e = ex;
				}
				closeAsyncResult.Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: false, e);
			}

			public static void End(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult.End<CloseAsyncResult>(result);
			}
		}

		internal ConnectionOrientedTransportChannelFactory(ConnectionOrientedTransportBindingElement bindingElement, BindingContext context, string connectionPoolGroupName, TimeSpan idleTimeout, int maxOutboundConnectionsPerEndpoint)

			this.connectionPoolGroupName = connectionPoolGroupName;
			exposeConnectionProperty = bindingElement.ExposeConnectionProperty;
			this.idleTimeout = idleTimeout;
			maxBufferSize = bindingElement.MaxBufferSize;
			this.maxOutboundConnectionsPerEndpoint = maxOutboundConnectionsPerEndpoint;
			maxOutputDelay = bindingElement.MaxOutputDelay;
			transferMode = bindingElement.TransferMode;
			Collection<StreamUpgradeBindingElement> collection = context.BindingParameters.FindAll<StreamUpgradeBindingElement>();
			if (collection.Count > 1)
			{
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString(Resources.MultipleStreamUpgradeProvidersInParameters)), null, EventLevel.Warning, ".ctor", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\ConnectionOrientedTransportChannelFactory.cs", 57);
			}
			if (collection.Count == 1)
			{
				upgrade = collection[0].BuildClientStreamUpgradeProvider(context);
				context.BindingParameters.Remove<StreamUpgradeBindingElement>();
				securityCapabilities = collection[0].GetProperty<ISecurityCapabilities>(context);
			}
		}

		public override T GetProperty<T>()
		{
			if (typeof(T) == typeof(ISecurityCapabilities))
			{
				return (T)securityCapabilities;
			}
			return base.GetProperty<T>();
		}

		internal abstract IConnectionInitiator GetConnectionInitiator();

		internal abstract ConnectionPool GetConnectionPool();

		internal abstract void ReleaseConnectionPool(ConnectionPool pool, TimeSpan timeout);

		protected override TChannel OnCreateChannel(EndpointAddress address, Uri via)
		{
			ValidateScheme(via);
			if (TransferMode == TransferMode.Buffered)
			{
				return (TChannel)(object)new ClientFramingDuplexSessionChannel(this, this, address, via, ConnectionInitiator, connectionPool, exposeConnectionProperty);
			}
			return (TChannel)(object)new StreamedFramingRequestChannel(this, this, address, via, ConnectionInitiator, connectionPool);
		}

		private bool GetUpgradeAndConnectionPool(out StreamUpgradeProvider upgradeCopy, out ConnectionPool poolCopy)
		{
			if (upgrade != null || connectionPool != null)
			{
				lock (base.ThisLock)
				{
					if (upgrade != null || connectionPool != null)
					{
						upgradeCopy = upgrade;
						poolCopy = connectionPool;
						upgrade = null;
						connectionPool = null;
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			upgradeCopy = null;
			poolCopy = null;
			return false;
		}

		protected override void OnAbort()
		{
			if (GetUpgradeAndConnectionPool(out var upgradeCopy, out var poolCopy))
			{
				if (poolCopy != null)
				{
					ReleaseConnectionPool(poolCopy, TimeSpan.Zero);
				}
				upgradeCopy?.Abort();
			}
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new CloseAsyncResult(this, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		protected override void OnEndClose(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			CloseAsyncResult.End(result);
		}

		protected override void OnClose(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			if (GetUpgradeAndConnectionPool(out var upgradeCopy, out var poolCopy))
			{
				TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
				if (poolCopy != null)
				{
					ReleaseConnectionPool(poolCopy, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
				}
				upgradeCopy?.Close(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
			}
		}

		protected override void OnOpening()
		{
			base.OnOpening();
			connectionPool = GetConnectionPool();
			DiagnosticUtility.DebugAssert(connectionPool != null, "ConnectionPool should always be found");
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginOpen(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new OpenAsyncResult(Upgrade, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		protected override void OnEndOpen(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			OpenAsyncResult.End(result);
		}

		protected override void OnOpen(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			Upgrade?.Open(timeout);
		}
	}

				{

					}

				{
					TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
					if (upgrade != null)

						upgrade.Close(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
					}
					base.OnClose(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
				}

					return new CompletedAsyncResult(callback, state);

					CompletedAsyncResult.End(result);
				}

						begin = upgrade.BeginClose;
						end = upgrade.EndClose;

				protected override void OnEndClose(IAsyncResult result)

				CompletedAsyncResult.End(result);

		}

	internal abstract class ConnectionOrientedTransportManager<TChannelListener> : TransportManager where TChannelListener : ConnectionOrientedTransportChannelListener
	{
		private UriPrefixTable<TChannelListener> addressTable;

		private int connectionBufferSize;

		private TimeSpan channelInitializationTimeout;

		private int maxPendingConnections;

		private TimeSpan maxOutputDelay;

		private int maxPendingAccepts;

		private TimeSpan idleTimeout;

		private int maxPooledConnections;

		private MessageReceivedCallback messageReceivedCallback;

		private UriPrefixTable<TChannelListener> AddressTable => addressTable;

		protected TimeSpan ChannelInitializationTimeout => channelInitializationTimeout;

		internal int ConnectionBufferSize => connectionBufferSize;

		internal int MaxPendingConnections => maxPendingConnections;

		internal TimeSpan MaxOutputDelay => maxOutputDelay;

		internal int MaxPendingAccepts => maxPendingAccepts;

		internal TimeSpan IdleTimeout => idleTimeout;

		internal int MaxPooledConnections => maxPooledConnections;

		protected ConnectionOrientedTransportManager()
		{
			addressTable = new UriPrefixTable<TChannelListener>();
		}

		internal void ApplyListenerSettings(IConnectionOrientedListenerSettings listenerSettings)
		{
			connectionBufferSize = listenerSettings.ConnectionBufferSize;
			channelInitializationTimeout = listenerSettings.ChannelInitializationTimeout;
			maxPendingConnections = listenerSettings.MaxPendingConnections;
			maxOutputDelay = listenerSettings.MaxOutputDelay;
			maxPendingAccepts = listenerSettings.MaxPendingAccepts;
			idleTimeout = listenerSettings.IdleTimeout;
			maxPooledConnections = listenerSettings.MaxPooledConnections;
		}

		internal bool IsCompatible(ConnectionOrientedTransportChannelListener channelListener)
		{
			if (channelListener.InheritBaseAddressSettings)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ChannelInitializationTimeout == channelListener.ChannelInitializationTimeout && ConnectionBufferSize == channelListener.ConnectionBufferSize && MaxPendingConnections == channelListener.MaxPendingConnections && MaxOutputDelay == channelListener.MaxOutputDelay && MaxPendingAccepts == channelListener.MaxPendingAccepts && idleTimeout == channelListener.IdleTimeout)
			{
				return maxPooledConnections == channelListener.MaxPooledConnections;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private TChannelListener GetChannelListener(Uri via)
		{
			TChannelListener item = null;
			if (AddressTable.TryLookupUri(via, HostNameComparisonMode.StrongWildcard, out item))
			{
				return item;
			}
			if (AddressTable.TryLookupUri(via, HostNameComparisonMode.Exact, out item))
			{
				return item;
			}
			AddressTable.TryLookupUri(via, HostNameComparisonMode.WeakWildcard, out item);
			return item;
		}

		internal void OnDemuxerError(Exception exception)
		{
			lock (base.ThisLock)
			{
				Fault(AddressTable, exception);
			}
		}

		internal ISingletonChannelListener OnGetSingletonMessageHandler(ServerSingletonPreambleConnectionReader serverSingletonPreambleReader)
		{

				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new ProtocolException(SR.GetString(Resources.FramingModeNotSupported, FramingMode.Singleton)), null, EventLevel.Warning, "OnGetSingletonMessageHandler", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\ConnectionOrientedTransportManager.cs", 150);
			}
			serverSingletonPreambleReader.SendFault("http://schemas.microsoft.com/ws/2006/05/framing/faults/EndpointNotFound");
			throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new EndpointNotFoundException(SR.GetString(Resources.EndpointNotFound, via)), null, EventLevel.Warning, "OnGetSingletonMessageHandler", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\ConnectionOrientedTransportManager.cs", 157);

		internal void OnHandleServerSessionPreamble(ServerSessionPreambleConnectionReader serverSessionPreambleReader, ConnectionDemuxer connectionDemuxer)
		{
			Uri via = serverSessionPreambleReader.Via;
			TChannelListener channelListener = GetChannelListener(via);

			throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new EndpointNotFoundException(SR.GetString(Resources.DuplexSessionListenerNotFound, via.ToString())), null, EventLevel.Warning, "OnHandleServerSessionPreamble", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\ConnectionOrientedTransportManager.cs", 186);

		internal override void Register(TimeSpan timeout, TransportChannelListener channelListener)

			channelListener.SetMessageReceivedCallback(OnMessageReceived);

		{
			TransportManager.EnsureRegistered(AddressTable, (TChannelListener)channelListener);
			AddressTable.UnregisterUri(channelListener.Uri, channelListener.HostNameComparisonModeInternal);
			channelListener.SetMessageReceivedCallback(null);

		{

			}
		}

	internal abstract class CommunicationPool<TKey, TItem> where TKey : class where TItem : class
	{
		protected abstract class IdleConnectionPool
		{
			public abstract int Count { get; }

			public abstract bool Add(TItem item);

			public abstract bool Return(TItem item);

			public abstract TItem Take(out bool closeItem);
		}

		protected class EndpointConnectionPool
		{
			protected class PoolIdleConnectionPool : IdleConnectionPool
			{
				private Pool<TItem> idleConnections;

				private int maxCount;

				public override int Count => idleConnections.Count;

				public PoolIdleConnectionPool(int maxCount)
				{
					idleConnections = new Pool<TItem>(maxCount);
					this.maxCount = maxCount;
				}

				public override bool Add(TItem connection)
				{
					return ReturnToPool(connection);
				}

				public override bool Return(TItem connection)
				{
					return ReturnToPool(connection);
				}

				private bool ReturnToPool(TItem connection)
				{
					bool flag = idleConnections.Return(connection);
					if (!flag)
					{
						ServiceBusEventSource.Log.WcfEventInformation(TraceCode.ConnectionPoolMaxOutboundConnectionsPerEndpointQuotaReached, this, SR.GetString(Resources.TraceCodeConnectionPoolMaxOutboundConnectionsPerEndpointQuotaReached, maxCount), "ReturnToPool", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\ConnectionPool.cs", 560);
					}
					return flag;
				}

				public override TItem Take(out bool closeItem)
				{
					closeItem = false;
					return idleConnections.Take();
				}
			}

			private TKey key;

			private List<TItem> busyConnections;

			private bool closed;

			private IdleConnectionPool idleConnections;

			private CommunicationPool<TKey, TItem> parent;

			protected TKey Key => key;

			private IdleConnectionPool IdleConnections
			{
				get
				{
					if (idleConnections == null)
					{
						idleConnections = GetIdleConnectionPool();
					}
					return idleConnections;
				}
			}

			protected CommunicationPool<TKey, TItem> Parent => parent;

			protected object ThisLock => this;

			public EndpointConnectionPool(CommunicationPool<TKey, TItem> parent, TKey key)
			{
				this.key = key;
				this.parent = parent;
				busyConnections = new List<TItem>();
			}

			public bool CloseIfEmpty()
			{
				lock (ThisLock)
				{
					if (!closed)
					{
						if (busyConnections.Count > 0)
						{
							return false;
						}
						if (idleConnections != null && idleConnections.Count > 0)
						{
							return false;
						}
						closed = true;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}

			protected virtual void AbortItem(TItem item)
			{
				parent.AbortItem(item);
			}

			protected virtual void CloseItem(TItem item, TimeSpan timeout)
			{
				parent.CloseItem(item, timeout);
			}

			public void Abort()
			{
				if (closed)
				{
					return;
				}
				List<TItem> idleItemsToClose = null;
				lock (ThisLock)
				{
					if (closed)
					{
						return;
					}
					closed = true;
					idleItemsToClose = SnapshotIdleConnections();
				}
				AbortConnections(idleItemsToClose);
			}

			public void Close(TimeSpan timeout)
			{
				List<TItem> list = null;
				lock (ThisLock)
				{
					if (closed)
					{
						return;
					}
					closed = true;
					list = SnapshotIdleConnections();
				}
				try
				{
					TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
					for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
					{
						CloseItem(list[i], timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
					}
					list.Clear();
				}
				finally
				{
					AbortConnections(list);
				}
			}

			private void AbortConnections(List<TItem> idleItemsToClose)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < idleItemsToClose.Count; i++)
				{
					AbortItem(idleItemsToClose[i]);
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < busyConnections.Count; j++)
				{
					AbortItem(busyConnections[j]);
				}
				busyConnections.Clear();
			}

			private List<TItem> SnapshotIdleConnections()
			{
				List<TItem> list = new List<TItem>();
				while (true)
				{
					bool closeItem;
					TItem val = IdleConnections.Take(out closeItem);
					if (val == null)
					{
						break;
					}
					list.Add(val);
				}
				return list;
			}

			public void AddConnection(TItem connection, TimeSpan timeout)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				lock (ThisLock)
				{
					if (!closed)
					{
						if (!IdleConnections.Add(connection))
						{
							flag = true;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					try
					{
						CloseItem(connection, timeout);
					}
					catch (CommunicationException exception)
					{
						ServiceBusEventSource.Log.HandledException(exception, null, "Relay", this, EventLevel.Warning, "AddConnection", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\ConnectionPool.cs", 400);
						AbortItem(connection);
					}
				}
			}

			protected virtual IdleConnectionPool GetIdleConnectionPool()
			{
				return new PoolIdleConnectionPool(parent.MaxIdleConnectionPoolCount);
			}

			public virtual void Prune(List<TItem> itemsToClose)
			{
			}

			public TItem TakeConnection(TimeSpan timeout)
			{
				TItem val = null;
				List<TItem> list = null;
				lock (ThisLock)
				{
					if (closed)
					{
						return null;
					}
					while (true)
					{
						val = IdleConnections.Take(out var closeItem);
						if (val == null)
						{
							break;
						}
						if (!closeItem)
						{
							busyConnections.Add(val);
							break;
						}
						if (list == null)
						{
							list = new List<TItem>();
						}
						list.Add(val);
					}
				}
				if (list != null)
				{
					TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(TimeoutHelper.Divide(timeout, 2));
					for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
					{
						CloseIdleConnection(list[i], timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
					}
				}
				return val;
			}

			public void ReturnConnection(TItem connection, bool connectionIsStillGood, TimeSpan timeout)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				bool flag2 = false;
				lock (ThisLock)
				{
					if (!closed)
					{
						if (busyConnections.Remove(connection) && connectionIsStillGood)
						{
							if (!IdleConnections.Return(connection))
							{
								flag = true;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							flag2 = true;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						flag2 = true;
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					CloseIdleConnection(connection, timeout);
				}
				else if (flag2)
				{
					AbortItem(connection);
					OnConnectionAborted();
				}
			}

			public void CloseIdleConnection(TItem connection, TimeSpan timeout)
			{
				bool flag = true;
				try
				{
					CloseItem(connection, timeout);
					flag = false;
				}
				catch (CommunicationException exception)

					ServiceBusEventSource.Log.HandledException(exception2, null, "Relay", this, EventLevel.Warning, "CloseIdleConnection", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\ConnectionPool.cs", 513);
				}
				finally
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						AbortItem(connection);
					}
				}
			}

			protected virtual void OnConnectionAborted()
			{
			}
		}

		private Dictionary<TKey, EndpointConnectionPool> endpointPools;

		private int maxCount;

		private int openCount;

		private int pruneAccrual;

		private const int pruneThreshold = 30;

		public int MaxIdleConnectionPoolCount => maxCount;

		protected object ThisLock => this;

		protected CommunicationPool(int maxCount)
		{
			this.maxCount = maxCount;
			endpointPools = new Dictionary<TKey, EndpointConnectionPool>();
			openCount = 1;
		}

		protected abstract void AbortItem(TItem item);

		protected abstract void CloseItem(TItem item, TimeSpan timeout);

		protected abstract TKey GetPoolKey(EndpointAddress address, Uri via);

		protected virtual EndpointConnectionPool CreateEndpointConnectionPool(TKey key)
		{
			return new EndpointConnectionPool(this, key);
		}

		public bool Close(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (openCount <= 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
				openCount--;
				if (openCount == 0)
				{
					OnClose(timeout);
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private List<TItem> PruneIfNecessary()
		{
			List<TItem> list = null;
			pruneAccrual++;
			if (pruneAccrual > 30)
			{
				pruneAccrual = 0;
				list = new List<TItem>();
				foreach (EndpointConnectionPool value in endpointPools.Values)
				{
					value.Prune(list);
				}
				List<TKey> list2 = null;
				foreach (KeyValuePair<TKey, EndpointConnectionPool> endpointPool in endpointPools)
				{
					if (endpointPool.Value.CloseIfEmpty())
					{
						if (list2 == null)
						{
							list2 = new List<TKey>();
						}
						list2.Add(endpointPool.Key);
					}
				}
				if (list2 != null)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < list2.Count; i++)
					{
						endpointPools.Remove(list2[i]);
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private EndpointConnectionPool GetEndpointPool(TKey key, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			EndpointConnectionPool value = null;
			List<TItem> list = null;
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (!endpointPools.TryGetValue(key, out value))
				{
					list = PruneIfNecessary();
					value = CreateEndpointConnectionPool(key);
					endpointPools.Add(key, value);
				}
			}
			DiagnosticUtility.DebugAssert(value != null, "EndpointPool must be non-null at this point");
			if (list != null && list.Count > 0)
			{
				TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(TimeoutHelper.Divide(timeout, 2));
				for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
				{
					value.CloseIdleConnection(list[i], timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
				}
			}
			return value;
		}

		public bool TryOpen()
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (openCount <= 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				openCount++;
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnClosed()
		{
		}

		private void OnClose(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
			foreach (EndpointConnectionPool value in endpointPools.Values)
			{
				try
				{
					value.Close(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
				}
				catch (CommunicationException exception)
				{
					ServiceBusEventSource.Log.HandledException(exception, null, "Relay", this, EventLevel.Warning, "OnClose", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\ConnectionPool.cs", 177);
				}
				catch (TimeoutException exception2)
				{
					ServiceBusEventSource.Log.HandledException(exception2, null, "Relay", this, EventLevel.Warning, "OnClose", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\ConnectionPool.cs", 181);
				}
			}
			endpointPools.Clear();
		}

		public void AddConnection(TKey key, TItem connection, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
			EndpointConnectionPool endpointPool = GetEndpointPool(key, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
			endpointPool.AddConnection(connection, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
		}

		public TItem TakeConnection(EndpointAddress address, Uri via, TimeSpan timeout, out TKey key)
		{
			TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
			key = GetPoolKey(address, via);
			EndpointConnectionPool endpointPool = GetEndpointPool(key, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
			return endpointPool.TakeConnection(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
		}

		public void ReturnConnection(TKey key, TItem connection, bool connectionIsStillGood, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
			EndpointConnectionPool endpointPool = GetEndpointPool(key, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
			endpointPool.ReturnConnection(connection, connectionIsStillGood, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
		}

	internal abstract class ConnectionPool : IdlingCommunicationPool<string, IConnection>
	{
		private int connectionBufferSize;

		private TimeSpan maxOutputDelay;

		private string name;

		public string Name => name;

		protected ConnectionPool(IConnectionOrientedTransportChannelFactorySettings settings, TimeSpan leaseTimeout)
			: base(settings.MaxOutboundConnectionsPerEndpoint, settings.IdleTimeout, leaseTimeout)
		{
			connectionBufferSize = settings.ConnectionBufferSize;
			maxOutputDelay = settings.MaxOutputDelay;
			name = settings.ConnectionPoolGroupName;
		}

		protected override void AbortItem(IConnection item)
		{
			item.Abort();
		}

		protected override void CloseItem(IConnection item, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			item.Close(timeout);
		}

		public virtual bool IsCompatible(IConnectionOrientedTransportChannelFactorySettings settings)
		{
			if (name == settings.ConnectionPoolGroupName && connectionBufferSize == settings.ConnectionBufferSize && base.MaxIdleConnectionPoolCount == settings.MaxOutboundConnectionsPerEndpoint && base.IdleTimeout == settings.IdleTimeout)
			{
				return maxOutputDelay == settings.MaxOutputDelay;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

					if (isConnectionFromPool)
					{
						connectionPool.ReturnConnection(connectionKey, rawConnection, connectionIsStillGood: false, TimeSpan.Zero);
					}
					throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new CommunicationObjectAbortedException(SR.GetString(Resources.OperationAbortedDuringConnectionEstablishment, via)), null, EventLevel.Warning, "SnapshotConnection", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\ConnectionPool.cs", 776);
				}
				this.upgradedConnection = upgradedConnection;
				this.rawConnection = rawConnection;
				this.isConnectionFromPool = isConnectionFromPool;
			}
		}

		public void Abort()
		{
			ReleaseConnection(abort: true, TimeSpan.Zero);
		}

		public void Close(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			ReleaseConnection(abort: false, timeout);
		}

		private void ReleaseConnection(bool abort, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			string key;
			IConnection connection;
			IConnection connection2;
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				closed = true;
				key = connectionKey;
				connection = upgradedConnection;
				connection2 = rawConnection;
				upgradedConnection = null;
				rawConnection = null;
			}
			if (connection == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				if (isConnectionFromPool)
				{
					connectionPool.ReturnConnection(key, connection2, !abort, timeout);
				}
				else if (abort)
				{
					connection.Abort();
				}
				else
				{
					connectionPool.AddConnection(key, connection2, timeout);
				}
			}
			catch (CommunicationException exception)
			{
				ServiceBusEventSource.Log.HandledException(exception, null, "Relay", this, EventLevel.Warning, "ReleaseConnection", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\ConnectionPool.cs", 841);
				connection.Abort();
			}
		}
	}
	internal abstract class ConnectionPoolRegistry
	{
		private Dictionary<string, List<ConnectionPool>> registry;

		private object ThisLock => registry;

		protected ConnectionPoolRegistry()
		{
			registry = new Dictionary<string, List<ConnectionPool>>();
		}

		public ConnectionPool Lookup(IConnectionOrientedTransportChannelFactorySettings settings)
		{
			ConnectionPool connectionPool = null;
			string connectionPoolGroupName = settings.ConnectionPoolGroupName;
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (registry.TryGetValue(connectionPoolGroupName, out var value))
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < value.Count; i++)
					{
						if (value[i].IsCompatible(settings) && value[i].TryOpen())
						{
							connectionPool = value[i];
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					value = new List<ConnectionPool>();
					registry.Add(connectionPoolGroupName, value);
				}
				if (connectionPool == null)
				{
					connectionPool = CreatePool(settings);
					value.Add(connectionPool);
				}
			}
			return connectionPool;
		}

		protected abstract ConnectionPool CreatePool(IConnectionOrientedTransportChannelFactorySettings settings);

		public void Release(ConnectionPool pool, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (!pool.Close(timeout))
				{
					return;
				}
				List<ConnectionPool> list = registry[pool.Name];
				for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
				{
					if (list[i] == pool)
					{
						list.RemoveAt(i);
						break;
					}
				}
				if (list.Count == 0)
				{
					registry.Remove(pool.Name);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal class DelegatingAsyncResult : AsyncResult<DelegatingAsyncResult>
	{
		private Action<IAsyncResult> end;

		public DelegatingAsyncResult(Func<TimeSpan, AsyncCallback, object, IAsyncResult> begin, Action<IAsyncResult> end, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			: base(callback, state)
		{
			this.end = end;
			IAsyncResult asyncResult = begin(timeout, Callback, this);
			if (asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
			{
				Completed(asyncResult, completedSynchronously: true);
			}
		}

		private static void Callback(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (!result.CompletedSynchronously)
			{
				((DelegatingAsyncResult)result.AsyncState).Completed(result, completedSynchronously: false);
			}
		}

		private void Completed(IAsyncResult result, bool completedSynchronously)
		{
			Exception e = null;
			try
			{
				end(result);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
				{
					throw;
				}
				e = ex;
			}
			Complete(completedSynchronously, e);
		}
	}
	internal class DelegatingCloseAsyncResult : AsyncResult<DelegatingCloseAsyncResult>
	{
		private ICommunicationObject innerObject;

		public DelegatingCloseAsyncResult(ICommunicationObject innerObject, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			: base(callback, state)
		{
			this.innerObject = innerObject;
			IAsyncResult asyncResult = this.innerObject.BeginClose(timeout, CloseCallback, this);
			if (asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
			{
				CloseCompleted(asyncResult, completedSynchronously: true);
			}
		}

		private static void CloseCallback(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (!result.CompletedSynchronously)
			{
				((DelegatingCloseAsyncResult)result.AsyncState).CloseCompleted(result, completedSynchronously: false);
			}
		}

		private void CloseCompleted(IAsyncResult result, bool completedSynchronously)
		{
			Exception e = null;
			try
			{
				innerObject.EndClose(result);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
				{
					throw;
				}
				e = ex;
			}
			Complete(completedSynchronously, e);
		}
	}

	internal static class DnsCache
	{
		private class DnsCacheEntry
		{
			private readonly IPHostEntry hostEntry;

			private readonly DateTime timeStamp;

			public IPHostEntry HostEntry => hostEntry;

			public DateTime TimeStamp => timeStamp;

			public DnsCacheEntry(IPHostEntry hostEntry, DateTime timeStamp)
			{
				this.hostEntry = hostEntry;
				this.timeStamp = timeStamp;
			}
		}

		private const int MruWatermark = 64;

		private static readonly MruCache<string, DnsCacheEntry> ResolveCache;

		private static string machineName;

		public static TimeSpan CacheTimeout { get; set; }

		public static string MachineName
		{
			get
			{
				if (machineName == null)
				{
					lock (ThisLock)
					{
						if (machineName == null)
						{
							try
							{
								machineName = Dns.GetHostEntry(string.Empty).HostName;
							}
							catch (SocketException exception)
							{
								ServiceBusEventSource.Log.HandledException(exception, null, "Common", typeof(DnsCache), EventLevel.Informational, "MachineName", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\DnsCache.cs", 45);
								machineName = UnsafeNativeMethods.GetComputerName(ComputerNameFormat.PhysicalNetBIOS);
							}
						}
					}
				}
				return machineName;
			}
		}

		private static object ThisLock => ResolveCache;

		static DnsCache()
		{
			ResolveCache = new MruCache<string, DnsCacheEntry>(64);
			CacheTimeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2.0);
		}

		public static IPHostEntry Resolve(string hostName)
		{
			IPHostEntry iPHostEntry = null;
			DateTime utcNow = DateTime.UtcNow;
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (ResolveCache.TryGetValue(hostName, out var value))
				{
					if (utcNow.Subtract(value.TimeStamp) > CacheTimeout)
					{
						ResolveCache.Remove(hostName);
					}
					else
					{
						if (value.HostEntry == null)
						{
							throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new EndpointNotFoundException(SR.GetString(Resources.DnsResolveFailed, hostName)), null, EventLevel.Warning, "Resolve", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\DnsCache.cs", 84);
						}
						iPHostEntry = value.HostEntry;
					}
				}
			}
			if (iPHostEntry == null)
			{
				SocketException ex = null;
				try
				{
					iPHostEntry = Dns.GetHostEntry(hostName);
				}
				catch (SocketException ex2)
				{
					ex = ex2;
				}
				lock (ThisLock)
				{
					ResolveCache.Remove(hostName);
					ResolveCache.Add(hostName, new DnsCacheEntry(iPHostEntry, utcNow));
				}
				if (ex != null)
				{
					throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new EndpointNotFoundException(SR.GetString(Resources.DnsResolveFailed, hostName), ex), null, EventLevel.Warning, "Resolve", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\DnsCache.cs", 114);
				}
			}
			return iPHostEntry;
		}
	}

	internal abstract class FramingDuplexSessionChannel : TransportOutputChannel, IDuplexSessionChannel, IDuplexChannel, IInputChannel, IChannel, ICommunicationObject, IOutputChannel, ISessionChannel<IDuplexSession>
	{
		private class ConnectionDuplexSession : IDuplexSession, IInputSession, ISession, IOutputSession
		{

			{
				private EndpointIdentity remoteIdentity;

				EndpointIdentity ISecuritySession.RemoteIdentity
				{
					get
					{
						if (remoteIdentity == null)

							SecurityMessageProperty remoteSecurity = channel.RemoteSecurity;
							if (remoteSecurity != null && remoteSecurity.ServiceSecurityContext != null && InvokeHelper.InvokeInstanceGet(typeof(ServiceSecurityContext), remoteSecurity.ServiceSecurityContext, "IdentityClaim") != null && remoteSecurity.ServiceSecurityContext.PrimaryIdentity != null)

								remoteIdentity = EndpointIdentity.CreateIdentity((Claim)InvokeHelper.InvokeInstanceGet(typeof(ServiceSecurityContext), remoteSecurity.ServiceSecurityContext, "IdentityClaim"));
							}
						}
						return remoteIdentity;
					}

		private class CloseAsyncResult : Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult
		{
			private FramingDuplexSessionChannel channel;

			private TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper;

			private static AsyncCallback onCloseOutputSession = DiagnosticUtility.ThunkAsyncCallback(OnCloseOutputSession);

			private static AsyncCallback onCloseInputSession = DiagnosticUtility.ThunkAsyncCallback(OnCloseInputSession);

			private static Action<object> onCompleteCloseScheduled;

			protected internal override EventTraceActivity Activity => channel.TrackingContext.Activity;

			protected override EventLevel TraceEventType => EventLevel.Warning;

			public CloseAsyncResult(FramingDuplexSessionChannel channel, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(callback, state)
			{
				this.channel = channel;
				timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
				IAsyncResult asyncResult = channel.BeginCloseOutputSession(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime(), onCloseOutputSession, this);
				if (asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously && HandleCloseOutputSession(asyncResult, isStillSynchronous: true))
				{
					Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: true);
				}
			}

			public static void End(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult.End<CloseAsyncResult>(result);
			}

			private bool HandleCloseOutputSession(IAsyncResult result, bool isStillSynchronous)
			{
				EndCloseOutputSession(result);
				if (channel.isInputSessionClosed)
				{
					return ScheduleCompleteClose(isStillSynchronous);
				}
				IAsyncResult asyncResult = channel.messageSource.BeginReceive(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime(), onCloseInputSession, this);
				if (!asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return HandleCloseInputSession(asyncResult, isStillSynchronous);
			}

			private bool HandleCloseInputSession(IAsyncResult result, bool isStillSynchronous)
			{
				System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message = channel.messageSource.EndReceive(result);
				if (message != null)
				{
					using (message)
					{
						ProtocolException ex = (ProtocolException)InvokeHelper.InvokeStaticMethod(typeof(ProtocolException), "ReceiveShutdownReturnedNonNull", message);
						throw ex;
					}
				}
				channel.OnInputSessionClosed();
				return ScheduleCompleteClose(isStillSynchronous);
			}

			private bool ScheduleCompleteClose(bool isStillSynchronous)
			{
				if (isStillSynchronous)
				{
					if (onCompleteCloseScheduled == null)
					{
						onCompleteCloseScheduled = OnCompleteCloseScheduled;
					}
					IOThreadScheduler.ScheduleCallbackNoFlow(onCompleteCloseScheduled, this);
					return false;
				}
				OnCompleteCloseScheduled();
				return true;
			}

			private static void OnCloseOutputSession(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				if (result.CompletedSynchronously)
				{
					return;
				}
				CloseAsyncResult closeAsyncResult = (CloseAsyncResult)result.AsyncState;
				bool flag = false;
				Exception e = null;
				try
				{
					flag = closeAsyncResult.HandleCloseOutputSession(result, isStillSynchronous: false);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
					{
						throw;
					}
					flag = true;
					e = ex;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					closeAsyncResult.Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: false, e);
				}
			}

			private static void OnCloseInputSession(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				if (result.CompletedSynchronously)
				{
					return;
				}
				CloseAsyncResult closeAsyncResult = (CloseAsyncResult)result.AsyncState;
				bool flag = false;
				Exception e = null;
				try
				{
					flag = closeAsyncResult.HandleCloseInputSession(result, isStillSynchronous: false);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
					{
						throw;
					}
					flag = true;
					e = ex;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					closeAsyncResult.Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: false, e);
				}
			}

			private static void OnCompleteCloseScheduled(object state)
			{
				CloseAsyncResult closeAsyncResult = (CloseAsyncResult)state;
				Exception e = null;

		private ArraySegment<byte> EncodeMessage(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message)
		{
			ArraySegment<byte> messageFrame = MessageEncoder.WriteMessage(message, int.MaxValue, bufferManager, 6);
			return SessionEncoder.EncodeMessageFrame(messageFrame);
		}

		private void ThrowIfOutputSessionClosed()
		{
			if (isOutputSessionClosed)
			{
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new InvalidOperationException(Resources.SendCannotBeCalledAfterCloseOutputSession), this, EventLevel.Warning, "ThrowIfOutputSessionClosed", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\FramingChannels.cs", 499);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnSend(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposedOrNotOpen();
			TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateOnly(timeout);
			if (!sendLock.TryEnter(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime()))
			{
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new TimeoutException(SR.GetString(Resources.SendToViaTimedOut, base.Via, timeout), ThreadNeutralSemaphore.CreateEnterTimedOutException(timeout)), null, EventLevel.Warning, "OnSend", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\FramingChannels.cs", 511);
			}
			try
			{
				ThrowIfDisposedOrNotOpen();
				ThrowIfOutputSessionClosed();
				bool flag = false;
				try
				{
					bool allowOutputBatching = message.Properties.AllowOutputBatching;
					ArraySegment<byte> arraySegment = EncodeMessage(message);
					Connection.Write(arraySegment.Array, arraySegment.Offset, arraySegment.Count, !allowOutputBatching, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime(), bufferManager);
					flag = true;
				}
				finally
				{
					if (!flag)
					{
						Fault();
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				sendLock.Exit();
			}
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginSend(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			ThrowIfDisposedOrNotOpen();
			return new SendAsyncResult(this, message, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		protected override void OnEndSend(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			SendAsyncResult.End(result);
		}

					return property;
				}
			}
			return base.GetProperty<T>();
		}
