	internal abstract class InitialServerConnectionReader : IDisposable
	{
		private class UpgradeConnectionAsyncResult : Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult
		{
			private ConnectionStream connectionStream;

			private static AsyncCallback onAcceptUpgrade = DiagnosticUtility.ThunkAsyncCallback(OnAcceptUpgrade);

			private IConnection connection;

			private StreamUpgradeAcceptor upgradeAcceptor;

			public UpgradeConnectionAsyncResult(IConnection connection, StreamUpgradeAcceptor upgradeAcceptor, IDefaultCommunicationTimeouts defaultTimeouts, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(callback, state)
			{
				this.upgradeAcceptor = upgradeAcceptor;
				connectionStream = new ConnectionStream(connection, defaultTimeouts);
				bool flag = false;
				IAsyncResult asyncResult = upgradeAcceptor.BeginAcceptUpgrade(connectionStream, onAcceptUpgrade, this);
				if (asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
				{
					CompleteAcceptUpgrade(asyncResult);
					flag = true;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: true);
				}
			}

			public static IConnection End(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				UpgradeConnectionAsyncResult upgradeConnectionAsyncResult = Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult.End<UpgradeConnectionAsyncResult>(result);
				return upgradeConnectionAsyncResult.connection;
			}

			private void CompleteAcceptUpgrade(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				Stream stream;
				try
				{
					stream = upgradeAcceptor.EndAcceptUpgrade(result);
					flag = true;
				}
				finally
				{
					if (upgradeAcceptor is StreamSecurityUpgradeAcceptor && flag)
					{
						ServiceBusEventSource.Log.WcfEventInformation(TraceCode.StreamSecurityUpgradeAccepted, this, upgradeAcceptor.GetType().ToString(), "CompleteAcceptUpgrade", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\InitialServerConnectionReader.cs", 364);
					}
				}
				connection = new StreamConnection(stream, connectionStream);
			}

			private static void OnAcceptUpgrade(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				if (result.CompletedSynchronously)
				{
					return;
				}
				UpgradeConnectionAsyncResult upgradeConnectionAsyncResult = (UpgradeConnectionAsyncResult)result.AsyncState;
				Exception e = null;
				try
				{
					upgradeConnectionAsyncResult.CompleteAcceptUpgrade(result);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
					{
						throw;
					}
					e = ex;
				}
				upgradeConnectionAsyncResult.Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: false, e);
			}
		}

		private int maxViaSize;

		private int maxContentTypeSize;

		private IConnection connection;

		private Action connectionDequeuedCallback;

		private ConnectionClosedCallback closedCallback;

		private bool isClosed;

		public IConnection Connection => connection;

		public Action ConnectionDequeuedCallback
		{
			get
			{
				return connectionDequeuedCallback;
			}
			set
			{
				connectionDequeuedCallback = value;
			}
		}

		protected bool IsClosed => isClosed;

		protected int MaxContentTypeSize => maxContentTypeSize;

		protected int MaxViaSize => maxViaSize;

		private object ThisLock => this;

		protected InitialServerConnectionReader(IConnection connection, ConnectionClosedCallback closedCallback)
			: this(connection, closedCallback, 2048, 256)
		{
		}

		protected InitialServerConnectionReader(IConnection connection, ConnectionClosedCallback closedCallback, int maxViaSize, int maxContentTypeSize)
		{
			if (connection == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("connection");
			}
			if (closedCallback == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("closedCallback");
			}
			this.connection = connection;
			this.closedCallback = closedCallback;
			this.maxContentTypeSize = maxContentTypeSize;
			this.maxViaSize = maxViaSize;
		}

		public Action GetConnectionDequeuedCallback()
		{
			Action result = connectionDequeuedCallback;
			connectionDequeuedCallback = null;
			return result;
		}

		public void ReleaseConnection()
		{
			isClosed = true;
			connection = null;
		}

		public void CloseFromPool(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			try
			{
				Close(timeout);
			}
			catch (CommunicationException exception)
			{
				ServiceBusEventSource.Log.HandledException(exception, null, "Relay", this, EventLevel.Informational, "CloseFromPool", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\InitialServerConnectionReader.cs", 121);
			}
			catch (TimeoutException exception2)
			{
				ServiceBusEventSource.Log.HandledException(exception2, null, "Relay", this, EventLevel.Informational, "CloseFromPool", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\InitialServerConnectionReader.cs", 125);
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (isClosed)
				{
					return;
				}
				isClosed = true;
			}
			connection?.Abort();
			if (connectionDequeuedCallback != null)
			{
				connectionDequeuedCallback();
			}
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		protected void Abort()
		{
			Abort(null);
		}

		protected void Abort(Exception e)
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (isClosed)
				{
					return;
				}
				isClosed = true;
			}
			try
			{
				if (e != null)
				{
					ServiceBusEventSource.Log.WcfEventWarning(TraceCode.ChannelConnectionDropped, this, e.ToString(), "Abort", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\InitialServerConnectionReader.cs", 174);
				}
				connection.Abort();
			}
			finally
			{
				if (closedCallback != null)
				{
					closedCallback(this);
				}
				if (connectionDequeuedCallback != null)
				{
					connectionDequeuedCallback();
				}
			}
		}

		protected void Close(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (isClosed)
				{
					return;
				}
				isClosed = true;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			try
			{
				connection.Close(timeout);
				flag = true;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (!flag)
				{
					connection.Abort();
				}
				if (closedCallback != null)
				{
					closedCallback(this);
				}
				if (connectionDequeuedCallback != null)
				{
					connectionDequeuedCallback();
				}
			}
		}

		internal static void SendFault(IConnection connection, string faultString, byte[] drainBuffer, TimeSpan sendTimeout, int maxRead)
		{
			EncodedFault encodedFault = new EncodedFault(faultString);
			TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(sendTimeout);
			try
			{
				connection.Write(encodedFault.EncodedBytes, 0, encodedFault.EncodedBytes.Length, immediate: true, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
				connection.Shutdown(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
			}
			catch (CommunicationException exception)
			{
				ServiceBusEventSource.Log.HandledException(exception, null, "Relay", connection, EventLevel.Informational, "SendFault", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\InitialServerConnectionReader.cs", 239);
				connection.Abort();
				return;
			}
			catch (TimeoutException exception2)
			{
				ServiceBusEventSource.Log.HandledException(exception2, null, "Relay", connection, EventLevel.Informational, "SendFault", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\InitialServerConnectionReader.cs", 245);
				connection.Abort();
				return;
			}
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			while (true)
			{
				try
				{
					num = connection.Read(drainBuffer, 0, drainBuffer.Length, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
				}
				catch (CommunicationException exception3)
				{
					ServiceBusEventSource.Log.HandledException(exception3, null, "Relay", connection, EventLevel.Informational, "SendFault", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\InitialServerConnectionReader.cs", 261);
					connection.Abort();
					return;
				}
				catch (TimeoutException exception4)
				{
					ServiceBusEventSource.Log.HandledException(exception4, null, "Relay", connection, EventLevel.Informational, "SendFault", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\InitialServerConnectionReader.cs", 267);
					connection.Abort();
					return;
				}
				if (num == 0)
				{
					break;
				}
				num2 += num;
				if (num2 > maxRead || timeoutHelper.RemainingTime() <= TimeSpan.Zero)
				{
					connection.Abort();
					return;
				}
			}
			ConnectionUtilities.CloseNoThrow(connection, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
		}

		{
			private IInputChannel channel;

			private TimeSpan timeout;

			private static AsyncCallback onReceive = DiagnosticUtility.ThunkAsyncCallback(OnReceive);

			private System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message;

			public HelpReceiveAsyncResult(IInputChannel channel, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(callback, state)
			{
				this.channel = channel;
				this.timeout = timeout;
				IAsyncResult asyncResult = channel.BeginTryReceive(timeout, onReceive, this);
				if (asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
				{
					HandleReceiveComplete(asyncResult);
					Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: true);
				}
			}

			public static System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message End(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				HelpReceiveAsyncResult helpReceiveAsyncResult = Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult.End<HelpReceiveAsyncResult>(result);
				return helpReceiveAsyncResult.message;
			}

			private void HandleReceiveComplete(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				if (!channel.EndTryReceive(result, out message))
				{
					throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(CreateReceiveTimedOutException(channel, timeout), null, EventLevel.Warning, "HandleReceiveComplete", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\InputChannel.cs", 211);
				}
			}

			private static void OnReceive(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				if (result.CompletedSynchronously)
				{
					return;
				}
				HelpReceiveAsyncResult helpReceiveAsyncResult = (HelpReceiveAsyncResult)result.AsyncState;
				Exception e = null;
				try
				{
					helpReceiveAsyncResult.HandleReceiveComplete(result);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
					{
						throw;
					}
					e = ex;
				}
				helpReceiveAsyncResult.Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: false, e);
			}
		}

	{
		private readonly IChannelFactory innerChannelFactory;

		protected IChannelFactory InnerChannelFactory => innerChannelFactory;

		public LayeredChannelFactory(IDefaultCommunicationTimeouts timeouts, IChannelFactory innerChannelFactory)
			: base(timeouts)
		{
			this.innerChannelFactory = innerChannelFactory;
		}

		public override T GetProperty<T>()
		{
			if (typeof(T) == typeof(IChannelFactory<TChannel>))
			{
				return (T)(object)this;
			}
			T property = base.GetProperty<T>();
			if (property != null)
			{
				return property;
			}
			return innerChannelFactory.GetProperty<T>();
		}

		{
			return innerChannelFactory.BeginOpen(timeout, callback, state);

		{
			innerChannelFactory.EndOpen(result);
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new ChainedCloseAsyncResult(timeout, callback, state, base.OnBeginClose, base.OnEndClose, innerChannelFactory);
		}

		protected override void OnEndClose(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			ChainedAsyncResult.End(result);
		}

		protected override void OnClose(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
			base.OnClose(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
			innerChannelFactory.Close(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
		}

		protected override void OnOpen(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			innerChannelFactory.Open(timeout);
		}

		protected override void OnAbort()
		{

			innerChannelFactory.Abort();
		}

	internal abstract class LayeredChannel<TInnerChannel> : ChannelBase where TInnerChannel : class, IChannel
	{
		private TInnerChannel innerChannel;

		private EventHandler onInnerChannelFaulted;

		protected TInnerChannel InnerChannel => innerChannel;

		protected LayeredChannel(ChannelManagerBase channelManager, TInnerChannel innerChannel)
			: base(channelManager)
		{
			this.innerChannel = innerChannel;
			onInnerChannelFaulted = OnInnerChannelFaulted;
			this.innerChannel.Faulted += onInnerChannelFaulted;
		}

		public override T GetProperty<T>()
		{
			T property = base.GetProperty<T>();
			if (property != null)
			{
				return property;
			}
			return InnerChannel.GetProperty<T>();
		}

		protected override void OnClosing()
		{
			innerChannel.Faulted -= onInnerChannelFaulted;
			base.OnClosing();
		}

		protected override void OnAbort()

			innerChannel.Abort();

		protected override void OnClose(TimeSpan timeout)

			innerChannel.Close(timeout);

		private class OpenAsyncResult : AsyncResult<OpenAsyncResult>
		{
			private ICommunicationObject communicationObject;

			private static AsyncCallback onOpenComplete = DiagnosticUtility.ThunkAsyncCallback(OnOpenComplete);

			public OpenAsyncResult(ICommunicationObject communicationObject, bool sharedInnerListener, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(callback, state)
			{
				this.communicationObject = communicationObject;
				if (this.communicationObject == null || sharedInnerListener)
				{
					Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: true);
					return;
				}
				IAsyncResult asyncResult = this.communicationObject.BeginOpen(timeout, onOpenComplete, this);
				if (asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
				{
					this.communicationObject.EndOpen(asyncResult);
					Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: true);
				}
			}

			private static void OnOpenComplete(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				if (result.CompletedSynchronously)
				{
					return;
				}
				OpenAsyncResult openAsyncResult = (OpenAsyncResult)result.AsyncState;
				Exception e = null;
				try
				{
					openAsyncResult.communicationObject.EndOpen(result);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
					{
						throw;
					}
					e = ex;
				}
				openAsyncResult.Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: false, e);
			}
		}

		private class CloseAsyncResult : AsyncResult<CloseAsyncResult>
		{
			private ICommunicationObject communicationObject;

			private static AsyncCallback onCloseComplete = DiagnosticUtility.ThunkAsyncCallback(OnCloseComplete);

			public CloseAsyncResult(ICommunicationObject communicationObject, bool sharedInnerListener, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(callback, state)
			{
				this.communicationObject = communicationObject;
				if (this.communicationObject == null || sharedInnerListener)
				{
					Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: true);
					return;
				}
				IAsyncResult asyncResult = this.communicationObject.BeginClose(timeout, onCloseComplete, this);
				if (asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
				{
					this.communicationObject.EndClose(asyncResult);
					Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: true);
				}
			}

			private static void OnCloseComplete(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				if (result.CompletedSynchronously)
				{
					return;
				}
				CloseAsyncResult closeAsyncResult = (CloseAsyncResult)result.AsyncState;
				Exception e = null;
				try
				{
					closeAsyncResult.communicationObject.EndClose(result);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
					{
						throw;
					}
					e = ex;
				}
				closeAsyncResult.Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: false, e);
			}
		}

					}

	internal class MaxMessageSizeStream : DelegatingStream
	{
		private long maxMessageSize;

		private long totalBytesRead;

		private long bytesWritten;

		public MaxMessageSizeStream(Stream stream, long maxMessageSize)
			: base(stream)
		{
			this.maxMessageSize = maxMessageSize;
		}

		public override IAsyncResult BeginRead(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			count = PrepareRead(count);
			return base.BeginRead(buffer, offset, count, callback, state);
		}

		public override IAsyncResult BeginWrite(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			PrepareWrite(count);
			return base.BeginWrite(buffer, offset, count, callback, state);
		}

		public override int EndRead(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			return FinishRead(base.EndRead(result));
		}

		public override int Read(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)
		{
			count = PrepareRead(count);
			return FinishRead(base.Read(buffer, offset, count));
		}

		public override int ReadByte()
		{
			PrepareRead(1);
			int num = base.ReadByte();
			if (num != -1)
			{
				FinishRead(1);
			}
			return num;
		}

		public override void SetLength(long value)
		{
			base.SetLength(value);
			bytesWritten = Length;
			totalBytesRead = Position;
		}

		public override void Write(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)
		{
			PrepareWrite(count);
			base.Write(buffer, offset, count);
		}

		public override void WriteByte(byte value)
		{
			PrepareWrite(1);
			base.WriteByte(value);
		}

		internal static Exception CreateMaxReceivedMessageSizeExceededException(long maxMessageSize)
		{
			string message = SR.GetString(Resources.MaxReceivedMessageSizeExceeded, maxMessageSize);
			Exception innerException = new System.ServiceModel.QuotaExceededException(message);
			return new CommunicationException(message, innerException);
		}

		internal static Exception CreateMaxSentMessageSizeExceededException(long maxMessageSize)
		{
			string message = SR.GetString(Resources.MaxSentMessageSizeExceeded, maxMessageSize);
			Exception innerException = new System.ServiceModel.QuotaExceededException(message);
			return new CommunicationException(message, innerException);
		}

		private int PrepareRead(int bytesToRead)
		{
			if (totalBytesRead >= maxMessageSize)
			{
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(CreateMaxReceivedMessageSizeExceededException(maxMessageSize), null, EventLevel.Warning, "PrepareRead", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\MaxMessageSizeStream.cs", 95);
			}
			long num = maxMessageSize - totalBytesRead;
			if (num > int.MaxValue)
			{
				return bytesToRead;
			}
			return Math.Min(bytesToRead, (int)(maxMessageSize - totalBytesRead));
		}

		private int FinishRead(int bytesRead)
		{
			totalBytesRead += bytesRead;
			return bytesRead;
		}

		private void PrepareWrite(int bytesToWrite)
		{
			if (bytesWritten + bytesToWrite > maxMessageSize)
			{
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(CreateMaxSentMessageSizeExceededException(maxMessageSize), null, EventLevel.Warning, "PrepareWrite", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\MaxMessageSizeStream.cs", 120);
			}
			bytesWritten += bytesToWrite;
		}
	}
	internal delegate void MessageReceivedCallback();
	internal class MruCache<TKey, TValue> where TKey : class, IEquatable<TKey> where TValue : class
	{
		internal struct CacheEntry
		{
			internal TValue value;

			internal LinkedListNode<TKey> node;
		}

		private LinkedList<TKey> mruList;

		private Dictionary<TKey, CacheEntry> items;

		private int lowWatermark;

		private int highWatermark;

		private CacheEntry mruEntry;

		internal int HighWatermark => highWatermark;

		internal Dictionary<TKey, CacheEntry> Items => items;

		public MruCache(int watermark)
			: this(watermark * 4 / 5, watermark)
		{
		}

		public MruCache(int lowWatermark, int highWatermark)
			: this(lowWatermark, highWatermark, (IEqualityComparer<TKey>)null)
		{
		}

		public MruCache(int lowWatermark, int highWatermark, IEqualityComparer<TKey> comparer)
		{
			DiagnosticUtility.DebugAssert(lowWatermark <= highWatermark, string.Empty);
			DiagnosticUtility.DebugAssert(lowWatermark > 0, string.Empty);
			this.lowWatermark = lowWatermark;
			this.highWatermark = highWatermark;
			mruList = new LinkedList<TKey>();
			if (comparer == null)
			{
				items = new Dictionary<TKey, CacheEntry>();
			}
			else
			{
				items = new Dictionary<TKey, CacheEntry>(comparer);
			}
		}

		public void Add(TKey key, TValue value)
		{
			DiagnosticUtility.DebugAssert(key != null, string.Empty);
			bool flag = false;
			try
			{
				if (items.Count == highWatermark)
				{
					int num = highWatermark - lowWatermark;
					for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
					{
						TKey value2 = mruList.Last.Value;
						mruList.RemoveLast();
						TValue value3 = items[value2].value;
						items.Remove(value2);
						OnSingleItemRemoved(value3);
					}
				}
				CacheEntry value4 = default(CacheEntry);
				value4.node = mruList.AddFirst(key);
				value4.value = value;
				items.Add(key, value4);
				mruEntry = value4;
				flag = true;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (!flag)
				{
					Clear();
				}
			}
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			mruList.Clear();
			items.Clear();
			mruEntry.value = null;
			mruEntry.node = null;
		}

		public bool Remove(TKey key)
		{
			DiagnosticUtility.DebugAssert(key != null, string.Empty);
			if (items.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
			{
				items.Remove(key);
				OnSingleItemRemoved(value.value);
				mruList.Remove(value.node);
				if (mruEntry.node == value.node)
				{
					mruEntry.value = null;
					mruEntry.node = null;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual void OnSingleItemRemoved(TValue item)
		{
		}

		public bool TryGetValue(TKey key, out TValue value)
		{
			if (mruEntry.node != null && key != null && key.Equals(mruEntry.node.Value))
			{
				value = mruEntry.value;
				return true;
			}
			CacheEntry value2;
			bool flag = items.TryGetValue(key, out value2);
			value = value2.value;
			if (flag && mruList.Count > 1 && mruList.First != value2.node)
			{
				mruList.Remove(value2.node);
				mruList.AddFirst(value2.node);
				mruEntry = value2;
			}
			return flag;
		}
	}
	internal delegate void OnViaDelegate(Uri via);
	internal class OpenCollectionAsyncResult : Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult
	{
		private class CallbackState
		{
			private readonly ICommunicationObject instance;

			private readonly OpenCollectionAsyncResult result;

			public ICommunicationObject Instance => instance;

			public OpenCollectionAsyncResult Result => result;

			public CallbackState(OpenCollectionAsyncResult result, ICommunicationObject instance)
			{
				this.result = result;
				this.instance = instance;
			}
		}

		private static readonly AsyncCallback nestedCallback = DiagnosticUtility.ThunkAsyncCallback(Callback);

		private TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper;

		private int count;

		private Exception exception;

		public OpenCollectionAsyncResult(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback otherCallback, object state, params ICommunicationObject[] collections)
			: this(timeout, otherCallback, state, (IList<ICommunicationObject>)collections)
		{
		}

		public OpenCollectionAsyncResult(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback otherCallback, object state, IList<ICommunicationObject> collection)
			: base(otherCallback, state)
		{
			timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
			count = collection.Count;
			if (count == 0)
			{
				Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: true);
				return;
			}
			foreach (ICommunicationObject item in collection)
			{
				if (item == null)
				{
					Decrement(completedSynchronously: true);
					continue;
				}
				if (exception != null)
				{
					break;
				}
				CallbackState callbackState = new CallbackState(this, item);
				IAsyncResult asyncResult;
				try
				{
					asyncResult = item.BeginOpen(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime(), nestedCallback, callbackState);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
					{
						throw;
					}
					Decrement(completedSynchronously: true, ex);
					item.Abort();
					continue;
				}
				if (asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
				{
					CompleteOpen(item, asyncResult);
				}
			}
		}

		public static void RunSynchronously(TimeSpan timeout, params ICommunicationObject[] collection)
		{
			TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
			for (int i = 0; i < collection.Length; i++)
			{
				collection[i]?.Open(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
			}
		}

		public static void End(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult.End<OpenCollectionAsyncResult>(result);
		}

		private static void Callback(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (!result.CompletedSynchronously)
			{
				CallbackState callbackState = (CallbackState)result.AsyncState;
				callbackState.Result.CompleteOpen(callbackState.Instance, result);
			}
		}

		private void CompleteOpen(ICommunicationObject communicationObject, IAsyncResult result)
		{
			Exception ex = null;
			try
			{
				communicationObject.EndOpen(result);
			}
			catch (Exception ex2)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(ex2))
				{
					throw;
				}
				ex = ex2;
				communicationObject.Abort();
			}
			Decrement(result.CompletedSynchronously, ex);
		}

		private void Decrement(bool completedSynchronously)
		{
			if (Interlocked.Decrement(ref count) == 0)
			{
				if (exception != null)
				{
					Complete(completedSynchronously, exception);
				}
				else
				{
					Complete(completedSynchronously);
				}
			}
		}

		private void Decrement(bool completedSynchronously, Exception exception)
		{
			this.exception = exception;
			Decrement(completedSynchronously);
		}
	}
	internal abstract class OutputChannel : TrackingContextChannelBase, IOutputChannel, IChannel, ICommunicationObject, ICommunicationObjectInternals
	{
		public EndpointAddress RemoteAddress { get; }

		public Uri Via { get; }

		protected OutputChannel(ChannelManagerBase manager, EndpointAddress remoteAddress, Uri via, string traceRole)
			: base(manager, remoteAddress.Uri, traceRole)
		{
			RemoteAddress = remoteAddress;
			Via = via;
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginSend(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{

	internal class Pool<T> where T : class
	{
		private T[] items;

		private int count;

		public int Count => count;

		public Pool(int maxCount)
		{
			items = new T[maxCount];
		}

		public T Take()
		{
			if (count > 0)
			{
				T result = items[--count];
				items[count] = null;
				return result;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public bool Return(T item)
		{
			if (count < items.Length)
			{
				items[count++] = item;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				items[i] = null;
			}
			count = 0;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class RefcountedCommunicationObject : ICommunicationObject
	{
		private class AlreadyClosedAsyncResult : CompletedAsyncResult
		{
			public AlreadyClosedAsyncResult(AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(callback, state)
			{
			}
		}

		private class AlreadyOpeningAsyncResult : Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult
		{
			private ThreadNeutralSemaphore semaphore;

			public AlreadyOpeningAsyncResult(ThreadNeutralSemaphore semaphore, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(callback, state)
			{
				this.semaphore = semaphore;
				this.semaphore.Enter(Callback, this);
			}

			private void Callback(object state)
			{
				AlreadyOpeningAsyncResult alreadyOpeningAsyncResult = (AlreadyOpeningAsyncResult)state;
				alreadyOpeningAsyncResult.Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: false);
				semaphore.Exit();
			}

			public static void End(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult.End<AlreadyOpeningAsyncResult>(result);
			}
		}

		private class SkippingOperationAsyncResult : CompletedAsyncResult
		{
			public SkippingOperationAsyncResult(AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(callback, state)
			{
			}
		}

		private class OpenAsyncResult : Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult
		{
			private RefcountedCommunicationObject communicationObject;

			private static AsyncCallback onOpenComplete = DiagnosticUtility.ThunkAsyncCallback(OnOpenComplete);

			public OpenAsyncResult(RefcountedCommunicationObject communicationObject, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(callback, state)
			{
				this.communicationObject = communicationObject;
				IAsyncResult asyncResult = this.communicationObject.OnBeginOpen(timeout, onOpenComplete, this);
				if (asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
				{
					HandleOpenComplete(asyncResult);
					Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: true);
				}
			}

			private static void OnOpenComplete(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				if (result.CompletedSynchronously)
				{
					return;
				}
				Exception e = null;
				OpenAsyncResult openAsyncResult = (OpenAsyncResult)result.AsyncState;
				try
				{
					openAsyncResult.HandleOpenComplete(result);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
					{
						throw;
					}
					e = ex;
					ServiceBusEventSource.Log.Warning(null, "Relay", openAsyncResult, $"Open Failed: {ex}", "OnOpenComplete", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\RefcountedCommunicationObject.cs", 791);
					openAsyncResult.communicationObject.Fault();
				}
				openAsyncResult.Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: false, e);
			}

			private void HandleOpenComplete(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				try
				{
					communicationObject.OnEndOpen(result);
					communicationObject.OnOpened();
					if (!communicationObject.onOpenedCalled)
					{
						throw communicationObject.CreateBaseClassMethodNotCalledException("OnOpened");
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					communicationObject.semaphore.Exit();
				}
			}

			public static void End(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult.End<OpenAsyncResult>(result);
			}
		}

		private class CloseAsyncResult : Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult
		{
			private RefcountedCommunicationObject communicationObject;

			private static AsyncCallback onCloseComplete = DiagnosticUtility.ThunkAsyncCallback(OnCloseComplete);

			public CloseAsyncResult(RefcountedCommunicationObject communicationObject, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(callback, state)
			{
				this.communicationObject = communicationObject;
				IAsyncResult asyncResult = this.communicationObject.OnBeginClose(timeout, onCloseComplete, this);
				if (asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
				{
					HandleCloseComplete(asyncResult);
					Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: true);
				}
			}

			private static void OnCloseComplete(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				if (result.CompletedSynchronously)
				{
					return;
				}
				CloseAsyncResult closeAsyncResult = (CloseAsyncResult)result.AsyncState;
				using (ServiceModelActivity.BoundOperation(null))
				{
					Exception e = null;
					try
					{
						closeAsyncResult.HandleCloseComplete(result);
					}
					catch (Exception ex)
					{
						if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
						{
							throw;
						}
						e = ex;
						ServiceBusEventSource.Log.Warning(null, "Relay", closeAsyncResult.communicationObject, $"Close failed: {ex}", "OnCloseComplete", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\RefcountedCommunicationObject.cs", 861);
						closeAsyncResult.communicationObject.Abort();
					}
					closeAsyncResult.Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: false, e);
				}
			}

			private void HandleCloseComplete(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				communicationObject.OnEndClose(result);
				communicationObject.OnClosed();
				if (!communicationObject.onClosedCalled)
				{
					throw communicationObject.CreateBaseClassMethodNotCalledException("OnClosed");
				}
			}

			public static void End(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult.End<CloseAsyncResult>(result);
			}
		}

		private bool aborted;

		private bool closeCalled;

		private object mutex;

		private bool onClosingCalled;

		private bool onClosedCalled;

		private bool onOpeningCalled;

		private bool onOpenedCalled;

		private bool raisedClosed;

		private bool raisedClosing;

		private bool raisedFaulted;

		private bool traceOpenAndClose;

		private object eventSender;

		private int refCount;

		private ThreadNeutralSemaphore semaphore;

		private CommunicationState state;

		public CommunicationState State => state;

		protected object ThisLock => mutex;

		protected abstract TimeSpan DefaultCloseTimeout { get; }

		protected abstract TimeSpan DefaultOpenTimeout { get; }

		internal virtual string CloseActivityName => SR.GetString(Resources.ActivityClose, GetType().FullName);

		internal virtual string OpenActivityName => SR.GetString(Resources.ActivityOpen, GetType().FullName);

		internal virtual ActivityType OpenActivityType => ActivityType.Open;

		internal bool TraceOpenAndClose

			set

		protected RefcountedCommunicationObject()
			: this(new object())
		{
		}

		protected RefcountedCommunicationObject(object mutex)
		{
			this.mutex = mutex;
			eventSender = this;
			state = CommunicationState.Created;
			semaphore = new ThreadNeutralSemaphore(1);
		}

		public void Abort()
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (!closeCalled)
				{
					if (refCount == 0)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.InvalidRefcountedCommunicationObject);
					}
					if (--refCount > 0)
					{
						return;
					}
				}
				if (aborted || state == CommunicationState.Closed)
				{
					return;
				}
				aborted = true;
				state = CommunicationState.Closing;
			}
			ServiceBusEventSource.Log.Info(null, "Relay", this, string.Empty, "Abort", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\RefcountedCommunicationObject.cs", 89);
			bool flag = true;
			try
			{
				OnClosing();
				if (!onClosingCalled)
				{
					throw CreateBaseClassMethodNotCalledException("OnClosing");
				}
				OnAbort();
				OnClosed();
				if (!onClosedCalled)
				{
					throw CreateBaseClassMethodNotCalledException("OnClosed");
				}
				flag = false;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					ServiceBusEventSource.Log.Warning(null, "Relay", this, "Abort failed", "Abort", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\RefcountedCommunicationObject.cs", 111);
				}
			}
		}

		public bool AddRef()
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (state == CommunicationState.Closing || state == CommunicationState.Closed)
				{
					return false;
				}
				refCount++;
				return true;
			}
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginClose(AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return BeginClose(DefaultCloseTimeout, callback, state);
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			if (timeout < TimeSpan.Zero)
			{
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("timeout", SR.GetString(Resources.SFxTimeoutOutOfRange0)), null, EventLevel.Warning, "BeginClose", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\RefcountedCommunicationObject.cs", 135);
			}
			using ((DiagnosticUtility.ShouldUseActivity && TraceOpenAndClose) ? CreateCloseActivity() : null)
			{
				CommunicationState communicationState;
				lock (ThisLock)
				{
					if (refCount == 0)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.InvalidRefcountedCommunicationObject);
					}
					if (--refCount > 0)
					{
						return new SkippingOperationAsyncResult(callback, state);
					}
					communicationState = this.state;
					if (communicationState != CommunicationState.Closed)
					{
						this.state = CommunicationState.Closing;
					}
					closeCalled = true;
				}
				switch (communicationState)
				{
				case CommunicationState.Created:
				case CommunicationState.Opening:
				case CommunicationState.Faulted:
					Abort();
					if (communicationState == CommunicationState.Faulted)
					{
						throw CreateFaultedException();
					}
					return new AlreadyClosedAsyncResult(callback, state);
				case CommunicationState.Opened:
				{
					bool flag = true;
					try
					{
						OnClosing();
						if (!onClosingCalled)
						{
							throw CreateBaseClassMethodNotCalledException("OnClosing");
						}
						IAsyncResult result = new CloseAsyncResult(this, timeout, callback, state);
						flag = false;
						return result;
					}
					finally
					{
						if (flag)
						{
							ServiceBusEventSource.Log.Warning(null, "Relay", this, "Close failed", "BeginClose", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\RefcountedCommunicationObject.cs", 188);
							Abort();
						}
					}
				}
				case CommunicationState.Closing:
				case CommunicationState.Closed:
					return new AlreadyClosedAsyncResult(callback, state);
				default:
					throw Fx.AssertAndThrow("CommunicationObject.BeginClose: Unknown CommunicationState");
				}
			}
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginOpen(AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return BeginOpen(DefaultOpenTimeout, callback, state);
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginOpen(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			if (timeout < TimeSpan.Zero)
			{
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("timeout", SR.GetString(Resources.SFxTimeoutOutOfRange0)), null, EventLevel.Warning, "BeginOpen", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\RefcountedCommunicationObject.cs", 212);
			}
			CommunicationState communicationState;
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				ThrowIfDisposed();
				if (this.state == CommunicationState.Opened)
				{
					return new SkippingOperationAsyncResult(callback, state);
				}
				communicationState = this.state;
				if (this.state == CommunicationState.Created)
				{
					this.state = CommunicationState.Opening;
					if (!semaphore.TryEnter())
					{
						throw new Exception(SRClient.InvalidStateMachineRefcountedCommunicationObject);
					}
				}
			}
			if (communicationState == CommunicationState.Opening)
			{
				return new AlreadyOpeningAsyncResult(semaphore, timeout, callback, state);
			}
			bool flag = true;
			try
			{
				OnOpening();
				if (!onOpeningCalled)
				{
					throw CreateBaseClassMethodNotCalledException("OnOpening");
				}
				IAsyncResult result = new OpenAsyncResult(this, timeout, callback, state);
				flag = false;
				return result;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					ServiceBusEventSource.Log.Warning(null, "Relay", this, "Open failed", "BeginOpen", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\RefcountedCommunicationObject.cs", 251);
					Fault();
				}
			}
		}

		public void Close()
		{
			Close(DefaultCloseTimeout);
		}

		public void Close(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			if (timeout < TimeSpan.Zero)
			{
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("timeout", SR.GetString(Resources.SFxTimeoutOutOfRange0)), null, EventLevel.Warning, "Close", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\RefcountedCommunicationObject.cs", 265);
			}
			using ((DiagnosticUtility.ShouldUseActivity && TraceOpenAndClose) ? CreateCloseActivity() : null)
			{
				CommunicationState communicationState;
				lock (ThisLock)
				{
					if (refCount == 0)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.InvalidRefcountedCommunicationObject);
					}
					if (--refCount > 0)
					{
						return;
					}
					communicationState = state;
					if (communicationState != CommunicationState.Closed)
					{
						state = CommunicationState.Closing;
					}
					closeCalled = true;
				}
				switch (communicationState)
				{
				case CommunicationState.Created:
				case CommunicationState.Opening:
				case CommunicationState.Faulted:
					Abort();
					if (communicationState == CommunicationState.Faulted)
					{
						throw CreateFaultedException();
					}
					break;
				case CommunicationState.Opened:
				{
					bool flag = true;
					try
					{
						OnClosing();
						if (!onClosingCalled)
						{
							throw CreateBaseClassMethodNotCalledException("OnClosing");
						}
						OnClose(timeout);
						OnClosed();
						if (!onClosedCalled)
						{
							throw CreateBaseClassMethodNotCalledException("OnClosed");
						}
						flag = false;
						break;
					}
					finally
					{
						if (flag)
						{
							ServiceBusEventSource.Log.Warning(null, "Relay", this, "Close failed", "Close", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\RefcountedCommunicationObject.cs", 321);
							Abort();
						}
					}
				}
				default:
					throw Fx.AssertAndThrow("CommunicationObject.BeginClose: Unknown CommunicationState");
				case CommunicationState.Closing:
				case CommunicationState.Closed:
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private Exception CreateBaseClassMethodNotCalledException(string method)
		{
			return new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString(Resources.CommunicationObjectBaseClassMethodNotCalled, GetCommunicationObjectType().ToString(), method));
		}

		internal Exception CreateClosedException()
		{
			if (!closeCalled)
			{
				return CreateAbortedException();
			}
			return new ObjectDisposedException(GetCommunicationObjectType().ToString());
		}

		private Exception CreateFaultedException()
		{
			string message = SR.GetString(Resources.CommunicationObjectFaultedStack2, GetCommunicationObjectType().ToString(), string.Empty);
			return new CommunicationObjectFaultedException(message);
		}

		internal Exception CreateAbortedException()
		{
			return new CommunicationObjectAbortedException(SR.GetString(Resources.CommunicationObjectAbortedStack2, GetCommunicationObjectType().ToString(), string.Empty));
		}

		private ServiceModelActivity CreateCloseActivity()
		{
			ServiceModelActivity serviceModelActivity = null;
			serviceModelActivity = ServiceModelActivity.CreateBoundedActivity();
			if (DiagnosticUtility.ShouldUseActivity)
			{
				ServiceModelActivity.Start(serviceModelActivity, CloseActivityName, ActivityType.Close);
			}
			return serviceModelActivity;
		}

		public void EndClose(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (result is AlreadyClosedAsyncResult)
			{
				CompletedAsyncResult.End(result);
			}
			else if (result is SkippingOperationAsyncResult)
			{
				CompletedAsyncResult.End(result);
			}
			else
			{
				CloseAsyncResult.End(result);
			}
		}

		public void EndOpen(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			if (result is AlreadyOpeningAsyncResult)
			{
				AlreadyOpeningAsyncResult.End(result);
			}
			else if (result is SkippingOperationAsyncResult)
			{
				CompletedAsyncResult.End(result);
			}
			else
			{
				OpenAsyncResult.End(result);
			}
		}

		protected void Fault()
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (state == CommunicationState.Closed || state == CommunicationState.Closing || state == CommunicationState.Faulted)
				{
					return;
				}
				state = CommunicationState.Faulted;
			}
			OnFaulted();
		}

		public void Open()
		{
			Open(DefaultOpenTimeout);
		}

		public void Open(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			if (timeout < TimeSpan.Zero)
			{
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("timeout", SR.GetString(Resources.SFxTimeoutOutOfRange0)), null, EventLevel.Warning, "Open", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\RefcountedCommunicationObject.cs", 455);
			}
			using ServiceModelActivity activity = ((DiagnosticUtility.ShouldUseActivity && TraceOpenAndClose) ? ServiceModelActivity.CreateBoundedActivity() : null);
			CommunicationState communicationState;
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				ThrowIfDisposed();
				if (state == CommunicationState.Opened)
				{
					return;
				}
				communicationState = state;
				if (state == CommunicationState.Created)
				{
					state = CommunicationState.Opening;
					if (!semaphore.TryEnter())
					{
						throw new Exception(SRClient.InvalidStateMachineRefcountedCommunicationObject);
					}
				}
			}
			if (communicationState == CommunicationState.Opening)
			{
				semaphore.Enter(timeout);
				semaphore.Exit();
				return;
			}
			if (DiagnosticUtility.ShouldUseActivity)
			{
				ServiceModelActivity.Start(activity, OpenActivityName, OpenActivityType);
			}
			bool flag = true;
			try
			{
				OnOpening();
				if (!onOpeningCalled)
				{
					throw CreateBaseClassMethodNotCalledException("OnOpening");
				}
				OnOpen(timeout);
				OnOpened();
				if (!onOpenedCalled)
				{
					throw CreateBaseClassMethodNotCalledException("OnOpened");
				}
				flag = false;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					ServiceBusEventSource.Log.Warning(null, "Relay", this, "Open failed", "Open", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\RefcountedCommunicationObject.cs", 507);
					Fault();
				}
				semaphore.Exit();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnClosed()
		{
			onClosedCalled = true;
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (raisedClosed)
				{
					return;
				}
				raisedClosed = true;
				state = CommunicationState.Closed;
			}
			ServiceBusEventSource.Log.Verbose(null, "Relay", this, string.Empty, "OnClosed", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\RefcountedCommunicationObject.cs", 527);
			EventHandler eventHandler = this.Closed;
			if (eventHandler == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				eventHandler(eventSender, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
				{
					throw;
				}
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new CallbackException(SR.GetString(Resources.GenericCallbackException), ex), null, EventLevel.Warning, "OnClosed", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\RefcountedCommunicationObject.cs", 541);
			}
		}

		protected internal void ThrowIfDisposed()
		{
			switch (state)
			{
			case CommunicationState.Closing:
				throw CreateClosedException();
			case CommunicationState.Closed:
				throw CreateClosedException();
			case CommunicationState.Faulted:
				throw CreateFaultedException();
			default:
				throw Fx.AssertAndThrow("ThrowIfDisposed: Unknown CommunicationObject.state");
			case CommunicationState.Created:
			case CommunicationState.Opening:
			case CommunicationState.Opened:
				break;
			}
		}

	internal abstract class RequestChannel : TrackingContextChannelBase, IRequestChannel, IChannel, ICommunicationObject
	{
		private class WaitForPendingRequestsAsyncResult : Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult
		{
			private static WaitOrTimerCallback completeWaitCallBack = OnCompleteWaitCallBack;

			private IRequestBase[] pendingRequests;

			private RequestChannel requestChannel;

			private TimeSpan timeout;

			private RegisteredWaitHandle waitHandle;

			public WaitForPendingRequestsAsyncResult(TimeSpan timeout, RequestChannel requestChannel, IRequestBase[] pendingRequests, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(callback, state)
			{
				this.requestChannel = requestChannel;
				this.pendingRequests = pendingRequests;
				this.timeout = timeout;
				if (this.timeout == TimeSpan.Zero || this.pendingRequests == null)
				{
					AbortRequests();
					CleanupEvents();
					Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: true);
				}
				else
				{
					waitHandle = ThreadPool.UnsafeRegisterWaitForSingleObject(this.requestChannel.closedEvent, completeWaitCallBack, this, TimeoutHelper.ToMilliseconds(timeout), executeOnlyOnce: true);
				}
			}

			private void AbortRequests()
			{
				if (pendingRequests != null)
				{
					IRequestBase[] array = pendingRequests;
					foreach (IRequestBase requestBase in array)
					{
						requestBase.Abort(requestChannel);
					}
				}
			}

			private void CleanupEvents()
			{
				if (requestChannel.closedEvent != null)
				{
					if (waitHandle != null)
					{
						waitHandle.Unregister(requestChannel.closedEvent);
					}
					requestChannel.FinishClose();
				}
			}

			private static void OnCompleteWaitCallBack(object state, bool timedOut)
			{
				WaitForPendingRequestsAsyncResult waitForPendingRequestsAsyncResult = (WaitForPendingRequestsAsyncResult)state;
				Exception e = null;
				try
				{
					if (timedOut)
					{
						waitForPendingRequestsAsyncResult.AbortRequests();
					}
					waitForPendingRequestsAsyncResult.CleanupEvents();
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
					{
						throw;
					}
					e = ex;
				}
				waitForPendingRequestsAsyncResult.Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: false, e);
			}

			public static void End(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult.End<WaitForPendingRequestsAsyncResult>(result);
			}
		}

		private bool manualAddressing;

		private EndpointAddress to;

		private Uri via;

			if (array != null)
			{
				IRequestBase[] array2 = array;
				foreach (IRequestBase requestBase in array2)

					requestBase.Abort(this);
				}
			}
		}

		private void FinishClose()
		{
			lock (outstandingRequests)
			{
				if (!closed)
				{
					closed = true;
					if (closedEvent != null)
					{
						closedEvent.Close();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private IRequestBase[] SetupWaitForPendingRequests()
		{
			return CopyPendingRequests(createEventIfNecessary: true);
		}

		protected void WaitForPendingRequests(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			IRequestBase[] array = SetupWaitForPendingRequests();
			if (array != null && !closedEvent.WaitOne(timeout, exitContext: false))
			{
				IRequestBase[] array2 = array;
				foreach (IRequestBase requestBase in array2)
				{
					requestBase.Abort(this);
				}
			}
			FinishClose();
		}

		private IRequestBase[] CopyPendingRequests(bool createEventIfNecessary)
		{
			IRequestBase[] array = null;
			lock (outstandingRequests)
			{
				if (outstandingRequests.Count > 0)
				{
					array = new IRequestBase[outstandingRequests.Count];
					outstandingRequests.CopyTo(array);
					outstandingRequests.Clear();
					if (createEventIfNecessary && closedEvent == null)
					{
						closedEvent = new ManualResetEvent(initialState: false);
					}
				}
			}
			return array;
		}

		protected void FaultPendingRequests()
		{
			IRequestBase[] array = CopyPendingRequests(createEventIfNecessary: false);
			if (array != null)
			{
				IRequestBase[] array2 = array;
				foreach (IRequestBase requestBase in array2)
				{
					requestBase.Fault(this);
				}
			}
		}

		private void ReleaseRequest(IRequestBase request)
		{
			lock (outstandingRequests)
			{
				outstandingRequests.Remove(request);
				if (outstandingRequests.Count == 0 && !closed && closedEvent != null)
				{
					closedEvent.Set();
				}
			}
		}

		private void TrackRequest(IRequestBase request)
		{
			lock (outstandingRequests)
			{
				ThrowIfDisposedOrNotOpen();
				outstandingRequests.Add(request);
			}
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginRequest(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			if (message == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("message");
			}
			if (timeout < TimeSpan.Zero)
			{
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("timeout", timeout, SR.GetString(Resources.SFxTimeoutOutOfRange0)), null, EventLevel.Warning, "BeginRequest", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\RequestChannel.cs", 251);
			}
			ThrowIfDisposedOrNotOpen();
			AddHeadersTo(message);
			IAsyncRequest asyncRequest = CreateAsyncRequest(message, callback, state);
			TrackRequest(asyncRequest);
			bool flag = true;
			try
			{
				asyncRequest.BeginSendRequest(message, timeout);
				flag = false;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					ReleaseRequest(asyncRequest);
				}
			}
			return asyncRequest;
		}

			if (!(result is IAsyncRequest asyncRequest))
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.Argument("result", SR.GetString(Resources.InvalidAsyncResult));

			try
			{
				System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message = asyncRequest.End();
				ServiceBusEventSource.Log.WcfEventInformation(TraceCode.RequestChannelReplyReceived, this, message.Headers.Action, "EndRequest", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\RequestChannel.cs", 297);
				return message;
			}
			finally
			{
				ReleaseRequest(asyncRequest);
			}
		}

	internal class RequestReplyCorrelator : IRequestReplyCorrelator
	{
		internal struct ReplyToInfo
		{
			private readonly EndpointAddress faultTo;

			private readonly EndpointAddress from;

			private readonly EndpointAddress replyTo;

			internal EndpointAddress FaultTo => faultTo;

			internal EndpointAddress From => from;

			internal bool HasFaultTo => !IsTrivial(FaultTo);

			internal bool HasFrom => !IsTrivial(From);

			internal bool HasReplyTo => !IsTrivial(ReplyTo);

			internal EndpointAddress ReplyTo => replyTo;

			internal ReplyToInfo(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message)
			{
				faultTo = message.Headers.FaultTo;
				replyTo = message.Headers.ReplyTo;
				if (message.Version.Addressing == AddressingVersion.WSAddressingAugust2004)
				{
					from = message.Headers.From;
				}
				else
				{
					from = null;
				}
			}

			private static bool IsTrivial(EndpointAddress address)
			{
				if (!(address == null))
				{
					return address == EndpointAddress2.AnonymousAddress;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private class Key
		{
			internal UniqueId MessageId;

			internal Type StateType;

			internal Key(UniqueId messageId, Type stateType)
			{
				MessageId = messageId;
				StateType = stateType;
			}

			public override bool Equals(object obj)
			{
				if (!(obj is Key key))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (key.MessageId == MessageId)
				{
					return key.StateType == StateType;
				}
				return false;
			}

			public override int GetHashCode()
			{
				return MessageId.GetHashCode() ^ StateType.GetHashCode();
			}

			public override string ToString()
			{
				return typeof(Key).ToString() + ": {" + MessageId?.ToString() + ", " + StateType.ToString() + "}";
			}
		}

		private Hashtable states;

		internal RequestReplyCorrelator()
		{
			states = new Hashtable();
		}

		void IRequestReplyCorrelator.Add<T>(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message request, T state)
		{
			UniqueId messageId = request.Headers.MessageId;
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(T);
			Key key = new Key(messageId, typeFromHandle);
			lock (states)
			{
				states.Add(key, state);
			}
		}

		T IRequestReplyCorrelator.Find<T>(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message reply, bool remove)
		{
			UniqueId relatesTo = GetRelatesTo(reply);
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(T);
			Key key = new Key(relatesTo, typeFromHandle);
			T result;
			lock (states)
			{
				result = (T)states[key];
				if (remove)
				{
					states.Remove(key);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		void IRequestReplyCorrelator.Remove<T>(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message request)
		{
			UniqueId messageId = request.Headers.MessageId;
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(T);
			Key key = new Key(messageId, typeFromHandle);
			lock (states)
			{
				states.Remove(key);
			}
		}

		private static UniqueId GetRelatesTo(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message reply)
		{
			UniqueId relatesTo = reply.Headers.RelatesTo;
			if (relatesTo == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(SR.GetString(Resources.SuppliedMessageIsNotAReplyItHasNoRelatesTo0));
			}
			return relatesTo;
		}

		internal static bool AddressReply(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message reply, System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message request)
		{
			ReplyToInfo info = ExtractReplyToInfo(request);
			return AddressReply(reply, info);
		}

		internal static bool AddressReply(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message reply, ReplyToInfo info)
		{
			EndpointAddress endpointAddress = null;
			if (info.HasFaultTo && reply.IsFault)
			{
				endpointAddress = info.FaultTo;
			}
			else if (info.HasReplyTo)
			{
				endpointAddress = info.ReplyTo;
			}
			else if (reply.Version.Addressing == AddressingVersion.WSAddressingAugust2004)
			{
				endpointAddress = ((!info.HasFrom) ? EndpointAddress2.AnonymousAddress : info.From);
			}
			if (endpointAddress != null)
			{
				endpointAddress.ApplyTo(reply);
				return !endpointAddress.IsNone;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static ReplyToInfo ExtractReplyToInfo(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message)
		{
			return new ReplyToInfo(message);
		}

		internal static void PrepareRequest(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message request)
		{
			MessageHeaders headers = request.Headers;
			if (headers.MessageId == null)
			{
				headers.MessageId = new UniqueId();
			}
			request.Properties.AllowOutputBatching = false;
		}

		internal static void PrepareReply(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message reply, UniqueId messageId)
		{
			if ((object)messageId == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString(Resources.MissingMessageID));
			}
			MessageHeaders headers = reply.Headers;
			if ((object)headers.RelatesTo == null)
			{
				headers.RelatesTo = messageId;
			}
		}

		internal static void PrepareReply(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message reply, System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message request)
		{
			UniqueId messageId = request.Headers.MessageId;
			if (messageId != null)
			{
				MessageHeaders headers = reply.Headers;
				if ((object)headers.RelatesTo == null)
				{
					headers.RelatesTo = messageId;
				}
			}
		}

	internal class ServerSessionPreambleConnectionReader : InitialServerConnectionReader
	{
		private sealed class ServerFramingDuplexSessionChannel : FramingDuplexSessionChannel
		{
			private class OpenAsyncResult : Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult
			{
				private ServerFramingDuplexSessionChannel channel;

				private TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper;

				private static WaitCallback readCallback;

				private static AsyncCallback onWriteAckResponse;

				private static AsyncCallback onWriteUpgradeResponse;

				private static AsyncCallback onUpgradeConnection;

				public OpenAsyncResult(ServerFramingDuplexSessionChannel channel, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
					: base(callback, state)
				{
					this.channel = channel;
					timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
					bool flag = false;
					bool flag2 = false;
					try
					{
						channel.ValidateContentType(ref timeoutHelper);
						flag = ContinueReading();
						flag2 = true;
					}
					finally
					{
						if (!flag2)
						{
							CleanupOnError();
						}
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: true);
					}
				}

				public static void End(IAsyncResult result)
				{
					Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult.End<OpenAsyncResult>(result);
				}

				private void CleanupOnError()
				{
					channel.Connection.Abort();
				}

				private bool ContinueReading()
				{
					while (true)
					{
						if (channel.size == 0)
						{
							if (readCallback == null)
							{
								readCallback = ReadCallback;
							}
							if (channel.Connection.BeginRead(0, channel.connectionBuffer.Length, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime(), readCallback, this) == AsyncReadResult.Queued)
							{
								break;
							}
							GetReadResult();
						}
						do
						{
							channel.DecodeBytes();
							switch (channel.decoder.CurrentState)
							{
							case ServerSessionDecoder.State.UpgradeRequest:
							{
								channel.ProcessUpgradeRequest(ref timeoutHelper);
								if (onWriteUpgradeResponse == null)
								{
									onWriteUpgradeResponse = DiagnosticUtility.ThunkAsyncCallback(OnWriteUpgradeResponse);
								}
								IAsyncResult asyncResult2 = channel.Connection.BeginWrite(ServerSessionEncoder.UpgradeResponseBytes, 0, ServerSessionEncoder.UpgradeResponseBytes.Length, immediate: true, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime(), onWriteUpgradeResponse, this);
								if (!asyncResult2.CompletedSynchronously)
								{
									return false;
								}
								if (!HandleWriteUpgradeResponseComplete(asyncResult2))
								{
									return false;
								}
								break;
							}
							case ServerSessionDecoder.State.Start:
							{
								channel.SetupSecurityIfNecessary();
								if (onWriteAckResponse == null)
								{
									onWriteAckResponse = DiagnosticUtility.ThunkAsyncCallback(OnWriteAckResponse);
								}
								IAsyncResult asyncResult = channel.Connection.BeginWrite(ServerSessionEncoder.AckResponseBytes, 0, ServerSessionEncoder.AckResponseBytes.Length, immediate: true, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime(), onWriteAckResponse, this);
								if (!asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
								{
									return false;
								}
								return HandleWriteAckComplete(asyncResult);
							}
							}
						}
						while (channel.size != 0);
					}
					return false;
				}

				private void GetReadResult()
				{
					channel.offset = 0;
					channel.size = channel.Connection.EndRead();
					if (channel.size == 0)
					{
						throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(channel.decoder.CreatePrematureEOFException(), null, EventLevel.Warning, "GetReadResult", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\SessionConnectionReader.cs", 694);
					}
				}

				private bool HandleWriteUpgradeResponseComplete(IAsyncResult result)
				{
					channel.Connection.EndWrite(result);
					IConnection connection = channel.Connection;
					if (channel.size > 0)
					{
						connection = new PreReadConnection(connection, channel.connectionBuffer, channel.offset, channel.size);
					}
					if (onUpgradeConnection == null)
					{
						onUpgradeConnection = DiagnosticUtility.ThunkAsyncCallback(OnUpgradeConnection);
					}
					try
					{
						IAsyncResult asyncResult = InitialServerConnectionReader.BeginUpgradeConnection(connection, channel.upgradeAcceptor, channel, onUpgradeConnection, this);
						if (!asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
						{
							return false;
						}
						return HandleUpgradeConnectionComplete(asyncResult);
					}
					catch (Exception ex)
					{
						if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
						{
							throw;
						}
						channel.WriteAuditFailure(channel.upgradeAcceptor as StreamSecurityUpgradeAcceptor, ex);
						throw;
					}
				}

				private bool HandleUpgradeConnectionComplete(IAsyncResult result)
				{
					channel.AcceptUpgradedConnection(InitialServerConnectionReader.EndUpgradeConnection(result));
					return true;
				}

				private bool HandleWriteAckComplete(IAsyncResult result)
				{
					channel.Connection.EndWrite(result);
					channel.SetupSessionReader();
					return true;
				}

				private static void ReadCallback(object state)
				{
					OpenAsyncResult openAsyncResult = (OpenAsyncResult)state;
					bool flag = false;
					Exception e = null;
					try
					{
						openAsyncResult.GetReadResult();
						flag = openAsyncResult.ContinueReading();
					}
					catch (Exception ex)
					{
						if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
						{
							throw;
						}
						flag = true;
						e = ex;
						openAsyncResult.CleanupOnError();
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						openAsyncResult.Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: false, e);
					}
				}

				private static void OnWriteUpgradeResponse(IAsyncResult result)
				{
					if (result.CompletedSynchronously)
					{
						return;
					}
					OpenAsyncResult openAsyncResult = (OpenAsyncResult)result.AsyncState;
					bool flag = false;
					Exception e = null;
					try
					{
						flag = openAsyncResult.HandleWriteUpgradeResponseComplete(result);
						if (flag)
						{
							flag = openAsyncResult.ContinueReading();
						}
					}
					catch (Exception ex)
					{
						if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
						{
							throw;
						}
						e = ex;
						flag = true;
						openAsyncResult.CleanupOnError();
						openAsyncResult.channel.WriteAuditFailure(openAsyncResult.channel.upgradeAcceptor as StreamSecurityUpgradeAcceptor, ex);
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						openAsyncResult.Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: false, e);
					}
				}

				private static void OnUpgradeConnection(IAsyncResult result)
				{
					if (result.CompletedSynchronously)
					{
						return;
					}
					OpenAsyncResult openAsyncResult = (OpenAsyncResult)result.AsyncState;
					bool flag = false;
					Exception e = null;
					try
					{
						flag = openAsyncResult.HandleUpgradeConnectionComplete(result);
						if (flag)
						{
							flag = openAsyncResult.ContinueReading();
						}
					}
					catch (Exception ex)
					{
						if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
						{
							throw;
						}
						e = ex;
						flag = true;
						openAsyncResult.CleanupOnError();
						openAsyncResult.channel.WriteAuditFailure(openAsyncResult.channel.upgradeAcceptor as StreamSecurityUpgradeAcceptor, ex);
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						openAsyncResult.Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: false, e);
					}
				}

				private static void OnWriteAckResponse(IAsyncResult result)
				{
					if (result.CompletedSynchronously)
					{
						return;
					}
					OpenAsyncResult openAsyncResult = (OpenAsyncResult)result.AsyncState;
					bool flag = false;
					Exception e = null;
					try
					{
						flag = openAsyncResult.HandleWriteAckComplete(result);
					}
					catch (Exception ex)
					{
						if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
						{
							throw;
						}
						e = ex;
						flag = true;
						openAsyncResult.CleanupOnError();
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						openAsyncResult.Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: false, e);
					}
				}
			}

			private class ServerSessionConnectionReader : SessionConnectionReader
			{
				private ServerSessionDecoder decoder;

				private int maxBufferSize;

				private BufferManager bufferManager;

				private MessageEncoder messageEncoder;

				private string contentType;

				private IConnection rawConnection;

				public ServerSessionConnectionReader(ServerFramingDuplexSessionChannel channel)
					: base(channel.Connection, channel.rawConnection, channel.offset, channel.size, channel.RemoteSecurity)
				{
					decoder = channel.decoder;
					contentType = decoder.ContentType;
					maxBufferSize = channel.channelListener.MaxBufferSize;
					bufferManager = channel.channelListener.BufferManager;
					messageEncoder = channel.MessageEncoder;
					rawConnection = channel.rawConnection;
				}

				protected override void EnsureDecoderAtEof()
				{
					if (decoder.CurrentState != ServerSessionDecoder.State.End && decoder.CurrentState != ServerSessionDecoder.State.EnvelopeEnd)
					{
						throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(decoder.CreatePrematureEOFException(), null, EventLevel.Warning, "EnsureDecoderAtEof", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\SessionConnectionReader.cs", 915);
					}
				}

				protected override System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message DecodeMessage(byte[] buffer, ref int offset, ref int size, ref bool isAtEof, TimeSpan timeout)
				{
					while (!isAtEof && size > 0)
					{
						int num = decoder.Decode(buffer, offset, size);
						if (num > 0)
						{
							if (base.EnvelopeBuffer != null)
							{
								if (buffer != base.EnvelopeBuffer)
								{
									Buffer.BlockCopy(buffer, offset, base.EnvelopeBuffer, base.EnvelopeOffset, num);
								}
								base.EnvelopeOffset += num;
							}
							offset += num;
							size -= num;
						}
						switch (decoder.CurrentState)
						{
						case ServerSessionDecoder.State.EnvelopeStart:
						{
							int num2 = decoder.EnvelopeSize;
							if (num2 > maxBufferSize)
							{
								SendFault("http://schemas.microsoft.com/ws/2006/05/framing/faults/MaxMessageSizeExceededFault", timeout);
								throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(MaxMessageSizeStream.CreateMaxReceivedMessageSizeExceededException(maxBufferSize), null, EventLevel.Warning, "DecodeMessage", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\SessionConnectionReader.cs", 947);
							}
							base.EnvelopeBuffer = bufferManager.TakeBuffer(num2);
							base.EnvelopeOffset = 0;
							base.EnvelopeSize = num2;
							break;
						}
						case ServerSessionDecoder.State.EnvelopeEnd:
							if (base.EnvelopeBuffer == null)
							{
								break;
							}
							using (DiagnosticUtility.ShouldUseActivity ? ServiceModelActivity.CreateBoundedActivity(suspendCurrent: true) : null)
							{
								System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message = null;
								try
								{
									message = messageEncoder.ReadMessage(new ArraySegment<byte>(base.EnvelopeBuffer, 0, base.EnvelopeSize), bufferManager, contentType);
								}
								catch (XmlException innerException)
								{
									throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new ProtocolException(SR.GetString(Resources.MessageXmlProtocolError), innerException), null, EventLevel.Warning, "DecodeMessage", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\SessionConnectionReader.cs", 974);
								}
								base.EnvelopeBuffer = null;
								return message;
							}
						case ServerSessionDecoder.State.End:
							isAtEof = true;
							break;
						}
					}
					return null;
				}

				protected override void PrepareMessage(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message)
				{
					base.PrepareMessage(message);
					IPEndPoint remoteIPEndPoint = rawConnection.RemoteIPEndPoint;
					if (remoteIPEndPoint != null)
					{
						RemoteEndpointMessageProperty property = new RemoteEndpointMessageProperty(remoteIPEndPoint.Address.ToString(), remoteIPEndPoint.Port);
						message.Properties.Add(RemoteEndpointMessageProperty.Name, property);
					}
				}
			}

			protected override void OnOpen(TimeSpan timeout)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				try
				{
					TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
					ValidateContentType(ref timeoutHelper);
					while (true)
					{
						if (size == 0)
						{
							offset = 0;
							size = base.Connection.Read(connectionBuffer, 0, connectionBuffer.Length, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
							if (size == 0)
							{
								break;
							}
						}
						do
						{
							DecodeBytes();
							switch (decoder.CurrentState)
							{
							case ServerSessionDecoder.State.UpgradeRequest:
							{
								ProcessUpgradeRequest(ref timeoutHelper);
								base.Connection.Write(ServerSessionEncoder.UpgradeResponseBytes, 0, ServerSessionEncoder.UpgradeResponseBytes.Length, immediate: true, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());

								if (size > 0)

								}
								try
								{
									base.Connection = InitialServerConnectionReader.UpgradeConnection(connection, upgradeAcceptor, this);
									connectionBuffer = base.Connection.AsyncReadBuffer;
								}
								catch (Exception exception)
								{
									if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
									{
										throw;
									}
									WriteAuditFailure(upgradeAcceptor as StreamSecurityUpgradeAcceptor, exception);
									throw;
								}
								break;
							}
							case ServerSessionDecoder.State.Start:
								SetupSecurityIfNecessary();
								base.Connection.Write(ServerSessionEncoder.AckResponseBytes, 0, ServerSessionEncoder.AckResponseBytes.Length, immediate: true, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
								SetupSessionReader();
								flag = true;
								return;
							}
						}
						while (size != 0);
					}
					throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(decoder.CreatePrematureEOFException(), null, EventLevel.Warning, "OnOpen", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\SessionConnectionReader.cs", 349);
				}
				finally
				{
					if (!flag)
					{
						base.Connection.Abort();
					}
				}
			}

					throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new ProtocolException(SR.GetString(Resources.UpgradeProtocolNotSupported, decoder.Upgrade)), null, EventLevel.Warning, "ProcessUpgradeRequest", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\SessionConnectionReader.cs", 451);
				}

		private void GetReadResult()
		{
			offset = 0;
			size = base.Connection.EndRead();
			if (size == 0)
			{
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(decoder.CreatePrematureEOFException(), null, EventLevel.Warning, "GetReadResult", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\SessionConnectionReader.cs", 132);
			}

		private void ContinueReading()
		{
			bool flag = false;
			try
			{
				while (true)
				{
					if (size == 0)
					{
						if (readCallback == null)
						{
							readCallback = ReadCallback;
						}
						if (base.Connection.BeginRead(0, connectionBuffer.Length, GetRemainingTimeout(), readCallback, this) == AsyncReadResult.Queued)
						{
							break;
						}
						GetReadResult();
					}
					int num = decoder.Decode(connectionBuffer, offset, size);
					if (num > 0)
					{
						offset += num;
						size -= num;
					}
					if (decoder.CurrentState != ServerSessionDecoder.State.PreUpgradeStart)
					{
						continue;
					}
					via = decoder.Via;
					if (!base.Connection.Validate(via))
					{
						return;
					}
					if (viaDelegate != null)
					{
						try
						{
							viaDelegate(via);
						}
						catch (ServiceActivationException exception)
						{
							ServiceBusEventSource.Log.HandledException(exception, null, "Relay", this, EventLevel.Informational, "ContinueReading", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\SessionConnectionReader.cs", 183);
							SendFault("http://schemas.microsoft.com/ws/2006/05/framing/faults/ServiceActivationFailed");
							break;
						}
					}
					settings = transportSettingsCallback(via);
					if (settings == null)
					{
						EndpointNotFoundException exception2 = new EndpointNotFoundException(SR.GetString(Resources.EndpointNotFound, decoder.Via));
						ServiceBusEventSource.Log.HandledException(exception2, null, "Relay", this, EventLevel.Informational, "ContinueReading", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\SessionConnectionReader.cs", 195);
						SendFault("http://schemas.microsoft.com/ws/2006/05/framing/faults/EndpointNotFound");
						return;
					}
					callback(this);
					break;
				}
				flag = true;
			}
			catch (CommunicationException exception3)
			{
				ServiceBusEventSource.Log.HandledException(exception3, null, "Relay", this, EventLevel.Informational, "ContinueReading", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\SessionConnectionReader.cs", 210);
			}
			catch (TimeoutException exception4)
			{
				ServiceBusEventSource.Log.HandledException(exception4, null, "Relay", this, EventLevel.Informational, "ContinueReading", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\SessionConnectionReader.cs", 214);
			}
			catch (Exception exception5)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception5))
				{
					throw;
				}
				if (!ExceptionHandler.HandleTransportExceptionHelper(exception5))
				{
					throw;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (!flag)
				{
					Abort();
				}
			}
		}
