	internal abstract class SessionConnectionReader : IMessageSource
	{
		private bool isAtEOF;

		private bool usingAsyncReadBuffer;

		private IConnection connection;

		private byte[] buffer;

		private int offset;

		private int size;

		private byte[] envelopeBuffer;

		private int envelopeOffset;

		private int envelopeSize;

		private bool readIntoEnvelopeBuffer;

		private WaitCallback onAsyncReadComplete;

		private System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message pendingMessage;

		private Exception pendingException;

		private WaitCallback pendingCallback;

		private object pendingCallbackState;

		private SecurityMessageProperty security;

		private TimeoutHelper readTimeoutHelper;

		private IConnection rawConnection;

		protected byte[] EnvelopeBuffer
		{
			get
			{
				return envelopeBuffer;
			}
			set
			{
				envelopeBuffer = value;
			}
		}

		protected int EnvelopeOffset
		{
			get
			{
				return envelopeOffset;
			}
			set
			{
				envelopeOffset = value;
			}
		}

		protected int EnvelopeSize
		{
			get
			{
				return envelopeSize;
			}
			set
			{
				envelopeSize = value;
			}
		}

		protected SessionConnectionReader(IConnection connection, IConnection rawConnection, int offset, int size, SecurityMessageProperty security)
		{
			this.offset = offset;
			this.size = size;
			if (size > 0)
			{
				buffer = connection.AsyncReadBuffer;
			}
			this.connection = connection;
			this.rawConnection = rawConnection;
			onAsyncReadComplete = OnAsyncReadComplete;
			this.security = security;
		}

		private System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message DecodeMessage(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			if (DiagnosticUtility.ShouldUseActivity && ServiceModelActivity.Current != null && ServiceModelActivity.Current.ActivityType == ActivityType.ProcessAction)
			{
				ServiceModelActivity.Current.Resume();
			}
			if (!readIntoEnvelopeBuffer)
			{
				return DecodeMessage(buffer, ref offset, ref size, ref isAtEOF, timeout);
			}
			int num = envelopeOffset;
			return DecodeMessage(envelopeBuffer, ref num, ref size, ref isAtEOF, timeout);
		}

		protected abstract System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message DecodeMessage(byte[] buffer, ref int offset, ref int size, ref bool isAtEof, TimeSpan timeout);

		public IConnection GetRawConnection()
		{
			IConnection connection = null;
			if (rawConnection != null)
			{
				connection = rawConnection;
				rawConnection = null;
				if (size > 0)
				{
					if (connection is PreReadConnection preReadConnection)
					{
						preReadConnection.AddPreReadData(buffer, offset, size);
					}
					else
					{
						connection = new PreReadConnection(connection, buffer, offset, size);
					}
				}
			}
			return connection;
		}

		public AsyncReceiveResult BeginReceive(TimeSpan timeout, WaitCallback callback, object state)
		{
			if (pendingMessage != null || pendingException != null)
			{
				return AsyncReceiveResult.Completed;
			}
			readTimeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
			while (true)
			{
				if (isAtEOF)
				{
					return AsyncReceiveResult.Completed;
				}
				if (size > 0)
				{
					pendingMessage = DecodeMessage(readTimeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
					if (pendingMessage != null)
					{
						PrepareMessage(pendingMessage);
						return AsyncReceiveResult.Completed;
					}
					if (isAtEOF)
					{
						return AsyncReceiveResult.Completed;
					}
				}
				if (size != 0)
				{
					throw Fx.AssertAndThrow("BeginReceive: DecodeMessage() should consume the outstanding buffer or return a message.");
				}
				if (!usingAsyncReadBuffer)
				{
					buffer = connection.AsyncReadBuffer;
					usingAsyncReadBuffer = true;
				}
				pendingCallback = callback;
				pendingCallbackState = state;
				bool flag = true;
				AsyncReadResult asyncReadResult;
				try
				{
					asyncReadResult = connection.BeginRead(0, buffer.Length, readTimeoutHelper.RemainingTime(), onAsyncReadComplete, null);
					flag = false;
				}
				finally
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						pendingCallback = null;
						pendingCallbackState = null;
					}
				}
				if (asyncReadResult == AsyncReadResult.Queued)
				{
					break;
				}
				pendingCallback = null;
				pendingCallbackState = null;
				int bytesRead = connection.EndRead();
				HandleReadComplete(bytesRead, readIntoEnvelopeBuffer: false);
			}
			return AsyncReceiveResult.Pending;
		}

		public System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message Receive(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message = GetPendingMessage();
			if (message != null)
			{
				return message;
			}
			TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
			while (true)
			{
				if (isAtEOF)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (size > 0)
				{
					message = DecodeMessage(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
					if (message != null)
					{
						PrepareMessage(message);
						return message;
					}
					if (isAtEOF)
					{
						return null;
					}
				}
				if (size != 0)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (buffer == null)
				{
					buffer = Fx.AllocateByteArray(connection.AsyncReadBufferSize);
				}
				if (EnvelopeBuffer != null && EnvelopeSize - EnvelopeOffset >= buffer.Length)
				{
					int bytesRead = connection.Read(EnvelopeBuffer, EnvelopeOffset, buffer.Length, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
					HandleReadComplete(bytesRead, readIntoEnvelopeBuffer: true);
				}
				else
				{
					int bytesRead = connection.Read(buffer, 0, buffer.Length, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
					HandleReadComplete(bytesRead, readIntoEnvelopeBuffer: false);
				}
			}
			throw Fx.AssertAndThrow("Receive: DecodeMessage() should consume the outstanding buffer or return a message.");
		}

		public System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message EndReceive()
		{
			return GetPendingMessage();
		}

		private System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message GetPendingMessage()
		{
			if (pendingException != null)
			{
				Exception exception = pendingException;
				pendingException = null;
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(exception, null, "Relay", this, EventLevel.Warning, "GetPendingMessage", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\SessionConnectionReader.cs", 1261);
			}
			if (pendingMessage != null)
			{
				System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message result = pendingMessage;
				pendingMessage = null;
				return result;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public AsyncReceiveResult BeginWaitForMessage(TimeSpan timeout, WaitCallback callback, object state)
		{
			try

				return BeginReceive(timeout, callback, state);

		{

				return false;
			}
		}

		public bool WaitForMessage(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			try
			{
				System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message = Receive(timeout);
				pendingMessage = message;
				return true;
			}
			catch (TimeoutException exception)
			{
				ServiceBusEventSource.Log.HandledException(exception, null, "Relay", this, EventLevel.Informational, "WaitForMessage", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\SessionConnectionReader.cs", 1312);
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected abstract void EnsureDecoderAtEof();

		private void HandleReadComplete(int bytesRead, bool readIntoEnvelopeBuffer)
		{
			this.readIntoEnvelopeBuffer = readIntoEnvelopeBuffer;
			if (bytesRead == 0)
			{
				EnsureDecoderAtEof();
				isAtEOF = true;
			}
			else
			{
				offset = 0;
				size = bytesRead;
			}
		}

		private void OnAsyncReadComplete(object state)
		{
			try
			{
				while (true)
				{
					int bytesRead = connection.EndRead();
					HandleReadComplete(bytesRead, readIntoEnvelopeBuffer: false);
					if (!isAtEOF)
					{
						System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message = DecodeMessage(readTimeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
						if (message != null)
						{
							PrepareMessage(message);
							pendingMessage = message;
							break;
						}
						if (!isAtEOF)
						{
							if (size != 0)
							{
								throw Fx.AssertAndThrow("OnAsyncReadComplete: DecodeMessage() should consume the outstanding buffer or return a message.");
							}
							if (connection.BeginRead(0, buffer.Length, readTimeoutHelper.RemainingTime(), onAsyncReadComplete, null) == AsyncReadResult.Queued)
							{
								return;
							}
							continue;
						}
						break;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				pendingException = exception;
			}
			WaitCallback waitCallback = pendingCallback;
			object state2 = pendingCallbackState;
			pendingCallback = null;
			pendingCallbackState = null;
			waitCallback(state2);
		}

		protected virtual void PrepareMessage(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message)
		{
			if (security != null)
			{
				message.Properties.Security = (SecurityMessageProperty)security.CreateCopy();
			}
		}

		protected void SendFault(string faultString, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			byte[] drainBuffer = new byte[128];
			InitialServerConnectionReader.SendFault(connection, faultString, drainBuffer, timeout, 65536);
		}

	internal class ClientDuplexConnectionReader : SessionConnectionReader
	{
		private ClientDuplexDecoder decoder;

		private int maxBufferSize;

		private BufferManager bufferManager;

		private MessageEncoder messageEncoder;

		private ClientFramingDuplexSessionChannel channel;

		public ClientDuplexConnectionReader(ClientFramingDuplexSessionChannel channel, IConnection connection, ClientDuplexDecoder decoder, IConnectionOrientedTransportFactorySettings settings, MessageEncoder messageEncoder)
			: base(connection, null, 0, 0, null)
		{
			this.decoder = decoder;
			maxBufferSize = settings.MaxBufferSize;
			bufferManager = settings.BufferManager;
			this.messageEncoder = messageEncoder;
			this.channel = channel;
		}

		protected override void EnsureDecoderAtEof()
		{
			if (decoder.CurrentState != ClientFramingDecoderState.End && decoder.CurrentState != ClientFramingDecoderState.EnvelopeEnd && decoder.CurrentState != ClientFramingDecoderState.ReadingUpgradeRecord && decoder.CurrentState != ClientFramingDecoderState.UpgradeResponse)
			{
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(decoder.CreatePrematureEOFException(), null, EventLevel.Warning, "EnsureDecoderAtEof", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\SessionConnectionReader.cs", 1434);
			}
		}

		private static IDisposable CreateProcessActionActivity()
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected override System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message DecodeMessage(byte[] buffer, ref int offset, ref int size, ref bool isAtEOF, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			while (size > 0)
			{
				int num = decoder.Decode(buffer, offset, size);
				if (num > 0)
				{
					if (base.EnvelopeBuffer != null)
					{
						if (buffer != base.EnvelopeBuffer)
						{
							Buffer.BlockCopy(buffer, offset, base.EnvelopeBuffer, base.EnvelopeOffset, num);
						}
						base.EnvelopeOffset += num;
					}
					offset += num;
					size -= num;
				}
				switch (decoder.CurrentState)
				{
				case ClientFramingDecoderState.Fault:
					channel.Session.CloseOutputSession(((IDefaultCommunicationTimeouts)channel).CloseTimeout);
					throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(FaultStringDecoder.GetFaultException(decoder.Fault, channel.RemoteAddress.Uri.AbsoluteUri, messageEncoder.ContentType), null, EventLevel.Warning, "DecodeMessage", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\SessionConnectionReader.cs", 1488);
				case ClientFramingDecoderState.End:
					isAtEOF = true;
					return null;
				case ClientFramingDecoderState.EnvelopeStart:
				{
					int num2 = decoder.EnvelopeSize;
					if (num2 > maxBufferSize)
					{
						throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(MaxMessageSizeStream.CreateMaxReceivedMessageSizeExceededException(maxBufferSize), null, EventLevel.Warning, "DecodeMessage", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\SessionConnectionReader.cs", 1498);
					}
					base.EnvelopeBuffer = bufferManager.TakeBuffer(num2);
					base.EnvelopeOffset = 0;
					base.EnvelopeSize = num2;
					break;
				}
				case ClientFramingDecoderState.EnvelopeEnd:
				{
					if (base.EnvelopeBuffer == null)
					{
						break;
					}
					System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message result = null;
					try
					{
						IDisposable disposable = CreateProcessActionActivity();
						using (disposable)
						{
							result = messageEncoder.ReadMessage(new ArraySegment<byte>(base.EnvelopeBuffer, 0, base.EnvelopeSize), bufferManager);
						}
					}
					catch (XmlException innerException)
					{
						throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new ProtocolException(SR.GetString(Resources.MessageXmlProtocolError), innerException), null, EventLevel.Warning, "DecodeMessage", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\SessionConnectionReader.cs", 1526);
					}
					base.EnvelopeBuffer = null;
					return result;
				}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class SingletonChannelAcceptor<ChannelInterfaceType, TChannel, QueueItemType> : InputQueueChannelAcceptor<ChannelInterfaceType> where ChannelInterfaceType : class, IChannel where TChannel : InputQueueChannel<QueueItemType> where QueueItemType : class, IDisposable
	{
		private TChannel currentChannel;

		private object currentChannelLock = new object();

		private static Action<object> onInvokeDequeuedCallback;

		public SingletonChannelAcceptor(ChannelManagerBase channelManager, Func<Exception> pendingExceptionGenerator)
			: base(channelManager, pendingExceptionGenerator)
		{
		}

		public override ChannelInterfaceType AcceptChannel(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			EnsureChannelAvailable();
			return base.AcceptChannel(timeout);
		}

		public override IAsyncResult BeginAcceptChannel(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			EnsureChannelAvailable();
			return base.BeginAcceptChannel(timeout, callback, state);
		}

		protected TChannel GetCurrentChannel()
		{
			return currentChannel;
		}

		private TChannel EnsureChannelAvailable()
		{
			bool flag = false;
			TChannel val;
			if ((val = currentChannel) == null)
			{
				lock (currentChannelLock)
				{
					if (base.IsDisposed)
					{
						return null;
					}
					if ((val = currentChannel) == null)
					{
						val = OnCreateChannel();
						val.Closed += OnChannelClosed;
						currentChannel = val;
						flag = true;
					}
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				EnqueueAndDispatch((ChannelInterfaceType)(object)val);
			}
			return val;
		}

		protected abstract TChannel OnCreateChannel();

		protected abstract void OnTraceMessageReceived(QueueItemType item);

		public void DispatchItems()
		{
			EnsureChannelAvailable()?.Dispatch();
		}

		public void Enqueue(QueueItemType item)
		{
			Enqueue(item, null);
		}

		public void Enqueue(QueueItemType item, Action dequeuedCallback)
		{
			Enqueue(item, dequeuedCallback, canDispatchOnThisThread: true);
		}

		public void Enqueue(QueueItemType item, Action dequeuedCallback, bool canDispatchOnThisThread)
		{
			TChannel val = EnsureChannelAvailable();
			OnTraceMessageReceived(item);
			if (val != null)
			{
				val.EnqueueAndDispatch(item, dequeuedCallback, canDispatchOnThisThread);
				return;
			}
			InvokeDequeuedCallback(dequeuedCallback, canDispatchOnThisThread);
			item.Dispose();
		}

		public void Enqueue(Exception exception, Action dequeuedCallback)
		{
			Enqueue(exception, dequeuedCallback, canDispatchOnThisThread: true);
		}

		public void Enqueue(Exception exception, Action dequeuedCallback, bool canDispatchOnThisThread)
		{
			TChannel val = EnsureChannelAvailable();
			if (val != null)
			{
				val.EnqueueAndDispatch(exception, dequeuedCallback, canDispatchOnThisThread);
			}
			else
			{
				InvokeDequeuedCallback(dequeuedCallback, canDispatchOnThisThread);
			}
		}

		public bool EnqueueWithoutDispatch(QueueItemType item, Action dequeuedCallback)
		{
			TChannel val = EnsureChannelAvailable();
			OnTraceMessageReceived(item);
			if (val != null)
			{
				return val.EnqueueWithoutDispatch(item, dequeuedCallback);
			}
			InvokeDequeuedCallback(dequeuedCallback, canDispatchOnThisThread: false);
			item.Dispose();
			return false;
		}

		public override bool EnqueueWithoutDispatch(Exception exception, Action dequeuedCallback)
		{
			TChannel val = EnsureChannelAvailable();
			if (val != null)
			{
				return val.EnqueueWithoutDispatch(exception, dequeuedCallback);
			}
			InvokeDequeuedCallback(dequeuedCallback, canDispatchOnThisThread: false);
			return false;
		}

		public void EnqueueAndDispatch(QueueItemType item, Action dequeuedCallback, bool canDispatchOnThisThread)
		{
			TChannel val = EnsureChannelAvailable();
			OnTraceMessageReceived(item);
			if (val != null)
			{
				val.EnqueueAndDispatch(item, dequeuedCallback, canDispatchOnThisThread);
				return;
			}
			InvokeDequeuedCallback(dequeuedCallback, canDispatchOnThisThread);
			item.Dispose();
		}

		public override void EnqueueAndDispatch(Exception exception, Action dequeuedCallback, bool canDispatchOnThisThread)
		{
			TChannel val = EnsureChannelAvailable();
			if (val != null)
			{
				val.EnqueueAndDispatch(exception, dequeuedCallback, canDispatchOnThisThread);
			}
			else
			{
				InvokeDequeuedCallback(dequeuedCallback, canDispatchOnThisThread);
			}
		}

		protected void OnChannelClosed(object sender, EventArgs args)
		{
			IChannel channel = (IChannel)sender;
			lock (currentChannelLock)
			{
				if (channel == currentChannel)
				{
					currentChannel = null;
				}
			}
		}

		private static void InvokeDequeuedCallback(Action dequeuedCallback, bool canDispatchOnThisThread)
		{
			if (canDispatchOnThisThread)
			{
				dequeuedCallback();
				return;
			}
			if (onInvokeDequeuedCallback == null)
			{
				onInvokeDequeuedCallback = OnInvokeDequeuedCallback;
			}
			IOThreadScheduler.ScheduleCallbackNoFlow(onInvokeDequeuedCallback, dequeuedCallback);
		}

		private static void OnInvokeDequeuedCallback(object state)
		{
			Action action = (Action)state;
			action();
		}
	}

		public IConnection CompletePreamble(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
			if (!transportSettings.MessageEncoderFactory.Encoder.IsContentTypeSupported(decoder.ContentType))
			{
				SendFault("http://schemas.microsoft.com/ws/2006/05/framing/faults/ContentTypeInvalid", ref timeoutHelper);
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new ProtocolException(SR.GetString(Resources.ContentTypeMismatch, decoder.ContentType, transportSettings.MessageEncoderFactory.Encoder.ContentType)), null, EventLevel.Warning, "CompletePreamble", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\SingletonConnectionReader.cs", 203);
			}
			StreamUpgradeAcceptor streamUpgradeAcceptor = null;
			StreamUpgradeProvider upgrade = transportSettings.Upgrade;
			if (upgrade != null)
			{
				streamUpgradeAcceptor = upgrade.CreateUpgradeAcceptor();
			}
			IConnection connection = base.Connection;
			while (true)
			{
				if (size == 0)
				{
					offset = 0;
					size = connection.Read(connectionBuffer, 0, connectionBuffer.Length, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
					if (size == 0)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				do
				{
					int num = decoder.Decode(connectionBuffer, offset, size);
					if (num > 0)
					{
						offset += num;
						size -= num;
					}
					switch (decoder.CurrentState)
					{
					case ServerSingletonDecoder.State.UpgradeRequest:
					{
						if (streamUpgradeAcceptor == null)
						{
							SendFault("http://schemas.microsoft.com/ws/2006/05/framing/faults/UpgradeInvalid", ref timeoutHelper);
							throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new ProtocolException(SR.GetString(Resources.UpgradeRequestToNonupgradableService, decoder.Upgrade)), null, EventLevel.Warning, "CompletePreamble", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\SingletonConnectionReader.cs", 243);
						}
						if (!streamUpgradeAcceptor.CanUpgrade(decoder.Upgrade))
						{
							SendFault("http://schemas.microsoft.com/ws/2006/05/framing/faults/UpgradeInvalid", ref timeoutHelper);
							throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new ProtocolException(SR.GetString(Resources.UpgradeProtocolNotSupported, decoder.Upgrade)), null, EventLevel.Warning, "CompletePreamble", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\SingletonConnectionReader.cs", 250);
						}
						connection.Write(ServerSingletonEncoder.UpgradeResponseBytes, 0, ServerSingletonEncoder.UpgradeResponseBytes.Length, immediate: true, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
						IConnection innerConnection = connection;
						if (size > 0)
						{
							innerConnection = new PreReadConnection(innerConnection, connectionBuffer, offset, size);
						}
						try

							connection = InitialServerConnectionReader.UpgradeConnection(innerConnection, streamUpgradeAcceptor, transportSettings);
							connectionBuffer = connection.AsyncReadBuffer;
						}
						catch (Exception exception)
						{
							if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
							{
								throw;
							}
							WriteAuditFailure(streamUpgradeAcceptor as StreamSecurityUpgradeAcceptor, exception);
							throw;
						}
						break;
					}
					case ServerSingletonDecoder.State.Start:
						SetupSecurityIfNecessary(streamUpgradeAcceptor);
						connection.Write(ServerSessionEncoder.AckResponseBytes, 0, ServerSessionEncoder.AckResponseBytes.Length, immediate: true, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
						return connection;
					}
				}
				while (size != 0);
			}
			throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(decoder.CreatePrematureEOFException(), null, EventLevel.Warning, "CompletePreamble", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\SingletonConnectionReader.cs", 224);
		}

		private void SetupSecurityIfNecessary(StreamUpgradeAcceptor upgradeAcceptor)
		{
			if (upgradeAcceptor is StreamSecurityUpgradeAcceptor streamSecurityUpgradeAcceptor)
			{
				security = streamSecurityUpgradeAcceptor.GetRemoteSecurity();

				}
				WriteAuditEvent(streamSecurityUpgradeAcceptor, AuditLevel.Success, null);
			}
		}

		private void WriteAuditFailure(StreamSecurityUpgradeAcceptor securityUpgradeAcceptor, Exception exception)
		{
			try
			{
				WriteAuditEvent(securityUpgradeAcceptor, AuditLevel.Failure, exception);
			}
			catch (Exception exception2)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception2))
				{

		public System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message Receive(TimeSpan timeout)
		{

					}

						if (size == 0)
						{
							DoneReceiving(atEof: true, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
							return null;
						}
					}
				}

				{

					}

			private bool HandleWriteStartBytes(IAsyncResult result)

			private bool WriteEndBytes()

				return HandleWriteEndBytes(asyncResult);
			}

			private bool HandleWriteEndBytes(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				connection.EndWrite(result);
				Cleanup();
				return true;
			}

			private static void OnWriteStartBytes(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				if (!result.CompletedSynchronously)
				{
					OnWriteStartBytesCallbackHelper(result);
				}
			}

			private static void OnWriteStartBytesScheduled(object state)
			{
				OnWriteStartBytesCallbackHelper((IAsyncResult)state);
			}

			private static void OnWriteStartBytesCallbackHelper(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				WriteMessageAsyncResult writeMessageAsyncResult = (WriteMessageAsyncResult)result.AsyncState;
				Exception e = null;
				bool flag = false;
				bool flag2 = true;
				try
				{
					flag = writeMessageAsyncResult.HandleWriteStartBytes(result);
					flag2 = false;

				{

					{
						throw;
					}

						writeMessageAsyncResult.Cleanup();
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					writeMessageAsyncResult.Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: false, e);
				}
			}

			private static void OnWriteEndBytes(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				if (result.CompletedSynchronously)
				{
					return;
				}
				WriteMessageAsyncResult writeMessageAsyncResult = (WriteMessageAsyncResult)result.AsyncState;

		public static void WriteMessage(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, IConnection connection, bool isRequest, IConnectionOrientedTransportFactorySettings settings, ref TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper)
		{
			byte[] array = null;
			if (message != null)
			{
				MessageEncoder encoder = settings.MessageEncoderFactory.Encoder;
				byte[] envelopeStartBytes = SingletonEncoder.EnvelopeStartBytes;
				bool flag;
				if (isRequest)
				{
					array = SingletonEncoder.EnvelopeEndFramingEndBytes;
					flag = TransferModeHelper.IsRequestStreamed(settings.TransferMode);
				}
				else
				{
					array = SingletonEncoder.EnvelopeEndBytes;
					flag = TransferModeHelper.IsResponseStreamed(settings.TransferMode);
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					connection.Write(envelopeStartBytes, 0, envelopeStartBytes.Length, immediate: false, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
					StreamingOutputConnectionStream streamingOutputConnectionStream = new StreamingOutputConnectionStream(connection, settings);
					streamingOutputConnectionStream.Immediate = !message.Properties.AllowOutputBatching;
					Stream stream = new TimeoutStream(streamingOutputConnectionStream, ref timeoutHelper);
					encoder.WriteMessage(message, stream);
				}
				else
				{
					ArraySegment<byte> messageFrame = encoder.WriteMessage(message, int.MaxValue, settings.BufferManager, envelopeStartBytes.Length + 5);
					messageFrame = SingletonEncoder.EncodeMessageFrame(messageFrame);
					Buffer.BlockCopy(envelopeStartBytes, 0, messageFrame.Array, messageFrame.Offset - envelopeStartBytes.Length, envelopeStartBytes.Length);
					connection.Write(messageFrame.Array, messageFrame.Offset - envelopeStartBytes.Length, messageFrame.Count + envelopeStartBytes.Length, immediate: true, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime(), settings.BufferManager);
				}
			}
			else if (isRequest)
			{
				array = SingletonEncoder.EndBytes;
			}
			if (array != null)
			{
				connection.Write(array, 0, array.Length, immediate: true, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
			}
		}

		public static IAsyncResult BeginWriteMessage(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message, IConnection connection, bool isRequest, IConnectionOrientedTransportFactorySettings settings, ref TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new WriteMessageAsyncResult(message, connection, isRequest, settings, ref timeoutHelper, callback, state);
		}

		public static void EndWriteMessage(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			WriteMessageAsyncResult.End(result);
		}
	}

		public SocketConnection(Socket socket, int asyncReadBufferSize, TrackingContext trackingContext)
		{
			if (socket == null || trackingContext == null)
			{

			}
			closeState = CloseState.Open;
			exceptionEventType = EventLevel.Warning;
			TrackingContext = trackingContext;
			this.socket = socket;
			readBuffer = Fx.AllocateByteArray(asyncReadBufferSize);
			this.socket.ReceiveBufferSize = (this.socket.SendBufferSize = Math.Max(524288, asyncReadBufferSize));
			sendTimeout = (receiveTimeout = TimeSpan.MaxValue);
			socketSyncSendTimeout = (socketSyncReceiveTimeout = TimeSpan.MaxValue);
			this.asyncReadBufferSize = asyncReadBufferSize;
			TraceSocketInfo(socket, TraceCode.SocketConnectionCreate, null);
		}

		private void Abort(string timeoutErrorString)
		{
			EventLevel traceEventType = EventLevel.Warning;

				traceEventType = ExceptionEventType;

		private void Abort(EventLevel traceEventType, string timeoutErrorString)
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (closeState == CloseState.Closed)
				{
					return;
				}
				this.timeoutErrorString = timeoutErrorString;
				aborted = true;
				closeState = CloseState.Closed;
				if (asyncReadPending)
				{
					CancelReceiveTimer();
				}
				else
				{
					DisposeReadEventArgs();
				}
				if (asyncWritePending)
				{
					CancelSendTimer();
				}
			}
			TraceSocketInfo(socket, TraceCode.SocketConnectionAbort, timeoutErrorString);
			socket.Close(0);
		}

		private void AbortRead()
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (asyncReadPending)
				{

						SetUserToken(asyncReadEventArgs, null);
						asyncReadPending = false;
						CancelReceiveTimer();
					}
					else
					{
						DisposeReadEventArgs();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void CancelSendTimer()

		}

		public void Close(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (closeState == CloseState.Closing || closeState == CloseState.Closed)
				{
					return;
				}
				TraceSocketInfo(socket, TraceCode.SocketConnectionClose, timeout.ToString());
				closeState = CloseState.Closing;
			}
			closeTimeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
			Shutdown(closeTimeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
			CloseSync();
		}

		private void CloseSync()
		{
			byte[] buffer = new byte[1];
			readFinTimeout = closeTimeoutHelper.RemainingTime();
			try
			{
				int num = ReadCore(buffer, 0, 1, readFinTimeout, closing: true);
				if (num > 0)
				{
					throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException((string m) => new CommunicationException(m), SR.GetString(Resources.SocketCloseReadReceivedData, RemoteIPEndPointString), this, ExceptionEventType, "CloseSync", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\SocketConnection.cs", 376);
				}
			}
			catch (TimeoutException innerException)
			{
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException((string m, Exception i) => new TimeoutException(m, i), SR.GetString(Resources.SocketCloseReadTimeout, RemoteIPEndPointString, readFinTimeout), innerException, TrackingContext, Component, this, ExceptionEventType, "CloseSync", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\SocketConnection.cs", 385);
			}
			ContinueClose(closeTimeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
		}

		private void ContinueClose(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			if (timeout <= TimeSpan.Zero)
			{
				ServiceBusEventSource.Log.WcfEventWarning(TraceCode.SocketConnectionAbortClose, this, string.Empty, "ContinueClose", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\SocketConnection.cs", 401);
			}
			socket.Close(TimeoutHelper.ToMilliseconds(timeout));
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (!asyncReadPending && closeState != CloseState.Closed && !asyncReadPending)
				{
					DisposeReadEventArgs();
				}
				closeState = CloseState.Closed;
			}
		}

		private Exception ConvertSendException(SocketException socketException, TimeSpan remainingTime)
		{
			return ConvertTransferException(socketException, sendTimeout, socketException, remainingTime);
		}

		private Exception ConvertReceiveException(SocketException socketException, TimeSpan remainingTime)
		{
			return ConvertTransferException(socketException, receiveTimeout, socketException, remainingTime);
		}

		private Exception ConvertObjectDisposedException(ObjectDisposedException originalException)
		{
			if (timeoutErrorString != null)
			{
				return new TimeoutException(TrackingContext.CreateTrackableErrorMessage(timeoutErrorString), originalException);
			}
			if (aborted)
			{
				return new CommunicationObjectAbortedException(TrackingContext.CreateTrackableErrorMessage(SR.GetString(Resources.SocketConnectionDisposed)), originalException);
			}
			return originalException;
		}

		private Exception ConvertTransferException(SocketException socketException, TimeSpan timeout, Exception originalException, TimeSpan remainingTime)
		{
			if (socketException.ErrorCode == 6)
			{
				return new CommunicationObjectAbortedException(TrackingContext.CreateTrackableErrorMessage(socketException.Message), socketException);
			}
			if (timeoutErrorString != null)
			{
				return new TimeoutException(TrackingContext.CreateTrackableErrorMessage(timeoutErrorString), originalException);
			}
			if (socketException.ErrorCode == 10053 && remainingTime <= TimeSpan.Zero)
			{
				return new TimeoutException(TrackingContext.CreateTrackableErrorMessage(SR.GetString(Resources.TcpConnectionTimedOut, timeout)), originalException);
			}
			if (socketException.ErrorCode == 10052 || socketException.ErrorCode == 10053 || socketException.ErrorCode == 10054)
			{
				if (aborted)
				{
					return new CommunicationObjectAbortedException(TrackingContext.CreateTrackableErrorMessage(SR.GetString(Resources.TcpLocalConnectionAborted)), originalException);
				}
				return new CommunicationException(TrackingContext.CreateTrackableErrorMessage(SR.GetString(Resources.TcpConnectionResetError, timeout)), originalException);
			}
			if (socketException.ErrorCode == 10060)
			{
				return new TimeoutException(TrackingContext.CreateTrackableErrorMessage(SR.GetString(Resources.TcpConnectionTimedOut, timeout)), originalException);
			}
			if (aborted)
			{
				return new CommunicationObjectAbortedException(TrackingContext.CreateTrackableErrorMessage(SR.GetString(Resources.TcpTransferError, socketException.ErrorCode, socketException.Message)), originalException);
			}
			return new CommunicationException(TrackingContext.CreateTrackableErrorMessage(SR.GetString(Resources.TcpTransferError, socketException.ErrorCode, socketException.Message)), originalException);
		}

			}
		}

		public void Write(byte[] buffer, int offset, int size, bool immediate, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			ConnectionUtilities.ValidateBufferBounds(buffer, offset, size);
			TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateOnly(timeout);
			try
			{
				SetImmediate(immediate);
				int num = size;
				while (num > 0)
				{
					SetWriteTimeout(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime(), synchronous: true);
					size = Math.Min(num, 16777216);
					socket.Send(buffer, offset, size, SocketFlags.None);
					num -= size;
					offset += size;
				}
			}
			catch (SocketException socketException)
			{
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(ConvertSendException(socketException, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime()), this, ExceptionEventType, "Write", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\SocketConnection.cs", 681);
			}
			catch (ObjectDisposedException ex)
			{
				Exception ex2 = ConvertObjectDisposedException(ex);
				if (ex2 == ex)
				{
					throw;
				}
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(ex2, this, ExceptionEventType, "Write", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\SocketConnection.cs", 693);
			}
		}

		public void Write(byte[] buffer, int offset, int size, bool immediate, TimeSpan timeout, BufferManager bufferManager)
		{
			try
			{
				Write(buffer, offset, size, immediate, timeout);
			}
			finally
			{
				bufferManager.ReturnBuffer(buffer);
			}
		}

		public int Read(byte[] buffer, int offset, int size, TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			ConnectionUtilities.ValidateBufferBounds(buffer, offset, size);
			ThrowIfClosed();
			return ReadCore(buffer, offset, size, timeout, closing: false);
		}

		private int ReadCore(byte[] buffer, int offset, int size, TimeSpan timeout, bool closing)
		{
			TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateOnly(timeout);
			try
			{
				SetReadTimeout(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime(), synchronous: true, closing);
				return socket.Receive(buffer, offset, size, SocketFlags.None);
			}
			catch (SocketException socketException)
			{
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(ConvertReceiveException(socketException, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime()), this, ExceptionEventType, "ReadCore", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\SocketConnection.cs", 728);
			}
			catch (ObjectDisposedException ex)
			{
				Exception ex2 = ConvertObjectDisposedException(ex);
				if (ex2 == ex)
				{
					ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(ex, this, ExceptionEventType, "ReadCore", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\SocketConnection.cs", 736);
					throw;
				}
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(ex2, this, ExceptionEventType, "ReadCore", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\SocketConnection.cs", 741);
			}
		}

		public virtual AsyncReadResult BeginRead(int offset, int size, TimeSpan timeout, WaitCallback callback, object state)
		{
			ConnectionUtilities.ValidateBufferBounds(AsyncReadBufferSize, offset, size);
			ThrowIfClosed();
			return BeginReadCore(offset, size, timeout, callback, state);
		}

		private AsyncReadResult BeginReadCore(int offset, int size, TimeSpan timeout, WaitCallback callback, object state)
		{
			bool flag = true;
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				ThrowIfClosed();
				Fx.AssertAndThrow(!asyncReadPending, "SocketConnection.BeginRead called with an existing read pending.");
				EnsureReadEventArgs();
				asyncReadState = state;
				asyncReadCallback = callback;
				SetUserToken(asyncReadEventArgs, this);
				asyncReadPending = true;
				SetReadTimeout(timeout, synchronous: false, closing: false);
			}
			try
			{
				if (offset != asyncReadEventArgs.Offset || size != asyncReadEventArgs.Count)
				{
					asyncReadEventArgs.SetBuffer(offset, size);
				}
				if (ReceiveAsync())
				{
					flag = false;
					return AsyncReadResult.Queued;
				}
				HandleReceiveAsyncCompleted();
				asyncReadSize = asyncReadEventArgs.BytesTransferred;
				flag = false;
				return AsyncReadResult.Completed;
			}
			catch (SocketException socketException)
			{
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(ConvertReceiveException(socketException, TimeSpan.MaxValue), this, ExceptionEventType, "BeginReadCore", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\SocketConnection.cs", 809);
			}
			catch (ObjectDisposedException ex)
			{
				Exception ex2 = ConvertObjectDisposedException(ex);
				ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(ex2, this, ExceptionEventType, "BeginReadCore", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\SocketConnection.cs", 814);
				if (ex2 == ex)
				{
					throw;
				}
				throw ex2;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					AbortRead();
				}
			}
		}

		private bool ReceiveAsync()
		{
			if (!PartialTrustHelpers.ShouldFlowSecurityContext && !ExecutionContext.IsFlowSuppressed())
			{
				return ReceiveAsyncNoFlow();
			}
			return socket.ReceiveAsync(asyncReadEventArgs);
		}

		[SecurityCritical]
		private bool ReceiveAsyncNoFlow()
		{
			using (ExecutionContext.SuppressFlow())
			{
				return socket.ReceiveAsync(asyncReadEventArgs);
			}
		}

		private void OnReceiveAsync(object sender, SocketAsyncEventArgs eventArgs)
		{
			CancelReceiveTimer();
			try
			{
				HandleReceiveAsyncCompleted();
				asyncReadSize = eventArgs.BytesTransferred;
			}
			catch (SocketException socketException)
			{
				asyncReadException = ConvertReceiveException(socketException, TimeSpan.MaxValue);
			}
			catch (Exception exception) when (!Fx.IsFatal(exception))
			{
				asyncReadException = exception;
			}
			FinishRead();
		}

		private void HandleReceiveAsyncCompleted()
		{
			if (asyncReadEventArgs.SocketError == SocketError.Success)
			{
				return;
			}
			throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new SocketException((int)asyncReadEventArgs.SocketError), this, ExceptionEventType, "HandleReceiveAsyncCompleted", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\SocketConnection.cs", 884);
		}

		private void FinishRead()
		{
			WaitCallback waitCallback = asyncReadCallback;
			object state = asyncReadState;
			asyncReadState = null;
			asyncReadCallback = null;
			waitCallback(state);
		}

		public int EndRead()
		{
			if (asyncReadException != null)
			{
				AbortRead();
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(asyncReadException, this, ExceptionEventType, "EndRead", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\SocketConnection.cs", 903);
			}
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (!asyncReadPending)
				{
					throw Fx.AssertAndThrow("SocketConnection.EndRead called with no read pending.");
				}
				SetUserToken(asyncReadEventArgs, null);
				asyncReadPending = false;
				if (closeState == CloseState.Closed)
				{
					DisposeReadEventArgs();
				}
			}
			return asyncReadSize;
		}

		private void DisposeReadEventArgs()
		{
			if (asyncReadEventArgs != null)
			{
				asyncReadEventArgs.Completed -= onReceiveAsyncCompleted;
				asyncReadEventArgs.Dispose();
				GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
			}
			TryReturnReadBuffer();
		}

		private void TryReturnReadBuffer()
		{
			if (readBuffer != null && !aborted)
			{
				readBuffer = null;
			}
		}

		private void SetUserToken(SocketAsyncEventArgs args, object userToken)
		{
			if (args != null)
			{
				args.UserToken = userToken;
			}
		}

		private void SetImmediate(bool immediate)
		{
			if (immediate != noDelay)
			{
				lock (ThisLock)
				{
					ThrowIfClosed();
					socket.NoDelay = immediate;
				}
				noDelay = immediate;
			}
		}

		private void SetReadTimeout(TimeSpan timeout, bool synchronous, bool closing)
		{
			if (synchronous)
			{
				CancelReceiveTimer();
				if (timeout <= TimeSpan.Zero)
				{
					throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException((string m) => new TimeoutException(m), SR.GetString(Resources.TcpConnectionTimedOut, timeout), this, ExceptionEventType, "SetReadTimeout", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\SocketConnection.cs", 983);
				}
				if (!UpdateTimeout(socketSyncReceiveTimeout, timeout))
				{
					return;
				}
				lock (ThisLock)
				{
					if (!closing || closeState != CloseState.Closing)
					{
						ThrowIfClosed();
					}
					socket.ReceiveTimeout = TimeoutHelper.ToMilliseconds(timeout);
				}
				socketSyncReceiveTimeout = timeout;
				receiveTimeout = timeout;
			}
			else
			{
				receiveTimeout = timeout;
				if (timeout == TimeSpan.MaxValue)
				{
					CancelReceiveTimer();
				}
				else
				{
					ReceiveTimer.Set(timeout);
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetWriteTimeout(TimeSpan timeout, bool synchronous)
		{
			if (synchronous)
			{
				CancelSendTimer();
				if (timeout <= TimeSpan.Zero)
				{
					throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException((string m) => new TimeoutException(m), SR.GetString(Resources.TcpConnectionTimedOut, timeout), this, ExceptionEventType, "SetWriteTimeout", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\SocketConnection.cs", 1024);
				}
				if (UpdateTimeout(socketSyncSendTimeout, timeout))
				{
					lock (ThisLock)
					{
						ThrowIfClosed();
						socket.SendTimeout = TimeoutHelper.ToMilliseconds(timeout);
					}
					socketSyncSendTimeout = timeout;
					sendTimeout = timeout;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				sendTimeout = timeout;
				if (timeout == TimeSpan.MaxValue)
				{
					CancelSendTimer();
				}
				else
				{
					SendTimer.Set(timeout);
				}
			}
		}

		private static bool UpdateTimeout(TimeSpan oldTimeout, TimeSpan newTimeout)
		{
			if (oldTimeout == newTimeout)
			{
				return false;
			}
			long num = oldTimeout.Ticks / 10;
			long num2 = Math.Max(oldTimeout.Ticks, newTimeout.Ticks) - Math.Min(oldTimeout.Ticks, newTimeout.Ticks);
			return num2 > num;
		}

		private void EnsureReadEventArgs()
		{
			if (asyncReadEventArgs == null)
			{
				if (onReceiveAsyncCompleted == null)
				{
					onReceiveAsyncCompleted = OnReceiveAsyncCompleted;
				}
				asyncReadEventArgs = new SocketAsyncEventArgs();
				asyncReadEventArgs.SetBuffer(readBuffer, 0, readBuffer.Length);
				asyncReadEventArgs.Completed += onReceiveAsyncCompleted;
			}
		}

		T IConnection.GetProperty<T>()
		{
			if (typeof(T) == typeof(TrackingContext))
			{
				return (T)(object)TrackingContext;
			}
			return default(T);
		}

	internal sealed class StreamedFramingRequestChannel : RequestChannel
	{
		internal class StreamedConnectionPoolHelper : ConnectionPoolHelper
		{
			private class SendPreambleAsyncResult : Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult
			{
				private StreamedFramingRequestChannel channel;

				private IConnection connection;

				private ClientFramingDecoder decoder;

				private StreamUpgradeInitiator upgradeInitiator;

				private SecurityMessageProperty remoteSecurity;

				private TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper;

				private static AsyncCallback onWritePreamble = DiagnosticUtility.ThunkAsyncCallback(OnWritePreamble);

				private static AsyncCallback onWritePreambleEnd;

				private static WaitCallback onReadPreambleAck = OnReadPreambleAck;

				private static AsyncCallback onUpgrade;

				private static AsyncCallback onFailedUpgrade;

				public SendPreambleAsyncResult(StreamedFramingRequestChannel channel, IConnection connection, ref TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper, ClientFramingDecoder decoder, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
					: base(callback, state)
				{
					this.channel = channel;
					this.connection = connection;
					this.timeoutHelper = timeoutHelper;
					this.decoder = decoder;
					IAsyncResult asyncResult = connection.BeginWrite(channel.Preamble, 0, channel.Preamble.Length, immediate: true, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime(), onWritePreamble, this);
					if (asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously && HandleWritePreamble(asyncResult))
					{
						Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: true);
					}
				}

				public static IConnection End(IAsyncResult result, out SecurityMessageProperty remoteSecurity)
				{
					SendPreambleAsyncResult sendPreambleAsyncResult = Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult.End<SendPreambleAsyncResult>(result);
					remoteSecurity = sendPreambleAsyncResult.remoteSecurity;
					return sendPreambleAsyncResult.connection;
				}

				private bool HandleWritePreamble(IAsyncResult result)
				{
					connection.EndWrite(result);
					if (channel.upgrade == null)
					{
						return ReadPreambleAck();
					}
					upgradeInitiator = channel.upgrade.CreateUpgradeInitiator(channel.RemoteAddress, channel.Via);
					if (onUpgrade == null)
					{
						onUpgrade = DiagnosticUtility.ThunkAsyncCallback(OnUpgrade);
					}
					IAsyncResult asyncResult = ConnectionUpgradeHelper.BeginInitiateUpgrade(channel.settings, channel.RemoteAddress, connection, decoder, upgradeInitiator, channel.messageEncoder.ContentType, timeoutHelper, onUpgrade, this);
					if (!asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
					{
						return false;
					}
					return HandleUpgrade(asyncResult);
				}

				private bool HandleUpgrade(IAsyncResult result)
				{
					connection = ConnectionUpgradeHelper.EndInitiateUpgrade(result);
					if (upgradeInitiator is StreamSecurityUpgradeInitiator)
					{
						remoteSecurity = ((StreamSecurityUpgradeInitiator)upgradeInitiator).GetRemoteSecurity();
					}
					upgradeInitiator = null;
					if (onWritePreambleEnd == null)
					{
						onWritePreambleEnd = DiagnosticUtility.ThunkAsyncCallback(OnWritePreambleEnd);
					}
					IAsyncResult asyncResult = connection.BeginWrite(ClientSingletonEncoder.PreambleEndBytes, 0, ClientSingletonEncoder.PreambleEndBytes.Length, immediate: true, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime(), onWritePreambleEnd, this);
					if (!asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
					{
						return false;
					}
					connection.EndWrite(asyncResult);
					return ReadPreambleAck();
				}

				private bool ReadPreambleAck()
				{
					AsyncReadResult asyncReadResult = connection.BeginRead(0, 1, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime(), onReadPreambleAck, this);
					if (asyncReadResult == AsyncReadResult.Queued)
					{
						return false;
					}
					return HandlePreambleAck();
				}

				private bool HandlePreambleAck()
				{
					int count = connection.EndRead();
					if (!ConnectionUpgradeHelper.ValidatePreambleResponse(connection.AsyncReadBuffer, count, decoder, channel.Via, connection))
					{
						if (onFailedUpgrade == null)
						{
							onFailedUpgrade = DiagnosticUtility.ThunkAsyncCallback(OnFailedUpgrade);
						}
						IAsyncResult asyncResult = ConnectionUpgradeHelper.BeginDecodeFramingFault(decoder, connection, channel.Via, channel.messageEncoder.ContentType, ref timeoutHelper, onFailedUpgrade, this);
						if (!asyncResult.CompletedSynchronously)
						{
							return false;
						}
						ConnectionUpgradeHelper.EndDecodeFramingFault(asyncResult);
						return true;
					}
					return true;
				}

				private static void OnWritePreamble(IAsyncResult result)
				{
					if (result.CompletedSynchronously)
					{
						return;
					}
					SendPreambleAsyncResult sendPreambleAsyncResult = (SendPreambleAsyncResult)result.AsyncState;
					Exception e = null;
					bool flag;
					try
					{
						flag = sendPreambleAsyncResult.HandleWritePreamble(result);
					}
					catch (Exception ex)
					{
						if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
						{
							throw;
						}
						flag = true;
						e = ex;
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						sendPreambleAsyncResult.Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: false, e);
					}
				}

				private static void OnWritePreambleEnd(IAsyncResult result)
				{
					if (result.CompletedSynchronously)
					{
						return;
					}
					SendPreambleAsyncResult sendPreambleAsyncResult = (SendPreambleAsyncResult)result.AsyncState;
					Exception e = null;
					bool flag;
					try
					{
						sendPreambleAsyncResult.connection.EndWrite(result);
						flag = sendPreambleAsyncResult.ReadPreambleAck();
					}
					catch (Exception ex)
					{
						if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
						{
							throw;
						}
						flag = true;
						e = ex;
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						sendPreambleAsyncResult.Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: false, e);
					}
				}

				private static void OnReadPreambleAck(object state)
				{
					SendPreambleAsyncResult sendPreambleAsyncResult = (SendPreambleAsyncResult)state;
					Exception e = null;
					bool flag;
					try
					{
						flag = sendPreambleAsyncResult.HandlePreambleAck();
					}
					catch (Exception ex)
					{
						if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
						{
							throw;
						}
						flag = true;
						e = ex;
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						sendPreambleAsyncResult.Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: false, e);
					}
				}

				private static void OnUpgrade(IAsyncResult result)
				{
					if (result.CompletedSynchronously)
					{
						return;
					}
					SendPreambleAsyncResult sendPreambleAsyncResult = (SendPreambleAsyncResult)result.AsyncState;
					Exception e = null;
					bool flag;
					try
					{
						flag = sendPreambleAsyncResult.HandleUpgrade(result);
					}
					catch (Exception ex)
					{
						if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
						{
							throw;
						}
						flag = true;
						e = ex;
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						sendPreambleAsyncResult.Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: false, e);
					}
				}

				private static void OnFailedUpgrade(IAsyncResult result)
				{
					if (result.CompletedSynchronously)
					{
						return;
					}
					SendPreambleAsyncResult sendPreambleAsyncResult = (SendPreambleAsyncResult)result.AsyncState;
					Exception e = null;
					try
					{
						ConnectionUpgradeHelper.EndDecodeFramingFault(result);
					}
					catch (Exception ex)
					{
						if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
						{
							throw;
						}
						e = ex;
					}
					sendPreambleAsyncResult.Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: false, e);
				}
			}

			private StreamedFramingRequestChannel channel;

			private ClientSingletonDecoder decoder;

			private SecurityMessageProperty remoteSecurity;

			public ClientSingletonDecoder Decoder => decoder;

			public SecurityMessageProperty RemoteSecurity => remoteSecurity;

			public StreamedConnectionPoolHelper(StreamedFramingRequestChannel channel)
				: base(channel.connectionPool, channel.connectionInitiator, channel.Via)
			{
				this.channel = channel;
			}

			protected override TimeoutException CreateNewConnectionTimeoutException(TimeSpan timeout, TimeoutException innerException, TrackingContext trackingContext)
			{

				return CreateNewTimeoutException(innerException, message, trackingContext);
			}

			{
				decoder = new ClientSingletonDecoder(0L);
				return channel.SendPreamble(connection, ref timeoutHelper, decoder, out remoteSecurity);
			}

			protected override IAsyncResult BeginAcceptPooledConnection(IConnection connection, ref TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{

		private class ClientSingletonConnectionReader : SingletonConnectionReader
		{
			private StreamedConnectionPoolHelper connectionPoolHelper;

			protected override long StreamPosition => connectionPoolHelper.Decoder.StreamPosition;

			public ClientSingletonConnectionReader(IConnection connection, StreamedConnectionPoolHelper connectionPoolHelper, IConnectionOrientedTransportFactorySettings settings)
				: base(connection, 0, 0, connectionPoolHelper.RemoteSecurity, settings, null)
			{
				this.connectionPoolHelper = connectionPoolHelper;
			}

			protected override bool DecodeBytes(byte[] buffer, ref int offset, ref int size, ref bool isAtEof)
			{
				while (size > 0)
				{
					int num = connectionPoolHelper.Decoder.Decode(buffer, offset, size);
					if (num > 0)
					{
						offset += num;
						size -= num;
					}
					switch (connectionPoolHelper.Decoder.CurrentState)
					{
					case ClientFramingDecoderState.EnvelopeStart:
						return true;
					case ClientFramingDecoderState.End:
						isAtEof = true;
						return false;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}

			protected override void OnClose(TimeSpan timeout)
			{
				connectionPoolHelper.Close(timeout);
			}
		}

			private bool HandleWriteMessage(IAsyncResult result)

		private IConnection SendPreamble(IConnection connection, ref TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper, ClientFramingDecoder decoder, out SecurityMessageProperty remoteSecurity)
		{
			connection.Write(Preamble, 0, Preamble.Length, immediate: true, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
			if (upgrade != null)
			{
				StreamUpgradeInitiator streamUpgradeInitiator = upgrade.CreateUpgradeInitiator(base.RemoteAddress, base.Via);
				if (!ConnectionUpgradeHelper.InitiateUpgrade(streamUpgradeInitiator, ref connection, decoder, this, ref timeoutHelper))
				{
					ConnectionUpgradeHelper.DecodeFramingFault(decoder, connection, base.Via, messageEncoder.ContentType, ref timeoutHelper);
				}
				if (streamUpgradeInitiator is StreamSecurityUpgradeInitiator)
				{
					remoteSecurity = ((StreamSecurityUpgradeInitiator)streamUpgradeInitiator).GetRemoteSecurity();
				}
				else
				{
					remoteSecurity = null;
				}
				connection.Write(ClientSingletonEncoder.PreambleEndBytes, 0, ClientSingletonEncoder.PreambleEndBytes.Length, immediate: true, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
			}
			else
			{
				remoteSecurity = null;
			}
			byte[] array = new byte[1];
			int count = connection.Read(array, 0, array.Length, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
			if (!ConnectionUpgradeHelper.ValidatePreambleResponse(array, count, decoder, base.Via, connection))
			{
				ConnectionUpgradeHelper.DecodeFramingFault(decoder, connection, base.Via, messageEncoder.ContentType, ref timeoutHelper);
			}
			return connection;
		}

		private abstract class SynchronizedAsyncResult<T> : Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult
		{
			private static readonly Action<object> onEnterComplete = OnEnterComplete;

			private T returnValue;

			private bool exitLock;

			private SynchronizedMessageSource syncSource;

			private TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper;

			protected IMessageSource Source => syncSource.source;

			public SynchronizedAsyncResult(SynchronizedMessageSource syncSource, TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(callback, state)
			{
				this.syncSource = syncSource;
				timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
				if (!syncSource.sourceLock.Enter(onEnterComplete, this))
				{
					return;
				}
				exitLock = true;
				bool flag = false;
				bool flag2;

					flag2 = PerformOperation(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
					flag = true;
				}
				finally

					if (!flag)
					{
						ExitLock();
					}
				}
				if (flag2)
				{
					CompleteWithUnlock(synchronous: true);
				}
			}

			protected void SetReturnValue(T returnValue)
			{
				this.returnValue = returnValue;
			}

			protected abstract bool PerformOperation(TimeSpan timeout);

			private void ExitLock()
			{
				if (exitLock)

					syncSource.sourceLock.Exit();
					exitLock = false;
				}
			}

			protected void CompleteWithUnlock(bool synchronous)

				CompleteWithUnlock(synchronous, null);
			}

			protected void CompleteWithUnlock(bool synchronous, Exception exception)

				Complete(synchronous, exception);
			}

			public static T End(IAsyncResult result)
			{

				return synchronizedAsyncResult.returnValue;
			}

			private static void OnEnterComplete(object state)
			{
				SynchronizedAsyncResult<T> synchronizedAsyncResult = (SynchronizedAsyncResult<T>)state;
				Exception ex = null;
				bool flag;
				try
				{
					synchronizedAsyncResult.exitLock = true;
					flag = synchronizedAsyncResult.PerformOperation(synchronizedAsyncResult.timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
				}
				catch (Exception ex2)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(ex2))
					{
						throw;
					}
					flag = true;
					ex = ex2;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					synchronizedAsyncResult.CompleteWithUnlock(synchronous: false, ex);

			}

	internal class ThreadNeutralSemaphore
	{
		private abstract class Waiter
		{
			public abstract void Signal();

			public abstract void Abort();
		}

		private class AsyncWaiter : Waiter
		{
			private Action<object> callback;

			private object state;

			public AsyncWaiter(Action<object> callback, object state)
			{
				this.callback = callback;
				this.state = state;
			}

			public override void Signal()
			{
				IOThreadScheduler.ScheduleCallbackNoFlow(callback, state);
			}

			public override void Abort()
			{
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new NotSupportedException(SR.GetString(Resources.ThreadNeutralSemaphoreAsyncAbort)), null, EventLevel.Warning, "Abort", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\ThreadNeutralSemaphore.cs", 332);
			}
		}

		private class SyncWaiter : Waiter
		{
			private ThreadNeutralSemaphore parent;

			private AutoResetEvent waitHandle;

			private bool aborted;

			public SyncWaiter(ThreadNeutralSemaphore parent)
			{
				waitHandle = new AutoResetEvent(initialState: false);
				this.parent = parent;
			}

			public void Wait()
			{
				waitHandle.WaitOne();
				waitHandle.Close();
				if (aborted)
				{
					throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(CreateObjectAbortedException(), null, EventLevel.Warning, "Wait", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\ThreadNeutralSemaphore.cs", 357);
				}
			}

			public bool Wait(TimeSpan timeout)
			{
				bool result = true;
				if (!TimeoutHelper.WaitOne(waitHandle, timeout))
				{
					if (!parent.RemoveWaiter(this))
					{
						waitHandle.WaitOne();
					}
					else
					{
						result = false;
					}
				}
				waitHandle.Close();
				if (aborted)
				{
					throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(CreateObjectAbortedException(), null, EventLevel.Warning, "Wait", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\ThreadNeutralSemaphore.cs", 380);
				}
				return result;
			}

			public override void Signal()
			{
				waitHandle.Set();
			}

			public override void Abort()
			{
				aborted = true;
				waitHandle.Set();
			}
		}

		private static readonly TimeSpan TraceDelay = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(3.0);

		private readonly object ThisLock = new object();

		private readonly bool traceOnFailureToEnter;

		private readonly string semaphoreName;

		private readonly int maxCount;

		private readonly IOThreadTimer delayTraceTimer;

		private int count;

		private int failureCount;

		private Queue<Waiter> waiters;

		private bool aborted;

		private bool delayTraceTimerStarted;

		public int Count
		{
			get
			{
				lock (ThisLock)
				{
					return count;
				}
			}
		}

		private Queue<Waiter> Waiters
		{
			get
			{
				if (waiters == null)
				{
					waiters = new Queue<Waiter>();
				}
				return waiters;
			}
		}

		public ThreadNeutralSemaphore(int maxCount)
			: this(maxCount, traceOnFailureToEnter: false, string.Empty)
		{
		}

		public ThreadNeutralSemaphore(int maxCount, bool traceOnFailureToEnter, string semaphoreName)
		{
			if (maxCount < 1)
			{
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("maxCount", maxCount, SR.GetString(Resources.ValueMustBePositive)), null, EventLevel.Warning, ".ctor", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\ThreadNeutralSemaphore.cs", 39);
			}
			this.maxCount = maxCount;
			this.traceOnFailureToEnter = traceOnFailureToEnter;
			this.semaphoreName = semaphoreName;
			delayTraceTimer = new IOThreadTimer(OnDelayTraceTimerCallback, null, isTypicallyCanceledShortlyAfterBeingSet: false);
		}

		public bool TryEnter()
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (count < maxCount)
				{
					count++;
					return true;
				}
				if (traceOnFailureToEnter)
				{
					IncrementFailureCount();
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public bool Enter(Action<object> callback, object state)
		{
			if (callback == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull("callback");
			}
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (count < maxCount)
				{
					count++;
					return true;
				}
				if (traceOnFailureToEnter)
				{
					IncrementFailureCount();
				}
				Waiters.Enqueue(new AsyncWaiter(callback, state));
				return false;
			}
		}

		public void Enter()
		{
			EnterCore()?.Wait();
		}

		public bool TryEnter(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			return EnterCore()?.Wait(timeout) ?? true;
		}

		public void Enter(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			if (!TryEnter(timeout))
			{
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(CreateEnterTimedOutException(timeout), null, EventLevel.Warning, "Enter", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\ThreadNeutralSemaphore.cs", 143);
			}
		}

		internal static TimeoutException CreateEnterTimedOutException(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			return new TimeoutException(SR.GetString(Resources.ThreadAcquisitionTimedOut, timeout));
		}

		private static CommunicationObjectAbortedException CreateObjectAbortedException()
		{
			return new CommunicationObjectAbortedException(SR.GetString(Resources.ThreadNeutralSemaphoreAborted));
		}

		private bool RemoveWaiter(Waiter waiter)
		{
			bool result = false;
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				for (int num = Waiters.Count; num > 0; num--)
				{
					Waiter waiter2 = Waiters.Dequeue();
					if (waiter2 == waiter)
					{
						result = true;
					}
					else
					{
						Waiters.Enqueue(waiter2);
					}
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		private SyncWaiter EnterCore()
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (aborted)
				{
					throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(CreateObjectAbortedException(), null, EventLevel.Warning, "EnterCore", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\ThreadNeutralSemaphore.cs", 189);
				}
				if (count < maxCount)
				{
					count++;
					return null;
				}
				if (traceOnFailureToEnter)
				{
					IncrementFailureCount();
				}
				SyncWaiter syncWaiter = new SyncWaiter(this);
				Waiters.Enqueue(syncWaiter);
				return syncWaiter;
			}
		}

		private void IncrementFailureCount()
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (!delayTraceTimerStarted)
				{
					delayTraceTimer.Set(TraceDelay);
					delayTraceTimerStarted = true;
				}
				failureCount++;
			}
		}

		private void OnDelayTraceTimerCallback(object o)
		{
			int num = 0;
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				num = failureCount;
				failureCount = 0;
				delayTraceTimerStarted = false;
			}
			if (num > 0)
			{
				MessagingClientEtwProvider.Provider.EventWriteThreadNeutralSemaphoreEnterFailed(semaphoreName, num, TraceDelay.TotalMilliseconds);
			}
		}

		public void Exit()
		{
			Waiter waiter;
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (count == 0)
				{
					string message = SR.GetString(Resources.InvalidLockOperation);
					throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new SynchronizationLockException(message), null, EventLevel.Warning, "Exit", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\ThreadNeutralSemaphore.cs", 261);
				}
				if (waiters == null || waiters.Count == 0)
				{
					count--;
					return;
				}
				waiter = waiters.Dequeue();
			}
			waiter.Signal();
		}

		public void Abort()
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (aborted)
				{
					return;
				}
				aborted = true;
				if (waiters != null)
				{
					while (waiters.Count > 0)
					{
						Waiter waiter = waiters.Dequeue();
						waiter.Abort();
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	internal class TimeoutStream : DelegatingStream
	{
		private TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper;

		public TimeoutStream(Stream stream, ref TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper)
			: base(stream)
		{
			if (!stream.CanTimeout)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.Argument("stream", SR.GetString(Resources.StreamDoesNotSupportTimeout));
			}
			this.timeoutHelper = timeoutHelper;
		}

		private void UpdateReadTimeout()
		{
			ReadTimeout = TimeoutHelper.ToMilliseconds(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
		}

		private void UpdateWriteTimeout()
		{
			WriteTimeout = TimeoutHelper.ToMilliseconds(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
		}

		public override IAsyncResult BeginRead(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{

			return base.BeginRead(buffer, offset, count, callback, state);
		}

		{
			UpdateWriteTimeout();
			return base.BeginWrite(buffer, offset, count, callback, state);
		}

		{
			UpdateReadTimeout();
			return base.Read(buffer, offset, count);
		}

		public override int ReadByte()
		{
			UpdateReadTimeout();
			return base.ReadByte();
		}

		public override void Write(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)
		{
			UpdateWriteTimeout();
			base.Write(buffer, offset, count);
		}

		{
			UpdateWriteTimeout();
			base.WriteByte(value);
		}

			return timeSpan;
		}

		public static TimeSpan FromSeconds(int seconds, string configValue)
		{
			TimeSpan timeSpan = TimeSpan.FromTicks(10000000L * (long)seconds);
			DiagnosticUtility.DebugAssert(timeSpan == TimeSpan.Parse(configValue, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), string.Empty);
			return timeSpan;
		}

		public static TimeSpan FromMilliseconds(int ms, string configValue)
		{
			TimeSpan timeSpan = TimeSpan.FromTicks(10000L * (long)ms);
			DiagnosticUtility.DebugAssert(timeSpan == TimeSpan.Parse(configValue, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), string.Empty);
			return timeSpan;
		}

		public static TimeSpan FromDays(int days, string configValue)

			return timeSpan;
		}

	internal static class TransferModeHelper
	{
		public static bool IsDefined(TransferMode v)
		{
			if (v != TransferMode.Buffered && v != TransferMode.Streamed && v != TransferMode.StreamedRequest)
			{
				return v == TransferMode.StreamedResponse;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool IsRequestStreamed(TransferMode v)
		{
			if (v != TransferMode.StreamedRequest)
			{
				return v == TransferMode.Streamed;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool IsResponseStreamed(TransferMode v)
		{
			if (v != TransferMode.StreamedResponse)
			{
				return v == TransferMode.Streamed;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static void Validate(TransferMode value)
		{
			if (!IsDefined(value))
			{
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new InvalidEnumArgumentException("value", (int)value, typeof(TransferMode)), null, EventLevel.Warning, "Validate", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\TransferModeHelper.cs", 32);
			}
		}

			this.hostNameComparisonMode = hostNameComparisonMode;
			manualAddressing = bindingElement.ManualAddressing;

			if (collection.Count > 1)

				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString(Resources.MultipleMebesInParameters)), null, EventLevel.Warning, ".ctor", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\TransportChannelListener.cs", 78);

			{
				messageEncoderFactory = defaultMessageEncoderFactory;
			}

			{

			{

			}
			ServiceSecurityAuditBehavior serviceSecurityAuditBehavior = context.BindingParameters.Find<ServiceSecurityAuditBehavior>();
			if (serviceSecurityAuditBehavior != null)
			{
				auditBehavior = (ServiceSecurityAuditBehavior)InvokeHelper.InvokeInstanceMethod(typeof(ServiceSecurityAuditBehavior), serviceSecurityAuditBehavior, "Clone");
			}
			else
			{
				auditBehavior = new ServiceSecurityAuditBehavior();
			}
			if (context.ListenUriMode == ListenUriMode.Unique && context.ListenUriBaseAddress == null)
			{
				context.ListenUriBaseAddress = new UriBuilder(Scheme, DnsCache.MachineName)
				{
					Path = GeneratedAddressPrefix
				}.Uri;
			}
			UriSchemeKeyedCollection.ValidateBaseAddress(context.ListenUriBaseAddress, "baseAddress");
			if (context.ListenUriBaseAddress.Scheme != Scheme && !context.ListenUriBaseAddress.Scheme.Equals("sbwss") && string.Compare(context.ListenUriBaseAddress.Scheme, Scheme, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) != 0)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.Argument("context.ListenUriBaseAddress", SR.GetString(Resources.InvalidUriScheme, context.ListenUriBaseAddress.Scheme, Scheme));
			}
			DiagnosticUtility.DebugAssert(context.ListenUriRelativeAddress != null, string.Empty);
			if (context.ListenUriMode == ListenUriMode.Explicit)

				SetUri(context.ListenUriBaseAddress, context.ListenUriRelativeAddress);

					text += "/";

				SetUri(context.ListenUriBaseAddress, text + Guid.NewGuid().ToString());
			}
			transportManagerContainer = new TransportManagerContainer(this);
		}

		internal bool IsScopeIdCompatible(HostNameComparisonMode hostNameComparisonMode, Uri uri)
		{
			if (this.hostNameComparisonMode != hostNameComparisonMode)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (hostNameComparisonMode == HostNameComparisonMode.Exact && uri.HostNameType == UriHostNameType.IPv6)
			{
				if (Uri.HostNameType != UriHostNameType.IPv6)
				{
					return false;
				}
				IPAddress iPAddress = IPAddress.Parse(Uri.DnsSafeHost);
				IPAddress iPAddress2 = IPAddress.Parse(uri.DnsSafeHost);
				if (iPAddress.ScopeId != iPAddress2.ScopeId)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool TryGetTransportManagerRegistration(out ITransportManagerRegistration registration)
		{
			if (!InheritBaseAddressSettings)
			{
				return TryGetTransportManagerRegistration(hostNameComparisonMode, out registration);
			}
			if (TryGetTransportManagerRegistration(HostNameComparisonMode.StrongWildcard, out registration))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (TryGetTransportManagerRegistration(HostNameComparisonMode.Exact, out registration))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (TryGetTransportManagerRegistration(HostNameComparisonMode.WeakWildcard, out registration))
			{
				return true;
			}
			registration = null;
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual bool TryGetTransportManagerRegistration(HostNameComparisonMode hostNameComparisonMode, out ITransportManagerRegistration registration)
		{
			return TransportManagerTable.TryLookupUri(Uri, hostNameComparisonMode, out registration);
		}

		internal virtual IList<TransportManager> SelectTransportManagers()
		{
			IList<TransportManager> list = null;
			if (!TryGetTransportManagerRegistration(out var registration))
			{
				ServiceBusEventSource.Log.WcfEventVerbose(TraceCode.NoExistingTransportManager, this, Uri.AbsoluteUri, "SelectTransportManagers", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\TransportChannelListener.cs", 518);
				if (HostedVirtualPath == null)
				{
					registration = CreateTransportManagerRegistration();
					TransportManagerTable.RegisterUri(registration.ListenUri, hostNameComparisonMode, registration);
				}
			}
			if (registration != null)
			{
				list = registration.Select(this);
				if (list == null)
				{
					ServiceBusEventSource.Log.WcfEventInformation(TraceCode.IncompatibleExistingTransportManager, this, Uri.AbsoluteUri, "SelectTransportManagers", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\TransportChannelListener.cs", 535);
					if (HostedVirtualPath == null)
					{
						Uri uri = Uri;
						if (uri != null)
						{
							registration = CreateTransportManagerRegistration(uri);
							TransportManagerTable.RegisterUri(uri, hostNameComparisonMode, registration);
							list = registration.Select(this);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (list == null)
			{
				ThrowTransportManagersNotFound();
			}
			return list;
		}

		private void ThrowTransportManagersNotFound()
		{
			if (HostedVirtualPath != null)
			{
				if (string.Compare(Uri.Scheme, Uri.UriSchemeHttp, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) == 0 || string.Compare(Uri.Scheme, Uri.UriSchemeHttps, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) == 0)
				{
					throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString(Resources.Hosting_NoHttpTransportManagerForUri, Uri)), null, EventLevel.Warning, "ThrowTransportManagersNotFound", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\TransportChannelListener.cs", 573);
				}
				if (string.Compare(Uri.Scheme, Uri.UriSchemeNetTcp, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) == 0 || string.Compare(Uri.Scheme, Uri.UriSchemeNetPipe, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) == 0)
				{
					throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString(Resources.Hosting_NoTcpPipeTransportManagerForUri, Uri)), null, EventLevel.Warning, "ThrowTransportManagersNotFound", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\TransportChannelListener.cs", 581);
				}
			}
			throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString(Resources.NoCompatibleTransportManagerForUri, Uri)), null, EventLevel.Warning, "ThrowTransportManagersNotFound", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\TransportChannelListener.cs", 587);
		}

		protected void SetUri(Uri baseAddress, string relativeAddress)
		{
			Uri uri = baseAddress;
			if (relativeAddress != string.Empty)
			{
				if (!baseAddress.AbsolutePath.EndsWith("/", StringComparison.Ordinal))
				{
					UriBuilder uriBuilder = new UriBuilder(baseAddress);
					FixIpv6Hostname(uriBuilder, baseAddress);
					uriBuilder.Path += "/";
					baseAddress = uriBuilder.Uri;
				}
				uri = new Uri(baseAddress, relativeAddress);
				if (!baseAddress.IsBaseOf(uri))
				{
					baseAddress = uri;
				}
			}
			if (baseAddress.Scheme.Equals("sbwss"))
			{
				UriBuilder uriBuilder2 = new UriBuilder(baseAddress)
				{
					Scheme = "sb",
					Port = RelayEnvironment.RelayHttpsPort
				};
				baseUri = uriBuilder2.Uri;
				uriBuilder2 = new UriBuilder(uri)
				{
					Scheme = "sb",
					Port = RelayEnvironment.RelayHttpsPort
				};
				ValidateUri(uriBuilder2.Uri);
				this.uri = uriBuilder2.Uri;
			}
			else
			{
				baseUri = baseAddress;
				ValidateUri(uri);
				this.uri = uri;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void ValidateUri(Uri uri)
		{
		}

		internal void SetMessageReceivedCallback(MessageReceivedCallback messageReceivedCallback)
		{
			this.messageReceivedCallback = messageReceivedCallback;
		}

		internal void RaiseMessageReceived()
		{
			if (messageReceivedCallback != null)
			{
				messageReceivedCallback();
			}
		}

		internal static void FixIpv6Hostname(UriBuilder uriBuilder, Uri originalUri)
		{
			if (originalUri.HostNameType == UriHostNameType.IPv6)
			{
				string dnsSafeHost = originalUri.DnsSafeHost;
				uriBuilder.Host = "[" + dnsSafeHost + "]";
			}
		}
