	internal abstract class TransportManager
	{
		private ServiceModelActivity activity;

		private int openCount;

		private object thisLock = new object();

		protected ServiceModelActivity Activity => activity;

		internal abstract string Scheme { get; }

		internal object ThisLock => thisLock;

		internal void Close(TimeSpan timeout, TransportChannelListener channelListener)
		{
			TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
			using (ServiceModelActivity.BoundOperation(Activity))
			{
				Unregister(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime(), channelListener);
			}
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (openCount <= 0)
				{
					throw Fx.AssertAndThrow("Invalid Open/Close state machine.");
				}
				openCount--;
				if (openCount == 0)
				{
					using (ServiceModelActivity.BoundOperation(Activity, addTransfer: true))
					{
						OnClose(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
					}
					if (Activity != null)
					{
						Activity.Dispose();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal static void EnsureRegistered<TChannelListener>(UriPrefixTable<TChannelListener> addressTable, TChannelListener channelListener) where TChannelListener : TransportChannelListener
		{
			if (!addressTable.TryLookupUri(channelListener.Uri, channelListener.HostNameComparisonModeInternal, out var item) || item != channelListener)
			{
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString(Resources.ListenerFactoryNotRegistered, channelListener.Uri)), null, EventLevel.Warning, "EnsureRegistered", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\TransportManager.cs", 72);
			}
		}

		protected void Fault<TChannelListener>(UriPrefixTable<TChannelListener> addressTable, Exception exception) where TChannelListener : ChannelListenerBase, ICommunicationObjectInternals
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<BaseUriWithWildcard, TChannelListener> item in addressTable.GetAll())
			{
				TChannelListener value = item.Value;
				value.Fault(exception);
				value.Abort();
			}
		}

		internal abstract void OnClose(TimeSpan timeout);

		internal abstract void OnOpen(TimeSpan timeout);

		internal void Open(TimeSpan timeout, TransportChannelListener channelListener)
		{
			TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
			if (DiagnosticUtility.ShouldUseActivity)
			{
				if (activity == null)
				{
					activity = ServiceModelActivity.CreateActivity(autoStop: true);
				}
				channelListener.ServiceModelActivity = Activity;
			}
			using (ServiceModelActivity.BoundOperation(Activity))
			{
				ServiceBusEventSource.Log.WcfEventInformation(TraceCode.TransportListen, this, SR.GetString(Resources.TraceCodeTransportListen, channelListener.Uri.AbsoluteUri), "Open", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\TransportManager.cs", 112);
				Register(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime(), channelListener);
				try
				{
					lock (ThisLock)
					{
						if (openCount == 0)
						{
							OnOpen(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
						}
						openCount++;
					}
				}
				catch
				{
					Unregister(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime(), channelListener);
					throw;
				}
			}
		}

		internal abstract void Register(TimeSpan timeout, TransportChannelListener channelListener);

		internal abstract void Unregister(TimeSpan timeout, TransportChannelListener channelListener);
	}
	internal delegate IList<TransportManager> SelectTransportManagersCallback();
	internal class TransportManagerContainer
	{
		private abstract class OpenOrCloseAsyncResult : Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult
		{
			private TransportManagerContainer parent;

			private static readonly Action<object> scheduledCallback = OnScheduled;

			protected OpenOrCloseAsyncResult(TransportManagerContainer parent, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(callback, state)
			{
				this.parent = parent;
			}

			protected void Begin()
			{
				IOThreadScheduler.ScheduleCallbackNoFlow(scheduledCallback, this);
			}

			private static void OnScheduled(object state)
			{
				((OpenOrCloseAsyncResult)state).OnScheduled();
			}

			private void OnScheduled()
			{
				using (ServiceModelActivity.BoundOperation(null))
				{
					Exception e = null;
					try
					{
						OnScheduled(parent);
					}
					catch (Exception ex)
					{
						if (Fx.IsFatal(ex))
						{
							throw;
						}
						e = ex;
					}
					Complete(didCompleteSynchronously: false, e);
				}
			}

			protected abstract void OnScheduled(TransportManagerContainer parent);
		}

		private sealed class CloseAsyncResult : OpenOrCloseAsyncResult
		{
			private TimeSpan timeout;

			public CloseAsyncResult(TimeSpan timeout, TransportManagerContainer parent, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(parent, callback, state)
			{
				this.timeout = timeout;
				Begin();
			}

			public static void End(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult.End<CloseAsyncResult>(result);
			}

			protected override void OnScheduled(TransportManagerContainer parent)
			{
				parent.Close(timeout);
			}
		}

		private sealed class OpenAsyncResult : OpenOrCloseAsyncResult
		{
			private SelectTransportManagersCallback selectTransportManagerCallback;

			private TimeSpan timeout;

			public OpenAsyncResult(TimeSpan timeout, SelectTransportManagersCallback selectTransportManagerCallback, TransportManagerContainer parent, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
				: base(parent, callback, state)
			{
				this.timeout = timeout;
				this.selectTransportManagerCallback = selectTransportManagerCallback;
				Begin();
			}

			public static void End(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				Microsoft.ServiceBus.Common.AsyncResult.End<OpenAsyncResult>(result);
			}

			protected override void OnScheduled(TransportManagerContainer parent)
			{
				parent.Open(timeout, selectTransportManagerCallback);
			}
		}

		private IList<TransportManager> transportManagers;

		private TransportChannelListener listener;

		private bool closed;

		public TransportManagerContainer(TransportChannelListener listener)
		{
			this.listener = listener;
			transportManagers = new List<TransportManager>();
		}

		private TransportManagerContainer(TransportManagerContainer source)
		{
			listener = source.listener;
			transportManagers = new List<TransportManager>();
			for (int i = 0; i < source.transportManagers.Count; i++)
			{
				transportManagers.Add(source.transportManagers[i]);
			}
		}

		public static TransportManagerContainer TransferTransportManagers(TransportManagerContainer source)
		{
			TransportManagerContainer result = null;
			lock (source.listener.TransportManagerTable)
			{
				if (source.transportManagers.Count > 0)
				{
					result = new TransportManagerContainer(source);
					source.transportManagers.Clear();
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginOpen(TimeSpan timeout, SelectTransportManagersCallback selectTransportManagerCallback, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new OpenAsyncResult(timeout, selectTransportManagerCallback, this, callback, state);
		}

		public void EndOpen(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			OpenAsyncResult.End(result);
		}

		public void Open(TimeSpan timeout, SelectTransportManagersCallback selectTransportManagerCallback)
		{
			TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
			lock (listener.TransportManagerTable)
			{
				if (closed)
				{
					return;
				}
				IList<TransportManager> list = selectTransportManagerCallback();
				if (list != null)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
					{
						TransportManager transportManager = list[i];
						transportManager.Open(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime(), listener);
						transportManagers.Add(transportManager);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public IAsyncResult BeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new CloseAsyncResult(timeout, this, callback, state);
		}

		public void EndClose(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			CloseAsyncResult.End(result);
		}

		public void Close(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
			if (closed)
			{
				return;
			}
			lock (listener.TransportManagerTable)
			{
				if (closed)
				{
					return;
				}
				closed = true;
				foreach (TransportManager transportManager in transportManagers)
				{
					transportManager.Close(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime(), listener);
				}
				transportManagers.Clear();
			}
		}
	}
	internal abstract class TransportOutputChannel : OutputChannel
	{
		private bool anyHeadersToAdd;

		private bool manualAddressing;

		private MessageVersion messageVersion;

		private Uri toUri;

		protected bool ManualAddressing => manualAddressing;

		public MessageVersion MessageVersion => messageVersion;

		protected TransportOutputChannel(ChannelManagerBase channelManager, EndpointAddress to, Uri via, bool manualAddressing, MessageVersion messageVersion, string traceRole)
			: base(channelManager, to, via, traceRole)
		{
			this.manualAddressing = manualAddressing;
			this.messageVersion = messageVersion;
			if (!manualAddressing && to != null)
			{
				if (to.IsAnonymous)
				{
					toUri = (Uri)InvokeHelper.InvokeInstanceGet(typeof(AddressingVersion), this.messageVersion.Addressing, "AnonymousUri");
				}
				else if (to.IsNone)
				{
					toUri = (Uri)InvokeHelper.InvokeInstanceGet(typeof(AddressingVersion), this.messageVersion.Addressing, "NoneUri");
				}
				else
				{
					toUri = to.Uri;
				}
				anyHeadersToAdd = to.Headers.Count > 0;
			}
		}

		protected override void AddHeadersTo(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Message message)
		{
			base.AddHeadersTo(message);
			if (toUri != null)
			{
				message.Headers.To = toUri;
				if (anyHeadersToAdd)
				{
					base.RemoteAddress.Headers.AddHeadersTo(message);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal class TransportReplyChannelAcceptor : ReplyChannelAcceptor
	{
		protected class TransportReplyChannel : ReplyChannel
		{
			private TransportManagerContainer transportManagerContainer;

			public TransportReplyChannel(ChannelManagerBase channelManager, EndpointAddress localAddress)
				: base(channelManager, localAddress)
			{
			}

			public bool TransferTransportManagers(TransportManagerContainer transportManagerContainer)
			{
				lock (base.ThisLock)
				{
					if (base.State != CommunicationState.Opened)
					{
						return false;
					}
					this.transportManagerContainer = transportManagerContainer;
					return true;
				}
			}

			protected override void OnAbort()
			{
				if (transportManagerContainer != null)
				{
					transportManagerContainer.Close(DefaultCloseTimeout);
				}
				base.OnAbort();
			}

			protected override void OnClose(TimeSpan timeout)
			{
				TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
				if (transportManagerContainer != null)
				{
					transportManagerContainer.Close(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
				}
				base.OnClose(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
			}

			private IAsyncResult DummyBeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{
				return new CompletedAsyncResult(callback, state);
			}

			private void DummyEndClose(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				CompletedAsyncResult.End(result);
			}

			protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
			{
				ChainedBeginHandler begin = DummyBeginClose;
				ChainedEndHandler end = DummyEndClose;
				if (transportManagerContainer != null)
				{
					begin = transportManagerContainer.BeginClose;
					end = transportManagerContainer.EndClose;
				}
				return new ChainedAsyncResult(timeout, callback, state, begin, end, base.OnBeginClose, base.OnEndClose);
			}

			protected override void OnEndClose(IAsyncResult result)
			{
				ChainedAsyncResult.End(result);
			}
		}

		private TransportManagerContainer transportManagerContainer;

		private TransportChannelListener listener;

		public TransportReplyChannelAcceptor(TransportChannelListener listener)
			: base(listener, () => listener.GetPendingException())
		{
			this.listener = listener;
		}

		protected override ReplyChannel OnCreateChannel()
		{
			return new TransportReplyChannel(base.ChannelManager, null);
		}

		protected override void OnOpening()
		{
			base.OnOpening();
			transportManagerContainer = listener.GetTransportManagers();
			listener = null;
		}

		protected override void OnAbort()
		{
			base.OnAbort();
			if (transportManagerContainer != null && !TransferTransportManagers())
			{
				transportManagerContainer.Close(DefaultCloseTimeout);
			}
		}

		private IAsyncResult DummyBeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			return new CompletedAsyncResult(callback, state);
		}

		private void DummyEndClose(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			CompletedAsyncResult.End(result);
		}

		protected override IAsyncResult OnBeginClose(TimeSpan timeout, AsyncCallback callback, object state)
		{
			ChainedBeginHandler begin = DummyBeginClose;
			ChainedEndHandler end = DummyEndClose;
			if (transportManagerContainer != null && !TransferTransportManagers())
			{
				begin = transportManagerContainer.BeginClose;
				end = transportManagerContainer.EndClose;
			}
			return new ChainedAsyncResult(timeout, callback, state, base.OnBeginClose, base.OnEndClose, begin, end);
		}

		protected override void OnEndClose(IAsyncResult result)
		{
			ChainedAsyncResult.End(result);
		}

		protected override void OnClose(TimeSpan timeout)
		{
			TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
			base.OnClose(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
			if (transportManagerContainer != null && !TransferTransportManagers())
			{
				transportManagerContainer.Close(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
			}
		}

		private bool TransferTransportManagers()
		{
			return ((TransportReplyChannel)GetCurrentChannel())?.TransferTransportManagers(transportManagerContainer) ?? false;
		}
	}

		public UriGenerator(string scheme, string delimiter)
		{
			if (scheme == null)
			{
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new ArgumentNullException("scheme"), null, EventLevel.Warning, ".ctor", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\UriGenerator.cs", 27);
			}
			if (scheme.Length == 0)
			{
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new ArgumentException(SR.GetString(Resources.UriGeneratorSchemeMustNotBeEmpty), "scheme"), null, EventLevel.Warning, ".ctor", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\UriGenerator.cs", 30);

			prefix = scheme + ":" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString() + delimiter + "id=";

		public string Next()
		{

			return prefix + num.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
		}

	internal sealed class UriPrefixTable<TItem> where TItem : class
	{
		private static class UriSegmenter
		{
			private struct UriSegmentEnum
			{
				private enum UriSegmentType
				{
					Unknown,
					Scheme,
					Host,
					Port,
					Path,
					None
				}

				private string segment;

				private int segmentStartAt;

				private int segmentLength;

				private UriSegmentType type;

				private Uri uri;

				internal UriSegmentEnum(Uri uri)
				{
					this.uri = uri;
					type = UriSegmentType.Unknown;
					segment = null;
					segmentStartAt = 0;
					segmentLength = 0;
				}

				private void ClearSegment()
				{
					type = UriSegmentType.None;
					segment = string.Empty;
					segmentStartAt = 0;
					segmentLength = 0;
				}

				public string[] GetSegments(HostNameComparisonMode hostNameComparisonMode, bool includePortInComparison)
				{
					List<string> list = new List<string>();
					while (Next())
					{
						switch (type)
						{
						case UriSegmentType.Path:
							list.Add(segment.Substring(segmentStartAt, segmentLength));
							break;
						case UriSegmentType.Host:
							switch (hostNameComparisonMode)
							{
							case HostNameComparisonMode.StrongWildcard:
								list.Add("+");
								break;
							case HostNameComparisonMode.Exact:
								list.Add(segment);
								break;
							default:
								list.Add("*");
								break;
							}
							break;
						case UriSegmentType.Port:
							if (includePortInComparison || hostNameComparisonMode == HostNameComparisonMode.Exact)
							{
								list.Add(segment);
							}
							break;
						default:
							list.Add(segment);
							break;
						}
					}
					return list.ToArray();
				}

				public bool Next()
				{
					switch (type)
					{
					case UriSegmentType.Unknown:
						type = UriSegmentType.Scheme;
						SetSegment(uri.Scheme);
						return true;
					case UriSegmentType.Scheme:
					{
						type = UriSegmentType.Host;
						string text = uri.Host;
						string userInfo = uri.UserInfo;
						if (userInfo != null && userInfo.Length > 0)
						{
							text = userInfo + "@" + text;
						}
						SetSegment(text);
						return true;
					}
					case UriSegmentType.Host:
						type = UriSegmentType.Port;
						SetSegment(uri.Port.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
						return true;
					case UriSegmentType.Port:
					{
						type = UriSegmentType.Path;
						string absolutePath = uri.AbsolutePath;
						if (absolutePath.Length == 0)
						{
							ClearSegment();
							return false;
						}
						segment = absolutePath;
						segmentStartAt = 0;
						segmentLength = 0;
						return NextPathSegment();
					}
					case UriSegmentType.Path:
						return NextPathSegment();
					case UriSegmentType.None:
						return false;
					default:
						return false;
					}
				}

				public bool NextPathSegment()
				{
					segmentStartAt += segmentLength;
					while (segmentStartAt < segment.Length && segment[segmentStartAt] == '/')
					{
						segmentStartAt++;
					}
					if (segmentStartAt < segment.Length)
					{
						int num = segment.IndexOf('/', segmentStartAt);
						if (-1 == num)
						{
							segmentLength = segment.Length - segmentStartAt;
						}
						else
						{
							segmentLength = num - segmentStartAt;
						}
						return true;
					}
					ClearSegment();
					return false;
				}

				private void SetSegment(string segment)
				{
					this.segment = segment;
					segmentStartAt = 0;
					segmentLength = segment.Length;
				}
			}

			internal static string[] ToPath(Uri uriPath, HostNameComparisonMode hostNameComparisonMode, bool includePortInComparison)
			{
				if (null == uriPath)
				{
					return new string[0];
				}
				return new UriSegmentEnum(uriPath).GetSegments(hostNameComparisonMode, includePortInComparison);
			}
		}

		private int count;

		private const int HopperSize = 128;

		private HopperCache lookupCache;

		private SegmentHierarchyNode<TItem> root;

		private bool useWeakReferences;

		private bool includePortInComparison;

		private object ThisLock => this;

		public int Count => count;

		public UriPrefixTable()
			: this(includePortInComparison: false)
		{
		}

		public UriPrefixTable(bool includePortInComparison)
			: this(includePortInComparison, useWeakReferences: false)
		{
		}

		public UriPrefixTable(bool includePortInComparison, bool useWeakReferences)
		{
			this.includePortInComparison = includePortInComparison;
			this.useWeakReferences = useWeakReferences;
			root = new SegmentHierarchyNode<TItem>(null, useWeakReferences);
			lookupCache = new HopperCache(128, useWeakReferences);
		}

		internal UriPrefixTable(UriPrefixTable<TItem> objectToClone)
			: this(objectToClone.includePortInComparison, objectToClone.useWeakReferences)
		{
			if (objectToClone.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<BaseUriWithWildcard, TItem> item in objectToClone.GetAll())
			{
				RegisterUri(item.Key.BaseAddress, item.Key.HostNameComparisonMode, item.Value);
			}
		}

		public bool IsRegistered(BaseUriWithWildcard key)
		{
			Uri baseAddress = key.BaseAddress;
			string[] path = UriSegmenter.ToPath(baseAddress, key.HostNameComparisonMode, includePortInComparison);
			SegmentHierarchyNode<TItem> segmentHierarchyNode;
			bool exactMatch;
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				segmentHierarchyNode = FindDataNode(path, out exactMatch);
			}
			if (exactMatch && segmentHierarchyNode != null)
			{
				return segmentHierarchyNode.Data != null;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<BaseUriWithWildcard, TItem>> GetAll()
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				List<KeyValuePair<BaseUriWithWildcard, TItem>> result = new List<KeyValuePair<BaseUriWithWildcard, TItem>>();
				root.Collect(result);
				return result;
			}
		}

		private bool TryCacheLookup(BaseUriWithWildcard key, out TItem item)
		{
			object value = lookupCache.GetValue(ThisLock, key);
			item = ((value == DBNull.Value) ? null : ((TItem)value));
			return value != null;
		}

		private void AddToCache(BaseUriWithWildcard key, TItem item)
		{
			lookupCache.Add(key, ((object)item) ?? ((object)DBNull.Value));
		}

		private void ClearCache()
		{
			lookupCache = new HopperCache(128, useWeakReferences);
		}

		public bool TryLookupUri(Uri uri, HostNameComparisonMode hostNameComparisonMode, out TItem item)
		{
			BaseUriWithWildcard baseUriWithWildcard = new BaseUriWithWildcard(uri, hostNameComparisonMode);
			if (TryCacheLookup(baseUriWithWildcard, out item))
			{
				return item != null;
			}
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				bool exactMatch;
				SegmentHierarchyNode<TItem> segmentHierarchyNode = FindDataNode(UriSegmenter.ToPath(baseUriWithWildcard.BaseAddress, hostNameComparisonMode, includePortInComparison), out exactMatch);
				if (segmentHierarchyNode != null)
				{
					item = segmentHierarchyNode.Data;
				}
				AddToCache(baseUriWithWildcard, item);
				return item != null;
			}
		}

		public void RegisterUri(Uri uri, HostNameComparisonMode hostNameComparisonMode, TItem item)
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				ClearCache();
				BaseUriWithWildcard baseUriWithWildcard = new BaseUriWithWildcard(uri, hostNameComparisonMode);
				SegmentHierarchyNode<TItem> segmentHierarchyNode = FindOrCreateNode(baseUriWithWildcard);
				if (segmentHierarchyNode.Data != null)
				{
					throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(new InvalidOperationException(SR.GetString(Resources.DuplicateRegistration, uri)), null, EventLevel.Warning, "RegisterUri", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Channels\\UriPrefixTable.cs", 161);
				}
				segmentHierarchyNode.SetData(item, baseUriWithWildcard);
				count++;
			}
		}

		public void UnregisterUri(Uri uri, HostNameComparisonMode hostNameComparisonMode)
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				ClearCache();
				string[] array = UriSegmenter.ToPath(uri, hostNameComparisonMode, includePortInComparison);
				if (array.Length == 0)
				{
					root.RemoveData();
				}
				else
				{
					root.RemovePath(array, 0);
				}
				count--;
			}
		}

		private SegmentHierarchyNode<TItem> FindDataNode(string[] path, out bool exactMatch)
		{
			exactMatch = false;
			SegmentHierarchyNode<TItem> segmentHierarchyNode = root;
			SegmentHierarchyNode<TItem> result = null;
			SegmentHierarchyNode<TItem> value;
			for (int i = 0; i < path.Length && segmentHierarchyNode.TryGetChild(path[i], out value); i++)
			{
				if (value.Data != null)
				{
					result = value;
					exactMatch = i == path.Length - 1;
				}
				segmentHierarchyNode = value;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private SegmentHierarchyNode<TItem> FindOrCreateNode(BaseUriWithWildcard baseUri)
		{
			string[] array = UriSegmenter.ToPath(baseUri.BaseAddress, baseUri.HostNameComparisonMode, includePortInComparison);
			SegmentHierarchyNode<TItem> segmentHierarchyNode = root;
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				if (!segmentHierarchyNode.TryGetChild(array[i], out var value))
				{
					value = new SegmentHierarchyNode<TItem>(array[i], useWeakReferences);
					segmentHierarchyNode.SetChildNode(array[i], value);
				}
				segmentHierarchyNode = value;
			}
			return segmentHierarchyNode;
		}
	}
	internal class SegmentHierarchyNode<TData> where TData : class
	{
		private BaseUriWithWildcard path;

		private TData data;

		private string name;

		private Dictionary<string, SegmentHierarchyNode<TData>> children;

		private WeakReference weakData;

		private bool useWeakReferences;

		public TData Data
		{
			get
			{
				if (useWeakReferences)
				{
					if (weakData == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return weakData.Target as TData;
				}
				return data;
			}
		}

		public SegmentHierarchyNode(string name, bool useWeakReferences)
		{
			this.name = name;
			this.useWeakReferences = useWeakReferences;
			children = new Dictionary<string, SegmentHierarchyNode<TData>>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
		}

		public void SetData(TData data, BaseUriWithWildcard path)
		{
			this.path = path;
			if (useWeakReferences)
			{
				if (data == null)
				{
					weakData = null;
				}
				else
				{
					weakData = new WeakReference(data);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				this.data = data;
			}
		}

		public void SetChildNode(string name, SegmentHierarchyNode<TData> node)
		{
			children[name] = node;
		}

		public void Collect(List<KeyValuePair<BaseUriWithWildcard, TData>> result)
		{
			TData val = Data;
			if (val != null)
			{
				result.Add(new KeyValuePair<BaseUriWithWildcard, TData>(path, val));
			}
			foreach (SegmentHierarchyNode<TData> value in children.Values)
			{
				value.Collect(result);
			}
		}

		public bool TryGetChild(string segment, out SegmentHierarchyNode<TData> value)
		{
			return children.TryGetValue(segment, out value);
		}

		public void RemoveData()
		{
			SetData(null, null);
		}

		public bool RemovePath(string[] path, int seg)
		{
			if (seg == path.Length)
			{
				RemoveData();
				return children.Count == 0;
			}
			if (!TryGetChild(path[seg], out var value))
			{
				if (children.Count == 0)
				{
					return Data == null;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (value.RemovePath(path, seg + 1))
			{
				children.Remove(path[seg]);
				if (children.Count == 0)
				{
					return Data == null;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal class UriSchemeKeyedCollection
	{
		internal static void ValidateBaseAddress(Uri uri, string argumentName)
		{
			if (uri == null)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.ArgumentNull(argumentName);
			}
			if (!uri.IsAbsoluteUri)
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.Argument(argumentName, SR.GetString(Resources.BaseAddressMustBeAbsolute));
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(uri.UserInfo))
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.Argument(argumentName, SR.GetString(Resources.BaseAddressCannotHaveUserInfo));
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(uri.Query))
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.Argument(argumentName, SR.GetString(Resources.BaseAddressCannotHaveQuery));
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(uri.Fragment))
			{
				throw Fx.Exception.Argument(argumentName, SR.GetString(Resources.BaseAddressCannotHaveFragment));
			}
		}
	}

		public void Close(TimeSpan timeout)
		{

		public void Write(byte[] buffer, int offset, int size, bool immediate, TimeSpan timeout)

					size = Math.Min(num, 65536);
					writeConnection.Write(buffer, offset, size, immediate, timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
					num -= size;
					offset += size;
					timeout = timeoutHelper.RemainingTime();
				}
			}
			catch (ObjectDisposedException ex)

				Exception ex2 = ConvertObjectDisposedException(ex);

		private int ReadCore(byte[] buffer, int offset, int size, TimeSpan timeout, bool closing)
		{
			int num = 0;
			TimeoutHelper timeoutHelper = TimeoutHelper.CreateAndStart(timeout);
			try
			{
				while (true)

						{
							throw;

					}
					if (num == 0 && readConnectionQueue.Count > 0)
					{
						if (role == HybridConnectionRole.Initiator)

							readConnection.Close(timeoutHelper.RemainingTime());
						}
						readConnection = readConnectionQueue.Dequeue();
						if (role == HybridConnectionRole.Listener)
						{
							writeConnectionQueue.Enqueue(readConnection);
						}
						continue;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			catch (ObjectDisposedException ex2)
			{
				Exception ex3 = ConvertObjectDisposedException(ex2);
				if (ex3 == ex2)

					throw;
				}
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(ex3, null, "Relay", this, ExceptionEventType, "ReadCore", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\HybridConnection\\HybridConnection.cs", 606);
			}
			return num;
		}

		public AsyncReadResult BeginRead(int offset, int size, TimeSpan timeout, WaitCallback callback, object state)
		{
			ConnectionUtilities.ValidateBufferBounds(AsyncReadBufferSize, offset, size);

		}

		private void AsyncReadCompleted(object state)
		{
			int num = 0;
			try
			{
				num = readConnection.EndRead();
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				asyncReadException = exception;
			}
			asyncReadResultSize = num;
			if (asyncReadException == null && num == 0 && readConnectionQueue.Count > 0)
			{
				if (role == HybridConnectionRole.Initiator)
				{
					try
					{
						readConnection.Close(readTimeout.RemainingTime());
					}
					catch (CommunicationException)
					{
						readConnection.Abort();
					}
					catch (TimeoutException)
					{
						readConnection.Abort();
					}
				}
				readConnection = readConnectionQueue.Dequeue();
				if (role == HybridConnectionRole.Listener)
				{
					writeConnectionQueue.Enqueue(readConnection);
				}
				try
				{
					readConnection.BeginRead(readBufferOffset, readBufferSize, readTimeout.RemainingTime(), AsyncReadCompleted, null);
					return;
				}
				catch (Exception exception2)
				{
					if (Fx.IsFatal(exception2))
					{
						throw;
					}
					ServiceBusEventSource.Log.HandledException(exception2, null, EventLevel.Warning, "AsyncReadCompleted", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\HybridConnection\\HybridConnection.cs", 731);
					return;
				}
			}
			Buffer.BlockCopy(readConnection.AsyncReadBuffer, readBufferOffset, AsyncReadBuffer, readBufferOffset, asyncReadResultSize);
			FinishAsyncRead();
		}

		private void FinishAsyncRead()
		{
			WaitCallback waitCallback = asyncReadCallback;
			object state = asyncReadState;
			asyncReadState = null;
			asyncReadCallback = null;
			waitCallback(state);
		}

		public int EndRead()
		{
			if (asyncReadException != null)
			{
				AbortAsyncRead();
				throw ServiceBusEventSource.Log.ThrowingException(asyncReadException, null, "Relay", this, ExceptionEventType, "EndRead", "X:\\bt\\1082328\\repo\\src\\product\\Clients\\Microsoft.ServiceBus.Messaging\\Connectivity\\HybridConnection\\HybridConnection.cs", 757);
			}
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (!asyncReadPending)
				{
					throw Fx.AssertAndThrow("HybridConnection.EndRead called with no read pending.");
				}
				asyncReadPending = false;
			}
			return asyncReadResultSize;
		}

		public void EnqueueConnection(IConnection connection)
		{
			lock (ThisLock)
			{
				if (closeState == CloseState.Closed)
				{
					connection.Close(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1.0));
					return;
				}
				if (connection.AsyncReadBufferSize != asyncReadBufferSize)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(SRClient.InvalidBufferSize);
				}
				readConnectionQueue.Enqueue(connection);
				if (role == HybridConnectionRole.Initiator)
				{
					writeConnectionQueue.Enqueue(connection);
				}
				connectionState = HybridConnectionState.Direct;
				OnConnectionStateChanged();
			}
		}

		T IConnection.GetProperty<T>()
		{
			if (typeof(T) == typeof(IHybridConnectionStatus))
			{
				return (T)(object)this;
			}
			if (typeof(T) == typeof(TrackingContext))
			{
				return (T)(object)TrackingContext;
			}
			return default(T);
		}

		private void OnConnectionStateChanged()
		{
			if (this.ConnectionStateChanged == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				this.ConnectionStateChanged(this, new HybridConnectionStateChangedArgs(connectionState));
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (Fx.IsFatal(exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
namespace Microsoft.ServiceBus.Channels.Security
{
	internal class RetriableCertificateValidator : X509CertificateValidator
	{
		private struct _CERT_CONTEXT
		{
			internal int dwCertEncodingType;

			internal IntPtr pbCertEncoded;

			internal int cbCertEncoded;

			internal IntPtr pCertInfo;

			internal IntPtr hCertStore;
		}

		private const int MaxRetries = 3;

		private static readonly TimeSpan RetryInterval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5.0);

		private static RetriableCertificateValidator instance;

		private readonly X509RevocationMode revocationMode;

		internal static RetriableCertificateValidator Instance
		{
			get
			{
				if (instance == null)
				{
					instance = new RetriableCertificateValidator();
				}
				return instance;
			}
		}

		private RetriableCertificateValidator()
		{
			revocationMode = ConfigurationHelpers.GetCertificateRevocationMode();
		}

		public override void Validate(X509Certificate2 certificate)
		{
			if (certificate == null)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new ArgumentNullException("certificate"));
			}
			DateTime now = DateTime.Now;
			if (now > certificate.NotAfter || now < certificate.NotBefore)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new SecurityTokenValidationException(SRClient.X509InvalidUsageTime(certificate.SubjectName.Name)));
			}
			ValidateUnTrustedCertificate(certificate);
			PeerOrChainTrustValidate(certificate);
		}

		private void ValidateUnTrustedCertificate(X509Certificate2 certificate)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			X509Store x509Store = new X509Store(StoreName.Disallowed, StoreLocation.CurrentUser);
			try
			{
				x509Store.Open(OpenFlags.ReadOnly);
				X509Certificate2Collection x509Certificate2Collection = x509Store.Certificates.Find(X509FindType.FindByThumbprint, certificate.Thumbprint, validOnly: false);
				flag = x509Certificate2Collection.Count > 0;
			}
			finally
			{
				x509Store.Close();
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				throw FxTrace.Exception.AsError(new SecurityTokenValidationException(SRClient.X509InUnTrustedStore(certificate.SubjectName.Name)));
			}
		}

		private void PeerOrChainTrustValidate(X509Certificate2 certificate)
		{
			X509ChainPolicy x509ChainPolicy = new X509ChainPolicy
			{
				RevocationMode = revocationMode
			};
			X509Certificate2Collection store = GetStore(certificate.Handle);
			X509Certificate2Enumerator enumerator = store.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				X509Certificate2 current = enumerator.Current;
				x509ChainPolicy.ExtraStore.Add(current);
			}
			X509CertificateValidator x509CertificateValidator = X509CertificateValidator.CreatePeerOrChainTrustValidator(useMachineContext: true, x509ChainPolicy);
			int num = 0;
			while (true)
			{
				try
				{
					x509CertificateValidator.Validate(certificate);
					break;
				}
				catch (SecurityTokenValidationException)
				{
					if (num++ >= 3)
					{
						throw;
					}
					Thread.Sleep(RetryInterval);
				}
			}
		}

		private static X509Certificate2Collection GetStore(IntPtr certContext)
		{
			X509Certificate2Collection result = new X509Certificate2Collection();
			if (certContext == IntPtr.Zero || certContext == new IntPtr(-1))
			{
				return result;
			}
			_CERT_CONTEXT cERT_CONTEXT = (_CERT_CONTEXT)Marshal.PtrToStructure(certContext, typeof(_CERT_CONTEXT));
			if (cERT_CONTEXT.hCertStore != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				X509Store x509Store = null;
				try
				{
					x509Store = new X509Store(cERT_CONTEXT.hCertStore);
					result = x509Store.Certificates;
				}
				finally
				{
					x509Store?.Close();
				}
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	internal interface IServiceBusSecuritySettings
	{
		TokenProvider TokenProvider { get; set; }
	}
}
